Oip eng' eunekwok robiinik otes che yamegei ak kamunutyonooto konyil aeng', ak che kiga kiweech eng' kutusweegap lolotinwekwok. Oweekte chooto ak icheek; abeere ki ma nai piik che ki indoi.
Omut weeriit ne otupche agine, ong'eetyee oba kogeny ye mi chiichooto.
Ingorireenak Kamuktaindet Ne po Kamuktaet, eng' taitap chiichooto, si kobiit kotyakwok weeriit ne otupche nin linda, ak Benjamin. Ak ngo peteno lagokyuk ko kagobetyo.”
Ki ip anyun pichooto kagoochinoichooto, ak ki ip robiinik che yamegei ak kamanuutyonooto konyil aeng', ak king'eetyo kobooto Benjamin koba Misiri, ki it anyun olooto ak kitononso eng' taitap Joseph.
Ye kingo keer `Joseph Benjamin komi kobooto icheek, koleenji ne tononjin koonnyi, “Imutu pichoo kobwa ko, ak oeeng'ji ak ochop kiy tugul, amu ki amisyei tugul ak pichooto peet kween.”
Ki yai chiichooto ko uu ye ki kamwachi Joseph; ak ki imut anyun `chiichooto pichooto kobwa kootap Joseph.

Ak ki iyweis pichooto, amu ki kimut koba kootap Joseph. Ki ile, “Kagimutwech kebwa ko amu chepkondok che ki kiweekte eng' lolotinwekyok yu kiga kibwa tai, si kobiit konyoor ng'olyoot ne igikyinenech, ak kogerchech ko, yeityo koyaech keegu otwogik, kobooto sigirokyok.”
Kiriikta ye mi chiito ne tononjin kootap Joseph, ak kong'alaalji ineendet eng' ole neegitee kurgeet,
koleenji, “Ee kiptaiyandennyu, ki kichooruge iman eng' panda ne po tai, keal amitwogik,
ak ye ki ngeit anyun kootap toek, kityaach lolotinwekyok, ki mi chepkondogap chii tugul kutitap lolennyi. Ara kagiibu anyun chooto kogeny, ak
kagiibu kora robiinik alak che ki ale amitwogik. Ma kingen chiito ne ki inde silingisyekyok lolotinwekyok.”

Ki leenji, “Ingotep kaalyeet eng' okweek; amoiyweisye. Ki koonok Kamuktaindeng'wong', Kamuktaindet ne po kwandang'wong', konorwet ne myee ne ung'aat eng' lolotinwekwok, ki ataach silingisyekwok.” Ak ki imutyi Simion komong'.
Ki imut anyun `chiichooto pichooto koba kootap Joseph, ak konaga peek, ak kiuun pichooto keelyekwak, ak ki pae sigirokwak amitwogik che ki konorotiin.
Kichopchi `icheek Joseph kagoochinoik eng' sait ne itune, peet kween, amu ki kas keele tagoi koamisyei eng' olooto.
Ye kingo it Joseph kaa, koipchi `pichooto ineendet kagoochinoik che ki ibu, kobwa ko, ak ki ing'uruuk eng' tainnyi agoi ng'wony.
Ak kiteebe icheeget chametapkei, koleenji, “Chamegei kwandang'wong', poiyondonooto ne ki komwaiwo? Tos ta kosabei?”
Ki leenji, “Chamegei otwogindeng'ung' kwandanyo. Ta kosabei.” Ak ki ing'uruukyi.
Ak kitabendo Joseph, ak ki keer tupchennyi Benjamin, ng'eetap kamet, ak ki le, “Tupcheng'wong' ne ming'in ni, ni ki komwaiwo?” Ak ki leenji, “Ingorirenen Kamuktaindet, weeri!”
Ak kichirchiren Joseph, amu kieet emosto eng' muguleldanyi amu ng'eetap kamet, ak ki cheeng' ole wendi koriiree. Ki manda anyun koonnyi ne po oriit, kwo koriir.
Yeityo koun togeennyi ak komong', ak kimuita si ma riir, ak ki le, “Oibu amitwogik.”

Ki kinde chechiik oldanyi ineegei, ak ki kinde oldanywa chechwaak icheegei, ak che po Misiriik oldanywa icheegei, che ki cham koamisyei kobooto ineendet: amu ki ma kochamei Misiriik koamis tugul ak Yahudik, amu king'wan eng' Misiriik koamjin.
Ki tebee tainnyi weeriit ne po tai ko uu sigennyi, ak ne ming'in ko uu ming'inatennyi, ak ki kwong'yo pichooto.
Ki igoochi pichooto kererutigap amitwogik che ki mi tainnyi, ago kieet kererutyetap Benjamin kosiir che po alak konyil muut. Ak kieeiso ak koboiboitu kobooto ineendet.
Ki ng'at anyun chiito ne kitononjin koonnyi, koleenji, “Inyiit amitwogik lolotinwegap pichu, ko uu che imuuch koip, ak inde chepkondogap chii tugul kutitap lolennyi.
Yeityo inde kigombennyu, nooto po fedha, eng' kutitap loletap toweet, kobooto silingisyekyik che po peek.” Ak ki yai ko uu ng'olyoot ne ki kamwa Joseph.
Ye kingo eech kota ko karon, kounda pichooto koba ak sigirokwak.
Ye kingo kagomanda eng' nganaseet, ye kitom kolooegitu, koleenji `Joseph chiito ne kitononjin koonnyi, “Ng'eet, isup pichooto, ye inyooru ileenji, ‘Amu nee si ogeere yaityet ne myee?
Tos ma kigombani ne eeise kiptaiyandennyu, ak kong'orse? Koyai ne leluut ngo yai ko uu ni.’ ”
Ye kingo nyoor anyun icheek, komwachi ng'aleechooto.
Ki leenji icheek, “Amu nee si komwa kiptaiyandennyu ng'aleek che uu chooto? Ingolooit eng' otwogiguk si ma yai kiy ne uu nooto!
Ogeero, robiinik, che ki kinyoorchi kutusweegap lolotinwekyok, kogiweekwok kogeny eng' emetap Kanaan. Kimuktoi ano anyun kechoore kootap kiptaindeng'ung' fedha anan ko thahabu?
Ingome age tugul eng' acheek otwogiguk ne kenyoorchin kioto, ak keegu acheek otwogigap kiptaiyandennyo.”
Ak ki le, “Ingotebi ko uu ng'aleeguk. Egu ineendet ne kenyoorchin kioto otwogindennyu, ak ma ki ityinok okweek yaityo.”
Ki itu chii tugul lolennyi kochokyi, ak kotyach chii tugul nenyi.
Ak ki cheeng', kotaune ne oo, agoi kogesune ne ming'in. Ki kinyoorchi kigombanooto loletap Benjamin.
Kigereer anyun ngoroikwak, ak kiratyi chii tugul tuguukyik sigiryennyi ak koweektagei koba nganaseet.
Ki it anyun Judah ak tupchosyekyik kootap Joseph amu kitom kwo ui, ak ki ibutyi icheek ng'wony eng' tainnyi.
Ki leenji `Joseph icheek, “Nee ni koyai? Tos mongen ole imuuchi kong'orso chiito ne uu anee?”

Ak ki le Judah, “Tos kimwaun nee anyun, kiptaiyandennyu? Ki ng'alaali keleen nee? Anan tos ki ityindoitech ano imanda? Kagonai Kamuktaindet tengektap otwogiguk, ara kimi yu anyun acheeget, ki otwogigap kiptaiyandennyo, ak ineendet ne kaginyoorchi kigombet agine.”
Ago ki le, “Ingolooit eng' anee ama yai ko uu nooto! Egu otwogindennyu ineendet ne kaginyoorchi kigombet, ago okweek, ko myee obe eng' kaalyeet kapkwandang'wong'.”
Yeityo koriikyi anyun `Judah Joseph ak koleenji, “Kaigai kiptaiyandennyu, asoomin ale, chamwo anee otwogindeng'ung' amwaun ng'olyoo, amenereekyo anee, otwogindeng'ung', amu i uu aginye Pharaoh.
Ki iteebenech acheek otwogiguk, kiptaiyandennyu, ile, ‘Otinye kwandang'wong', ak komi weeriit age ne otupche?’

Ak ki kimwaun inyee, kiptaiyandennyo, keleenjin, ‘Ki tinyei abba, poiyot ne oos, ak kotinyei lakweet ne po osindanyi, neta koming'in. Ki kome ng'eetap kamet, ak mi nooto ineegei ne po kamennywa, ak kochamei `kwandanyi ineendet.’
Ak ki ileenjech acheek otwogiguk, ‘Omutwaa, kochoorgei ole ami, si kobiit ageer ineendet eng' konyekyuk.’
Ki kimwaun inyee, kiptaiyandennyo, keele, ‘Ma imuuchi koobeesyo weerooto ak kwandanyi, amu ngot kometo ineendet kwandanyi, ko tos me kwandanyi.’
Ak ki ileenjech acheek otwogiguk, ‘Ngot ko mobwa ochooruge kobooto weeriit ne otupche ne ming'in ko momuuchi ogeera togoch kogeny.’
Ye ki ngeit anyun kapotwogindeng'ung' kwandanyu, kemwachi ineendet ng'aleeguk.
Ak kileenjech abba, ‘Oba kogeny oalwech amitwogik tutigin,’
ki kileenji, ‘Ma kimuuchi kechoortegei, ago ngo mi tupchennyo ne ming'in kobootech kechoortegei anyun keebe, amu ma kimuuchi kegeer chiichooto togoch kobatee kemi ak tupchennyo ne ming'in.’
Ak kileenjech otwogindeng'ung', kwandanyo, ‘Ongen ole kisikwo kwondonyu weeriik aeng';
ak kibetena age, ak ki ale, Angen komyee ale kigetonaton, ak kobooch yooto, ko mata tuun ageer.
Ngot omutena niito agine, ak konyoor kiy ne ya, ko kogoono ariirat agoi tuun amei.’
Nooto anyun, ye ait kapotwogindeng'ung' abba, ama mi weeri kobootech, amu ki namgei saboondanyi ak saboondap weeriito,
komeei anyun abba ye keer kole ma mi lakweet, ak kigoochini `acheek otwogiguk abba, otwogindeng'ung', koriirat agoi tuun kome.
Amu kibunjo anee otwogindeng'ung' lakwaniito, atononjinechi abba, aleenji, ‘Ngot koma mutuun ineendet, ko kabunjo chalwogoto peetuusyek tugul eng' taitap abba.’
Eng' nooto anyun, asaain ale chamwo atebi aek otwogindeng'ung', inyee kiptaiyandennyu, ageeregei weeri. Ago ingwo weeri kotogosta kobooto tupchosyekyik.
Amu amuktoi ano anyun awo atogosta ye mi abba, ama kimi ak lakweet? Si ma keer yaityet ne tuun nyooru abba.”

Ki ma imuuch Joseph anyun komuita eng' taitap piik tugul che ki tonondos eng' ole neegitee ineendet. Ki ng'at ak komwa eng' tuugeet ne oo kole, “Omaande chii tugul eng' ole ami.” Ki ma ng'et chii ne ki mi ak Joseph, ye king'aang'jigei `ineendet tupchosyekyik.
Ago ki riir kowaach kot kogas Misiriik, ak ki kas kap Pharaoh ak icheek.
Ak ki leenji `Joseph tupchosyekyik, “Aa Joseph! Tos ta kosabei abba?” Ago ki ma imuuch kowolji tupchosyekyik, amu ki iyweis eng' tainnyi.
Ki leenji anyun `Joseph tupchosyekyik, “Kaigai oriigu yu ami.” Ak kiriikta anyun. Ak ki leenji, “Aa tupcheng'wong' Joseph, ne ki oalde kwo Misiri.
Nooto anyun, ama ta oaragense, anan onereekyigei okweegei eng' okweegei agobo aldaet ne ki oaldocho oli, amu ki iyookwo Kamuktaindet andounenok si kobiit asar piik.
Ki kobiit rubeet eng' emet eng' kenyisyechu aeng', ak ta komi kenyiisyek muutu alage, che ma piitu kabatisyet anan kesisyet.
Ak ki iyookwo Kamuktaindet andounenok, si kobiit ariibwok che ng'etu eng' ng'wony, ak asarwok osapche eng' saruunet ne oo.
Ara anyun, ki ma ko okweek che ki omutwaa anyo oli, ago Kamuktaindet ne ki koyaa aek kwanda eng' Pharaoh, ak aegu kiptaiyatap koonnyi tugul, ak pounindetap emet komugul ne po Misiri.
Ara anyun, ochakte otogoste ole mi abba, ak oleenji, ‘Kamwa ko uu ni weeriing'ung' Joseph, kiyaa Kamuktaindet aek kiptaiyatap Misiri komugul, chooruge nyoo ole ami, amegagei.
Ak inyoo imeny emetap Goshen, si ineegitena, inyee ak lagoguk kobooto mochogoroniguk, kechireguk, tuuga cheguuk ak tuguuk tugul che itinye.
Abain eng' olooto si mebanan, inyee ak koong'ung', ak tugul che itinye; amu ta komi kenyiisyek muutu che pwoonei che po rubeet.’
Ogeere nguno eng' konyekwok, ak kogeerei Benjamin tupchennyu agine, kole kutinnyu ne ng'alaalwok.
Omwachi abba teegistanyu tugul eng' Misiri, ak tuguuk tugul che kaogeer, ak ochakte omutu abba konyo oli.”
Yeityo kosuup kaatitap ng'eetap kamet Benjamin, ak koriir, ki riir Benjamin agine komi kaatitap Joseph.
Ak ki ng'utut tupchosyekyik tugul, koriirei. Ak ye ibata nooto kong'alaalji tupchosyekyik ineendet.
Ki kigas ng'aleechooto eng' kootap Pharaoh, keele, “Kagoit tupchosyegap Joseph,” ak ki ibaibai Pharaoh nooto, kobooto otwogikyik.
Ki leenji `Pharaoh Joseph, “Ileenji tupchosyeguk, ‘Oyai ni; oratyi sigirokwok tuguukwok, ak obe, agoi emetap Kanaan.
Omutu kwandang'wong' ak piigap kooriikwok, ak obwa ole ami, si agoonok tuguuk che myach che po emetap Misiri, ak oam akwaiyetap emet.’
Ara anyun, kaging'atak, ‘Oyai ko uu ni: oip kariisyek che po emetap Misiri amu lagokwok, ak kwonyiikwok, ak obwa, omutu kwandang'wong'.
Ago amobwaat tuguukwok, amu chekwok tuguuk tugul che myachen che po emetap Misiri.’ ”
Ki yai ko uu nooto weeriigap Israel. Ki igoochi `Joseph icheek kariisyek ko uu ng'atuutyetap Pharaoh, ak kogoochi amitwogik che amoti eng' ooreet.
Ki igoochi chii age tugul ngoroik che kiwalawale alak, ago ki igoochi Benjamin silingisyek pogol somok, ak ngoroik muut che walawali.
Ki iyookyi kwandanyi tuguuk ko uu ni: sigiroik taman che kilae tuguuk che myach che po Misiri, sigiroik che iyuogik taman che kilae peek ak magatiinik ak amitwogik alak che tuun amonu eng' ooreet.
Kimonorisyechi anyun Joseph tupchosyekyik ak ye ki inamei panda, koleenji, “Amonereekyinotegei eng' ooreet.”
Ki pa anyun kotogosta eng' Misiri agoi koit emetap Kanaan kap Jakobo kwandanywa.
Ak ki mwachi koleenji, “Ta kosabei Joseph! Ak ineendet ko pounindetap emet komugul ne po Misiri.” Ak ki tanui muguleldap Jakobo, amu ma iyan icheeget.
Ago ye ki ngemwachi ng'aleek tugul che po Joseph, che kiga komwachi Joseph weerchooto, ak ye kingo keer Jakobo kariisyek che ki iyook Joseph si kimutee ineendet, kosap muguleldap Jakobo kwandanywa.
Ak ki le Israel, “Yamei ko uu nooto! Ta kosabei weeriinnyu Joseph. Awendi anyun ageere ineendet kotom amei.”
Ki nam panda anyun Israel kobooto tugul che ki tinyei, ak ye kingo it Beer-sheba kogoochi tiseiywot Kamuktaindet ne po kwandanyi Isak.
Ki ng'alaalji `Kamuktaindet Israel eng' ng'ang'utik che po kemoi, koleenji, “Jakobo! Jakobo!” Ak ki le, “Ami yu.”
Koleenji Kamuktaindet, “Aa Kamuktaindet, Kamuktaindet ne po kwandang'ung'. Meiywei, ichoortegei iwe Misiri; amu ayain iegu pororyet ne oo eng' olooto.
Achoortoigei agane kobooten awendi Misiri, ak tuun amutun iman itogosu kogeny, ak kotwae Joseph eunnyi konyeguk.”
Ki ng'eet anyun Jakobo eng' Beer-sheba; ak ki imut `weeriigap Israel kwandanywa Jakobo, ak lagokwak ak kwonyiikwak eng' kariisyek che kiga koyook Pharaoh si kobiit kimute ineendet.
Ki kweri tuukwak, ak ki ip tuguukwak che kiga konyoor eng' emetap Kanaan. Ki it anyun Misiri `Jakobo kobooto lagokyik tugul;
weeriikyik, tiibiikyik kobooto mochogoronikyik che weeriik ak che tiibiik, ak ki imut lagokyik tugul koba Misiri.
Chu kainaigap piigap Israel, che ki it Misiri, Jakobo ak weeriikyik: Reuben, weeriit ne po tai ne po Jakobo,
ak weeriigap Reuben chu: Hanok, Palu, Hesron ak Karmi.
Weeriigap Simion chu: Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jakin, Sohar ak Shaul weeriitap Chepkanaanindet.
Weeriigap Lawi chu: Gerson, Kohat ak Merari.
Weeriigap Judah chu: Er, Onan, Shelah, Peres ak Zerah. (Ago ki pek Er ak Onan eng' emetap Kanaan). Ak weeriigap Peres ko ki Hesron ak Hamul.
Weeriigap Issakar chu: Tola, Pupa, Job ak Simron.
Weeriigap Zebulun chu: Zereth, Elon ak Jaleel.
Chuuto ko weeriigap Leah che ki sikyi Leah Jakobo eng' Padan-aram, kobooto cheptonyi Dina. Ki sosom ak somok weeriikyik kobooto tiibiikyik.
Weeriigap Gad chu: Sipion, Hagi, Suni, Esbon, Eri, Arodi ak Areli.
Weeriigap Asher chu: Jimna, Isba, Isbi, Beriah ak Zerah chepkametinnywa. Weeriigap Beriah chu: Heber ak Malkiel.
Chuuto ko weeriigap Silpa ne ki igoochi Laban Leah cheptonyi, ki sikyi Jakobo chooto - ki piik taman ak lo.
Chu weeriigap Rael kwondap Jakobo: Joseph ak Benjamin.
Ki kisikyi Joseph eng' emetap Misiri Manasseh ak Ephraim, che ki sikyi Asenat cheptap Potipera tisiindet ne po On.
Weeriigap Benjamin chu: Bela, Beker, Asbel, Gera, Naaman, Ei, Rosh, Hupim ak Ard.
Chuuto weeriigap Rael che ki sikyi ineendet Jakobo - ki piik taman ak ang'wan.
Weeriitap Dan ko Husim.
Weeriigap Naphtali chu: Jaseel, Guni, Jeser ak Silem.
Chuuto ko weeriigap Bila, ne ki igoochi Laban Rael cheptonyi, ki sikyi Jakobo chuuto - ki piik tisap tugul.
Piik tugul che ki it Misiri kobooto Jakobo, ko ki piik tamanwogik lo ak lo che ki mang'une poortap Jakobo, kobatee kwonyiigap weeriigap Jakobo.
Weeriigap Joseph, che ki kisikyi eng' Misiri, ko ki aeng'. Piik tugul che po kootap Jakobo che ki it Misiri, ko ki tamanwogik tisap.
Ki iyookto `Jakobo Judah kondoe ineendet kwo kap Joseph, koarorchi ooreet ne wendi Goshen, ak ki it anyun emonooto kiguure Goshen.
Ki chop anyun Joseph chepkichutinnyi, ak kwo kotorookta kwandanyi Israel agoi Goshen. Ki iboorchigei Joseph ak kotoroigei, ak koriir eng' kaatinnyi konyil ak konyil.
Ki `leenji Israel Joseph, “Kamee anyun, amu kaageer togeng'ung', kaagaa taisabe kora.”
Ki leenji Joseph tupchosyekyik, ak piigap kootap kwandanyi, “Katogoste anyun awe amwachi Pharaoh aleenji, ‘Kagobwanjo weeriik che ketupche, ak piigap kootap abba, che ki mi emetap Kanaan.
Pichooto ko kayogik, ak icheeget ko piigap tuuga; ak kaget keechiirekwak, tuukwak ak tuguukwak tugul che tinyei.’
Ye kuurok anyun Pharaoh, koteebenak kole, ‘Poisyeeng'wong' ko nee?’

Oleenji, ‘Acheek otwogiguk ko ki piigap tuuga kong'etee ko kimengech agoi kora, acheek, ak kwanisyekyok agicheek’ si kobiit omeny emet ne kiguure Goshen, amu chii age tugul ne iyagisyei ko ng'waan eng' Misiri.”
Ki wo anyun Joseph komwachi Pharaoh, koleenji, “Kagoit abba ak weeriik che kitupche, ak keechiirekwak, ak tuukwak, ak tuguukwak tugul che tinyei kobunu emetap Kanaan, miitei nguno emetap Goshen.”
Ki imut weeriik muut eng' weeriik che tupcho, ak kobarta eng' taitap Pharaoh.
ki teebee `Pharaoh weeriik che tupcho ak Joseph koleenji, “Nee poisyeng'wong'?” Ak ki wolji Pharaoh, koleenji, “Acheek otwogiguk ko ki riibiikap kiyagiik, ko uu ye ki uu kwanisyekyok.”

Ki leenji `icheek Pharaoh, “Kageuchi emoni ko ki toek, amu ma mi ole kiyage akwotisyegap otwogiguk; amu ng'waan rubeet eng' emetap Kanaan. Ara anyun, kaigai chamwech acheek otwogiguk kemeny emetap Goshen.”
Ak ki ng'alaalji `Pharaoh Joseph, koleenji, “Kagoit oldang'ung' kwandang'ung' ak weeriik che otupche,

mi taing'ung' emoniito po Misiri. Igoochi kwandang'ung' ak weeriik che otupche komeny emet ole karaaran miising' kosiir tugul, ingomeny anyun emetap Goshen. Ak ngot ingen piik eng' icheek che ng'oomen, igoochi koriip tuukyuk.”
Ki imut anyun `Joseph kwandanyi kwo taitap Pharaoh, ak ki iberuur `Jakobo Pharaoh.
ki teebee `Pharaoh Jakobo, koleenji, “Ata kenyisyeguk?”

Ak ki wolji `Jakobo Pharaoh, koleenji, “Kenyiisyekyuk che ki atar eng' rutoitanyu ko pogol ak sosom. Ng'ering' ak ko yaacheen kenyiisyekyuk che ki atar, ak ma iit kenyiisyekyuk che ki it kenyiisyegap kwanisyekyuk eng' rutoitonywa.”
Ki iberuur `Jakobo Pharaoh, yeityo kwo eng' ole ki mi ineendet.

Ki yai anyun Joseph komeng'iis kwandanyi ak weeriik che tupcho, ki igoochi icheek ole punjin eng' emetap Misiri, ole karaaran kosiir tugul eng' emonooto, eng' emetap Rameses, ko uu ye kiga ng'at Pharaoh.
Kibai `Joseph kwandanyi, tupchosyekyik ak piik tugul che po kootap kwandanyi, eng' amitwogik, ko uu ye ki tee lagokwak.
Ki ma kota komi amitwogik eng' emet komugul, amu king'wanit miising' rubeet, ak kinyalul emetap Misiri ak emetap Kanaan amu rubanooto.
Ki iyum Joseph robiinik tugul che ki piit eng' emetap Misiri ak emetap Kanaan che ki koip piik koale peek, ak ki ip fedhaisyechooto kobwa kootap Pharaoh.
Ye kingo keskei robiinik che po emetap Misiri, ak che po emetap Kanaan, kobwonji Misiriik tugul Joseph, ak koleenji, “Koonech amitwogik. Amu nee si kebegu eng' taing'ung'? Amu kogogeskei robiinik.”
Ak ki leenji Joseph, “Ogoonu tuukwok, si agoonok amitwogik che ogeere tuukwok, ngot ko kogogeskei robiinik.”
Kigetyi anyun `icheek Joseph tuukwak; ak ki igoochi Joseph amitwogik che ki ale paraisisyek, akwotisyek, tuuga ak sigiroik. Kibae kenyinooto amitwogik che ki ale tuukwak tugul.

Ye kingo keskei kenyinooto, kobwonji ineendet eng' kenyiit ne po aeng', ak koleenji, “Ma kimuuchi keung'e kiptaiyandennyo, keele kogogeskei silingisyekyok tugul, ak ki kobunji tuukyok kiptaiyandennyo. Ma komi kiy ne ng'etunot neta keipchini kiptaiyandennyo, kobatee poorwekyok kityo, ak koratinwekyok.

Amu nee anyun si kebegu eng' taing'ung', acheek ak emennyo? Alech acheek kobooto emennyo, si kenyooru amitwogik, ak kebunji acheek Pharaoh kobooto emennyo keegu otwogikyik. Koonech kesweek, si kesapchee, si ma kibegu, si ma kuber emet.”
Ki alji anyun `Joseph Pharaoh emet komugul ne po Misiri. Ki alda chii tugul eng' Misiriik mbareennyi, amu kieetyi rubeet icheek, ak ki punji anyun Pharaoh emet.
Ki yai anyun `ineendet piik koek otwogikyik kong'etee tabanda age agoi tabanda age ne po Misiri.
Kobatee emetap tisiik ne ma al ineendet, amu ki cham konyooru tisiik amitwogik chechwaak eng' Pharaoh, si koamei kebebertanywa ne ki igoochin Pharaoh. Ki ma alda anyun emennywa amu nooto.
Ki leenji `Joseph piik anyun, “Ogeero, kaalak rani, okweek ak emeng'wong' obunji Pharaoh. Irochu kesweek, si ogoole mbareenik.
Si ye ogesisye ogoochi Pharaoh kebeberta ne po muut. Ak kobunjook kebeberwek ang'wanu: si koek kesweegap mbareenik ak koek amitwogikwok, che po piigap kooriikwok ak amitwogik che po lagokwok.”
Ki le icheek, “Kaisaru saboonwekyok. Myee kenyooru chameet eng' taitap kiptaiyandennyo, ak keegu otwogigap Pharaoh.”
Ki yai anyun Joseph ng'olyoondonooto koek ng'atuutyet eng' emetap Misiri ne mi agoi rani, keele kobunji Pharaoh kebeberta ne po muut, kobatee emetap tisiik ineegei ne ma punjin Pharaoh.
Ki meny anyun `Israel Goshen, eng' emetap Misiri, Ak ki ek mogore eng' olooto, ak ki sigiis ak kotesagis miising'.
Ki meny Jakobo emetap Misiri kenyiisyek taman ak tisap, ak kenyiisyek tugul che ki tar Jakobo kosabei ko ki pogol ak artam ak tisap.

Ye kingo riik anyun peetuusyek che po kalilotetap Israel, koguur anyun weeriinnyi Joseph ak koleenji, “Ngo kaanyooru chameet eng' taing'ung', inde anyun eung'ung' kubestanyu, iyaiywo ne myee, ak ne po iman. Kaigai ametupcha Misiri,
ago ye aru kobooto kwanisyekyuk, isuta amanda eng' Misiri, ak itupcha kereeriisyekwak.” Ak ki le, “Ayae ko uu ye kaimwa.”
Ak ki le, “Iyosyeiwo.” Ak ki iyasyechi. Yeityo kong'uruuk Israel eng' itogunnyi meto.
Kingo pata tuguuchuuto, koleenji chiito age Joseph, “Keero, myani kwandang'ung'.” Ki wo anyun komut weeriikyik tuwai, Manasseh ak Ephraim.
Ki leenji chiito age Jakobo, “Ineni weeriing'ung' Joseph, nyoonei ole imi,” ak ki igiilgei Israel kong'eet kotebee itoogut.
Ak ki leenji `Jakobo Joseph, “Kimong'jo Kamuktaindet Ne po Kamuktaet eng' Luz eng' emetap Kanaan, ak ki iberuura,
ak ki leenjo, ‘Keero, agoonin iyoteet, ak abarain, ak ayain iegu pororyosyek che chaang'. Ak tuun agoochini emoni iyoteet ne piitu let eng' inyee, koek nenywa koigeny.’
Chechuuk anyun nguno weeriichuguk aeng'u, chu ki kisigun eng' emetap Misiri, ye kitom aitu ole imi; egu chechuuk Ephraim ak Manasseh, ko uu ye chechuuk Reuben ak Simion.
Ago egu cheguuk che tuun isiche let eng' chu; kiguurtoe kainaigap weeriik che tupcho eng' porotennywa.
Ye kita anyoone abunu Padan, korebena meet Rael eng' emetap Kanaan, eng' ooreet ye ma loo kitigin eng' Eprat, ak ki atupchi anyun yooto po ooreetap Eprat (nooto ko Bethlehem).”
Ye kingo keer `Israel weeriigap Joseph, koteebe koleenji, “Ng'oo chu?”
Ki leenji Joseph kwandanyi, “Weeriikyuk chu che ki koono Kamuktaindet eng' olito.” Ak ki le, “Kaigai imutwaa kobwa yu, si aberuur.”
Nguno ko ki neegit kogoryo konyegap Israel amu osindo; ki ma kota komuuchi kogeer kiy komyee. Ak ki imut `Joseph lagochooto koriikyi ineendet ak ki ng'utut, ak koue eunekyik.
Ki leenji `Israel Joseph, “Kama kota abwaati ale ta ageere togeng'ung', ago nguno ko kagoboorwo Kamuktaindet lagoguk ak icheek.”
Yeityo koisto `Joseph lagochooto eng' kutung'oigap Jakobo ak kong'uruuk ineendet agoi ng'wony.
Ki nam `Joseph icheek tuwai, kiname Ephraim eunnyi ne po tai kotokyi murot kaataam ne po Israel, ak koname Manasseh eunnyi ne po kaataam kotokyi eutap Israel ne po tai, ak komut koriikyi kwandanyi.

Ago ki iito Israel eunnyi ne po tai kogonoor metitap Ephraim, weeriit ne ming'in ak kogonoor eunnyi ne po kaataam metitap Manasseh, ki igonoor eunekyik ko uu nooto, nganda ki weeriit ne po tai Manasseh.
Ki iberuur Joseph, ak kole, “Kamuktaindet ne kibendotee tainnyi kwanisyekyuk Abraham ak Isak, Kamuktaindet ne ki paata atkinye tugul agoi kora,

malaikaiyat ne ki ityaacha eng' yaitwogik tugul, ingoberuur lagochu; ak keguurtoe icheek kainennyu, ak kainaigap kwanisyekyuk ak icheek, Abraham ak Isak; ak ingotesagis kochang'a eng' kwenutap ng'wony.”
Ye kingo keer Joseph kole kagogonoor kwandanyi eunnyi ne po tai metitap Ephraim, koyait eng' tainnyi, ak ki nam anyun eutap kwandanyi kole koisto eng' metitap Ephraim si konde metitap Manasseh.
Ki leenji `Joseph kwandanyi, “Ma uu nooto, abba! Amu ni ko weeriit ne po tai; igonoor eung'ung' ne po tai metinnyi.”

Ago ki eesyo kwandanyi, ak kole, “Angen ale uu nooto, weeriinnyu, angen. Egu agine ineendet pororyet, ak tuun eetu. Ago eetu ng'eetap kamet ne ming'in kosiir ineendet ak chaang'aitu lagokyik koegu pororyosyek che chaang'.”
Ki iberuur anyun icheek peetuunooto, koleen, “Iberuuri Israel piik amu inyee, koleen, ‘Ingoyain Kamuktaindet ogergeitu ak Ephraim ak Manasseh.’ ” Ki nam anyun Ephraim kondoe Manasseh.
Yeityo koleenji `Israel Joseph, “Keero, neegit ame, ago mi Kamuktaindet kobooten ak koweekten kogeny iwe emetap kwanisyeguk.
Kaagoonin nguno Shekem kebeberta agenge ne siirei che po tupchosyeguk, nooto ne ki aluule Amorik eng' rotwennyu po chok ak kwangennyu.”
Yeityo koguur `Jakobo weeriikyik ak koleenji, “Oyumgei tugul, si kobiit aboorwok tuguuk che tuun pwonjinok eng' peetuusyek che po let.
Oyumgei anyun si ogas, okweek weeriigap Jakobo; Ogas Israel kwandang'wong'.
Inyeendet Reuben ko ii weeriinnyu ne po tai, ii kamugennyu, agoi taunetap kimnateennyu; Etunateet ne po toroorindo, ak etunateet ne po kimnateet.
Iwasegei ko uu peek, menyooru anyun etunateet; Amu ki iwe itoogutap kwandang'ung'.
Tupcho Simion ak Lawi; Kariigap koroomnateet rotonikwak po chok.
Ee, muguleldanyu, amat iwe kapkirwoogennywa; Ee, teegistanyu, amonamge ak tuiyennywa. Amu ki par chii eng' nereegekwak, Ak ki ep kwaryatap eiik eng' kwetyinennywa.
Chuboot nyitatennywa, amu ki pichiien, ak nereegekwak, amu ki koroomen. Apchee icheek eng' Jakobo, ak aiyeste icheek eng' Israel.
Inyeendet Judah ne tuun ilasun tupchosyeguk. Indoi eung'ung' kaatitap puuniguk; ing'uruukyinin weeriigap kwandang'ung' eng' taing'ung'.
Judah ko neraneetap ng'etundo; kaiwe weeriinnyu eng' ole kaibarchi tyondo. Ki ing'uruuk, koribis ko uu ng'etundo, ak ko uu ng'etundo ne nyebuito; ng'oo ne ing'eeti?
Ma istoegei Judah kirokto ne po pounateet, ak ma petei ne igoitoi ng'atuutik eng' iyotennyi, agoi koit Shiloh; ak kase iit piik tugul ineendet.

Ratyin sigiryennyi keetitap sabibuk, ak ratyin moitap sigiryennyi keetitap sabibuk ne myee kosiir; ki komwete ngoroikyik divaik che po sabibuk, ak komwete che tugegei piik che piriireen che po sabibuk.
Ak kobiriritu konyekyik eng' divaik, ak leelagitu kelekyik eng' cheego.
Tuun menyei Zebulun ngeguutap nyanjet, ak koek kamuung'eetap melisyek. Egu kiwotennyi Sidon.
Sigiryet ne kiim Issakar, ne ribise kwenutap njorusyek che po keechiirek.
Ki keer ole kimuung'e kole myee, ak ki keer emet kole karaaran, ki ing'uruuk si kolaiso, ak koek otwogindet ne poisyei.
Irwookyin Dan piikyik, amu ooreet agenge ineendet eng' Israel.
Egu Dan ereneet eng' ole kibunei, ereneet eng' ooreet, ne susei kwarinigap paraisisyek, si kobut kowee patai chiito ne laanyei.
Ki agen yetuneng'ung', ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Igiichi lugeet Gad, ago igiichi ineendet icheek agoi konam kwaryat.
Ruryotin amitwogik che tuun punu Asher, ak tuun koonu tuguuk che iboiboi laitorinik.
Kenyeleet ne subeendo Naphtali ne kagiunda, ne ng'alaali ng'aleek che myachen.
Josep ko keetit ne yiei kot, ne yiei kot ne mi ye neegitee kondap peek; iwaktoi mooriik kosiirei inaatut.
Kagogoochi ineendet ng'wanindo che mwoktoi kotyek, kamwok ineendet ak kausaus ineendet miising'.
Ago tebye kwangennyi eng' kimnateet, ak ki kimegitu eunekyik, eng' eunegap Ineendet ne Kiim ne po Jakobo, eng' kainetap Mestowot, Koita ne po Israel,

agot eng' Kamuktaindet ne po kwandang'ung', ne tuun toretin, eng' Kamuktaindet Ne po Kamuktaet ne tuun iberuurin, eng' perurwogik che po parak kipsengwet, ak perurwogik che mitune rireet, perurwogik che po kinaik, ak che po iyoteet.

Ki kimegitu perurwogigap kwandang'ung' kosiir perurwogigap aguiywogikyuk, agoi ole itei tuloonook che po koigeny. Tebee metitap Joseph perurwogichooto, ak eng' metit parak ne po ineendet ne ki kitabaane tupchosyekyik.
Benjamin ko suiyot ne tonisyei; amei karon che po logeet, ak kopchei koskoleny che kaluul.”
Chuuto tugul ko ortinwek taman ak aeng' che po Israel, ak chuuto ko ng'aleek che ki mwachi kwandanywa koberuuri icheek, ki iberuur chii tugul ko uu ole teptoi perurtanyi.
Kingo pata anyun, kong'at icheek koleenji, “Neegit kiyuma awo ole mi piikyuk. Otuba kobooto kwanisyekyuk eng' kebeneet ne miitei mbareetap Epron Hitindet,
eng' kebenonooto miitei mbareetap Makpela, ne tokyingei Mamre, eng' emetap Kanaan, ne ki al Abraham kobooto mbaranooto eng' Epron Hitindet, si koek ye mi kereeriisyek.
Ki kitupchi yooto Abraham ak kwondonyi Sarah, ki kitupchi yooto kora Isak ak Rebeka kwondonyi ak icheek, ak ki atupchi Leah yooto agine.
Ki kiale weeriigap Het mbaranooto ak kebenonooto mi yooto.”
Ye kingo kagogees Jakobo ng'atuutik che king'ate weeriikyik, kogetita keelyekyik koba itook, ki ilil anyun ak ki kiyum kobooto piikyik.
Ki ing'uruuk anyun Joseph kotokyigei togeetap kwandanyi, koriirchi ak kong'utut.
Ki ng'at `Joseph otwogikyik chepkerichinik konde kerichek muustap kwandanyi. Ki inde anyun chepkerichinichooto kerichek muustap Israel.
Ki kinde anyun kerichek ak ki igeskei peetuusyek artamu agobo ineendet, amu tenitu chooto peetuusyek che ki cham kindoe piik kerichek. Ak ki riirchi Misiriik ineendet peetuusyek tamanwogik tisap.

Ye kingo kagobata peetuusyek che po riirek, kong'alaalji `Joseph piigap kootap Pharaoh, koleenji, “Ngo ki anyooru chameet eng' taing'wong', ko kaigai omwachi Pharaoh kogas komyee eng' itiikyik, oleenji,
Kimakwo abba ayasyo, ak ki le, ‘Keero, kamei; tupcho kererinnyu ne ki achopchigei eng' emetap Kanaan.’ Ara anyun, kaigai igoono atogosta awo atup abba, si aweigei.”
Ki leenji Pharaoh, “Ui togoste, itup kwandang'ung', ko uu ye kimagun inee iyasye.”
Ki togosta anyun Joseph kwo kotup kwandanyi. Ki togosta kobooto ineendet otwogik tugul che po Pharaoh, ak poisyegap koonnyi, poisyek tugul che po emetap Misiri,
ak kootap Joseph komugul, tupchosyekyik ak piigap kootap kwandanyi. Kobatee lagokwak, keechiirekwak ak tuuga che ki ng'et eng' emetap Goshen.
Ki pa kobooto ineendet kariisyek ak piik che ketei paraisisyek. Ki piik che chaang' kot.
Ye kingo it rwanyut ne kiboorsee ne po Atad, ne miitei Jordan pitoniin, ko ki iteiyo eng' olooto eng' riirek che ng'woneen che pichiien; ak ki ng'at keriirchi kwandanyi peetuusyek tisap.
Ye kingo keer che menyei emonooto, Kanaanik, riirek eng' rwanyutap Atad, kole, “Eechen riirechu eng' Misiriik.” Ki kiguure anyun yooto Abel-Misiri, ne miitei Jordan pitoniin.
Ki yachi anyun weeriikyik ko uu ye kiga ng'at ineendet icheek.

Kisut poortannyi weeriikyik kwo emetap Kanaan, ak kitupchi kebeneet ne mi mbareetap Makpela, ne ki al Abraham kobooto mbareet eng' Epron Hitindet ne tokyingei Mamre, kobunji ineendet, si koek ye mi kereeriisyek.
Kingo kagotup Joseph kwandanyi, koweektagei kwo Misiri kobooto tupchosyekyik, ak tugul che kiga kotogosta kobooto ineendet, ye kibendi kotubei kwandanyi.
Ye kingo keer weeriik che tupcho ak Joseph kole kagome kwandanywa, kole, “Abeere, imuuchi kowechech Joseph ak kogeerwech yaityet tugul ne kiga kiyachi ineendet.”
Amu nooto anyun koyookto `icheek chiito kwo kap Joseph, koleenji, “Ki ng'at kwandang'ung' ye ki tomo kome, kole,

‘Omwachi Joseph oleenji: Kaigai inyochigaat tupchosyeguk amu pistoennywa ak tengektonywa, amu kiyaun yaityet.’ Ara anyun, kisaain keele nyoiywech kaat acheek otwogigap Kamuktaindet ne po kwandang'ung'.” Ak ki riir Joseph ye ki ng'alaaljin `icheeget ineendet.
Ki pa anyun weerchooto tupcho ak icheek kobutyi ng'wony eng' tainnyi, ak koleenji, “Keero, acheek ko ki otwogiguk.”
Ago ki leenji Joseph, “Amoiywei, tos ageeregei Kamuktaindet?
Okweek, ko ki oleen ki oyaiywo ne ya, ago ki yai Kamuktaindet komyeeit, si kosulda ko uu rani, si kesar piik che chaang'.
Amata oiywei anyun nguno. Abook kobooto lagokwok.” Ak ki igaigai icheek ak kong'alaalji eng' talasyet.
Ki meny anyun Joseph Misiri, ineendet ak piigap kootap kwandanyi. Ki tar Joseph kenyiisyek pogol ak taman.
Ki keer Joseph lagogap Ephraim agoi ibinda ne po somok, ak ki kigu lagogap Makir weeriitap Manasseh eng' kutung'oigap Joseph.
Ak ki leenji Joseph tupchosyekyik, “Neegit ame; ago rutochinok iman Kamuktaindet, ak komaandak otogoste eng' emoni obe emet ne ki iyasyechi Abraham, Isak ak Jakobo.”
Ak kimach `Joseph piigap Israel koyasyo kole, “Rutochinok iman Kamuktaindet, ak oip kawekyuk kotogosta koba eng' oli.”
Kime anyun Joseph, ye kiga kotar kenyiisyek pogol ak taman. Ki kiinde kerichek muustonyi ak kinde moinget eng' olooto po Misiri.
Chu anyun kainaigap weeriigap Israel che ki it Misiri kobooto Jakobo; ki wo chii tugul ak koonnyi:
Reuben, Simion, Lawi ak Judah,
Issakar, Zebulun ak Benjamin,
Dan, Naphtali, Gad ak Asher.
Ki tamanwogik tisap piik tugul che po iyoteetap Jakobo. Eng' peetuusyechooto ko ki mi Joseph Misiri.
Ki it anyun kolil Joseph, ak kobek tupchosyekyik tugul ak piik tugul che po ibinooto.
Ak ki sigiis piigap Israel, kotesagis kochang'a kot konyi emet ak kogimegitu kot.
Ki piit anyun laitoryat age ne ki poi Misiri ne ki ma kongen Joseph.
Ki leenji `ineendet piikyik, “Ogeero, chaang' ak ko kiimeen piigap weeriigap Israel kosiirech.
Kanyool anyun keng'ulatiitu si ma tesagis, amu nda piitu pooryeet, konamegei icheek ak puunikyok ak koboryenech, yeityo komweiso eng' emoni.”
Ki inde anyun kipnyeberainik si kobiit konyaliil icheek eng' otisyet ne ki nyigiis. Ki teech koteekyi Pharaoh ole kigonoree tuguuk; nganasoogap Pitom ak Raamses.
Ago ye kingo tesak kanyaliilet ne ki kinyalil piigap Israel, ko kitesagis ak icheek kosiir, ak konyi emet. Ki iimgei kot Misiriik agobo icheek.
Ki pirto `Misiriik piigap Israel eng' koroomnateet ne oo.

Ki igoochi saboonwekwak kong'woneegitu eng' otwoknateet ne koroom eng' poisyetap meneet ak matubaruuk, ak eng' poisyonik alak tugul che po emet. Eng' otwoknateennywa tugul ne ki ootis, ko ki ootis eng' kanyaliilet.
Ki ng'at anyun `laitoryatap Misiri chebyosogap sigisyo che po Yahudik che ki kiguure Sipra ak Pua,
koleenji; “Ye osigisyechi kwonyiik che po Yahudik ak ngo keer eng' ng'echereetap sigisyo lakweet ne kagisich ole weeriit, obar, ago ngo chepto, omete kosap.”
Ki iywei chebyosochooto po sigisyo Kamuktaindet, ak ma yai ko uu ye ki kang'at `laitoryat, ak kimeto weeriik kosapcho.
Ki kuur laitoryat chebyosochooto ak koteepse koleenji, “Amu nee si oyai ko uu ni, omete weeriik kosapcho?”
Kowolji `chebyosochooto Pharaoh koleenji; “Ma kergei kwonyiigap Yahudik ak che po Misiriik. Kiimeen icheek ak isip kosigisyei kotom koitita chebyosetap sigisyo.”
Ki yachi Kamuktaindet ne myee chebyosochooto po sigisyo, ak kitesagis anyun piik ak kogimegitu miising'.
Amu kayweet ne ki iywei chebyosochooto po sigisyo Kamuktaindet, ko ki iberuur Kamuktaindet kooriikwak.
Ki ng'at `Pharaoh piikyik kogeny koleenji; “Owiirchi weeriit age tugul ne kisichei aino ak omete chepto age tugul kosap.”
Eng' peetuusyechooto ko ki itunis chiito age ne po pororyetap Lawi, kotun cheptap pororyonooto po Lawi.
Ak ki manach osotyondonooto ak kosich weeriit, ak ye kingo keer kole lakweet ne karaaran, kouny ineendet arawek somok.
Ye ki mata komuuchi kouny kosiir yooto, kocheeng'ji ineendet kitonget ne po mutweek, ak komale lamit ak manget ak konde lakweet oriit. Yeityo konde kouny eng' saoset oriit eng' ngeguutap aineet.
Kitonone chepkamet ye ma loo, si kogeer kiit ne tos yaak eng' lakwanooto.

Ki choortagei cheptap Pharaoh kwo kouungei eng' aino. Ye kibendoti tiibiik eng' tabandap aineet che ki mi kobooto ineendet, kogeer cheptap Pharaoh kitonget eng' saoset oriit ak ki iyookto otwogindennyi kwo koipchi.
Kingo yaat kogeer lakweet ne weeriit koriirei. Kiriree `ineendet lakwanooto ak kole; “Agenge lakwani eng' che po Yahudik.”
ki teebee chepkametap lakwanooto cheptap Pharaoh koleenji; “Tos myee awo aguurun cheplakwet eng' osotigap Yahudik si koriibun lakwaniito?”
Koleenji cheptap Pharaoh; “Ee, Ui iguur.” Ki wo anyun chebooto koguur kametap lakweet.
Ki leenji `cheptap Pharaoh ineendet; “Imut lakwani, ui iiguiywa, si agoonin melektang'ung'.” Ki imut anyun osotyondonooto lakweet ak koriip.
Kingo kagoner ak koeet lakweet, komutyi cheptap Pharaoh ak ki nam koek weeriinnyi. Kiguure kainennyi Musa kole: “Amu ki among'u eng' peek.”
Eng' peetuusyek alak ye kiga koeet Musa, ko ki wo ole mi tupchosyekyik ak ki keer laisennywa. Ki keer Misirindet kobirei Hebranindet ne ki age eng' piikyik.
Kigusyigong' Musa komosi ak komosi, ak kingo keer kole ma mi chii, kobar misirindonooto ak kotube ng'aniek.
Ki wo kogeny eng' peetuut ne po aeng' ak ki keer kobiregei piik aeng'u che po Yahudik. Koleenji ineendet ne ki kalel, “Amu nee si ibir chiing'wong'?”
Kowolji koleenji, “Ng'oo ne koindein iegu pounindet ak kirwoogindet irwookwech? Ileen ibara, ko uu ye koibar Misirindet?” Amu niito ko ki iyweis Musa ak ki ibwaat kole, “Kaagaa kogenai niito.”
Kingo kas Pharaoh ng'olyoondonooto, kocheeng' kobar Musa. Ago ki mwei anyun Musa eng' taitap Pharaoh ak kwo komeny emetap Midian, kotebi eng' ole neegitee keriingetap peek.
Ki pwa tiibiik tisabu che po tisiindet age ne po Midian si kosiil peek konyiit moingonik si kobiit konaga akweetap keechiiregap kwandanywa.
Ak ki pwa mestoweek koon tiipchooto, ago king'eet Musa kotoret ak konaga peek akweet.
Ye kingo it tiipchooto ole mi kwandanywa Reuel, koteebe koleenji, “Ngo sip oweigei rani?”
Kowol icheek kole; “Katoretech Misirindet eng' eunegap mestoweek, yeityo kosiilwech peek ak konaga akweet.”
Koleenji icheek; “Mi ano chiichooto? Amu nee si omete? Oguur konyo koamis.”
Ki cham Musa kotebi ak chiichooto, ak ki igoochi `ineendet Musa cheptonyi Ziporah kotun.
Ki sich `Ziporah weeriit, ak kiguure Musa kainennyi Gershom. Amu ki le; “Aa kiprutoiyo eng' emetap pororyosyek alak.”
Ye kingo pata peetuusyek che chaang', kome laitoryatap Misiri. Ki tigenso eng' ng'wanindo ak koriiryo piigap Israel amu otwoknateet, ak ki ityi riirekwak Kamuktaindet amu otwoknateet.
Ki kas Kamuktaindet tigenoikwak, ak ki ibwaat kayomisennyi ne ki iyomisyi Abraham, Isak ak Jakobo.
Ki keer Kamuktaindet piigap Israel, ak ki nai kiit ne uu.
Eng' pesyo ye ki iyagi Musa akweetap keechiirek che po kapyugoinnyi Jethro, tisiindetap Midian, kokweri koba surkwen komosin, ak ki it tulweetap Kamuktaindet, ne kiguure Horeb.
Eng' yooto, komong'ji ineendet `malaikaiyatap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' maat ne lalei ne ki mang'une kwenutap keetit ne samum. Kingo keer, kogeer kole, ki ma kolalei keetoto kilale maat.
Ak ki le Musa, “Kawe ageer kwang'utyoni tee ni, katepto ano si ma lalei keetit?”
Ye kingo keer Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole, kawo kogeer, koguur ineendet `Kamuktaindet eng' kwenutap keetit koleenji; “Musa, Musa!” Kole Musa, “Ami yu.”
Koleenji, “Ameriigu yu, ireegu kweoniguk eng' keelyeguk amu tiliil yooto itonone.”
Ak ki leenji, “Aa Kamuktaindet ne po kwandang'ung', aa Kamuktaindetap Abraham, aa Kamuktaindetap Isak, aa Kamuktaindetap Jakobo.” Ki uny Musa togeennyi, amu ki iywei kogeer Kamuktaindet.
Ki leenji Kamuktaindet ne Toroor; “Koageer iman nyalilwogigap piikyuk che mi Misiri, koagas riirekwak amu chemogenik che usausi icheek ak angen ng'wanindanywa.

Kachooruge anyun si kobiit asar icheek eng' eunegap Misiriik, ak amutu icheek kotogos komong' eng' emonooto koba emet ne myee ne paraa. Emet ne nyiitaat cheego ak komi kumyat eng' chaang'indo; emetap Kanaanik, Hitik, Amorik, Perisik, Hibik, ak Jebusik.
Ee, kagobwanjo riiregap piigap Israel, ak koageer kanyaliilet ne inyalili icheek `Misiriik.
Nyoo anyun, si ayookten iwe kap Pharaoh, si kobiit imoong'u piikyuk, piigap Israel eng' Misiri.”
Ago ki leenji `Musa Kamuktaindet, “Aa ng'oo, ne tos amuuch awo kap Pharaoh, ak among'u piigap Israel eng' Misiri?”
Ak ki le Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, “Ami kobooten iman ak egu ni kaboorunet ne inae ile kayookten: ye kaimoong'u piik eng' Misiri, oboisyechi Kamuktaindet eng' tulwooni.”

Ki leenji `Musa Kamuktaindet, “Ye ait ole mi piigap Israel, ak amwachi aleenji, Kagoyokwo Kamuktaindet ne po kwanisyekwok Anyoonjok; ak ngo teebena koleenjo, ‘Kiguure ngo kainennyi?’ Aleenjini nee pichooto?”
Koleenji `Kamuktaindet Musa; “ ‘Aa ne Aa,’ Mwachi piigap Israel ng'olyoondoni, leenji, Kagoyokwo anyoonjok.”

Ak ki leenji `Kamuktaindet Musa kogeny, “Imwachini piigap Israel ng'olyoondoni ileenjini, Kagoyokwo Anyoonjok Kamuktaindet ne po Toroornatet ne po kwanisyekwok, Kamuktaindetap Abraham, Kamuktaindetap Isak, Kamuktaindetap Jakobo; kainennyu niito agoi koigeny, ak kabwaatennyu niito agoi ibinwek tugul.

Ui, iyum poisyegap Israel, ak ileenji icheek, Ki komong'ja Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindet ne po kwanisyekwok; Abraham, Isak, ak Jakobo, koleenjo: Kaanyonjok iman, ak kaageer nooto ne kiyaiywok eng' Misiri.
Ak kaatil ale, Amutwok otogosu omang'une nyalildap Misiri, agoi oit emetap Kanaanik, Hitik, Amorik, Perisik, Hibik, ak Jebusik, emet ne nyiitaat cheego ak komi kumyat eng' chaang'indo.”

Tuun kasei iit kuting'ung' icheek. Eng' yooto, obe kaplaitoryatap Misiri, inyee kobooto poisyegap Israel, ak oleenji, “Kogetuiye ak Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindet ne po Yahudik. Ara anyun, kisaain keele ityaachech keebe pandap peetuusyek somok eng' surkwen, si kobiit kigoochi tiseiywot Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindennyo.
Angen ale ma chamwok laitoryatap Misiri obe, kobatee eng' euut ne kiim.
Ara achuule eunnyu abiree Misiriik kwang'utik che amache ayai eng' kwenunnywa ak ye ibata chooto kotyachak obe.
Ak agoonok onyooru chameet eng' taitap Misiriik si ye obe, koma tuun obe puch.

Ingosoom anyun kwondo age tugul chiitap kokwennyi, ak eng' ineendet ne tebee koonnyi, tuguuk che po fedha, ak tuguuk che po thahabu, ak ngoroik. Si olaakyi weeriikwok, ak tiibiikwok, ak onyaban anyun tuguugap Misiriik.”
Ki wolji anyun Musa koleenji, “Ma iyana anan kogas iit kutinnyu pichooto? Amu mwaei koleen, ‘Ma iboorungei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.’ ”
koteebee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor koleenji, “Nee no itinye eng' euut?” Kowol kole; “Kirokto.”
Koleenji Kamuktaindet, “Wirchi ng'wony.” Ak kingo wiirchi ng'wony kowalak koek ereneet, ak ki mwee Musa.
Ak ki leenji `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Musa; “Iyogoite eung'ung', ak inam katutyennyi.” Ki iyogoito eunnyi anyun Musa, ak konam, ak kiwalak koek kirokto eng' eunnyi.
“Si kobiit koyan icheek kole, ki iboorungei Kamuktaindet ne po Toroornatet, ne po kwanisyekwok Kamuktaindetap Abraham, Kamuktaindetap Isak ak Kamuktaindetap Jakobo.”
Ak ki leenji Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kogeny, “Irooch euut tegeng'ung'.” Kingo rooch eunnyi tegeet ak kocher, ogeero, ki tinyei eunnyi mogondosaik, ak kiwalak koleelit ko uu teluji.
Koleenji Kamuktaindet; “Ketite euut irookte tegeng'ung'.” Ki iweech Musa euut korookto tegeennyi ak ye kingo nem, ko kagomyeeit ko uu yegai.
“Ngo ma kasin, anan ngo ma iyan kaboorunet ne po tai, komuuchi koyan kaboorunet ne po let.

Ago, ngo ma iyan kaboorunoichuuto aeng', anan ngo ma kas kuting'ung', isilu anyun peek eng' aineet ak iroong'ji ng'wony ole yaamaat. Walaksei peechooto kerame aineet koegu korotiik eng' emet ne yaamaat.”
Ago ki leenji `Musa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, “Ee, Kiptaiyannyu, mangen ang'alaal kobooch keny agoi raini ing'alaalwo, amu nyigiis ng'eleptanyu ak ko ua kuut.”
Ak kiteebe `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ineendet koleenji; “Ng'oo ne kiyaei kutitap chii? Anan ne yaei chii konamak kuut, anan kotimak, anan si kogeerto, anan kogor? Tos ma anee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor?
Ara anyun, tau panda ui, ami kobooten eng' ng'alaaleng'ung', ak aneetiin che kanyool imwa.”
Ago ki le Musa, “Ee, Kamuktaindet, asaain ale, iyookte chii age ne imache iyookte.”

Ki koromitu nereegegap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' Musa, ak ki leenji, “Tos ma mi ng'eetap komet Aron lawindet? Angen ale imuuchi kong'alaal komyee. Nyoonei ineendet agine kotorogun, ak ye kerin ineendet koboiboitu eng' muguleldanyi.
Ing'alaaljini ineendet ak imwachi ng'aleek che mwaei. Ami anee kobooten eng' ng'alaaleng'ung', ak eng' ng'alaalennyi, ak aneetaak ne kanyool oyai.
Egu ineendet kuting'ung', ng'alaalindet ne ng'alaaljin piik, ak iigei inyee kamuktaindet eng' ineendet.
Ara anyun, ibote inyee kirogi eng' eung'ung' si koek ne iyae kaboorunoik.”
Kingo pata koweek Musa kwo kap `Jethro; kapyugoinnyi ak koleenji, “Kaigai chamwo awo, aweekyigei ole mi piikyuk eng' Misiri, ageer ngo ta kosaptos.” Ak ki leenji Jethro Musa, “Ui eng' kaalyeet.”
Kingo ta komiitei Musa oliin po Midian kong'alaalji Kamuktaindet ne Toroor koleenji, “Ui, ketitegei Misiri amu ki kobek piik tugul che ki cheeng'ei kobarin.”
Ki imut Musa osotyonnyi ak weeriikyik ak kolaany sigiryet, yeityo konaam panda koweek kwo emetap Misiri. Ak ki ip anyun Musa kirokto ne po Kamuktaindet eng' eunnyi.
Ki leenji `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Musa; “Ye igetitegei Misiri, iriip ak iyai eng' taitap Pharaoh kwang'utik tugul cho koagoonin kimnateet iyai. Ago auuiiti muguleldanyi, si ma igoochi piik koba.
Ileenjini Pharaoh, ‘Kamwa ko uu ni Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Weeriinnyu Israel ak ko taitanyu,
ak kaamwaun aleenjin, Igoochi weeriinnyu kwo, si kobiit koboisyeiwo. Ago amu kaiete kwo, abare anyun taitang'ung'.’ ”
Ye kita komi kootap toek eng' ooreet kowendi, kotuiye `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Musa ak kimach kobar ineendet.
Ki nam anyun Ziporah koita ne ng'atip, koyatitae weeriinnyi ak koting'e iriryot keelyegap Musa. Yeityo kole, “Iman ii manong'otyondennyu ne po korotiik.”
Ki pagaakta `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ineendet. Ak ki le osotyondonooto, “Ii manong'otyot ne po korotiik, amu kamuratanet.”
Ki leenji `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Aron, “Ui, torookte Musa eng' surkwen.” Ki wo anyun, ak kituiyechi tulweetap Kamuktaindet ak kitorooch ineendet.
Ak ki mwachi `Musa Aron ng'aleek tugul che po Kamuktaindet ne Toroor che kiga koyooktoe, ak kaboorunoik tugul che kiga koyomisyi.
Yetyo koba Musa ak Aron koyum poisyek tugul che po piigap Israel.
Ki mwa anyun Aron ng'aleek tugul che kiga komwachi `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Musa, ak ki yai kaboorunoik eng' taitap piik tugul,
ak ki iyan piik. Ak ye kingo kas kole kagonyonji `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor piigap Israel, ak kogogeer nyalilwogikwak, kong'uruukso kosa anyun.
Kingo pata chuuto koba Musa ak Aron ak koleenji Pharaoh, “Kamwa ko uu ni Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindet ne po Israel, kole, ‘Mete piikyuk koba, si kobiit koyaiywo igoorto eng' surkwen.’ ”
koteebee Pharaoh koleenji, “Ng'oo Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ne tos agas iit ng'aleekyik kot achamji Israel koba? Mangen Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ak kogeny, ma chamjini Israel koba.”

Ak ki le icheek, “Kinyonjech Kamuktaindet ne po Yahudik. Kaigai anyun undech keebe pandap peetuusyek somok eng' surkwen, si keeng'ji Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindennyo, tiseiywot, si ma pirenech koroito, anan ko rotwetap chok.”
Ago ki wolji `laitoryatap Misiri icheek koleenji, “Amu nee si omache otyach piik eng' poisyonikwak inyee Musa ak Aron? Oba ole mi poisyonikwok.”
Ki le Pharaoh, “Kagochang'a piikwok che mi emet kosiir, nguno ko kaogoochi kometo laisennywa.”
Eng' peetuut nooto kong'at `Pharaoh kipnyeberainigap piik ak pounik, koleenji,
“Amata ogoochi piik kogeny mobeek che cham koyae matubaruuk. Ingoba icheegei kocheeng'jigei.

Ago obirchini icheek koyai matubaruuk che tee che kocham koyaei eng' kotugul. Amochuchuch kiy eng' chooto. Choriren pichu, nooto amu nee si ko riirtos ak koleen: ‘Koonech keebe keeng'ji tiseiywot Kamuktaindennyo.’
Otesyi icheek poisyet ne nyigiis, si kobiit koyai asi mata koepchi iit ng'aleek che ma po iman.”
Ki manda anyun kipnyeberainik ak chemogenikwak, kong'alaalji piik koleenji, “Kamwa ko uu ni Pharaoh kole, ‘Ma agoonok mobeek,
oba okweegei, ocheeng' eng' ole omuuchi onyoorchi, ago ma kichuchuchi kiy eng' poisyeng'wong'.’ ”
Ki yestaat anyun piik eng' emet komugul ne po Misiri koyumat mobeek che beelee matubaruuk.
Ki ichirchir `kipnyeberainik piik, koleenji, “Owong'u poisyonikwok, che kocham oyae peetuut age tugul, ko uu ye kocham oyae otinye mobeek.”

Ki kibir anyun kipnyeberainigap piigap Israel, che ki indoi chemogenigap Pharaoh, ak keteebe keleenji, “Amu nee si mowong'u motwetap poisyet ne po amut ak ne po ra, oyai matubaruuk ko uu ye kocham oyae oin kora?”
Ak ki pa anyun pounigap piigap Israel koriirchi Pharaoh, koleenji, “Amu nee si iyaiywech acheek otwogiguk ko uu ni?
Ma ki koonech mobeek, ago kibirchinech keyai matubaruuk ak kebirech acheek otwogiguk, ago mi lelutyet piiguk.”
Ago ki leenji, “Oo choriren, oo choriren; nooto anyun si omwae oleen, ‘Koonech keebe keeng'ji tiseiywot Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.’
Ara anyun, oba oyai poisyet. Ma kigoonok mobeek, ak kanyool oibu matubaruuk che yamegei ak che kogimachei.”
Ki keer pounigap piigap Israel kole tinyei nyalilda, ye ki ngemwachi keleenji, “Mochuchuchi kiy eng' matabarukwok che cham oyae eng' peetuut age tugul.”
Ye kingo manda icheek eng' kap Pharaoh, kotuiye Musa ak Aron kotonondos eng' ooreet,
ak ki leenji icheek, “Ingogeerok Kamuktaindet ne Toroor korwookwok, amu kaoyaech kesamisitu eng' taitap Pharaoh, ak eng' taitap otwogikyik, kot onde rotwetap chok eunekwak kobarenech.”
Ak kiweekyigei Musa ye mi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ak koleenji, “Ee, Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, amu nee si iyachi ne ya pichu? Amu nee si iyookwo?
Amu kobooch ngap anyoo kap Pharaoh ang'alaalji eng' kaineng'ung', ko ki koyachi pichu ne ya, ak tomo isaru piiguk agot kitigin.”
Ki leenji `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Musa, “Machei si igeer nguno kiit ne amache ayachi Pharaoh, amu eng' eunyu ne kiim, kogoochin icheek koba, ak koon koba eng' emennyi eng' eunooto kiim.”
Ki ng'alaalji `Kamuktaindet Musa koleenji; “Aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ki among'ji Abraham, Isak ak Jakobo, ko aa Kamuktaindet Ne po Kamuktaet agot nga ki ma naa icheek eng' kainennyu Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ki agimiit kayomisennyu kobooto icheek, ale agoochi emetap Kanaan, ole ki menyei icheek ko kiprutoin.
Kobooto nooto, ko koagas tigenoigap piigap Israel che mi eunegap Misiriik ko ratotiin, ak kaabwaat kayomisennyu.

Ileenji anyun piigap Israel, ‘Aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ak among'wok omang'une otetap Misiriik. Asarwok eng' otwoknateet ne oote icheek ak atyachak eng' euut ne chuulaat ak eng' kwang'utik che eecheen che po kirwooget.
Anamok oegu piikyuk, ak aegu Kamuktaindet eng' okweek, si onai ole Aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindeng'wong' ne imoong'wok omang'une otetap Misiriik.
Ak amutwak obwa emet ne ki aitoochi eunnyu agoochi Abraham, Isak ak Jakobo, ak agoonok kobunjook. Aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.’ ”
Ki ng'alaalji anyun `Musa piigap Israel ko uu nooto. Nga no, ko ki ma kas icheek ng'aleekyik amu ng'wanindo ne ki tinyei eng' mugulelwekwak, ak otwoknateet ne ki koroom.
Ki ng'alaalji anyun `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Musa koleenji,
“Mande, ing'alaalji Pharaoh laitoryatap Misiri ileenji kochamji piigap Israel komanda eng' emennyi.”
Ago ki ng'alaal Musa eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole, “Ngot koma kasa piigap Israel, ko tos imuuchi kogasta ano Pharaoh ak anee atinye kutit ne palyach?”
Ki ng'alaalji `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Musa ak Aron agobo piigap Israel ak Pharaoh laitoryatap Misiri, ak kong'at icheek koomaanda piigap Israel eng' emetap Misiri.
Chu ko poisyegap kooriigap weeriigap Reuben taitap Israel: Hanok, Palu, Hesron, ak Karmi. Chuuto ko ortinwegap kap Reuben.
Weeriigap Simion ko ki: Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jakin, Sohar, ak Shaul weeriitap cheptap Kanaan. Chuuto ko ortinwegap kap Simion.
Chu ko kainaigap weeriigap Lawi ko uu ortinwekwak: Gerson, Kohat, ak Merari; ak kenyiisyegap Lawi kotee kosabei ko ki kenyiisyek pogol ak sosom ak tisap.
Weeriigap Gerson ko ki: Libni ak Shimei, ko uu kooriikwak.
Ak weeriigap Kohat ko ki: Amram, Itshar, Hebron, ak Uzziel. Kenyiisyegap Kohat kotee kosabei ko ki kenyiisyek pogol ak sosom ak somok.
Weeriigap Merari ko ki: Mali ak Musi. Chuuto ko kooriigap Lawiik ko uu ortinwekwak.
Ki itun anyun Amram sengennyi Jokebed, ne ki sikyi Aron ak Musa. Kenyiisyegap Amram kotee kosabei ko ki kenyiisyek pogol ak sosom ak tisap.
Weeriigap Itshar ko: Kora, Nepeg ak Zikri.
Ki weeriigap Uzziel ko Mishael, Elzaphan ak Sitri.
Ki itun `Aron Eliseba, cheptap Aminadab, chepkametap Nason, ne ki sikyi ineendet Nadap, Abiu, Eleazar ak Ithamar.
Weeriigap Kora ko: Asir, Elkanah, ak Abiasap; chuuto ko kooriigap Koraik.
Ak ki itun Eleazar weeriitap Aron age eng' tiibiigap Putiel, ne ki sikyi ineendet Phineas. Chuuto ko poisyegap kooriik che po kwanisyegap Lawiik ko uu kooriikwak.
Ki Aron ak Musa che ki mwachi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor koleenji: “Omoong'u piigap Israel eng' emetap Misiri ko uu lugosyekwak.”
Ki icheeget Musa ak Aron che ki mwachi Pharaoh laitoryatap Misiri, komaanda piigap Israel eng' Misiri.
Ak eng' peetuunooto ne ki ng'alaaljin `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Musa eng' emetap Misiri,
kong'alaalji koleenji, “Aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor. Mwachi Pharaoh laitoryatap Misiri tuguuk tugul che amwaun.”
Ago ki mwa Musa eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole, “Atinye kutit ne palyach, imuuchi kogastaa ano Pharaoh?”
Ak ki wolji `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Musa koleenji, “Kayain iigei Kamuktaindet eng' Pharaoh, ak koek ng'eetap komet Aron maotyondeng'ung'.
Imwachini ng'eetap komet Aron tuguuk tugul che ang'atiin, si komwachi ineendet Pharaoh kounda piigap Israel komanda eng' emennyi.
Auuiiti muguleldap Pharaoh, ak ates kaboorunoikyuk ak kwang'utikyuk eng' emetap Misiri,
ago ma imuuchi kogasaak Pharaoh, ak eng' nooto anyun, andai eunnyu Misiri, ak among'u lugosyekyuk, piikyuk piigap Israel, komang'une emetap Misiri eng' poisyonik che eecheen che po kirwoogutik.
Ye achuul eunnyu atokyi Misiri, ak among'u piigap Israel eng' kwenunnywa, konai Misiriik kole aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.”
Ki yai anyun Musa ak Aron ko uu nooto, ko uu ye ki ng'at Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Kiga koit kenyiisyegap Musa tamanwogik sisiit, ak ki tamanwogik sisiit ak somok kenyiisyegap Aron ye ki ng'alaaljindos icheek ak Pharaoh.
Ki ng'alaalji `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Musa ak Aron, koleenji,
“Ye teebenak Pharaoh kwang'utyet, imwachi inyee Aron anyun konam kiroktonyi ak kowiirchi ng'wony si kobiit koek ereneet eng' taitap Pharaoh.”

Ko uu nooto ko ki pa Musa ak Aron anyun kap Pharaoh, ak ki yai ko uu ye kiga ng'at Kamuktaindet ne Toroor. Ki wiirchi ng'wony Aron kiroktonyi eng' taitap Pharaoh, ak eng' taitap otwogikyik, ak kiwalak koek ereneet.
Ki guur agine Pharaoh piik che tinyei utaatyet ak orgoik. Ak ki yai ak icheek ko uu nooto eng' ng'oorsennywa piigap Misiri che ng'oorsei ak che ng'oomen.
Ki wiirchi chii age tugul eng' icheek kiroktonyi ng'wony ak kiwalogis koek erenook. Ago kilugui kirokto ne po Aron kirokweekwak.
Ki iuit muguleldap Pharaoh, ak ma kas iit icheek ko uu ye kiga komwa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ki leenji `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Musa, “Uui muguleldap Pharaoh, kaeesyo kounda piik koba.
Ara anyun ui karon kap Pharaoh amu wendi aino. Tonone tabandap aineet si otuiyechi yooto. Ip kirokto nooto kowalak koek ereneet eng' eung'ung',
ui ak ileenji ineendet, ‘Kagoyokwo Kamuktaindet ne po Toroornatet ne po Yahudik, ak kale, mete piikyuk koba si kobiit koboisyeiwo eng' surkwen; agoi kora ko tomo igas.’
Kamwa anyun ko uu ni Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ‘Inae eng' ni ile aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor. Keero, akweree kirogi atinye eng' eunnyu peechu mi ainooni, ak kowalogis peek koek korotiik.
Pegu njireenik che mi aineet, ak kobul aineet, ak kowech Misiriik koe peek che punu aineet.’ ”

Ki leenji `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Musa, “Ileenji Aron, ‘Nam kiroktong'ung' ak ichuul eung'ung' itokyi peegap Misiri, ainoosyekwak, kereruusyekwak, tamboinikwak ak togomwekwak tugul che po peek. Piitu korotiik eng' emet komugul ne po Misiri ak eng' tereenigap peek che po keetiik, ak eng' tereenigap peek che po koik.’ ”

Ki yai Musa ak Aron ko uu ye ki kang'at Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, kisut kirogoto ak kokweree peek che mi aineet, eng' taitap Pharaoh, ak eng' taitap otwogikyik, ak kiwalogis peek tugul che mi aineet koek korotiik.
Ki pek njireenik che ki mi aineet ak kibul aineet kot ko mata komuuch Misiriik koe peegap aineet, ak ki piit korotiik eng' emet tugul ne po Misiri.
Ago ye kingo yai ko uu nooto eng' ng'oorsennywa ak icheek piik che ng'oomen che ng'oorsei che po Misiri, kogiuit muguleldap Pharaoh, ak ma kas iit icheek; ko uu ye ki kamwa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Kiweektagei anyun Pharaoh kwo koonnyi, ak ki ma iit ineendet tuguuk che koyaagiis koek kiy.
Kibalaat anyun Misiriik tugul ole neegitee aineet koleen tamangap konyoor peek che eei, amu ki ma imuuch koe peegap aineet.
Ki iwong'kei peetuusyek tisabu kobooch ngap kokwer Kamuktaindet ne Toroor aineet.
Yeityo koleenji `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Musa, “Ui kap Pharaoh ak ileenji kang'atiin Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: ‘Mete piikyuk koba, si kobiit koboisyeiwo.
Ngot ietee koba, keero, abiree emeng'ung' komugul mororochik.

Nyiei aineet mororochik, ak kotogosta koba koong'ung', ak koba koot ne irue, agoi itogung'ung', kooriigap otwogiguk ak kooriigap piiguk. Pendi mororochik kapkoimaung'ung', ak tereeniguk che ki chobe magatiinik.
Togostaenen inyee, piiguk ak otwogiguk tugul mororochik.’ ”
Ak ki leenji `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Musa, “Ileenji Aron, ‘Chuul eung'ung' ne iting'e kirokto itokyi ainoosyek, kereruusyek ak tamboinik, si komong' mororochik komong'ji emetap Misiri.’ ”
Ki chuul anyun Aron eunnyi kotokyi peegap Misiri, ak ki togos mororochik konyi emetap Misiri.
Ago ki yai piik che ng'oomen che ng'oorsei eng' ng'oorsennywa ko uu nooto, ak komoong'ji mororochik emetap Misiri.
Ki kuur anyun `Pharaoh Musa ak Aron ak koleenji, “Oriirchi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, si koistaena anee ak eng' piikyuk mororochik, ak amete anee piik koba kogoochi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor tiseiywot.”
Koleenji Musa Pharaoh, “Kagoonin imwa ile auyo ole asaun, ak asachi otwogiguk, ak piiguk kebar mororochik ak koistoenogei eng' korikwok ak kotebee aino kityo.”
Ak ki wol kole, “Mutai.” Koleenji Musa, “Ingoyaak ko uu ng'olyoondeng'ung', si kobiit inai ile ma mi age ne uu Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindennyo.
Istoenengei mororochik, ak eng' kooriguk, eng' otwogiguk ak eng' piiguk. Ng'etu eng' aino kityo.”
Ki manda anyun Musa ak Aron eng' kap Pharaoh ak koriirchi `Musa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor koisto mororochik che kiga ibookyine Pharaoh.
Ki yai Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ko uu ng'olyootap Musa ak ki pek mororochik eng' kooriik, eng' kokwotinwek ak eng' emet komugul.
Ak ki kiiyumat keburusyek che chaang', ak ki ibul emet komugul.
Ago kingo keer Pharaoh kole ma komi mororochik, kouiit muguleldanyi ineendet, ak ki ma kas icheek, ko uu ye kiga komwa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Koleenji kogeny `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Musa, “Ileenji Aron, ‘Sut kiroktong'ung' ak ikwere temburyegap emet, si kobiit kowalogis temburyechooto koek isireek eng' emet komugul ne po Misiri.’ ”

Ki yai inee ko uu nooto. Ki chuul eunnyi Aron ak kokwere kiroktonyi temburyek che po ng'wony, ak ki piit isireek che ki laany piik ak tyong'ik. Ki ek temburyek tugul che po emetap Misiri komugul isireek.
Kityem piik che ng'oomen che ng'oorsei eng' ng'oorsennywa komong' isireek, ago ki ma imuuch. Ki nam anyun isireechooto piik ak tyong'ik.
Ki mwachi anyun pichooto ng'oomen che ng'oorsei, Pharaoh, koleenji, “Ni ko mornetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor. Ki uiit muguleldap Pharaoh, ak ma kas icheek ko uu ye kiga mwa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.”
Ak ki leenji `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Musa, “Ng'eet karon muste ak itonon eng' taitap Pharaoh ye wendi aino ak ileenji ineendet, ‘Kamwa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole, mete piikyuk koba koboisyeiwo.’

Ago ngot ko mechamji piikyuk koba, ko ne ma tiny ayoogu kalyang'ik eng' chaang'indo kobwonjin, ak kobwonji otwogiguk ak piiguk, ak kooriguk oriit. Nyiei kalyang'ik kooriigap piigap Misiri, ak nyie ole tonone tugul eng' ng'wony.
Ago abestosi atabaani eng' peetuunooto emetap Goshen ole menyei piikyuk si ma it kalyang'ik olooto ak si kobiit inai inyee ile aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne mi emet.
Andai kiwateet kwenutap piikyuk ak piiguk. Piitu kaboorunonooto mutai.”
Ak ki yai Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ko uu nooto; Kichang'a kalyang'ik miising' eng' kootap Pharaoh, ak eng' kooriigap otwogikyik ak king'emak emetap Misiri komugul amu kalyang'ik.
Kiyookto Pharaoh keguur Musa ak Aron, ak koleenji, “Oba eng' emoni po Misiri ibogoochi tiseiywot Kamuktaindeng'wong'.”

Ago ki wolji Musa Koleenji, “Ma nyolu keyai ko uu nooto amu tiseiywek che ma kegoochi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindennyo, ko imuuch ko kanaguut eng' Misiriik. Tos ngegoite tiseiywot ne wechei icheek eng' tainnywa, ko tos ma lachech eng' koik?
Nyolu keebe panda ne po peetuusyek somok eng' surkwen, si kegoochi tiseiywot Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindennyo, ko uu ye kong'atech.”
Kowol kole Pharaoh, “Agoonok obe pandang'wong' si kobiit ogoochi tiseiywot Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindeng'wong' eng' surkwen. Ago mat obe anyun ole loo miising', ak osaaiywo agane.”

Koleenji Musa, “Keero, kawe eng' ole imi nguno si asa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor si kobiit koistoenen inyee Pharaoh, otwogiguk ak piiguk kalyang'ik mutai. Ago mat koboisyee kogeny Pharaoh kaberberisyet koetee piik koba kogoochi tiseiywot Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.”
Ki wo anyun Musa eng' ole mi Pharaoh kwo kosa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ak ki yai Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ko uu saaetap Musa. Ki istoe kalyang'ik Pharaoh, otwogikyik ak piikyik, ma ng'et kalyang' agot agenge.
Nga no, ko ki iuit Pharaoh muguleldanyi kogeny, ak ma meto piik koba.
Ki leenji anyun `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Musa, “Ui kap Pharaoh ak ileenji, ‘Kamwa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ineendet Kamuktaindet ne po Yahudik kole: igoochi piikyuk koba, koboisyeiwo.
Ago ngot ietee koba ak kota iraany icheek,
keero, nyooru pireetap koroito ne ng'waan ne amei icheek kobun eutap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kiyagiiguk che mi akwot: paraisisyeguk, sigiroiguk, tambeesiguk, tuguuk ak keechiireguk.
Ibestos Kamuktaindet ne Toroor tuugap Israel eng' tuugap Misiri si ma me kiy agot agenge eng' tugul che po piigap Israel.’ ”
Ak ki inde Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kasarta, ak komwa kole, “Yaei Kamuktaindet kii mutai eng' emet.”
Ki yai Kamuktaindet kioto eng' peetuut ne ki isubi ak ki pek kiyagiik tugul che po Misiri, ago ma me agot agenge eng' kiyagiigap piigap Israel.
Ki iyookto `Pharaoh piik kooro agobo kiyagiik che po piigap Israel, ak ki ma me agot agenge eng' kiyagiikwak. Ago kiuit muguleldap Pharaoh, ak ma chamji piik koba.
Ak ki leenji `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Musa ak Aron, “Oram oreegap maat ne oo, ak ingoseerchi Musa parak eng' taitap Pharaoh.
Egu chooto temburyek che puspus eng' emet komugul ne po Misiri, ak koek ondirik che mong'u kobwandos eng' piik ak eng' tyong'ik eng' emetap Misiri komugul.”
Ki ip anyun icheek oreegap maat ne oo, ak koba kotononso eng' taitap Pharaoh, yeityo koseerchi Musa parak ak ki ek ondirik che mong'u kobwandos eng' piik ak eng' tyong'ik.
Ak ki ma imuuch kotononso piik che ng'oomen che ng'oorsei eng' taitap Musa, amu ondirichooto. Ki nam ondirik piik che ng'oomen che ng'oorsei ak icheek ko uu Misiriik.
Ago, agot nga chooto tugul, ko ki iuit Kamuktaindet ne Toroor muguleldap Pharaoh, ak ki ma kas ko uu ye kiga komwachi `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Musa.

Ki leenji `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Musa, “Ng'eet, muste karon, ak iwe itonon eng' taitap Pharaoh, ak ileenji, ‘Kamwa ko uu ni Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ineendet Kamuktaindet ne po Yahudik kole mete piikyuk koba asi koboisyeiwo.
Amu ayookyini korotwek che ng'woneen muguleldang'ung', otwogiguk, ak piiguk, si kobiit inai ile ma mi age ne uu anee eng' ng'wony komugul.
Amu kata achuule eunnyu abariin ak piiguk eng' koroito, ak ta kageisten ibet eng' ng'wony,
ago kaachamun isap, si kobiit aboorun kimnateennyu, ak kemwaita kainennyu konaak eng' ng'wony komugul.
Ta ilasugei iraanye piikyuk, ak tomo igoochi koba?
Amu nooto anyun, agoonu mutai kotee ni asiis koroobon koigap ropta che eecheen, che tomo kegeerei eng' Misiri ole kigoi.

Iyookte anyun, keget kiyagiiguk kobwa, ak tugul che itinye che miitei akwot amu choorchingei koigap ropta ak parei kobek chii age tugul ak tyony age tugul ne mi timiin, ngot koma kiget anan kimut konyo kaa.’ ”
Ineendet ne ki iywei ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' otwogigap Pharaoh ko ki imweito otwogikyik ak akwotisyekyik koba kooriik.
Ago ineendet ne ki ma iit ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole kiy, ko kemetoi otwogikyik ak akwotisyekyik eng' timiin.

Ak ki leenji `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Musa, “Chuul eung'ung' anyun tokyi kipsengwet, si kobiit koigap ropta eng' emetap Misiri komugul, kobir piik, tyong'ik ak kiy age tugul ne piitei eng' ng'wony ak eng' emetap Misiri komugul.”

Ki chuul anyun Musa kiroktonyi kotokyi kipsengwet, ak ki iyook Kamuktaindet ne Toroor tuleet ak koigap ropta ak kochoorgei maat konyo ng'wony. Ak ki isurur Kamuktaindet ne Toroor koigap ropta koroong'ji emetap Misiri.
Ki piit anyun koigap ropta kobooto maat ne ki ilyeli eng' kimnateet ne oo kot, ne ki tomo kobiitu eng' emetap Misiri komugul kong'etee ngo ek poror.
Ki pir koigap ropta tugul che ki mi timiin eng' emet komugul ne po Misiri, piich ak tyong'in; kibir kiy age tugul ne piitei eng' ng'wony ak koiri keet age tugul ne po timiin.
Emetap Goshen ineegei, ole ki mi piigap Israel, ole ma it koigap ropta.
Eng' yooto anyun, ko ki iyookto Pharaoh keguur Musa ak Aron ak koleenji, “Kaayai tengekto eng' niito; po imanda Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ago aa kiptengekyo kobooto piikyuk.
Osaa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor amu kagoyam tuleennyi ak koik; agoonok anee obe, amat ogagei.”

Koleenji Musa ineendet, “Ye kaamande eng' nganaseet, eng' yooto anyun asutyi eunekyuk Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, si kosiis tuleet, ak kong'et koiyat, ak kobiit inai ile po Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ng'wony.
Ago angen ale, ne uu inyee ak otwogiguk, kotom oiywei Kamuktaindet ne po Toroornatet.”
Ki kibir minutik alak che ki kiguure mabuteek ak baale amu kigaba met baale ak kiga yesyo taaptogap mabuteek.
Ago ki ma kibir nganuuk ak peek alak che kiguure kusemet amu ki tomo koeegitu.
Ki manda Musa eng' nganaseet kwo eng' ole mi Pharaoh. Yeityo koitoochi eunekyik Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ak ki siis tuleet ak kong'et koiyat; ak mata korobonji ng'wony.
Ye kingo keer Pharaoh kole ma komi ropta ak koigap ropta ak tuleet, kogetyigei koyai tengekto ak kongelel ineendet ak otwogikyik.
Ko uu ye kiga komwa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' Musa, kogiuit muguleldap Pharaoh, ak ma igoochi piigap Israel koba.
Koleenji `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Musa, “Ui kap Pharaoh. Amu kaauit anee muguleldanyi, ak mugulelwegap otwogikyik, si kobiit abarta kaboorunoichu eng' kwenunnywa.
Si kobiit omwa kogas lagokwak ak mochogorenikwok ole ki aite Misiriik koek che perber, ak kaboorunoikyuk che ki ayai eng' kwenunnywa, si onai ole aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.”

Ki pa anyun Musa ak Aron kap Pharaoh, ak koleenji; “Kamwa ko uu ni Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindet ne po Yahudik, ‘Ieesyoi agoi au si iming'inigei eng' tainnyu? Mete piikyuk koba, koba koboisyeiwo.
Keero, ngieesye imete piikyuk koba, ayookyini mutai chereng'endet emeng'ung'.
Tuchei emet, kot ko mata komuuch chii kogeer ng'wonyut. Amei tuguuk tugul che ng'etunotiin, che kong'etune koigap ropta, ak koam keet age tugul agot chooto katoi ko piityo kogeny eng' emet.

Nyiei kooriguk, kooriigap otwogiguk ak che po Misiriik tugul. Chaang'itu ne ki tomo kogeerei kwanisyeguk anan aguiywogiguk, kobooch peetuut ye kingo piit agoi ra.’ ” Ak kiwelelgei kwo eng' ole mi Pharaoh.
koteebee otwogikyik Pharaoh koleenji, “Egu mesteet chiichi eng' acheek kot kotyanit? Igoochi piik koba, koba koboisyechi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindennywa. Tos tomo inai ile kogome Misiri?”
Eng' nooto anyun, ko ki kimutyi Musa ak Aron Pharaoh kogeny, ak ki leenji `ineendet icheek, “Oba, oboisyechi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindeng'wong'. Ago anyun ngorcho che pendi?”
Kowolji Musa koleenji, “Kibendi kobooto neranikyok, ak poisyekyok, ak weeriikyok, ak tiibiikyok. Kikwerye neekyok ak tuukyok amu kanyool keyachi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor igoorto.”
Ak ki `leenji ineendet icheek, “Ingotep iman Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kobootok ngot achamwok obe kobooto lagokwok. Tagunoot keele otinye mageet ne ya.
Ma uu nooto. Ma chamwok omut lagokwak. Oba okweegei murenik, obe oboisyechi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor; amu nooto ne omache.” Ak ki kioon Musa ak Aron komong' eng' ole mi Pharaoh.

Koleenji `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Musa, “Chuul tokyi eung'ung' emetap Misiri si kobwa chereng'enyinik kotogos emetap Misiri, kotogos koam keet age tugul ne tuon ne po emet. Koam agot tugul che kong'etune koigap ropta.”

Kochuul anyun Musa eunnyi ak kotokyi kiroktonyi emetap Misiri. Kogoon Kamuktaindet ne Toroor usoonet ne punu kong'asiis kousyi emet peetuunooto komugul, ak kemout komugul, ak kingo eech, koip usoonetap kong'asiis chereng'endet.

Ki togos chereng'endet kobookyi emet komugul ne po Misiri, ak ki ru eng' ng'wonyutap emet tugul ne po Misiri. Ki koroomen kot ak ki tomo kobiitu chereng'endet ne uu nooto, ama kobiitu kogeny ne uu nooto.

Amu ki tuch emet komugul, kot koimenit. Ki am keet age tugul ne tuon ne mi emet, ak logoek tugul che po keetiik che ki ng'etune koigap ropta. Ki ma ng'et keet age tugul ne nyaliil, anan keet age tugul ne tuon ne mi timiin, eng' emet komugul ne po Misiri.
Ki iyookto anyun Pharaoh keguur Musa ak Aron eng' chokyinet, ak koleenji, “Kaayachi tengekto Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindeng'wong', ak kaayaiywok okweek.
Nooto anyun, asaain ale nyoiywo kaat amu tengektonyu niito ineegei, ak osaa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindeng'wong', koistoena meoni kityo.”
Ki wo eng' ole mi Pharaoh, kwo kosa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.

Ki wol Kamuktaindet ne Toroor usoonet ne kiim miising' kousune cherongo, ne ki ip chereng'endet, ak koon kwo Araraita ne Piriir ak ki ma ng'et chereng'endet agot agenge eng' emet komugul ne po Misiri.
Ago ki iuit `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor muguleldo ne po Pharaoh, kouiit si ma meto piigap Israel koba.
Yeityo koleenji `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Musa, “Chuul eung'ung' tokyi kipsengwet, si kobiit mesundeito eng' emetap Misiri, mesundeito ne kitung'dung'yoti.”
Ki chuul anyun Musa eunnyi kotokyi kipsengwet, ak ki piit mesundeito ne oo miising' eng' emet komugul ne po Misiri eng' peetuusyek somok.
Ki ma imuuch chii kogeer chii eng' Misirik, ak ki ma ng'eet chii eng' ye tebee eng' peetuusyechooto somok. Ago kilapkeen meng'otosyek tugul che po piigap Israel.
Ki kuur `Pharaoh Musa yeityo koleenji, “Oba, oboisyechi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor. Omut lagokwok kobootok ago omete neekwok ak tuukwok kotebi.”
Ago ki leenji Musa, “Kanyool kora ichamwech che kienyei ak kagoochinoik che kibeelei, si kobiit keeng'ji tiseiywot Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindennyo.

Kikwerye akwotisyekyok ak icheek. Ma ng'etu agot agenge. Amu chooto che kekwerye si keboisyechine Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindennyo amu ma kingen kiit ne kanyool keboisyechine Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, agoi tuun keit olooto.”
Ago ki iuit `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor muguleldap Pharaoh, ak ki ma chamji inee Pharaoh icheek koba.
Ki leenji Pharaoh Musa, “Pet eng' ole ami, ak iriipkei, ama ta igeera togoch kogeny, amu imee eng' peetuut ne igeere togeennyu.”
Kowolji Musa agine koleenji, “Kaimwa komyee; ma ageerin togoch kogeny.”
Ki leenji `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Musa, “Kang'et koroito agenge neta aipchini Pharaoh ak Misiriik, ak ye ibata kochamwok obe eng' olito. Ye kagochamwok obe, koonok omande ne matiny.
Mwachi anyun piik kogas komyee ileenji kosoom chii age tugul chiitap kokwennyi tuguuk che po fedha ak che po thahabu.”
Ki yai Kamuktaindet ne Toroor anyun piik konyoor chameet eng' Misiriik. Ne siirei nooto, ko kitagunoot miising' Musa eng' emetap Misiri eng' taitap otwogigap Pharaoh ak eng' taitap piik.
Ki leenji `Musa Pharaoh, “Kamwa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: alabuli Misiri ko neegit kemoi kween.

Pegu anyun kiboretook tugul eng' emetap Misiri kobooch taita ne po Pharaoh ne tebee ng'echereetap pounateet agoi taita ne po kwondo ne otwogindet ne ng'aisei. Agot kirgit age tugul ne twatei tyony age tugul, kobegu.
Piitu kateiyet ne oo ne kitom kobiitu eng' emetap Misiri komugul ak ma kobiitu ne uu nooto kogeny.
Ago eng' piigap Israel koma mi agot seset ne imuuchi koseng'eng'ji chii anan tyony. Si kobiit onai ole ibestos `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Misiriik ak Israel.

Yeityo kochoorgei anyun otwogichuguk kobwa ole ami ak kong'uruukso eng' tainnyu eng' konyit ne oo, koleen, ‘Mande inyee ak piik tugul che isubin.’ Ye ibata nooto, awe amande anyun.” Kingo pata kwo Musa eng' ole mi Pharaoh eng' nereegek che laldos.
Ki leenji `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Musa, “Eesyoi Pharaoh kogasak, asi kobiit kotesagis kochang'a kwang'utikyuk eng' emetap Misiri.”
Nganda ki yai Musa ak Aron kwang'utichuuto tugul eng' taitap Pharaoh, ko ki iuit `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor muguleldap Pharaoh ak ki ma chamji piigap Israel koba eng' emennyi.
Ki ng'alaalji `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Musa ak Aron eng' emetap Misiri, koleenji,
“Egu eng' okweek arawani taunetap arawek ak koek arawet ne po tai eng' kenyiit.
Omwachi tuiyet komugul ne po Israel oleenji eng' peetuutap taman ne po arawani, konam chii age tugul eng' koot age tugul aarwet ko uu ole tee kooriigap kwanisyekwak.
Ngo ng'ering' piik eng' kapchii ne ma imuuchi koam arwanooto, konyolu anyun koyomogei ak chiitap kokwennyi ko uu koitetap piik. Yeityo kolewen aarwet koiityin chii age tugul che tee che imuuchi koam.
Egu arweng'wong' mengit ne libwoop ne ma siirei kenyiit agenge. Oleweni arwanooto eng' keechiirek anan ko ng'oroorek.
Yeityo otabaan agoi koit peetuutap taman ak ang'wan ne po arawaniito, si koeny anyun piigap Israel aarekwak eng' koskoleng'utap peetuunooto.
Ingonam icheek anyun korotiik ak koilee tugatugik tuwai ak rateiywotap tugatuk eng' koot age tugul ne ki ame arwanooto.
Amei kemounooto panyechooto kagibeel eng' ma, koamdoi magatiinik che ma kinde mermereek kobooto ingweek che ng'woneen.
Amoam ko tuonen, amat oyo agot kitigin eng' peek, ago obeele eng' ma metit, keelyek ak tuguugap ke.
Ne siirei nooto ko mat kong'et agot kitigin kot koeekyi. Ago ne kang'et agoi koeech obeel eng' ma.
Oame anyun ko kaoratkei, ko kaolaach kweonikwok, oting'e eunekwok kirokweek ak oam ochokyini. Niito ko paska ne po Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Amu eng' kemounooto, abunoti kwenutap emetap Misiri, ak abar kiboretook tugul eng' emonooto, che po piik ak che po tai tyong'ik ak arwookyi kamuktaik tugul che po Misiri. Aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Egu anyun korotichooto ko oile tugatugik kaboorunet eng' okweek eng' kooriikwok ole omi. Ye ageer korotiik asiirtoenok ak ma ityinok koroato konyo kong'emak ye abare emetap Misiri,
Egu peetuuniito peetuutap kabwaatet eng' okweek. Oriip kobunji igoorto ne po Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ak oyai igoorito koek ng'atuutyet eng' ibinwekwok tugul agoi koigeny.

Oam magatiinik che ma kinde mermereek peetuusyek tisap. Oistoi eng' peetuut ne tai mermereek eng' kooriikwok. Amu king'etoi age tugul eng' Israel ne kaam magatiinik che mi mermereek eng' kong'etee peetuut ne po tai agoi ne po tisap.
Peetuut ne po tai ak ne po tisap ko egu eng' okweek peetuutap kayumetapkei ne itabaanat ne tiliil. Ma kiyaei poisyo age tugul eng' peetuusyechooto, kobatee kochop chii age tugul amitwogik che amei.

Oriip igoori po magatiinik che ma kinde mermereek amu ki eng' peetuuni ne ki among'u lugosyekwok komang'une emetap Misiri. Amu nooto anyun oriip ak oyai igoori eng' peetuuniito eng' ibinwekwok tugul ak koek ng'atuutyet ne po koigeny.
Oame anyun magatiinik che ma kinde mermereek eng' arawet ne po tai eng' koskoleng'utap peetuutap taman ak ang'wan agoi koskoleng'utap peetuutap tiptem ak agenge.
Ma kinyoorchin kooriikwok mermereek eng' peetuusyechooto tisap: King'etoi eng' Israel age tugul ne amei ne kaginde mermereek, ngo ne kiprutoiyo anan ko ne ki kisikyin emoniito.
Moame kiy age tugul ne kaginde mermereek. Oame magatiinik che ma kinde mermereek eng' meng'otosyekwok tugul.”
Ki kuur anyun `Musa poisyek tugul che po Israel ak koleenji, “Oba olewenote eng' akweetap keechiirek kobeate kapchii ak oeeny koek tiseiywotap paska.
Onam ratuutyetap keetiik che kiguure husop, ak orooch korotiik che mi taabeet ak oise korotichooto rateiywotap tugatuk ak tugatugik tuwai. Amat komanda chii saang' agoi koeech.

Amu nyoo kosiirtoi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kowendi kobarei taiywegap Misiriik. Ye keer korotiik eng' rateiywotap tugatuk ak eng' tugatugik tuwai eng' kooriikwok, kosiirto ineendet eng' kurganooto ak ma chamjin ng'emindet komong' nyoo kobaraak.
Oriibe anyun ng'olyoondoni koek ng'atuutyet ne po koigeny eng' inyee ak weeriiguk.
Ak ye tuun oit emet ne koonok Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ko uu ye ki koaror oriip anyun igoorito.
Ye tuun teebenak lagokwok, kole, ‘Po nee igoorito?’

Oleenji anyun icheek, ‘Tiseiywot ni ne po paska ne kigonyite Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne kisiirtoe kooriigap piigap Israel ak kosar eng' Misiri ye kingo parei Misiriik.’ ” Ak ki ing'uruukso piik kolas Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ki pa anyun piigap Israel koyai ko uu ye kiga ng'at `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Musa ak Aron.

Kingo it kemoi kween, kobar Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kiboretook tugul eng' emetap Misiri kobooch taita ne po Pharaoh agoi taita ne po luulenet ne ki rataat eng' korgoreet ak tugul che kitwatei tyong'ik.
Ki ng'eet anyun Pharaoh kemoi kobooto otwogikyik tugul ak Misiriik tugul. Ki piit kateiyet ne oo eng' Misiri amu ki ma ng'et koot agot agenge ne ki ma mee chii.
Eng' kemounooto, ko ki iyookto Pharaoh keguur Musa ak Aron koleenji, “Ong'eetyee ak obe eng' oldap piikyuk okweek kobooto piigap Israel. Oba, oboisyechi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ko uu ye ki omwa.
Okweri keechiirekwok ak tuukwok ak obe, ak oberuura agane.”
Ki ichirchir `Misiriik piik kochaakta komanda eng' emet, amu ki le, “Ngo mobe kebegu tugul.”
Ki nam anyun piik magatiinik che tuonen che tomo kinde mermereek ak tereenikwak che kikwang'e ak ye kingo kagorate ngoroikwak, konde tigigoikwak kola.
Ki yai piigap Israel ko uu ng'olyootap Musa, ki soom Misiriik tuguugap fedha ak thahabu ak ngoroik.
Ki igoochi `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Misiriik kocham Yahudik, ak ki igoochi kiy age tugul ne ki soom. Amu nooto, ko ki nyaban anyun Yahudik tuguugap Misiriik.
Ki pa anyun piigap Israel kong'eetyee Rameses agoi koit Sukoth. Ki neegit murenik eliphuusyek pogol lo che ki pendi eng' keelyek, koma ki itito kwonyiik ak lagok.
Ki pa kobooto icheeget tuiyet ne oo ne po piik alak tugul che teerchiin; kobooto keechiirek ak tuuga che chaang'.

Ki peel magatiinik che tuonen che mengeechen che ki ma kinde mermereek che ki ibune Misiri. Ki ma kinde mermereek amu ki kioon eng' Misiri ak ki mata komuuch konyoor poroindo ne chopchinegei amitwogik alak tugul.
Kiga kotebi anyun piigap Israel eng' Misiri kenyiisyek pogol ang'wan ak sosom.
Kingo pata kenyisyechooto pogol ang'wan ak sosom, komanda eng' peetuunooto lugoosyek tugul che po Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' emetap Misiri.

Kemounooto ki riip Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ak kosar piigap Israel, ko egu kemout ne kanyool kibwaate Kamuktaindet ne Toroor amu ki imut icheek komong' eng' emetap Misiri. Niito ko kemoutap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne ibwaati piigap Israel tugul eng' ibinwekwak tugul.
Ki leenji `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Musa ak Aron, “Che isubu ko ng'atuutik che po paska: Ma amei too ne ma agenge eng' piigap Israel,
ago otwogindet ne po chii age tugul ne ki kiale silingisyek ne kigeyatita, kechamji koam.
Ma amei punootyot anan otwogindet ne nyooru melekto.
Kiame koot agenge; amat oip peeny komanda saang' agot kitigin. Amat oiri kawet age tugul.
Kanyool anyun koyai ko uu nooto Israel komugul.

Ago ngo rutochin kiprutoiyot ne machei koboiboenji paska ne po Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ko kanyool kimuratan muren age tugul ne mi kobooto ineendet. Yeityo koriikyi anyun eng' yooto ak koriip, ak kogergeit ak ne ki kisikyi emeng'wong'. Ago among' koam chii age tugul ne ma kiyatita.
Ng'atuutyet niito ko agenge ak kogergei eng' ne ki kisikyin emeng'wong' ak eng' ne toondet ne rutochinok.”
Ki yai piigap Israel tugul ko uu ye ki ng'at `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Musa ak Aron.
Ak ki imaanda Kamuktaindet ne Toroor peetuunooto piigap Israel eng' emetap Misiri eng' lugosyekwak.
Ki leenji `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Musa,
“Itabaanwa kiboretook tugul. Punjino age tugul ne yaatei iyoteet eng' piigap Israel, eng' piik ak eng' che po tai eng' tyong'ik.”

Yeityo koleenji `Musa piik, “Obwaat anyun peetuuni ki omang'une Misiri kootap otwoknateet. Amu ki imoong'wok Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' kimnateetap eunnyi omang'une olooto. Eng' peetuuni anyun koma ki amei magatiinik che kaginde mermereek.
Omandoi rani eng' arawetap Abib.

Ye kagomutak Kamuktaindet ne Toroor oit emetap Kanaanik, Hitik, Amorik, Hibik ak ne po Jebusik; emet ne ki iyasyechi `ineendet kwanisyeguk kole tuun koonok emet ne nyiitaat cheego ak komi kumyat eng' chaang'indo. Amu nooto anyun, kanyoolu oriip ak oyai igoorita eng' kenyiit age tugul eng' arawaniito.
Oame magatiinik che ma kinde mermereek eng' peetuusyek tisap ak koek igoortap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor peetuutap tisap.
Ki amei eng' peetuusyechooto tugul tisap magatiinik che ma kinde mermereek. Amat kenyoorchi chii magatiinik che ki kinde mermereek ak amat kobiitune emeng'ung' komugul mermereek.
Tuun anyun imwachini weeriing'ung' eng' peetuunooto ileenjini, ‘Ayae niito amu kiit ne ki yaiywo Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ye ki among'u eng' Misiri.’

Ak tuun egu nooto kaboorunet eng' eung'ung' ak koek kabwaatet ne mi kwenutap konyeguk si kobiit kotebee ng'atuutigap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kuting'ung'. Amu ki imoong'wok Kamuktaindet ne Toroor omang'une Misiri eng' euut ne kiim.
Ara anyun oyai igoori eng' peetuunnyi ne ki king'atyi eng' kenyiit age tugul.
“Ye tuun iitak Kamuktaindet ne Toroor emetap Kanaanik ko uu ye ki iyasyeun ak kwanisyeguk kole koonok,
itabaan anyun kobunji Kamuktaindet ne Toroor tugul che yaatei iyoteet. Ak che po tai tyong'ik ko punjin Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ityachi ne twatei sigiryet, ityage aarwetap keechiir, ago ngo metyach iirye kaatinyi. Ityachi taita age tugul eng' weeriiguk.

Ye tuun teebenen weeriing'ung' eng' peetuusyek che pwoonei, koleenjin, ‘Amu nee si keyai ko uu niito?’ Ileenji anyun, ‘Ki imoong'wech Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' Misiri eng' kootap otwoknateet, eng' euut ne kiim.
