Ak ye kingo etenech Pharaoh keebe, kobar anyun `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor taita age tugul eng' emetap Misiri, che po piik ak che kitwatei tyong'ik. Ara anyun aeng'jini Kamuktaindet ne Toroor tugul che yaatei iyoteet, che kiruugik. Ago atyachi weeriikyuk tugul che yaatei iyoteet.’
Egu niito kaboorunet eng' eung'ung' ak koek ratuutik che kirate anook eng' turyetap togeng'ung'. Amu ki imutwech Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' euut ne kiim kemang'une Misiri.”

Kingo kagounda `Pharaoh piik koba, koma indochi `Kamuktaindet icheek kobun ooreet ne punei emetap Philistik, nganda ki neegit. Amu ki le Kamuktaindet, “Si ma iyweis piik ye keer lugeet, ak komach koweekyigei Misiri.”
Ago ki indochinot `Kamuktaindet piik kobun surkwen ne tokyingei Araraita ne Piriir. Ki togosta anyun piigap Israel komanda eng' emetap Misiri ko kagolaach kariik.
Ki ip `Musa kawegap Joseph. Amu kiga kogimgim `ineendet piigap Israel koyasyo koleenji, “Ye tuun kanyonjok Kamuktaindet ne Toroor iman kosarwok, oip kawekyuk obendi otogostoi eng' oli.”
Ki inam anyun pandanywa kong'eetyee Sukoth, ak ki pa komuung'e Etam eng' ole poochin surkwen.
Ki indoe icheek `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' toloitap pooldet peet, ak kondochi icheek kemoi eng' toloitap maat, kokweng'ji; si kobiit komuuch koba peet ak kemoi.
Ki ma isto ineendet eng' taitap piik toloitap pooldet peet, ama isto toloata po maat kemoi.
Yeityo koleenji `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Musa,
“Mwachi lagogap Israel koweek komuung'e taitap Pi-hairot kwenutap Migdol ak nyanjet ole itoorchingei Baal-sepon ak komuung'e yooto neegitee nyanjet.
Amu tuun mwaei Pharaoh agobo piigap Israel koleen, ‘Ki kobetyo eng' emet ak ki kogeer surkwen icheek.’

Eng' yooto kogeny auuiiti muguleldap Pharaoh si koosup icheek ak anyoorunee teegisto Pharaoh ak lugeennyi tugul si konai Misiriik kole aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.” Ki yai anyun piigap Israel ko uu nooto.

Ki ngemwachi laitoryatap Misiri keleenji, “Kogoba komweiso piik,” kogiwalak muguleldanyi ak kowalagis mugulelwegap otwogikyik agobo piigap Israel ak ki ibwaat icheek kole, “Nee kii kogeyai, kot kechamji Yahudik koba kometo otwoknateet ne kootech?”
Ki chop anyun chepkichutitap paraisiit ak komut asigarikyik che po lugeet.
Ki ip kariisyegap paraisisyek che po lugeet pogol lo che ki kilewen ak kariisyegap paraisisyek che po lugeet alak che po Misiri kotinyei age tugul kiptainikwak che ki pou.
Ki iuit Kamuktaindet ne Toroor muguleldap Pharaoh laitoryatap Misiri ak ki isup piigap Israel che kimondoi eng' kimnateet ne oo.

Ki isup `Misiriik icheek ak paraisisyek tugul, kariisyek che po Pharaoh, piikyik che ki laanyei paraisisyek ak lugeennyi. Ki namji icheek ole ki imuung'ee eng' ye neegit nyanjet, koriikyin Pi-hairot ole tokyingei Baal-sepon.
Ye kingo riikta Pharaoh, kotabendo piigap Israel ak ki keer kobwanei Misiriik kosubu icheek. Ki toi koyweis miising' ak koriirchi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ki ing'ung'ung'ji `icheek Musa ak koleenji, “Tos ki imutwech kebekyi surkwoni amu ki ma komi kereeriisyek Misiri? Amu nee si iyaiywech ko uu ni, imoong'wech eng' Misiri?
Tos ma ki kimwaun eng' Misiri keleenjin, ‘Pagaaktech keoot Misiriik?’ Amu kita kaigai keoot Misiriik kosiir kebekyi surkwen.”
Ago ki wolji `Musa piik koleenji, “Amoiywei, ogany kityo si ogeer yetunetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne yaiywok rani. Amu ma ogeere kogeny misirichu ogeere rani.
Yaei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ineendet lugeet agobo okweek; osisye okweek.”
Koleenji `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Musa, “Amu nee si iriircho? Ileenji piigap Israel koba kotestai.
Namji parak kiroktong'ung' ak ichuul eung'ung' itokyi nyanjet, si kopcheak kobun aeng' ak kobun piigap Israel kwenutap nyanjet, ng'wonyut ole yaamaat.
Auuiiti aneendet mugulelwegap Misiriik, si koosup icheek ak anyoorunee teegisto Pharaoh, lugeennyi tugul, kariisyekyik ak piikyik che ketei paraisisyek.
Ye kaanyoorunee teegisto Pharaoh, kariisyekyik, ak piikyik che ketei paraisisyek, konai Misiriik kole aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.”
Ki wo anyun let malaikaiyatap Kamuktaindet ne ki indoe piigap Israel ak ki wo kora toloitap pooldet ne ki mi tainnywa ak kotonone let.

Kitonone kwenutap lugeetap Misiriik ak tuiyetap Israel. Kingo imen, kooluu poldanooto kookweng'ji piigap Israel, ak ki mi mesundeito komostap Misiriik; ki ma riikyin lugeetap Misiriik ak tuiyetap piigap Israel eng' kemout komugul.
Ki chuul Musa eunnyi kotokyi nyanjet ak ki iyook Kamuktaindet usoonet ne punu kong'asiis kous kemout komugul koobeesyo peek si kobiit emet ne yaamaat; ak kipcheigei peek.
Ki pa anyun piigap Israel kobun emet ne yaamaat eng' kwenutap nyanjet. Kitoten peek eng' komostap tai ak eng' komostap kaataam.
Ki isup `Misiriik icheek kochoorchigei kwenutap nyanjet; paraisisyek tugul che po Pharaoh ak kariisyekyik ak piikyik che ketei paraisisyek.
Eng' riipseet ne po karon, kogeerot Kamuktaindet ne Toroor lugeetap Misiri, kogeerunee toloitap maat ak ne po pooldet ak kogochi lugeetap Misiriik koaragenso.
Kichun keelyegap kariisyekwak ak kong'onng'onio kot ko ye ki kwerye ko uueen. Kole anyun Misiriik, “Ongemwee Yahudik amu yaei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor lugeet agobo icheek konyo kobarech acheek.”
Yeityo koleenji `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Musa, “Chuul eung'ung' tokyi nyanjet si kobiit koweigei peek kotuch Misiriik kobooto kariisyekwak ak piikwak che laanyei mbatanyisyek.”

Ki chuul Musa eunnyi kotokyi nyanjet ak ki weigei peek kotuiyo ko uu yegonye ko kaeech. Ki mweiso Misiriik ye kingo keer peek kotokyingei icheeget ago kitoorchi `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Misiriik kwenutap nyanjet.
Ki weigei peek komaaluuch kariisyek, piik che ketei paraisisyek ak lugeet tugul ne po Pharaoh ne ki isubi icheek kobendi nyanjet. Ki ma ng'et agot agenge eng' icheek.
Ago ki pun piigap Israel ng'wonyut ne yaamaat eng' kwenutap nyanjet ko katoten peek eng' komosi ak komosi.
Ki sar eng' peetuunooto anyun `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Israel eng' eunegap Misiriik ak ki keer `Israel Misiriik ko kagobek komi ngeguutap nyanjet.
Ki keer Israel poisyet ne kiim ne ki yachi `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Misiriik. Ki iywei anyun `piik Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ak koyan `icheek ineendet ak Musa otwogindennyi.

Ki tyen tyeni Musa kobooto piigap Israel kotyenji Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole, “Atyenjini Kamuktaindet ne Toroor amu ki ibelis eng' kabelisyet ne toroor miising'. Ki wiirchi araraita paraisiit kobooto chiito ne kibunei.
Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ko kimnateennyu ak tyendanyu, ak yetunennyu. Niito Kamuktaindennyu ak alasu ineendet; Ineendet ko Kamuktaindet ne po abba, atoroori ineendet.
Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ineendet ko ne po lugeet. Kainennyi ko Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ki wiirchi araraita kariisyegap Pharaoh kobooto lugeennyi. Ki imaluuch Araraita ne Piriir kiptainikyik che ki lewen.
Ki tuch icheek rirosyek ak kirorokta koba rirosyek ko uu koita.
Eung'ung' ne po tai, ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ko konyitot eng' kimnateet, Eung'ung' ne po tai, ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ko nyinyiri puunik kotonatonagis.
Iluuli icheek che ng'eetyinin eng' ooindap telunateng'ung'. Iyooktoi nereegeguk; peelei icheek kowong'kei ko uu mobeek.
Ki iyumgei peek amu kimnateetap kabuuset ne po seruneguk; kitononso peek kotooten; kinamgei peek kouegitu eng' araraita kween.
Ki le puunyoot, Asubi, aname ak apchei che kagiluul, ak kobiyong'e magennyu icheek. Ang'usu rotwennyu po chok, ak kobar eunnyu icheek.
Ki iusyi eng' usooneng'ung', ak ki tuch `araraita icheek. Kirorokyi peek che kiimeen oriit ko uu ngosyelait.
Ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, tos ngoro ne uu inyee eng' kamuktaik? Tos ng'oo ne uu inyee, ne konyitot eng' tiliilindo, ne kiywei eng' kalasunet, ne yaei kwang'utik?
Ki ichuul eung'ung' ne po tai ak kilugui `ng'wony icheek.
Ki indochi inyee eng' rireeneng'ung' piik che ki ityaach komanda; ki indochi icheek eng' kimnateng'ung' koba oldang'ung' ne tiliil.
Ki kas pororyosyek alage, ak kibotanso; kinyoor ng'wanindo che menyei Philistia.
Ki tang'any anyun kirwoogik che po Edom; potandos che kiimeen che po Moabik; kachootyo tugul che menyei Kanaan.
Kanam icheek kamuiset ak kaiyweisyet; eng' etunatetap eung'ung', ko siisyo ko uu koita; agoi kolanda piiguk, ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, agoi kolanda piik che ki ial.
Imutu icheek komong' ak inde icheek kominogis eng' tulweetap poroteng'ung', komosta ne ki ichopchigei si imeny, ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Ole-Tiliil, ee Kamuktaindet, ne ki kogimit eung'ung'.
Laitorani Kamuktaindet ne Toroor koigeny ak koigeny.”

Kingo pa paraisisyek che po Pharaoh nyanjet kobooto kariisyekyik ak piikyik che ketei paraisisyek ko ki iweech Kamuktaindet ne Toroor peegap nyanjet kogeny kotuch icheek; ago kibun piigap Israel emet ne yaamaat eng' kwenutap nyanjet.
Ki nam anyun Miriam kwondo ne maotyoo, chepkametap Aron, sugutit ne ming'in eng' eunnyi ak ki isup `ineendet kwonyiik tugul che ki ibei sugutisyek che mengeechen kotyenoti.
Ki wolji Miriam koleenji, “Otyenji Kamuktaindet ne Toroor amu ki ibelis eng' kabelisyet ne toroor miising'; ki kiwiirchi nyanjet paraisiit kobooto ne ki laanyei.”
Ki indochi `Musa Yahudik koba eng' Araraita ne Piriir ak ki it surkwen ne po Sur. Ki pa pandap peetuusyek somok eng' surkwen ak ki ma nyoor peek.
Kingo it Marah, koma komuuch koe peegap Marah amu king'woneen. Ki kiguure anyun kainennyi Marah amu nooto.
Ki ing'unyng'ung'ji `piik Musa, koleenji, “Ki ee nee?”

Ki riirchi `Musa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ak ki iboorchi `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ineendet keetit. Ki nam keetoto yeityo kowiirchi peek ak ki anyinyitu. Kichopchi `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor icheek eng' olooto ng'atuutyet ak kirwooget kotyeme icheeget:

ak ki le, “Ngot igas iman kutitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindeng'ung', iyai ne po iman eng' tainnyi, iepchji iit ng'atuutikyik ak isup katigonutikyik tugul, koma koonin myan age tugul ne ki agoochi Misiriik, amu anee ko aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne asaabin.”
Ki it anyun icheek ole kiguure Elim, ole ki mi kong'igap peek tamanu ak aeng' ak tiironigap sosik tamanwogik tisap; ak ki imuung'ee icheek ole neegitee peechooto.

Ki inam anyun pandanywa kong'eetyee Elim, ak ki it tuiyet komugul ne po piigap Israel surkwen ne po Sin ne mi kwenutap Elim ak Sinai. Ki it olooto eng' peetuutap taman ak muut ne po arawetap aeng' kobooch ye kingo mong' eng' emetap Misiri.
Ki ing'unyng'ung'ji tuiyet komugul ne po piigap Israel Musa ak Aron eng' surkwen.

Ki leenji `piigap Israel icheek, “Kita kaigai kebegu eng' eutap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' emetap Misiri ye ki kitebee ole neegitee tereenigap panyeek ye ki kiamisyei kot kebiyong'se, ago ki omoong'wech kebwa surkwenini si obare rubeet tuiyoni komugul.”

Ki leenji `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Musa anyun, “Aroong'wok amitwogik che punu kipsengwet. Pendi piik peetuut age tugul koyumi che yamei peetuut si kobiit atyem icheek anai ngo muuchi koosup ng'atuutyennyu.
Eng' peetuut ne po lo, ye chobei icheek amitwogichooto che kaip kobwa ko, konyilee aeng' eng' che po kotugul.”
Ki leenji `Musa ak `Aron piigap Israel tugul, “Onae koskoleny ole ki imutwak Kamuktaindet ne Toroor omang'une emetap Misiri,
ak ogeer karon telunatetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor amu kasei ineendet kang'unyng'unyeng'wong' ne ong'unyng'ung'jini Kamuktaindet ne Toroor. Acheek anyun ko king'o si ong'unyng'ung'jech?”

Ki le Musa, “Koonok anyun Kamuktaindet ne Toroor panyeek oam koskoleny, ak koonok karon magatiinik oam obiye amu kasei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kang'unyng'unyeng'wong' ne ong'unyng'ung'jini ineendet. Acheek ko king'o? Ma acheek che ong'unyng'ung'jini ago ong'unyng'ung'jini Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.”
Ki leenji `Musa Aron, “Ileenji tuiyet komugul ne po piigap Israel, ‘Obwa oriikyi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor amu kogogas kang'unyng'unyeng'wong'.’ ”
Ak ye kita kong'alaaljin `Aron tuiyet komugul ne po piigap Israel, kitabendo kotokyigei surkwen ak ki took eng' pooldet liilindap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ki ng'alaalji `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Musa koleenji,
“Kaagas kang'unyng'unyetap piigap Israel. Mwachi ileenji, ‘Oame panyeek koskoleny ak oam obiye magatiinik karon si onai ole aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindeng'wong'.’ ”
Ki pwa taok koskoleny konyi nganaseet ak ki ibut rewoot karon koyiem nganaseet.
Ye kingo togosta rewoot ne koga ibut, kotook eng' surkwen tuguuk che mengeechen che tertereen komi ng'wony che uu chepkoset.
Ye kingo keer piigap Israel tuguuchooto, koteebegei icheegei, kole, “Nee tuguuchuuto?” Amu ki ma nai tuguuchooto. Ak ki leenji Musa, “Amitwogik chuuto che kagoonok Kamuktaindet ne Toroor oam.

Niito kiit ne kong'at Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole, ‘Ingoyum chii tugul che yamei koam. Yamei chii tugul che po kerebet ne kiguure omer; ingoipchi chii age tugul che yamei koitetap piikyik che mi koonnyi.’ ”
Ki yai ko uu nooto piigap Israel ak ki iyum alak che chaang', koyum alage che ng'ering'.
Ye kingo ker eng' kerebet, koma siirto che po ineendet ne kagaiyum che chaang', ak ki ma ng'ering'itu che po ineendet ne kagaiyum che ng'ering'. Ki iyum chii tugul che yamei koam.
Ki leenji `Musa icheek, “Amat kotuuch chii agoi koeech.”
Ago ki ma kas iit alage eng' icheek kiit ne kimwachin Musa. Ki ituuch kotep kot koeech ak ki am kuutik ak ki pulyo. Ki nereekyi anyun `Musa pichooto.
Ki iyumi karonet age tugul che yamei koam chii tugul ak kingo ng'wanit asiis kochootyo.
Ki iyum eng' peetuut ne po lo che tee che cham koyumi konyil aeng': kereboonik aeng' chii tugul. Ak ki pa pounik tugul che po tuiyet komwachi Musa.

Ki leenji `Musa icheek, “Nooto ko kiit ne ki mwa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: ‘mutai ko kamuung'et, sabato ne itabaanat eng' Kamuktaindet ne Toroor. Obeel che omache obeel, ak oyoi che omache oyoi ak ogonorchigei che kang'et kobunji mutai.’ ”
Ki konor kobunji mutai ko uu ye ki mwachi Musa, ak ki ma pulyo ama ki nyoorchi kuutik.
Ki le Musa, “Oam chooto rani; amu sabato ne po Kamuktaindet ne Toroor rani, monyoorchini rani emet.
Oyumi eng' peetuusyek lo; ago eng' peetuutap tisap ko sabato, ma piitu eng' peetuunooto.”
Ki pa alage eng' peetuutap tisap koleen koyumat, ago ma nyoor.
Ki leenji `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Musa, “Oeesyoi osup ng'atuutikyuk ak kayomisutikyuk kot kotyanit?
Onai ole kagoonok anee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor sabato; eng' nooto anyun agoonok amitwogik eng' peetuutap lo che yamei peetuusyek aeng'; ingotebee chii tugul oldanyi, amat kwo ui eng' peetuutap tisap.”
Ki imuuny anyun piik eng' peetuutap tisap.
Ki kuure kootap Israel amitwogichooto Mana: ki kergei tuguuchooto ak peek che mubere che leelach ak ki chamu magatiinik che mengeechen che ki kikwanda kumyat.

Ki le Musa, “Niito kiit ne kong'at Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole, Kinyiit kerebet agenge tuguuchooto, kegonorchi ibinwekwok che piitu let si kobiit kogeer amitwogichooto che ki abaenak eng' surkwen ye ki among'wok omang'une emetap Misiri.”
Ki leenji `Musa Aron, “Inemu tereet ne ming'in, inyiit mana che yamei kerebet agenge ak igonor eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, kegonorchi ibinwek che piitu let.”
Ki igonor anyun Aron eng' taitap paornateet kole keriip ko uu ye ki ng'at `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Musa.
Ki am piigap Israel mana kenyiisyek artam agoi koit emet ne menyei piik. Ki am mana agoi koit kiwotosyegap emetap Kanaan.
Kerebonooto kigeree mana ne kiguure omer ko aechin ak kebebertap taman ne po epah.

Ki inam panda anyun tuiyet komugul ne po piigap Israel kong'eetyee surkwen ne po Sin, ko uu ye king'atei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor. Eng' let ko ki it Rephidim ak komuung'so, nganda ki ma komi peek olooto che eei piik.
Amu nooto, ko ki polyo piik kobolji Musa koleenji, “Inagech peek kee.” Ak ki leenji `Musa icheek, “Amu nee si oboljo? Amu nee si otyem Kamuktaindet ne Toroor?”
Ki am piik melelda eng' olooto, ak ki ing'unyng'ung'ji `icheek Musa ak koleenji, “Kilya si imutwech acheek, lagokyok ak akwotisyekyok kemang'une Misiri ak inyoo ibarenech melelda?”
Ki riirchi `Musa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor koleenji, “Alyonji pichu? Neegit kolacha!”
Ak ki wolji `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Musa koleenji, “Ui indoe piik ak imut poisyegap Israel alak. Ip kiroktong'ung' ne ki ikwere aineet.
Atonone taing'ung' eng' yooto po rwandet eng' Horeb. Ikwere rwandanooto komang'une peek si kobiit koe piik.” Ki yai anyun Musa ko uu nooto eng' taitap poisyegap Israel.
Ak ki kuure yooto Masa ak Meriba, amu polatetap `piigap Israel che ki tyem Kamuktaindet ne Toroor koleen, “Tos iman mi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kobootech?”
Ki pwa anyun Amelek nyoo kobaregei ak Israel eng' Rephidim.
Ki leenji `Musa Joshua, “Lewenwech piik, ak obe obargei ak Amelek. Awendi atononi mutai eng' tulweet parak, atinye eng' eunyu kirokto ne po Kamuktaindet.”
Ki yai anyun Joshua ko uu ye kiga komwachi Musa ak ki wo kobargei ak Amelek. Ki togosta anyun Musa tulweet parak kobooto Aron ak Hur.
Ki yaak ko uu ni: ye kingo namji Musa parak eunnyi koterteeris Israel, ak ye kingo tu koterteeris Amelek.

Kingo ng'etyo anyun eunegap Musa, konam Aron ak Hur koita kondechi kotebee ineendet, yeityo konam eunekyik kotononso; ki nam age eutap tai, konam age murot kaataam konamji parak. Kitononso eunegap Musa agoi kororokto asiis.
Ki iterteer anyun `Joshua Amelek ak piikyik eng' rotwetap chok.
Ki leenji `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Musa, “Sirchi ng'aleechu bukuit si koek ne kibwaatee, somanji Joshua kogas, amu abuuktoi kabwaatetap Amelek kobet eng' kurereetap kipsengwet.
Ki teech Musa kaptisisyet, ak koguure yooto Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne iterteerwa.”
Ak ki le, “Kagoyosyo Kamuktaindet ne Toroor koyai lugeet ak Amelek eng' ibinwek tugul.”
Ki kas anyun Jethro tisiindetap Midian, kabyugoitap Musa agobo tugul che ki koyachi `Kamuktaindet Musa ak piikyik Israel. Ki kas ole ki imutunda `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Israel komang'une Misiri.
Ki imut anyun `Jethro Ziporah, osotyotap Musa amu kiga koweekta Musa ineendet kwo,
ak weeriikyik aeng'. Ki kiguure age Gerson, amu ki le, “Ki aegunote kiprutoiyo eng' emetap pororyosyek alak”,
ak ki kiguure age Elieser; amu ki le, “Ki ek toretindennyu Kamuktaindet ne po abba ak kisarwo eng' rotwetap chok ne po Pharaoh.”
Ki wo anyun Jethro kobooto weeriigap Musa ak osotyonnyi ole ki mi Musa eng' surkwen komuunyi eng' tulweetap Kamuktaindet.
Ki iyookto ineendet keleenji Musa, “Kaaitu oling'ung' anee Jethro kabyugoing'ung' kobooto osotyondeng'ung' ak weeriikyik aeng'.”
Ki manda anyun Musa kwo kotorookta kapyugoinnyi. Ki ing'uruuk ak kotoroochkei ak kiteebegei chametapkei yeityo komanda koba emait oriit.

Ki mwachi Musa anyun kapyugoinnyi tuguuk tugul che ki koyachi `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Pharaoh ak Misiriik agobo Israel, ak nyalilwogik tugul che kinyoor eng' ooreet ak ole kisaruundo icheek `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ki paibait Jethro amu myeeindo tugul ne kiga koyachi `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Israel kosar icheek komang'une eunegap Misiriik.
Ki le Jethro, “Iberuurot Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne kisarwok eng' eunegap Misiriik ak eng' eutap Pharaoh, ne ki sar piik komang'une pounatetap Misiriik.
Angen nguno anyun ale oo Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kosiir kamuktaik tugul. Amu ki sar piik eng' eunegap Misiriik che ki yachi pichooto kiit ne ya eng' menoteet.”

Eng' yooto anyun konam Jethro kabyugoitap Musa kagoochinet ne kibeelei ak tiseiywot ak koeng'ji Kamuktaindet. Ki nyo Aron kobooto poisyek tugul che po Israel koamis ak kabyugoitap Musa eng' taitap Kamuktaindet.
Eng' karonet ne po aeng', kotep ng'wony Musa korwooksechi piik. Ki tononso piik eng' ole mi Musa kong'etee karon agoi koimen.

Ye kingo keer kabyugoitap Musa tuguuk tugul che ki yachin `Musa piik, koteebe koleenji, “Nee ni iyachini piik? Amu nee si itebi inyegei ak kotonondos piik tugul ko kayiemin kobooch karon agoi koimen?”
Kowolji `Musa kapyugoinnyi koleenji, “Amu pwonjino piik si koteepse Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ye tinyei ng'olyoo kobwonjino, ak abesyechini chii tugul ak chiitap kokwennyi. Aneeti icheek konai kaneetisyosyegap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ak ng'atuutikyik.”
Koleenji anyun `kapyugoinnyi Musa, “Ma myee kii iyae.
Iwong'ugei kimnateng'ung' inyee ak ne po pichu omiitei tugul. Amu siirei kimnateng'ung' niito ago memuuchi iyai inyegei.
Kas anyun ng'olyoondennyu aboorun kiit ne iyae ak ingotep Kamuktaindet kobooten. Myee iegu ne ing'alaaljini Kamuktaindet ne kata piik ak iipchi Kamuktaindet ng'aleekwak.
Ineet icheek kaneetisyosyek, ng'atuutik ak iboorchi ooreet ne kanyolji koosup ak poisyet ne kanyolji koyai.

Nyolu kogeny ilewenote eng' piik tugul piik che kiimeen, che iywei Kamuktaindet, piigap imanit che wechei tuguugap asoya. Inde icheek koboi piik koek pounigap eliphuusyek, che po pogolwogik, che po konomusyek ak che po tamanusyek.
Ingoek icheek kirwoogik che irwookyin piik eng' peetuusyek tugul ak koibun ng'olyoot age tugul ne uui. Ago ingobesyechi icheek ng'olyoo age tugul ne ming'in, si kobiit konyamnyumun amu kogesen tugul.
Ngot iyai kiito anyun ak ngo ng'atin Kamuktaindet ko uu nooto, imuuch anyun itonon ak koba pichu tugul ak icheek oldanywa eng' kaalyeet.”
Ki kas anyun Musa ng'aleegap kapyugoinnyi ak ki yai chooto tugul kamwachi ineendet.
Ki lewenot piik che kiimeen eng' Israel tugul ak konde koboi piik koek pounik che po eliphuusyek, che po pogolwogik, che po konomusyek ak che po tamanusyek.
Ki irwookyin `icheek piik eng' peetuusyek tugul. Ki ipchi Musa ng'aleek che uueen ago ki ibesyechi icheek ng'olyoo age tugul ne ming'in.
Yeityo kochamji anyun `Musa kapyugoinnyi kwo. Ki wo anyun pandanyi agoi emennyi.
Ki it anyun piigap Israel surkwen ne po Sinai eng' arawet ne po somok kobooch ngap komanda eng' emetap Misiri.
Kingo kagoba eng' Rephidim ak koit surkwen ne po Sinai, komuung'so eng' olooto ak kotebee ye kigatokyigei tulweet.
Ki togosta Musa kwo ole mi Kamuktaindet ak kiguur `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ineendet eng' tulweet koleenji, “Mwachi ko uu ni kootap Jakobo, ak imwachi piigap Israel ileenji,
‘Ki ogeer kiit ne ki ayachi Misiriik ak ko uu ye ki agesenenak kebebaigap kipsichinik amutwak obwanjo.
Eng' nooto anyun, ngot ogas iit kutinnyu iman ak oriip kayomisennyu, oegu anyun iman eng' anee chamanikyuk che itabaanatiin eng' piik tugul, amu nenyu ng'wony komugul.
Oegu eng' anee laitornatetap tisiik ak pororyet ne itabaanat. Chuuto ng'aleek che iwendi imwachini piigap Israel.’ ”
Ki nyo anyun Musa koguur poisyegap pichooto ak kotetyi icheek ng'aleechooto tugul che ki kang'at `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ineendet.
Ki wol piik tugul eng' kibagenge kole, “Kiyae chooto tugul kamwa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.” Ki ipchi anyun `Musa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ng'aleegap piik,
ak ki leenji `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Musa, “Anyoonjinin iman eng' pooldet ne tuui si kobiit kogas piik ye ang'alaalun ak koyanin agoi.” Kingo mwachi `Musa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ng'aleegap piik,
koleenji `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ineendet, “Chortegei ui ole mi piik ianyiny icheek ra ak mutai ak ingomwet ngoroikwak.
Ingochopkei agobo peetuut ne po somok: amu choorchingei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor tulweetap Sinai eng' peetuutap somok eng' taitap piik tugul.
Tilji piik ole iboch ak ileenji; ‘Oriipkei si motogoste tulweet anan otwaa kiwotennyi. Kibarei age tugul ne tiinyei tulweet.
Ma kitiinyei eng' euut chii ne katiny kobatee kilage koik anan kemwok. Ama sabei age tugul, ngo tyony anan chii. Ye ki kuut igonditap kuinetap mengit kochulyo kotogos icheeget kobwa tulweet.’ ”
Ki choortagei Musa anyun kwo ole mi piik, kwo koanyiny icheeget ak kimwet icheek ngoroikwak.
Ki leenji piik, “Ochopkei ogen peetuutap somok amat koriikyi chii kobogoryo.”
Eng' peetuutap somok anyun, ko kaeech kobiit tuloosyek ak kalyelosyek. Ki ilaach `pooldet ne tuui tulweet ak ki mi cheetap iryageet ne cheei kot. Kibotanso piik tugul che ki mi nganaseet.
Ki indochi `Musa piik ak komuut komong' eng' nganaseet koba kotuiyo ak Kamuktaindet. Ki pa anyun piik kotononie tulweet keel.
Ki iyeni tulweet komugul ne po Sinai amu kichoorchigei `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor tulwoonooto eng' maat. Ki togosta iyetanyi ne uu ne po maat ne oo kot ak ki potan tulweet miising'.
Kingo tesak cheetap iryageet kwo parak miising', kotwek Musa ak ki wolji `Kamuktaindet ineendet eng' tuugeet.
Kichoorchigei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor tulweetap Sinai parak ak kiguur `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Musa kwo tulweet parak, ak kitogosta Musa.
Yeityo koleenji `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Musa, “Ui choortegei iteechi piik si ma put kiwateet kogeer Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ak kobek che chaang'.
Ingoanyinygei tisiik ak icheek che riikyin Kamuktaindet ne Toroor si ma par icheek.”
Ki leenji `Musa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, “Ma chamdaat eng' piik kotogos tulwooniito po Sinai, amu ki iteiywech ileenjech, ‘Onde kiwateet tulweet ak otabaan.’ ”
Ak ki wolji `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ineendet koleenji, “Ui choortegei si otogosu ak Aron. Ago amat kobut piik ak tisiik kiwateet kotogos ole mi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor si ma par `ineendet icheek.”
Ki choortagei anyun Musa kwo ole mi piik, kwo komwachi.
Ki mwa Kamuktaindet ng'aleechu tugul kole,
“Aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindeng'ung' ne ki imutun imang'une emetap Misiri, kootap otwoknateet.
“Amecheeng'jigei cheptalelisyek che teer, kobatena aneege.
“Ameyachigei kanamwet anan itoondap kiy age tugul ne mi parak kipsengwet anan ne mi ng'wony anan ne mi nyanjet ng'wony oriit;

ameng'uruukyi anan ioot icheek, amu anee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindeng'ung', ko aa Kamuktaindet ne ama ng'etkong'. Ageerchini lagok tengektap kwanisyekwak agoi ibindap somok ak ne po ang'wan eng' icheek che wecho.
Ago ariiree eliphuusyek eng' icheek che chama ak kosubi ng'atuutikyuk.
“Amemwa kainetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindeng'ung' eng' tangoi. Amu iityin Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ng'oogisto ne mwaei kainennyi eng' tangoi.
“Ibwaat peetuutap sabato, iriip itabaan.
Iboisyee peetuusyek lo ak iyai poisyoniguk tugul,

ago peetuutap tisap ko sabato ne po Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindeng'ung'. Ameyai poisyo eng' peetuunooto inyee anan weeriing'ung' anan cheptong'ung', anan otwogindeng'ung' ne muren anan otwogindeng'ung' ne tye anan tuguuk anan toondeng'ung' ne miitei kurgotiguk.

Amu ki yai Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kipsengwet ak ng'wony, nyanjet ak tuguuk tugul che mi oriitinnywa eng' peetuusyek lo ak komuuny eng' peetuutap tisap. Ki iberuur anyun Kamuktaindet ne Toroor peetuutap sabato amu nooto ak kotabaan.
“Teech kwandang'ung' ak kamenng'ung' si kochang'a peetuusyeguk eng' emet ne koonin Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindeng'ung'.
“Amerumisye.
“Amoipkei.
“Amechoorse.
“Amebaoryanji chiitap kokweng'ung' eng' lembech.

“Amegase myat kootap chiitap kokweng'ung'. Amegase myat osotyotap chiitap kokweng'ung' anan otwogindennyi ne muren anan otwogindennyi ne tye anan eitonyi anan sigiryennyi anan kiy age tugul ne po chiitap kokweng'ung'.”
Ye kingo keer piik tugul kalyelosyek ak tulweet ne ki iyeni, ak kogas tuleetap ilotik ak cheetap iryageet, kobotanso eng' arageneet ak kotononso eng' ole loo.
Ak ki leenji `icheek Musa, “Ng'alaalwech inyee si kegasin, ago amengong'alaalwech Kamuktaindet, amu ngot ko ng'alaalwech ineendet kebeguu.”
Koleenji `Musa piik, “Amoiywei, amu kanyo Kamuktaindennyo kotyemak si kotebee taing'wong' kaiyweisyennyi ne oiywei ineendet asi moyai tengek.”
Kitononso piik anyun eng' ole loo ak kiriikta Musa ole mi Kamuktaindet eng' pooldet ne tuui.
Ki leenji `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Musa, “Mwachi piigap Israel leenjin, ‘Kaogeerchigei okweegei ole, kaang'alaalwok kong'etee kipsengwet.
Amat oyachigei kanamonik otesena che po fedha, anan kanamonik che po thahabu.

Teekwo kaptisyet ne po ng'ung'unyek ak ieng'wo eng' kaptisisyonooto kagoochinoiguk che kibeelei ak kagoochinoiguk che po kaalyeet, keechiireguk ak tuguuk. Anyoonjinin ak aberuurin eng' komosta age tugul ole andoi kainennyu kibwaate.
Ngimache iteekwo kaptisisyet ne po koik, ko meteege koik che ki kiwai amu ngiwai, ko keng'wanit.
Ametogoste iwe kaptisisyennyu ibune lang'eiywot si mewe aach ngor.’ ”
Chu anyun ng'atuutik che indechini tainnywa:
Ngial otwogindet ne Hebranindet, koboisyeun kenyiisyek lo, ak eng' kenyiitap tisap kowendi puch kotyagat.
Ngo ki nyonei ineegei, komandoi ineegei. Ago ngo kiga kotunis komandoi ak osotyonnyi.
Ago ngo ki igoochin kiptaiyandennyi osotyot ak kosikyi weeriik anan ko tiibiik, kobunjiin osotyondonooto ak lagokyik kiptaiyandennyi ak komanda chiichooto ineegei.
Ngo mwa ineegei eng' chamennyi otwogindet kole achame anee kiptaiyandennyu, osotyondennyu ak lagokyuk, ma mandoi nganda atyagat,
komut anyun kiptaiyandennyi chiichooto kwo taitap Kamuktaindet. Yeityo kimut konyo kurgat anan tugatukyetap kurgeet ak kobarbar itinnyi kiptaiyandennyi eng' kateet si koot ineendet agoi.
Ngo alda chii cheptonyi koek otwogindet koma mandoi chebooto ko uu otwogik che muren.
Ngo ma ibaibai chebooto kiptaiyandennyi ne ki lewen kole si tuun koek osotyonnyi, kochamda koek ne ityagat. Ma tinyei kimnateet kiptaiyandennyi koalda kwo pororyosyek alak amu king'al ineendet.
Ngo koochi weeriinnyi koek osotyonnyi, koyachin chebooto ko uu ye yachin tiibiikyik.
Ngo syon, ko mat kochuchuch amitwogikyik anan ngoroikyik anan ko uu ye nyoljin osotik.
Ngo ma yachi ineendet tuguuchooto somok, komuuchi osotyondonooto kwo puch ama melekto age tugul.
Ineendet ne pirei chii kot kome, kebarei ne matiny.
Ago chii ne kama koyaei ko kwetyin, ago ki yaak eng' mageetap Kamuktaindet, achopchini ole imuuchi komwechi.
Ngosetyi chii chiitap kokwennyi ak kobar ineendet eng' ng'aalseet, ko agot ngo mwechi kaptisisyennyu, omong'u ineendet si kebar.
Ineendet ne pirei kwan anan kamet, kebarei ne matiny.
Ineendet ne choorei chii ak koalda anan ngenamji komi eunekyik, kebarei iman.
Ineendet ne sasei kwan anan kamet, kebarei iman.
“Ngo pooryo piik ak kewire age koita, anan ngo luch ama ta kome, ago iguotenot ne mang'etei eng' itogunnyi,
ak ngot kong'eet kowendot kotebenoti kiroktonyi, keunda anyun ne kibirei. Ago nganda kiuundoi, kogoochin tuguuk che yamei peetuusyekyik che kibetyo puch ak konya ineendet komyee agoi kosap.
“Ngo pir chii otwogindennyi ne muren anan ne tye eng' kirokto kot komechi eunekyik, kigeerchin chiichooto yaityennyi ne matiny.
Ago ngot koeekyi peetuut agenge anan ko aeng' ama me, koma kigeerchin kiy, amu kiga al ineendet.

“Ngo pooryo piik kot kokwer osotyot ne tomono ak kororok moet ama koam kiy osotyondonooto, kogeerchin ineendet ne kalel che yamegei ak che machei manong'otyotap osotyondonooto. Igoitoi ko uu ye kamwa kirwoogik.
Ago ngo yaak kiy ne ya, kigeeri saboondo eng' saboondo,
konda eng' konda, keldet eng' keldet, euut eng' euut, keeldo eng' keeldo,
peelset eng' peelset, kaguotenet eng' kaguotenet, pireet eng' pireet.
“Ngo kwer chii kondap otwogindennyi ne muren anan ne tye, kot kotui, kounda kwo kotyagat amu kondanyi.
Ngo kwer keldetap otwogindennyi ne muren anan otwogindennyi ne tye kot kochun, kounda kwo kotyagat amu keldennyi.
“Ngo toor kirgit muren anan kobogoryo ak kome, kelachei kirgootok iman ak ma ki amei panyeekyik. Ma ki ityin anyun chiitap ko po kirgooto leluut age tugul.
Ago ngo kocham kobarei piich kirgooto ak kigemwachi chiitap ko po ama koger ineendet, ago kabar muren anan kobogoryo, kelachei kirgooto ak kebar chiitap ko po agine.
Ago ngemage ineendet kagerutyet kotyagegei, kogoito anyun nooto kityage saboondanyi ko uu ye magaat.
Kiyae ko uu kirwoogoniito ngo ki par kirgooto weeriit anan ko chepto.
Ngo toor kirgit otwogindet ne muren anan otwogindet ne tye, kogoitoi chiitap ko po kirgit shekelisyek sosom che po fedha, kogoochin kiptaiyannywa ak kelach kirgooto kebar.
“Ngo yaat chii keriinget anan ngo pal keriing' ama koger ak kororokyi tany anan sigiryo,
kogeeri chiichooto po keriinget, ak kogoochi chiitap ko po tuguuchooto silingisyek, ak kobunji nooto kagome chiitap ko po keriinget.
“Ngo par kirgit kirgitap chiito age kot kome, kealdoi nooto sabei ak kopchei pichooto po kiruugik tuguuk che kagialdae ak kopchei panyeegap nooto kame.
Ago ngot kingen keele ki cham kobarisyei kirgooto, ama koger chiitap ko po, kowale kirgooto kirgit age ak kobunji ineendet panyeegap nooto kame.”
“Ngo choor chii tany anan keechiir ak koeeny anan koalda, kogoonu tuuga muut kogeere tanyata anan ko keechiirek ang'wan kogeere keechiiryonooto.
Ngenam choorindet kobutisyei komachei kochoorso ak kebar, koma mi tengektap korotiik eng' ineendet ne kabarei.
Ago ngebar ineendet ko kagochor asiis, komiitei tengektap korotiik eng' ineendet ne kabarei. Nyoljin choorindonooto kogeer che yamei, ngo ma tinyei kiy kealdoi ineendet amu choorsennyi.
Ngenyoorchi eunnyi kioto kachoor kota kosabei, ngo tany anan ngo sigiryo anan ngo keechiir, kogeeri konyil aeng'.
“Ngo yage chiito tennyi mbareetap chiito age anan ko mbareet ne po sabibuk, kogeerchin chiitap ko po mbareet tuguukyik che myachen che po mbareennyi, ak logoegap keetikyik che korooron.
“Ngo lal maat ak konam ng'ootweet si kobeel peek che mi mbar anan ko peek che iyumotiin anan kobeel mbareet, kogeeri iman chiito ne kainaami maat aseenet ne kagon maata.
“Ngo koochi chii age tugul chiitap kokwennyi chepkondok anan tuguuk kogonorchi ak kechoor eng' kootap chiichooto, ak ngenam choorindet, kogeeri choorindonooto konyil aeng'.
Ago ngo ma ki nam choorindet, konyonei anyun chiitap ko po koot taitap Kamuktaindet si kobiit kotook ngo ki nam tuguugap chiitap kokwennyi.

“Ngot komi tiyet age tugul agobo kiy age tugul; ngo ne po tany anan sigiryo anan keechiir anan ne po ingor anan kiy age tugul ne ki pet ak komaiytos piik aeng'u koleen age tugul, ‘Ineni,’ keibu anyun ng'aleekwak kobwa taitap kirwoogik. Ineendet ne mwaei kirwoogik kole tinyei leluut, kogeerchin chiitap kokwennyi konyil aeng'.
“Ngomanaakyi chii age tugul chiitap kokwennyi sigiryet anan eito anan keechiir anan tany age tugul, ak ngo me anan ngo myan anan ngekweri ama keer chii,
kotebee kayosyetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kwenutap pichooto tuwai, si koboor iman kole ma choor tuguugap chiitap kokwennyi; ak koyan agine chiitap ko po, ak ma kigeeri kiy.
Ago ngot ko ki kichoor iman, kogeerchin chiitap ko po che yamei.
Ngot ko ki nam tyony kotonaton, ingoip anyun tanyata nyoo koek paornateet. Ma koonu kiy kogeere nooto ki kibar.
“Ngosoom chii chiitap kokwennyi kiy koboisyee, ak ngo ng'emak anan ngo me ama mi chiitap ko po, kogeere age iman.
Ago ngo ki mi chiitap ko po, koma kigeeri. Ngo ki kikweri kobois si kigoito melekto, ko yamegei ak melekto kityo.
“Ngo kaigai `chii pergeiyat ne tomo keyachi koito ak koruiyo ak ineendet, ko kogandoi tuguuk si kobiit kotun.
Ngo eesyo kwandap pergeiyandanooto eng' kimnateet, kogoitoi tuguuk che aechin ak che kigandoe pergeinik.
“Amemete poonindet kosap.
“Kibarei age tugul ne ruitos ak tyony.
“Chii age tugul ne eeng'jin tiseiywot kamuktain age tugul ne ma Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, keng'emei kiwong'u.
“Ameyachi ne ya too anan inyaliil. Amu ki oo toek ak okweek eng' emetap Misiri.
Ameus kwony age tugul ne kagosiirtoe manong'otyonnyi anan lakwa ne ma tinyei sigiik.
Ngius icheek eng' kiy age tugul ak koriircho, agasyini iman riirekwak,
ak kolaany parak nereegekyuk ak abarenak rotwetap chok, si koek mosoogik osotikwok ak koek ponoon lagokwok.
“Ngi pesenji piikyuk robiinik, che kibananook che mi kobooten, komat iyaach amemage icheek keljinet.
Nginame pesendo ngoryeetap chiitap kokweng'ung', iweekyini kotom kororokto asiista,
amu nooto kityo ngoryeet ne tugegei. Tos tugegei nee koruei? Ngo riircho agasyini amu atinye rireenet.
“Amat isas Kamuktaindet. Amat ichup pounindetap piiguk.
“Amegagei si igoitoi kobun chaang'indap tuguuguk ak eng' che kieei. Igoono taitang'ung' ne weeriit.
Yai ko uu nooto eng' tuguuk ak icheek ak eng' keechiireguk. Igoochi kotebi ak kamet peetuusyek tisap ak igoono eng' peetuut ne po sisiit.
Oegu piigap tiliilindo eng' anee. Eng' nooto anyun, ko amoam panyeek alak tugul che kabar tyong'in eng' timiin. Owiirchini sesenik.”
“Amemwaate ng'aleek che po lembech. Amonamge ak kiptengekyot iegu paoryat ne ma po iman.
Amesup tuiyet iwe iyai kiy ne ya. Ye ibaoryan eng' kapkirwook ko matonamgei ak tuiyet ibaoryan lembech, imaas kirwooget.
Ametiytiy kibanania eng' ng'aleekyik.
“Nginyooru tetap punyondeng'ung' anan sigiryennyi ne petoti, ikwerichi.
Nginyooru sigiryetap ne wechin ko kagobut amu tuguuk che laei, nganda kama imache itoret, ko kanyool itoret ing'eet sigiryonooto.
“Amat imaas kirwoogetap kibananiandeng'ung' eng' kirwoogutikyik.
Istegei looitu eng' kirwoogutik che kirwookyin chii eng' lembech; amebar che ma tinyei yaityo ak che po imanda, amu ma ityinii imanda chii ne yae tengegito.
Ametaach tuguuk che po asoya, amu tuchei konunoik icheeget che ng'oomen ak kogunuuri ng'aleegap che po imanda.
“Amenyaliil toondet amu ongen ole teptoi muguleldap toondet amu ki oo toek eng' emetap Misiri.
“Igoole mbareeng'ung' kenyiisyek lo ak iges ruratennyi,

ago mete eng' kenyiit ne po tisap kotep komuuny. Niito ko si kobiit konyoor turoonik kibananogap piiguk, ak koam tyong'igap timiin che ituuchi pichooto. Iyae ko uu nooto eng' mbareeng'ung' ne po sabibuk ak eng' mbareeng'ung' ne po keetiigap mseituni che punu mwanik.
“Yai poisyeng'ung' eng' peetuusyek lo ak imuuny eng' peetuutap tisap. Iyae niito si kobiit komuuny eitang'ung' ak sigiryeng'ung' ak konyoor kamuung'et weeriitap otwogindeng'ung' ne tye ak toondet.
Riip tuguuk tugul che kaamwaun. Amat imwa kainaigap kamuktaik, amat kegasyi kutinng'ung'.
“Iyaiywo igoorto konyil somok eng' kenyiit age tugul.

Yai igoortap magatiinik che ma kinde mermereek. Iame eng' peetuusyek tisap magatiinik che ma kinde mermereek ko uu ye ki ang'atiin eng' peetuut ne ki kiaror eng' arawetap Abib; amu arawanooto ne ki omang'une Misiri. Amat konyo chii tainnyu ak euut puch.

Riip igoorto ne po kesisyet eng' tongoanigap minutikyik che igooljini mbar. Riip kora igoortap peetuusyek che kiyumune tuguugap mbar eng' kagesunetap kenyiit, ye iyumi tuguugap poisyeng'ung' eng' mbar.
Pwoonei taitap Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor murenik tugul konyil somok eng' kenyiit agenge.
“Ameibu korotiigap tiseiywondennyu kobooto magatiinik che kaginde mermereek. Amengoeekyi mwanigap igoortanyu.
“Kanyool iibu tuguuk che po tai eng' tongoanik che po emeng'ung' kobwa kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindeng'ung'. “Ameyoe aarwet cheegap kamet.
“Ayooktoi anyun malaikaiyat kondoenak koriibootok eng' ooreet ak komutaak obe ole ki achop.
Oriipkei eng' tainnyi ak ogas iit ng'aleekyik; ama ta obistoe ineendet. Amu ma nyochin kaat pistoeng'wong' amu mi kainennyu eng' ineendet.
Ago ngigas iit ng'aleekyik, ak iyai tugul che amwaun, aegu anyun puunyootap puuniguk, ak aegu usiindetap che usin.
Amu wendi malaikaiyandennyu kondoenen, komutin iwe ole mi Amorik, Hitik, Perisik, Kanaanik, Hibik ak Jebusik ak aiste icheek awong'u.
Amat isaa kanamonikwak, anan ioot, anan isup poisyonikwak. Ago oluul kot koma ng'et kiy ak obut kotonogis tolochikwak.
Oboisyeiwo anee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindeng'wong', si koberuur amitwogiguk ak peeguk, ak aiste myanwogik eng' kwenung'ung'.
Ma piitu ne rorogu moet anan ne oosu anan ne soneni eng' emeng'ung'. Ayae kosulda koitetap peetuusyeguk.
“Ayooktoi kamuisennyu kondoenen ak anyaliil piik tugul che mi ole iite ak ayai puuniguk tugul komweenen.
Ayooktoi kaaraamyet kondoenen kwo koon Hibik, Kanaanik ak Hitik, koba eng' taing'ung'.
Maone icheek koba eng' taing'ung' eng' kenyiit agenge, si ma kuber emet ak kotesagis tyong'igap timiin ak koiimak.
Ago aoone komutya koba eng' taing'ung' agoi itesage ak inyaban emet.
Andoi kiwoteng'ung' koboochit Araraita ne Piriir agoi nyanjetap Mediterenian ak koboochit surkwen agoi aineet. Amu andoi piigap emonooto eunekwok, si ioon icheek koba eng' taing'ung'.
Amoyai arorut ak icheek, anan agot eng' kanamonikwak.
Amat komeny emeng'ung' si ma koonin iyaiywo tengek. Amu imuuch ioot kamuktaikwak koek nooto iman mesteet eng' inyee.”
Yeityo koleenji `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Musa, “Otogosu ole mi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, inyee, Aron, Nadap, Abiu ak poisyek tamanwogik tisap che po Israel. Ye neegit oitu ole ami, ong'uruukyo osaa.
Nyoonei Musa ineegei koriikyin Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ago ma riigu icheek ak mat kotogos chii kobooto ineendet.”

Ki nyo anyun Musa komwachi piik ng'aleek tugul che po Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ak kirwoogutik tugul, ak ki wol piik tugul eng' kutit agenge kole, “Kiyae ng'aleechooto tugul kamwa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.”

Ki sir Musa ng'aleek tugul che po Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ak king'eet karon ko tuui ak koteech kaptisisyet eng' tulweet keel. Kiteeche koik tolochik taman ak aeng' ko uu ortinwek taman ak aeng' che po Israel.
Yeityo koyookto murenik che neran che po piigap Israel kogoito kagoochinoik che kibeelei ak kieng'ji tuuga Kamuktaindet ne Toroor koek tiseiywegap kaalyeet.
Kisiil Musa korotiik kebeber, konde taabook che mengeechen, ak koisotee che kiganget kaptisisyet.
Yeityo konam kitabuutap arorutyet ak kosomanji piik kogas, ak ki le icheek, “Kigase iit Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ak keyae chooto tugul kamwa.”
Kingo pata konam Musa korotiik ak koisote piik komwae koleen, “Chu korotiigap arorutyet ne kagoyai Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kobootok eng' ng'aleechu tugul.”
Ki togosta anyun Musa ak Aron, Nadap, Abiu ak poisyek tamanwogik tisap che po Israel.
Ki keer anyun icheek Kamuktaindet ne po Israel. Ki mi keelyekyik keel koita ne keguure sapphire ne uu sengwetyet eng' tiliilindanyi.
Nga ki keer icheek kondoigap Israel Kamuktaindet, koma twa ineendet icheek eng' eunnyi. Ago ki amis ak koe eng' taitap Kamuktaindet.
Ki leenji `Kamuktaindet Musa, “Togosu oli ami eng' tulweet ak itebee olito, si agoonin koik che lebeleen che ki asirchi ng'atuutik ak kayomisutik si kobiit ineete piik.”
Ki ng'eet anyun Musa ak Joshua kiboityondennyi, ak ye ibata kotogosta Musa kwo tulweetap Kamuktaindet.
Ki leenji poisyek, “Otebi eng' yu, ogenech agoi keeweege kogeny ole omi: ‘Ogeero, mi Aron ak Hur kobootok. Ingonyo ole mi icheek chii age tugul ne tinyei ng'olyoo.’ ”
Ki togosta anyun Musa kwo tulweet ak ki tuch `pooldet tulweet.
Ki tebee liilindap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor tulweetap Sinai ak ki tuch `pooldet tulwoonooto peetuusyek lo. Eng' peetuutap tisap koguur `Kamuktaindet Musa eng' pooldet oriit.
Ki uu itoondap liilindap Kamuktaindet maat ne peelei kowong'u eng' tulweet parak ko uu ye kigeerei piigap Israel.
Ki wo Musa pooldet oriit ak kotogosta tulweet. Ki tebee ineendet tulweet peetuusyek artam ak kemousyek artam.
Ki ng'alaalji `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Musa koleenji,
“Mwachi piigap Israel koibwa konunoik. Iname konunoichooto kobun chii age tugul ne ichirchirchin muguleldanyi kogoon konunoikyuk.”
Chu konunoik che itaache eng' icheek: thahabu, fedha ak sugunonik,
angook che buluu, che arusen ne piriir ak che piriireen, katanit ne karaaran ak che kiyae koroorigap ng'oroorek;
ak magatogap mengichik che ki kisal kobiriritu, kobooto magatogap mengichigap peek ak keetiik che uu chebitoik,
mwaitap kiit ne ikweng'sei, tuguuk che ng'uu ne anyiny che po mwaita ne kiilegei, che po nyamdutik che kibeelei,
koik che kiguure soam, koik che kitetyin ephod ak ngoryeet age ne kilaakyin tegeet.
Ko uu nooto kora, ko ingoteekwo ole-tiliil si ameny kwenunnywa.
Oyai ole teptoi emaitap Kamuktaindet ak ole teptoi tuguuk tugul che kindoi oriit ko uu ye aboorun.

Ingoyai piigap Israel moinget eng' keetiigap chebitoik, ne koindonyi ko sendimita pogol ak taman. Tebeesindanyi ko sendimita tamanwogik lo ak lo. Ingoek kooindap tononennyi sendimita tamanwogik lo ak lo.
Iliige thahabu che tiliileen oriit ak parak ak itegele tegeleiywotap thahabu iyieme paragunnyi tugul.
Itang'ji peteinik ang'wan che po thahabu ak inde peteinichooto luuita age tugul ne po moinget ole po keel. Indoi aeng' komosta age, inde aeng' komosta age.
Iyae keetiik che kiname che po chebitoik ak iliige thahabu.
Yeityo irookte keetichooto peteinik che mi tabanwegap moinget si koek che kitandane moingonooto.
Tebee keetichooto peteinigap moinget, ama kicheru eng' yooto.
Ak inde `paornateet ne agoonin moingonooto oriit.
Yeityo iyai kerwennyi ne po rireenet ne po thahabu che tiliileen; ne koindonyi ko sendimita pogol agenge ak taman ak tebeesindanyi ko tamanwogik lo ak lo.
Iyae kora kerubisyek aeng' eng' thahabu che kitaanyi eng' tabanwek aeng' che po kerwetap rireenet.
Yai kerubit age kotebee tabanda age ak inde age kotabon komosta age. Kinamdos kerwet ne po rireenet ak kerubit eng' tabanda age tugul.
Itoorchingei togoochigap kerubisyek ak ko koegitu kebebaikwak koba parak, si kouure kebebaikwak kerwetap rireenet ak kotoorchigei togoochikwak, ko keerei kerwetap rireenet.
Inde kerwanooto po rireenet paragutap moinget ak inde moinget oriit paornateet ne tuun agoonin.

Yeityo ketuiye ak inyee eng' olooto ak keng'alaal kobooten ko katebee kerwanooto po rireenet parak, ami kwenutap kerubisyek aeng' che mi paragutap moingetap paornateet ak amwaun tuguuk tugul che ang'atiin agobo piigap Israel.
Iyae meset eng' keetiigap chebitoik. Koindonyi ko sendimita sosom ak sisiit, tebeesindanyi ko sendimita artam ak ang'wan ak ko sendimita tamanwogik lo ak lo kooindap tononennyi.
Iliige thahabu che tiliileen ak itegele tegeleiywotap thahabu iyieme paragunnyi tugul.
Chop tegeleiywot ne sendimita tamanwogik lo ak lo tebeesindanyi koyiem kioto ak iyai tegeleiywotap thahabu koyiem tabanwekyik tugul kotegel.
Yachi peteinik ang'wan che po thahabu ak inde peteinichooto luukwek ang'wan, ole mi keelyekyik ang'wanu.
Ingoriikyi peteinichooto tegeleiywot koek che chutei keetiik che ki ibe meset.
Yai keetiik che po chebitoik ak iliige thahabu si kobiit keibe meset.
Itaany thahabu che tiliileen iyai koek taabookyik, kechigosyekyik, kigombokyik ak tageiywekyik che kiroong'jine tuguuk.
Inde magatiinik che itabaanatiin meset kotebee tainnyu kotugul.
Ak iyai keldap tait eng' thahabu che tiliileen. Iyae thahabu che kitaanyi keloto, kelunnyi ak toloitanyi; kigombokyik, mulonokyik, ak taaptokyik ak kiropchindos chooto tugul koek kiy agenge.
Sachei anyun mooriik koek lo eng' toloita nooto; sachei mooriik somogu eng' komosta age ne po keloto ak sachei mooriik somogu ko uu nooto eng' komosin.

Tinyei temeet ne po komosta age kigombok somok che ki kiyai koigei taaptook che kiguure almond ak mulwet ak taapteet. Kotinyei ko uu nooto temeet ne po komosta nin age kigombok somok che ki kiyai koigei taptochooto kiguure almond ak mulwet ak taapteet. Kergeitu anyun eng' mooriik tugul lo che sage keloto komugul.
Ak miitei ole po toloita ineendet kigombok ang'wan che ki kiyai kogergeit ak taaptogap almond kobooto mulonokyik ak tapokyik.
Eng' ye kisage mooriik aeng'u, komi keel yooto mulwet ne ki kituiye koek kiy agenge. Mitoti anyun ko uu nooto eng' olda age tugul ole kisage mooriik tugul ko lo eng' keldap tait.
Namegei mulonokwak ak mooriikwak koek kiy agenge. Kitang'e kioto komugul thahabu che tiliileen.
Yeityo iyai taisyekyik tisap ak inam si kobiit kokweny ole mi.
Yae kora thahabu che tiliileen kanameiywondennyi ak taabookyik che mengeechen.
Iyae tainooto ak tuguuchuuto tugul thahabu che tiliileen che po keruutik sosom ak muut.
Riip si iyai tugul ko uu kergeindenywa ne ki kiboorun eng' tulweet.

Ne siirei nooto anyun, ko teech emaitap Kamuktaindet iteeche angook taman che ki kinabee katanit ne karaaran ne ki kileet eng' che buluu. Ngo lelesan anyun angoonochooto nabiindet ne ng'oom kochooronji kerubisyek.
Koindap angeet age tugul ko mitainik taman ak aeng' ak tebeesindo ko mitainik aeng'. Aechindos angoochooto tugul.
Kiropchindos angook muut ak keropchin angook alak muut ak icheek.
Napchi pelelutik che buluu eng' tabandap angeet age eng' ole kurmanat ak eng' ole kagituiyechi. Iyae ko uu nooto eng' tabandap angeet age ne tabanu parak eng' ole kagituiye ne po aeng'.
Napchi angeet age pelelutik konom ak inapchi pelelutik konom eng' tabandap angeet ne po aeng' eng' ole kagituiyechi; tokyindos pelelutik tugul.
Iyae kariik konom che po thahabu che kiname angook si ituiye angook karichooto si koek agenge emaitap Kamuktaindet.
Nap angook taman ak agenge inabe koroorigap ng'oroorek koek emait ne kituge emaitap Kamuktaindet.
Koindap angeet age tugul ko mitaitinik taman ak somok ak mitainik aeng' tebeesindap age tugul. Aechindos anyun angoonochooto tugul tamanu ak agenge.
Ituiye angook muut koek agenge ak ituiye alak lo koek agenge ak icheek yeityo iliich anganooto po lo eng' ole kimandoe eng' emait.
Yeityo iyachi pelelutik konom eng' tabandap angeet age ne tabanu parak eng' ole kituiyechin ak iyachi pelelutik konom eng' tabandap angeet ne po aeng' eng' ole kituiyechin.
Ne rupei iyai kariik konom che po sugunonik ak irooch karichooto pelelutik si ituiye emait koek agenge.
Kebeberta ne kang'etune ngetunenigap angoogap emait, kosonginine patetap emaitap Kamuktaindet.
Ko kebeberwek che ng'etune komoswek tuwai eng' kooindap angoogap emait, ko ingosongininso eng' komosi ak komosi si kobiit kotuch emaitap Kamuktaindet.
Inabe muiywegap mengichigap keechiirek che ki kisal kobiriritu si ketuge emait ak inap muiywegap mengichigap peek kotabon parak.
Iyae pagoinik che tonondos che po keetiigap chebitoik kobunji emaitap Kamuktaindet.
Iyae koek mitainik sisiit kooindap pagoiyot, tebeesindap pagoiyot age tugul ko sendimita tamanwogik lo ak lo.
Iyae pagoiyot age tugul konyoor ng'elyebwek aeng' che ki ituiyogei; yai ko uu nooto eng' pagoinik tugul che po emaitap Kamuktaindet.
Yai pagoinigap emaitap Kamuktaindet che itei tiptem ak inde ole tokyingei murot tai,

ak ibarbar fedha isikyi kong'iik artam si koobeesyo kapkelyenutap pagoinichooto tiptem, chutei ng'elyebwek aeng'u che po pagoiyot agenge kong'iik aeng' che mi kapkelyen. Chutei ko uu nooto ng'elyebwek aeng'u che po pagoiyot age kong'iik aeng' che mi kapkelyen,
ak che po komosta age ne po koot ole tokyingei murot kaataam, inde pagoinik tiptem,
ak kong'iikwak artam che po fedha, kong'iik aeng' eng' kapkelyenutap pagoiyot age tugul.
Yai anyun pagoinik lo kobunji koot patai ole tokyingei cherongo.
Yeityo iyai pagoinik aeng' kobunji luukwek che po ko che mi patai.
Terchindos aeng' kobooch ng'wony agoi parak ago kituiye tugul peteiyot eng' parak. Kiyaei ko uu nooto eng' tuwai kindoi luukwek aeng'.
Egu chooto anyun pagoinik sisiit ak kong'iikwak che po fedha taman ak lo: kong'iik aeng' eng' kapkelyenutap pagoiyot agenge ak kong'iik aeng' eng' kapkelyenutap pagoiyot age.
Ak iyai eng' chebitoik keetiik che uu rateiywek; iyae muut che po pagoinik che po komosta agenge ne po emaitap Kamuktaindet,
ak rateiywek muut che po pagoinik che po komosta age ne po emaitap Kamuktaindet ak rateiywek muut che po pagoinik che po komosta age ne po emaitap Kamuktaindet ne mi patai ole tokyingei cherongo.
Ingobochit tabanda age agoi tabanda age rateiywot ne po kween ne muroksei ne mi kwenutap pagoinichooto.
Iliige thahabu pagoinik ak iyai peteinikwak che po thahabu koek chooto ole kirooktoi rateiywek ak iliige rateiywechooto thahabu.
Ingotonon anyun koyooto ko uu ye ki king'at ak kiboorun eng' tulweet.
Iyae angeet ne ki kioiye emaitap Kamuktaindet ne buluu ak ne aruus ne piriir, ne piriir ak katanit ne karaaran ne ki kileet. Kinapchin anganooto kerubisyek che poisyetap laindet ne ng'oom.
Isonginine lumeiywek ang'wan che po keetiigap chebitoik che kiliige thahabu; po thahabu ireusyekwak ak tonone lumeiywechooto kong'iik ang'wan che po fedha che ki kibal.
Isonginine anganooto kapkelyenutap kariik che kiname angook ak iibu moinget ne po paornateet inde koot ne po oriit ne tilate angeet, si kopcheiywok anganooto ole-tiliil ak ole-tiliil miising'.
Inde kerwet ne po rireenet moinget ne po paornateet eng' ole-tiliil miising'.
Inde meset koot ne sip kemong'jin, angeet ne ki kioiye koot ak inde keldap tait kotoorchin ak meset eng' komostap murot tai eng' koot. Yeityo inde meset ole tokyingei murot kaataam.
Nap angeet ne kigeree kurgeetap emait. Inabe ngoryoniito ne buluu, ne aruus ne piriir, ne piriir, ak katanit ne karaaran ne ki kileet, poisyetap chiito ne nabei kondai lelesta.
Yeityo iyachi ngoryonooto lumeiywek muut che po keetiigap chebitoik ak iliige thahabu ak punjin thahabu ireusyekwak. Itang'ji eng' sugunwet kong'iik muut che kilolonda.

“Teech kaptisisyet eng' keetiigap chebitoik koek koindo mitainik aeng' ak robo ak koek tebeesindo mitainik aeng' ak robo. Aechin komoswek tugul ang'wanu che po kaptisisyonooto ak ingoek koindo ne po tononennyi mitait agenge ak robo.
Iyae kuinoikyik eng' luukwekyik ang'wan: itaanyi inoichooto konomnyo ak kaptisisyet koek kiy agenge ak iliige sugunwet.
Min tereenikyik che ki ibe oreek ak kechigosyekyik che eecheen, taabookyik che mengeechen, kariik che sogotiin ak taabookyik alak che ki ibe maat. Yae tuguuchu tugul sugunonik.
Yeityo iyai kora sugunonik che kiregeri ak inde sugunonichooto kagireger peteinik ang'wan eng' luukwekyik ang'wan.
Inde karnanooto kagireger kapkelyenutap mireiywot ne yiemei kaptisisyet komosta ole po keel si komuurmuur kaptisisyet.
Yachi kaptisisyet keetiik che ki ibe; chooto ko keetiigap chebitoik ak iliige sugunwet.
Kirooktoi keetichooto peteinik ak tebee keetichooto komoswek aeng' che po kaptisisyet si kobiit keibe.
Itete pagoinik koek moinget eng' kaptisisyonooto: ingoyai piik ko uu ye ko ki porun eng' tulweet.

“Iyae seremut ne ng'ootaat ne po emaitap Kamuktaindet. Eng' ole tokyingei murot tai, kindoi angook che uu emait ne po katanit ne karaaran ne ki kileet ne yamei mitainik artam ak ang'wan ko uu kooindap seremut eng' komosta agenge.
Egu tiptem lumeiywek che po sugunonik che keratyin ngoroichooto ak kong'iikwak tiptem che po sugunonik che tononie, agobo fedha ireusyegap lumeiywek.

Uu nooto koindo agine eng' komostap murot kaataam, king'ote angook che uu emait che yamei mitainik artam ak ang'wan ak egu tiptem lumeiywekwak che po sugunonik, po fedha ireusyegap lumeiywek kobooto rateiywekwak che kituiye.
Eng' tebeesindap seremut eng' komostap cherongo, ing'ote angook che uu emait che yamei mitainik tiptem ak aeng'. Egu taman lumeiywekwak ak kong'iikwak taman che tononie.
Ingoek mitainik tiptem ak aeng' tebeesindo ne po seremut ne tokyingei kong'asiis,
koek mitainik lo ak kebeberyat angook che uu emait che po komosta age ak lumeiywekwak somok ak kong'iikwak somok che tononie.
Ingoek che po komosta age angook che yamei mitainik lo ak kebeberyat kobooto lumeiywekwak somok ak kong'iikwak somok che tononie.

Iyae koek angook che po ormariichet ne po seremut mitainik lo iyae che buluu, che arusen ne piriir, che piriireen ak katanit ne karaaran ne ki kileet, indoi chiito ne nabei lelesta. Ingoek lumeiywek ang'wan ak kong'iikwak ang'wan che tononie.
Po fedha rateiywek che keratote lumeiywek tugul che yiemei seremut, po fedha ireusyekwak ak po sugunonik kong'iikwak che tononie.

Iteeche koek kooindap seremut mitainik artam ak ang'wan, koek tebeesindo mitainik tiptem ak aeng' ak ingoek tononet mitainik aeng' ak robo che po katanit ne karaaran ne ki kileet ak ingobunji sugunonik kong'iik che tononie.
Ingobunji sugunonik tuguuk tugul che keboisyee eng' poisyetap emaitap Kamuktaindet, tigongenikyik tugul ak tigongenik tugul che po seremut.
“Ng'at piigap Israel koibun mwaita ne tiliil ne po mseituni ne ki kitui si kobunji kiit ne ikweng'sei si kobiit kolal tait kotugul.

Ingochobei Aron ak weeriikyik lapkeiyonooto eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kong'etee koskoleny agoi karon eng' emait ne kituiyechin eng' ole sip kemong'jin eng' angeet ne iyoitos emaitap Kamuktaindet, ne mi tai eng' paornateet. Egu ng'atuutyet ne po koigeny eng' ibinwekwak tugul agobo piigap Israel.

“Imutu anyun Aron ng'eetap komet konyo ole ami kobooto weeriikyik, kobwa eng' ole mi piigap Israel, si kobiit koboisyeiwo eng' tisiisyet. Icheeget che imutu ko; Aron ak weeriikyik, Nadap, Abiu, Eleazar ak Ithamar.
Napchi Aron ng'eetap komet ngoroik che itabaanatiin che po teegisto ak korooronindo.
Yeityo ing'alaalji tugul che tinyei muguleldo ne po kaguiyet, che ki anyiit kabuusetap ng'omnateet, si konap ngoroik che po Aron si kobiit kitabaan ineendet koboisyeiwo eng' tisiisyet.

Chu angook che nabei icheek: ngoryeet ne kilaakyin tegeet, ephod, ngoryeet ne kooi, ak age ne kooi miising' ne ki kilelesan, naaryeet ak pireneet. Ilaachi Aron ng'eetap komet ak weeriikyik ngoroichuuto itabaanatiin si koboisyeiwo eng' tisiisyet.
Ingoboisyee icheek usiisyek che ililii, che buluu, che arusen ne piriir ak che piriireen kobooto katanit ne karaaran ne ki kileet.
“Yae icheek ephod eng' thahabu che buluu, eng' che arusen ne piriir, eng' che piriireen ak eng' katanit ne karaaran ne ki kileet.
Tinyei eng' tigigoik kebeberwek che ituitos ngoroichooto tuwai koek ngoryeet agenge.
Ak ki kinap pireneet eng' ng'omnateet ki tuiyo kogergeit ak ephod si kerategei. Kinabe thahabu, buluu, che arusen ne piriir, che piriireen ak katanit ne karaaran ne ki kileet.
“Nam koik aeng' che kiguure soam ak iwachi eng' sireet kainaigap piigap Israel ko uu ortinwekwak;
sirchi koita age kainaik lo, ak kainaik lo che kang'et isirchi koita age.
Sirchi koichooto aeng' kainaigap piigap Israel, eng' poisyetap waindetap koik, ko uu waet ne po ng'ookset ak inde koichooto thahabu che ki kitogul konam koik.
Yeityo inde koichooto aeng' tigigoigap ephod si koek koichooto kabwaatet agobo piigap Israel. Ingoibot Aron kainaikwak eng' tigigoikyik aeng' eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor koek kabwaatet.
Iyae tuguuk che togulotin eng' thahabu,
ak sirimoik aeng' che po thahabu che tiliileen. Ilet koigei rogoonik ak iratyi sirimwechooto kagilet tuguuchooto togulotin.
“Nap eng' poisyetap nabiindet ne ng'oom, ngoryonooto po tegeet ne po kirwooget, inabe kogergeit ak ephod eng' thahabu ne buluu, ne aruus ne piriir, ne piriir ak eng' katanit ne karaaran ne ki kileet.
Ingoaechin koindo ak tebeesindo ko kagiliich. Ingoek kakwautyennyi olo po sendimita tiptem ak aeng' eng' koindo ak eng' tebeesindo.
Inde ngoryonooto koik che tetotin eng' ortinwekwak ang'wan. Inde ooreet ne po tai sardio, topasio ak bareqet,
ak inde ooreet ne po aeng' sumaragdo, sapphire ak yaholom.
Eng' ooreet ne po somok inde huakinto, sebu ak ametusto.
Eng' ooreet ne po ang'wan inde berulo, soam ak jasipi. Kitetyin koichooto kelongonigap thahabu.
Egu koichooto taman ak aeng' ko uu kainaigap piigap Israel. Pendi ko uu kainaikwak ko uu ye kiwaei ng'ookset, tinyei koita age tugul kainennyi ak ko pee ortinwek taman ak aeng'.
Napchi ngoryonooto po tegeet sirimwek che uu rogoonik che po thahabu che tiliileen che ki kilet ko uu rogoet.
Napchi kora peteinik aeng' che po thahabu ak inde peteinichooto aeng' tabanwegap luukwek aeng' che po ngoryonooto po tegeet.
Yeityo inde sirimwechooto aeng' po thahabu che ki kilet peteinik aeng' che mi tabanwek aeng' che po ngoryonooto po tegeet.
Nam anyun komoswechuun alak aeng' che po sirimwechooto aeng' ki kilet ak irooch kelongonik aeng' che ki kitogul yeityo ituiye ak ephod eng' komostap tigigoik ole tabanu tai.
Chop peteinik aeng' che po thahabu yeityo inapchji ngoryonooto po tegeet eng' komostap luukwek aeng' eng' tabanwekyik che tabanu komostap oriit eng' ephod keel.

Chop anyun peteinik aeng' che po thahabu inapchi tuguuchooto tigigoigap ngoryonooto kiguure ephod eng' komostap kapkelyen ole tabanu tai eng' ole neegitee ye ki kituiye, eng' paragutap pirenonooto po ephod ne ki kinap eng' ng'omnateet.

Igiichi icheek ngoryeetap tegeet eng' peteinikyik koratyin ak peteinigap ephod, korate rogoet ne buluu si kotebee paragutap pireneet ne po ephod ne ki kila eng' ng'omnateet, si ma peesyo ngoryeetap tegeet ak ephod.
Ye mandoi Aron ole-tiliil, koibe kainaigap piigap Israel ngoryonooto po tegeet ne po kirwooget eng' muguleldanyi si koek kabwaatet eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kotugul.

Inde ngoryonooto po tegeet ne po kirwooget Urim ak Tumim si kotebee chooto muguleldap Aron ye mandoi taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor. Eng' nooto anyun koibei Aron kirwoogetap piigap Israel eng' muguleldanyi eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kotugul.
“Inabe ngoryeet ne kiroochigei ne po ephod ne ki kisal konyalilit ne ais kityo.
Ak inap ole kirooktoi metit eng' kwenunnyi ak igurman kaatit ko uu poisyetap laindet ak ko uu ye kichobei ngoroigap lugeet si ma kereer.
Napchi ngoryonooto tabandap keel logoek che buluu, che arusen ne piriir, che piriireen, koyiem tabandap kapkelyen tugul ak itilate cheptingiloogap thahabu kot kotuiyo.
Indoi twolyot ne po thahabu yeityo inde logoiyandanooto korupkei ak itilate ko uu nooto korubatkei agoi tabandap ngoryeet komugul.
Ak ingolaach Aron si koboisyee ak kegas cheetap cheptingilinichooto ye wendi ole-tiliil eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ak ye mong'u si ma me.
“Itaany kora thahabu che tiliileen kolebelitu ak iwai eng' paragunnywa waet ne uu ne po ng'ookset, ile, Tiliil eng' Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Iratee rogoet ne buluu si kotebee naaryeet chepkulet ak kotebee naaryeet ole po togoch.

Tebee togeetap Aron ak koibot Aron tengektap tuguuk che tiliileen, che itabaani piigap Israel eng' kagoochinoikwak tugul che tiliileen. Ak kotebee nooto togeetap Aron kotugul si kobiit kochamogis eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Inapchini Aron ngoryeet ne kooi eng' katanit ne karaaran ak inde lelesta ak inap ko uu nooto naaryeet ne po katanit ne karaaran ak inap pireneet.
“Eng' weeriigap Aron inapchini ngoroik che kooen, pirenaik ak chepkuloik che mengeechen che po teegisto ak kororindo.
Yeityo ilaakyi ng'eetap komet Aron tuguuchooto ak weeriikyik ak icheek ak iil, ak itoroorchi icheek poisyetap tiliilindo itabaan, si kobiit koboisyeiwo eng' tisiisyet.
Inapchini icheek sulwalisyek che ng'ete suet agoi kubesoik che po katanit si kobiit kotuge aach ngorinnywa.

Ilaachi Aron ak weeriikyik tuguuchooto ye pendi emaitap oriit, anan ye riikyin kapkorosuut si kobiit kobois eng' ole-tiliil si ma nam icheek tengekto, ak kobek. Egu niito ng'atuutyet eng' ineendet ak eng' iyotennyi ne piitu let.
“Ni kiit ne iyachini icheek ianyinyi, si kobiit koboisyeiwo eng' tisiisyet: iname kirgit agenge ne neran ak mengichik aeng' che libwoben,

kobooto magatiinik che ma kinde mermereek, magatiinik che mengeechen che ki kikwang'da mwaiita, magatiinik che tertereen che kigi iilee mwaita ak ichobe peek che ng'ootiin che tambulul che po nganuuk.
Indoi ateruut agenge ak iibune ateruunooto yeityo igetu kirgit kobooto mengichichooto aeng'.
Imutu Aron ak weeriikyik kobwa kurgeetap emait ne kituiyechin ak iun icheek eng' peek.
Nam ngoroik ak ilaakyi Aron ngoryeet ne kooi, ak ngoryeet ne ki kilelesane ephod, ephod ineendet ak ngoryeetap tegeet. Kermenee ineendet `pireneet ne po ephod ne ki kinap eng' ng'omnateet.
Kerchinee metinnyi naaryeet ak iratyi kuutweet ne tiliil ne po thahabu paragutap naryonooto.
Yeityo inam mwaita ne ki ilse iroong'ji metinnyi ak iil ineendet.
“Imutu weeriikyik ak icheek ak ilaakyi ngoroik che kooen.

Yeityo igermen Aron ak weeriikyik eng' pirenaik ak igerchinee metowekwak chepkuloik che mengeechen. Si konam poisyonooto po tiseinateet eng' ng'atuutyet ne po agoi. Itoroorchi anyun Aron ak weeriikyik poisyonooto po tiliilindo.
“Ketu anyun kirgit konyo taitap emait ne kituiyechin. Ingogonoor Aron ak weeriikyik eunekwak metitap kirgooto.
Yeityo ieny kirgooto eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' kurgeetap emait ne kituiyechin.
Taach korotiigap kirgooto ak iilee tolochigap kaptisisyet eng' morneng'ung' yeityo iroong'ji korotichooto tugul kaptisisyet keel.
Put mwanik tugul che ki ilaach moet ak kwambelelyet ne tuchei kooet, soromok tuwai, mwanik che mi soromochooto ak ibeel chooto eng' kaptisisyet.
Ki peel eng' maat panyeegap kirgooto, muitonyi ak eiyandennyi eng' saang'utap nganaseet. Nooto ko kagoochinet ne po tengekto.
“Nam mengit agenge agine, ak kogonoor Aron ak weeriikyik eunekwak metitap mengoto.
Eeny mengit ak itaach korotiikyik ak iisote kaptisisyet.
Yeityo itonaton panyeegap mengoto, ak iun tuguugap ke tugul ak keelyekyik ak ituiye ak panyechooto kagetonaton kobooto metinnyi.
Beel mengoto komugul eng' kaptisisyet: niito ko kagoochinet ne kibeelei ne po Kamuktaindet ne Toroor; nyamdutyet ne anyiny, kagoochinet ne kigoochin Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kobunei maat.
“Nam mengit ne po aeng', si kogonoor Aron ak weeriikyik eunekwak metitap mengoto.

Eeny anyun mengoto ak itaach korotiik che iilee walisyegap itigap tai che po Aron ak weeriikyik, ak eng' morik che eecheen che po eunekwak che po tai ak eng' morik che eecheen che po keelyekwak che po tai. Yeityo iisote korotiik che kang'et komoswek tugul eng' kaptisisyet.
Ye ibata inam korotiik che mi kaptisisyet parak ak mwaita ne kiilse, ak iise Aron ak ngoroikyik, ak iise weeriikyik ak ngoroikwak. Si kitabaan ineendet ak ngoroikyik, ak weeriikyik ak ngoroikwak.

“Inemune mengit mwanikyik, mwanigap saruryet, mwanik che ki ilaach moet, kwambelelyet ne po kooet ak soromok tuwai, kobooto sunetikwak ak kubesto ne po tai, amu niito ko mengit ne po poisyetap katabaanet.
Eng' ateruut ole mi magatiinik che ma kinde mermereek, inemu; magatyat agenge komugul, magatyat ne ming'in ne kagiilee mwaita ak magatyat agenge ne terter ne mi taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Yeityo inde chooto tugul eunegap Aron ak eunegap weeriikyik ak iongoi inyee koek kagoochinet ne kiruuri eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.

Icheru tuguuchooto eng' eunekwak ak ibeel eng' kaptisisyet eng' paragutap kagoochinet ne kibeelei, koek nyamdutyet ne anyiny eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor. Niito ko kagoochinet ne kigoochin Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kobunei maat.
“Iip tagateet ne po mengitap poisyet ne po katabaanet ne po Aron, ak iongoi koek kagoochinet ne kiongoi eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor si koek nooto kebebertang'ung'.
Itabaan tagateet ne po kagoochinet ne kiongoi ak kubesto ne po kagoochinet ne kinamjin parak, ne kiongoi ak ne kinamjin parak che po mengoto po poisyetap katabaanet agobo Aron ak weeriikyik.

Punjin chooto Aron ak weeriikyik koek ng'atuutyet ne po agoi eng' piigap Israel, amu niito kebebertap kagoochinet ne kagitabaan, ak koek nooto kagoochinet ne kinamjin parak ne punu lagogap Israel eng' tiseiywegap kagoochinoikwak che po kaalyeet. Niito anyun ko kagoochinennywa ne kagitabaanji Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
“Tuun punjin weeriikyik ngoroichooto itabaanatiin che po Aron, ilaachi icheek si ki ili kitoroorchin poisyonooto tiliil.
Ilaachi ngoroichooto peetuusyek tisap, weerooto tuun namjin Aron tisiisyet ye mandoi emait ne kituiyechin si koboisyei eng' ole-tiliil.
“Nam mengit ne po poisyetap katabaanet si iyo panyeekyik eng' ole ki kitiliil,
ak koam Aron ak weeriikyik panyeegap mengoto ak magatiinik che mi ateruut eng' kurgeetap emait ne kituiyechin.
Amei icheegei tuguuchooto che kiyae kagaigaet, ak kinde poisyetap tiliilindo, ak kitabaan icheek. Ago amat koam toondet amu tiliileen tuguuchooto.
Ngo ng'et panyeek che po nooto ki kitabaanji poisyetap katabaanet anan eng' magatiinik, ak ngo tebi kot koeech, ibeel anyun eng' ma tugul che kong'et; amat keam amu tiliileen.
“Yachi Aron anyun ak weeriikyik ko uu tugul che kang'atiin. Inde icheek poisyonooto tiliil eng' peetuusyek tisap.
Igoitoi inyee peetuut age tugul kirgit ne neran ne po kagoochinet ne po tengekto kobunji kagaigaet. Ianyinyi kaptisisyet ye iyachini kagaigaet agobo ineendet. Yeityo iil ianyiny.
Iyae kagaigaet agobo kaptisisyet eng' peetuusyek tisap ak itiliil. Si kotiliilit kaptisisyet miising', ak kanyool kotiliilit kiy age tugul ne twaei kaptisisyet.
“Chu che igoitoi eng' kaptisiisyo; igoitoi peetuut age tugul aarek aeng' che mengichik che po keechiir che ma siirei kenyiit agenge koek kiit ne po agoi.
Igoite aarwet age karon ak igoite aarwet ne po aeng' koskoleny.
Itesyini aarwet age keruutyet agenge ne po peek che ng'ootiin che tambulul che kagiburukto litait agenge ne po mwaita ne pitunee tuisyet, ak litait agenge ne po divaik koek kagoochinet ne kirong'u.

Igoite aarwet age koskoleny ak iyachi ko uu kagoochinetap peek ni kabo karon ak ko uu kagoochinennyi ne kirong'u, koek nyamdutyet ne anyiny, kagoochinet ne kigoochin Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne punei maat.

Egu nooto kagoochinet ne kibeelei ne po kotugul eng' ibinwekwok tugul eng' kurgeetap emait ne kituiyechin eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, eng' ole kituiyechini ak inyee si ang'alaalun eng' olooto.
Kituiyechini yooto ak piigap Israel ak itiliili toroornatennyu yooto.
Atiliilii emait ne kituiyechin ak kaptisisyet. Atabaani Aron ak weeriikyik ak icheek si koboisyeiwo eng' tisiisyet.
Amenye kwenutap piigap Israel ak aegu Kamuktaindennywa.
Ak konai icheek kole aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindennywa ne ki among'u eng' emetap Misiri, si kobiit ameny kwenunnywa. Aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindennywa.
“Iyae anyun kaptisisyet ole kibeelee nyamdutik iyae keetiigap chebitoik.
Ingoek koindonyi ak tebeesindanyi sendimita artam ak muut. Aechindos koindo ak tebeesindo. Koindap tononennyi ko egu sendimita tamanwogik sogool. Namegei kapkorosuut ak kuinoikyik koegu kiit agenge.
Iliige thahabu che tiliileen paragunnyi ak komoswekyik tugul ak kuinoikyik. Yeityo itaany tegeleiywotap thahabu iyieme.
Itaany peteinik aeng' che po thahabu ak inde tuguuchooto koobeesyo tegeleiywot keel eng' tegeet ne po komosi ak ne po komosin, iyachi komoswek tuwai si koek ole kiroochi keetiik che ki ibe.
Yae keetichooto ki ibe keetiigap chebitoik ak iliige thahabu.
Indoi kaptisisyonooto taitap angeet ne ioitos koot, ye neegitee moingetap paornateet ne miitei taitap kerwet ne po rireenet ne mi paragutap paornateet ole kituiyechini ak inyee.
Peelei Aron nyamdutik che po tuguuk che ng'uu ne anyiny eng' olooto eng' karonet age tugul ye chobei taisyek,
ak peelei ineendet ye inaami taisyek koskoleny, koek nyamdutyet ne kibeelei eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' ibinwekwok tugul.
Amobeele olooto nyamdutik che teer anan tiseiywek che kibeelei anan che po peek. Amoroong'ji yooto kagoochinoik alak tugul che kiee.

Ingoyai Aron kagaigaet eng' kuinoigap kaptisisyonooto konyil agenge eng' kenyiit age tugul. Yaei kagaigaet eng' korotiigap kagoochinetap tengekto ne po kagaigaet konyil agenge eng' kenyiit age tugul eng' ibinwekwok tugul. Nooto ne tiliil miising' eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.”
Ki ng'alaalji `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Musa koleenji,
“Ye iit piigap Israel ko uu eng' koiitennywa, ko eng' yooto anyun kogoochi chii tugul `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kiit ne ityage saboondanyi si ma piit koroito eng' kwenunnywa ye iiti icheek.

Chu che koonu icheek: koonu chii age tugul kebebertap chepkondok ko uu chepkondogap ole-tiliil, ye siirtoi kowendi ole mi che kagiit. Egu kebebertap fedhaisyechooto kagoochinet ne punjin Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Igoochin chii age tugul Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kagoochinet, ne siirtoi kowendi ole mi che kagiit, che po kenyiisyek tiptem ak che siirei chooto.
Ingogon che kergei mogoryot kibananiat, koonu tugul kebebertap chepkondok, ye igoochin Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kagoochinet si oyai kagaigaet ne po saboonwekwok.

Taach fedha che po kagaigaet eng' piigap Israel ak igoite kobunji poisyetap emaitap tuiyet. Si koek nooto kabwaatet agobo piigap Israel eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor si koyai kagaigaet agobo saboonwekwok.”
Ki ng'alaalji `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Musa koleenji,
“Yai karait agine ne po sugunwet ak iyae sugunwet ng'echerennyi si kiuunse. Inde kwenutap Emait ne kituiyechin ak kaptisisyet ak iroong'ji peek.
Si koune Aron ak weeriikyik eunekwak ak keelyekwak.
Iunegei icheek ye mandoi emait ne kituiyechin si ma pek anan ye riikyin kaptisisyet si kobois ye peelei kagoochinet ne kigoochin Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kobunei maat.
Iuni anyun eunekwak ak keelyekwak si ma pek, ak koek ng'atuutyet ne po agoi eng' icheek, eng' ineendet ak eng' iyotennyi eng' ibinwekwak tugul.”
Ki ng'alaalji `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Musa kogeny koleenji,
“Inemunote tuguuk che myachen kosiir, tuguuk che uu igomoik, keruutik lo ne po kumyat, keruutik somok ne po kinamon che anyiny, keruutik somok ne po kalamus che anyiny,
ak keruutik lo che po kasia, ko uu che po ole-tiliil ak litaisyek ang'wan ne po mwaitap mseituni.
Yeityo ichop tuguuchooto koburugogis koek mwaita ne tiliil ne ki iilse ne ng'uu ne anyiny ne poisyetap ng'amotyot ne puruchi tuguuk che ng'uu ne anyiny. Egu mwaita ne tiliil ne ki iilse.
Iil emait ne kituiyechin eng' mwaita ak moinget ne po paornateet,
ak meset ak tuguukyik tugul, keldap tait ak tuguukyik, kaptisisyet ne kibeelee nyamdutik,
ak kaptisisyet ne kibeelee tiseiywot ak tuguukyik tugul ak taabeet ak kelunnyi.
Itabaan anyun tuguuchooto si kotiliiliitu miising', ak kanyool kotiliilit age tugul ne twaei tuguuchooto.
Iil Aron ak weeriikyik, ianyiny, si koboisyeiwo eng' tisiisyet.
Ak ing'alaalji piigap Israel ileenji, ‘Egu mwai eng' anee ne tiliil ne ki ilse eng' ibinwekwok tugul.
Ma kiroong'jin poortap chii age tugul mwai, amoyai mwai age ne uu niito. Amu tiliil niito ak egu ne tiliil eng' okweek.
Chii age tugul ne puruchi mwai age tugul koigei niito anan chii age tugul ne iilee mwaiita toondet, king'etoi chiichooto eng' piikyik.’ ”

Ki leenji `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Musa, “Inemunote tuguuk che ng'uu ne anyiny, natab, shekelet, kelbena; tuguuk che ng'uu ne anyiny kobooto tuguuk che nyamdut che tiliileen: ingoaechin tugul eng' karagendoet agenge.
Iyae eng' chooto nyamdutik, tuguuk che ng'uu ne anyiny, ne poisyetap ng'omnateet ne puruchi tuguuk che ng'uu ne anyiny che kitestoi muunyuk che tiliileen che ki kitabaan.
Yeityo itui alak eng' chooto komengegitu ak inde chooto taitap paornateet eng' emait ne kituiyechin, ole kituiyechini ak inyee. Egu ne tiliil miising' eng' okweek.
Amat oyachigei nyamdutik alak tugul che kergei ak chuuto. Egu ne tiliil eng' inyee ne po Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ngo yai chii age tugul alak che uu chooto kole kogas ng'uunennyi, king'etoi chiichooto eng' piikyik.”
Ki ng'alaalji `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Musa koleenji,
“Keero, ki aguur Bezalel weeriitap Uri weeriitap Hur ne po ooreetap Judah,
ak kaanyiit ineendet Kabuuset ne po Kamuktaindet, ng'omnateet, kaguiyet ak naet, konai ole teptoi poisyet age tugul ne po musoknateet.
Imuuchi inee koyai poisyonigap musoknateet ne kiboisyee thahabu, fedha, ak sugunonik,
ak waetap koik che kitetyin kelongonik, keetiik ak poisyet age tugul ne po musoknateet.
Ak asi kotoret ineendet, ko kaalewen anee Aholiab weeriitap Aisamak ne po ooreetap Dan, ak kaande ng'omnateet mugulelwegap tugul che tinyei kaguiyet si kobiit koyai icheek tugul che kaang'atiin:
emait ne kituiyechin, moingetap paornateet, kerwet ne po rireenet ne mi paragunnyi ak tuguuk tugul che mi Emainooto;
meset ak tuguukyik, keeldo ne tiliil ne po tait ak tuguukyik tugul ak kaptisisyet ne kibeelee nyamdutik,
kaptisisyet ne po tiseiywek che kibeelei ak tuguukyik tugul ak taabeet kobooto ng'echerennyi ne tebee,
ngoroik che kisalei kogororonitu che itabaanatiin che po Aron tisiindet ak ngoroigap weeriikyik si koboisyee eng' tisiisyet;
ak mwaita ne ki iilse ak nyamdutigap tuguuk che ng'uu ne anyiny che po ole-tiliil. Yaei anyun icheek ko uu tugul che kaang'atiin.”
Ki ng'alaalji `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Musa koleenji,
“Ng'alaalji piigap Israel ileenji, ‘Oriip sabatosyekyuk komyee. Amu niito kaboorunet eng' kwenunnyo anee ak okweek eng' ibinwekwok tugul, si kobiit onai ole aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne atabaanok.
Nooto anyun oriip sabato amu itabaanat eng' okweek. Kibarei iman age tugul ne imurwooni.’ ” Ago king'etoi eng' piikyik chii age tugul ne yaei poisyet age tugul eng' peetuunooto.

Kiyaei poisyet peetuusyek lo, ago peetuutap tisap ko sabato ne po kamuung'et ne tiliil ne itabaanat eng' Kamuktaindet ne Toroor. Kibarei iman chii age tugul ne yaei poisyet age tugul eng' peetuutap sabato.
Eng' nooto anyun ko kanyool koriip piigap Israel sabato ak kotabaan eng' ibinwekwak tugul koek arorutyet ne po koigeny.
Kaboorunet niito eng' kwenunnyu ak piigap Israel ne po agoi, amu ki yai Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kipsengwet ak ng'wony eng' peetuusyek lo ak eng' peetuut ne po tisap ko ki imuuny kotalbis.
Ye kingo kagogees Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ng'alaalet ne ki ng'alaali ak Musa eng' tulweetap Sinai, kogoochi Musa koik aeng' che lebeleen che po paornateet che ki kisire mornetap Kamuktaindet.

Ye kingo keer piik kole kagogagei Musa eng' tulweet ama choorgei, kotuiyechi ole mi Aron ak koleenji, “Ng'eet yaiywech kanamonik che pendi kondoi eng' acheek, amu ma kingen kiit ne kinyoor Musa-iniito, chiichooto ki imutwech kemang'une emetap Misiri.”
Koleenji `Aron pichooto, “Ocherunee munaogap thahabu osotikwok, weeriikwok ak tiibiikwok che tinyei eng' itiik ak oibwa.”
Ki icher piik tugul anyun munaok tugul che po thahabu che ki mi itiikwak ak koipchi Aron.

Kitaach tuguuchooto kobunu eunekwak. Yeityo kobeel kochotyo ak kochop eng' karnet ne kiboisyee kotany kanamwet ne po moita. Ak ki mwa piik eng' poiboiyet kole, “Kanamoniguk chu, inyee Israel, che ki imutun imang'une emetap Misiri!”
Ye kingo keer Aron poiboiyennywa, koteech kaptisisyet eng' taitap kanamwonooto ak komwaita kole, “Egu igoorto ne oo mutai eng' Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.”
Ki ng'eetyo karon miising' eng' peetuut ne ki isubi peetuunooto ak kogoito kagoochinoik che kibeelei. Ki ip kagoochinoigap kaalyeet, ak ki tep ng'wony piik koamis, koeeiso ak kong'eetyo kourerenso.
Ki ng'alaalji `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Musa koleenji, “Ui, choortegei; amu kagong'emgei piiguk che ki imutu komang'une emetap Misiri.

Kagosip komasta kometo ooreet ne kiga ang'atyi. Kagoyachigei kanamwet ne po moita ne ki kitaany, ak kogutung'ji, ak kagoeng'ji tiseiywot, ak koleen, ‘Kanamoniguk chu, inyee Israel, che ki imutun imang'une emetap Misiri.’ ”
Ki testai Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kong'alaalji Musa ak koleenji, “Koageer ale, uueen kaat pichu.
Pagaakta anyun, si kolaany parak nereegekyuk agobo icheek ak awong'u pichuuto. Yeityo ayain inyee iegu pororyet ne oo.”

Ki igaigai `Musa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindennyi, koleenji, “Ee, Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, amu nee si kolalyo nereegeguk agobo piiguk che ki imutu komang'une emetap Misiri eng' kimnateet ne oo ak eng' euut ne kiim?
Amu nee si komwa tuun Misiriik kole, ‘Kiga imutyin icheek yaityet kole si kobar eng' tuloonook, ak kowong' kobetyo eng' ng'wony?’ Ketite nereegeguk che laldos ak iwal kii ya koistoegei piiguk.

Ibwaat Abraham, Isak, ak Israel, otwogiguk che ki iyasyechi inyegei, ileenji, ‘Abaroi iyoteng'wong' kotenit kecheigap kipsengwet ak agoochini iyoteng'wong' emoni komugul ne ki amwaiwok ak kobunji icheek koigeny.’ ”
Ki wol anyun `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kabwaatutikyik agobo yaityonooto ki kamwa kole yachin piikyik.
Ki weigei Musa kochoortagei eng' tulweet, koibe eunnyi koik aeng' che lebeleen che po paornateet. Ki siraatiin koichooto komoswek tuwai, amu kiga kisir tai ak patai.
Ki poisyetap Kamuktaindet koichooto ak siruutichooto ko ki siruutigap Kamuktaindet che ki kagisir kewai eng' koichooto.
Ye kingo kas Joshua polatetap piik koboldos, koleenji Musa, “Mi polatetap pooryeet nganaseet.”
Ago ki le Musa, “Ma po kutinooto icheeget che poldos amu kagoterteeris ama po che poldos amu kagiterter, ago po polatonooto agase icheeget che tyendos.”
Ye kingo riik nganaseet ak kogeer kanamwetap moita ak ureryet, konereech miising' Musa. Ki wiirta anyun koichooto ki tinyei eng' eunekyik, kotui eng' tulweet keel.
Ki nam kanamwonooto po moita ne kiga kotany, ak kobeel eng' ma, yeityo kong'a kotambululitu ak koseerchi peek parak ak kobirchi piigap Israel koe.
Ki leenji `Musa Aron, “Nee ne kiyaun pichu kot iipchi icheek tengegi oo tee ni?”
Kowol Aron kole, “Amat konereech miising' kiptaiyandennyu, ingen inyee pichu ile ki kotokyigei yaityet.
Amu ki leenjo, ‘Yaiywech kanamonik, che pendi kondoenech, amu Musa-iniito, chiito ne ki imutwech kemang'une emetap Misiri koma kingen kiit ne kinyoor.’
Ara ki aleenji icheek, ‘Ingocher chii age tugul thahabu che tinyei, ak kogoono.’ Ki awirchi ma, ak ki mong' moi.”
Ye kingo keer Musa kole kabistoe piik, amu ki igoochi `Aron icheek kobistoe si koek che kireenyei eng' kwenutap puunikwak,
kotonon anyun eng' ormariichetap nganaseet ak kole, “Ingonyo age tugul ole ami ne mi komostap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.” Ak ki pwanji ineendet tugul che po ooreetap Lawi.

Yeityo koleenji `ineendet icheek, “Kamwa ko uu ni Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindetap Israel kole, ‘Ingorat chii age tugul rotwennyi po chok ak ingwo chii tugul komosi ak komosi kobun kwenutap kurgeet age agoi kurgeet age, eng' nganaseet komugul, ak kobar chii tugul ne tupcho, chorwennyi ak chiitap kokwennyi.’ ”
Ki yai weeriigap Lawi ko uu ng'olyootap Musa. Ki pek piik peetuunooto che itei eliphuusyek somok.
Ak ki le Musa, “Kaotabaanjigei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor rani chii tugul ne ma namegei ak weeriinnyi anan ne tupcho, si kogoonok ineendet perurto rani.”
Eng' peetuut ne ki isubi, koleenji `Musa piik, “Ki oyai tengekto ne oo. Katogoste anyun nguno awe ole mi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, tamangap ayai kagaigaet agobo tengektong'wong'.”
Kiweekyigei `Musa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ak koleenji, “Pwo! Ki yai pichu tengekto ne oo miising', ak ki koyachigei kanamwet ne po thahabu.
Ago ngot icham, nguno, inyochigaat tengektonywa. Ngo ma uu nooto, asoomin ale iistaa eng' bukuing'ung' ne ki isir.”
Ago ki leenji `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Musa, “Aistoi eng' bukuinnyu age tugul ne ki koyaiywo tengekto.
