Ingomwet ngoroikyik ne ibei poortap tyonyooto kame, ko murwoniitu agoi koimen; ng'woneen chooto eng' okweek.
“Ng'woneen eng' okweek chu eng' che ichuutegei ng'wony: kungundo, muryat ne ming'in, ak ne kergei ak mororochet,
ne po ooreetap chepswererit, nyirityet, chebenetyet, kimng'elyegut ak pung'ung'wet.
Chuuto che ng'woneen eng' okweek eng' tugul che ichuutegei, age tugul ne twaei ne kagome eng' chooto ko murwoniitu agoi koimen.

Ng'wanitu kiy age tugul ne ibutyin ne kagome eng' chooto, ngo kiy age tugul ne ki kiyae keetiik, anan ngor, anan mui, anan kuniet, kiy age tugul ne kiboisyee; nyolu kirooch peek ak murwoniitu agoi koimen, yeityo anyun koanyinyak.
Ngo putyi age tugul eng' chooto tereetap ng'ung'unyek oriit, ko ng'wanitu kiy age tugul ne mi oriit, ak nyolu otui teronooto.
Ng'woneegitu amitwogik alak tugul che kechobe peegap teronooto, ak ng'woneegitu tuguuk tugul che kiee che mi teronooto.
Ak kiy age tugul ne ibutyin kebebertap poorto ne po tyondo ne kagome ko ng'wanitu. Ngo kapkoimaut, anan tereenik, kituei chooto amu ng'woneen. Ng'woneegitu chooto eng' okweek.
Ago konda ne kutune peek anan keriinget ne mi peek ko tiliiliitu, ago ne twaei poortap tyondo ne kame ko murwoniitu.
Ngo putyi peny age tugul ne po tyonyooto kame kesweek che ki koolei, ko anyinyen.
Ago nginur keswechooto ak kobutyi peny age tugul ne po tyony ne kame, ko ng'wanitu eng' okweek.
“Ngo me tyony age tugul ne oame, ko ineendet ne twaei poortap tyonyooto ko murwoniitu agoi koimen.
Ak ne amei panyeegap nooto kame ko ingomwet ngoroikyik ak murwoniitu agoi koimen. Ingomwet ngoroik ne ibei tyonyooto kame ak murwoon ineendet agoi koimen.
“Egu eng' okweek ne kiwechei kiy age tugul ne ichuutegei ng'wony; ma ki amei.
Kiy age tugul ne ichuute moet ng'wony ak ne punei keelyek ang'wan, anan age tugul ne tinyei keelyek che chaang', chooto tugul che ichuutegei ng'wony ko moam amu kiwechei.
Among'wanitkei eng' kiy age tugul ne ichuutegei ng'wony, amomurwongei eng' icheek si konamak murwoonindo.
Amu aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindeng'wong', otabaangei anyun ak oegu che tiliileen amu aa tiliil. Amomurwongei eng' kiy age tugul ne ichuutegei ng'wony.
Aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne ki amutwak otogosu omang'une emetap Misiri, aek Kamuktaindeng'wong'; otiliiliitu anyun amu aa tiliil.”
Ni ng'atuutyet anyun agobo tyong'in, toriit, kiy age tugul ne sabei ne wendoti eng' pei ak kiy age tugul ne ichuutegei ng'wony;
si kobiit koobeesyo che ng'woneen ak che ma ng'woneen, che saptos che ki amei ak che saptos che ma ki amei.
Ki ng'alaalji `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Musa koleenji,
“Mwachi piigap Israel ileenji: Ngo manach kwony age tugul ak kosich weeriit, komi eng' murwoonindo eng' peetuusyek tisap. Murwoniitu ko uu eng' peetuusyegap myandanyi ne po arawet age tugul.
Ak eng' peetuut ne po sisiit kimuratani iriryotap poortap weerooto.
Ingotebee kwonyooto korotiigap katiliilennyi peetuusyek sosom ak somok. Matwaei ineendet kiy age tugul ne itabaanat, ama mong'u ole-tiliil agoi kogeskei peetuusyek che kitiliile ineendet.
Ago ngo sich chepto, komurwoniitu peetuusyek taman ak ang'wan, ko uu eng' peetuusyegap myandanyi. Ak tebyei eng' korotiigap katiliilennyi peetuusyek tamanwogik lo ak lo.

“Ye kagogeskei peetuusyegap katiliilennyi, agobo weeriit, anan ko chepto, koipchi tisiindet eng' kurgeetap emait ne kituiyechin aarwetap keechiir ne ma siirei kenyiit agenge koek kagoochinet ne kibeelei, ak aarwetap toriit, anan cheptuget koek kagoochinetap tengekto.

Igoitoi ineendet chooto eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ak koyai kagaigaet agobo kwonyooto, ak kitiliil amu pandap korotiikyik. Po ng'atuutyoni ineendet ne sigisyei, ngo kagisich weeriit, anan ko chepto.

“Ngo ma imuuchi koal kwonyooto aarwetap keechiir, konam anyun cheptugenik aeng', anan ko aarek aeng' che po toriitik, po age kagoochinet ne kibeelei ak po age kagoochinet ne po tengekto; ak koyai tisiindet kagaigaet agobo ineendet, ak kotiliilit.”
Ki ng'alaalji `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Musa ak Aron koleenji,

“Ngoobwa iriryotap poortap chii, anan ngo piit moet ne kayaam, anan ole ibwanat ne uu ngosyat, ak koek koroito ne po mogondos eng' iriryotap poortanyi, kimut anyun kwo ole mi Aron tisiindet anan ko age eng' weeriikyik che tisiik.

Keerei tisiindonooto koroyooto miitei iriryotap poorto ak ngo kogowalak koroorik che mi koroyooto koleelagitu ak ngo kogororokto moanooto kwo oriit, ko kagoek koroito ne po mogondos. Ye kagogeer tisiindet komwaita anyun kole murwoon chiichooto.
Ago ngo leel ngosyat ne mi iriryotap poortanyi, ak ma lolondoot, ak ngo mawalak koroorikyik koleelagitu, kogerchi ui anyun tisiindet eng' peetuusyek tisap ineendet ne tinyei koroyooto.
Keerei tisiindet ineendet eng' peetuut ne po tisap, ngo keer kole ta ko uu yegonye koroyooto ak ma konenderi eng' iriryot, kogerchi ui anyun tisiindet ineendet peetuusyek tisap alak.

Keerei tisiindet ineendet kogeny eng' peetuut ne po tisap, ngo machei kola ak ma konenderi koroito eng' iriryot, komwaita anyun tisiindet kole kagotiliilit chiichi; kaagaa moet ne kayaam. Mwetei ineendet ngoroikyik, ak koek ne tiliil.
Ago ngo nender moet eng' iriryot ye kagoboorchigei tisiindet agobo katiliilennyi, konyolu koboorchigei tisiindet kogeny.
Keerei tisiindet, ak ngo keer kole kagonender moet eng' iriryot, komwaita anyun tisiindet kole murwoon ineendet; mogondos chuuto.
“Ye kagonam chii myandap mogondos, kimutyi ineendet anyun tisiindet.
Keerei anyun tisiindet, ak ngo leel ole ibwanat eng' iriryot ak kogowalak koroorik koleelagitu, ak kotook panyeek eng' ye koibwanat,
ko mogondos che ki koamei keny iriryotap poortanyi, komwaita tisiindet kole murwoon chiichito. Ma keerei tisiindet ineendet, amu murwoon.
Ngo mang'une mogondosaik ola tugul eng' iriryonnyi, ak koyom poorto tugul ne po ineendet ne tinyei koroito, kobooch metinnyi agoi keelyekyik, ne tee ne imuuchi kogeer tisiindet;
kogeer anyun tisiindet, ngo kogoyom mogondosaik poortanyi tugul, komwaita anyun kole tiliil chiichito tinyei koroito, amu kogowalak poorto tugul koleelit, tiliil ineendet.
Ago ye katook panyeek ko uu yegonye, ko murwoon ineendet.
Keerei tisiindet panyechooto ak komwaita kole murwoon chiichito. Murwooneen panyeechooto taagu, amu niito ko mogondos.
Ago ngo walak panyeek kogeny koleelagitu, konyo ineendet anyun ole mi tisiindet;
ak kogeer tisiindet ineendet, ak ngo kagowalak koroito koleelit, komwaita anyun tisiindet kole tiliil ineendet ne tinyei koroito. Tiliil anyun ineendet.
“Ngo pitunee iriryotap poorto ondiryet, ne kiga kosap,
ak ngo pitunee ole kami ondiryet kibwondo ne leel, anan ngosyat ne taagu ne leel ne machei ko piriir, koboorchi anyun tisiindet.
Keerei tisiindet, ngo keer kole lolondoot eng' poorto ak kowalak koroorikyik koleelagitu, komwaita tisiindet kole murwoon ineendet. Niito koroito ne po mogondos ne kogomang'une ondiryet.
Ago ngo keer tisiindet kole ma mi koroorik che leelach, ama lolondoot eng' iriryot, ago ma taagu miising', kogerchi ui anyun tisiindet ineendet peetuusyek tisap.
Ngo nenderi eng' iriryot, komwaita anyun tisiindet kole murwoon ineendet; amu korot ne ya niito.
Ago ngo matesak ngosiandanooto konender, ko kaagaa perutyetap ondiryet; komwaita tisiindet kole tiliil ineendet.
“Anan ye tinyei chii ole kalal eng' iriryot ak kotook panyeekyik eng' olooto kalal, ak koigei yooto ngosyat ne leel ne piriir anan ko ne leel,

kogeer anyun tisiindet kioto. Ngo kogowalak koroorik koleelagitu ak ko lolondoot, ko mogondos nooto ne kogomang'une ole kolal. Mwaitoi anyun tisiindet kole murwoon ineendet, amu koroito ne po mogondos niito.
Ago ngo keer tisiindet kole ma mi koroorik che leelach ngosiandanooto ak ma lolondoot eng' iriryot ak ma taagu miising', kogerchi ui anyun tisiindet ineendet peetuusyek tisap.
Ak kogeer tisiindet ineendet kogeny eng' peetuut ne po tisap, ak ngo nenderi eng' iriryot, komwaita anyun tisiindet kole murwoon chiichito, amu niito koroito ne po mogondos.
Ago ngo matesak ngosiandanooto konender eng' iriryot, ama taagu miising', ko kabwanetap ole kolal, ak komwaita anyun tisiindet kole tiliil chiichi, amu niito ko perutyet kityo eng' ole kolal.
“Ye tinyei mureno anan kobogoryo koroito eng' metit anan ko eng' tamnet,

kogeer anyun tisiindet koroyooto. Ak ngo keer ko lolondoot eng' iriryot, ak miitei korooryet ne talelyo ak ko tenden, komwaita anyun tisiindet kole murwoon chiichi; moet niito ne uu kacheet, mogondos ne po metit anan ko tamnet.
Ago ngo keer tisiindet moanooto uu kacheet kole ma lolondoot eng' iriryot, ama mi koroorik che tuuen, kogerchi ui anyun tisiindet peetuusyek tisap ineendet ne tinyei koroyooto yaamei.
Ak kogeer tisiindet koroyooto eng' peetuut ne po tisap, ngo ma tesoksei moanooto, ama mi koroorik che talelyonen, ak ngo ma lolondoot moanooto eng' iriryot,
kicherchi anyun metit, ago ma icheru ineendet ole mi kacheet. Keerei tisiindet eng' peetuusyek alak tisap chiichooto tinyei kacheet,
ak eng' peetuut ne po tisap kogeer tisiindet moanooto. Ngo ma tesoksei moet eng' iriryot, ama lolondoot eng' yooto, komwaita anyun tisiindet kole tiliil ineendet. Ak komwet ngoroikyik, ak kotiliilit.
Ago ngo tesak moet eng' iriryot ko kagobata katiliilennyi,
kogeer anyun tisiindet ineendet. Ngo tesoksei moet eng' iriryot, koma cheeng'ei anyun tisiindet koroorik che talelyonen, amu murwoon ineendet.
Ago ngo keer kole ma tesoksei kachaanooto ak kooro kole kogobityo koroorik che tuuen eng' yooto, kagosap kioto, kagotiliilok ineendet; ak komwaita tisiindet kole tiliil ineendet.
“Ye tinyei mureno anan kobogoryo ole ibwanat ne uu ngosenik eng' iriryotap poortanyi, ngosen che leelach,
kogeer anyun tisiindet, ak ngo ma leelachen miising' ngosenichooto eng' iriryotap poorwekwak; ko kaagaa tisonok kityo che komang'une iriryot; tiliil anyun ineendet.
“Ngo pek suumeek eng' metitap chii, ko chii ne po poosto, ko tiliil ineendet.
Ak ngo pek suumeek eng' met ole po togoch, kotinyei poosto eng' togoch, ko tiliil ineendet.
Ago ngo miitei myando ne ibooru leelindo ne piriir eng' poosto anan eng' togoch, nooto ko mogondosaik che komang'une poostonyi anan ko togeennyi.
Kogeer anyun tisiindet ineendet, ak ngo leel ne piriir myando ne ibwanat eng' poostonyi, anan ko eng' togeennyi, ko uu ye taagu mogondosaik eng' iriryotap poorto,
ko ineendet ko chii ne po mogondos ak ko murwoon. Mwaitoi anyun tisiindet kole murwoon chiichi, amu mi koroto metinnyi.
“Ilachei ne tinyei mogondosaik ngoroik che kibetak, ak kiyaatei metinnyi, tuchei kutit ye po parak ak koboloti kowachei koleen, ‘Aa ng'waan, aa ng'waan!’
Murwoniitu ineendet peetuusyek tugul kotee koamei myanooto. Meng'iisyei ineegei; meng'ootennyi ko saang'utap nganaseet.
“Kiboorchin tisiindet ngoryeet ne mi koroitap mogondosaik, ngo po ngoryonooto koroorigap keechiirek, anan ngo po katanit,
anan ngo mitune usiisyek che ki kitoor anan che ki kimur, che po katanit, anan ngo che po koroorigap keechiirek, ngo magateet, anan eng' kiy age tugul ne kiyae magateet,

ngo machei konyaliil anan ngo machei kobiriir koroyooto eng' ngoryeet, anan eng' magateet, anan eng' usiisyek che ki kitoore anan che ki kimure, anan eng' kiy age tugul ne ki kiyae magateet; niito ko koroito ne po mogondos.
Ak kogeer tisiindet koroyooto, ak kogonor kioto tinyei koroito eng' peetuusyek tisap.

Keerei koroyooto eng' peetuut ne po tisap, ak ngo nenderi koroito eng' ngoryeet, ngo mitune usiisyek che ki kitoore anan che ki kimure, anan eng' magateet ne kiboisyee eng' kiy age tugul, ko mogondosaik che ng'emisyei; ng'waan kioto.

Peelei ngoryonooto anyun eng' ma, ngo po usiisyek che ki kitoor anan che ki kimur, ngo che po koroorigap keechiirek anan ngo che po katanit, anan kiy age tugul ne po magateet, ne tinyei koroito, amu nooto ko mogondosaik che ng'emisyei.
“Ngo keer tisiindet kole ma tesaksei koroyooto eng' ngoryeet, ngo eng' usiisyek che ki kitoor anan che ki kimur, anan eng' kiy age tugul ne po magateet,
kong'at anyun tisiindet kole kemwet kioto tinyei koroito, ak kogonor kioto eng' peetuusyek tisap alak,

ak kogeer tisiindet, ko kagiundo koroyooto. Ak ngo mawalak koroyooto eng' saleiywekyik, amainenderi koroyooto, ko ng'waan anyun; ibeel eng' ma. Ng'emindet nooto, ngo mitune churateet oriit anan saang'.
“Ak ngo keer tisiindet kole ma kotaagu komyee koroyooto ko kagemwet, kogereer ole mi koroyooto koisto eng' ngoryeet anan eng' magateet anan eng' usiisyek che ki kitoore anan che ki kimure;
ak ngo ta ko taagu eng' ngoryeet, eng' usiisyek che ki kitoore anan che ki kimure, anan eng' kiy age tugul ne po magateet, ko koroito ne inenderi, ibeelei anyun kioto tinyei koroito eng' ma.
Ago ngo kogobagaakta koroito ngoryeet, ngo ne po usiisyek che ki kitoor anan che ki kimur, anan kiy age tugul ne po magateet ne imwete, kemwet anyun ne po aeng', ak ko tiliilit.”

Ni ng'atuutyet ne po koroitap mogondosaik ne mi ngoryeetap koroorigap keechiirek anan ko ne po katanit, anan eng' usiisyek che ki kitoore anan che ki kimure, anan eng' kiy age tugul ne po magateet, komwaita anyun kole tiliil, anan komwaita kole ng'waan.
Ki mwachi `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Musa koleenji,
“Egu niito ng'atuutyet ne po chiito ne tinyei mogondosaik eng' peetuut ne po katiliilennyi. Kimutyin ineendet tisiindet,
mandoi tisiindet eng' nganaseet ak kogeer ineendet. Ngo kogosap koroitap mogondosaik eng' chiichooto komyani,
kong'at anyun tisiindet keip toriitik aeng' che tiliileen che saptos agobo ineendet ne kitiliili, kobooto keetitap taragonik, ngoryeet ne piriir ak husop.
Ak kong'at tisiindet kole kobar toriityon age eng' tereet ne po ng'ung'unyek, eng' paragutap peek che rootei.

Namei tisiindet toriityon ne sabei ak keetitap taragonik, ngoryeet ne piriir ak husop, ak korooch chooto tugul kobooto toriityon ne sabei, korotiigap toriityanooto kagibar eng' paragutap peek che rootei.
Ak koisee ineendet ne kitiliili eng' mogondosaik konyil tisap, ak komwaita kole tiliil. Yeityo kounda toriityanooto sabei kwo kewanin.

Mwetei ngoroikyik anyun chiichooto kitiliili, ak konem suumeekyik tugul, yeityo kouungei eng' peek, ak kotiliilit. Ye ibata nooto konyo nganaseet oriit, ak kotebee saang'utap emainnyi peetuusyek tisap.
Eng' peetuutap tisap konem suumeekyik tugul eng' metinnyi ak tamnennyi ak koroorigap koonyek. Inemu agot koroorikyik tugul, ak komwet ngoroikyik, ak kouungei, ak kotiliilit ineendet.

“Ak konam eng' peetuut ne po sisiit aarek aeng' che mengichik che libwoben, ak aarwetap keechiir, subeendo ne libwoop, ne ma siirei kenyiit agenge, ak kebebertap somok ne po litaiyat che po peek che ng'ootiin che tambulul, koek kagoochinetap peek, che ki kiburukto mwaita, ak taabeet ne ming'in ne po mwaita.
Igoitoi tisiindet ne itiliili ineendet, chiichooto kitiliili ak tuguuchooto, eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, eng' kurgeetap emait ne kituiyechin.

Ak konam tisiindet mengit agenge eng' areechooto po keechiir, kogoito koek kagoochinetap chalwokto, kobooto taabeet ne ming'in ne po mwaita, koongoi tuguuchooto koek kagoochinet ne kiongoi eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.

Enyei anyun mengoto ming'in eng' komosta ne kieng'e kagoochinetap tengekto ak kagoochinet ne kibeelei, eng' ole-tiliil. Amu ko uu ye punjin kagoochinetap tengekto tisiindet, ko uu nooto punjin ineendet kagoochinetap chalwokto; kogoochinet nooto ne Tiliil miising' kosiir.

Namei tisiindet korotiik alak eng' che po kagoochinetap chalwokto, ak konde walitap itit ne po tai ne po ineendet ne kitiliili, ak eng' mornet ne oo ne po eutap tai, ak eng' mornet ne oo ne po keldanyi ne po tai.
Yeityo konem tisiindet mwanik alak che mi taabeet, ak koroong'ji rubeitap eunnyi ne po kaataam,
ak korooch tisiindet mornennyi ne po tai mwaata mi eunnyi ne po kaataam, ak koisisye mwaata eng' mornennyi eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor konyil tisap.

Ak mwaita ne kang'etune eutap tisiindet konde walitap itit ne po tai ne po ineendet ne kitiliili, ak eng' mornet ne oo ne po eunnyi ne po tai, ak eng' mornet ne oo ne po keldanyi ne po tai, eng' paragutap korotiigap kagoochinet ne po chalwokto.
Yeityo koroong'ji mwaita ne kang'etune euut metitap ineendet ne kitiliili, ak koyai tisiindet kagaigaet agobo ineendet eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Igoitoi tisiindet kagoochinetap tengekto, ak koyai kagaigaet agobo ineendet ne kitiliili amu murwoonindanyi. Ye ibata koeny kagoochinet ne kibeelei,
ak kogoito kagoochinetap peek eng' kaptisisyet, ak koyai tisiindet kagaigaet agobo ineendet, ak kotiliilit.

“Ago ngo kibanania, amaimuuchi konyoor che yamegei ak kioto, kokweri anyun mengit agenge ne ming'in koek kagoochinet ne po chalwokto ne kiongoi, si koyai kagaigaet agobo ineendet, ak kiloit agenge ne po peek che ng'ootiin che tambulul che kagiburukto mwaita koek kagoochinetap peek, ak taabeet ne ming'in ne po mwaita.
Ibu kora cheptugenik aeng', anan aarek aeng' che po toriitik, ko uu ye imuuchi konyoor, ak kobunji age kagoochinetap tengekto, kobunji age kagoochinet ne kibeelei.
Ingoipchi ineendet tisiindet tuguuchooto eng' peetuut ne po sisiit, kobunji katiliilennyi, eng' kurgeetap emait ne kituiyechin, eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ak konam tisiindet aarwetap keechiir ne po kagoochinetap chalwokto, ak taabeetap mwaita, ak koongoi chooto eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor koek kagoochinet ne kiongoi.

Yeityo koeny arwanooto po kagoochinetap chalwokto, ak ingoip tisiindet alak eng' korotiigap kagoochinetap chalwokto, ak konde walitap itit ne po tai ne po ineendet ne kitiliili, ak eng' mornet ne oo ne po eunnyi ne po tai, ak eng' mornet ne po keldanyi ne po tai.
Ak koroong'ji tisiindet mwanik alak rubeitap eunnyi ne po kaataam,
ak koisisye eng' mornennyi ne po tai mwanik alak che mi eunnyi ne po kaataam konyil tisap eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.

Ak konde tisiindet mwanichooto alak che mi eunnyi, walitap ititap tai ne po ineendet ne kitiliili, ak eng' mornet ne oo ne po eunnyi ne po tai, ak eng' mornet ne oo ne po keldanyi ne po tai, eng' paragutap korotiigap kagoochinet ne po chalwokto.
Yeityo koroong'ji tisiindet mwanik che kang'etune eunnyi, metitap ineendet ne kitiliili, si koyai kagaigaet agobo ineendet eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ye ibata kogoito agenge eng' cheptugenik, anan aarwet agenge ne po toriitik, ko uu ye imuuchi konyoor;

agot ko uu ye imuuchi konyoor, kobunji age kagoochinetap tengekto, ak kobunji age kagoochinet ne kibeelei, kobooto kagoochinetap peek. Yae tisiindet kagaigaet agobo ineendet ne kitiliili eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Niito ng'atuutyet ne po ineendet ne miitei koroitap mogondosaik oriitinnyi, ne ma imuuchi konyoor che yamei kitiliile.”
Ki mwachi `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Musa ak Aron, koleenji,
“Ye oit emetap Kanaan, ne agoonok kobunjook, ak ande koroitap mogondos koot age eng' emet ne punjinok,
konyo anyun chiitap koyooto konyo komwachi tisiindet, koleenji miitei koroito koot.
Kong'at anyun tisiindet kimaanda tuguuk tugul eng' ko, kotomo kwo ko tisiindet kogeer koroyooto, si mang'woneegitu tuguuk tugul che mi koyooto. Yeityo anyun kwo ko tisiindet kogeerot koot.
Keerei koroito, ngot komi koroito inatusyegap koot, ak ngo mitoti kelongonik che machei ko nyalileen ak che machei ko piriireen, ak ngo lolondootin kosiir tooteet,
komanda anyun tisiindet eng' koyooto agoi kurgat ak koger koyooto peetuusyek tisap.
Ak konyo tisiindet kogeny eng' peetuut ne po tisap, nyoo kogeer, ak ngo keer ko tesoksei koroyooto eng' inatusyegap koot,
kong'at anyun tisiindet, kicher koik che tinyei koroito, ak kewiirchi komosta ne ya eng' saang'utap nganaseet.
Ng'atei ineendet keng'oing'oi koot komoswek tugul eng' koot oriit, ak kotumji pichooto taartaarik che king'oing'oe koyooto saang'utap nganaseet komosta ne ya.
Yeityo koip koik alak, konde ole kami koik chugai, ak konam ineendet taartaarik alak, komale koot.
“Ngo mong' koroito kogeny kotook eng' koot, ko kagoip koik koba saang', ak ko kagong'oing'oi ineendet koot, ak ko kagemal,
konyo anyun tisiindet ko konyo kogeer, ak ngo katesak koroito eng' koot, ko mogondosaik che ng'emisyei eng' ko; ng'waan anyun koyooto.
Ingobut koyooto, koikyik, ak keetiikyik, ak taartaarik tugul che po koyooto, ak koip chooto koba komosta ne ya eng' saang'utap nganaseet.
Ak kogeny, ngwo chii koyooto kota ko kerat koot, kong'wanitu agoi koimen.
Mwetei ngoroikyik ne karu koyooto ak ineendet ne kaamisye koyooto.
“Ago ngwo ko tisiindet ak kogeer ko matesak koroito eng' koyooto ko kagemal, komwaita anyun tisiindet kole, tiliil koot, amu kagosap koot eng' koroyooto.
Asi ki anyiny koyooto, konamei anyun ineendet toriitik aeng', keetitap taragonik, ngoryeet ne piriir ak husop.
Parei toriityon age eng' tereetap ng'ung'unyek eng' paragutap peek che rootei,
ak konam keetitap taragonik, husop, ngoryeet ne piriir, kobooto toriityon ne sabei, ak korooch tuguuchooto korotiigap toriityon ne kagebar, ak eng' peek che rootei, ak koisee koot konyil tisap.
Ianyinyi anyun koot eng' korotiik che po toriityanooto, eng' peechooto rootei, eng' toriityanooto sabei, eng' keetitap taragonik, eng' husop ak eng' ngoryeet ne piriir.
Ago ingounda anyun toriityon ne sabei kotiriren komanda eng' nganaseet kwo kewanin. Yaei anyun ko uu nooto kagaigaet agobo koot, ak kotiliilit.”
Ni ng'atuutyet ne po koroito age tugul ne po mogondosaik, ne po kacheet,
ne po ngoryeet ne tinyei mogondosaik, ak ne po koot,
ole ibwansei, ole yaamaat moet ak ole ibwanat ne uu ngosyat;
si kenae ye murwonen ak ye tiliileen. Niito ng'atuutyetap mogondosaik.
Ki ng'alaalji `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Musa ak Aron, koleenji,
“Omwachi piigap Israel, oleenji, Ye tinyei chii kusereet eng' poortanyi, komurwoniit anyun amu kuseroonooto.
Ak ni murwoonindanyi ne po kuseroonooto: agot ngomandoi tuguuchooto eng' poortanyi anan ngo kerak, ko murwoonindanyi nooto.
Ng'wanitu itoogut age tugul ne rue ineendet ne tinyei kusereet, ak ko ng'wanitu kiy age tugul ne tebee.
Ak mwetei chii age tugul ngoryennyi ne twaei itogunnyi, ak kouungei eng' peek, ak murwoniitu agoi koimen.
Mwetei ngoroikyik, ak kouungei eng' peek ineendet ne tebee kiy age tugul ne katebee chiichooto tinyei kusereet, ak komurwoniit agoi koimen.
Mwetei ngoroikyik ineendet ne twaei poortap chiichooto tinyei kusereet, ak kouungei eng' peek, ak komurwoniitu ineendet agoi koimen.
Ak ngo ng'utyi ne tinyei kuseroonooto chiito ne tiliil; komwetei anyun ngoroikyik, ak kouungei eng' peek, ak komurwoniit agoi koimen.
Ng'wanitu kiy age tugul ne ki itoi, si kotebee chiichooto tinyei kuseroonooto.
Ago murwoniitu agoi koimen chii age tugul ne twaei kiy age tugul ne mi ole tebee. Ak mwetei ngoroikyik ineendet ne ibei tuguuchooto, ak kouungei eng' peek, ak komurwoniit agoi koimen.
Mwetei ngoroikyik chii age tugul ne katwa nooto ne tinyei kuseroonooto, ago katomo koun eunekyik, ak kouungei, ak komurwoniit agoi koimen.
Ak kituei tereet ne ki kiyai eng' ng'ung'unyek ne katwa chiichooto tinyei kusereet, ak kiuuni eng' peek kiit age tugul ne ki kiyae keetit.
“Ye sap chiichooto eng' myanooto po kusereet, koiityigei peetuusyek tisap che po kaanyinyennyi, ak komwet ngoroikyik, ak koun poortanyi eng' peek che rootei, ak kotiliilit.
Ak kocheeng'jigei eng' peetuut ne po sisiit cheptugenik aeng', anan aarek aeng' che po toriitik, ak konyo taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor agoi kurgeetap emait ne kituiyechin, kwo kogoochi tisiindet,
ak kogoito tisiindet chooto kobunji age kagoochinetap tengekto, kobunji age kagoochinet ne kibeelei. Yae tisiindet kagaigaet eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor agobo ineendet amu kuserennyi.
“Ngo rwotito chii age tugul, ak komanda kesweegap iyoteet eng' poortanyi, kouungei anyun poorto tugul eng' peek, ak komurwoniit agoi koimen.
Ak kemwet ngoryeet age tugul, ak kiuun muito age tugul, ne katiiny keswechooto, ak komurwoniit agoi koimen.
Ak ngo tuiyogei muren ak kwony ak komaanda kesweegap iyoteet, konyolu kouungei icheek tuwai, ak komurwoniitu tuwai agoi koimen.
“Ngo tyech ng'wony kobogoryondo, ak konai kole, kaagaa peetuunnyi ne po arawet, kotebee murwoonindanyi peetuusyek tisap; ak komurwoniit agoi koimen age tugul ne twaei ineendet.
Ak ng'wanitu kiy age tugul ne syebei eng' murwoonindanyi, ak komurwoniit kiy age tugul ne tebee.
Kanyool anyun komwet ngoroikyik chii age tugul ne twaei itogunnyi, ak kouungei, ak komurwoniit agoi koimen.
Ak mwetei ngoroikyik chii age tugul ne twaei kiy age tugul ne katebee kobogoryondonooto, ak kouungei ak komurwoniit agoi koimen.
Ngo mi tuguuchooto itoogut, anan ko eng' kiy age tugul ne kateebe kobogoryondonooto, ye katwa ineendet kioto, komurwoniitu agoi koimen.
Ngo ruiyo chii age tugul ak kobogoryondonooto, ak kotiiny ineendet simwegap kobogoryondonooto, komurwoniitu peetuusyek tisap chiichooto, ak kong'waniit itoogut age tugul ne karue.

“Ngo pwoonei korotiik eng' kobogoryot eng' peetuusyek che chaang' che ma eng' peetuusyek che kitabaane, anan ngo siir peetuusyek che po katabaanennyi kobwanei, ko peetuusyechooto tugul che pwoonei korotiik che po simwo eng' ineendet kogergeitu ak peetuusyek che kitabaani: murwoon ineendet.
Kergeitu itoogut age tugul ne rue eng' peetuusyek che mang'une korotiik ak itoogutap peetuusyegap katabaanennyi. Murwoniitu kiy age tugul ne tebee ko uu murwoonindap katabaanennyi.
Murwoniitu age tugul ne twaei tuguuchooto, ak mwetei ngoroikyik, ak kouungei, ak murwoniitu agoi koimen.
Ago ngo kagogeskei mandaetap simwekyik, koiityigei anyun peetuusyek tisap, ak tiliiliitu ye kagobata chooto.
Eng' peetuut ne po sisiit konamjigei cheptugenik aeng', anan aarek aeng' che po cheptugenik, ak koipchi tisiindet, agoi kurgeetap emait ne kituiyechin.
Ak kogoito tisiindet age kobunji kagoochinetap tengekto, age kobunji kagoochinet ne kibeelei, ak koyai tisiindet kagaigaet agobo ineendet eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor amu mandaetap simwekyik.
“Ara anyun otabaani piigap Israel ko uu nooto agobo simwekwak, si ma pek kotinyei simwo, ye imurwon koonnyu ne miitei kwenunnywa.”
Po ng'atuutyoni ineendet ne tinyei kusereet, ak ineendet ne mandoe kesweegap iyoteet, ak murwoniitu amu nooto.
Po kora kobogoryot ne kitabaani amu simwekyik, muren ne tinyei kusereet, po muren, ak ko po kobogoryo, ak ko po ineendet ne ruitos ak kobogoryo ne ma tiliil.
Ki ng'alaalji `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Musa, ye kingo pata meetap weeriik aeng' che po Aron, ye kingo riikyi taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor,

koleenji, “Mwachi Aron ng'eetap komet, si ma nyoonei atkai tugul ole-tiliil oriit ne po angeet ne ki kioiye koot, eng' taitap kerwetap rireenet ne mi moinget parak; si ma me. Amu among'u eng' pooldet eng' paragutap kerwetap rireenet.
Nyoonei Aron ole tiliil ak kirgit ne neran kobunji kagoochinetap tengekto, ak mengit kobunji kagoochinet ne kibeelei.

Ingolaach ngoryeet ne kooi ne itabaanat ne po katanit, ak ingolaach sulwalisyek che po katanit, ak korategei pireneet ne po katanit ak kilaakyi chepkulet ne po katanit: chooto ngoroik che itabaanatiin. Iuni poortanyi eng' peek, si kolaachi ngoroichooto.
Ak koget eng' tuiyetap piigap Israel kwesik aeng' kobunji kagoochinetap tengekto, ak mengit agenge kobunji kagoochinet ne kibeelei.
“Igoitoi Aron kirgit kai, ni ko po kagoochinetap tengekto, ne nenyi ineegei, ak koyachjigei kagaigaet, ak koonnyi.
Yeityo kokweri kwesichooto aeng', ak konde taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, eng' kurgeetap emait ne kituiyechin.
Iseri Aron parbareek agobo kwesichooto aeng'; punjin age Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, kobunjin age Asasel.
Yeityo kogoito Aron kwesta ne kagobutyi parbaryat, kobunji Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ak kogoito koek kagoochinetap tengekto.
Ago kwesta ne kagobutyi parbaryat ne po Asasel, kinde taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kosabei, si keyai kagaigaet agobo ineendet, si keonda kwo surkwen kobunji Asasel.
“Yeityo kogoito Aron eito ne po kagoochinetap tengekto, ne nenyi ineegei, ak koyachigei kagaigaet, ak koonnyi, ak koeny kirgooto po kagoochinetap tengekto ne nenyi ineegei.

Ak konem tereet ne nyiitaat ng'etetyot ne punu maatap kaptisisyet ne mi taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ak ko nyiitaat eunekyik nyamdutik che ng'uu ne anyiny che ki kitui komengegitu, ak koip koba koot ne po oriit, ne ki kioiye angeet.
Indoi ineendet nyamdutik ma, eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor si kobiit kotuch iyeto ne po nyamdutik kerwetap rireenet ne mi paragutap paornateet, si ma me.
Ak konem korotiik alak che po kirgooto, ak koisee eng' mornennyi kerwetap rireenet ole tokyingei kong'asiis; ak koisisye korotiik eng' taitap kerwetap rireenet eng' mornennyi konyil tisap.

“Yeityo koeny kwesta ne po kagoochinetap tengekto, ne po piik, ak koip korotiigap kweata koba koot ne po oriit ne ki kioiye angeet, ak koyachi korotichooto kiit ne koyachi korotiik che po kirgit, ak koisee kerwetap rireenet, ak taitap kerwetap rireenet.

Yaei anyun kagaigaet agobo ole-tiliil, amu murwoonindap piigap Israel, ak pistoennywa, agot tengekwogikwak tugul. Ak koyachi ko uu nooto emait ne kituiyechin, ne meng'iisyei kobooto icheek eng' kwenutap murwoonindanywa.

Amat kobiit chii ne mi emait ne kituiyechin, ye wendi tisiindet ineendet si koyai kagaigaet eng' ole-tiliil, agoi komong' saang', ko kagoyachigei kagaigaet, ak koonnyi, ak tuiyet komugul ne po Israel.

Yeityo komanda saang', kwo ole mi kaptisisyet ne mi taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ak koyai kagaigaet agobo nooto; ak konam korotiik alak che po kirgit, ak che po kwesta, koilee kuinoigap kaptisisyet komoswek tugul.
Ak koisee korotiik kaptisisyet eng' mornennyi konyil tisap, ak koanyiny, ak kotiliil koistoe murwoonindap piigap Israel.
“Ye kagogees kagaigaetap ole-tiliil, ak emait ne kituiyechin, ak kaptisisyet, kogoito anyun kwesta ne sabei,

ak kogonoor Aron eunekyik tuwai metitap kweata sabei, kong'aany tengekwogik tugul che po piigap Israel, ak pistoennywa tugul, kong'ururi artanooto; ak kogesenji chooto metitap kweata, ak kogoochi chiito ne kagochopkei kokweri kwo surkwen;
ak kogesen anyun kweata tengekwogikwak tugul koba emet ole ma menyei chii, ak kounda artet kwo eng' olooto po surkwen.
“Yeityo konyo Aron agoi emait ne kituiyechin, ak koreek ngoroigap katanit che kailaagoti ineendet si kowendi ole-tiliil, ak kobagaakta eng' olooto.
Ak kouungei eng' komosta ne tiliil, ak kolaach ngoroikyik, yeityo komong' saang', ak kogoito kagoochinennyi ne kibeelei ak kagoochinet ne kibeelei ne po piik, ak koyachigei kagaigaet ak koyachi piik.
Peelei mwanik eng' kaptisisyet, che po kagoochinetap tengekto.
Ak mwetei ngoroikyik ineendet ne kweryei kwesta ne punjin Asasel, ak kouungei. Ye ibata konyo nganaseet oriit.

Ak keip koba saang'utap nganaseet kirgit ne po kagoochinetap tengekto, ak ng'orooryet ne po kagoochinetap tengekto che kagiip korotiikwak si keyai kagaigaet eng' ole-tiliil, ak kobeel muiywekwak eng' ma, panyeekwak ak eiyannywa.
Mwetei ngoroikyik ineendet ne kabeelei tuguuchooto ak kouungei. Ye ibata, konyo nganaseet oriit.

“Ak punjin koigeny kaneetisyoni eng' okweek: oming'inge eng' arawetap tisap, eng' peetuutap taman ne po arawanooto, amat oyai poisyet age tugul, ineendet ne ki sikyin kaa, anan punootyot ne mi kobootok.
Amu kiyaiywok kagaigaet peetuunooto, kitiliilok, ak otiliiliitu anyun eng' tengekwogikwok eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Peetuunooto ko sabato ne po kamuung'et eng' okweek, ak oming'inigei. Niito ng'atuutyet ne po koigeny.
Ak koyai kagaigaet tisiindet ne ki ili, ne kitoroorchin poisyetap tiliilindo, ne igeeri kwandanyi, ak kolaach ngoroigap katanit, ngoroichooto itabaanatiin,
Yae kagaigaet agobo koot ne tiliil, kagaigaet agobo emait ne kituiyechin ak kaptisisyet, ak koyai kagaigaet agobo tisiik ak piik tugul che po tuiyet.

Egu niito anyun ng'atuutyet ne po koigeny eng' okweek, keyai kagaigaet agobo piigap Israel konyil agenge eng' kenyiit, amu tengekwogikwak tugul.” Ki yai anyun ineendet ko uu ye ki ng'at `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Musa.
Ki ng'alaalji `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Musa koleenji,
“Mwachi Aron, weeriikyik ak lagok tugul che po Israel, ileenji, Ni ng'atuutyet ne kong'at Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole,
Chii age tugul ne po kootap Israel ne enyei kirgit, anan ne enyei aarwetap keechiir, anan ng'orooryet, eng' nganaseet, anan ne kagieng'ji saang'utap nganaseet,

ama ket konyo kurgeetap emait ne kituiyechin, si kogoito koek kagoochinet ne igoochin Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' taitap kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ki ityin chiichooto korotiik. Kagotumda korotiik, ak king'etoi chiichooto eng' piikyik.

Niito ko si kobiit koget piigap Israel tiseiywekwak che kata enyei eng' kewanin, kobwa ole mi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, agoi kurgeetap emait ne kituiyechin, agoi ole mi tisiindet, ak koeny chooto koek tiseiywegap kagoochinoik che po kaalyeet che kigoochin Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ak koisee tisiindet korotiik kaptisisyetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' kurgeetap emait ne kituiyechin, ak kobeel mwanik koek nyamdutyet ne anyiny eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Si mata koeng'ji oik tiseiywekwak kogeny, che kocham kosuboti koibegei tugul. Egu ng'olyoondoni ng'atuutyet ne po koigeny eng' icheek eng' ibinwekwak tugul.
“Ak ileenji icheek, Chii age tugul ne po kootap Israel, anan ne po punootik che mi kobooto icheek, ne igoitoi kagoochinet ne kibeelei anan tiseiywot,
ama ket agoi kurgeetap emait ne kituiyechin, si kobiit koeng'ji Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, king'etoi chiichooto eng' piikyik.
“Ngo am korotiik alak tugul chii age tugul ne po kootap Israel, anan ne po punootik che tebyei kobootok, ko wechei togeennyu ineendet ne amei korotiik, ak ang'etoi ineendet eng' piikyik.
Amu mi saboondap poorto korotiik. Ki agoonok korotichooto oyachinegei kagaigaet eng' kaptisiisyo amu saboonwekwok. Amu korotiik che yaei kagaigaet agobo saboondo.
Ki amwachi anyun piigap Israel amu nooto aleenji, Amat koam chii eng' okweek korotiik, amat koam agine punootyot age tugul ne mi kobootok, korotichooto.
“Ngo par chii age tugul ne po piigap Israel, anan eng' punootik che mi kobooto icheek, tyony age tugul anan toriityon age tugul ne ki amei, kotumda korotiikyik, ak kotuge ng'ung'unyek.

Amu korotiik ko saboondo ne po poorto komugul, ak agenge korotiik ak saboondap poorto. Nooto anyun, ki aleenji piigap Israel, Amatata oam korotiik alak tugul che po poorto age tugul, amu saboondap poorto age tugul korotiikyik. King'etoi age tugul ne amei.

“Ak chii age tugul ne amei kiy ne kame ineegei, anan ne kabar tyong'ik kotonaton, ngo chii ne ki sikyin kaa anan punootyot, ingomwet anyun ngoroikyik, ak kouungei, ak komurwoniit agoi koimen; yeityo anyun koanyinyit.
Ago ngo ma mwet, anan ngo ma iungei, kotebee ineendet anyun tengektanyi.”
Ki ng'alaalji `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Musa koleenji,
“Mwachi piigap Israel leenji, Aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindeng'wong'.
Amat oyai tuguuk che kiyaei emetap Misiri, ole ki omenye, amat oyai poisyonigap emetap Kanaan, ole amutok ak amat obendate kaneetisyosyekwak.
Oyai kirwoogutikyuk ak oriip ng'atuutikyuk, obendate chooto. Aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindeng'wong'.
Oriip anyun ng'atuutikyuk ak kirwoogutikyuk: amu ngo yai chiito chooto, kosabei eng' chooto. Aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
“Amat koriikyi age tugul eng' okweek tilyennyi kong'aany aach ngorinnyi. Aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Amat ing'aany aach ngoritap kwandang'ung', oruiye ak kwondonyi, amu ineendet ko komet; amat ing'aany aach ngorinnyi.
Amat ing'aany aach ngoritap osotyotap kwandang'ung'; amu nooto aach ngoritap kwandang'ung'.
Amat ing'aany aach ngoritap chepkomet, cheptap kwandang'ung', anan cheptap kamenng'ung', ngo ki kisikyin kaa, anan olda age.
Amat ing'aany aach ngoritap cheptap weeriing'ung', anan cheptap cheptong'ung'; amu aach ngorinnywa ko neng'ung'.
Amat ing'aany aach ngoritap cheptap osotyotap kwandang'ung', ne ki sichei kwandang'ung', ineendet ko chepkomet.
Amat ing'aany aach ngoritap isengeng'ung'; amu ineendet ko kwondo ne neegit ne tilya, ne po kwandang'ung'.
Amat ing'aany aach ngoritap chepkametap kamenng'ung'; amu ineendet ko kwondo ne neegit ne tilya, ne po kamenng'ung'.
Amat ing'aany aach ngoritap ng'eetap kametap kwandang'ung', amat iriikyi osotyonnyi; amu kamenng'ung'.
Amat ing'aany aach ngoritap osotyotap weeriing'ung'; amu osotyotap weeriing'ung'; amat ing'aany aach ngorinnyi.
Amat ing'aany aach ngoritap imbomurtang'ung'; amu aach ngoritap ng'eetap kamenng'ung'.

Amat ing'aany aach ngoritap kobogoryo ak cheptonyi; amemut cheptap weeriinnyi, anan cheptap cheptonyi sip ing'aany aach ngorinnyi; amu icheeget ko tiibiik che tilyonut che neegityin; sogornateet nooto.
Amat imutyige chepkametap osotyondeng'ung', si inyaar osotyondeng'ung', si ing'aany aach ngorinnyi, kobooto nin age kota kosabei.
“Amat iriikyi kobogoryo ing'aany aach ngorinnyi, kota kotinyei murwoonindap simwekyik che po arawet.
Amat oipkei ak osotyotap chiitap kokweng'ung', omurwongei ak ineendet.
“Amegoite iyoteng'ung' ibeelji Molek, ak amereeny kainetap Kamuktaindeng'ung'. Aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
“Amoruiye ak muren ko uu ye ruitos chii ak osotyo; etan nooto.
Amoruiye ak tyony age tugul si imurwongei. Amat koruiyo kobogoryondo ak tyony; sogornat nooto.
“Amat omurwongei eng' alak tugul eng' chuuto, amu ki imurwonegei chuuto tugul pororyosyek che ki aoon eng' taing'wong'.
Ki komurwoniit emet ak aiityini tengekto amu nooto, ak ki ing'ung'da emet piikyik.
Ago oriip anyun ng'atuutikyuk ak kirwoogutikyuk amu nooto, amat oyai age tugul eng' tuguuchu samis; agot ne ki kisikyin kaa anan ne punootyo ne mi kobootok,
(amu ki yai piigap emoni chooto tugul samisen, che ki menyei olito keny, ak king'wanit emet),
si ma ing'ung'dak ak okweek emet, ye omurwon, ko uu ye ki ing'ung'da pororyosyek che ki mi kotom oitu.
Amu king'etoi eng' piikwak chii age tugul ne yaei kiy age tugul eng' tuguuchu samis.
Oriip anyun katigonutikyuk amu nooto, si moyai age tugul eng' pitonwechu samis, che ki kiyaei kotom oitu, si momurwonegei chooto. Aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindeng'wong'.”
Ki ng'alaalji `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Musa koleenji,
“Mwachi tuiyet komugul ne po piigap Israel, ileenji, Oegu che tiliileen, amu aa tiliil anee, Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindeng'wong'.
Ingoiywei chii age tugul kamennyi, ak kwandanyi, ak oriip sabatosyekyuk. Aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindeng'wong'.
Amat omaste osup tuguuk che ma tilei kiy, amoyachigei kanamonik che po kariik che kitaanyi. Aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindeng'wong'.
“Ak ye ogoochini Kamuktaindet ne Toroor tiseiywot ne po kagoochinoik che po kaalyeet, ogoite anyun si kobiit ketaachak.
Ki amei eng' peetuunooto ogoitoi, ak eng' peetuut ne po aeng', ak ngo ng'et kiy agoi peetuut ne po somok, kebeel anyun chooto eng' ma.
Egu kiit ne kiwechei ngot keam agot kitigin eng' peetuut ne po somok; ma kitaachei,
ak ibei tengektanyi chii age tugul ne amei, amu kareeny kioto tiliil ne po Kamuktaindet ne Toroor. King'etoi chiichooto eng' piikyik.
“Ye ogesisye eng' emeng'wong', ko mat iges igeesu luukwegap mbareeng'ung', amat iyumate turoonik.
Ak ameturote mbareeng'ung' ne po sabibuk, amat ikwei logoek che kagobutyi ng'wony; pagakyi chooto kibananook ak toek. Aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindeng'wong'.
“Amochoorse, amoberberisye, amomwachigei lembech.
Amoyosyechigei eng' kainennyu eng' lembech, agoi ireeny kainetap Kamuktaindeng'ung'. Aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
“Amesastae chiitap kokweng'ung', anan irebe kiy. Amat inamdegei melektap otwogindet kot koeech.
Amat isas chii ne miing'at, amende kiy ne riichei piich taitap ne koraat, ago iywei Kamuktaindeng'ung'. Aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
“Amat oyai ne ma po iman eng' kirwooget; ametiytiy kibananook anan igonyit che eecheen; ago irwookyi chiitap kokweng'ung' eng' imanda.
Amewe komosi ak komosi ichaamate piiguk. Ameuny ne kabar chiitap kokweng'ung'. Aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
“Amewech ne otupche eng' muguleldang'ung', kergong' iman chiitap kokweng'ung', si ma namin tengekto amu ineendet.
Ameyaakyi mugetuut anan isus ng'al agobo lagogap piiguk, ago cham chiitap kokweng'ung' ko uu ye ichamegei. Aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
“Oriip ng'atuutikyuk. Amengorie tuuga cheguuk alage che teer che ma tuuga. Amegol mbareeng'ung' kesweek aeng' che teerchiin. Amelaach ngoryeet ne ki kiyae usiisyek che teerchiin.
“Age tugul ne ruitos ak chepto ne otwogindet, ne ki kiamji koito, ne tomo kityaach anan kechamji kwo, kirwookyin tuwai. Ma kibarei, amu ki tomo kityaach chebooto.
Ago ketu chiichooto kagoochinennyi ne po chalwokto konyo ole mi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, agoi kurgeetap emait ne kituiyechin, egu mengit nooto, ne kagoochinetap chalwokto.
Ak koyai tisiindet kagaigaet agobo ineendet, kobooto mengoto po kagoochinetap chalwokto eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, amu tengektanyi ne kogoyai; ak kenyochigaat amu tengektanyi ne kogoyai.
“Ye oit emonooto ak ye kaomiin keetiik alak tugul che kiamei, oiit anyun logoekwak ole etaatin; egu eng' okweek che eetaatin eng' kenyiisyek somok; ma ki amei.
Ago ki anyinyi logoekwak tugul eng' kenyiit ne po ang'wan, si kobiit kilasune Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ak oam logoekwak eng' kenyiit ne po muut, si kobiit koiiywok logoek alak. Aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindeng'wong'.
“Amat oam kiy age tugul kobooto korotiikyik. Amoboisyee ponisyet anan ong'oorse.
Amobior metowekwok, ameng'em tabanwegap tamneng'ung'.
Amotil poorwekwok agobo piik che pegu, amobeel saremik alak tugul. Aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
“Amegoite cheptong'ung' koyait koek chepkugonio, si ma isup emet kugoinatet ak konyi emet tengekto.
Oriip sabatosyekyuk, ak ogonyit koonnyu ne tiliil. Aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
“Amobe ye mi che poisyee oik anan pooniik; amocheeng'ate, si ma ing'wanitak. Aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindeng'wong'.
“Tononji ne tinyei kalwalek ak igonyit poiyo, ak iywei Kamuktaindeng'ung'. Aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
“Ameyachi ne ya toondet ne mi kobooten eng' emeng'wong'.
Igeitu toondet ne meng'iisyei kobootok ak ne kisikyin kaa, cham ineendet ko uu ye ichamegei; amu ki oo toek eng' emetap Misiri. Aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindeng'wong'.
“Amoyai ne ma po iman eng' kirwooget anan ye okwai eng' koindo, anan ye ogere eng' nyigiisindo, anan eng' karogutik che po tuguuk che pei.
Oboisyee kerutik che aechin ak koik che kigerisye eng' nyigiisindo che po iman: epah ak hin che po iman. Aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindeng'wong' ne ki amutwak omang'une emetap Misiri.
Kanyool anyun osup ng'atuutikyuk tugul ak kirwoogutikyuk tugul, ak oyai. Aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.”
Ki ng'alaalji `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Musa koleenji,

“Ileenji piigap Israel, Chii age tugul ne igoochin lagokyik Molek, ngo age eng' piigap Israel anan age eng' punootik che meng'iisyei eng' Israel, kebarei chiichooto iman. Lachei piigap emet eng' koik.
Wechei togeennyu chiichooto ak ang'etoi eng' piikyik; amu koigoochi ineendet lagokyik Molek si komurwon koonnyu ne tiliil, ak koreeny kainennyu ne tiliil.
Ak ngo yaigei piigap emet ko uu yo ma keer chiichooto, kouny, ye kagogoito lagokyik kogoochi Molek, ama kobar,
eng' yooto anyun aboorchi chiichooto nereegegap togeennyu ak piigap koonnyi. Ak ang'etoi ineendet eng' piikwak, ak tugul che isubi koyaei ibeetapkei kobooto ineendet, che yaei ibeetapkei ak Molek.
“Aboorchini nereegegap togeennyu chiito ne mastoi kosubi ne poisyee oik ak pooniik, ne isubi koyaei ibeetapkei kobooto icheek, ak ang'etoi chiichooto eng' piikyik.
Otabaange anyun, oegu che tiliileen; amu aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindeng'wong'.
Oriip ng'atuutikyuk ak oyai. Aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne atabaanok.
Amu kibarei chii age tugul ne sasei kwan anan kamet. Amu kasas kwandanyi ak kamennyi, ko tebee ineendet korotiikyik.
“Chiito ne ibegei ak osotyotap chiito age, agot ne ibegei ak osotyotap chiitap kokwennyi, kebarei iman chiichooto ak osotyondonooto.
Chiito ne ruitos ak osotyotap kwandanyi, ko kang'aany aach ngoritap kwandanyi; kibarei iman tuwai, ak tebee korotiikwak icheek.
Ngo ruiyo chii ak osotyotap weeriinnyi, kebarei iman tuwai. Kagoyai ng'emisyet; tebee korotiikwak icheek.
Ngo ruiyo mureno ak muren, ko uu ye ruitos ak kobogorisyek, kagoyai tuwai kiit ne samis. Kibarei iman, ak tebee icheek korotiikwak.
Ngo tun chii chepto kobooto kamet, ko sogornateet nooto. Kibeelei icheeget eng' maat, chiichooto ak chuun aeng', si ma piitune ng'oogisto kwenung'wong'.
Ngo ruiyo chii ak tyony, kebarei iman chiichooto, ak obar tyonyooto agine.
Ngo riikyi kobogoryondo tyony age tugul ak koruiyo tuwai, kebarei anyun kobogoryondonooto ak tyonyooto, ak tebee korotiikwak icheek.

“Ngomut chii chepkamet, cheptap kwandanyi, anan cheptap kamet, ak kogeer aach ngorinnyi, ak kogeer chebooto aach ngoritap murenonooto ko teweernateet nooto. King'etoi icheek tuwai eng' taitap lagogap piikwak, amu kagong'aany aach ngoritap chepkamet, ak ibei ineendet tengektanyi.

Ngo ruiyo chii ak kobogoryo ne katyech ng'wony, ak kong'aany poortanyi, ko kagong'aany ole rootune korotiik ak kang'aany agine kobogoryondonooto ole rootune korotiikyik. King'etoi icheek tuwai eng' piikwak.
Amat ing'aany poortap chepkametap kamenng'ung', anan isengeng'ung', amu kagong'aany poortap tilyonutik che neegit. Ibei icheek tengektonywa.
Ngo ruiyo chii ak osotyotap imamet ko kagong'aany poortap imamet. Ibei icheek tengektonywa; pegu ama sich lagok.
Ngo ipkei chii ak osotyotap ng'eetap kamet ko murwoonindo nooto; kagong'aany poortap ng'eetap kamet. Pegu ama sich lagok.
“Oriip anyun ng'atuutikyuk tugul amu nooto, ak kirwoogutikyuk tugul, ak oyai, si ma ing'ung'dak emet ole amutok omeny.
Amobendate pitonwegap pororyet ne aoone eng' taing'wong'. Amu ki yai icheek tuguuchuuto tugul, ak ki awech anyun icheek amu nooto.

Ago ki amwaiwok aleenjok, ‘Onyabani emennywa, ak agoonok kobunjook emonooto nyiitaat cheego ak komi kumyat eng' chaang'indo.’ Aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindeng'wong', ne ki atabaanenak pororyosyek.

Obeesye anyun tyong'ik che anyiny ak che ng'woneen, ak toriitik che anyiny ak che ng'woneen. Amogoochi saboonwekwok koek che kiwechei amu tyong'ik anan toriitik, anan kiy age tugul ne wendote ng'wony, che kitabaanenak amu ng'woneen.
Oegu che tiliileen eng' anee, amu aa tiliil anee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ne ki atabaanenak pororyosyek, si oegu chechuuk.
“Kibarei iman ne poisyee oik, ne muren anan ne kwony, anan chii ne poonin. Kilachei icheek eng' koik, ak tebee korotiikwak icheek.”
Ki leenji `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Musa, “Mwachi tisiik weeriigap Aron, ileenji icheek, Amat komurwongei chii eng' chii ne kame eng' piikyik,
kobatee eng' tilyonutikyik che neegit, kamet, kwandanyi, weeriinnyi, cheptonyi, ng'eetap kamet,
ak eng' chepkamet ne pergeiya, ne po tilyet ne neegit ne tomo kotun chii, imuuchi komurwongei amu chepkamet.
Amat komurwongei, amu ineendet ko chiito ne tagunoot eng' piikyik.
Amat kocher metowekwak anan tabanwegap tamnokwak, anan kotilatil poorwekwak.

Egu che tiliileen eng' Kamuktaindennywa, amat koreeny kainetap Kamuktaindennywa. Amu igoitoi icheek kagoochinoik che punei maat, che po Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, chooto amitwogigap Kamuktaindennywa. Egu anyun icheek che tiliileen amu nooto.
Amat kotun chepkugonio anan ne murwoon. Amat kotun osotyot ne ki oon manong'otyondennyi, amu tiliil ineendet eng' Kamuktaindennyi.
Itiliil ineendet anyun amu nooto, amu ineendet ne igoitoi amitwogigap Kamuktaindeng'ung'; ingotiliilit anyun ineendet eng' inyee, amu anee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne atiliilok, ko aa tiliil.
Ak ngo murwongei cheptap tisiindet age tugul, komurwongei ineegei eng' kugoinatet, ko kagomurwon kwandanyi, kebeelei eng' ma.
“Ineendet ne tisiindet ne oo eng' che tupcho, ne ki kiroong'ji mwaita ne ki ilse metinnyi ne ki kitabaan kolaach ngoroik, ko mat koyaat metinnyi, anan kogereer ngoroikyik.
Amat kwo ole miitei muusto, anan komurwongei amu kwan anan kamet.
Amat komanda eng' ole-tiliil anan komurwon ole-tiliil ne po Kamuktaindennyi, amu mi metinnyi mwaitap katabaanet ne ki ilse ne po Kamuktaindennyi. Aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ingotun anyun chepto ne pergeiya.
Amat kotun kwony ne ki kosiirtoe manong'otyot anan ne kigeon, anan kobogoryo ne murwoon, anan chepkugonio. Ago ingotun pergeiyat eng' piikyik,
amat konyerat iyotennyi eng' piikyik. Amu aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne atiliilii ineendet.”
Ki ng'alaalji `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Musa koleenji,
“Mwachi Aron ileenji, amat koriikta koipchi Kamuktaindennyi amitwogikyik, chii age tugul eng' iyoteng'ung' ne ma libwoop, eng' ibinwekwak tugul.
Amu ma riiktoi chii age tugul ne ma libwoop, ne koraat, ne ing'wali, anan ne tinyei serut ne lebel, anan ne ki kotesak kiy age tugul eng' poortanyi,
anan ne ki il keeldo, anan ne ki il euut,
anan ne kibalbut, anan ne kiring'ak poortanyi, anan ne tinyei teta eng' konda, anan ne tinyei kochek, anan ne tinyei mook che ki koyaamyo, anan ne ki koyesyo kitikyik.
Amat koriikta chii ne ma libwoop ne po lagogap Aron tisiindet, kwo kogoito kagoochinoigap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, che punei maat, amu ma libwoop, ma riigu nyoo kogoitoi amitwogigap Kamuktaindennyi.
Amei ineendet amitwogigap Kamuktaindennyi chooto tiliileen miising' ak eng' chooto tiliileen.
Ago ma wendi ineendet angeet oriit ne ki kioiye koot, anan koriikyi kapkorosuut, amu ma libwoop; si mat komurwon oldinwekyuk che tiliileen, amu anee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne atabaani oldinwechooto.”
Ki mwachi anyun Musa ko uu nooto Aron ak weeriikyik ak piigap Israel tugul.
Ki mwachi `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Musa koleenji,
“Ileenji Aron ak weeriikyik, kotabaanegei tuguuk che tiliileen che po piigap Israel, che itabaanwa, si ma reeny kainennyu ne tiliil. Aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.

Ileenji, King'etoi eng' tainnyu chii age tugul ne po iyoteng'wong' tugul eng' ibinekwok tugul, ne riikyin tuguuk che tiliileen, che itabaanjin piigap Israel Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, kotinyei murwoonindanyi. Aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.

Amat koam tuguuk che tiliileen chii age tugul eng' lagogap Aron ne tinyei mogondos, anan ne tinyei ole mandae tugun, agoi kotiliilit. Age tugul ne twaei ne kigonyoor simwo amu muusto, anan chiito ne mandae kesweegap iyoteet,
anan age tugul ne twaei ne ichuutegei ng'wony, ne ing'waniti chii, anan chii ne imuuchi kong'waniit ineendet, eng' murwoonindo age tugul ne tinyei,
ng'wanitu agoi koimen ne twaei age eng' chooto, ak ma amei tuguuk che tiliileen ngot ko tomo kouungei.
Ye karorokto asiis, koanyinyit, ak yeityo koam tuguuk che tiliileen, amu amitwogichooto.
Amat koam panyeegap tyong'ik che pegu icheegei, anan che tonatoni tyong'ik, si mat kong'wanitkei eng' chooto. Aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Riibei anyun katigonutikyuk, si ma nam icheek tengektap tuguuchooto, ak kobekyi tuguuchooto ngo reeny. Anee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne atabaani icheek.
“Ma amei kipsagarin age tugul tuguuk che tiliileen. Ma amei punootyot ne po tisiindet, anan otwogindet ne nyooru melekto,
ago ngo al tisiindet chii, koale silingisyekyik, koamei nooto tuguuchooto, ak che kisikyin koonnyi, amei chooto amitwogikyik.
Ngo tun cheptap tisiindet kipsagarin, koma amei chebooto kagoochinet ne kinamjin parak, ne po tuguuk che tiliileen.

Ago ngo kwony ne ki kosiirtoe manong'otyot cheptap tisiindet, anan ngo ki oon manong'otyot, ama sich lakwa, ak koweektagei kootap kwandanyi, ko uu ye kita koming'in, koamei ineendet amitwogigap kwandanyi. Ago ma amei toondet age tugul chooto.
Ak ngo am chii age tugul tuguuk che tiliileen koma nai, kotesyin chooto anyun kebebertap muut, ak kogoochi tisiindet kioto tiliil.
Amat koreeny tisiik tuguuk che tiliileen che po piigap Israel, che igoochin Kamuktaindet ne Toroor;
si konyoor ng'oogisto; ye amei tuguukwak che tiliileen. Amu anee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne atiliilii icheek.”
Ki ng'alaalji `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Musa koleenji,

“Mwachi Aron ak weeriikyik ak piigap Israel tugul, ileenji icheek, Age tugul ne po kootap Israel, anan che punootik eng' Israel, ne igoitoi kagoochinennyi, ngo po kagoochinonooto age tugul eng' arorutikwak, anan ko age tugul eng' kagoochinoikwak che po chamyet ne igoochin Kamuktaindet ne Toroor koek kagoochinet ne kibeelei,
si kobiit ketaachak, ogoitoi kagoochinet ne kirgit ne libwoop eng' tuuga, anan eng' keechiirek, anan eng' ng'oroorek.
Ago amat ogoite ne ma libwoop, amu ma kitaachei nooto agobo okweek.

Ak chii age tugul ne igoitoi tiseiywot ne po kagoochinoigap kaalyeet kogoochin Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, si kobiit koyai kosulda nooto ne kiga koaror, anan kagoochinetap chamyet ne po tuuga, anan ko ne po keechiirek, kanyool koek ne ititaat si kobiit ketaach; ne ma piitune perutyet age tugul.

Amat ogoochi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne koraat, anan ne kigoil, anan ne kigonyoor peruut, anan ne rootei tugun, anan ne tinyei kochek, anan ne tinyei kacheet, amoyai koek kagoochinet ne punei maat eng' kaptisisyet, keele kigoochi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' chooto.
Imuuchi igoite koek kagoochinetap chamyet kirgit anan aarwetap keechiir ne tinyei tuguuk che uu kunduenik, anan kebeberta ne ma mi eng' poortanyi; ago ma kitaachei ngo po kiit ne ki kiaror.
Amat ogoochi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne ki kibir kitik, anan ne ki kitui, anan ne kigong'etyo, anan ne ki kitil; amat oyai ko uu nooto eng' emeng'wong'.
Amotaach eng' eutap kipsagarin amitwogigap Kamuktaindeng'wong', alak tugul eng' chuuto, ole si ogoite. Amu mi ng'emisyennywa icheek, tinyei perutik, ma kitaachei chooto agobo okweek.”
Ki mwachi `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Musa koleenji,

“Ye kagii kirgit, anan keechiiryet, anan ng'orooryet, kotebyei ak kamet peetuusyek tisap, ak eng' peetuut ne po sisiit ak kwo tai, ketaachei koek kagoochinet ne punei ma ne kigoochin Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ago amat oeny teta ne rooryat anan keechiiryet ne kotoy, kobooto moitanyi anan arwennyi peetuunak.
Ak ye oeng'ji Kamuktaindet ne Toroor tiseiywotap kongoi, oeng'ji si kobiit ketaachak.
Ki amei eng' peetuunooto, motuuch kiy kot koeekyi. Aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
“Ara oriip anyun ng'atuutikyuk amu nooto ak oyai. Aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Amoreeny kainennyu ne tiliil, ago kitabaana eng' piigap Israel. Anee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne atabaanok,
ne ki amutwak omang'une emetap Misiri, si aek Kamuktaindeng'wong'. Aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.”
Ki ng'alaalji `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Musa koleenji,
“Mwachi piigap Israel leenjin, Igorwegap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor che ki king'at keele omwaite koek kayumosyegapkei che itabaanatiin, chooto igoorwekyuk che ki king'at.

Kiyaei poisyet peetuusyek lo, ago peetuutap tisap ko sabato ne kimuung'e; kayumetapkei ne itabaanat. Amat oyai poisyo age tugul, nooto ko sabato eng' Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' meng'otosyekwok tugul.
“Chu igoorwegap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor che ki king'at, kayumosyegapkei che itabaanatiin, che omwaitoi eng' peetuusyekwak che ki king'at.”
“Eng' peetuutap taman ak ang'wan ne po arawet ne po tai, eng' koskoleny, ko paska ne po Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Egu igoorto ne po magatiinik che ma kinde mermereek, eng' Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, eng' peetuutap taman ak muut ne po arawanooto. Oame magatiinik che ma kinde mermereek peetuusyek tisap.
Egu kayumetapkei ne itabaanat eng' peetuut ne po tai; amat oyai poisyo age tugul ne po otwoknot.

Ago ogoite kagoochinet ne punei maat ne kigoochin Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, eng' peetuusyek tisap. Egu kayumetapkei ne itabaanat eng' peetuut ne po tisap; amat oyai poisyo age tugul ne po otwoknot eng' peetuunooto.”
Ki ng'alaalji `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Musa koleenji,
“Mwachi piigap Israel leenjin, Ye oit emet ne agoonok, ak ogesisye eng' olooto, eng' yooto anyun oipchi tisiindet peek che togoanik che po kesisyeng'wong'.
Koongoi anyun ineendet peechooto eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, si kobiit ketaach agobo okweek; ongoi tisiindet chooto eng' peetuut ne po aeng', ko kagobata sabato.
Ak eng' peetuunooto oongoi okweek peek, ogoite anyun mengit ne libwoop ne ma siirei kenyiit agenge koek kagoochinet ne kibeelei ne po Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.

Ak egu kagoochinennyi ne po peek kiloinik aeng' che po peek che ng'ootiin che tambulul che kagiburukto mwaita, kagoochinet ne punei maat kigoochin Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, koek nyamdutyet ne anyiny. Ak egu kagoochinennyi ne kieei, divaik, che yamei litaiyat agenge.

Amat oam magatya anan peek che kigelei, anan mesiisek agoi koit peetuuniito, agoi oibu kagoochinet ne po Kamuktaindeng'wong'. Niito ng'atuutyet ne po koigeny eng' ibinwekwok tugul eng' meng'otosyekwok tugul.
“Oiityigei kong'etee peetuut ne po aeng' ko kagobata sabato, kobooch peetuut ne kioibu peek che po kagoochinet ne kiongoi; egu sabatoisyek tisap che nyiitootiin.
Oiit peetuusyek konom agoi peetuut ne po aeng' ko kagobata sabato ne po tisap, ak ogoochi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kagoochinet ne leel ne po peek.
Oibu eng' meng'otosyekwok magatiinik aeng' che kiongoi che kichoben kiloinik aeng' che po peek che ng'ootiin che tambulul, che kibeeldoi mermereek, koek tongoanik che po Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.

Ak ogoite kobooto magatiinik aarek tisap che libwoben che po keechiir che ma siirei kenyiit agenge ak kirgit agenge ne neran, ak mengichik aeng'. Egu kagoochinet ne kibeelei ne po Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, kobooto kagoochinennywa ne po peek ak kagoochinoikwak che kieei, kagoochinet ne punei maat, ne po nyamdutyet ne anyiny eng' Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ogoitoi kwesta agenge koek kagoochinetap tengekto, ak koek aarek aeng' che mengichik che ma siirei kenyiit agenge, kobunji tiseiywotap kagoochinoik che po kaalyeet.

Ak koongoi tisiindet chooto kobooto magatiinik che po tongoanik koek kagoochinet ne kiongoi eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, kobooto mengichichooto aeng'. Tiliilitu eng' Kamuktaindet ne Toroor amu tisiindet.
Oititen eng' peetuunooto; piitu kayumetapkei ne itabaanat eng' okweek; amat oyai poisyo age tugul ne po otwoknot. Niito ng'atuutyet ne po koigeny eng' meng'otosyekwok tugul eng' ibinwekwok tugul.
“Ye ogesisye eng' emeng'wong', ko mat iges igeesu luukwegap mbareeng'ung', anan iyumate turoonigap kesisyeng'ung'. Pagakyi kibananook ak che toek. Aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindeng'wong'.”
Ki ng'alaalji `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Musa koleenji,
“Mwachi piigap Israel leenjin, Egu kamuung'et eng' okweek, peetuut ne po tai eng' arawetap tisap, kabwaatet ne po kuutetap iryagook, kayumetapkei ne itabaanat.
Amat oyai poisyo age tugul ne po otwoknot ak ogoite kagoochinet ne punei maat kigoochin Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.”
Ki mwachi `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Musa koleenji,

“Ago egu peetuutap kagaigaet eng' peetuutap taman eng' arawaniito po tisap. Egu kayumetapkei ne itabaanat eng' okweek, ne oming'inge, ak ogoite kagoochinet ne punei maat ne kigoochin Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Amat oyai poisyo age tugul eng' peetuunooto, amu peetuutap kagaigaet, si keyai kagaigaet amu okweek eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindeng'wong'.
Amu chii age tugul ne ma iming'inegei eng' peetuunooto, king'etoi eng' piikyik.
Chii age tugul ne yaei poisyet age tugul eng' peetuunooto, ang'eme chiichooto aistoe piikyik.
Amat oyai poisyo age tugul. Niito ko ng'atuutyet eng' ibinwekwok tugul eng' meng'otosyekwok tugul.
Egu sabato ne po kamuung'et eng' okweek ak oming'inge. Oriip sabato neng'wong' peetuut ne po sogool ne po arawet, kobooch koskoleny agoi koskoleny.”
Ki ng'alaalji `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Musa koleenji,
“Mwachi piigap Israel leenjin, Egu igoortap keryosyek peetuusyek tisap eng' Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' peetuutap taman ak muut ne po arawaniito po tisap.
Egu kayumetapkei ne itabaanat eng' peetuut ne po tai, amat oyai poisyo age tugul ne po otwoknot.

Ogoitoi kagoochinet ne punei maat, ne kigoochin Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, eng' peetuusyek tisap. Egu kayumetapkei ne itabaanat eng' okweek eng' peetuut ne po sisiit, ak ogoitoi kagoochinet ne punei maat, ne kigoochin Kamuktaindet ne Toroor. Tuiyet ne po kaming'inetapkei niito; amat oyai poisyo age tugul ne po otwoknot.

“Chuuto igoorwegap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor che ki king'at, che omwaitoi ole, kayumosyegapkei che itabaanatiin, si ogoite kagoochinet ne punei maat ne kigoochin Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, kagoochinet ne kibeelei ak kagoochinet ne po peek, tiseiywot ak kagoochinoik che kieei; kigoitoi kagoochinet age tugul eng' peetuunnyi.
Konunoichu kosiirei che po sabatoisyek che po Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ak kosiirei kagoochinoikwok che ki oaroorte tugul ak kagoochinoikwok tugul che po chamyet, che ogoochini Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.

“Ago ye kaoyum ruroteetap emet eng' peetuutap taman ak muut, ne po arawetap tisap, oriip koek igoortap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' peetuusyek tisap. Kitere kamuung'et eng' peetuut ne po tai ak kitere kamuung'et eng' peetuut ne po sisiit.

Obutyigei eng' peetuut ne po tai logoegap keetiik che korooron, mooriigap tiironigap sosik ak mooriigap keetiik che nyigiisen, ak keetiik che piityee kereruusyek, ak oboiboitu eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindeng'wong' eng' peetuusyek tisap.
Oriip nooto koek igoortap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' peetuusyek tisap eng' kenyiit. Niito ng'atuutyet ne po koigeny eng' ibinwekwok; oriip anyun igoorata eng' arawetap tisap.
Omenye keryosyek peetuusyek tisap, ak menyei keryosyechooto tugul che salu Israel,
si kobiit konai ibinwekwok che piitu let kole, ki agoochi piigap Israel komeny keryosyek, ye ki amutu icheek komang'une emetap Misiri. Aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindeng'wong'.”
Ki mwachi anyun Musa piigap Israel igoorwegap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor che ki king'at.
Ki mwachi `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Musa koleenji,
“Ng'at piigap Israel koibun mwanigap mseituni che tiliileen che ki kitui agobo lapkeiyet, si kolaal tait kotugul.

Chobei Aron tait eng' saang'utap angeet ne ki kioiye koot, ne po paornateet, eng' emait ne kituiyechin, kong'etee koskoleny agoi karon kotugul eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor. Egu niito ng'atuutyet ne po koigeny eng' ibinwekwok tugul.
Chobei ineendet taisyek eng' keldap tait ne tiliil eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kotugul.
“Inemu peek che ng'ootiin che tambulul kiloinik taman ak aeng' ak ibeel magatiinik taman ak aeng'. Yamei magatyat agenge kiloinik aeng'.
Ak itet koek ortinwek aeng', kobee lo lo, eng' meset ne tiliil eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ak inde ooreet age tugul tuguuk che tiliileen che nyamdut, si kobiit koek kabwaatet eng' magatinichooto, kagoochinet ne punei maat ne kigoochin Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Tetei ineendet kioto eng' sabato age tugul eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor; nooto ko amu piigap Israel, koek kayomiset ne po koigeny.
Punjin Aron ak weeriikyik, ak amei eng' ole-tiliil, amu tiliil miising' eng' ineendet eng' kagoochinoik che punei maat che po Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' ng'atuutyet ne po koigeny.”
Ki manda ye mi piigap Israel weeriitap kobogoryotap Israel, ne ki Misirindet kwandanyi, ak kiboryo weerooto po kobogoryotap Israel ak chiitap Israel eng' nganaseet,
ki sas ak kochup Kainet weerooto po kobogoryotap Israel. Ak ki imut `icheek ineendet kwo ole mi Musa. Ki kiguure kainetap kamet Selomit, cheptap Dibri, ne po ooreetap Dan.
Ak kiger `icheek ineendet, koganyis kot konai kiit ne punu kutitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor agobo ineendet.
Ki mwachi `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Musa koleenji,
“Imoong'u ineendet ne kosasiis kwo saang'utap nganaseet; ak ingogonoor eunekwak metinnyi icheek tugul che kogasei kosasisyei, ak kolage koik tuiyet komugul ineendet.
Ak imwachi piigap Israel ileenji, Ibei tengektanyi age tugul ne sasei Kamuktaindennyi.
Ineendet ne chubei kainetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kebarei iman. Lage koik iman tuiyet komugul chiichooto; ngo punootyo anan ne kisikyin kaa, kibarei ye kachup kainet.
Kibarei iman chii age tugul ne parei chiito age.
Igeeri age ineendet ne kabar ne po akweet; saboondo eng' saboondo.
Ngo nde chiito peruut chiitap kokwennyi, ko uu ye ki yai, kiyachin ineendet ko uu nooto;
moet eng' moet, konda eng' konda, keldet eng' keldet. Ko uu ye kagonde chiito age perutyet, kigeerchin ko uu nooto agine.
Ineendet ne parei ne po akweet kogeeri age, ak kebarei chiito ne parei chii.
Egu agenge ng'atuutyeng'wong', kergeitu ne punootyo ak ne salwok. Amu aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindeng'wong'.”

Ara ki ng'alaalji `Musa piigap Israel ak ki imut `icheek chiichooto kisasisyei kwo saang'utap nganaseet ak kelage ineendet koik. Ki yai anyun piigap Israel ko uu ye ki ng'at `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Musa.
Ki ng'alaalji `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Musa eng' tulweetap Sinai koleenji,
“Mwachi piigap Israel leenjin, Ye oit emet ne agoonok, koriip anyun `emet sabato agobo Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Igoole mbareeng'ung' ne po sabibuk kenyiisyek lo, ak isabor keetiigap logoeguk eng' kenyiisyek lo, ak iyum ruratennyi kobwa kaa;
ago egu sabato eng' kenyiit ne po tisap ne imuunyi emet, sabato ne po Kamuktaindet ne Toroor. Amat igol mbareeng'ung' ne po sabibuk anan isabor keetiigap logoeguk.
Amat iges kolgeinik che po mbareeng'ung', amat ibut sabibuk che po keetiiguk che po logoek che ma kisabor. Ak egu kenyiit ne imuunyi emet.
Ago egu ruroteetap emet eng' sabatonooto amitwogikwok; cheguuk, po otwogindeng'ung', ak otwogindeng'ung' ne tye ak po otwogindet ne nyooru melekto ak punootyot ne mi kobooten,
ak ko po akweeng'ung' ak tyong'ik che mi emeng'ung', ruratennyi tugul amitwogikwak.
“Iityigei sabatoisyek tisap che po kenyiisyek, chooto ko kenyiisyek tisap konyil tisap, koek eng' inyee peetuusyegap sabatoisyek tisap che po kenyiisyek, chooto ko kenyiisyek artam ak sogool.
Yeityo iguut iryageet ne cheei miising', eng' peetuutap taman eng' arawetap tisap; oguute iryageet koyom emeng'wong' komugul eng' peetuutap kagaigaet.
Ak otabaan kenyiit ne po konom, ak omwaite eng' emet komugul katyagetap tugul che meng'iisyei. Egu jubilii eng' okweek. Wendi chii tugul ole ki nenyi, ak koweekyigei chii tugul oldap piikyik.
Egu jubilii eng' okweek kenyinooto po konom. Mogolse anan oges kolgeinik eng' olooto, amat obut logoegap keetiik che ma kisabor.
Amu jubilii, egu ne tiliil eng' okweek. Oame ruratennyi che punu mbar.
“Ak oweekyigei chii tugul ole ki nenyi eng' kenyini po jubilii.
Ngialdochi kiy chiitap kokweng'ung' anan ngial kiy eng' chiitap kokweng'ung', ko matoyachigei ne ya, okweegei eng' okweegei.
Iale chiitap kokweng'ung' ne yamegei ak koitetap kenyiisyek, ko kagobata jubilii, ak ingoaldaun che yamegei ak koitetap kenyiisyek che po kesisyet.
Itese alyennyi ko uu chaang'indap kenyiisyek ak ichuchuch alyennyi ko uu ng'ering'indap kenyiisyek, amu aldaun ne yamegei ak kesisyet.
Ago amoyachigei ne ya, okweegei eng' okweegei; ago iywei Kamuktaindeng'ung'. Amu aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindeng'wong'.
“Amu nooto anyun, oriip ng'atuutikyuk ak oyai kirwoogutikyuk, si omeny emet eng' kaalyeet.
Ak kooi `emet logoek ak oam obiye, ak omeny olooto eng' kaalyeet.
Ak ngot ole, ‘Ki ame nee eng' kenyiitap tisap, Ogeero, ma ki koolsei, ama kigese tuguukyok?’
Ang'ate anyun perurtanyu eng' okweek eng' kenyiit ne po lo, koruryo che yamei kenyiisyek somok.
Ye ogoolse eng' kenyiitap sisiit, oame logoek che konorotiin che po keny, agoi kenyiitap sogool, oame che po keny agoi koruryo kogeny.
“Ma ki aldoi emonooto agoi, amu nenyu emet; amu oo toek ak kiprutoinik kobooto eng' emonooto.
Ogoite katyaget ne po emet, eng' emeng'wong' komugul.
“Ngo ek panan ne otupche ak koalda kebebertap oldanyi, konyo anyun ne tilyennyi ne neegit, konyo kotyach nooto ki alda tupchennyi.
Ngo ma tinyei chiito chii ne ityaachi, ak ngoboor, ak kotinyei che yamei kotyagegei,
ingoiit anyun kenyiisyek kobooch ngap koalda, ak koweekyi chiito ne kiga aldochi, che kang'etune; yeityo koweekyigei olooto ki nenyi.

Ago ngo ma imuuch kotyakyigei, kotebee nooto eutap ineendet ne kiga al, agoi koit kenyiitap jubilii. Ak nyolu komaanda alindet koronooto eng' eunnyi eng' kenyinooto po jubilii ak kobunji chiichooto ki po.
“Ngo alda chii koot ne ki menyei ne mi nganaseet ne ki kiyieme irimeet, komuuchi kotyach eng' kenyiit ne isubi nooto ki aldae. Ki chamjin kotyach eng' kenyinooto komugul.
Ngo ma kityaach eng' kenyinooto komugul, kobunji koyooto miitei nganaseet ne ki king'ot, ineendet ne ki alei, agoi, eng' ibinwekyik tugul; ma kityaachi nooto eng' kenyiitap jubilii.
Ago ki iti kooriik che mi nganasook che ma kiyieme irimeet, kogergeit ak mbareenik che po emet. Kimuuchi kityaach chooto, mandoi chooto eng' kenyiitap jubilii.
Ago imuuchi Lawiik kotyach nganasookwak, ak kooriik che mi nganasook che chechwaak, eng' peetuut age tugul.

Ak ngo tyach chiito age ne po Lawiik, komandoi anyun koyooto ki kialda, kobooto nganaseet ne nenyi, eng' kenyiitap jubilii; amu chechwaget kooriik che mi nganasoogap Lawiik eng' kwenutap piigap Israel.
Ago amat kealda emet ole agete tuukwak che po nganasookwak, amu chechwaak agoi.”
“Ngo ek kibanania tupcheng'ung' ama sich kiy ne toretegei, ko myee itoret anyun ineendet ak otebi tuwai ko uu toondet anan punootyot.
Amat image ineendet kelunet anan che tesatiin. Ago iywei Kamuktaindeng'ung', si kotebi tupcheng'ung' kobooten.
Amegoochi siling'isyeguk ile si inyoorunee che siirtoot, anan igoochi amitwogiguk ile si kotesak.
Aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindeng'wong', ne ki amutwak omang'une emetap Misiri, si agoonok emetap Kanaan, ak aegu Kamuktaindeng'wong'.
“Ngo ek kibanania tupcheng'ung' ne mi kobooten, ak kochamdagei ial ineendet, ko megoochi ineendet kootin ko uu otwogin.
Ingotebi kobooten ko uu otwogindet ne nyooru melekto anan ko uu punootyot. Ak kootin agoi kenyiitap jubilii.
Yeityo anyun komanda eng' oldang'ung', ineendet kobooto lagokyik, ak koweekyigei oldap piigap ooreenywa, koweekyigei ole mi tuguugap kwanisyekyik.
Amu icheek ko otwogikyuk, che ki amutu komang'une emetap Misiri; ma ki aldoi anyun icheeget ko uu otwogik.
Amat ibou ineendet eng' kimnateet ne koroom, ago iywei Kamuktaindeng'ung'.
Ago eng' ng'olyootap otwogiguk che murenik ak che tiibiik, che ta inyooru, che po pororyosyek che kiyiemak, oale chooto.
Oale eng' lagogap punootik che meng'iisyei eng' kwenung'wong', ak eng' piikwak che mi kobootok che ki kisikyin emeng'wong', egu anyun icheek chekwoget.
Ak oyai chooto koek poroteetap lagokwok, che piitu let, si konam kobunji. Onyoorunee icheek otwogikwok agoi, ago amobou eng' kimnateet ne koroom tupchosyekwok, piigap Israel, okweegei eng' okweegei.

“Ngot koek mogoryo ne kipsagarin anan punootyo ne mi kobooten, ak konam pananda tupcheng'ung' ne mi kobooto ineendet, ak kochamdagei koal kipsagarindonooto anan punootyondonooto mi kobooten, anan ne salu kesweegap ooreet ne po chiichooto,
kimuuchi kityaach kogeny ye kagialda; imuuchi kotyach age eng' tupchosyekyik.
Imuuchi kotyach ineendet chiitap ooreennyi anan weeriitap ne po ooreennyi, anan tilyet age tugul ne neegit ne po ooreennyi, anan ngo ek mogoryo komuuchi kotyachkei.

Koiit tuwai kobooto chiichooto ki alei ineendet kobooch kenyiit ne ki aldaegei agoi kenyiitap jubilii. Ak kotenit che ki kialdae ineendet koitetap kenyiisyek; tebyei kobooto ineendet che yamegei ak peetuusyegap otwogindet ne nyooru melekto eng' otisyennyi.
Ngo ta komi kenyiisyek che chaang', koweekyi silingisyek che yamei katyagennyi eng' silingisyek che kiga kiale ineendet.
Ak ngo ta komi kenyiisyek che ng'ering' kityo si koit kenyiitap jubilii, koiit anyun tuwai, ak koweekyi silingisyek che yamei kenyiisyek che po katyagennyi.
Ngo tebi kobooto ineendet ko uu otwogindet ne nyooru melekto eng' kenyiit agoi kenyiit; amat koboi ineendet eng' kimnateet ne koroom eng' taing'ung'.
Ago ngo ma kityaach chiichooto eng' ortinwechooto, komanda anyun kwo eng' kenyiitap jubilii, ineendet kobooto lagokyik.
Amu otwogikyuk piigap Israel; icheeget otwogikyuk che ki amutu komang'une emetap Misiri. Aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindeng'wong'.

“Amat koyachigei tuguuk che ma tilei kiy, amat olumdochigei kanamwet ne ki kiwai, anan toloita, amat onde koita ne ki kiwai eng' emeng'wong', ogutung'ji. Amu aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindeng'wong'.
Oriip sabatosyekyuk, ak ogonyit koonnyu ne tiliil. Aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
“Ngo pendate kaneetisyosyekyuk ak oriip ng'atuutikyuk, ak oyai,
agoonok anyun ropta eng' peetuusyekyik, ak koii emet, ak koii keetiigap mbar logoekwak.
Yamei kesuutik che obore, agoi koit ruroteetap keetiigap logoek, ak itei ruroteetap logoek koolset. Ak oam amitwogikwok kot obiye, ak omeny emeng'wong' eng' kaalyeet.
Ak agoonu kaalyeet eng' emet ak oruiye, ama piitu ne imuok. Abeeti tyong'ik eng' emeng'wong', ama punei emeng'wong' rotwetap chok.
Oone puunikwok ak kobutyo eng' taing'wong' eng' rotwetap chok.
Oonei piikwok muutu piik pogol, ak koon piikwok pogolu eliphuusyek taman. Ibutos eng' rotwetap chok eng' taing'wong' puunikwok.
Atokyinok agane togeennyu ak agoonok iyoteet, atesak ak agimiit kayomisennyu kobootok.
Oam anyun tuguuk che konorotiin che po keny, ak omoong'u che po keny si kobiit ole ondoi che ogese.
Ak ande koonnyu kwenung'wong', ama wechok saboondanyu.
Awendotee kwenung'wong' ak aegu Kamuktaindeng'wong', ak oegu piikyuk.
Aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindeng'wong', ne ki amutwak omong'u eng' emetap Misiri, si mata oegu otwogikwak. Ak ki airii keetiigap choging'wong' ak ang'eetak obe komyee.
“Ago ngo mogasa iit, amoyai ng'atuutichooto tugul,
ak ngot oeesye kaneetisyosyekyuk, ak kowech saboonwekwok kirwoogutikyuk, kot ko moyai ng'atuutikyuk tugul, obut kayomisennyu,
ayaiywok ni agane: ang'ate kamuiset konyonjok, chebuonit ak eseet, che ng'emei koonyek, ak kogoochi saboondo kosagit. Ogoole kesweekwok puch, amu amei puunikwok.
Aboorwok nereegekyuk, ak kebaraak eng' taitap puunikwok. Poiywok che wechok, ak omwei ko maonok chii.
Ago ngo mogasa iit eng' tuguuchuuto, abirok anyun konyil tisap kosiir amu tengekwogikwok.
Airie anyun menoteetap kimnateng'ung', ak ayai kipsengwet neng'wong' koigei karnet ak koigei emeng'wong' sugunwet.
Oboisyee puch kimnateeng'wong', amu ma koonu emeng'wong' rurateet, ak ma iitos keetiigap emet logoekwak.
“Ngo testai oeesya, amogasa iit, aibwok korotwek konyil tisap kosiir, ko uu tengekwogikwok.
Ayoogu tyong'ik che po timiin kobwa kwenung'wong', che pwoonei korebenok lagokwok ak kobar tuukwok; ak koyaak ong'ering'itu ak koek kipkuberet ortinwekwok.
“Ngot ko amu kergong'yani komocham owekyogei, ago ngot otestai oeesya,
aeesyok anyun ak okweek ak abirok anyun aneendet konyil tisap amu tengekwogikwok.
Aibwok rotwetap chok ne yaakwok mugetuut ne po kayomiset. Ye oyumjigei nganasookwok, ayookwok koroito konyo kweng'wong' ak kindeak eunegap puunikwok.
Ye atil amitwogikwok kong'ering'itu, kobeel anyun kobogorisyek tamanu amitwogikwok eng' kapkoimaut agenge, ak kebimanwak amitwogikwok eng' ratilit. Oamisyei amobiyonyi.
“Ak ngo mogasa iit eng' tuguuchu tugul, ago otila let,
atilok let anyun eng' pandanyu eng' nereegek che pichiien, ak abirok agane konyil tisap amu tengekwogikwok.
Ak oam panyeegap poorwegap weeriikwok ak che po tiibiikwok.
Ang'eme awong'u komoswekwok che torooreen ak aluul kanamonikwok che po asiista, ak awirchi muuswekwok ole mi muuswegap kanamonikwok, ak kowechok saboondanyu.
Ayae nganasookwok koek karotwek, ak ayai oldinwekwok che tiliileen koek kipkuberet, ma achame kong'ucha anyinyindap nyamdutikwok.
Ak ayai emet koek surkwen ak kokwong'yo puunikwok che menyei olooto.
Ak aiyestochok pororyosyek alak, ak ang'usu rotwetap chok kosubok. Koguber anyun emeng'wong', ak koek karotwek nganasookwok.
“Yeityo kobaibaitune anyun emet sabatoisyekyik, eng' peetuusyechooto ko kuberot, omi emetap puunikwok; komuuny anyun emet, ak kobaibait eng' sabatoisyekyik.
Imuunyi emet kota ko kuberot, eng' kamuung'onooto ki ma nyoor eng' sabatosyekwok, ye ki omenye olooto.

Ak eng' icheeget che ng'etu eng' okweek, ayookyini mugulelwekwak kaiyweisyet eng' emotinwegap puunikwak, ak koon icheek cheetap sogoot ne ibei usoonet, ak komwei icheek ko uu chii ne mwee rotwetap chok, ak kobutyoti ye maonei chii.
Koriichkei icheegei eng' icheegei, ko uu eng' taitap rotwetap chok, ye ma mi ne oonei. Monyooru anyun kimnateet ne otononie eng' taitap puunikwok.
Eng' let olusyi pororyosyek ak koluguak emetap puunikwok.
Ak ichuchui che ng'etu eng' okweek eng' tengekwogikwak eng' emotinwegap puunikwok; ak kogeny amu tengekwogigap kwanisyekwak kochuchui ko uu icheek.
“Ago ngot kong'aany tengekwogikwak, ak che po kwanisyekwak eng' kachiliilutikwak che ki yaiywo icheek, ak kogeny amu kitila let,
ak ki atil let agane icheek, ak amutu icheek kobwa emetap puunikwak. Ngo ming'ingei anyun mugulelwekwak che ma imuratanotiin ak kotaach piretap tengekwogikwak,
abwaat anyun kayomisennyu ne ki ayomisyi Jakobo; kayomisennyu agine ne kayomisyi Isak ak abwaat agine kayomisennyu ne ki ayomisyi Abraham, ak abwaat emet.

“Ak kometo icheek emet ak kobaibait eng' sabatoisyekyik, ye tebyei emonooto ko kuberot koma mi icheek, ak kotaach piretap tengekwogikwak, amu ki eesyo kirwoogutikyuk, ak ki wech saboonwekwak kaneetisyosyekyuk.
Agot nganda uu chooto tugul, ye mi emetap puunikwak, koma eesyoi icheek, amaweche, amang'eme awong'u ak ma pute kayomisennyu kobooto icheek. Amu aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindennywa.
Ago abwaati amu icheek kayomiset ne ki ayomisyi poisyekwak che ki among'u eng' emetap Misiri kogeeronu pororyosyek, si aek Kamuktaindennywa. Aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.”
Chu anyun kaneetisyosyek ak kirwoogutik ak ng'atuutik che ki yai Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ak piigap Israel eng' tulweetap Sinai eng' Musa.
Ki ng'alaalji `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Musa koleenji,
“Mwachi piigap Israel leenjin icheek, Ye yaei chii kaarorunet, kogoito chii kobunji Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ak komach kogoito alyetap kamanuutyetap chiichooto,

itaune kamanuutyeng'ung' ne irogendochini; murenik che po kong'etee kenyiisyek tiptem agoi che po kenyiisyek tamanwogik lo, ingoek kamanuutyeng'ung' ne irogendochini shekelisyek konom che po fedha, ko uu shekel ne po ole-tiliil.
Ak ngo kobogoryo, koegu kamanuutyeng'ung' shekelisyek sosom.
Ngo po kenyiisyek muut agoi kenyiisyek tiptem, koegu anyun kamanuutyeng'ung' shekelisyek tiptem eng' muren ak shekelisyek taman eng' kobogoryo.
Ngo po arawet agenge agoi kenyiisyek muut, koegu anyun kamanuutyeng'ung' shekelisyek muut che po fedha eng' muren, ak shekelisyek somok che po fedha eng' ne tye.
Ngo po kenyiisyek tamanwogik lo ak kwo tai, ngo muren koegu kamanuutyeng'ung' shekelisyek taman ak muut, ak kobogoryo koegu shekelisyek taman.
Ngo panan chiichooto kosiir kamanuutyeng'ung', kinde ineendet taitap tisiindet si komwa tisiindet che kimage; mwaei tisiindet che kimage chiichooto kayai kaarorunet ak kogoito ko uu kamugennyi.
“Ngogoito piik kagoochinet ne kigoochin Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ngo ne po akweet, tugul che po chooto che igoochin chii Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ko tiliileen.
Amat kowal chii, kowale ne ya ne myee, anan ne myee eng' ne ya; ago ngot kowal tuguuchooto po akweet, kowale `age age ko tiliileen tuwai, nooto ak ne kiwale.
“Ngo tyony age tugul ne ng'waan, ne ma kigoitoi koek kagoochinet ne po Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, konde anyun tyonyooto taitap tisiindet,
koiit tisiindet anyun ole tee, ngo myee anan ngo ya, ko uu ye kaiit tisiindet, kotebyei ko uu nooto.
Ago ngo machei iman kotyach tyonyooto, kotesyi anyun kamanuutyennyi kebeberta agenge eng' muut.
“Ye itabaani chii koonnyi koek ne tiliil eng' Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, koiit anyun tisiindet kogeer ngo myee anan ngo ya. Ko uu ye kaiit tisiindet, kotep ko uu nooto.
Ngo machei kotyach koonnyi chiichooto koitabaani, kotes anyun kebeberta agenge eng' muut ne po kamanuutyeng'ung', si kobunji ineendet koot.
“Ngo tabaanji chii Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kebebertap mbareennyi, kotenitu anyun kamanuutyeng'ung' kolsetap mbaranooto; ki iti kolsetap homer agenge ne po baale eng' shekelisyek konom che po fedha.
Ngo tabaan mbareennyi kobooch kenyiitap jubilii, kotebyei ko uu kamanuutyeng'ung' ne irogendochini.
Ago ngo tabaan ineendet mbareennyi ko kagosiirto jubilii, koiti tisiindet anyun ineendet silingisyek ko uu kenyiisyek che kang'et agoi koit kenyiitap jubilii, ak keetil eng' kamanuutyeng'ung'.
Ak ngo tyach iman mbareet ineendet ne ki itabaani, kotesyi anyun kebeberta agenge eng' muut ne po kamanuutyeng'ung' ne irogendochini, ak kobunji ineendet iman.
Ago ngo ma ityaach ineendet mbaranooto, anan ngo ki koaldochi chiito age mbaranooto, koma kityaachi agoi.
Tiliilitu mbaranooto eng' Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ye mandoi eng' jubilii, ko uu mbareet ne ki kitabaan; punjin tisiindet.
“Ngo tabaanji chii Kamuktaindet ne Toroor mbareet ne ki koal, ne ma mbareet ne ki nenyi,
koiityi anyun tisiindet ineendet ole tenitu kamanuutyetap mbaranooto agoi kenyiitap jubilii, ak kogoon ineendet eng' peetuunooto kamanuutyet, koek kiy ne ki kitabaanji Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Kiweekyin mbaranooto chiito ne ki kiale eng' kenyiitap jubilii, ineendet ne ki nenyi mbareet.
Ak uu kamanuutiguk tugul shekelisyek che po ole-tiliil: tinyei shekel agenge gerahisyek tiptem.
“Che kitwatei eng' che kiyagi, che ki kiyai koek che po kiboretook che punjin Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, chooto icheegei che ma itabaani chii; po Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne kirgit anan ne keechiiryet.
Ngo po tyong'ik che ng'woneen, kotyach anyun ineendet ko uu kamanuutyet ne irogendochini, ak kotesyi kebeberta agenge eng' muut ne po nooto. Ngo ma kityaachi kealdoi ko uu kamanuutyeng'ung'.
