Kitilak mana eng' peetuunooto ki iamei kesuutigap emonooto che po kenyiit. Mata konyoor kogeny piigap Israel mana; ki am eng' kenyinooto amitwogigap emetap Kanaan.

Ye ki neegit koit Joshua Jeriko, ko kitabendo ak ki keer kotononi chiito ko katokyigei ineendet kotinyei rotwetap chok eng' eunnyi ne kang'us. Ki wo Joshua ole miitei ineendet ak koteebe koleenji, “Ii nenyo anan ii po puunikyok?”

Kowol chiichooto kole, “Achicha, kaanyo nguno aegu kiptaiyatap lugeet ne po Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.” Ki ing'uruuk Joshua kot koit ng'wony togeennyi kolas ak koleenji, “Imwachini nee otwogindeng'ung', ee kiptaiyandennyu?”
Ki mwachi `kiptaiyat ne po lugeetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Joshua koleenji, “Icheru kweoniguk eng' keelyeguk, amu tiliil yo itonone.” Ak ki yai Joshua ko uu nooto.
Kiga kiger Jeriko kot amu piigap Israel. Ki ma komandoi chii anan kochut oriit.
Ki mwachi `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Joshua koleenji, “Keero, kande eung'ung' Jeriko, laitoryandennyi ak murenikyik che po lugeet.
Oyiem nganaseet; murenik tugul che po lugeet omuuti nganaseet konyil agenge. Oyae ko uu nooto eng' peetuusyek lo.
Ngo ip tisiik tisabu igondisyek tisap che po kuinoigap mengichik eng' taitap moinget. Eng' peetuut ne po tisap, omuut nganaseet konyil tisap ak koguut tisiik igondisyek.
Ye ogas cheetap igoondit ko kagoguut tisiik koek keny, kowaakyo piik tugul waagaat ne oo, ak koluul irimeetap nganaseet kwo ng'wony ak kwo chii age tugul kotogosta kotoorchigei ye kageer.”
Ki kuur `Joshua weeriitap Nun tisiik koleenji, “Oip moingetap arorutyet, ak ingoip tisiik tisabu igondisyek tisap che po kuinoigap mengichik kondoe moingetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.”
Kong'at piik koleenji, “Oba ak oyiem nganaseet ak ingondoe murenik che ilaachi kariik moingetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.”

Ko uu ye ki mwachi `Joshua piik, ko ki pa tisiik tisabu che ki ibei igondisyek tisap che po kuinoigap mengichik kondo eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, koguutei igondisyek, ak kosubi eng' let moingetap arorutyetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ki indoe murenik che ki ilaachi kariik tisiik che kiguutei igondisyek, ak kosubu piik che kiletu moinget, koguutoti tisiik igondisyek ak kobendi.
Ki ng'at `Joshua piik koleenji, “Amat owaach anan otwegu, anan komang'une ng'olyoo kutiswekwok kot koit peetuut ne aleenjok owaach, owaach anyun.”
Ki ip anyun moingetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kimuute nganaseet konyil agenge, ak ye ibata, kobwa kemoi nganaseet koruiyo.
Ki ng'eet Joshua karon miising', ak koip tisiik moingetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.

Ki pa ko uu nooto kotugul tisiik tisabu che ki ibei igondisyek tisap che po kuinoigap mengichik kondoe moingetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor koguutei igondisyek. Ki indoe icheek murenik che ki ilaachi kariik ak ki isup piik che kiletu moingetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor koguutoti tisiik igondisyek ak kobendi.
Kiyiem nganaseet peetuut ne po aeng' konyil agenge, yeityo koweektagei koba nganaseet; ak ki yai ko uu nooto peetuusyek lo.
Eng' peetuut ne po tisap, kong'eetyo karon miising' ko kairir emet, ak komuut nganaseet konyil tisap. Peetuunooto kityo ne kiyiem nganaseet konyil tisap.
Eng' ne po tisap koguutei tisiik igondisyek, koleenji `Joshua piik, “Owaach anyun amu kagogoonok Kamuktaindet ne Toroor nganasani!
Nganaseet ak tugul che mi oriitinnyi kitabaanjin Kamuktaindet ne Toroor. King'emei kobatee Rahab chepkugoniot ak tugul che mi koonnyi amu kiuny piik che ki kiyogu.
Oriipkei okweeget eng' kiy ne itabaanat si ma ye kaotabaan, kota onam kogeny si oyai nganaseetap Israel koek ne chuboot ak koityi nyalil.
Ago fedhaisyek, thahabu tugul ak tuguuk tugul che po sugunonik ak che po kariik ko kitabaanjin Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ak keipu chooto kobwa ole kigonoree tuguugap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.”

Ki waakyo piik ak koguut tisiik igondisyek. Kingo kas piik cheetap igoondit, kowaakyo eng' waagaat ne oo. Eng' yooto kogiluul irimeet koobutyi ng'wony ak ki laany piik koba nganaseet oriit. Ki wo chii tugul tai kotoorchigei ye kageerei ak konyaban.
Kibaree rotwetap chok tugul che ki mi nganaseet kogees: murenik ak kwonyiik, ne ming'in ak ne oos, tany, keechiir ak sigiryo.
Ki leenji `Joshua pichooto aeng' che kigaba kosegei emet, “Oba kootap chepkugoniot ak oomutu komong' tugul che mi koonnyi ak tugul che tinyei ko uu ye ki oyosyechi.”

Ki pa ko anyun murenjoto aeng' segeik, ak koomut Rahab komong' kobooto kwandanyi, kamennyi, tupchosyekyik ak tugul che ki tinyei; ki imut komong' saang' tilyonutikyik tugul ak icheek. Ki pa ak kotebee saang'utap nganaseetap Israel.

Ye kingobata, kobeel nganaseet kobooto tuguuk tugul che ki mi oriit. Ago tuguugap fedhaisyek, thahabu, tuguuk che po sugunonik ak che po kariik ko ki inde ole kigonoree tuguugap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ki pagaach `Joshua Rahab chepkugoniot kosap, kobooto piigap kootap kwandanyi ak tugul che ki tinyei. Ki meng'iis icheek ak Israel agoi ra amu kiuny piik che kigaiyookto Joshua koba kosegei Jeriko.

Ki ng'at `Joshua icheek koyastos kole: “Chuboot eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor chii ne ng'eetei koteechei nganasani po Jeriko! Age tugul ne lumei lumeiywondennyi, ko mee taaitanyi, ak age tugul ne lumdoi kurgennyi, ko mee toweennyi.”
Ki mi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kobooto Joshua, ak ki yom emet komugul kalasunennyi.

Ago ki yai chalwok piigap Israel agobo tuguuk che itabaanatiin. Ki ip Akan weeriitap Karmi, weeriitap Sabdi, weeriitap Zerah ne po pororyetap Judah tuguuk alak eng' che itabaanatiin. Ki nereech kot Kamuktaindet ne Toroor agobo piigap Israel.
Ki iyookto `Joshua piik eng' Jeriko koba Ai, ne neegitee Beth-aben eng' komostap kong'asiis ne po Bethel komwachi koleenji, “Oba ak osegei emonooto.” Ak ki pa anyun piik kosegei Ai.
Ki week ole ki mi Joshua ak koleenji, “Ng'ering' pichooto, ara amat koba piik tugul. Ingoba piik olo po eliphuusyek aeng' anan ko somok koba kobar Ai.”
Ki pa piik olo po eliphuusyek somok, ago kimweiso komweune piigap Ai.
Kibaris piigap Ai kobar piigap Israel, piik olo po sosom ak lo ak koon eng' ormariichet kot koit Sebarik, ak kobarat korektoi. Kimeiyo miising' kot mugulelwegap piik.
Kigereer Joshua ngoroikyik ak kong'uruuk kot koit ng'wony togeennyi, ak konde temburyek metowekwak, ineendet ak poisyegap Israel eng' taitap moingetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor agoi koskoleny.
Ki le Joshua, “Pwo, wee Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor! Amu nee si imutu pichu kolong'une Jordan, igoochech eunegap Amorik kelusye? Kita kaigai kemeny Jordan pitoniin!
Ee Kiptaiyat, amwae nee anyun ye kagomweune Israel puunikwak!
Tuun kasei Kanaanik ak tugul che menyei emet agobo kiito, koyiemech ak kotil kainennyo kobet eng' ng'wony. Tos iite nee kaineng'ung' ne oo?”
Koleenji `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Joshua, “Ng'eet! Amu nee si ibutyi ng'wony ing'uruuge ko uu ni?
Kogoyai Israel tengekto, ee kogobistoe kayomisennyu ne kiga ang'at ak kogoip tuguuk eng' che itabaanatiin, kogochoorso, koberberis ak kogonde ole mi tuguukwak.

Nooto anyun amu nee si ma imuuchi piigap Israel kotononso eng' taitap puunikwak, komweune puunikwak amu kagoek che chubootiin. Ma ami kobootok kogeny ngot ko mong'em eng' kwenung'wong' tuguuchooto itabaanatiin.

Ng'eet ianyiny piik ak ileenji, Oanyinygei agobo mutai, amu kamwa ko uu ni Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindetap Israel kole, ‘Mi tuguuk che itabaanatiin kwenung'ung', ee Israel. Memuuchi itonone taitap puuniguk agoi oiste chooto itabaanatiin eng' kwenung'wong'.

Kimutwok karon oriigu kobee pororyosyekwok. Pororyet ne namei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, koriigu kobeen ortinwekwak. Ak ooreet ne namei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, koriigu kobeen kooriikwak, ak koot ne kanam `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, koriigu chiito agenge agenge.
Chii ne kinyoorchin kiit ne itabaanat, kebeelei eng' maat kobooto tuguuk tugul che tinyei amu kobistoe kayomisetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ak amu koyai abusnateet eng' Israel.’ ”
Kong'eet anyun `Joshua karon miising' ak komut Israel koriik kobee pororyosyekwak, ak ki kinam pororyetap Judah.
Ki imut `ineendet ortinwegap Judah koriik ak ki kinam ooreetap Seraik. Ki imut ooreetap Seraik koriik konyonune chiito agenge agenge ak ki kinam Sabdi.
Ki imut koonnyi konyonune chiito agenge agenge ak ki kinam Akan, weeriitap Karmi, weeriitap Sabdi, weeriitap Zerah, ne po pororyetap Judah.
Koleenji Joshua Akan, “Weeriinnyu asaain ale, igoochi toroornatet Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindetap Israel. Ng'aang'ji ineendet ak imwaiwo nguno kiit ne koiyai, mat iung'ena.”
Ki wolji `Akan Joshua koleenji, “Eng' iman ko koayachi chalwok Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindetap Israel, ak koayai ko uu ni ak ko uu ni.

Kinga keer eng' tuguuk che ki kiluul ngoryeet ne karaaran ne po Babilon ak shekelisyek pogol aeng' che po fedha, ak thahabu ne nyigiisindanyi ko shekelisyek konom, agase myat anyun ak aip. Ung'ootiin tuguuchooto eng' ng'wony eng' kwenutap emainnyu ak ko tabanu ng'wony fedha eng' tuguuchooto.”
Ki iyookto anyun `Joshua piik, ak ki rwai koba emait; ak ogeero kiung'otin eng' emainnyi ak kitabanu fedha ng'wony.
Ki inem eng' kwenutap emait ak koipchi Joshua, ak piigap Israel tugul. Ki inde ng'wony eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.

Yeityo konam `Joshua ak Israel tugul Akan weeriitap Zerah kobooto fedha, ngoryeet ak thahabu, weeriikyik, tiibiikyik, tuukyik, sigirokyik, keechiirekyik, emainnyi ak tugul che ki tinyei ak komut koba atebweetap Akor.
Ki leenji Joshua, “Amu nee si inyalilech? Inyaliilin Kamuktaindet ne Toroor rani.” Ak kilach Israel tugul ineendet eng' koik; ki peel eng' maat ak kolach eng' koik.
Ki iruruuch koik eng' paragunnyi ak mi koichooto agoi ra. Ki istogei anyun nereegek eng' Kamuktaindet ne Toroor. Ki kiguure anyun yooto atebweetap Akor agoi ra.

Ki mwachi `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Joshua koleenji, “Meiywei anan komein mugulelel, ago imut piik tugul che po lugeet ak ong'eetyee otogoste Ai. Keero, kaande eung'ung' laitoryatap Ai kobooto piikyik, nganasennyi ak emennyi.

Iyachini Ai ak laitoryandennyi ko uu ye ki iyachi Jeriko ak laitoryandennyi. Ago tuguukyik ak tuukyik che kiluulei, oipchinigei kobunjook koek parunenik. Ng'at anyun piik koribisyo eng' ole po nganaseet let.”
Ki ng'eet anyun Joshua ak piik tugul che po lugeet koba kobookyi Ai. Ki lewen `Joshua piik eliphuusyek sosom, murenik che kiimeen che nyigoonen ak koyookto koba kemoi.
Ak kong'at icheek koleenji, “Ogas komyee; oribistosi si obookyi nganaseet, eng' nganaseet ole po let; amat olooegitu miising' eng' nganasanooto, ago ochoboge okweek tugul.
Ariikyini nganaseet anee ak piik tugul che mi kobooto, ak ye mong' kobokyech, ko uu eng' tai, kemwei eng' tainnywa.
Mongu icheek koonwech kot kirete eng' nganaseet, amu mwaei koleen, ‘Kamweenech, ko uu yuginye.’ Ye kimwei ko uu nooto eng' tainnywa;
ong'eetyee eng' ribiseet ak onam nganaseet, amu indoi `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindeng'wong' eunekwok.
Ye kaonam nganaseet, obeel; oyaei ko uu ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor; ogeero, kaang'atak”
Ki iyookto anyun `Joshua icheek koba; ak ki pa koribisyo kotebee kwenutap Bethel ak Ai, komostap cherongo ne po Ai; ago ki ru Joshua ole mi piik kemounooto.
Ki ng'eet Joshua karon miising' ak koyum piik, kitogosta ineendet ak poisyegap Israel kondoe piik koba Ai.
Ki togosta piik tugul che po lugeet che ki mi kobooto ineendet ak ki pa koriikta ole pooch nganaseet ak koba koteekso eng' murot kaataam ne po Ai, ki mi atebweet kwenunnyi ak Ai.
Ki imut piik `Joshua olo po eliphuusyek muut, ak konde koribisyo eng' kwenutap Bethel ak Ai eng' komostap cherongo ne po nganaseet.

Ki inde piik anyun kotebi ko uu nooto, lugeet tugul ne ki mi murot kaataam ne po nganaseet ak piikwak tugul che kiribistos che ki mi komostap cherongo ne po nganaseet. Ki wo Joshua kemounooto kot koit kwenutap atebweet.

Ye kingo keer laitoryatap Ai kochirchiren, kong'eetyo karon miising' ak komanda piigap nganaseet koba kobargei ak Israel, ineendet ak piikyik tugul eng' sait ne kiga kichop, eng' ole tokyingei Arabah. Ago ki ma nai kole mi piik che ribistos si kobookyi ineendet eng' nganaseet let.
Ak ki yaigei Joshua ak Israel tugul ko uu yo kagiterter eng' tainnywa, ak ki mwei kobun ooreetap surkwen.
Ak ki kiguur piik tugul che ki mi nganaseet koba koon icheek, ak ye ki oone `icheek Joshua ko ki kireto icheek kolooegitu eng' nganaseet.
Ki ma komi chii ne ki ng'et eng' Ai anan ko Bethel, ne ki ma wo koon Israel. Ak ki pagaach nganaseet ko seng'eng'at yeityo koon Israel.
Ki leenji `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Joshua, “Tokyi Ai ng'otit ne itinye eng' euut, amu andoi eung'ung' nganasaniito.” Ak kitokyi Joshua ng'otit ne ki tinyei eng' eunnyi nganaseet.
Ye kingo tokyi Joshua ng'otit nganaseet, kong'eetyo pichu karibistos eng' chokyinet eng' ole kiribisye ak korwai kotokyigei yooto. Ki pa ak konam nganaseet ak kobeel kochokyi.

Ye kingo kuskong' piigap Ai, kogeer eng' kwong'eet kotogostoi iyeto kowendi parak eng' nganaseet. Ki mata kosich kimnateet komwechi komosi anan ko komosi, amu ki week pichu kamwee kobendi surkwen koweekyigei kobookyi pichu kaonu.
Ye kingo keer Joshua ak Israel tugul kole kagonam nganaseet pichu karibistos ak kogeer kotogostoi iyeto eng' nganaseet, koweek anyun ak kobar piigap Ai.

Ki pwa ak icheek che ki mi nganaseet kobargei ak pichooto; kotebee anyun kwenutap `Israel piigap Ai; ki mi alak komosi, komi alak komosi. Ki par `piigap Israel icheek kot koma ituuch agot agenge ne ki ng'et anan kochilil.
Ago ki nam laitoryatap Ai kosabei ak komutyi Joshua.

Kingo kagogees Israel pareetap piik tugul che ki menyei Ai eng' warenget eng' surkwen ole ki oonee icheek, ak kingo kagobutyo tugul eng' rotwetap chok kot kogeskei, koweektagei anyun Israel tugul koba Ai, ak koba kobare Ai rotwetap chok.
Murenik ak kwonyiik tugul che ki kibar eng' piigap Ai eng' peetuunooto ko ki eliphuusyek taman ak aeng'.
Amu ma aruny Joshua eunnyi ne kigaiito koname ng'otit agoi kobar kogees piik tugul che ki menyei Ai.
Ki kweri Israel tuuga ak parunenigap nganasanooto kobunji ko uu ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne ki kang'at Joshua.
Ki peel Joshua Ai ak koyai koek tulwo ne tebyei agoi, ki ek karaatya ne mi agoi ra.

Ki isonginin laitoryatap Ai eng' keetit kot koimen. Kingo rorokta asiista, kong'at `Joshua kechoor muustonyi eng' keetit konyo ng'wony, ak kowiirchi ole kichutei eng' kurgeetap nganaseet. Ak korurukyi yooto karurugutyet ne oo ne po koik, ne mi agoi ra.
Kiteekyi anyun `Joshua Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindetap Israel, kaptisisyet eng' tulweetap Ebal,

ko uu ye ki kang'at `Musa otwogindetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor piigap Israel ak ko uu ye ki kisir eng' bukuitap ng'atuutigap Musa, kaptisisyetap koik che ma kiwai, che mawai chii eng' karna. Ki igoochi eng' yooto Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kagoochinoik che kibeelei, ak kieng'ji kagoochinoigap kaalyeet.
Ak eng' yooto, eng' taitap piigap Israel, ko kisir Joshua kosirchi koik ng'atuutigap Musa, che kigagesir.

Kitononso Israel tugul, ne toondet ak ne ki kisikyi kaa, kobooto poisyekwak ak kiptainikwak ak kirwoogikwak, eng' moinget komosi ak komosi eng' taitap tisiik Lawiik, kotoorchindos ak che ibei moingetap arorutyetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor. Ki imii kebeber taitap tulweetap Gerizim, komi kebeber taitap tulweetap Ebal, ko uu ye ki kang'at Musa otwogindetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor korook, kole kiberuure piigap Israel.
Ye ibata kosoman Joshua ng'aleek tugul che po ng'atuutik, kaberuret ak chubisyet, ko uu tugul che ki kisir eng' bukuitap ng'atuutik.
Ma mi ng'olyoo eng' ng'aleek tugul che ki ng'at Musa ne masoman Joshua eng' taitap tuiyet tugul ne po Israel, komi kwonyiik, lagok ak toek che ki mi kwenunnywa.

Ye kingo kas laitorinik tugul (laitorinigap Hitik, Amorik, Kanaanik, Perisik, Hibik, kobooto Jebusik) che ki mi Jordan pitoniin, emetap tuloonook, ak warenget, ak ngeguut tugul ne po araraitap Mediterenian ne mi tai eng' Lebanon,
koyumgei kobargei ak Joshua ak Israel.
Ago kingo kas piigap Gibeon kiit ne ki kayachi `Joshua Jeriko ak Ai,
koyai ng'aalseet ak icheek: ki pa koigei piik che kiyooktoi, ki ip kuniok che oosen eng' sigirokwak, lolotinwegap divaik che oosen che ki kogereer ak ko che kigenabanap.
Ki ilaach kweonik che ki koosegitu che kigeginogin ak kolaach ngoroik che oosen. Magatiinik tugul che ki amitwogikwak ko kiga koyaamyo ak ko kiga koucho.
Ki pa ole mi Joshua eng' nganaseet eng' Gilgal, ak komwachi ineendet ak piigap Israel koleenji, “Ki punu emet ne loo, ara anyun ongeyai arorutyet ak okweek.”
Koleenji piigap Israel Hibik, “Kale ng'oo momenye kwenunnyo, kimuktoi ano keyai arorutyet ak okweek?”
Koleenji `icheek Joshua, “Ki otwogiguk.” koteebee `Joshua icheek koleenji, “Oo ng'oo? Ak obunu ano?”
Kowol kole, “Punu otwogiguk emet ne loo kot amu kainetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindeng'ung'; amu kigegas etunatennyi ak tuguuk tugul che ki yai eng' Misiri,
ak tuguuk tugul che ki yachi laitorinik aeng' che po Amorik che ki mi Jordan pitoniin, Sihon laitoryatap Hesbon ak Og laitoryatap Bashan ne ki mi Astarot.
Kimwaiwech poisyekyok ak tugul che menyei emennyo kole, Oip amitwogik che po panda; obe otorookte Israel ak oleenji, ‘Ki otwogikwok, obwa anyun si keyai arorutyet ak okweek.’
Ki kiibu magatinichuchok eng' kooriikyok kota komi ma eng' peetuut ne ki king'eetosi kebwane oling'wong', ago nguno ko ki koyaamyo ak koucho.
Kileelach lolotinwechu kiga kinyiit divaik ak ko nguno ko ki kogereeris. Ki koosegitu ngoroikyok ak kweonikyok amu panda ne kooi kot.”
Ki am icheek amitwogigap pichooto ama teep ng'olyoo kobun kutitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ki yai Joshua ak icheeget kayanjinetap kaalyeet, ak koarorto kobagaakta pichooto kosapcho, ak ki igimit pounigap tuiyet eng' kayosyet.
Ago kingo pata peetuusyek somogu ko kagoyai arorutyet ak icheek, kogas keele kaagaa ki piigap kokwennywa ak komenyei kwenunnywa.
Ki pa piigap Israel ak koit nganasoogap pichooto eng' peetuutap somok. Nganasokwak ko ki Gibeon, Kepira, Beerot ak Kiriath-Jearim.
Ago ma par `piigap Israel icheek, amu kiga koyasyechi pounigap tuiyet eng' Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindetap Israel. Ki ing'unyng'uny tuiyet komugul agobo pounik.
Ago ki leenji pounik tugul tuiyet komugul, “Ki kiyasyechi icheek eng' Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindetap Israel, ara anyun ma kimuuchi ketwa icheek.
Kiyachini ko uu ni; kibagaaktoi kosapcho, si ma ityeech nereegek amu kayasyoet ne ki kiyasyechi.”
Ki leenji `pounik icheek, “Obagaach kosapcho.” Ki ek anyun pichooto che petei kweenik ak koramjin peek tuiyet komugul ko uu ye ki kamwachi pounik.
Ki iyookto anyun Joshua keguur icheek, ak ki ng'alaalji koleenji, “Amu nee si ong'alech ole, ‘Kimenye ole loo miising' eng' okweek,’ ago kaagaa omenye kwenunnyo?
Ara anyun oo chubootiin, amagoi petyo eng' okweek che otwogik che petei kweenik ak che ramei peek che po kootap Kamuktaindennyu.”

Ki wolji `icheek Joshua koleenji, “Amu ki kimwaiwech acheek otwogiguk iman ko uu ye ki ng'at `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindeng'ung' otwogindennyi Musa kogoonok emet tugul ak kobar eng' taing'wong' piik tugul che menyei emoni. Ki kiyai anyun niito amu ki kiaragen miising' agobo saboonwekyok amu okweek.
Ki mi anyun nguno euneguk. Iyaiywech ko uu ye igeere ile myee eng' inyee.”
Ki yachi anyun ko uu nooto, kosar eng' eunegap piigap Israel, ak ma ki par icheek.
Ki yai `Joshua icheek eng' peetuunooto koek che petei kweenik ak koramjin peek tuiyet ak kaptisisyetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' ole leweni ineendet, ak mi ko uu nooto agoi ra.

Kingo kas Adoni-sedek laitoryatap Jerusalem kole ki konam Joshua Ai ak kong'em kogees; ko kogoyachi Ai ak laitoryandennyi ko uu ye kigayachi Jeriko ak laitoryandennyi, ak ko uu ye ki yai kaalyeet piigap Gibeon ak Israel ak komi kwenunnywa.
Ki iywei miising' amu ki nganaseet ne oo Gibeon, ko uu age eng' nganasoogap kaplaitoryat, ak amu ki oo kosiir Ai ak ko ki kiimeen murenik tugul che po nganasanooto.
Ki iyookto anyun Adoni-sedek laitoryatap Jerusalem, ng'olyoo koyookyi Hoam laitoryatap Hebron, Piram laitoryatap Jarmut, Japia laitoryatap Lakish ak Debir laitoryatap Eglon koleenji,
“Otogosu oldanyu obwa otoreta si kibookyin Gibeon, amu ki koyai kaalyeet ak Joshua ak piigap Israel.”

Ki iyumgei anyun laitorinik muutu che po Amorik: laitoryatap Jerusalem, laitoryatap Hebron, laitoryatap Jarmut, laitoryatap Lakish ak laitoryatap Eglon ak kotogosta. Ki togosta icheek ak lugosyekwak tugul ak koteech taitap Gibeon ak kobookyi nganasanooto.

Ki iyookto `piigap Gibeon Joshua eng' nganaseet eng' Gilgal, koleenji, “Amebagaakte otwogiguk; nyoo togosu ichogu ak isarwech! Toretech amu kagoyumjeigei laitorinik tugul che po Amorik che menyei emetap tuloonook.”
Ki togosta anyun Joshua eng' Gilgal ak piik tugul che po lugeet, kobooto murenik tugul che kiimeen che nyigoonen.
Ki leenji `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Joshua, “Meiywei icheek, amu kande icheek euneguk. Ma mi chii eng' icheek ne imuuchi kotonon eng' taing'ung'.”
Kiche anyun Joshua icheek, amu kiga kotogosta eng' Gilgal kemout komugul.
Ki iyeesta `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor icheek eng' taitap Israel ak kobar icheek eng' pareet ne oo eng' Gibeon. Ak koon icheek kobun ooreet ne togostoi Beth-horon ak kobarat kot koit Aseka ak Makeda.

Ye ki mwee eng' taitap Israel, ye kichoortaegei Beth-horon, kowiir `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor icheek eng' koik che eecheen che punu kipsengwet kot koit Aseka, ak ki pek icheek; ki chaang' che ki pek eng' koigap ropta kosiir che ki par piigap Israel eng' rotwetap chok.

Eng' peetuut ne ki igoito Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Amorik kogoochin piigap Israel, koleenji `Joshua Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' taitap piigap Israel, “Ee Asiisi, tonon eng' Gibeon, ee Arawet, telel eng' atebweetap Aijalon.”

Ki tonon asiista ak kosiis arawet, kot koyaaktochigei mugetuut pororyet eng' puunikwak. Tos ma ki sirchi niito bukuitap Jasar? Ki tonon asiista mata kwo eng' kwenutap kipsengwet, ak mata kwo kochaakta kororokto ne tee peetuut komugul.
Kitom kobiitu peetuut ne uu nooto eng' tai amata kobiit eng' let ne ki kas Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kutitap chii. Amu ki yai Kamuktaindet ne Toroor lugeet agobo Israel.
Ki week Joshua anyun kobooto Israel tugul koba nganaseet eng' Gilgal.
Kimwei anyun laitorinichooto muutu ak kounygei eng' kebeneet eng' Makeda.
Ki kimwachi Joshua keleenji, “Kagenyoor laitorinichooto muut kounyegei eng' kebeneet eng' Makeda.”
Kole Joshua, “Omilji koik che eecheen kurgeetap kebeneet ak onde piik yooto koriip.
Amat otebi okweeget, oon puunikwok ak obar che mi let, amat ochamji koba nganasookwak oriit. Amu kagonde Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindeng'wong' icheek eunekwok.”
Kingo kagobar Joshua ak piigap Israel icheek kogees eng' pareet ne oo miising' kot koek tutigin che ki ng'et ak koba nganasook che ng'ootaatiin.
Ki week anyun piik tugul eng' kaalyeet koba nganaseet ole mi Joshua eng' Makeda. Ma piit chii ne kitwek komwa ng'olyoo ne ya agobo piigap Israel.
Komwa Joshua anyun kole, “Oyat kurgeetap kebeneet, ak omutwaa laitorinichooto muut.”
Ki yai ko uu nooto, ak ki imutyi ineendet laitorinichooto muut; laitoryatap Jerusalem, laitoryatap Hebron, laitoryatap Jarmut, laitoryatap Lakish ak laitoryatap Eglon.

Kingo kagomut laitorinichooto kagomutyi Joshua, koguur `Joshua murenik tugul che po Israel ak komwachi pounigap lugeet che kigaba kobooto ineendet koleenji, “Obwa oriigu onde keelyekwok kaatwegap laitorinichu.” Kobwa anyun koriik ak konde keelyekwak kaatwegap pichooto.
Koleenji `Joshua icheek, “Amoiywei anan otoptoben, ogimegitu ak onyiganitu amu yachin ko uu nooto Kamuktaindet ne Toroor puunikwok tugul che obaregei.”
Ye ibata, kokweerot `Joshua icheek ak kobar ak kosonginine keetiik muut. Ki tebee keetiik kosonginindos agoi koimen.
Ye kimachei kororokto asiista, kogoon Joshua ng'atuutyet kechoor eng' keetiik kobwa ng'wony ak kowiirchi kebeneet ole kigaung'egei, ak konde koik che eecheen kurgeetap kebeneet, ne mi agoi ra.

Ki nam `Joshua Makeda peetuunooto, ak ki par kobooto laitoryandennyi eng' rotwetap chok, ak kobar kowong' tugul che ki mi oriit. Ki ma pagaakta agot agenge. Ak ki yachi laitoryatap Makeda ko uu ye kigayachi laitoryatap Jeriko.
Ak kisiirto Joshua eng' Makeda ak Israel tugul koba Libna ak kobookyi olooto.

Ki igoito Kamuktaindet ne Toroor nganasanooto agine kobooto laitoryandennyi konde eunegap Israel. Ki par nganasanooto ak piik tugul che ki mi oriit eng' rotwetap chok. Ki ma pagaakta agot agenge eng' oriit. Ak ki yachi laitoryandennyi ko uu ye kigayachi laitoryatap Jeriko.
Ki pa Joshua ak Israel tugul eng' Libna koba Lakish; ki teech taitap nganasanooto ak kobargei.
Ki inde `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Lakish eunegap Israel ak ki nam eng' peetuut ne po aeng'. Ki par kobooto piik tugul che ki mi oriit eng' rotwetap chok, ko uu tugul che kigayachi Libna.
Kigatogos Horam laitoryatap Gezer koleen kotoret Lakish, ago ki par `Joshua ineendet kobooto piikyik, ak ma pagakyi agot agenge.
Ki isiptogei Joshua eng' Lakish kobooto Israel tugul koba Eglon ak koteech taitap nganasanooto, ak kobargei.
Ki nam eng' peetuunooto ak kobar eng' rotwetap chok piik tugul che ki mi oriit. Ki par kogeskei eng' peetuunooto, ko uu tugul che kigayachi Lakish.
Ki togosta Joshua ak Israel tugul eng' Eglon koba Hebron ak ki par olooto.

Ki nam ak kobar eng' rotwetap chok piik tugul che ki mi oriit kobooto laitoryandennyi ak nganasookyik tugul, ma pagaakta agot agenge. Ko uu tugul che kigayachi Eglon, koging'em kogees kobooto piik tugul che ki mi oriit.
Ki week anyun Joshua kobooto Israel tugul koba Debir ak kobar olooto.

Ak ki nam kobooto laitoryandennyi ak nganasookyik tugul ak kobar eng' rotwetap chok ak piik tugul che ki mi oriit kowong'. Ma pagaakta agot agenge. Ki yachi Debir ak laitoryandennyi ko uu ye kigayachi Hebron kobooto laitoryandennyi, ak ko uu ye kigayachi Libna agine ak laitoryandennyi.

Ki par anyun Joshua emet tugul; emetap tuloonook, komostap murot tai, warenget ak chepkeigeusyek kobooto laitorinikwak tugul. Ma pagaakta kong'et agot agenge. Ki par kogees tugul che ki tinyei kabuuset, ko uu ye ki ng'at Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindetap Israel.
Ki par `Joshua icheek kobooch Kadesh-barnea agoi Gaza ak emet komugul ne po Goshen agoi Gibeon.
Ki nam `Joshua laitorinichooto tugul ak emotinwekwak eng' peetuusyechooto, amu ki yai Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindetap Israel lugeet agobo Israel.
Kiweektagei Joshua kobooto Israel tugul koba nganaseet eng' Gilgal.
Ye kingo kas Jabin laitoryatap Hasor agobo niito, koyookto ng'olyoo kwo kap Jobap laitoryatap Madon, kap laitoryatap Simron, kap laitoryatap Aksap,
ak koyookto kwo kap laitorinik che ki mi murot kaataam ne po emetap tuloonook, ak eng' Arabah murot tai ne po Kinnereth, ak eng' warenget kobooto che ki mi Napoth-dor eng' cherongo.
Ki iyookyi ng'olyoo kora Kanaanik eng' kong'asiis, ak eng' cherongo kobooto Amorik, Hitik, Perisik, Jebusik eng' emetap tuloonook ak Hibik eng' Hermon keel eng' emetap Mispa.
Ki pwa komong' anyun icheeget ak lugosyekwak tugul. King'iisyat icheek kobooto paraisisyekwak ak kariisyek ko uu ng'aniek che mi ngeguutap nyanjet eng' chaang'indo.
Ki tuiyo laitorinichuuto tugul ak kobwa koteech komosta agenge eng' ye neegitee peegap Merom si kobargei ak Israel.
Ki leenji `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Joshua, “Meiywei icheek, amu mutai ko tee ni asiis agoitoi icheek tugul kebar eng' taitap Israel. Iebe kwarinigap paraisisyekwak ak ibeel kariisyekwak eng' maat.”
Konyo anyun `Joshua kobooto piikyik tugul che po lugeet eng' ye neegitee peegap Merom ak kobookyi icheek.

Ak ki inde `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor icheek eunegap Israel, si kobar ak koon kot koit Sidon ne oo ak Misrepot-maim agoi atebweetap Mispe ole tokyingei kong'asiis. Ki par icheek kowong' kot koma ng'et agot agenge.
Ki yachi `Joshua icheek ko uu ye ki ng'at Kamuktaindet ne Toroor. Ki ep kwarinigap paraisisyekwak yeityo kobeel kariisyekwak eng' maat.
Ki week `Joshua eng' ak konam Hasor ak kobar laitoryandennyi eng' rotwetap chok. Ki ne oo Hasor eng' tai eng' laitornatosyechooto tugul.
Ki par piik tugul che ki mi nganasanooto eng' rotwetap chok kobar kogees; ma ng'et agot agenge, ak kobeel Hasor eng' maat.
Ki nam Joshua nganasook tugul che po laitorinichooto ak laitorinikwak tugul; ak kobar kooges icheek eng' rotwetap chok ko uu ye ki kang'at `Musa otwogindetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ago ki ma peel `Israel nganasook che kitonondos eng' tuloonookwak kobatee Hasor kityo ne ki peel Joshua.
Ki ip Israel tuguuk tugul che po nganasochuuto ak kokweri tuuga koek chechwaak. Ki par chii age tugul eng' rotwetap chok, kot kogees icheek, ama pagaakta agot agenge kota ko sabei.

Ko uu ye ki kang'at `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Musa otwogindennyi, koging'at `Musa Joshua ko uu nooto, ak ki yai `Joshua ko uu nooto. Ma pagaakta kiy age tugul ne ma yai eng' tuguuk tugul che ki ng'at `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Musa.
Ki nam anyun Joshua emet komugul: emetap tuloonook, Murot tugul ne po Tai, emet tugul ne po Goshen, warenget, Arabah, emetap tuloonook ne po Israel ak warengetap emonooto.
Ki nam kora kobooch tulweetap Halak ne tokyingei Seir agoi Baal-gad eng' atebweetap Lebanon eng' Hermon keel. Ki nam laitorinikwak tugul, ak kokweerot kobar.
Ki yai Joshua lugeet eng' peetuusyek che chaang' kobooto laitorinichooto.
Ma piit nganaseet agot agenge ne ki yai kaalyeet ak piigap Israel kobatee Hibik che ki menyei Gibeon. Ki nam chooto tugul eng' pooryeet.

Ki ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne ki iuit mugulelwekwak si kobargei ak Israel eng' lugeet, si kong'em icheek kogees, ak ma kiriree icheek, ago si kobiit kong'em icheek kogees ko uu ye ki kang'at `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Musa.

Ki nyo Joshua eng' peetuusyechooto kobar Anagik kowong' eng' emetap tuloonook, ak eng' emotinwegap Hebron, Debir, Anap, eng' emet tugul ne po tuloonoogap Judah ak eng' emet tugul ne po tuloonoogap Israel. Ki par `Joshua icheek kogeskei kobooto nganasookwak.
Ma ng'et agot agenge Anagichooto eng' emetap piigap Israel; kobatee king'etune Gaza, Gath ak Ashdod kityo.

Ki nam anyun Joshua emet komugul, ko uu tugul che ki kamwachi `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Musa. Ki igoochi `Joshua emonooto Israel koek porotennywa ko uu pcheutigap pororyosyekwak. Ki imuuny anyun emet eng' pooryeet.

Chu ko laitorinigap emonooto che ki par `piigap Israel ak konam emennywa kobunji; eng' Jordan pitoniin ole tokyingei kong'asiis, kobooch atebweetap Arnon kot koit tulweetap Hermon kobooto Arabah tugul ne tokyingei kong'asiis:

Sihon laitoryatap Amorik ne ki menyei Hesbon, ak ki pou Aroer ne mi tabandap atebweetap Arnon, ak kobooch kwenutap atebweet kot koit aineetap Jabbok, ne kiwotetap lagogap Ammon, ni ko kebebertap Gilead.

Ki pou kora Arabah agoi nyanjetap Kinnereth kong'asiis kot koit nyanjetap Arabah ne nooto Araraitap Munyuk, ne tokyingei kong'asiis ooreet ne wendi Beth-Jesimoth ak eng' murot tai eng' chepkeigeusyegap Piska keel,
ak Laitoryat Og ne po Bashan, ne po che ki ng'etune Repaik, che ki menyei Astarot ak Edrei.
Ki pounisyei ineendet eng' tulweetap Hermon, Saleka ak Bashan komugul kot koit kiwotetap Gesurik, Maakatik ak kebeberta ne po Gilead kiwotetap Sihon laitoryatap Hesbon.

Ki par `Musa otwogindetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ak `piigap Israel icheek. Ak kogoochi `Musa otwogindetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor emonooto piigap Reuben ak che po Gad ak kebebertap pororyetap Manasseh kobunji.

Chuuto laitorinigap emonooto che ki par `Joshua ak piigap Israel eng' Jordan pitoniin ole tokyingei cherongo, kobooch Baal-gad eng' atebweetap Lebanon kot koit tulweetap Halak, ne togostoi agoi Seir (ak ki igoochi `Joshua emonooto pororyosyegap Israel kobunji ko uu pcheutikwak:
emetap tuloonook, warenget, Arabah, chepkeigeusyek, surkwen, murot tai, Hitik, Amorik, Kanaanik, Perisik, Hibik ak Jebusik):
laitoryatap Jeriko agenge, laitoryatap Ai, ne neegitee Bethel agenge;
laitoryatap Jerusalem agenge, laitoryatap Hebron agenge;
laitoryatap Jarmut agenge, laitoryatap Lakish agenge;
laitoryatap Eglon agenge, laitoryatap Gezer agenge;
laitoryatap Debir agenge, laitoryatap Geder agenge;
laitoryatap Horma agenge, laitoryatap Arad agenge;
laitoryatap Libna agenge, laitoryatap Adulam agenge;
laitoryatap Makeda agenge, laitoryatap Bethel agenge;
laitoryatap Tappuah agenge, laitoryatap Hepher agenge;
laitoryatap Apek agenge, laitoryatap Lasaron agenge;
laitoryatap Madon agenge, laitoryatap Hasor agenge;
laitoryatap Simron-meron agenge, laitoryatap Aksap agenge;
laitoryatap Taanak agenge, laitoryatap Megiddo agenge;
laitoryatap Kedesh agenge, laitoryatap Jokneam eng' Karmel agenge;
laitoryatap Dor ne ki mi Dor parak agenge, laitoryatap Goim eng' Gilgal agenge,
ak laitoryatap Tirzah agenge. Ki ek laitorinichooto tugul sosom ak agenge.
Kiga koosit Joshua amu kiga kotar kenyiisyek che chaang'. Ak ki mwachi `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor koleenji, “Kaiositu ak itinye kenyiisyek che chaang', ago ta kong'etunot emet ne oo ne nyolu kenam.
Ni emet ne ta ko ng'etunot: komoswek tugul che po Philistiik ak che po Gesurik,

kiityin keele po `Kanaanik koroniito kobooch Sihor ne mi murot tai ne po Misiri, kot koit kiwotetap Ekron eng' murot kaataam. Ki po kiptainik muut che po Philistiik: Gasaik, Asdodik, Askelonik, Gitik, Ekronik ak Abik,
eng' murot tai, emet tugul ne po Kanaanik, Meara ne po Sidonik, kot koit Apek, agoi kiwotetap Amorik,
ak emetap Gebalik, Lebanon tugul, ne tokyingei ole charunee asiista, kobooch Baal-gad eng' tulweetap Hermon keel kot koit ole kimandoe kebendi Lebo-hamath.

Piik tugul che menyei emetap tuloonook kong'etee Lebanon kot koit Misrepotmaim agot Sidonik tugul, aoone icheek koba eng' taitap piigap Israel. Ago igoochi emoni Israel koek porotennywa ko uu ye ki ang'atiin.
Pchechi anyun pororyosyechuuto sogool ak kebebertap eng' che po Manasseh.”
Ki sich porotennywa piigap Reuben ak che po Gad kobooto ne kigaigoochi Musa eng' Jordan pitoniin tokyingei kong'asiis, ko uu ye ki igoochi `icheek Musa otwogindetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor:
kobooch Aroer, ne mi tabandap atebweetap Arnon, ak nganaseet ne mi kwenutap atebwonooto ak warenget tugul ne po Medeba agoi Dibon,
nganasook tugul che po Sihon laitoryatap Amorik, ne ki laitorani eng' Hesbon, agoi kiwotetap lagogap Ammon,
Gilead ak kiwotetap Gesurik ak Maakatik ak tulweet tugul ne po Hermon ak Bashan tugul agoi Saleka,
laitornatet tugul ne po Og eng' Bashan, ne ki laitorani eng' Astarot ak Edrei (ineendet ko agenge eng' Repaik che ki ng'et); kiga kobar chuuto `Musa ak koon.
Ago maon piigap Israel Gesurik anan ko Maakatik. Ki meny Gesurik ak Maakatik kwenutap Israel agoi ra.
Pororyetap Lawiik kityo ne ma igoochi poroteet, amu porotennywa kagoochinoigap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindetap Israel, che kigoitoi kobun maat ko uu ye ki mwachi ineendet.
Ki igoochi `Musa pororyetap lagogap Reuben ko uu ortinwekwak.
Ki pooch kiwotennywa Aroer ne mi tabandap atebweetap Arnon ak nganaseet ne mi kwenutap atebweet kobooto warenget tugul ne neegitee Medeba
ak Hesbon ak nganasookyik tugul che mi warenget; Dibon ak Bamotbaal ak Beth-baal-meon,
ak Jahas, Kedemot, Mepaat,
Kiriataim, Sibma ak Seret-sahar eng' tulweetap atebweet,
Beth-peor, chepkeigeusyegap Piska ak Beth-Jesimoth;

Nganasook tugul che po warenget, laitornatet tugul ne po Sihon laitoryatap Amorik, ne ki laitorani eng' Hesbon ne ki par `Musa kobooto kirwoogigap Midian ak Ebi, Rekem, Sur, Hur ak Reba pounigap Sihon che ki menyei emonooto.
Ki par `piigap Israel Balaam agine weeriitap Beor orgoiyot eng' rotwetap chok.
Kiwotetap lagogap Reuben ko ki Jordan ak tabandanyi. Niito poroteetap lagogap Reuben ko uu ortinwekwak, nganasookwak che eecheen ak che mengeechen.
Ki igoochi `Musa pororyetap Gad, ko uu ortinwekwak.
Kiwotennywa ko ki Jaser, nganasook tugul che po Gilead ak kebebertap emetap lagogap Ammon, agoi Aroer ne mi taitap Rabbah,
kobooch Hesbon kot koit Ramat-mispe ak Betonim. Kobooch Mahanaim kot koit kiwotetap Debir,

ak eng' atebweet, Beth-aram, Beth-nimra ak Sukoth kobooto Sapon nooto ne ki ng'et eng' laitornatetap Sihon laitoryatap Hesbon ne ki Jordan kiwotennyi kot koit ole pooch tabandap araraita ne po Kineret Jordan pitoniin ole tokyingei kong'asiis.
Niito ko poroteetap lagogap Gad ko uu ortinwekwak, nganasookwak che eecheen ak che mengeechen.
Ki igoochi `Musa kebebertap pororyetap Manasseh poroteet. Ki punji icheek kebebertap pororyetap Manasseh ko uu ortinwekwak.
Kiboch kiwotennywa Mahanaim, Bashan tugul, laitornatet tugul ne po Og laitoryatap Bashan ak nganasook tugul che po Jair che mi Bashan, nganasook che eecheen tamanwogik lo.
Kibooto kebebertap Gilead, Astarot, Edrei, nganasook che eecheen che po laitornatetap Og eng' Bashan. Ki punji chuuto lagogap Makir weeriitap Manasseh kebebertap lagogap Makir ko uu ortinwekwak.
Chuuto ko porotosyek che kipchei `Musa eng' warengosyegap Moab Jordan pitoniin eng' Jeriko ne tokyingei kong'asiis.
Ago ma igoochi `Musa pororyetap Lawiik poroteet age tugul. Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindetap Israel, ko porotennywa ko uu ye ki kamwachi icheek.
Chu ko porotosyek che kinyoor piigap Israel eng' emetap Kanaan che kipchechi icheek `Eleazar tisiindet, ak Joshua weeriitap Nun kobooto kandoigap kooriik che po pororyosyegap piigap Israel.
Ki pchei kosube parbareegap porotennywa ko uu ye ki ng'at `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Musa agobo pororyosyechooto sogool ak kebeberyat.
Kiga kogoochi `Musa poroteet pororyosyechooto aeng' ak kebeberyat eng' Jordan pitoniin. Ma igoochi `Lawiik poroteet age tugul eng' kwenunnywa.
Ki pororyosyek aeng' lagogap Joseph, chooto ko ki Manasseh ak Ephraim. Ma kigoochi Lawiik kebeberta eng' emonooto kobatee nganasook che ki meny kobooto korotinwek che agete kiyaagikwak.
Kipchei emet piigap Israel ko uu ye ki kang'at `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Musa.

Ki riikta piigap Judah ole ki mi Joshua eng' Gilgal. Ki mwachi `Kaleb weeriitap Jepune Kenisindet ineendet koleenji, “Ingen kiit ne ki mwa `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor komwachi Musa chiitap Kamuktaindet agobo anee ak inyee eng' Kadesh-barnea.
Ki abo kenyiisyek artam ye ki iyookwo `Musa otwogindetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' Kadesh-barnea anyo asegei emet. Ki aipchi ineendet ng'olyoot ko uu ye ki mi muguleldanyu.
Ki igoochi tupchosyekyuk che ki kitogostoi tugul mugulelwegap piik komeiyo, ago ki asup Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindennyu eng' kagesunatetapkei.
Ki iyasyo anyun Musa peetuunooto kole, ‘Egu poroteng'ung' ak ko punjin inyee ak lagoguk koigeny emet ne ka tyech keelyeguk amu ki isup Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindennyu eng' kagesunatetapkei.’

Ko uu nooto anyun, ko ki koriibo Kamuktaindet ne Toroor asap ko uu ye ki mwa. Kenyiisyek artam ak muut kobooch peetuut ne ki mwachi `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Musa ng'olyoondoni, ye kingo ta kobendoti Israel eng' surkwen ak ang'ni nguno atinye kenyiisyek tamanwogik sisiit ak muut!
Ta atinye kimnateet rani ko uu eng' atkinye koyooktaa Musa. Kiit ne ki uu kimnateennyu eng' peetuunooto, ko uu nooto kimnateennyu nguno, ta amuuchi awo lugeet ak aweege.

Ara anyun, konoo tulwooni ki kamwa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' peetuunooto. Ki igas eng' peetuunooto ile ki mi Anagik olooto ak nganasook che eecheen che ng'ootaatiin. Imuuch komi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kobooto, si aoon koba ko uu ye ki mwa ineendet.”
Ki iberuur `Joshua ineendet ak kogoochi Kaleb weeriitap Jepune Hebron koek porotennyi.
Ki ek anyun `Hebron poroteetap Kaleb weeriitap Jepune Kenisindet agoi ra, amu ki isup Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindetap Israel eng' kagesunatetapkei.
Kainetap Hebron eng' tai ko ki Kiriath-arba. Ki chiito ne oo Arba kosiir tugul eng' Anagik. Ki imuuny emet eng' lugeet.
Kebeberta ne ki ibutyi pororyetap lagogap Judah, ko uu ortinwekwak, ko kiwootetap Edom agoi surkwen ne po Sin ne tokyingei tabanda ne po murot tai.
Kibochit kiwotennywa ne po murot tai tabandap Araraitap Munyuk, kot koit nyanjet ne kiluktogei kotokyigei murot tai.
Wendi kotokyigei murot tai ne po Akrabbim ak kosiirto kot koit Sin, ak kotogosta kwo murot tai ne po Kadesh-barnea, ak kosiirto agoi koit Hesron, ak kotogosta kwo Adar, ak koweek kora konyo Karka.
Ki siirto kwo Asmon ak kwo komandae aineetap Misiri ak kwo kiwotonooto agoi nyanjetap Mediterenian. Egu nooto kiwoteng'wong' ne po murot tai.
Kiwotet eng' kong'asiis ko ki itei Araraitap Munyuk agoi Jordan. Kiwotetap kebeberta ne po murot kaataam, kotaune tabandap nyanjet ye mang'une Jordan;
ak kwo kiwoteet kot koit Beth-hogla ak kosiirto kobun murot kaataam ne po Beth-araba, ak kwo kot koit Koita ne po Boan weeriitap Reuben.

Kong'eetee yooto, kwo kiwoteet kot koit Debir kobunu atebweetap Akor ak kotokyigei murot kaataam kwo Gilgal, kotoorchigei ole kitogostoe kebendi Adumim, ne mi murot tai ne po aineet. Kong'eetee yooto, kosiirto kiwoteet kot koit peegap En-semes, ak kwo agoi En-rogelo.

Kwo kotestai kiwoteet agoi atebweetap weeriitap Hinom, eng' tabandap Jebusindet murot tai, ne nooto ko Jerusalem ak kwo agoi tulweet parak ne ikweeni atebweetap Hinom eng' cherongo, murot kaataam ne po atebweetap Repaik.
Kong'eetee tulweet parak, kowegaak kiwoteet kot koit kondap peegap Neptoa ak kwo agoi nganasoogap tulweetap Epron, yeityo kowegaak kiwoteet kotokyigei Baala, ne nooto ko Kiriath-Jearim.

Kong'eete Baala kotokyigei kiwotet cherongo agoi tulweetap Seir ak kosiirto kwo tabandap tulweetap Jearim eng' murot kaataam, ne nooto ko Kesalon ak kotokyigei Beth-shemesh, yeityo kosiirto kwo agoi Timnah.

Ki manda kiwoteet kora ak kwo tabandap Ekron murot kaataam, yeityo kowegaak kiwoteet agoi Sikeron, ak kosiirto agoi tulweetap Baala. Yeityo kwo komanda agoi Jabneel ak kwo kiwoteet agoi komong'ji nyanjetap Mediterenian.
Kiwotet ne po cherongo, ko kitabaandap nyanjetap Mediterenian.
Ko uu ye ki ng'at `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Joshua, ko ki kigoochi Kaleb weeriitap Jepune kebeberyan eng' kwenutap lagogap Judah nooto ko Kiriath-arba nooto ko Hebron. (Arba ko ki kwandap Anak.)
Ki oon Kaleb eng' olooto weeriik somok che po Anak: Sheshai, Ahiman ak Talmai, lagogap Anak.
Kong'eetee yooto kotogosta kwo kobargei ak che ki menyei Debir. Kainetap Debir eng' tai ko ki Kiriath-sepher.
Ki mwa Kaleb kole, “Ineendet ne ibookyin Kiriath-sepher ak konam, agoochini Achsah cheptonyu kotun.”
Ki nam Othniel weeriitap Kenas ng'eetap kametap Kaleb nganasanooto, ak ki igoochi ineendet Achsah cheptonyi kotun.
Kingo nyo kwonyooto ole mi ineendet, komwachi Othniel eng' kagiiletapkei kosoom kwandanyi kooret. Ye ki choorugei eng' sigiryennyi koteebe Kaleb koleenji, “Imache nee?”
Kowol kole, “Koono konunotyon, amu ki indea emetap Negeb, koono kong'igap peek ak icheek.” Ki igoochi anyun kong'igap peek che po meto ak che mi ole rektoot.
Ni ko poroteetap pororyetap Judah ko uu ortinwekwak.
Nganasook che mi tabandap pororyetap Judah eng' ole tokyingei kiwotetap Edom eng' murot tai: ko ki Kabseel, Eder ak Jagur.
Kina, Dimona ak Adada,
Kedesh, Hasor ak Itnan,
Ziph, Telem ak Bealoth,
Hasor-hadata, Keryot-hesron (nooto ko Hasor),
Amam, Shema ak Molada,
Hasar-gada, Hesmon ak Beth-pelet,
Hasar-sual, Beer-sheba ak Bisiotia,
Bala, Iim ak Esem,
Eltolad, Chesil ak Horma,
Ziklag, Madmana ak Sansana,
Lebaot, Silim, Ain ak Rimon. Nganasochooto tugul ko ki tiptem ak sogool kobooto kokwatinwekwak.
Eng' warenget, Estaol, Sora ak Asna,
Sanoa, En-ganim, Tappuah ak Enam,
Jarmut, Adulam, Soko ak Aseka,
Saaraim, Aditaim, Gedera ak Gederotaim. Ki nganasook taman ak ang'wan kobooto kokwotinwekwak.
Senan, Hadasa ak Migdalgad,
Dilan, Mispe ak Jokteel,
Lakish, Boskat ak Eglon,
Kabon, Lamam ak Kitlis,
Gederoth, Beth-dagon, Naamah ak Makeda. Tugul ko nganasook taman ak lo kobooto kokwotinwekwak.
Libna, Eter ak Asan,
Ipta, Asna ak Nesip,
Keila, Aksip ak Maresha. Tugul ko nganasook sogool kobooto kokwotinwekwak.
Ki kigoochi Ekron kobooto nganasookyik ak kokwotinwekyik;
kobooch Ekron agoi nyanjet, tugul che ki mi ole neegitee Ashdod kobooto kokwotinwekwak.
Ashdod, nganasookyik ak kokwotinwekyik, Gaza, nganasookyik ak kokwotinwekyik agoi aineetap Misiri, ak nyanjetap Mediterenian ak kiwotennyi.
Ak eng' emet ne mi tuloonook: Samir, Jatir ak Soko,
Dana ak Kiriath-sana, nooto ko Debir,
Anap, Estemo ak Anim,
Goshen, Holon ak Gilo; nganasook taman ak agenge kobooto kokwotinwekwak.
Arab, Duma ak Esan,
Janim, Beth-tapua ak Apeka,
Humta, Kiriath-arba nooto ko Hebron ak Sior; nganasook sogool ak kokwotinwekwak.
Maon, Karmel, Ziph, Juta,
Jezreel, Jokdeam, Sanoa,
Kain, Gibea ak Timnah; nganasook taman kobooto kokwotinwekwak.
Halul, Beth-zur, Geder.
Maarat, Beth-anot ak Eltekon; nganasook lo tugul kobooto kokwotinwekwak.
Kiriath-baal nooto ko Kiriath-Jearim, ak Rabbah; nganasook aeng' kobooto kokwotinwekwak.
Eng' surkwen: Beth-araba, Midin, Sekaka,
Nibsan, Nganaseetap Munyuk ak En-gedi; nganasook lo kobooto kokwotinwekwak.
Ki ma imuuch piigap Judah koon Jebusik che ki menyei Jerusalem; ara ki meny Jebusik ak piigap Judah eng' Jerusalem agoi ra.
Kebeberta ne ki ibutyi eng' parbaryat lagogap Joseph kotaune Jordan eng' Jeriko eng' kong'asiis agoi surkwen, ak kotogosta eng' Jeriko kobun emetap tuloonook kwo Bethel.
Ki wo komanda eng' Bethel kwo komong'ji Luz ak kosiirto kot koit kooretap Arikik eng' Ataroth.
Ak kwo kochoortagei kotokyigei cherongo agoi kooretap Japhletik, kot koit kooretap ole rektoot ne po Beth-horon ak kotokyigei Gezer ak komong'ji nyanjetap Mediterenian.
Ki nam anyun lagogap Joseph, chooto Manasseh ak Ephraim porotennywa.
Kooretap lagogap Ephraim ko uu ortinwekwak ko uu ni; kiwotetap koorennywa kong'etee kong'asiis ne po Ataroth-addar kot koit Beth-horon parak,
ak kwo kiwoteet kot koit araraitap Mediterenian. Eng' murot kaataam kowendi kiwoteet kong'etee Mikmethath agoi kong'asiis ne po Taanath-shiloh kosiirto kotogosta agoi kong'asiis ne po Janoah.
Kong'eete Janoah kochoortagei kwo Ataroth ak Naarah koit Jeriko ak kwo kot komong'ji Jordan.
Eng' cherongo, kogiwo kiwoteet kong'etee Tappuah kot koit aineetap Kanah ak komong'ji nyanjetap Mediterenian. Niito anyun ko poroteetap pororyetap lagogap Ephraim ko uu ortinwekwak,
kobooto nganasook tugul ak kokwotinwekwak che ki kitabaanji Ephraim ak lagokyik eng' kwenutap poroteetap lagogap Manasseh.
Ago ma imuuch `icheek ko oon Kanaanik che ki menyei Gezer. Ki meny anyun Kanaanik kwenutap Ephraim agoi rani ak ki ek otwogik che yaei poisyonigap otwoknateet.

Ni ko kebeberta ne ki ibutyi eng' parbaryat pororyetap Manasseh; amu kitaita ne po Joseph. Ko uu Makir, ne kitaita ne po Manasseh, kwandap Gilead, ko amu kichii ne po lugeet, ko ki kigoochi ineendet Gilead ak Bashan.

Ki punji lagogap Manasseh che ki ng'et, ko uu ortinwekwak, chooto lagogap Abiezer, lagogap Helek, lagogap Asriel, lagogap Shekem, lagogap Hepher ak lagogap Shemida. Chooto murenik che po iyoteetap Manasseh weeriitap Joseph, ko uu ortinwekwak.
Kimasich weeriik Zelophehad weeriitap Hepher, weeriitap Gilead weeriitap Makir weeriitap Manasseh, ago tiibiik icheegei; ak chu kainaigap tiibiikyik: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milkah ak Tirzah.

Ki pwa icheek tait ne po Eleazar tisiindet, Joshua weeriitap Nun ak pounik, koleen, “Ki ng'at `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Musa kogoonech poroteet eng' kwenutap tupchosyekyok.” Ara ko uu ng'atuutyetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ko ki igoochi `Joshua icheek poroteet eng' kwenutap tupchosyegap kwandanywa.
Ki sich Manasseh kebeberwek taman koma pooto emetap Gilead ak Bashan, ne mi Jordan pitoniin,
amu ki tinyei tiibiigap Manasseh poroteet kobooto weeriikyik. Ak ki punji emetap Gilead weeriigap Manasseh che ki ng'et.
Kiwotetap Manasseh kong'etee Asher kot koit Mikmethath, ne neegitee Shekem. Ki testai kiwoteet kwo komostap tai, kotokyigei ole menyei piigap En-tapua.
Ki po Manasseh emetap Tappuah, ago Tappuah ne mi kiwotetap Manasseh ko ki po lagogap Ephraim.

Kichoortage kiwoteet kwo aineetap Kanah. Nganasochooto mi komostap tai kobunjiin Ephraim koek che kaginemu eng' nganasoogap Manasseh. Kiwotetap Manasseh komi komostap kaataam ne po aineet ak kwo komong'ji nyanjetap Mediterenian.
Po Ephraim ne mi komostap tai, ak ne mi komostap kaataam ko po Manasseh, kobooto nyanjetap Mediterenian koek kiwotennyi. Ki it Asher eng' murot kaataam agoi Issakar eng' kong'asiis.

Eng' Issakar ak eng' Asher, ko ki tinyei Manasseh chu; Beth-shean ak nganasookyik, Ibleam kobooto nganasookyik, che ki menyei Dor ak nganasookyik ak che ki menyei Endor kobooto nganasookyik. Ki tinyei kora che ki menyei Taanak kobooto nganasookyik, che ki menyei Megiddo kobooto nganasookyik ak kebeberta agenge eng' somok ne po Nabat.
Ago ki ma imuuch lagogap Manasseh koon piik che ki menyei nganasochooto. Amu kigamach Kanaanik komeng'iis eng' emonooto,
ko ye kiga kogimegitu piigap Israel, konde Kanaanik koyai poisyonigap otwoknateet ama oon icheek.
Ki ng'alaalji `lagogap Joseph Joshua koleenji, “Amu nee si igoono parbaryat agenge, kebeberta agenge koek poroteet ak ingen ile aa pororyet ne oo amu ki koberuura Kamuktaindet ne Toroor agoi rani?”
Ak ki leenji Joshua icheek, “Ngot ko ii pororyet ne oo, itogoste iwe timiin ak ibatyigei oldo eng' emetap Perisik ak ne po Repaik, amu mariich emetap tuloonook ne po Ephraim eng' inyee.”

Ki mwa `lagogap Joseph kole, “Mayamech emetap tuloonook ak kotinyei kariisyegap kariik Kanaanik tugul che menyei emetap atebweet, icheek che mi Beth-shean ak nganasookyik ak icheek che menyei atebweetap Jezreel.”
Ki ng'alaalji `Joshua kootap Joseph che Ephraim ak Manasseh koleenji, “Ii pororyet ne oo ak itinye kimnateet, mesiche parbaryat agenge kityo,
ago punjinin emetap tuloonook, amu nganda timdo, iswache ak punjinin ole pooch. Amu ioone Kanaanik koba, nganda tinyei kariisyegap kariik ak nganda kiimeen.”
Ki iyumgei tuiyet tugul ne po piigap Israel eng' Shiloh ak koteech eng' olooto emait ne kituiyechin. Ki iterteerat anyun emonooto eng' tainnywa.
Ki ng'et eng' piigap Israel pororyosyek tisabu che kitom kopchei porotennywa.
Ara anyun ki leenji `Joshua piigap Israel, “Ogaigei kot kotyanit si onam emet ne ki koonok Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindetap kwanisyekwok?
Olewenjigei piik somok eng' pororyet age tugul, si ayookto icheek kong'eetyo kobendat eng' emet asi kosiir ole teptoi porotennywa yeityo kobwa ole ami.
Ngo pchei koek kebeberwek tisap, ko katebee Judah kiwotennyi eng' murot tai ak ko katebee Joseph kiwotennywa eng' murot kaataam.
Osir emonooto koek kebeberwek tisap yeityo oibwa siranooto, si aserchinewok parbareek eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindennyo.

Amu ma tinyei Lawiik kebeberta eng' kwenung'wong', amu tiseinatetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ko porotennywa, ak kigosich Gad ak Reuben ak kebebertap pororyetap Manasseh porotennywa, eng' Jordan pitoniin po kong'asiis, ne ki igoochi `Musa otwogindetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.”

Ara anyun king'eetyo piik ak koba; ak ki iyomis `Joshua piik che kigaba kosiir oleteptoi emet koleenji, “Oba obun emet ak osir oleteptoi yeityo obwa kogeny ole ami, si aserchinewok parbareek eng' yu eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' Shiloh.”
Ki pa anyun pichooto kobun emet ak kosirchi bukuit kobee nganasook koek kebeberwek tisap yeityo kobwa ole mi Joshua eng' nganaseet eng' Shiloh.
Ak ki iser `Joshua parbareek agobo icheek eng' Shiloh eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor; Ak kipchechi `Joshua emet piigap Israel ko uu pcheutikwak eng' olooto.
Ki piit kuraitap pororyetap lagogap Benjamin ko uu ortinwekwak. Ak ki wo kiwotetap parbaryannywa, kwenutap lagogap Judah ak lagogap Joseph.

King'eete kiwotennywa ne po komostap kaataam Jordan ak kitogosta kiwotennywa kobun tabandap Jeriko eng' murot kaataam ak kotogosta kobun emetap tuloonook kotokyigei cherongo. Kimong'ji kiwotennywa surkwen ne po Beth-aben.

Ki wo kiwoteet eng' olooto agoi Luz, agoi tabandap Luz (nooto ko Bethel), kotokyingei murot tai yeityo kochoortagei kiwoteet kot koit Ataroth-addar, kobun tulweet ne mi komostap tai ne po Beth-horon ne mi ole rektoot.

Yeityo keetil kiwoteet keyiem komostap cherongo ole tokyingei murot tai kong'etee tulweet ne mi taitap Beth-horon ne tokyingei murot tai komong'ji kiwotennyi Kiriath-baal (nooto ko Kiriath-Jearim) nganaseetap lagogap Judah: niito ko ki komostap cherongo.
King'eete murot tai tabandap Kiriath-Jearim, ak kwo kiwoteet kotokyigei cherongo komong'ji kondap peegap Neptoa.

Yeityo kochoortagei kiwoteet agoi tabandap tulweet ne mi taitap atebweetap weeriitap Hinom, ne mi atebweetap Repaik ne tokyingei murot kaataam. Ki choortagei kwo atebweetap Hinom, kot koit tabandap Jebusindet ne tokyingei murot tai ak kochoortagei kwo En-rogelo.
Yeityo kiwech kobun murot kaataam, komong'ji En-semes, kwo Gelilot, ne tokyindos ak ole kitogostoe kebendi Adumim ak kochoortagei agoi koitap Boan weeriitap Reuben,
ak kosiirto kobun tabanda ne tokyingei Arabah murot kaataam ak kochoortagei kot koit Arabah.

Yeityo kwo kiwoteet kobun tabandap Beth-hogla kotokyigei murot kaataam ak komong'ji ole kiluktoegei peek murot kaataam ne po Araraita ne po Munyuk eng' murot tai ye pooch Jordan: niito ko ki kiwootet ne po murot tai.
Ki Jordan kiwotennyi eng' komostap kong'asiis. Niito ko ki poroteetap lagogap Benjamin ko uu kiwotosyekyik che ki imut komoswek tugul ko uu ortinwekwak.
Nganasoogap pororyetap lagogap Benjamin ko uu ortinwekwak ko ki Jeriko, Beth-hogla, ak Emek-kesis;
Beth-araba, Semaraim ak Bethel;
Abim, Para ak Ophrah;
Keparamoni, Opni ak Geba; nganasook taman ak aeng' kobooto kokwotinwekwak.
Gibeon, Ramah ak Beerot,
Mispe, Kepira ak Motsa,
Rekem, Irpeel ak Tarala;
Shelah, Elep ak Jebusindet (nooto ko Jerusalem), Gibeat ak Kiryat. Nganasook taman ak ang'wan kobooto kokwotinwekwak. Niito ko poroteetap lagogap Benjamin ko uu ortinwekwak.
Ki mong' parparyatap aeng' kobutyi pororyetap lagogap Simion ko uu ortinwekwak. Ki imii porotennywa kwenutap poroteetap lagogap Judah.
Kigebeberta ne po porotennywa Beer-sheba, Sheba, Molada,
Hasarsual, Bala, Esem,
Eltolat, Betul, Horma,
Ziklag, Beth-markabot, Hasar-susa,
Beth-lebaot ak Saruen. Tugul kogi nganasook taman ak somok kobooto kokwotinwekwak.
Ain, Rimon, Eter ak Asan, nganasook ang'wan kobooto kokwotinwek,
ak kokwotinwek tugul che ki yiem nganasochuuto agoi Balat-Beer, Ramah ne po murot tai. Ki poroteet ne po pororyetap lagogap Simion ko uu ortinwekwak.
Ki pun poroteetap lagogap Simion kebeberta ne po lagogap Judah; ki amu ki oo kebeberta ne po Judah kosiir, ko ki sich anyun lagogap Simion poroteet eng' kwenutap porotennywa.
Ki mong' parparyatap somok kobutyi lagogap Zebulun ko uu ortinwekwak. Kiwotetap porotennywa kogiwo agoi Sarid,
ak kotogosta kotokyigei cherongo kot koit Marala ak kotiny Dabeset, yeityo kwo agoi kotiny aineet ne mi taitap Jokneam.
Kong'eetee Sarid, koweek kotokyigei kong'asiis ak kwo kot koit kiwotetap Kislot-tabor. Kimong'ji Daberat ak kotogosta kwo Japia.
Kisiirto kong'etee yooto kotokyigei kong'asiis kwo Get-eper agoi Et-kasin, ak ki wo kot koit Rimon ak komurok kotokyigei Nea.
Kiyiemak kiwoteet eng' murot kaataam kwo Hannathon ak kobekyi atebweetap Ipta-el,
Katat, Naalal, Simron, Idala ak Bethlehem; nganasook taman ak aeng' kobooto kokwotinwekwak.
Ni ko poroteetap lagogap Zebulun ko uu ortinwekwak; nganasochu kobooto kokwotinwekwak.
Ki mong' parparyatap ang'wan ne po lagogap Issakar ko uu ortinwekwak.
Ki it kiwotennywa Jezreel, Kesulot, Sunem,
Aparaim, Shion, Anaarat,
Rabit, Kision, Ebes,
Remet, En-ganim, En-hada agoi Beth-pases.
Kitiiny kora kiwoteet Tabor, Saasuma ak Beth-shemesh, ak komong'ji Jordan; nganasook taman ak lo kobooto kokwotinwekwak.
Ni ko poroteet ne po pororyetap lagogap Issakar ko uu ortinwekwak; kokwatinwek kobooto nganasookwak che mengeechen.
Ki mong' paraparyatap muut kobutyi pororyetap lagogap Asher ko uu ortinwekwak.
Ki kiwotennywa Helkat, Ali, Beten, Aksap,
Alamelek, Amad ak Misal ak eng' cherongo ko tiiny Karmel ak Sihor-libnat.

Kong'eetee yooto koweek kotokyigei kong'asiis ak kwo agoi Beth-dagon, ak ko tiiny Zebulun, atebweetap Ipta-el ak kotokyigei murot kaataam kwo Beth-emek ak Neiel, yetyo komong'ji Kabul eng' murot kaataam,
ak Hebron, Rehob, Haman ak Kanah agoi koit Sidon ne oo.
Eng' yooto koweegak kiwoteet kwo Ramah ak koit nganaseetap Tyro ne ki king'ot, yeityo koweek kwo Hosah ak kobekyi nyanjetap Mediterenian eng' emetap Aksip,
Uma, Apek ak Rehob. Ki nganasook tiptem ak aeng' kobooto kokwotinwekwak.
Ni ko poroteet ne po pororyetap lagogap Asher ko uu ortinwekwak; nganasochu ak kokwotinwekwak.
Ki mong' parparyat ne po lo kobutyi lagogap Naphtali ko uu ortinwekwak.
King'eete kiwotennywa Helep, eng' keetit ne ki mi Saananim, Adaminekeb ak Jabneel agoi Lakum ak komong'ji Jordan.
Eng' yooto koweek kiwoteet kotokyigei cherongo kwo Asnot-tabor, Hukok ak kwo kotiiny Zebulun eng' murot tai ak Asher eng' cherongo, ak Judah eng' kong'asi, eng' Jordan.
Nganasook che kiga king'ot ko Sidim, Ser, Amat, Rakat, Kineret,
Adama, Ramah, Hasor,
Kedesh, Edrei, En-hasor,
Iron, Migdal-el, Horem, Beth-anat ak Beth-shemesh; nganasook taman ak sogool kobooto kokwotinwekwak.
Ni ko poroteet ne po pororyetap lagogap Naphtali ko uu ortinwekwak; nganasook kobooto kokwotinwekwak.
Ki mong' parparyat ne po tisap kobutyi pororyetap lagogap Dan ko uu ortinwekwak.
Kiwotetap porotennywa ko ki Sora, Estaol, Ir-semes,
Saalabin, Aijalon, Itla,
Elon, Timnah, Ekron,
Elteke, Gibeton, Baalat,
Jeud, Bene-berak, Gat-rimon,
Mejarkon ak Rakon, kobooto kiwoteet ne tokyingei Joppa.

Ye ki ngerebee koreet lagogap Dan, koba kotogosta kobargei ak Lesem. Ki iluul ak kobar icheek eng' rotwetap chok, ak konam emet kobunji, yeityo komeny olooto ak koguure Lesem ak Dan koguurtoe kainetap Dan kwandanywa.
Ni ko poroteet ne po pororyetap Dan ko uu ortinwekwak; nganasochu ak kokwotinwekwak.
Kingo kes anyun kopchee takwegap emet ko porotosyek, kogoochi `piigap Israel Joshua weeriitap Nun poroteet eng' kwenunnywa.
Ki igoochi nganaseetap Timnatsera eng' emetap tuloonook ne po Ephraim ne kigasoom ko uu ng'atuutyetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ak ki teech nganasanato ak komeny.

Chu porotosyek che kipchei eng' parbarek tisiindet Eleazar ak Joshua weeriitap Nun kobooto che eecheen eng' kooriigap kwanisyek che po pororyosyegap piigap Israel. Kipchei eng' Shiloh koek poroteet eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' kurgeetap emait ne kituiyechin. Ki iges anyun pcheetap emet.
Ki ng'alaalji `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Joshua koleenji,
Mwachi piigap Israel leenjin, “Otabaan nganasook che kimwechin, ko uu ye ki amwachi Musa.
Mwechin rumiindet age tugul ne kalel ko manai ak koek eng' okweek ole kimwechin keungei ineendet ne yaaktoi korotiik.

Mwechin `rumindonooto age eng' nganasochooto yeityo kotonon eng' kurgeetap nganaseet ak komwa ng'aleekyik kogas poisyegap nganasanooto. Ye ibata, komut kwo nganaseet oriit ak kogoochi ui ak komeny eng' kwenunnywa.
Ngot koon ineendet ne yaaktoi korotiik koma igoitoi poisyek rumindonooto kwo eunekyik, amu ki par chiitap kokwennyi eng' lelet ak ki ma kowechei ineendet eng' tai.

Myee anyun komeny nganasanooto agoi kwo kotonon eng' taitap tuiyet si kirwookyi. Menye olooto kot kome tisiindet ne oo ne mi eng' peetuusyechooto. Ye me tisiindonooto, koweektagei anyun rumindonooto kwo nganasennyi ne kimweune agoi koonnyi.”

Amu nooto anyun, ko ki itabaan Kedesh eng' Galilaya eng' emetap tuloonook ne po Naphtali, Shekem eng' emetap tuloonook ne po Ephraim ak Kiriath-arba (nooto ko Hebron) eng' emetap tuloonook ne po Judah.

Eng' Jordan pitoniin eng' Jeriko ne tokyingei kong'asiis, ko ki itabaan Beser eng' surkwen eng' warengetap pororyetap Reuben, Ramot eng' Gilead eng' pororyetap Gad ak Golan eng' Bashan eng' pororyetap Manasseh.

Chuuto kogi nganasook che ki kitabaanji lagok tugul che po Israel ak che po punootyot ne menyei kwenunnywa. Ki kiitabaan keele si komwechi olooto chii age tugul ne kabar chii ama nai si ma me eng' eutap ne yaaktoi korotiik kot kotonon eng' taitap tuiyet.
Kingo pata, kobwa kandoigap kooriigap kwanisyek che po Lawiik koriik ole mi Eleazar tisiindet, Joshua weeriitap Nun ak kandoigap kooriigap kwanisyek che po pororyosyegap piigap Israel.
Ki ng'alaalji icheek eng' Shiloh eng' emetap Kanaan, koleenji, “Ki ng'at `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' eutap Musa kole kegoonech nganasook kemeny kobooto emotinwekwak ole agete tuuga.
Ak ki igoochi `piigap Israel Lawiik eng' porotennywa ko uu ng'atuutyetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, nganasochu, kobooto emotinwekwak.”

King'eyai kurainik, komong' korook che po ooreetap Kohatik. Ki sich lagogap Aron tisiindet che po ooreetap Kohat nganasook taman ak somok kobun pororyetap Judah, pororyetap Simion ak pororyetap Benjamin.
Ki sich eng' kuraitap lagogap Kohat che ki ng'et nganasook taman eng' ortinwegap pororyosyegap Ephraim, Dan ak eng' kebebertap pororyetap Manasseh.
Ki sich eng' kurait lagogap Gerson nganasook taman ak somok eng' ortinwegap ooreetap Issakar, Asher, Naphtali ak eng' kebebertap ooreetap pororyetap Manasseh eng' Bashan.
Ki sich eng' kurait lagogap Merari ko uu ortinwekwak nganasook taman ak aeng' eng' pororyetap Reuben, Gad ak eng' pororyetap Zebulun.
Ki igoochi anyun eng' kurait `piigap Israel Lawiik nganasochooto kobooto emotinwekwak che kiyagisye ko uu ye ki ng'at `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' eutap Musa.
Ki igoito eng' pororyetap lagogap Judah ak eng' pororyetap lagogap Simion nganasochu kagimwa eng' yu eng' kainaik:
Ki punji chooto lagogap Aron che po ortinwegap Kohatik che ki po lagogap Lawi: amu ki nenywa kuraitap tai.
Ki igoochi Kiriath-arba kwandap Anak (nooto ko Hebron) eng' emetap tuloonook ne po Judah kobooto emotinwekwak che kiyagisye che kiyiem.
Ago ki igoochi Kaleb weeriitap Jepune korotinwegap nganaseet kobunji kobooto kokwotinwekwak.
Ki igoochi icheek `lagogap Aron tisiindet Hebron kobooto emotinwekyik che kiyagisye, nooto kogi nganaseet ne mwechin rumiindet ak Libna kobooto emotinwekyik che kiyagisye,
ak Jatir kobooto emotinwekyik che kiyagisye, ak Estomoa kobooto emotinwekyik che kiyagisye.
Holon kobooto emotinwekyik che kiyagisye ak Debir kobooto emotinwekyik che kiyagisye,
ak Ain kobooto emotinwekyik che kiyagisye ak Juta kobooto emotinwekyik che kiyagisye, Beth-shemesh ak emotinwekyik. Nganasook sogool eng' pororyosyechuuto aeng'.
Eng' pororyetap Benjamin, ko ki Gibeon kobooto emotinwekyik, Geba kobooto emotinwekyik che kiyagisye,
Anatoth kobooto emotinwekyik che kiyagisye ak Almon kobooto emotinwekyik che kiyagisye. Tugul ko nganasook ang'wan.
Nganasook tugul che po lagogap Aron, tisiik, ko ki taman ak somok kobooto emotinwekwak che kiyagisye.
Ak ki sich ortinwegap lagogap Kohat, Lawiik, che icheek che ki ng'et eng' lagogap Kohatik, nganasoogap kurainnywa eng' pororyetap Ephraim.
Ki igoochi icheek Shekem kobooto emotinwekyik che kiyagisye eng' emetap tuloonook ne po Ephraim, nooto kogi nganaseet ne mwechin rumiindet ak Gezer kobooto emotinwekyik che kiyagisye.
Ak Kibasaim kobooto emotinwekyik che kiyagisye ak Beth-horon kobooto emotinwekyik che kiyagisye. Tugul ko nganasook ang'wan.
Eng' pororyetap Dan, ko ki Elteke kobooto emotinwekyik che kiyagisye, Gibeton kobooto emotinwekyik che kiyagisye,
Aijalon kobooto emotinwekyik che kiyagisye ak Gat-rimon kobooto emotinwekyik che kiyagisye. Tugul ko nganasook ang'wan.
Ak eng' kebebertap pororyetap Manasseh, ko ki Taanak kobooto emotinwekyik che kiyagisye ak Gat-rimon kobooto emotinwekyik che kiyagisye; nganasook aeng'.
Nganasook tugul che po ortinwegap lagogap Kohat che ki ng'et ko ki taman kobooto emotinwekwak che kiyagisye.

Ki igoochi lagogap Gerson eng' ortinwegap Lawiik eng' kebebertap pororyetap Manasseh, Golan eng' Bashan kobooto emotinwekyik che kiyagisye, nooto kogi nganaseet ne mwechin rumiindet ak Be-estera kobooto emotinwekyik che kiyagisye, chooto ko nganasook aeng'.
Eng' pororyetap Issakar ko ki Kision kobooto emotinwekyik che kiyagisye, Daberat kobooto emotinwekyik che kiyagisye,
Jarmut kobooto emotinwekyik che kiyagisye ak En-ganim kobooto emotinwekyik che kiyagisye; nganasook ang'wan.
Eng' pororyetap Asher, ko ki Misal kobooto emotinwekyik che kiyagisye, Abdon kobooto emotinwekyik che kiyagisye,
Elkat kobooto emotinwekyik che kiyagisye ak Rehob kobooto emotinwekyik che kiyagisye, chooto ko nganasook ang'wan.

Ak eng' pororyetap Naphtali, ko ki Kedesh eng' Galilaya kobooto emotinwekyik che kiyagisye, nooto kogi nganaseet ne mwechin rumiindet, ak Amot-dor kobooto emotinwekyik che kiyagisye, Kartan kobooto emotinwekyik che kiyagisye. Tugul ko nganasook somok.
Nganasook tugul che po Gershonik ko uu ortinwekwak, ko ki taman ak somok kobooto emotinwekwak che kiyagisye.
Ki igoochi ortinwegap lagogap Merari che icheek che ki ng'et eng' Lawiik eng' pororyetap Zebulun, Jokneam kobooto emotinwekyik che kiyagisye, Karta kobooto emotinwekyik che kiyagisye,
Dimna kobooto emotinwekyik che kiyagisye, Naalal kobooto emotinwekyik che kiyagisye. Chooto ko nganasook ang'wan.
Eng' pororyetap Reuben, ko ki Beser kobooto emotinwekyik che kiyagisye, Jahas kobooto emotinwekyik che kiyagisye,
Kedemot kobooto emotinwekyik che kiyagisye ak Mepaat kobooto emotinwekyik che kiyagisye. Tugul ko nganasook ang'wan.
Eng' pororyetap Gad, ko ki Ramot eng' Gilead kobooto emotinwekyik che kiyagisye, nooto kogi nganaseet ne mwechin rumiindet, Mahanaim kobooto emotinwekyik che kiyagisye,
ak Hesbon kobooto emotinwekyik che kiyagisye, Jaser kobooto emotinwekyik che kiyagisye. Tugul ko nganasook ang'wan.
Chuuto tugul kogi nganasoogap lagogap Merari ko uu ortinwekwak kobooto che ki ng'et eng' ortinwegap Lawiik; ak kurainnywa kogi nganasook taman ak aeng'.
Nganasook tugul che po Lawiik eng' kwenutap emetap piigap Israel kogi nganasook artam ak sisiit kobooto emotinwekwak che kiyagisye.
Ki tinyei age tugul eng' nganasochuuto emotinwekyik che kiyagisye che kiyiem ak ki uu nooto eng' nganasochuuto tugul.
Ki igoochi anyun `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Israel emet tugul ne ki iyasyechi kwanisyekwak kole tuun igoochin ak ki nam kobunji ak komeny,

ak ki igoochi `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor icheek kamuung'et eng' komoswek tugul, ko uu tugul che ki iyasyechi kwanisyekwak, ak ma piit chii eng' puunikwak tugul ne ki imuuch kotonon eng' tainnywa. Ki inde `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor puunikwak tugul eunekwak.
Ki isulda ng'aleek tugul che myach che kiga komwachi `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kootap Israel, ma pet ng'olyoo agot agenge ne myee.
Ki kuur anyun `Joshua piigap Reuben, che po Gad ak kebebertap pororyetap Manasseh,
ak koleenji icheek, “Ki oriip tuguuk tugul che king'ataak `Musa otwogindetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ak ki ogas iit kutinnyu eng' tugul che ki ang'ataak.
Ma omete tupchosyekwok eng' peetuusyechu chaang' agoi peetuuni ago ki oriip kayomisetap ng'atuutyetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindeng'wong'.

Ak nguno ko kagogoochi `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindeng'wong' tupchosyekwok kamuung'et ko uu ye ki mwachi. Oweeige anyun nguno ak obe emaisyekwok agoi emet ne kibunjok ne ki koonok Musa otwogindetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' Jordan pitoniin.

Ago oriipkei miising' oyai kayomisutyet ak ng'atuutyet che king'ataak Musa otwogindetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ocham Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindeng'wong' ak obendate ortinwekyik tugul ak oriip ng'atuutikyik onamge ak ineendet ak oot eng' mugulelwekwok tugul ak saboonwekwok tugul.”
Ki iberuur anyun `Joshua icheek ak koleenji koba, ak ki pa emaisyekwak.

Kiga kogoochi `Musa kebebertap pororyetap Manasseh poroteet eng' Bashan: ak ki igoochi `Joshua kebeberta age ne po pororyonooto poroteet eng' kwenutap tupchosyekwak eng' Jordan pitoniin ole tokyingei cherongo. Ak kingo machei `Joshua komwachi icheek koba emaisyekwak koberuur,

ak kong'alaalji koleenji, “Oweeige emaisyekwok ak mogornateet ne oo, tuuga che chaang', fedha, thahabu, sugunonik, kariik ak ngoroik che chaang' miising'. Opchei parunenichuuto ki po puunikwok kobooto tupchosyekwok.”

Ki week anyun lagogap Reuben, lagogap Gad ak kebebertap pororyetap Manasseh, koba eng' ole mi piigap Israel komanda eng' Shiloh, ne mi emetap Kanaan koba emetap Gilead, emet ne nenywa, ne kiga konam kobunji ko uu ng'atuutyetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' eutap Musa.
Ye kingo it emet ne neegit Jordan, ne mi emetap Kanaan, lagogap Reuben, Gad ak kebebertap pororyetap Manasseh, koteech kaptisisyet ne oo ne taagu eng' olooto, eng' ye po Jordan.

Kingo kas piigap Israel kemwaei koleen kogoteech kaptisisyet lagogap Reuben, lagogap Gad ak kebebertap pororyetap Manasseh eng' taitap emetap Kanaan, eng' kooret ne neegit Jordan, eng' komosta ne po piigap Israel,
koyumgei tuiyet komugul ne po piigap Israel eng' Shiloh kole koba kobargei ak pichooto.
Ki iyookto piigap Israel piik che ki indochin Phineas weeriitap Eleazar tisiindet koba emetap Gilead ole mi lagogap Reuben, Gad, ak kebebertap pororyetap Manasseh.

Ki mi kobooto Phineas pounik tamanu; kobunu pounindet age tugul kootap kwanisyek eng' pororyetap age tugul ne po pororyosyegap Israel ak age tugul ko ki ne oo eng' kootap kwanisyekwak eng' eliphusyegap Israel.
Ki pwa anyun ole mi lagogap Reuben, lagogap Gad ak kebebertap pororyetap Manasseh eng' emetap Gilead ak kong'alaalji koleenji,

“Kamwa ko uu ni tuiyet komugul ne po Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole, ‘Nee chalwogi kooyachi Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindetap Israel, kot omaste rani eng' kasubet ne osubi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor amu kooteekyigei kaptisisyet ak ongelelji Kamuktaindet ne Toroor rani?’
Tos mayamech tengektap Peor ne tomo kitiliilgei eng' tengegoto agoi ra, nganda ki nyoonji koroito tuiyetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor?
Ago kaomaste rani eng' kasubet ne osubi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor? Amu kaongelelji Kamuktaindet ne Toroor rani, ko mutai konereekyin ineendet tuiyet komugul ne po Israel.

Ago ngo ma ianyinyat emet ne neng'wong', olande emet ne po Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ole menyei kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ak obwa onam emet eng' kwenunnyo kobunjook. Amat ongelelji Kamuktaindet ne Toroor anan ongeleljech oteekyigei kaptisisyet age ne ma kaptisisyetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindennyo.
Tos ki ma ibutyi nereegek tuiyet komugul ne po Israel amu ki yai Akan weeriitap Zerah chalwokto eng' kiit ne ki itabaanat ak tos kimalus chiichooto ineegei eng' tengektanyi?”
Ki wol anyun lagogap Reuben, Gad ak kebebertap pororyetap Manasseh ak kong'alaalji kandoigap eliphusyegap Israel koleenji,

“Ingen Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindet ne pou kamuktaik, ak ta konaei Israel agine, ngot ko eng' ngelelnateet anan ngot ko eng' kachililutyet ne kagichililji Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, (ko mat isarwech rani,)

keteekyigei kaptisisyet kemaste eng' kasubet ne kisubi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor anan ngot kemache kigoite kagoochinet ne kibeelei anan ngot ko kagoochinetap peek anan ngot kigoite korosegap kagoochinoik che po kaalyeet ko ingoyaakta Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ineegei.

Anan ngot ko ki kiyai kii eng' riibetapkei agobo kiy keele, Ma nai chii ngot ko tuun ng'alaaljin lagokwok lagokyok eng' peetuusyek che pwoonei kole, ‘Oting'egei nee ak Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindetap Israel?’

Amu ki yai `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Jordan koek kiwotennyo ak okweek lagogap Reuben ak lagogap Gad. Motinye kebeberta eng' Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, koyai anyun lagokwok lagokyok kobagaakta kayweet ne iywei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Nooto anyun ko kogimwa keele, Ongechoboge keteekyigei kaptisisyet ne ma po kagoochinoik che kibeelei anan ko tiseiywek,

ago si koek paornateet eng' kwenunnyo acheek ak okweek ak eng' kwenutap ibinwek che piitu let eng' acheek si kobiit keyai poisyetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' tainnyi eng' kagoochinoikyok che kibeelei ak eng' tiseiywekyok ak eng' kagoochinoikyok che po kaalyeet, si ma tuun leenji lagokwok lagokyok eng' peetuusyek che pwoonei, Motinye kebeberta eng' Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.

Amu nooto, ko ki kimwa anyun keele, ‘Ye tuun kamwaiwech ko uu nooto anan komwachi ibinwekyok eng' peetuusyek che pwoonei, kemwa anyun keele, Ogeer kergeindap kaptisisyetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne ki yai kwanisyekyok ne ma po kagoochinoik che kibeelei ama po tiseiywek ago paornateet eng' kwenunnyo acheek ak okweek.

Ingolooit eng' acheek ama kingelelji Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ama kimaste rani eng' kasubet ne kisubi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kot keteech kaptisisyet ne po kagoochinoik che kibeelei ak ko po kagoochinoigap peek anan ko ne po tiseiywek, age ne ma kaptisisyetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindennyo ne mi taitap koonnyi.’ ”
Kingo kas Phineas tisiindet, pounigap tuiyet ak kandoigap eliphusyegap Israel che ki mi kobooto ineendet ng'aleek che ki mwa lagogap Reuben, Gad ak lagogap Manasseh, kobaibai icheek miising'.

Ki wolji Phineas weeriitap Eleazar tisiindet lagogap Reuben, lagogap Gad ak lagogap Manasseh, Kaginai rani keele mi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kwenunnyo, amu mata ochalwogenji Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' kiito. Kaosaru anyun piigap Israel eng' eutap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.

Eng' yooto koweek Phineas weeriitap Eleazar tisiindet kobooto pounik eng' ole mi lagogap Reuben, ak lagogap Gad ak koba eng' Gilead agoi emetap Kanaan ole mi piigap Israel, koipchi icheek ng'aleek kogeny.
Ki ibaibai kioto piigap Israel, ak ki ilas piigap Israel Kamuktaindet, amata komwa kogeny kole koba kobargei ak icheek kong'em emet ne ki menyei lagogap Reuben ak lagogap Gad.
Ki kuure anyun lagogap Reuben ak lagogap Gad kaptisisyonooto Ed, amu ki le, “Niito ko paornateet eng' kwenunnyo ne kagimwa keele Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ko Kamuktaindet.”
Kingo pata peetuusyek che chaang' ye kingo kagogoochi `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Israel kamuung'et eng' puunikwak tugul eng' komoswek tugul, ye kiga koosit Joshua ko kagotar kenyiisyek che chaang',
koguur anyun `Joshua Israel tugul, poisyekwak, kandoikwak, kirwoogikwak ak kiptainikwak yeityo koleenji icheek, “Kaaositu ak ki kochang'a kenyiisyekyuk.
Ki ogeer tuguuk tugul che ki koyachi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindeng'wong' pororyosyechu tugul amu okweek, amu Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindeng'wong' ineendet ne ki yai lugeet agobo okweek.
Ki apcheiywok pororyosyechu kang'et koek poroteetap ortinwekwok kobooch Jordan, kobooto pororyosyek tugul che ki abar agoi nyanjetap Mediterenian ne tokyingei kong'asiis.
Timdoi anyun `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindeng'wong' icheek eng' taing'wong' ak koon si ma ogeere; ak onam emennywa kobunjook, ko uu ye kimwaiwok `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindeng'wong'.
Onyiganitu anyun miising' si oriip ak oyai tuguuk tugul che ki kisir eng' bukuitap Ng'atuutik ne po Musa, si momaste oistoegei tuguuchooto obe eutap tai anan ko ne po kaataam,
si mobe kwenutap pororyosyechu chuuto kong'et eng' kwenung'wong' anan omwa kainaigap kanamonikwak anan oyosye eng' icheek anan oot anan ogutung'ji.
Ago onamge ak Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindeng'wong' ko uu ye ki oyai agoi ra.
Amu ki koon `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' taing'wong' pororyosyek che eecheen ak ko kiimeen. Ago ma piit chii ne ki tonon eng' taing'wong' agoi ra.
Oone chiito agenge eng' okweek eliphuut amu Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindeng'wong' ne yaei lugeet agobo okweek ko uu ye kimwaiwok.
Oriipkei anyun miising' si ocham Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindeng'wong'.
Amu ngot ochuchuigei obe let eng' kiy age tugul ak onamge ak pororyosyechuuto ki ng'et eng' kwenung'wong', otunge ak icheek ak obe ole mi ak kobwa ole omi,

onai komyee ole ma koonei kogeny Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindeng'wong' pororyosyechuuto eng' taing'wong', ago egu mesteet ak kiit ne riichei piich eng' okweek ak kipchoritiit eng' karasaikwok ak katook eng' konyekwok, kot kotun olusye eng' emoni karaaran ki koonok Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindeng'wong'.

“Awendi anyun rani ooreet ne pendi piik tugul che po ng'wony. Ongen eng' mugulelwekwok tugul ak eng' saboonwekwok tugul, ole ma pet ng'olyoo agot agenge eng' tuguuk tugul che myachen che ki mwa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindeng'wong' agobo okweek. Ago ki isulda chooto tugul eng' okweek ama pet kiy agot agenge eng' chooto.

Ago onai anyun ole, ko uu ye ki pwanjok tuguuk tugul che myachen che kimwaiwok Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindeng'wong', koibwok Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ko uu nooto, tuguuk tugul che yaacheen agoi kogeswok eng' emoni karaaran ki koonok Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindeng'wong'.

“Ngo ngelelji kayomisetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindeng'wong', ne king'ataak ak obe oot kanamonik ak ogutung'ji, kolaldos anyun nereegegap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor agobo okweek ak ochakte obegu, owong'ugei eng' emoni karaaran kigogoonok ineendet.”
Ki iyum anyun `Joshua pororyosyek tugul che po Israel koba Shekem, ak koguur poisyegap Israel, pounikwak, kirwoogikwak ak kiptainikwak. Ki pwa anyun ak kotononso eng' taitap Kamuktaindet.

Yeityo kong'alaal `Joshua ak koleenji piik tugul, “Kamwa ko uu ni Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindetap Israel kole, Ki menyei kwanisyekwok keny aineet pitoniin; che icheeget ko Tera kwandap Abraham ak kwandap Nahor ak kiotei kanamonik.
Ki amutu kwandang'wong' Abraham eng' aineet pitoniin ak amutate eng' emet tugul ne po Kanaan ak ates iyotennyi agoochi Isak.
Ki agoochi `Isak Jakobo ak Esau, ak ki agoochi `Esau tulweetap Seir kobunji ak ko ki rekto Jakobo ak lagokyik koba Misiri.
Ki ayookte `Musa ak Aron, ak abire Misiri korotwek ko uu kiit ne ki ayai eng' kwenunnywa, ak ye ibata amutwak omong'u.
Yeityo anyun amutu kwanisyekwok komang'une Misiri ak ki obwa agoi nyanjet. Ki oon Misiriik kwanisyekwok eng' kariisyek ak piik che ketei paraisisyek kot koit Araraita ne Piriir.

Kingo riirchi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor konde mesundeito kwenung'wong' ak Misiriik ak koip nyanjet komaaluuch icheek ak kotuch. Ki keer iman konyekwok kiit ne ki ayai eng' Misiri. Eng' let ko ki omeny surkwen peetuusyek che chaang'.
Yeityo amutwak oitu emetap Amorik che ki menyei Jordan pitoniin. Ki yai lugeet ak okweek ak ki ande icheeget eunekwok ak ki onam emennywa kobunjook, ak ki abar icheek eng' taing'wong'.
Ki ng'eet anyun Balak weeriitap Sipor laitoryatap Moab ak kobargei ak Israel. Ki iyookto ineendet keguur Balaam weeriitap Beor konyo kochubok.
Ago ma acham agas ng'aleegap Balaam. Eng' nooto anyun, nganda ki uu nooto, ko ki iberuurok, ak ki asarwok anyun eng' eunnyi.
Ki olong'une `Jordan obwa Jeriko ak ki yai lugeet ak okweek piigap Jeriko, Amorik, Perisik, Kanaanik, Hitik, Girgasik, Hibik ak Jebusik, ak ki ande icheek eunekwok.
Ki ayookte kaaraamyet kondoenak eng' taing'wong' ne ki oon laitorinichooto aeng' po Amorik; ma eng' rotweng'ung' po chok anan kwangeng'ung'.
Ki agoonok emet ne kimaoyai kiy, nganasook omeny che kimaoteeche; oame che po mbareenigap sabibuk ak che po mseituni che ki ma omiine.

“Oiywei anyun Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ak oboisyechi ineendet eng' muguleldo ne ma tinyei keniisyet ak eng' imanit. Oiste kanamonik che kiotei kwanisyekwok eng' aineet pitoniin ak eng' Misiri, ak oboisyechi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.

Ago ngot ogeere ko ya oboisyechini Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, olewen rani ne oboisyechini; ngo kanamonik che kiotei kwanisyekwok eng' aineet pitoniin anan kanamonigap Amorik che omenye emennywa; ago aboisyechini anee ak koonnyu Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.”
Ki wol pichooto kole, “Achicha, Ma kibagaaktoi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ak keoot kanamonik.

Amu Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindennyo, ko ineendet ne ki imutwech ak kwanisyekyok kemang'une emetap Misiri eng' kootap otwoknateet ak ko ineendet ne ki yai kaboorunoichu kieechen eng' tainnyo ak koriibonwech eng' ooreet tugul ne ki kibunu ak eng' kwenutap piik tugul che ki kibunu kwenunnywa.
Ki oon `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor piik tugul koba eng' tainnyo, chooto Amorik che ki menyei emoniito. Nooto anyun kiboisyechini Kamuktaindet ne Toroor agacheek, amu ineendet ko Kamuktaindennyo.”

Koleenji `Joshua piik, “Momuuchi oboisyechi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, amu ineendet ko Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne tiliil. Ineendet ko Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne amei ng'etkong'; ma nyoiywok kaat eng' pistoeng'wong' anan ko eng' tengekwogikwok.
Ngot omete Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ak oot kamuktaik che too, koweeksei anyun ak koyaiywok ne ya ak kogeswok, ago kiga koyaiywok ne myee.”
Ak ki leenji `piik Joshua, “Achicha, kiboisyechini Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.”
Ak ki leenji `Joshua piik, “Oo paorinik che obaoryanjinigei ole kaolewen Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, oboisyechi ineendet.” Ak ki mwa kole, “Ki paorinik.”
Ara anyun, oiste kanamonik che too che mi kwenung'wong' ak otokyi mugulelwekwok Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindetap Israel.
Koleenji `piik Joshua, “Kiboisyechini Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindennyo ak kegas iit kutinnyi.”
Koyomiskei `Joshua anyun ak pichooto peetuunooto, ak koyachi ng'atuutyet ak kayomisutyet eng' Shekem.
Ki sir ng'aleechuuto `Joshua eng' bukuitap ng'atuutigap Kamuktaindet. Ki inem koita ne oo ak konde kotonon eng' keetitap alayet keel ne ki mi ye po ole-tiliil ne po Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.

Yeityo komwachi `Joshua piik tugul koleenji, “Ee, egu kooi paoryat agobo acheek. Amu kagogas ng'aleek tugul che po Kamuktaindet ne Toroor che kimwaiwech, ko egu anyun paoryat agobo okweek, si moeesye Kamuktaindeng'wong'.”
Ki leenji anyun Joshua piik koba, ak ki wo chii tugul ye mi porotennyi.
Kingo pata tuguuchuuto, kome Joshua weeriitap Nun otwogindetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ko po kenyiisyek pogol ak taman.
