Ak eng' peetuutap ang'wan, kong'eetyo karon inne, ak king'eet kole kwo. Ki mwachi kwandap kwonyooto sandennyi, koleenji, “Igaigai muguleldang'ung' eng' magatyat kitigin, yeityo obe.”
Ki tebi ng'wony ak ki amis ak koeeiso icheek tuwai. Ak ki leenji kwandap kwonyooto chiichooto, “Asoomin ale, cham itebi kemout komugul, ak ingobaibait muguleldang'ung'.”
Kingo ng'eet chiichooto kole kwo, ko ki igaigai kapyugoinnyi, ak ki ru yooto kogeny.
Ki ng'eet karon miising' eng' peetuut ne po muut kole kwo, ak ki le kwandap kwonyooto, “Asoomin ale, igaigai muguleldang'ung', ak otebi agoi koskoleny.” Ak ki amis icheek tuwai.

Kingo ng'eet chiichooto kole kwo, ineendet ak chebaigeiyandennyi ak otwogindennyi, koleenji ineendet kapyugoinnyi kwandap kwonyooto, “Keero, amu machei koimen, asoomin ale tebi kemout komugul. Machei kogeskei peetuut, ru yuto, si kobaibait muguleldang'ung', si imuste karon miising', iwe kaa.”

Ago ma cham chiichooto kotebi kemounooto, ago king'eet ak kwo, agoi koit ole tokyingei Jebus (nooto ko Jerusalem). Ki tinyei sigiroik aeng' che kiga kiito, ki mi agine chebaigeiyandennyi kobooto ineendet.
Kingo mi ye neegitee Jebus, koimen, ak ki leenji otwogindet kiptaiyandennyi, “Asoomin ale nyoo kemaste keebe nganaseetap Jebusik, ak keruiye yooto.”
Ago ki leenji kiptaiyandennyi, “Ma kimastoi kebendi nganaseetap toondet, ne ma po piigap Israel, ago kisiirtoi kebendi Gibea.”
Ki leenji otwogindennyi, “Nyoo keriikyi yeto age eng' chu, si keruiye Gibea anan ko Ramah.”
Kisiirto anyun koba pandanywa ak kirorokta asiista kota kobendi ko neegit koit Gibea, ne po Benjamin.
Ki masta icheek koba olooto, koba koruiyo Gibea. Ki wo oriit, ak kotebi ng'wony eng' ooreetap nganaseet, amu ma piit chii ne ki imut icheek koba koonnyi koruiyo.
Ki nyo poiyot age ne ki punu poisyennyi eng' mbar koskoleny. Ki po chiichooto emetap tuloonoogap Ephraim, ak ki meny Gibea koek toondet. Ki piik che ki menyei Gibea ko Benjaminik.
Ye kitabendo inee kogeer kiprutoiyot eng' ooreetap nganaseet, ak ki le poiyondonooto, “Iwendi ano ak ibunu ano?”
Ki wol ineendet kole, “Kibunu Beth-lehem-juda ak kesiirtoi kebendi emetap tuloonoogap Ephraim komosin. Aa po olooto, ak awendi nguno kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor; ama mi chii ne imuta koonnyi.
Ago ki tinyei mobeek ak amitwogik che ki kigonor che po sigirokyok. Atinye magatyat ak divaik, che yamech anee, otwogindet ne chepto ak murenoni mi kobooton. Ma mi kiy age tugul ne rartaat.”
Ki le poiyondonooto, “Ingotep kaalyeet kobooten! Ingobunjo tuguuk tugul che imache, koek kityo, mat iru ooreet.”
Komut anyun kwo koonnyi ak kogoochi sigiroik amitwogik. Ki iun keelyekwak, ak ki amis ak koeeiso.

Ye kita koboiboi mugulelwekwak, ogeero, ki pwa murenigap nganasanooto, weeriigap Belial, koyiem koot ak kobir kurgeet. Ki ng'alaalji `icheek poiyondonooto, chiitap ko po koot, koleenji, “Imoong'u chiichi kanyo koong'ung', si kobiit kesuup.”
Ki manda anyun chiichooto po koot, kwo ole mi icheek ak koleenji, “Achicha, tupchosyekyuk, asoomok ale, amoyai tengekto ne tee ni. Amu kanyo chiichi koonnyu, amoyai sogornatani.

Ogeero, mi yu cheptonyu ne pergeiya ak chebaigeiyatap chiichi. Ochamwon amutwok icheek kobwa saang' nguno, si omut ak oyachi icheek ko uu ye ogeere ole myee, ago amat oyachi chiichi sogornatani uu ni.”

Ago ma cham pichooto kogasyi ineendet ng'aleek. Ki nam anyun chiichooto chebaigeiyandennyi ak komutyi icheek eng' saang'. Kisuup kwonyooto ak koteweer ineendet agoi koeech. Kingo machei koeech, kobagaakta kwo.
Ki nyo anyun kwonyooto ko kairir emet, ak kobutyi kurgeetap kootap chiichooto ole ki mi kiptaiyandennyi, kot koeech.
Ki ng'eet kiptaiyandennyi karon, koyaat kurgotigap koot, komanda koleen kwo pandanyi. Ogeero, kogobutyi kurgeetap koot chebaigeiyandennyi, komi eunekyik tugatuk.
Ki leenji ineendet, “Ng'eet keebe.” Ago ma wol kiy. Kiganapchi anyun sigiryet ak king'eet kwo oldanyi.
Kingo kakwo koonnyi oriit, konem rotweet, ak konam chebaigeiyandennyi ak kopcheapchei koek kebeberwek taman ak aeng'. Yeityo koyookto kebeberwechooto koba komoswek tugul che po Israel.
Ki mwa tugul che ki keer kole, “Kitom kobiitu poisyet ne uu ni kobooch ngap komong' piigap Israel, eng' emetap Misiri agoi ra. Obwaat, orwooch agobo kiito, ak omwa ne kaotil.”
Ki manda anyun piigap Israel tugul, kobooch Dan agoi Beer-sheba, kobooto emetap Gilead, ak ki iyumgei tuiyet koigei chiichak, ki iyumgei eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' Mispa.
Ki iyomechigei tuiyet taitap Kamuktaindet, kirwoogik tugul che punu pororyosyek tugul che po Israel, piik eliphuusyek pogol ang'wan che punei keelyek, che tinyei rotoogap chok.
(Ki kas anyun lagogap Benjamin kole kagotogosta piigap Israel koba Mispa.) Ak ki le piigap Israel, “Omwaiwech, ki piitunda ano tengegi?”
Ak ki wol Lawindet manong'otyotap kwonyooto ki kibarei kole, “Ki anyoo Gibea ne po Benjamin, anee ak chebaigeiyandennyu ale keru yooto.
Ki ng'eetyo piigap Gibea kobwa koyiem koot ne ki ami kemoi. Ki machei kole kobara aneendet, ak kisuup chebaigeiyandennyu agoi kome.
Ki anam chebaigeiyandennyu ak aton, ak ayookte keip koba emet tugul ne poroteetap Israel, amu ki koyai tengekto ak abusnateet eng' Israel.
Ogeero, okweek piigap Israel, okweek tugul, omwa, ak orwooch kiit ne nyolu.”
Ki ng'eetyo piik tugul koigei chiichak kole, “Ma wendi koweechigei chii age tugul eng' acheek emainnyi, anan koonnyi.
Ago nguno ko ni kiit ne keyachini Gibea: kitogostoi kebendi yooto eng' seretap parbareek.

Kinemu murenik taman eng' pogolut age tugul eng' pororyosyek tugul che po Israel, pogolut eng' eliphuut age tugul ak kinemu eliphuut eng' eliphuusyek taman, koba koipchi piik amitwogik, si ye iit Gibea ne po Benjamin koyai ko uu abusnateet tugul ne ki yai icheek eng' Israel.”
Koyumjigei anyun tugul che po Israel nganasanooto, konamgei icheek koek agenge.
Ki iyookto `ortinwegap Israel piik koba komoswek tugul eng' ooreetap Benjamin, kole, “Nee tengegi kogobiit eng' kwenung'wong'?
Omong'u anyun pichooto yaacheen, weeriigap Belial, che mi Gibea, si kobiit kebar ak keiste yaityet eng' Israel.” Ago ma cham Benjamin kogas ng'aleegap tupchosyekwak piigap Israel.
Ki iyumgei lagogap Benjamin che ki mang'une nganasook, koyumjigei Gibea ak koba kobargei ak piigap Israel.

Ki kiit lagogap Benjamin peetuunooto che ki mang'une nganasook, koek murenik eliphuusyek tiptem ak lo che tinyei rotoogap chok, ama ki itito piik che ki menyei Gibea, che ki ek murenik pogol tisap che ki kilewen.
Eng' kwenutap pichuuto tugul che ki kilewen ko ki mi murenik pogolwogik tisabu che po kaataam, che ki imuuchi age tugul kowiirtae porowet koita kowiir sumeiyot, ama ichilili.
Ki ek murenigap Israel tugul che po lugeet eliphuusyek pogol ang'wan che ki kiit ama pooto Benjamin. Chuuto tugul ko ki murenigap lugeet.

Ki ng'eetyo piigap Israel kotogosta Bethel, ole kiteebe Kamuktaindet kiit ne kanyool koyai. Ak ki le, “Ng'oo ne sip kotogostoi koba kobargei ak lagogap Benjamin?” Ak ki le Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, “Judah ne indoi.”
Ki ng'eetyo anyun piigap Israel karon, ak koteech ye tokyingei Gibea.
Ki manda piigap Israel kobargei ak Benjamin, ak kitet lugeet kotokyigei icheek eng' Gibea.
Ki mong' lagogap Benjamin eng' Gibea ak ki par eng' peetuunooto murenik eliphuusyek tiptem ak aeng' kobutyi ng'wony che po Yahudik.
Ki igimitkei piik, murenigap Israel, ak kotet lugeet kogeny eng' yu ki paregei eng' tai.

(Ki togosta piigap Israel koba koriiryo eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor agoi koskoleny, ak ki teebe `icheek Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole, “Awe kogeny ayai lugeet ak lagogap Benjamin tupchennyu?” Ak ki le Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, “Togoste obargei ak ineendet.”)
Ki riikyi `piigap Israel lagogap Benjamin eng' peetuut ne po aeng'.
Ki manda Benjamin eng' Gibea ak kobargei ak icheek eng' peetuut ne po aeng', ak ki par kogeny murenik eliphuusyek taman ak sisiit kobutyi ng'wony; ki tinyei chuuto tugul rotoogap chok.

Yeityo kotogosta lagok tugul che po Israel, ak piik tugul agoi koit Bethel. Ki riiryo, ak kotebi ng'wony eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ak korugutkei peetuunooto agoi koskoleny, ak ki igoito kagoochinoik che kibeelei ak kagoochinoigap kaalyeet eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ak kiteebe `piigap Israel Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, (amu ki mi olooto moingetap arorutyetap Kamuktaindet eng' peetuusyechooto,

ak kitonone taitap moingonooto Phineas, weeriitap Eleazar, weeriitap Aron, eng' peetuusyechooto,) koleenji, “Ta awe kogeny kebarge ak lagogap Benjamin tupchennyu, anan atebi?” Ak ki le Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, “Togoste, amu andoi ineendet eung'ung' mutai.”
Ara ki inde Israel piik che ribistos koyiem Gibea koriip.
Ki togosta Israel koba kobargei ak lagogap Benjamin eng' peetuut ne po somok, ak kotetkei kobargei ak Gibea ko uu peetuusyechuun alak.

Ki manda lagogap Benjamin kobookyi pichooto, ak ki kireto koba ole loo eng' nganaseet. Ki toi kowiir ak kobar eng' pichooto ko uu peetuusyechuun alak, olo po piik sosom che po Israel, eng' ortinwek che eecheen. Kiwendi age Bethel, kowendi age Gibea, eng' mbareenik.
Ki mwa lagogap Benjamin kole, “Kagibar eng' tainnyo ko uu eng' tai.” Ago ki le piigap Israel, “Ongemwee, ak kirete koba eng' nganaseet koba ortinwek che eecheen.”
Ki ng'eetyo piik tugul che po Israel eng' komostanywa ak koba kotetkei eng' Baal-tamar. Ki mong' eng' komostanywa piik che kiribistos che po Israel, eng' Maaregeba.
Ki pwa kobargei ak Gibea, murenik eliphuusyek tamanu che ki kilewen eng' Israel tugul, ak king'wanit pooryeet. Ago ki ma nai kole neegit yaityet eng' icheek.
Ki par `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Benjamin eng' taitap Israel. Ki par piigap Israel eng' peetuunooto murenik eliphuusyek tiptem ak muut ak pogol che po Benjamin. Ki tinyei chuuto tugul rotoogap chok.
Ki keer lagogap Benjamin anyun kole kagebar. Amu ki istochigei piigap Israel Benjamin, amu ki imang'u piik che kiribistos koriipsei, che kiga konde icheek koriip Gibea.
Kichaakta piik che karibistos korwai Gibea. Ki iseergei pichooto, ak kobar nganaseet tugul eng' rotwetap chok.
Ki mi kaboorunet ne kiga kichop eng' kwenutap piigap Israel ak piik che kiribistos keele konaam iyeto ne oo kotogosta eng' nganaseet,
ko nyolu koweek anyun murenigap Israel eng' pooryeet. Ki toi Benjamin kowiir ak kobar murenigap Israel olo po piik sosom, amu ki le “Kagibar iman, ko uu eng' pooryeet ne po tai.”
Ago kingo toi kotogosta iyeto ne uu toloita eng' nganaseet, kogeer let Benjamin, ak ogeero, ki togostoi maat eng' nganaseet kowendi parak.
Ki week anyun piigap Israel ak ki kwong'yo piigap Benjamin, amu ki keer kole kanyonji yaityet.
Ki mweiso anyun icheek eng' taitap piigap Israel kotuktoochi patai, koba ooreetap surkwen, ago ki kibarat icheek; ak ki par pichooto eng' kwenunnywa piik che ki mang'une nganasook.
Ki yiem `icheek Benjaminik konde kween, ki oon ak kotyegaat eng' ole imuung'ee kot koit ole tokyingei Gibea ole charunee asiista.
Ki pek piik eliphuusyek tamanu ak sisiit che po Benjamin, chuuto tugul ko ki murenik che nyigoonen.

Ki week ak komweiso kotokyigei surkwen kot koit rwandetap Rimon. Ak kikweat piik eliphuusyek muut eng' icheek, eng' ortinwek che eecheen. Ki oon kot koit Gidom ak ki par piik eliphuusyek aeng' eng' icheek.
Ki pek anyun eng' peetuunooto piik eliphuusyek tiptemu ak muut che po Benjamin che ki tinyei rotoogap chok, chuuto tugul ko ki murenik che nyigoonen.
Ago ki week piik pogolwogik lo, komwei kotokyigei surkwen kot koit rwandetap Rimon, ki meny rwandetap Rimon oriit arawek ang'wan.
Ki weekyigei kogeny piigap Israel lagogap Benjamin ak kobar eng' rotwetap chok, nganaseet komugul, tuuga ak tugul che kinyoor. Ak ki peel kogeny nganasook tugul che kinyoor.
Kiga koyasyo piigap Israel eng' Mispa, kole, “Ma igoochin chii eng' acheek cheptonyi Benjamin kotun.”
Ki pwa piik Bethel ak kotep ng'wony eng' yooto eng' taitap Kamuktaindet kot koit koskoleny, ak kowaach, ak koriiryo ne ng'waan.
Ak kole, “Ee, Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindetap Israel, amu nee si kobiit kii eng' Israel, kot koma komi rani ooreet age eng' Israel?”
Ak ki eng' mutai kong'eetyo piik kota ko karon, ak koteech kaptisisyet eng' yooto, ak kogoito kagoochinoik che kibeelei ak kagoochinoigap kaalyeet.

Ki le piigap Israel, “Mi ng'oo eng' ortinwek tugul che po Israel ne ma nyo kotogos tuiyet ole mi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor?” Amu kiga yai kayasyoet ne oo agobo ineendet ne ma nyo kotogos ole mi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' Mispa, kole, “Kibarei ineendet iman.”
Ago ki sich riirge piigap Israel agobo Benjamin tupchennywa, ak ki mwa kole, “Mi ooreet agenge ne kagobet ra eng' Israel.
Kiyae nee si konyoor osotik icheek che kong'et, amu ki kiyasye eng' Kamuktaindet ne Toroor keele ma kigoochini icheek tiibiikyok kotun?”
Ak ki le icheek, “Ng'oo ne po ortinwek eng' Israel ne ma nyo kotogos ole mi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' Mispa?” Ak ogeero, Ki ma nyo chii agot agenge nganaseet ne ki punu Jabes-gilead konyo tuiyet.
Amu ye kingo kagiit piik, ogeero, ki ma komi chii eng' piik che ki menyei Jabes-gilead.

Ara ki iyookto `tuiyet piik eliphuusyek taman ak aeng' che po che nyigoonen eng' tugul, ak kong'at icheek koleenji, “Oba obar eng' rotwetap chok piik che menyei Jabes-gilead, kobooto kwonyiik ak lagok.
Kiit ne obendi oyae ko ni; obare ogesu muren age tugul ak kwony age tugul ne ki koruiyo ak muren.”
Ki nyoor eng' piik che ki menyei Jabes-gilead pergeinik pogol ang'wan che neranik, che ki tomo konai muren, ak ki imut icheek kobwa nganaseet eng' Shiloh, ne mi emetap Kanaan.
Ki iyookto tuiyet komugul piik koba kong'alaalji lagogap Benjamin che ki mi rwandetap Rimon oriit, ak komwachi icheek kaalyeet.
Ki week Benjamin eng' peetuusyechooto; ak ki igoochi icheek kwonyiik che ki sar kosapcho eng' che po kwonyiigap Jabes-gilead; ago ki ma yam icheek.
Ki aragenso piik agobo Benjamin amu ki koyai Kamuktaindet ne Toroor koyaatak oldo age eng' ortinwegap Israel.
Ki le anyun poisyegap tuiyet, “Ki yai nee si konyoor osotik icheek che kong'et, amu ki kibar kwonyiik eng' Benjamin?”
Ak ki le icheek, “Ne matiny konyolu kobiit poroteet eng' icheek che kichililso che po Benjamin, si ma pet ooreet age eng' Israel.
Ago ma kimuuchi kigoochi icheek osotik eng' tiibiikyok.” Amu kiga koyasyo piigap Israel, kole, “Chuboot ne igoochin osotyot Benjamin.”

Ak ki le icheek, “Ogeero, miitei igoortap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' kenyiit age tugul eng' Shiloh, ne miitei murot kaataam ne po Bethel, eng' komostap kong'asiis ne po ooreet ne oo ne togostoi eng' Bethel kowendi Shekem, ak eng' murot tai ne po Lebanon.”
Ak ki ng'at lagogap Benjamin, koleenji, “Oba, oribisye eng' mbareenigap sabibuk,
ak ogeer, ngot komong' tiibiigap Shiloh kobwa kourerenso eng' ureryosyek, omong'u anyun eng' mbareenigap sabibuk, konam chii tugul osotyonnyi eng' tiibiigap Shiloh, kobwa emetap Benjamin.

Ak ye pwa kwanisyekwak anan ko tupchosyekwak koboljech, keleenji anyun, ‘Ogoonech icheek eng' myeeindo, amu ma kimutu chii tugul eng' acheek osotyonnyi eng' pooryeet, ama ogoochi okweek icheek. Amu nda ki koyai ko uu nooto, ta otinye tengekto.’ ”
Ki yai ko uu nooto lagogap Benjamin, ak ki imutyigei osotik, che tee koiitennywa, eng' che kiuerendos che ki imut. Ki pa koweektagei ole kimi porotennywa, ak ki teech nganasook ak komeny.
Ki pa piigap Israel eng' peetuusyechooto, kwo chii tugul pororyennyi ak ole kimi ooreennyi, kimanda eng' yooto chii tugul kwo ole mi porotennyi.
Ki ma komi laitoryat Israel eng' peetuusyechooto. Kiyaei chii tugul ko uu ye kigeerei kole myee.
Eng' peetuusyek che ki irwoochi kirwoogik, ko ki piit rubeet eng' emet. Ki wo chii ne po Bethlehem eng' Judah kwo komeny emetap Moab, ineendet ak osotyonnyi kobooto weeriikyik aeng'.
Kainetap chiichooto ko ki Elimelek, ko osotyonnyi ko ki Naomi, ak weeriichooto aeng' ko ki Malon ak Kilion, che icheeget ko ki Epratik kobun Bethlehem eng' Judah. Ki it emetap Moab ak kotebee olooto.
Ki me Elimelek manong'otyotap Naomi ak ki ng'et Naomi ak weeriikyik aeng'.
Ki itun `weerchooto osotik eng' kwonyiigap Moab ne kainetap age ko ki Orpa, ko age ko ki Ruth. Ki meny olooto olo po kenyiisyek taman.
Ki pek ak icheek Malon ak Kilion, ak ki ng'et Naomi ineegei ama lagokyik aeng' anan manong'otyondennyi.
Ki ng'eet ineendet anyun kobooto kwonyiigap weeriikyik komachei koweektagei eng' emetap Moab, amu kiga kogas komi emetap Moab kole ki korutoochi `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor piikyik ak kogoochi amitwogik.
Ki wo eng' komosta ne ki mi ak osotigap weeriikyik aeng', ak koba pandanywa koweektagei emetap Judah.
Ki leenji `Naomi osotichooto aeng' po weeriikyik, “Ingoweektagei age tugul kwo kootap kamennyi ak ingoyaiywok Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne myee ko uu ye ki oyachi che ki kobek ak ko uu ye ki oyaiywo.
Ingogoonok Kamuktaindet ne Toroor onyooru kaalyeet, konyoor age tugul eng' okweek eng' kootap manong'otyondennyi.” Ki ng'utut icheek, ak ki waakyo koriiryo.
Koleenji `icheek ineendet, “Achicha, ki weeksei kebendi tugul ole mi piiguk.”
Koleenji Naomi, “Obechigei tiibiikyuk. Amu nee si keebe tugul? Ta asiche weeriik alak che imuuchi koek manong'otaikwok?
Oba tiibiikyuk, obechigei amu koaositu ak koma kituno. Agot ndata abwaati ale ta komi kamang'unet, ak asich manong'otyot kemouni ak anyooru weeriik,
ko tos ogen kot koechegitu? Tos otebii koma kitunook? Achicha tiibiikyuk! Ki kong'wanit miising' eng' anee kosiirook, amu ki konyaliila eutap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.”
Ki testai kowaakyo icheek. Inga ki ng'utut `Orpa korgennyi po yugoi kosaiseret, ko ki nam `Ruth ak komeitoochi.
Koleenji `Naomi Ruth, “Keero, kagoweek kwondap pomurtang'ung' kwo ole mi piikyik ak kamuktaindennyi. Weektegei aginye! Isup ne po pomurtang'ung'.”
Ago ki wolji Ruth koleenji, “Amegimnjo ile abagachin anan ile aweek matkebe tuwai! Ole kewe, awendi, ak ole itebee atebee agane. Egu piiguk piikyuk, ak egu Kamuktaindeng'ung' Kamuktaindennyu.
Ole imechini, amechini, ak ketupchino yooto. Ingoyaiywo Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ko uu nooto, ak kotes kosiir, kobatee meet ineegei ne ibestoseech anee ak inyee.”
Kingo keer Naomi kole kiga kobegechi koba tuwai, ko mata komwachi kiy ineendet.
Ki pa anyun tuwai kot koit Bethlehem. Kingo it Bethlehem, komong' nganaseet komugul eng' poiboiyet ak kole kwonyiik, “Naomi niito iman?”
Koleenji `ineendet icheek, “Moguureno Naomi (chebaibai)! Oguureno Marah (chepnereekya), amu ki koyaiywo ineendet Ne po Kamuktaet kiit ne ng'waan.
Ki awendi ko aa nyiitaat, ak kogomutwaa `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kaa ami puch. Amu nee si oguureno Chebaibai ko ki kobaoryan Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kogikyo, ak konyaliila Ineendet Ne po Kamuktaet?”
Ki week anyun Naomi eng' emetap Moab kobooto Ruth cheptap Moab osotyotap weeriinnyi. Ki it Bethlehem ko katoygei kesisyetap baale.
Ki tinyei `Naomi chiitap ooreetap manong'otyonnyi, chii ne oo ne mogoryo, ne po ooreetap Elimelek, ak kainennyi ko ki Boaz.
Ak ki leenji `Ruth chemoabindet Naomi, “Ngawo mbar si aturot peek che kameto kesiik. Amang'u ale anyooru ineendet ne imuuch koriirena.” Koleenji Naomi, “Ui, cheptonyu.”
Ki wo anyun Ruth mbar ak koturisyot kosubi piik che kesisyei. Ki it keljiinennyi, ye kingo it kebebertap mbareet ne po Boaz, nooto ki po ooreetap Elimelek.
Ki it anyun koit Boaz kobunu Bethlehem, ak kogat kesiik koleenji, “Ingotep Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kobootok.” Kowolji `icheek ineendet kole, “Ingoberuurin Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.”
koteebeee `Boaz otwogindennyi ne kitononjin piik che kesisyei koleenji, “Po kap ng'oo chebi?”
Kowolji `otwogindet ne kitononjin piik che kesisyei koleenji, “Ineendet ko cheptap Moab ne kibwanei ak Naomi ye kingo weeksei eng' emetap Moab.

Koleenjo ineendet, ‘Kaigai, chamwo aturisyot ak ayumate peek eng' kwenutap ratuutigap peek, asubi piik che kesisyei.’ Kait ak koturis kong'etee karon agoi nguno ne ma imuny kot koek nguno ne kaimuny kitigin.”
Koleenji `Boaz Ruth, “Kas anyuno cheptonyu! Amat iwe iturisyote eng' mbareet age, anan isiirte eng' yu, ago tebi ineegite kwonyiik.
Tokyi konyeguk kogeer mbareet ne kesei icheeget, ak iwe isup icheek. Kaang'at murenik aleenji mat kotwain. Ye amin melel, iwe iee peek che kagoramji tereenik murenichooto.”
Ki ing'uruuk Ruth kot kotiiny ng'wony togeennyi eng' teegis, ak koleenji chiichooto, “Amu nee si anyoor myeeindo eng' taing'ung' kot ibwaata anee ne aa too?”

Kowolji `Boaz ineendet koleenji, “Kogemwaiwo tuguuk tugul che ki iyachi korgeng'ung' po yugoi kobooch ngo me manong'otyong'ung', ak ko uu ye ki ibagaakte kwandang'ung' ak kamenng'ung' kobooto emet ne ki kisikyinin, ak inyoo ole mi piik che ki ma ingen eng' tai.
Ingoyaagun Kamuktaindet ne Toroor poisyeng'ung', ingogoonin melekto ne nyiitaat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindetap Israel, ne ki inyoo imwechi kebebaikyik!”
Koleenji Ruth, “Inganyoor myeeindo eng' taing'ung' kiptaiyandennyu, amu kaigaigaa ak amu kaing'alaalji cheptong'ung' ne otwogin eng' chamyet, agot nganda ma uu age eng' tiibiiguk che otwogik.”

Kingo it saitap amitwogik, koleenji `Boaz ineendet, “Nyoo putul amitwogichu, ak iamde kererutyeng'ung' siki.” Ki tebi Ruth anyun ak kesiik ak ki igoochi Boaz peek che kagigeel. Ki am kobiyo kot kong'et katuganik.
Kingo kang'eet kwo koturisyot, kong'at `Boaz parnotikyik koleenji, “Ingoturot chebi agot eng' kwenutap ratuutik ago mo kerong'.
Ong'usyi metoweegap peek eng' ratuutik, ak ometoochi kotur amoger kong' ineendet.”
Kiturisyot anyun Ruth eng' mbar agoi koskoleny. Kiboor che kagoturot, ak ki olo po keruutik tiptem.
Kila koip turoonik kwo nganaseet ak koboorchi korgennyi po yugoi che tee che kagotur. Ki ipchi amitwogik che kigaituuch ko kagobiyo, ak kogoochi ineendet.
koteebeee Naomi koleenji, “Keturee ano ra turoonichu techu? Keturee mbareetap ng'oo? Iberuurot ineendet ne kanain.” Komwochi `Ruth Naomi koleenji kaboisyei eng' mbareetap chiito ne kiguure Boaz.

Koleenji `Naomi osotyondonooto ki po weeriinnyi, “Ingoberuur Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Boaz! Ma metoi rireenennyi eng' che saptos ak che ki kobek.” Kotestai kora koleenji, “Chiichooto ko chiitap ooreennyo ne neegit.”
Kole Ruth, “Wei, kamwaiwo kole atebee ole neegitee parnotikyik agoi kotar kogosori peek.”
Koleenji `Naomi Ruth, “Cheptonyu, kaigai obe ak otwogik che kwonyiik si ma iimin piik eng' mbareet age.”
Ki tebi kobois anyun ak otwogik che kwonyiik agoi kegosor baale ak nganuuk, ak komeng'iis kobooto korgennyi po yugoi.
Ki leenji `Naomi korgennyi po yugoi, “Cheptonyu, tos ma cheeng'un anee ole imuung'ee, si komyeeit eng' inyee?
Tos ma po ooreennyo Boaz, ne ki omi ak tiibiikyik? Keero, iruri baale kooi kemoi eng' rwanyut ne kiboorsee.
Iungei nguno ak iilgei, ak ilaach ngoroiguk, yeityo iwe olooto mi rwanyut; ago amat iboorchigei ineendet kot kooges amisyet ak eiset.
Ye kagoru, igeer ye karu; iwe anyun ak ing'aany keelyekyik ak iru yooto; si komwaun kiit ne kanyool iyai.”
Ki leenji `Ruth Naomi, “Ayae chooto tugul kemwa.”
Ki choortagei anyun kwo ole mi rwanyut, kwo koyai tugul che kamwachi korgennyi po yugoi.
Ye kingo kagoamis Boaz ak koe ak kobaibait muguleldanyi, kwo koru ye pooch karurugutyetap peek. Ki nyo Ruth mutyo ak kong'aany keelyekyik, ak koru yooto.
Ak kingo ek kemoi kween kosiir chiichooto eng' rwondo, ak koweigei ak eng' yooto konai kole kiruei kwony eng' keelyekyik.
Ki le ineendet, “Ii ng'oo?” Ak ki wol kole, “Aa Ruth cheptong'ung' ne otwoget. Tugee cheptong'ung' ne otwoget ngoryeeng'ung' amu ii chiitap ooreet ne neegit.”
Ki le chiichooto, “Ingoberuurin Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, cheptonyu, kaibooru myeeindo ne oo eng' let kosiir eng' taunet, amu ma isup murenik che mengech, ngo che ponoon anan ngo che mogore.
Nooto anyun cheptonyu, meiywei; ayaun tugul chooto kemwa, amu ingen nganaseet tugul ne po piikyuk kole, ii kwondo ne tinyei atebeet ne nyolunot.
Iman aa chiitap ooreet ne neegit, ago miitei chiito age neta koneegit kosiiro.

Tebi kemouni, ak ngot koyaun chiichooto mutai karon nooto nyolunot eng' chiitap ooreet, ko myee nooto, ko ingoyai nooto nyolunot eng' chiitap ooreet. Ago ngot koma yaun nooto nyolunot eng' chiitap ooreet, ayai anyun nooto nyolunot eng' chiitap ooreet, ko uu ye sabei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor. Ru anyun agoi koeech.”
Ki ru eng' keelyekyik agoi koeech, ak king'eet kotomo kinyit chii. Amu ki le Boaz, “Amengonai chii kole konyo kwony rwanyut.”
Ki leenji, “Ibu ngoryono ilaachi ak itaach.” Ak kingo yai ko uu nooto, ko kigerchi keruutik lo che po baale, ak kogesenji. Ki wo Boaz koweektagei nganaseet.
Kingo it Ruth ole mi korgennyi po yugoi, koteebe koleenji, “Ko uu nee ng'aleek cheptonyu?” Ak ki mwachi ineendet tuguuk tugul che koyachi chiichooto.
Ak ki le, “Kagono kerutichu lo po baale; amu ki le, ‘Amewe puch ole mi korgeng'ung' po yugoi.’ ”
Ki le anyun, “Muitee cheptonyu, kot inai kiit ne egu ng'aleechooto. Amu ma imuunyi agoi koyai kioto chiichooto rani kosulda.”

Kingo togosta Boaz kwo ormariichetap nganaseet ak kotep ng'wony eng' yooto, ko ki nyo kobun yooto chiichooto po ooreet ne neegit nooto ki mwaei Boaz. Ak ki leenji, “Nyoo yu ornyo, ak itep ng'wony.” Ki wo anyun chiichooto ak kotep ng'wony.
Ki kuur `Boaz poisyek taman che po nganaseet ak koleenji, “Obuur eng' yu.” Kobuur anyun icheek.
Ki leenji anyun `Boaz chiitap ooreet ne neegit, “Aldoi Naomi ne ki koweek eng' emetap Moab kooret ne ki po tupchennyo Elimelek.

Koabwaat amwaun ale ial koronooto eng' taitap pichu ibuuri eng' yu, ak eng' taitap poisyegap piikyuk. Ngot imach ityaach, ityaach; ago ngot ko memach ityaach, imwaiwo si anai. Amu ma mi age ne ityaachi kobatenen; ak arubin.” Ak ki wol kole, “Atyachi.”
Ki testai kole Boaz, “Eng' peetuut ne ialeen koronooto Naomi, ko ialeen Ruth chemoabindet agine, osotyotap ne ki kome, si kobiit ilaalji maat ne ki kome eng' porotennyi.”
Ki le chiichooto po ooreet ne neegit, “Ma muuchi atyakyigei, ngayai ko uu nooto amuuch ang'em porotennyu. Ip imandap katyaget ne kata atyachi kobunjiin; amu ma muuchi atyach.”
Ki uu ni piteet ne ki mi Israel agobo katyaget ak agobo waleet: si ki kimiit kayanjinet, ko ki icheru chiito kweiyondennyi ak kogoochi chiitap kokwennyi. Ki piteetap paornateet eng' Israel nooto.
Koleenji anyun `Boaz chiichooto po ooreet ne neegit, “Aljigei.” Ak ki icher kweiyondennyi.
Ki leenji `Boaz poisyek ak piik tugul, “Oo paorinik ra, ole kaal eng' eutap Naomi, tuguuk tugul che ki po Elimelek, ak tuguuk tugul che ki po Kilion ak che ki po Malon.

Kogeny, ko kaal Ruth chemoabindet ne ki osotyotap Malon, koek osotyonnyu, si kobiit alaalji maat eng' porotennyi ineendet ne kime, si ma pet kainennyi eng' tupchosyekyik ak eng' kurgeetap oldanyi. Oo paorinik rani.”

Ki le anyun piik tugul che ki mi ormariichet kobooto poisyek, “Ki paorinik. Ingoyai Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kwondo ne kanyo koong'ung' koigei Rael ak Leah, chooto aeng' che ki teech kootap Israel. Iegu ne nyolu eng' Ephratah ak iegu ne tagunoot eng' Bethlehem.
Ak eng' kesweek che tuun koonin Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' kwonyi, ko ingogergeit koong'ung' ak kootap Peres ne ki sikyi `Tamar Judah.”
Ki imut anyun `Boaz Ruth ak ki ek osotyonnyi. Ki ituiyogei ak ineendet ak ki igoochi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor komanach, ak kosich weeriit.
Ki leenji `kwonyiik Naomi, “Iberuurot Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ne ma pagakten eng' peetuuni ametinye chiitap ooreet ne neegit koalin. Ingotook kainennyi eng' Israel!
Egu ineendet ne weegun saboondang'ung' ak koek ne riibin eng' osindang'ung'; amu osotyotap weeriing'ung', ne chamin, ne kaigai eng' inyee kosiir weeriik tisap, ko kasich lakweet.”
Ki nam `Naomi lakweet ak kotiny eng' tegeennyi, ak ki ek ineendet cheplakwet.
Ki toochi kainet kwonyiigap kokwet, kole, “Kogesikyi Naomi weeriit.” Ki kuure kainennyi Obed. Ineendet kwandap Jesse, kwandap Daudi.
Chu anyun ko ortinwegap Peres: ki sich `Peres Hesron,
kosich `Hesron Ram ak kosich `Ram Aminadab,
ki sich `Aminadab Nason, kosich `Nason Salmon,
ki sich `Salmon Boaz, kosich `Boaz Obed,
ki sich `Obed Jesse ak kosich Jesse Daudi.
Ki mi chii ne ki kiguure Elkanah ne po Ramataim ne ki po Suphim ne po emetap tuloonoogap Ephraim. Ki weeriitap Jeroham, weeriitap Elihu, weeriitap Tohu, weeriitap Suph Ephraimindet.
Ki tinyei osotik aeng'; kainetap age ko ki Hannah ak kainetap age ko ki Peninnah. Ki tinyei Peninnah lagok ago ki ma kotinyei Hannah lakwa.

Ki cham kotogostoi chiichooto eng' nganasennyi eng' kenyiit age tugul kowendi kosaaei ak kogoochin Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne po lugoosyek tiseiywek eng' Shiloh. Ki mi yooto weeriik aeng' che po Eli, Hopni ak Phineas, icheeget che ki tisiigap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Kingo it peetuut ne igoitoi Elkanah tiseiywek, ko ki igoochin kebeberwek Peninnah osotyonnyi, weeriikyik tugul ak tiibiikyik,
ago ki igoochin Hannah kebeberwek aeng' amu ki chamei `Elkanah ineendet nga kiga rat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor moennyi.
Kitach `syennyi ineendet kole si kogereer met amu kiga rat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor moennyi.
Ki testai ko uu nooto Elkanah eng' kenyiit age tugul, ak ye kitogostoi Hannah kowendi kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, kotestai kotaach `ineendet kwonyooto. Ki igooch koriir anyun, ak ma amis.
Ki leenji `Elkanah manong'otyondennyi, “Hannah, iriirchini nee? Amu nee si meamisyei? Amu nee si koarageni muguleldang'ung'? Tos ma aa kaigai eng' inyee kosiir weeriik taman?”
Ki ng'eet anyun Hannah ye kingo kagoamis ak koeeiso eng' Shiloh. Ki tisiindet Eli ne kitebyei eng' ye po tugatukyetap kurgeet ne po hekaluutap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Eng' ng'wanindo ne ki tinyei eng' saboondanyi ko ki sa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' riirek ak eng' ng'wanindo.

Ki yai kayasyoet kole, “Ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne po lugoosyek, ngot igeer nyalildap cheptong'ung' ne otwoget ak ibwaata ak ko meutye cheptong'ung' ne otwoget, ak igoochi weeriit, agoochini anyun weeroto Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' peetuusyekyik tugul kotee kosabei, ama kicheru suumeekyik.”
Ye kita kosaaei eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, kogeer Eli kutinnyi.
Ki ng'alaali Hannah eng' muguleldanyi. Kitwau kutinnyi kityo ago ki ma kegasei tweguunennyi. Eng' nooto, kobwaat anyun Eli kole aleen kabogit.
Koleenji Eli, “Ibogiti kot kotyanit? Iste divaiguk.”
Ago ki wol Hannah kole, “Achicha, kiptaiyandennyu, aa kwony ne iimat kot. Maee divaik anan ko maiyek, ago katyach saboondanyu eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Meit cheptong'ung' ne otwoget ile chii puch. Amu koang'alaal agoi rani eng' chaang'indap kang'unyng'unyennyu ak choteet ne kichoto ak ketacha.”
Ki wol anyun Eli kole, “Ui eng' kaalyeet; ak ingogoonin Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindetap Israel soomeng'ung' ne kesoom ineendet.”
Kole Hannah, “Ingonyoor otwogeng'ung' myeeindo eng' taing'ung'.” Ki wo anyun kwonyooto ak koamis, amata konyoor kaimetapkei kogeny.

Eng' peetuut ne ki rubei, kong'eetyo anyun karon miising' kap Elkanah ak kogutung'so eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, yeityo koweek agoi koonnywa eng' Ramah. Ki tuiyo Elkanah ak Hannah osotyonnyi ak ki ibwaat `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kwonyooto.
Ki manach anyun Hannah ak kosich weeriit. Kiguure kainennyi Samuel koleen, “Amu ki asoom ineendet eng' Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.”
Ki togosta Elkanah kobooto koonnyi tugul kwo kogoochi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor tiseiywotap kenyiit age tugul ak koyaakta kaarortoennyi.
Ago ma togosta Hannah, amu ki leenji manong'otyondennyi, “Ma wendi kot aluge lakweet, si amut kwo taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kwo kotebee olooto agoi.”

Ki mwachi `Elkanah manong'otyondennyi koleenji, “Yai ko uu ye igeere ile myee, tebi kot iluge lakweet ago ingogimiit `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ng'olyoondennyi.” Ki tep anyun kwonyooto kochuchun lakweennyi ne ki weeriit kot koluge.

Ye kingo kagoluge ak ye kita ko ming'in lakwanooto, komut ineendet kwo kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' Shiloh. Ki kweri kiruugik somok ak koip kiloinik taman che po peek che ng'ootiin kobooto soteet agenge ne po divaik.
Ki eeny kirgit ak komutyi Eli lakweet.
Ak ki mwa kwonyooto kole, “Ee kiptaiyandennyu, ko uu ye isabe, ko aa kwonyo kitononi eng' yu kimi, asaae Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Lakwani ne ki asoome ak kigogoono `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor soomennyu ne ki asoom ineendet.
Nooto anyun, kaagoochi ineendet Kamuktaindet ne Toroor. Kotee kosabei, ko ki agoochi `ineendet Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.” Ak ki itoroor Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' yooto.
Ak ki sa Hannah kole: “Igasegei muguleldanyu eng' Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, kagotesak kimnateennyu eng' Kamuktaindet ne Toroor. Arorechini puunikyuk, amu abaibai eng' yetuneng'ung'.
Ma mi ne tiliil ko uu Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ma mi age kobatenen; ama mi rwandet ne uu Kamuktaindennyo.
Among'alaal eng' menoteet, anan komang'une kutusweekwok lasetapkei. Amu Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ko Kamuktaindet ne po naet tugul, eng' ineendet ko naaksei ole uu poisyonik.
Ildos kwangogap piik che nyigoonen, ak kermenotin eng' kimnateet icheeget che ki kiinach.
Icheeget che ki piyong'otiin, ko aldagei si konyoor amitwogik, ko che ki amei rubeet kobiyong'otiin. Ineendet ne soon ko kigosich tisap, ago ineendet ne tinyei lagok che chaang' ko nyaluli.
Parei `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ak kosaabi. Choortoi koba kererit ak komutu kotogos.
Ibanani `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor chii ak komogornoni. Iming'ini ak koeeti.

Ing'eeti kibananook komang'une temburyek, ak ko kanabu eng' kapng'atat che ma tinyei kiy, si kogoochi kotebi ak pounik, ak kosich ng'echereetap toroornatet. Amu po Kamuktaindet ne Toroor tolochigap ng'wony, ak ki konde ng'wony kotonone chooto.
Riibei keelyegap piik che iywei ineendet, ago yaei kiptengeginik kolusyo eng' imenindo. Amu ma eng' kimnon si kobelis chii.

Ki ng'emei che ibeligei ak Kamuktaindet ne Toroor; tuljin icheek ko uu ilat ne ng'eete kipsengwet. Irwookyin Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ng'wony komugul; igoochin kimnateet laitoryandennyi, ak kogoochi kabelisyet nenyi ne iilaat.”
Kingo pata, kwo Elkanah kaa eng' Ramah, ak kong'et lakweet koboisyechi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' taitap tisiindet Eli.
Weeriigap Eli ko kingelelik; ki ma kotinyei kaiyweisyo agobo Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Kingo koito chii tiseiywot ko uu piteetap tisiik eng' piik, ko ki iyooktoi icheek otwogindetap tisiindet ye kita kiyoi panyeek, kotinyei eng' euut karnet ne ki sagunegei somok ne ki rutune panyeek,

si korookta karnanooto tereet oriit anan kibiriget anan saburyet anan ko tereetap ng'ung'unyek si koipchigei `tisiindet panyeek tugul che kainem karnanooto. Ki yachin ko uu nooto piigap Israel tugul eng' Shiloh che kibwanei yooto.
Kingo tomo kobeel mwaita, konyo otwogindetap tisiindet ak koleenji chiito ne kieng'sei, “Koonu pendo ne kiwatanjin tisiindet, amu ma ibei pendo ne kagiyo ne igoonu, kobatee ne tuon.”
Ngot koleenji `chiito ineendet, “Ingobeelak sunetik korook, yeityo iip che tee che imache,” kowolu anyun koleen, “Achicha, koono nguno ngot ko megoono aibe eng' kimnateet.”
Ki oo miising' tengektap murenjooto eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, amu ki it kagoochinoigap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ko tugun che ma kiy.
Nga ki lakwa Samuel, ko ki poisyei ineendet eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, kolaachi ephod ne po katanit.
Eng' kenyiit age tugul koginapchin kamet ngoryeet ne ming'in ak koipchi ineendet ye kibendi ak manong'otyondennyi kogoitoi tiseiywegap kenyiit age tugul.
Ki iberuur `Eli Elkanah ak osotyonnyi, koleen, “Ingogoonin Kamuktaindet ne Toroor iyoteet eng' kwonyi kogeer nooto ki isoom ak igoochi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.” Yeityo koba kaa.
Ki rutoochi `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Hannah ak kingo manach, kosich weeriik somok ak tiibiik aeng'. Ak kieet lakweet Samuel eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Nga kiga koosit Eli miising', ko ki kas tuguuk tugul che kiyachin weeriikyik Israel tugul, ak ko uu ye ki ibegei ak kwonyiik che kiboisyei eng' kurgeetap emait ne kituiyechin.
Ki leenji icheek, “Amu nee si oyai tuguuk che uu cho? Agase eng' pichu tugul poisyonikwok che yaacheen.
Achicha, weeriikyuk; ma myee atepto ne agase komwaati piigap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.

Ngot koyachi chii chiito age tengek, korwookyin Kamuktaindet. Ago ngot koyachi chii tengek Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ko ng'oo ne saaei agobo ineendet?” Ago ki ma kas ng'aleegap kwandanywa, amu kimachei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kobar icheek.
Ki eet anyun lakwanooto Samuel ak ki chamat eng' Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ak eng' piik ak icheek.
Ki nyoonji `chiitap Kamuktaindet Eli ak koleenji, “Kamwa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ko uu ni, ‘Tos ki ma ang'aang'jigei kootap kwandang'ung' ye ki miitei Misiri eng' kootap Pharaoh?

Ak ki alewen ineendet eng' pororyosyek tugul che po Israel koek tisiindennyu, kotogosta ole mi kapkorosunnyu, kwo kobeel nyamdutik ak kolaach ephod eng' tainnyu? Tos ma ki agoochi kootap kwandang'ung' kagoochinoik tugul che po Yahudik che kigoitoi kobun maat?
Amu nee anyun si otyar tiseiywekyuk ak kagoochinoikyuk che ki ang'at eng' meng'ootennyu? Amu nee si igonyit weeriiguk kosiiro ak oneryee kagoochinoik che eecheen eng' tugul che po piikyuk Israel?’

Nooto anyun mwaei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindetap Israel kole, ‘Ki amwa iman ale, wendoti eng' tainnyu koong'ung' ak kootap kwandang'ung' koigeny.’ Ago kamwa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor nguno kole, ‘Ingolooit eng' anee!’ Icheek che konyita, agonyiti, ago icheeget che ma iita kole aa kiy, kesasei.
Keero pwoonei peetuusyek che atile eung'ung' ak eutap kootap kwandang'ung' kot koma piit poiyo eng' koong'ung'.
Iimigei ye igeere mogornateet tugul ne igoochin `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Israel, ak ma piitu poiyo eng' koong'ung' agoi.
Ak chiing'ung' ne ma istoi anee eng' kapkorosunnyu koegu ne igeesu konyeguk ak kogoochi arageneet muguleldang'ung'. Pegu iyoteet tugul ne po koong'ung' kota ko neran.
Ak egu ni kaboorunet ne tuun nyoonjin weeriiguk aeng' Hopni ak Phineas; pegu tuwai eng' peetuut agenge.
Ak ang'eetyigei tisiindet ne kiyani ne tuun yaei kiit ne mi muguleldanyu ak eng' kabwaatutikyuk ak ateekyi ineendet koot ne kiim, ak kowendote taitap nenyu ne iilaat koigeny.

Tuun nyoonei age tugul ne kang'et eng' koong'ung' konyo kong'uruukyi ineendet si konyoor fedhaiyat ak magatyat ak kole, ‘Asoomin ale indea aek age eng' poisyonigap tisiik si aam agot magatyat kitigin.’ ”
Ki poisyechin lakwanooto `Samuel Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' taitap Eli. Ki ma kota kegasei ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' peetuusyechooto, ak ki ma komi ng'ang'utyet ne taagu.
Ye kingo ru Eli peetuut age eng' oldanyi, kigatoi kogoryo konyekyik ak ki ma kogeerei kiy,
ye kitom kome tait ne po Kamuktaindet, ak ko kagoru Samuel eng' hekaluutap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' ole ki mi moingetap Kamuktaindet,
koguur `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Samuel, ak ki le, “Ami yu.”
Ak kilabat ole mi Eli ak koleenji, “Ami yu, amu keguura.” Koleenji Eli, “Ma aguurin, ui ru.” Ak ki wo koru.
Ki kuur `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kogeny kole, “Samuel!” Ki ng'eet Samuel kogeny ak kwo ole mi Eli, koleenji, “Ami yu amu keguura.” Ki wolji Eli koleenji, “Ma aguurin, weeriinnyu, weegen, ui ru.”
Kitom konai `Samuel Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ak kitom keng'aang'ji ineendet ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ki kuur `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Samuel kogeny ne po somok. Ak king'eet kwo ole mi Eli ak koleenji, “Ami yu amu keguura.” Eng' yooto anyun, konai Eli kole kaguur Kamuktaindet ne Toroor lakwanooto.
Koleenji anyun `Eli Samuel, “Ui iru, ak ngot koguurin kogeny, imwa ile, ‘Ng'alaal Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, amu ebei iit otwogindeng'ung'.’ ” Kwo anyun Samuel koru eng' oldanyi.
Ki nyo `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ak kotonon, koguur ko uu tai, kole, “Samuel! Samuel!” Ak ki wol Samuel kole, “Ng'alaal amu ebei iit otwogindeng'ung'.”
Koleenji `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Samuel, “Ayae kiit eng' Israel ne tang'anyee chii age tugul ne kasei.
Eng' peetuunooto ayachini Eli tuguuk tugul che ki amwa agobo koonnyi, kobooch taunet agoi let.
Ki amwachi aleenji arwookyini koonnyi koigeny amu tengekto ne ki ingen amu ki ipchigei `weeriikyik chubisyet ama kergong'.
Nooto anyun ki ayosye agobo kootap Eli ale, ma kitisei tengektap kootap Eli eng' tiseiywot anan ko eng' kagoochinoik agoi.”
Ki ru anyun Samuel agoi koeech, yeityo koyaat kurgotigap kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor. Ki iywei Samuel koboorchi Eli ng'ang'utyonooto.
Ki kuur `Eli Samuel ak koleenji, “Weeriinnyu Samuel.” Ak ki le, “Ami yu.”

Ak kiteepsee Eli kole, “Nee kiit ne komwaun Kamuktaindet ne Toroor? Asoomin ale ameung'ena ng'olyoondonooto. Ingoyaun Kamuktaindet ak ngo yaun ne siirei nooto, ngot iung'ena kiy age tugul eng' tuguuk tugul che komwaun ineendet.”
Ki mwachi anyun Samuel kiy age tugul, ak ma ung'e kiy ineendet. Ak ki le Eli, “Ineendet ko Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ingoyai ko uu ye keerei kole myee.”
Ki eet Samuel ak ki mi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kobooto ineendet, ak ki ma komi kiy eng' ng'aleek che kiga komwa Samuel ne ma isulda.
Kobooch Dan agoi Beer-sheba ko ki nai Israel tugul kole Samuel iman ko maotyotap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ak ki testai koboorgei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' Shiloh: king'aang'jigei `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Samuel eng' Shiloh kobun ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ki ityi ng'olyootap `Samuel Israel tugul. Ki manda Israel anyun koba kobargei ak Philistiik. Ki teech Yahudik emainnywa eng' ole neegitee Eben-haezer, koteech Philistiik nenywa eng' Apek.
Ki tetkei Philistiik si kobargei ak Israel. Ye kingo tuiyo lugeet, ko ki iterteer `Philistiik Israel. Ki par piigap lugeet che po Israel olo po eliphuusyek ang'wan eng' koronooto.

Ye kingo it piigap lugeetap Israel nganaseet, koteep poisyegap Israel kole, “Amu nee si kobarech Kamuktaindet ne Toroor rani eng' taitap Philistiik? Ongeibu moingetap arorutyetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' Shiloh konyo kwenunnyo si kosarwech eng' eunegap puunikyok.”

Ki kiyookto anyun piik koba Shiloh, ak ki ip eng' yooto moingetap arorutyetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne po lugoosyek ne tebee kerubisyek. Ki imi yooto anyun Hopni ak Phineas, weeriichooto aeng'u po Eli kobooto moingetap arorutyetap Kamuktaindet.
Ye kingo it moingetap arorutyetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor nganaseet, kowaach Israel tugul eng' waagaat ne oo kot kochei emet.
Kingo kas Philistiik polatetap waagaat, koteebegei koleenjigei, “Ngu po nee waagaandani oo eng' nganaseetap Yahudik?” Kingo nai Philistiik kole kagoit moingetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor nganaseet,
koywei amu ki le, “Kanyo kamuktaindet nganaseet.” Kotestai kole, “Pwo eng' acheek! Amu tomo kobiitu kiit ne uu ni kobooch keny.
Pwo acheek! Ng'oo ne sarwech eng' kamuktaichu kiimeen? Chu ko kamuktaik cho ki parei Misiriik koboree korotwo alak tugul eng' surkwen.
Ogimegitu ak oegu murenik, ee okweek Philistiik si moegu otwogigap Yahudik ko uu ye ki otwogikwok icheek. Onyiganiitu ko uu muren anyun ak oyai lugeet.”
Ki yai Philistiik lugeet ak koterteer Israel, ak ki mwei chii age tugul komwechi emainnyi. Ki piit pareet ne oo miising' amu ki pek kiplugotiniigap Israel eliphuusyek sosomu che punei keelyek.
Ki kiip moingetap Kamuktaindet ak kebar Hopni ak Phineas, weeriichooto aeng' po Eli.
Ki labat chii ne po ooreetap Benjamin eng' ole kimi lugeet peetuunooto agoi Shiloh ko kagogereer ngoroikyik ak komi ng'ung'unyek metinnyi.

Ye kingo it, ko ki tebee `Eli ng'echerennyi eng' tabandap ooreet koriipsei, amu kibotani muguleldanyi agobo moingetap Kamuktaindet. Kingo it chiichooto nganaseet ak komwa ng'aleechooto, kowaach nganaseet tugul.
Kingo kas `Eli polatetap riirek koteep kole, “Po nee polatoni wasegei piik?” Ki wo chiichooto kochaakta ak komwachi Eli.
Ki po Eli kenyiisyek tamanwogik sogool ak sisiit, ak kiga kogor ne ki mata komuuchi kogeer kiy.
Ki mwachi `chiichooto Eli koleenji, “Aa ineendet ne kabunu ole mi lugeet; kaamweu eng' ole mi lugeet.” Koteepse anyun Eli koleenji, “Kalya o, weeriinnyu?”

Kowol ineendet ne ki ibu ng'aleek kole, “Kagomwei Israel eng' taitap Philistiik ak kagobiit pareet ne oo eng' piik. Kagobek ak icheek weeriiguk tuwai, Hopni ak Phineas, ak kageip moingetap Kamuktaindet.”

Kingo mwa agobo moingetap Kamuktaindet, koobut Eli kobun patai eng' ng'echerennyi eng' tabandap ormariichet. Ki ng'et kaatinnyi ak kome, amu ki chii ne kiga koosit ak konyigiis kot. Kiga koek kirwoogindetap Israel kenyiisyek artam.

Ki tomono osotyotap Phineas weeriitap Eli ak ki neegit kosigiis. Ye kingo kas ng'aleek keele kageip moingetap Kamuktaindet, ak kagome kwandap manong'otyondennyi kobooto manong'otyondennyi, konyoonji ineendet ng'wanindap sigisyo. Ki ing'uruuk anyun si kosigiis amu ki nyoonji ng'wanindap sigisyo ne oo.
Ye ki neegit kome, komwachi kwonyiik che kitoreti ineendet koleenji, “Meiywei, amu kesich weeriit.” Ago ma wol kiy anan koepchi iit ng'aleechooto.
Kiguure lakwanooto Ikabod koboor kole kagoistogei toroornatet eng' Israel, amu kageip moingetap Kamuktaindet, ak amu meetap kwandap manong'otyondennyi ak ne po manong'otyondennyi.
Ki mwa kole, “Kagoistogei toroornatet eng' Israel; amu kageip moingetap Kamuktaindet.”
Kingo luul Philistiik moingetap Kamuktaindet, koip eng' Eben-haezer kwo Ashdod.
Ki ip Philistiik moingonooto po Kamuktaindet ak konde kootap Dagon, ole neegitee Dagon.
Ye kingo ng'eetyo piigap Ashdod karon miising' eng' peetuutap aeng' ko kiga koluul Dagon kosyep moo eng' taitap moingetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor. Ki ing'eet Dagon ak konde komostanyi kogeny.

Ago ye kingo ng'eetyo karon miising' eng' peetuutap somok, ko kogoluul Dagon kogeny kosyep moo eng' taitap moingetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor. Kiga kong'et metitap Dagon kobooto eunekyik tuwai, ak ki ruei eng' kurgat. Ki ng'eet ineegei poorto komugul.
Nooto anyun amu nee si agoi ra ko matyechei kurgeetap Dagon eng' Ashdod tisiigap Dagon ak tugul che chutei hekaluutap Dagon.
Kinyigiisyi `eutap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor piigap Ashdod ak kogoochi icheek koaragenso ak kobire myando ne ibwansei Ashdod komugul ak kiwotosyekyik.
Kingo keer piigap Ashdod tuguuk che ki yaagiis, kole, “Ma kotebyei moingetap Kamuktaindetap Israel kobootech amu kagong'wanit eunnyi eng' acheek ak eng' Dagon kamuktaindennyo.”

Ki iyookto che kiyooktoi kole kiyum kiptainik tugul che po Philistiik kobwa ole mi icheek ak koleenji, “Kilyonjini moingetap Kamuktaindetap Israel?” Kowol kole, “Ngeip moingetap Kamuktaindetap Israel kot koit Gath.” Ki ip anyun moingetap Kamuktaindetap Israel.
Ago ye kingo kagoip, konyaliil `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor nganasanooto eng' kanyaliilet ne oo miising'. Ki pir piik che mengech ak che eecheen che po nganaseet ak ki mang'une icheek myando ne ibwansei.
Ki iyookto moingetap Kamuktaindet kwo Ekron. Kingo it moingetap Kamuktaindet Ekron, kowaach Ekronik kole, “Kagoibwech moingetap Kamuktaindetap Israel konyo kobarech ak piikyok.”

Ki iyookto ak icheek che kiyooktoi ak koyum kiptainik tugul che po Philistiik kotuiyo ak kole, “Oiste moingetap Kamuktaindetap Israel kwo si ma parech ak piikyok.” Amu ki piit kanyaliilet ne po meet eng' nganaseet komugul ak konyigiisyi miising' eutap Kamuktaindet olooto.
Piik che ma pek ko ki kibiree myando ne ibwansei; kitogosta kipsengwet riiregap nganaseet.
Ki tebee moingetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor emetap Philistiik arawek tisap.
Ki kuur anyun Philistiik tisiik ak che ng'oorsei ak koleenji, “Ki itoi nee moingetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor? Oboorwech ole kiweektoitoi kwo oldanyi.”

Ak ki wol kole, “Ngot oweekte moingetap Kamuktaindetap Israel, ko matoweekte puch, ago matiny kilya oweektochini ineendet kobooto kagoochinetap chalwokto. Ngo yai ko uu nooto kisoobok, ak kong'ang'wogei ineendet, ngo ma uu nooto koma istogei eunnyi eng' okweek.”

Koteep anyun kole, “Nee kagoochinetap chalwokto ne kiweekyini ineendet?” Kowol tisiik kole “Kabwanutik muut che po thahabu ak mureek muut che po thahabu, ko uu koitetap kiptainigap Philistiik, amu ki mong'jok koroito agenge okweek tugul kobooto kiptainikwok.

Nooto anyun, oyai itoonwegap kabwanutikwok ak itoonwegap murekwok che ng'emei emet, si kobiit otoroor Kamuktaindetap Israel tamangap ko tustus eunnyi eng' okweek ak eng' kanamonikwok ak eng' emeng'wong'.
Amu nee anyun si ouiit mugulelwekwok ko uu ye ki iuit Misiriik ak Pharaoh mugulelwekwak? Kingo kagoyai tuguuk eng' kwong'eet eng' kwenunnywa, ko tos ma chamji pichooto koba, ak ki pa?
Oyai anyun chepkichutit ne leel ak onam tuuga aeng' che aboen che tomo kerat; oratyi chepkichutinooto tuchaata, ago oget moekwak kobwa kaa.
Oip moingetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ak onde chepkichutit; ak onde sandugut ne mi tabandanyi, tuguugap thahabu che oweektochini koek kagoochinetap chalwokto ak oyookte kwo.

Ak ogeer; ngot kotogosta kobun kiwotennyi kowendi Beth-shemesh, ko kaagaa ko ineendet ne kiyaiywech yaityoni oo. Ago ngot koma pun, kenai anyun keele ma eunnyi ne kobirech ago kaagaa kiy ne koityech puch.”
Ki yai pichooto ko uu nooto. Ki ket tuuga aeng' che aboen ak koratyi chepkichutit ak koger moekwak eng' kaa.
Yeityo konde moingetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor chepkichutit ak sandugut ne mi mureek che po thahabu ak itoonwegap kabwanutikwak che ki kiyai.

Ki pun tuuga chooto ooreet ne litit ne wendi Beth-shemesh. Ki pun ooreet ne oo koutyoti ama masta koba eutap tai anan ko ne po kaataam ak ki isup kiptainigap Philistiik kot koit kiwotetap Beth-shemesh.
Kigesei nganuukwak piigap Beth-shemesh eng' atebweet. Kitobendo ak kogeer moinget, ak kiboiboitu kot ko kageer.

Ki it chepkichutinooto mbareetap Joshua ne po Beth-shemesh, ak ki tonon eng' yooto, eng' ole ki mi koita ne oo. Ki pet keetiigap chepkichutinooto ak kogoito tuuga chooto koek kagoochinet ne kibeeljin Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.

Ki inem `Lawiik moingetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ak sandugut ne ki mi yooto ne ki mi tuguuk che po thahabu oriit ak konde paragutap koyato oo. Ki igoito piigap Beth-shemesh kagoochinoik che kibeelei ak koeng'ji Kamuktaindet ne Toroor tiseiywot eng' peetuunooto.
Kingo kagogeer kiptainik muutu che po Philistiik tuguuchooto, koweek koba Ekron peetuunooto.

Chu ko kabwanutik che ki kiyae thahabu che kiweektoochi `Philistiik Kamuktaindet ne Toroor koek kagoochinetap chalwokto: po agenge Ashdod, ko po agenge Gaza, po agenge Askelon, ko po agenge Gath, ak ko po agenge Ekron.

Ki iyookto kora mureek che ki kiyae thahabu, ko uu koitetap nganasook tugul che po Philistiik che ki po kiptainik muut, che ki po nganasook che ng'ootaatiin ak nganasook che mengeechen eng' emet. Koyato oo, ne ki kinde moingetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kotonone, komi agoi rani kooretap Joshua ne po Beth-shemesh.

Ki pir `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Beth-shemesh amu ki it moingetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kogeer oriit. Ki par `ineendet piik tamanwogik tisap eng' pichooto ak piik eliphuusyek konom. Ki riiryo piik amu ki par `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor piik eng' pareet ne oo.
Ki le piigap Beth-shemesh, “Ng'oo ne imuuchi kotonon eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindani tiliil? Ak togostoi eng' olinnyo kowendi ole mi ng'oo?”
Ki iyookto piik koba ole mi meng'iigap Kiriath-Jearim koleenji, “Kagoip Philistiik moingetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor konyo oli, ara obwa ochooruge ak oip kotogosta kwo oling'wong'.”

Ki pwa anyun piigap Kiriath-Jearim ak koip moingetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kotogosta. Ki ip kwo kootap Abinadab eng' tulweet ak kotabaan `Eleazar weeriinnyi si koriip moingetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Kichaang'it peetuusyek kobooch ngo tebee moinget Kiriath-Jearim; ki ek kenyiisyek tiptem, ak ki riirchi koot tugul ne po Israel Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.

Ki leenji `Samuel koot tugul ne po Israel, “Ngot oweekyinigei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' mugulelwekwok tugul, ko nyolu oiste kamuktaik che pororyosyek alak ak Astarot eng' kwenung'wong' ak otokyi mugulelwekwok Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ak oot ineendet ineegei, si kosarwok eng' eunegap Philistiik.”
Ki isto anyun `piigap Israel Baalik ak Astarot ak koot Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ineegei.
Ki le Samuel, “Oyumji Israel tugul Mispa, si kobiit asaiywok Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.”

Ki iyumjigei tugul Mispa ak kiram peek ak kotumda eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor. Ki irugutkei peetuunooto ak komwa eng' yooto kole, kigeyachi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor tengekto. Ki irwookyi anyun `Samuel piigap Israel eng' Mispa.
Kingo kas Philistiik kole koiyumgei piigap Israel eng' Mispa, koba kiptainigap Philistiik kotogosta kobargei ak Israel. Ak kingo kas piigap Israel, koywei Philistiik.
Ki leenji `piigap Israel Samuel, “Amebagaakte iriirchi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindennyo agobo acheek, si kosarwech eng' eunegap Philistiik.”

Ki nam Samuel aarwetap keechiir ne reryei ak kogoito komugul koek kagoochinet ne kibeeljin Kamuktaindet ne Toroor. Ak ki riirchi `Samuel Kamuktaindet ne Toroor agobo Israel ak ki wolji `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ineendet.

Ye kingo ta kogoitoi Samuel kagoochinet ne kibeelei, koriik Philistiik kobwa kobargei ak Israel. Ago kitulji `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Philistiik eng' tuleet ne oo peetuunooto ak konyaliil icheek ak ki kibar eng' taitap Israel.
Ki manda piigap Israel eng' Mispa koba koon Philistiik ak kobarat agoi koit Beth-ka keel.
Ki nam `Samuel koita konde kwenutap Mispa ak Sen, ak koguuree kainennyi Eben-haezer kole, “Agoi nguno ko ki kotoretech Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.”
Ki kiterteer anyun Philistiik, ak matagai kobwa kogeny kosiir kiwotetap Israel. Ki kirinda `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Philistiik eng' peetuusyek tugul che po Samuel.
Ki kiweekyi Israel nganasook che kiga koibe Philistiik, kobooch Ekron kot koit Gath, ak ki iweek Israel kiwotennyi eng' eutap Philistiik. Ki piit kaalyeet eng' kwenutap Israel ak Amorik.
Ki irwookyi `Samuel Israel eng' peetuusyek tugul che po sabeennyi.
Kiwendi eng' kenyiit age tugul komuutoti Bethel, Gilgal ak Mispa, ak ki irwookyi Israel eng' komoswechooto tugul.
Kiweekyingei Ramah, amu kimi koonnyi yooto ak ki irwookyi Israel eng' olooto, ak kiteekyi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kaptisisyet eng' yooto.
Kingo osit Samuel, konde weeriikyik koek kirwoogik che pou Israel.
Kainetap taaitanyi ko ki Joel, ne po aeng' ko ki Abijah. Ki kirwoogik tuwai eng' Beer-sheba.
Ma pendate weeriikyik ortinwekyik, ago kimasta kosup mogornateet eng' ooreet ne ya. Kitaach asoya ak komaas kirwooget.
Ki iyumgei anyun poisyek tugul che po Israel ak kobwa ole mi Samuel eng' Ramah,
ak koleenji ineendet, “Keero, kaiositu, ama pendote weeriiguk ortinweguk. Ara anyun cheeng'wech laitoryat ne irwokwech ko uu pororyosyek tugul.”
Ki ma paibait Samuel kingo mwa icheek kole, “Koonech laitoryat ne irwokwech.” Ki sa `Samuel Kamuktaindet ne Toroor,
ak koleenji `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Samuel, “Kas ng'aleegap piik agobo tuguuk tugul che kamwaun, amu ma inyee ne kaeesyo ago kaeesyo anee kole ma egu laitoryat eng' icheek.
Ko uu poisyonik tugul che ki koyai icheek kobooch peetuut ne ki amutu kotogos eng' Misiri kot koit ra, kobagaaktoa ak kootot kamuktaik alak, koyaun aginye ko uu nooto.
Kasyi anyun ng'aleekwak, ago iteechi komyee ak iboorchi kiit ne uu laitoryat ne tuun laitorane icheek.”
Ki mwachi `Samuel pichooto kisoomei eng' ineendet laitoryat ng'aleek tugul che po Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ki le, “Uu ni laitoryat ne tuun laitoranenok: namei weeriikwok ak kolewenjigei kotononji kariisyekyik koek che laanyei paraisisyekyik ak korwai kondoe kariisyekyik;
ak kolewenjigei icheeget koek kiptainigap eliphuusyek ak kiptainigap konomusyek, ak kobat mbareenikyik alage, ak koges peekyik ak kotany kariikyik che po lugeet ak tuguugap kariisyekyik.
Namei tiibiikwok koek che yaei nyamdutik, ak koek che kwanyei ak che peelei magatiinik.
Rebenak mbareenikwok ak mbareenikwok che po sabibuk ak che po mseituni che korooron eng' tugul ak kogoochi otwogikyik.
Ibei kebeberta agenge eng' taman ne po kesweekwok ak ne po mbareenikwok che po sabibuk si kogoochi kiboitiinikyik ak otwogikyik.
Ak korebenak otwogikwok che murenik, otwogikwok che tiibiik, neranikwok che korooron ak sigirokwok yeityo konde koyai poisyonikyik.
Ibei kora kebeberta agenge eng' taman ne po keechiirekwok ak oegu okweek otwogikyik.
Ak oriirye eng' peetuunooto amu laitoryandeng'wong' ne olewenjinigei, ago mawolwok Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' peetuunooto.”
Ago ki eesyo piik kogas kateunetap Samuel, ak ki le, “Achicha, kimache laitoryat ne poiywech,
si keigei ak acheek pororyosyek tugul ak si korwookwech laitoryandennyo ak komandoi kondoenech koyaiywech lugosyekyok.”
Kingo kas Samuel ng'aleek tugul che po piik, ko ki ipchi komwachi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ng'aleechooto.
Ak ki leenji `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Samuel, “Kasyi ng'aleekwak ak icheeng'ji icheek laitoryat.” Koleenji `Samuel piigap Israel, “Ingwo chii tugul nganasennyi.”
Ki mi chii ne ki tagunoot ak ko kiim ne po ooreetap Benjamin ne kainennyi ko ki Kish weeriitap Abiel, weeriitap Seror, weeriitap Bekorat, weeriitap Apia, weeriitap Benjaminindet.
Ki tinyei weeriit ne ki kiguure kainennyi Saulo, neraneet ne karaaran. Ki ma komi chii ne karaaran kosiir ineendet eng' piigap Israel! Ki kooi kosiir chii tugul.
Eng' pesyo ko kibetyo sigiroigap Kish kwandap Saulo. Ki leenji `Kish weeriinnyi Saulo, “Imut agenge eng' otwogik ak obe ocheeng' sigiroik.”
Ki pa kobun emetap tuloonoogap Ephraim ak emetap Salisa, ago ma nyoor. Ki pa kora kobun emetap Saalim ago ki ma komi olooto. Koba kogeny kobun emetap piigap Benjamin ago ma nyoor.
Kingo it emetap Suph, koleenji `Saulo otwogindennyi ne ki mi tuwai, “Myee keeweege, nda puch ko pagaachi kwandanyu kobwaati agobo sigiroik ak konam kogererchech met.”

Koleenji otwogindet, “Keero, miitei nganasani chiitap Kamuktaindet, ak ineendet ko chiito ne kigonyiti, ak ko tuguuk tugul che mwaei kosuldoi iman. Ngebe anyun yooto tamangap komuuch komwaiwech agobo pandanyo ne kibendi.”
Koleenji `Saulo otwogindennyi, “Ngot keebe keipchini nee chiichooto? Kagogeskei amitwogik eng' tuguuk che ko ki ibune, ama mi kagoochinet ne keipchini chiichooto po Kamuktaindet. Nee ne ketinye?”
Kowolji `otwogindonooto Saulo kogeny koleenji, “Atinye eng' eunnyu kebeberta agenge eng' ang'wan ne po shekelitap fedha. Agoochini nooto chiitap Kamuktaindet si komwaiwech agobo pandanyo.”
(Kingwo chii keny eng' Israel kwo koteebe Kamuktaindet ng'olyoo, komwaei kole, “Obwa keebe kapkeerindet” amu ineendet ne kiguure maotyot nguno, ko ki kiguuren keny keerindet.)
Koleenji anyun `Saulo otwogindennyi, “Kemwa kiit ne myee, nyoo keebe.” Koba anyun nganaseet ole ki mi chiitap Kamuktaindet.
Ye kingo togostoi kobendi nganaseet, konyoor tiibiin che kibendi koramei peek. koteebee koleenji, “Mi keerindet yu?”
Kowolji tiipchooto koleenji, “Ee, mi taing'ung'. Chaakte amu kata koitu nganaseet nguno ak amu tinyei piik ra tiseiywot eng' kapkoros.

Ne po oititoi kityo nganaseet, onyooru ineendet eng' yooto kotomo kotogosta kapkoros koamis. Ma amisyei piik kot koit ineendet, amu ineendet ne iberuuri tiseiywot ak ye ibata koamis piik che kagiguur. Otogoste anyun nguno, amu onyooru ineendet eng' sainiito.”
Ki togosta anyun koba nganaseet ak ye kingo chut nganaseet oriit, komong' Samuel ak kotokyigei icheek konyonei kowendi kapkoros.
Eng' peetuut kotomo koit Saulo, ko kiga kong'aang'ji `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Samuel koleenji,
“Koteni asiis mutai, ayoogun chii ne punu emetap Benjamin, si iil koek pounindetap piikyuk Israel. Saru piikyuk eng' eunegap Philistiik amu ko ageer piikyuk ak ko kogoityo riirekwak.”
Kingo keer `Samuel Saulo, koleenji ineendet `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, “Chiichi chiito ne koamwaun aleenjinin pou piikyuk.”
Ki wo Saulo ole kimi Samuel eng' ormariichet oriit ak koleenji, “Mwaiwo kaigai ole mi kootap keerindet.”
Kowolji `Samuel Saulo koleenji, “Aa keerindonooto, togoste indoenan, ui kapkoros, amu ki amisyei tugul ak okweek ra, ak karon abagaakteen iwe ak amwaun tuguuk tugul che mi muguleldang'ung'.
Ko sigiroiguk che kogobetyot peetuusyek somok che kogosiirto, ko mata ibwaat amu kogenyoor. Tos tokyingei ng'oo mageet tugul ne po Israel, ne ma inyee ak kootap kwandang'ung' tugul?”

Kowol Saulo kole, “Aa Benjaminindet, ne po pororyet ne ming'in eng' pororyosyek tugul che po Israel, ak ooreennyo ko ne ming'in eng' ortinwek tugul che po pororyetap Benjamin. Amu nee anyun si ing'alaalwo ko uu ni?”
Ki imut anyun `Samuel Saulo ak otwogindennyi koba kootap toek ak kogoochi kotebee ole tagunoot kosiir tugul eng' kwenutap che kiga kiguur che ki olo po piik sosom.
Ki leenji `Samuel kwang'indet, “Ibu kebeberta ne kagagoonin ak kagamwaun aleenjin konor.”

Ki inem kwang'indonooto kubesto ak che ki mi paragutap peenyooto yeityo konde taitap Saulo. Kole Samuel, “Che kagigonorun, ko kaginde taing'ung'. Am, amu kagigonorun kot koit sait ne koging'at, si oam ak pichu kaguur.” Ki amis anyun Saulo ak Samuel eng' peetuunooto.
Ki choorgei eng' kapkoros ak koba nganaseet, koba kong'alaal ak Saulo eng' koot parak.
Kingo kairir emet, koguur `Samuel Saulo eng' koot parak koleenji, “Ng'eet si atyachin iwe.” Ki ng'eet anyun Saulo, yeityo komanda tuwai ineendet ak Samuel koba saang'.
Kingo choortogei eng' ye pooch nganaseet, koleenji `Samuel Saulo, “Mwachi otwogindeng'ung' kondo”, ak ki indo, “Ago tonon inyee nguno si amwaun ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet igas.”
Ki inem anyun Samuel chuboitap mwaita ak koroong'ji metinnyi, yeityo kong'utut ineendet ak koleenji, “Tos ma kagoiilin Kamuktaindet ne Toroor iegu pounindet ne po piikyik?

Ye iwe rani eng' yu, inyooru piik aeng' eng' ole po kereritap Rael eng' kiwotetap Benjamin eng' Selsa, ak komwaun pichooto kole, Kigenyoor sigirocho kigewe icheeng'ate. Kogobagaach kwandang'ung' kabwaatetap sigiroik ak kobwaataak koleen, ‘Ayae nee agobo weeriinnyu?’

Iwendi tai eng' yooto kot iit keetitap Tabor, ak ko nyoorun eng' yooto piik somogu kotogosyin ye mi Kamuktaindet eng' Bethel, ko kanabi age aarek somok che po ng'oroor, koibei age magatiinik somok ak koibei age soteetap divaik.
“Igatin ak kogoonin magatiinik aeng' che itaache kobun eunnywa.

Ye ibata, iwe itestai agoi iit tulweetap Kamuktaindet ole mi kiplugotinigap Philistiik. Ye iit nganaseet, ituiye maotik che kaiyumgei kochoorugei eng' kapkoros kotinyei kibugandet, sugutit ne ming'in, ndurerut ak ketubet eng' tainnywa komaotenonu.
Nyonjinin Kabuusetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' kimnateet, ak imaoten kobooto icheek ak kewalin iegu chiito age.
Ye pwaanjin kaboorunoichu, iyai ko uu ye kenyooru poroindo, amu miitei Kamuktaindet kobooten.

Yeityo ichoortegei indoena iwe Gilgal amu achoorugei ole imi, anyoo agoite kagoochinoik che kibeelei, ak aeeny tiseiywek che kagoochinoik che po kaalyeet. Igenisye peetuusyek tisap agoi aitu ole imi si aboorun kiit ne iyae.”
Ye kingo welelgei kwo eng' ole mi Samuel, kogoochi `Kamuktaindet ineendet muguleldo age. Ki isulda anyun kaboorunoichooto tugul eng' peetuunooto.
Kingo it tulweet, kotuiye ineendet maotik che kigaiyumgei, ak ki nyoonji ineendet Kabuusetap Kamuktaindet eng' kimnateet, ak ki maoten eng' kwenunnywa.
Ye kingo keer piik tugul che ki ingen ineendet eng' tai komaoteni ak maotik, koleenjigei, “Nee ni kogonyonji weeriitap Kish? Tos agenge Saulo eng' maotik?”
Kowol chii age eng' yooto kole, “Ng'oo kwandanywa?” Nooto anyun si ki piit kalewenet keele, “Tos pooto Saulo agine maotik?”
Ye kingo kagogees komaoteni, konyo kochut kapkoros.
ki teebee `imametap Saulo ineendet ak otwogindennyi koleenji, “Kigobe ano?” Kowol kole, “Kiga kibe kecheeng'ate sigiroik, ak ye ki ngegeer keele mata kobiit, kebwa ole mi Samuel.”
Komwa `imametap Saulo kole, “Kaigai mwaiwo kiit ne komwaun Samuel.”
Koleenji `Saulo imamennyi, “Kimwaiwech komyee kole ki kenyoor sigiroik.” Ma mwachi agobo ng'aleegap laitornatet, che ki kamwachi Samuel.
Ki kuur `Samuel piik koyumgei eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' Mispa,

yeityo koleenji piigap Israel, “Kamwa ko uu ni Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindetap Israel kole, ‘Ki amutu Israel kotogos eng' Misiri, ak asarwok eng' eunegap Misiriik, ak eng' eunegap laitornatosyek tugul che kiusok.’

Ago kaoeesye ra Kamuktaindeng'wong' ne ineendet ko sarwok eng' pichiinwekwok ak nyalilwogikwok tugul. Komwa ole, ‘Achicha, itoroorwech laitoryat koboiywech.’ Obwa anyun taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor obwanune pororyosyekwok ak ortinwekwok.”
Ki imut anyun `Samuel pororyet age tugul eng' che po Israel koriik ak eng' parbaryat kenam pororyetap Benjamin.
Ak ki imut pororyetap Benjamin koriik kobwanune ortinwekwak ak ki kinam ooreetap Matirik. Eng' let ko ki kinam Saulo weeriitap Kish. Ago ye ki ngecheeng' ineendet, koma kinyoor.
Koteebse `icheek Kamuktaindet ne Toroor anyun kogeny koleenji, “Ta komi chii neta konyonei yu? Kowol `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole, Wei kaung'egei kurubet.”
Ki rwai piik koba komut ineendet eng' olooto, ak ye kingo tonon eng' kwenutap piik, ko ki koit kosiir chii tugul kong'etee tigigoikyik ak kotogosta.
Koleenji `Samwel piik tugul, “Ogeere ineendet ne kogolewen `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ole ma mi ne kergei ak ineendet eng' piik tugul?” Komwa piik tugul eng' kutit ne oo kole, “Ingwo keny laitoryat!”
Komwachi `Samuel piik maguutik ak poisyonigap laitornatet. Yeityo kosirchi bukuit ak konde taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor. Kingo pata komwachi `Samuel piik tugul koba. Ki wo chii tugul koonnyi.
Ki wo Saulo agine koonnyi eng' Gibea ak ki pa ak murenik che nyigoonen che kiga twa Kamuktaindet mugulelwekwak.
Ago ki mwa abusanik alage kole, “Sarundoech ano chiichi?” Ki sas ineendet ama ipchi kagoochinoik. Ki siis Saulo ko uu yo ma mage kiy.
Ki togos Nahas Amonindet ak konam Jabes-gilead. Ki le `piik tugul che po Jabes Nahas, “Ongiyomiske si keotin.”
Ak ki leenji `Nahas Amonindet icheek, “Ayae arorutyonooto kobootok eng' ng'olyoondoni ale kebalu konyekwok tugul che po tai si ande koek teweernateet eng' Israel tugul.”
Koleenji `poisyegap Jabes ineendet, “Koonech peetuusyek tisap si kiyookte piik koba kiwotosyek tugul che po Israel si ngot koma piit chii ne sarwech kemong'u kebwa olo imi.”
Kingo it anyun piik che kiga kiyookto Gibea ne po Saulo ak komwachi piik ng'aleechuuto kogas, kowaach piik tugul ak koriiryo.
Ogeero, kinyonei Saulo kobunu mbar kosubu eiik; ak kiteep kole, “Kaam nee piik si koriiryo?” Ak ki mwachi ineendet agobo ng'aleegap piigap Jabes.
Ye kingo kas ng'aleechooto, konyonji ineendet Kabuusetap Kamuktaindet eng' kimnateet, ak ki nereekyi ineendet kot.

Ki nam eiik aeng' che po chogit ak kotonaton yeityo koyooktoe piik koba komoswek tugul che po Israel koleenji, “Chii age tugul ne mamong'u kosubu Saulo ak Samuel, keyachin eikyik ko uu niito.” Ki ibutyi piik kamuisetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ak ki mong' koigei chiichak.
Ki iit icheek eng' Besek ak ki ek piigap Israel eliphuusyek pogol somok, koek piigap Judah eliphuusyek sosom.

Ki leenji pichooto kiga kiyok chu kiga pwa, “Omwachini piigap Jabes-gilead ko uu ni, oleenjini, ‘Tuun mutai ko kang'wanit asiista, onyooru saruunet.’ ” Ki pwa pichooto kiga kiyookto ak komwachi piigap Jabes, ak kiboiboitu.
Ki leenji anyun `piigap Jabes Amonik, “Kigonugei kebwane mutai ole omi si oyaiywech tuguuk tugul che ogeere ole myee eng' okweek.”

Kingo eech kopcheune `Saulo piik kweanaik somok. Ki it kwenutap nganaseet eng' riipseet ne po karon ak kobar Amonik kot kong'wanit asiis. Kiyesta che kiga ng'et kot ko mata kenyoor che mi aeng' eng' komosta agenge.
Ak ki leenji `piik Samuel, “Ng'oo ni kileen, Tos poiywech Saulo? Imutu pichooto si kebar.”
Ago ki le Saulo, “Ma kibarei chii agot agenge eng' peetuuni! Amu kagoyai rani Kamuktaindet ne Toroor saruunet eng' Israel.”
Ki leenji `Samuel piik, “Obwa keebe Gilgal keebe kigimit laitornatet eng' yooto.”

Ara ki pa piik tugul Gilgal, ak eng' olooto Gilgal koyai Saulo koek laitoryat eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor. Ki eeny eng' olooto tiseiywek che po kagoochinoigap kaalyeet eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor; ak ki yai igoortap poiboyet ne oo Saulo ak piik tugul che po Israel eng' olooto.
Ki leenji `Samuel Israel tugul, “Ki agas ng'aleekwok eng' tuguuk tugul che ki omwaiwo, ak ki acheeng'wok laitoryat ne poiywok.
Kobooch ra, ko egu laitoryat kandoindeng'wong'. Kaositu anee ak ko koabunji kalwal, ak nga no, komi weeriikyuk kobootok. Ki aegu kandoindeng'wong' kobooch ming'inatennyu agoi peetuuni.

Ang'ni anee! Obaoryanjo yaityo eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ak eng' taitap nenyi ne iilaat. Ki arebee ng'oo tennyi? Anan ki arebee ng'oo sigiryennyi? Anan ki aberber ng'oo? Ki aus ng'oo? Anan ki anam eng' eutap ng'oo tugun che po asoya si atuge konyekyuk? Ngo mi aweekwok.”
Kowol piik kole, “Ma iberberech anan iuseech, ak tomo inam eng' eutap chii kiy age tugul.”
Kowolji Samuel kole, “Paoryat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor agobo okweek, ak paoryat nenyi ne ki kiil eng' peetuuni, keele ma onyooru kiy eng' eunnyu.” Kowol piik kole, “Paoryat ineendet.”
Komwachi `Samuel piik koleenji, “Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ineendet ne ki leweni Musa ak Aron, ak komut kwanisyekwok kotogos eng' emetap Misiri.
Otononie anyun nguno si kobiit ateiywok eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor agobo poisyonik tugul che po imanda che po Kamuktaindet ne Toroor che kiyaiywok ak kwanisyekwok.
“Ye kingo nyo Jakobo Misiri, ak koriirchi `kwanisyekwok Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, koyook `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Musa ak Aron che ki imong' kwanisyekwok eng' Misiri ak kogoochi komeny olito.

Ago kiutye `icheek Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindennywa, ne ki aldochi icheek eutap Sisera kiptaiyatap lugeetap Hasor, ak koaldochi kora eutap Philistiik, ak eutap laitoryatap Moab si kobargei ak icheek.
Ki riirchi `icheek Kamuktaindet ne Toroor koleenji, ‘Ki kiplelutiin, amu kigebagaakte Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ak keoot Baalik ak Astarot. Sarwech anyun nguno eng' eutap puunikyok si keotin.’
Ki iyook `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Jeru-baal, Bedan, Jephta ak Samuel ak kosarwok eng' eunegap puunikwok eng' komosta age tugul ak ki omeng'iisye eng' kaalyeet.
Ago ye kingo keer `Nahas laitoryatap lagogap Ammon konyonjook obargei, oleenjo, ‘Achicha, agoi kenyooru laitoryat ne poiywech nga Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindeng'wong' ko laitoryandeng'wong'.’
Wei, kagolewen Kamuktaindet ne Toroor anyun laitoryat koboiywok! Ang'ni anyun laitoryat ne kaolewen, nooto ne kaosoom.

Ngot oiywei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ak oot ineendet, ogas iit kutinnyi, amobistoe ng'atuutyennyi, ak ngot oegu okweek ak laitoryat ne poiywok kasubiigap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindeng'wong', komyeeitu anyun eng' okweek.
Ago ngot ko mogas iit kutitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ak obistoe ng'atuutyennyi, konyalilok anyun eutap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ko uu ye ki inyaliil kwanisyekwok.
Ara anyun otononse si ogeer kitap kwang'utyet ne machei koyai Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ogeere.

Kasarta ne po kesisyetap nganuuk ni. Aguure Kamuktaindet ne Toroor si koyook tuleet ak ropta, si onai ak ogeer ole oo tengektong'wong' ne ki oyai eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor amu ki osoomjigei laitoryat.”
Ki kuur anyun `Samuel Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ak ki iyook `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor peetuunooto tuleet ak ropta. Ki iywei piik tugul Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ak Samuel miising'.
Koleenji `piik tugul Samuel, “Saa igaigai Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindeng'ung' agobo otwogiguk si ma kibegu, amu kogetesyi tengekwogikyok tugul yaityoni, kesoomjigei laitoryat.”
Kowolji `Samuel piik koleenji, “Amoiywei, ki oyai iman yaityoni tugul, ago amomaste obagaach Kamuktaindet ne Toroor. Ago oot Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' mugulelwekwok tugul.
Momaste osup tuguugap puch che ma imuuchi kotoret kiy anan kosar amu puch.
Kosupkei ak kainennyi ne oo, koma pagaaktoi `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor piikyik amu ki cham ineendet koyaak oegu piikyik.
Eng' anee, ko ingolooit ayachi tengek Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ak abagaakte asaiywok; atesetai aneetook eng' ooreet ne myee ak ne nyolu.
Ne siirei tugul, ko oiywei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kityo ak oot ineendet eng' imanit, eng' mugulelwekwok tugul, ak obwaat olete tuguuk che eecheen che ki koyaiywok.
Amu ngot otestai eng' yaityenng'wong', kigeswok okweek ak laitoryandeng'wong'.”
Kiga kotar Saulo kenyiisyek (sosom) ye ki tau kolaitorani, ak ki laitoran kenyiisyek aeng' eng' Israel.

Ki lewenjigei `Saulo murenik eliphuusyek somok che po Israel. Ki mi eliphuusyek aeng'u eng' chooto kobooto Saulo eng' Mikmas ak eng' tulweetap Bethel ak kimi eliphuut agenge kobooto Jonathan eng' Gibea ne po Benjamin. Ki iyookto kiplugotinik che kiga ng'et koba kaa.
King'em `Jonathan irimeetap kiplugotinigap Philistiik ne ki miitei Geba ak ki kas Philistiik agobo niito. Ki ng'at Saulo keguut iryageet eng' emet tugul, koleen, “Ingogas Yahudik.”
Ki kas Israel tugul kole kogobar `Saulo irimeetap kiplugotinigap Philistiik ak kole ki koek Israel ne kiwechei eng' Philistiik. Ki iyumgei piik koosup Saulo koba Gilgal.

Ki iyumgei Philistiik si kobargei ak Israel kotinyei kariisyek eliphuusyek sosom ak piik eliphuusyek lo che ketei paraisisyek, kobooto piik che tee ng'aniegap ngeguutap nyanjet eng' chaang'indo. Ki togos koteech Mikmas ne tokyingei kong'asiis eng' Beth-aben.
Kingo keer piigap Israel kole mi eng' pichiindo, (amu kinyalilso piik,) kounykei anyun eng' kebenonik, eng' sondisyek, eng' rwandosyek, eng' keriingonik ak eng' keriingonik alak che mengeechen.
Kiga kolandae Jordan Yahudik alage koba emetap Gad ak Gilead. Ago kita komi Saulo Gilgal, ak ki isup piik tugul ineendet kobotanioti.
Kingo kenis peetuusyek tisap, koma nyo `Samuel Gilgal ko uu ye kiga ng'at, ko kiyesta piik anyun koba eng' ole mi ineendet.
Kole Saulo, “Oibwa kagoochinet ne kibeelei konyo yu kobooto kagoochinoigap kaalyeet.” Ak ki igoito kagoochinonooto kibeelei.
Eng' sainooto ki igeesune kagoitoetap kagoochinet ne kibeelei, koit Samuel, ak kimanda Saulo kotorookta ineendet kole kwo kogat.
Ago ki le Samuel, “Nee ni kaiyai?” Kowol Saulo kole, “Kageer piik ale kaiyesta koba; ak ma inyoo eng' kasarta che kiga king'at, ak kogagoyumgei Philistiik eng' Mikmas.
Abwaat anyun ale chorugei Philistiik nguno kobwanei ole ami eng' Gilgal kotom asoom chametap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, andegei anyun agoito kagoochinet ne kibeelei.”

Koleenji `Samuel Saulo, “Keyai eng' perberyo ama iriip ng'atuutyetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindeng'ung' ne king'atin, amu kata igimiti Kamuktaindet ne Toroor laitornateng'ung' eng' Israel koigeny.

Ago nguno koma kotebyei laitornateng'ung' agoi. Kagocheeng'jigei `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor chiito ne iboiboi muguleldanyi, ak kagonde `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor chiichooto koek pounindet ne pou piikyik amu ma iriip ng'olyoot ne king'atin Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.”
Ki ng'eet Samuel ak kwo kotogosta eng' Gilgal agoi Gibea ne po Benjamin. Ki it `Saulo kiplugotinik che ki ng'et kobooto ineendet, koek murenik olo po pogol lo.
Ki tebee Saulo ak Jonathan weeriinnyi ak kiplugotinik che ki mi ak ineendet Geba ne po Benjamin, ago ki teech Philistiik Mikmas.
Ki mong' luulik eng' nganaseetap Philistiik kopcheunegei somok. Ki pun kweanet age ooreet ne wendi Ophrah agoi emetap Saulo,
kobun kweanet age ooreet ne wendi Beth-horon, ak ki pun kweanet ne po let ooreet ne punei kiwoteet ne ing'ururi atebweetap Seboim kotokyigei surkwen.
Ki ma komiitei kitang'indet emet komugul ne po Israel. Ki iywei Philistiik kole imuuch koyachigei Yahudik rotoogap chok anan ng'otwek.
Ki choortagei Yahudik tugul kobendi ole mi Philistiik, si kolit chii tugul mogombennyi, rotwennyi, aiywennyi ak marunnyi,
Ki kigoito kebeberta aeng' eng' somok che po shekel eng' marusyek, rotonik, umaisyek, aonok ak ne lite kiplitok kobunji ne ki tinyei liteito ne kilitisye.
Ki ma piit eng' peetuutap lugeet rotwetap chok anan ko ng'otit eng' eutap chii age tugul ne ki mi kobooto Saulo ak Jonathan, nga ki tinyei Saulo ak Jonathan weeriinnyi chechwaak.
Ak kimanda lugeetap Philistiik koba ole kibunei eng' Mikmas.
Eng' peetuut age, koleenji `Jonathan weeriitap Saulo muren age ne ki cham koipchin kariikyik, “Nyoo keebe kelande ole mi lugeetap Philistiik.” Ago ki ma mwachi Jonathan kwandanyi.
Ki tebee Saulo tabandap Gibea eng' keetit keel ne po logoek ne mi Migron. Ki olo po pogol lo murenik che ki mi ak ineendet.

Ki mi olooto Ahija, weeriitap Ahitub, ng'eetap kametap Ikabod, weeriitap Phineas, weeriitap Eli, tisiindetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' Shiloh, kolaachi ephod. Ago ki ma nai kiplugotinik kole kakwo Jonathan.
Ki mi rwandet ne ng'atip komosi, komi age komosin eng' kwenutap kererchosyek che kimachei Jonathan kobun kolanda kwo ole mi lugeetap Philistiik. Kainetap age ko ki Boses ak kainetap age ko ki Sene.
Kiga tonon rwandet age eng' murot kaataam ne po taitap Mikmas, kotonon age eng' murot tai eng' taitap Geba.

Ki leenji `Jonathan murenooto ki ipchin kariikyik che po lugeet, “Nyoo kelande keebe ole mi lugeetap chu ma kimuratan, abeere imuuchi kotoretech Kamuktaindet ne Toroor amu ma mi kiy ne etee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kosar eng' che chaang' anan ko eng' che ng'ering'.”
Koleenji `chiito ne ki ipchin kariik, “Yai tuguuk tugul che mi muguleldang'ung'. Welelgei, keero, ami kobooten ko uu eng' muguleldang'ung'.”
Yeityo koleenji Jonathan, “Nyoo anyun, kilandoi kebendi ole mi pichooto ak kiboorchigei.
Ngot komwaiwech kole, ‘Otebi kot kebwa ole omi.’ Ketonondosi anyun eng' oldanyo ma kitogostoi ole mi icheek.
Ago ngot koleenjech, ‘Otogosu ole kimi.’ Ketogoste anyun, amu kagonde `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor icheek eunekyok ak egu niito kaboorunet eng' acheek.”
Ki iboorchigei anyun icheek tuwai lugeetap Philistiik. Ak ki le Philistiik, “Ogeero, kamong' Yahudik eng' keriingonik ole koga ung'egei.”

Ki leenji `piigap lugonooto Jonathan kobooto chiito ne ki ipchin kariik, “Otogosu ole kimi si kiboorwok kiy.” Koleenji `Jonathan chiichooto ki ipchin kariik, “Togosu isubwo, amu kagonde `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor icheek eunegap Israel.”
Ki wo Jonathan kolaany eng' eunek ak keelyek ak ki isubi ineendet chiichooto ki ipchin kariik. Ki ibutyo Philistiik eng' taitap Jonathan ak ki parat icheek eng' let chiito ne ki ipchinoti kariik.
Eng' paronooto po tai ko ki par Jonathan ak chiito ne ki ipchin kariik piik olo po tiptem eng' kooret ne po kebebertap ekait.
Ki piit potanet eng' nganaseet, eng' emet ak eng' piik tugul. Ki potan lugeet kobooto luulik ak icheek; ak ki potan ng'wony, kot koit kobiit potanet ne oo miising'.
Ki keer riibiigap Saulo eng' Gibea ne po Benjamin; ogeero, chaang'indo, kibetyo ak koyestoi koba komosi ak komosi.
Koleenji anyun `Saulo piik che ki mi kobooto ineendet, “Oiit piik nguno ak ogeer chiito ne kakwo eng' acheek.” Ye kingo kagoit, ko ki ma komi Jonathan ak chiito ne ki ipchinoti kariik.
Koleenji `Saulo Ahija, “Ibu moingetap Kamuktaindet konyo yu.” Amu kimi moingetap Kamuktaindet kobooto piigap Israel eng' peetuusyechooto.
Ye kita kong'alaaljin `Saulo tisiindet, koeet polateet kotesak eng' nganaseetap Philistiik. Amu nooto anyun koleenji `Saulo tisiindet, “Iste eung'ung'.”
Ki iyumgei piik tugul che ki mi ak Saulo ak koba pooryeet. Ki nyoor Philistiik komi eng' wasetapkei ak ki par chii tugul chiito ne kitokyigei, ak kieet miising' parisyet.

Ki week Yahudik che ki mi kobooto Philistiik ko uu ye ki uu eng' tai, che kiga togosta kobooto icheeget koba nganaseet, kobun korotinwek che kiga yiem. Ki namgei chooto ak icheek kobooto Yahudik che ki mi kobooto Saulo ak Jonathan.
Ye kingo kas piik tugul che po Israel che kiga unygei eng' emetap tuloonoogap Ephraim kole kamwei Philistiik, kochut lugeet ak koon ak icheek Philistiik.
Kosar anyun `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Israel eng' peetuunooto; ak ki landa lugeet kwo Beth-aben.

Ki iimak kiplugotinigap Israel eng' peetuunooto. Ko uu ye kiga konde Saulo kotebee kayasyoet kiplugotinik kole, “Chuboot chiito ne amei amit age tugul kotom koit koskoleny, si asich ayooktochigei mugetuut eng' puunikyuk.” Ma chamcham anyun chii age tugul amit eng' pichooto.
Ki pa piik tugul timiin, ak ki mi kumyat ng'wony.
Ye kingo it piik timiin, kooro kosou kumyat, ago ma inde chii kuut eng' eunnyi; amu ki iywei icheek kayasyoet.
Ago ki tomo kogas Jonathan kole kigong'at kwandannyi piik eng' kayasyoet. Ki iyogoito anyun kirokto ne ki mi eunnyi, ak kotooree masamek yeityo konde kutit, ak kiyatagis konyekyik.
Kowol anyun age eng' piik kole, “Ki ng'at kwandang'ung' piik eng' kayasyoet ak eng' kimnateet kole, ‘Chuboot chiito ne amei amitwogik eng' peetuuni.’ ” Ak kiga kong'etyo piik kot.
Ki le Jonathan anyun, “Kigoiim emet abba. Ogeerchingei anyun ole kayatitagei konyekyuk ye kachamcham kitigin eng' kumyandani.
Kotam nee nda kagaam piik tuguugap puunikwak che kanyoor ko uu ye machei? Kata piitu pareet ne oo eng' Philistiik.”
Ki par Philistiik eng' peetuunooto kobooch Mikmas agoi Aijalon, ak kiga koam rubeet piik miising'.
Ki rwochi piik tuguuk che ki nyaban; ak ki nam keechiirek ak tuuga kobooto moek ak koeny eng' yooto ak ki am piik panyechooto kobooto korotiik.
Ye ki ngemwachi Saulo keleenji, “Keero, yachin `piik Kamuktaindet ne Toroor tengekto amu amei panyeek kobooto korotiik.” Kowol ineendet kole, “Kaoyai ng'aalseet, omilwa koito ne oo konyo yu ami.”

Ak ki le Saulo, “Oyestee oba kwenutap piik ak oleenji kogetwo chii tugul eitonyi, ak kogetwo chii tugul keechiiryennyi yeityo koeny eng' yu ak koam, si moyachi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor tengekto ye oame kobooto korotiik.” Kiget chii age tugul eitonyi konyo kemounooto yeityo koeny eng' yooto.
Kiteekyi anyun `Saulo Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kaptisisyet; nooto ko ki kaptisisyet ne po tai ne kiteekyi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
