Ak ki le Saulo, “Ongechoortegei kisup Philistiik kembouni ak kenyabane tuguuk kot koeech, amat ongebagaach chii agot agenge eng' icheek kosap.” Kowol icheek kole, “Yai kiit age tugul ne igeere ile myee eng' inyee.” Ago ki mwa tisiindet kole, “Ongeriigu yu keriikyi Kamuktaindet.”
ki teebee `Saulo Kamuktaindet kiit ne yaei kole, “Achoortegei asup Philistiik? Tos indoi icheek eutap Israel?” Ago ma wolji ineendet eng' peetuunooto.
Ki le anyun Saulo, “Oriigu yu okweek pounik tugul che po piik, si kegeer ole kabiitunda tengegi rani.
Amu ko uu ye sabei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne saru Israel, ko agot ngo Jonathan weeriinnyu, komeei iman.” Ago ma piit chii eng' piik tugul ne ki wolji ineendet.
Yeityo komwachi `Saulo Israel tugul koleenji, “Otebee komosta agenge ak ketebee ak Jonathan weeriinnyu komosta age.” Ki mwachi anyun `piik Saulo koleenji, “Yai kiit ne igeere ile myee eng' inyee.”

Ki le anyun Saulo “Ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindetap Israel, lyon si kotom iwolji kiboityong'ung' ra? Ngot komi anee lelutyoni anan komi weeriinnyun Jonathan, ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindetap Israel, ibooru eng' Urim, ago ngot komi lelutyoni piiguk Israel, ibooru eng' Thummim.” Ak ki kinam Jonathan ak Saulo eng' parbaryat ago kichililso piik.
Ak ki le Saulo, “Oseer parbareek nguno agobo anee ak Jonathan weeriinnyu.” Kingi seer, kenam Jonathan.
Ki leenji anyun `Saulo Jonathan, “Mwaiwo kiit ne koiyai.” Ak ki mwachi Jonathan ineendet koleenji, “Koachamcham iman kumyat kitigin eng' walitap kirokto ne komi eunnyu. Achoboot nguno ame.”
Kole `Saulo, “Ingoyai Kamuktaindet ko uu nooto ak koyai kotes kora, amu agoi imee iman, Jonathan!”

Ago ki leenji `piik Saulo, “Tos meei Jonathan, ne koyai yetunoni oo eng' Israel? Achicha, ma uu nooto. Ko uu ye sabei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, koma ibutyin ng'wony agot agenge eng' suumeegap metinnyi, amu kabois ak Kamuktaindet rani.” Ki sar piik anyun Jonathan si ma me.
Ki togosta anyun Saulo ko mata koosup Philistiik, ak ki week Philistiik oldanywa.

Kingo kagonam anyun Saulo laitornatet eng' Israel, kobargei ak puunikyik tugul eng' komosta age tugul. Kibargei ak piigap Moab, piigap Ammon, piigap Edom, piigap Philistiik ak laitorinigap Soba. Ki iterteer icheek eng' komosta age tugul ole kiweleljigei.
Ki yai eng' nyiganateet ak ki par Amelegik ak kosar Israel eng' eunegap icheek che kiga koluul.
Weeriigap Saulo anyun ko ki Jonathan, Isbi ak Malkisua. Kainaigap tiibiikyik tuwai ko ki chu: taita ko ki kiguuree Merap ak kainetap ne ming'in ko Mikal.
Kainetap osotyotap Saulo ko ki Ainoam cheptap Ahimaaz. Kiptaiyatap lugeennyi ko ki kiguuree Abner weeriitap Ner, nooto ne ki imametap Saulo.
Kwandap Saulo ko ki Kish, ak Ner kwandap Abner ko ki weeriitap Abiel.
Eng' peetuusyek tugul che po Saulo, ko ki piit lugeet ne koroom agobo Philistiik, kot ko kingo keer `Saulo chii age tugul ne kiim, anan ko chii age tugul ne nyigan, komuti ineendet kotebee oldanyi.
Ak ki leenji `Samuel Saulo, “Ki iyookwo Kamuktaindet ne Toroor anyo aiiliin iegu laitoryatap piikyik si ibou Israel. Ara kas anyun ng'aleegap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor!”
Kamwa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne po lugoosyek kole, “Kaabwaat kiit ne ki yachi `Amelek Israel, ye ki kirinda ineendet eng' ooreet ye kitogosu eng' Misiri.
Ui anyun nguno ibookyi Amelek ak ing'em igeesu tuguuk tugul che tinyei. Amat ibagaakte chii, ago par muren ak kwony, lakwa ak ne reryei, teta ak keechiiryet, tambeesyet ak sigiryet!”
Ki kuur anyun `Saulo piik ak koiit icheek eng' Telaim: piik eliphuusyek pogol aeng' che punei keelyek ak piik eliphuusyek taman che po Judah.
Ki wo `Saulo kot koit nganaseetap Amelek ak koribis eng' atebweet.

Ki mwachi `Saulo Kenik koleenji, “Oba oistegei, ochoortegei oistoegei Amelegik, si ma paraak kobooto icheek. Amu ki oriree lagok tugul che po Israel, ye kitogosu komong'u eng' Misiri.” Koistogei anyun Kenik eng' Amelegik.
Ki par anyun `Saulo Amelegik kobooch Havilah agoi Sur, ne neegit Misiri.
Ki nam Agag laitoryatap Amelegik kosabei; ak kobar piik tugul kogees eng' rotwetap chok.

Ago ki pagaach Agag `Saulo ak `piik ak keechiirek che korooron eng' tugul, kobooto tuuga che akwaen ak aaregap keechiir kobooto tuguuk tugul che ki myachen, ama cham kobar kogees. Ago king'em kiit age tugul ne kisasei ak ne ma kiy kogees.
Ki ityi anyun ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor `Samuel koleenji,
“Ki ma ta myee aeet Saulo koek laitoryat. Amu kagoweektagei let mata kosuba, ama yai ng'atuutikyuk.” Ki nereech anyun Samuel ak koriirchi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kemout komugul.
Ki ng'eet Samuel karon miising' kwo kotuiyo ak Saulo. Ki kimwachi Samuel keleenji kanyo Saulo Karmel ak koteekyigei kiit ne kibwaatee ineendet, yeityo kowendot kwo kosiirto kochoortagei Gilgal.
Ye kingo nyo Samuel ole mi Saulo, koleenji `Saulo ineendet, “Ingoberuurin Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, koayai ng'atuutyetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.”
Ak ki le Samuel, “Po nee anyun kautoni po keechiirek agase eng' itiikyuk ak kautetap tuuga ne agase?”

Kole Saulo, “Koget piik kechirechooto ak tuuga chooto eng' Amelegik, amu kobagaakta piik keechiirek ak tuuga che korooron eng' tugul, si koeng'ji Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindeng'ung', ago ko ki par kigesu che kong'et.”
Komwachi anyun `Samuel Saulo koleenji, “Kany amwaun kiit ne kamwaiwo Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kemouni.” Ak ki leenji ineendet, “Mwa inyee.”
Ki mwa Samuel kole, “Nganda ki iming'in ye ki igeeregei, ko ki ma kieetin iegu kandoindetap pororyosyegap Israel? Ki iilin Kamuktaindet ne Toroor iegu laitoryat eng' Israel,
ak ki iyookten Kamuktaindet ne Toroor iwe panda ak kole, ‘Ui ak ibar Amelegik kiptengeginicho igeesu, ak obargei ak icheek kot kogeskei.’
Amu nee anyun si me kas iit kutitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ago kelabatyi parunenik ak iyai kiit ne ya eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor?”
Koleenji `Saulo Samuel, “Ee, koagas iit kutitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ak koawe ooreet ne koiyookto Kamuktaindet ne Toroor awe ak koamutu Agag laitoryatap Amelegik ak koabar Amelegik kogeskei.
Ago koget piik parunenik, keechiirek ak tuuga chooto che korooron che ko kitabaan, si keeng'ji Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindeng'ung' eng' Gilgal.”

Ak ki mwa Samuel kole, “Tos, ting'ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor poiboiyet ne oo kagoochinoik che kibeelei ak tiseiywot, ko uu ye ting'ee kasetap iit ne po ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor? Keero, siirei kasetap iit tiseiywot ak siirei kasetap iit mwanigap mengichik.
Amu kergei ngelelnateet ak tengektap ponisyet ak kergei uuindap met ak chalwokto ak saaetap kanamonik. Amu koieesye ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ko kagoeesyen aginye si mata iegu laitoryat.”
Ak ki mwachi `Saulo Samuel koleenji, “Koayai tengekto amu koabistoe ng'atuutyetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ak ng'aleeguk. Amu koaiywei piik ak agas iit kutinnywa.
Ara asaain anyun nguno ale, nyoiywo kaat tengektonyu, ak ingeweigei tuwai, si kobiit agutung'ji Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.”
Ak ki mwachi `Samuel Saulo koleenji, “Ma kiweeksei ak inyee, amu koieesye ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ko kagoeesyen Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ma iegu laitoryat eng' Israel.”
Ye kingo welelgei Samuel kwo, konam Saulo tabandap ngoryennyi; ak kigereer.
Ki mwachi `Samuel ineendet koleenji, “Kagogereerenen Kamuktaindet ne Toroor laitornatetap Israel rani, ak kogoochi chiitap kokweng'ung' ne kaigai eng' inyee.
Ma mwaei lembech Kimnateetap Israel ama sigu; amu ineendet koma chiito si kowalak.”
Komwa Saulo kole, “Koayai tengekto, ago asaain kora ale konyita nguno eng' taitap poisyegap piikyuk ak eng' Israel ak ingeweigei tuwai, si agutung'ji Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindeng'ung'.”
Koweek anyun Samuel koosup Saulo ak ki kutung'ji `Saulo Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Yeityo komwa Samuel kole, “Omutwaa Agag laitoryatap Amelegik konyo yu.” Ki nyo anyun Agag kobaibai ak kobwaati koleen, “Eng' iman ni ko ng'wanindap meet.”

Ago ki mwa Samuel kole, “Ko uu ye ki yachi rotweng'ung' po chok kobogorisyek kobetyi lagok, koegu kamenng'ung' agine ne ma tinyei lakwa eng' kobogorisyek.” Ak kimurmur `Samuel Agag kotonaton eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' Gilgal.
Yeityo kwo anyun Samuel Ramah, ak kitogosta Saulo koonnyi eng' Gibea ne po Saulo.
Ak ki mata konyo kogeny Samuel kogeer Saulo agoi peetuutap meennyi. Nga no ko ki riirchi `Samuel Saulo; amu ki riir let Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole kiga koyai Saulo koek laitoryat koboi Israel.

Ki mwachi `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Samuel koleenji, “Iriirchini Saulo kot kotyanit, ko uu ye koaeesye ineendet koek laitoryat eng' Israel? Inde mwaita laleng'ung' konyi ak itau panda iwe. Ayooktoin iwe kap Jesse Bethlehemindet, amu kaalewenjigei laitoryat eng' weeriikyik.”
Ki mwa Samuel kole, “Awetitoi ano? Ngot kogas Saulo, kobara.” Koleenji Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, “Kweri rooryat, ak imwa ile, ‘Kanyo aeng'ji Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.’
Kuur Jesse konyo ole itisisye si aboorun kiit ne iyae, yeityo iilwa chiito ne amwaun.”
Ki yai Samuel kioto ki kamwa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor. Kingo it Bethlehem, kotorook ineendet poisyegap nganaseet kobotanionu. ki teebee ineendet koleenji, “Inyone eng' kaalyeet?”
Ak ki le, “Ee, anyoone eng' kaalyeet, kanyo aeng'ji Kamuktaindet ne Toroor. Otabaange anyun ak obwa keebe ole atisisye.” Ak ki itabaan Jesse ak weeriikyik ak koguur icheek kobwa ole tisiisyee.
Kingo it kogeer Eliap ak ki ibwaat kole, “Miitei iman ne iilaat ne po Kamuktaindet ne Toroor tainnyi.”

Ago ki leenji `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Samuel, “Amat igeer togeennyi anan ko kooindap tononennyi, amu kaeesye ineendet. Ma keerei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ko uu ye keerei piik. Keerei piik itoondo, ago keerei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor muguleldo.”
Koguur anyun `Jesse Abinadab ak koleenji kosiirto eng' taitap Samuel. Ago ki le Samuel, “Ma lewen agine Kamuktaindet ne Toroor niito.”
Yeityo koleenji Jesse Shammah kosiirto. Ago ki le, “Agot niito koma lewen agine Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.”
Ki leenji `Jesse weeriikyik tisap kosiirto eng' taitap Samuel. Ago ki leenji `Samuel Jesse, “Ma lewen Kamuktaindet ne Toroor age eng' chuuto.”
Ki leenji `Samuel Jesse, “Mi yu lagoguk tugul?” Ak ki le, “Ta komi ne ming'in ne iyagi keechiirek.” Koleenji `Samuel Jesse, “Iyookte chiito kwo komut ineendet, amu ma kitebyei ng'wony agoi koit.”
Ki iyookto chiito, ak ki imut ineendet. Ki piriir, ak ki tinyei koonyek che korooron, ak ki karaaran. Ak ki le Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, “Ng'eet, iil ineendet, amu ineendet niito.”

Konem anyun Samuel lalet ne ki mi mwaita ak koiil ineendet eng' kwenutap tupchosyekyik. Ki nyoonji `Kabuusetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Daudi eng' kimnateet kobooch peetuunooto agoi. Kingo pata, kong'eet anyun Samuel ak kwo Ramah.
Kiga kwo Kabuusetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' Saulo, ak ki inyaliil ineendet tamirmiryet ne ya ne ki punu Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ki mwachi `otwogikyik Saulo koleenji, “Keero, imuin tamirmiryet ne ya ne punu Kamuktaindet.
Ingong'at kiptaiyandennyo otwogikyik che mi tainnyi kocheeng' chiito ne putiin ketubet. Asi ye nyoonji tamirmiryet ne ya ne punu Kamuktaindet kobut ketubet eng' eunnyi si isap.”
Koleenji `Saulo otwogikyik, “Ocheeng'wo chiito ne ingen kobut ketubet komyee ak omutwaa ineendet.”

Ki wolji anyun age eng' murenjoto chiget koleenji, “Ki ageer weeriit age ne po Jesse Bethlehemindet, ne putiin, chii ne kiim ne tinyei nyiganateet ak ko chiitap lugeet, ng'oom eng' ng'alaalet, inender ko chii ne karaaran ak komi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kobooto ineendet.”
Koyookto anyun `Saulo piik koba kap Jesse, koba koleenji, “Iyookwo Daudi weeriing'ung' ne iyagi keechiirek.”
Ki chop `Jesse sigiryet ak koganapchi amitwogik, soteet ne mi divaik ak aarwetap ng'oroor ak koyooktoe Daudi weeriinnyi koipchi Saulo.
Ki it `Daudi kap Saulo ak koboisyechi ineendet. Ki cham `Saulo ineendet miising' ak ki yai koek chiito ne ipchin kariikyik.
Ki iyookto `Saulo chiito kwo kap Jesse koleenji, “Asoomin ale chamji Daudi koboisyewo amu kogonyoor chameet eng' anee.”
Ye kanyonji Saulo `tamirmiryet ne ya ne punu Kamuktaindet, ko ki inemu Daudi ketubet ak kobut, kogaigait Saulo ak komyeeit kogeny ak kwo eng' ineendet tamirmiryet ne ya.
Ki iyum anyun Philistiik lugosyekwak koba lugeet, ak ki iyumgei eng' Soko ne po Judah, ak ki teech kwenutap Soko ak Aseka eng' Epes-damin.
Ki iyumgei piigap Israel kobooto Saulo ak ki teech atebweetap Elah ak kotet lugeet si kobargei ak Philistiik.
Kitonone `Philistiik tulweet komosta age, kotonone `Israel tulweet komosta age, ak kimi atebweet kwenunnywa.
Ki mong' nyiganeet age eng' nganaseetap Philistiik ne ki kiguure Goliat ne po Gath. Ki koindonyi ko ki olo po mitainik somok.
Ki tinyei kuutweet ne po sugunwet eng' metinnyi ak ki ilaachi ngoryeet ne po kariik. Nyigiisindap ngoryonooto ko ki shekelisyek eliphuusyek muut che po sugunonik.
Ki tinyei kariigap sugunonik eng' keelyekyik ak ndiritap sugunwet eng' patennyi.

Ki kergei irumetap ndirinnyi ak keetit ne taachin usiisyek chiito ne nabisyei. Nyigiisindap meleitap ng'otinnyi ko ki shekelisyek pogol lo che po kariik, ak kiwendi chiito ne ki ipchin long'eet kondoe ineendet.
Ki tonon ak kotwekyi lugosyegap Israel eng' kutit ne oo koleenji, “Amu nee si omang'u otet lugeeng'wong'? Ma aa Philistindet, ko oo otwogigap Saulo? Olewenjigei chiito, ak ongochoorgei konyoonjo.
Ngot komuuch kebarge tuwai ak kobara keegu anyun otwogikwok. Ago ngot aterteer ineendet ak abar, oegu anyun otwogikyok ak ootech.”
Ki le Philistindonooto, “Areenye lugosyegap Israel ra, ogoono chiito si kobiit kebarge.”
Kingo kas Saulo ak Israel tugul ng'aleechooto po Philistindet, kotoptobenso ak koiyweis miising'.
Daudi ko ki weeriitap Epratindetap Beth-lehem-juda ne ki kainennyi ko Jesse. Ki tinyei weeriik sisiit, ak eng' peetuusyegap Saulo ko kiga koosit ineendet.
Kigaba lugeet weeriik che eecheen somogu che po Jesse koosup Saulo. Kainaigap weeriichooto somok che kigaba lugeet ko kitaita Eliap, ne rubei ineendet ko ki Abinadab ak ne po somok ko Shammah.
Ki ne ming'in Daudi. Kiga isup Saulo chooto eecheen somogu.
Kiwendi `Daudi kap Saulo ak koweeksei koyagi keechiiregap kwandanyi eng' Bethlehem.
Eng' peetuusyek artam, ko kiriigu Philistindonooto karon ak koskoleny koboorugei.
Pesyet age, koleenji `Jesse weeriinnyi Daudi, “Nam ip chaaktae kiloinik taman che po peek che kagigeel ak magatinichu taman, ipchi tupchosyeguk eng' ole mi lugoosyek.
Ipchi kora mugunichu taman po cheego kiptaiyannywa ak igeer chametapkei ne po tupchosyeguk yeityo iibu waluunennywa.”
Ki mi Saulo ak icheek kobooto piik tugul che po Israel atebweetap Elah, kobaregei ak Philistiik.

Ki ng'eet `Daudi karon miising' ak kobagakyi keechiirek riibindet yeityo kwo ko uu ye kiga ng'at Jesse koibei tuguuchooto. Ki it ole mi kariisyek ye kiwaachei lugeet agobo pooryeet komachei komanda koba koyai lugeet.
Kitet lugeet Israel ak Philistiik kotoorchingei lugoosyek tuwai.
Ki pagaakyi Daudi tuguukyik riibindetap tuguuk ak kolabat ye mi lugeet kwo kogat weeriik che tupcho.
Ye kita kong'alaaldos ak icheek kotogos nyiganeet, Philistindet ne po Gath ne kainennyi ko ki Goliat komang'une kweanaigap Philistiik ak komwa ng'aleek che cham komwaei ak ki kas Daudi.
Kingo keer piik tugul che po `Israel chiichooto, koiywei kot ak komwee ineendet.

Ki le piigap Israel, “Kaogeer chiichi katogos? Katogosu iman konyo koreenyei Israel. Chii ne parei ineendet, kogoochin laitoryat mogornateet ne oo ak kogoochi cheptonyi kotun ak kotyach kootap kwandanyi eng' Israel.”

Ki ng'alaalji `Daudi piik che kitonondos eng' ye mi ineendet koleenji, “Kiyachin nee chiito ne parei Philistindoni ak koisto teweernatani eng' Israel? Amu ng'oo Philistindoni ma kimuratan kot koreeny lugosyegap Kamuktaindet ne sabei?”
Ki wolji `pichooto ineendet ko uu ni koleenji, “Kiyachin ko uu nooto chiito ne parei ineendet.”

Kingo kas Eliap ng'eetap kamet ne oo kong'alaaljin pichooto, konereech miising' agobo Daudi ak koleenji, “Amu nee si ichooruge? Kebagakyi ng'oo keechiirechooto ng'ering' eng' surkwen? Angen menateng'ung' ak yaityetap muguleldang'ung' amu kechooruge inyoo igeer lugeet.”
Ak ki le Daudi, “Kawech nee nguno? Tos ma mi kiy ne po pani?”
Kiwelelgei kotokyigei chiito age ak komwa ko uu atkai. Ki wolji `piik ineendet kogeny ko uu tai.
Ye ki ngegas ng'aleek che ki mwa Daudi, keba kemwachi Saulo ak kiyookto chii koguur ineendet.
Kingo it koleenji `Daudi Saulo, “Amat kome chii mugulel agobo ineendet; wendi otwogindeng'ung' kobaregei ak Philistindoniito.”
Koleenji `Saulo Daudi, “Memuuchi iwe obargei ak Philistindoniito, amu ta ko ii ming'in ak ineendet ko chiitap lugeet kobooch ming'inatennyi.”
Ki leenji `Daudi Saulo, “Ki iyagi otwogindeng'ung' keechiiregap kwandanyi ak ko ye kingo nyo ng'etundo anan ko tyony age ne kergei ak keerit konam aarwetap keechiir eng' akweet,
awe asu, ak abar ak asaru eng' kutinnyi. Kingo ng'eet kole kobara anam tamnet yeityo akwer ak abar.
Ki par otwogindeng'ung' tyong'ichooto tuwai, ng'etundo ak magalaluut. Igeitu anyun Philistindoniito ma kimuratan age eng' icheek, amu kogoreeny lugosyegap Kamuktaindet ne sabei.
Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne kisarwo eng' siyoogap ng'etundo ak eng' siyoogap tyonyooto, kosarwo eng' eutap Philistindoni.” Koleenji `Saulo Daudi, “Ui ak mi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kobooten.”
Ki ilaakyi `Saulo Daudi ngoryennyi ne po lugeet, ak kogerchine metit kuutweetap sugunwet ak ki ilaakyi ngoryeetap kariik.
Kiratyi Daudi ngoryennyi rotwennyi po chok yeityo kotyem kole kwo amu kitom kotyemei. Ki leenji `Daudi Saulo, “Ma muuchi aip tuguuchu, amu tomo atyeme.” Ara ki ireek Daudi tuguuchooto.

Ki nam kiroktonyi ak kokwechigei kibargoinik muut eng' kereruut ak konde loletap mestoweek ne ki tinyei, nooto ko ki suberennyi, ak komi eunnyi chemasindaryet, ne ki wiirtoe koita, koriikyi anyun Philistindet.
Ki nyo Philistindet koriikyi Daudi ak ki indoe ineendet chiito ne ki ipchin long'eet.
Ak kingo keerot Philistindet ola tugul, kogeer Daudi ak kosas, amu kita ko ming'in ak ki piriir, ak kotinyei togeet ne karaaran.
Koleenji `Philistindet Daudi, “Tos aa seset kot inyoonjo ak kirokweek?” Ak ki chup Philistindonooto Daudi eng' kanamonikyik.
Ki leenji `Philistindet Daudi, “Nyoo ole ami si kobiit agoochi poortang'ung' toriitigap parak ak tyong'igap timiin.”
Koleenji `Daudi Philistindonooto, “Kenyoonjo ak rotwetap chok, ng'otit ak ndirit, ago anyoonjinin eng' kainetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne po lugoosyek, Kamuktaindetap lugosyegap Israel ne koireeny.

Indein rani Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eunnyu. Awirin abariin ak atil meting'ung' yeityo agoochi rani muuswegap lugeetap Philistiik toriitik che po parak, ak tyong'igap timiin che po ng'wony, si kobiit konai ng'wony tugul kole mi Kamuktaindet Israel.
Nae tuiyoni tugul kole, ma saruunee chii Kamuktaindet ne Toroor rotwetap chok ak ng'otit, amu po lugeet Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ak indeok eunekyok.”
Kingo ng'eet Philistindet konyo koriik, kotorook Daudi, kochaakta Daudi, kolabat kotokyigei ole mi lugeet kotorookta Philistindet.
Ki irooch Daudi euut lolennyi ak konem koita konde chemasindaryet ak kowiir Philistindet kokwer turyetap togeet. Kichut koita togeet oriit ak ki ibut kondoe met.
Ki iterteer anyun `Daudi Philistindet eng' chemasindaryanooto ak koita, ki wiir Philistindet kobar ineendet. Ago ki ma komi rootwo ne po chok eutap Daudi.
Ki labat anyun Daudi ak kotonone Philistindet, konam rotwetap Philistindonooto kong'us eng' choget ak kobar ak koebe kaatit kong'et. Kingo keer Philistiik kole kagome nyiganennywa, komwei.

Ki ng'eetyo piigap Israel ak che po Judah ak kowaach yeityo koon Philistiik agoi koit Gath, agoi kurgotigap Ekron. Ki ibutyot eng' ooreet ne wendi Saaraim Philistiik che ki kiguoten agoi Gath ak Ekron.
Kingo week piigap Israel eng' oneet ne ki oonei Philistiik, konyaban nganasennywa.
Ki ip Daudi metitap Philistindonooto konyo Jerusalem, ak kigonoree emainnyi kariigap Philistindet.

Kingo keer `Saulo Daudi kowendi kobaregei ak Philistindet, koteebe Abner ne ki kiptaiyatap lugeet koleenji, “Abner, po kap ng'oo weeri?” Kole Abner, “Ko uu ye sabei saboondang'ung' ee laitoryat, ko mangen.”
Ak ki le laitoryat, “Teep ole po weeriito.”
Ye kingo weeksei Daudi kobunu pareetap Philistindet, konam Abner ineendet ak komut kwo taitap Saulo kotinyei metitap Philistindet eng' eunnyi.
Kingo it koteebe Saulo koleenji, “Ii po kap ng'oo weeri?” Ak ki wolji Daudi koleenji, “Aa weeriitap otwogindeng'ung' Jesse, Bethlehemindet.”
Ye kingo kagogees Daudi kong'alaaljindos ak Saulo, konamgei saboondap Jonathan ak saboondap Daudi. Ki cham `Jonathan ineendet ko uu saboondanyi.
Kong'eetee peetuunooto, komut ineendet `Saulo, mata kochamji kwo kaa, kootap kwandanyi kogeny.
Ki iyomiskei anyun Jonathan ak Daudi, amu ki cham Jonathan ineendet ko uu saboondanyi.
Ki ireek Jonathan ngoryennyi ne po parak ne ki ilaachi ak kogoochi Daudi kobooto ngoryennyi ne kooi, rotwennyi ne po chok, kwangennyi ak pirenennyi.

Ki wo Daudi oldo age tugul ole ki iyookto Saulo, ak ki tebi eng' ng'omnateet. Ki inde `Saulo ineendet koboi murenigap lugeet ak ki myeeit kioto eng' taitap piik tugul, ak eng' taitap otwogigap Saulo ak icheek.

Ye kingo pwanei icheek koweeksei Daudi kobunu pareetap Philistindet, komong' kwonyiik eng' nganasook tugul che po Israel kotyenonu ak kourereni kotorogu Laitoryat Saulo ak kobirei sugutisyek che mengeechen kobooto tuguuk che kibutei eng' poiboiyet.
Kityendos kwonyichooto kourerendos koleen, “Ki par Saulo eliphusyekyik, kobar Daudi tamanusyegap eliphusyekyik.”
Ki nereech Saulo kot. Ma ibaibai ineendet mwaonooto ak ki mwa kole, “Kagoiityi Daudi tamanusyegap eliphuusyek ak koiitya eliphuusyek kityo. Nee age ne kang'et ne nyooru kobatee laitornatet?”
Kobooch peetuunooto agoi, ko kigeerote kong' ne ya `Saulo Daudi.

Eng' peetuut ne ki isubi peetuunooto, konyonji Saulo `tamirmiryet ne ya eng' kimnateet ne ki punu Kamuktaindet. Ki ng'alaal eng' ko ko uu chii ne amei iywek, ak kibut Daudi ketubet eng' eunnyi ko uu ye ki cham koyaei peetuut age tugul. Ki tinyei Saulo ng'otit eng' eunnyi.
Ki toorta ng'otinooto Saulo kotokyi Daudi, amu ki le, “Atoore Daudi kosore koit inaat.” Ago kichilil Daudi eng' tainnyi konyil aeng'.
Ki iywei `Saulo Daudi, amu ki mi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kobooto ineendet, ak kiga kobagaakta Saulo.
Ki isto Saulo anyun ineendet eng' ole mi, ak ki inde ineendet koek kiptaiyatap eliphuut. Ago ki indochi icheek Daudi ye kimandoi ak koweeksei.
Ki tebi Daudi eng' ng'omnateet eng' ortinwekyik tugul ak ki mi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kobooto ineendet.
Kingo keer Saulo kotebyei Daudi eng' ng'omnateet ne oo, koywei ineendet.
Ago ki cham `Israel tugul ak `Judah Daudi, amu ki indochi icheeget ye kimandoi ak koweeksei.

Ki leenji `Saulo Daudi, “Oroni cheptonyu ne oo Merap, agoonin ineendet itun. Egu kityo nyiganennyu, ak iyai lugosyegap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.” Amu ki le Saulo, “Ma mache kotwa eunekyuk ineendet, ago ingobar ineendet eunegap Philistiik.”
Ak ki leenji `Daudi Saulo, “Aa ng'oo ak nee saboondanyu, anan ko ooreetap abba eng' Israel kot aegu saani eng' kaplaitoryat?”
Ago eng' peetuut ne kita kigoochin Daudi Merap cheptap Saulo, kigoochi Adriel Meolatindet kotun.
Ago ki cham `Mikal cheptap Saulo Daudi. ki ngemwachi Saulo ko ki ibaibai ng'olyoondonooto ineendet.

Ki ibwaat anyun Saulo kole, “Agoochini ineendet Mikal si kobiit koek mesteet eng' Daudi, ak si kobiit kobar ineendet eutap Philistiik.” Ki mwachi anyun `Saulo Daudi koleenji ne po aeng', “Itinye kasartap aeng' iegu sandanaa eng' anee.”
Ki ng'at `Saulo otwogikyik koleenji, “Ong'alaal ak Daudi eng' ung'oot oleenji, ‘Keero, paibai laitoryat eng' inyee ak kochamin otwogikyik tugul,’ nooto anyun ko myee iegu saania eng' kaplaitoryat.”
Ki mwachi anyun `otwogigap Saulo Daudi ng'aleechooto kogas. Ago ki mwa Daudi kole, “Ogeere ko kiit ne ming'in eng' okweek koek chii sandetap kaplaitoryat ago anee ko aa chii ne panan ne sasaat?”
Ki mwachi anyun otwogikyik `Saulo koleenji, “Kang'alaal Daudi ko uu ni.”

Kole Saulo, “Omwachini Daudi ko uu ni oleenjini, ‘Ma machei laitoryat kanyiok alak tugul, ago machei irirenik pogol che po Philistiik, si kobiit keyaaktoochi mugetuut puunigap laitoryat.’ ” Ki kabwaatutyetap Saulo kome Daudi eng' eunegap Philistiik.
Kingo mwachi `otwogikyik Daudi ng'aleechuuto, kobaibait komyee Daudi koek sandanaa eng' kaplaitoryat. Kotom kogeskei peetuusyechooto,

kong'eet `Daudi kwo kobooto piikyik kobar Philistiik piik pogol aeng'. Ki ip Daudi irirenikwak ak kogoochi laitoryat irirenichooto tugul si koek saania eng' kaplaitoryat. Ko uu nooto anyun, ko ki igoochi Saulo ineendet Mikal cheptonyi kotun.
Kingo keer ak konai Saulo kole mi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kobooto Daudi, ak ki cham ineendet Mikal cheptonyi,
kotes koiywei Daudi. Ki ek Saulo puunyootap Daudi peetuut age tugul.
Ki manda anyun pounigap Philistiik, ak ye ki cham komandoi, kotebi Daudi eng' ng'omnateet kosiir otwogik tugul che po Saulo, ak ki kigonyit kainennyi miising'.
Ki ng'alaalji `Saulo Jonathan weeriinnyi kobooto otwogikyik tugul koleenji kobar Daudi.

Ago ki paibai miising' Jonathan weeriitap Saulo agobo Daudi. Ara ki mwachi `Jonathan Daudi koleenji, “Cheeng'ei abbannyu Saulo kobarin. Nooto anyun asaain miising' ale, riipkei karon ak itebi eng' ung'oot iunyge.
Amandai ak awe atonon eng' ye neegitee abba eng' keeweet eng' ole imi ak keng'alaal ak ineendet agobo inyee. Ngot ageer kiy amwaun.”
Ki ng'alaalji `Jonathan Saulo kwandanyi ak kochoi Daudi koleenji, “Amat koyachi tengek laitoryat otwogindennyi Daudi, amu ma yaun tengek ak amu kagomyagitu miising' poisyonikyik che kogoyaun.

Ma iit saboondanyi ak kogobar Philistindet ak ki yai Kamuktaindet ne Toroor yetunet ne oo agobo Israel tugul. Ki igeer kioto aginye ak ki ibaibaitu, amu nee anyun si iyachi tengek korotiik che ma tinyei tengek, ibar Daudi puch?”
Ki kas `Saulo ng'olyootap Jonathan, ak koyasyo Saulo kole, “Ko uu ye sabei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, koma ki parei ineendet.”
Ki kuur anyun `Jonathan Daudi ak komwachi ineendet tuguuchooto tugul. Ki imut `Jonathan Daudi kwo ole mi Saulo ak ki tebee tainnyi ko uu eng' tai.
Ki piit lugeet kogeny, ak kimanda Daudi kwo kobargei ak Philistiik. Ki par icheek eng' pareet ne oo kot komweiso eng' tainnyi.
Ago ki nyoonji Saulo `tamirmiryet ne ya ne ki punu Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ye kitebyei eng' koonnyi kotinyei ng'otit eng' eunnyi. Kibutei Daudi kibugandet eng' eunnyi.
Kileen Saulo kotoor Daudi eng' ng'otit kosoree inaat, ago kichilil eng' taitap Saulo, ak kitoor inaatut eng' ng'otit. Kochilil Daudi ak komwei kemounooto.
Ki iyookto `Saulo piik koba kootap Daudi koriip ineendet kole si kobar ineendet karon. Ki mwachi Daudi `Mikal osotyonnyi koleenji, “Ngot ko mesaru saboondang'ung' kemouni kebarin mutai.”
Ki choorta anyun `Mikal Daudi kwo ng'wony kobun tirisyet, ak ki mwei kochilil.
Ki nam `Mikal kanamwet ak komogon eng' itoogut ak kotichine metit mutoit ne po koroorigap ng'oroorek yeityo kotuge ngoroik.
Ye kingo yookto `Saulo piik koba konam Daudi, komwa kwondonyi kole, “Myani.”
Ki iyookto `Saulo pichooto koba kogeer Daudi ak koleenji, “Omutwaa konyo eng' itogunnyi si abar.”
Kingo pwa ko pichooto, konyoor komi kanamwet itook ak komi metinnyi mutoinotap koroorigap ng'oroorek.
Ki leenji `Saulo Mikal, “Amu nee si igena ko uu ni ak ichuunde punyondennyu kwo kot ko nguno ko kagochilil?” Kowolji `Mikal Saulo koleenji “Ki leenjo, pagaakta awo. Kalya si imach abariin?”
Kimwei anyun Daudi, kochilil ak kwo ole mi Samuel eng' Ramah. Ki wo komwachi tuguuk tugul che ki yachi ineendet Saulo. Yeityo koba tuwai ak Samuel koba komeny Naiot.
Ki kimwachi Saulo keleenji, “Keero, miitei Daudi Naiot eng' Ramah.”

Ara anyun ki iyookto `Saulo piik koba konam Daudi, ak kingo keer tuiyetap maotik komaotendos ng'aleek, kotononi Samuel kondochin icheek, konyonji `Kabuusetap Kamuktaindet piigap Saulo ak komaotenso ak icheek.
ki ngemwachi Saulo ng'aleechooto, koyookto piik alak ago ki maotenso ak icheek. Ki iyookto `Saulo piik ne po somok ak ki maotenso ak icheek.
Ki wo ineendet agine Ramah kot koit ole mi keriinget ne oo ne po peek ne miitei Seku. Kiteep kole, “Mi ano Samuel ak Daudi?” Ak ki le chiito age, “Mi Naiot eng' Ramah.”
Ki wo olooto po Naiot eng' Ramah, ak ki nyoonji ineendet agine Kabuusetap Kamuktaindet, ak ki wo komaotenot kot koit Naiot eng' Ramah.
Ki ireek ngoroikyik ak komaoten agine eng' taitap Samuel. Ki ru aach ngor peetuunooto tugul ak kemounooto tugul. Nooto anyun kimwaei keleen, “Tos age Saulo agine eng' maotik?”
Kimwei Daudi eng' Naiot eng' Ramah ak kwo komwa eng' taitap Jonathan kole, “Ki ayai nee? Nee tengektonyu? Nee chalwoktanyu eng' taitap kwandang'ung' si kocheeng'ei saboondanyu?”
Koleenji Jonathan, “Ingolooit nooto, memee; keero, ma yaei abba kiy ne oo anan ne ming'in, ama iboorwo. Amu nee si koung'ena Abba kiito? Ma uu nooto.”

Ak ki iyasyo Daudi kogeny kole, “Ingen kwandang'ung' komyee kole ichamoo; nooto amu nee asi koleenjigei, ‘Amat konai Jonathan kiito si ma aragen.’ Ago iman ko uu ye sabei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ak ko uu ye sabei saboondang'ung' agine, komi kakwautyet agenge kityo eng' kwenunnyu ak meet.”
Koleenji anyun `Jonathan Daudi, “Kiit age tugul ne machei saboondang'ung', ayaun kioto.”
Ki leenji `Daudi Jonathan, “Leelei arawet mutai ago magaat atebi ak laitoryat eng' amisyet. Kaigai chamwo awo si aunygei eng' timiin agoi peetuutap somok koskoleny.

Ngot kogeer kwandang'ung' kole ma mi, imwachi anyun ileenji, ‘Kosooma Daudi miising' kole achamji kolabat kwo Bethlehem nganasennyi. Amu mi olooto tiseiywotap kenyiit age tugul ne po ooreenywa tugul.’
Ngot komwa kole, ‘Myee,’ konyooru anyun otwogindeng'ung' kaalyeet, ago ngot konereech, inai anyun ile kagotil kole yaei kiit ne ya.

Eng' nooto anyun iyachi ne myee otwogindeng'ung'; amu ki iyachi otwogindeng'ung' arorutyet ne po Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kobooten: ago ngot atinye tengekto, ibara inyeendet, amu kalya si imutyo kwandang'ung'?”
Ki le Jonathan, “Ingolooit eng' inyee, amu nda angen ale kagotil Abba kole koyaun kiit ne ya, ko tos ma mwaun?”
Koleenji anyun `Daudi Jonathan, “Ng'oo ne mwaiwo ngot kogowolun kwandang'ung' eng' koroomnateet?”
Koleenji `Jonathan Daudi, “Nyoo keebe turguin.” Ara ki pa tuwai anyun turguin.

Ki leenji `Jonathan Daudi, “Ingoek paoryat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindetap Israel, ye ateebee Abba mutai koteni asiis anan eng' peetuutap somok, ngot komi ng'olyoo ne myee agobo Daudi, ko tos mayogun ak aboorun?

Ingoyachi `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Jonathan ko uu nooto ak kosiir, ngot kochamei abba koyaun ne ya, ama amwaun. Amwaun si kobiit iwe eng' kaalyeet. Ingotebi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kobooten ko uu ye ki mi kobooto abba.
Ngo ta asabe, iboorwo myeeindap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ago ye amei,
ko meiste myeeindong'ung' eng' koonnyu koigeny. Achicha meiste agot ye kagoisto Kamuktaindet ne Toroor puunik alak tugul che po Daudi eng' ng'wony.
Ki yai anyun `Jonathan arorutyet kobooto kootap Daudi kole, Tuun mage Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kioto eunegap puunigap Daudi.”
Ki iyasyechi `Jonathan Daudi ne po aeng', amu chamyet ne oo ne kiting'e ineendet, amu ki chamei ineendet ko uu ye ki chamei saboondanyi.
Ki leenji anyun `Jonathan ineendet, “Leelei arawet mutai. Kigeerei keele memi, amu mi ng'echereeng'ung' puch.
Ye kaibeni peetuusyek somok, ichoortegei ichakte iit ole kigeung'egei ye ki kimwaei ng'aleechooto yeityo itebee ole neegitee koitap Esel.
Amwoge tabandanyi eng' kipchabonik somok; ko uu ye kamwoge kiy.

Yeityo ayoogu muren aleenji, Ui cheeng' kipchabonik. Ngot amwachi murenonooto aleenji, Keero, miitei kipchabonik komosi, iyum, inyoo anyun, amu ko uu ye sabei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ko miitei kaalyeet eng' inyee, ama mi ng'oiyondit.
Ago ngot amwachi weerooto aleenji, Miitei komosin kipchabonik, iwe, amu kamwaun Kamuktaindet ne Toroor iwe.
Ak agobo ng'aleek chu kagagimwa inyee ak anee, ko keero, mi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kwenunnyo.”
Ki unygei Daudi anyun eng' turguin, ak kingo leel arawet, kotep ng'wony laitoryat koamis.
Ki tebee laitoryat ng'echerennyi ko uu peetuusyek alak eng' ng'echereet ne kineegite inaat: ak ki tonon Jonathan, ak ki tebee Abner ole neegitee Saulo, ago kimi puch komostap Daudi.
Ago ki ma mwa ng'olyoo age tugul peetuunooto Saulo. Amu ki ibwaat kole, “Kagonyonji kiy ineendet; ma tiliil ineendet; iman ma tiliil ineendet.”
Eng' peetuut ne po aeng' ko kagoleel arawet, kogimi puch komostap Daudi. ki teebee `Saulo Jonathan weeriinnyi koleenji, “Amu nee si ma nyo weeriitap Jesse amisyet amut ak raini?”
Kowolji `Jonathan Saulo koleenji, “Kosoom Daudi kwo Bethlehem

kole, ‘Asoomin ale chamwo awo, amu enyei piigap ooreennyo tiseiywot eng' nganaseet ak kong'ata weeriit ne ketupche awo. Nguno anyun ko ngot iyanwo eng' myeeindong'ung', asoomin ale chamwo awo ageer che kitupche.’ Nooto anyun amu nee si ma nyo meseetap laitoryat.”

Ki nereekyi anyun `Saulo Jonathan ochei, ak komwachi ineendet koleenji, “Weeri po kwondo ne imaasat ak ko ngelelyot! Tos mangen ale ki ilewen weeriitap Jesse, ne egu kalilaneng'ung' ak koegu kalilanetap aach ngoryeet ne po kamenng'ung'?
Amu kotee kota kosabei weeriitap Jesse eng' ng'wony, koma ki kimiitin anan ki kimiit laitornateng'ung'. Iyookte anyun kimutwaa ineendet, amu meei iman.”
Kowolji `Jonathan kwandanyi Saulo koleenji, “Kibarei amu nee? Koyai nee?”
Kitoor `Saulo ineendet eng' ng'otit koleen kobar. Konae nooto anyun Jonathan kole kogotil kwandanyi kobar Daudi.
Kong'eet anyun Jonathan eng' meset eng' nereegek che ng'woneen. Ma amis eng' peetuutap aeng' ne po arawet, amu ki arageni agobo Daudi, amu ki iteweer kwandanyi.
Ki eng' karon, kwo Jonathan turguin eng' sait ne kiga ng'at Daudi. Ki pendi ak weero ne neran.
Ak ki leenji weeroto ming'in, “Labat si icheeng' kipchabonik che amwoktoi.” Ak ye kilabati lakwanooto, komwokto kipchabet kondoe ineendet.
Kingo it lakwanooto ole ki mi kipchabet ne kiga mwokto Jonathan, koguur `Jonathan lakwanooto koleenji, “Ta komi tai kipchabet!”
Ki kuur `Jonathan weeroto koleenji, “Chaakte labat, mat igagei.” Ki iyum weeroto po Jonathan kipchabonik yeityo konyo ole mi kiptaiyandennyi.
Ago ki ma nai kiy age tugul. Jonathan ak Daudi icheegei che ki ingen ng'aleechooto.
Ki igoochi Jonathan kariikyik lakwanatonyi ak koleenji, “Ui, ip tuguuchu koba nganaseet.”

Kingwo weerooto, kong'eet Daudi eng' ole tokyingei murot tai ak kong'uruuk kotiing'e togeennyi ng'wony. Ki ing'uruuk konyil somok, yeityo kotorochkei icheek ak koriiryo, ak kitesak miising' riiregap Daudi.

Ki leenji `Jonathan Daudi, “Ui eng' kaalyeet, amu ko uu ye kagiyosye tuwai eng' kainetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ko Kamuktaindet ne Toroor paoryat eng' kwenunnyo anee ak inyee ak eng' kwenutap iyotennyu ak iyoteng'ung' koigeny.” Ki ng'eet anyun Daudi kwo, ak ki wo Jonathan nganaseet.
Ki wo anyun Daudi Nob kap Ahimelek tisiindet. Ki nyo Ahimelek kotorook Daudi kobotanonu ak koleenji, “Amu nee si imi inyegei? Amu nee si ma mi chii kobooten?”

Kowolji `Daudi Ahimelek tisiindet koleenji, “Kang'ata laitoryat komwaiwo ng'olyoo kole, Mat igany konai chii agobo ng'olyoondoniito kayooktochin, anan agobo kiit ne kang'atiin. Agobo murenik che cham kemi tugul, ko kang'at icheek koba uiya.
Ara itinye nee anyun nguno eng' eung'ung'? Koono magatiinik muut anan ko kiit age tugul ne itinye.”
Ago ki wolji `tisiindonooto Daudi koleenji, “Ma mi magatiinik che ma itabaanatiin, kobatee magatiinik che tiliileen. Agoonin ngot ko koitabaangei murenjoto eng' kwonyiik.”

Kowolji `Daudi tisiindonooto koleenji, “Eng' iman, ko kitabaanenech kwonyiik eng' peetuusyechu somok, ko uu uitugul ye cham awendi lugeet. Ngot kocham kotabaanotiin tuguugap murenik agot eng' pandap peetuusyek tugul, ko tos anyun itabaanatiin tuguukwak ne tya ra?”

Kogoochi anyun `tisiindet ineendet magatiinik che itabaanatiin, amu ki ma komi magatiinik alage kobatee magatiinik che itabaanatiin, che ki kinemu eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor. Ki kinemu si kinde magatiinik che kabunu ma eng' peetuut ne kagiisto che kami.
Ki mi yooto chiito age ne po otwogigap Saulo eng' peetuunooto ne ki kiraany kotebi eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor. Kainennyi ko ki Doeg, Edomindet. Ineendet ko ki ne oo eng' mestowegap Saulo.
Ki teebe `Daudi Ahimelek koleenji, “Metinye eng' yu ng'otit anan ko rotwetap chok eng' eung'ung'? Ma aibu rotwennyu anan ko kariikyuk, amu komachei poisyetap laitoryat kechokyi.”

Kowol tisiindonooto kole, “Mi yu rotwetap chok ne po Goliat Philistindoni ki ibare eng' atebweetap Elah. Ki kitaae angeet ak miitei eng' patetap ephod. Ngot imache iip nooto, iip, amu ma mi age yu kobatee nooto.” Kole `Daudi, “Ma mi age ne kergei, koono nooto.”
Ki ng'eet anyun `Daudi komwei peetuunooto amu ki iywei Saulo ak kwo kap Akis laitoryatap Gath.

Ago ki leenji `otwogikyik Akis, Tos ma Daudi niito laitoryatap emet? Tos ki ma tyenjigei icheek agobo ineendet eng' ureryosyek kole, “Ki par `Saulo eliphusyekyik, Kobar `Daudi tamanusyegap eliphuusyek?”
Kigonor `Daudi ng'aleechuuto eng' muguleldanyi; ak ki iywei `Akis laitoryatap Gath Daudi miising'.
Ara ki wal atebeennyi eng' tainnywa ak ki yaigei koigei kibiywet eng' eunekwak, ak kisirasir kurgotigap ormariichet ak kobagaakta meninek kochoortaegei tamnennyi.
Ki leenji anyun `Akis otwogikyik, “Ogeero, ogeere ole kibiywo chiichi! Amu nee anyun si omutwaa?
Tos korerwo kibionik kot omutwaa chiichi konyo koiiywen eng' tainnyu? Tos nyolu konyo chiichi koonnyu?”
Ki wo `Daudi anyun eng' olooto kochilil kwo kebeneetap Adulam. Kingo kas tupchosyekyik ak piik tugul che po kootap kwandanyi, kochoortagei koba ole mi.

Ki iyumjigei ineendet chii age tugul ne kinyalili, age tugul ne ki tinyei pesen ak age tugul ne ki tinyei ng'wanindo eng' muguleldanyi, ak ki ek ineendet kiptaiyannywa. Ki mi ak ineendet murenik olo po pogol ang'wan.
Ki wo eng' olooto `Daudi kwo Mispe ne po Moab ak koleenji laitoryatap Moab, “Asoomin ale chamji abba ak kamennyu kobwa otebi tugul agoi anai kiit ne yaiywo Kamuktaindet.”
Ki imut icheek kobwa taitap laitoryatap Moab, ak kimeng'iis ak ineendet eng' peetuusyek tugul che ki mi Daudi kebeneet.
Ago ki leenji maotyot `Gad Daudi, “Amat itebee kebeneet, ng'et ak iwe emetap Judah.” Ara ki wo anyun Daudi ak ki it timdap Heret.

Ki kas `Saulo anyun kole ki kenyoor Daudi kobooto murenik che mi ak ineendet. Kitepchei ng'wony `Saulo eng' Gibea eng' keetit keel eng' Ramah, kotinyei ng'otit eng' eunnyi ak kitonondos otwogikyik eng' ye neegitee ineendet.

Ki leenji `Saulo otwogichooto kitonondos, “Ogas nguno okweek Benjaminik. Tos igoochi weeriitap Jesse chii age tugul eng' okweek mbareenik ak mbareenigap sabibuk? Tos yaak okweek tugul oegu kiptainigap eliphuusyek ak kiptainigap pogolwogik,

kot ko kochaama okweek tugul? Ma mi agot agenge eng' okweek ne ng'ang'wa ye yaei arorutyet weeriinnyu ak weeriitap Jesse, ama mi chii eng' okweek ne rireena anan ko ne ng'ang'wa kole kogong'eet weeriinnyu otwogindennyu kosuryena, kosapcha, ko uu rani?”
Eng' yooto, kowol anyun `Doeg Edomindet ne kitononi eng' ye neegitee otwogigap Saulo kole, “Ki ageer weeriitap Jesse konyonei Nob, ole mi Ahimelek weeriitap Ahitub.
Kiteepsechi Ahimelek eng' Kamuktaindet ne Toroor agobo ineendet yeityo kogoochi amitwogik ak rotwetap chok ne ki po Goliat Philistindet.”
Ki iyookto anyun laitoryat keguur tisiindet Ahimelek, weeriitap Ahitub ak piik tugul che po kootap kwandanyi che ki tisiik che ki mi Not, ak ki pwa icheek tugul ole mi laitoryat.
Ki le `Saulo, “Kas nguno inyee weeriitap Ahitub.” Ak ki wol kole, “Ami yu, kiptaiyandennyu.”

Ki mwachi `Saulo ineendet koleenji, “Amu nee si ochaama inyee ak weeriitap Jesse, ki igoochi ineendet magatiinik, ak rotwetap chok, ki iteebsechi ineendet eng' Kamuktaindet si kong'eetya koboryena, kosapcha, ko uu rani?”
Kowolji anyun `Ahimelek laitoryat koleenji, “Ago ng'oo eng' otwogiguk tugul ne po iman ko uu Daudi ne sandanaa eng' laitoryat, ne ki kinem kwo kapkirwoogeng'ung' ak ko konyitot eng' koong'ung'?

Tos katau rani ateepsechi ineendet eng' Kamuktaindet? Ingolooit eng' anee, amat koiityi laitoryat kiy age tugul otwogindennyi anan koot tugul ne po abba. Amu ma ingen otwogindeng'ung' agobo ng'aleechu tugul che ng'ering' anan ngo che chaang'.”
Ago ki le laitoryat, “Imee iman inyee Ahimelek ak piik tugul che po kootap kwandang'ung'.”

Yeityo koleenji `laitoryat riibiik che kitonondos eng' ye neegitee ineendet, “Owelelgei ak obar tisiigap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor; amu ting'egei icheek yamdaet ak Daudi, amu ki ingen kole ki mwei ama ng'ang'wa.” Ago ma cham otwogigap laitoryat kochuul eunekwak kobar tisiigap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.

Eng' yooto, koleenji Laitoryat Doeg, “Welelgei inyee, ak ibar tisiik.” Kiwelelgei anyun Doeg Edomindet ak kobar tisiik. Ki par eng' peetuunooto piik tamanwogik sisiit ak muut che ki ilaachi ephod ne po katanit.
Ki par kora Nob nganaseetap tisiik eng' rotwetap chok; murenik ak kwonyiik, lagok ak che reryei, ak tuuga kobooto sigiroik ak keechiirek.
Kichilil age eng' weeriigap Ahimelek weeriitap Ahitub, ne ki kiguure Abiathar ak komwei koosup Daudi.
Ki mwachi `Abiathar Daudi koleenji, “Kogobar Saulo tisiigap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.”
Ki leenji `Daudi Abiathar, “Kiganai eng' peetuunooto, ye kimi yooto Doeg Edomindet ale mwachin iman Saulo. Koaipchi meet piik tugul che po kootap kwandang'ung'.
Tebi kobooto, ameiyweisye, amu ineendet ne cheeng'ei saboondanyu kocheeng'ei saboondang'ung'. Ngemi tuwai ko ii riiboot.”
ki ngemwachi Daudi keleenji, “Paregei Philistiik ak Keila ak kochoorei tuguuk eng' rwanyut ne kiboorsee,”
koteebe anyun Daudi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor koleenji, “Tos myee awo abar Philistichuuto?” Ak ki leenji `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Daudi, “Ui ak ibar Philistiik ak isaru Keila.”
Ago ki leenji `piikyik Daudi, “Ngot kiyweisyei eng' olito po Judah, ko siirei ne tya anyun ngot keebe Keila kebarge ak lugosyegap Philistiik?”
koteebee anyun Daudi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kogeny, ak ki wolji `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ineendet koleenji, “Ng'eet, choortegei Keila, amu andoi Philistiik euneguk.”
Ki wo `Daudi Keila kobooto piikyik kobargei ak Philistiik. Kiluul tuukwak ak kobar piik eng' pareet ne oo. Ki sar anyun `Daudi piigap Keila.
Kingo mwechi Abiathar weeriitap Ahimelek Daudi eng' Keila, kochoorgei kotinyei ephod eng' eunnyi.
ki ngemwachi Saulo keleenji, “Kogonyo `Daudi Keila,” kole, “Kagonde Kamuktaindet ineendet eunnyu, amu kagegerchi oriit, amu ki wo nganaseet ne tinyei ormariichok ak temeleiywek.”
Ki kuur anyun `Saulo piik tugul kochoortagei koba lugeet eng' Keila, koba koyiem Daudi ak piikyik.
Ago ki nai Daudi kole chobei `Saulo yaityet agobo ineendet. Ki leenji Abiathar tisiindet, “Ibu ephod konyo yu.”
Yeityo komwa Daudi kole, “Ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindetap Israel kagogas iman otwogindeng'ung' kole, machei konyo `Saulo Keila, konyo kobar nganaseet agobo anee.

Tos indea piigap Keila eunnyi? Chorugei Saulo, ko uu ye kagogas otwogindeng'ung'? Ee, Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindetap Israel, asoomin miising' ale, mwachi otwogindeng'ung'.” Kowol Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole, “Chorugei.”
Kotep `Daudi anyun kole, “Tos indea anee ak piikyuk eutap Saulo piigap Keila?” Ak ki le Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, “Indein.”
Ki ng'eet anyun Daudi kobooto piikyik che ki olo po pogol lo ak koba eng' Keila, koba oldo tugul ole ki imuuch koba. ki ngemwachi Saulo keleenji ki komwei Daudi eng' Keila, ko mata kwo.
Ki tebee `Daudi irimoik eng' surkwen ak ki tebee emetap tuloonook eng' surkwen ne po Ziph. Ki cheeng'ei `Saulo ineendet eng' peetuut age tugul, ago ma inde `Kamuktaindet ineendet eunnyi.
Kingo mi Daudi surkwen ne po Ziph eng' timiin, konai anyun kole kagonyo saang' Saulo kocheeng' saboondanyi.
Ki ng'eet Jonathan weeriitap Saulo ak kwo ole mi Daudi eng' timiin kogimit ineendet eng' Kamuktaindet.
Ki leenji ineendet, “Meiywei, amu ma nyoorun eutap kwandanyu Saulo, ak iegu laitoryat eng' Israel, ak aegu ne rubin. Agot Saulo kwandanyu kongen nooto agine.”
Ki iyomiskei tuwai eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor. Ki tebee Daudi timiin ak ko ki wo Jonathan koonnyi.
Ki pa anyun `Sipik kotogosta ole mi Saulo eng' Gibea koba koleenji, “Tos ma unyegei Daudi eng' olinnyo eng' irimoik che mi timiin eng' tulweetap Hakila, ne mi murot tai ne po surkwen?
Ara anyun, ee laitoryandani nyoo choorugei ko uu mageet tugul ne po saboondang'ung', poisyennyo koginde ineendet eutap laitoryat.”
Kowol `Saulo kole, “Ingoberuurok Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, amu kaorireena.
Asoomok anyun ale oba ocheeng' komyee si ogeer ak onai ole mi, onai ineendet ne keerei ineendet eng' olooto, amu ki kimwaiwo keele poisyee ng'aalseet.
Ogeer anyun ak onai komoswek tugul ole ung'egei yeityo obwa kogeny yu ami oibu ng'aleek che po iman, si keebe tugul. Ngot komi emoni, acheeng'oti eng' eliphuusyek tugul che po Judah.”
Ki ng'eetyo koba Ziph kondoe Saulo, ago kimi Daudi ak piikyik surkwen ne po Maon eng' Arabah murot tai ne po surkwen.

Ki pa Saulo ak piikyik koba kocheeng' ineendet. Ak ki ngemwachi Daudi, kochoortagei anyun kwo ole mi rwandet, ak ki tebee surkwen ne po Maon. Kingo kas Saulo, kwo koosup Daudi eng' surkwen ne po Maon.
Ak ki pun Saulo tulweet komosi, ak ki pun Daudi ak piikyik tulweet komosin. Kichaakta Daudi komwei amu ki iywei Saulo, amu kiyiem `Saulo ak piikyik Daudi kobooto piikyik kole konam.
Ago ki nyo chii komwachi Saulo koleenji, “Nyoo chogu, amu kagopookyi emet Philistiik.”
Ki week anyun `Saulo mata koosup Daudi ak ki wo kobargei ak Philistiik. Kiguure yooto anyun Sela-hamalekot.
Ak kitogosta Daudi eng' yooto kwo komeny irimoigap En-gedi.
Ye kingo kagoweek `Saulo eng' kasubet ne ki isubi Philistiik, kemwachi keleenji, “Miitei Daudi surkwen ne po En-gedi.”
Kingo kas ko uu nooto Saulo konam murenik eliphuusyek somok che ki kilewen eng' Israel tugul, koba kocheeng' Daudi ak piikyik eng' rwandosyegap sitok.
Ki it ole mi piusyegap keechiirek eng' ooreet eng' ole ki mi kebeneet. Ki wo Saulo oriit ak kotoretkei. Ki mi Daudi ak piikyik kebenooto oriit miising'.

Ak ki leenji `piikyik Daudi, “Eng' iman ko peetuut ni ne kimwaun Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole, ‘Andai punyondeng'ung' eung'ung', si iyachi kiit ne igeere ile myee eng' inyee.’ ” Ki ng'eet anyun Daudi kosapta ak kotil tabandap ngoryeetap Saulo eng' ung'oot.
Eng' let kogas Daudi ng'wanindo eng' muguleldanyi, amu kagotil tabandap ngoryeetap Saulo.

Ki leenji piikyik, “Ingolooit eng' anee eng' Kamuktaindet ne Toroor si ma yachi kiptaiyandennyu ne iilaat ne po Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, kiy ne uu ni si ma chuul eunnyu ayachi kiy ne ya, amu ineendet ko ne iilaat ne po Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.”
Ki eetee anyun `Daudi piikyik ng'aleechuuto ama chamji kong'eetyo kobar Saulo. Ki ng'eet Saulo kwo eng' kebeneet ak kwo pandanyi.

Yeityo kong'eet Daudi agine ak kwo eng' kebeneet ak komwachi Saulo eng' kutit ne oo, koleenji, “Kiptaiyandennyu laitoryat.” Kingo kuskong' Saulo, kong'uruuk Daudi kot kotiiny togeennyi ng'wony, kogutung'ji.
Koleenji `Daudi Saulo, “Amu nee si igas ng'aleegap piik, che mwaei kole, ‘Cheeng'ei Daudi koyaun kiy ne ya?’

Kaigeer eng' konyeguk rani ile kaindein Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eunnyu eng' kebeneet. Kamwaiwo piik alage kole abariin, ago karirenen, ak kamwa ale, machuule eunnyu abare kiptaiyandennyu, amu ineendet ko ne iilaat ne po Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.

Kogeny, ee, keero abba keer walitap ngoryeeng'ung' ne mi eunnyu! Katil walitap ngoryeeng'ung' ak ma abariin, nai anyun ak igeer ile ma tinye yaityet anan ko pistoet eng' eunekyuk ak tomo ayaun tengek agot nganda icheeng'e saboondanyu ibar.
Ingooiyech Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ak ingoyooktoiwo Kamuktaindet ne Toroor mugetuut eng' inyee, ago ma parin eunnyu.
Ko uu ye mwaei kalewenetap piik che po keny, kole, ‘Punu sogornateet sogoranik,’ ago ma parin eunnyu.
Kamong' saang' laitoryatap Israel koon ng'oo? Ioone ng'oo? Ioone seset ne ki kome, anan kimityat?
Ingoek Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kirwoogindet, kotil kirwooget eng' kwenunnyo, anee ak inyee, kogeer, kong'alaal agobo anee ak kosarwo eng' eung'ung'.”
Kingo kagogees `Daudi ng'aleechooto kimwachin Saulo, komwa ineendet kole, “Kuting'ung' niito weeriinnyu Daudi?” Ak kiwaach Saulo eng' kutit ne oo.
Ki mwachi `laitoryat Daudi koleenji, “Ii po iman isiira, amu kaiyaiywo ne myee, ago ki ayaun ne ya.
Kaibarte rani ile kaiyaiywo ne myee, amu ko uu ye kaindea Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eung'ung', koma ibara.
Amu tos ngot konyoor chii punyondennyi, kobagaaktoi kwo kochamegei? Nooto anyun ingogoonin Kamuktaindet ne Toroor myeeindo agobo nooto keyaiywo rani.
Nguno anyun, angen ale iegu laitoryat iman ak ki kimiti laitornatetap Israel eng' eung'ung'.
Iyosyeiwo anyun eng' Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ile, meistoi iyotennyu che piitu let eng' anee ak ile megesu kainennyu eng' kootap abba.”
Ara anyun ki iyasyechi `Daudi Saulo. Yeityo kwo Saulo kaa, ago kitogosta Daudi ak piikyik koba irimeet.
Kime Samuel, ak ki iyumgei Israel tugul ak koba koriirchi ineendet yeityo kotupchi ineendet koonnyi eng' Ramah. Ki ng'eet Daudi ak kochoortagei kwo surkwen ne po Paran.
Ki mi chii Maon ne ki mi tuguukyik Karmel. Ki chii ne ki tagunoot chiichooto ak ki tinyei keechiirek eliphuusyek somok ak ng'oroorek eliphuut agenge, ak kitilei koroorigap keechiirekyik eng' Karmel.

Kainetap chiichooto ko ki Nabal, ak kainetap osotyonnyi ko ki Abigail. Ki ng'oom osotyondonooto ak ko ki tinyei itoondo ne karaaran, ago ki uui met manong'otyonnyi ak ki yaach poisyonikyik. Ki po chiichi ooreetap Kaleb.
Kingo mi `Daudi surkwen, kogas keele tilei Nabal koroorigap keechiirekyik.
Ara ki iyookto anyun `Daudi murenik taman koleenji, “Otogoste Karmel ak obe ole mi Nabal ak ogat ineendet eng' kainennyu,
yeityo omwachi ineendet ne meng'iisyei eng' kaberuret oleenji, ‘Ingotep kaalyeet kobooten, kobooto koong'ung' ak tugul che itinye.
Kaagas keele itinye piik che tilei koroorigap keechiirek; kogotebi mestoweguk kobootech ama ki yachi kiy ne ya, anan kobetyi icheek kiy age tugul eng' peetuusyek tugul ye kimi Karmel.

Teebe murenjotoguget si komwaun. Ingonyoor anyun chameet murechuchuk eng' taing'ung', amu kagibwa eng' peetuut ne myee. Asoomin anyun ale, igoochi otwogiguk ak weeriing'ung' Daudi kiy age tugul ne itinye.’ ”
Ye kingo it murenjoto po Daudi, komwachi Nabal ng'aleechooto tugul eng' kainetap Daudi yeityo kosiisyo.
Ki wolji `Nabal otwogigap Daudi koleenji, “Daudi ko ng'oo? Ak weeriitap Jesse ko ng'oo? Chaang' otwogik peetuusyechu che mwee kiptaiyannywa.
Amu nee si anam amitwogikyuk, peekyuk, ak panyeek che kaeng'ji piikyuk che tilei koroorigap keechiirek ak agoochi piich che mangen ole punu?”
Kiwelelgei anyun murenjoto po Daudi ak koweektagei ak koba komwachi ineendet ng'aleechuuto tugul.

Koleenji `Daudi piikyik, “Ingorat chii tugul rotwennyi po chok.” Ki rat chii tugul rotwennyi po chok ak ki rat Daudi agine rotwennyi po chok ak kotogosta murenik olo po pogol ang'wan koosup Daudi. Ago ki tebi murenik pogolwogik aeng'u koriip tuguuk.
Ago ki mwachi age eng' murenjoto Abigail osotyotap Nabal koleenji, “Ki iyook `Daudi piik kobwa eng' surkwen nyoo kogat kiptaiyandennyo ago ki nereekyi ineendet icheek.
Ago kiyaiywech ne myee kot pichooto ama amenech kiy, ama petwech kiy ye kita kemi tugul ye ki kimi kewanin.
Ki ek icheek ng'ootwennyo kemoi ak peet eng' peetuusyek tugul ye ki kimiitei tugul ak icheek kiyagi keechiirek.
Nai anyun ak ibwaat kiit ne iyae, amu kigetilji yaityet kiptaiyandennyo ak koonnyi tugul. Amu ineendet ko chii ne ya, ne uui met ak ma imuuchi chii kotwekyi.”

Kichirchiren anyun Abigail ak konam magatiinik pogol aeng' ak sotonik aeng' che po divaik, ak keechiirek muut che kageeny che chobootiin, keruutik muut che nyiitootiin peek che kagegel, mooriik pogol che mi sabibuk che yamyotiin ak magatiinik pogol aeng' che po mogoonik ak koratyi sigiroik.
Yeityo koleenji piikyik, “Oba ondoena, anyoone asubwok.” Ago ki ma mwachi manong'otyondennyi Nabal.
Ye kita kobunei sigiryennyi, kochoortagei kobun ole ma taagu eng' tulweet, ko ki choorugei Daudi ak piikyik kotoorchingei ineendet ak kituiye icheek.
Kigale `Daudi, “Kaagaa ki ariip puch iman tuguuk tugul che ki tinyei chiichi eng' surkwen kot koma pet kiy eng' tuguukyik tugul, ak kagoweekwa yaityet eng' ne myee.
Ingoyachi Kamuktaindet ko uu nooto puunigap Daudi ak kotes koosir ngot abagaakte kiy age tugul ne nenyi mutai kaeech agot lakweet agenge ne ng'etet.”
Ye kingo keer `Abigail Daudi, kochoorgei eng' chokyinet eng' sigiryennyi ak kobutyi taitap Daudi, kong'uruuk kotiing'e togeet ng'wony.
Ki ibutyi keelyekyik ak koleenji, “Ingobunjo yaityoni kiptaiyandennyu, ingobunjo Asaain ale, chamji cheptong'ung' ne otwoget kong'alaal igas ak igasyi cheptong'ung' ne otwoget ng'aleekyik.

Asaain kiptaiyandennyu ale mat iit kipyaitwani ile kiy, amu ko uu kiit ne uu kainennyi, ko uu nooto ineendet. Kainennyi ko Nabal, ak tinyei abusnateet. Ma ageer anee cheptong'ung' ne otwogindet murenjoto po kiptaiyandennyu che kigeyagu.

Ara anyun kiptaiyandennyu, ko uu ye sabei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ak ko uu ye sabei saboondang'ung', ak ko uu ye kietenen Kamuktaindet ne Toroor si metumde korotiik, si meyaaktochigei mugetuut eng' eung'ung', ko ingoigei puuniguk Nabal ak icheek che cheeng'jin yaityet kiptaiyandennyu.
Ingigoochi kagoochinoni kaipchin otwogindeng'ung' kiptaiyandennyu, ingigoochi murenik che isuboti kiptaiyandennyu.

Asaain ale nyochi kaat cheptong'ung' ne otwogindet lelutyennyi, amu igimiti Kamuktaindet ne Toroor iman kootap kiptaiyandennyu, amu yaei kiptaiyandennyu lugosyegap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ama kinyoorchinin yaityet eng' peetuusyeguk tugul.

Nganda ng'eetei chii konaatiin ak kocheeng' saboondang'ung', ko ki kiratyi saboondap kiptaiyandennyu ratuutyetap saboondo kobooto Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindeng'ung', ak wiirtoi ineendet saboondap puuniguk, ko uu ye ki wiirtoe loletap chemasindaryet.
Ye kagoyachi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kiptaiyandennyu ko uu myeeindo tugul ne kimwaitaenen ak kondein iegu pounindetap Israel,

koma egu niito arageneet eng' inyee, ama egu kanagutyetap muguleldo eng' kiptaiyandennyu, ngot ko ki itumde korotiik puch, anan ngot ko ki koyaaktochigei mugetuut kiptaiyandennyu. Ak ye tuun kagoyachi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kiptaiyandennyu kiit ne myee, ibwaat anyun cheptong'ung' ne otwogindet.”
Ki leenji `Daudi Abigail, “Iberuurot Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindetap Israel ne kaiyogun rani itorookwo.
Iberuurot ng'omnateng'ung', ak iberuurot inyee ne kaietena rani si ma tumde korotiik, amayaaktochigei mugetuut eng' eunnyu.

Amu iman, ko uu ye sabei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindetap Israel ne kaetena si ma yaun kiit ne ya, nda ma ichogu itorookwo, ta kama kong'etyin Nabal agot lakweet agenge ne ng'etet mutai kaeech.”
Yeityo kotaach anyun `Daudi tuguuk che kiga ipchi ineendet osotyondonooto, ak ye rook koleenji `Daudi ineendet, “Togoste ui kaa eng' kaalyeet, keero, kaagasun ak achamun ng'aleeguk.”

Kingo it Abigail ole mi Nabal, ko ki tinyei ineendet igoorto ne uu igoortap laitoryat eng' koonnyi, ak ki paibai muguleldap Nabal amu kiga pogit kot. Ma mwachi kiy Abigail, ne ming'in anan ko ne oo agoi koeech.
Eng' karon ko kogasap Nabal, kogabek maiyek komwachi `osotyonnyi ineendet tuguuchuuto tugul ak kime muguleldanyi ak koigei ineendet koita.
Kingo keskei olo po peetuusyek taman, kobir Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Nabal, ak kime.

Ye kingo kas `Daudi kole kagome Nabal kole, “Iberuurot Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne ki korwookyinewa Nabal agobo chubeet ne ki chubo ak kieetee otwogindennyi yaityet. Ki weekyi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor metitap Nabal yaityennyi ne ki yai.” Yeityo koyookto `Daudi keng'alaalji Abigail si komut koek osotyonnyi.
Kingo it otwogigap Daudi ole mi Abigail eng' Karmel, kong'alaalji koleenji, “Kagoyokwech Daudi kebwa ole imi, si kimutin iegu osotyonnyi.”
Ki ng'eet anyun ak kong'uruuk kotiing'e togeennyi ng'wony ak kole, “Otwogindet cheptong'ung' ne otwogindet ne iuni keelyegap otwogigap kiptaiyandennyu.”
Kichirchiren Abigail ak kong'eet ak kolaany sigiryet kobooto tiibiik muut che ki tinyei che ki isup ineendet ak kwo koosup piigap Daudi ak ki ek osotyonnyi.
Ki imut `Daudi agine Ainoam ne po Jezreel ak ki ek tuwai osotikyik.
Kiga kogoochi `Saulo Mikal cheptonyi, ne ki osotyotap Daudi Palti weeriitap Lais ne ki po Galim.
Ki pwa Sipik ole mi Saulo eng' Gibea ak koleenji, “Tos ma unyegei Daudi eng' tulweetap Hakilah ne tokyingei surkwen?”
Kong'eet anyun `Saulo kochoortagei kwo surkwen ne po Ziph komi ak murenik eliphuusyek somok che po Israel che ki kilewen, koba kocheeng'at Daudi eng' surkwen ne po Ziph.
Ki teech `Saulo emanyii eng' tulweetap Hakilah ne tokyingei surkwen ole ne neegitee ooreet. Ago ki tebee Daudi nenyi eng' surkwen ak ki keer kole kogosup `ineendet Saulo konyo surkwen.
Ki iyookto anyun `Daudi segeik ak ki inai komyee kole kogonyo Saulo.

Ki ng'eet anyun Daudi ak kwo ole kiga teech Saulo. Ki keer Daudi ole kiruee Saulo kobooto Abner weeriitap Ner ne ki kiptaiyatap lugeennyi. Kiruee `Saulo kwenutap kariisyek ak ki teech piik koyiem ineendet.
ki teebee anyun `Daudi Ahimelek Hitindet ak Abisai weeriitap Zeruiah, ng'etap kametap Joab koleenji, “Ng'oo ne nyoonei si kechoortegei tuwai ole mi Saulo?” Kole Abisai, “Kichoortoigei tuwai.”
Ki it anyun Daudi ak Abisai kemoi ole mi piik, ak ogeero, kiruee `Saulo kwenutap kariisyek, ko lumdaat ng'otinnyi eng' ye neegitee metinnyi, ak kiruei Abner kobooto piik ko kayiem ineendet.
Koleenji anyun `Abisai Daudi, “Kagonde Kamuktaindet eung'ung' punyondeng'ung' rani, ara anyun, asoomin ale chamwo atoor ineendet eng' ng'otit, atoore agenge kosore ak matoore kogeny asakyini.”
Ago ki leenji `Daudi Abisai, “Amebar, amu ng'oo ne imuuchi kochuul eunnyi ak kobar ne iilaat ne po Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ama nyoor ng'oogisto?”
Yeityo kole `Daudi, “Ko uu ye sabei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, kobarei `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ineendet anan koityi peetuunnyi ne meei anan kwo lugeet kwo komechi olooto.

Ingolooit eng' anee eng' Kamuktaindet ne Toroor si ma chuul eunnyu abar ne iilaat ne po Kamuktaindet ne Toroor. Ago asoomin ale ip ng'otit ne mi ye neegitee metinnyi kobooto soteetap peek yeityo keebe.”

Ki ip anyun `Daudi ng'otit ak soteetap peek che ki mi ye neegitee metitap Saulo, ak ki pa ama keer chii anan konai. Ma kos chii age tugul, amu ki ruitos tugul amu ki ibutyi icheek rwondo ne nyigiis ne ki punu Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Yeityo kwo Daudi pitoniin ak kotonon eng' tulweet parak eng' ole loo. Ki loochin kot.
Kitwekyi `Daudi piik kobooto Abner weeriitap Ner, koleenji, “Tos mewoluu kiy Abner?” Ak ki wol Abner kole, “Ii ng'oo inyee nooto itwekyini laitoryat?”

Ak ki leenji `Daudi Abner, “Tos ma ii muren? Ak tos ng'oo ne kergei ak inyee eng' Israel? Amu nee anyun si meriip kiptaiyandeng'ung' laitoryat? Konyo chii eng' piik konyo kobar lairtoryat kiptaiyandeng'ung'.

Ma myee kii koiyai. Ko uu ye sabei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, konyaaljinok obegu, amu ma oriip kiptaiyandeng'wong', ne iilaat ne po Kamuktaindet ne Toroor. Ocheeng' oroo. Mi ano ng'otitap laitoryat ak soteetap peek cho komi ye neegitee metinnyi?”
Kingo nai `Saulo kutitap Daudi, kole, “Kuting'ung' nooto inyee weeriinnyu Daudi?” Kowol Daudi kole, “Ee, kutinnyu nooto kiptaiyandennyu, ee, laitoryat.
Amu nee si kosubot `kiptaiyandennyu otwogindennyi? Koayai nee? Anan nee yaityet ne mi eunekyuk?

Nooto anyun asoomin ale, ingogas `kiptaiyandennyu laitoryat ng'aleegap otwogindennyi. Ngot ko Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne ki ing'eetin iyaiywo ne ya, ko ingotaach ineendet kagoochinet. Ago ngot ko weeriigap piik, ko ingoek icheek che chubootiin eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor. Amu kagoona icheek rani si ma ki namgei ak pororyetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor koleen, ‘Ui ioot kamuktaik alak.’
Ara anyun, amat kotumjigei ng'wony korotiikyuk eng' ole looe ole mi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor amu kanyo laitoryatap Israel kocheeng' kimityat ko uu ye cheeng'ei chiito taiywet eng' tuloonook.”
Kole anyun Saulo, “Kaayai tengek. Weeigei weeriinnyu Daudi, ma ayaun kiy ne ya kogeny. Amu kabunji kamanuut ne oo rani saboondanyu eng' taing'ung'. Kaayai perberyo ak ko kaalel miising'.”
Ki wol Daudi kole, “Keer ng'otit o, ee laitoryat! Ingonyo anyun age eng' murenik pitoni si koip.
Yaakyin `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor chii age tugul imandanyi ak myeeindonyi; amu kagondein `ineendet eunnyu rani ago ma acham achuul eunnyu abar ne iilaat ne po Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.

Kogeny, kaariree rani saboondang'ung' amu tinyei kamanuutyet ne oo eng' tainnyu, ko uu nooto anyun ingosich agine saboondanyu kamanuutyet ne oo eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ak ingosarwo ineendet eng' nyalilda tugul.”
Koleenji anyun `Saulo Daudi, “Ingiberuurin weeriinnyu Daudi; ta iyae tuguuk che eecheen ak ibelisyei iman.” Kwo anyun Daudi pandanyi ak ki week Saulo kwo oldanyi.

Ki mwa Daudi eng' muguleldanyi kole, “Tatun amechini eunegap Saulo. Ma mi kiy ne myee kosiir amwechi emetap Philistiik, si kogeskei kamang'unetap Saulo, si ma kocheeng'a kogeny eng' kiwotosyek tugul che po Israel, ak achilile eunekyik.”
Ara king'eet `Daudi kolanda ak piik pogol lo che ki mi kobooto ineendet kot koit ole mi Akis weeriitap Maok laitoryatap Gath.
Ki tebi Daudi ak Akis eng' Gath kobooto piikyik. Ki tebi chii age tugul ak piigap koonnyi agot Daudi ak osotikyik aeng', Ainoam Jesreelyot, ak Abigail Chepkarmelyot ineendet ne ki osotyotap Nabal.
ki ngemwachi `Saulo keleenji, kogomwechi Daudi Gath, ko mata kocheeng'at ineendet kogeny.

Ki leenji `Daudi Akis, “Ngot ko koanyooru myeeindo eng' taing'ung', ko ingogoono oldo eng' age eng' nganasoogap emoni, si kobiit ameny olooto. Amu kalya si komeny otwogindeng'ung' nganaseetap laitoryat kobooten?”
Ara ki igoochi anyun Akis ineendet Ziklag eng' peetuunooto. Nooto anyun ki punji Ziklag laitorinigap Judah agoi ra.
Ki meny `Daudi emetap Philistiik peetuusyek che itei kenyiit agenge ak arawek ang'wan.
Ki togosta anyun `Daudi ak piikyik kobookyi Gesurik, Girsik ak Amelegik, amu chooto ko ki piik che ki menyei emonooto, piik che ki po keny, eng' ooreet ne kibunei kebendi Sur agoi emetap Misiri.
Ki par `Daudi emonooto, ama pagaakta muren anan kwony kosap. Ki nyaban keechiirek, tuuga, sigiroik, tambeesik ak ngoroik ak koweek kwo kap Akis.
ki teebee Akis koleenji, “Kobar ano ra?” Ak ki le Daudi, “Kagibar murot tai ne po Judah, kobooto murot tai ne po Jeramelik ak murot tai ne po Kenik.”

Ma pagaakta Daudi muren anan kwony kosap, si ma imut koba Gath amu ki le, “Si ma mwaitech kole, ‘Ki yai ko uu nooto Daudi ak kiyaei ko uu nooto eng' pitennyi eng' peetuusyek tugul che ki meny emetap Philistiik.’ ”
Ki iyan Akis ng'aleegap Daudi kole, “Kagogoochi piikyik Israel kowech ineendet miising', nooto anyun egu otwogindennyu agoi.”
Ki iyum Philistiik lugosyekwak eng' peetuusyechooto koba lugeet kobargei ak Israel. Ki leenji `Akis Daudi, “Nai komyee ile kibendi tuwai lugeet kobooto mureniguk.”
Kowolji `Daudi Akis koleenji, “Nooto anyun, inae kiit ne yaei otwogindeng'ung'.” Koleenji `Akis Daudi, “Nooto anyun, ayain iegu ne iriibwa metinnyu agoi.”
Eng' kasarata, ko kiga kome Samuel ak kiga koriirchi Israel tugul ineendet ak kotupchi ineendet Ramah, nganasennyi. Kiga koon `Saulo che kiboisyee oik ak chepsogeinik eng' emet.
Ki iyumgei `Philistiik ak koba koteech Sunem, ak ki iyum `Saulo Israel tugul ak koteech Gilboa.
Kingo keer `Saulo lugeetap Philistiik, koywei ak ki rukrugen muguleldanyi miising'.
Ye kingo leen koteebe `Saulo Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, koma kowolji `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' karwotitaosyek anan eng' Urim, anan eng' maotik.
Koleenji anyun `Saulo otwogikyik, “Ocheeng'wo kwondo ne poisyee oik, si awo ole mi ineendet ak ateepse.” Ak ki wolji `otwogikyik ineendet, “Mi kwony agenge En-dor ne ng'oorsei.”

Kiwalgei `Saulo kolaach ngoroik alak yeityo kwo ineendet kobooto piik aeng' ak ki it kemoi ole ki mi kwonyooto. Ki leenji `Saulo kwonyooto, “Asoomin ale ng'oorsewa eng' oindet ak imutwaa kotogos chii age tugul ne amwaun kainennyi.”
Koleenji `kwonyooto ineendet, “Ingen inyee kiit ne ki koyai `Saulo koisto eng' emet icheeget che poisyee oik, ak chepsogeinik. Amu nee si iriich saboondanyu, igoono ame?”
Ki iyasyechi `Saulo ineendet eng' Kamuktaindet ne Toroor koleenji, “Ko uu ye sabei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, koma mi pireet ne inyooru agobo kiito.”
Ki le anyun `kwonyooto, “Ng'oo ne imache amutun kotogos?” Ak ki le, “Imutwaa Samuel kotogos.”
Kingo keer `kwonyooto Samuel, kowaach eng' kutit ne oo ak komwachi Saulo koleenji, “Amu nee si igena? Ii Saulo inyee.”
Koleenji `laitoryat ineendet, “Meiywei, igeere nee?” Ak ki leenji `kwonyooto Saulo, “Ageere kamuktain ne togosu eng' ng'wony.”
Koteebe `Saulo ineendet koleenji, “Tinyei itoondo nee?” Kowol kole, “Poiyot ne togosu ne ilaachi ngoryeet.” Konai Saulo kole Samuel nooto, ak ki ing'uruuk kot kotiiny togeennyi ng'wony kogutung'ji.

Ki mwachi `Samuel Saulo koleenji, “Amu nee si iima imutwaa atogos?” Kowolji `Saulo koleenji, “Atinye nyalilda ne ng'waan amu kabwa Philistiik kebarge ak ki kometa Kamuktaindet, ama kowolwo kiy eng' maotik anan eng' karwotitaosyek. Nooto anyun kaguurin si kobiit iboorwo kiit ne ayae.”
Koleenji `Samuel, “Amu nee si iteebena ago ki kometen Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ak koek punyondeng'ung'?
Kigoboisyechigei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ko uu ye ki mwa eng' anee. Ki kobetenen Kamuktaindet ne Toroor laitornatet ak kogoochi chiitap kokweng'ung' Daudi.
Amu ma igas iit kutitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ama isuldochi nereegekyik che koroomen eng' Amelek, ko kayaun anyun Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kii rani amu nooto.

Kogeny, kondai `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Israel eunegap Philistiik kobooten aginye. Omite mutai kobooto, inyee ak weeriiguk; ak kogeny kondoi `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor lugeetap Israel eunegap Philistiik.”
Ki ibutyi ng'wony Saulo anyun kogutuny, ak ki aragen miising' amu ng'aleegap Samuel. Ki ma kota kotinyei kimnateet, amu ki ma amis eng' peetuut komugul anan kemout komugul.

Kingo nyo `kwonyooto ole mi Saulo ak kogeer kole tinyei arageneet ne oo, koleenji ineendet, “Kagas cheptong'ung' ne otwogindet ng'aleeguk ak kaande saboondanyu eunnyu, ak kaayai ng'aleek che kemwaiwo.
Asoomin anyun ale, igas ng'aleegap cheptong'ung' ne otwoget, ak chamwo aibun amitwogik tutigin ande taing'ung', iam, si kobiit isich kimnateet eng' pandang'ung'.”
Ago ki eesyo Saulo ak kole, “Ma ame.” Ago kingo pirchi ineendet otwogikyik ak kwonyooto, kogas ng'aleekwak. Ki ng'eet eng' ng'wony ak kotebee itoogut.
Ki tinyei kwonyooto eng' ko moita ne neraat. Ara kichaakta kwo koeny. Ki inem peek ak kokwany ak kobeel magatiinik che ma kinde mermereek.
Yeityo koip amitwogichooto ak kogoochi Saulo ak otwogikyik koam. Ki am icheek yeityo kong'eetyo ak koba pandanywa kemounooto.
Ki iyumji anyun `Philistiik lugosyekwak tugul Apek: ak ki teech Israel ye neegitee kondap peek ne mi Jezreel.
Kingo pendi kiptainigap Philistiik, kobee pogolwogik ak eliphuusyek, kogiletu Daudi ak piikyik kobooto Akis.

Kiteep `pounigap Philistiik kole, “Yaei nee Hebranichu?” Ak ki wolji `Akis pounigap Philistiik koleenji, “Niito ko Daudi niito otwogindetap Saulo laitoryatap Israel, ne mi kobooto eng' peetuusyechu anan eng' kenyisyechu, ak tomo anyooru leluut eng' ineendet.”

Ago ki nereekyi `ineendet pounigap Philistiik. Ki leenji pounigap Philistiik ineendet, “Ileenji chiichi koweek, koweektagei oldanyi ole ki iboorchi amat kochoortagei kwo lugeet kobootech si ma ek punyondennyo eng' ole mi lugeet, Nee ne igoochin konamgei ak kiptaiyandennyi? Tos ma eng' metowegap pichu?
Tos ma Daudi niito, ne kityenjingei icheek agobo ineendet eng' ureryosyek kole, ‘Ki par `Saulo eliphuusyek, kobar `Daudi tamanusyegap eliphuusyek.’ ”

Ara ki kuur anyun `Akis Daudi ak koleenji, “Ko uu ye sabei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ko ki itebi eng' imanda ak myee eng' tainnyu mandaeng'ung' ak nyonuneng'ung' kobooto eng' lugeet. Amu tomo anyoorchin yaityet kobooch inyoo ole ami agoi rani, agot nganda uu nooto, koma chamin kiptainik.
Ara anyun weektegei, ui eng' kaalyeet si megoochi kiptainigap Philistiik konereekso.”
Ago ki leenji `Daudi Akis, “Koayai nee? Ak koinyoorchi nee otwogindeng'ung' kobooch ye ki ami taing'ung' agoi rani, si ma we kebarge ak puunigap kiptaiyandennyu laitoryat?”
Kowolji `Akis Daudi koleenji, “Angen ale ii myee eng' tainnyu ko uu malaikaiyatap Kamuktaindet, ago kagomwa pounigap Philistiik kole, ‘Ma kibendi tugul lugeet kobooto ineendet.’
Nooto anyun, muste karon kobooto otwogigap kiptaiyandeng'ung' che koobwane tugul: ak ye ong'eetyee karon ko kaeech ko kalapkeit, obe.”
Ki ng'eet anyun `Daudi karon miising' ak piikyik, si koba karon koweektagei emetap Philistiik, ak kitogosta Philistiik koba Jezreel.
Kingo it `Daudi ak piikyik Ziklag eng' peetuutap somok, ko kiga kopookyi Amelegik murot tai ak Ziklag ak kiga kobar Ziklag ak kobeel eng' maat;
Kiga koluul kwonyiik che ki mi yooto, che mengech ak che eecheen. Ma par chii age tugul ago kiluul ak koba.
Kingo it `Daudi ak piikyik nganaseet, ko kiga kebeel ak keluul osotikwak, weeriikwak ak tiibiikwak.
Kiwaach `Daudi ak piik che ki mi kobooto ineendet, ak koriiryo kot koma komuuchi koriiryo.
Kiga kiluul osotigap Daudi tuwai, Ainoam Jesreelyot ak Abigail ne ki osotyotap Nabal Karmelindet.

Ki iimgei miising' `Daudi, amu ki mwa piik kole kilache ineendet eng' koik, amu ki aragenso saboonwegap piik tugul ak ki aragen chii age tugul agobo weeriikyik ak tiibiikyik, ago ki igimitkei Daudi eng' Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindennyi.
Ki leenji `Daudi Abiathar tisiindet, weeriitap Ahimelek, “Asoomin iibwo ephod konyo yu.”
Kingo ip koteebe `Daudi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor koleenji, “Tos ngot asup lugoni, aname?” Kowolji Kamuktaindet ne Toroor koleenji, “Isup, amu iname iman, ak ne matiny isaru tuguuk tugul.”
Ki wo `Daudi anyun, kobooto murenik pogol lo che ki mi kobooto ineendet, kot koit kererutap Besor, ole kiga tebee piik che kigang'et.
Ago ki isup `Daudi pichooto kobooto murenik pogol ang'wan. Amu ki tebi piik pogolwogik aeng'u che ki ma imuuchi kolandae kererutap Besor amu kiga kong'etyo miising'.
Ki nyoor `pichooto Misirindet eng' keeweet ak ki imutyi Daudi. Ki igoochi amitwogik ak ki am ak ki inaga peek koe.
Yeityo kogoochi magatyat ne ming'in ne po mogoonik ak mooriik aeng' che po sabibuk che yamyotiin. Kingo kagoam kosap, amu ki ma am kiy anan koe peek eng' peetuusyek somok ak kemousyek somok.

ki teebee `Daudi ineendet koleenji, “Ii po kap ng'oo? Ak ibunu ano?” Ki wol kole, “Aa muren ne po Misiri ak aa otwogindetap Amelegindet. Ki pagaakta kiptaiyandennyu amu ki amyan eng' peetuusyechu somok.
Kiga kibookyi murot tai ne po Keretik, kap Judah ak kap Kaleb ne mi murot tai ak ki kibeel Ziklag eng' maat.”
koteebee `Daudi ineendet koleenji, “Tos ichame imuta ole mi lugonooto?” Kowol kole, “Iyosyeiwo eng' Kamuktaindet ile mebara anan indea eunegap kiptaiyandennyu, si amutin ole mi lugonooto.”
Ye kingo kagomut kochoortagei, ko kiga koyom pichooto ola tugul eng' emet, koamisyei ak koeisei. Ki urerendos amu parunenik che chaang' che kiga luul eng' emetap Philistiik ak eng' emetap Judah.
Ki par `Daudi icheek kobooch ko karatarat agoi koskoleng'utap peetuut ne po aeng', ama chilil chii agot agenge, kobatee murenik pogol ang'wan che ki laany tambeesik ak komwei.
Ki sar `Daudi tugul che kiga luul Amelegik. Ki sar `Daudi kora osotikyik tuwai.
Ki ma petee kiy icheek, ngo ne ming'in anan ko ne oo, ngo weeriik anan ko tiibiik anan ko parunenik anan ko kiy age tugul ne kiga ip, ko ki ip Daudi tugul koweek.
Ki kweri `Daudi akwotisyek tugul che po keechiirek ak che po tuuga, che ki kweri murenik kondoe tuuga alak ak koleen, “Chuuto ko parunenigap Daudi.”

Ki it anyun Daudi ole ki mi murenjoto pogolwogik aeng'u, che kiga kong'etyo miising' kot ko mata komuuch koosup Daudi, che kiga mwechi ak kotebee kererutap Besor. Ki pa kotorookta Daudi ak piik che ki mi kobooto ineendet. Kingo riikyi `Daudi pichooto, kogat icheek.

Ago ki wol anyun piik tugul che yaacheen, ak che uueen metowoi eng' piik che kigaba ak Daudi kole, “Ma kigoochini icheek kiy age tugul eng' parunenik che kagiweegu amu ki ma kibe tugul, kobatee kityo kigoochin chii tugul osotyonnyi ak lagokyik, si komut ak koba.”
Ago ki le `Daudi, “Amat oyai ko uu nooto che kitupche eng' tuguuk che kogoonech Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne koriibech, ak koinde eunekyok lugoni koibookyinech.
Ng'oo ne kasok eng' ng'aleechu? Amu ko uu ole tenitu kebebertap ne wendi lugeet, kotenitu nooto kebebertap ne tebyei koriibei tuguuk, pcheei koaechin.”
Ki ek ko uu nooto kobooch peetuunooto agoi. Ki yai koek ng'atuutyet ak kayomiset agobo Israel agoi rani.
Kingo nyo `Daudi Ziklag, koyookyi parunenik poisyegap Judah, icheeget che ki choronokyik ak kole, “Kagoochineng'wong' ne po parunenigap puunigap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.”
Ki iyookyi che ki mi Bethel, che ki mi Ramot ne po murot tai, che ki mi Jatir,
che ki mi Aroer, che ki mi Sipmot, che ki mi Estemoa;
che ki mi Rakal, che ki mi nganasoogap Jerameelik, che ki mi nganasoogap Kenik,
che ki mi Horma, che ki mi Korasan, che ki mi Atak,
ak che ki mi Hebron ak komoswek tugul che ki cham koitei Daudi ak murenikyik.
Ki pargei anyun Philistiik ak Israel; ak kimweiso murenigap Israel eng' taitap Philistiik ak kebar kobutyo eng' tulweetap Gilboa.
Ki oon `Philistiik miising' Saulo ak weeriikyik. Kingo riikyi, kobar Jonathan, Abinadab ak Malkisua, weeriichooto po Saulo.
Ki koromit pooryeet miising' eng' Saulo, ak kingo oon ineendet mwogik, koriich ak konyaliil.

Eng' yooto, koleenji anyun `Saulo chiito ne ki ipchin kariikyik, “Ng'usu rotweng'ung' po chok ak itoorena, si ma pwa pichu ma kimuratan, kotoora, ak kogengeniena.” Ago ma cham chiito ne ki ipchin kariikyik, amu ki iywei kot. Ara ki inem anyun Saulo rotwennyi po chok ak kobutyi.
Kingo keer chiito ne ki ipchin kariik kole, kagome Saulo, kobutyi agine rotwennyi po chok, ak kime kobooto ineendet.
Ki me anyun Saulo, kobooto weeriikyik somok, ak chiito ne ki ipchin kariikyik ak piikyik tugul, eng' peetuunak.

Kingo keer piigap Israel che ki mi atebweet komosin ak icheek che ki mi Jordan pitoniin, kole kagomweiso piigap Israel ak kagome Saulo ak weeriikyik, kobagaakta nganasook ak komwei. Ak ki pwa Philistiik komeng'iis.
Eng' peetuut ne ki isubi nooto, ye kingo pwa Philistiik kobut piik che kiga kibar, konyoor Saulo ak weeriikyik somok ko kagobek eng' tulweetap Gilboa.
Kitil metinnyi ak koreegune kariikyik, yeityo koyookto kemwaita eng' emetap Philistiik komoswek tugul, keip ng'aleechooto koba kootap kanamonikwak ak koipchi piik.
Ki inde kariikyik kootap Astarot ak koratyi muustonyi inaatutap Beth-san.
Kingo kas piik che ki menyei Jabes-gilead agobo kiit ne ki yachi `Philistiik Saulo,
kong'eetyo murenik tugul che nyigoonen ak koba eng' kemout komugul. Ki inem muustap Saulo ak muuswegap weeriikyik eng' inaatutap Beth-san ak koba kot koit Jabes ak kobeel eng' olooto muuswechooto.
Yeityo koip kawekwak ak kotupchi keetit keel eng' Jabes, ak korugutkei peetuusyek tisap.
Kingo pata meetap Saulo, ko kagoweek Daudi kobunu pareetap Amelegik, kobeni Daudi peetuusyek aeng' eng' Ziklag.
Eng' peetuutap somok, konyo chiito kobun nganaseet ne ki mi Saulo, ko kereerotiin ngoroikyik ak komi ng'ung'unyek metinnyi. Ye kingo it ole mi Daudi, kobutyi ng'wony ak kogutuny koganyit laitoryat.
Ki teebee `Daudi ineendet koleenji, “Ibunu ano?” Ak ki wol kole, “Koachilili eng' kambitap Israel.”

koteebee `Daudi ineendet koleenji, “Kitepto ano ng'aleek? Kanyool iman imwaiwo.” Ki wol kole, “Kimweiso piik eng' lugeet ak kogeny ko ki ibutyot piik che chaang' ak kobek. Ki kome agine Saulo ak Jonathan weeriinnyi.”
koteebee `Daudi murenonooto kimwachin ineendet koleenji, “Inae nee ile ki kome Saulo ak Jonathan weeriinnyi?”
Koleenji murenenooto Daudi, “Ye kita ami tulweetap Gilboa, ko ki mi Saulo ko katiegei ng'otinnyi. Ki oonei ineendet miising' `kariisyek ak piik che ketei paraisisyek.
Ye kingo welelgei, kogeero ak kotwekwo ak ki awolji aleenji, ‘Ami yu.’
koteebeena koleenjo, ‘Ii ng'oo?’ Ak ki awolji aleenji, ‘Aa Amelegin.’
Ak ki leenjo, ‘Asoomin ale itononeno eng' yu ami ak ibara amu kagotirityo nga ta asabe.’

Ki atonone anyun ineendet eng' yooto ki miitei ak abar, amu ki anai eng' iman ale ma komuuchi kosap ko kagobut. Ki anemu kuutweetap laitornatet ne ki mi metinnyi ak karnet ne ki mi eunnyi, ak kaaibu kobwa yu aipchi kiptaiyandennyu.”
Ki nam anyun `Daudi ngoroikyik kogereer. Ki yai ko uu nooto piik tugul che ki mi ak ineendet yooto.
Ki iteiyo ak koriiryo ak korugutkei agoi koskoleny agobo Saulo, Jonathan weeriinnyi, agobo piigap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ak kootap Israel che ki pek eng' rotoogap chok.
Ki teebee `Daudi murenonooto ki mwachin ineendet ng'aleechooto koleenji, “Ii po kap ng'oo?” Ak ki wol kole, “Aa weeriitap punootyot, Amelegindet.”
koteebee anyun `Daudi ineendet koleenji, “Kolya si meiywei ichuul eung'ung' ibar ne iilaat ne po Kamuktaindet ne Toroor?”
Kingo pata, koguur `Daudi age eng' murenik ak koleenji, “Riikte, ibar ineendet.” Ak ki ep ineendet koobut ak kome.
Yeityo koleenji `Daudi ineendet, “Ingotebee korotiguk meting'ung' amu kagobaoryan kuting'ung' korwogun kole, ‘Ki abar ne iilaat ne po Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.’ ”
Ki riirchi `Daudi Saulo ak Jonathan weeriinnyi eng' riirechu,
ak ki mwachi icheek koneet piigap Judah tyendap kwanget, (ki kisirchi bukuitap Jasar):
Ee Israel, ki kibar toroornateng'ung' eng' komosweguk che torooreen! Ki ibututa ano che kiimeen!
Mat omwaite eng' Gath, mat obarte eng' ortinwegap Askelon; si ma poiboitu tiibiigap Philistiik, si ma iloskei tiibiigap che ma kimuratan.

Okweek tuloonoogap Gilboa, Mat kobiitunenak rewoot anan ropta anan mbareenik che mbareenigap kagoochinoik: Amu ki kiwiirta eng' teweernateet long'eetap ineendet ne kiim eng' olooto, Long'eetap Saulo, ne ma koilaat eng' mwaita.
Eng' korotiigap che ki kibar, eng' mwanigap che kiimeen, koma week let kwangetap Jonathan, ama week puch rotwetap chok ne po Saulo.
Ki korooron Saulo ak Jonathan, ak ki chamaatiin eng' saboonwekwak, Ak ma pesyo eng' sabeennywa anan eng' meennywa; Ki chepcheben kosiir kipsichinik, Ki kiimeen kosiir ng'etuunyik.
Okweek tiibiigap Israel, oriirye agobo Saulo, ineendet ne ki ilaakwok ngoroik che piriireen che po poiboiyet, ne ki inde lelestap thahabu ngoroikwok.
Ki ibututa ano che kiimeen eng' kwenutap pooryeet! Ki kibar Jonathan eng' komosweguk che torooreen.
Aarageni amu inyee, tupchennyu Jonathan: Ki igoono abaibait miising': Ki po kwong'eet chamyeng'ung' ne ki ichama, ki siirei chamyetap kwonyiik.
Ki ibututa ano che kiimeen, ki petyo kariigap lugeet!

Kingo pata tuguuchuuto koteebe `Daudi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole, “Atogoste awe age eng' nganasoogap Judah?” Ak ki wolji `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ineendet koleenji, “Togoste.” koteebee `Daudi koleenji, “Atogoste awe ano?” Ak ki leenji, “Ui Hebron.”
Kotogosta anyun `Daudi olooto kobooto osotikyik aeng', Ainoam Jesreelyot ak Abigail ne ki osotyotap Nabal Karmelindet.
Ki imut `Daudi piikyik che ki mi kobooto ineendet kotogosta, ak ki wo chii tugul ak piigap koonnyi, ak komeny nganasoogap Hebron.
Ki pwa piigap Judah kobwa koiil Daudi eng' olooto koek laitoryatap kootap Judah. Ki ngemwachi Daudi keleenji ki piigap Jabes-gilead che ki tubei Saulo,
koyookto `Daudi piik koba oldap piigap Jabes-gilead koleenji icheek, “Ingoberuurok Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, amu ki oboorchi myeini kiptaiyandeng'wong', nooto ko Saulo otup ineendet.
Ingoboorwok Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ak kogoonok myeeindo ak imanit, ak ayaakwok agane myeiniito amu ki oyai kiito.
Ingogimegitu anyun eunekwok ak oegu che nyigoonen, amu kogome Saulo kiptaiyandeng'wong', ak kogoiila kootap Judah aek laitoryat eng' icheek.”
Kiga komut Abner weeriitap Ner, ne ki kiptaiyatap lugeetap Saulo, Ishbosheth weeriitap Saulo kolanda Mahanaim.
Ki inde ineendet koek laitoryat koboi Gilead, Ashurik, Jezreel, Ephraim, Benjamin ak koboi Israel tugul.
(Ki po Ishbosheth weeriitap Saulo kenyiisyek artam ye ki tau kolaitorani, ak ki laitoran kenyiisyek aeng'.) Ago ki isup `kootap Judah Daudi.
Ak peetuusyek che ki laitoran Daudi eng' Hebron eng' kootap Judah ko ki kenyiisyek tisap ak arawek lo.
Ki pa Abner weeriitap Ner ak otwogigap Ishbosheth weeriitap Saulo kong'etee Mahanaim koba Gibeon.
Ki pa ak icheek Joab weeriitap Zeruiah ak otwogigap Daudi ak kituiyechi ak Abner tamboiyotap Gibeon. Ki ibuure alak tamboiyot komosi, kobuure alak tamboiyot komosin.
Ki leenji `Abner Joab, “Asoomin ale ingong'eetyo murenik kourerenso eng' tainnyo.” Kowol Joab kole, “Ingong'eetyo.”
Ki ng'eetyo anyun koba ak ki kiit; ki taman ak aeng' che po Benjamin ak che po Ishbosheth weeriitap Saulo, ak ki taman ak aeng' che po otwogigap Daudi.
Ki nam age tugul metitap age ak kotoorgei karasaik eng' rotoogap chok, ak ki ibutyo tuwai. Ki kiguure yooto anyun Helkat-hasurim ne miitei Gibeon.
Kiga koromit pooryeet miising' eng' peetuunooto ak ki kiterteer Abner kobooto piigap Israel eng' taitap otwogigap Daudi.
Ki mi yooto weeriik somogu che po Zeruiah: Joab, Abisai ak Asahel. Ki chepchep Asahel ko uu cheptirgichet.
Ki oon `Asahel Abner. Ma masta kwo eutap tai anan ko murot kaataam ye ki oonei Abner.
