Kiguskong' Abner ak koteebe koleenji, “Tos inyee ni Asahel?” Kowol kole, “Anee.”
Ak ki leenji `Abner ineendet, “Ui taban, eutap tai anan ko ne po kaataam ak inam age eng' murenjo yeityo irebe kariikyik.” Ago ma cham Asahel komasta kobagaakta ineendet.
Ak ki leenji `Abner Asahel kogeny, “Ui taban, mata isubwo, amu nee si imach atoorin kosorenen? Si kota amukta ano anyun ageer togeetap Joab ng'eetap kamenng'ung'?”
Ago kingo eesyo komasta, kotoor anyun `Abner ineendet moet eng' chileiywotap ng'otit kosore. Ki ibut eng' yooto ak komechi yooto. Kitononso anyun tugul che ki it yooto kigebutyi Asahel ak kome.
Ago ki oon `Joab ak Abisai Abner. Ye kingo roroktoi asiista, koit tulweetap Ama, ne mi taitap Gia eng' ooreet ne wendi surkwen ne po Gibeon.
Ki iyumgei lagogap Benjamin konamgei ak Abner koek lugeet agenge yeityo kotononso eng' tulweet parak.
Ki kuur `Abner Joab koleenji, “Tos parisyei rotweet agoi? Mengen ile egu ng'wanindo eng' let? Tyanitu si imwachi piik koweek ko mata koosup che tupcho?”
Kowol kole Joab, “Ko uu ye sabei Kamuktaindet, ko nda kama ing'alaal ta kagoba piik iman atkai karon, ta kama kosubi chii tugul tupchennyi.”
Ki kuut anyun Joab iryageet ak kitononso piik tugul, mata koon Israel kogeny anan kota koboryo kogeny.
Ki pa Abner ak piikyik kemounooto tugul kobun Arabah ak kilandae Jordan kobun tugul Pitron ak ki it Mahanaim.
Ki week anyun Joab ma ta koosup Abner. Kingo kagoyum piik tugul, ko ki petyotiin eng' otwogigap Daudi piik tamanu ak sogool kobooto Asahel.
Ago kiga kobar otwogigap Daudi che po Benjamin ak murenigap Abner kot kobek piik pogolwogik somogu ak tamanwogik lo.
Kila `icheek Asahel ak kotupchi kereritap kwandanyi ne ki miitei Bethlehem. Yeityo koba Joab ak piikyik kemout tugul ak kieekyi eng' Hebron.
Ki piit pooryeet eng' peetuusyek che chaang' eng' kootap Saulo ak kootap Daudi. Ki kimiit Daudi kotesak, ago kinyalul kimnateetap kootap Saulo kwo let.
Ki kisikyi `Daudi weeriik eng' Hebron; Taaitanyi ko ki Amnon, ne kisiche Ainoam Jesreelyot.
Weeriinnyi ne po aeng' ko ki Kileap, ne kisichei Abigail ne ki osotyotap Nabal Karmelindet. Ne po somok ko ki Absalom ne kisichei Maaka cheptap Talmai laitoryatap Gesur.
Ne po ang'wan ko ki Adonijah weeriitap Haggith ak ne po muut ko ki Shepatiah weeriitap Abital.
Ne po lo ko ki Itream ne kisichei Eglah osotyotap Daudi. Ki kisikyi chuuto Daudi eng' Hebron.
Ye kibortos kootap Saulo ak kootap Daudi, ko kitechkei Abner kogimit eng' kootap Saulo.
Ki tinyei `Saulo chebaigeiyat ne ki kiguure kainennyi Rispa, cheptap Aia. Ki teebee `Ishbosheth Abner koleenji, “Amu nee si obaigei ak chebaigeiyatap abba?”

Ki nereech anyun miising' `Abner amu ng'aleegap Ishbosheth, ak kowol kole, “Tos Aa metitap seseetap Judah? Ago rani aboorchini myeeindo kootap Saulo kwandang'ung', tupchosyekyik ak choronokyik ak ma andein eutap Daudi, ago kerwokwo rani ile kalel agobo kwonyi.
Ingoyachi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ko uu nooto Abner, ak kotes ngot koma yachi anee Daudi ko uu ye ki iyasyechi `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ineendet.
Autoi laitornatet eng' kootap Saulo ak alumde ng'echereetap Daudi kolaitoran eng' Israel ak Judah kobooch Dan agoi Beer-sheba.”
Ki mata komuuch kowolji Abner ng'olyoot age, amu ki iywei ineendet.
Yeityo koyookto piik `Abner koba kap Daudi ne kita wendi ineendet koleenji, “Po ng'oo emet? Ngeyai tuwai arorutyet kiyomegei, mi eunnyu kobooten si amutun Israel tugul kobwa ole imi.”
Kowol `Daudi kole, “Myee, ayae arorutyet kobooten, ago kiit agenge ne amagenen, ko megeere togeennyu agoi imutu korook Mikal cheptap Saulo ye inyone igeera.”
Yeityo koyookto `Daudi piik koba kap Ishbosheth weeriitap Saulo koleenji, “Koono osotyondennyu Mikal ne ki anyoonune koito irirenik pogol che po Philistiik.”
Ara ki iyookto Ishbosheth piik koba komutune manong'otyondennyi; nooto ko Paltiel weeriitap Lais.
Ki pa ak monong'otyondennyi koriiroti manong'otyondennyi kosubi kwonyooto kot koit Baurim. Eng' yooto po Baurim, koleenji anyun `Abner monong'otyonooto, “Ui, iweektegei.” Ak ki week.
Ki ng'alaal Abner ak poisyegap Israel kole, “Ki ocheeng' koek laitoryandeng'wong' Daudi eng' peetuusyek che ki kosiirto.
Ara anyun oyai, amu ki komwa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor agobo Daudi kole, ‘Asaru piikyuk Israel eng' otwogindennyu Daudi eng' eunegap Philistiik ak eng' eunegap puunikwak tugul.’ ”
Ki ng'alaalji `Abner Benjamin agine kogas. Yeityo kogeny kwo Abner komwachi Daudi kogas eng' Hebron tuguuk tugul che kigeerei Israel ak kootap Benjamin tugul kole nyolu.
Kigoit anyun `Abner ole mi Daudi eng' Hebron, kobooto piik tiptem, koyachi igoorto `Daudi Abner kobooto murenjoto ki mi kobooto ineendet.

Ki leenji `Abner Daudi, “Ang'eete awendi ak ayumji Israel tugul kiptaiyandennyu laitoryat si kobiit koyai arorutyet kobooten, ak si kobiit ilaitorane che machei muguleldang'ung'.” Eng' let kosaiseret `Daudi Abner, ak ki wo eng' kaalyeet.

Ki pwanei eng' sainooto otwogigap Daudi ak Joab kobunu lugeet ak ki ibu parunenik che chaang'. Ago king'oitu koma mi Abner kobooto Daudi eng' Hebron, amu kiga komwachi `Daudi ineendet kwo eng' kaalyeet.
Kingo it Joab ak lugeet tugul ne ki mi ak ineendet, kemwachi Joab keleenji, “Kanyo Abner weeriitap Ner ole mi laitoryat ak kagoleenji kwo, ak kakwo eng' kaalyeet.”
Konyo anyun `Joab ole mi laitoryat ak koleenji, “Nee ne kaiyai? Kanyo Abner oldang'ung' ak amu nee si iunde kwo ak kakwo iman?
Ingen inyee Abner weeriitap Ner ile kanyo koberberin si konai mandaeng'ung' ak nyonuneng'ung' ak konai tuguuk tugul che iyae.”
Kingo mong' Joab eng' kap Daudi, koyookto piik koosup Abner ak koweech ineendet eng' keriingetap peek ne po Sira, ago ki ma nai Daudi.
Kingo kagoweek Abner konyo Hebron, komut Joab ineendet kwo taban agoi kwenutap ormariichet, kwo kong'alaalji mutyo ak kitoor ineendet moet eng' yooto ak kime agobo korotiigap Asahel ng'eetap kamet.
Kingo kas `Daudi eng' let, komwa kole, “Ma tinye anee ng'oogisto ak laitornatennyu eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor koigeny eng' korotiigap Abner weeriitap Ner.

Ingotebee metitap Joab ak kotebee kootap kwandanyi tugul. Amat kobet eng' kootap Joab chii ne tinyei kusereet anan ne tinyei mogondos anan ne tebenoti kirokto anan ne kibarei eng' rotwetap chok anan ko ne ma tinyei amitwogik.”
(Ki par anyun `Joab ak Abisai ng'eetap kamet, Abner, amu kiga kobar Abner Asahel weeriit ne tupcho, eng' Gibeon eng' lugeet.)
Yeityo koleenji `Daudi Joab kobooto piik tugul che ki mi ak ineendet, “Ogereer ngoroikwok ak ogermenegei kuniok yeityo oteiye eng' taitap Abner.” Ak ki isubi Daudi kiit ne ki kisute.
Kitupchi Abner Hebron, ak kiwaach laitoryat eng' kutit ne oo ak koriir eng' kereritap Abner. Ki riiryo kora piik tugul.
Ki riir laitoryat agobo Abner kole; Konyolji Abner kome ko uu ye meei chiito ne abusat?
Ki ma ko ratotiin euneguk, ak ki ma ki rat keelyeguk eng' mugurek. Ko uu ye ibutyin chiito taitap lagogap yaityet, ko koibut anyun ko uu nooto. Ak ki riiryo piik tugul kogeny agobo ineendet.

Yeityo kobwa piik tugul komwachi Daudi koamis ye kita ko peet. Ago ki iyasyo Daudi kole, “Ingoyaiywo Kamuktaindet ko uu nooto ak kotes koosir, ngot achamcham amitwogik anan ko kiy age agoi kororokto asiista.”
Ki keer piik tugul kioto, ak ki ibaibai icheek; amu kiit age tugul ne ki yai laitoryat, ko ki ibaibai piik tugul.
Ki nai anyun piik tugul ak Israel tugul eng' peetuunooto kole, ki ma kobooto laitoryat pareetap Abner weeriitap Ner.
Yeityo koleenji laitoryat otwogikyik, “Mongen ole kaibut rani pounindet ak ko chiito ne oo eng' Israel?
Aa nyalulat rani, agot nganda aa laitoryat ne ki kiil, ak temena pichu, weeriigap Zeruiah. Ingoyaakyi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor yaindetap yaityet ko uu yaityennyi.”
Kingo kas Ishbosheth weeriitap Saulo kole kogome Abner eng' Hebron, konyalul ak ki aragenso Yahudik tugul.

Nguno anyun ko ki tinyei weeriitap Saulo murenik aeng' che ki kiptainigap kweanaigap lugeet. Ki kiguure kainetap age Baanah, keguure ne po age Regap, weeriigap Rimon Berotindet, ne po lagogap Benjamin: (amu ki ityin Berot agine Benjamin:
ak kimwechi Berotik Gitaim ak ki pa koek punootik eng' olooto agoi ra.)

Ki tinyei Jonathan weeriitap Saulo weeriit ne kimeiyotiin keelyek. Ki po kenyiisyek muut ineendet ye ki itu ng'aleegap Saulo ak Jonathan eng' Jezreel ak kiganap cheplakwet ak komwei. Ye ki chooktoi komwei cheplakwanooto, kobut lakweet ak kiyaagitu keelyek. Ki kiguure kainennyi Mephibosheth.
Ki pa weeriigap Rimon Berotindet, Regap ak Baanah kot koit kootap Is-bonet ye ki imunyi peet kween ko kang'wanit asiista.
Ki pa kwenutap koot, ko uu piich che kimachei koip nganuuk ak kitoor moennyi. Kichililso Regap ak Baanah, ng'eetap kamet.
Kigaba icheek ak kingo it ko anyun, konyoor koruei eng' itogunnyi eng' koot ne kirue, kokwer ak kobar, yeityo kotil metit ak koip ak koba kobun ooreetap Arabah kemout komugul.

Ki ip metoto po Ishbosheth koipchi Daudi eng' Hebron ak koleenji laitoryat, “Metitap Ishbosheth weeriitap Saulo punyondeng'ung' ne ki cheeng'ei saboondang'ung'; ak kagoyaaktoochi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor mugetuut rani kiptaiyandennyu laitoryat eng' Saulo ak iyotennyi.”
Ki wolji `Daudi Regap ak Baanah ng'eetap kamet, weeriigap Rimon Berotindet koleenji, “Ko uu ye sabei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne ki kotyach saboondanyu eng' nyalilda tugul,
ye kingo mwaiwo chiito age kole, ‘kogome Saulo,’ koleen kaip logoiywek che myach, anam ineendet ak abar eng' Ziklag nooto ko melekto ne ki agoochi ineendet agobo logoiywekyik.
Siirei ne tya ye kabar piik che yaacheen chiito ne po iman eng' koonnyi komi itogunnyi, ko tos ma mage korotiikyik eunekwok ak aistook eng' ng'wony?”

Ara anyun ki ng'at `Daudi murenikyik ak ki par icheek. Kitil eunekwak ak keelyekwak ak kosonginin eng' ole neegitee tamboiyot ne mi Hebron. Ago ki ip metitap Ishbosheth ak kotupchi kereritap Abner eng' Hebron.
Ki pwa anyun pororyosyek tugul che po Israel ole mi Daudi eng' Hebron ak komwachi koleenji, “Keero, acheek anyun ko ki koweguk ak poortang'ung'.

Eng' peetuusyek che ki kosiirto ye ki laitoryat Saulo ne kiboiywech, ko inyee ne ki indochini Israel ye kimandoi ak komang'u eng' lugoosyek tugul. Ak ki leenjin `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ‘Ibae piikyuk Israel ak iegu pounindetap Israel.’ ”

Ki pwa anyun poisyek tugul che po Israel ole mi laitoryat eng' Hebron; ak ki yai `Laitoryat Daudi arorutyet kobooto icheek eng' Hebron eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ak ki iil `icheek Daudi koek laitoryat koboi Israel.
Ki po Daudi kenyiisyek sosom ye ki tau kolaitorani, ak ki laitoran kenyiisyek artam.
Ki laitoran eng' Hebron kobou Judah kenyiisyek tisap ak arawek lo, ak ki laitoran eng' Jerusalem kenyiisyek sosom ak somok kobou Israel tugul ak Judah.

Yeityo kwo laitoryat ak piikyik kobookchi Jerusalem. Ki ibwaati `Jebusik che ki menyei emonooto koleen ma imuuch Daudi kobar icheeget. Ara ki mwachi `icheek Daudi koleenji, “Me muuchi inyoo ko nganasennyo. Agot kipkoratinik ak che ing'waldos ko kerin si menyo ko.”
Ago ki nam Daudi irimeetap Zion, nooto ko nganaseetap Daudi.

Eng' peetuunooto kole `Daudi, “Chii age tugul ne parei Jebusik, ko ingotogosta kwo kereruutap peek si kwo kobar che ing'waldos ak kipkoratinik che puunigap Daudi.” Nooto amu nee si kimwaei keleen, “Ma imuuchi kobwa ko kipkoratinik ak che ing'waldos.”
Ki meny anyun `Daudi irimonooto ak koguure nganaseetap Daudi. Ki teech `ineendet komoswek tugul kong'etee Milo agoi oriit.
Ki eet Daudi kotesak amu ki mi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindetap lugoosyek, kobooto ineendet.
Ki iyookto `Iram laitoryatap Tyro piik koba kap Daudi koibei taragonik, kobooto musogik ak che waei koik, che kiteekyi koot Daudi.
Ak ki nai Daudi kole kigogimiit `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ineendet koek laitoryat ne pou Israel, ki nai kora kole ki kotoroor ineendet laitornatennyi agobo piikyik Israel.
Kingwo Daudi eng' Hebron, komutyigei chebaigeinik alak ak osotik alak eng' Jerusalem, ak ki kisikyi Daudi weeriik ak tiibiik alak.
Chu ko kainaigap che ki kisikyi ineendet eng' Jerusalem; Shamua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon,
Ibar, Elishua, Nepeg, Japhia,
Elishama, Eliada ak Eliphelet.
Kingo kas Philistiik kole ki kiil Daudi koek laitoryat koboi Israel, kotogosta tugul koba kocheeng' Daudi, ago ki kas Daudi ak kichoortagei kwo irimeet.
Kingo pwa Philistiik ak koyom atebweetap Repaim,
koteebe `Daudi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor koleenji, “Awe kebargei ak Philistiik? Tos indoi icheek eunnyu?” Ak ki leenji `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Daudi, “Togoste, amu andoi iman Philistiik eung'ung'.”
Ki it `Daudi Baal-perasim ak ki par icheek eng' yooto. Ki le, “Kagotui Kamuktaindet ne Toroor puunikyuk eng' tainnyu, ko uu mogoochek.” Kiguure anyun yooto Baal-perasim.
Ki pagaakta kanamonikwak Philistiik eng' yooto ak ki ip Daudi ak piikyik.
Ki togos Philistiik kogeny ne po aeng' ak koyom atebweetap Repaim.
Ak ye kingo teebee `Daudi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, kowolji koleenji ineendet, “Metogoste, ago alagu patennywa ak iyem yeityo ibookyi icheek eng' ye itoorchingei keetiigap logoek.
Ye igas cheetap panda eng' keetichooto po logoek parak, ing'eet ichakte, amu kagondoenen Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kobar lugeetap Philistiik.”
Ara ki yai Daudi ko uu nooto ko uu ye ki ng'at Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ak ki par `ineendet Philistiik kobooch Geba agoi koit Gezer.
Ki iyum `Daudi kogeny murenik eliphuusyek sosom che po Israel che ki kilewen.

Ki ng'eet Daudi ak kwo kobooto piik tugul che ki mi ak ineendet eng' Baale Judah koba koip moingetap Kamuktaindet ne ki kimwaitae kainet, kainetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne po lugoosyek ne tebee kerubisyek.
Ki inde icheek moingetap Kamuktaindet chepkichutit ne leel ak koip konyo eng' kootap Abinadab ne ki mi tulweet. Ki kweri weeriigap Abinadab Uzzah ak Ahio, chepkichutinooto leel.
Ki ip konyo eng' kootap Abinadab ne ki mi tulweet, kobooto moingetap Kamuktaindet. Ki indoe Ahio moingonooto.

Kiboiboitu Daudi ak koot tugul ne po Israel eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kobutei kibugandisyek tugul, kobooto ketubosyek, kibugandinik che ki kiyae keetiigap piribiryet, sugutisyek che mengeechen, ndurerusyek ak eng' sanisyek che cheeitos.
Kingo it icheek rwanyut ne kiboorsee ne po Nakon, koyogooito Uzzah eunnyi kotokyi moingetap Kamuktaindet ak konam amu kiterteryot eiik.
Eng' yooto, konereech miising' Kamuktaindet ne Toroor agobo Uzzah, ak kibir `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ineendet eng' yooto amu lelutyennyi. Kimechi yooto kimi moingetap Kamuktaindet.
Ki ma cham Daudi, amu ki par Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Uzzah. Ara kiguure yooto Peres-usa agoi ra.
Ki iywei `Daudi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor peetuunooto, ak ki mwa kole, “Imuktoi ano moingetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor konyo ole ami?”
Ara ma cham Daudi anyun koip moingetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor konyo ole mi ineendet eng' nganaseetap Daudi. Ago ki ip `ineendet kwo taban, kwo kootap Obed-edom Getindet.
Ki tebee moingetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kootap Obed-edom Getindet arawek somok, ak ki iberuur `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Obed-edom, ak koonnyi tugul.

Ki kimwachi Daudi keleenji, “Kigoberuur Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kootap Obed-edom, ak tuguukyik tugul, amu moingetap Kamuktaindet.” Ara ki wo `Daudi koip moingetap Kamuktaindet eng' poiboiyet eng' kootap Obed-edom kotogos konyo nganaseetap Daudi.
Kingo kagoba mitainik lo icheeget che ki ibei moingetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, koeny eito ne pungus ak age ne akwai.
Kogagermenegei `Daudi ephod ne po katanit, koureren eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' kimnateennyi tugul.
Ki ibu anyun `Daudi ak koot tugul ne po Israel moingetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kotyenonu ak koguutonu iryagook.

Kingo it moingetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor nganaseetap Daudi, koiit eng' tirisia Mikal cheptap Saulo. Kingo keer `ineendet Laitoryat Daudi kotwoltwoli ak kourereni eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, kosas ineendet eng' muguleldanyi.

Ki ip moingetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor konyo ko, ak konde oldanyi eng' kwenutap emait ne kiga koteekyi Daudi. Yeityo kogoito `Daudi kagoochinoik che kibeelei ak kagoochinoigap kaalyeet eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Kingo kagogees Daudi kagoitoetap kagoochinet ne kibeelei ak kagoochinoigap kaalyeet, koberuur piik eng' kainetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne po lugoosyek.
Kipchechi magatyat, pendo ak magatyatap sabibuk che yamyotiin piik tugul eng' tuiyet tugul ne po Israel, murenik ak kwonyiik. Ki igoochi chii age tugul yeityo kwo chii tugul koonnyi.

Ye kingo week Daudi koberuur piigap koonnyi, konyo saang' Mikal cheptap Saulo kotorook Daudi ak koleenji, “Ka itoroorot ne tya laitoryatap Israel rani, ne kang'aanygei eng' taitap otwogikyik che tiibiik, ko uu kiptangoiya ne ng'aanyegei ama ililani!”

Koleenji `Daudi Mikal, “Kagaureren eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne ki lewena asiir kwandang'ung' ak asiir koonnyi tugul, kondea aek pounindet eng' piigap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, aboi Israel. Nooto anyun, aurereni eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Iman, ak ta kesasa kosiir niito, ak ageeregei aegu ne ming'in. Ko agobo tiibiicho otwogik che kemwa, koteecha icheeget.”
Ak ma sich Mikal cheptap Saulo lakwa agoi peetuutap meennyi.
Ye kingo meny laitoryat koonnyi ak kogoochi `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ineendet kamuung'et eng' puunikyik tugul che ki mi eng' komoswek tugul,
koleenji `laitoryat Nathan maotyot, “Keero, amenye kootap taragonik, ago menyei moingetap Kamuktaindet emait oriit.”
Koleenji `Nathan laitoryat, “Ui, ak iyai tugul che mi muguleldang'ung', amu mi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kobooten.”
Ak ki ityi Nathan ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kemounooto, koleenji,
“Ui imwachi otwogindennyu Daudi ileenji, ‘Kamwa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Tos inyee ne teekwo koot ne amenye?
Amu tomo amenye ko kobooch peetuut ne ki amutu piigap Israel eng' Misiri agoi peetuuni, ago ki ameng'ootee emait ak kootap moinget.

Eng' komoswek tugul ole ki awendotee ak lagok tugul che po Israel, ko tos ki ateebee kandoigap ortinwegap Israel che ki ang'at koriip piikyuk Israel aleenji, Amu nee si ma oteekwo koot ne po taragonik?

Ara anyun, imwachini otwogindennyu Daudi ileenjini, kamwa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne po lugoosyek kole, Ki amutun eng' piutap keechiirek, eng' kayagetap keechiirek, si kobiit iegu pounindet eng' piikyuk ibou Israel.
Ki atebi kobooten eng' oldo tugul ole ki iwe ak ki aiste puuniguk tugul eng' taing'ung'. Aeeti kaineng'ung', ko uu kainetap piik che eecheen eng' ng'wony.
Alewenjini yeto piikyuk Israel ak amiine icheek, si kobiit komeny yetanywa. Ma kiutoi kogeny anan konyaliil icheek `lagogap yaityet kogeny ko uu eng' tai,
kobooch peetuut ne ki ang'at kirwoogik koboi piikyuk Israel, agoonin imuuny eng' puuniguk tugul. Ak mwaun Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kogeny kole teegun koot Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ye igeskei peetuusyeguk ak oruiye ak kwanisyeguk, ang'eet iyoteng'ung' ne piitu let ne punu poortang'ung', ak agimiit laitornatennyi.
Tuun teekyin koot ineendet kainennyu ak agimiit ng'echereetap laitornatennyi koigeny.
Aegu kwandanyi ak koek weeriinnyu. Ngot koyai inee tengek, atigoone kirokto ne po piik ak pirutigap lagogap piik.
Ago ma istoegei ineendet rireenennyu ko uu ye ki arebee Saulo, ineendet ne ki aiste eng' taing'ung'.
Ki kimiiti koong'ung' ak laitornateng'ung' koigeny eng' taing'ung'. Ki kimiiti ng'echereetap laitornateng'ung' agoi koigeny.’ ”
Ki ng'alaalji `Nathan Daudi ko uu ole teptoi ng'aleechooto tugul ak ko uu ng'ang'utyoni tugul.
Kingo pata, kwo ko laitoryat, kwo kotebi ng'wony eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor yeityo kole, “Aa ng'oo, ee Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ak nee koonnyu kot imutwaa agoi ra?

Ko uu yo kiy niito ne ming'in eng' taing'ung' ee Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ko kaing'alaal kogeny agobo kootap otwogindeng'ung' eng' peetuusyek che chaang' che pwoonei. Uu ni piteetap kimugulmet, ee Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor!
Nee age neta komuuchi Daudi komwaun? Amu ingen inyee otwogindeng'ung', ee Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Amu kaiyai etunatoni tugul agobo ng'olyoondeng'ung' ak ko uu muguleldang'ung' inyegei, si kobiit igoochi otwogindeng'ung' konai.
Ii oo amu nooto, ee Kamuktaindet ne po Toroornatet, amu ma mi ne ogerge, ama mi Kamuktaindet age kobatenen, ko uu eng' tugul che kigegas eng' itiikyok.

Ngoro pororyet ne kergei ak piiguk Israel ne ki wo Kamuktaindet kotyakyigei koek piikyik ak koyachigei kainet? Ngoro pororyet ne ki yachi tuguuk che eecheen agobo okweek ak tuguuk che po kamuiset agobo emeng'ung' eng' taitap piiguk? Icheek che ki ityaach eng' Misiri koek cheguuk, ak eng' pororyosyek ak kamuktaikwak?
Ki igimityigei piiguk Israel koek piiguk koigeny; ak ki iegu inyee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindennywa.
Ara anyun, ee Kamuktaindet ne po Toroornatet, igimit koigeny ng'olyoot ne kaimwa agobo otwogindeng'ung', ak agobo koonnyi ak iyai ko uu ye kemwa.
Ingitoroor kaineng'ung' koigeny keele, ‘Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne po lugoosyek ko Kamuktaindet ne pou Israel.’ Ak ki kimiti koigeny kootap otwogindeng'ung' Daudi eng' taing'ung'.

Amu ki ing'aang'ji inyee otwogindeng'ung', ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne po lugoosyek, Kamuktaindetap Israel, ileenji ‘Ateegun koot.’ Kanyiganit anyun otwogindeng'ung' eng' muguleldanyi kosaain saaoni.
Ara anyun, ee Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ii Kamuktaindet, iman ng'aleeguk ak kaiyomisyi otwogindeng'ung' kii myee.

Ingobaibain iberuur kootap otwogindeng'ung' si kobiit kotep koigeny eng' taing'ung'. Amu kaimwa inyee, ee Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ak ingoek ne iberuurot koigeny kootap otwogindeng'ung' eng' kaberureng'ung'.”
Kingo pata niito, kobar `Daudi Philistiik ak koterteer icheek, ak korep `Daudi Metegama eng' eunegap Philistiik.

Ki iterteer ak kobar Moab. Ki ng'at icheek koruiyo eng' ng'wony yeityo kokwa icheek eng' porowet ak kokwa icheeget eng' porowet. Ki kibar kobek piik eng' uitugul ye ite kakwaindap poroonik aeng', ago ki chamji kosapcho che mi uitugul ole ite porowet ne po somok. Ara anyun ki ek Moabik otwogigap Daudi ak ki ip kagoochinoik.
Ki par kogeny `Daudi Hadadeser weeriitap Rehob, laitoryatap Soba, ye kiwendi koweechi pounatennyi kogeny eng' aineet.

Kiluule `Daudi ineendet murenikyik eliphuut agenge ak pogol tisap che ki laanyei paraisisyek ak eliphuusyek tiptem che kibunei keelyek. Ki ep Daudi kutung'oigap paraisisyek tugul che ki ichuuti kariisyek, ago ki ituuch eng' chooto che yamei kariisyek pogol.
Kingo pwa piigap Syria che menyei Damasko kotoret Hadadeser laitoryatap Soba, kobar Daudi piik eliphuusyek tiptem ak aeng' eng' piigap Syria.
Ki inde anyun Daudi irimosyek Syria ne po Damasko. Ki ek piigap Syria otwogigap Daudi ak ki ip kagoochinoik. Ki igoochi `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Daudi katerteeret eng' komosta age tugul ne ki wo.
Ki ip `Daudi long'onigap thahabu che ki tinyei otwogigap Hadadeser ak ki ip kobwa Jerusalem.
Ki ip Laitoryat `Daudi sugunonik che chaang' miising' eng' Beta ak eng' Berotai, nganasoogap Hadadeser.
Kingo kas `Toi laitoryatap Hamath kole kogobar `Daudi lugeet tugul ne po Hadadeser,

koyookto anyun `Toi Joram weeriinnyi kwo kaplaitoryat Daudi, kwo kogat ineendet ak koberuur, amu kiga kobargei ak Hadadeser ak ki par ineendet, amu ki pargei Hadadeser ak Toi. Ki ip Joram tereenigap fedha, tereenigap thahabu ak tereenigap sugunonik.
Ki itabaanji `Daudi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor tuguuchuuto ak icheek, kobooto fedha ak thahabu che kiga kotabaan eng' pororyosyek tugul che kiga koterteer,
che po Syria, che po Moab, che po lagogap Ammon, che po Philistiik, che po Amelek ak che parunenigap Hadadeser weeriitap Rehob laitoryatap Soba.
Ki eet kainetap Daudi ye ki weeksei kobunu pareet ne ki parei piigap Syria eng' Atebweetap Munyuk, ole ki pare murenik eliphuusyek taman ak sisiit.
Ki inde irimosyek Edom komugul, ak ki ek Edomik tugul otwogigap Daudi. Ki igoochi `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Daudi katerteeret eng' komosta age tugul ne ki wo.
Ak ki laitoran Daudi eng' Israel tugul; ak ki irwookyi Daudi piikyik tugul eng' lititindo ak iman.
Ki pou Joab weeriitap Zeruiah lugeet, ak ko ki siriindetap tuguuk che piitu, Jehoshaphat weeriitap Ahilud.
Ki tisiik Zadok weeriitap Ahitub ak Ahimelek weeriitap Abiathar, ko ki siriindet Seraiah.
Ki pou Benaiah weeriitap Jehoiada Keretik ak Peletik ak ki tisiik weeriigap Daudi.
Eng' peetuut age, kotep Daudi kole, “Tos mi chii ne ki ng'et eng' kootap Saulo, si kobiit ayachi ne myee amu Jonathan?”

Ki mi eng' kootap Saulo otwogindet ne ki kiguure kainennyi Siba ak ki kiguur kwo ole mi Daudi. ki teebee anyun `laitoryat ineendet koleenji, “Ii Siba?” Ak ki wol kole, “Aa ineendet, anee otwogindeng'ung'.”

Yeityo koteebe laitoryat koleenji, “Tos ta komi chii eng' kootap Saulo, si kobiit ayachi ineendet myeeindap Kamuktaindet?” Ak ki leenji Siba laitoryat, “Ta komi weeriitap Jonathan ne yaacheen keelyekyik.”
koteebee `laitoryat ineendet koleenji, “Mi ano?” Ak ki leenji `Siba laitoryat, “Keero, mi kootap Makir weeriitap Amiel, eng' Lo-debar.”
Ki iyookto anyun `Daudi kimut ineendet konyo eng' kootap Makir weeriitap Amiel eng' Lo-debar.
Ki nyo ole mi Daudi `Mephibosheth, weeriitap Jonathan weeriitap Saulo ak kobutyi ng'wony kogutung'ji. Ki kuur `Daudi koleenji, “Mephibosheth.” Ak ki wol kole, “Keer otwogindeng'ung'!”
Ki leenji anyun `Daudi ineendet, “Meiywei; amu ayaun ne myee iman agobo Jonathan kwandang'ung', ak iamisye mesennyu kotugul.”
Ki ing'uruuk Mephibosheth ak kole, “Nee otwogindeng'ung' kot igeer seset ne ki kome ko uu anee?”
Ki kuur anyun `laitoryat Siba otwogindetap Saulo, ak koleenji ineendet, “Kaagoochi weeriitap kiptaiyandeng'ung' tuguuk tugul che ki po Saulo ak koonnyi tugul.

Ibatyi emet inyee, weeriiguk ak otwogiguk, ak iibu peek kobwa ko, si kobiit konyoor weeriitap kiptaiyandeng'ung' amitwogik che amei. Ago amisye mesennyu kotugul Mephibosheth weeriitap kiptaiyandeng'ung'.” Ki tinyei `Siba weeriik taman ak muut ak otwogik tiptem.

Ki wolji anyun `Siba laitoryat koleenji, “Ayae ko uu tugul che ng'ata kiptaiyandennyu laitoryat anee otwogindennyi.” Ago ki le laitoryat, “Amisye mesennyu Mephibosheth ko uu age eng' weeriigap laitoryat.”
Ki tinyei `Mephibosheth weeriit ne ming'in, ne ki kiguure kainennyi Mikah. Ak piik tugul che ki menyei kootap Siba ko ki otwogigap Mephibosheth.
Ki meny anyun Mephibosheth Jerusalem; amu ki amisye kotugul meesetap laitoryat, ak ki ing'wali eng' keelyekyik tuwai.
Kingo pata niito, kome laitoryatap lagogap Ammon, ak ki laitoran Hanun weeriinnyi kogeer ineendet.

Ki le anyun `Daudi, “Ayachini ne myee Hanun weeriitap Nahas, ko uu ye ki yaiywo ne myee kwandanyi.” Ara anyun ki iyookto `Daudi piik koba kogaigai ineendet amu kwandanyi. Ago kingo it otwogigap Daudi emetap lagogap Ammon,
koleenji `pounigap Hanun kiptaiyannywa, “Ibwaati ile konyiti Daudi kwandang'ung', kot koyogun kagoigoik? Ma iyook Daudi otwogikyik kobwa oldang'ung' kosyach nganaseet, kosegei ak kobar?”
Ki nam anyun Hanun otwogigap Daudi, ak konem kebeber eng' tamnokwak, ak kotil ngoroikwak komut kwenut koboochit ngorook yeityo kounda icheek koba.
ki ngemwachi Daudi ng'olyoondonooto, koyookto piik kotorookta icheeget si komwachi koleenji, “Otebi eng' Jeriko ak ye tuun piityo tamnokwok, obwa,” amu ki ililandos pichooto miising'.

Kingo keer lagogap Ammon kole kagoyaagitu icheeget eng' Daudi, koyookto keguur piigap Syria che menyei Beth-rehob ak piigap Syria che menyei Soba, si konyoor melekto murenik eliphuusyek tiptemu che punei keelyek, kobooto Laitoryat Maaka ak murenik eliphuut ak murenik eliphuusyek taman ak aeng' che po Tob.
Kingo kas `Daudi, koyookto Joab ak lugeet tugul ne po murenik che kiimeen.
Ki pwa lagogap Ammon ak kotet lugeet eng' ye kibunei eng' ormariich. Ki mi icheegei piigap Syria che menyei Soba, ak che po Rehob ak murenigap Tob ak che po Maaka, eng' warenget.
Kingo keer Joab kole kagetet lugeet agobo ineendet eng' tai ak let, kokwei murenik che ki kilewen che po Israel ak kotet si kobargei ak piigap Syria.
Ki inde piik che kiga ng'et, eutap Abisai, ng'eetap kamet, ak kitet icheek si kobargei ak lagogap Ammon.
Yeityo kole, “Ngot kogimegitu piigap Syria koterteera, itoreta, ago ngot kogimegitu lagogap Ammon koterteerin, anyoo atoretiin.
Nyiganitu ak ingeegu murenik agobo piikyok ak nganasoogap Kamuktaindennyo, ak ingoyai Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ko uu ye keerei kole myee.”
Kingo riikta anyun Joab ak murenik che ki mi ak ineendet koba lugeet kobargei ak piigap Syria, komwee `icheek ineendet.
Kingo keer lagogap Ammon kole kagomwei piigap Syria, komwei ak icheek eng' taitap Abisai ak ki pa nganaseet. Ki week Joab anyun eng' ole kimi lagogap Ammon, kobwa Jerusalem.
Kingo keer piigap Syria kole kagiterter icheek eng' taitap Israel, koyumgei.
Ak ki iyookto Hadareser kimut piigap Syria che ki mi aineet pitoniin, ak ki pwa Helam kobooto Sobak kiptaiyatap lugeetap Hadareser kondoune.
Ki ngemwachi Daudi, koyum Israel tugul, yeityo kolandae Jordan ak koba Helam. Kitetkei piigap Syria kotokyigei Daudi ak kobargei ak ineendet.

Ki mwee `piigap Syria Israel kogeny, ak ki par `Daudi piigap Syria pogol tisap che po kariisyek ak murenik eliphuusyek artam che ki laanyei paraisisyek ak ki par Sobak kiptaiyatap lugeennywa komechi yooto.

Kingo keer laitorinik tugul che ki otwogigap Hadareser kole kagiterter icheek eng' taitap Israel, koyai kaalyeet ak Israel, ak koot icheek. Koiywei anyun piigap Syria kota kotoret lagogap Ammon kogeny.

Kingo it kasartap kenyiit ne cham kobee laitorinik lugeet, koyookto `Daudi Joab kobooto otwogikyik ak Israel tugul kobar lagogap Ammon. Kiyiem lugeetap Israel Rabbah. Ago ki tebi Daudi eng' Jerusalem.
Kingo it koskoleny eng' pesyet age, kong'eet `Daudi eng' itogunnyi ak kowendote kootap laitoryat parak. Ye kingo mi parak, kogeer kwony ne ki karaaran kot kounegei.
Ki iyookto `Daudi piik koteep agobo kwonyooto. Ak ki le age, “Niito ko Bathsheba cheptap Eliam, nooto ne osotyotap Uriah Hitindet”
Ki iyookto anyun `Daudi piik koba kimut, ak ki nyo ole mi ineendet ak kiruiyo ak ineendet; (amu kiga koanyinygei eng' murwoonindanyi.) Yeityo koweektagei kwo koonnyi.
Ki manach kwonyooto, ak ki iyookto kemwachi Daudi agobo nooto.
Ara anyun ki iyookto `Daudi chii kwo ole mi Joab, koleenji, “Iyookwo Uriah Hitindet.” Ak ki iyookto `Joab Uriah kwo ole mi Daudi.
Kingo it Uriah ole mi ineendet, koteebe `Daudi ineendet agobo Joab, ak ole chamdogei piik ak ole ki uu lugeet.
Yeityo koleenji `Daudi Uriah, “Chortegei, ui koong'ung' ak iun keelyeguk.” Ki wo Uriah eng' kootap laitoryat, ak ki kisube ineendet amitwogik che ki punu laitoryat.
Ago ki ru Uriah kurgeetap kootap laitoryat kobooto otwogik tugul che po kiptaiyandennyi, ma choortagei kwo koonnyi.
Ak kingo kagomwachi `icheek Daudi koleenji, “Ma choortagei Uriah kwo koonnyi,” koleenji `Daudi Uriah, “Kama ibunu panda? Amu nee anyun si mechoortegei iwe koong'ung'?”

Kowolji `Uriah Daudi koleenji, “Tebee `keryosyek moinget ak Israel ak Judah, ak menyei keeweet kiptaiyandennyu Joab ak otwogigap kiptaiyandennyu. Tos awetitoi ano anyun anee koonnyu, aamisye ak aeeise ak keruiye ak osotyondennyu? Ko uu ye isabe ak ko uu ye sabei saboondang'ung', ma yae kioto.”
Koleenji `Daudi Uriah, “Peni olito rani ak mutai achamun iwe.” Kibeni anyun Uriah Jerusalem peetuunooto, ak peetuut ne ki isubi nooto.

Ak kingo kuur `Daudi ineendet, koamis ak koeiso eng' tainnyi; ki igoochi koe kot kobogit. Ki wo komanda koskoleny kwo koru eng' itogunnyi kobooto otwogigap kiptaiyandennyi, ago ma choortagei kwo koonnyi.
Kingo kagoeech, kosirchi `Daudi parweet Joab, ak koyooktoe Uriah.
Ki sir eng' parwaanooto kole, “Onde Uriah tai eng' lugeet ne ng'waan miising', ak ochuchuigei obagaakte ineendet si kobiit kebar kome.”
Ak kingo ta koriibei Joab nganaseet, konde Uriah komosta ne ki mi murenik che nyigoonen.
Ak kimanda piigap nganaseet koba kobargei ak Joab. Ki pek piik alak eng' icheek, eng' otwogigap Daudi, ak kime Uriah Hitindet agine.
Ki iyookto anyun Joab kemwachi Daudi tuguuk tugul agobo lugeet.
Ki ng'at chiito ne kiga iyookto koleenji, “Ye kaimwachi laitoryat tuguuk tugul agobo lugeet kogeskei,
ko ngot konereech laitoryat ak koleenjin, Amu nee si ooriikyi nganaseet obargei? Kama ongen ole imuuchi komwogok eng' irimeet?

Ng'oo ne ki par Abimelek weeriitap Jerubeset? Ki ma wiiree kwondo age ineendet isyet eng' irimeet, ak ki mechi Tebes? Amu nee anyun si ooriikyi irimeet? Ile, Ki kome otwogindeng'ung' Uriah Hitindet agine.”
Ki wo anyun ne ki kiyookto ak kiit ak koboorchi Daudi tuguuk tugul che kiga iyooktoe Joab ineendet.
Ki leenji `chiichooto Daudi, “Ki iterteerech pichooto, ki imong'jech eng' keeweet ak ki kibarategei kot koit ye kibunei eng' ormariichet.
Kimwok `mwoogik otwogiguk eng' irimeet; ak ki pek alak eng' otwogigap laitoryat, ak kime agine otwogindeng'ung' Uriah Hitindet.”

Koleenji `Daudi chiichooto kagiyogu, “Imwachini Joab ko uu ni ileenjini, Ameng' koiimin ng'olyoondoni, amu parei rotwetap chok age ko uu ye parei age. Igimiit lugeeng'ung' kota kogimit, si kobargei ak nganaseet ak oterteer, ak icheer ineendet.”
Kingo kas osotyotap Uriah kole kogome manong'otyondennyi, koote agobo ineendet.
Ak kingo pata kateet, koyookto `Daudi kimut konyo koonnyi, ak ki ek osotyonnyi ak ki sikyi ng'etet. Ago ma cham Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kioto ki yai Daudi.
Ki iyookto `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Nathan kwo ole mi Daudi. Ak ye kingo nyo ole mi ineendet koleenji, “Kimi piik aeng'u nganaseet agenge. Ki mogoryot age, ko ki kibananiat age.
Ki tinyei ne ki mogoryot akwotisyek che chaang' miising' che po keechiirek ak tuuga.

Ago ki ma kotinyei kiy ne ki kibananiat, kobatee subeendo agenge ne ming'in ne po keechiir ne kiga al ak kogu. Ki eegitu tuwai ak lagokyik. Ki amei amitwogikyik, kiee kigombennyi ak korue tegeennyi. Ki uu eng' ineendet cheptonyi.

Ki nyo anyun kiprutoiyo kap mogoryondonooto, ak ma cham konam ne po akweennyi ne po keechiirek ak ne po akweetap tuukyik koeng'ji chiichooto kisiirtoi ne kiga nyoonji ineendet, ago ki nam aarwetap kibananiandanooto, ak koeng'ji chiichooto kiga nyoonji ineendet.”
Ki nereekyi miising' `Daudi chiichooto ak ki leenji Nathan, “Ko uu ye sabei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, konyaaljin chiichooto ki yai kioto kome,
ak koyook arwanooto konyil ang'wan amu ki yai kiito ak amu ki ma kotinyei rireenet.”
Koleenji `Nathan Daudi, “Ii chiichooto. Kamwa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindetap Israel kole, Ki aiiliin iegu laitoryat ibou Israel, ak ki asaruun eng' eutap Saulo.

Ki agoonin kootap kiptaiyandeng'ung' ak ki agoonin osotigap kiptaiyandeng'ung' kobwa tegeng'ung' ak agoonin kootap Israel ak ne po Judah. Nda kiga ng'ering'itu chooto, ta ki atesun tuguuk alak ak alak.

Amu nee anyun si isas ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor iyai kiit ne ya eng' tainnyi? Koibar Uriah Hitindet eng' rotwetap chok, ibare ineendet rotwetap chok ne po lagogap Ammon, yeityo imutu osotyonnyi koek osotyondeng'ung'.
Nguno anyun, komagoi istogei rotwetap chok eng' koong'ung' amu koisasa ak koimutu osotyotap Uriah Hitindet koek osotyondeng'ung'.
Kamwa anyun Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole, ‘Keero, ang'eetun yaityet eng' koong'ung' ak arebenen osotiguk igeeroti, ak agoochi icheek chiitap kokweng'ung' ak koruiyo ak osotiguk kooluu asiista.
Koiyai eng' ung'oot, ago ayae kiito eng' taitap Israel tugul, ak kogeerei asiis.’ ”
Koleenji `Daudi Nathan, “Koayachi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor tengekto.” Kowolji `Nathan Daudi koleenji, “Kagoisto Kamuktaindet ne Toroor agine tengektong'ung'; memee.
Ago amu kaigoochi eng' yaityoni puunigap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor poroindo ne oo kochubis, komeei iman agine lakweet ne tuun kisigun.”
Kingo kakwo Nathan koonnyi, kobir `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor lakweet ne kiga sikyi Daudi osotyotap Uriah, ak kimyan kot.
Ki sa `Daudi Kamuktaindet agobo lakwanooto. Ki irugutkei Daudi ak ki wo ko, kwo koru ng'wony kemout komugul.
Ki ng'eetyo poisyegap koonnyi kotononio eng' ye mi ineendet koleen kong'eet ineendet, ago ma cham ak ma cham koamis ak icheeget.

Eng' peetuut ne po tisap, kome lakweet. Ki iywei otwogigap Daudi komwachi ineendet koleenji kagome lakweet, amu ki le, “Ogeero, ngot ko ye kota kosabei lakweet, ko koging'alaalji ineendet ama cham kogas ng'aleekyok, kobirtogei anyun ne tya ngot keleenji kagome lakweet?”
Ago kingo keer Daudi kochaamjingei otwogikyik, konai Daudi kole kagome. Ki teebee `Daudi otwogikyik, koleenji, “Kagome lakweet i?” Ak ki wol kole, “Kagome.”

Ki ng'eet anyun Daudi eng' ng'wony kwo koun kei, koiilgei ak kolaach ngoroik alak, yeityo konyo kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kosa. Kingo tar kosaaei, kwo koonnyi ak king'yemach amitwogik, kindochi tainnyi ak ki am.
Ki leenji anyun `otwogikyik, “Nee kii koiyai? Koirugutigei ak iriire agobo lakweet yu kota kosabei, ago ko ngo me, ing'eet ak iamisye.”
Ki wol kole, “Ko ngo ta kosabei lakweet, ko koarugutigei ak ariire amu koaleen tamangap koriirena Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, si kosap lakweet?
Ago nguno ko kagome, kota arugutyigei nee? Ta amuuchi aweech kosap kogeny? Ta awendi ole mi ineendet, ago ma weeksei ineendet konyonei oli ami.”
Ki igaigai `Daudi Bathsheba osotyonnyi yeityo kwo ole mi ineendet kotuiyogei. Ki sich weeriit ak koguuree kainennyi Solomon. Amu ki cham `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ineendet,
ko ki iyooktoe ng'aleek Nathan maotyot, keguure kainennyi Jedidia.
Kibargei `Joab ak Rabbah ne po lagogap Ammon, ak kiluul nganaseetap kaplaitoryat.
Ki iyookto `Joab piik koba ole mi Daudi komwachi koleenji, “Kogebargei ak Rabbah, ak koaluul nganaseetap peek.
Ara anyun, iyum piik che ng'etunotiin, teech ye tokyingei nganaseet ak inam si ma anam anee nganaseet ak kemwaitae kainennyu.”
Ki iyum `Daudi piik tugul yeityo koba Rabbah kobargei ak nganasanooto ak koluul.

Ki inemune laitoryannywa naaryeetap laitornatet, ne kinyigiisindanyi ko ki talendait agenge ne po thahabu, ne ki kinde koik che po kamanuutyet ne oo ak ki kigerchine `Daudi metit. Ki ip komong' parunenik che chaang' miising' che po nganaseet.

Ak ki imut piik che ki mi oriit komong', ak konde icheek koboisyee musumenosyek, kariik che kiburburenisye ak aonogap kariik, ak kobirchi kobois eng' ole kibeelee matubaruuk. Ki yachi ko uu nooto nganasook tugul che po lagogap Ammon. Yeityo koweek Daudi ak piik tugul koba Jerusalem.
Ki tinyei Absalom weeriitap Daudi chepkamet ne karaaran, ne ki kiguure Tamar. Ki cham `Amnon weeriitap Daudi Tamar.
Ki iimgei Amnon kot komyan amu chepkametinnyi Tamar, amu ki pergeiyat, ak ki keer Amnon kouuit koyachi kiy age tugul ineendet.
Nguno anyun ko ki tinyei Amnon chorweet, ne kainennyi ko ki Jonadab, weeriitap Simea, ng'eetap kametap Daudi. Ki chii ne ng'aaliin miising' Jonadab.
ki teebee `Jonadab Amnon koleenji, “Kolya o, weeriitap laitoryat, si isagiti peetuut age tugul?” Kowolji `Amnon ineendet koleenji, “Koacham ak amache Tamar chepkametap tupchennyu Absalom.”

Koleenji `Jonadab ineendet, “Ui ru eng' itogung'ung' ak iigei chiito ne myani, si ye nyo kwandang'ung' kogeerin, ileenji, Asoomin ale konyo tupchennyu Tamar nyoo kogoono amitwogik aam ak kochobwa amitwogik eng' tainnyu, si kobiit ageer yeityo kogoono eng' eunnyi aam.”

Ara ki ru anyun Amnon, koigei chiito ne myani. Kingo nyo laitoryat kogeer ineendet, koleenji Amnon laitoryat, “Asoomin ale konyo tupchennyu Tamar ak kochobwa magatiinik aeng' ageere si kobiit kogoono eng' eunnyi aam.”
Koyookto anyun Daudi keguur Tamar eng' kaa ak koleenji, “Ui kootap ng'eetap kamenng'ung' Amnon si ichopchi amitwogik.”
Ko uu nooto anyun, kogiwo Tamar kootap ng'eetap kamet Amnon ne kiruei. Ki nam peek che kagitesyi peek ak kokwanykwany yeityo kochop magatiinik eng' tainnyi ak kobeel.
Yeityo konam taabeetap karnet ak koluluk eng' tainnyi kogoochi, ago ki eesyo koam. Ki le `Amnon, “Ingomanda piik tugul eng' yu ami.” Ak kimanda chii tugul eng' ye ki mi ineendet.
Ki leenji `Amnon Tamar, “Ibu amitwogik kobwa kooi arue si kobiit igoono eng' eung'ung' aam.” Ki ip Tamar magatiinik che kagochop, koip koba koyooto koipchi ng'eetap kamet Amnon.
Ago ye kingo kagoip magatinichooto koba ye neegitee ineendet si koam, kosuup ineendet ak koleenji, “Nyoo keruiye tuwai, tupchennyu.”
Ak ki wolji `Tamar koleenji, “Achicha, tupchennyu, amesuuba, amu ma mi kiy ne uu no ne nyolu keyai eng' Israel; ameyai yaityoni.
Si awo ano anyun anee eng' teweernatennyu? Ak iigei inyee age eng' che yaacheen che abusotiin eng' Israel. Ara anyun, asoomin ale ng'alaalji laitoryat; amu maetenen abunjin.”
Ago ma cham kogas ng'aleekyik, ago amu ki kiim kosiir chebooto, ko kisuup ak koruiyo ak ineendet.
Kingo pata kosas `Amnon ineendet eng' saset ne oo miising', amu kieet weget ne kiwech ineendet kosiir chamyet ne kiga chame ineendet. Ki leenji `Amnon ineendet, “Ng'eet, ui.”
Kowol Tamar koleenji ineendet, “Ma uu nooto, amu ya yaityoni oo keonena kosiir kiit ne kaiyaiywo.” Ago ma cham kogas ng'aleekyik.
Yeityo koguur otwogindet ne kiboisyechin konyo ole mi ak koleenji, “Imaande kwonyi kwo eng' yu ami, ak itemel kurgeet ko kagomanda.”

Ki ilaachi chebooto ngoryeet ne kooi, amu ki cham kolaachi tiibiigap laitoryat che pergeinik ngoroik che uu chooto. Ki imut anyun otwogindennyi ineendet konyo saang' ak kotemel kurgeet ko kagomong' konyo saang'.
Ki inde Tamar oreek metinnyi ak kogereer ngoryennyi ne kooi ne ki ilaachi. Kinamatkei met ak kwo koriiroti eng' kutit ne oo.

Ki leenji `Absalom ng'eetap kametap Tamar ineendet, “Koomi ak Amnon ng'eetap kamenng'ung'? Siis nguno anyun, tupchennyu; ineendet ko ng'eetap kamenng'ung'. Mende kiito muguleldang'ung'.” Ki tebi Tamar anyun ineegei eng' kootap ng'eetap kamet Absalom.
Ago kingo kas Laitoryat `Daudi tuguuchuuto tugul, konereech miising'.
Ma mwachi `Absalom Amnon kiy ne myee anan ko ne ya. Ki sas `Absalom Amnon, amu kiga suup chepkamennyi Tamar.
Ye kingo siirto kenyiisyek aeng'u, ko ki mi Absalom ak piik che kitilei koroorigap keechiirek eng' Baal-hasor ne mi ye neegitee Ephraim, ak kiguur Absalom weeriik tugul che po laitoryat.
Ki wo Absalom ole mi laitoryat ak koleenji, “Keero, tinyei otwogindeng'ung' piik che tilei koroorigap keechiirek. Ara asoomin ale ingoba laitoryat ak otwogikyik kobooto otwogindeng'ung'.”
Kowolji `laitoryat Absalom koleenji, “Achicha, weeriinnyu, ma myee keebe tugul, si ma kigoonin nyigiisindo. Ki igaigai ineendet,” ago nganda ma cham kwo, ko ki iberuur ineendet.
Ki soom anyun Absalom kole, “Ngot ko mewendi, asoomin ale keebe kobooto Amnon tupchennyu.” Ki teebee `laitoryat ineendet koleenji, “Amu nee si imache obe tuwai?”
Ago ki igaigai `Absalom ineendet, kochamji Amnon ak weeriik tugul che po laitoryat koba kobooto ineendet.
Ki ng'at `Absalom otwogik koleenji, “Ye kagobaibait muguleldap Amnon eng' maiyek, ko ye aleenjok, ‘Okwer Amnon,’ obar anyun ineendet matoiywei. Ma anee ne kang'atak? Ogimegitu ak onyiganitu.”
Ki yachi `otwogigap Absalom Amnon ko uu ye kiga ng'at Absalom. Ki ng'eetyo anyun weeriik tugul che po laitoryat kolaany chii tugul nyumbunnyi ak komwei.
Ye kita kobendi eng' ooreet, koit ng'aleek ole kimi Daudi keele, kagobar `Absalom weeriik tugul che po laitoryat, ak ma ng'et agot agenge eng' icheek.
Ki ng'eet anyun laitoryat kogereer ngoroikyik ak koru eng' ng'wony. Ki tononso otwogikyik tugul eng' ole mi ineendet ko kagogereer ngoroikwak.

Ki wol Jonadab weeriitap Simea, ng'eetap kametap Daudi kole, “Mat kobwaat kiptaiyandennyu kole kagebar weeriigap laitoryat tugul, amu Amnon ineegei ne kame. Amu kiga kotil niito eng' ng'atuutyetap Absalom kobooch peetuut ne kigasuup Amnon chepkamennyi Tamar.
Nooto anyun, amat konde kiptaiyandennyu laitoryat kii muguleldanyi, kobwaat kole kagobek weeriik tugul che po laitoryat. Amnon ineegei ne kame.”
Kimwei Absalom. Ak kitabendo murenet age ne kiriipsei, ak kingo keer, kogeer kobwanei piik che chaang' kobunu ooreetap tegeiyat ne ki mi let eng' ineendet.
Ki leenji `Jonadab laitoryat, “Keero, kagobwa weeriigap laitoryat, ko uu ye kamwa otwogindeng'ung' ko uu nooto.”
Kingo kagogees ng'alaalet, koit weeriigap laitoryat ak kowaakyo ak kooteeiyo. Ki ite laitoryat agine ak otwogikyik tugul eng' kateet ne oo.
Ago ki mwei Absalom kwo ole mi Talmai weeriitap Amiur laitoryatap Gesur. Ki riirchi `Daudi weeriinnyi peetuut age tugul.
Kimwei anyun Absalom kwo Gesur ak ki tebee olooto kenyiisyek somok.
Ak kimach miising' Laitoryat Daudi kwo ole mi Absalom, amu kiga konyoor kagaigaet agobo Amnon, amu kiga kome.
Ki nai Joab weeriitap Zeruiah kole tokyingei kabwaatutigap muguleldap Laitoryat Absalom.

Ara anyun ki iyookto `Joab keguur kwondo ne utaat eng' Tekoa yeityo koleenji, “Asaain ale iyaigei ogergeitu ak chiito ne riirei. Ilaach ngoroigap riirek, amat iilegei mwaita, ago ogergeitu ak kwondo ne ki koriir keny agobo chiito ne kime.
Yeityo iwe kaplaitoryat ak ing'alaalji ko uu ni.” Ki inde anyun Joab ng'aleek kutitap kwonyooto.
Ara anyun ki wo kwonyotok po Tekoa kaplaitoryat, ak ye kingo ng'alaaljin laitoryat, kobutyi ng'wony koting'e togeennyi ng'wony, kogutung'ji ak kole, “Toreto, ee laitoryat.”
Ki teebee `laitoryat ineendet koleenji, “Amin nee?” Ak ki wolji koleenji, “Aa kwony ne ki kosiirtoe manong'otyot iman. Ki kome manong'otyondennyu.
Ak ki tinyei otwogindeng'ung' weeriik aeng', ak kiboryo tuwai eng' timiin, ama piit chii ne ki ibesyo icheek ak kikwer `age age ak kobar.

Ki ng'eetyo koot komugul koborye otwogindeng'ung' ak ki le, ‘Koonu ineendet ne kobar ng'eetap kamet si kobiit kebar ineendet agobo saboondap ng'eetap kamennyi nooto kobar, si kebar agine ne kata namei tuguuk, si komis mannyu ne kong'et, ama ituukyi manong'otyondennyu kainet anan ko ne ng'etu eng' ng'wony.’ ”
Ki leenji `laitoryat kwonyooto, “Ui koong'ung', si ang'at keyaun ng'aleechooto.”
Ago ki leenji kwonyooto po Tekoa laitoryat, “Kiptaiyandennyu, ee laitoryat, ingotebena tengegi ak kotebee kootap abba, ak ingoek ne ma tinyei ng'oogisto laitoryat ak ng'echerennyi ne po laitornatet.”
Kowol laitoryat kole, “Chii age tugul ne mwaun ng'olyoo imutwaa, si mata kotwain kogeny.”

Yeityo komwa kwonyooto kole, “Asoomin ale ingobwaat `laitoryat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindeng'ung', si mata kobaris ne yaaktoi korotiik, si ma par weeriinnyu.” Ak ki le laitoryat, “Ko uu ye sabei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, koma ibutyin ng'wony agot sumeiyot agenge ne po weeriing'ung'.”
Kole anyun kwonyooto, “Asoomin ale chamji cheptong'ung' ne otwogindet komwachi ng'olyoot kiptaiyandennyu laitoryat.” Ak ki le, “Mwa.”

Ki le kwonyooto, “Kilya si ibwaat kiit ne uu no agobo piigap Kamuktaindet? Amu ngo mwa laitoryat ng'olyoot ne uu ni, ko kaigei chii ne tinyei ng'oogisto, amu ma imut laitoryat konyo kaa nenyi ne ki kioon.
Amu nyoljinech kebegu ne matiny ak ki uu peek che kagitumji ng'wony, che ma kimuuchi keram kogeny. Ama istoi `Kamuktaindet saboondo, ago chobei ooreet si mata koigei ne ki kioon ne ki king'eeto.

Nooto anyun kaanyo amwachi ng'olyoondoni kiptaiyandennyu laitoryat, amu ki imua piik. Ki ale anee otwogindeng'ung' ne chepto, ‘Ang'alaaljini laitoryat, abeere imuuchi laitoryat koyachi otwogindennyi soomennyi.’
Amu kasei laitoryat ak kosarwo anee otwogindennyi eng' eutap chiito ne machei kobara ak weeriinnyu koistoenech poroteetap Kamuktaindet.

Amwa anyun anee otwogindeng'ung' ale, ‘Asoomin ale, ingomyeeit ng'olyootap kiptaiyandennyu laitoryat. Iguitos kiptaiyandennyu laitoryat kiit ne myee ak ne ya ko uu malaikaiyatap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ak ingotep Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindeng'ung' kobooten.’ ”
Ki wolji anyun laitoryat kwonyooto koleenji, “Asoomin ale, ameung'ena kiy age tugul ne ateebenen.” Ak ki wol kwonyooto kole, “Ingong'alaal kiptaiyandennyu laitoryat nguno.”

Koteebee laitoryat koleenji, “Tos omi ak Joab eng' ng'aleechu tugul?” Kowol kwonyooto kole, “Ko uu ye sabei saboondang'ung', kiptaiyandennyu laitoryat, ma mi chii ne imuuchi komasta kwo eutap tai anan kwo murot kaataam eng' kiy age tugul ne kagomwa kiptaiyandennyu laitoryat. Amu kong'ata otwogindeng'ung' Joab, ak komwaiwo anee otwogindeng'ung' ng'aleechuuto tugul.
Ki yai otwogindeng'ung' Joab kiito, si kobiit kewal kiit ne uu ng'olyoondoniito. Tinyei kiptaiyandennyu utaatyet ne uu utaatyetap malaikaiyatap Kamuktaindet, konai tuguuk tugul che mi ng'wony.”
Ki leenji anyun `laitoryat Joab, “Keer anyuno, ayae kioto. Ui anyun, imutu nerananooto Absalom.”

Ki ibutyi ng'wony Joab, kong'uruuk ak koberuur laitoryat. Ki le Joab, “Kagonai otwogindeng'ung' rani kole kaanyooru myeeindo eng' taing'ung', kiptaiyandennyu, ee laitoryat, amu kagoyachi laitoryat otwogindennyi soomennyi.”
Ki ng'eet anyun Joab kwo Gesur, kwo komut Absalom konyo Jerusalem.
Ago ki le laitoryat, “Amat konyo kogeero togoch, ago ingowo koonnyi.” Kwo anyun Absalom koonnyi, ama keer laitoryat togoch.
Ki ma komi eng' Israel tugul chiito ne ki kilasu eng' korooronindo ko uu Absalom. Ki ma kotinyei perutyet kong'etee keldebesyet agoi metinnyi parak.

Kingo nem metinnyi, amu ki inemu suumeekyik eng' kagesunetap kenyiit age tugul, amu kinyigiisen eng' ineendet, ko ki ngebiman suumeekyik ko ki egu keruutik pogol aeng' ak kiy, eng' ratilitap laitoryat.
Ki kisikyi Absalom weeriik somok ak chepto agenge, ne ki kiguure kainennyi Tamar, ak ki chepto ne karaaran kot.
Ki tebee Absalom kenyiisyek aeng' Jerusalem koma keerei laitoryat togoch.
Ki iyookto anyun Absalom keguur Joab, si kobiit koyookto kwo kaplaitoryat, ago ma cham konyo ole mi ineendet. Ki iyookto kogeny ne po aeng', ago ma cham konyo.
Ki leenji anyun Absalom otwogikyik, “Ogeero, neegitee mbareetap Joab mbareennyu, ak tinyei baale eng' mbaranooto. Oba obeel.” Ak ki peel otwogigap Absalom mbaranooto.
Kong'eet anyun `Joab ak konyo ole mi Absalom eng' koonnyi, ak koteebe ineendet koleenji, “Amu nee si kobeel otwogiguk mbareennyu?”

Ak ki wolji `Absalom Joab koleenji, “Koaguurin ale, nyoo yu si kobiit ayookten iwe kaplaitoryat, ileenji, Amu nee si anyo eng' Gesur? Kita myee atebee olooto agoi. Chamwo anyun nguno ageer togeetap laitoryat. Nguno anyun, ngot atinye tengekto, kobara.”
Ki nyo anyun `Joab kaplaitoryat ak komwachi; ak kingo kageguur Absalom, konyo anyun kaplaitoryat ak kong'uruuk kot kotiiny togeennyi ng'wony eng' taitap laitoryat. Ki ng'utut `Laitoryat Absalom.
Kingo pata ni, kochopchigei Absalom chepkichutit kobooto paraisisyek, ak murenik konom che rwae kondoe ineendet.

Ki ng'eetei Absalom karon miising' ak kotonon eng' ye neegitee ormariichet. Ak kingo tinyei chii age tugul ng'olyoo ne ibei kwo kaplaitoryat kirwookyinechi, koguurei Absalom konyo ye mi ineendet ak koleenji, “Ii po nganaseet ingiro?” Ak kole, “Po otwogindeng'ung' age eng' pororyosyegap Israel.”
Yeityo koleenji Absalom ineendet, “Keero, myach ng'aleeguk ak ko lititen, ago ma mi chii ne ki inde laitoryat kogasun.”
Ki le kogeny Absalom, “Oiye, nda kiga kiyaa aek kirwoogindet eng' emet, ko ngo nyo ole ami chii age tugul ne tinyei ng'olyoo anan kirwooget, ayachini imanda!”
Kingo riikyi chii age tugul kwo kong'uruuk eng' tainnyi, koyogooito eunnyi, konam ineendet ak kotorooch.
Ki yachi Absalom ko uu nooto Israel tugul che ki pendi kaplaitoryat agobo kirwooget, ak ki chamak ko uu nooto anyun Absalom mugulelwegap piigap Israel.
Kingo keskei kenyiisyek ang'wanu, koleenji `Absalom laitoryat, “Kaigai ichamwo awo agoito kaarortaennyu, ne ki aaroorchi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' Hebron.
Amu ki aaroorte anee otwogindeng'ung' ye kita ami Gesur eng' Syria ale, ‘Ngot koweektaa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kogeny iman awo Jerusalem, aboisyechini anyun Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.’ ”
Kingo leenji laitoryat ineendet, “Ui eng' kaalyeet,” kong'eet anyun ak kwo Hebron.
Ago ki iyookto Absalom segeik koba pororyosyek tugul che po Israel, koleenji, “Eng' sait ne kogas iryageet, omwa ole, Laitorani Absalom eng' Hebron.”
Ki pa piik pogolwogik aeng'u eng' Jerusalem kobooto Absalom che kiga kiguur ak ki pa eng' perberindanywa komengen kiy.
Ki iyookto Absalom keguur Ahitopel Gilonindet, toretindetap Daudi eng' nganasennyi, Gilo, ye ki igoitoi tiseiywot. Kitesak chaamset, amu kitesaksei piik che namegei ak Absalom.
Ki nyo chiito kap Daudi ne ki ibu ng'aleek, ak koleenji, “Mi mugulelwegap piigap Israel ak Absalom.”

Ak ki leenji `Daudi otwogikyik tugul che ki mi ak ineendet eng' Jerusalem, “Ong'eetyee, kanyool kemwei, amu ngo ma uu nooto, koma mi chii ne chilili eng' Absalom. Ongechaakte, si ma nyoorwech nguno ak koibwech yaityet ak kobar nganaseet eng' rotwetap chok.”
Kowolji `otwogik laitoryat koleenji, “Ki chobootiin acheek otwogiguk keyai kiit age tugul ne kalewen kiptaiyandennyo laitoryat.”
Ki manda laitoryat ak ki isup ineendet `piik tugul che po koonnyi. Ago ki pagaakta laitoryat chebaigeinik taman koriip kootap laitornatet.
Ki manda laitoryat anyun ak ki isup ineendet `piik tugul, ago ki tebi kitigin eng' koot ne mi tabanuutap nganaseet.
Ki pa otwogikyik tugul kobun ye neegitee ineendet. Ki indoe ineendet Keretik, Peletik tugul ak Gitik che ki murenik pogol lo che ki isubu ineendet kobunu Gath.
Yeityo koleenji laitoryat Itai Gitindet, “Amu nee si inyoo keebe tugul aginye? Weektegei, ui otebi ak Laitoryat Absalom. Ii punootyo inyee ne ki kionun eng' oldang'ung', ara weektegei ui oldang'ung'.
Amu koiitu amut, tos myee amutatin ketogostoi ak kerektoi? Amu awendi ole kamach. Weege anyun ak iweech tupchosyeguk, ak ingotep kobooten rireenet ak imanit.”

Ago ki wolji `Itai laitoryat koleenji, “Ko uu ye sabei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ak ko uu ye sabei kiptaiyandennyu laitoryat, ko oldo tugul ole mi kiptaiyandennyu laitoryat, ami olooto agane iman, anee otwogindeng'ung' ngo eng' meet anan eng' sabeet.”
Koleenji `Daudi Itai, “Ui lande.” Ki landa anyun Itai Gitindet ak piikyik tugul kobooto lagok tugul che ki mi ak ineendet.
Ki waach emet komugul eng' kutit ne oo yooto ki pendi kolondoi, ak ki landae laitoryat kererutap Kidron ak piik tugul kotokyingei surkwen.

Ki mi Zadok agine kobooto Lawiik tugul che ki mi ak ineendet koibei moingetap arorutyetap Kamuktaindet. Ki itu, konde ng'wony moingetap Kamuktaindet, yeityo kogoito Abiathar kagoochinoik agoi komanda piik tugul eng' nganaseet.

Yeityo koleenji `laitoryat Zadok, “Oweekte moingetap Kamuktaindet koweek kwo nganaseet. Ngot anyooru chameet eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ko tuun komutwaa kogeny ineendet ak koboorwo moingonooto ak ole tebee.
Ago ngot komwa kole, Ma abaibai eng' inyee, ami yu, ingoyaiywo ko uu ye keerei kole myee.”
Ki mwachi anyun laitoryat kogeny Zadok tisiindet koleenji, “Tos ma ii keerindet? Weektegei nganaseet eng' kaalyeet ak weeriiguk tuwai; Ahimaaz weeriing'ung', ak Jonathan weeriitap Abiathar.
Atebee ole kilandoe kebendi surkwen, agoi agas ng'olyoo eng' inyee ne imwaiwo.”
Ki ip anyun Zadok ak Abiathar moingetap Kamuktaindet kogeny kwo Jerusalem, ak ki pa kotebee olooto.

Ki togosta Daudi kobun ooreet ne kitogostoe kebendi tulweetap mseituni koriiroti. Kiga tuchkei met ago ma tinyei kweonik. Kituchkei met chii age tugul eng' piik tugul che ki mi kobooto ineendet ak kotogostoi, koriiryoti.
Ak ki kimwachi Daudi keleenji, “Mi Ahitopel kobooto njaamigap Absalom.” Ak ki sa Daudi kole, “Ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, asoomin ale, wal kirwoogetap Ahitopel koek perberyo.”
Kingo it `Daudi tulweet parak ole ki cham kilasune Kamuktaindet, ko ki nyo Hushai Arkindet kotorook ineendet, ko kagogereer ngoryennyi ak komi ng'ung'unyek metinnyi.
Ki leenji `Daudi ineendet, “Ngot inyone keebe tuwai iegu mileet eng' anee.

Ago ngot iweege iwe nganaseet ak ileenji Absalom, ‘Aegu otwogindeng'ung', ee laitoryat ko uu ye ki aa otwogindetap kwandang'ung' eng' peetuusyek che ki kosiirto, aegu anyun nguno otwogindeng'ung'.’ Eng' yooto anyun, iterteerwa kirwoogetap Ahitopel.
Tos ma mi kobooten tisiik, Zadok ak Abiathar? Ko ye igase ng'olyoo age tugul ne punu kootap laitoryat, imwachi Zadok ak Abiathar, tisiik.
Tinyei icheek eng' yooto weeriikwak aeng', Ahimaaz weeriitap Zadok ak Jonathan weeriitap Abiathar. Ara oyogune icheek kiy age tugul ne ogase.”
Ki it anyun nganaseet Hushai chorweetap Daudi ye kingo itei Absalom Jerusalem.

Kingo kagosiir `Daudi tulweet parak kitigin, ko ki tuiyo ak ineendet Siba otwogindetap Mephibosheth, kogetu sigiroik aeng' che kiga kiito koibei magatiinik pogol aeng', mooriik pogol agenge che po sabibuk che yamyotiin, logoek pogol agenge che po kemei ak soteetap divaik.

Ki teebee `laitoryat Siba koleenji, “Po nee tuguuchu?” Kowol Siba kole, “Sigiroik ko chelaanyei piigap kootap laitoryat, ko po murenik magatiinik, logoechu po kemei, ko che amei ak divaik ko si koe piik che katanuiso eng' surkwen.”
Koteebee `laitoryat Siba koleenji, “Mi ano weeriitap kiptaiyandeng'ung'?” Koleenji `Siba laitoryat, “Kotebi eng' Jerusalem, amu ki le, ‘Kono rani kootap Israel laitornatetap abba.’ ”
Yeityo koleenji `laitoryat Siba, “Cheguuk tuguuk tugul che po Mephibosheth.” Yeityo kole `Siba, “Agutunyi, inganyoor chameet eng' taing'ung', kiptaiyandennyu, ee laitoryat.”
Kingo it `laitoryat Daudi Baurim, komong' eng' olooto chiito ne po ooreetap kap Saulo ne ki kiguure kainennyi Shimei, weeriitap Gera. Ki mong' ineendet kochubisyonu.
Kilach `ineendet Daudi ak otwogikyik eng' koik nga kimi piik tugul che nyigoonen eunnyi ne po tai ak eunnyi ne po kaataam.
Ki mwa Shimei ye kichubisyei kole, “Ui, ui inyee tartaindonep koroti, kiptengekyondoni ya.

Kagoweekyin `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor korotiik tugul che po kootap Saulo, ne ki ilaitoran igeer ineendet, ak kagonde Kamuktaindet ne Toroor laitornatetap eutap weeriing'ung' Absalom. Keero, kaginamin eng' yaityeng'ung', amu ii tartain ne po koroti.”
Ki teebee anyun `Abisai weeriitap Zeruiah laitoryat koleenji, “Amu nee si kochup kiptaiyandennyu laitoryat sesoni ki kome? Asoomin ale ichamwo alanda awo atil metinnyi.”

Koleenji `laitoryat, “Kiting'egei nee ak okweek, weeriigap Zeruiah? Amu chubisyei, Ngot ko amu kamwachi `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ineendet koleenji, ‘Chup Daudi,’ ko ng'oo anyun ne mwaei kole, ‘Amu nee si iyai ko uu no?’ ”

Yeityo koleenji `Daudi Abisai, kobooto otwogikyik tugul, “Ngot ko cheeng'ei saboondanyu weeriinnyu ne ki punu poortanyu, ko tam nee anyun Benjaminindoni. Omete ineegei, ak ongochubis, ngot ko kagong'at `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ineendet koyai ko uu nooto.
Abeere keerei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor yaityet ne kagiyaiywo, ak igeerwo Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne myee agobo chubisyoni kagichubo rani.”
Ki pa anyun Daudi ak piikyik pandanywa: ki wo Shimei korob tulweet kotoorchigei ineendet, kochubisyoti, kolachei ineendet eng' koik ak koseerchin temburyek.
Ki it laitoryat ak piik tugul che ki mi kobooto ineendet ko kang'etyo kot, ak ki imuuny eng' yooto.
Eng' kasarata ko ki it Jerusalem `Absalom ak piik tugul, murenigap Israel ak kimi Ahitopel ak ineendet.
Kingo it Hushai Arkindet, chorweetap Daudi, ole mi Absalom koleenji `Hushai Absalom, “Ingosap laitoryat, ingosap laitoryat.”
Ago kiteebe `Absalom Hushai koleenji, “Tos myeeindong'ung' niito ne iyachini chorweng'ung'? Amu nee si mobe ak chorweng'ung'?”
Kowolji `Hushai Absalom koleenji, “Achicha, abunjini ineendet ne kolewen Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, pichu ak murenik tugul che po Israel, ak kitebyei ak ineendet.
Kogeny, aboisyechini ng'oo? Ne ma eng' taitap weeriinnyi? Ko uu ye ki aboisye eng' taitap kwandang'ung', aboisyei ko uu nooto eng' taing'ung'.”
Koleenji anyun `Absalom Ahitopel, “Mwaa kiit ne kiyae.”
Koleenji `Ahitopel Absalom, “Obaigei ak chebaigeinigap kwandang'ung' che ki pagaakta koriip kootap laitornatet. Ye kas Israel tugul kole ii puunyootap kwandang'ung', kogimegitu che omi tugul.”
Ara ki teekyi anyun `icheek Absalom emait eng' paragutap koot, ak ki ipkei Absalom ak chebaigeinigap kwandanyi kogeerei Israel tugul.

Eng' peetuusyechooto anyun, ko ki uu kirwoogetap Ahitopel ne ki irwoochi, kirwoogetap chii ne teebei eng' ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet. Ki uu nooto anyun kirwoogutik tugul che po Ahitopel eng' Daudi ak eng' Absalom.
Ki leenji `Ahitopel Absalom kogeny, “Chamwo alewen murenik eliphuusyek taman ak aeng', ak ang'eet asup Daudi kemouni.
Si ache kota ko ng'etat koma imuuchi koyai kiy, ak amuu, ak komwei piik tugul che mi kobooto ineendet. Si abar laitoryat ineegei,
ak amutun piik tugul. Uu meetap chiichooto icheeng'e, ye keeweech piik tugul, ak kotebi piik tugul eng' kaalyeet.”
Ki ibaibai Absalom ng'olyoondonooto, kobooto poisyek tugul che po Israel.
Yeityo komwa `Absalom kole, “Oguur Hushai Arkindet agine konyo si kegas kiit ne mwaei agine.”
Kingo it Hushai ole mi Absalom, komwachi Absalom ineendet koleenji, “Kamwa ko uu ni Ahitopel. Ara ki yai ko uu ye kamwa? Ngo ma uu nooto, imwa inyee ng'olyoong'ung'.”
Ki leenji `Hushai Absalom, “Ma myee ng'olyoot ne kamwa Ahitopel ra.”

Ki le kogeny Hushai, “Ingen kwandang'ung' ak piikyik ile piik che nyigoonen ak tinyei ng'wanindo eng' kabwaatutikwak ko uu magalaluut ne kagirebe aarekyik eng' timiin. Ne siirei ko kwandang'ung' ko chiitap lugeet; ma koi ruiyo ak piik.
Agot nguno ko kogiuny eng' keriinget, anan ko eng' komosta age. Si ye kagobek alak eng' icheek korook, ko age tugul ne kagas komwa kole, ‘Mi parisyet eng' kwenutap piik che isubi Absalom.’
Agot ineendet ne nyigan, ne uu muguleldanyi muguleldap ng'etundo, kochootei kogesugei, amu ingen Israel tugul kole chiito ne nyigan kwandang'ung' ak icheek che mi ak ineendet ko piik che nyigoonen.
Ago arwoochi aleen, ingoyumjingei Israel tugul, kobooch Dan agoi Beer-sheba, kotenit ng'aniek che miitei ngeguutap araraita eng' chaang'indo, si iwe lugeet inyeendet.
Si keche ineendet eng' komosta ne kaginyoorchi ak kibutyi ineendet ko uu ye ibutyin rewoot ng'wony. Ma kituuchi agot agenge eng' ineendet ak piik tugul che mi kobooto ineendet.
Ak kogeny, ngwo nganaseet, koibu Israel anyun rogoosyek kobwa nganasanooto, yeityo kong'us kwo aineet kot koma ng'et koita agenge ne ming'in eng' olooto.”

Kole anyun Absalom ak piik tugul che po Israel, Karaaran kirwoogetap Hushai Arkindet kosiir kirwoogetap Ahitopel. Amu kiga til Kamuktaindet ne Toroor koterteer kirwooget ne myee ne po Ahitopel, si kobiit koipchi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor yaityet Absalom.
Ki leenji anyun `Hushai Zadok ak Abiathar tisiik, Kamwachi Ahitopel ko uu ni ak ko uu ni Absalom ak poisyegap Israel, ago kamwa ko uu ni ak ko uu ni.
Ara anyun oyookte ng'olyoot ochokyi ak omwachi Daudi oleenji, “Amat irue kemouni eng' ole kilandoe kebendi surkwen, ago myee olande ui tugul, si ma kigees laitoryat ak piik tugul che mi ak ineendet.”

Ki tebi Jonathan ak Ahimaaz eng' ole neegitee En-rogelo. Ki cham kowendi chepto ne otwogindet komwachin icheek ng'aleek, ak ki pendi komwachin Laitoryat Daudi, amu ki ma komachei kogeer chii icheek kobendi nganaseet.

Ago ki keer icheek ng'etet age, ak kwo komwachi Absalom. Ki pa tuwai kochaakta ak kiit kootap chiito age eng' Baurim. Ki tinyei chiichooto keriingetap peek eng' kurgennyi, ak ki pa kochoortagei keringonooto oriit.
Ki nam osotyonnyi kerwet ak kogeree kutitap keriingonooto ak komae nganuuk che kagibor paragunnyi, ak ma ki nai.

Ki pwa otwogigap Absalom ole mi kwonyooto eng' koyooto ak kingo teebee koleenji, “Mi ano Ahimaaz ak Jonathan?” Koleenji kwonyooto icheek, “Kagoba kolandae kereruut ne mi peek.” Kingo kagocheeng', amaimuuchi konyoor icheek, koweek koba Jerusalem.
Kingo kagoba icheek, komong' eng' keriingonooto po peek ak koba komwachi Laitoryat Daudi koleenji, “Ong'eetyee ak olande eng' peek, ochaakte, amu kagotil ko uu ni ak ko uu ni Ahitopel agobo okweek.”
Ki ng'eet anyun Daudi ak piik tugul che ki mi ak ineendet ak kolandae Jordan. Kingo choru asiista, ko ki ma kota komi agot agenge eng' icheek ne ki tomo kolanda eng' Jordan.

Kingo keer Ahitopel kole mata koosup chii kirwoogennyi, koiito sigiryennyi ak kong'eet kwo kaa, kot koit nganasennyi. Kirarchi keet piigap koonnyi yeityo kwo kogeetkei, ak kime. Ara ki kitupchi poortanyi kereritap kwandanyi.
Ki it `Daudi Mahanaim, ak ki landa Absalom eng' Jordan ineendet ak murenik tugul che po Israel kobooto ineendet.
Kiga kolewen `Absalom Amasa koboi lugeet kogeer Joab. Amasa ko ki weeriitap chiito ne kainennyi ko ki Itra Yahudyot, ne ki koipkei ak Abigail cheptap Nahas, chepkametap Zeruiah kametap Joab.
Ki teech Israel ak Absalom emetap Gilead.
Kingo it `Daudi Mahanaim, koip Sobi weeriitap Nahas ne po Rabbah ne po lagogap Ammon, Makir weeriitap Amiel ne po Lo-debar, Barsilai Gileadindet ne po Rogelim,
itogusyek, taabook, tereenik, nganuuk, ak baale, peek ak peek che ng'ootin, magandek, sogoryek, igobek
kobooto kumyat, mwaitap cheego ak keechiirek ak mugunigap cheego, koipchi Daudi ak piik che ki mi kobooto ineendet, koam. Amu ki le, “Amei rubeet piik, ng'etyotiin ak koamei melelda eng' surkwen.”
Ki iit `Daudi piik che ki mi ak ineendet ak konde kiptainigap eliphuusyek ak kiptainigap pogolwogik koboi icheek.

Ak kipchei Daudi lugeet kobee kweanaik somok: ki inde Joab kondochi kebeberta agenge eng' somok. Konde Abisai weeriitap Zeruiah, ng'eetap kametap Joab, kondochi kebeberta agenge eng' somok ak ki inde Itai Gitindet kondochi kebeberta agenge eng' somok. Yeityo koleenji `laitoryat piik, “Awendi agane iman kobootok.”

Ago ki le piik, “Mewendi, amu ngot kemwei, koma magenech kiy, anan ngot kobek kebeberta agenge eng' acheek, koma magenech kiy, ago oaechine ak piik eliphuusyek taman eng' acheek. Nooto anyun, myee ichoboge si itoretech eng' nganaseet.”
Koleenji `laitoryat icheek, “Kiit ne ogeere okweek ole nyolu, ayae nooto.” Ara anyun kitonone laitoryat ormariichet taban, ak kimanda piik kobee pogolwogik ak eliphuusyek.
Ki ng'at `laitoryat Joab ak Abisai ak Itai koleenji, “Oriree nerananooto Absalom agobo anee.” Ak ki kas piik tugul ye king'atei `laitoryat kiptainik tugul agobo Absalom.
Ki manda anyun piik koba kobargei ak Israel eng' keeweet, ak kimi pooryeet eng' timdap Ephraim.
Ki par otwogigap Daudi piigap Israel eng' yooto, ak ki piit parisyet ne oo eng' olooto eng' peetuunooto ne po piik eliphuusyek tiptem.
Kiyom emet tugul lugonooto, ak kibar timiin piik eng' peetuunooto che siirei che ki kibare rotwetap chok.

Ki chunji `Absalom otwogigap Daudi. Kibunei Absalom nyumbunnyi, ak kingo chut nyumbut mooriik che kichang'a che po keetitap alayet ne oo, konam metitap Absalom keetoto ak kisonginin. Ki wo anyun nyumbut ne ki punoti kosiirto.
Kingo keer chiito age, komwachi Joab koleenji, “Kageer Absalom kosonginini eng' keetitap alayet.”
Koleenji `Joab chiichooto kimwachin ineendet, “Nee ni, Keroo ineendet? Kalya si metoor ineendet eng' yooto kosore kokwer ng'wonyut? Ak ta kaagoonin fedhaisyek taman ak pireneet.”

Ago ki leenji `chiichooto Joab, “Agot ndaname fedhaisyek eliphuut eng' eunnyu, ko matwae kora weeriitap laitoryat eng' eunnyu. Amu king'atin laitoryat ak Abisai ak Itai kegase kole, ‘Oriipkei, si ma twa chii nerananooto Absalom.’
Nda kagaayachi saboondanyi ko uu nooto, ang'aalse (ama mi ng'olyoo ne ung'aksei eng' laitoryat), ko kata iistoenage inyee.”
Kole anyun Joab, “Ma myee kigagei ne tee ni ak inyee.” Ki nam ng'otwek somok ak kotoor muguleldap Absalom, ye kita kosabei eng' keetoto.
Ak kiyiem ineendet murenik tamanu, che ki ipchin `Joab kariikyik ak kotoor Absalom, kobar.
Yeityo koguut `Joab iryageet ak ki week piik kobagaakta ooreet ne ki oone Israel, amu ki eetee Joab piik.
Kisut Absalom ak kowiirchi keriinget ne oo eng' timiin ak korurukyi ineendet karurugutyet ne oo ne po koik. Kimwei Israel tugul, kwo age tugul emainnyi.

Ye kita kosabei Absalom, ko kiga koteekyigei kiit ne uu toloita eng' atebweetap laitorya. Amu ki le, “Ma tinyei weeriit ne kibwaatee kainennyu.” Kimwaitae kioto kainennyi, ak ki kiguure toloitap Absalom agoi ra.
Ki le anyun Ahimaaz weeriitap Zadok, “Ingalabat, aipchi laitoryat ng'aleek, aleenji kagoyaaktochigei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor mugetuut eng' puunikyik.”
Ago ki leenji `Joab ineendet, “Meibe ng'aleek ra, ago iibe ng'aleek peetuut age. Meibe ng'olyoo age tugul peetuuni, amu kagome weeriitap laitoryat.”
Yeityo koleenji `Joab Kusindet, “Ui mwachi laitoryat tuguuk che kaigeer.” Ki ing'uruuk Kusindet eng' taitap Joab, ak kolabat.

Koleenji anyun Ahimaaz, weeriitap Zadok Joab kogeny, “Agot nda piitu kiy age tugul, asoomin ale, chamwo agane alabat asup Kusindet.” Ago kiteebe Joab koleenji, “Amu nee si imache ilabat o, weeriinnyu, ago mesiche melek agobo ng'aleechooto?”
Ago ki le, “Agot nda piitu kiy age tugul, alabati.” Ak ki leenji ineendet, “Labat.” Ki labat anyun Ahimaaz kobun ooreetap Warenget ak ki wo kondoe Kusindet.
Ki tebee Daudi kwenutap ormariichok aeng', ak kitogosta riibindet kwo ormariichet parak kot koit irimeet. Kingo tabendoi kogeer, chiito ne labatu ineegei.
Ki kuurso riibindet ak komwachi laitoryat. Kole laitoryat, “Ngot ko ineegei, kotinyei ng'aleek che miyach.” Kingo teseitai kolabot koriik,
kogeer riibindet chiito age kolabotu, ak kiguur riibindet, riibindetap ormariichet ak koleenji, “Labotu chiito age ineegei.” Kole laitoryat, “Agot agine koibu ng'aleek che myach.”
Ki le riibindet, “Ageere ko kergei labatetap ne indou ak labatetap Ahimaaz weeriitap Zadok.” Ak ki le laitoryat, “Ineendet ko chii ne myee, ak ibu ng'aleek che myach.”

Ki kuurso Ahimaaz ak koleenji laitoryat, “Chamegei kiy tugul.” Ki ing'uruuk eng' taitap laitoryat kot kotiiny togeennyi ng'wony ak kole, “Iberuurot Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindeng'ung' ne kaigoito piik che koleen kobargei ak kiptaiyandennyu laitoryat.”
Ki teebee laitoryat kole, “Chamegei nerananooto Absalom?” Ak ki wol Ahimaaz kole, “Kangoyogu Joab otwogindetap laitoryat, anee otwogindeng'ung', ageer wasetapkei ne oo, ago manai kiit ne kabo.”
Ki leenji laitoryat, “Ui taban ak itonon eng' yu.” Ak ki wo taban ak kotonon.
Ki it Kusindet ak kole, “Kas ng'aleek che po kiptaiyandennyu laitoryat, amu kayooktoun Kamuktaindet ne Toroor rani mugetuut eng' tugul che koga ng'eetyo kole obargei.”

Ki teebe `laitoryat Kusindet koleenji, “Chamegei nerananooto Absalom?” Ak ki wolji Kusindet kole, “Ingoigei puunigap kiptaiyandennyu laitoryat, ak piik tugul che ng'eetyinin kole kobarin, kiit ne kaigei nerananooto.”

Ki aragen miising' laitoryat ak kitogosta kwo koot oriit ne mi ormariichet parak ak koriir. Kingo wendi koleenoti, “Ooi weeriinnyu Absalom, weeriinnyu, weeriinnyu Absalom! Kata kaigai ame ne kata inyee, Ooi Absalom, weeriinnyu, weeriinnyu!”
Ki kimwachi Joab keleenji, “Riirei laitoryat ak kotei agobo Absalom.”
Kiwalak katerteerisyet eng' peetuunooto koek kateiyet eng' piik tugul, amu ki kas piik kemwaei peetuunooto keele, Arageni laitoryat agobo weeriinnyi.
Ki pa piik nganaseet peetuunooto koung'ategei, ko uu ye ung'ootegei piik che ililandos, ye mweitos eng' lugeet.
Ki tuch `laitoryat togeennyi, ak ki ite laitoryat eng' kutit ne oo kole, “Ooi weeriinnyu Absalom, ooi Absalom, weeriinnyu, weeriinnyu!”

Ki nyo Joab kochut ko ole kimi laitoryat ak koleenji, “Kegoochi togoochigap otwogiguk tugul eng' peetuuni kolilaanso, che kasar saboondang'ung' rani ak saboonwegap weeriiguk, tiibiiguk, saboonwegap osotiguk ak saboonwegap chebaigeiniguk,

amu ichame icheek che wechin ak iweche icheek che chamin. Kebaarte rani ile ma kiy eng' inyee pounik ak otwogik, amu kaageer rani ale nda ko kasap Absalom ak kebegu acheek tugul rani, ko kata iboiboin miising'.

Ng'eet anyun, mande ak ing'alaalji otwogiguk, igaigai. Amu ayostosi eng' Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ale, ngot ko memande ko mang'etun chii kemouni. Yaitu nooto eng' inyee kosiir yaityet tugul ne kigonyonjin kobooch ming'inateng'ung' agoi nguno.”

Ara king'eet anyun laitoryat ak kotebee ormariichet. Ki kimwachi piik tugul keleenji, “Ogeero, tebyei ng'wony laitoryat eng' ormariich”; ak ki pwa tugul taitap laitoryat. Kiga komwei Israel, kwo chii tugul emainnyi.

Ki piit suryet eng' piik tugul eng' pororyosyek tugul che po Israel kole, “Kisarwech laitoryat eng' puunikyok, ak kisarwech eng' eunegap Philistiik. Ago nguno ko ki komwei ineendet eng' emet komwee Absalom.
Ak kogome eng' lugeet Absalom ne kiga kiiil koboiywech. Ara anyun amu nee si momwa kiy agobo kimut laitoryat koweek?”

Ki iyookto anyun `laitoryat Daudi ng'aleek koba kap Sadok ak Abiathar che ki tisiik keleenji, “Omwachi poisyegap Judah oleenji, ‘Amu nee si oegu che po let eng' kamutunetap laitoryat koweek konyo koonnyi? Kogobwonji laitoryat ng'aleegap Israel tugul keele, kimut ineendet konyo koonnyi.
Oo tupchosyekyuk, oo kawekyuk ak panyeekyuk, amu nee anyun si oegu che po let eng' kamutunetap laitoryat koweek?’
Oleenji Amasa, ‘Tos ma ii kowekyuk ak panyeekyuk? Ingoyaiywo Kamuktaindet ko uu nooto ak kotes kosiir, ngot ko meegu kiptaiyatap lugeet eng' tainnyu kotugul igeer Joab.’ ”
Kiwelel mugulelwegap piik tugul che po Judah, ko uu ne po chiito agenge, ak ki iyookto kemwachi laitoryat keleenji, “Myee iweigei kobooto otwogiguk tugul.”
Ki week anyun laitoryat, konyo Jordan. Ki nyo `Judah Gilgal, kotorook laitoryat, komut kolong'une Jordan.
Kichook Shimei weeriitap Gera, Benjaminindet, ne ki po Baurim kochoorgei kobooto piigap Judah kotorook Laitoryat Daudi.
Ki mi kobooto ineendet piik eliphuut agenge che po Benjamin ak Siba otwogindetap kootap Saulo, weeriikyik taman ak muut ak otwogikyik tiptem ak kolandae Jordan eng' taitap laitoryat.
Ki landa kolandae ole kilondoe si komut piigap kootap laitoryat kolong', ak koyai kiit ne kigeerei kole myee. Ki ibutyi ng'wony Shimei weeriitap Gera eng' taitap laitoryat ko kagolong' eng' Jordan,

ak koleenji laitoryat, “Amat koiitya tengekto kiptaiyandennyu anan ibwaat kii kiga yai otwogindeng'ung' komaasak eng' peetuuni kimandoi kiptaiyandennyu laitoryat eng' Jerusalem. Myee ma nam laitoryat kioto eng' muguleldanyi.
Amu ingen otwogindeng'ung' kole ki koyai tengekto. Nooto anyun, kanyo rani andou eng' piik tugul che po kootap Joseph achooruge atorogu kiptaiyandennyu laitoryat.”
Ago ki wol Abisai weeriitap Zeruiah, kole, “Tos manyalu kebar Shimei agobo kiito, amu ki chup ne iilaat ne po Kamuktaindet ne Toroor?”
Ago ki wol `Daudi kole, “Kiting'egei nee ak okweek weeriigap Zeruiah kot oegu puunik eng' anee rani? Tos kibarei chii rani eng' Israel? Tos mangen ale, aa laitoryat rani ne pou Israel?”
Ara ki leenji `laitoryat Shimei, “Memee.” Ak ki iyasyechi laitoryat ineendet.

Ki choorgei Mephibosheth weeriitap Saulo agine kotorook laitoryat. Ki mata kotil siyoogap keelyekyik anan kocher tamnennyi, anan komwet ngoroikyik kobooch peetuut ne kigawo laitoryat agoi peetuut ne ki weeksei kaa eng' kaalyeet.
Kingo nyo Jerusalem kogat laitoryat, koleenji `laitoryat ineendet, “Amu nee o, Mephibosheth si mecham keebe tuwai?”
Ak ki wol kole, “Kiptaiyandennyu, ee laitoryat, amu ang'wali anee otwogindeng'ung', ko ki aleenji otwogindennyu Siba, ‘Iitoiwo sigiryet si kobiit alaany keebe ak laitoryat,’ ago ki iberbera ineendet.
Ki komwaitaena lembech anee otwogindeng'ung' eng' kiptaiyandennyu laitoryat. Ago uu `kiptaiyandennyu laitoryat malaikaiyatap Kamuktaindet, yai anyun kiit ne igeere ile myee.

Amu ki uu koot tugul ne po kwandanyu piik che ki kobek eng' taitap kiptaiyandennyu laitoryat, ago ki inde otwogindeng'ung' kwenutap icheeget che amisye meseng'ung'. Ara anyun tos atinye imanda nee anyun kot kota ariirchi laitoryat?”
Koleenji `laitoryat ineendet, “Amu nee si kota ing'alaale tuguuguk? Kang'at ale, opchei kooret ak Siba.”
Ak ki leenji Mephibosheth laitoryat, “Ingoip ineendet tugul amu ki koweek kiptaiyandennyu laitoryat eng' kaalyeet konyo koonnyi.”
Ki choortagei `Barsilai Gileadindet eng' Rogelim; kwo Jordan kobooto laitoryat, si komut ineendet kolandae Jordan.
Kiga koosit miising' Barsilai, ki po kenyiisyek tamanwogik sisiit. Kichopchin laitoryat amitwogik ye kimi Mahanaim, amu ki chiito ne tagunoot.
Ki leenji `laitoryat Barsilai, “Ngelande keebe keamisye tuwai eng' Jerusalem.”
Ago ki wolji `Barsilai laitoryat koleenji, “Ata peetuusyek che po kenyiisyegap saboondanyu kot ketogoste ak laitoryat keebe Jerusalem?

Aa po rani kenyiisyek tamanwogik sisiit. Tos ta amuuchi abesyo ne myee ak ne ya? Ta komuuchi otwogindeng'ung' kogas kiit ne chamu tuguuk che aame anan ko che aee? Ta amuuchi agas cheetap murenik che tyendos ak kwonyiik che tyendos? Amu nee anyun si kota koek mileet otwogindeng'ung' kogeny, eng' kiptaiyandennyu laitoryat?
Landoi otwogindeng'ung' eng' Jordan kityo, kobooto laitoryat, ago amu nee si koyookwo laitoryat melekto ne uu nooto?”

Asoomin ale, ngaweek anee otwogindeng'ung' kogeny awo amechi nganasennyu, ye neegitee kereritap kwandanyu ak kamennyu. Ago oroni otwogindeng'ung' Kimham, ingolanda kobooto kiptaiyandennyu laitoryat ak iyachi ineendet kiit ne igeere ile myee eng' inyee.
Ki wol `laitoryat kole, “Kilandoi ak Kimham ak ayachi ineendet kiit ne ageere ale myee eng' inyee, ak kiit age tugul ne imageno, ayaun kioto.”
Kilandae piik tugul Jordan, ak ki landa laitoryat. Ki ng'utut Laitoryat Barsilai ak koberuur, ak kiweektagei kwo oldanyi.
Kingo landa anyun laitoryat kwo Gilgal, kolanda Kimham agine ak ineendet. Ki imut `piik tugul che po Judah laitoryat kolong' ak kebebertap piigap Israel.

Yeityo kobwonji laitoryat `piik tugul che po Israel, ak koleenji ineendet, “Amu nee si kochoorin tupchosyekyok piigap Judah ak komutin kobooto koong'ung' ilong'une Jordan kobooto piik tugul che po Daudi?”

Yeityo kowolji piik tugul che po Judah piigap Israel koleenji, “Ki kiyai niito amu chiitap ooreet ne neegit laitoryat eng' acheek. Amu nee anyun si onereech agobo ng'olyoondonooto? Tos ki kiam tuguugap laitoryat? Anan ki koonech konunet age tugul?”

Kowolji `piigap Israel piigap Judah koleenji, “Ki tinyei kebeberwek taman eng' laitoryat, ne siirei ketinye kebeberta ne oo eng' Daudi kosiirok. Ara anyun amu nee anyun si osasech, si moteebenech kotom omutu laitoryandennyo?” Ago ki koromitu waluunetap piigap Judah kosiir ng'aleegap piigap Israel.

Ki piit eng' yooto chii ne ya ne kainennyi ko ki Sheba weeriitap Bikri, Benjaminindet. Ki kuut iryageet ak kole, “Ma ki tinyei kebeberta eng' Daudi, ama ki tinyei poroteet eng' weeriitap Jesse. Ingwo chii tugul emaisyekyik, ee Israel.”
Kotogosta anyun piik tugul che po Israel, mata koosup Daudi, ki isup Sheba weeriitap Bikri. Ago ki namgei piigap Judah ak laitoryannywa kobooch Jordan agoi Jerusalem.

Ye kingo nyo `Daudi koonnyi eng' Jerusalem, konam kwonyichugiche taman, chebaigeinikyik chu kiga pagaakta koriip koot, ak konde riibiik koriip icheek kotebee koot oriit. Kibai, ago mata kwo ole mi icheek koipkei ak icheek. Ki kirat anyun agoi peetuutap meennywa, kotep koek mosoogik.
Ki leenji anyun laitoryat Amasa, “Kuurwa murenigap Judah koyumgei eng' peetuusyek somok ak inyoo aginye.”
Kingwo Amasa koguur piigap Judah kotuiyo kogagei kosiir ye kiga ng'at laitoryat ineendet.

Koleenji `Daudi Abisai, “Yaiywech yaityet Sheba weeriitap Bikri nguno kosiir ne ki yai Absalom. Imut anyun otwogigap kiptaiyandeng'ung' ak isup ineendet, si ma namjigei nganasook che ng'ootaatiin ak kochilil si mata kegeer.”
Ara anyun ki isup ineendet piigap Joab ak Keretik ak Peletik ak piik tugul che nyigoonen. Ki pa eng' Jerusalem koosup Sheba weeriitap Bikri.

Kingo riikyi koita ne oo ne mi Gibeon, konyo Amasa kotorook icheek. Kiga rat Joab kariikyik che po lugeet che kiga ilaach ak ki tinyei pireneet ak rotwetap chok ne kiga ratyi suennyi komi choget. Ye kiwendi, kochun rotweet.
Ki leenji `Joab Amasa, “Tos ichamegei, tupchennyu?” Ki nam Joab tamnetap Amasa eng' eunnyi ne po tai ko uu yo machei kong'utut ineendet.

Ago ma keer Amasa rotwetap chok ne ki tinyei Joab eng' eunnyi. Kitoor anyun Joab moetap Amasa eng' rotwonooto ak kitumdagei agutanikyik koba ng'wony. Nga ki mata kotoor ineendet kogeny, kogime Amasa. Yeityo koosup Joab ak Abisai ng'eetap kamet, Sheba weeriitap Bikri.
Ki tonon eng' ye neegitee ineendet age eng' murenigap Joab ak kole, “Ineendet ne chamei Joab ak ineendet ne po Daudi, koosup Joab.”
Kimildoegei Amasa korotiikyik eng' kwenutap ooreet ne oo. Ye kingo keer chiichooto kole ngo iit chii tugul yooto kotonon, kola Amasa koistogei eng' oranooto oo kwo keeweet ak kotuge ngoryeet.
Kingo kageisto eng' oranooto oo, koba piik tugul koosup Joab, koon Sheba weeriitap Bikri.
Ki pun Sheba pororyosyek tugul che po Israel agoi koit Abel Beth-maaka ak ole mi Berik tugul che kiga iyumgei ak koba ak icheek koosup ineendet.

Ki pwa lugeet tugul ne ki mi ak Joab ak koyiem Sheba eng' Abel ne po Beth-maaka. Ki iyum ng'ung'unyek koek tulwo konamgei ak nganaseet ak ki tonon konamgei ak irimeet. Ki ryep irimeet piik tugul che ki mi ak Joab koluul kwo ng'wony.
Ki kuurso eng' kutit ne oo anyun kwondo age ne utaat eng' nganasanooto kole, “Ogaso, ogaso, asoomok ale oleenji Joab konyo koriik yu, si kobiit ang'alaalji.”
Kingo nyo ye mi kwonyooto, ak koteebe kwonyooto koleenji, “Ii joab?” Kowolji koleenji, “Aa ineendet.” Koleenji anyun ineendet, “Kas ng'aleegap cheptong'ung' ne otwogindet.” Ak ki wol kole, “Agase.”
Yeityo komwa kwonyooto kole, “Ki cham kemwaei keny keele, ‘Ingoteeb icheek eng' Abel,’ ak kigees anyun ng'aleechooto.
Aa po icheek che po kaalyeet ak che po iman eng' Israel. Icheeng'e ibar nganaseet ne kamet eng' Israel. Amu nee si imache ilugui poroteetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor?”
Ki wol `Joab kole, “Ingolooit, ingolooit eng' anee, si ma lugui anan abar.
