Ma uu nooto ng'olyoondonooto, kimach Sheba weeriitap Bikri, chiito ne po emetap tuloonoogap Ephraim, kobar laitoryat ineendet Daudi. Ara ogoonu ineendet ineegei, si awo eng' nganaseet.” Koleenji kwonyooto Joab, “Keero, ki wiirun metinnyi kosiir irimeet.”

Kwo anyun kwonyooto eng' utotyennyi ole mi piik tugul. Ak kitil icheek metitap Sheba weeriitap Bikri yeityo kowiir konyo saang' ole mi Joab. Ki kuut anyun Joab iryageet, ak koba eng' nganaseet, kwo chii tugul emainnyi. Ak ki week Joab kwo Jerusalem ole mi laitoryat.
Kiboi Joab lugeet tugul ne po Israel, koboi Benaiah weeriitap Jehoiada Keretik ak Peletik.
Kiboi Adoram aisuruut ak ki siriindetap tuguuk che piitu Jehoshaphat weeriitap Ahilud.
Ki siriindet Seva ak ki tisiik Zadok ak Abiathar.
Ko ki tisiindetap Daudi agine Ira Jairindet.

Ki piit rubeet eng' peetuusyegap Daudi, eng' kenyiisyek somok che ki isubegei. Kingo cheeng' `Daudi togetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole Kamuktaindet ne Toroor “Po Saulo ak koonnyi ne po korotiik ng'olyoondoni, amu ki par Gibeonik.”

Ki kuur `laitoryat Gibeonik ak koleenji; (ki ma ko po Gibeonik piigap Israel, ago ki po piik che ki ng'etune Amorik. Nga kiga koyasyechi icheek `piigap Israel kole maborei, ko kiga kotyem Saulo kobar icheek kogiiljingei piigap Israel ak Judah.)
Ki leenji `Daudi anyun Gibeonik, “Ayaiywok nee? Ak ayai kagaigao nee si kobiit oberuur poroteetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor?”

Koleenji `Gibeonik ineendet, “Ma ng'olyootap fedha anan ko thahabu eng' kwenunnyo acheek ak Saulo, anan ko koonnyi. Ak ma potech kebar chii age tugul eng' Israel.” Ago ki le Daudi, “Kiit ne omwae ayaiywok kioto.”
Koleenji `icheek laitoryat, “Chiichi ki igeswech ak ne kichobei kegirindech kole kebarech kot koma king'etu eng' kiwoteet age tugul ne po Israel;
ingegoonech weeriikyik tisap si kigartatyi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' Gibea ne po Saulo, ne ki lewen Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.” Ak ki le laitoryat, “Agoonu icheek.”
Ago ki riiree laitoryat Mephibosheth weeriitap Jonathan, weeriitap Saulo, amu kayosyetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne ki mi kwenunnywa; kwenutap Daudi ak Jonathan weeriitap Saulo.

Ago ki nam laitoryat weeriik tuwai che po Rispa cheptap Aia, che kiga sikyi Saulo, Armoni ak Mephibosheth ak weeriik muut che po Mikal cheptap Saulo, che kiga sikyi Adriel weeriitap Barsilai Meolatindet,

ak konde eunegap Gibeonik ak ki igartaat icheek eng' tulweet eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor. Ki pek tugul ko tisap kibagenge. Ki kibar icheek eng' peetuusyegap kesisyet, eng' peetuusyek che po tai eng' taunetap kesisyetap baale.

Ki inem Rispa cheptap Aia kuniok ak kotochigei eng' rwandet, kobooch taunetap kesisyet agoi korobonji ropta ne punu kipsengwet. Ma chamji toriitik kobutyi muuswekwak peet anan kobwa tyong'igap timiin kemoi.
ki ngemwachi Daudi kiit ne koyai Rispa cheptap Aia, chebaigeiyatap Saulo,

kwo koip kawegap Saulo ak kawegap Jonathan weeriinnyi eng' piigap Jabes-gilead, che kiga choor eng' ooreetap Beth-san, ole kiga igartate Philistiik eng' peetuut ne kibarei `Philistiik Saulo eng' Gilboa.
Ki ip kawegap Saulo ak kawegap Jonathan weeriinnyi kotogos ak koyum kawegap icheeget che kiga kigartaat.

Kitup anyun kawegap Saulo ak che po Jonathan weeriinnyi eng' emetap Benjamin eng' Shelah, eng' kereritap Kish kwandanyi, ak ki yai tuguuk tugul che ki ng'at laitoryat. Kingo pata chooto kogasyi Kamuktaindet icheek riirek agobo emet.
Ki piit lugeet kogeny eng' Philistiik ak Israel, ak king'eet kichoortagei Daudi ak otwogikyik, koba kobargei ak Philistiik.
Kileen Isbi-benok ne ki po weeriigap piik chemosinik ak ko ne kinyigiisindap ng'otinnyi ko ki keruutik somok ak kebeber che po sugunwet, ak kiga rat rotwetap chok ne leel kole kobar Daudi.
Ago kitoret Daudi Abisai weeriitap Zeruiah. Kikwer Philistindet kobar, yeityo koyasyechi `piigap Daudi ineendet koleenji, “Ma kebendi tugul kogeny lugeet ak inyee, si memis taitap Israel.”
Kingo pata niito, kobiit lugeet kogeny ak Philistiik eng' Gob. Ki par eng' yooto `Sibeikai Husatindet Shaaph, ne ki po weeriigap piik chemosinik.
Ki piit kogeny lugeet ak Philistiik eng' Gob, ak ki par Elanan weeriitap Jaareoregim Bethlehemindet Goliat Gitindet, ne ki kergei irumetap ndirinnyi ak keetit ne taachin usiisyek chiito ne nabisyei.

Ki piit lugeet kogeny eng' Gath, ole ki mi chiito ne kooi kot, ne ki tinyei morik lo eng' euut age tugul, ak ki tinyei morik lo eng' keeldo age tugul, ki tiptem ak ang'wan tugul. Ki isichei chiichooto agine chiito chemosit.
Ye kingo reeny Israel, kobar ineendet Jonathan weeriitap Shimei ng'eetap kametap Daudi.
Ki kisikyi pichooto ang'wan chiito chemosit eng' Gath, ak ki par Daudi ak otwogikyik pichooto.
Kityenji `Daudi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ng'aleegap tyeni eng' peetuut ne kigasar `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ineendet eng' eunegap puunikyik tugul ak eng' eutap Saulo.
Kityen kole, “Kamuktaindet ne Toroor rwandennyu, irimennyu ak saruunindennyu.
Kamuktaindet ko rwandennyu, ne amang'u. Long'ennyu ak kuinetap yetunennyu, teeksennyu ne kooi ak ole amwechini, yetindennyu ne sarwo eng' koroomnateet.
Aguure Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ne nyoljin kilas, si kesarwo eng' puunikyuk.
Ki yiema peek che mildogei che po meet, ki koono maranosyegap yaityet aiyweis.
Ki yiema poroonigap Olemi Che ki kobek; kichea mestonogap meet.
Ki aguur Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' pichiindanyu, ee, ki aguur Kamuktaindennyu; Ki kas kutinnyu eng' hekalunnyi, ak ki it riirekyuk itiikyik.
Ki kirgiren ng'wony anyun ak ki potan, ki twagei lumeiywegap kipsengwet, ak kotumdumgei amu kinereech.
Ki togosta iyeto ne ki mang'une seruunekyik; ki peelso maat ne ki mang'une kutinnyi. Kilalyo nesek eng' maata.
Ki im kipsengwet ak kochoorgei ineendet. Ki mi mesundeito ne oo kurereetap keelyekyik.
Ki laany kerubindet ak kotiriren; ee, ki took eng' kebebaigap usoonet.
Ki yai mesundeito koek emaisyekyik che mi komoswekyik tugul, kayumetapkei ne po peek, poolik che tuuen che po parak.
Kilalyo nesek eng' kaluunet ne ki mi tainnyi.
Kitul Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' kipsengwet, ak kitwek Ineendet Ne Toroor Miising'.
Kimwokto kipchabonik ak koiyesta puunik; kigon kalyeleet ak koiyesta icheek.
Ki took anyun kereruusyegap nyanjet, king'ang'agis lumeiywegap ng'wony, eng' kereetap kong' ne po Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ak eng' cheetap kabuusetap seruunekyik.
Ki iyogoigei eng' parak ak koganaba; ki ichuutwa among' eng' peek che chaang'.
Kisarwo eng' punyondennyu ne kiim, eng' icheeget che kiwecha, amu ki kiimeen kosiiro.
Kichea eng' peetuutap nyalildanyu, ago ki ek Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne atiegei.
Ki imuta amanda awo ole paraa; kisarwo amu ki paibait eng' anee.
Ki koono Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ko uu imandanyu; ki koono ko uu tiliilindap eunekyuk.
Amu ki ariip ortinwegap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ma abagaakte Kamuktaindennyu asup oor ne ya.
Mi tainnyu kirwoogutikyik tugul, ak ma aistoegei kaneetisyosyekyik.
Ki aititaat agane eng' tainnyi, ak ki ariipkei si ma nama tengekto.
Ki koono anyun Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ko uu imandanyu; ko uu tiliilindanyu eng' tainnyi.
Eng' che tinyei rireenetapkei ii po rireenetapkei; ak eng' chiito ne igeesunotke iboortoigei ile ii igeesunotke.
Eng' che tiliileen iboortoigei ile ii tiliil, ak eng' che mastoi, obortosi.
Isaru che nyerootiin, ago igeere che mendos si kobiit iming'in.
Ii tainnyu Kamuktaindet ne Toroor; ak ikwenyi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor mesundeitonyu.
Eng' amuuchi aiyestoi lugeet eng' inyee, eng' Kamuktaindennyu atorombeni asiire irimeet.
Ititaat ooreetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor; ki konaak ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Ineendet long'eetap icheeget tugul che imang'u ineendet.
Amu tos ng'oo Kamuktaindet, kobatee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor? Ak tos ng'oo rwandet, kobatee Kamuktaindennyo?
Kamuktaindet ne koono kimnateet, irimennyu ne kiim ak ko ne yao aek ne igeesunotke eng' ooreennyu.
Yaei ineendet keelyekyuk koigei che po kenyeleet, nama atonon eng' komoswekyuk che torooreen.
Ineeti eunekyuk koyai lugeet; si kong'i eunekyuk kwanget ne po sugunwet.
Ki igoono long'eetap yetuneng'ung' agine; ak ki koeeta talasyeng'ung'.
Ki ibaraiywa kakwautikyuk, ama ichabaita keelyekyuk.
Ki asup puunikyuk ak abar; ak ma aweigei agoi kogeskei.
Ki awong'u icheek, ak atui kot koma komuuchi kong'eetyo. Ee, kagobutyi icheek keelyekyuk keel.
Ki iratwa kimnateet ne po lugeet; ki iterteerwa aboi che king'eetya.
Ki iwelel puunikyuk kotuktocha patai, si kobiit agees icheek che wecho.
Ki riiryo, ago ki ma piit ne ki sar icheek; ki riirchi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ago ki ma wolji.
Ki atonaton anyun icheek komengegitu koigei temburyegap ng'wony, ki atyech ko uu ng'atateek che mi ortinwek ak aiyeste.
Ki isarwo aginye eng' pooryosyegap piikyuk; ki iriibo aek metitap pororyosyek, tuun ota piik che tomo anai.
Tuun kasa iit weeriigap punootyot, ye kas agobo anee, eng' yooto kogasa iit.
Pegunoti toek kowandogei, ak komong' eng' ole ung'egei kobotandos.
Sabei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ak ilasunoot rwandennyu, ak ingotororit Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindetap rwandetap yetunennyu,
Kamuktaindet ne yaaktoiywo mugetuut, ineendet ne iming'ini piik kogasa iit,
ineendet ne imutwaa amang'une puunikyuk. Ee, itoroora asiir icheek che ng'eetyina; isarwo eng' chiito ne koroom.
Aweegun kongoi anyun, ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, eng' kwenutap pororyosyek, ak atyenji kaineng'ung' kalasunoik.
Igoochin laitoryandennyi saruunet ne oo; ak koboorchin nenyi ne iilaat chamyennyi ne tala, Daudi ak iyotennyi agoi koigeny.”

Chu anyun ko ng'aleek che po let che po Daudi. Ng'alaalutigap Daudi weeriitap Jesse, Chuuto ng'aleegap chiito ne ki itoroor Kamuktaindet, ne iilaat ne po Kamuktaindetap Jakobo, ne chamat ne po tyenwogigap Israel.
Ki ng'alaalena Kabuusetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ak ki mi ng'olyoondennyi ng'elyeptanyu.
Ki ng'alaal Kamuktaindetap Israel, ki ng'alaalwo Rwandetap Israel kole: “Ineendet ne pou piik eng' imanda, ko ingoboi eng' kaiyweisyetap Kamuktaindet,
ko kergeitu ak lapkeiyet ne po karon, ye charu asiista eng' karonet ne lapkei, ye piitos susweek che ng'orng'oren, eng' kaluunet ne lapkei ko kamoen ropta.”

Tos ma uu nooto iman koonnyu eng' Kamuktaindet? Tos ma ki koyomiswa kayomiset ne po koigeny, ne ki kichop eng' tuguuk tugul ak ko ne lumdaat? Amu nooto ko yetunennyu tugul ak ko magennyu tugul, Agot ngo ma yai kotesak.
Ago kergeitu tugul che ma iywei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ak katook che ki wiirtoi, amu ma namaksei eng' euut.
Ago chiito ne namei ko kanyool kotinyei kariik ak irumetap ng'otit; kibeelei eng' maat kogeskei eng' komostanywa.
Chu ko kainaigap murenik che nyigoonen che ki tinyei Daudi: Joseb-basebet Takemonindet, ne oo eng' kiptainik somok. Ineendet ne kibar piik pogol sisiit eng' ng'otinnyi peetuunak.

Rubeiywnnyi eng' che kirubei ineendet ko ki Eleazar weeriitap Dodai weeriitap Ahoindet. Ineendet ko ki agenge eng' murenichooto somok nyigoonen che ki mi ak Daudi ye kichotei Philistiik che kiga iyumgei eng' yooto agobo lugeet ak kiga koba murenigap Israel.

Ki ng'eet kobar Philistiik kot kong'et eunnyi ak koyaam eunnyi koyaamji rotwetap chok. Ki iyai Kamuktaindet ne Toroor katerteeret ne oo peetuunooto. Ak ki week piik kityo koosup ineendet koba konyaban tuguuk.
Ne rubei ineendet ko ki Shammah weeriitap Agee Hararindet. Kingo yumgei Philistiik koek lugeet, eng' ole ki mi mbareet ne mi sogorik che chaang', komwee piigap Israel icheek.
Ago ki tonon Shammah eng' kwenutap mbaranooto, koeet mbareet ak ki par Philistiik ak ki yai Kamuktaindet ne Toroor katerteeret ne oo.
Ki choortagei somogu eng' pounik che eecheen sosom, ak koba ole mi Daudi eng' peetuusyegap kesisyet agoi kebeneetap Adulam ak kiga teech lugeetap Philistiik atebweetap Repaim.
Eng' kasarata, ko ki mi `Daudi irimeet ak kimi lugeetap Philistiik Bethlehem.
Ki am melelda `Daudi ak ki le, “Oiye, inaga ng'oo peegap keriingetap peek ne mi Bethlehem ne neegitee ormariichet, aee”

Kichut lugeetap Philistiik `murenjoto nyigoonen somogu, koba koram peek eng' keriingonooto po peek ne mi Bethlehem, ne ki mi ye neegitee ormariichet yeityo koipchi Daudi. Ago ma cham koe, kitumda eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.

Ki le, “Ingolooit eng' anee, ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, si ma yai kii. Tos ma korotiigap piik che kachut ng'oiyondit saboonwekwak?” Ma cham anyun koe amu nooto. Chuuto anyun tuguuk che ki yai pichooto somogu nyigoonen.
Ki ne oo eng' chooto somok Abisai ng'eetap kametap Joab weeriitap Zeruiah ak ki nam ng'otinnyi ak kobar piik pogol somok ak ki took kainennyi eng' murenjoto somok.
Tos ma ineendet ne ki tinyei teegisto miising' eng' chooto somok? Ki kiyai ineendet anyun koek kiptaiyannywa, ago ma ityi chugai somok po tai.

Benaiah weeriitap Jehoiada, weeriit ne nyigan ne punu Kabseel, ineendet ne ki yai poisyonik che eecheen: ki par weeriik aeng' che po Ariel che po Moab; kichoortagei kogeny kwo kobar ng'etundo eng' kwenutap keriinget eng' peetuusyegap teluji;

ak ki par Misirindet murenet ne karaaran. Nga ki tinyei misirindonooto ng'otit eng' eunnyi, ko ki choortagei kwo ole mi ineendet ak kirokto yeityo kong'us ng'otit eng' eutap misirindonooto ak kobare ng'otinnyi.
Ki yai tuguuchuuto Benaiah weeriitap Jehoiada ak ki took kainennyi eng' murenjoto somok nyigoonen.
Ki sich teegisto kosiir chooto somok, ago ma ityi chugai somok po tai. Ki inde `Daudi ineendet koboi riibiikyik.
Alak eng' chooto sosom ko ki: Asahel ng'eetap kametap Joab, Elanan weeriitap Dodo ne po Bethlehem,
Shammah Harodindet, Elika Harodindet,
Heles Paltindet, Ira weeriitap Ikes Tekoindet,
Abiezer Anatotindet, Mebunai Husatindet,
Salmon Aoindet, Maarai Netopatindet,
Heleb weeriitap Baanah Netopatindet, Itai weeriitap Ribai ne po Gibea ne po lagogap Benjamin,
Benaiah Piratonindet, Idai ne po ainoosyegap Gaas,
Abi-albon Arbatindet, Asmabet Baharumindet,
Eliaba Saalbonindet, weeriigap Jasen, Jonathan;
Shammah Hararindet, Aiam weeriitap Sarar Ararindet,
Eliphelet weeriitap Aasbai, weeriitap Maakatindet, Eliam weeriitap Ahitopel Gilonindet,
Hesro Karmelindet, Paarai Arbindet,
Igal weeriitap Nathan ne po Soba, Bani Gadindet,
Selek Amonindet, Naarai Beerotindet, ne ki ipchin kariik Joab weeriitap Zeruiah,
Ira Itrindet, Gareb Itrindet ak
Uriah Hitindet. Ki sosom ak tisap pichooto tugul.
Ki nereech kot kogeny Kamuktaindet ne Toroor agobo Israel, ak king'eetyi `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Daudi kosich kabwaatet ne ya agobo icheek. Ki leenji anyun “Ui, iit Israel ak Judah.”
Ak ki leenji `laitoryat Joab kiptaiyatap lugeet ne ki mi ak ineendet, “Ui punoote pororyosyek tugul che po Israel, kobooch Dan agoi Beer-sheba ak oiit piik si kobiit anai ole tee koiitennywa.”

Ago ki leenji `Joab laitoryat, “Ingotes piik `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindeng'ung', ingotenit kiit ne tee konyil pogol ak ingogeer kiptaiyandennyu laitoryat, ago amu nee si komachei koyai kiptaiyandennyu laitoryat kii?”
Ago ki iterteer ng'olyootap laitoryat Joab ak ki iterteer kiptainigap lugeet. Ki pa Joab ak kiptainigap lugeet eng' ole mi laitoryat, koba koiit piigap Israel.
Kilandae Jordan ak komung'yo eng' Aroer, komostap tai ne po nganaseet ne mi kwenutap atebweetap Gad kotokyigei Jaser,
yeityo kobwa Gilead ak emetap Tatim-hodsi. Ki pwa Dan-jan ak koyiemat agoi Sidon.
Yeityo kobwa irimeetap Tyro agoi nganasook tugul che po Hibik ak che po Kanaanik. Ki manda koba murot tai ne po Judah eng' Beer-sheba.
Kingo kagobunoot anyun emet tugul kobwa Jerusalem ko kaigeskei arawek sogoolu ak peetuusyek tiptem kobooch ngo pa.
Ki igoochi Joab laitoryat kiit ne tee koitetap piik. Ki mi Israel murenik eliphuusyek pogolwogik sisiitu che nyigoonen che po rotoogap chok ak ki ek che po Judah murenik eliphuusyek pogol muut.

Ki aragen miising' Daudi eng' muguleldanyi ye kingo kagoiit piik. Ki leenji anyun `Daudi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, “Ki ayai tengekto ne oo eng' kioto koayai, ago asoomin ale iste anyun tengektap otwogindeng'ung', ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, amu ki ayai eng' perberyo ne oo.”
Kingo ng'eet Daudi karon, koityi ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor maotyot Gad, keerindetap Daudi, koleenji,
“Ui imwachi Daudi ileenji, kamwa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole, Kagoonin tuguuk somok ak lewen agenge eng' chooto, si kobiit ayaun.”

Ki nyo anyun Gad ole mi Daudi ak komwachi ineendet koleenji, “Myee koamin rubeet kenyiisyek tisap eng' emeng'ung'? Anan imweote eng' arawek somok eng' taitap puuniguk koonotin? Anan piit koroitap ng'wony eng' emeng'ung' peetuusyek somok? Lewen anyun nguno ak imwaa kiit ne awoljini ineendet ne kaiyokwo.”
Ki leenji `Daudi Gad, “Ami eng' pichiindo ne oo, ngabutyi eutap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, amu chaang' rireenosyekyik, ago ameng' abutyi eutap chii.”
Ki iyookyi `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor anyun koroitap ng'wony Israel, kong'etee karon agoi sait ne ki king'at ak ki pek piik eliphuusyek tamanwogik tisabu kobooch Dan agoi Beer-sheba.

Ye kingo tokyi malaikaiyat eunnyi Jerusalem kole kobar, kowal Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kabwaatutikyik agobo yaityonooto ak koleenji malaikaiyandonooto kibarei piik, “Kagoyam, ingosiis eung'ung'.” Ki mi malaikaiyatap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ole neegitee rwanyut ne kiboorsee ne po Arauna Jebusindet.

Ye kingo keer `Daudi malaikaiyat ne kibarei piik, kong'alaalji Kamuktaindet ne Toroor `ineendet koleenji, “Keero, ki ayai tengekto, ki amaste, ago ki yai nee keechiirechu? Asaain ale, ingobira eung'ung' ak ingobir kootap kwandanyu.”
Ki nyo `Gad peetuunooto ole mi Daudi koleenji ineendet, “Togoste, iteekyi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kaptisisyet eng' rwanyut ne kiboorsee ne po Arauna Jebusindet.”
Ara ki togosta anyun `Daudi ko uu ye ki mwa Gad ko uu ye kiga ng'at Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Kingo tabendo `Arauna, kogeer laitoryat ak otwogikyik kobwanei kotokyingei ineendet; kwo Arauna ak kong'uruuk eng' taitap laitoryat kot kotiiny togeet ng'wony.

Yeityo kole `Arauna, “Kalya si konyo kiptaiyandennyu laitoryat ole mi otwogindennyi?” Ak ki le Daudi, “Kanyo aa alenen rwanyut ne kiboorsee, si kobiit ateekyi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kaptisisyet, si kobiit keraany koroitap ng'wony kosiis si ma kobarei piik.”

Koleenji `Arauna Daudi, “Ingoip kiptaiyandennyu laitoryat ak kogoita kiit ne keerei kole myee eng' ineendet. Keero mi yu eiik che po kagoochinet ne kibeelei ak tuguuk che kiboorsee ak chogisyegap tuuga che egu kweenik.
Ee laitoryat, kaigoochi Arauna chuuto tugul laitoryat.” Koleenji kogeny `Arauna laitoryat, “Ingotaachin Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindeng'ung'.”

Ago ki leenji `laitoryat Arauna, “Achicha, aalenen iman eng' alyet. Ma koochini Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindennyu kagoochinoik che kibeelei che ma agoite kiy.” Ki al anyun Daudi rwanyunooto kiboorsee kobooto tuuga eng' shekelisyek konom che po fedha.

Ki teekyi `Daudi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kaptisisyet eng' yooto ak kogoito kagoochinoik che kibeelei ak kagoochinoigap kaalyeet. Ki kasyi anyun `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor icheek riirek agobo emet ak ki kiraany koroitap ng'wony kosiis eng' Israel.
Kiga koosit anyun Laitoryat Daudi; kiga kotar kenyiisyek che chaang', ak nganda ki tuch `icheek ineendet eng' ngoroik, koma kas lalang'yo.

Ki leenji `otwogikyik ineendet, “Ingecheeng'ji pergeiya laitoryat kiptaiyandennyu neta ko ming'in, si koriip ak kobois eng' taitap laitoryat, ak ingorue tegeng'ung', si kogas laitoryat kiptaiyandennyu lalang'yo.”
Kocheeng' anyun chepto ne karaaran eng' komoswek tugul che po Israel, ak kinyoor ak komutyi `laitoryat Chepsunamindet ne ki kiguure Abishag.
Ki karaaran chebooto miising' ak ki riip laitoryat ak koboisyechi ineendet. Agot ingano, koma ituiyogei laitoryat ak ineendet.
Ki ietkei Adonijah weeriitap Haggith kole, “Aegu laitoryat!” Ko uu nooto ko ki chopchigei kariisyek ak paraisisyek che laanyei, ak piik konom che rwaei kondoe ineendet.
Ago ma polji `ineendet kwandanyi eng' peetuut age tugul anan koteebe kole, “Amu nee si iyai ko uu niito?” Ki muren ne karaaran kot agine ak kirubu Absalom.
Ki ng'alaal ineendet ak Joab weeriitap Zeruiah kobooto Abiathar tisiindet, ak ki igongei icheek kotoret ineendet.
Ago ki ma iyan kotoret Zadok tisiindet, Benaiah weeriitap Jehoiada, maotyot Nathan, Shimei, Rei ak piigap Daudi che kinyigoonen.

Ki eny Adonijah keechiirek, tuuga ak che akwaen eng' ole neegitee koitap Zoheleth, ne mi ole neegitee En-rogel. Ki kuur tupchosyekyik tugul, weeriigap laitoryat ak piik tugul che po Judah che otwogigap laitoryat.
Maguur ineendet maotyot Nathan anan Benaiah, anan piik che nyigoonen agot Solomon ng'eetap kamet.
Komwachi anyun `Nathan Bathsheba kametap Solomon koleenji, “Tom igas keele laitorani Adonijah weeriitap Haggith, amaingen Daudi kiptaiyandennyi?
Nyoo anyun, asoomin ale aneetiin kiy, si kobiit isaru saboondang'ung' ak saboondap weeriing'ung' Solomon.

Ui ko ole mi Daudi ak ileenji ineendet, Tos ki ma iyasyechi inyee kiptaiyandennyu, ee laitoryat, otwogindeng'ung' ne chepto, ileenji, ‘Laitorani iman Solomon weeriing'ung' ko kaamei ak tebee ng'echerennyu ne po laitornatet? Amu nee anyun si kolaitoran Adonijah?’
Ak ye ta ong'alaali ak laitoryat, asubun anyo ko agane ak agimiit ng'aleeguk.”
Ki wo anyun Bathsheba agoi ko oriit ole mi laitoryat; kiga koosit laitoryat miising' ak kiboisyechin ineendet Abishag Chepsunamindet.
Ki ing'uruuk Bathsheba kogutung'ji laitoryat. Ak kiteebe laitoryat koleenji, “Imache nee?”

Ak ki wolji laitoryat koleenji, “Ki iyasye inyee kiptaiyandennyu eng' Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindeng'ung', iyasyechi otwogindeng'ung' ne chepto ileenji, ‘Laitorani iman Solomon weeriing'ung' ko kaameei ak tebee ng'echerennyu ne po laitornatet.’
Ago nguno ko laitorani Adonijah, amengen inyee kiptaiyandennyu laitoryat.
Kagoeeny ineendet tuuga, che akwaen ak keechiirek ng'iisyat, ak koguur weeriik tugul che po laitoryat, Abiathar tisiindet kobooto Joab kiptaiyatap lugeet, ago ma kuur Solomon otwogindeng'ung'.
Keerin konyegap Israel tugul inyee laitoryat kiptaiyandennyu, imwachi ne namei ng'echereetap laitornatet ne po kiptaiyandennyu laitoryat.
Anan ngot koma uu nooto, ko ye kagoru kiptaiyandennyu laitoryat kobooto kwanisyekyik, kiitech anee ak weeriinnyu Solomon keegu ngelelik.”
Ye kita kong'alaali ak laitoryat, konyo ko maotyot Nathan
ak ki kimwachi laitoryat keleenji, “Keero, mi yu maotyot Nathan.” Ak kingo nyo ineendet taitap laitoryat, kong'uruuk eng' taitap laitoryat kot kotiing'e togeennyi ng'wony ak kole,
“Kiptaiyandennyu ee laitoryat, ki imwa ile tuun laitorani Adonijah ko keemee ak kotebee ng'echereeng'ung' ne po laitornatet?

Kachoortagei rani ak koeny tuuga ak che akwaen ak keechiirek ng'iisyat, ak kagoguur weeriik tugul che po laitoryat, kiptainigap lugeet ak Abiathar tisiindet. Keero, amisyei ak koeisei eng' tainnyi, ak koleen, ‘Iwe keny Laitoryat Adonijah!’
Ago, ma kuuro agot anee otwogindeng'ung', Zadok tisiindet, Benaiah weeriitap Jehoiada ak otwogindeng'ung' Solomon.
Tos ki yai kii kiptaiyandennyu laitoryat, ama ibooru ineendet ne tebee ng'echeretap kiptaiyandennyu laitoryat ko kagome?”
Kowol anyun Laitoryat Daudi kole, “Oguurwa Bathsheba.” Ak ki nyo ineendet taitap laitoryat ak kotonon eng' tainnyi.
Ki iyasyo laitoryat kole, “Ko uu ye sabei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ne ki kotyach saboondanyu komang'une ng'oiyondit tugul,

ko uu ye ki ayosyeun iman eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindetap Israel ale laitorani iman Solomon weeriing'ung' ko kaamee, ak kotebee ng'echerennyu ne po laitornatet kogeero; ayae ko uu nooto kora rani.”
Ki ing'uruuk anyun Bathsheba kotiing'e togeet ng'wony kogutung'ji laitoryat ak kole, “Ingwo keny laitoryat kiptaiyandennyu Daudi!”
Kole Laitoryat Daudi, “Oguurwa Zadok tisiindet, maotyot Nathan ak Benaiah weeriitap Jehoiada.” Ki pwa taitap laitoryat ak
ki leenji `laitoryat icheek, “Omut otwogigap kiptaiyandeng'wong' ak ogoochi Solomon weeriinnyu kolaany nyumbunnyu, ak omutu kochoorgei konyo Gihon.
Ingoiil ineendet eng' olooto Zadok tisiindet ak maotyot Nathan koek laitoryat ne pou Israel. Oguut iryageet ak oleen, ‘Ingwo keny Laitoryat Solomon!’
Yeityo otogosu osubu ineendet inyoo kotebee ng'echerennyu ne po laitornatet, amu egu laitoryat kogeera. Kaatoroor ineendet koek pounindet ne pou Israel ak Judah.”
Ki wolji Benaiah weeriitap Jehoiada laitoryat koleenji, “Sere! Ingomwa agine Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindetap kiptaiyandennyu laitoryat, ko uu nooto.

Ko uu ye ki mi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kobooto kiptaiyandennyu laitoryat, ko ingotep kobooto Solomon agine, ak koyai ng'echerennyi ne po laitornatet koeet kosiir ne po kiptaiyandennyu Laitoryat Daudi.”
Ki choortagei anyun Zadok tisiindet, ak Nathan maotyot, ak Benaiah weeriitap Jehoiada, kobooto Keretik ak Peletik, ak kolaany Solomon nyumbutap Laitoryat Daudi, ak yeityo komut ineendet kwo Gihon.
Ki inem Zadok tisiindet laletap mwaita eng' Emait ak koiil Solomon. Ki kuut icheek iryageet ak kuguurso piik tugul koleen, “Ingwo keny Laitoryat Solomon!”
Ki pwa piik tugul komutu ineendet ak kogutonu ndurerusyek. Ak kiboiboitu eng' poiboiyet ne oo kot ko regregen emet amu cheennywa.
Ki kas Adonijah ak toekyik tugul che ki mi ak ineendet ye kingo kagogees amisyet. Kingo kas Joab cheetap iryageet koteep kole, “Po nee polatoni kawo parak eng' nganaseet?”
Ye kita kong'alaali, koit Jonathan weeriitap Abiathar tisiindet, ak koleenji `Adonijah ineendet, “Nyoo ko, amu ii chii ne nyigan ak iibu logoiywek che myach.”
Ak ki wolji `Jonathan Adonijah koleenji, “Achicha ma uu nooto! Kagoyai `kiptaiyandennyo Laitoryat Daudi Solomon koek laitoryat.
Kagoyookto `laitoryat Zadok tisiindet, ak maotyot Nathan, ak Benaiah weeriitap Jehoiada, kobooto Keretik ak Peletik koba ak ineendet, ak kagoochi ineendet kolaany nyumbutap laitoryat.
Kagoiil Zadok tisiindet ak maotyot Nathan Solomon koek laitoryat eng' Gihon. Togosu eng' olooto kogasanugei kot ko kagululen nganaseet kogeny. Nooto polateet ne kogase.
Ne siirei nooto, ko tebee Solomon ng'echereetap laitornatetap pounateet.

Ak kogeny-i, ko kabwa otwogigap laitoryat koberuur laitoryat kiptaiyandennyo Daudi, koleen, ‘Ingoyai kamuktaindeng'ung' kainetap Solomon kogararanit kosiir neng'ung', ak koyai ng'echerennyi ne po laitornatet koeet kosiir neng'ung!’ Ak ki ing'uruuk laitoryat eng' ng'echerennyi.
Ak kogeny, ko kamwa laitoryat kole, ‘Iberuurot Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindetap Israel, ne kagonde chiito kotebee ng'echerennyu ne po laitornatet eng' peetuuni kogeerei konyekyuk.’ ”
Ki aragenso toegap Adonijah tugul ak kong'eetyo koba; ki wo chii tugul ooreennyi.
Eng' kayweisyet ne ki iywei `Adonijah Solomon, koging'eet ak kwo konam kuinoigap kaptisisyet.

Ki kimwachi Solomon keleenji, “Keero! Iywei `Adonijah Laitoryat Solomon ak kagonam kuinoigap kaptisisyet ak koleen, ‘Ingoyosyeiwo Laitoryat Solomon rani kole ma parei otwogindennyi eng' rotwetap chok.’ ”
Kole Solomon, “Ngot koboorgei koek chiito ne myee, koma ibutyin ng'wony agot agenge eng' suumeekyik ng'wony. Ago ngot kenyoorchi ineendet yaityet, komeei.”
Ki iyookto anyun Laitoryat Solomon keemut ineendet konyo kochoorgei eng' kaptisisyet. Ak ki nyo ak kogutung'ji Laitoryat Solomon. Ki leenji `Solomon ineendet, “Ui koong'ung'.”
Ki irik anyun peetuusyek che po kaliletap Daudi, ak ki ng'at weeriinnyi Solomon koleenji,
“Neegit awo ole pendi piik tugul che po ng'wony. Kimitu anyun ak iegu muren.

Riip kayomisetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindeng'ung', iwendote ortinwekyik, iriip kaneetisyosyekyik, ng'atuutikyik, kirwoogutikyik ak paornatosyekyik, ko uu chooto ki kisir eng' Ng'atuutyetap Musa, si kiberuurin eng' tugul che iyae, eng' oldo tugul ole iwendi,

si kobiit koogimiit Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ng'olyoondennyi ne ki mwa agobo anee, kole, Ngot koriip lagoguk ortinwekwak, kobendat eng' tainnyu eng' imanit eng' mugulelwekwak tugul ak eng' saboonwekwak tugul, koma petenen chiito ne tebee ng'echereetap laitornatet eng' Israel.

“Ak kogeny ingen aginye kiit ne ki yaiywo Joab weeriitap Zeruiah, kiit ne ki yachi kiptainik aeng' che po lugosyegap Israel, Abner weeriitap Ner ak Amasa weeriitap Jeter, che kibar, ak kotumda korotiigap lugeet eng' peetuusyegap kaalyeet, ak konde korotiigap lugeet pireneet ne kiga rategei, kobooto kweonik che ki mi keelyekyik.
Yai anyun ko uu utaatyeng'ung', amechamji koolil eng' kalwalekyik eng' kaalyeet.
“Ago riiree weeriigap Barsilai Gileadindet, ak ingoek icheek alak che amisye meseng'ung'. Amu ki pwa icheek ole ami ye ki amwee Absalom ng'eetap komet.

Keero, mi kobooten Shimei weeriitap Gera, Benjaminindet, ne po Baurim, ne ki chubo eng' chubeet ne ng'waan eng' peetuut ne ki awendi Mahanaim. Ye ki choorgei kotorookwo eng' Jordan, ko ki ayosyechi ineendet eng' Kamuktaindet ne Toroor aleenji, ‘Mabarin eng' rotwetap chok.’
Ara anyun, amat ile, ma tinyei ng'oogisto. Ii chiito ne ng'oom; ak imuuchi inai kiit ne kanyooljin iyachi, ak ichoorunee kalwalekyik korotiik koba ye mi che ki kobek.”
Ki ru anyun Daudi kobooto kwanisyekyik ak ketupchi nganaseetap Daudi.
Ki laitoran Daudi eng' Israel kenyiisyek artam. Ki laitoran ineendet eng' Hebron kenyiisyek tisap ak kolaitoran eng' Jerusalem kenyiisyek sosom ak somok.
Ki tebee anyun Solomon ng'echereetap laitornatet ne po Daudi, kwandanyi; ak ki kigimit laitornatennyi miising'.
Ki nyo anyun Adonijah weeriitap Haggith ole mi Bathsheba kametap Solomon. Ak ki le, “Inyone eng' kaalyeet?” Ak ki le, “Anyoone eng' kaalyeet.”
Ak ki le kogeny, “Atinye kiit ne amache amwaun.” Ak ki leenji, “Mwa anyun.”
Ak ki le, “Ingen ile ki nenyu laitornatet, ak kigeera Israel tugul, kole alaitoran. Ago kiwalak laitornatet, ak ki kobunji weeriit ne kitupche; amu ki nenyi kobunu Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ara anyun, asoomin kiit agenge, amat ietena.” Ak ki leenji, “Mwa anyun.”
Ak ki le, “Asoomin ale ng'alaalji Laitoryat Solomon, (amu maesyoun,) ale kogoono Abishag Chepsunamindet atun.”
Ak ki le Bathsheba, “Myee, ang'alaaljineun laitoryat.”

Ki wo anyun `Bathsheba ole mi Laitoryat Solomon, kwo kong'alaaljinechi Adonijah. Ki ng'eet laitoryat kotorook ineendet ak kong'uruukyi, ak kotebee ng'echerennyi ne po laitornatet. Ki ng'at anyun keip ng'echereetap laitornatet kotebee kametap laitoryat, ak ki tebee kamennyi eunnyi ne po tai.
Yeityo kole, “Asoomin kiy agenge ne ming'in; amat ietena.” Ak ki leenji `laitoryat ineendet, “Soom anyun, kamennyu; amu maetenen.”
Ki le ineendet, “Ingigoochi Adonijah ng'eetap komet Abishag chepsunamindet kotun.”

Ki wolji `laitoryat Solomon kamet koleenji, “Amu nee si isomji Adonijah Abishag Chepsunamindet? Somji ineendet laitornatet agine! Amu ineendet ko tupchennyu ne oo; mat isoomji ineendet kityo ak ko kobooto Abiathar tisiindet ak Joab weeriitap Zeruiah.”
Koyasyo anyun Laitoryat Solomon eng' Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole, “Ingoyaiywo Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ko uu nooto, ak kotes koosir, ngot koma mwa Adonijah ng'olyoondoni agobo saboondanyi.
Nooto anyun ko uu ye sabei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ne ki igimita, ak kondea ng'echereetap laitornatet ne po Daudi abba, ak ne kiteekwo koot, ko uu ye ki iyomis ineendet; kebarei Adonijah iman rani.”
Ki iyookto anyun Laitoryat Solomon Benaiah weeriitap Jehoiada, ak ki wo kobar ineendet.

Ki leenji `laitoryat Abiathar tisiindet, “Ui Anatoth, ole mi mbareeniguk; amu nyoljinin imee. Ago ma parin rani, amu ki ibe moingetap Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' taitap Daudi abba, ak ki kinyaliilin eng' tuguuk tugul che ki kinyalile abba.”
Koon anyun `Solomon Abiathar si mata koek tisiindetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, si kobiit kosulda ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ne ki mwa agobo kootap Eli eng' Shiloh.
Ye kingo it ng'aleek kap Joab, amu kiga koosup `Joab Adonijah, agot nganda ki ma isup Absalom kogimwechi Joab Emaitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ak konam kuinoigap kaptisisyet.
Ki kimwachi Laitoryat Solomon keleenji, “Kagomwechi Joab Emaitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ak mi ye po kaptisisyet.” Ki iyookto anyun `Solomon Benaiah weeriitap Jehoiada, koleenji, “Ui ibar ineendet.”

Ki it anyun Benaiah Emaitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ak koleenji ineendet, “Kamwa laitoryat ko uu ni, kole, ‘Mong'u.’ ” Ak ki le, “Achicha; amechini yuto.” Ak ki ipchi `Benaiah laitoryat ng'olyoot kogeny, koleenji, “Kamwa Joab ko uu ni ak kawolwo ko uu ni.”
Ki leenji `laitoryat ineendet, “Yai ko uu ye kagomwa, ak ibar ineendet ak itup; si kobiit iiste korotiik, che kitumda Joab puch, eng' anee ak eng' kootap abba.

Weekyin Kamuktaindet ne Toroor korotiikyik metinnyi, amu, ama ingen kwandanyu Daudi, ko ki ibookyi ak kobar eng' rotwetap chok piik aeng' che ki po iman ak ko koigoi kosiir ineendet, chooto ko Abner weeriitap Ner, kiptaiyatap lugeetap Israel, ak Amasa weeriitap Jeter, kiptaiyatap lugeetap Judah.

Weekyingei anyun korotiikwak metitap Joab, ak metowegap iyotennyi koigeny. Ago mi kaalyeet koigeny ne punu Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, kap Daudi ak iyotennyi, kobooto koonnyi ak ng'echerennyi ne po laitornatet.”
Kotogosta anyun Benaiah weeriitap Jehoiada, kwo kokwer ineendet ak kobar, ak ki kitupchi koonnyi eng' surkwen.
Ki inde laitoryat Benaiah weeriitap Jehoiada koboi lugeet kogeer ineendet, ak ki inde Zadok tisiindet kogeer Abiathar.
Ki iyookto laitoryat keguur Shimei konyo ole mi ineendet ak koleenji, “Teekyigei koot eng' Jerusalem, ak imeny olooto, amat iwe ui.
Amu eng' peetuut ne imandoi ak ilandoe kererutap Kedron, inai anyun komyee ile imee iman. Tebee korotiguk meting'ung'.”
Ak ki leenji Shimei laitoryat, “Myee mwaonooto: ko uu ye kamwa kiptaiyandennyu laitoryat, koyaei otwogindeng'ung' ko uu nooto.” Ak ki meny Shimei Jerusalem peetuusyek che chaang'.
Ago kingo pata kenyiisyek somogu, komwei otwogik aeng' che po Shimei koba kap Akis, weeriitap Maaka laitoryatap Gath. Ak ki kimwachi Shimei keleenji, “Keero, mi otwogiguk Gath.”
Ki ng'eet Shimei ak koiito sigiryennyi, ak kwo agoi kap Akis eng' Gath, kocheeng' otwogikyik. Ki wo Shimei komut otwogikyik eng' Gath.
Ye ki kimwachi Solomon keleenji, kokwo Shimei eng' Jerusalem, kwo agoi Gath, ak kogoweek,

ko ki iyookto laitoryat keguur Shimei, ak koleenji ineendet, “Ki ma aleenjin iyasye eng' Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ak ateeun aleenjin, ‘Nai komyee ile, eng' peetuut ne imandoi, ak iwendote eng' oldo age tugul, imee iman?’ Ak ki ileenjo, ‘Myee mwaoniito kaagas.’
Amu nee anyun si meriip kayosyetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ak ng'atuutyet ne ki ang'atiin?”
Ki mwachi kogeny laitoryat Shimei koleenji, “Ingen inyee tengektong'ung' tugul ne mi muguleldang'ung'; ne ki iyachi Daudi abba. Nooto anyun weekyin Kamuktaindet ne Toroor tengektong'ung' meting'ung'.
Ago kiberuuri Laitoryat Solomon, ak ki kimiti koigeny pounatetap laitornatet ne po Daudi eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.”
Ki ng'at anyun laitoryat Benaiah weeriitap Jehoiada; ak kimanda saang' ak kobar ineendet, ak kome anyun. Ak ki kigimit laitornatet eng' eutap Solomon.

Ki yaigei Solomon koek tilyonut ak Pharaoh laitoryatap Misiri, ki itun cheptap Pharaoh ak komut konyo nganaseetap Daudi, kot kogees teekseetap koonnyi, kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ak irimeet ne kiyiem Jerusalem.
Ago kienyei piik tiseiywek eng' komoswek che torooreen, amu ki ma komi ko ne kiga kiteekyi kainetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor agoi peetuusyechooto.
Ki cham `Solomon Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, kowendote ng'atuutigap Daudi kwandanyi; ago kienyei tiseiywek ak kobeelei nyamdutik eng' komoswek che torooreen.
Ki wo `laitoryat Gibeon kwo koeny tiseiywek eng' olooto, amu kitoroor yooto, ole oo; ki igoito Solomon kagoochinoik eliphuut che kibeelei eng' kaptisisyonooto.
Kimong'ji `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Solomon eng' Gibeon eng' karwotitoet kemoi. Ki le Kamuktaindet, “Soom kiit ne imache agoonin.”

Ak ki le Solomon, “Ki iyachi otwogindeng'ung' Daudi abba myeeindo ne oo, ko uu ye kiwendote taing'ung' eng' imanit, ak eng' imanda, ak eng' lititindap muguleldo eng' inyee; ak ki igonorchi ineendet myeini oo, amu ki igoochi ineendet weeriit kotebee ng'echerennyi ne po laitornatet, ko uu ra.

Ak nguno anyun, ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindennyu, ki iyai otwogindeng'ung' koek laitoryat kogeer Daudi abba, ago anee, kota ko aa lakweet ne ming'in; mangen ole amandoitoi ak ole among'undoi.
Ak mi otwogindeng'ung' kwenutap piiguk che ki ilewen, piik che chaang', che ma kimuuchi kiit anan ko kerar amu chaang'indo.
Igoochi anyun otwogindeng'ung' muguleldo ne tinyei kaguiyet si korwookyi piiguk, si kobiit abesyo ne myee ak ne ya; amu ng'oo anyun ne imuuchi korwookyi pororyoning'ung'et tagunoot?”
Ki ibaibai Kiptaiyat ng'olyoondonooto, amu ki soom Solomon kiito.
Ki leenji `Kamuktaindet ineendet, “Amu kaisoom kii, ama isoomjigei isap keny anan mogornatosyek, ama isoom kebar puuniguk, ago kesoomjigei kaguiyet ibesye kirwooget,
nguno anyun ko kaayai ko uu ng'olyoondeng'ung'. Kaagoonin muguleldo ne utaat ak kotinyei kaguiyet; ne ki tomo kobiitu age ne ogerge, ama kobiitu age ne ogerge eng' let.
Kaagoonin agine kiit ne ma isoom, mogornatosyek ak teegisto, ne ma piitu eng' laitorinik ne ogergeitu, eng' peetuusyeguk tugul.
Ngot iwendotee ortinwekyuk, iriip kayomisutikyuk ak ng'atuutikyuk, ko uu ye kiwendotee Daudi kwandang'ung', atesun anyun kochang'a peetuusyeguk.”

Kigos anyun Solomon, ak konai kole kaagaa karwotitoet. Ki nyo Jerusalem, ak kotonon eng' taitap moinget ne po arorutyetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor. Ki igoito kagoochinoik che kibeelei ak kagoochinoigap kaalyeet, ak koyachi igoorto otwogikyik tugul.
Ki pwa anyun ole mi laitoryat `kwonyiik aeng' che ki chepkugonik, kotononio eng' tainnyi.
Ki le kwondo age, “Ee kiptaiyandennyu, ki menye ak kwonyi koot agenge; ki asich lakweet kemi tuwai koyooto.
Ak eng' peetuutap somok ko kaasigisye, kosigiis kwonyi agine. Ki kimi tuwai; ki ma kemi ak too eng' ko, kobatee acheegei aeng' kityo.
Kime lakweetap kwonyi kemoi, amu kisyep.
Ki ng'eet kemoi kween ak komut weeriinnyu eng' ye koami kota konuuchi otwogindeng'ung' ne chepto, ak komogonji tegeennyi, yeityo konde lakweennyi ne kagome tegeennyu.
Ye kanga ng'eet karon ale agoochi lakweet kochuchun, ageer ale kaagaa kagome; ago kanga keer komyee karon, koma weeriinnyu ne kigasich.”
Ago ki le ne po aeng', “Achicha! Ni kogome ko weeriing'ung' ak ni sabei ko weeriinnyu.” Kitiiyo ko uu nooto anyun eng' taitap laitoryat.
Ki le anyun laitoryat: Mwaei ni kole, “Weeriinnyu ni sabei, ak weeriing'ung' ni kogome; koleen age, ‘Achicha! Kogome weeriing'ung', weeriinnyu ni sabei.’ ”
Ki le anyun laitoryat, “Oibwa rotwetap chok!” Ak ki kiipchi laitoryat rotwetap chok.
Yeityo kole laitoryat, “Opcheune aeng' lakweet ne sabei, si ogoochi kebeber kwondo age, ogoochi kebeber kwondo age.”

Ki ng'alaalji kwondo ne ki nenyi lakweet ne sabei, laitoryat, amu ki riir moo agobo weeriinnyi, kole, “Ee kiptaiyandennyu, igoochi ineendet lakwani sabei, amat ibar!” Ago ki le age, “Mabunjino, ama punjinin; pchei.”
Ki wol anyun laitoryat kole, “Ogoochi ne po tai lakwani sabei, matobar, amu ineendet ko kamennyi.”
Ki kas Israel tugul kirwooget ne ki irwooch laitoryat; ak ki iywei laitoryat, amu ki keer kole mi utaatyetap Kamuktaindet eng' ineendet, si kobiit korwooch.
Ki Laitoryat Solomon ne ki pou Israel tugul,
ak chu ko ki pounik che ki tinyei ineendet: Azariah, weeriitap Zadok ko kitisiindet.
Eliorep ak Ahija weeriigap Shisha ko ki Siriik; Jehoshaphat weeriitap Ahilud ko ki siriindetap tuguuk che piitu.
Ki pou lugeet Benaiah weeriitap Jehoiada; Zadok ak Abiathar ko kitisiik.
Azariah weeriitap Nathan, ko ki pou kiptainik; tisiindet Zabud weeriitap Nathan, ko ki ek ineendet chorweetap laitoryat.
Ki pou Ahishar kootap laitoryat; ak ki pou Adoniram weeriitap Abda aisuruut.
Ki tinyei Solomon kiptainik taman ak aeng' che ki pou Israel tugul, che ki ipchin laitoryat amitwogik kobooto koonnyi. Ki king'at koip chii age tugul amitwogik eng' arawet eng' kenyiit.
Chu kainaikwak: Ben-Hur, eng' emetap tuloonoogap Ephraim.
Ben-Deker, eng' Makaz, Saalbim, Beth-shemesh ak Elon-beth-hanam.
Ben-Hesed, eng' Arubboth; ki nenyi Soko, ak emet tugul ne po Hepher.
Ben-Abinadab, eng' Napat-dor tugul; ki itun Tapat cheptap Solomon.
Baanah weeriitap Ahilud, eng' Taanak ak Megiddo, Beth-shean tugul ne neegitee Zarethan, ne mi atebweetap Jezreel, kobooch Beth-shean agoi Abel-meolah, kot koit pitetap Jokmeam.

Ben-Geber, eng' Ramoth-gilead; ki chechiik nganasoogap Jair weeriitap Manasseh, che miitei Gilead; ki nenyi agine kooretap Argob, ne mi Bashan, nganasook che eecheen tamanwogik lo che tinyei irimoik ak temeleiywegap sugunonik.
Ainadap weeriitap Ido, eng' Mahanaim.
Ahimaaz, eng' Naphtali; ki itun agine Basemath cheptap Solomon.
Baanah weeriitap Hushi eng' Asher ak Bealoth.
Jehoshaphat weeriitap Paruah, eng' Issakar.
Shimei weeriitap Elah, eng' Benjamin.
Geber weeriitap Uri, eng' emetap Gilead, kooretap Sihon laitoryatap Amorik ak ne po Og laitoryatap Bashan; ak ki kiptaiyat ineegei ne ki mi emonooto.
Ki chaang' Judah ak Israel, ko uu ng'aniek che mi nyanjet eng' chaang'indo, ki amisyei icheek ak koeisei ak koboiboegei.
Ki laitorane Solomon laitornatosyek tugul kobooch aineet agoi emetap Philistik, agoi kiwotetap Misiri. Ki ibu kagoochinoik, ak kootei Solomon eng' peetuusyek tugul che po sabeennyi.
Ak amitwogigap Solomon che po peetuut agenge ko ki keruutik pogol lo che po peek che ng'ootiin che tambulul che po nganuuk, ak keruutik eliphuut agenge pogol ang'wan che po peek che ng'ootiin;
eiik taman che akwaen, eiik tiptem che kigetune akwotisyek, keechiirek pogol, koma pooto teweretinik, cheptirgichik, tyong'ik che uu chemnyogosonik ak ngogaik che akwaen.
Amu ki pou kooret tugul ne po aineet Yufrets, Tiphsah agoi Gaza, kiboi laitorinik tugul che mi aineet komosi. Ki chamdos ak piik che ki mi komoswekyik tugul.
Ki meng'iis Judah ak Israel eng' chametapkei, ki tebee chii tugul kelutap keetinnyi ne po sabibuk, ak mogoywennyi, kobooch Dan agoi Beer-sheba, eng' peetuusyek tugul che po Solomon.
Ki tinyei Solomon kooriik eliphuusyek artam che po paraisisyegap kariisyekyik, piik eliphuusyek taman ak aeng' che ketei paraisisyek.
Ki ipchi `kiptainichooto Laitoryat Solomon amitwogik, kobooto tugul che ki amisye meesetap Laitoryat Solomon, ki ipchi chii tugul eng' arawennyi; ma kany korarchi kiy.
Ki ipchi baale ak icheek ak mobeek che po paraisisyek ak tyong'ik che chepcheben koip kobwa ole mi kiptainik, chii tugul ko uu ye ki king'at.
Ki igoochi `Kamuktaindet Solomon utaatyet, naet ne oo miising' ak kaguiyet ko uu ng'aniek che mi ngeguutap nyanjet.
Ki siir utaatyetap Solomon ng'omnatetap piik tugul che po kong'asiis, ak ng'omnateet tugul ne po Misiri.
Amu king'oom kosiir piik tugul; kosiir Ethan Ezraindet, Herman, Chalkol, Darda, weeriitap Mahol. Ki yom tagunatennyi pororyosyek tugul che kiga yiem ineendet.
Ki toi ineendet kalewenaik eliphuusyek somok ak tyenwogikyik eliphuut ak muut.
Ki ng'alaal agobo keetiik, kobooch taragonik che mi Lebanon agoi husop che piitos eng' inaatut. Ki ng'alaal kogeny agobo tyong'ik, toriitik, tuguuk che ichuutegei ng'wony ak njireenik.
Ki pwa piik eng' pororyosyek tugul kogas utaatyetap Solomon, kobun kaplaitorinik tugul che po ng'wony, che kiga kas agobo ng'omnatennyi.
Ki iyookto Hiram laitoryatap Tyro otwogikyik koba kap Solomon, ye kingo kagogas keele ki kiil ineendet koek laitoryat kogeer kwandanyi ak amu ki chamei Hiram Daudi eng' peetuusyek tugul.
Ki iyookto `Solomon piik koba kap Hiram koleenji,

“Ingen ile ki ma imuuch abba Daudi koteekyi koot kainetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindennyi amu lugoosyek che kiga yiem ineendet, che ki mi komoswek tugul, kot konde `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor icheek keldebesaigap keelyekyik.
Ago nguno ko kogogoono Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindennyu kamuung'et eng' komosta age tugul; ma mi puunyoot anan ko kiy ne ya ne piitu.

Ara kaabegechi ateekyi koot kainetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindennyu, ko uu ye ki mwachi `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor abba Daudi, koleenji, ‘Tuun teekyin kainennyu koot weeriing'ung' ne tuun andoi kotebee ng'echerennyu ne po laitornatet, kogeerin.’

Ko uu nooto ng'at anyun keebwa keetiigap taragonik eng' Lebanon. Ingobois otwogikyuk ak otwogiguk, ak agoonin melektap otwogiguk che kemwa; ko uu ye ingen inyee ile ma mi chii eng' acheek ne ingen koep keetiik ko uu Sidonik.”
Kingo kas Hiram ng'aleegap Solomon, kobaibait miising' ak kole, “Ingilas Kamuktaindet ne Toroor rani, ne ki igoochi Daudi weeriit ne utaat koboi pororyoni oo.”
Ki iyookto `Hiram piik koba kap Solomon koleenji, “Kaagas ng'aleek che keyokwo, ayae ko uu mageng'ung' tugul agobo pagoinigap taragonik ak pagoinigap piribiryet.

Ibu otwogikyuk kochoorgei eng' Lebanon kobwa nyanjetap Mediterenian; ak aratyine si koba kobun nyanjet kot koit ole imwaiwo, ak amwaite kityaach eng' yooto, si inyoo iip. Ak isuldaiwo magennyu igoochi amitwogik piigap koonnyu.”
Ki igoochi anyun `Hiram Solomon pagoinigap taragonik ak pagoinigap piribirinik, ko uu che tee che kimache.

Ki igoochi `Solomon Hiram keruutik eliphuusyek tiptem che po nganuuk koek amitwogigap koonnyi, ak keruutik tiptem che po mwanik che tiliileen. Ki igoochi anyun `Solomon Hiram ko uu nooto kenyiit age tugul.
Ki igoochi `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Solomon utaatyet, ko uu ye ki iarorchi. Ki mi kaalyeet eng' kwenutap Hiram ak Solomon; ak ki yai tuwai arorutyet.
Ki ng'at Solomon kekwei piik eng' Israel tugul; ki ek pichooto tugul eliphuusyek sosom.
Ki iyookto koba Lebanon, piik eliphuusyek taman eng' arawet age tugul kochunjun; kimi Lebanon arawet agenge, komi kaa eng' arawek aeng'. Ki pou Adoniram pichooto.
Ki tinyei kora Solomon piik eliphuusyek tamanwogik tisap che kilaisei, ak eliphuusyek tamanwogik sisiit che kiebisyei eng' tuloonook,
koma pooto kiptainik che eecheen eliphuusyek somok ak pogol somok che po Solomon che ki indochin poisyet ak ko ki pou piik che kiyaei poisyonooto.
Ki ng'at anyun laitoryat, ak kiwai icheek koik che eecheen, che po kamanuutyet ne oo, koek che tonone koot kobooto koik che ki kiwai.
Ki yai koichooto teegigap Solomon ak teegigap Hiram ak Gebalik ak ki chop pagoinik ak koik koteege koot.

Ak kingo pata kenyiisyek pogol ang'wanu ak tamanwogik sisiit kobooch ngap kobwa Israel komong' eng' emetap Misiri, eng' kenyiit ne po ang'wan ne po laitornatetap Solomon ne ki pou Israel, eng' arawetap Ziph, nooto arawet ne po aeng', kotoi koteech kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ak koot ne kiteekyi `laitoryat Solomon Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ko ki koindonyi ko mitainik tiptem ak tisap, tebeesindo ko ki mitainik sogool ak kooindap tononennyi ko ki mitainik taman ak somok.
Ki ek kooindap keterut ole kimandoe kebendi ko eng' taitap Hekaluut mitainik ang'wan ak kebeberyat, ko uu tebeesindap koot; ki ek mitainik sogool tebeesindanyi eng' taitap koot.
Ki yachi koot tirisyok che ki kiyai kong'walng'walgei.

Ki teech kooriik alak che mi parak eng' koot, koyiem inaatutap koot, konamatkei ak inatusyegap koot eng' komoswek tugul, eng' Hekaluut ak koot ne po oriit; ak ki teech kooriik alak che mi koot taban eng' komoswek tugul.

Ki ek tebeesindap koot ne po ng'wony mitainik aeng' ak robo, ak ki ek tebeesindap koot ne po kwenut mitainik aeng' ak robo somok, ak ki ek tebeesindap koot ne po somok mitainik somok. Amu ki teech kiit ne uu mireiywot kotobon saang' eng' inaatutap koot eng' komoswek tugul, si ma namgei keetiik ak inatusyegap koot.

Kingeteechei koyooto ko ki kiteege koik che kiga kechop eng' ole kibaale. Ki ma komi cheetap kiriswet anan ko ne po aiywet anan ko ne po karna age tugul ne kiboisyee, ne ki kigas eng' koyooto keteechei.
Ki mi komostap tai kurgeetap kooriik che po kwenut ne po koot: ki kitogostae lang'eiywot ne ki ing'atkei kot koit kooriik che po kwenut, ak kong'etee che po kwenut agoi che po somok.
Ki teech anyun koot ak ki iges; ak kitetee koot pambanik ak kosyebee pagoinigap taragonik.
Ki teech kooriik che po parak konamatkei ak koot tugul, ki po age tugul mitainik aeng' ak robo kwo parak; ak kitonone koot kimurtoinigap taragonik.
Ki nyoonji `ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Solomon koleenji,
“Eng' kooi iteeche, ko ngot iwendotee kaneetisyosyekyuk, ak iyai kirwoogutikyuk, ak iriip ng'atuutikyuk tugul iwendote, agimiit anyun ng'olyoondennyu eng' inyee, ne ki amwachi Daudi kwandang'ung'.
Ak amenye kwenutap piigap Israel, amametoi piikyuk Israel.”
Ki teech anyun Solomon koot ak ki iges.
Ki teech inatusyegap koot che po oriit eng' pagoinigap taragonik; kobooch koot ng'wony kot koit inatusyegap tabotet, koliige keetiik ole po oriit; ak kitetee koot ng'wony pagoinigap piribirinik.
Ki teech mitainik sogool eng' komosta ne po let ne po koot eng' pagoinigap taragonik kobooch ng'wony agoi inatusyek. Kiteege chooto oriit, koek koot ne po oriit, nooto ko ole-tiliil miising'.
Ak kooindap koot, nooto ko Hekaluut ne mi tai, ko ki mitainik taman ak ang'wan.
Ki kilige koot oriit taragonik che ki kiwai kosich mulonok ak taaptook che yesyotiin. Ki po tugul taragonik, ki ma komi koita ne kitaagu.
Ki chop koot ne po oriit eng' kwenutap koot oriit, si konde yooto moingetap arorutyetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.

Kigoindap koyooto po oriit ko mitainik sogool, tebeesindo kogi mitaisyek sogool ak koindo ne po tononennyi ko mitainik sogool; ak ki iliige thahabu che tiliileen. Ki iliige kora kapkorosuut taragonik.
Ki iliige koot oriit thahabu che tiliileen; ak ki rat sirimwegap thahabu kobun taitap koyooto po oriit; ak ki iliige thahabu.
Ki iliige koot komugul thahabu, kot kogeskei koot tugul. Ki iliige agine thahabu kapkorosuut komugul ne po koyooto po oriit.
Ki yai kerubisyek aeng' che po keetiigap mseituni eng' ole-tiliil, ne age tugul ko mitainik ang'wan ak kebeberyat kwo parak.
Ki mitainik aeng' ak robo kebepchet agenge ne po kerubit; ki mitainik aeng' ak robo kebepchet age, koboochin walitap kebepchet age agoi walitap kebepchet age ko ki mitainik ang'wan ak kebeberyat.
Ak ki mitainik ang'wan kerubit age: ki aechin eng' kakwaet kerubisyechooto tuwai ak ki kergei.
Kigoindap tononetap kerubit age ko ki mitainik ang'wan ak kebeberyat, ak ki uu nooto che po kerubit age.

Ki inde kerubisyechooto koot ne po oriit: kiga iitagei kebebaigap kerubisyechooto kot kotiiny kebepchetap age inaatut age, ak kitiiny kebepchet age inaatut age, ak kitiinygei kebebaikwak eng' kwenutap koot.
Ak ki iliige kerubisyechooto thahabu.
Ki wai inatusyek tugul che po koot komoswek tugul, eng' kerubisyek che ki kiwaat ak tiironigap sosik ak taaptook che yesyotiin eng' ko oriit ak saang'.
Ki iliige thahabu ng'wonyutap koot oriit ak saang'.
Ki yachi kereiywegap kurgotik che po keetiigap mseituni, ole kibunei kebendi koot ne po oriit. Ki kebeberta agenge eng' muut rateiywotap tugatuk kobooto tugatugik.

Ki yai anyun kereiywek aeng' che po mseituni; ak ki wai itoonwegap kerubisyek ak che po tiironigap sosik ak che po taaptook che yesyotiin eng' kurgotichooto, ak koliige thahabu, ak kotuge thahabu kerubisyechooto ak tiironigap sosik.
Ki yachi ko uu nooto ole kichutei kebendi Hekaluut, tugatugigap keetiigap mseituni, koek kebeberta agenge eng' ang'wan ne po inaatut,
ak ki yai kereiywek aeng' che po kurgotik che po piribirinik; ki arung'oksei kebeberwek aeng' che po kereiywot agenge, ak ki arung'oksei kebeberwek aeng'u che po kereiywot age.
Ki wai eng' chooto itoonwegap kerubisyek ak che po tiironigap sosik ak che po taaptook che yesyotiin, ak ki iliige thahabu che ki kibirchi konamgei ak wautichooto.
Kiteege seremut ne po oriit koik che ki kiwai, ortinwek somok, ak ooreet agenge ne po keetiigap taragonik.
Ki kilumei koot ne po Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' kenyiit ne po ang'wan, eng' arawetap Ziph.

Ki igeskei koot kobooto kebeberwekyik tugul eng' kenyiitap taman ak agenge eng' arawetap Bul, nooto ko arawetap sisiit, ak ko uu tugul che kiga king'at agobo koyooto. Ki teech anyun koyooto eng' kenyiisyek tisap.
Ki teech Solomon koonnyi ne po laitornatet ak ki tar kenyiisyek taman ak somok si kogees.

Amu ki teech kootap timdap Lebanon; koindonyi ko ki mitainik artam ak ang'wan ak kebeberyat, tebeesindanyi ko ki mitainik tiptem ak aeng' ak robo, ak koindo ne po tononennyi ko ki mitainik taman ak somok ak kebeberyat, kimi tolochik eng' ortinwek ang'wan, che po taragonik ak ki kimure paragutap tolochichooto pambanik che po taragonik.
Ki kisyebe parak taragonik eng' pambanichooto artam ak muut, che ki mi tolochik parak, che kiga kitet koek taman ak muut eng' ooreet agenge.
Ki mi tirisyok eng' ortinwek somok, che kiga tokyin eng' ortinwek somok, che kiga tebee age paragutap age.
Ak ki aechin komoswek tugul eng' kurgotik ak tugatugik, ak kiga tokyin tirisyosyek eng' ortinwek somok.

Ki yai keterut ne po tolochik; koindonyi ko ki mitainik tiptem ak aeng' ak robo, tebeesindanyi ko ki mitainik taman ak somok ak kebeberyat. Ak keterut ne ki mi tainnywa; ak tolochik ak pambanik che nyigiisen che ki kimur che ki mi tainnywa.
Ki teech koot ne uu keterut ole tebee ng'echereetap laitornatet ole ki irwoge, nooto ko kapkirwook. Kitetee taragonik kong'etee koot ng'wony agoi tabuut.
Ak koonnyi ne ki menyei, seremut ne ki mi keter oriit, ko ki po poisyet ne uu nooto. Kiteekyi koot agine cheptap Pharaoh, (ne kiga itun Solomon,) kogergeit ak keterunooto kiga teech.

Kitegee chuuto tugul koik che po kamanuutyet ne oo, koik che ki kiwai, ko uu karagendaet, che ki kitile musumenosyek, oriit ak saang', kobooch lumeiywot kot koit parak, ak ki uu nooto agine saang' kot koit seremut ne oo.
Ki koik che po kamanuutyet ne oo che kitonone kot, koik che eecheen, koindonyi ko ki mitainik somok ak nusu, ak tebeesindannyi ko ki mitainik ang'wan ak nusu.
Ak kimi paragunnywa koik che po kamanuutyet ne oo, koik che ki kiwai, ko uu karagendoet, ak keetiigap taragonik.

Ki tinyei seremut ne oo koik che ki king'ote che ki kiwai che ki sooniot somok, ak ooreet ne po pambanik che po taragonik; ko uu seremutap oriit ne po kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ak keterutap koot.
Ki iyookto Laitoryat Solomon kimut Hiram eng' Tyro.

Ki weeriitap mosoget ne po ooreetap Naphtali, ak kwandanyi ko ki chiitap Tyro, kitang'indetap sugononik; ak ki tinyei ng'omnateet ne oo, ak kaguiyet, ak naetap musoknateet, ne yaei poisyonik tugul che po sugunonik. Ak ki nyo kaplaitoryat Solomon, ak ki yai poisyennyi tugul.
Ki yai tolochik aeng' che po sugunonik ne ki tinyei age tugul mitainik ang'wan kwo parak ak ki mitainik muut ak kebeberyat nyigiisindap tolochichooto ngeyiem.
Ki yai metowek aeng' che po sugunonik che ki kibeel kochootyo, si konde walisyegap tolochichooto; kooindap tononetap metit age tugul ko ki mitainik aeng' ak robo.
Ki mi kariik che regerotiin, ak tuguuk che uu nyororosyek che ki king'walng'walat, che ki po metowek che ki mi paragutap tolochik; ki tisap che po metit age tugul.
Ki yai anyun tolochik, ak kimi ortinwek aeng' che kiyiem paragutap karichooto regerotiin, ketuge metowek che ki mi paragutap tolochik. Ki yachi metit age ko uu nooto.
Ak ki po mitait agenge ak robo somok metowek che ki miitei paragutap tolochik eng' keter, che ki kilelesanjine itoonwegap taaptook.

Ki mi metowek paragutap tolochichooto aeng' ak icheek, ole neegitee mulwet, ne ki mi ole neegitee karichooto regerotiin. Ki mi ak itoonwegap logoek ko ki pogol aeng', che kiyiem metoto age eng' ortinwek.
Ak ki lumda tolochik eng' keterutap Hekaluut: ki lumda toloito ne po komostap tai, ak koguuree kainennyi Jakin, ak ki lumda toloita ne po komostap kaataam, ak koguuree kainennyi Boaz.
Ki mi itoonwegap taaptook paragutap tolochichooto. Ki igeskei anyun poisyetap tolochik.

Ki yai nyanjet ne kitanyi, ne po mitainik ang'wan ak nusu kong'etee taban agoi taban, ne ki kitainganat, ak ki mitainik aeng' ak robo koindo ne po tononennyi: ak kimi mireiywot ne po mitainik taman ak somok ak nusu.
Ki mi mulonok ng'wonyutap mireiywot che kiyiem kotuiyo, che po mitainik taman ak somok ak nusu, che kiyieme nyanjanooto: kisoniot aeng' mulonochooto, che ki kiyaei ye ki ngeyaei nyanjanooto.

Kiga tonone nyanjanooto itoonwegap eiik taman ak aeng', kigeerei somogu murot kaataam, kogeerei somogu cherongo, kogeerei somogu murot tai, kogeerei somogu kong'asiis. Kitonone paragunnywa nyanjanooto ak ki keer sugulumwekwak oriit.

Tebeesindanyi ak nyigiisindanyi ko ki sendi mitainik tisap ak nusu; ak ki kiyai mireiywondennyi kogergeit ak mireiywotap kigombet, ko uu taapteet ne kaiye. Kiyamegei ak peegap litaisyek eliphuusyek artam.

Ki yai ng'echerok taman che po sugunonik che tebee; ki mitait agenge ak robo somok kooindap ng'echereet agenge, ak ki mitait agenge ak robo somok tebeesindanyi, ak ki mitait agenge ak robo somok kooindap tononennyi.
Ki uu ni poisyetap ng'echerochooto: ki tinyei tegeleiywek, ak kimi tegeleiywek kwenutap tuguuk che uu marugut,

ak eng' tegeleiywechooto kimi kwenutap tuguuchooto uu marugut ko ki mi itoonwegap ng'etuunyik, eiik, ak kerubisyek; ak eng' paragutap tuguuchooto uu marugut ko ki mi kiit ne uu ng'echereet paragunnyi. Eng' ng'wonyutap ng'etuunyik ak eiik kogimitei tuguuchooto ki king'walng'walat kosongininso.

Ki tinyei ng'echereet age tugul keelyek ang'wan che uu tirook, ak kimurtoinigap sugunonik che namei tirook. Ki tinyei tiroochooto ang'wan kariik che tiyei: ak kimi karichooto kitiie, che ki kitany, kurereetap tereet, komi tabandap age tugul tuguuchooto ki king'walng'wal.

Ak ki kakwautyet agenge ne po eut kutinnyi eng' oriit ne po metit ak eng' parak. Ak kitainganak kutinnyi, ko uu ole ki kiyaita ng'echereet ne tebee, ki sendi mitainik tamanwogik tisap; ak kimi wautik paragutap kutinnyi agine, ak ki aechin komoswekwak tugul eng' koindo, ki ma ko tainganat.
Ki mi kurereetap tegeleiywechooto tiroochooto ang'wanu, ak kimi kimurtoinichooto namei keelyek ole po keel. Ak kooindap tononetap tireet ko ki mitainik tamanwogik tisap ak muut.

Ak ki uu yaetap tiroochooto yaetap keelyegap chepkichutit: kimurtoinikwak, ak tirookwak icheeget, ak kariik che ituitos tireet ak kungit eng' kwenut, ak kungit ineendet eng' kwenut, ko ki kitanyi chooto tugul.
Ki mi kariik ang'wanu che kitiiei eng' luukwek ang'wan che po ng'echereet age tugul. Kinamgei ak ng'echereet kariikyik che ki kitiye.

Ki mi paragutap ng'echereet tegeleiywot ne ki kayiem kotuiyo, ne ki koindap tononennyi ko sendimita tamanwogik tisap ak muut. Ki kanamgei ko uu nooto tiyeiywekyik ak tegeleiywekyik eng' paragutap ng'echereet.

Ki wai itoonwegap kerubisyek ak ng'etuunyik ak tiironigap sosik eng' sanisyegap tiyeiywekyik ak eng' tegeleiywekyik, ko uu poroindo ne po age tugul, kobooto kariik che ki king'walng'wal, che kiga yiem.
Ki yai ko uu nooto ng'echerochooto taman: ki kiyai chooto tugul kogergeit ak ki aechin tugul eng' yaeet.

Ki yai taabook taman che po sugononik, agenge eng' chepkichutit age tugul. Ki tebeesindap taabeet age tugul ko mitait agenge ak robo somok, kiyamei taabeet agenge peegap litaisyek pogol sisiit ak tamanwogik sisiit ak ki tebee taabeet age tugul ng'echereet.
Ki itepto ng'echerok, kotebee muutu komostap tai ne po koot, kotebee muutu komostap kaataam ne po koot. Ki inde nyanjanooto komostap tai ne po koot kogeer kong'asiis, ne po murot tai.
Ki yai Hiram taabook, kechigosyek ak taabook che mengeechen. Ki iges anyun Hiram poisyet tugul ne ki yachi Laitoryat Solomon eng' kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor:
tolochik aeng', taabook aeng' che po metowek che ki mi paragutap tolochichooto; karichooto aeng' regerotiin kotuch tabochooto aeng' che ki mi paragutap tolochik;

itoonwegap logoek pogol ang'wan che po karichooto aeng' regerotiin; ortinwek aeng' che po logoek che po karnet age tugul ne ki kireger, kotuch pagulisyechooto aeng' po metowek che ki mi paragutap tolochik;
ng'echerok taman, ak taabookwak taman che ki mi ng'echerochooto;
ak nyanjanooto agenge ak itoonwegap eiik che ki mi kurereetap nyanjanooto;
tereenik, kechigosyek che eecheen, ak taabook che mengech. Ak tuguuchooto tugul che ki yachi Hiram Laitoryat Solomon, eng' kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ko ki po sugunonik che sitatiin.
Ki yai laitoryat tuguuchooto eng' atebweetap Jordan, eng' ole mi meneet eng' kwenutap Sukoth ak Zarethan.
Ki pagaakta Solomon karichooto tugul, ama kipiman, amu ki chaang' miising' kot ak ma imuuch chii konai nyigiisindap sugunonik.
Ki yai Solomon tuguuk tugul che ki mi kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor: kapkorosutap thahabu, meesetap thahabu ne ki tebee magatiinik che itabaanatiin,
keelyegap taisyek, kimi muutu komostap tai, komi muutu komostap kaataam eng' taitap koot ne po oriit, ki po thahabu che tiliileen, ak taaptook, ak taisyek ak kanameiywek, ki po thahabu;

kigombok, magasisyek che kitile ole lalei eng' taisyek, taabook che mengeechen, kechigosyek, tereenik che ki ibe maat, ki po thahabu che tiliileen; kobooto kariik che namei kereiywotap kurgeet, che po kereiywegap kurgotigap koot ne po oriit, ole-tiliil miising', ak che po kurgotigap koot, nooto ko Hekaluut, ki po thahabu.

Ki igeskei anyun poisyet tugul ne ki yai Laitoryat Solomon eng' kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor. Yeityo koip Solomon tuguuk che kiga kotabaan Daudi kwandanyi, kobwa ko, fedha, thahabu ak tuguuk che kiboisyee ak konde ole kindoi konoraik eng' kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.

Ki iyum anyun `Solomon poisyek che po Israel, kandoik tugul che po ortinwek ak pounigap kwanisyegap piigap Israel kobwa ole mi Laitoryat Solomon eng' Jerusalem, koip moingetap arorutyetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kotogos eng' nganaseetap Daudi, ne nooto ko Zion.
Ki iyumgei piik tugul che po Israel eng' ole kimi Laitoryat Solomon eng' igoorto, eng' arawetap Etanim, ne arawetap tisap.
Ki pwa poisyek tugul che po Israel ak kiganop tisiik moinget.
Ki ip Tisiik ak Lawiik moingetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, emait ne kituiyechin, ak tereenik tugul che tiliileen che ki mi Emait Lawiik.
Ki pwa koyumgei eng' taitap moinget, Laitoryat Solomon ak tuiyet tugul ne po Israel ak koeny keechiirek ak eiik, che chaang' che ma ki ma kimuuchi kiit.
Ki ip tisiik moingetap arorutyet ne po Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, konyo ole tebee eng' koot oriit ole-tiliil eng' ye Tiliil Miising', kurereetap kebebaigap kerubisyek.
Amu kiga iito kerubisyek kebebaikwak kouur ole mi moinget, ak ki tuch kerubisyek moinget ak keetiikyik che ki ibe.
Kigooen keetichooto miising'; ak kitaagu walisyekwak eng' ole-tiliil eng' taitap koot ne po oriit; ago ki ma ko taagu eng' saang'. Mi yooto agoi ra.
Ki ma komi kiy moingonooto oriit kobatee koik aeng' che lebeleen che ki indoi Musa eng' Horeb, ye kingo yai Kamuktaindet ne Toroor arorutyet ak piigap Israel, ye ki mong'u eng' emetap Misiri.
Kingo mong' tisiik eng' ole-tiliil, konyi pooldet kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor,
kotko mata komuuch tisiik kobois amu pooldet; amu ki nyi kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor liilindap toroornatennyi.
Kong'alaal anyun Solomon kole, “Ki le Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, menyei ineendet mesundeito ne oo.
Kaateegun iman koot ne imenye, komostang'ung' ne imenye koigeny.”
Kiwelelgei laitoryat, ak koberuur tuiyet tugul ne po Israel, ak kitononso tuiyet tugul ne po Israel.
Ak ki le, “Iberuurot Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindetap Israel, ne ki ng'alaalji eng' kutinnyi Daudi abba, ak kagosulda eng' eunekyik kole,

‘Kobooch peetuut ne ki amutu piikyuk Israel komong' eng' Misiri, koma alewen nganas eng' ortinwek tugul che po Israel ateech koot, si kobiit kotebee yooto kainennyu; ago ki alewen Daudi koboi piikyuk Israel.’
Ki mi muguleldap abba Daudi kole koteekyi koot kainetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindetap Israel.
Ago ki leenji Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kwandanyu Daudi, ‘Amu kimi muguleldang'ung' iteekyi koot kainennyu, ko ki iyai kiit ne myee ibwaat ko uu nooto eng' muguleldang'ung'.
Ago ma inyee ne teechei koyooto; ago weeriing'ung' ne mang'une poortang'ung', ineendet ne teekyin kainennyu koot.’

Ak kagogimiit Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ng'olyoondennyi ne ki mwa; amu ki abiitu ageer kwandanyu Daudi, ak atebee ng'echereetap laitornatet ne po Israel, ko uu ye ki iyomis Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ak koateekyi koot kainetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindetap Israel.
Koachop eng' yooto ole tebee moinget, ne mi arorutyetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor oriit, ne ki yai ak kwanisyekyok, ye ki imutu komong' eng' emetap Misiri.”
Ki tonon Solomon eng' taitap kaptisisyetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' taitap tuiyet tugul ne po Israel, ak kochuul eunekyik kotokyi kipsengwet,

ak ki le, “Ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindetap Israel, ma mi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor age ne uu inyee, eng' parak kipsengwet, anan eng' ng'wony oriit; ne riibei kayomiset ak rireenet eng' otwogiguk, che pendote taing'ung' eng' mugulelwekwak tugul.
Ki isuldochi otwogindeng'ung' abba Daudi kiit ne kigeyomisyi ineendet; ee, ki imwa eng' kuting'ung', ak kaiyai eng' eung'ung' kosulda, ko uu kiit ne uu rani.

Ara anyun, ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindetap Israel, isuldochi otwogindeng'ung' abba Daudi kiit ne ki iyomisyi, ileenji, ‘Ma petenen chiito ne tebee ng'echereetap laitornatet ne po Israel eng' tainnyu; ngot koriip lagoguk ortinwekwak, kobendatee tainnyu ko uu ye ki iwendote tainnyu.’
Ara anyun, ee Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindetap Israel, asaain ale ingogimiit ng'olyoondeng'ung', ne ki imwachi otwogindeng'ung' abba Daudi.
“Ago tos meny Kamuktaindet ng'wony iman? Keero, ma yamin kipsengwet itebee, anan kipsengwet ne po parak miising', ko ming'in ne tya anyun kooi koateech!
Ago konyit saaetap otwogindeng'ung' ak soomennyi, kas, ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindennyu, riirek ak saaet ne saaei otwogindeng'ung' eng' taing'ung' rani.
Ingogeer konyeguk kooi kemoi ak peet, kogeer komosta ne ki imwa ile, ‘Tebee yooto kainennyu’; si igas saaet ne saaei otwogindeng'ung' kotokyingei komosita.
Kas soometap otwogindeng'ung', ak piiguk Israel, ye saaei kotokyingei yuto. Kas anyun eng' kipsengwet oldang'ung' ole imenye; ak ye igas, inyochigaat.
“Ngot koleelji chii chiitap kokwennyi, ak kebirchi ineendet koyasyo, konyo koyasyo eng' taitap kaptisisyeng'ung' eng' kooi,
igas anyun eng' kipsengwet, ak iyai, irwooksechi otwogiguk, igikyi ineendet ne kalel, si inde kotebee metinnyi ortinwekyik. Iityi imanda ineendet ne po iman, igoochi ineendet ko uu imandanyi.
“Ye kibar piiguk Israel eng' taitap puunik, amu ki koyaun tengekto; ngot koweekyingei kogeny, ak kong'aany kaineng'ung', ak kosa, ak koriirchin eng' kooi,
igas anyun eng' kipsengwet, ak inyochi kaat piiguk Israel eng' tengektonywa, ak imutu icheek kogeny kobwa emet ne ki igoochi kwanisyekwak.
“Ye kerak kipsengwet, ak kobet ropta, amu ki koyaun tengekto, ko ngot kosa kotokyigei komosi, kong'aany kaineng'ung' ak koweek eng' tengektonywa, ye inyaliil icheek,

igas anyun eng' kipsengwet, ak inyochi kaat otwogiguk, eng' tengektonywa ak ne po piiguk Israel, ye ineeti icheek ooreet ne myee ne nyolu kobendatee; iyookyi ropta emeng'ung', ne ki igoochi piiguk koek porotennywa.

“Ngot kobiit rubeet eng' emet, anan ko koroito, ngot kobiit chelalityet anan ko uchatet, chereng'endet anan ko kutyet; ngot koyiem icheek puunikwak eng' emetap nganasookwak; koroito age tugul anan komi myando age tugul ne piitu,
ngo ip saaet anan ko soomet age tugul ne kasoom chii age tugul, anan ko ne kasoom piiguk tugul che po Israel, ne naei chii age tugul myandap muguleldanyi, ak kochuul eunekyik kotokyi kooi,

igas anyun eng' kipsengwet oldang'ung' ole imenye, ak inyochi kaat, iyai ak iyaakyi chii age tugul ko uu ortinwekyik tugul, ne ineegei muguleldanyi (amu inyee inyegei ne ingen mugulelwegap weeriigap piik);
si kobiit koiywein peetuusyek tugul komenyei emet ne ki igoochi kwanisyekyok.
“Ko uu nooto chiito ne po pororyosyek, ne ma po piiguk Israel, ngo nyo eng' emet ne loo agobo kaineng'ung',
(amu tuun kasei icheek agobo kaineng'ung' ne oo, ak agobo eung'ung' ne kiim, eung'ung' ne chuulaat;) ye nyo ak kosa kotokyigei kooi,

igas eng' kipsengwet oldang'ung' ole imenye, ak iyai ko uu tuguuk tugul che kaguurchin chiichooto po pororyosyek; si kobiit konai kaineng'ung' piik tugul che po ng'wony, koiywein, ko uu ye iywein piiguk Israel, ak si kobiit konai kole kooi ki ateech kemwaitoe kaineng'ung'.
“Ngot koba piiguk kobargei ak puunikwak, eng' ooreet age tugul ne keyooktoe, ak kosa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kotokyigei nganasani ki ilewen, kotokyigei kooi koateekyi kaineng'ung',
igas anyun eng' kipsengwet saaennywa ak soomennywa, ak iyachi icheek kiit ne machei.
“Ngot koyaun tengek, (amu ma mi chii ne ma yaei tengek,) ak inereekyi, igoochi icheek eunegap puunikwak, koluul icheek komut koba emetap puunik, ngot ko loo anan ko neegit,
ago ngot kobwaatkei eng' emet ne ki kimut koek luulenik, ak kosik, koriirchin eng' emetap piik che ki imut icheek koluul, kole, ‘Kigeyai tengekto, ki keyai kiit ne imaasat, ki keyai kiit ne ya kot’;

ngot koweegiyigei eng' mugulelwekwak tugul ak eng' saboonwekwak tugul, eng' emetap puunikwak che kiluul icheek, ak kosaain kotokyigei emennywa, ne ki igoochi kwanisyekwak, nganaseet ne ki ilewen, ak koot ne ki ateekyi kaineng'ung',
igas anyun saaennywa ak soomennywa eng' kipsengwet oldang'ung' ole imenye ak iyachi icheek kiit ne machei.
Nyochi kaat piiguk che ki koyaun tengekto, ak pistaosyekwak tugul che ki kobistaenen; ak iriiree icheek eng' taitap piik che ki imut icheek koluul,
amu icheek ko piiguk, poroteng'ung', che ki imutu komong' eng' Misiri, eng' kwenutap maatap karnet.
Ingogeer konyeguk soometap otwogindeng'ung', ak soometap piiguk Israel, igasyi icheek eng' sait age tugul ne kariirchin.

Amu ki itabaan icheek eng' piik tugul che po ng'wony, koek poroteng'ung', ko uu ye ki imwa eng' Musa otwogindeng'ung', ye ki imutu kwanisyekyok komong' eng' Misiri, ee Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.”
Kingo kagogees Solomon saaet eng' saaoni ak soomet ne ki saaei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, kong'eet eng' taitap kaptisisyetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, eng' ole kigutung'e kotokyin eunekyik kipsengwet.
Ki tonon ak koberuur tuiyet tugul ne po Israel eng' kutit ne oo kole,

“Iberuurot Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ne Ki kogoochi kamuung'et piikyik Israel, ko uu tuguuk tugul che kiga koaror. Ma pet ng'olyoot agot agenge eng' arorutyennyi tugul ne myee, ne ki iaror eng' otwogindennyi Musa.
Ingotep Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindennyo kobootech ko uu ye kimi ak kwanisyekyok; amat kobagaaktech anan kometech.
Ingoyai mugulelwekyok kotokyigei ineendet, kebendatee ortinwekyik tugul, keriip ng'atuutikyik, etanutikyik ak kirwoogutikyik, che ki ng'at kwanisyekyok.

Ak ingoriikyi ng'aleechuchuk Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindennyo, peet ak kemoi, chu kasoome eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, si kobiit koyachi otwogindennyi kiit ne machei, ak kiit ne machei piikyik Israel, ko uu ye machei eng' peetuut age tugul,
si kobiit konai piik tugul che po ng'wony kole, Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ko Kamuktaindet; ma mi age.
Ingoek anyun mugulelwekwok che ititaatiin eng' Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindennyo, obendate ng'atuutikyik, ak oriip etanutikyik, ko uu rani.”
Ki igoito laitoryat kobooto Israel tugul tiseiywek eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.

Ki igoito Solomon tiseiywek koek kagoochinoigap kaalyeet, che ki igoochi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, tuuga eliphuusyek tiptem ak aeng', ak keechiirek eliphuusyek pogol ak tiptem. Kotabaan anyun laitoryat kobooto lagok tugul che po Israel, kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.

Ki itiliil peetuunooto laitoryat kwenutap seremut ne ki mi taitap kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor; amu yooto ole ki igoitoe ineendet kagoochinet ne kibeelei, ak kagoochinet ne po peek, ak mwanik che po kagoochinoigap kaalyeet: amu ki ming'in kaptisisyetap sugunwet ne ki mi taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ma yam kagoochinet ne kibeelei, ak kagoochinetap peek, ak mwanigap kagoochinoigap kaalyeet.

Ki yai anyun Solomon igoorto eng' peetuusyechooto, kobooto Israel tugul, tuiyet ne oo, kong'etee ye kibunei kebendi Lebo-hamath agoi aineetap Misiri, eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindennyo, peetuusyek tisap konyil aeng', tugul ko peetuusyek taman ak ang'wan.

Ki mwachi piik koba eng' peetuutap sisiit, ak ki iberuur icheek laitoryat, ak koba emaisyekwak koboiboen, kogasategei eng' mugulelwekwak amu myeeindo tugul ne ki yachi `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Daudi otwogindennyi ak Israel piikyik.
Kingo kagogees Solomon teekseetap kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, kobooto kootap laitoryat ak tuguuk tugul che kimachei Solomon koyai,
komong'ji anyun `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Solomon ne po aeng', ko uu ye kiga komong'ji eng' Gibeon.

Ki leenji `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ineendet, “Kaagas saaeng'ung' ak soomeng'ung' ne kaisa ak isoom eng' tainnyu. Kaatiliil kooi koiteech, si ande kainennyu yooto koigeny. Tebee yooto konyekyuk ak muguleldanyu peetuusyek tugul.
Ngiwendotee tainnyu inyee, ko uu ye kiwendotee Daudi kwandang'ung', eng' kagesunetapkei ne po muguleldo ak eng' imanda, iyai ko uu tugul che kaang'atiin, iriip ng'atuutikyuk ak kirwoogutikyuk;

agimiit anyun ng'echereetap laitornatet ne po pounateng'ung' eng' Israel koigeny, ko uu ye kigayomisyi Daudi kwandang'ung' aleenji, ‘Ma petenen chiito ne tebee ng'echereetap laitornatet ne po Israel.’
Ago ngot omaste ko mata osuba, okweek anan lagokwok, amoriip ng'atuutikyuk ak etanutikyuk, che ki ande taing'wong', ak obe oot kanamonik, ogutung'ji,
ang'etoi Israel anyun eng' emet ne ki agoochi, ak kooi ki atiliil agobo kainennyu, aistoi eng' tainnyu; si koek Israel kalewenet ak atindyot eng' piik tugul.
Agot nganda toroor kooi kot, ko tuun kwong'ee age tugul ne siirtoe yooto, ak kosasei; ak komwa icheek kole, ‘Amu nee si koyachi ko uu ni Kamuktaindet ne Toroor emoni ak kooi?’

Kowol piik kole, ‘Amu kimeto icheek Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindennywa, ne ki imut kwanisyekwak komong' eng' emetap Misiri, ak konamgei ak kanamonik, kogutung'ji ak koot icheek. Ki ipchi anyun `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor icheek yaityoni tugul amu nooto.’ ”
Ak kingo kagogeskei kenyiisyek tiptemu, che kiteege Solomon koorchooto aeng', kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ak kootap laitoryat,

(kiga kogoochi Hiram laitoryatap Tyro Solomon keetiigap taragonik ak keetiigap piribirinik, ak thahabu, ko uu tugul che kimachei,) kogoochi anyun `Laitoryat Solomon Hiram nganasook tiptem eng' emetap Galilaya.
Ki nyo Hiram eng' Tyro konyo kogeer nganasochooto kiga kogoochi Solomon ineendet; ago kimacham.
Ki le ineendet, “Nee nganasochu kegono, tupchennyu?” Ak kiguure emet Kabul, agoi ra.
Kiga koiyookyi `Hiram Laitoryat Solomon keruutik eliphuusyek somok ak pogol lo che po thahabu.
Ak ni arorunet ne ki igoochi Laitoryat Solomon koyum tuguuk si kobiit koteege kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, koonnyi, Milo, irimeetap Jerusalem, ak Hasor, Megiddo ak Gezer.
Ki wo Pharaoh laitoryatap Misiri kwo konam Gezer, ak kobeel eng' maat, ak kobar Kanaanik che ki menyei nganasanooto, ak kogoochi cheptonyi, osotyotap Solomon, koek kagoochinet.
Ki teech anyun Solomon Gezer, ak Beth-horon ne mi komosta ne rektoot,
Baalat, ak Tamar ne mi surkwen, eng' emet,

ak nganasook tugul ole kigonoree Solomon tuguuk, nganasook che po kariisyekyik, ak nganasoogap murenik che ketei paraisisyek, ak ne kimachei Solomon koteekyigei eng' Jerusalem, eng' Lebanon ak eng' emet tugul ne po pounatennyi.
Ak eng' piik tugul che kiga ng'et che po Amorik, Hitik, Perisik, Hibik ak Jebusik, che ki ma ko po Israel;
lagokwak che kiga ng'et eng' emet, che ki ma imuuch piigap Israel kobar kogees, ki iyum Solomon otwogik eng' pichooto, agoi rani.
Ago ma yai Solomon piigap Israel koek otwogik; ki ek icheek murenigap lugeet, kiboitiinikyik, pounikyik, kiptainikyik, kandoigap kariisyekyik che po lugeet ak murenikyik che ki laanyei paraisisyek.
Chu ko kiptainikyik che ki pou poisyetap Solomon, piik pogol muut ak konom, che ki pou piik che kiboisyei.
Ki togos cheptap Pharaoh eng' nganaseetap Daudi kwo koonnyi ne kiga teekyi Solomon; yeityo koteech Milo.

Ki igoitoi Solomon kagoochinoik che kibeelei ak kagoochinoigap kaalyeet konyil somok eng' kenyiit eng' kaptisisyet ne kiteekyi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, kitesta chooto nyamdutik che kibeelei, eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor. Kogees anyun koot.
Ki yai Laitoryat Solomon melisyek che po lugeet eng' Esion-geber ye neegitee Elot, eng' ngeguutap Araraita ne Piriir, eng' emetap Edom.
Ak ki iyookto Hiram otwogikyik, piigap moinget, che ingen nyanjet, kobooto otwogigap Solomon.
Ki pa icheek Opir, ak koip thahabu che po keruutik eliphuusyek taman ak sisiit eng' olooto, koipchi Laitoryat Solomon.
Kingo kas laitoryatap Sheba ne ki kwony, kalasunetap Solomon agobo kainetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, konyo kotyem ineendet eng' teebutik che uueen.

Ki it Jerusalem kobooto piikyik che chaang', ak tambeesik che ibei tuguuk che ng'uu ne anyiny, thahabu che chaang' ak koik che po kamanuutyet ne oo. Kingo it ole mi Solomon kong'alaal ak ineendet agobo tuguuk tugul che ki mi muguleldanyi.
Ki wolji Solomon ineendet teebutikyik tugul; ki ma piit kiy age tugul ne ung'aat eng' laitoryat ne ma mwachi ineendet.
Kingo kagogeer laitoryandanooto po Sheba utaatyet tugul ne po Solomon ak koot ne kiga koteech,

ak amitwogikyik, ole teptoi otwogikyik, tononet ne tononjin poisyet kiboitiinikyik, ngoroikwak, piikyik che ipchin tuguuk che eei ak kagoochinoikyik che ki igoitoi eng' kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ko kitemeneen ak konam kuut kityo.
Ki leenji `kwonyooto laitoryat, “Po iman ng'aleechu ki agase eng' emennyu agobo poisyoniguk ak utaatyeng'ung'.
Ago ki ma yan ng'aleechooto kot koten anyo ageerchigei eng' konyekyuk. Keero, ki ma iit agot kebeber che kiga kimwaiwo, siirei utaatyeng'ung' ak perurtang'ung' kalasunet ne kigagas.
Poiboi piiguk! Poiboi otwogichuguk, chu tonondos eng' taing'ung' kotugul ak kogasei utaatyeng'ung'!

Iberuurot Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindeng'ung', ne ki paibait eng' inyee ak kondein ng'echereetap laitornatetap Israel. Amu ki cham `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Israel koigeny, koyain anyun iegu laitoryat, si iyai kirwooget ak imanda.”

Ki igoochi anyun `kwonyooto Solomon keruutik eliphuusyek ang'wan che po thahabu, nyamdutik che ng'uu ne anyiny che chaang' miising' ak koik che po kamanuutyet ne oo: ki mata keip kogeny nyamdutik che ng'uu ne anyiny ng'iisyat che tee chooto che ki igoochi laitoryatap Sheba Laitoryat Solomon.
Ki ip melisyegap Hiram ak icheek thahabu eng' emetap Opir, eng' olooto ko ki kiip kora keetiigap almug che chaang' kot ak koik che po kamanuutyet ne oo.

Kiyae laitoryat keetichooto po almug, tolochigap kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ak kootap laitoryat, kiyae kogeny keetichooto ketubosyek ak kibugandinik che po piik che tyeni. Ara mata keip keetiigap almug che uu chooto kogeny, amata kegeer agoi rani.

Ki igoochi `laitoryat Solomon laitoryatap Sheba kiy age tugul ne kimach, kiy age tugul ne ki soom, koma pooto chooto che ki igoochi Solomon kwonyooto eng' aiyebindap laitornatennyi. Kiweektagei anyun, kwo emennyi kobooto otwogikyik.
Ki kiipchi Solomon eng' kenyiit agenge thahabu che po nyigiisindanyi keruutik eliphuusyek tiptem ak aeng',
ama pooto che ki aldooti piik, ak che kiyae mung'aaret chemung'arainik, ak che po laitorinik tugul che po emetap Arabia ak che po pounigap emet.
Ki yai Laitoryat Solomon long'onik che eecheen pogol aeng' che po thahabu che ki kitany; ki kiyae long'eet agenge ne oo keruutik tisap che po thahabu.
Ki yai long'onik che mengeechen pogol somok che po thahabu che ki kitany, ki kiyae long'eet agenge kiloit agenge ak nusu che po thahabu; kigonoree laitoryat long'onichooto kootap timdap Lebanon.
Ak koyai kogeny laitoryat ng'echereet ne oo ne po laitornatet eng' kelegap peeleek, ak koliige thahabu che korooron miising'.

Ki mi tuguuk lang'eiywot ne ki tinyei tuguuk lo che ki kityegoti ketogosyin ng'echereetap laitornatet, ak ki kitainganat ng'echeronooto komostap patai: ak kimi keetiik komosi ak komosi che tiegei eunek, kobooto itoonwek aeng' che po ng'etuunyik eng' komosi ak komosi, eng' olooto kitiie eunek.

Ki tonondos itoonwek tamanu ak aeng' che po ng'etuunyik eng' komoswek tuwai eng' lang'eiywondonooto ki tinyei tuguuk lo che kityegoti ketogostoi. Ki ma komi age ne kergei ak nooto ne ki kiyai eng' laitornatet age tugul.

Ki po thahabu tuguuk tugul che keeise che po Laitoryat Solomon, ak tuguuk tugul che ki kiboisyee eng' kootap timdap Lebanon ko ki po thahabu che tiliileen. Ki ma komi agot agenge ne po fedha; ki ma ko kiy fedha eng' peetuusyegap Solomon.

Amu ki tinyei laitoryat eng' nyanjet melisyek che po Tarsis kobooto melisyek che po Hiram, ko ki cham koibu melisyek che po Tarsis konyil agenge eng' kenyiisyek somok thahabu, fedha, kelegap peeleek, tisook ak toriitik che kiguure tausi.
Ki siir anyun `Laitoryat Solomon laitorinik tugul che po ng'wony eng' mogornateet ak utaatyet.
Ki cheeng' ng'wony komugul kogeer Solomon, kogas utotyennyi, ne kigainde Kamuktaindet muguleldanyi.
Ki ip chii tugul kagochinennyi, tuguugap fedha, tuguugap thahabu, ngoroik, kariigap lugeet, nyamdutik ak paraisisyek ak nyumbusyek, koitet ne ki kigoonu eng' kenyiit age tugul.

Ki iyum Solomon kariisyegap lugeet ak piik che ketei paraisisyek. Ki tinyei kariisyek eliphuut ak pogol ang'wan ak piik che ketei paraisisyek eliphuusyek taman ak aeng' che ki inde nganasoogap kariisyek, ak che ki mi ole mi laitoryat eng' Jerusalem.
Ki yai laitoryat fedha eng' Jerusalem koigei koik, ak ki yai taragonik koigei mogoonik che mi emet ne soi, eng' chaang'indo.
