igas anyun eng' kipsengwet eng' oldang'ung' ole imenye, saaennywa ak soomutikwak, iyachi anyun icheek kiit ne machei ak inyochi kaat piiguk che ki koyaun tengekto.”
Ara anyun, ee Kamuktaindennyu, asaain ale, ingogeer konyeguk ak ingogas itiiguk saaet ne ki saaei eng' yuto.

“Ara anyun, ng'eet, ee Kamuktaindet ne po Toroornatet, nyoo oli imuung'ee, inyee ak moingetap kimnateng'ung'. Ingolaach tisiiguk yetunet, ee Kamuktaindet ne po Toroornatet, ak ingoboiboitu piiguk che tiliileen eng' myeeindo.
Ee Kamuktaindet ne po Toroornatet, ameiste togeetap neng'ung' ne iilaat. Ibwaat rireenosyegap Daudi otwogindeng'ung'.”
Ye kingo kes Solomon saaet, kochoorgei maat eng' kipsengwet ak kobeel kagoochinet ne kibeelei ak koroseek, ak ki nyi koot liilindap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ko uu ye kiganyi liilindap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ko ki ma imuuch tisiik koba koot oriit.

Ye kigeerei lagok tugul che po Israel kochoorugei maat ak kotebee liilindap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor paragutap koot, ak ki ing'uruugis icheek kot koit ng'wony togoochikwak eng' ye ki kitetyi koik, ak kolas ak komwachi kongoi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole, “Amu myee ineendet, amu po koigeny rireenennyi.”
Kogoito anyun laitoryat kobooto piik tugul tiseiywek eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ki igoito Laitoryat Solomon tiseiywek che po eiik eliphuusyek tiptem ak aeng' ak keechiirek eliphuusyek pogol ak tiptem. Ara ki itabaan anyun laitoryat ak piik tugul kootap Kamuktaindet.

Kitononso anyun tisiik kobee poisyonikwak; ki yai ko uu nooto Lawiik ak icheek che ki tinyei kibungandinigap tyenwogik che po Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, che kiga koyai Daudi laitoryat che kimwachine kongoi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor. Kityenso kole “Amu po koigeny rireenennyi,” ko uu ye ki ng'at `Daudi icheek eng' otisyennywa. Kiguutei iryagook tisiik eng' tainnywa, ak kitononso Israel tugul.

Kogeny ki itiliil Solomon kwenutap seremut ne ki mi taitap kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, amu ki igoito eng' yooto kagoochinoik che kibeelei ak mwanik che po kagoochinoigap kaalyeet, amu ki ma koyamei kaptisisyetap sugunwet ne kiga koyai Solomon kagoochinet ne kibeelei ak kagoochinet ne po peek ak mwanik.
Eng' peetuusyechooto kogiyai anyun Solomon igoorto peetuusyek tisap, kobooto Israel tugul, tuiyet ne oo miising' che ki pwa kong'etee ye kibunei kebendi Lebo-hamath agoi aineetap Misiri.
Eng' peetuutap sisiit, kogiyai tuiyetap kaming'inetapkei; amu kiga koyai katabaanetap kaptisisyet eng' peetuusyek tisap ak igoorto peetuusyek tisap.

Eng' peetuutap tiptem ak somok ne po arawetap tisap ko ki mwachi piik koba emaisyekwak, eng' poiboiyet ak kagasetapkei ne po muguleldo amu myeeindo ne ki yachi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Daudi ak Solomon ak Israel piikyik.

Kogees anyun Solomon kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ak kootap laitoryat. Ak ki yai Solomon eng' aiyebindo tuguuk tugul che ki ibwaat ineendet eng' muguleldanyi, koyai eng' kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ak eng' koonnyi.
Kimong'ji `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Solomon kemoi ak koleenji ineendet, “Kaagas saaeng'ung', ak kaalewenjigei yuto koek kootap tiseiywek.
Ngot ager kipsengwet si ma robon, anan ngot ang'at chereng'endet koam emet, anan ayookyi koroito piikyuk,
ngot koming'ingei piikyuk che kemwaitoe kainennyu, kosa, kocheeng'a ak kolakta ortinwekwak che po yaityet, agas anyun eng' kipsengwet; ak anyochi kaat eng' tengektonywa ak asoop emennywa.
Kogeer anyun konyekyuk ak kogas itiikyuk saaet ne ki saaei eng' yuto.
Amu kaalewen kooi ak atabaan si kobiit kotebee kainennyu olooto koigeny. Ak tebee yuto konyekyuk ak muguleldanyu kotugul.
Ak ngot iwendote inyee tainnyu ko uu ye kiwendote Daudi kwandang'ung', iyai ko uu tuguuk tugul che kaang'atiin ak iriip ng'atuutikyuk ak kirwoogutikyuk,
agimiit anyun ng'echereetap laitornatet ne po pounateng'ung', ko uu ye ki ayai arorutyet ak Daudi kwandang'ung' aleenji, ‘Ma petenen chiito ne egu pounindet eng' Israel.’
Ago ngot omaaste, ak olakte kaneetisyosyekyuk ak ng'atuutikyuk che ki ande taing'wong', obe oot kanamonik ak ogutung'ji,
atutu anyun icheek eng' emennyu ne ki agoochi; ak awirte kooi eng' tainnyu ne ki atabaanji kainennyu, ak ayai koek kalewenet ak atindyot eng' pororyosyek tugul.
Ak kwong'ei age tugul ne siirei yuto, agobo kooi oo tee ni, ak kole, ‘Amu nee si koyachi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ko uu ni emoni ak kooi?’

Yeityo kowol kole, ‘Amu kimeto `icheek Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindetap kwanisyekwak, ne ki imut icheek komong' eng' emetap Misiri ak konamgei ak kanamonik, kogutung'ji ak koot icheek: nooto anyun ki ipchi `ineendet icheek yaityoni tugul.’ ”
Kingo kagogeskei kenyiisyek tiptemu, ne eng' chuuto ko kiteege Solomon kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ak koonnyi,
ki teech Solomon nganasook che kiga kogoochi `Huram ineendet ak kogoochi piigap Israel komeny olooto.
Ki wo Solomon kobookyi Hamat-seba ak koterteer olooto.
Ki teech Tadmor eng' surkwen ak nganasook tugul che kigonoree tuguuk eng' Hamath.
Ki teech kogeny Beth-horon ne po meto ak Beth-horon ne rektoot, nganasook che ng'ootaatiin, che ki tinyei irimoik, ormariichok, ak temeleiywek,

ak Baalat, ak nganasook tugul che kigonorisye, ak nganasook tugul che po kariisyekyik ak nganasoogap piik che laanyei paraisisyekyik, ak tuguuk tugul che po magennyi che ki cham Solomon koteech eng' Jerusalem, eng' Lebanon ak eng' emet tugul ne po pounatennyi.
Piik tugul che ki ng'et eng' Hitik, Amorik, Perisik, Hibik ak Jebusik che ki ma ko po Israel,
che kiga ng'et eng' emet, che ki ma par piigap Israel kogees, koging'at Solomon kelewen piik eng' lagogap pichooto koek otwogik agoi rani.

Ago eng' piigap Israel, ko ki ma yai Solomon icheek koek otwogik che yaei poisyennyi. Ki igoochi icheek koek murenigap lugeet, koek che eecheen eng' kiptainikyik, pounigap kariisyekyik ak murenikyik che ki laanyei paraisisyekyik.
Chu ko ki kiptainik che eecheen che po Laitoryat Solomon, piik pogol aeng' ak konom, che ki pou piik.

Ki imut `Solomon cheptap Pharaoh kotogos eng' nganaseetap Daudi konyo koot ne kiga koteekyi ineendet: amu ki le, “Ma menyei osotyondennyu kootap Daudi laitoryatap Israel, amu tiliileen komoswek che ki nyo moingetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kotebee.”
Ki igoochi anyun `Solomon Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kagoochinoik che kibeelei eng' kaptisisyetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ne kiga koteech eng' taitap keterut,

ko uu ye yamei poisyetap peetuut age tugul, kogoitoi ko uu ng'atuutyetap Musa, eng' sabatoisyek, eng' ye kaleel arawet, ak eng' igoorwek che ki king'at, konyil somok eng' kenyiit, igoorto ne po magatiinik che ma kinde mermereek, igoortap wigisyek ak igoortap keryosyek.

Ko uu ng'atuutyetap Daudi kwandanyi koging'at riipsosyegap tisiik eng' otisyennywa, ak Lawiik koyai poisyonikwak si kolasu ak koboisyei kobooto tisiik ko uu ye yamei poisyetap peetuut age tugul. Ki ng'at riibiigap kurgeet ak icheek koyai riipsosyekwak eng' kurgeet age tugul; amu kiga ng'at Daudi chiitap Kamuktaindet ko uu nooto.
Ki ma meto ng'atuutyetap laitoryat ne ki ng'at Tisiik ak Lawiik agobo ng'olyoot age tugul, anan agobo konoraik.
Ara kichobok anyun poisyetap Solomon kobooch peetuut ne ki kilume lumeiywotap kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor agoi kogeskei. Ki igeskei anyun poisyetap kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Yeityo kwo Solomon Esion-geber ak Elot, che mi ngeguutap emetap Edom.

Ki iyookyi Huram melisyek ineendet koyooktoe otwogikyik, ak otwogik che ingen agobo nyanjet. Ki pwa icheek Opir kobooto otwogigap Solomon, ki ip eng' olooto talendaisyek che po thahabu pogol ang'wan ak konom, koipchi Laitoryat Solomon.

Kingo kas laitoryatap Sheba ne ki kwony kalasunetap Solomon, ko ki nyo Jerusalem konyo kotyem Solomon eng' teebutik che uueen. Ki nyo kobooto piik che chaang' ak tambeesik che ibei tuguuk che ng'uu ne anyiny, thahabu che chaang' ak koik che po kamanuutyet ne oo. Kingo it ole mi Solomon kong'alaal ak ineendet agobo tuguuk tugul che ki mi muguleldanyi.
Ki wolji `Solomon ineendet teebutikyik tugul; ak ki ma komi kiy age tugul ne ki ma nai Solomon anan ne kitemenee kowolji ineendet.
Kingo kagogeer laitoryandanooto po Sheba utaatyetap Solomon, kobooto koot ne kiga teech,

amitwogik che mi mesennyi, ole teptoi otwogikyik, tononet ne tononjin poisyet kiboitiinikyik komi eng' ngoroikwak, piikyik ak icheek che ipchin tuguuk che eei eng' ngoroikwak ak kagoochinoikyik che kibeelei che ki igoitoi eng' kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, kogeskei anyun kimnateennyi.
Ara ki leenji `kwonyooto laitoryat, “Po iman ng'aleechu ki agase eng' emennyu agobo poisyoniguk ak agobo utaatyeng'ung'.
Ago ki ma ayan ng'aleekwak kot kotee anyo ageerchigei eng' konyekyuk. Abeere ki ma kimwaiwo agot kebebertap ooindap utaatyeng'ung'; isiire kalasunoni ki agase.
Poiboi piiguk! Poiboi otwogichuguk, chu tonondos eng' taing'ung' kotugul ak kogasei utaatyeng'ung'!

Iberuurot Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindeng'ung', ne ki paibait eng' inyee ak kondein ng'echerennyi ne po laitornatet iegu laitoryatap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindeng'ung'. Amu ki cham `Kamuktaindeng'ung' Israel ak kogimit icheek koigeny, kondein anyun iegu laitoryat ibou icheek iyai kirwooget ak imanda.”

Ki igoochi `kwonyooto laitoryat talendaisyek pogol ak tiptem che po thahabu, kobooto tuguuk ng'iisyat che ng'uu ne anyiny ak koik che po kamanuutyet ne oo. Ki ma piit nyamdutik che uu chooto ki igoochi `laitoryandanooto po Sheba Laitoryat Solomon.
Ki ip ak icheek otwogigap Huram ak otwogigap Solomon thahabu eng' Opir, ak keetiigap almug ak koik che po kamanuutyet ne oo.

Kiboisyee laitoryat keetichooto po almug koyae ole kitogostoe eng' kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ak eng' kootap laitoryat; kiyae kora ketubosyek ak kibugandinik che po tyeniik. Kitomo kogeerei chii tuguuk che uu chooto eng' emetap Judah.

Kosupkei ak nooto, ko ki igoochi agine `Laitoryat Solomon laitoryandanooto po Sheba kiy age tugul ne kimach, ak kiy age tugul ne ki soom koma pooto tuguuk che kiga ipchi kwonyoto Solomon. Kiweektagei anyun kwo emennyi kobooto otwogikyik.
Ki ek nyigiisindap thahabu che ki kiipchi Solomon eng' kenyiit agenge tanisyek eliphuusyek tiptem ak muut,
ama pooto che ki ibu piik che aldooti ak che ki ibu chemung'arainik, ak ki ip laitorinik tugul che po Arabia ak pounigap emet, thahabu ak fedha, koipchi Solomon.
Ki yai Laitoryat Solomon, long'onik che eecheen pogol aeng' che po thahabu che ki kitany; ki kiyae long'eet agenge ne oo keruutik tisap che po thahabu che ki kitany.
Ki yai long'onik che mengeechen pogol somok che po thahabu che ki kitany; ki kiyae long'eet agenge keruutik somok che po thahabu. Kigonoree laitoryat long'onichooto Kootap Osnetap Lebanon.
Ki yai kogeny laitoryat ng'echereet ne oo ne po laitornatet eng' kelegap peeleek ak koliige thahabu che tiliileen.

Ki mi lang'eiywot ne tinyei tuguuk lo che kityegoti ketogosyin ng'echereetap laitornatet, kobooto ng'echereet ne tebee keelyek ne ki po thahabu, ne kiga kiratyi ng'echereetap laitornatet, ak kimi keetiik komosi ak komosi che tiegei eunek, ak itoonwek aeng' che po ng'etuunyik eng' komosi ak komosi eng' ye neegitee keetichooto kitiie eunek.
Ki tonondos itoonwek tamanu ak aeng' che po ng'etuunyik eng' komoswek tuwai eng' tuguuchooto lo kityegoti ketogostoi. Ki ma komi age ne kergei ak nooto ne ki kiyai eng' laitornatet age tugul.
Ki po thahabu tuguuk tugul che kieise Laitoryat Solomon, ak tuguuk tugul che ki kiboisyee eng' Kootap Osnetap Lebanon ko ki po thahabu che tiliileen; ki ma ko kiy fedha eng' peetuusyegap Solomon.

Amu ki tinyei laitoryat melisyek che ki pendi Tarsis kobooto otwogigap Huram, ki ibu melisyek che po Tarsis konyil agenge eng' kenyiisyek somok, thahabu, fedha, kelegap peeleek, tisook ak toriitik che kiguure tausi.
Ki siir anyun Laitoryat Solomon laitorinik tugul che po ng'wony eng' mogornatosyek ak utaatyet.
Ki cheeng' laitorinik tugul che po ng'wony kogeer Solomon kole kogas utotyennyi, ne ki inde Kamuktaindet muguleldanyi.
Ki ip chii tugul kagoochinennyi, tuguugap fedha ak tuguugap thahabu, ngoroik, kariigap lugeet, nyamdutik, ak paraisisyek, ak nyumbusyek, koitet ne ki kigoonu eng' kenyiit age tugul.

Ki tinyei Solomon kooriik eliphuusyek ang'wan che po paraisisyek ak kariisyek, ak piik eliphuusyek taman ak aeng' che po paraisisyek, che ki inde nganasoogap kariisyek ak che ki mi ole mi laitoryat eng' Jerusalem.
Ki pou laitorinik tugul kobooch Aineetap Yufrets agoi emetap Philistiik, ak agoi kiwotetap Misiri.
Ki yai laitoryat fedha eng' Jerusalem koigei koik, ak ki yai eng' chaang'indo taragonik koigei mogoonik che mi emet ne soi.
Ki kigetyi Solomon paraisisyek eng' Misiri, ak eng' emotinwek tugul.

Poisyonigap Solomon che kang'et, che po tai ak che po let, tos ma ki sirchi kitabuutap ng'aleegap maotyot Nathan, ak eng' maonateetap Ahija Silonindet, ak eng' ng'ang'utigap keerindet Ido agobo Jeroboam weeriitap Nebat?
Ki laitoran Solomon eng' Jerusalem koboi Israel tugul kenyiisyek artam.
Ki ru Solomon kobooto kwanisyekyik, ak ki kitupchi nganaseetap Daudi kwandanyi. Ak ki laitoran Rehoboam weeriinnyi kogeer ineendet.
Ki wo Rehoboam Shekem, amu kigabwa Israel tugul Shekem, konde ineendet koek laitoryat.
Kingo kas Jeroboam weeriitap Nebat agobo nooto, (amu kimi Misiri, ole kiga mwechi komwee Laitoryat Solomon,) koweek Jeroboam eng' Misiri.
Ki iyookto keguur ineendet; ak ki nyo Jeroboam kobooto Israel tugul, ak kong'alaalji Rehoboam, koleenji,
“Ki yai kwandang'ung' choginnyo kouiit. Ara anyun, yai kowisisiit otisyet ne uui ne ki po kwandang'ung', ak iyai kowisisiit choginnyi ne nyigiis ne ki indeech, si kobiit keotin.”
Ki leenji icheek, “Obwa kogeny ole ami koga ibata peetuusyek somogu.” Koba anyun piik.
Kong'alaal Laitoryat Rehoboam ak poisyek, che ki cham kotonondos eng' taitap Solomon kwandanyi, ye kita kosabei, koleenji, “Nee ng'olyoot ne omwaiwo ne awoljini pichu?”
Ki mwachi koleenji, “Ngot iegu chii ne myee eng' pichu ak ibaibai icheek, ak imwachi ng'aleek che myach, koegu anyun icheek otwogiguk koigeny.”
Ago ki pagaakta ng'aleegap poisyek, che ki mwachi ineendet ak kong'alaal ak neranik che kinerchindos tugul che kitonondos eng' tainnyi.
Ki leenji icheek, “Nee ng'olyoot ne omwae okweek, si kobiit kewolji pichu kong'alaalwo koleenjo, yai kowisisiit chogit, ne ki indeech kwandang'ung?”

Ki wolji neranik che kinerchindos ak ineendet koleenji, “Imwachini ko uu ni pichu kong'alaalun, koleenjinin, ‘Ki yai kwandang'ung' choginnyo konyigiisit, ago yaiywech kowisisiit’; imwachini ko uu ni, ileenjini, ‘Nyigiis mornennyu ne ming'in ne po euut kosiir suetap abba.
Nguno anyun, ko uu ye ki koonok abba chogit ne nyigiis, atese choging'wong'. Ki itigonenok abba kipcharitisyek, ago atigoonenok melmelwek.’ ”
Kobwa anyun Jeroboam ak piik tugul ole mi Rehoboam eng' peetuutap somok, ko uu ye kiga ng'at laitoryat, kole, “Obwa eng' peetuutap somok.”
Ki wolji laitoryat icheek eng' koroomnateet. Ki meto Laitoryat Rehoboam ng'aleegap poisyek,
ak kong'alaalji icheek ko uu ye ki kamwachi neranik, koleenji, “Ki yai abba choging'wong' konyigiisit, ago atese; ki itigonenok abba kipcharitisyek, ago atigoonenok melmelwek.”

Ara ki ma kasyi anyun laitoryat pichooto, amu ki kiit ne ki punu Kamuktaindet, si kobiit kogimit Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ng'olyoondennyi, ne ki mwa eng' Ahija Silonindet komwachi Jeroboam weeriitap Nebat.

Kingo keer Israel tugul kole mata kogasyi laitoryat icheek, kowolji piik laitoryat, koleenji, “Nee kebeberta ne ketinye eng' Daudi? Ama ki tinyei poroteet eng' weeriitap Jesse. Ingwo chii tugul emainnyi, ee Israel! Riip koong'ung' anyun, Daudi.” Ki pa Israel tugul anyun emaisyekwak.
Ago ki laitoran Rehoboam eng' piigap Israel che ki menyei nganasoogap Judah.
Ki iyookto anyun `Rehoboam Hadoram, ne ki pou aisuruut; ak kilach piigap Israel ineendet eng' koik, kome. Kichaakta anyun Laitoryat Rehoboam kolaany chepkichutinnyi komwei kwo Jerusalem.
Ara ki ingelelji anyun Israel kootap Daudi agoi ra.

Kingo it `Rehoboam Jerusalem, koyum murenik eliphuusyek pogol ak tamanwogik sisiit che po lugeet, che ki kilewen eng' kootap Judah ak kootap Benjamin si kobargei ak Israel ak koweekyi laitornatet Rehoboam.
Ago ki nyoonji `ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Semaiah chiitap Kamuktaindet, koleenji
ng'alaalji Rehoboam weeriitap Solomon, laitoryatap Judah, kobooto Israel tugul eng' Judah ak Benjamin, ileenji,

kamwa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ko uu ni, kole: “Amobe otogoste anan obargei ak tupchosyekwok. Ingoweek chii tugul kwo koonnyi, amu punwa kii.” Kogas anyun icheek ng'aleegap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ak koweek mata koba kobargei ak Jeroboam.
Ki meny `Rehoboam Jerusalem, ak koteech eng' Judah nganasook che kiriibegei.
Ki teech Bethlehem, Etam, Tekoa,
Beth-zur, Soko, Adulam,
Gath, Maresha, Ziph,
Adoraim, Lakish, Aseka,
Sora, Aijalon ak Hebron. Chuuto nganasook che ng'ootaatiin che mi Judah ak Benjamin.
Ki kimiit irimoik, ak konde kiptainik koriip, ak kogonoree amitwogik, mwanik ak divaik.
Ki inde nganaseet age tugul long'onik ak ng'otwek, ak kogimit miising'. Ara ki punji ineendet Judah ak Benjamin.
Ki pwanji kotoret ineendet `Tisiik ak `Lawiik che ki mi Israel tugul, komong' eng' kiwotosyekwak tugul.
Amu ki pagaakta Lawiik emotinwekwak che kiyagisye ak tuguukwak, ak kobwa Judah ak Jerusalem, amu ki oon Jeroboam ak weeriikyik icheek, si ma yai tisiisyet koyachi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ki lewenjigei tisiik che po komoswek che torooreen, ak che po oik, ak che po moek che kiga koyai.

Ki pwa Jerusalem, piik alak eng' ortinwek tugul che po Israel, icheek che kiga igiilgei eng' mugulelwekwak kocheeng' Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindetap Israel, koosup pichooto, kobwa koeng'ji Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindetap kwanisyekwak.
Ki igimit anyun laitornatetap Judah, ak kogimit Rehoboam weeriitap Solomon eng' kenyiisyek somok, amu kibendate ortinwegap Daudi ak Solomon eng' kenyiisyek somok.
Ki itun `Rehoboam Maalat cheptap Jerimoth weeriitap Daudi, ak Abiail cheptap Eliap weeriitap Jesse.
Ki sikyi ineendet weeriik: Jeush, Semaria ak Saham.
Yeityo kotun Maaka cheptap Absalom, ak ki sikyi ineendet Abijah, Atai, Shisha ak Selomit.

Ki cham Rehoboam Maaka cheptap Absalom kosiir osotikyik tugul ak chebaigeiniyik (amu ki itun osotik taman ak sisiit ak chebaigeinik tamanwogik lo, ak ki sich weeriik tiptem ak sisiit ak tiibiik tamanwogik lo).
Ki inde Rehoboam Abijah weeriitap Maaka koek ne oo, koboi tupchosyekyik, amu kimach konde ineendet koek laitoryat.

Ki yai eng' ng'omnateet, kopcheita weeriikyik tugul koyom emotinwek tugul che po Judah ak Benjamin, koba nganaseet age tugul ne ng'ootaat. Ki igoochi icheek amitwogik che chaang' kot ak kocheeng'ji icheek osotik che chaang'.
Kingo kagigimit pounatetap Rehoboam ak kogimit agine, kometo ng'atuutigap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ineendet ak Israel tugul.
Ak amu kiga kongelelji Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ko ki togos Sisak laitoryatap Misiri konyo kobar Jerusalem eng' kenyiit ne po muut ne po Laitoryat Rehoboam.

Ki tinyei ineendet kariisyek eliphuut agenge ak pogol aeng' ak piik eliphuusyek tamanwogik lo che ketei paraisisyek. Ki ma ko iitoksei piik che kigabwa kobooto ineendet eng' Misiri: piigap Libya, Sukik ak Ethiopik.
Ki nam nganasook che ng'ootaatiin che ki po Judah ak kobwa Jerusalem.

Ki nyo `maotyot Semaiah kap Reoboam, ak pounigap Judah, che kiga koyumjigei Jerusalem, komwee Sisak, ak koleenji icheek, “Kamwa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ko uu ni, kole, ‘Ki ometa, eng' nooto ko kabagakyok anyun agane eutap Sisak.’ ”
Ki iming'ingei anyun pounigap Israel kobooto laitoryat, ak ki le, “Po iman Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.”

Kingo keer Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole kagoming'ingei, konyonji `ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Semaiah, koleenji: “Kagoming'ingei icheek, ma abare, ago asaru kitigin, ak ma keroong'jin Jerusalem nereegekyuk eng' eutap Sisak.
Ago egu icheek otwogikyik, si kobiit konai poisyennyu ak poisyetap laitornatosyek emotinwek.”

Ki togos anyun Sisak laitoryatap Misiri kobar Jerusalem, ak koip konoraigap kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ak konoraigap kootap laitoryat: ki ip tugul, ki ip kogeny long'onik che po thahabu che kiga yai Solomon.
Ki yai Laitoryat Rehoboam long'onik che po sugunonik kogeere chooto, ak kogoochi kiptainigap riibiik koriip, che ki riibei kurgeetap kootap laitoryat.
Ak eng' peetuut age tugul ne kanyo laitoryat kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, kobwa riibiik koip, yeityo koweekta koba kootap riibiik.
Kingo ming'ingei, koistoegei nereegegap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ineendet, si ma par ineendet kowong'. Ak kogeny, ki miitei Judah tuguuk che myach.

Ki igimitkei anyun Laitoryat Rehoboam eng' Jerusalem ak kolaitoran. Ki po kenyiisyek artam ak agenge Rehoboam ye ki tau kolaitorani, ak ki laitoran kenyiisyek taman ak tisap eng' Jerusalem, nganasanooto kiga kolewen Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' ortinwek tugul che po Israel, konde kainennyi olooto. Ki kiguure kamet Naamah Jebamonindet.
Ki yai yaityet, amu ma igiilgei kocheeng' Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' muguleldanyi.

Ak poisyonigap Rehoboam, che po tai ak che po let, tos ma kisir eng' ng'aleegap Semaiah maotyot ak che po Ido keerindet, kobee tetuutigap ibinwek che ki kosiirto? Ki mi lugoosyek kwenutap Rehoboam ak Jeroboam kotugul.
Ki ru Rehoboam kobooto kwanisyekyik ak ki kitupchi nganaseetap Daudi. Ak ki laitoran Abijah weeriinnyi kogeer ineendet.
Ki toi kolaitoran Abijah eng' Judah eng' kenyiitap taman ak sisiit ne po laitornatetap Jeroboam.
Ki laitoran kenyiisyek somok eng' Jerusalem. Ki kiguure kamet Mikaia cheptap Uriel ne po Gibea. Ki tinyei lugeet Abijah ak Jeroboam eng' kwenunnywa.

Kitet lugeet Abijah kobooto lugeetap murenik che nyigoonen che po lugeet, murenik eliphuusyek pogol ang'wan che ki kilewen, kitet agine Jeroboam lugeet kotinyei murenik eliphuusyek pogol sisiit, che ki kilewen, piik che kiimeen, che nyigoonen, kobargei ak ineendet.
Ki tonon anyun Abijah eng' tulweetap Semaraim ne mi emetap tuloonook ne po Ephraim, ak kole, “Ogasa, ee Jeroboam ak Israel tugul!
Tos manyoljok onai ole ki igoochi `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindetap Israel `Daudi pounateet koboi Israel koigeny ak weeriikyik eng' kayomisetap muunyuk?”
Ago king'eet Jeroboam weeriitap Nebat, otwogindetap Solomon weeriitap Daudi, kongelelji kiptaiyandennyi.
Ki iyumjigei ineendet piik che yaach weeriigap Belial che ki igimitkei kobargei ak Rehoboam weeriitap Solomon, ye kita ko ming'in Rehoboam ak kotinyei riirge, ak ma imuuch kogirinda icheek.
“Ak nguno oleen omuuchi ogirinde laitornatetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne mi eunegap weeriigap Daudi, ak oo tuiyet ne oo, ak otinye moek che po thahabu che ki itang'wok Jeroboam koek kanamonik.

Tos ma oonu tisiigap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, weeriigap Aron, ak Lawiik, ak olewenjigei tisiik, osubi pitonwegap piigap emotinwek alak? Si age tugul ne nyoonei koanyinyegei kirgit anan mengichik tisap, koegu nooto tisiindetap tuguuk che ma tilei kiy.
Ago Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ko Kamuktaindennyo acheek, ak tomo kebagaakte ineendet. Ki tinyei tisiik che poisyechin Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, weeriigap Aron, ak Lawiik che yaei poisyennywa.

Peeljin `icheek Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kagoochinoik che kibeelei, ak nyamdutik che ng'uu ne anyiny, karonet age tugul ak koskoleng'ut age tugul, tetei magatiinik che itabaanatiin eng' meset ne tiliil, ak keldap tait ne po thahabu kobooto taisyekyik, si kolal koskoleng'ut age tugul; amu kiriibe acheek poisyetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindennyo, ago ki omete ineendet.

Ogeero, mi Kamuktaindet kobootech, kondoiywech, ak tisiikyik che tinyei iryagook che po waagaat si koguutwak ne po waagaat. Ee piigap Israel, amat obargei ak Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindetap kwanisyekwok; amu mo poore.”
Ago ki chop Jeroboam piik kobwa koribisyo eng' let, ki mi icheek taitap Judah ak kimi let che kiribistos.
Ak kingo keer piigap Judah let, kogeer komi lugeet tainnywa ak let. Ki riirchi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ak ki kuut tisiik iryagook,
ak kowaach anyun piigap Judah. Ak ye kita kowaachei piigap Judah, kobar Kamuktaindet Jeroboam ak Israel tugul eng' taitap Abijah ak Judah.
Kimwei piigap Israel eng' taitap Judah, ak ki inde `Kamuktaindet icheek eunekwak.
Ki par `Abijah ak piikyik icheek eng' pareet ne oo; kobek anyun piik che ki kilewen eliphuusyek pogol muut.
Ki kiming'in ko uu nooto piigap Israel eng' peetuusyechooto, ak ki iterteeris lagogap Judah amu kitiegei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindetap kwanisyekwak.
Ki oon `Abijah Jeroboam, ak korebe ineendet nganasook, Bethel ak nganasookyik, Jesana ak nganasookyik ak Epron ak nganasookyik.
Mata konyoor kimnateet kogeny Jeroboam eng' peetuusyegap Abijah. Ki par `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ineendet.
Ago kitesak Abijah kogimit. Ki itun osotik taman ak ang'wan, ak ki sich weeriik tiptem ak aeng' ak tiibiik taman ak lo.
Ki kisirchi poisyonik che ng'etunotiin che po Abijah, ak ortinwekyik, ak ng'aleekyik, kitabuutap maotyot Ido.
Ki ru anyun Abijah kobooto kwanisyekyik, ak ki kitupchi nganaseetap Daudi, ak ki laitoran Asa weeriinnyi kogeer ineendet. Ki nyoor emet kaalyeet kenyiisyek taman eng' peetuusyekyik.
Ki yai Asa ne myee ak ne po iman eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindennyi.
Ki isto kapkorosusyek che teer, ak komoswek che torooreen, kibut tolochik ak koep Aserik.
Ki ng'at Judah kocheeng' Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindetap kwanisyekwak, ak koyai ng'atuutik ak kayomisutik.
Ki isto kogeny eng' nganasook tugul che po Judah komoswek che torooreen ak ole kibeeljine kanamonik kagoochinoik; ak ki tinyei kaalyeet laitornatet eng' tainnyi.
Ki teech nganasook che ng'ootaatiin eng' Judah. Ki mi kaalyeet emet ak ki ma kotinyei lugeet eng' kenyisyechooto, amu kiga kogoochi `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ineendet kamuung'et.

Ki mwachi piigap Judah koleenji, “Ongeteech nganasochu, ak kiyieme irimoik ak teeksosyek che kooen, ormariichok ak temeleiywek; ta komi emet tainnyo amu kigecheeng' Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindennyo; kigecheeng' ineendet ak ki kogoonech kamuung'et eng' komosta age tugul.” Ara kiteekso anyun ak koboor.

Ki tinyei Asa lugeet ne po piik eliphuusyek pogol somok che po Judah che ki tinyei long'onik ak ng'otwek, ak piik ki eliphuusyek pogol aeng' ak tamanwogik sisiit che po Benjamin, che ki tinyei long'onik ak kwangok. Ki piik che kiimeen che nyigoonen chuuto tugul.
Ki nyo kobargei ak icheek `Zerah Ethiopiaindet, kotinyei lugeet ne po piik millionit agenge ak kariisyek pogol somok; ak ki it Maresha.
Ki wo anyun Asa kotorookta ineendet ak kitet lugeet eng' atebweetap Sepata ne mi Maresha.

Ki riirchi `Asa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindennyi, kole, “Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ma mi age kobatenen ne imuuchi kotoretis eng' kwenutap ne kiim ak ne ma tinyei kimnateet: toretech, ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindennyo; amu kimang'un, ak kagibwa kebarge ak tuiyoni eng' kaineng'ung'. Ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ii Kamuktaindennyo; amat koterteerin chii.”
Kobar anyun `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Ethiopik eng' taitap Asa ak eng' taitap Judah. Kimwei Ethiopik,

ak ki oon Asa ak piik che ki mi tugul agoi Gerar. Ki pek Ethiopik che chaang' ne mata komuuch kosargei; amu ki kibar eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ak eng' taitap lugeennyi. Ki ip piigap Judah parunenik che chaang'.
Ki par nganasook tugul che ki mi ole neegitee Gerar, amu ki nyoonji icheek kamuisetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor. Ki nam icheek tuguuk eng' nganasook tugul; amu kimi parunenik che chaang' nganasochooto.
Ki par kogeny kaptugusyek, ak kokweri keechiirek ng'iisyat ak tambeesik. Yeityo koweek koba Jerusalem.
Ki nyoonji `Kabuusetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Azariah weeriitap Obed,

ak ki wo kotorookta Asa, koleenji, “Ogasa okweek, inyee Asa ak Judah tugul ak Benjamin! Mi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kobootok koteen otebye ak ineendet. Ye ocheeng' ineendet, onyooru, ago ngot omete ineendet, kometook.
Kiga kotebee Israel egosyek che chaang' ama tinyei Kamuktaindet ne po iman, ama tinyei tisiindet ne ineetisyei, ama tinyei ng'atuutik.
Ago kingo weekyigei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindetap Israel, eng' nyalildanywa, ak kocheeng' ineendet, konyoor ineendet.
Ki ma komi kaalyeet eng' peetuusyechooto eng' ineendet ne mandoi anan ko eng' ineendet ne nyoonei ko, ago ki tinyei kaimutik icheek tugul che ki menyei emotinwechooto.
Kibargei, kobar pororyet age pororyet age, ak kobar nganaseet age nganaseet age: amu ki inyaliil Kamuktaindet icheek eng' nyalilowogik tugul.
Ago ogimegitu, among' kochorirenso eunekwok, amu onyooru melekto eng' poisyonikwok.”

Kingo kas Asa ng'aleechuuto, ak maonateetap maotyot Obed, konyiganit, ak koisto tuguuk che kiwechei eng' emet tugul ne po Judah ak Benjamin, ak eng' nganasook che kiga korep eng' emetap tuloonoogap Ephraim. Ak ki teech kogeny kaptisisyetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ne ki mi taitap keterutap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.

Ki iyum `inee Judah tugul ak Benjamin, ak punootik che ki mi kobooto icheek, che po Ephraim, che po Manasseh ak che po Simion. Ki pwanji ineendet `piik che chaang' miising' kobun Israel, ye kingo keer kole mi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindennyi kobooto ineendet.
Koyumgei anyun eng' Jerusalem eng' kenyiitap taman ak muut eng' arawetap somok ne po laitornatetap Asa.
Ki eng'ji Kamuktaindet ne Toroor tiseiywek eng' peetuunooto, che po parunenik che kigetu, eiik pogol tisap ak keechiirek eliphuusyek tisap.
Ki yai arorutyet kocheeng' Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindetap kwanisyekwak, eng' mugulelwekwak tugul ak eng' saboonwekwak tugul,
ak kole, “Age tugul ne ma chamei kocheeng' Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindetap Israel, kebarei ngo ming'in anan ko oo, ngo muren anan ko kwony.”
Ki iyasyechi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor komwa eng' kutit ne oo, ak eng' waagaat, ak eng' iryagook, ak eng' igondisyek.

Kiboiboitu Judah tugul amu kayasyonooto; amu kigayosyo eng' mugulelwekwak tugul, ak kocheeng' ineendet eng' magennywa tugul, ak kinyoor ineendet. Ki igoochi anyun `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor icheek kamuung'et eng' tabanwekwak tugul.

Ki isto `Asa kamennyi Maaka agine, si mata koek laitoryat ne kwondo, amu kiga koyai kanamwet ne kiwechei ne po Asera. Kibut Asa kanamwennyi ak kotui koek temburyek, ak kobeel eng' ole neegitee kererutap Kidron.
Ago ki ma kiisto komoswek che torooreen eng' Israel. Nganda ki uu nooto ko ki igeesunotkei muguleldap Asa eng' peetuusyekyik tugul.
Ki ip kobwa kootap Kamuktaindet tuguuk che kigaitabaan kwandanyi kobooto che kiga kotabaan ineendet: fedha, thahabu ak tereenik.
Ki mata kobiit lugeet kogeny agoi kenyiitap sosom ak muut ne po laitornatetap Asa.
Eng' kenyiitap sosom ak lo ne po laitornatetap Asa, kogiwo Baasha laitoryatap Israel kobargei ak Judah, ak koteech Ramah si mata kochamji chii komanda anan konyo oriit ole mi Asa laitoryatap Judah.
Ki inem anyun `Asa fedha ak thahabu eng' ole kigonoree tuguugap kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ak kootap laitoryat, ak koyookyi Ben-Hadad laitoryatap Syria, ne ki menyei Damasko, koleenji,

“Miitei kasyinet kwenunnyo, anee ak inyee, ko uu ye kimi kwenutap kwandanyu ak kwandang'ung'. Keero, kaayogun fedha ak thahabu; ui put kasyinet ne oting'egei ak Baasha laitoryatap Israel, si kwo koistoenagei.”

Ki kasyi anyun `Ben-Hadad laitoryat Asa ng'aleekyik, ak koyookto kiptainigap lugosyekyik koba kobar nganasoogap Israel. Ki par Ijon, Dan, Abel-maim ak nganasook tugul che po Naphtali che ki kigonoree tuguuk.
Kingo kas Baasha, ko mata koteech Ramah, kobagaakta poisyennyi ne kiyaei.
Ki imut anyun laitoryat `Asa Judah tugul, ak koba koip koik che po Ramah, kobooto keetiik, che kiga teekse Baasha. Kiboisyee chooto koteege Geba ak Mispa.

Ki nyo eng' peetuusyechooto Hanani keerindet ole mi Asa laitoryatap Judah, ak koleenji, “Amu koitiegei laitoryatap Syria, ma itiegei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindeng'ung', ko kachililso anyun lugeetap laitoryatap Syria eng' eung'ung' amu nooto.

Tos ki ma ko lugeet ne oo Ethiopik ak piigap Libya, che ki tinyei kariisyek ak piik che chaang' miising' che ki laanyei paraisisyek? Ko amu ki itiegei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ko ki inde ineendet icheek eung'ung'.

Amu pendoti konyegap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' ng'wony komugul, koboortogei kole kiim agobo icheeget che ititaatiin mugulelwekwak eng' tainnyi. Koiyai kioto eng' perberyo; amu kobooch nguno ko kenyooru lugoosyek agoi.”
Ki nereekyi anyun Asa miising' keerindet, kot konde ineendet korgoreet. Eng' peetuusyechooto, ko ki inam kous Asa piik alak eng' pichooto.
Poisyonigap Asa, kobooch che po tai agoi che po let, ko ki kisirchi kitabuutap laitorinigap Judah ak Israel.

Eng' kenyiitap sosom ak sogool ne po laitornatennyi, ko ki nam Asa myando keelyekyik ak kieet miising' myandanyi. Agot eng' myandanyi koma cheeng' Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ago ki cheeng' toreteet eng' chepkerichinik.
Ki ru Asa ak kwanisyekyik, ak kime eng' kenyiitap artam ak agenge ne po laitornatennyi.

Ki kitup ineendet eng' kererit ne kiga kowachigei eng' nganaseetap Daudi. Ki kinde itoogut ne ki nyiitaat nyamdutik che anyiny, ak tuguuk alak che teerchiin che ki kichop eng' ng'omnatetap chepkerichinik: ak ki kibeelji tuguuk che chaang' miising'.
Ki laitoran weeriinnyi Jehoshaphat kogeer ineendet ak kogimitkei kobargei ak Israel.
Ki inde lugoosyek nganasook tugul che ng'ootaatiin che po Judah, ak konde riibiik emetap Judah, ak nganasoogap Ephraim, che kiga rep kwandanyi Asa.
Ki mi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ak Jehoshaphat amu kiwendote ortinwek che po tai che po kwandanyi Daudi. Ki ma cheeng' `ineendet Baalik,
ago ki cheeng' Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindetap kwandanyi ak kowendote ng'atuutikyik, ama isup tuguuk che ki yai Israel.
Ki igimit anyun Kamuktaindet ne Toroor laitornatet eng' eunnyi. Ki ipchi piik tugul che po `Judah Jehoshaphat kagoochinoik, ak ki tinyei mogornateet eng' chaang'indo ak teegisto.
Ki itoroorok muguleldanyi eng' ooreetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ak kogeny, ki isto komoswek che torooreen ak Aserik kobetyo eng' Judah.
Eng' kenyiitap somok ne po laitornatennyi, ko ki iyookto pounikyik, chooto ko ki Benail, Obadiah, Zekariah, Nethanel ak Mikaia, koba koneetisyot eng' nganasoogap Judah.
Ki mi kobooto icheek Lawiik, chooto ko Semaiah, Netania, Sebadia, Asahel, Semiramot, Jeonatan, Adonijah, Tobija ak Tobadonija, ak tisiik che ki mi kobooto icheek ko Elisama ak Jehoram.
Ki ineetisyot eng' Judah, kotinyei bukuitap Ng'atuutigap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor. Kibendate nganasook tugul che po Judah ak koneetisyot eng' kwenutap piik.
Ki ibutyi `kamuisetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor laitornatosyek tugul che po emotinwek che ki mi tabanwegap Judah, kot ko mata kobookyi Jehoshaphat.

Ki ipchi Philistiik alak Jehoshaphat kagoochinoik ak fedha koek aisuruut, kigetyi Arabuuk ak icheek akwotisyegap keechiirek, mengichik eliphuusyek tisap ak pogol tisap, ak kwesik eliphuusyek tisap ak pogol tisap.
Kitesak Jehoshaphat koeet miising'. Ki teech irimoik ak nganasook che kigonoree tuguuk eng' Judah.
Ki tinyei poisyonik che chaang' eng' nganasoogap Judah; kobooto piigap lugeet, che kiimeen che nyigoonen, eng' Jerusalem.
Chu kaitosyekwak ko uu kooriigap kwanisyekwak: che po kap Judah, che ki kiptainigap eliphuusyek ko ki Adna ne ki kiptaiyat, ak ki tinyei piik che kiimeen che nyigoonen eliphuusyek pogol somok.
Ne kirubei ineendet ko ki Jeohanan ne ki kiptaiyat, ak ki tinyei piik eliphuusyek pogol aeng' ak tamanwogik sisiit,
kirubei ineendet Amasia weeriitap Zikri, ne ki igoochigei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' chamyet, ak ki tinyei piik che kiimeen che nyigoonen eliphuusyek pogol aeng'.
Eng' che po kap Benjamin ko ki Eliada ne kiim ak ko nyigan, ak ki tinyei piik eliphuusyek pogol aeng' che ki tinyei kwangok ak long'onik,
ak kirubei ineendet Jeosabad ne ki tinyei piik eliphuusyek pogol ak tamanwogik sisiit che ki chobootiin koyai lugeet.
Chuuto ko che kiboisyechin laitoryat, koma ki itito che ki inde laitoryat nganasook che ng'ootaatiin che po Judah tugul.
Ki tinyei Jehoshaphat mogornatosyek eng' chaang'indo ak teegisto ak kigaangei ak Ahab.

Kingo siirto kenyiisyek alage kochoortagei kap Ahab eng' Samaria. Ki eng'ji Ahab ineendet keechiirek ak tuuga che chaang' miising', kobooto piik che ki mi ak ineendet ak kogaigai ineendet kwo kotogosta kobookyi Ramoth-gilead.

Ki leenji `Ahab laitoryatap Israel Jehoshaphat laitoryatap Judah, “Ichame keebe tuwai Ramoth-gilead?” Ak ki wolji Jehoshaphat koleenji, “Auu kiit ne iuu, ak uu piikyuk piiguk. Ki mi kobooten eng' lugoni.”
Ago ki leenji `Jehoshaphat laitoryatap Israel, “Asoomin ale, teep eng' ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor rani.”
Ara ki iyum anyun laitoryatap Israel maotik pogol ang'wan, ak koleenji icheek, “Kibe kebargei ak Ramoth-gilead, anan atebi?” Ak ki leenji, “Togoste, amu indoi Kamuktaindet eutap laitoryat.”
Ago ki le Jehoshaphat, “Tos ma mi maotyotap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor age yu, si keteepse ineendet?”

Ki leenji `laitoryatap Israel Jehoshaphat, “Ta komi chiito age ne kimuuchi keteepse eng' Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ineendet ko Mikaia weeriitap Imla, ago aweche amu ma maoteni tuguuk che myachen agobo anee, kobatee yaityet kotugul.” Ki le Jehoshaphat, “Amat komwa laitoryat ko uu no.”
Ki kuur anyun laitoryatap Israel kiptaiyat age, ak koleenji, “Ui imutu ichogune Mikaia weeriitap Imla.”

Kiga tebee laitoryatap Israel ak Jehoshaphat laitoryatap Judah chii tugul ng'echerennyi ne po laitornatet, kolaachi ngoroikwak che po laitornatet, ak ki tebi eng' ole paraa eng' ole kibunei eng' ormariichetap Samaria; ak ki maoteni maotik tugul eng' tainnywa.
Kiyachigei Zedekiah weeriitap Kenaana kuinoigap kariik, ak kole, “Kamwa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Itoortae chuuto piigap Syria, kot kowong'kei.”
Kimaotenso maotik tugul ko uu nooto ak icheek, kole, “Togoste Ramoth-gilead ak iboor, amu indoi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor nganasanooto eutap laitoryat.”

Ki ng'alaalji ineendet `chiito ne kiga kiyookto koguur Mikaia, koleenji, “Keero, kachamak eng' laitoryat ng'aleegap maotik che kamwachi eng' kasyinet agenge. Asoomin ale, ingoigei anyun ng'olyoondeng'ung' ng'olyootap age eng' icheek, ng'alaal ng'aleek che myach.”
Ago ki le Mikaia, “Ko uu ye sabei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ko ki it ne mwaei Kamuktaindennyu, amwae nooto.”
Kingo it ineendet ole mi laitoryat, koleenji laitoryat ineendet, “Mikaia, kibe Ramot-gilead, anan atebi?” Ki le ineendet, “Otogoste ak oboor; ak kindo eunekwok pichooto.”
Ki leenji `laitoryat ineendet, “Ayosyeun konyil ata ale, amat imwaiwo kiy age kobatee imanda eng' kainetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor?”

Ki le Mikaia, “Ki ageer Israel tugul ko kaiyesta eng' tuloonook, ko uu keechiirek che ma tinyei mestowot, ak ki mwa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole, ‘Ma tinyei chuuto kiptaiyat; ingoweek chii tugul kwo koonnyi eng' kaalyeet.’ ”
Ki leenji `laitoryatap Israel Jehoshaphat, “Kama amwaun ale, ma maoteni ineendet tuguuk che myachen agobo anee, kobatee yaityet?”

Ki leenji Mikaia, “Ogas anyun ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor: ki ageer Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kotebyei eng' ng'echerennyi ne po laitornatet, ak kitononi lugeet tugul ne po kipsengwet eng' eunnyi ne po tai ak ne po kaataam.
Ak ki le Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ‘Ng'oo ne iberberi Ahab laitoryatap Israel, si kwo kotogosta ak kome eng' Ramoth-gilead?’ Ki mwa age ko uu ni, komwa age ko uu ni.
Ki mong' tamirmiryo ak kotonon eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ak kole, ‘Awendi aberberi.’ Ki leenji `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ineendet, ‘Iberbertoi ano?’
Ak ki le, ‘Awendi ak aegu tamirmir ne kenisyei eng' kutusweegap maotikyik tugul.’ Ak ki mwa ineendet kole, ‘Iberberi ineendet ak iterteer; ui anyun ak iyai ko uu nooto.’
Ara anyun, keero, kagonde Kamuktaindet ne Toroor tamirmir ne kenisyei kutusweegap maotichuguk tugul; ak kagomwa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor yaityet agobo inyee.”
Ki riik anyun Zedekiah weeriitap Kenaana, ak korabach Mikaia matanda, ak koleenji, “Kabun ano Kabuusetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ak konyo kong'alaalun?”
Ak ki le Mikaia, “Igeere eng' peetuunooto ye tuun iwendi koot ne po oriit iunyegei.”
Ki le laitoryatap Israel, “Onam Mikaia ak oweekte omutyi Ammon pounindetap nganaseet ak Joash weeriitap laitoryat.
Oleenji kamwa laitoryat kole, ‘Onde chiichi korgoreet, ak obae amitwogigap nyalilda ak peegap nyalilda, agoi aweege eng' kaalyeet.’ ”
Ak ki le Mikaia, “Ngot iweege iman eng' kaalyeet, ko kaagaa ma ng'alaalena Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.” Ak ki testai kole, “Ogas okweek piik tugul!”
Ara kitogosta anyun laitoryatap Israel ak Jehoshaphat laitoryatap Judah koba Ramot-gilead.
Ki leenji `laitoryatap Israel Jehoshaphat, “Awalegei aegu age ak awe lugeet, ago ilaach inyee ngoroik che po laitornatet.” Kowalgei anyun laitoryatap Israel koek age ak koba lugeet.
Kiga ng'at `laitoryatap Syria kiptainigap kariisyekyik, koleenji, “Amat obargei ak ne ming'in anan ko ne oo, kobatee laitoryatap Israel ineegei.”

Kingo keer kiptainichooto po kariisyek Jehoshaphat, komwa kole, “Niito ko laitoryatap Israel.” Ara kiweekyigei anyun kole kobargei ak ineendet; ago kiwaach Jehoshaphat, ak kitoret `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ineendet. Ki igoochi `Kamuktaindet icheek kobagaakta ineendet.
Kingo keer kiptainigap kariisyek kole ma laitoryatap Israel ni, koweek, mata koosup ineendet.

King'i chiito age kwangennyi komwok kosapsapchi ak kityech laitoryatap Israel ole tuiyechin kariikyik che ki ilaachi. Ki leenji anyun chiito ne kweriei chepkichutinnyi, “Imuta amanda eng' oli mi lugeet, amu kagiguotena miising'.”
Kitesak lugeet peetuunooto, ak kitiigei laitoryatap Israel eng' chepkichutinnyi kotokyigei piigap Syria agoi koskoleny. Ye kingo neegit kororokto asiista, kome ineendet.
Ki week Jehoshaphat laitoryatap Judah kwo koonnyi eng' Jerusalem eng' kaalyeet.

Ki wo Jehu weeriitap Hanani keerindet, kotorookta ineendet ak koleenji Laitoryat Jehoshaphat, “Tos yamin itoret kiptengekyot ak icham che wechei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor? Amu kiito, ko pwonjinin nereegek che punu taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Nganda uu nooto ko ki kigeerchin tuguuk che myachen, amu ki iste Aserot eng' emet ak ki igiil muguleldang'ung' icheeng' Kamuktaindet.”
Ki meny `Jehoshaphat Jerusalem, ak kiwendot kogeny eng' kwenutap piik kobooch Beer-sheba agoi emetap tuloonoogap Ephraim, ak komut icheek koweekyi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindetap kwanisyekwak.
Ki inde kirwoogik emet, eng' nganaseet age tugul eng' nganasook tugul che ng'ootaatiin che po Judah.
Ki leenji kirwoogichooto, “Obwaat kiit ne oyae, amu morwoochi agobo chii ago orwoochi agobo Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, mi ineendet kobootok ye oyae kirwooget.

Ingotebenok anyun kaiyweisyet ne oiywei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, oriip ak oyai, amu ma mi tengekto eng' Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindennyo anan ko tiytiyetap piik, ama taachei konunoik che kigoigoisye.”

Ki inde kogeny `Jehoshaphat Jerusalem alak eng' Lawiik ak tisiik, ak alak che po kandoigap kooriigap kwanisyegap Israel, agobo kirwoogetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ak agobo tuguuk che kamoiyo. Ak ki week koba Jerusalem.
Ki ng'at icheek koleenji: “Oyai ko uu niito eng' kaiyweisyet ne oiywei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, eng' imanda ak eng' muguleldo ne ititaat.

Eng' peetuut age tugul ne kaityok ng'olyootap chii age tugul ne punu tupchosyekwok che menyei nganasookwak, agobo korotiik eng' korotiik, ak agobo ng'atuutik ak kayomisutik, kaneetisyosyek ak kirwoogutik, oteechi, si ma nam icheek tengekto eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ak konyonjok nereeknateet, okweek ak tupchosyekwok. Oyai niito, si ma namak tengekto.

Keero, poiywok Amariah tisiindet ne oo eng' tuguuk tugul che po Kamuktaindet ne Toroor; ak koboiywok Sebadia weeriitap Ishmael, pounindetap kootap Judah eng' tuguuk tugul che po laitoryat, ak egu Lawiik kiptainik eng' taing'wong'. Oboisye eng' nyiganateet, ak kotebi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kobooto ineendet ne yaei ne myee.”
Kingo pata niito, kobwa kobargei ak Jehoshaphat piigap Moab ak piigap Ammon, ak alak eng' Amonik.
Ki pwa piik alak komwachi Jehoshaphat, koleenji, “Ipookyinin tuiyet ne oo ne punu nyanjet pitoniin eng' Syria; ak mi Hasason-tamar (nooto ko En-gedi).”
Ki iyweis anyun Jehoshaphat, ak ko ki ilgei kocheeng' Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ak komwaita karugutetapkei eng' Judah tugul.
Ki iyumgei Judah tugul kocheeng' toreteet eng' Kamuktaindet ne Toroor; ki pwa eng' nganasook tugul che po Judah kocheeng' Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ki tonon anyun Jehoshaphat eng' tuiyetap Judah ak ne po Israel, eng' kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, eng' taitap seremut ne leel,

ak ki le, “Ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindetap kwanisyekyok, tos ma ii Kamuktaindet eng' kipsengwet? Tos ma ii pounindet ne pou laitornatosyek tugul che po pororyosyek? Mi eung'ung' kimnateet ak kamuktaet, ne ma mi ne imuuchi kogirinden.
Tos ma ioon inyee, ee Kamuktaindennyo, piik che ki menyei emoni eng' taitap piiguk Israel, ak igoochi kobunji iyoteetap Abraham chorweng'ung' koigeny?
Ki meny icheek olito, ak ki koteegun ole-tiliil agobo kaineng'ung', koleen,

‘Ngot konyonjech yaityet, rotwetap chok, kirwooget, anan koroito anan rubeet, ketononie eng' taitap kooi, ak eng' taing'ung', amu mi kaineng'ung' kooi, ak keriirchin eng' nyalilwogikyok, ak igaseech ak isarwech.’
Keer nguno anyuno, lagogap Ammon, Moab ak che po tulweetap Seir, che ki ma ichamji Israel kobookyi ye kingo pwanei komong'u eng' emetap Misiri, ago kirop taban, ama par.
Keer anyuno, ole kagogeerundawech, kobwa komaandech eng' poroteng'ung', ne ki igoonech kobunjech.
Ee Kamuktaindennyo, merwookyini? Amu ma ki tinyei kamuget kebarge ak tuiyoni oo kagobokyech. Ma kingen kiit ne kiyaei, ago inyalin konyekyok.”
Kitononso Judah tugul eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, kobooto manyurunikwak, osotikwak ak lagokwak.
Ki nyoonji anyun Kabuusetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Jaasyel weeriitap Zekariah, weeriitap Benaiah, weeriitap Jeiel, weeriitap Mattaniah, Lawindet, ne po weeriigap Asaph, eng' kwenutap tuiyet.

Ki le ineendet, “Oeb iit okweek tugul kap Judah ak che omenye Jerusalem, kobooten inyee Laitoryat Jehoshaphat: kamwaiwok Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ko uu ni, kole: ‘Amoiywei anan oaragense amu lugoni oo; amu ma neng'wong' lugeet, ago po Kamuktaindet.
Orektee mutai obargei ak icheek. Togosu icheek eng' tegeiyetap Sis; ak onyoorchini ye igeesunegei atebweet, taitap surkwen ne po Jeruel.

Ma okweek che oyae lugoni. Otetkei, otononse, si ogeer yetunetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne mi kobootok, ee Judah ak Jerusalem. Amoiyweisye, anan oaragense. Oba opookyi icheek mutai; amu mi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kobootok.’ ”
Ki ing'uruuk anyun Jehoshaphat kot kotiiny togeet ng'wony, ak kap Judah tugul ak piigap Jerusalem ak ki ibutyi taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ak kolas Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Kitononso Lawiik, ak che po lagogap Kohatik, ak che po lagogap Koraik, kolas Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindetap Israel, eng' kutit ne oo miising'.

Ki ng'eetyo karon miising', komusta surkwen ne po Tekoa. Ye kingo ta kobendi, kotonon Jehoshaphat ak kole, “Ogasa, ee Judah, ak che omenye Jerusalem! Oyan Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindeng'wong', si kobiit ogimegitu; oyan maotikyik, si oboor.”

Kingo kagong'alaal ak piik, kolewen che tyenjin Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ak kolasu ineendet eng' karaaranindap tiliilindo, komandoi kondoe lugeet, koleen, “Oweekyi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kongoi, amu po koigeny rireenennyi.”
Kingo toi kotyenso ak kolasu, konde `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor piik che ribistos si kobargei ak lagogap Ammon, ak Moab, ak tulweetap Seir, che ki kobwonji kobookyi Judah; ak ki kibar.
Amu kitononso lagogap Ammon ak Moab kobargei ak che ki menyei tulweetap Seir, kobar kogees ak kong'em. Ye kingo kagogees che ki menyei Seir, kotoret chii tugul kobar chiito ne kami tuwai.
Kingo it piigap Judah teekseet ne kooi ne kiriipse eng' surkwen, kotoben piik che chaang'; ak kiga kobutyo koek muuswek, ak ki ma komi agot agenge ne kichilil.

Kingo nyo Jehoshaphat kobooto piikyik konam tuguuk, konyoor eng' kwenunnywa tuguuk ng'iisyat che po mogornateet ak ngoroik, tuguuk che po kamanuutik che eecheen, che kibut eng' pichooto koipchigei, che kitemenee kola. Ki tar peetuutap somok koibei parunenichooto, amu ki chaang' kot.
Ki iyumjigei atebweetap Beraka eng' peetuutap ang'wan; amu eng' olooto ko ki ilas Kamuktaindet ne Toroor. Ki kiguure anyun kainetap yooto Atebweetap Beraka, agoi ra.
Ki week tugul che po Judah ak Jerusalem, kondoe Jehoshaphat, kobendi Jerusalem eng' poiboiyet, amu ki igoochi `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor icheek koboiboitu amu puunikwak.
Ki pwa Jerusalem kobutonu kibugandinik ak ketubosyek, ak koguutonu iryagook kot koit kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ki nam kaiyweisyet ne iywei Kamuktaindet laitornatosyek tugul che po emotinwek, ye kingo kas kole ki par Kamuktaindet ne Toroor puunigap Israel.
Ki imuuny anyun pounatetap Jehoshaphat, amu ki igoochi Kamuktaindennyi kamuung'et eng' tabanwek tugul.
Ara ki laitoran Jehoshaphat eng' Judah. Ki po kenyiisyek sosom ak muut ye ki tau kolaitorani, ak ki laitoran kenyiisyek tiptem ak muut eng' Jerusalem. Kainetap kamennyi ko ki Hasubah cheptap Sili.
Kiwendote ortinwegap kwandanyi Asa ak ma masta kometo, ki yai ne myee eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ago ma ki isto komoswek che torooreen; ki tomo kogiil piik mugulelwekwak kotokyi Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindetap kwanisyekwak.
Ki kisirchi poisyonigap Jehoshaphat che ng'etunotiin, che po tai ak che po let, kitabuutap Jehu weeriitap Hanani, ki kisirchi chooto kitabuutap laitorinigap Israel.
Kingo pata niito konamgei Jehoshaphat laitoryatap Judah ak Ahasia laitoryatap Israel, ki yai Ahasia ne ya miising'.
Ki namgei ak ineendet si kobiit koteech melisyek koba Tarsis; ak ki teech melisyechooto eng' Esion-geber.

Ki maoten Elieser weeriitap Dodabahu ne po Maresha agobo Jehoshaphat, kole, “Amu koonamge ak Ahasia, ko kagong'em Kamuktaindet ne Toroor poisyoniguk.” Kibutok anyun melisyek ak ki mata komuuch koba Tarsis.
Ki ru Jehoshaphat ak kwanisyekyik ak ki kitupchi ole ki kitupchi kwanisyekyik eng' nganaseetap Daudi. Ki laitoran anyun Jehoram weeriinnyi kogeer ineendet.
Ki tinyei ineendet weeriik alak che tupcho, weeriigap Jehoshaphat chooto ko: Azariah, Jehiel, Zekariah, Azariah, Mikael ak Shepatiah. Chuuto tugul ko ki weeriigap Jehoshaphat laitoryatap Israel.

Ki igoochi `kwandanywa icheek kagoochinoik che eecheen, che po fedha, che po thahabu ak che po tuguuk che po kamanuutyet ne oo, kobooto nganasook che ng'ootaatiin che po Judah; ago ki igoochi `ineendet laitornatet Jehoram amu ki taita.
Kingo kagonam Jehoram pounatetap kwandanyi ak kogimitkei, kobar tupchosyekyik tugul eng' rotwetap chok ak alak che po pounigap Israel.
Ki po Jehoram kenyiisyek sosom ak aeng' ye ki tau kolaitorani ak ki laitoran kenyiisyek sisiit eng' Jerusalem.
Kiwendote ortinwegap laitorinigap Israel, ko uu ye ki yai kootap Ahab, amu ki itun cheptap Ahab. Ki yai ne ya eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Agot nganda ki uu nooto koma cham Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kong'em kootap Daudi amu kayomiset ne kiga koyomisyi Daudi, ak ko uu ye ki iarorchi ineendet ak lagokyik kole igoochin ineendet tait koigeny.
Ki ingelelji `Edomik pounatetap Judah eng' peetuusyekyik ak ki ieetyigei laitoryat ne pou icheek.
Ki wo anyun Jehoram kolanda kobooto kiptainikyik kotinyei kariisyekyik tugul. Ki ng'eet kemoi ak kobookyi Edomik che kigayiem ineendet kobooto kiptainigap kariisyek.
Ki ingelel anyun Edomik kobagaakta pounatetap Judah agoi rani. Ki ingelel agine Libna eng' peetuusyechooto, amu kiga kometo Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindetap kwanisyekyik.
Ma nooto kityo, ago ki teech kogeny komoswek che torooreen eng' tuloonoogap Judah, ak koyai che ki menyei Jerusalem koibotkei, ak kobeet Judah.

Ki nyoonji ineendet parweet ne ki punu maotyot Elijah, koleenji, “Kamwa ko uu ni Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindetap Daudi kwandang'ung', kole: Amu ma iwendote ortinwegap Jehoshaphat kwandang'ung' anan ortinwegap Asa laitoryatap Judah,

ago ki iwendote ortinwegap laitorinigap Israel, ak ki igoochi Judah ak che menyei Jerusalem koyai ibeetapkei, ko uu ye ki yai kootap Ahab. Ki ibar kogeny tupchosyeguk che po kootap kwandang'ung', che kigoigoi kosiirin,
ara anyun, parei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor piiguk, lagoguk, osotiguk ak tuguuguk tugul, eng' koroito ne oo.
Inyooru myando ne oo eng' moet, agoi komong' agutaniguk eng' myanooto, peetuut age tugul.”
Ki ing'eet Kamuktaindet ne Toroor nereeknatetap Philistik ak ne po Arabuuk che menyei ole neegitee Ethiopik kobargei ak Jehoram.

Ki togos icheek kobookyi Judah, ak kobut koba oriit ak koip tuguuk tugul che kinyoor eng' kootap laitoryat, kiluul weeriikyik ak icheek, ak osotikyik kot koma ng'etyi weeriit agot agenge, kobatee Jehoahas, weeriit ne ming'in eng' tugul.
Kingo pata chuuto tugul, kobir `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ineendet eng' myando eng' agutanikyik ne ma inyaaksei.
Kingo pata kenyiisyek aeng'u komong' agutanikyik amu myandanyi, ak kime eng' myanwogik che ng'woneen. Ma peelji piikyik kiy ineendet, ko uu ye ki kibeelji kwanisyekyik.

Ki po kenyiisyek sosom ak aeng' ye ki tau kolaitorani, ak ki laitoran eng' Jerusalem kenyiisyek sisiit. Kime anyun, koma komachei chii ineendet ak ki kitupchi nganaseetap Daudi, ago ma eng' kereeriisyegap laitorinik.

Ki inde piik che ki menyei Jerusalem Ahasia weeriinnyi ne ming'in koek laitoryat kogeer ineendet: amu ki par kweanet ne kigabwa nganaseet kobooto Arabuuk, weeriik tugul che eecheen. Ara ki laitoran anyun Ahasia weeriitap Jehoram eng' Judah.
Ki po kenyiisyek artam ak aeng' Ahasia ye ki tau kolaitorani; ak ki laitoran kenyiit agenge eng' Jerusalem. Kainetap kamennyi ko ki Athaliah cheptap Omri.
Kiwendote agine ortinwegap kootap Ahab, amu ki ek kamennyi kaneetindennyi ne ki ineet ineendet koyai ne ya.
Ki yai ne ya eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ko uu ye ki yai kootap Ahab; amu ki kaneetikyik che ki ineeti ineendet, kingo kagome kwandanyi, agoi ng'emisyennyi.
Ki isup kaneetisyennywa, ak koba ak Jehoram weeriitap Ahab laitoryatap Israel kobargei ak Hazael laitoryatap Syria eng' Ramoth-gilead. Ki iguoten `piigap Syria Joram.

Ki week konyo kinya eng' Jezreel, mook che ki kitoor eng' Ramah, ye ki paregei ak Hazael laitoryatap Syria. Ak kichoortagei Azariah weeriitap Jehoram laitoryatap Judah kwo kogeer Jehoram weeriitap Ahab eng' Jezreel, amu kimyani.

Ki punu Kamuktaindet ng'emisyetap Ahasia, amu ki wo ole mi Joram. Kingo it ineendet, koba ak Jehoram kobargei ak Jehu weeriitap Nimshi ne kiga koiil Kamuktaindet ne Toroor si kobiit kobar kootap Ahab kogees.
Ye kita korwookyin Jehu kootap Ahab, konyoor pounigap Judah ak weeriigap tupchosyegap Ahasia, che kiboisyechin Ahasia, ak ki par icheek.

Ki cheeng' Ahasia, ak ki nam ineendet ye ki ung'egei eng' Samaria. Ki kimutyi Jehu ak ki par ineendet. Kitup `icheek ineendet, amu ki le “Ineendet ko weeriitap Jehoshaphat, ne ki cheeng' Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' muguleldanyi tugul.” Ak ma sich kootap Ahasia kimnateet konam laitornatet.
Kingo keer Athaliah kametap Ahasia kole ki kome weeriinnyi, kong'eet ak kobar iyoteet tugul ne po kaplaitoryat ne po kootap Judah.

Ago ki imut komweito Jehoshabeat, cheptap laitoryat, Joash weeriitap Ahasia, kochoor ineendet komut eng' ole mi weeriigap laitoryat, chu ki kibarei, ak konde ineendet ak cheplakwet koot ne kiruei eng' koot oriit. Kouny anyun ineendet `Jehoshabeat cheptap Laitoryat Jehoram, osotyotap Jehoiada tisiindet, amu ki chepkametap Ahasia, si ma par Athaliah.
Ki tebi kobooto icheek ko ung'aat eng' kootap Kamuktaindet kenyiisyek lo, ye ki laitorani Athaliah eng' emet.

Ki nyoor nyiganateet Jehoiada eng' kenyiitap tisap, ak ki yai koyomiset ak kiptainigap pogolusyek, Azariah weeriitap Jeroham, Ishmael weeriitap Jeohanan, Azariah weeriitap Obed, Maaseia weeriitap Adaiah, ak Elisapat weeriitap Zikri.
Kibendat icheek koyom Judah komugul, ak koyum Lawiik eng' nganasook tugul che po Judah kobooto kandoigap kwanisyegap Israel, ak ki pwa Jerusalem.
Ak ki iyomiskei ak laitoryat tuiyet komugul eng' kootap Kamuktaindet. Ak ki leenji, “Ingolaitoran weeriitap laitoryat, ko uu ye ki mwa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor agobo weeriigap Daudi.
Ni kiit ne oyae: egu riibiigap kurgotik kebeberta agenge eng' somok eng' okweek, che pwoonei eng' peetuutap sabato, che po Tisiik ak Lawiik;
kotebee kebeberta agenge eng' somok kootap laitoryat; kotebee kebeberta agenge eng' somok kurgeetap lumeiywot: ak ingotebee piik tugul seremusyegap kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ago amochamji chii konyo kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, kobatee tisiik, ak Lawiik che otisyei; pwoonei icheeget amu tiliileen: ago riibei piik tugul riipseetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Si koyiem Lawiik laitoryat, kotinyei chii tugul kariikyik eng' eunnyi ak chii age tugul ne nyoonei ko, kebarei: ak otebi ak laitoryat ye nyoonei ko ak ye mandoi.”

Koyai anyun Lawiik ak Judah tugul kiit ne kang'at icheek Jehoiada tisiindet: komut chii tugul piikyik, piik che pwoonei eng' sabato, ak che kimandoi eng' sabato; amu ma pagaakta Jehoiada tisiindet riipsosyechooto.
Ak ki igoochi Jehoiada tisiindet kiptainigap pogolwogik ng'otwek, ak long'onik che mengeechen, ak long'onik che eecheen, che ki po Laitoryat Daudi, che ki mi kootap Kamuktaindet.
Ak kitet piik tugul, kotinyei chii tugul kariikyik eng' eunekyik, kobooch komostap tai ne po koot agoi komostap kaataam ne po koyooto, ye neegitee kaptisisyet, ak koot, koyiem laitoryat.
Komong' anyun weeriitap laitoryat, ak kolaakyi naaryeet, ak kogoochi paornateet, ak konde ineendet koek laitoryat: ak ki iil Jehoiada ak weeriikyik, ineendet; ak kole ingosap laitoryat.
Ak kingo kas Athaliah polatetap piik che rwaoti ak kolasu laitoryat, konyo ole mi piik eng' kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor:

Ak ki keerot, ogeero, ki tononi laitoryat eng' ole neegitee toloitanyi eng' ye kibunei kebendi oriit, komi kiptainik ak iryagook ye mi laitoryat; ak kiboiboitu piik tugul che po emet, ak koguutei iryagook; kibutei ak icheek tyeniik kibugandinik, ak kondochin tyendap kalasunet. Kogereer anyun Athaliah ngoroikyik, ak kole, “Chaamset! Chaamset!”

Komut anyun Jehoiada tisiindet kiptainigap pogolwogik, kobwa saang', che kiga kinde koboi lugeet, koleenji, “Omaande ineendet eng' kwenutap piik; ak kibarei eng' rotwetap chok chiito ne isubi ineendet.” Amu ki le tisiindet, “Amobarchi kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.”
Koistochigei anyun icheek ineendet; ak ki wo ye kichutei ormariichetap paraisiit ne po kootap laitoryat; ak ki parchi yooto.
Koyomiskei anyun Jehoiada ak piik tugul, ak laitoryat, kole koek piigap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ak ki pa piik tugul kootap Baal, kobut, ak kobut kapkorosusyekyik, ak kotuatui kanamonikyik, ak kobar Matan tisiindetap Baal eng' taitap kapkorosusyek.

Ak ki ng'at Jehoiada poisyonigap kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor koboi tisiik, Lawiik, che kiga kopchei Daudi eng' kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, si kogoitoi kagoochinoik che kibeelei che po Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ko uu ye ki kisir eng' ng'atuutigap Musa, si koboiboitu ak kotyendos, ko uu ng'atuutyetap Daudi.
Ak ki inde riibiik kurgotigap kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, si ma wo ko chii age tugul ne ma tiliil eng' kiy age tugul.

Ak ki nam kiptainigap pogolwogik, ak piik che taagunotiin, ak pounigap piik, kobooto piik tugul che po emet, si komut laitoryat kochoorgei eng' kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor: ak ki pun ormariichet ne toroor kot koit kootap laitoryat, ak konde laitoryat kotebee ng'echereetap laitornatet ne po pounateet.
Koboiboitu anyun piik tugul che po emet, ak ki siis nganaseet: ak ki par Athaliah eng' rotwetap chok.
Ki po Joash kenyiisyek tisap ye ki tau kolaitorani; ki laitoran kenyiisyek artam eng' Jerusalem. Ki kiguure kamet Sibia, ne po Beer-sheba.
Ki yai Joash ne myee eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' peetuusyek tugul che po Jehoiada tisiindet.
Ak ki itunji Jehoiada ineendet osotik aeng', ak ki sich weeriik ak tiibiik.
Kingo pata chooto komach Joash koteech kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ole kiga kobutok.

Ki iyum Tisiik ak Lawiik ak koleenji, “Oba nganasoogap Judah ak oyumate Israel tugul fedhaisyek che kiteege kogeny kootap Kamuktaindeng'wong', eng' kenyiit age tugul, oyai niito eng' chokyinet.” Ago ki ma yai Lawiik ko uu nooto.

Koguur anyun `laitoryat tisiindet ne oo Jehoiada, ak koleenji, “Amu nee si memwachi Lawiik koyumat eng' Judah ak Jerusalem aisuruut ne ki ng'at Musa otwogindetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ak tuiyetap Israel, agobo emaitap paornateet?
Amu ki kobut weeriigap Athaliah, kwonyooto sogoran kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ak kogoochi Baalik tuguuk tugul che kiga kitabaanji kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.”
Kong'at anyun laitoryat, ak ki yai moinget, ak konde kurgeet saang' ne po kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ki kimwaita eng' Judah ak Jerusalem keipchi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor aisuruut ne ki ng'at Musa otwogindetap Kamuktaindet eng' surkwen agobo Israel.
Kiboiboitu pounik tugul ak piik tugul, ak ki ip aisurunooto konde moinget agoi konyiit.

Ak kingo kagoip Lawiik moinget konyo kootap laitoryat, ko ngo keer kole chaang' fedhaisyek eng' oriit, konyo siriindetap laitoryat ak kiboityotap tisiindet ne oo ak korong' fedhaisyek eng' moinget, ak koip moinget koweekta kwo ye kami. Ki yai ko uu nooto peetuut age tugul, ak ki iyum fedhaisyek che chaang'.

Ki igoochi `laitoryat ak `Jehoiada fedhaisyechooto piik che kitononjin poisyetap kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor. Ki sir `icheek musogigap koik ak che po pagoinik si koteech kogeny kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ole kiga kobutok, ak ki igoochi kogeny kitang'igap kariik ak che po sugunonik, si kogetyi kogeny kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Kobois anyun kiboitiinik, ak ki yai poisyonooto kosulda, ak ki lumda kootap Kamuktaindet ko uu ye ki uu, ak kogimit.

Kingo kagogees, koipchi `icheek laitoryat ak Jehoiada fedhaisyek che kiga ng'et; chuuto che ki kiyae tuguuk che po kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, che chooto ko ki tuguuk che ki kiotisye, che ki kigoitoisye, kechigosyek ak tuguuk che po thahabu ak che po fedha. Ki igoitoi kotugul kagoochinoik che kibeelei eng' kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' peetuusyek tugul che po Jehoiada.
Ago ki oosit Jehoiada ko uu ye kiga kochang'a peetuusyekyik, ak ki ilil; kiga kotar ineendet kenyiisyek pogol ak sosom ye kingo meei.
Ak ki kitupchi ineendet nganaseetap Daudi kobooto laitorinik, amu ki yai ne myee eng' Israel, eng' Kamuktaindet ak koonnyi.
Kingo kagome Jehoiada kobwa pounigap Judah ak kogutung'ji laitoryat. Kogasyi anyun laitoryat ng'aleekwak.
Kometo anyun kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindetap kwanisyekwak, ak koot Aserik ak kanamonik. Ki nyoonji anyun nereegek Judah ak Jerusalem agobo ng'oogiswechuchwak.
Agos ki iyookyi icheek maotik kole komut icheek koweekyi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor; ak kibaoryan kogirinda icheek, ago ma cham kogas.

Ki nyoonji `Kabuusetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Zekariah weeriitap Jehoiada tisiindet; ki tonon eng' ole toroor ak koleenji piik, “Kale Kamuktaindet: Amu nee si obistoe ng'atuutigap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, si mobor? Amu ki omete Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ko kagometook ak okweek.”
Ago kichaam ineendet ak kolage koik eng' ng'atuutyetap laitoryat eng' seremutap kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Nooto anyun, ma ibwaat Laitoryat Joash myeeindo ne kiga koyachi Jehoiada kwandanyi, ago ki par weeriinnyi. Ak kingo meei, komwa kole, “Ingogeer Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kioto, ak koyaakta.”
Ak kingo keskei kenyiit, kotogos lugeetap piigap Syria kobookyi Joash. Ki it icheek Judah ak Jerusalem, ak ki par pounik tugul che po piik. Ki iyookyi parunenik tugul laitoryatap Damasko.

Nganda ki nyo lugeetap piigap Syria komut kweanet ne ming'in, ko ki inde Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eunekwak lugeet ne oo miising', amu kiga kometo Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindetap kwanisyekwak. Ki irwookyi anyun Joash.

Ye kingo pa icheek, kobagaach ineendet koguotenot, kochaam ineendet otwogikyik amu korotiigap weeriigap Jehoiada tisiindet, ak ki parchi itogunnyi. Kitupchi ineendet nganaseetap Daudi, ago ma tupchi ineendet kereeriisyegap laitorinik.
Ak chu ko icheek che kichaam ineendet: Sabad weeriitap Simeat Jebamonindet, ak Jeosabad weeriitap Simirit chemoabindet.

Ogeero, ki kisir agobo weeriikyik, ak ooindap milosyek che ki kigesenji ineendet ak teekseetap kootap Kamuktaindet, eng' ng'aleegap bukuitap laitorinik. Ak ki laitoran Amasia weeriinnyi kogeer ineendet.
Ki po Amasia kenyiisyek tiptem ak muut ye ki tau kolaitorani; ak ki laitoran kenyiisyek tiptem ak sogool eng' Jerusalem. Kainetap kamennyi ko ki Jehoadan ne po Jerusalem.
Ki yai ne myee eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ago ma eng' muguleldo ne ititaat.
Kingo kagogimiit laitornatennyi, kobar otwogikyik che ki par kwandanyi laitoryat.

Ago ma par lagokwak, ki yai ko uu ye ki kisir eng' Ng'atuutik che mi bukuitap Musa, ko uu ye kiga ng'at Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole, “Mabegu kwanisyek agobo lagok, anan kobek lagok agobo kwanisyekwak; ago meei chii tugul agobo tengektanyi.”

Kogeny, ko ki iyum Amasia piigap Judah, ak kotet icheek kobee kooriigap kwanisyekwak, kondochin kiptainigap eliphuusyek ak kiptainigap pogolwogik Judah tugul ak Benjamin: ak kiit icheek kobooch che po kenyiisyek tiptem ak che siirei, ak ki ek piik eliphuusyek pogol somok che ki kilewen, che imuuchi koba lugeet, che ki imuuchi konam ng'otwek ak long'onik.
Ki sir kogeny piik eliphuusyek pogol che kiimeen ak ko nyigoonen eng' Israel eng' talendaisyek pogol che po fedha.
Ago ki nyo chiitap Kamuktaindet ole mi, ak koleenji, “Ee laitoryat, amobe kobooto lugeetap Israel; amu ma mi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kobooto Israel, chooto ko lagok tugul che po Ephraim.
Ago ngot imache iwe, iwe, inyiganitu, igimitu eng' lugeet: wiirtoin Kamuktaindet eng' taitap puunyoot; amu tinyei Kamuktaindet kimnateet kotoret, ak kotinyei kimnateet kowiirta.”

Ak ki leenji `Amasia chiitap Kamuktaindet, Ara si kelyonji talendaisyek pogol che ki agoochi lugeetap Israel? Kowol anyun chiitap Kamuktaindet kole imuuchi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kogoonin che siirei chuuto miising'.
Koweekta anyun Amasia icheek, nooto ko lugeet ne kiga nyo oldanyi, ne ki punu Ephraim, koweek koba kaa: kolalyo anyun nereegekwak kot agobo Judah, ak ki week koba kaa eng' nereegek che ng'woneen.
Konyiganit anyun Amasia, ak kondochi piikyik, kwo Atebweetap Munyuk, ak kobar che po lagogap Seir eliphuusyek taman.
Ak kiluul `lagogap Judah piik alak eliphuusyek taman, ak komut kobwa paragutap rwandet, ak kotoorta eng' rwandanooto parak, ak kitonogis tugul.
Ago ki par piigap lugeet che kiweektoi Amasia kole amaba tugul lugeet, nganasoogap Judah kobooch Samaria kot koit Beth-horon, ki par piik eliphuusyek somok, ak koip parunenik che chaang'.
Ak kingo punu Amasia pareetap Edomik, koip kanamonigap lagogap Seir, ak kolumda koek kanamonikyik, ak kong'uruukyi icheek eng' tainnywa, ak kobeelji nyamdutik.
Kolalyo anyun nereegegap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor agobo Amasia, ak koyookyi maotyot ne ki mwachi ineendet koleenji, “Amu nee si icheeng' kanamonigap piik, che tomo kosar piikwak eng' eung'ung'?”

Ak ye kita kong'alaaldos ak ineendet, koleenji laitoryat, Tos kogindein iegu kirwoogindetap laitoryat? Muite; amu nee si imache kebarin? Kimuita anyun maotyot, ak ki le, Angen ale, kagotil Kamuktaindet kole kong'emin, amu kaiyai ni, ama igas ng'aleekyuk.
Korwooch anyun Amasia laitoryatap Judah, ak ki iyookto piik koba kap Joash weeriitap Jehoahas weeriitap Jehu laitoryatap Israel, koleenji, Nyoo ketuiye kegeerge togoch.

Ak ki iyookyi Joash laitoryatap Israel piik Amasia laitoryatap Judah, koleenji, “Ki iyookto ng'olyoot kateet ne rutei piich ne ki mi Lebanon koyookyi tarakwet ne ki mi Lebanon, koleenji igoochi cheptong'ung' weeriinnyu kotun: ak kisiirto tyondo ne po timiin ne ki mi Lebanon, ak kotyech katanooto rutei piich.”
Imwae ile, Keero, ki ibar Edom; ak itoroorin muguleldang'ung' si ilasuge: tebee koong'ung'; amu nee si icheeng'jigei nyalilda, si ibut inyee, kobooto Judah?
Ago ma cham Amasia kogas; amu ki punu Kamuktaindet kioto, si kobiit konde icheek eunegap puunikwak, amu ki cheeng' kanamonigap Edom.
Ki togosta anyun Joash laitoryatap Israel; ak kigeergei ineendet ak Amasia laitoryatap Judah togoch eng' Beth-shemesh, ne po Judah.
Ak ki kiterteer Judah eng' taitap Israel; ak ki mwei chii tugul kwo emainnyi.

Ak ki imut Joash laitoryatap Israel Amasia laitoryatap Judah weeriitap Joash weeriitap Jehoahas, eng' Beth-shemesh, ak komut ineendet konyo Jerusalem, ak kobut irimeet ne po Jerusalem kobooch ormariichetap Ephraim agoi ormariichetap luuita, mitainik pogol ang'wan che po euut.
Ak ki ip thahabu tugul ak fedha, ak tuguuk tugul che ki mi kootap Kamuktaindet kobooto Obed-edom, ak konoraik che po kootap laitoryat, kobooto luulenik ak icheek, ak ki week kwo Samaria.
Ak kita kosap Amasia weeriitap Joash laitoryatap Judah kenyiisyek taman ak muut kingo pata meetap Joash weeriitap Jehoahas laitoryatap Israel.
Ak poisyonik che ng'etunotiin che po Amasia, che po tai ak che po let, ogeero, tos ma siraatiin eng' kitabuutap laitorinigap Judah ak Israel?
Kichaam `piik Amasia eng' Jerusalem, kobooch ngap komasta kobagaakta Kamuktaindet ne Toroor; ak ki mwei kwo Lakish: ago ki iyookto piik koosup ineendet koba Lakish, ak kobar ineendet eng' olooto.
Ak kilaune ineendet paraisisyek, ak kotupchi nganaseetap Judah kobooto kwanisyekyik.
Yeityo konam piik tugul che po Judah Uzziah ne ki po kenyiisyek taman ak lo, ak koeet ineendet koek laitoryat kogeer kwandanyi Amasia.
Ki teech Elot ak koweekyi Judah, ko kagoru laitoryat kobooto kwanisyekyik.
Ki po Uzziah kenyiisyek taman ak lo ye ki tau kolaitorani; ak ki laitoran kenyiisyek konom ak aeng' eng' Jerusalem. Ki kiguure kamet Jekilia ne po Jerusalem.
Ki yai ne myee eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ko uu tugul che ki yai kwandanyi Amasia.

Ki igiil muguleldanyi kocheeng' Kamuktaindet eng' peetuusyegap Zekariah, ne ki tinyei kaguiyet agobo ng'ang'utyetap Kamuktaindet; ak eng' peetuusyek tugul che ki cheeng' Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ko ki iberuur `Kamuktaindet ineendet.
Ki wo anyun kobargei ak Philistiik, ak kobut irimeetap Gath, ak irimeetap Jabne ak irimeetap Ashdod; ak ki teech nganasook eng' Ashdod ak eng' kwenutap Philistiik.
Kitoret `Kamuktaindet ineendet kobargei ak Philistiik, ak kobargei ak Arabuuk che ki menyei Gur-baal, kobooto Meunik.
Ki igoochi Amonik Uzziah kagoochinoik, ak ki yom kainennyi agoi kiwotosyegap Misiri; amu kitesak kimnateennyi kot.
Kogeny, ko ki teech Uzziah teeksosyek che kooen eng' Jerusalem eng' ormariichetap luuita, ak eng' ormariichetap atebweet, ak eng' ole weegegei irimeet, ak kogimit.

Ak ki teech teeksosyek che kooen eng' surkwen, ak ki pal keriingonik che chaang' che po peek, amu ki tinyei tuuga che chaang'; eng' emet ne soi agine, ak eng' warenget. Ki tinyei kabotik ak che riibei logoegap sabibuk eng' tuloonook ak eng' mbareenik che rurtos miising'; amu ki chamei kabatisyet.

Ki tinyei kogeny Uzziah lugeet ne po piigap pooryeet, che kigaba paretapkei eng' kweanaik ko uu koiitennywa ne kiiti Jeiel siriindet ak Maaseia pounindet, kondochin Hananiah, ne ki agenge eng' kiptainigap laitoryat.
Koitet komugul ne po kandoigap kooriigap kwanisyek, piik che kiimeen ak ko nyigoonen, ko ki eliphuusyek aeng' ak pogol lo.
Ki mi eunekwak kiplugotinik che ineetatin eliphuusyek pogol somok ak tisap ak pogol muut, che ki yai lugeet eng' kimnateet ne oo, si kotoret laitoryat kobargei ak puunik.
Kichopchi Uzziah lugeet tugul, long'onik, ng'otwek, kutonook, kariigap tegeet, kwangok ak koik che ki wiirtoe porowet.

Ak ki yai injinisyek eng' Jerusalem, che ki toi koyai piik che ng'oomen, kotebee teeksosyek che kooen ak irimoik, che kimwoktoe kipchabonik ak ki wiirtoe koik che eecheen. Ak ki yom ole loo kainennyi, amu ki kitoret miising' kot kogimit.

Ago ye kingo kagogimiit, koloskei eng' muguleldanyi kot koyai ne ya, ak ki ingelelji Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindennyi; amu ki wo Hekaluutap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kobeel nyamdutik eng' kapkorosutap nyamdutik.
Ki wo Azariah tisiindet koosup ineendet, kobooto tisiik che nyigoonen tamanwogik sisiit che po Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kwo ko.

Ki kirinda Uzziah laitoryat ak koleenji, “Manyoljin, Uzziah, ibeelji Kamuktaindet ne Toroor nyamdutik, ago nyoljin tisiik weeriigap Aron, che ki kitabaan kobeel nyamdutik. Mande eng' ole-tiliil; amu kengelel; ma egu teegisto niito eng' inyee ne punu Kamuktaindet ne po Toroornatet.”

Ki nereech anyun Uzziah. Ki tinyei ineendet tereet eng' eunnyi ne kibeelee nyamdutik; ak ye kinereekyin tisiik, komang'une mogondosaik togeennyi eng' taitap tisiik eng' kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, eng' ye neegitee kapkorosutap nyamdutik.

Ye ki keer Azariah tisiindet ne oo, ak tisiik tugul, kogeer ko kagomang'une mogondosaik togeennyi. Ki oon ineendet eng' yooto kochokyi, ak kichaakta agine komanda, amu kiga kobir `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ineendet.

Ki am mogondosaik Uzziah laitoryat agoi peetuutap meennyi, ak ki meny koot ne itabaanat, amu ki tinyei mogondosaik; amu ki kiistoe ineendet kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor. Ki pou Jotham weeriinnyi piigap kootap laitoryat, korwookyin piigap emet.
Ak poisyonik che ng'etunotiin che po Uzziah, che po tai ak che po let, ko kisir maotyot Isaiah, weeriitap Amos.
Koru anyun Uzziah ak kwanisyekyik; ak ki kitup ineendet ak kwanisyekyik, eng' kooretap kereeriisyegap laitorinik; amu ki le, “Tinyei mogondosaik.” Ki laitoran Jotham kogeer ineendet.
Ki po Jotham kenyiisyek tiptem ak muut ye ki tau kolaitorani; ak ki laitoran kenyiisyek taman ak lo eng' Jerusalem. Ki kiguure kamennyi Jerusha cheptap Zadok.
Ki yai ne myee eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ko uu tugul che kiga yai kwandanyi Uzziah: ago ki ma wo Hekaluutap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor. Nganda uu nooto, ko ki testai koyai piik yaitwogik.
Ki teech kurgeet ne po meto eng' kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ak ki yai poisyetap teekseet ne oo eng' inaatutap Ophel.
Ki teech kogeny nganasook eng' emetap tuloonook che po Judah, ak ki teech irimoik ak teeksosyek che kooen eng' osnosyek.

Kibargei Jotham ak laitoryatap `lagogap Ammon, ak koterteer icheek. Ak ki igoochi lagogap Ammon ineendet eng' kenyinooto talendaisyek pogol che po fedha, ak keruutik eliphuusyek taman che po nganuuk, ak keruutik eliphuusyek taman che po baale. Ki igoochi ko uu nooto lagogap Ammon ineendet eng' kenyiit ne po aeng' ak ne po somok.
Ki kimiit anyun Jotham amu ki chop ortinwekyik eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindennyi.
Ak poisyonik che ng'etunotiin che po Jotham, ak lugosyekyik tugul, ak ortinwekyik tugul, ko siraatiin eng' kitabuutap laitorinigap Israel ak che po Judah.
Ki po kenyiisyek tiptem ak muut ye ki tau kolaitorani, ak ki laitoran kenyiisyek taman ak lo eng' Jerusalem.
Ki ru Jotham ak kwanisyekyik ak ki kitupchi nganaseetap Daudi. Ak ki laitoran Ahaz weeriinnyi kogeer ineendet.
Ki po Ahaz kenyiisyek tiptem ye ki tau kolaitorani; ak ki laitoran kenyiisyek taman ak lo eng' Jerusalem. Ki ma yai ne myee eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ko uu Daudi kwandanyi.
Ago kiwendote ortinwegap laitorinigap Israel, ak ki itang'ji kogeny Baalik kanamonik.
Ki peel kogeny nyamdutik eng' atebweetap weeriitap Hinom ak kobeel lagokyik eng' maat, ko uu tuguuk che kiwechei che po pororyosyek, che kigaon Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' taitap piigap Israel.
Ak kieny tiseiywek ak kobeel nyamdutik eng' komoswek che torooreen, eng' tuloonook ak eng' kelutap keetit age tugul ne tuon.

Ki inde Ahaz anyun `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindennyi eutap laitoryatap Syria, ak ki iterteer ineendet ak komut tuiyet ne oo ne po piikyik koek luulenik ak komut koba Damasko. Ki kinde ineendet kogeny eunegap laitoryatap Israel, ne ki iterteer ineendet eng' pareet ne oo.

Ki par Pekah weeriitap Remaliah piik eng' Judah eliphuusyek pogol agenge ak tiptem eng' peetuut agenge, che ki piik che nyigoonen chooto tugul, amu kimeto Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindetap kwanisyekwak.
Ak ki par Zikri, chiito ne kiim, ne po Ephraim, Maaseia weeriitap laitoryat, Asrikam pounindetap koot, ak Elkanah ne kirubei laitoryat.
Kiluul piigap Israel tupchosyekwak eliphuusyek pogol aeng', kwonyiik, weeriik ak tiibiik; ak ki ip parunenik che chaang' eng' icheek koba Samaria.

Ago kimi maotyotap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor olooto, ne ki kiguure Oded; ak ki wo kotorookta lugeet ne kinyonei Samaria, ak koleenji icheek, “Amu ki nereekyi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindetap kwanisyekwok Judah, ko no koinde icheek eunekwok, ak kaobar icheek eng' nereegek che ng'woneen che kagoit kipsengwet.
Ak nguno omache oyai lagogap Judah ak Jerusalem che murenik ak che kwonyiik koek otwogikwok. Ago motinye okweek kachiliilutik che ki ochiliilji Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindeng'wong'?
Ogasa anyun, oweech luulenik che kaoluul eng' tupchosyekwok, amu mi paragung'wong' nereegek che ng'woneen che po Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.”

Yeityo kotononso alak eng' kandoigap lagogap Ephraim, Azariah weeriitap Johanan, Berekiah weeriitap Meshillemoth, Jehizkiah weeriitap Shallum ak Amasa weeriitap Hadlai, kogirinda pichooto ki punu lugeet,

ak koleenji icheek, “Momuuchi omutu luulenik kobwa olito: amu omache oyai kiit ne ibwech kachiliilutyet eng' Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, si kobiit otes tengekwogikyok ak kachiliilutik: amu eecheen kachiliilutikyok, ak miitei nereegek che ng'woneen agobo Israel.”
Ara ki pagaakta anyun murenigap luuget luulenik ak parunenik eng' taitap pounik ak tuiyet tugul.

Ki ng'eetyo anyun piik che ki kimwa kainaikwak ak komut luulenik, ak ki nam tuguuk che kibooru ak kolaaksechine piik tugul che ki mi aach ngor. Ki ilaaksechi icheek ak kolaakyi kweonik, kibai ak konaga koe, ak koiil icheek; ak komute tugul che nyalulyotin sigiroik, komut kobwa Jeriko, nganaseetap tiironigap sosik, agoi ole mi tupchosyekwak, ak koweek anyun koba Samaria.
Ki iyookto eng' peetuusyechooto `Laitoryat Ahaz piik koba kaplaitorinigap Assyria kotoret ineendet.
Amu kigabwa kogeny Edomik kobookyi ak koterteer Judah, ak komut luulenik.

Kiga kobookyi ak icheek Philistiik nganasook che po atebweet, ak che po Judah murot tai. Kiga nam ak komeny Beth-shemesh, Aijalon, Gederoth, Soko kobooto nganasookyik, Timnah kobooto nganasookyik, ak Gimso agine kobooto nganasookyik.
Amu ki iming'in `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Judah agobo Ahaz laitoryatap Israel, amu ki yai atebosyegap teweernateet eng' Judah, ak kongelelji Kamuktaindet ne Toroor miising'.
Ak ki nyoonji ineendet `Tilgath-pilneser laitoryatap Assyria, ak konyaliil ineendet, ma igimit.
Ki inem Ahaz kebeberta ne ki mi kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ak ne ki mi kootap laitoryat ak ne po pounik, ak kogoochi laitoryatap Assyria; ago ma toret nooto ineendet.
Ak kites kosiir kongelelji Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' peetuusyegap nyalildanyi, laitoryandaniito Ahaz.

Amu kieng'ji tiseiywek kamuktaigap Damasko, che kibar ineendet; ak ki le, “Amu toreti kamuktaigap laitorinigap Syria icheek, aeng'jini anyun agane icheek, si kobiit kotoreta.” Ago ki ek chooto che king'em ineendet ak Israel tugul.

Ki iyum Ahaz tereenigap kootap Kamuktaindet, ak kotui tereenichooto po kootap Kamuktaindet. Kiger kurgotigap kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ak koteekyigei kapkorosusyek eng' luuita age tugul ne po Jerusalem.
Ak ki yai komoswek che torooreen eng' nganaseet age tugul ne po Judah, si kobeeljine nyamdutik kamuktaik, ak kotach Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindetap kwanisyekyik, konereech.
Ak poisyonikyik che ng'etunotiin, ak ortinwekyik tugul, che po tai ak che po let, ko siraatiin eng' kitabuutap laitorinigap Judah ak Israel.
Ak ki ru Ahaz kobooto kwanisyekyik, ak ki kitupchi nganaseetap Jerusalem, ago ma kisut kwo kereeriisyegap laitorinigap Israel. Ki laitoran Hezekiah weeriinnyi kogeer ineendet.
Ki tau Hezekiah kolaitorani ko po kenyiisyek tiptem ak muut; ak ki laitoran kenyiisyek tiptem ak sogool eng' Jerusalem. Ki kiguure kamennyi Abijah cheptap Zekariah.
Ak ki yai ne myee eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ko uu tugul che ki yai Daudi kwandanyi.
Ki yaat kurgotigap kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, eng' kenyiit ne po tai ne po laitornatennyi, eng' arawet ne po tai, ak koteech kogeny ole kiga kobutok.
Ki imut Tisiik ak Lawiik kobwa ko, ak koyumji icheek komosta ne paraa eng' kong'asiis,
ak koleenji, “Ogas, okweek Lawiik; oanyinyge, ak oanyiny kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindetap kwanisyekyok, ak omaande tuguugap simdo eng' ole-tiliil.
Amu ki kochiliil kwanisyekyok ak koyai ne ya eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindennyo, ak ki kometo ineendet ak kowelelgei kometo ole menyei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ak kotuktoochi patai.
Kigoger kurgotigap keterut, ak komis taisyek, mata kobeel nyamdutik anan kogoito tiseiywek che kibeelei eng' ole-tiliil, kogoochi Kamuktaindetap Israel.
Ki nyoonji anyun nereegegap `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Judah ak Jerusalem, ak ki igoito icheek ketoortaat koba komosi ak komosi, koek kwang'utyet, ak koek che kireenyei ko uu ye ogeere eng' konyekwok.
Kigebar kwanisyekyok eng' rotoogap chok, ak kigeluul weeriikyok ak tiibiikyok ak osotikyok amu niito.
