Ara anyun, mi muguleldanyu kiyomiske ak Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindetap Israel, si keistoenech nereegekyik che koroomen.
Weeriikyuk, amata oegu che ma igiilegei, amu ki lewenok Kamuktaindet ne Toroor otonone tainnyi, oboisyechi ineendet ak oegu kiboitiinikyik, ak obeel nyamdutik.”

Ki ng'eetyo anyun Lawiik, Mahath weeriitap Amashai, ak Joel weeriitap Azariah, eng' weeriigap Kohatik; ak eng' weeriigap Merari, Kish weeriitap Abdi, ak Azariah weeriitap Jehallelel; ak eng' Gershonik, Joah weeriitap Zimmah, ak Eden weeriitap Joah;
ak eng' weeriigap Elizaphan, Shimri ak Jeuel; ak eng' weeriigap Asaph, Zekariah ak Mattaniah;
ak eng' weeriigap Herman, Jehuel ak Shimei; ak eng' weeriigap Jeduthun, Semaiah ak Uzziel.
Ki iyum tupchosyekwak ak koanyinygei, ak koba ko kotiliil kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ko uu ng'atuutyetap laitoryat, kosuubi ng'aleegap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.

Ki pa tisiik komosta ne po oriit miising' eng' kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, koba kotiliil, ak komaanda tugul che po simdo che kiganyoorchi Hekaluutap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ak koip koba seremutap kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor. Ki nam Lawiik ak koip koba timiin ak kowiirchi kererutap Kidron.

Ki toi anyun koanyinyis eng' peetuut ne po tai ne po arawet ne po tai, ak ki pwa eng' peetuut ne po sisiit ne po arawet, keterutap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor. Ki ianyiny kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor peetuusyek sisiit, ak ki iges eng' peetuutap taman ak lo eng' arawanooto po tai.

Ki pa anyun ole mi Hezekiah laitoryat eng' ko ak koleenji, “Kagitiliil koot tugul ne po Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, kaptisisyet ne po kagoochinoik che kibeelei kobooto tereenikyik tugul, ak meesetap magatinigap kabartaet kobooto tuguukyik tugul.
Kogechop ak ki anyiny tuguuk tugul che kiga wiirta Laitoryat Ahaz eng' laitornatennyi ye kiga kobistoe; keero, mi taitap kaptisisyetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.”
Ki ng'eet anyun Hezekiah laitoryat karon inne ak koyum pounigap nganaseet ak kotogosta kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.

Kiget kiruugik tisap, mengichik tisap, aaregap keechiir tisap ak kwesik tisap koek kagoochinetap tengekto ne po laitornatet ak ne po ole-tiliil ak ne po Judah. Ki ng'at `ineendet tisiichooto ko weeriigap Aron kogoito chooto eng' kaptisisyetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ki eeny anyun kiruugik, ak kotaach tisiik korotiik, ak koisee kaptisisyet; kieny mengichik ak koisee korotiik kaptisisyet; ak kieny aaregap keechiir ak koisee korotiik kaptisisyet.
Kiget kwesigap kagoochinetap tengekto koriik taitap laitoryat ak tuiyet; ak ki igonoor eunekwak paragunnywa.

Ki eeny anyun tisiik ak ki igoito korotiikwak eng' kaptisisyet koek kagoochinetap tengekto, si koyai kagaigaet agobo Israel tugul; ko uu ye ki ng'at laitoryat kole kigoito kagoochinet ne kibeelei ak kagoochinetap tengekto agobo Israel tugul.

Ki inde Lawiik kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, kotinyei sanisyegap sugunonik che kibirei, kibugandinik ak ketubosyek, ko uu ng'atuutyetap Daudi, ak ne po Gad keerindetap laitoryat, ak maotyot Nathan; amu ki punu ng'atuutyonooto Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' maotikyik.
Ara kitononso Lawiik kotinyei kibugandinigap Daudi, kotinyei tisiik iryagook.

Ki ng'at Hezekiah kigoito kagoochinet ne kibeelei eng' kaptisisyet. Ak ki ngetoi kigoito kagoochinet ne kibeelei, ketoi tyendap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor agine, ak iryagook kobooto kibugandinigap Daudi laitoryatap Israel.
Ki ing'uruukso tuiyet tugul, ak kotyenso tyeniik, ak koguut iryagook piik che kuutei; ki yai ko uu nooto agoi kogeskei kagoochinet ne ki kibeelei.
Kingo kagogees kagoitoet tugul, kong'uruuk laitoryat kobooto tugul che ki mi ak ineendet ak kolas.

Ki ng'at kogeny `Laitoryat Hezekiah ak `pounik, Lawiik kotyenji Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kalasunoik eng' ng'aleegap Daudi ak che po Asaph keerindet. Ara kityen kalasunoik eng' kagasetapkei, ak ki ing'uruukso ak kolas.

Yeityo kowol Hezekiah kole, “Amu kaotabaanjigei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, oriigu oibu tiseiywek ak kagoochinoigap kongoi kobwa kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.” Ki ip tuiyet tiseiywek ak kagoochinoigap kongoi; ak tugul che ki chamei eng' mugulelwekwak ko ki ip kagoochinoik che kibeelei.

Ak ki ek koitetap kagoochinoik che kibeelei che kiget tuiyet, kiruugik tamanwogik tisap, mengichik pogol ak aaregap keechiir pogol aeng'; ki po chooto tugul kagoochinoik che kibeeljin Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ki ek tuguuk che ki kitabaan eiik pogol lo ak keechiirek eliphuusyek somok.

Ago king'ering' tisiik kot koma imuuch koeny kagoochinoik tugul che kibeelei; kotoret anyun Lawiik tupchosyekwak, kot kogeskei poisyonooto, ak agoi koanyinygei tisiik; amu ki lititen mugulelwegap Lawiik che ki chamei koanyinygei kosiir tisiik.

Ak ki chaang' kogeny kagoochinoik che kibeelei, kobooto mwanigap kagoochinoigap kaalyeet, kobooto kagoochinoigap tuguuk che kieei che po kagoochinet age tugul ne kibeelei. Ki kitet anyun otisyet eng' kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ak ki paibait Hezekiah, kobooto piik tugul, amu otisyonooto kiga chopchi `Kamuktaindet piik; amu kiyaak ng'olyoondonooto eng' yooto.

Ki iyookto anyun Hezekiah keguur Israel tugul ak Judah, ak ki sirchi paronok Ephraim ak Manasseh, kole kobwa kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' Jerusalem, koboiboiyenji paska ne po Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindetap Israel.
Amu kiga komwa laitoryat kobooto pounik ak tuiyet tugul eng' Jerusalem, kole koriip paska eng' arawet ne po aeng'.
Ki ma imuuch koyai eng' peetuusyechooto, amu kitom koyam tisiik che kiga koanyinygei, anan koyumjigei piik Jerusalem.
Ak ki myeiit kioto eng' taitap laitoryat ak tuiyet tugul.

Kogimit anyun ng'atuutyet kole kemwaita eng' Israel tugul, kobooch Beer-sheba agoi Dan, kole kobwa koboiboiyenji paska ne po Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindetap Israel eng' Jerusalem; amu ki tomo koriibei piik che chaang' ko uu nooto ko uu ye ki kisir.

Ki ip anyun piik che kiga kiyookto, paronok che ki punu laitoryat ak pounikyik, koba Israel tugul ak Judah, ko uu ng'atuutyetap laitoryat, koleenji, “Okweek piigap Israel, oweekyigei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindetap Abraham, Isak ak Israel, si komuuch ineendet koweekyigei piik che ki ng'et, che kichililso eng' okweek eng' eunegap laitorinigap Assyria.
Amoigei kwanisyekwok ak tupchosyekwok, che ki ingelelji Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindetap kwanisyekwak, kot kobagaakta icheek koek che kikwong'ee, ko uu ye ogeere.

Amoegu anyun che uui kaat, ko uu ye ki uu kwanisyekwok; ago ogoochigei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ak obe oldanyi ole-tiliil, ne ki kotabaan kobunji koigeny. Oboisyechi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindeng'wong', si koistoenogei nereegekyik che koroomen.

Amu ngo weekyigei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, kosichei tupchosyekwok ak lagokwok rireenet eng' taitap icheeget che kiluul icheek, ak koweek kogeny kobwa emoni. Amu tinyei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindeng'wong' myeeindo ak rireenet, ama ituktochinok patai ngot oweekyigei ineendet.”
Ki pun anyun piik che kiga kiyookto nganaseet age tugul eng' emetap Ephraim ak Manasseh, agoi Zebulun; ago kirorechi, kochot icheek, ak kochurachur.
Agos ki iming'ingei alak che po Asher, Manasseh ak Zebulun ak kobwa Jerusalem.
Ki mi kogeny eutap Kamuktaindet Judah si kogoochi icheek muguleldo agenge koyai ng'atuutyetap laitoryat ak pounik eng' ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ki iyumjigei Jerusalem tuiyet ne ki oo kot si koriip igoortap magatiinik che ma kinde mermereek eng' arawetap aeng'.
Kong'eetyo anyun ak koisto kaptisisyosyek che ki mi Jerusalem, ak kapkorosusyek tugul che po nyamdutik ak kowiirchi kererutap Kidron.
Ki eeny anyun aarwetap paska eng' peetuutap taman ak ang'wan eng' arawetap aeng'. Ki ililanso Tisiik ak Lawiik, ak koanyinygei ak ki ip kagoochinoik che kibeelei kobwa kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ak ki tononso eng' komostanywa ko uu ye kiga king'at, ko uu Ng'atuutyetap Musa chiitap Kamuktaindet; ki isisye tisiik korotiik che kitaachei eng' eunegap Lawiik.
Amu kimi che chaang' eng' tuiyet che kitom koanyinygei; ko uu nooto anyun ko ki poisyetap Lawiik koeng'ji paska chiito age tugul ne ki ma ko tiliil, koanyinyji Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.

Amu kitom koanyinygei che chaang' eng' pichooto, che chaang' che ki po Ephraim, che po Manasseh, che po Issakar, ak che po Zebulun, ago ki am paska ama ko uu ye ki kisir. Amu kiga sa Hezekiah agobo icheek kole, “Ingonyochi kaat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne myee chii age tugul,
ne chobei muguleldanyi kocheeng' Kamuktaindet, Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindetap kwanisyekyik, agot ngo tomo ki anyiny ko uu kaanyinyetap ole-tiliil.”
Ki kasyi `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Hezekiah ak kosoop piik.

Ak ki riip piigap Israel che ki mi Jerusalem igoorto ne po magatiinik che ma kinde mermereek peetuusyek tisap eng' kagasetapkei ne oo; ak ki ilas Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Lawiik ak tisiik peetuut age tugul, kotyenjin Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' kibugandinik che cheitos miising'.

Kicheer anyun `Hezekiah Lawiik tugul che ki ineetatin eng' otisyetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor. Koamis anyun eng' igoorto tugul eng' peetuusyek tisap, kogoitoi tiseiywek che po kaalyeet, ak komwachin kongoi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindetap kwanisyekwak.
Ki chamyechi anyun tuiyet komugul kole kota koriip igoorto peetuusyek alak tisap; ak ki riip peetuusyek alak tisap eng' kagasetapkei.

Amu ki igoochi `Hezekiah laitoryatap Judah tuiyet kiruugik eliphuut ak keechiirek eliphuusyek tisap koek kagoochinoik; ak ki igoochi pounik tuiyet kiruugik eliphuut ak keechiirek eliphuusyek taman. Ki ianyinygei anyun tisiik eng' chaang'indo.
Kiboiboitu tuiyet komugul ne po Judah, kobooto Tisiik ak Lawiik ak tuiyet tugul ne ki punu Israel, ak toek che ki punu emetap Israel ak che ki menyei Judah.
Ki piit poiboiyet ne oo anyun eng' Jerusalem, amu kobooch eng' peetuusyegap Solomon weeriitap Daudi laitoryatap Israel ko ki tomo kobiit kiit ne uu nooto eng' Jerusalem.
Ki ng'eetyo anyun Tisiik ak Lawiik ak koberuur piik; ak ki kigas kutinnywa, ak kitogosta saaennywa kwo oldanyi ne tiliil eng' kipsengwet.

Kingo kagogeskei chuuto tugul, koba nganasoogap Judah Israel tugul che ki mi koba kobut tolochik, koep Aserik ak kobut komoswek che torooreen ak kapkorosusyek eng' Judah tugul ak Benjamin, eng' Ephraim ak Manasseh, kot kong'em kogees tugul. Ki week anyun lagok tugul che po Israel koba nganasookwak, kwo chii tugul ole mi tuguukyik.

Kipchei Hezekiah riipsosyegap Tisiik ak Lawiik kobee riipsosyekwak, chii tugul ko uu poisyennyi, Tisiik ak Lawiik agobo kagoochinoik che kibeelei ak kagoochinoik che po kaalyeet, kootis eng' ormariichogap nganaseetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ak koweekta kongoi ak kolas.

Ki ng'at laitoryat agine kebeberta ne po tuguukyik koek kagoochinoik che kibeelei, kagoochinoik che kibeelei karon ak koskoleny, kagoochinoik che kibeelei che po sabatoisyek, che po ye kaleel arawet, ak che po igoorwek che ki king'at, ko uu ye ki kisir eng' ng'atuutigap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ki ng'at kogeny piik che ki menyei Jerusalem kogoito kebeberta ne punjin Tisiik ak Lawiik, si kobiit kogoochigei ng'atuutyetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.

Ak kingo kasak ng'atuutyet eng' emet, kogoito piigap Israel eng' chaang'indo tongoanigap peek, che po divaik, mwanik, kumyat, ak che po rurateet tugul ne po emet; ak ki ip kebebertap taman ne po tuguuk tugul eng' chaang'indo.

Ak ki ip ak icheek piigap Israel ak Judah che ki menyei nganasoogap Judah, kebebertap taman ne po eiik ak keechiirek, ak kebebertap taman ne po tuguuk tugul che itabaanatiin che kiga kigoochi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindennywa, ak ki iyumat.
Ki toi koyumat eng' arawetap somok, ak kogees eng' arawetap tisap.
Kingo nyo Hezekiah ak pounik ak kogeer kayumanik, kolas Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ak piikyik Israel.
Ki teebee anyun `Hezekiah Tisiik ak Lawiik agobo kayumanichooto.

Ki wolji Azariah tisiindet ne oo ne po kootap Zadok koleenji, “Kobooch ngap kotoi piik koip kagoochinoik kobwa kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ko ki kiamisye koyamech ak ki kituch che chaang': amu ki koberuur `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor piikyik; ak che kong'et ko chu chaang'.”
Ki ng'at anyun Hezekiah kechop kooriik che mengeechen eng' kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor; ak ki chop.
Koip anyun kobwa ko eng' kayaneet, kagoochinoik, kebeberwegap taman ak tuguuk che itabaanatiin. Ki pounindet Konaniah Lawindet ne ki pou icheek, ak ki ne po aeng' Semei ng'eetap kamet.

Ak Jehiel, Azaziah, Nahath, Asahel, Jerimoth, Josabad, Eliel, Ismachiah, Mahath, ak Benaiah, ko ki riibiik che ki indochin Konaniah ak Shimei ng'eetap kamet, ko uu ye ki ng'at Laitoryat Hezekiah, ak Azariah pounindetap kootap Kamuktaindet.

Ki pou Kore weeriitap Imnah Lawindet, ne ki riibindetap kurgeet ne mi kong'asiis, kagoochinoigap chamyet che po Kamuktaindet, si kopcheita, kagoochinoigap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor che kinamjin parak, kobooto tuguuk che tiliileen miising'.

Kirubei ineendet Eden, Miniamin, Jeshua, Semaiah, Amariah, ak Shekaneiah eng' nganasoogap tisiik, eng' poisyennywa ne ki kigoochi si kogoochi tupchosyekwak kobee riipsosyekwak, kogoochi che eecheen ak che mengech kogergeit,

koma pooto icheek che ki kiit kobee tetuutigap ibinwek che ki kosiirto che po murenik, kobooch che po kenyiisyek somok ak che siirei, age tugul ne kiwendi kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ko uu ye yamegei ak poisyetap peetuut age tugul, eng' otisyennywa eng' poisyennywa, kobee riipsosyekwak.
Ki kiyai koitet ne po tisiik ko uu kooriigap kwanisyekwak; chooto po Lawiik che po kenyiisyek tiptem ak che siirei ko uu poisyennywa, kobee riipsosyekwak.
Ki kiit tisiik kobooto lagokwak che mengeechen, osotikwak, weeriikwak, ak tiibiikwak eng' tuiyet komugul kobee ibinwek che ki kosiirto; amu ki yai ne myee ye ki itabaanigei eng' poisyennywa.

Ak uu nooto agine eng' weeriigap Aron, tisiik, che ki menyei mbareenigap emotinwek che kiyagisye che po nganasookwak, eng' nganaseet age tugul, piik ko uu kainaikwak koginyol kopchechi murenik tugul che po tisiik ak chii age tugul eng' che po Lawiik che ki kiit kobee tetuutigap ibinwek che ki kosiirto.
Ki yai anyun ko uu nooto Hezekiah eng' Judah komugul; ki yai ne myee ak ne litit ak ne po iman eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindennyi.
Ak eng' poisyet age tugul ne ki toi koyai eng' otisyetap kootap Kamuktaindet, ak eng' ko uu ng'atuutik ak eng' kayomisutik, kocheeng' Kamuktaindennyi, kogiyai eng' muguleldanyi komugul, ak kibor.

Kingo pata tuguuchooto tugul ki yai Hezekiah eng' iman, konyo Sennacherib laitoryatap Assyria ak kochut Judah eng' kimnateet. Ki teech koyiem nganasook che ng'ootaatiin, kobwaati koleen konam kobunji.
Kingo keer Hezekiah kole kagonyo Sennacherib, ak kobegechinot kobar Jerusalem,
kong'alaaljiin ak pounikyik ak kiplugotinik che kiimeen agobo si koger peek eng' kondametusyek che ki mi saang'utap nganaseet; ak kitoret pichooto ineendet.
Koyumgei anyun piik che chaang', ak koger kondametusyek tugul ak kereruut ne kirootei eng' kwenutap emet, kole, “Amu nee si kobwa laitorinigap Assyria, ak konyoor peek eng' chaang'indo?”

Kibegeechi koteech irimeet tugul ne kiga kobutok ak ki teech teeksosyek che kooen eng' paragunnyi. Ki teech irimeet age ne tobonu saang'eng' ni Kai ak kogiimit Milo eng' nganaseetap Daudi, ak ki yai kariik ak long'onik che chaang'.
Ki inde kiptainigap lugeet koboi piik, ak koyum icheek kobwa ole mi ineendet eng' ole paraa eng' ormariichetap nganaseet ak kocheer icheek koleenji,
“Ogimegitu ak onyiganitu. Amoiyweisye anan otoptobense amu laitoryatap Assyria ak tuiyet tugul ne mi kobooto ineendet; amu mi ne oo kobootech kosiir ne mi ak ineendet.

Mi kobooto ineendet kityo euut ne po poorto; ago mi kobootech Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindennyo, kotoretech ak koyai lugosyekyok.” Ak kinyoor piik nyiganateet eng' ng'aleegap Hezekiah laitoryatap Judah.

Kingo pata niito, ye kimi Sennacherib laitoryatap Assyria ole neegitee Lakish kobooto lugeennyi tugul koyookto otwogikyik koba Jerusalem, kap Hezekiah laitoryatap Judah ak kap Judah tugul che ki mi Jerusalem, koleenji,
“Kamwa ko uu ni Sennacherib laitoryatap Assyria kole: Omang'u nee, ngo tebyei ak ogeere ko kageyiemak eng' Jerusalem?
Ye mwaei Hezekiah kole, ‘Sarwech Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindennyo eng' eutap laitoryatap Assyria,’ ko igoigook iman ineendet si kogoitook obegu eng' rubeet ak melelda.
Tos ma Hezekiah niito ne ki isto komoswek che torooreen ak kapkorosusyekyik, ak kong'atei Judah ak Jerusalem koleenjin, ‘Osae eng' kapkorosuut agenge, ak obeel nyamdutik eng' yooto?’
Tos mongen kiit ne ki kiyachi anee ak kwanisyekyuk pororyosyek tugul che po emotinwek? Tos ki imuuchi kamuktaigap pororyosyek che po emotinwek kosar emennywa eng' oor age tugul eng' eunnyu?
Ng'oo eng' kamuktaik tugul che po pororyosyechooto che ki par kwanisyekyuk kogees ne ki imuuch kosar piikyik eng' eunnyu, kot ole imuuchi Kamuktaindeng'wong' kosarwok eng' eunnyu?

Nooto anyun among' koberberak Hezekiah anan kogaigaak eng' oor ne uu ni. Matoyan ineendet amu ma mi kamuktain ne po poror age tugul, anan laitornatet age tugul ne ki imuuch kosar piikyik eng' eunnyu anan eng' eunegap kwanisyekyuk. Tos imuktoi ano anyun kamuktaindeng'wong' kosarwok eng' eunnyu?”
Ki tes otwogikyik kong'alaal che yaach agobo Kamuktaindet ne po Toroornatet ak otwogindennyi Hezekiah.

Ki sir kogeny paronok kole kochurachur Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindetap Israel, ak komwa che yaach agobo ineendet, kole, “Ko uu ye ma sar kamuktaigap pororyosyegap emotinwek piikwak eng' eunnyu, koma saru agine Kamuktaindetap Hezekiah piikyik eng' eunnyu.”
Kiwaage pichooto piigap Jerusalem che ki mi irimeet parak eng' waagaat ne oo, eng' kutitap Yahudik, kole komu icheek ak koim tamangap koaragenso, si komuuch konam nganaseet.
Ki ng'alaal agobo Kamuktaindetap Jerusalem koyanie kanamonigap piik che po ng'wony, che poisyonigap eunegap piik.
Ki sa Laitoryat Hezekiah ak maotyot Isaiah weeriitap Amos koriirchi kipsengwet agobo niito.

Ak ki iyookto `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor malaikaiyat ne ki par murenik tugul che kiimeen che nyigoonen ak kandoik ak kiptainik eng' nganaseet ne po laitoryatap Assyria. Ki week anyun ineendet eng' kalilanet kwo emennyi. Kingo it kootap kanamwennyi, kobar lagokyik ineendet eng' yooto eng' rotwetap chok.
Ki sar anyun `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Hezekiah ak piik che ki menyei Jerusalem, eng' eutap Sennacherib laitoryatap Assyria ak eng' eunegap puunikyik tugul, ak koriip icheek eng' komosta age tugul.

Ki ipchi piik che chaang' Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kagoochinoik kobwa Jerusalem, ak ki ipchi Hezekiah laitoryatap Judah tuguuk che po kamanuutyet, kot kotoroorok ineendet eng' pororyosyek tugul kobooch peetuunooto agoi.
Kimyan Hezekiah eng' peetuusyechooto ak ki neegit kome. Ki sa `ineendet Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ak ki wolji ineendet ak kogoochi kaboorunet.
Ago ma yai Hezekiah ko uu ye kiga kiyachi ne myee; amu kiimeen. Ki nyoonji anyun nereeknateet ineendet ak Judah ak Jerusalem.
Ago ki iming'ingei Hezekiah kometo menoteetap muguleldanyi, ineendet ak piik che ki menyei Jerusalem, ak ki ma nyoonji nereegegap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor icheek eng' peetuusyegap Hezekiah.

Ki tinyei Hezekiah mogornatosyek che chaang' miising' ak teegisto; ak kichopchigei ole kigonoree fedha, thahabu, koik che po kamanuutyet, tuguuk che ng'uu ne anyiny, long'onik ak tuguuk che korooron che teerchiin;
chogenik che po peek che karuryo, divaik ak mwanik; ak kooriigap tuuga tugul che teerchiin, ak piusyegap akwotisyegap keechiirek.
Kichopchigei nganasook, ak ki tinyei akwotisyegap keechiirek ak che po tuuga eng' chaang'indo; amu kiga kogoochi Kamuktaindet tuguuk ng'iisyat.
Hezekiah niito ne ki imaas peegap kondametut ne mi meto eng' Gihon, ak koip eng' ooreet ne litit korek kobwa komostap cherongo ne po nganaseetap Daudi. Ak kibor Hezekiah eng' poisyonikyik tugul.

Ago eng' ng'aleegap piik che ki iyook pounigap Babilon, che ki pwa koteepse agobo kwang'utyet ne kiyaak eng' emet, ko ki pagaakta `Kamuktaindet ineendet, kotyem si konai tuguuk tugul che ki mi muguleldanyi.
Poisyonik che ng'etunotiin che po Hezekiah, ak poisyonikyik che myach, ko siraatiin eng' ng'ang'utyetap maotyot Isaiah weeriitap Amos, eng' kitabuutap laitorinigap Judah ak Israel.

Ki ru Hezekiah kobooto kwanisyekyik, ak ki kitupchi ole kitogostoe kebendi kereeriisyegap weeriigap Daudi; ak kigonyit ineendet Judah tugul ak piik che ki menyei Jerusalem eng' meennyi. Ak ki laitoran Manasseh weeriinnyi kogeer ineendet.
Ki po Manasseh kenyiisyek taman ak aeng' ye ki tau kolaitorani; ak ki laitoran kenyiisyek konom ak muut eng' Jerusalem.
Ki yai ne ya eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, kosuubi tuguuk che kiwechei che po pororyosyek che kigaon Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' taitap piigap Israel.
Ki teech komoswek che torooreen che kiga kobut kwandanyi Hezekiah, kiteekyi Baalik kapkorosusyek ak koyai Aserot. Kigutung'ji tuguuk tugul che po kipsengwet ak koot chooto.
Ki teech kapkorosusyek eng' kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ne ki mwa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor agobo nooto kole, “Tebee kainennyu Jerusalem koigeny.”
Ak kiteekyi kapkorosusyek tuguuk tugul che po kipsengwet, eng' seremusyechooto aeng' che po kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.

Ak ki igoito kogeny lagokyik kobun maat eng' atebweetap weeriitap Hinom: ak king'orso ak ki isogis, ak ki yai ponisyet, ak ki ng'alaal ak che poisyee oik ak pooniik: ki yai yaityet ne oo eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, kotach ineendet konereech.

Ak ki inde kiit ne ki kiwai ne po kanamwet ne ki yai ineendet, kootap Kamuktaindet, ne ki mwachi `Kamuktaindet Daudi ak Solomon weeriinnyi, agobo koyooto, koleenji, “Andoi kainennyu koigeny kooi, ak Jerusalem, ne ki alewen eng' ortinwek tugul che po Israel:
amaistoi kogeny keldap Israel eng' emet ne ki aaroorchi kwanisyekwak: ngot koriip koyai tugul che ki ang'at icheek eng' Musa, ng'atuutik tugul ak etanutik ak kayomisutik.”
Ak ki igoochi anyun Manasseh Judah ak piik che ki menyei Jerusalem, koyai tengekto kot koyai yaityet kosiir pororyosyek che king'em Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' taitap piigap Israel.
Ak ki ng'alaalji `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Manasseh ak piikyik; ago ki ma mage kiy.
Komutyi anyun `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor icheek kiptainigap lugeet ne po laitoryatap Assyria che ki imut Manasseh ko rataat eng' nyororosyek ak mugurek, ak komut ineendet kwo Babilon.
Ak kingo mi eng' nyalilda kosa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindennyi, ak koming'ingei miising' eng' taitap Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindetap kwanisyekyik.
Ak ki sa, ak ki kigasyi; ki kas Kamuktaindet ne Toroor soomennyi, ak ki imut ineendet kogeny konyo Jerusalem ole mi laitornatennyi. Konai anyun Manasseh kole Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ko Kamuktaindet.

Kingo pata niito koteech irimeet ne po saang' ne po nganaseetap Daudi eng' komostap cherongo ne po Gihon, eng' atebweet, eng' ole kichutei eng' ormariichetap njireenik; ak kiyiem Ophel, ak koteech kogoit miising'; ak ki inde kiptainik che nyigoonen nganasook tugul che ng'ootaatiin che po Judah.

Ak ki isto kanamonik che too ak kanamwet ne ki mi kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ak kapkorosusyek tugul che kiga koteech eng' tulweetap kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ak eng' Jerusalem, ak kowiirchi saang'utap nganaseet.
Ak ki teech kaptisisyetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ak kogoitoe yooto tiseiywegap kagoochinoigap kaalyeet ak che po kongoi, ak kong'at Judah koot Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindetap Israel.
Agos kita koeny piik tiseiywek eng' komoswek che torooreen, ago kieng'jine yooto Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindennywa kityo.

Ak poisyonik che ng'etunotiin che po Manasseh, ak saaet ne ki sa Kamuktaindennyi, ak ng'aleegap keerik che ki ng'alaalji ineendet eng' kainetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindetap Israel, ogeero, siraatiin kobooto poisyonigap laitorinigap Israel.

Ki kisirchi agine saaennyi, ak ole kigasyindo Kamuktaindet, ak tengektanyi tugul ak kachiliilutyennyi, ak komoswek ole ki teech komoswek che torooreen, ak kolumda Aserik ak kanamonik che ki kiwai, ye ki tomo koming'ingei; ogeero, siraatiin chooto eng' kitabuutap ateptap peetuusyegap Hosai.
Ki ru anyun Manasseh kobooto kwanisyekyik, ak ki kitup eng' koonnyi: ak ki laitoran weeriinnyi Ammon kogeer ineendet.
Ki po Ammon kenyiisyek tiptem ak aeng' ye ki tau kolaitorani; ak ki laitoran kenyiisyek aeng' eng' Jerusalem.
Ak ki yai ne ya eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ko uu ye ki yai kwandanyi Manasseh: ak kieng'ji Ammon tiseiywek kanamonik tugul che ki kiwai che kiga koyai kwandanyi Manasseh, ak koot.
Ak ki ma iming'ingei eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ko uu ye ki iming'ingei kwandanyi Manasseh; ago kites Ammon koyai chalwokto miising' kosiir.
Ak kichaam ineendet otwogikyik, ak kobar ineendet eng' koonnyi.
Ak ki par piigap emonooto pichooto tugul kichaam laitoryat Ammon; ak ki ieet piigap emet Josiah weeriinnyi koek laitoryat kogeer ineendet.
Ki po Josiah kenyiisyek sisiit ye ki tau kolaitorani; ak ki laitoran kenyiisyek sosom ak agenge eng' Jerusalem.
Ak ki yai ne myee eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ak kiwendote ortinwegap Daudi kwandanyi, ama masta kwo eutap tai anan ne po kaataam.

Amu eng' kenyiitap sisiit ne po laitornatennyi, ye kita ko ming'in, kotoi kocheeng' Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindetap Daudi kwandanyi: ak eng' kenyiitap taman ak aeng' kotoi kotiliil Judah ak Jerusalem koisto komoswek che torooreen, ak Aserik, ak kanamonik che ki kiwai ak kanamonik che ki kitany.

Ak kibut kapkorosusyegap Baalik eng' tainnyi; ak koluul kanamonik che po asiista che ki miitei paragunnywa; ak kituatui Aserik, ak kanamonik che ki kiwai ak kanamonik che ki kitany, ak kong'a koek temburyek ak koseerchi kereeriisyegap icheeget che kieng'ji.
Ak ki peel kawegap tisiik eng' kapkorosusyekwak, ak kotiliil Judah ak Jerusalem.
Ak ki yachi ko uu nooto nganasoogap Manasseh ak Ephraim, ak Simion, agoi Naphtali, ak komoswek tugul che po karatwekwak.

Ak kibut kapkorosusyek, ak kong'a Aserik ak kanamonik che ki kiwai ak kanamonik che ki kitany, koek temburyek, ak koluul kanamonik tugul che po asiista eng' emet komugul ne po Israel, yeityo koweek Jerusalem.

Ak eng' kenyiitap taman ak sisiit ne po laitornatennyi, ye kiga kotiliil emet ak koot, koyookto anyun Sapan weeriitap Asalia, ak Maaseia pounindetap nganaseet, ak Joah weeriitap Joahas siriindetap tuguuk che piitu, koteech ole ki kobutok eng' kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindennyi.

Ak ki pwa ole mi Hilkiah, tisiindet ne oo, ak kogoochi fedhaisyek che ki kiibu kobwa kootap Kamuktaindet, che kiga koyum Lawiik, riibiigap kurgeet, che ki kiyumune Manasseh ak Ephraim, ak Israel tugul che ki kong'et, ak che po Judah tugul ak Benjamin ak che po piik che ki menyei Jerusalem.

Ak ki igoochi kiboitiinik che kitononjin kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor; ak ki igoito kiboitiinik che kiboisyei eng' kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor si kobiit kechobe ak keteege ole kiga kobutok eng' koot;
ki igoochi musogik ak teegik, koale koik che kigewai, ak pagoinik che ki kituiyote, ak che kiyae pambanigap kooriik che kiga kobut laitorinigap Judah.

Ak ki yai pichooto poisyet koek piik che kiyani: ak kandoigap pichooto ko ki Jahat ak Obadiah, Lawiik eng' weeriigap Merari; ak Zekariah ak Mesulam eng' weeriigap Kohat, che ki ichirchiri poisyet: ak Lawiik alak, che ki utaatiin eng' putetap kibugandinik.
Ak ki pou kogeny piik che kilaei milosyek, ak ki ichirchiri tugul che kiyaei poisyet age tugul: ak kimi Lawiik che ki Siriik ak kiptainik ak riibiigap kurgotik.
Ak ye kingo nem fedhaisyek che kiga kiip kobwa kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, konyoor Hilkiah tisiindet bukuitap Ng'atuutigap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor che ki koonu Musa.
Ak ki wolji Hilkiah Sapan siriindet, koleenji, “Kaanyooru bukuitap Ng'atuutik eng' kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor. Ak ki igoochi Hilkiah Sapan bukuinooto.
Ak ki ipchi Sapan laitoryat bukuinooto, ak ki leenji laitoryat kogeny, Yaei otwogiguk kiit age tugul ne kemwachi.
Ak ki koip fedhaisyek tugul che ki kinyoorchi kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ak kogochi riibiik, ak kiboitiinik.”
Ak ki mwachi Sapan siriindet laitoryat koleenji, “Kagoono Hilkiah tisiindet bukuit.” Ak kisooman Sapan bukuinooto eng' taitap laitoryat.
Ak kingo kas laitoryat ng'aleegap ng'atuutichooto, kobet ngoroikyik.
Ak ki ng'at laitoryat Hilkiah, ak Aikam weeriitap Sapan, ak Abdon weeriitap Mikah, ak Sapan siriindet, ak Asaiah otwogindetap laitoryat, koleenji,

Oba oteebunena Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ak agobo piik che ki ng'et eng' Israel ak Judah, agobo ng'aleegap bukuit ne kogenyoor: amu oo nereeknatetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne roong'jinech, amu ma riip kwanisyekyok ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, koyai ko uu tugul che ki kisirchi bukuini.

Ki pa anyun Hilkiah ak icheek che ki iyookto laitoryat, kap Hulda chebyoset ne maotyot, osotyotap Shallum weeriitap Tokat, weeriitap Hasra, riibindetap ngoroik; (ki menyei Jerusalem nganaseet ne po aeng';) ak komwachi ko uu nooto.
Ak ki leenji icheek, Kamwa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindetap Israel ko uu ni, kole, “Omwachi chiito ne kaiyokwok obwa ole ami, oleenji,
kamwa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ko uu ni, kole, ‘Ogeero, aipchini yaityet yuto, ak icheek che menyei olito, chubisyosyek tugul che ki kisirchi bukuit ne kagesoman eng' taitap laitoryatap Judah:
amu ki kometa, ak ki kobeelji nyamdutik kanamonik, si kobiit kotacha anereech eng' poisyonik tugul che po eunekwak; nooto anyun, karoong'jigei nereegekyuk yuto, ama kimisi.
Ago oleenji laitoryatap Judah, ne kagoyokwok obwa oteepse Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamwa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindetap Israel ko uu ni, kole: Eng' ng'aleechooto kaigas,

amu kitangus muguleldang'ung', ak ki iming'ingei eng' taitap Kamuktaindet, ye kegas ng'aleekyik che nereekyin yuto, ak piik che menyei olito, ak iming'inigei eng' tainnyu, ak igereer ngoroiguk, ak iriir eng' tainnyu; ko kaagasun agane, mwaei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Keero, ayumin iwe ole mi kwanisyeguk, ak iwe kerering'ung' eng' kaalyeet, ama keerei konyeguk yaityet tugul ne aipchini koroni, kobooto piik che menyei. Ak ki ipchin laitoryat ng'olyoot kogeny.’ ”
Koyookto anyun laitoryat kiyum poisyek tugul che po Judah ak Jerusalem.

Ak kitogosta laitoryat kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, kobooto piik tugul che po Judah ak piik che ki menyei Jerusalem, ak tisiik, ak Lawiik, ak piik tugul, che eecheen ak che mengeechen: ak kosoman ng'aleek tugul che po bukuitap arorutyet ne ki kinyooru eng' kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.

Ak ki tonon laitoryat eng' komostanyi, ak koyai arorutyet eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, koosup Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ak koriip ng'atuutikyik, ak paornatosyekyik, ak kayomisutikyik, eng' muguleldanyi tugul, ak eng' saboondanyi tugul, koosup ng'aleegap arorutyet che ki kisirchi bukuini.
Ak ki ng'at piik tugul che ki mi Jerusalem ak Benjamin kotononso koyan ng'aleechooto. Ak ki yai che ki menyei Jerusalem ko uu kayomisetap Kamuktaindet, Kamuktaindetap kwanisyekwak.

Ak ki isto Josiah tuguuk tugul che kiwechei eng' emotinwek tugul che po Israel, ak kong'at piik tugul che po Israel kootis, koot Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindennywa. Ma meto pichooto koosup Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindetap kwanisyekwak, eng' peetuusyekyik tugul.
Ak kiriipchi `Josiah Kamuktaindet ne Toroor paska eng' Jerusalem; ak kieny aarwetap paska eng' peetuutap taman ak ang'wan ne po arawet ne po tai.
Ak ki inde tiisik riipsosyekwak, ak ko ki il icheek eng' otisyetap kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.

Ak ki leenji Lawiik che ki ineeti Israel tugul, che kitiliileen eng' Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Onde moinget ne tiliil koot ne ki teech Solomon weeriitap Daudi laitoryatap Israel; ma koegu mileet ne mi tigigoikwok: oot anyun Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindeng'wong', ak piikyik Israel.
Ak ochopkei obee kooriigap kwanisyekwok ko uu riipsosyekwok, ko uu siruutigap Daudi laitoryatap Israel, ak siruutigap Solomon, weeriinnyi.
Ak otononse eng' ole-tiliil ko uu ole ki kipcheita kooriigap kwanisyek che po tupchosyekwok lagogap piik, ak ingobunji age tugul kebebertap kootap kwanisyegap Lawiik.
Ak oeny aarwetap paska ak oanyinyge, ochopchji tupchosyekwok, koyai ko uu ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne ki ng'at eng' Musa.

Ak ki igoochi `Josiah piik, che po akweetap keechiirek, aaregap keechiir ak che po ng'oroorek, kobunji chooto tugul che po kagoochinoigap Paska, kogoochi piik tugul che ki mi yooto; ki ek tugul eliphuusyek sosom, ak kiruugik eliphuusyek somok: ki po laitoryat chuuto.

Ak ki igoochi pounikyik piik ak tisiik, ak Lawiik, kagoochinetap chamyet. Ki igoochi Hilkiah ak Zekariah ak Jehiel, che pounigap kootap Kamuktaindet, kogoochi tisiik, tuuga eliphuusyek aeng' ak pogol lo, ak eiik pogol somok koek kagoochinoigap paska.

Ak ki igoochi Konaniah, ak Semaiah ak Nethanel, tupchosyekyik, ak Hasabia, Jeiel, ak Josabad, che eecheen eng' Lawiik, kogoochi Lawiik, tuuga eliphuusyek muut, ak eiik pogol muut, koek kagoochinoigap paska.
Kochobok anyun otisyet ak kotononso tisiik eng' komostanywa, ak Lawiik eng' riipsosyekwak, ko uu ng'atuutyetap laitoryat.
Ak kieny aarwetap paska, ak ki isisye tisiik korotiik che kitaachei eng' eunegap Lawiik, ak kieny Lawiik tiseiywechooto.

Ak ki isto kagoochinoik che kibeelei, si kobiit kogoito, ko uu ole ki kipcheita kooriigap kwanisyegap lagogap piik, kogoochi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ko uu ye siraat eng' bukuitap Musa. Ak ki yachi ko uu nooto eiik.
Ak ki peel aarwetap paska eng' maat ko uu kayomiset: ak ki iyo kagoochinoik che tiliileen eng' tereenik, ak saburyonik, ak taaboogap kariik, ak koipchi lagok tugul che po piik kochaaktae.
Ye ibata kochopchigei ak tisiik; amu kichirchirendos tisiik weeriigap Aron kogoitoi kagoochinoik che kibeelei ak mwanik agoi kemoi: kichopchigei anyun Lawiik, ak tisiik, weeriigap Aron.

Ak kimi komostanywa tyeniik weeriigap Asaph, ko uu ng'atuutyetap Daudi, ak Asaph, Herman, ak Jeduthun keerindetap laitoryat; ak kimi riibiik ormariichet age tugul; ki ma ko nyoljin kobagaakta poisyennywa, amu kichopchin Lawiik tupchosyekwak tugul.

Kichobok anyun otisyet tugul ne po Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' peetuunooto, si koriip paska, ak kogoito kagoochinoik che kibeelei eng' kaptisisyetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ko uu ng'atuutyetap Laitoryat Josiah.
Ki riip piigap Israel che ki mi yooto, paska, eng' peetuusyechooto, ak koriip igoortap magatiinik che ma kinde mermereek eng' peetuusyek tisap.

Ak kitom kobiit paska age kobooch peetuusyegap maotyot Samuel ne kergei ak nooto ki kiriip eng' Israel; ama riip age tugul eng' laitorinigap Israel ne uu nooto koyai Josiah, ak tisiik, ak Lawiik, ak Judah tugul ak Israel che ki mi yooto, ak piik che ki menyei Jerusalem.
Ki kiriip paskainooto eng' kenyiitap taman ak sisiit ne po laitornatetap Josiah.
Kingo pata chooto tugul ko kagochop Josiah Hekaluut, kotogos Neko laitoryatap Misiri kobargei ak Karkemish ye neegitee Yufrets: ak ki wo Josiah kobargei ak ineendet.

Ago ki iyookto Neko piik koba ole mi ineendet, koleenji, “Kiting'egei nee ak inyee, laitoryatap Judah? Ma pookyin inyee, peetuuni, ago abookyini koot ne ating'ee pooryeet; ak kang'ata Kamuktaindet achokyi: pagakte, amegirinde Kamuktaindet ne mi kobooto, si ma parin ineendet.”
Ago ki ma cham Josiah kobagaakta ineendet, ago kiwalgei koek age si kobiit kobargei ak ineendet, ama kas ng'aleegap Neko che ki punu kutitap Kamuktaindet, ak ki nyo kobargei eng' atebweetap Megiddo.
Ak kimwok mwogik Laitoryat Josiah; ak ki leenji laitoryat otwogikyik, Omuta; amu kagiguotena miising'.

Komut anyun otwogikyik ineendet eng' chepkichutit, ak konde ineendet chepkichutit ne po aeng' ne ki tinyei, ak ki imut ineendet konyo Jerusalem; ak kime ak ki kitupchi kereeriisyegap kwanisyekyik. Ak ki riirchi Josiah Judah tugul ak Jerusalem.

Ak ki riir Jeremiah agobo Josiah: ak ki riirchi Josiah tyeniik tugul che murenik ak kwonyiik, eng' riirekwak agoi kora; ak ki yachi icheek kayomiset eng' Israel: ak ogeero, siraatiin eng' bukuitap riirek.
Ak poisyonik che ng'etunotiin che po Josiah, ak poisyonikyik che myach, ko uu che siraatiin eng' bukuitap Ng'atuutigap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor,
ak poisyonikyik, che po tai ak che po let, ogeero, siraatiin eng' kitabuutap laitorinigap Israel ak Judah.
Ki ieet anyun `piigap emet Jehoahas weeriitap Josiah koek laitoryat eng' Jerusalem kogeer kwandanyi.
Ki po Jehoahas kenyiisyek tiptem ak somok ye ki tau kolaitorani: ak ki laitoran arawek somok eng' Jerusalem.
Ak kiriibe laitornatennyi laitoryatap Misiri eng' Jerusalem, ak kimage emet talendaisyek pogol che po fedha ak talendait agenge ne po thahabu.
Ak ki ieet laitoryatap Misiri ng'eetap kamet Eliakim koboi Judah ak Jerusalem, ak kiweech kainennyi koguure Jehoiakim. Ak ki imut Neko ng'eetap kamet Jehoahas kwo Misiri.
Ki po Jehoiakim kenyiisyek tiptem ak muut ye ki tau kolaitorani; ak ki laitoran kenyiisyek taman ak agenge eng' Jerusalem; ak ki yai ne ya eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindennyi.
Ki togos Nebukadnezar laitoryatap Babilon konyo kobargei ak ineendet, ak kirate ineendet mugurek, komut kwo Babilon.
Ki ip kogeny Nebukadnezar tereenigap kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor koba Babilon, ak konde hekalunnyi eng' Babilon.

Ak poisyonik che ng'etunotiin che po Jehoiakim, ak tuguuk che kiwechei che ki yai, ak tuguuk che yaach che ki kinyoorchi ineendet, ogeero, siraatiin eng' kitabuutap laitorinigap Israel ak Judah: ak ki laitoran Jehoiakin weeriinnyi kogeer ineendet.
Ki po Jehoiakin kenyiisyek sisiit ye ki tau kolaitorani; ak ki laitoran arawek somok ak peetuusyek taman eng' Jerusalem: ak ki yai ne ya eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.

Ak ye kingo keskei kenyiit koyook Laitoryat Nebukadnezar piik komut ineendet konyo Babilon, kobooto tereenik che korooron che po kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ak ki ieet Zedekiah ng'eetap kamet koek laitoryat koboi Judah ak Jerusalem.
Ki po Zedekiah kenyiisyek tiptem ak agenge ye ki tau kolaitorani: ak ki laitoran kenyiisyek taman ak agenge eng' Jerusalem.
Ak ki yai ne ya eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindennyi; ki ma iming'injigei maotyot Jeremiah ye ki ng'alaal ng'aleek che punu kutitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ak ki ingelelji kogeny Laitoryat Nebukadnezar, ne ki kabirchi koyasyo eng' Kamuktaindet: ago ki iuit kaatinnyi ak muguleldanyi, ma weekyigei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindetap Israel.
Ki ingelelso kogeny miising' tisiik tugul che eecheen, ak piik, koosup tuguuk tugul che kiwechei che po pororyosyek; ak ki imurwon kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne kiga kotabaan eng' Jerusalem.
Ak ki iyooktoi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindetap kwanisyekwak, piikyik, komusta koba ole mi icheek; amu ki riiree piikyik, ak ole menyei ineendet.
Ago ki reeny pichooto ki iyooktoi Kamuktaindet, ak ki sas ng'aleekyik, kogengenie maotikyik, agoi konereekyi `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor piikyik, kot koma komi kiit ne kinyae.

Komutyi anyun icheeget laitoryatap Kaldeik, ne ki nyo kobar neranikwak eng' rotwetap chok, eng' kootap oldanywa ne tiliil, ama riiree muren anan tye, poiyot anan ne neegit koolil: ki inde tugul eunnyi.

Ak ki ip anyun tuguuk tugul che po kootap Kamuktaindet, che eecheen ak che mengeechen, ak konoraigap kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ak konoraigap laitoryat, ak che po pounikyik, ki ip tugul koba Babilon.
Ak ki peel kootap Kamuktaindet, ak kobut irimeetap Jerusalem, ak kobeel kooriik tugul che po laitoryat, ak kong'em tuguuk tugul che korooron che ki mi koorchooto.
Ak ki imut koba Babilon che kiga chililye rotwetap chok; ak ki ek otwogikyik ak che po weeriikyik agoi laitornatetap Persia:

si kosulda ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne ki mwa eng' kutitap Jeremiah, agoi kogasegei emet sabatoisyekyik: amu ki riip sabatoisyekyik eng' peetuusyechooto ki ma komenyei chii, kot kosulda kenyiisyek tamanwogik tisap.

Ak eng' kenyiit ne po tai ne po Cyrus laitoryatap Persia, si kobiit kosulda ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne ki mwa eng' kutitap Jeremiah, kochirchir `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Cyrus laitoryatap Persia, si komwaita eng' laitornatennyi tugul, ak kosiirta kogeny, kole

kamwa ko uu ni Cyrus laitoryatap Persia, kole, “Ki koono Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindetap kipsengwet, laitornatosyek tugul che po ng'wony; ak king'ata ateekyi koot eng' Jerusalem, ne mi Judah. Ingotogosta age tugul eng' okweek che oo po piikyik tugul, ak ingotep Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindennyi kobooto chiichooto.”

Eng' kenyiit ne po tai ne po Cyrus laitoryatap Persia, si kobiit kosulda ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne ki mwa eng' kutitap Jeremiah, ko ki ichirchir `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Cyrus laitoryatap Persia komwaita eng' laitornatennyi tugul ak kosiir kole:
“Kamwa ko uu ni Cyrus laitoryatap Persia, ‘Ki koono Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindetap kipsengwet laitornatosyek tugul che po ng'wony, ak kagong'ata ateekyi koot eng' Jerusalem ne mi Judah.

Ingotogosta Jerusalem ne mi Judah age tugul eng' okweek che oo piikyik, ak ingotep Kamuktaindennyi kobooto ineendet. Ingwo koteekyi koot Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindetap Israel (ineendet ko Kamuktaindet) ne mi Jerusalem.

Ak chii age tugul ne kang'et eng' oldo tugul ole menyei, ko ingotoret piigap oldanyi chiichooto eng' fedha, thahabu, tuguuk ak tuuga kobooto kagoochinoik che po chamyet agobo kootap Kamuktaindet ne mi Jerusalem.’ ”

Ki ng'eetyo anyun che eecheen eng' kandoigap kooriigap kwanisyek che po Judah ak Benjamin ak tisiik, kobooto Lawiik, ak tugul che ki ing'eet Kamuktaindet saboonwekwak kotogosta koba koteech kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne mi Jerusalem.
Ki igoochi tugul che ki mi ak icheek tuguuk che po fedha, thahabu, kobooto tuguuk che toretegei, tuuga ak tuguuk che po kamanuutyet ne oo, kobooto kagoochinoik tugul che kiga kigoochi eng' chamyet.
Ne siirei ko ki inem Laitoryat Cyrus tuguuk che po kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, che kiga koip Nebukadnezar eng' Jerusalem ipkonde kootap kanamonikyik.
Ki ip chooto Cyrus laitoryatap Persia eng' eutap Mitredat konorindet ak koiityi Sesbasar, pounindetap Judah.
Chu ko koitetap tuguuchooto: taabook sosom che po thahabu, taabook eliphuut che po fedha ak rotonik tiptem ak sogool;
taabook sosom che mengeechen che po thahabu, ak taabook alak che mengeechen pogol ang'wan ak taman che po fedha ak tereenik alak eliphuut agenge.
Tereenik tugul che po thahabu ak fedha, ko ki ek eliphuusyek muut ak pogol ang'wan. Ki ip Sesbasar chuuto tugul kotogos, ye ki kimutu luulenik kotogos kobunu Babilon kobwa Jerusalem.
Chu anyun ko piigap emonooto che kiga togos kobunu ole kiga kiluulji, che kiga iluul Nebukadnezar laitoryatap Babilon koba Babilon; che kiweegis koba Jerusalem ak Judah, kwo chii tugul nganasennyi.
Kigabwa icheek kobooto Zerubabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Seraiah, Reelaia, Mordekai, Bilsan, Mispar, Bigbai, Reum ak Baanah. Koitetap murenigap piigap Israel:
Lagogap Paros ko ki eliphuusyek aeng' ak pogol ak tamanwogik tisap ak aeng'.
Lagogap Shepatiah ko ki pogol somok ak tamanwogik tisap ak aeng'.
Lagogap Ara ko ki pogol tisap ak tamanwogik tisap ak muut.
Lagogap Pahat-moap, eng' lagogap Jeshua ak Joab, ko ki eliphuusyek aeng' ak pogol sisiit ak taman ak aeng'.
Lagogap Elam ko ki eliphuut agenge ak pogol aeng' ak konom ak ang'wan.
Lagogap Satu ko ki pogol sogool ak artam ak muut.
Lagogap Sakai ko ki pogol tisap ak tamanwogik lo.
Lagogap Bani ko ki pogol lo ak artam ak aeng'.
Lagogap Bebai ko ki pogol lo ak tiptem ak somok.
Lagogap Askad ko ki eliphuut agenge ak pogol aeng' ak tiptem ak aeng'.
Lagogap Adonikam ko ki pogol lo ak tamanwogik lo ak lo.
Lagogap Bigbai ko ki eliphuusyek aeng' ak konom ak lo.
Lagogap Adin ko ki pogol ang'wan ak konom ak ang'wan.
Lagogap Ater, che po Hezekiah, ko ki tamanwogik sogool ak sisiit.
Lagogap Besai ko ki pogol somok ak tiptem ak somok.
Lagogap Jora ko ki pogol agenge ak taman ak aeng'.
Lagogap Asum ko ki pogol aeng' ak tiptem ak somok.
Lagogap Gibar ko ki tamanwogik sogool ak muut.
Lagogap Bethlehem ko ki pogol agenge ak tiptem ak somok.
Murenigap Netopa ko ki konom ak lo.
Murenigap Anatoth ko ki pogol agenge ak tiptem ak sisiit.
Lagogap Asmabet ko ki artam ak aeng'.
Lagogap Kiriath-arim, Kepira, ak Beerot, ko ki pogol tisap ak artam ak somok.
Lagogap Ramah ak Geba ko ki pogol lo ak tiptem ak agenge.
Murenigap Mikmas ko ki pogol agenge ak tiptem ak aeng'.
Murenigap Bethel ak Ai ko ki pogol aeng' ak tiptem ak somok.
Lagogap Nebo ko ki konom ak aeng'.
Lagogap Magbis ko ki pogol agenge ak konom ak lo.
Lagogap Elam age, ko ki eliphuut agenge ak pogol aeng' ak konom ak ang'wan.
Lagogap Harim ko ki pogol somok ak tiptem.
Lagogap Lod, Hadid, ak Ono, ko ki pogol tisap ak tiptem ak muut.
Lagogap Jeriko ko ki pogol somok ak artam ak muut.
Lagogap Senaa ko ki eliphuusyek somok ak pogol lo ak sosom.
Tisiik: lagogap Jedaiah, che po kootap Jeshua, ko ki pogol sogool ak tamanwogik tisap ak somok.
Lagogap Imer ko ki eliphuut agenge ak konom ak aeng'.
Lagogap Pasur ko ki eliphuut agenge ak pogol aeng' ak artam ak tisap.
Lagogap Harim ko ki eliphuut agenge ak taman ak tisap.
Lawiik: lagogap Jeshua ak Kadmiel, che po lagogap Hodabiah, ko ki tamanwogik tisap ak ang'wan.
Tyeniik: lagogap Asaph ko ki pogol agenge ak tiptem ak sisiit.
Lagogap riibiigap kurgotik: lagogap Shallum, lagogap Ater, lagogap Talmon, lagogap Akub, lagogap Hatita, lagogap Sobai, ki ek tugul pogol agenge ak sosom ak sogool.
Otwogigap Hekaluut: lagogap Siha, lagogap Hasupa, lagogap Tabaot;
lagogap Keros, lagogap Siaa, lagogap Padon;
lagogap Lebana, lagogap Hagaba, lagogap Akub;
lagogap Hagap, lagogap Samlai, lagogap Hanan;
lagogap Gidel, lagogap Gahar, lagogap Reaiah;
lagogap Rezin, lagogap Nekoda, lagogap Gasam;
lagogap Uzzah, lagogap Pasea, lagogap Besai;
lagogap Asna, lagogap Meunik, lagogap Nepisik;
lagogap Bakbuk, lagogap Hakupa, lagogap Harur;
lagogap Baslut; lagogap Meida, lagogap Harsa;
lagogap Barkos, lagogap Sisera, lagogap Tema;
lagogap Nesia, lagogap Hatipa.
Lagogap otwogigap Solomon: lagogap Sotai, lagogap Hasoperet, lagogap Peruda;
lagogap Jaala, lagogap Darkon, lagogap Gidel;
lagogap Shepatiah, lagogap Hatil, lagogap Pokereth-hasebaim, lagogap Ami.
Otwogigap Hekaluut tugul ak lagogap otwogigap Solomon, ko ki pogol somok ak tamanwogik sogool ak aeng'.
Chu ko che ki togosta eng' Tel-mela, Tel-harsa, Kerub, Adan ak Imer. Ago ki ma imuuch koboor kooriigap kwanisyekwak ak iyotennywa, ngo ki po Israel.
Lagogap Delaiah, lagogap Tobia, lagogap Nekoda, ko ki ek pogol lo ak konom ak aeng'.
Ak che po lagogap tisiik: Lagogap Habaia, lagogap Hakos, lagogap Barsilai, ne ki itun osotyot ne po tiibiigap Barsilai Gileadindet ak ki kimwaitae kainennywa.
Ki cheeng' chuuto kiit ne ki kisirchi kainaikwak, kobee tetuutigap ibinwek che ki kosiirto, ago ma kinyoor: amu nooto ki kiit koek che ng'woneen ak ki kiistoe tiseinateet.
Ak ki leenji Tirsata icheek, ma nyooljin koam tuguuk che tiliileen miising', kot kobiit tisiindet ne tinyei Urim ak Tumim.
Ki ek tuiyet tugul eliphuusyek artam ak aeng' ak pogol somok ak tamanwogik lo,
koma pooto otwogikwak che murenik ak che tiibiik, ki ek chooto eliphuusyek tisap ak pogol somok ak sosom ak tisap. Ki tinyei tyeniik che murenik ak kwonyiik pogol aeng'.
Paraisisyekwak ko ki pogol tisap ak sosom ak lo. Nyumbokwak ko ki pogol aeng' ak artam ak muut;
tambeesikwak ko ki pogol ang'wan ak sosom ak muut. Sigiroik ko ki eliphuusyek lo ak pogol tisap ak tiptem.
Kingo pwa kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne mi Jerusalem, kandoigap kooriigap kwanisyek, kogoito tuguuk eng' chamyet si keteege kootap Kamuktaindet eng' ole kimi.
Ki igoito ko uu kamugennywa, darkoni eliphuusyek tamanwogik lo ak agenge che po thahabu, ratilisyek eliphuusyek muut che po fedha ak ngoroik pogol agenge che po tisiik koba ole kigonoree tuguuk.
Ki meny anyun nganasookwak tisiik, Lawiik, piik alak, tyeniik, riibiigap kurgotik, otwogigap Hekaluut ak Israel tugul eng' nganasookwak.
Kingo it arawetap tisap ye kiga komeng'iis piigap Israel eng' nganasookwak, koyumjigei piik Jerusalem ko uu chiichak.

Yeityo kotonon anyun `Jeshua weeriitap Josadak ak tupchosyekyik tisiik, kobooto Zerubabel weeriitap Shealtiel, ak tupchosyekyik, ak koteech kaptisisyet ne po Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindetap Israel, si kogoitoe kagoochinoik che kibeelei ko uu ye siraat eng' Ng'atuutyetap Musa chiitap Kamuktaindet.

Nga ki tinyei; amu ki tinyei kaiyweisyet amu piigap emotinwek alak, ko ki inde kaptisisyet ole tebee ak kogoochi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kagoochinoik che kibeelei, karon ak koskoleny eng' kaptisisyonooto.
Ki riip igoorto ne po keryosyek, ko uu ye siraat ak kogoito kagoochinoik che kibeelei eng' peetuut age tugul kobee koiitennywa, ko uu kayomiset ak ko uu ye yamei poisyetap peetuut age tugul.

Ye kingo pata kogoito kagoochinet ne kibeelei ne po kotugul, kagoochinoik che po ye kaleel arawet, che po igoorwek tugul che po Kamuktaindet ne Toroor che ki king'at, che ki kitabaan ak che po chii tugul ne ki igoochin Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kagoochinetap chamyet.
Kitau kogoochin Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kagoochinoik che kibeelei eng' peetuut ne po tai ne po arawetap tisap, nga ki tomo kelumda lumeiywegap Hekaluutap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.

Ki igoochi kogeny fedhaisyek musogigap koik, ak che po pagoinik, ak kogoochi piigap Sidon ak che po Tyro amitwogik, che kieei ak mwanik, si kobiit koip taragonik eng' Lebanon kobwa nyanjetap Mediterenian, agoi Joppa, ko uu ye kiga koyanji Cyrus laitoryatap Persia.

Ak eng' kenyiit ne po aeng' ngap koit kootap Kamuktaindet eng' Jerusalem, kotoi Zerubabel weeriitap Shealtiel ak Jeshua weeriitap Josadak kobooto tupchosyekwak (tugul che tisiik, Lawiik ak luulenik tugul che kiga week Jerusalem) poisyet. Ki inde Lawiik, kobooch che po kenyiisyek tiptem ak che siirei, koriip poisyet ne po kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.

Ki tonon anyun Jeshua kobooto weeriikyik ak tupchosyekyik, Kadmiel ak weeriikyik, weeriigap Judah, komi tugul koriip kiboitiinik eng' kootap Kamuktaindet: weeriigap Henadad, kobooto weeriikwak ak tupchosyekwak Lawiik.

Kingo lumda teegik lumeiywotap Hekaluutap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, konam poisyennywa tisiik ak kolas Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kolaachi ngoroikwak che po tiseinateet ak kotinyei iryagook, kobooto Lawiik weeriigap Asaph che ki tinyei sanisyegap sugunonik che kibirei, ko uu ng'atuutyetap Daudi laitoryatap Israel.

Kiwoljingei kotyeni kolasu ak komwachin kongoi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor koleen, “Amu myee ineendet, amu po koigeny rireenennyi eng' Israel.” Ak ki waakyo piik tugul eng' waagaat ne oo ye ki ilasu Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, amu kiga kelumda lumeiywotap kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.

Ago ki riiryo eng' kutit ne oo tisiik che chaang' ak Lawiik ak kandoigap kooriigap kwanisyek, poisyek chooto kiga keer koot ne ki po tai, ye ki ngelumdoi lumeiywotap koiito eng' tainnywa, ak ki waakyo alak eng' poiboiyet.
Ki ma mata komuuch piik koobeesyo waagaat ne po poiboiyet ak ne po riiregap piik, amu ki waakyo piik eng' waagaat ne oo, ak ki it waagandanooto ole loo.
Kingo kas anyun puunigap Judah ak Benjamin kole kateekyi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindetap Israel Hekaluut, luulenik,

koriikta anyun ole mi Zerubabel ak kandoigap kooriigap kwanisyek, ak koleenji icheek, “Ongeteech tugul, amu kicheeng'e Kamuktaindeng'wong' ko uu okweek, ak keeng'jini ineendet tiseiywek kobooch peetuusyegap Esarhaddon laitoryatap Assyria ne ki imutwech kebwa olito.”

Ago ki leenji icheek `Zerubabel kobooto Jeshua ak kandoik tugul che po kooriigap kwanisyek che po Israel, “Ma kiting'egei yamdao ak okweek keteech tugul kootap Kamuktaindennyo. Ago kiteekyini acheegei `koot Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindetap Israel, ko uu ye king'atech laitoryat Cyrus laitoryatap Persia.”
Ki yai anyun `piigap emonooto piigap Judah komeiyo mugulelwogik ak koim icheek eng' teekseet.
Ki igoochi `asoya kandoik che pcheu melekto, si kogirinda icheek kowal magennywa koek puch eng' peetuusyek tugul che po Cyrus laitoryatap Persia, agoi koit laitornatetap Darius laitoryatap Persia.
Eng' taunetap laitornatetap Aasuerus, kosiir pichooto kataamset agobo piik che ki menyei Judah ak Jerusalem.

Ak eng' peetuusyegap Artaserses kosirchi parweet Bislam, Mitredat Tabeel, kobooto choronokwak tugul, kosirchi Artaserses laitoryandanooto po Persia. Ki kisire parwaanooto siruutigap Syria ak kemwae kutitap Syria.
Ki sir anyun parweet Reum pounindetap kirwooget ak Simsai siriindet, kosirchi Laitoryat Artaserses, kotaam Jerusalem ko uu ni:
Ki sir anyun Reum pounindetap kirwooget ak Simsai siriindet, kobooto choronokwak tugul, Dinaik, Aparsakitik, Tarpelik, Aparsik, Arkebik, Babilonik, Susankik, Deaik ak Elamik,
ak pororyosyek alak che ki imutu Osnaper ne oo ak ko tagunoot, kolong' kobwa nganaseetap Samaria ak emet ne mi aineet pitoniin.
Chu anyun ng'aleek che po parwaanooto ki kiyooktochin Laitoryat Artaserses: “Kigotiin acheek otwogiguk che kemi pitoni.
Ingonaak eng' laitoryat kole Yahudik chooto kobunu oldang'ung' ko kogoitwech ak kogoit Jerusalem ak koteechei kogeny nganasanooto ya ago ngelelyo. Teechei kogeny irimoik ak lumeiywot ne kiga kobutok.
Ingonaak nguno eng' laitoryat kole ngot koteech nganasani ak kogees irimoikyik, koma kogoitoi konunoik, kodi, anan aisuruutap tuguuk alak tugul ak eng' let, kong'em mogornateetap pounatet.
Ara anyun, amu ki ame munyugap kootap laitoryat, koma nyoljinech kegeer keng'emjin laitoryat teegisto. Ara kagiyogu parwaani anyun amu nooto kiboorchi laitoryat,

si kobiit kecheeng' eng' bukuit ne po ng'aleegap peetuusyegap kwanisyeguk. Inyooru eng' bukuinooto po ng'aleegap peetuusyek ak inai ile ngelelyo nganasani ak koiimi laitorinik ak emotinwek, ak kigong'eet chaamset kobooch keny. Nooto anyun amu ne si keng'em nganasaniito.
Kiboorchini anyun laitoryat keleenjini, ngot keteech nganasani ak kigees irimoik, kobooru nooto kole, ma itinye kebeberta eng' aineet pitoni.”
Ki iyookyi anyun laitoryat waluunet Reum pounindetap kirwooget ak Simsai siriindet ak choronokwak tugul che ki menyei Samaria, ak emet tugul ne mi aineet pitoniin kole ingotep kaalyeet ko uu nooto.
Parweet ne ki kooyokwech ko kagesomannywa komyee eng' tainnyu.
Koang'at ak kogecheeng', ak koginyoor keele kobooch keny ko ki kongelelji `nganasaniito laitorinik ak ki kobiitune ngelelnateet ak chaamset.
Ki miitei kogeny laitorinik che ki kiimeen che ki pou Jerusalem che ki pou emet tugul ne mi aineet pitoniin ak ki kigoochin konunoik, kodi, ak aisuruutap tuguuk.
Ong'at anyun kiit ne igoochin pichooto kosiisyo, si mata koteech nganasani agoi tuun ang'at.
Oriipkei anyun si mogaegei ng'olyoondonooto. Amu nee si kotesak ng'emisyet ne inyalili laitorinik?

Kingo kagesoman ng'aleegap parweetap Laitoryat Artaserses eng' taitap Reum ak Simsai siriindet ak choronokwak, kochaakta Jerusalem ole mi Yahudik, kwo kong'at icheek eng' koroomnateet ak kimnateet kobagaakta poisyet.
Ki tonon anyun poisyetap kootap Kamuktaindet ne mi Jerusalem agoi kenyiit ne po aeng' ne po laitornatetap Darius laitoryatap Persia.
Kingo maoten maotichu; maotyot Haggai ak Zekariah weeriitap Ido, komaotenji Yahudik che ki mi Judah ak Jerusalem eng' kainetap Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindetap Israel,
kong'eet anyun Zerubabel weeriitap Shealtiel ak Jeshua weeriitap Josadak ak kotoi koteech kootap Kamuktaindet ne mi Jerusalem. Ki mi kobooto icheek maotigap Kamuktaindet kotoreti.

Ki pwanji icheek eng' peetuusyechooto Tatenai ne ki pounindet eng' aineet pitoniin, Setar-bosenai ak choronokwak ak koteebe icheek koleenji, “King'ataak ng'oo ogetyigei teekseetap kooi ak ogesu inatuni?”
Kotep kogeny kole, “Ng'oo kainaigap piik che teechei kooi?”
Ago ki riip konyegap Kamuktaindennywa poisyegap Yahudik ak ma mwachi icheek kobagaach poisyonooto. Ki riip kot koit ng'olyoot kap Darius ak keeweech waluunet eng' parweet agobo ng'olyoondoniito.
Chu ng'aleegap parweet ne ki iyookto Tatenai pounindet ne po aineet pitoniin, Setar-bosenai ak choronokyik Aparsakitik, che ki mi aineet pitoniin, koyookyi Laitoryat Darius.
Ki iyookyi ineendet parweet, ne ki kisir ko uu ni: Kisirchini Laitoryat Darius, taach chametapkei.

Myee konaak eng' laitoryat kole ki kibe emetap Judah agoi kootap Kamuktaindet ne oo, ne kiteechee koik che eecheen ak kindoi pagoinik inatusyek; wendi tai poisyoni eng' kagiiletapkei ak koberuurot eng' eunekwak.
Ki kiteebe anyun poisyechooto, keleenji, “King'ataak ng'oo ogetyigei teekseetap kooi ak ogesu inatuni?”
Ki kiteebe kainaikwak kogeny si kobiit kiboorun, si kimuuch kesir kainaigap piik che ki indochin icheek.

Ak kiwolwech anyun, kole, “Ki otwogigap Kamuktaindetap kipsengwet ak ng'wony, ak kiteeche kogeny koot ne kiga keteech eng' kenyisyechu chaang' ki kosiirto ne kiteechei laitoryat ne oo ne po Israel ak kogees.
Ago kingo kagotach `kwanisyekyok Kamuktaindetap kipsengwet kot konereech, konde icheek eutap Nebukadnezar laitoryatap Babilon, Kaldeindet ne king'em kooi ak komut piik koba Babilon.
Ago eng' kenyiit ne po tai ne po Cyrus laitoryatap Babilon, kong'at Laitoryat Cyrus keteech kooi po Kamuktaindet.

Ki inem Laitoryat Cyrus eng' hekaluutap Babilon, tereenigap thahabu ak che po fedha ak icheek che po kootap Kamuktaindet, che kiga ip Nebukadnezar eng' Hekaluut ne ki mi Jerusalem kobwa hekaluutap Babilon ak ki kigoochi chiito age ne kiguure Sesbasar ne kiga koeet ineendet koek pounindet,
ak ki leenji ineendet, ‘Ip tereenichu ak iwe Hekaluut ne mi Jerusalem ak ingeteech kootap Kamuktaindet eng' ole kimi yeginye.’
Ki nyo anyun Sesbasar niito ak kolum lumeiywegap kootap Kamuktaindet ne miitei Jerusalem. Kobooch peetuusyechooto agoi ra, keteechei kora, ago tomo kogeskei.

Ara anyun, ngot kogeer laitoryat kole myee, kecheeng' eng' koot ne kigonoree tuguugap laitoryat, ne mi olooto po Babilon, si kegeer ngo uu nooto, ngo ki ng'at Laitoryat Cyrus keteech koiito po Kamuktaindet eng' Jerusalem. Ingoyokwech laitoryat ng'olyoot komwaiwech kiit ne chamei eng' ng'olyoondoniito.”
Ki ng'at anyun Laitoryat Darius ak ki kicheeng' koot ne po bukuisyek ole ki kigonoree tuguuk eng' Babilon.
Ak ki kinyoorchi kitabuut Ekbatana eng' kootap laitoryat ne mi emetap Media, ne ki kisir ko uu ni koek kabwaatet:

Eng' kenyiit ne po tai ne po Laitoryat Cyrus, koyai Cyrus ng'atuutyet agobo kootap Kamuktaindet eng' Jerusalem kole ngeteech koot, ole kigoitoe tiseiywek, ak kelumda lumeiywekyik kouegitu; ingoek kooindap tononennyi mitainik tamanwogik lo che po euut ak tebeesindanyi mitainik tamanwogik lo che po euut,
kobooto ortinwek somok che po koik che eecheen, ak ooreet agenge ne po pagoinik che leelach. Ingobun kootap laitoryat tuguuk che keyaaktoe tuguuchooto.

Kora ko ingeweekta kogeny tereenik che po thahabu ak che po fedha che po kootap Kamuktaindet, che kiga ip Nebukadnezar eng' Hekaluut ne ki mi Jerusalem kobwa Babilon. Ingeip kogeny koba Hekaluut ne mi Jerusalem ak inde kiit age tugul komostanyi ak inde kotebee kootap Kamuktaindet.
Ki ng'at Laitoryat kole; “Ara oistegei anyun inyee Tatenai pounindetap aineet pitoniin, Setar-bosenai ak choronoguk Aparsakitik che mi aineet pitoniin.
Oistoegei poisyetap kootap Kamuktaindet, ingoteech pounindetap Yahudik kobooto poisyegap Yahudik koyooto po Kamuktaindet eng' ole ki mi ye kinye.”

Kang'at kogeny agobo kiit ne oyachini poisyechooto po Yahudik agobo teekseetap koiito po Kamuktaindet. Kigoochin pichooto eng' kagiiletapkei tuguuk che kiyaaktoi che po laitoryat che tuguugap aisuruut eng' aineet pitoniin, si ma ki kirinda icheek.

Tuguuk che makyingei ko uu kiruugik che mengeechen, mengichik, aaregap keechiir, koek kagoochinoik che kibeeljin Kamuktaindetap kipsengwet ak nganuuk, muunyuk, divaik, ak mwanik, ko uu eng' ng'olyootap tisiik che mi Jerusalem; ingigoochi icheek peetuut age tugul amat keele ma mi,
si kobiit kogoochi Kamuktaindetap kipsengwet korosegap nyamdutik che anyiny ak kosa agobo saboondap laitoryat ak weeriikyik.
Kang'at kogeny ale, chii age tugul ne walei ng'olyoondoniito ko ingeng'us pambaniat eng' koonnyi ak keganapchi ineendet ak keratyi keetoto ak keyai koonnyi koek kapng'atat agobo niito.

Ngo par Kamuktaindet ne ki inde kainennyi komeny olooto, laitorinik tugul ak piik tugul che iitoi eunekwak kole kowal ng'olyoondonooto ak kong'em kootap Kamuktaindet ne miitei Jerusalem. Kaang'at anee Darius. Ara ingoyaak ng'atuutyoniito eng' kagiiletapkei tugul.
Ki yai anyun ko uu nooto kochokyi Tatenai pounindetap aineet pitoniin kobooto Setar-bosenai ak choronokwak, amu kiga koyookto piik Laitoryat Darius.

Kiteekso anyun poisyegap Yahudik ak koboor eng' maonateetap maotyot Haggai ak Zekariah weeriitap Ido. Kiteekso ak ki iges ko uu ng'atuutyetap Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindetap Israel ak ko uu ng'atuutyetap Cyrus, Darius ak Artaserses laitoryatap Persia.
Ki kigees anyun koyooto eng' peetuut ne po somok eng' arawetap Adar ne ki po kenyiit ne po lo eng' laitornatetap Laitoryat Darius.
Ki itabaan koyooto po Kamuktaindet eng' poiboiyet piigap Israel, tisiik kobooto Lawiik ak piik tugul che ki luulenik che ki weeksei.

Ki igoito kiruugik pogol agenge, mengichik pogol aeng', aaregap keechiir pogol ang'wan eng' peetuutap katabaanetap koyooto po Kamuktaindet. Ak ki igoito kwesik taman ak aeng' koek kagoochinetap tengekto agobo Israel tugul kobee koitetap ortinwegap Israel.
Ki inde `icheek tisiik ko uu pcheutikwak ak Lawiik ko uu riipsosyekwak agobo otisyetap Kamuktaindet ne mi Jerusalem, ko uu ye siraat eng' bukuitap Musa.
Ki riip anyun paska `lagogap luulenik eng' peetuutap taman ak ang'wan ne po arawet ne po tai.
Amu kiga koanyinygei Tisiik ak Lawiik, kitiliileen tugul. Ki eeny aarwetap paska agobo lagok tugul che po luulenik ak agobo tupchosyekwak tisiik, ak agobo icheeget.
Ki am paska piigap Israel che ki weeksei kobunu ole kiga kiluulji ak tugul che kiga istoegei simdap pororyosyegap emonooto, kocheeng' Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindetap Israel.

Kiboiboitu eng' poiboiyet ne oo, koboiboenji igoorto ne po magatiinik che ma kinde mermereek peetuusyek tisap, amu ki igoochi `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor icheek koboiboitu ak ki wal muguleldap laitoryatap Assyria kotokyigei icheek si kogimit icheek eng' poisyetap kootap Kamuktaindet, Kamuktaindetap Israel.
Kingo pata tuguuchu eng' laitornatetap Artaserses laitoryatap Persia, ko ki mi Ezrah weeriitap Seraiah, weeriitap Azariah, weeriitap Hilkiah,
weeriitap Shallum, weeriitap Zadok, weeriitap Ahitub,
weeriitap Amariah, weeriitap Azariah, weeriitap Meraiot,
weeriitap Seraiah, weeriitap Usi, weeriitap Buki,
weeriitap Abisua, weeriitap Phineas, weeriitap Eleazar, weeriitap Aron tisiindet ne oo.

Ki togosta anyun Ezrah niito eng' Babilon. Ki siriindet ne ng'oom eng' ng'atuutigap Musa che kiga kogoochi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindetap Israel. Ki chamji laitoryat soomennyi tugul, ko uu ye kimi eutap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindennyi paragunnyi.
Ki togosta alak che po piigap Israel ak che po tisiik, Lawiik, tyeniik, kobooto riibiigap kurgotik ak otwogigap Hekaluut kobwa Jerusalem, eng' kenyiit ne po tisap ne po Laitoryat Artaserses.
Ki it `Ezra Jerusalem eng' arawet ne po muut ne ki kenyiit ne po tisap ne po laitoryat.

Ki katoi kotogos eng' Babilon eng' peetuut ne po tai ne po arawet ne po tai ak eng' peetuut ne po tai ne po arawetap muut, koit Jerusalem ko uu ye ki mi ak ineendet euut ne myee ne po Kamuktaindennyi.
Amu kiga kogiilgei eng' muguleldanyi Ezrah kocheeng' ng'atuutigap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, koyai ak koneet kayomisutik ak kirwoogutik eng' Israel.
Chu ng'aleegap parweet ne ki igoochi `Laitoryat Artaserses Ezrah tisiindet, ne kora ko siriindetap ng'aleegap ng'atuutik che po Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ak kayomisutik che ki igoochi Israel:
Anee Artaserses, laitoryatap laitorinik, asirchini Ezrah tisiindet, siriindetap ng'atuutigap Kamuktaindetap kipsengwet ne ititaat; Taach chametapkei.
Kang'at ale, Oba tugul, piigap pororyetap Israel kobooto tisiikwak ak Lawiik che mi laitornatennyu, che chamei koba Jerusalem eng' magennywa.
Amu kagoyookten laitoryat ak kirwoogikyik tisap iwe iteep agobo Judah ak Jerusalem ko uu ng'atuutyetap Kamuktaindeng'ung' ne mi kobooten.
Ne siirei, iip fedha ak thahabu che ki igoochi eng' chamyet `laitoryat ak kirwoogikyik Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindetap Israel, ne mi meng'ootennyi Jerusalem.

Ip kobooto fedha tugul ak thahabu che inyoorchini emet tugul ne po Babilon, kobooto kagoochinet ne po chamyet ne po piik ak ne po tisiik, kogoitoi eng' chamyet agobo kootap Kamuktaindennywa ne mi Jerusalem.

Myee anyun iale fedhaisyechu, kiruugik, mengichik, aaregap keechiir, kobooto kagoochinoikwak che po peek ak kagoochinoikwak che kieei ak igoite chooto eng' kaptisisyetap kootap Kamuktaindeng'wong' ne mi Jerusalem.
Kiit age tugul ne ogeere inyee ak tupchosyeguk ole myee oyae fedhaisyek tugul che kang'et ak thahabu, oyae ko uu mageetap Kamuktaindeng'wong'.
Igoite eng' taitap Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindetap Jerusalem tereenik che kigoonin agobo otisyetap kootap Kamuktaindeng'ung'.
Kiit age tugul neta kemakyin kootap Kamuktaindeng'ung' ne kanyool igoite, igoite eng' tuguuk che konorotiin che po kootap laitoryat.

Ang'ate anee, Laitoryat Artaserses konoriik tugul che po tuguuk che mi aineet pitoniin ale kiit age tugul neta komagenok Ezrah tisiindet, siriindetap ng'atuutigap Kamuktaindetap kipsengwet, keyai eng' kagiiletapkei,
kot koit talendaisyek pogol che po fedha, keruutik pogol che po nganuuk, divaik che yamegei ak debeisyek pogol aeng', mwanik che yamegei ak debeisyek pogol aeng', ak muunyuk che ma ki mwa ole tee.
Kiit age tugul ne ng'atei Kamuktaindetap kipsengwet, koyaak ko uu nooto agobo kootap Kamuktaindetap kipsengwet ang' dabuch nyoonji nereeknateet pounatetap laitoryat ak weeriikyik.

Kiboorwok kogeny keele, ma chamdaat eng' ng'atuutik kogoito kodi anan aisuruut anan ko aisuruut ne po tuguuk, age tugul eng' tisiik, Lawiik, tyeniik, riibiigap kurgotik ak otwogigap Hekaluut anan ko otwogigap kootap Kamuktaindet.

Lewen inyee Ezrah ko uu utaatyetap Kamuktaindeng'ung' ne mi eung'ung', kirwoogik ak pounik che imuuchi koboi piik tugul che mi aineet pitoniin, icheek tugul che ingen ng'atuutigap Kamuktaindeng'ung' ak oneet ineendet ne ma ingen.

Age tugul ne ma chamei koyai ng'atuutigap Kamuktaindeng'ung' ak ng'atuutigap laitoryat, kirwookyi iman ak konyoor pireet; ngo ne po meet anan ngo ne po kang'etoet, ngo kerebe tuguuk anan ngo ratisyet.
Iberuurot Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindetap kwanisyekyok, ne ki inde ng'olyoot ne uu ni muguleldap laitoryat, si kochop kogararanit kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne mi Jerusalem,

ne kigoiitwa ak anee rireenet eng' taitap laitoryat ak kirwoogikyik ak eng' taitap pounik tugul che kiimeen che po laitoryat. Ak ki anyiganitu amu ki mi kobooto eutap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindennyu ak kiayum eng' Israel piik che taagunotiin ketogoste tugul.
Chu ko kandoigap kooriigap kwanisyekwak ak tetuutigap ibinwekwak che ki kosiirto che ki kitogosu tugul eng' Babilon eng' peetuusyegap laitornatetap Laitoryat Artaserses:
Eng' weeriigap Phineas, ko Gershom; eng' weeriigap Ithamar, ko Daniel; eng' weeriigap Daudi, ko Hatus.
Eng' weeriigap Shekaneiah, eng' weeriigap Paros, ko Zekariah, ak ki kiitito ineendet murenik pogol ak konom eng' tetuutigap ibinwek che ki kosiirto.
Eng' weeriigap Pahat-moap, ko Eliehoenai weeriitap Seraiah, ak ki mi kobooto ineendet murenik pogolwogik aeng'u.
Eng' weeriigap Shekaneiah ko weeriitap Jahasyel, ak ki mi kobooto ineendet murenik pogolwogik somogu.
Eng' weeriigap Adin, ko Ebed weeriitap Jonathan, ak ki mi kobooto ineendet murenik konomu.
Eng' weeriigap Elam, ko Jesaia weeriitap Athaliah, ak ki mi kobooto ineendet murenik tamanwogik tisabu.
Eng' weeriigap Shepatiah, ko Sebadia weeriitap Mikael, ak ki mi kobooto ineendet murenik tamanwogik sisiitu.
Eng' weeriigap Joab, ko Obadiah weeriitap Jehiel, ak ki mi kobooto ineendet murenik pogolwogik aeng'u ak taman ak sisiit.
Eng' weeriigap Selomit, ko weeriitap Josipia, ak ki mi kobooto ineendet murenik pogolut agenge ak tamanwogik lo.
Eng' weeriigap Bebai, ko Zekariah weeriitap Bebai; ak ki mi kobooto ineendet murenik tiptemu ak sisiit.
Eng' weeriigap Askad, ko Johanan weeriitap Hakatan, ak ki mi kobooto ineendet murenik pogolut agenge ak taman.
Eng' weeriigap Adonikam, che po let, ak chu kainaikwak, Eliphelet, Jeuel ak Semaiah, ak ki mi kobooto icheek murenik tamanwogik lo.
Ak eng' weeriigap Bigbai, ko Utai ak Zabud. Ki mi kobooto icheek murenik tamanwogik tisabu.
Ki ayumji icheek aineet ne rootyin Ahaba. Ki kitebee yooto peetuusyek somok ak ki ageerote piik ak tisiik ak ma anyooru weeriigap Lawi.
Ki ayookte anyun keguur Elieser, Ariel, Semaiah, Elnatan, Jarib, Elnatan, Nathan, Zekariah ak Mesulam, piik che eecheen, kobooto Joiarib ak Elnatan, che ki kaneetik,

ayookte icheek koba kap Ido ne ki oo eng' ole kiguure Kasipia. Ki amwachi kiit ne kanyool komwachi Ido ak tupchosyekyik otwogigap Hekaluut eng' komosato po Kasipia, si komutwech kiboitiinik che po kootap Kamuktaindennyo.

Amu kimi kobootech euut ne myee ne po Kamuktaindennyo, komutwech chiito ne tinyei naet, ne po weeriigap Mali, weeriitap Lawi, weeriitap Israel ak Serebia, kobooto weeriikyik ak tupchosyekyik taman ak sisiit,
ak Hasabia ak ki mi kobooto ineendet Jesaia ne po weeriigap Merari tupchosyekyik ak weeriikwak, tiptem.
Eng' otwogigap Hekaluut che kiga konde Daudi ak pounik agobo otisyetap Lawiik, ko ki kiguur otwogik pogol aeng' ak tiptem, tugul eng' kainaikwak.
Yeityo ang'at anyun karugutetapkei, eng' aineetap Ahaba, si kobiit kiming'inge eng' taitap Kamuktaindennyo, kecheeng' eng' ineendet ooreet ne litit, eng' acheek ak lagokyok ak ne po tuguukyok tugul.

Amu ki alilan asoom laitoryat kweanet ne po kiplugotinik ak piik che ketei paraisisyek si kotoretech kegirindee puunik che mi ooreet. Amu kiga kemwachi laitoryat keleenji, “Mi eutap Kamuktaindennyo kobooto icheek tugul che cheeng'ei ineendet, koyachi ne myee, ago kirindoi kimnateennyi ak nereeknatennyi piik tugul che metoi ineendet.”
Ki kirugutkei anyun ak kesaa Kamuktaindennyo agobo niito ak kigaswech.
Ki atabaan anyun taman ak aeng' che eecheen eng' tisiik, icheeget ko ki Serebia ak Hasabia ak ki mi kobooto icheek tamanu eng' tupchosyekwak,
ak ki agerchi icheek fedha, thahabu, tereenik ak kagoochinetap kootap Kamuktaindennyo che kiga kogoon laitoryat ak kirwoogikyik, pounikyik ak Israel tugul che ki mi yooto.
Ki agerchi icheek talendaisyek pogol lo ak konom che po fedha ak tuguuk che po fedha che yamei talendaisyek pogol ak thahabu che yamei talendaisyek pogol,
ak taabook tiptem che po thahabu, che yamei keruutik sisiit ak kebeberyat, ak tereenik aeng' che po sugunonik, che myachen, che liilei piich che tinyei kamanuutyet ne uu ne po thahabu.

Yeityo aleenji icheek, “Oo tiliileen eng' Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ak ko tiliileen tereenik ak fedha ak thahabu ko kagoochinoigap chamyet che kigoochin Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindetap kwanisyekwok.

Oriipse ak oriip tuguuchooto agoi obiman eng' kooriik che po oriit eng' kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' taitap che eecheen eng' tisiik, Lawiik ak pounik che po kooriigap kwanisyekwok che po Israel eng' Jerusalem.”
Kitaach anyun Tisiik ak Lawiik nyigiisindap fedha ak thahabu ak tereenik, si koip kobwa Jerusalem kootap Kamuktaindennyo.

Eng' peetuutap taman ak aeng' ne po arawet ne po tai, keng'etye anyun eng' aineetap Ahaba ak keebe Jerusalem. Ki mi kobootech eutap Kamuktaindennyo ak kisarwech eng' eutap puunyoot ak ne kisapchinech eng' ooreet.
Kingeitu Jerusalem, ketebee yooto peetuusyek somok.

Eng' peetuut ne po ang'wan ko ki kiger fedha ak thahabu ak tereenik eng' kootap Kamuktaindennyo, ki kigoochi Meremot weeriitap Uriah tisiindet. Ki mi kobooto ineendet Eleazar weeriitap Phineas, ak ki mi kobooto icheek Josabad weeriitap Jeshua, ak Noahdia weeriitap Binui, Lawiik.
Ki kiit tuguuk tugul ak keger, ak ki kisir ole kite nyigiisindo eng' peetuunooto.

Ki igoito lagogap luulenik, che ki weeksei eng' ole ki kiluulji, kagoochinoik che kibeelei kogoochi Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindetap Israel; kiruugik taman ak aeng' agobo Israel tugul, mengichik tamanwogik sogool ak lo, aaregap kechir tamanwogik tisap ak tisap, kwesik taman ak aeng', koek kagoochinetap tengekto. Ki ek chuuto tugul kagoochinet ne kibeeljin Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ki igoochi kora ng'atuutigap laitoryat kandoik che po kaplaitoryat ak pounik che ki mi aineet pitoniin, ak kitoret piik ak kootap Kamuktaindet.

Kingo kagoyaak tuguuchu, kobwonjo kandoik ak koleenjo, “Ma itabaanegei piigap Israel ak Tisiik ak Lawiik piigap emotinwek; yaei tuguuk che kiwechei che po Kanaanik, Hitik, Perisik, Jebusik, Amonik, Moabik, Misiriik ak Amorik.
Amu ki kotun tiibiikwak, kotunji weeriikwak kot koburuigei keswoot ne tiliil ak piigap emotinwek, ee, che ki indochin pistooniito ko ki kandoik ak pounik.”
Ak kinga kas ng'olyoondoni, abet ngoryennyu ne po oriit ak ne po parak, ak ang'ei sumeekyuk ak atut tamnennyu yeityo atebi ng'wony akwong'.
Ki iyumjagei anyun chii age tugul ne kibotani agobo ng'aleegap Kamuktaindetap Israel, agobo pistoetap che kiga kiluul. Ki atebi ng'wony akwong' kot koit kagoitoetap kagoochinetap koskoleny.

Yeityo ang'eet eng' kaming'inennyu pogei ye ki kigoitoi kagoochinetap koskoleny, ko kaabet ngoryennyu ne po oriit ak ne po parak. Ki agutuny ak aitoochi eunekyuk Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindennyu,

ak ale, “Ee Kamuktaindennyu, alilani miising' ak kagowalak togeennyu kot koma muuch anyalin, inyee Kamuktaindennyu, amu kogotesak tengekwogikyok kot ko maluuchech ak ki koeet ng'oogistonyo kot koit kipsengwet.

Ki keegu kiptengegiinik miising' kobooch peetuusyegap kwanisyekyok agoi rani, ak ki kindeech eunegap laitorinik che po emotinwek agobo tengekwogikyok acheek, laitorinikyok ak tisiikyok, kebarech eng' rotwetap chok, keluulech, ng'emisyet ak kalilanet, ko uu rani.

Kagiboorwech anyun nguno eng' poroini ming'in myeeindo ne punu Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindennyo, kot kotuukwech alak kochililso ak kogoonech tigongyot eng' oldanyi ne tiliil, si kokweng'wech konyekyok Kamuktaindennyo ak kogoonech kasoobet ne ming'in eng' ratisyennyo.

Nga ki otwogik, koma pagakyech Kamuktaindennyo otwoknatennyo, ago ki ityech rireenet eng' taitap laitorinigap Persia, si kogoonech kasoobet, si kelumda kootap Kamuktaindennyo ak keteech ole Ki kong'emak eng' koyooto ak kegoonech irimeet eng' Judah ak Jerusalem.”
Ara anyun, ee, Kamuktaindennyo, ta kemwae nee kogeny? Amu kigemete ng'atuutiguk,

che kigeng'at eng' otwogiguk maotik, ile, “Ma tiliil emet ne obendi oname kobunjook, amu simwegap piik che po emotinwek, eng' tuguukwak che kiwechei che ki konyiit ng'wanindanywa emet kong'etee tabanda age agoi tabanda age.

Amogoochi anyun tiibiikwok weeriikwak, anan kotun weeriikwok tiibiikwak anan ocheeng' kalyennywa anan ko porotennywa koigeny, si kobiit ogimegitu ak oam ruroteetap emet ak obagakyi lagokwok koek porotennywa koigeny.
Kigobwanjech chooto tugul amu poisyonikyok che yaach ak ng'oogistonyo ne oo. Amu ma ibirech inyee Kamuktaindennyo ko uu ye yamegei ak tengekwogikyok, ak ki igoonech chu ng'etunotiin,
ko tos kibut kogeny ng'atuutiguk ak kenamge ak piik che yaei tuguuchu kiwechei? Tos menereekyinech kot igeswech kot koma mi che ng'etu anan che chilildos?

Ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindetap Israel, ii po iman, amu ki piik che kigeng'etu, che kichililso, ko uu rani. Ki mi taing'ung' eng' ng'oogistonyo, amu ma mi ne imuuchi kotonon eng' taing'ung' amu niito.”

Ye kita kosaaei Ezrah ak kong'aanyei chalwogik, koriirei ak kowiirchingei ng'wony eng' taitap kootap Kamuktaindet, koyumjigei ineendet tuiyet ne oo miising' ne ki punu Israel, ne po murenik ak kwonyiik ak lagok. Ki riiryo piik ak icheek eng' ng'wanindo.

Ak ki wolji Shekaneiah weeriitap Jehiel, weeriitap Elam, Ezrah koleenji, “Ki kichililji Kamuktaindennyo ak ki kitun tiibiik che salu saang' che po piigap emoni, ago mi nguno kamang'unet agobo Israel agobo ng'olyoondoniito.

Ongiyomiske anyun ak Kamuktaindennyo keiste osotik tugul ak lagok che kisichei osotichooto ko uu ng'olyoondeng'ung' inyee kiptaiyandennyu ak ne po icheeget che kabotanso amu ng'atuutyetap Kamuktaindennyo ak ingoyaak ko uu ng'atuutyet.
Ng'eet anyun; amu neng'ung' ng'olyoondoniito ak kimi, kobooten ara nyiganitu ak iyai.”
Kong'eet anyun Ezrah ak kong'at che eecheen eng' tisiik, Lawiik ak Israel tugul, koyasyo kole yaei ko uu ng'olyoondoniito. Ara ki iyasyo anyun.

Kong'eet anyun Ezrah eng' taitap kootap Kamuktaindet ak kwo koot ne po oriit ne po Jeohanan weeriitap Eliasib. Kingo it yooto, koma koamis anan koe peek, amu kirirei agobo kachililutyetap icheek che kiga kiluul.
Kimwaita eng' Judah tugul ak Jerusalem, komwachi lagok tugul che po piik che kiga kiluul si kobiit koyumjigei Jerusalem.
Age tugul ne ma nyo ko kagobata peetuusyek somogu, ko uu ng'olyootap pounik ak poisyek, kerebe tuguukyik tugul ak kitabaane tuiyetap pichooto kiga kiluul.

Ki iyumjigei anyun Jerusalem `piik tugul che po Judah ak Benjamin kotomo kogeskei peetuusyek somogu. Ki arawetap sogool eng' peetuutap tiptem ne po arawanooto, ak ki tebee piik tugul komosta ne paraa eng' taitap kootap Kamuktaindet kobotandos agobo ng'olyoondonooto ak ropta ne oo.
Yeityo kotonon anyun Ezrah tisiindet ak koleenji icheek, “Ki ochiliil ak ki otun tiibiik che salu saang' ak otes ng'oogistap Israel.
Ong'aang'ji anyun Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindetap kwanisyekwok ak oyai kiit ne chamei. Otabaanegei piigap emet ak kwonyiik che toek.”
Ki wol anyun tuiyet tugul eng' kutit ne oo kole, “Ko uu ye kaimwa agobo acheek, konyaaljinech keyai.
Chaang' piik che mi yu ak nguno ko peetuusyegap ropta ne oo. Ma kimuuchi ketononse eng' saang', ago ma poisyetap peetuut agenge niito anan aeng', amu ki kichiliil miising' eng' kiito.

Ingelewen anyun pounikyok agobo tuiyet tugul ak ingobwa icheek tugul che mi nganasookyok che ki itun tiibiik che toek. Ingobwa eng' peetuusyek che king'atei ak Ingobwa kobooto icheek poisyegap nganaseet age tugul ak kirwoogikyik agoi koistoeneigei nereegek che koroomen che po Kamuktaindennyo, kot keisto poisyoniito.”
Jonathan weeriitap Asahel ak Jaseia weeriitap Tikba icheegei che kitononso kogirinda ng'olyoondoniito, ak kitoret icheek Mesulam ak Sabetai Lawindet.

Ki yai ko uu nooto lagogap piik che kiga kiluul. Ki kitabaan tisiindet Ezrah kobooto kandoik alak che po kooriigap kwanisyek kobee kooriigap kwanisyekwak ak icheek tugul ko uu kainaikwak ak ki tebi ng'wony eng' peetuut ne po tai ne po arawetap taman kogin ng'aleechooto.
Ki iges eng' peetuut ne po tai eng' arawet ne po tai ng'aleek tugul che po murenik che kiga kotun tiibiik che toek.
Ki piit eng' weeriigap tisiik che kiga kotun tiibiik che toek: eng' weeriigap Jeshua, weeriitap Josedak ak tupchosyekyik, ko ki Maaseia, Elieser, Jarib, ak Gedalia.
Ki iyasyo icheek kole istoi osotikwak, ak amu ki tinyei tengekto, ko ki igoito mengit ne po akweet kobunji tengektonywa.
Eng' weeriigap Imer ko ki Hanani ak Sebadia.
Eng' weeriigap Harim ko ki Maaseia, Elijah, Semaiah, Jehiel ak Uzziah.
Eng' weeriigap Pasur ko ki Elioenai, Maaseia, Ishmael, Nethanel, Josabad ak Elasa.
Eng' Lawiik ko ki Josabad, Shimei, Kelaia (ineendet Kelita), Petaia, Judah ak Elieser.
Eng' tyeniik ko ki Eliasib, ak eng' riibiigap kurgotik ko ki Shallum, Telem ak Uri.
Eng' Israel, eng' weeriigap Paros ko ki Ramya, Isia, Malkija, Mijamin, Eleazar, Malkija ak Benaiah.
Eng' weeriigap Elam ko ki Mattaniah, Zekariah, Jehiel, Abdi, Jeremot ak Elijah.
Eng' weeriigap Satu ko ki Elioenai, Eliasib, Mattaniah, Jeremot, Sabad ak Asisa.
Eng' weeriigap Bebai ko ki Jeohanan, Hananiah, Sabai, Atlai.
Eng' weeriigap Bani ko ki Mesulam, Maluk, Adaiah, Jasub, Seal ak Jeremot.
Eng' weeriigap Pahat-moap ko ki Adna, Kelal, Benaiah, Maaseia, Mattaniah, Bezalel, Binui ak Manasseh.
Eng' weeriigap Harim ko ki Elieser, Isija, Malkija, Semaiah, Shimeon;
Benjamin, Maluk, Semaria.
Eng' weeriigap Asum ko ki Matenai, Matata, Sabad, Eliphelet, Jeremai, Manasseh ak Shimei.
Eng' weeriigap Bani ko ki Madai, Amram ak Uel,
Benaiah, Bedeia, Kelui;
Bania, Meremot, Eliasib;
Mattaniah, Matenai, Jaasu;
Bani, Binui, Shimei;
Selemya, Nathan, Adaiah;
Maknadebai, Sasai, Sarai;
Asarel, Selemya, Semaria;
Shallum, Amariah ak Joseph.
Eng' weeriigap Nebo ko ki Jeiel, Matitia, Sabad, Sebina, Ido, Joel ak Benaiah.
Kiga kotun `chuuto tugul tiibiik che toek ak ki tinyei alak osotik che kiga kosikyi lagok.
Che isubi ko ng'aleegap Nehemiah weeriitap Hakalia: Eng' arawetap Kisleb eng' kenyiitap tiptem, ye ki ami Susa eng' kaplaitoryat,
konyo Hanani, age eng' tupchosyekyuk ak piik alak che ki punu Judah. Ki ateebee icheek agobo Yahudik che kiga kochililso, che ki ng'et eng' che kiga keluul, ak ateebee kora agobo Jerusalem.
Kimwaiwo icheek kole, “Tinyei nyalilda ne oo ak churisyet eng' emonooto piik che ki ng'et eng' che kiga keluul. Ki kobutok agine irimeetap Jerusalem ak ki kebeel ormariichokyik.”
Ye kinga kas ng'aleechuuto, atep ng'wony ariir ak aaragen eng' peetuusyek alak, ki arugutkei ak asaa eng' taitap Kamuktaindetap kipsengwet.
