Ng'wonennywa ko uu ng'wonetap ndaret; kergei icheek ak ereneet ne ma kastoi, ne timei itiikyik,
ne ma epchin iit kutitap piik che kuurei erenook eng' kagaigaet, matiny kaguur eng' ng'omnateet.
Ee Kamuktaindet, iri kelekwak, icheru, ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, kelek che eecheen che po ng'etuunyik che neran!
Ingochootyo koigei peek che rootei; ingoigei icheek susweek che kityekyin ng'wony ak kotonogis.
Ingoigei kimng'elyegut ne chootei kowong'ugei, ingoigei kwondo ne karorok moet, ne ma keer asiis.
Kotom kogas tereenikwok maatap katok, Istoi ineendet icheek eng' kipchurchuryet, che tuonen ak che laldos kogergeit.
Paibai ne po imanda ye keerei yaaktaetap mugetuut; iune keelyekyik korotiigap kiptengeginik.
Si komwa piik kole, “Miitei iman melekto ne po chiito ne po imanda; mi iman Kamuktaindet ne irwoochi eng' ng'wony.”
Ee Kamuktaindennyu, sarwo eng' puunikyuk; ieeta asiir icheek che ng'eetyina.
Sarwo eng' yaigap tengekto, ak isarwo eng' piik che chamei kotumda korotiik.
Amu, keero, ratei icheek ooreet agobo saboondanyu; kagoyumjagei che kiimeen. Ma amu pistoennyu, anan tengektonyu, ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor,
rwaei icheek kochobegei ma amu lelutyennyu. Ng'eet inyee, toreto, ak igeer!
Inyee, ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindetap lugoosyek, Kamuktaindetap Israel, ng'eet ibookyi pororyosyek; amat iriiree pistoik alak tugul che yaach.
Weeksei icheek koskoleny, ikwari ko uu seset, ak pendi koyiemei nganaseet.
Keero, ing'irugei ng'aleek eng' kutusweekwak; miitei rotonik kutusweekwak. Amu mwaei kole, “Ng'oo ne kasei?”
Ago irorechini inyee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor; ireenye pororyosyek.
Ee kimnateennyu, ageniin; amu inyee Kamuktaindet, ko irimennyu ne kooi.
Indoena Kamuktaindennyu ne po rireenet, tuun chamwo Kamuktaindet ageer magennyu eng' puunikyuk.
Amebar icheek, si ma utye piikyuk; iyeste pichooto eng' kimnateng'ung', ak ichooru, ee Kiptaiyat long'ennyo.
Ingenam icheek eng' menatennywa, amu tengektap kutusweekwak, ak ng'aleegap ng'elyebwekwak, amu chubisyet ak lembechek che mwaei.
Iwong'u icheek eng' nereegek, iwong'u anyun, kot koma komi! Si konai piik kole pounisyei Kamuktaindet eng' Jakobo, agoi ole poochin ng'wony.
Ingoweechkei icheek koskoleny, ingokwaryo ko uu seset, ak ingoba koyiem nganaseet.
Ombenoti kocheeng'oti amitwogik, ak kong'unyng'ung'so kemout komugul ngo ma piyong'so.
Ago atyeni agobo kimnateng'ung'; atyeni agobo rireeneng'ung' karon. Amu inyee ko ki ii irimennyu ne kooi, ak ole amwechini eng' peetuutap pichiindo.
Ee kimnateennyu, atyenun inyee kalasunoik; amu inyee, Kamuktaindet, ko irimennyu ne kooi, Kamuktaindet ne irireenage.
Ee Kamuktaindet, ki iwiirtech ak ki iyestech; ki inereech; ee iweechech kogeny.
Ki itumdum emet ak ki ibet; isoop ole ki kobetak amu potani.
Ki iboorchi piiguk tuguuk che nyigiisen; ki igoonech kee divaik che kibogiti.
Ki igoochi che iywein songolyet, si kobiit kobarta amu imanda.
Si kesar chamaniguk, saru eng' eung'ung' ne po tai ak iwolwech.
Kigotwek Kamuktaindet eng' tiliilindanyi; kole, “Agasigei ye apchee Shekem, ak akwaa atebweetap Sukoth.
Nenyu Gilead, ak nenyu Manasseh; Ephraim agine ko kimnateetap metinnyu, Judah ko kiroktonyu ne po laitornatet.
Moab ko karait ne aunegei; awirchini kweiyonnyu Edom. ooren inyee Philistia amu anee.”
Imuta ng'oo awo nganaseet ne kiim? Indoiywa ng'oo agoi Edom?
Tos ma inyee ne ki iwiirtech, ee Kamuktaindet? Ama iwe inyee kobooto lugosyekyok, ee Kamuktaindet.
Koonech toreteet kegirindae puunyoot, amu ma tilei kiy toretetap chii.
Kiterteerisyei eng' nyiganateet eng' Kamuktaindet, amu ineendet ne tyekyin ng'wony puunikyok.
Ee Kamuktaindet, kaswa riirekyuk, epchi iit saaennyu.
Aguurin eng' tabandap ng'wony, ye kagotanui muguleldanyu. Imutya rwandet ne kooi kosiiro,
amu inyee ko ii ole amwechini, ii koot ne kooi ne kiim ole aung'egei eng' puunik.
Amenye koong'ung' koigeny, amweu aung'egei kebebaiguk.
Amu inyee, ee Kamuktaindet ne ki igas kaarortaosyekyuk, ki igoono poroteetap icheeget che konyiti kaineng'ung'.
Itesyini laitoryat peetuusyek; tarei kenyiisyekyik ibinwek che chaang'.
Tebee taitap Kamuktaindet koigeny, chop si koriip ineendet chamyet ne tala ak imanit.
Si atyenji kaineng'ung' kalasunet koigeny, si kobiit agoito peetuut age tugul che ki aaroorte.
Igeni Kamuktaindet kityo saboondanyu, punu yetunennyu ineendet.
Ineendet ineegei rwandennyu ak yetunennyu, ineendet ko irimennyu ne kooi; ma ki istoa miising'.
Opookyini chii kot kotyanit, ole si kobiit obar ineendet, okweek tugul, ko uu inaatut ne kogoimom, ak ko uu ng'ootweet ne neegit koluul?
Irwoochi kityo komachei kotoorta ineendet amu telunatennyi; poiboi eng' lembechek. Iberuuri eng' kutusweekwak, ago sasisyei eng' mugulelwekwak.
Ee saboondanyu, igen Kamuktaindet kityo; amu punu kamang'unennyu ineendet.
Ineendet ineegei rwandennyu ak yetunennyu, irimennyu ne kooi ineendet; ma ki istoa.
Tinyei Kamuktaindet yetunennyu ak toroornatennyu; rwandetap kimnateennyu ak ole amwechini ko Kamuktaindet.
Ee okweek pichu, omang'u ineendet kotugul; oroong'ji mugulelwekwok ineendet, Kamuktaindet ole kemwechini.
Iman puch piik che nyerootiin, ak kiplembechonik piik che taagunotiin. Ma ing'eeti kiit ne kigeeree nyigiisindo, wisisen icheek tugul kosiir kabuuset.
Amomang'u sastaet, amomene rebisyet; ngo tesak mogornatosyek ko mat otiegei.
Kitwek Kamuktaindet konyil agenge, ki agas nooto konyil aeng': ale po kimnateet Kamuktaindet;
Ee Kiptaiyat, neng'ung' rireenet agine; amu inyee ne iyaakyini chii tugul ko uu poisyennyi.
Ee Kamuktaindet, inyee ko ii Kamuktaindennyu; acheeng'in eng' kagiiletapkei; Amei melelda saboondanyu amu machin, machin kot poortanyu, eng' emet ne yaamaat ne po ng'etatet, ole ma mi peek.
Ara uu nooto koageerin eng' ole-tiliil, si ageer kimnateng'ung' ak toroornateng'ung'.
Amu myee chamyeng'ung' ne tala kosiir saboondo; ilasun anyun kutinnyu.
Ara anyun alasun kota asabe; anamjini parak eunekyuk amu kaineng'ung'.
Piyonyi saboondanyu eng' igoorto ak akwaiyet; ak ilasun kutinnyu eng' poiboiyet,
ye abwaatin ami itogunnyu, ak abwaatin eng' saisyegap kemoi;
amu ki iegu toretindennyu, abaibai anyun eng' urwetap kebebaiguk.
Isubotin saboondanyu miising'; nama eung'ung' ne po tai.
Ago pendi ng'wony oriit, che cheeng'ei kong'em saboondanyu.
Kigoitoi kobek eng' kimnateetap rotwetap chok, ak kobunji lelwek.
Ago paibai laitoryat eng' Kamuktaindet; igasegei age tugul ne iyastos eng' ineendet; amu kigerei kutusweegap kiplembechonik.
Ee Kamuktaindet, kas kutinnyu, eng' riirekyuk; riip saboondanyu si ma ywei kamuisetap puunyoot.
Unya eng' kirwoogutigap ung'oot che po che yaei tengekto; si ma nyoorwo wasetapkei ne po kiptengeginik.
Che kagolit ng'elyebwekwak ko uu rotoogap chok, ak komwokto kipchabonikwak, chooto ng'aleek che ng'woneen.
Si komwok eng' ung'oot ne ititaat, ak kosip komwok ineendet, amaiywei.
Kicheergei eng' mageet ne ya; kichaamjigei kouny mestonok, ki le, “Ng'oo ne imuuchi kogeer icheek?”
Cheeng'oti tengekwogik; mwaei icheek kole, “Kogeyai eng' kagiiletapkei kosulda cheeng'sennyo.” Po ung'oot miising', kabwaatetap chiito age tugul, kobooto muguleldanyi!
Ago mwogei Kamuktaindet icheek; ak koguoten eng' yooto.
Amu ng'aleegap ng'elyebwekwak komaasi icheek; ak tugul che keerei icheek kolelechi metowek.
Yeityo koiyweis piik tugul; ak komwaita poisyetap Kamuktaindet, ak korwoochi eng' ng'omnateet agobo poisyennyi.
Ingobaibait ne po imanda eng' Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ak konyoor ole mwechin eng' ineendet. Ingogaskei tugul che po iman eng' mugulelwek!
Ee Kamuktaindet, igenin kalasunet eng' Zion, ak keyaei che ki kiarorun.
Ee inyee ne kasei saaet, pwonjinin piik tugul.
Katemena tengekwogik, inyee ne iundoi pistaosyekyok.
Paibai miising' chiito ne ileweni, ak imuti koriikyin, Si kobiit komeny seremusyeguk: Ak kebiye myeeindap koong'ung', Ole tiliil eng' hekalung'ung'.
Ak iwolwech eng' imanda eng' tuguuk che imuisei, Ee Kamuktaindetap yetunennyo; Inyee ko ii kamang'unetap komoswek tugul che po ng'wony, Ak ne po icheek che mi nyanjet ne loo:
Ne iuuiiti tuloonook eng' kimnateennyi; Ak korategei eng' kamuktaet:
Ne igoochin tuleetap nyanjosyek kosiis, tuleetap peek che mildogei, Ak polatetap piik.
Ak koiyweisyei che menyei ole loo miising' amu kaboorunoiguk: Igoochini koboiboitu ole charunee asiis ak ole roroktoe.
Irutochini ng'wony, ak inagi peek, Ak iakwai miising'; Nyiitaat peek aineetap Kamuktaindet: Ichopchini piik peek, ko kaichop ng'wony.
Inyiiti peek ole kigereer eng' ng'wony, komarane; Iripribi komoswekyik che sutotin: Itangusi eng' ropta ne inesi; Iberuuri tuguukyik che piitos.
Inyiiti kenyiit myeeindong'ung'; Ak sau akwaiyet eng' ortinweguk.
Sachin chooto kewosyegap surkwen: Ak kirate tuloonook poiboiyet.
Nyiitootiin kewosyek keechiirek; Ak nyiitootiin peek atebwosyek; Igasegei amu poiboi ak kotyendos.
Otyenji Kamuktaindet eng' poiboiyet, ng'wony komugul:
Otyen toroornatetap kainennyi; Otoroor kalasunennyi.
Oleenji Kamuktaindet, Po kamuiset ne tya poisyoniguk! Iming'injiningei puuniguk amu etunatetap kimnateng'ung'.
Tuun ilasun ng'wony komugul, Ak kotyenun; Tyenjin kaineng'ung'.
Obwa, ogeer poisyonigap Kamuktaindet; Po kamuiset poisyonik che yachin ineendet weeriigap piik.
Ki wol nyanjet koek emet ne yaamaat: Kilandae aineet kobunei keelyek. Ki kiboiboitu eng' ineendet eng' olooto.
Laitorani koigeny eng' kamuktaennyi; Keerei konyekyik pororyosyek: Amat koeetkei ngelelik.
Olasu Kamuktaindennyo, okweek piik, Ak ongogasak kutitap kalasunennyi:
Ne riibei saboonwekyok kosapcho, Ak ne ma chamdoi keisto keelyekyok.
Ee Kamuktaindet, kiityemech inyee: Ki ityemech, ko uu ye kityeme maat fedha.
Ki imutyech mesteet ne uu regereiywot; Ki iratyi suenutikyok nyalilda ne oo.
Ki igoochi piik kotyech metowekyok; Ki kibun maat ak peek; Ago ki imutwech kebwa ole tunenot.
Anyoone koong'ung' aibu kagoochinoik che kibeelei, Ayaagun tuguuk che ki aaroorun,
Chooto che ki mwa ng'elyeptanyu, ak che ki komwa kutinnyu, ye ki ami nyalilda.
Ago kagoochinoik che kibeelei che akwaen, Kobooto nyamdutigap mengichik; Agoitoi kiruugik kobooto kwesik.
Obwa, ogas, okweek tugul che oiywei Kamuktaindet, Si amwaita tuguuk che ki yachi saboondanyu.
Ki ariirchi eng' kutinnyu, Ak ki alasu ineendet eng' ng'elyeptanyu.
Ye abwaat tengekto eng' muguleldanyu, koma kaswa Kiptaiyat.
Ago iman kogogas Kamuktaindet; ki koepchi iit tweguunetap saaennyu.
Iberuurot Kamuktaindet, ne ki ma timda saaennyu, ak ki ma istoena rireenennyi.
Ingorirenech Kamuktaindet, ak koberuurech, ak kotokyech togeennyi kokwenyech;
si konaak oreng'ung' eng' ng'wony, ak yetuneng'ung' eng' pororyosyek tugul.
Ingolasun piik, ee Kamuktaindet; Ingolasun piik tugul.
Ingoboiboitu pororyosyek ak kotyenso eng' poiboiyet: Amu irwookyini piik eng' imanda, Ak indochi pororyosyek eng' ng'wony.
Ingolasun piik, ee Kamuktaindet; Ingolasun piik tugul.
Kigogon ng'wony iyotennyi: Iberuurech Kamuktaindet, ineendet Kamuktaindennyo.
Iberuurech Kamuktaindet; Ak kogonyit ineendet komoswek tugul che po ng'wony.
Ingong'eet Kamuktaindet, ingoiyesta puunikyik; Ak ingomwei eng' tainnyi che wechei ineendet.
Iyeste icheek ko uu ye kiyestoi iyeto: Ko uu ye chootei temeniet eng' ye neegitee maat, Ko uu nooto ingolusyo kiptengeginik eng' taitap Kamuktaindet.
Ago ingoboiboitu che po imanda; ingogaskei eng' taitap Kamuktaindet: Ee, ingoboiboitu eng' kagasetapkei.
Otyenji Kamuktaindet, olasu kainennyi; ochopchi ooreet ne oo ineendet ne punei ong'atosyek, ko uu ne laanyei paraisiit. Kainennyi ko Kamuktaindet ne Toroor; ak ogaaskei eng' tainnyi.
Kwandap che ma tinyei sigiik, ak ne tononjin mosoogik, Ko Kamuktaindet eng' koonnyi ne tiliil.
Igoochin Kamuktaindet che mi icheegei komeng'jin ak alak: Imutyin kimonjororinik poroteet: Ago menyei pistoik emet ne yaamaat.
Ee Kamuktaindet, ye kinga imande indoe piiguk, Ye kiityegoti surkwen,
Kobotan ng'wony, Ak kororok kipsengwet eng' taitap Kamuktaindet: Kobotan Sinai nooto eng' taitap Kamuktaindet, Kamuktaindetap Israel.
Ee Kamuktaindet, ki iyoogu ropta ne oo, ak ki igimit poroteng'ung' ye ki tinyei ng'etatet.
Ki meny olooto tuiyeng'ung'; ee Kamuktaindet, ki ichopchi che po myeeindong'ung' kibananook.
Igoitoi Kiptaiyat ng'olyoot: Oo lugeetap kobogorisyek che mwaitoi ng'aleek.
Mweei laitorinigap lugoosyek, mweei: Ak kopchei kwondo ne ng'etu eng' kaa parunenik,
Agot ngirue piusyegap keechiirek, ko uu kebebaigap cheptuget ne ki kituge fedha, Ak koroorikyik che ki kiile thahabu che talelyonen.
Ye ki iyeesta Ne po Kamuktaet laitorinik eng' olooto, Ko ki uu ye ibuti teluji eng' Salmon.
Tulweetap Kamuktaindet ko tulweetap Bashan; Tinyei tulweetap Bashan walisyek che kooen.
Amu nee si koamak ng'etkong', okweek tuloonook che kooen, Agobo tulweet ne ki komach Kamuktaindet komeny? Ee, menyei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor olooto koigeny.
Karisyegap Kamuktaindet ko eliphuusyek tiptem, agot eliphuusyek ak eliphuusyek: Mi Kiptaiyat kwenunnywa, eng' Sinai, eng' Ole-Tiliil.
Ki itogoste parak, ki imut luulenik che ki iluul; Ki itaach piik koek kagoochinoik, Ee, agot ngelelik ak icheek, si kobiit komeng'iis Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Iberuurot Kiptaiyat, ne ibei peetuut age tugul milennyo, Kamuktaindet ineendet ko yetunennyo.
Kamuktaindet eng' acheek ko Kamuktaindet ne po saruunet; po Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ortinwek che kechilile eng' meet.
Ago tuei Kamuktaindet metowegap puunikyik, Metitap chiito ne wendote tengektanyi.
Ki le Kiptaiyat, Amutu kogeny eng' Bashan, Amutu kogeny komang'une rirosyegap nyanjet:
Si kobiit irooch keeldong'ung' korotiik, Si konyoor ng'elyeptap seseniguk kebebertanyi eng' puunik.
Ki kogeer icheek panweguk, ee Kamuktaindet, Panwegap Kamuktaindennyu, Laitoryandennyu, agoi ole-tiliil.
Ki indo tyeniik, ak ki isubu che kibutei kibugandinik, kimi kween kootap Kor che kibirei sugutisyek che mengeechen.
Olasu Kamuktaindet eng' tuiyosyek, Olasu Kiptaiyat, che ko po kondametutap Israel.
Miitei Benjamin ne ming'in, pounindennywa, Miitei pounigap Judah ak tuiyennywa, Pounigap Zebulun, pounigap Naphtali.
Ki kong'at Kamuktaindeng'ung' kimnateng'ung': Igimiit, ee Kamuktaindet, nooto ne ki iyai agobo acheek.
Ibun laitorinik kagoochinoik Amu hekalung'ung' eng' Jerusalem.
Kergong' tyondap timiin ne mi mutweek, Chaang'indap kiruugik, ak moegap piik, Koming'inonugei age tugul koibu fedha; Kigoiyesta `ineendet piik che chamei pooryeet.
Tuun mang'une pounik Misiri; Iyogoochin Kush eunekyik Kamuktaindet kochokyin.
Otyenji Kamuktaindet, okweek laitornatosyegap ng'wony; Otyenji Kiptaiyat kalasunoik;
Ineendet ne laanyei kipsengwetisyegap kipsengwet, chooto po keny; Ogeero, twegu eng' kutinnyi, kutit ne kiim.
Ingobunji kimnateet Kamuktaindet: Mi telunatennyi Israel, Ak mi kimnateennyi paragusyek.
Ee Kamuktaindet, kiywein eng' oldinweguk che tiliileen: Kamuktaindetap Israel, ne igoochin piikyik kimnateet ak kamuktaet. Iberuurot Kamuktaindet.
Sarwo, ee Kamuktaindet; amu kagoityon peek che mache komaluucha kaatit.
Karorokyi ng'atatyat ne oo, ama mi ole ketonone; kaitu ye mi rireetap peek, ole katucha maranosyek.
Koang'et eng' riirekyuk; kagoyaam moktanyu: Kago imenitu konyekyuk ye ta ageni Kamuktaindennyu.
Chaang' kosiir suumeekyuk che wecho puch; Kiimeen puunikyuk che mwaei lembech che machei kobara: Ak ki agoite chooto che ki ma arebee chii.
Ee Kamuktaindet, ingen inyee perberindanyu; Ak ma ung'ootiin tengekwogikyuk eng' inyee.
Ee Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne po lugoosyek, amat kolilaanso che igenin amu anee: Ee Kamuktaindet ne po Israel, amat koteweerogis agobo anee icheeget che cheeng'in.
Amu ki aegu ne kirosyin agobo inyee: Ki kotuch togeennyu kalilanet.
Ki aegu too eng' che kitupche, ak ki aegu kipsagarin eng' lagogap chebyoset ne kisicha.
Amu ki ama ng'etkondap koong'ung'; Ak ki kobwonjo rosyinetap icheeget che rosyinin.
Ak ye ki ariire, aming'init saboondanyu eng' karugutetapkei, ko kirosya icheek agobo nooto.
Ye ki alaagoti kuniet, aegu kalewenet eng' icheek.
Ng'alaali agobo anee che tebyei eng' ormariich; Ak ki aegu tyendap kibogitinik.
Ago anee, asaain, ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, eng' peetuut ne chamaksei: Ee Kamuktaindet, eng' chaang'indap rireeneng'ung', Wolwo eng' imandap yetuneng'ung'.
Sarwo eng' ng'atatyat, si ma lugua: meto achilil eng' icheeget che wecho, ak eng' rireetap peek.
Amengosuta mogoochek, ak amengolugua rireet; amengoger kutinnyi keriinget kota ami oriit.
Wolwo Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, amu myee chamyeng'ung' ne tala: Iweekyage ko uu chaang'indap rireenosyeguk.
Ak ameung'e togeng'ung' kiboityondeng'ung'; Chokyi wolwo, amu ami tiritindo.
Rikyi saboondanyu, ak ityaach: Sarwo amu puunikyuk.
Ingen rosyinet ne kirosyina, ak kalilanennyu, ak teweernatennyu: Miitei taing'ung' puunikyuk tugul.
Kogoiri muguleldanyu rosyinet; ak aa rumot: Ak ki agen che tinyei rireenet, ago ki ma piit; Ak che imuuchi kogaigai chii, ago ma anyooru.
Ki koono tuguuk che ng'woneen koek amitwogik; Ak ye ki ama melel konaga siki aee.
Ingoek mesteet meesennywa ne mi tainnywa; Ak ingoek mesteet ye mi icheek eng' kaalyeet.
Ingoimenitu konyekwak, si ma keer kiy; Ak igoochi kobotanso suenutikwak kotugul.
Rong'ji icheek nyitateng'ung', Ak ingonam icheek koroomindap nereegeguk,
Ingoguber ole menyei; Amat komeny chii emaisyekwak.
Amu usei icheek ineendet ne ki ibir; Ak komwaoti agobo arageneetap icheek che ki iguoten.
Tesyi tengekto age tengektonywa: Ak amat kobwonji icheek imandang'ung'.
Ingibukto icheek eng' bukuitap saboon, Amat kesir kobooto che po imanda.
Ago aa kibananiat ak atinye arageneet: Ingotoroora yetuneng'ung', ee Kamuktaindet.
Alasu kainetap Kamuktaindet eng' tyendo, Ak amwae kongoi atoroori ineendet.
Ak kobaibai nooto Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kosiir eito, Anan kirgit ne tinyei kuinoik ak siyok.
Kagogeer che talaen, ak kogaskei: Ingosapcho mugulelwekwok, okweek che ocheeng'e Kamuktaindet.
Amu kasei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor che ponondos, Ak masasei kimonjororinikyik.
Ingolas ineendet kipsengwet ak ng'wony, Nyanjosyek, ak tuguuk tugul che pendote olooto.
Amu saru Kamuktaindet Zion, ak koteech nganasoogap Judah; Ak komeny icheek olooto, kobunji.
Nyabani ak icheek kesweegap otwogikyik olooto, ak komeny olooto icheek che chamei kainennyi.
Ee Kamuktaindet, sarwo; chokyi toreto, ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ingolilanso ak koteweerogis che cheeng'ei saboondanyu. Ingoweektagei let ak koteweerogis che poiboi amu ng'wanindanyu.
Ingeweekta koba let amu teweernatennywa. Che leen, Haa, Haa.
Ingoboiboitu icheek tugul che cheeng'in, ak kogaskei eng' inyee. Ak ingomwa kotugul icheek che chamei yetuneng'ung', Kole, Ingitoroor Kamuktaindet.
Ago anee ko aa panan ak ma tinye kiy; Chogu ole ami, ee Kamuktaindet: Ii toretindennyu ak ko ii saruunindennyu; Ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, amegagei.
Amang'un, ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, amegoono alilan agoi.
Sarwo eng' imandang'ung', ak ieta; epcha iit ak isarwo.
Egu eng' anee rwandet ne amenye, ole awendi kotugul: Ki igoonu ng'atuutyet kosarwo; Amu ii rwandennyu, ak ko ii irimennyu.
Koono achilil, ee Kamuktaindennyu, eng' eutap kiptengekyot, eng' eutap chiito ne ma po imanda, ak ne kolgol.
Amu inyee ne ageniin, ee Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Ii kamang'unennyu kobooch ko aa ming'in.
Ki atienengei kong'etee ko kagisicho; Inyee ne ki imoong'wa eng' moetap iyoonyu ne kisicho. Neng'ung' kalasunennyu kotugul.
Auu kwang'utyet eng' che chaang'; ago inyee ko ii ole amwechini ne kiim.
Nyiei kutinnyu kalasuneng'ung', kobooto teegistang'ung' peetuut komugul.
Amewiirta ye tuun kaaositu; amebagaaktaa ye kagobet kimnateennyu.
Amu ng'alaalena puunikyuk; ak irwoochi icheek che sapchin saboondanyu,
leen icheek, “Ki kobagaakta `Kamuktaindet ineendet; oon ak onam ineendet; amu ma mi ne saru.”
Ee Kamuktaindet, amelooena: Ee, Kamuktaindennyu, chogu toreto.
Ingolilanso ak kobetyo che puunigap saboondanyu; Ingotuch icheek rosyinet ak teweernateet che cheeng'ei koyaiywo ne ya.
Ago amang'u kotugul, Ak atese alasun kosiir.
Mwaitoi kutinnyu imandang'ung', Ak yetuneng'ung' peetuut komugul; Amu mangen ole tee chooto.
Anyoone kobooto poisyonik che kiimeen che po Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor: Amwae imandang'ung', ne neng'ung' inyegei.
Ee Kamuktaindet, ki ineeta kobooch ko aa ming'in; ak ki amwaite agoi nguno poisyoniguk che po kwong'eet.
Ee, ye tuun kaaositu, asich kalwalek, ko mebagaakta, ee Kamuktaindet; agoi amwachi kimnateng'ung' ibinda ne nyoonei, amwachi kamuktaeng'ung' age tugul ne piitu.
Toroor agine imandang'ung' miising', ee Kamuktaindet; Inyee ne ki iyai tuguuk che eecheen, Ee Kamuktaindet, ng'oo ne ogerge?
Inyee ne ki iboorwech nyalilwogik che chaang' che koroomen, ta isoobech kogeny, Ak tuun imoong'wech kemang'une oriit miising' ne po ng'wony.
Tes etunatennyu, Ak iweeige kogeny igaigaa.
Alasun agane eng' kibugandet, agobo imandang'ung', ee Kamuktaindennyu; atyenun kalasunoik eng' ketubet, ee Inyee ne Tiliil ne po Israel.
Paibaitu kutinnyu miising' ye atyenun kalasunoik; Ak paibaitu saboondanyu, ne ki ityaach inyee.
Ng'alaali ng'elyeptanyu agobo imandang'ung' peetuut komugul: Amu ililandos, ak koteweeroksei, icheek che cheeng'jino yaityet.
Ee Kamuktaindet, igoochi laitoryat kirwoogutiguk, Ak igoochi imandang'ung' weeriitap laitoryat.
Irwookyin piiguk eng' imanda, Ak kobesyechi kibananoguk.
Ipchin tuloonook piiguk kaalyeet, Ak ipchin tuloonook che mengeechen piiguk imanda.
Irwooksechin kibananogap piik, Ak kosaru lagogap che nyalildos, Ak kotonaton usiindet.
Iywein icheek kota komi asiista, Ak kotee komi arawet, eng' ibinwek tugul.
Chorugei ineendet ko uu ropta ne choorchingei malelyet: Ko uu ropta ne inesyin ng'wony.
Eng' peetuusyekyik konyooru ne po imanda perurto; Ak chaang'indap kaalyeet agoi koma komi arawet.
Laitorani ineendet kobooch nyanjet agoi nyanjet age, Ak kobooch aineet agoi ole poochin ng'wony.
Ing'uruukyin ineendet icheek che menyei surkwen; Ak komel temburyek puunikyik.
Ibu kagoochinoik laitorinigap Tarsus ak che po ngeguusyek; Igoitoi kagoochinoik laitorinigap Sheba ak Seba.
Ee, ibutyin keelyekyik laitorinik tugul: Otei ineendet pororyosyek tugul.
Amu saru ne nyalili ye kariir; Ak kibananiat, ne ma tinyei toretin.
Riire kibananiat ak ne nyalili, Ak kosaru saboonwegap che nyalildos.
Ityachi saboonwekwak eng' usiisyet ak koroomnateet; Ak punjin kamanuut korotiikwak eng' tainnyi:
Ak saptos icheek; ak kigoochi ineendet thahabu ne po Sheba: Ak saaei piik kotugul agobo ineendet; Iberuuri ineendet peetuut komugul.
Ak tuun piitu chaang'indap peek eng' ng'wony eng' tuloonook parak; Ak itumdumegei logoekyik ko uu Lebanon: Ak tunendos icheek che po nganaseet ko uu susweek che po ng'wony.
Tebyei kainennyi koigeny; Tebyei kainennyi kota komi asiista: Ak kiberuuri piik eng' ineendet; Ak kuure pororyosyek tugul ne paibai.
Iberuurot Kamuktaindet ne po Toroornatet, Kamuktaindetap Israel, Ne ineegei ne yaei tuguuk che po kwong'eet:
Ak iberuurot kainennyi ne tinyei toroornatet agoi koigeny; Ak ingonyi ng'wony komugul toroornatennyi. Amen, ak Amen.
Kagogeskei saautigap Daudi weeriitap Jesse.
Iman, myee Kamuktaindet eng' Israel, eng' icheeget che tiliileen mugulelwek.
Ago eng' anee ko ki neegit komasta keelyekyuk; ki neegit kochabaita kakwautikyuk.
Amu ki ama ng'etkong' agobo che mendos, ye kinga keer kaalyeetap kiptengeginik.
Amu ma nyooru ng'wanindo; chamegei poorwekwak, ak ko kiimeen.
Ma tinyei icheeget nyalilwogik ko uu piik alak; Ama nyooru pireet ko uu piik alak.
Eng' nooto anyun uu menoteet sirimdo ne mi kaatwekwak; katuch icheek koroomnateet ko uu ngoryeet.
Ibwanotin konyekwak eng' nerateet: tinyei tuguuk che siirei che machei mugulelwekwak.
Chotisyei, ak mwaei sastaet eng' tengekto: ng'alaaldos eng' katorooretapkei.
Kigotoroor kutusweekwak agobo kipsengwet, ak kobendote ng'elyebwekwak ng'wony.
Eng' nooto anyun, weeksei piikyik oli: ak lugui icheek peek che nyiitootiin.
Ak koleen icheek, “Nae nee Kamuktaindet? Tos miitei naet eng' Ineendet Ne Toroor Miising'?”
Ogeero, kiptengeginik chuuto; miitei icheeget kotugul eng' kaalyeet; tesoksei eng' mogornatosyek.
Iman ki atiliil muguleldanyu puch, Ak ki aune eunekyuk libwobindo puch;
Amu kaanyooru pireet eng' peetuut komugul, Ak kitigoono karonet age tugul.
Nda ki kamwa ale ang'alaali ko uu ni, Keero, ta kiga aberber ibindap lagoguk.
Ye kinga cheeng' ole amuuchi anaita niito, Kotemena;
Agoi among'ji kap Kamuktaindet ole-tiliil, Anai anyun ole poochin kagesunennywa.
Iman igoochini kotebee icheek komoswek che chaboen: Ak iwiirchini icheek ng'wony koba ng'emisyet.
Katepto ano kot kosip kong'emogis icheek eng' chokyinet; kagowong'kei eng' kamuisosyek.
Uu karwotitoet ye kagos chiito; Ko uu nooto, ee Kiptaiyat, ye ing'eet inyee, isase itoondanywa.
King'wanit muguleldanyu, Ak ki kitoor saboondanyu:
Ki aa abusat, amangen kiy; ki auu tyondo eng' taing'ung'.
Agot nga uu nooto ami kobooten kotugul: Ki inam eunnyu ne po tai.
Inyee ne indoiywa eng' ruchineng'ung', Ak eng' let itaacha anyo ye mi liilindo.
Ng'oo ne atinye eng' kipsengwet ne ma inyee? Ama mi age ne amache eng' ng'wony kosiirin.
Ichuchui poortanyu ak muguleldanyu: Ago Kamuktaindet kimnateetap muguleldanyu ak kebebertanyu koigeny.
Amu keero, petos icheeget che looen eng' inyee: Amu ki ing'em icheek tugul che ki isup ibeetapkei koistoenengei.
Ago myee eng' anee ariikyi Kamuktaindet: Ki acham koek Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ole amwechini, Si kobiit amwaita poisyoniguk tugul.
Ee Kamuktaindet, amu nee si iwiirtech agoi? Amu nee si koiyenji nereegeguk keechiiregap akweeng'ung'?
Ibwaat tuiyeng'ung' ne ki ial keny, Ne ki ityaach koek pororyetap poroteng'ung'; Tulweetap Zion ole ki imeny.
Iyogoochi keeldong'ung' ole Ki kong'emak koigeny, Yaityet tugul ne ki koyai puunyoot eng' ole-tiliil.
Kogoborisenso puuniguk eng' kwenutap tuiyeng'ung'; Ki konde songolikwak koek kaboorunoik.
Ki uu icheek piik Che namjin parak aonok, komachei koep keetiigap sondiit.
Ago putei icheek nguno aonok ak kirisonok poisyennyi tugul ne kagiwai.
Kigobeel oldang'ung' ne tiliil; Ki koyai ole menyei kaineng'ung' kong'wanit agoi ng'wony.
Ki le eng' mugulelwekwak, Ongeng'em kowong'kei tugul: Kigobeel kapkorosusyek tugul che po Kamuktaindet eng' emet.
Ma kigeere kaboorunoikyok; Ma komi maotyondo; Ama mi kwenunnyo age tugul ne ingen kole tyanitu.
Ee Kamuktaindet, rosu puunyoot kot kotyanit? Tos chubei puunyoot kaineng'ung' agoi koigeny?
Kalya si iweekte eung'ung', eung'ung' ne po tai? Inemu eng' tegeng'ung', ak iwong'u icheek.
Ago Kamuktaindet ko Laitoryandennyu kobooch keny, Ne yaei yetunet eng' kwenutap ng'wony.
Ki ipchei inyee nyanjet eng' kimnateng'ung': Ki iri metowegap cheluguinik eng' peek.
Ki iri kotonogis metowegap tyong'ik che eecheen che po peek, che uu ting'ong'ok, Ki igoite koek amditap piik che menyei surkwen.
Ki igereer kong'igap peek ak ainoosyek: Ki iteenyi ainoosyek che kirootei agoi.
Neng'ung' peetuut, ak neng'ung' kemout agine: Ki ichop tuguuk che iluu, ak asiista.
Ki ipchei kiwotosyek tugul che po ng'wony: Ki iyai kemeut ak iwot.
Ibwaat niito, ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ile, ki kogerin kong' puunyoot, ak ki chup piik che abusotiin kaineng'ung'.
Ee, amegoochi saboondap cheptugeng'ung' tyondap timiin: Ameutyee koigeny saboonwegap piiguk che nyalildos.
Ibwaat kayomiset: Amu nyiitaat komoswek che imenen che po ng'wony, ole menyei che koroomen.
Amengoweek kolilaananu ne tinyei usiisyet; Ingolas kaineng'ung' che nyalildos ak che ma tinyei kiy.
Ng'eet, ee Kamuktaindet, ibesyechigei ng'aleeguk: Ibwaat ole kertoin kong' eng' peetuut komugul, chiito ne abusat.
Ameutyee ng'aleegap puuniguk: Togostoi kotugul polatetap icheeget che ng'eetyinin.
Kiweegun kongoi, ee Kamuktaindet; kiweegun kongoi, amu neegit kaineng'ung': mwaitoi piik kwang'utiguk.
Ye kanyooru poroindo ne choboot, arwooch eng' imanda.
Kigochoot ng'wony kobooto chechiik tugul che menyei olooto, ki alum tolochikyik.
Ki aleenji che mendos, Amomenie: Ak ki aleenji che yaacheen, Amotoroor kuineng'wong':
Amotoroor miising' kuineng'wong'; Among'alaal eng' menoteet.
Amu ma punu katorooret kong'asiis, anan cherongo, Ama punu murot tai.
Ago kirwoogindet Kamuktaindet: Iming'ini age, ak koeeti age.

Amu miitei kigombet eutap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ak kuutu divaik; Ak ki kiburuch che chaang' che teerchiin, ak korong'u ineendet chooto: Iman, irurunyi misigiikwak kiptengeginik tugul che po ng'wony ak koeei.
Ago amwaitoi anee koigeny, Atyenjini kalasunoik Kamuktaindetap Jakobo.
Atile kuinoigap kiptengeginik; Ago eegitu kuinoigap che po imanda.
Naat Kamuktaindet eng' Judah: Oo kainennyi eng' Israel.
Miitei koonnyi Salem, Ak miitei Zion ole menyei.
Ki iri eng' olooto kipchabonik che po kwanget; Long'eet ak rotwetap chok, ak lugeet.
Iluu ak itinye telunateet kosiir tuloonoogap che luulsei.
Kogeluul che nyigoonen, kogoruiyo konuukso; Ak ma mi eng' piik che kiimeen ne kinyoor eunekwak.
Ee Kamuktaindetap Jakobo, inuuktos kariisyek ak paraisisyek Amu kereng'ung' po kong'.
Kanyool kiywein inyeendet, inyee; Ak ng'oo ne imuuchi kotonon eng' taing'ung' ko kenereech?
Ki imwau kirwooget kogasak kobun kipsengwet; Ki iyweis emet, ak ki siis,
Ye kingo ng'eet Kamuktaindet korwooch, kosar tugul che talaen che po ng'wony.
Iman ilasun nereegegap piik: Irategei nereegek che kang'et.
Oarorchi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindeng'wong', ak oyaakyi: Ingoipchi kagoochinoik, icheeget che mi ole neegitee ineendet, ineendet ne nyoljin kiywei.
Tilei ineendet saboonwegap pounik: Imui ineendet laitorinigap ng'wony.
Ariirchini Kamuktaindet; Ee, ariirchini Kamuktaindet eng' kutinnyu, si koepcha iit.
Ki acheeng' Kiptaiyat eng' peetuutap nyalildanyu: Ki aiite eunnyu kemoi, ama amuuny; Ki eesyo saboondanyu kigaigai.
Abwaati Kamuktaindet, ak atigeni: Abwaatoti, ak kotanui saboondanyu.
Iname konyekyuk kogos: Aiimigei kot koma muuchi ang'alaal.
Koabwaat peetuusyek che po keny. Kenyiisyek che ki kobunji keny miising'.
Abwaati tyendanyu kemoi: Ang'alaali ak muguleldanyu; Ak kogosyach saboondanyu eng' kagiiletapkei.
Tos toortaisyei Kiptaiyat agoi? Tos mata kobaibait kogeny?
Tos ki kogeskei rireenennyi koigeny? Tos ma kosuldoi arorutyennyi koigeny?
Tos kigoutye Kamuktaindet rireenennyi? Anan ki kogeer nereegekyik rireenennyi ne tala?
Ak ki ale, kaimennyu niito; abwaati ale ki kowalak euut ne po tai ne po Ineendet Ne Toroor Miising'.
Abwaati poisyonigap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor; Ak abwaati kwang'utiguk che po keny.
Abwaatoti agine tuguuk che ki iyai, Ak ang'alaalote poisyoniguk.
Ee Kamuktaindet, mi oreng'ung' ole-tiliil: Ng'oo kamuktain ne oo ne kergei ak Kiptaiyat?
Inyeendet Kamuktaindet ne iyae kwang'utik: Ki ibarte kimnateng'ung' eng' kwenutap pororyosyek.
Ki ityaach piiguk eng' eung'ung', Weeriigap Jakobo ak Joseph.
Kigeerin peek, ee Kamuktaindet; Kigeerin peek ak ki iyweis: Kibotanso ak icheek rirosyek.
Kirong' poolik peek; Kibiitune cheet parak: Ak ki iyeesta kipchaboniguk.
Ki mi tuugeetap tuleeng'ung' kipchurchuryet; ki ikweny ng'wony `kalyelosyek: ki potan ng'wony ak kotumdumgei.
Ki mi oreng'ung' nyanjet, Ak kimi ortinweguk peek che kiimeen, Ak ki ma naak tyegutiguk.
Ki imut piiguk ko uu akweetap keechiirek, Eng' eutap Musa ak Aron.
Oepchi iit ng'atuutyennyu, ee piikyuk: Otokyi itiikwok ng'aleegap kutinnyu.
Ayaate kutinnyu eng' kalewenet; Amwae ng'aleek che ung'ootiin che po keny:
Che kigegas ak kenai, Ak ki komwaiwech kwanisyekyok.
Ma kiung'e chooto lagokwak, Kimwachini ibinda ne nyoonei kalasunoigap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Ak kimnateennyi, ak kwang'utikyik che ki koyai.
Amu ki igimit paornateet eng' Jakobo, Ak ki inde ng'atuutyet eng' Israel, Ne ki ng'at kwanisyekyok, kole, Konet lagokwak:
Si konai chooto ibinda ne piitu, agot lagok che tuun kisichei; Che tuun ng'eetos ak komwachi lagokwak:
Si konde kamang'unennywa eng' Kamuktaindet, Si ma utye poisyonigap Kamuktaindet, Ago si koriip ng'atuutikyik:
Ak si ma tuun igei kwanisyekwak, Ibinda ne uui met ak ko ngelelyo; Ibinda ne ki ma chop mugulelwekwak, Ak che ki ma litititu saboonwekwak eng' Kamuktaindet.
Kiweektagei let lagogap Ephraim eng' peetuutap lugeet, Kotinyei kariik ak koiboti kwangok.
Ki ma riip kayomisetap Kamuktaindet, Ak ki eesyo kobendatee ng'atuutyennyi:
Ak kiutye tuguukyik che kiga yai, Ak kwang'utikyik che kiga koboorchi icheek.
Ki yai ineendet tuguuk che po kwong'eet eng' taitap kwanisyekwak, Eng' emetap Misiri, eng' tembwetap Zoan.
Kipcheune aeng' nyanjet, ak kogoochi kolandae; Ak ki igoochi peek kototenso konamgei.
Ki indochi eng' pooldet peet, Ak ki indochi kemout komugul eng' lapkeiyetap maat.
Kitui rwandosyek eng' surkwen, Ak ki inaga peek che chaang' ko uu che punu rirosyek.
Ki imang'une rwandet peek che rootei, Ak ki igoochi peek kosururgei ko uu ainoosyek.
Ago kites icheek koyachi ineendet tengekto, kongelelji Ineendet Ne Toroor Miising' eng' emet ne yaamaat.
Ak kityem Kamuktaindet eng' mugulelwekwak Eng' soometap amitwogik eng' kasennywa po myat.
Ee, kichaam Kamuktaindet; Ki le, Tos imuuchi Kamuktaindet kochobwech amitwogik eng' surkwen?
Ogeero, kikwer ineendet rwandet, ak kisururgei peek, Konyi ainoosyek kot kong'irtagei; Tos imuuchi kogoonech magatiinik ak icheek? Anan imuuchi kogoonech panyeek?
Ki kas Kamuktaindet ne Toroor anyun, ak kinereech: Ak ki lal maat agobo Jakobo, Ak kitogosta nereegek agobo Israel;
Amu ki ma iyan pichooto Kamuktaindet, Ama imang' yetunennyi.
Ago ki ng'at poolik eng' parak, Ak ki yaat kurgotigap kipsengwet,
Ak kiroong'ji mana si koam, Ak ki igoochi peegap kipsengwet.
Ki am piik amitwogigap che kiimeen: Ki iyookyi amitwogik kobiyong'so.
Ki igoochi usoonetap kong'asiis kous eng' kipsengwet: Ak ki indochi usoonet ne po murot tai eng' kimnateennyi.
Kiroong'ji icheek panyeek che tee temburyek, Ak toriitik che po kebebaik che tee ng'aniegap nyanjosyek:
Ak ki igoochi kobutyi kwenutap nganasennywa, Komoswek tugul che po meng'otosyekwak.
Ki amis anyun, ak kibiyong'so kot; Ak ki igoochi che kigasei myat.
Ago ki ma igeskei magennywa, Ak ye kita komi panyeek kutusweekwak,
Konyonji eng' yooto nereegegap Kamuktaindet, Ak kobar che neryootiin alak eng' icheek, Ak kokwer neranigap Israel kobar.
Agot nganda kinyoor chooto tugul ko kita koyai tengekto, Ak ki ma iyan poisyonikyik che po kwong'eet.
Ki iwong' anyun peetuusyekwak kobetyo puch, Ak kenyiisyekwak eng' kamuiset.
Ye kingo par icheek, kocheeng' anyun icheek ineendet: Ak ki week kocheeng' Kamuktaindet eng' kagiiletapkei.
Ki ibwaat icheek kole Kamuktaindet ko rwandennywa, ak kole katyagindennywa Kamuktaindet Ne Toroor Miising'.
Ago ki iberber ineendet eng' kutusweekwak, Ak komwachi lembechek eng' ng'elyebwekwak.
Amu ki ma ko lititen mugulelwekwak eng' ineendet, Ak ki ma ek che kiyani agobo kayomisennyi.
Ago kinyochi kaat tengektonywa amu ki nyiitaat ineendet rireenetapkei, ak ki ma par icheek: Ee, kiweekta nereegekyik konyil che chaang', Ama ing'eet nereegekyik tugul.
Ak ki ibwaat kole icheeget ko poorto kityo: Usoonet ne siirtoi, ama weeksei kogeny.
Ak kingelelji ineendet konyil ata eng' surkwen, Ak ki igoochi arageneet eng' surkwen!
Ak ki week kogeny kotyem Kamuktaindet, Ak kitach Ineendet ne Tiliil ne po Israel.
Ma ibwaat eunnyi, Anan peetuut ne ki ityaach icheek eng' puunyoot.
Ko uu ye ki yai kaboorunoikyik eng' Misiri, Ak kwang'utikyik eng' tembwetap Zoan;
Ak ki wal peegap ainoosyekwak koek korotiik, Agot kereruusyek ak icheek, kot koma ko eeoksei.
Ki iyookto kalyang'ik koba kwenunnywa, che kisus icheek; Ak mororochik che king'em icheek.
Ak ki igoochi koam tinapchet ruratennywa, Ak ki igoochi chereng'endet koam poisyonikwak.
King'eme koigap ropta sabibukwak, Ak king'eme chepkoset mogoonikwak.
Ak kibiree koiyat tuukwak, Ak ki am ilet akweennywa po keechiir.
Ki wiirchi icheek koroomnatetap nereegekyik, Nereegek, ng'wanindo ak nyalilda, Ak ki iyookyi kweanetap malaikaisyek che ibei yaityet.
Ki yachi nereegekyik ooreet; Ak ki ma riiree saboonwekwak eng' meet, Ago ki igoochi saboonwekwak koroito:
Ak ki par kiboretook tugul eng' Misiri, Ki par taunetap kimnateennywa eng' emaisyegap Ham:
Ago ki indochi piikyik ko uu keechiirek, Ak ki imut ko uu akweetap keechiirek eng' surkwen.
Ki indochi eng' kaalyeet, si ma iyweis: Ago ki tuch nyanjet puunikwak.
Ak ki imut agoi koit kiwotetap oldanyi ole-tiliil, Agoi tulwooni, ne kiga ale eunnyi ne po tai.
Ki oon pororyosyek eng' tainnywa, Ak kipchechi icheek emonooto eng' kiwotosyek koek porotennywa, Ak ki igoochi ortinwegap Israel komeny emaisyekwak.
Ago kityem ak kongelelji Kamuktaindet Ne Toroor Miising', ak ki ma riip paornatosyekyik.
Ak kiweektagei let, koosup ng'aalseet ko uu kwanisyekwak: Ki kiweekta koba taban ko uu kwanget ne ma litit.
Kitach ineendet kot konereech eng' oldinwekwak che sutotin, Ak ki igoochi ineendet ng'etkonda eng' kanamonikwak che ki kiwai.
Ye kingo kas Kamuktaindet niito konereech, Ak kiwech Israel miising':
Ak kimeto anyun Hekaluut ne ki mi Shiloh, Emait ne ki inde kwenutap piik;
Ak ki igoito kimnateennyi keluul, Ak ki inde karaaranindanyi eutap puunyoot.
Ki igoito piikyik ak icheek kebare rotwetap chok; Ak ki nereekyi porotennyi.
Ki par maat weeriikwak; Ama kityenji tiibiikwak tyendap katunisyet.
Ki kibare tisiikwak rotwetap chok; Ak ki ma iteiyo mosoogikwak.
Ki ng'eet anyun Kiptaiyat ko uu ne karuei, Ko uu chiito ne kiim ne parori amu maiyek.
Ak ki parat puunikyik koweektagei let: Ak ki igoochi kolilaanso agoi.
Ak ki eesyo emaitap Joseph, Ak ki ma lewen ooreetap Ephraim;
Ago ki lewen ooreetap Judah, Tulweetap Zion ne ki cham.
Ak ki teech oldanyi ne tiliil koigei ole sutot, Koigei ng'wonyut ne kigogimiit ineendet koigeny.
Ki lewen Daudi agine kiboityondennyi, Ak ki imutune piusyegap keechiirek:
Ye ki isubu keechiirek che aboen, Ki imut ineendet si kobiit kobai kap Jakobo che piikyik, ak Israel che porotennyi.
Kibai anyun icheek ko uu kagesunatetapkei ne po muguleldanyi; Ak ki indochi eng' utaatyetap eunekyik.
Ee Kamuktaindet, kagomong'ji poroteng'ung' pororyosyek; Kagomurwon hekalung'ung' ne tiliil; Kagoyai Jerusalem koegunoot karurugutik.
Kigogoochi muuswegap kiboitiniguk toriitigap parak koam, Ki igoochi tyong'igap timiin koam poorwegap piiguk che tiliileen.
Kitumjinot Jerusalem korotiigap piiguk ko uu peek; Ak ki ma piit chii ne kitup icheek.
Kigeegu che iteweerotin eng' piik che neegiteenech, Saseech ak kororechinech anyun, che mi komoswekyok tugul.
Ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, tyanitu, tos inereechi agoi? Tos lalei ng'etkondang'ung' ko uu maat?
Rong'ji nereegeguk pororyosyek che ma ingenin, Ak laitornatosyek che maguurei kaineng'ung'.
Amu kigoam Jakobo, Ak ki koyai koek karaita ole menyei.
Amebwaat iityech tengekwogigap kwanisyekyok: Ingosip kondoenech rireenosyeguk: Amu kigenyeratitu miising'.
Toretech, ee Kamuktaindetap yetunennyo, amu toroornatetap kaineng'ung'; Sarwech, ak iunde tengekwogikyok, amu kaineng'ung'.
Amu nee si koleen pororyosyek, Mi ano Kamuktaindennywa? Ingonaak eng' pororyosyek eng' tainnyo Yaaktaetap korotiik che po kiboitiniguk che ki kitumda.
Ingonyo taing'ung' tigenetap kimonjororyot; Riip inyee eng' ooindap kimnateng'ung' che kagitoorchi meet;
Ak iyaakyi pororyosyek che neegiteenech konyil tisap eng' tegetikwak Kerennywa po kong', ne kigerin kong', inyee, ee Kiptaiyat.
Ak acheek anyun, che ki piiguk ak keechiiregap akweeng'ung', Kemwaun kongoi koigeny: Ak kimwaitoi kalasuneng'ung' eng' ibinwek tugul.
Ep iit, ee Mestowotap Israel, Inyee ne indochini Joseph ko uu akweetap keechiirek; Iluu, inyee ne itebee kerubisyek.
Ing'eet kimnateng'ung' eng' taitap Ephraim, ak Benjamin, ak Manasseh, ak inyoo isarwech.
Ee Kamuktaindet, weektech kogeny; ak ingokweng'is togeng'ung', si kesarwech.
Ee Kamuktaindet ne po Toroornatet ne po lugoosyek, inereekyini saaetap piiguk kot kotyanit?
Ki ibae icheek amitwogigap peegap kong', ak ki inage peegap kong' koee eng' kerutyet ne oo.
Iyaech keegu che moitoseech pororyosyek che neegiteenech: ak roritos puunikyok icheegei eng' icheegei.
Ee Kamuktaindet ne po lugoosyek, weektech; Ak ingokweng'is togeng'ung', si kesarwech.
Ki ibu inyee sabibuk eng' Misiri: ki ioon pororyosyek, ak imin sabibunooto.
Kisip ichopchi poroindo, Ak ki pa ng'wony oriit tigitikyik, ak koyom emet.
Ki iuur urwennyi tuloonook, Ak ki kergei mooriikyik ak taragonigap Kamuktaindet.
Ki iwaakta mooriikyik kot koit nyanjetap Mediterenian, Ak kong'atos che ng'orng'or kot koit aineet.
Amu nee si ibut ng'otonokyik, Si kobut age tugul ne siirtoi logoekyik?
Ng'emei icheek toret ne punu timiin, Ak koamei tyong'igap warenget.
Kisaain, acheek ee Kamuktaindet ne po lugoosyek, keele, iweege: Keer oli eng' kipsengwet, ak igeer, ak irutoochi sabibuniito,
Ak keetit ne ki imiine eung'ung' ne po tai, Ak temeet ne ki igimityige.
Kigebeel eng' maat, ak kigeep: Lustos eng' kereetap kong' ne po togeng'ung'.
Ingotebee eung'ung' chiitap eung'ung' ne po tai, Eng' weeriitap chii ne ki igimityige.
Si ma kegetyinige let kemetoin: Isoobech, si keguur kaineng'ung'.
Ee Kamuktaindet ne po Toroornatet ne po lugoosyek, weektech kogeny; Ingokweng'is togeng'ung', si kesarwech.
Otyenji Kamuktaindet eng' kutit ne oo, ineendet kimnateennyo; otyenji Kamuktaindetap Jakobo eng' poiboiyet.
Otyen tyendap kalasunet, ak obir sugutit ne ming'in, ketubet ne tinyei cheet ne rurei, ak kibugandet.
Oguut iryageet ko kaleel arawet, ye kagoeet arawet, eng' peetuunnyo ne po igoorto ne oo.
Amu ng'atuutyet niito eng' Israel, kirwoogetap Kamuktaindetap Jakobo.
Ki ng'at niito koek paornateet eng' Joseph, ye kingo manda eng' emetap Misiri, ole ki agase kutit ne ma anai.
Ki aistoe tigikyennyi mileet: ki kiistoe eunekyik kitongok.
Ki iguurse eng' nyalilda, ak ki asaruun; Ak ki awolun eng' ole ung'aat ne po tuleet; Ki atyemin eng' ole mi peegap Meribah.
Ogas, okweek piikyuk, si abaoryanwok: Ee Israel, ndechame iepcha iit!
Amat kobiitunenen kanamwet ne too; Anan igutung'ji kamuktain age tugul ne po pororyosyek alak.
Aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindeng'ung', Ne ki amutun itogosu eng' emetap Misiri: Iseng'eng'e, si anyiit kuting'ung'.
Ago ki ma epchi iit kutinnyu piikyuk; Ak ki ma ko magena kiy Israel.
Ki aunde anyun koba eng' uuindap mugulelwekwak, Si kobendatee kirwoogutikwak.
Pwo! Nda kiga epcha iit piikyuk, Ee, nda kiga cham Israel kobendatee ortinwekyuk!
Ta kasip aterteerchi puunikwak, Ak aluukyi eunnyu usiikwak.
Yaegei koek che kase iit icheeget che wechei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor: Ago kata teptoi peetuusyekwak koigeny.
Kata pae icheek nganuuk che neryootiin kosiir: Ak kata abaenen kumyat ne punu rwandet kot ibiye.
Tononi Kamuktaindet eng' tuiyet ne oo ne po kipsengwet; irwoochi Kamuktaindet eng' kwenutap kamuktaik.
Orwoochi kirwooget ne ma po iman kot kotyanit, ak ogonyiti kiptengeginik?
Orwooksechinechi ne panan ak ne ma tinyei sigiik: Oyachi ne po iman che kinyaliili ak ponoonik.
Osaru kibananiat ak ne ma tinyei kiy: Osaru icheek eng' eunegap kiptengeginik.
Ma ingen kiy, ama iguitos kiy; Pendi komosi ak komosi eng' mesundeito: Kibotanso lumeiywek tugul che po ng'wony.
Ki amwa ale, “Oo kamuktaik, ak okweek tugul ko oo weeriigap Ineendet Ne Toroor Miising';
nganda uu nooto, obegu ko uu piik, ak obutosi ko uu age eng' pounik.”
Ee Kamuktaindet, ng'eet, irwooksechi ng'wony: Amu tuun egu pororyosyek tugul poroteng'ung'.
Ee Kamuktaindet, amesiis: amesiis, amemuuny, ee Kamuktaindet.
Amu, keero, poldos puuniguk, ak kagoyot metowekwak icheeget che wechin.
Kagotuiyogei si korwooch kirwooget ne ya agobo piiguk, ak ko tetei ng'aalseet agobo cheguuk che ung'ootiin.
Ki kole icheek, “Obwa, keng'eti si mata koek pororyet: si ma kibwaati kainetap Israel kogeny.”
Amu kigong'alaaljigei ak kogasyin; Yaei icheek arorutyet si kogirinden:
Emaisyegap Edom ak Ismaelik; Moab, ak Hagarenik;
Gebal, ak Ammon, ak Amelek; Philistia, kobooto icheek che menyei Tyro:
Kanamgei agine Assyria kobooto icheek; Kogotoret lagogap Lot.
Yachi icheek ko uu ye ki iyachi Midian; Ko uu ye ki iyachi Sisera, ak Jabin, eng' aineet Kison:
Che ki pekyi En-dor; Ki ek ng'atateek che po ng'wony.
Yachi piikwak che taagunotiin kogergeit ak Oreb ak Seeb; Ee, yachi pounikwak tugul kogergeit ak Seba ak Salmuna:
Che ki mwa kole, ongenam kobunjech Meng'otosyegap Kamuktaindet.
Ee Kamuktaindennyu, yai icheek koek temburyek che arureni; Ko uu meteteek che ibei usoonet.
Ko uu maat ne peelei timiin, Ak ko uu liplibenet ne peelei tuloonook;
Oon icheek anyun eng' kipchurchuryeng'ung', Ak imu icheek eng' usooneng'ung' ne kiim.
Inyiit teweernateet togoochikwak; Si kobiit kocheeng' kaineng'ung', ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ingolilanso ak koiyweis koigeny; Ee, ingoteweerogis ak kolusyo:
Si kobiit konai kole inyeendet inyegei ne kaineng'ung' ko Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Inyee ko ii Ne Toroor Miising' ne pou ng'wony komugul.
Korooron ne tya kooriguk, Ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne po lugoosyek!
Amei emo saboondanyu, ee, machei kotanui agobo seremusyegap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor; Tyenjin muguleldanyu ak poortanyu, Kamuktaindet ne sabei.
Kagonyoor chepkelembut koot, Ak kagonyoor kibiswet keswet, ole iichin, Agot eng' kaptisisyosyeguk, ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne po lugoosyek, Laitoryandennyu ak ko Kamuktaindennyu.
Poiboen icheek che menyei koong'ung': Ilasun kotugul.
Paibai chii ne mi kimnateennyi eng' inyee; Ineendet ne mi muguleldanyi ortinwek che paroen che pendi Zion.
Ye punei icheek atebweetap Riirek koyai koek kong'igap peek; Ilaakyin perurwogik ropta ne po tai.
Pendi kong'etee kimnateet agoi kimnateet, Taagu age tugul eng' taitap Kamuktaindet eng' Zion.
Ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindet ne po lugoosyek, kas saaennyu, Ep iit, Kamuktaindetap Jakobo.
Keer, ee Kamuktaindet ne I long'ennyo, Ak igeer togeetap neng'ung' ne iilaat.
Myee peetuut agenge ne atebee seremusyeguk kosiir eliphuut. Achame ariip kurgeetap kootap Kamuktaindennyu, Kosiir ameny emaisyegap kiptengeginik.
Amu Kamuktaindet ne po Toroornatet ko uu asiista ak long'eet: Koonu Kamuktaindet ne Toroor myeeindo ak teegisto: Maete icheek che pendoti eng' imanda kiy age tugul ne myee.
Ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne po lugoosyek, Paibai chii ne imang'un.
Ki iriree emeng'ung', inyee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor; ki iweegu Jakobo konyo eng' ole kiga luul ineendet.
Ki inyochi kaat piiguk eng' tengekwogikwak, ki ituch tengektonywa tugul.
Ki iste nereegeguk tugul: Ki ituktoochi patai koroomnatetap nereegeguk.
Weekyeige, Kamuktaindetap yetunennyo. Ak ingosiisyo nereegeguk che tokyineigei.
Tos inereekyinech agoi? Tos isube nereegeguk ibinwek tugul?
Tos ma isoobech kogeny, si kobiit koboiboitunenen piiguk?
Ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, iboorwech rireeneng'ung', ak igoonech yetuneng'ung'.
Nan agas kiit ne mwaei Kamuktaindet, Kamuktaindet ne Toroor; amu mwachin kaalyeet piikyik, chechiik che tiliileen; ago amat kota koweekyigei perberyo.
Iman neegitee yetunennyi icheek che iywei ineendet; Si komeny telunateet emennyo.
Katuiyo rireenet ak imanda; Kang'ututkei imanda ak kaalyeet.
Kabiitune imanda ng'wony; Ak ing'ururi ng'wony imanda eng' kipsengwet.
Ee, koonu Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne myee; Ak koiyiei emennyo ruratennyi.
Wendi imanda kondoe ineendet; ak kochopchin ooreet kakwautikyik.
Ing'uruuge kasa, ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ak iwolwoo; Amu aa kibanania ama tinye kiy.
Riip saboondanyu; amu aa chii ne po iman: Ee inyee Kamuktaindennyu, saru kiboityondeng'ung' ne imang'un.
Rireena, ee Kiptaiyat; Amu ariirchinin peet komugul.
Ibaibai saboondap kiboityondeng'ung'; Amu atokyinin saboondanyu, ee Kiptaiyat.
Amu ii myee inyee Kiptaiyat, ak ii choboot inyochi kaat, Ak itinye chaang'indap rireenetapkei eng' icheek che kuurin.
Kaswa saaennyu, ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor; Epchi iit kutitap soomutikyuk.
Aguurin eng' peetuutap nyalildanyu; Amu iwolwoo.
Ma mi ne uu inyee eng' kamuktaik, ee Kiptaiyat; Ama mi poisyonik alak che uu cheguuk.
Tuun pwoonei pororyosyek tugul che ki iyae Ak kogutung'so eng' taing'ung', ee Kiptaiyat; Ak kotoroor icheek kaineng'ung'.
Amu ii oo, ak iyae kwang'utik; Ii Kamuktaindet inyegei.
Ineeta oreng'ung', ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor; si awendotee imandang'ung': Ituiye muguleldanyu si koywei kaineng'ung'.
Alasun, ee Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindennyu, eng' muguleldanyu komugul; Ak atoroori kaineng'ung' koigeny.
Amu oo rireeneng'ung' eng' anee; Ak ki isaru saboondanyu eng' keriinget ne loo miising'.
Ee Kamuktaindet, kagong'eetya menotik, Kogocheeng' saboondanyu tuiyetap sogoranik, Ak ma ibwaatin icheek.
Ago inyee, ee Kiptaiyat, ko ii Kamuktaindet ne nyiitaat rireenet ak ko po myeeindo, Ne ma sip konereechi, ne tinyei chaang'indap rireenetapkei ak imanit.
Weekyage, ak irireena; Igoochi kimnateng'ung' kiboityondeng'ung', Ak isaru weeriitap otwogindeng'ung' ne tye.
Yaiywo kaboorunet ne po myeeindo: Si kogeer che wecho ak kolilaanso, Amu kaitoreta, inyee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ak kaigaigaa.
Mi lumeiywondennyi tuloonook che tiliileen.
Chamei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kurgotigap Zion Kosiir meng'otosyek tugul che po Jakobo.
Kimwaitaenen tuguugap teegisto, Ee inyee nganaseetap Kamuktaindet.
Amwae kainetap Rahab ak Babilon eng' icheek che ingeno: Ogeer Philistia, ak Tyro, kobooto Kush; Ki kisikyin chiichi olooto.
Ee, kimwaei agobo Zion keele, “Ki kisikyin olooto chiichi ak chiichoo;” ak igimiti Ne Toroor Miising' ineendet.
Tuun iiti Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ye sirei piik, kole Ki kisikyin chiichi olooto.
Mwaei icheek che tyeni ak icheeget che urerendos kole, Miitei oldang'ung' kong'iikyuk tugul che po peek.
Ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindetap yetunennyu, Kaariir eng' taing'ung' peet ak kemoi:
Ingonyo saaennyu oldang'ung'; Epchi iit riirekyuk:
Amu nyiitaat nyalilwogik saboondanyu, Ak kagoriikta saboondanyu ye mi meet.
Kagiitita che choorchingei keriinget; Auu chii ne ma tinyei toreto:
Ki kiwiircha ye mi che ki kobek, Ko uu che kigebar, che ruitos eng' kererit, Che ma ibwaati inyee kogeny; Ak kigeisto eng' eung'ung'.
Kaindea keriinget ne loo miising', Eng' oldinwegap mesundeito, eng' rirosyek.
Irurunya nereegeguk, Ak kainyalila eng' peeguk tugul che mildogei.
Kaistoena che kingenge kolooegitu; kaiyaa aek ne wegot eng' icheek. Kigegera ak ma amuuchi among' saang'.
Kagochuchuiso konyekyuk amu nyalilda: Aguurin peetuut age tugul, ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kaayogaun eunekyuk.
Tos iboorchi kwang'utik piik che ki kobek? Tos ng'eetyo che ki kobek si kolasun?
Tos kiboortoi chamyeng'ung' ne tala eng' kererit? Anan imandang'ung' eng' ye mi ng'emisyet?
Tos naaksei kwang'utiguk eng' mesundeito? Tos naaksei imandang'ung' eng' emet ne po piik che ki keutye?
Ago ki ariirchin, ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Ak nyoonei saaennyu karon oldang'ung'.
Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, amu nee si ioon saboondanyu? Amu nee si iung'ena togeng'ung'?
Ki kinyalila kobooch koa ming'in agoi ra, ak neegit ame: Atoptobeni ye amuitoi agobo kamuisosyeguk.
Katucha nereegeguk che laldos; Kagowong'wa kamuisosyeguk.
Ki pwa koyiema ko uu peek peetuut komugul; Ki yiema komoswek tugul.
Ki istoena chamaneet ak chorweet, Ak miitei mesundeito icheek che ingeno.
Atyeni agobo rireenetapkei ne po Kamuktaindet ne Toroor agoi koigeny: Aboortoi eng' kutinnyu imandang'ung' eng' ibinwek tugul.
Amu ki ale, Teegoksei koigeny rireenetapkei. Igimiit imandang'ung' eng' kipsengwet.
Ki imwa ile, “Ki kiyomiske ak nenyu ne ki alewen, ki ayosyechi Daudi kiboityondennyu aleenji:
‘Agimiiti kesweguk koigeny, ak agimiiti ng'echereeng'ung' ne po laitornatet agoi ibinwek tugul.’ ”
Ilasu kipsengwet kwang'utiguk, ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor; Ak ilasu agine imandang'ung' eng' tuiyetap che tiliileen.
Amu mi ng'oo eng' parak ne kirogendoe Kamuktaindet ne Toroor? Tos mi ng'oo eng' weeriigap che kiimeen ne kergei ak Kamuktaindet ne Toroor,
Ineendet Kamuktaindet ne kiywei miising' eng' tuiyetap che tiliileen, Ne kiywei kosiir tugul che kiyiem ineendet?
Ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindet ne po lugoosyek, Ng'oo ne po kamuktaet ko uu inyee, ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor? Ak yiemin imandang'ung'.
Inyee ne ibou wasetapkei ne po nyanjet: Ye kang'eet mildaennyi pogei igeregong' kosiis.
Ki ituatui Rahab ko uu ne kagebar. Ki iyeste puuniguk eng' eutap kimnateng'ung'.
Cheguuk kipsengwet ak ng'wony agine: Inyee ne ki iyai ng'wony ak che nyiitaat olooto.
Ki itau iyai murot kaataam ak murot tai: Tyendos eng' poiboiyet Tabor ak Hermon eng' kaineng'ung'.
Itinye euut ne po kamuktaet: Kiim eung'ung', ak toroor eung'ung' ne po tai.
Ole tebee ng'echereeng'ung' ne po pounateet ko imanda ak kirwooget: Indoenen rireenetapkei ak imanit.
Poiboen piik che ingen tyendap poiboiyet: Pendote icheek lapkeiyetap togeng'ung', ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Igasegei peetuut komugul eng' kaineng'ung': Ak kitoroori icheek eng' imandang'ung'.
Amu inyee karaaranindap kimnateennywa: Ak kitoroori kuinennyo eng' chameng'ung'.
Amu po Kamuktaindet ne Toroor long'ennyo; Ak po Ineendet ne Tiliil ne po Israel laitoryandennyo.
Ki ing'alaalji anyun cheguuk che tiliileen eng' ng'ang'utik, Ak ileenjini, Kaalaakyi toreteet ineendet ne nyigan; Ki atoroor ne ki kilewen eng' piik.
Ki anyooru Daudi kiboityondennyu; Ki aiile ineendet mwaitanyu ne tiliil:
Ne tuun kimitu eunnyu eng' ineendet; Igimiiti agine eunnyu ineendet.
Ma imuuchi puunyoot koyachi ineendet kiy ne ya; Anan konyaliil weeriitap yaityet ineendet.
Atuatui puunikyik eng' tainnyi, Ak abir che wechei ineendet.
Ak tebyei kobooto ineendet imandanyu ak rireenennyu; Ak tororitu kuinennyi eng' kainennyu.
Agoochini eunnyi koboi nyanjet, Ak koboi ainoosyek eunnyi ne po tai.
Riirchino koleen, Ii abba inyee, Kamuktaindennyu, ak rwandetap yetunennyu.
Ayae ineendet koek taaitanyu, Koeet kosiir laitorinik tugul che po ng'wony.
Agonorchini rireenennyu koigeny, Ak tononi eng' kimnateet kayomisennyu kobooto ineendet.
Achamjini iyotennyi agine kotebi koigeny. Ak ng'echerennyi ne po laitornatet ko uu peetuusyegap kipsengwet.
Ago ngo pagaakta lagokyik ng'atuutyennyu, Ak ngo ma pendatee kirwoogutikyuk;
Ngot kobut kaneetisyosyekyuk, ak ngo ma riip ng'atuutikyuk;
atigoone anyun pistoennywa kirokto, ak atigoone tengektonywa pirutik.
Ago ma istoi rireenennyu kot kogestagei eng' ineendet, Amayae koek puch imandanyu.
Mabute kayomisennyu, Amawale kiit ne ki mang'une kutinnyu.
Ki ayosye konyil agenge eng' tiliilindanyu; Ale, Ma perberi Daudi;
Tebyei iyotennyi koigeny, Ak ng'echerennyi ne po laitornatet ko uu asiista eng' tainnyu.
Ki kimiti koigeny ko uu arawet, Ak ko uu paornateet ne po iman ne mi parak.
Ago kiitimde ak ieesye, Ki inereekyi neng'ung' ne iilaat.
Ki isas kayomiset ne po kiboityondeng'ung'; ak ki ing'wanit naaryeennyi ne po laitornatet kot iwiirchi ng'wony.
Ki ibut ng'otonokyik tugul; Ki iluul irimoikyik.
Rebe ineendet tuguukyik piik che siirtoi: Ki koek ne iteweerat eng' piigap kokwennyi.
Ki itoroor eutap tai ne po puunikyik; Ki igoochi puunikyik tugul koboiboitu.
Ee, ki iweekyi let ng'atiibiindap rotwennyi ne po chok, Ama igoochi kobelis eng' lugeet.
Ki iunde tiliilindanyi kogeskei. Ak ki iwiirchi ng'wony ng'echerennyi ne po laitornatet.
Ki itil kong'ering'itu peetuusyegap ming'inatennyi; Ki ilaakyi ineendet teweernateet.
Iunyegei kot kotyanit, ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor? Laldos nereegeguk ko uu maat kot kotyanit?
Ee, ibwaat ole tee nwagindap peetuusyekyuk: Ki itau iyai weeriik tugul che po piik koek puch agobo nee?
Tos ng'oo chii ne sabei ne ma keerei meet, Ne tos sar saboondanyi eng' kimnateetap meet?
Ee, Kiptaiyat, mi ano rireenosyeguk che po keny, Che ki iyasyechi Daudi eng' imandang'ung'?
Ibwaat, ee Kiptaiyat, sastaet ne po kiboitiniguk; Ko uu ye aiboti eng' tegeennyu kereetap kong' ne po piik tugul che chaang';
Nooto ne ki kogerisye kong' puuniguk, ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Che ki kogerate kong' kakwautigap neng'ung' ne iilaat.
Iberuurot Kamuktaindet ne Toroor agoi koigeny. Amen, ak Amen.
Ee Kiptaiyat, ki iegu ole ki menye Eng' ibinwek tugul.
Ye kitom kobiit tuloonook, Anan ye kitom iyai emet ak ng'wonyut, Ii Kamuktaindet, kobooch keny agoi koigeny.
Iweektoi chiito kwo temburyek; Ak ileen, “Oweege, okweek weeriigap piik.”
Amu kergei kenyiisyek eliphuut eng' taing'ung' Ak amut ne kogosiirto, Ak ko uu riipseet ne po kemoi.
Imuti koba ko uu mogoochek; uu icheek kanuuget: Uu icheek karon susweek che piitos.
Ing'atos karon, ak koeegitu; Kitemei koskoleny, ak koresyo.
Amu kagiwong'wech eng' nereegeguk, Ak ki aragendosi eng' nyitateng'ung'.
Ki inde tengekwogikyok taing'ung', Ak ki inde tengekwogikyok che ung'ootiin lapkeiyetap togeng'ung'.
Amu ki kosiirto peetuusyekyok tugul eng' nereegeguk: Kiwong'u acheek kenyiisyekyok ko uu atindyot ne ki kimwa.
Peetuusyegap kenyiisyekyok koitei kenyiisyek tamanwogik tisap, Ago eng' che kiimeen koitei tamanwogik sisiit; Ago menatennywa ko nyalilda ak arageneet; Amu choktoi ko uu nooto, ak keebe kesiirte.
Ng'oo ne ingen kimnateetap nereegeguk, Ak nereegeguk che ng'woneen, ko uu ye nyoljin kiywein?
Ineetech anyun kiit peetuusyekyok, Si kobiit kesich muguleldo ne po utaatyet.
Weeguge, ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor; tyanitu? Ak irireegei kiboitiniguk.
Ee, paech kebiye eng' rireeneng'ung' karon; Si kobiit keboiboitu ak kigaskei eng' peetuusyekyok tugul.
Ibaibaech eng' peetuusyek che tee che ki inyalilech, Che tee kenyiisyek che ki kigeer yaityet.
Ingotook poisyoniguk eng' kiboitiniguk, Ak telunateng'ung' eng' lagokwak.
Ak ingotebenech karaaranindap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindennyo: Ak igimitwech poisyonigap eunekyok; Ee, igimit poisyonigap eunekyok.
Ineendet ne menyei ole ung'aat ne po Ineendet Ne Toroor Miising' Kotebee nooto urwetap Ineendet Ne po Kamuktaet.
Amwae agobo Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ale, Ineendet ole amwechini ak ko irimennyu; Kamuktaindennyu ne amang'u.
Amu saruun eng' mesteetap namindetap toriitik, Ak eng' koroito ne parisyei.
Tugenen koroorikyik, Ak inyooru ole imwechini eng' kebebaikyik: Imandanyi ko long'eet ak ne kiteektoegei.
Meiywei kamuisetap kemoi, Anan kipchabet ne kimwoktoi peet;
Anan koroito ne wendoti eng' mesundeito, Anan ng'emisyet ne parisyei peet.
Ibutos eliphuut eng' ole neegiteenen, Ak ibutos eliphuusyek tamanu eng' ole neegitee eung'ung' ne po tai; Ago mariikyinin.
Ago igeere eng' konyeguk, Igeere melektap kiptengeginik.
Amu inyee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ko ii ole amwechini! Ki iyai Ineendet Ne Toroor Miising' koek meng'ooteng'ung';
Ma nyoorun yaityet age tugul, Mariikyin koong'ung' koroito age tugul.
Amu iyomisi malaikaisyekyik koriibin, Si koriibin eng' ortinweguk tugul.
Kanabin eng' eunekwak, Si marus koita keeldong'ung'.
Ityeche ng'etundo ak ereneet: Ityeche eng' keelyeguk ng'etundo ne neran ak cheluguit.
Amu kigochama, asaru eng' nooto anyun: Atoroori ineendet, amu ki konai kainennyu.
Kuura, ak aitenji; kitebyei tuwai eng' nyalilda, asaru ineendet ak agoonyit.
Agoochini ineendet kosap kenyiisyek che chaang', Ak aboorchini yetunennyu.
Kiit ne myee ko keeweekyi kongoi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Ak ketyenji kaineng'ung' eng' kalasunoik, ee inyee Ne Toroor Miising':
Kibarta chamyeng'ung' ne tala karon, Ak imandang'ung' lagatut age tugul,
Eng' kibugandet ne tinyei inoik taman, ak kibugandet age; Kobooto ketubet ne cheei miising'.
Amu ki ibaibaa, ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, eng' poisyeng'ung': Agasigei eng' poisyonigap euneguk.
Eechen ne tya poisyoniguk, ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor! Ma tinyei ole poochin kabwaatutiguk.
Ma ingen chiito ne uu tyony; Ama iguitos ne perber;
Ye kaeegitu kiptengeginik ko uu susweek, Ak ye kanyoor perurto yaigap tengekto; Ko si keng'em agoi koigeny:
Ago inyee, ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, imi parak agoi koigeny.
Amu, keero, ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, puuniguk, Amu, keero, lustos puuniguk. Kiyestooti yaigap tengekto tugul.
Ago kiitoroor kuinennyu ko uu kuinetap soet: Kagiilena mwaita ne karaaran.
Kogogeer konyekyuk ak icheek magennyu eng' puunikyuk, Ak kogogas itiikyuk magennyu eng' yaigap yaityo che setyina.
Sabei ne po imanda ko uu tiiret: piitei ko uu tarakwetap Lebanon.
Icheeget che ki kiminji kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Koeegitu eng' seremusyegap kootap Kamuktaindennyo.
Ta koiitos agot ko kagoosegitu; Tuonitu amu peek che eei, ak kotunendos:
Si kobiit kobarta kole po iman Kamuktaindet ne Toroor; Ineendet rwandennyu, ama mi kiy ne ma po iman eng' ineendet.
Laitorani Kamuktaindet ne Toroor; ilaagat eng' telunateet; Ilaagat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, kigermenegei kimnateet: Ki kigimit ng'wony, si ma ng'eigei.
Ki kigimit ng'echereeng'ung' ne po laitornatet kobooch keny: Ki imi kobooch keny agoi.
Ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, tuldos ainoosyek, Kigong'eet ainoosyek tuleennywa; Ing'eeti maranosyek mildaennywa pogei.
Kiim Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' parak, Kosiir tuleetap peek che chaang', Kosiir mildaetapkei ne kiim ne po nyanjet.
Lumdootin paornatosyeguk: Nyoljin koong'ung' tiliilindo, Ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, agoi koigeny.
Ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, inyee Kamuktaindet ne po yaaktaetap mugetuut, Iluu, inyee Kamuktaindet ne po yaaktaetap mugetuut.
Ng'eet, inyee kirwoogindetap ng'wony: Igeerchi menotik ko uu ye nyoljin.
Ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, tyanitu, Iterteerisyei kiptengeginik kot kotyanit?
Ng'alaalati icheek ng'aleek che chaang', ng'alaale menoteet: Ilasugei yaik tugul che po tengekto.
Tuatui icheek piiguk, ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Ak konyalili icheek poroteng'ung'.
Parei mosoget ak toondet, Ak rumei che ma tinyei sigiik.
Ak koleen, Ma keerei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Ama mage kiy Kamuktaindetap Jakobo.
Obwaat, okweek che o koseng'eng'inik eng' kwenutap piik: Ak okweek che oo perberen, ong'omegitu auyo?
Tos ineendet ne kiyaei itit, koma kastoi? Tos ineendet ne kiyaei koonyek, koma keertoi?
Tos ma itigoni ineendet ne kere kong' pororyosyek, Ne ineendet ne ineeti piik naet?
Ingen Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kabwaatutigap chii, Kole puch.
Igasegei chii ne igeregong', ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Ak ineeti eng' ng'atuutiguk;
Si kobiit imuung'ji eng' peetuusyegap nyalilda, Agoi kebalji keriinget kiptengeginik.
Amu ma toortai `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor piikyik, Ama metoi porotennyi.
Amu weekyingei kirwooget imanda: Ak kosubi nooto tugul che po iman eng' mugulelwekwak.
Tos ng'oo ne ng'eetei kotoreta eng' yaigap yaityo? Tos ng'oo ne tononi kotoreta eng' kiptengeginik?
Nda ki ma ek toreteennyu Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Ta kiga kochaakta saboondanyu komeny ye mi siisek.
Ye kinga le, Ichaboitoi keldanyu, Kotiia rireeneng'ung', ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Eng' chaang'indap kabwaatutik che mi oriitinnyu koboiboi kagaigaosyeguk saboondanyu.
Tinyei yamdaet nee ng'echereetap pounatetap tengekwogik ak inyee, Ne chobei yaitwogik eng' ng'atuutik?
Iyumigei agobo saboondap ne po iman, Ak korwookyi korotiik che ma tinyei tengek.
Ago ki koek Kamuktaindet ne Toroor irimennyu ne kooi; Ak Kamuktaindennyu rwandet ne amwechini.
Ak ki koweekyi icheek tengektonywa, Ak koisto icheek amu tengektonywa; Ak kowong' icheek Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindennyo.
Obwa, ongetyenji Kamuktaindet ne Toroor: Ongetyenji rwandetap yetunennyo eng' kutitap poiboiyet.
Ongebwa tainnyi keeweekyi kongoi, Ongetyenji ineendet eng' kutitap poiboiyet eng' tyenwogigap kalasunet.
Amu Kamuktaindet ne oo Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Ineendet laitoryat ne oo ne siirei kamuktaik tugul.
Mi eunnyi komoswegap oriit che po ng'wony; Ak chechiik ak icheek walisyegap tuloonook.
Nenyi nyanjet, ineendet ne kiyaei; Ak kiyaei eunekyik emet ne yaamaat.
Obwa kilasu, ak king'uruukyi; Ongegutung'se eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Yaindennyo:
Amu ineendet Kamuktaindennyo, Ak ki piik che po akweennyi, keechiiregap eunnyi, Ee, kata myee ngo kas okweek kutinnyi rani!
Amat ouiit mugulelwekwok, ko uu eng' Meribah, Ko uu eng' peetuutap Massah eng' surkwen:
Ye kiyoma kwanisyekwok, Kotyema, ak ki keer poisyennyu.
Ki aaragen kenyiisyek artam eng' ibinooto, Ak ki ale, Icheeget ko piik che mastoi eng' mugulelwekwak, Ak tomo konai ortinwekyuk:
Ki ayosye anyun eng' nereegekyuk, Ale, Ma itei icheek kamuung'ennyu.
Otyenji Kamuktaindet ne Toroor tyendo ne leel: Otyenji Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ng'wony komugul.
Otyenji Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, oberuur kainennyi; Obarte yetunennyi eng' peetuut agoi peetuut.
Omwaite toroornatennyi eng' pororyosyek, Ak poisyonikyik che kikwong'ee eng' piik tugul.

Ogeero, kiberuuri ko uu nooto chiito ne iywei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Iberuurin Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' Zion. Ak igeere poroteetap Jerusalem peetuusyek tugul che po sabeeng'ung'.
Ee, tuun igeere mochogoroniguk. Ingotebee kaalyeet Israel!
“Kigonyaliila icheek konyil che chaang' kobooch ko aa ming'in” Ingomwa Israel nguno kole,
“Kigonyalila icheek konyil che chaang' kobooch ko aa ming'in, ago ki ma iterteera.
Ki ibat patennyu kabotik; kigereer kererchosyek koeegitu.”
Po iman Kamuktaindet ne Toroor; kigong'eti poroonigap kiptengeginik.
Ingolilanso ak koweekyigei let, icheek tugul che wechei Zion.
Ingoigei icheek susweek che mi kooriik parak, che restos kotom koeegitu,
che ma inyiiti eunnyi kesiindet, ama yamei koue chooto eunek tuwai, ineendet ne ratei ratuutigap peek.
Ama mwaei che siirtoi kole, “Ingotebenok perurtap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor! Kiberuurok eng' kainetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor!”
Ki ariirchin eng' rirosyek, ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Kiptaiyat, kas kutinnyu! Ingoepchi iit iting'ung' kutitap soomutikyuk.
Ngot iit inyee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, tengekwogik, ko ng'oo ne imuuchi kotonon, ee Kiptaiyat?
Ago miitei nyoetap kaat eng' inyee, si kobiit kiywein.
Ageni Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, igenisyei saboondanyu, ak amang'u ng'olyoondennyi.
Igeni saboondanyu Kiptaiyat, kosiir riibiik che igeni egonet; ee, kosiir riibiik che igeni egonet.
Ee Israel, imang'u Kamuktaindet ne Toroor; amu mi rireenet eng' Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ak mi katyaget ne siirei eng' ineendet.
Ak kityaachi ineendet Israel eng' tengekwogikyik tugul.
Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ma meenei muguleldanyu; ama mi katorooretapkei eng' konyekyuk; ama yae tuguuk che eecheen. Ma alosyige tuguuk che eechen anan che kikwong'ee miising'.
Ki abirge iman ak agoochi saboondanyu kosiis; ko uu lakweet ne kaluge kamet, uu saboondanyu lakweet ne kagiluge.
Ee Israel, imang'u Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kobooch nguno agoi koigeny.
Ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ibwaat agobo Daudi ibwaat nyalilwogikyik tugul che ki nyoor;
Ko uu ye ki iyasyechi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ak ki iarorchi Ineendet Ne po Kamuktaet ne po Jakobo, koleenji:
“Iman, ma wendi emait oriit ne po koonnyu, anan atogoste itogunnyu;
ma kere konyekyuk eng' rwondo, anan anuuch;
agoi acheeng'ji Kamuktaindet ne Toroor oldo, meng'ootetap Ineendet Ne po Kamuktaet ne po Jakobo.”
Ogeero, kigegas agobo nooto eng' Ephratah; ki kinyoorchi keeweet ne mi timiin.
Kibendi meng'otosyekyik; kigutunyi eng' ng'echereetap keelyekyik keel.
Ng'eet, ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ui ole imuung'ee; inyee ak moingetap kimnateng'ung'.
Ingolaach tisiiguk imanda; ak ingogaskei eng' kutit ne oo eng' poiboiyet cheguuk che tiliileen.
Amewelel togeetap neng'ung' ne iilaat amu kiboityondeng'ung' Daudi.
Ki iyasyechi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Daudi eng' iman; ma weechegei let: Andoi age ne punu poortang'ung' kotebee ng'echereeng'ung' ne po pounatet.
Ngot koriip lagoguk arorutyennyu ak pounatennyu ne tuun aneeti, kotebee anyun lagokwak ak icheek ng'echereeng'ung' ne po pounateet agoi koigeny.
Amu ki kolewen Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Zion; kimakyigei koek ole tebee.
Yuto ko komosta ole amuung'e koigeny; atebee yuto; amu ki amach.
Aberuuri miising' amitwogikyik; abae kibananookyik amitwogik kot kobiyong'so.
Alaakyini tisiikyik ak icheek yetunet; ak kogaskei eng' kutit ne oo eng' poiboiyet chechiik che tiliileen.
Ayae eng' olooto kuinetap Daudi kong'at; ki achop tait agobo nenyu ne iilat.
Alaakyini puunikyik kalilanet; ago tuneni eng' ineendet naaryeennyi ne po pounateet.
Ogeero, myee ne tya ak karaaran ne tya ye meng'indos che tupcho eng' yamdaet agenge!
Kergei ak mwaita ne karaaran miising' ne ki ile metit, ne kirootei agoi tamnet, agot tamnetap Aron: ne kirootei agoi kaatitap ngoroikyik.
Uu rewootap Hermon, che choorchingei tuloonoogap Zion. Amu olooto ole king'ate Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kaberuret, agot saboondap koigeny.
Obwa, olasu Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, okweek kiboitinigap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, che tonondos kemoi eng' kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Otokyi eunekwok ye mi tiliilindo, ak olasu Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ingoberuurin Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' Zion; ineendet ne ki yai kipsengwet ak ng'wony.
Olasu Kamuktaindet ne Toroor! Olasu kainetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor; olasu ineendet, okweek kiboitinigap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor,
okweek che kotonondosi eng' kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, eng' seremusyegap kootap Kamuktaindennyo.
Olasu Kamuktaindet ne Toroor; amu myee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor: otyenji kainennyi kalasunoik amu myee inee.
Amu ki kolewenjigei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Jakobo, ak Israel koek kinnyi ne nenyi iman.
Amu angen ale oo Kamuktaindet ne Toroor; ak siirei Kiptaiyandennyo kamuktaik tugul.
Ki koyai Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kiit age tugul ne chamei, eng' kipsengwet ak eng' ng'wony, eng' nyanjosyek ak rirosyek tugul.
Igoochin kibungweret kotogosta kong'etee ole poochin ng'wony; yachin ropta kalyelosyek; imoong'u usoonet eng' konoraikyik.
Ne ki par kiboretook che po Misiri, che po piik ak che kitwatei che kiyagi.
Ki iyookto kaboorunoik ak kwang'utik koba kwenung'ung', ee Misiri, kobwonji Pharaoh ak otwogikyik tugul.
Ne ki pir pororyosyek che chaang', ak ki par laitorinik che kiimeen:
Sihon laitoryatap Amorik, ak Og laitoryatap Bashan, ak laitornatosyek tugul che po Kanaan.
Ak ki igoito emennywa koek poroteet, poroteetap piikyik Israel.
Tebyei kaineng'ung' koigeny, ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor; tebyei kabwaateng'ung' eng' ibinwek tugul, ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Amu irwooksechin `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor piikyik, ak koriiregei kiboitiinikyik.
Kanamonigap pororyosyek ko po fedha ak thahabu. poisyetap eunegap piik.
Tinyei kutusweek, ago ma twegu; tinyei koonyek, ago ma keertoi.
Tinyei itiik, ago ma kastoi; ama mi kabuuset eng' kutusweekwak.
Kergeitu icheeget che kiyaei, ak tuguuchooto; ee, age tugul ne imang'u icheek.
Ee kootap Israel, olasu Kamuktaindet ne Toroor! Ee kootap Aron, olasu Kamuktaindet ne Toroor!
Ee kootap Lawi, olasu Kamuktaindet ne Toroor! Okweek che oiywei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, olasu Kamuktaindet ne Toroor!
Iberuurot Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' Zion, ineendet ne menyei Jerusalem. Olasu Kamuktaindet ne Toroor!
Ogoochi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kongoi, amu myee ineendet; amu tebyei rireenennyi koigeny.
Ee oweekyi kongoi Kamuktaindet ne pou kamuktaik; amu tebyei rireenennyi koigeny.
Ee oweekyi kongoi Kiptaiyatap kiptainik; amu tebyei rireenennyi koigeny.
Ineendet ne yaei ineegei kwang'utik che eecheen; amu tebyei rireenennyi koigeny.
Ineendet ne eng' kaguiyet ko ki yai kipsengwet, amu tebyei rireenennyi koigeny;
ineendet ne ki iito ng'wonyut eng' peek parak, amu tebyei rireenennyi koigeny;
ineedet ne ki yai lapkeiyosyek che eecheen, amu tebyei rireenennyi koigeny;
asiista ne pou eng' peetuut, amu tebyei rireenennyi koigeny;
arawek ak kecheik che pou eng' kemoi, amu tebyei rireenennyi koigeny.
Ineendet ne ki pir Misiri eng' taiywekwak, amu tebyei rireenennyi koigeny;
ak ki imut Israel komong' eng' kwenunnywa, amu tebyei rireenennyi koigeny;
eng' euut ne kiim ak eng' euut ne chuulaat, amu tebyei rireenennyi koigeny;
ineendet ne ki pcheune aeng' Araraita ne Piriir, amu tebyei rireenennyi koigeny;
ak ki igoochi Israel kobun kwenunnyi, amu tebyei rireenennyi koigeny;
ago ki toorchi Pharaoh ak lugosyekyik Araraita ne Piriir, amu tebyei rireenennyi koigeny.
Ineendet ne ki indochi piikyik kobun surkwen, amu tebyei rireenennyi koigeny.
Ineendet ne ki pir laitorinik che eecheen: amu tebyei rireenennyi koigeny;
ak ki par laitorinik che taagunotiin, amu tebyei rireenennyi koigeny;
Sihon laitoryatap Amorik, amu tebyei rireenennyi koigeny;
ak Og laitoryat Bashan, amu tebyei rireenennyi koigeny;
ak ki igoito emennywa koek poroteet, amu tebyei rireenennyi koigeny;
poroteetap kiboityondennyi Israel, amu tebyei rireenennyi koigeny.
Ne ki ibwaatech eng' nyeraatyennyo, amu tebyei rireenennyi koigeny;
ak ne ki ityaachech eng' puunikyok, amu tebyei rireenennyi koigeny.
Ineendet ne igoochin amitwogik tugul che po tuguuk tugul che saptos, amu tebyei rireenennyi koigeny.
Ee oweekyi kongoi Kamuktaindetap kipsengwet, amu tebyei rireenennyi koigeny.
Eng' ngeguutap ainoosyegap Babilon, ko ki kitebee olooto ak ki kiriirtosi, ye kingi pwaati Zion.
Eng' keetiik che po kereruusyegap emonooto ko ki kigartate ketubosyekyok.
Eng' olooto icheeget che kiluulech ko ki magenech tyenwogik, ak icheeget che ki inyalilech ko ki magenech poiboiyet, koleen, “Otyenwech tyendo agenge eng' tyenwogigap Zion!”
Kimuktoi ano ketyen tyendap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' emet ne ki onon?
Ngot autyenen, ee Jerusalem, ko ingoek eunnyu ne po tai ne meat!
Ingonamgei ng'elyeptanyu ak kutit, ngot koma abwaatin, ngo ma achame Jerusalem kosiir poiboiyennyu ne siirtoot.
Ibwaat, ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, kiit ne ki yai piigap Edom peetuut ye ki kiluule Jerusalem; che kileen, “Obut! Obut! Agot oldanyi ole tonone kooriik!”
Ee, cheptap Babilon, ne tuun kiwong'un! Paibai ineendet ne igeerun ko uu ye ki iyaiywech!
Paibai ineendet ne namei manyuruniguk ak kowiire rwandet!
Agoonin kongoi eng' muguleldanyu komugul; atyenun kalasunoik eng' taitap kanamonik.
Agutunyi atokyinige hekalung'ung' ne tiliil, ak agoochini kaineng'ung' kongoi amu chamyeng'ung' ne tala amu imandang'ung'; amu ki ieet ng'olyoondeng'ung' kosiir kaineng'ung' komugul.
Ki iwolwoo eng' peetuut ne ki aguurin, ki igimita eng' kimnateet eng' saboondanyu.
Koonin kongoi laitorinik tugul che po ng'wony, ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, amu ki kogas ng'aleegap kuting'ung'.
Tyeni icheek agobo ortinwegap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, amu oo toroornatetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Agot nga toroor Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, kogeerei ne nyeraat, ago ingen ineendet menotyot agot ngo mi ole loo.
Agot ngabunoti kwenutap nyalilda, ko inyee ne iriiba; iitoi eung'ung' igirindoe nereegegap puunikyuk; ak sarwo eung'ung' ne po tai.
Isuldaiwo Kamuktaindet ne Toroor tuguuk che nyoljino; tebyei rireeneng'ung' koigeny, ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor; amebagaakte poisyonigap euneguk.
Ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ki isyacha ak ki inaa.
Ingen ye atebye ak ye ang'eete, ingen kabwaatutikyuk agot ngimi ole loo.
Isyachi ooreennyu ak ole arue, ak ingen ortinwekyuk tugul.
Amu ma mi ng'olyoo ng'elyeptannyu, keero, ingen inyee tugul, ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ki iyiema tai ak let, ak ki igonoora eung'ung'.
Po kwong'eet ne oo eng' anee, ng'omnateet ne uu nooto; toroor miising', ma muuchi aityi.
Awendi ano aistoegei Kabuuseng'ung' ne Tiliil? Anan amwechini ano ole memi?
Ngatogoste kipsengwet, imi olooto; agot ngaite itogunnyu eng' ye mi che ki kobek, keero, imi olooto.
Ngaip kebebaigap karon, ak awe atebee tabanwegap nyanjet;
agot eng' olooto kondoiywa eung'ung', ak nama eung'ung' ne po tai.
Ngot amwa ale, “Tucha mesundeito iman, ak ngale koek lapkeiyet ne yiema, kemout, ”
ko agot mesundeito, koma ung'enengei, ago iluu kemout ko uu peet; kergei mesundeito ak lapkeiyet eng' inyee.
Amu inyee ne ki iyai saboondanyu; ki itucha eng' moetap kamennyu.
Aweegun kongoi, amu ki kiyaa eng' ooreetap kaiyweisyet, ak eng' kwang'utyet. Kwang'utik poisyoniguk. ak ingen saboondanyu ng'olyoondonooto komyee.
Ma ung'enenge poortanyu, ye ki kiyaa eng' ung'oot, ak ye ki kimimia eng' ng'omnateet eng' ng'wony oriit.
Ki keer konyeguk poortanyu kotom kosulda, ki kisirchi bukuing'ung' kebeberwekyuk tugul, che ki kiyaei peetuut age tugul, ye kitom kobiit agot agenge eng' icheek.
Korooron ne tya kabwaatutiguk che iting'ena, ee Kamuktaindet! Eechen ne tya icheek tugul ko kagiyomo!
Nda aiiti icheek, ko chaang' kosiir ng'aniek; ye agosu, kota ami kobooten.
Iman, ibare kiptengeginik, ee Kamuktaindet: Oistoenage anyun, okweek piik che tumdoi korotiik.
Amu mwaei icheek tengekto agobo inyee, ak mwaei kaineng'ung' puch puuniguk.
Ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, tos ma weche icheek che wechin? Ak ma nereekyini icheek che ng'eetyinin?
Aweche icheek konyi; aiiti icheek ale puunikyuk.
Isyacha, ee Kamuktaindet, ak inai muguleldanyu; tyema, ak inai kabwaatutikyuk.
Keer ngo mi oor age tugul ne po tengek eng' anee, ak indoiywa eng' ooreet ne po koigeny.
Sarwo, ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, eng' chiito ne ya; riibo eng' chiito ne koroom;
che ibwaati yaitwogik eng' mugulelwekwak; iyomdoskei kotugul agobo lugeet.
Ki kolit ng'elyebwekwak ko uu ereneet; miitei ng'wonetap erenook kutusweekwak.
Riibo, ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, eng' eunegap kiptengekyot; riibo eng' chiito ne koroom ne pekyinot kotoorta.
Kigouny menotik mesteet agobo anee, ak poroonik; kigoiito mesteet ne uu regereiywot eng' ooreet taban; ki koriich mestonok agobo anee.
Ki aleenji Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, “Inyee ko ii Kamuktaindennyu.” Epchi iit soomutikyuk che punu kutinnyu, ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kiptaiyandennyu, kimnateetap yetunennyu, ki ituch metinnyu eng' peetuutap lugeet.
Amegoochi kiptengeginik tuguuk che machei, ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor; ametoret konyoor magennyi ne ya; si ma yaigei koeegitu.
Ago ingotuch metowegap icheeget che yiema, yaityetap kutusweekwak.
Ingobutyi icheek ng'etetyot! ingewiirchi icheek rirosyek, si mata kong'eetyo kogeny.
Ma kigimiti chiito ne po ng'aleek che yaach eng' emet; cheeng'ei yaityet chiito ne koroom, si koterteer ineendet.
Angen ale toreti Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ng'aleegap ne kinyaliili, ak kiit ne nyoljin ineendet ne panani.
Iman, igoochin kongoi kaineng'ung' piik che po imanda; menyei taing'ung' che lititen.
Kaaguurin Kamuktaindet ne Toroor; chogu nyoonjo; epchi iit kutinnyu ye aguurin.
Ingotogosta saaennyu ko uu nyamdutik eng' taing'ung'; ingoigei eunekyuk che anamjini parak korosyot ne po koskoleny.
Nde riibindet kutinnyu, ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor; riip kurgeetap kutinnyu.
Ametokyi muguleldanyu kiy age tugul ne ya, koyai poisyonigap tengekto kobooto piik che yaei tengekto; amechamwo aam tuguukwak che anyiny.
Ingobira ne po iman, si koek nooto ne myee. Mechamji mwaita ne po kiptengeginik koiil metinnyu; amu ma metoi asa agirinda tengekwogikwak.
Ye ki kitoorta kirwoogikwak kong'irtae rwandet, kogas anyun kole anyinyen ng'aleekyuk.
Ko uu ye ibati chiito ng'wonyut ak kogereeri, ko uu nooto iseeroksei kawekyok eng' kutitap kererit.
Amu inyalin konyekyuk, ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kiptaiyandennyu; amang'un inyee; amegoochi saboondanyu konyalil.
Riibo si ma nama mesteet ne ki riich icheek agobo anee, ak mestonogap yaigap yaityo.
Ingobutyi kiptengeginik mestonokwak, ye achilili.
Ariirchini Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' kutinnyu; atwekyini Kamuktaindet ne Toroor aipchini soomennyu.
Aroong'jini tainnyi riirekyuk; aboortoi eng' tainnyi nyalildanyu.
Ye kingo tanui saboondanyu, inai ooreennyu. Kigouny icheek mesteet agobo anee eng' ooreet ne abune.
Kusyi kong' eunnyu ne po tai, ak igeer; amu ma mi chii ne ingeno; ki kobetwa ole amwechini, ma mi chii ne riibei saboondanyu.
Ariirchin inyee, ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor; ki amwa ale, “Ii oldanyu ole amwechini, ii kebebertanyu eng' emetap che saptos.”
Epchi iit riirekyuk, amu kinyerata miising'; sarwo eng' usiikyuk, amu kiimeen kosiiro.
Imoong'u saboondanyu eng' korgoreet, si aweekyi kongoi kaineng'ung'. Yiema che po iman komoswekyuk tugul, amu iyaiywo eng' aiyebindo.
Kas saaennyu, ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor! Epchi iit soomutikyuk, wolwo eng' imandang'ung' ak lititindang'ung'.
Amerwookyi otwogindeng'ung'; amu ma mi chii ne sabei ne kiityin imanda eng' taing'ung'.
Amu kigous puunyoot saboondanyu; kigokwer saboondanyu kobutyi ng'wony, kigo koono ameng'oot ole imen, ko uu che ki kobek keny.
Kigo tanui amu saboondanyu eng' oriit; kaek muguleldanyu kipkuberet eng' oriit.
Abwaatati peetuusyek che po keny; aruchinoti poisyoniguk tugul, aruchinoti poisyonigap euneguk.
Atokyinin eunekyuk; amei melelda saboondanyu agobo inyee ko uu emet ne yaamaat.
Chokyi wolwo, ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor; ichuchui saboondanyu. Ameung'ena togeng'ung'; si ma ige icheek che choorchingei keriinget.
Koono agas chamyeng'ung' ne tala karon; amu amang'un. Koono anai ooreet ne abune; amu atokyinin saboondanyu.
Sarwo, ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, eng' puunikyuk; amwechinin iunya.
Ineeta ayai mageng'ung'; amu inyee ko ii Kamuktaindennyu. Myee kabuuseng'ung'; ingondoiywa eng' emetap lititindo.
Isooba, ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, amu kaineng'ung'. Imoong'u saboondanyu eng' nyalilda amu imandang'ung'.
Ak ing'eti puunikyuk eng' chamyeng'ung' ne tala, ak ing'em icheek tugul che inyalili saboondanyu; amu aa kiboityondeng'ung'.
Iberuurot Kamuktaindet ne Toroor rwandennyu, ne ineeti eunekyuk lugeet, ak koneeti morikyuk pooryeet.
Ineendet chamyennyu ne tala ak irimennyu, teeksennyu ne kooi ak saruunindennyu; long'ennyu ak ineendet ne amang'u; ne igoochin piikyuk kogasa iit.
Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, tos nee chii kot inai? Anan weeriitap chii, ne tos iit ile kiy?
Kergei chii ak kiy puch; uu peetuusyekyik merumbet ne siirtoi.
Ing'uruuch kipsengwetisyeguk, ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ak ichooruge! Twa tuloonook, si koiyenso!
Iyookte kalyeleet, ak iyeste icheek; mwokte kipchaboniguk, ak inyaliil icheek.
Iyogou eung'ung' eng' parak; ityacha ak isarwo eng' peek che chaang', eng' eunegap toek;
che nyalili kutusweekwak tuguugap puch, ak eunekwak che po tai ko eunek che po lembech.
