Ago ki piit piik tamanu eng' kwenunnywa che ki mwachi Ishmael koleenji, amebarech: amu ki tinyei tuguuk che ki kiuny eng' mbar, nganuuk, ak baale, ak mwanik, ak kumyat. Kobagaakta anyun, mata kobar icheek eng' kwenutap tupchosyekwak.

Ki inyiit anyun Ishmael weeriitap Netania keriingonooto piik che kiga kebar, keriinget ne kiga kowiirchi Ishmael muuswek tugul che po piik che kiga kobar, ki wiirchi ole neegitee Gedalia (keriingonooto ko ne kibaalei laitoryat Asa amu ki iywei Baasha laitoryatap Israel).

Yeityo komut Ishmael piik tugul che ki ng'et eng' Mispa koek luulenik, agot tiibiigap laitoryat, kobooto piik tugul che ki ng'et eng' Mispa che kiga konde Nebusaradan kiptaiyatap riibiik eutap Gedalia weeriitap Aikam: ki imut Ishmael weeriitap Netania pichooto koek luulenik, ak koba kaplagogap Ammon.
Ago ye kingo kas Johanan weeriitap Karea ak kiptainik tugul che po lugoosyek che ki mi kobooto ineendet, yaityet tugul ne kiga koyai Ishmael weeriitap Netania,
komut anyun piik tugul, koba kobargei ak Ishmael weeriitap Netania, ak kinyoorchi ineendet ole neegitee peek che chaang' che mi Gibeon.
Kingo keer anyun piik tugul che ki mi kobooto Ishmael Johanan weeriitap Karea, ak kiptainik tugul che po lugoosyek, che ki mi kobooto ineendet, kogaskei anyun miising'.
Kiwelelgei anyun piik tugul che kiga komut Ishmael eng' Mispa koek luulenik, koweek koba ole mi Johanan weeriitap Karea.
Ago kichilil Ishmael weeriitap Netania eng' Johanan kobooto piikyik sisiit, ak koba kaplagogap Ammon.

Komut anyun Johanan weeriitap Karea ak kiptainik tugul che po lugoosyek che ki mi kobooto ineendet, piik tugul che ki ng'et eng' piik che kiga koweech ineendet eng' Ishmael weeriitap Netania, eng' Mispa, ye kingo kagobar Gedalia weeriitap Aikam, piigap lugeet, ak kwonyiik, ak lagok, ak kiptainik che kiga komut kogeny eng' Gibeon:
ak ki pa komeny Gerut Kimham, ne mi ole neegitee Bethlehem, si kobiit koba agoi Misiri,
amu Kaldeik: amu ki iywei icheek, amu kiga kobar Ishmael weeriitap Netania, Gedalia weeriitap Aikam, ne ki inde laitoryatap Babilon koek pounindetap emet.
Ki riik anyun kiptainik tugul che po lugoosyek, ak Johanan weeriitap Karea, ak Jesania weeriitap Hosaia, ak piik tugul kong'etee ne ming'in agoi ne oo,

ak koleenji maotyot Jeremiah, Kisoomin keele, kaswech soomennyo, ak saiywech Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindeng'ung', acheek tugul che ki king'etu; amu ki king'etu piik che ng'ering' eng' piik che chaang', ko uu ye igeerech:
si kobiit koboorwech Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindeng'ung' ooreet ne kanyool kebendatee, ak kiit ne kanyool keyai.

Koleenji anyun `maotyot Jeremiah icheek, Kaagasak; ogeero, asaae Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindeng'wong' ko uu ng'aleekwok; ak kiit age tugul ne wolwok Kamuktaindet ne Toroor amwaiwok kioto; ma ung'enok kiy.

Ki mwachi anyun `icheek Jeremiah koleenji, ingoek Kamuktaindet ne Toroor paoryat ne po iman ak ko ne kiyani eng' kwenunnyo, ngot koma ki yai ko uu ng'olyoot age tugul ne kaiyogunenen Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindeng'ung' iibwech.

Ngo ng'olyoo ne myee, anan ngo ne ya, kegase iit kutitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindennyo, ne kiyooktochinin; si kobiit komyeeit eng' acheek, ye ki kas iit kutitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindennyo.
Ak kingo pata peetuusyek tamanu, konyonji `ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Jeremiah.
Ki kuur anyun ineendet Johanan weeriitap Karea, ak kiptainik tugul che po lugoosyek che ki mi kobooto ineendet ak piik tugul kong'etee ne ming'in agoi ne oo,
ak koleenji icheek, Mwaei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindetap Israel ne ki oyooktocha aip soomeng'wong' kwo tainnyi, kole:
Ngot kota omeny emoni, ateechok anyun, ama abutok, ak aminak, ama atutok: amu kaawal kabwaatutikyuk eng' yaityet ne koayaiywok.
Amoiywei laitoryatap Babilon, ne oiywei; amoiywei ineendet, mwaei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor: amu ami kobootok, si asarwok, ak atyachak eng' eunnyi.
Ak agoonok rireenet, si kobiit koriirenak ineendet ak kogoonok oweege obe emeng'wong'.
Ago ngot omwa ole, Ma ki menye emoni; kot ko mogas iit kutitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindeng'wong',
omwae oleen, Achicha; kibendi emetap Misiri, ole ma kigeere lugeet, ama kigase iryageet, ama amech rubeet; ak kemeny olooto:

ogas anyun ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ee okweek che ki ong'etu che oo po Judah; mwaei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne po lugoosyek, Kamuktaindetap Israel, kole ngot ogiiljige otokyigei Misiri, ak obe otebee olooto;
konamak anyun eng' olooto, eng' emetap Misiri, rotwetap chok ne oiywei, ak kosubok rubeet ne oiywei koriichak eng' olooto eng' Misiri; ak obekyi olooto.

Igeitu nooto eng' piik tugul che tokyingei Misiri kobendi kotebee olooto; pegu eng' rotwetap chok ak eng' rubeet, ak eng' koroito: ak ma mi agot agenge eng' icheek ne ng'etu anan ne chilili eng' yaityet ne aipchini.

Amu mwaei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne po lugoosyek, Kamuktaindetap Israel, ko uu ni kole; Ko uu ye kigeroong'ji nereegekyuk ak nereegekyuk che ng'woneen, piik che menyei Jerusalem, keroong'jinok anyun ko uu nooto nereegekyuk che ng'woneen, ye obe Misiri: ak oegu che kichubei, ak che kikwong'ee ak che kisasei, ak che kichotei; ama ogeere olito kogeny.
Kagong'alaal Kamuktaindet ne Toroor agobo okweek, ee okweek che ki ong'etu che oo po Judah, kole amobe Misiri: onai komyee ole kaabaoryanwok rani.

Amu ki oyachi kaberberisyet saboonwekwok; amu ki oyookto awo ye mi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindeng'wong', ole, Saiywech Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindennyo; ak imwaiwech ko uu tugul che mwaei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindennyo, si keyai:
ak kaamwaiwok ng'aleechooto rani; ago ma ogas iit kutitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindeng'wong' eng' kiy age tugul ne kogoyogunena amwaiwok.
Onai anyun komyee ole, obegu eng' rotwetap chok, ak eng' rubeet, ak eng' koroito, eng' ole omache obe otebee.

Ak ye kingo kagogees Jeremiah ng'alaalet ne ki ng'alaaljin piik tugul ng'aleek tugul che po Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindennywa, che kiga koyooktoe Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindennywa ineendet komwachi icheek ng'aleechooto tugul,

komwa anyun Azariah weeriitap Hosaia, ak Johanan weeriitap Karea, ak piik tugul che meniotin, koleenji Jeremiah, “Imwae lembech. Ma iyogun Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindennyo inyoo imwa ile, ‘Mobendi Misiri otebee olooto’;
ago kaiberberin Baruk weeriitap Neriah si kogirindech, si kobiit kondeech eutap Kaldeik, si kobarech, ak komutech keebe Babilon keegu luulenik. ”
Ma kas iit anyun kutitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Johanan weeriitap Karea, ak kiptainik tugul che po lugoosyek, ak piik tugul, si kobiit komeny emetap Judah.
Ago ki imut Johanan weeriitap Karea ak kiptainik tugul che po lugoosyek piik tugul che ki ng'et che ki po Judah, che ki weeksei kobunu pororyosyek tugul ole kiga ki oonji, kobwa kotebee Judah;

murenik, ak kwonyiik, ak lagok ak tiibiigap laitoryat, ak chii age tugul ne kiga kobagaach Nebusaradan kiptaiyatap riibiik kobagakyi Gedalia weeriitap Aikam, weeriitap Sapan, ak maotyot Jeremiah, ak Baruk weeriitap Neriah;
ak kiit emetap Misiri; amu ki ma kas iit kutitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor: ak ki pwa agoi Tapanes.
Yeityo konyonji `ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Jeremiah eng' Tapanes, koleenji,
Nam koik che eecheen, ak iung'e matubaruuk oriit eng' ole kiyae matubaruuk, ne mi ole kibunei kebendi kootap Pharaoh eng' Tapanes, kogeerei piigap Judah;

ak ileenji icheek, Mwaei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne po lugoosyek, Kamuktaindetap Israel, kole: Ogeero, ayooktoi kimut Nebukadresar laitoryatap Babilon, otwogindennyu, ak ande ng'echerennyi ne po laitornatet paragutap koichu kaauny; ak koiitae paragutap koichooto emainnyi ne po laitornatet.
Ak konyo kobar emetap Misiri; che po meet kobendi meet, ak che po luuleet, kobendi luuleet, ak che po rotwetap chok, kobendi rotwetap chok.
Ak alaal maat eng' kooriigap kanamonigap Misiri; ak kobeel ineendet kanamonichooto, ak koip: ak kolaach emetap Misiri, ko uu ye ilaachi mestowot ngoryennyi; ak kwo eng' olooto eng' kaalyeet.
Putei kogeny tolochigap Beth-shemesh, ne mi emetap Misiri; ak kobeel kooriigap kanamonigap Misiri.
Ki nyoonji ng'olyoot Jeremiah agobo Yahudik tugul che ki menyei emetap Misiri, che ki menyei Migdok, ak Tapanes, ak Nop, ak emetap Patros, koleenji,

Mwaei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne po lugoosyek, Kamuktaindetap Israel, ko uu ni kole: Ki ogeer yaityet tugul ne ki apchi Jerusalem, ak nganasook tugul che po Judah; ak ogeero, karatwek rani nganasochooto, ama mi chii ne menyei olooto;
amu yaityennywa ne ki koyai kotacha anereech, amu ki pa kobeel nyamdutik, koot kamuktaik che ki ma kongen, icheeget, anan okweek, anan kwanisyekwok.
Ago ki ayookwok otwogikyuk tugul, che maotik, ang'eete karon miising' ak ayoogu, aleenjinok, “Amat oyai kiito samis ne aweche.”
Ago ma kas, anan koep iit si kobiit koweek kometo yaityennywa, si mata kobeelji nyamdutik kamuktaik che teer.
Kirong'kei anyun nereegekyuk che ng'woneen, ak kong'waanityi nganasoogap Judah ak eng' ortinwek che po Jerusalem; ak ki koek karatwek ak kigoguber ko uu kiit ne uu peetuusyechu.

Mwaei anyun Kamuktaindet ne po Toroornatet ne po lugoosyek, Kamuktaindetap Israel, kole: Amu nee si oyachi saboonwekwok yaityoni oo, si kobiit kigeesunenok muren ak kwony, lakwa ak ne reryei, komong' eng' Judah, si ma ng'etwok agot agenge;
amu otagena poisyonigap eunekwok, obeeljini nyamdutik kamuktaik eng' emetap Misiri, ole ki obe otebee; si kobiit kigeswok, ak oegu che kisasei ak che kichotei eng' pororyosyek tugul che po ng'wony?

Tos ki outye yaitwogigap kwanisyekwok, ak yaitwogigap laitorinigap Judah, ak yaitwogigap osotikwak, ak yaitwogikwok, ak yaitwogigap osotikwok, che ki yai eng' emetap Judah, ak eng' ortinwegap Jerusalem?
Ma iming'ingei agoi rani, anan koiyweis, anan kobendatee ng'atuutikyuk, anan kayomisutikyuk, che ki ande taing'wong', ak eng' taitap kwanisyekwok.
Mwaei anyun Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne po lugoosyek, Kamuktaindetap Israel, kole: Ogeero, atokyinok togeennyu aibwok yaityet, agoi ageesu Judah tugul.

Ak anam che ng'etu che po Judah, che kitokyigei emetap Misiri, koba kotebee olooto, ak kigeesu icheek tugul: ibutos eng' emetap Misiri; kigeesu icheek eng' rotwetap chok ak eng' rubeet; pegu icheek, kong'etee ne ming'in agoi ne oo, eng' rotwetap chok ak eng' rubeet: ak koek che kichubei, ak che kikwong'ee, ak che kisasei, ak che kichotei.
Amu abire icheek che menyei emetap Misiri, ko uu ye ki abir Jerusalem, eng' rotwetap chok, ak eng' rubeet, ak eng' koroito;

kot koma chilil anan kong'et agot agenge eng' che kiga ng'et che po Judah, che ki pa emetap Misiri, kotebee olooto, kole koweek kobwa emetap Judah, emet ne machei kole koweekyigei koba komeny: amu ma piitu ne weechigei kobatee ne chilili.

Ki wol anyun murenik tugul che ki ingen kole kibeeljin osotikwak nyamdutik kamuktaik che teer, ak kwonyiik tugul che kitonondos eng' ole neegit, che kituiyet ne oo, agot piik tugul che ki menyei emetap Misiri, eng' Patros, kowolji Jeremiah koleenji,
Ma kigasun ng'olyoondonooto kemwaiwech eng' kainetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.

Ago kiyae iman ng'olyoot age tugul ne kagemwa, keele kibeeljini nyamdutik laitoryatap kipsengwet, ne kwondo, ak keroong'jini ineendet kagoochinoik che kieei, ko uu ye ki keyai, acheek ak kwanisyekyok ak laitorinikyok, ak pounikyok, eng' nganasoogap Judah, ak eng' ortinwek che po Jerusalem: amu ki kitinye eng' peetuusyechooto amitwogik che chaang', ak ki kichamegei, ama ki keer yeityo.
Ago kobooch ngap kebagaakte kebeelji nyamdutik laitoryatap kipsengwet ne kwondo, ak keroong'jini kagoochinoik che kieei, korarwech tuguuk tugul, ak kigeswech eng' rotwetap chok ak rubeet.

Ak ye ki kibeeljini nyamdutik laitoryatap kipsengwet ne kwondo, ak keroong'jini kagoochinoik che kieei, tos ma kikwang'kwang'ji magatiinik che kilasune ineendet, ak keroong'ji kagoochinoik che kieei, koma pooto manong'otaikyok?
Ki mwachi anyun Jeremiah piik tugul, murenik, ak kwonyiik, agot piik tugul che kiga kowolji, koleenji,

Tos ki ma ibwaat `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor icheek ama chut metinnyi, nyamdutik che ki obeele eng' nganasoogap Judah, ak eng' ortinwek che po Jerusalem, okweek ak kwanisyekwok, laitorinikwok, ak pounikwok, ak piigap emet,

kot ko mata komuuch Kamuktaindet ne Toroor komuita, amu yaityetap poisyonikwok, ak amu tuguuk che kiwechei che ki oyai? Ki ek anyun emeng'wong' ne kuberot, ak ne kikwong'ee, ak ne kisasei, ama menyei chii, ko uu ye uu rani.

Amu ki obeel nyamdutik, ak amu ki oyachi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor tengekto, ama ogas iit kutitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, anan obendate ng'atuutikyik, anan kayomisutikyik, anan paornatosyekyik; konyonjok anyun yaityoni ko uu ye uu rani.
Ki mwachi kogeny `Jeremiah piik tugul, kobooto kwonyiik tugul, koleenji: Ogas ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, okweek Judah tugul che omi emetap Misiri:

Mwaei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne po lugoosyek, Kamuktaindetap Israel, ko uu ni kole, ki omwa eng' kutusweekwok, okweek kobooto osotikwok, ak oyai kosulda, eng' eunekwok, oleen, Kiyae iman kaarorunosyek che ki kiaroru, kebeelji nyamdutik laitoryatap kipsengwet ne kwondo, ak keroong'ji kagoochinoik che kieei: ogimiit anyun kaarorunosyekwok, ak oyai kaarorunosyekwok.

Ogas anyun ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, okweek piigap Judah tugul che omenye emetap Misiri: Ogeero, koayosye eng' kainennyu ne oo, mwaei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ale, ma komwaei kainennyu chii age tugul ne po Judah eng' emet tugul ne po Misiri, kole, ko uu ye sabei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ogeero, ariibe icheek agobo yaityet, ma agobo ne myee: ak kigeesu murenik tugul che po Judah che mi emetap Misiri, eng' rotwetap chok ak eng' rubeet, agoi kogeskei.

Ak koweigei icheek che chililee rotwetap chok komong' eng' emetap Misiri, kobwa Judah, che ng'ering'; ak konai tugul che ki kong'et che po Judah, che ki pa emetap Misiri koba kotebee olooto, kole ng'olyootap ng'oo ne isuldoi, nenyu anan nenywa.
Ak ni kaboorunet eng' okweek, mwaei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ale kabirok eng' olito, si onai ole isuldoi iman ng'aleekyuk koibwok yaityet:

Mwaei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Ogeero, andoi Pharaoh Hopra laitoryatap Misiri, eutap puunikyik, ak eutap icheeget che cheeng'ei saboondanyi; ko uu ye ki ande Zedekiah laitoryatap Judah, eutap Nebukadresar laitoryatap Babilon, punyondennyi, ak ko ne ki cheeng'ei saboondanyi.
Ki mwachi `maotyot Jeremiah Baruk weeriitap Neriah, ng'olyoot ye kisirchin bukuit ng'aleechu komwaei Jeremiah, eng' kenyiitap ang'wan ne po Jehoiakim weeriitap Josiah laitoryatap Judah, koleenji,
Mwaun Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindetap Israel, inyee ee Baruk, ko uu ni kole:
Ki imwa ile, pwo eng' anee! Amu kagotesyi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor arageneet ng'wanindanyu; kaang'et amu tigenoikyuk, amanyooru kamuung'et.
Mwachi anyun ineendet ko uu ni, ileenji, mwaei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ko uu ni kole: Keero, abute ne ki ateech, ak atutu ne ki amin; ak ayae niito eng' emet komugul.

Ko tos, icheeng'jinigei inyee tuguuk che eecheen? Amecheeng': amu, keero, aipchini yaityet piik tugul, mwaei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor: ago agoonin saboondang'ung' koek luuleneng'ung' eng' komoswek tugul ole iwendi.
Ki nyoonji maotyot Jeremiah ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor agobo pororyosyek.

Ng'aleegap Misiri: agobo lugeetap Pharaoh-neko laitoryatap Misiri, ne ki mi ole neegitee aineet Yufrets eng' Karkemish, ne ki par Nebukadresar laitoryatap Babilon eng' kenyiitap ang'wan ne po Jehoiakim weeriitap Josiah, laitoryatap Judah.
Ochop long'onik che mengech ak che eecheen ak ooriikyi lugeet.
Ochop paraisisyek ak olaany, okweek che olaanye paraisisyek, ak otononse ko kaolaach chepkuloikwak che po lugeet; osit ng'otwek, ak olaach ngoroigap lugeet.
Amu nee si ageere ko uu nooto? Aragendos ak koweechegei let; kagetuatui piikwak che kiimeen, ak kagomwei kochaakta, ama kusegong': mi kamuiset komosta age tugul, mwaei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Amat komwei ne chepchep, anan kochilil chiito ne nyigan; ki konachkei ak kobutyo eng' murot kaataam ne po ole neegitee aineetap Yufrets.
Ng'oo ni ng'eetei ko uu aineet, ne wasegei peekyik ko uu ainoosyek?
Ng'eetei Misiri ko uu aineet, ak wasegei peekyik ko uu ainoosyek: ak leen, Ang'eete ak atuch emet; ang'eme nganaseet ak piik che menyei olooto.
Otogoste, okweek, paraisisyek; ak ochakte okweek, kariigap lugeet; ak ingoba piik che nyigoonen: Kush ak Put, che tinyei long'onik; ak Ludik, che tinyei kwangok ak kong'iei.

Amu po peetuunooto Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne po lugoosyek, peetuutap yaaktaetap mugetuut, si koyaaktoochi ineendet mugetuut eng' puunikyik: ak koamis rotwetap chok ak kobiyo, ak koeei korotiikwak kobiyo: amu tinyei Kiptaiyat, Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne po lugoosyek, tiseiywot eng' emetap murot kaataam ole neegitee aineetap Yufrets.
Togoste Gilead ak iip mwanik che kinyaise, ee pergeiyandani, cheptap Misiri: iboisyee kerichek che chaang' puch; mesabe.
Ki kogas pororyosyek agobo teweernateng'ung', ak kigonyi emoni riireguk: amu kagonach chiito ne nyigan ne nyigan, kagobutyo tuwai.
Ni ng'olyoot ne ki mwachi `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor maotyot Jeremiah, kole nyoonei Nebukadresar laitoryatap Babilon ak kobar emetap Misiri.
Omwaite eng' Misiri, ak obarte eng' Migdol, ak obarte eng' Nop ak eng' Tapanes: oleenji, Otononse, ochopkei; amu kagoamis rotwetap chok eng' tabanweguk.
Amu nee si kibukto cheguuk che kiimeen? Ma tononso, amu ki oon Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ki riich che chaang', ee, ki ibutyi age paragutap age: ak ki le, Ong'eetyee, ongebe kogeny oldap piikyok, agoi emet ne ki kisikyinech kemwee rotwetap chok ne usiisyei.
Kiwookyo eng' olooto kole polateet kityo Pharaoh laitoryatap Misiri; ki kobagakta kosiirto peetuut ne kiga kichop.
Mwaei Laitoryat ne kainennyi ko Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne po lugoosyek, kole, Ko uu ye asabe, nyoonei iman ineendet ko uu Tabor eng' tuloonook, ak ko uu Karmel eng' ole neegitee nyanjet.
Ee inyee chepto ne imenye Misiri, monorsechigei si iwe keluulin: amu egu Nop karaatya, ak kebeel, ama mi chii ne menyei.
Rooryat ne karaaran miising' Misiri; ago kagonyo ng'emisyet ne punu murot kaataam, kagonyo.
Uu kogeny piikyik che kesirei che mi kwenunnyi moek che neryootiin; amu kagoweigei let ak icheek, kagomwei tugul, ma tononso: amu kanyonji icheek peetuutap nyalildanywa, peetuut ne kibirei.
Wendi kutinnyi ko uu ereneet; amu pendi ak lugeet, ak kobookyine ineendet aonok, ko uu piik che ebei keetiik.
Iluuli osnennyi, mwaei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, agot ngo ma kimuuchi kisyach; amu chaang' kosiir chereng'enyinik, ama iitoksei.
Kiteweeri cheptap Misiri; kindoi eutap piigap murot kaataam.

Mwaei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne po lugoosyek, Kamuktaindetap Israel, kole: Ogeero, abire Ammon ne po No, ak Pharaoh, ak Misiri, kobooto kamuktaikyik, ak laitorinikyik; chooto ko Pharaoh ak icheeget che imang'u ineendet:
ak andoi icheek eutap icheeget che cheeng'ei saboonwekwak, ak eutap Nebukadresar laitoryatap Babilon, ak eutap otwogikyik; ye ibata kemeny ko uu peetuusyek che po keny, mwaei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.

Ago meiywei, ee Jakobo otwogindennyu, anan iaragen, ee Israel; amu, keero, asaruun eng' ole loo, ak asaru iyoteng'ung' eng' emet ne ki kiluulji; ak koweek Jakobo, ak komuuny ak kotebee kaalyeet, ama mi chii ne imui.
Meiywei, ee Jakobo otwogindennyu, mwaei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor; amu ami kobooten: amu ageesu pororyosyek tugul che kigaonjin, ago magesun; ago atigoonin eng' kirwooget, amabagaaktoin ama kibirin.
Ki nyoonji `ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor maotyot Jeremiah agobo Philistik, kotomo kobar Pharaoh Gaza.

Mwaei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Ogeero, Tesoksei peek kobunu murot kaataam kot koek kereruut aineet ne chwaldoi, ak kochwalda emet ak tugul che mi olooto, nganaseet kobooto che menyei olooto: ak koriiryo murenik, ak kowaakyo piik tugul che menyei emet.

Ye kas kirgirenetap keelyegap paraisisyegap piikyik che kiimeen, eng' rwaetap kariisyekyik che po lugeet, eng' cheetap keelyegap kariisyekyik, magusyin kong' kwanisyek lagokwak amu nyalulnatetap eunek;
amu peetuut ne nyoonei koluulei Philistik tugul, si koisto eng' Tyro ak Sidon toretindet age tugul ne ng'etu: amu luulei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Philistik, che ki ng'et che po ngeguutap Kaptor.
Kanyonji Gaza poosto; kagiges Askelon, che ki ng'et che po atebweetap Mediterenian: iriire ak itei kot kotyanit?
Ee, inyee rotwetap chok ne po Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, tyanitu si tuun isiis? Weekyigei chogeng'ung'; imuuny, ak isiis.
Imuktoi ano isiis, igeere ile ki kong'atin Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ibar Askelon, ak ngeguutap nyanjet? Ki kong'at ko uu nooto.
Ng'aleegap Moab: Mwaei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne po lugoosyek, Kamuktaindetap Israel, kole: Pwo eng' Nebo! Amu kagoek karaatya; kagiteweer Kiriataim, kageluul: kagiteweer Miskap, kagebut.
Ma komi kalasunetap Moab; Ki kochop yaityet eng' Hesbon agobo emonooto, ne mwaei koleen, Nyoo kigeesu si ma koegu pororyet kogeny. Agot inyee, ee Madmen, kigoonin isiis; onin rotwetap chok.
Kutitap riirek ne punu Horonaim, luuleet ak ng'emisyet ne oo!
Kageng'em Moab; kagoriiryo lagokyik kot kegas.
Amu togostoi ole kitogostoe ne po Luhit koriiryoti kotugul; amu ki kogas pichiindap riiregap ng'emisyet eng' ole kichoortoegei ne po Horonaim.
Omwei, osaru saboonwekwok, ak oige sondiit eng' surkwen.
Amu-i, kiluulin aginye, amu kaimang'u poisyoniguk ak konoraiguk: ak keluul Kemos, kobooto tisiikyik ak pounikyik.
Ak nyoonjin luulindet nganaseet age tugul, ama mi nganaseet ne chilili; lusei kogeny atebweet, ak keng'emei warenget; ko uu ye kagomwa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Igoochi Moab kebebaik, si kobiit kotiriren komwei: ak koek nganasookyik karatwek, ne ma mi chii ne menyei.
Chuboot ineendet ne machuuljingei poisyetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ak chuboot ineendet ne etee rotwennyi po chok korotiik.

Kigotebee Moab kaalyeet kobooch ming'inatennyi, ki kotepto kimnateennyi ko uu divaik che mi ak misigiikyik, che tomo kerong' eng' tereet age koba tereet age: ak tomo keluul: ta kotinyei anyun amu nooto anyinyindanyi, ak tomo kowalak ng'uunennyi.
Ogeer anyuno, pwoonei peetuusyek, mwaei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, che ayookyini ineendet piik che rong'u, ak koranda ineendet; ak korong' kogeskei eng' tereenikyik, ak kotui sotonikwak.
Ak kolilaan Moab amu Kemos, ko uu ye ki ililan kootap Israel agobo Bethel, ne ki imang'u.
Omuktoi ano omwa ole, ki murenik che nyigoonen, ak ko ki murenik che kiimeen eng' lugeet?
Kigong'emak Moab, ki kotogosta icheek nganasookyik, kigoba parisyet murenikyik che ki kilewen, mwaei Laitoryat, ne kainennyi ko Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne po lugoosyek.
Kariikyi Moab nyalildanywa, ak chogu usiisyennyi.
Oriirchi ineendet okweek tugul che omi ole neegitee ineendet, ak okweek tugul che ongen kainennyi; omwa ole, Katepto ano si koil kirokto ne kiim, kirokto ne karaaran!
Ee inyee chepto ne itebee Dibon, chooruge eng' toroornateng'ung', ak itebi eng' melelda; amu kagopookyin ng'emindetap Moab, kagong'em irimoiguk.
Ee inyee ne imenye Aroer, tonon eng' ooreet taban, ak itoben: teebee ne mweei, ak chepto ne chilili; ileenji, kageyai nee?
Kagiteweer Moab; amu kagebut: owaach ak oriirye; omwaite eng' Arnon, ole, Kageng'em Moab.
Ak kagonyonji kirwooget warenget; kanyonji Holon, Jasa, ak Mepaat;
ak Dibon, Nebo, ak Beth-diblataim;
ak Kiriataim, Beth-gamul, ak Beth-meon;
ak Keryot, Bosra, ak nganasook tugul che po emetap Moab, che looen ak che neegit.
Kageisto kuinetap Moab, ak kagoil eunnyi, mwaei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ogoochi ineendet kobogit; amu ki kotoroorgei kogirinda Kamuktaindet ne Toroor; ak mildoegei Moab kang'undaekyik, ak kerorechin.
Tos ma ek Israel eng' inyee ne kirorechin? Tos ki kinyoor komi ak chooriik? Amu kotugul ye ing'alaali agobo ineendet, ilelechi metit.
Ee okweek che omenye kebenonik; ak oige cheptuget ne teechei keswennyi eng' tabanwegap kurgeetap kebeneet.
Kigegas menoteetap Moab, keele, menot miising'; kaetetapkei, ak menatennyi, ak kachaunennyi pogei, ak losennyi pogei.
Angen nereegekyik, mwaei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ale puch; ma yai kiy kachaunaikyik pogei.
Awaache anyun agobo Moab; ee, ariirchini miising' Moab tugul: amu iteeitos icheek agobo piigap Kir-heres.
Ariirchinin eng' riirek che siirei che po Jaser, ee keetitap sabibuk ne po Sibma: kagolandae nyanjet temeniguk, kiit nyanjetap Jaser: kagonam luuloindet logoeguk che po kemei, ak ole kitue sabibuk.

Ak kageisto kagasetapkei ak poiboiyet, eng' mbareet ne rurei kot ak eng' emetap Moab; ak kaagoochi kogeskei divaik eng' ole kituisye: ma mi ne tyechei eng' waagaatap kagasetapkei; ma egu waagandanooto waagaatap kagasetapkei.
Kagotwek icheek kobooch riiregap Hesbon agoi Eleale, kot koit Jahas, kobooch Zoar agoi Horonaim, agoi Eglat-Selesiya: amu teng'dos peegap Nimrim.
Ageesu kogeny eng' Moab, mwaei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ineendet ne igoitoi koroseek eng' ole toroor, ak ineendet ne peeljin nyamdutik kanamonikyik.
Cheei anyun muguleldanyu agobo Moab ko uu ndurerusyek, ak kocheei muguleldanyu ko uu ndurerusyek agobo piigap Kir-heres: kagobetyo anyun chaang'indap tuguuk che kiga konyoor.
Amu churat metit age tugul, ak kigetil tamnet age tugul: mi eunek tugul perutik che ki kitilei, ak kogermenegei kuniok.
Mi kateiyasyek kooriik tugul parak che po Moab ak eng' komosta age tugul eng' ortinwekyik: amu ki atui Moab ko uu tereet ne ma kiboiboitune, mwaei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Kitepto ano si koyie! Iteitoi ano icheek! Katepto ano si kotukta patai Moab eng' kalilanet! Egu anyun Moab ne kirorechin ak koek ne kwong'ee icheek tugul che mi tabanwekyik.
Amu mwaei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole, ogeero, tirireni ko uu kipsiichit, ak kouito kebebaikyik kotokyi Moab.
Kageluul Keryot, ak kageche irimoikyik, ak koigei mugulelwegap piik che nyigoonen che po Moab, eng' peetuunooto, muguleldap kwondo ne tinyei ng'wanindo ye machei kosigiis.
Ak keng'em Moab si ma koegu pororyet, amu ki kotoroorgei kogirinda Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Kabwonjin kaiyweisyet, ak keriinget, ak mesteet, ee inyee ne imenye Moab, mwaei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ibutyin keriinget, ne mwee kaiyweisyet; ak konam mesteet ne togosune keriinget: ak aipchini ineendet, nooto ko Moab, kenyiit ne aityini ineendet pireet, mwaei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.

Tonondos che mweei ama tinyei kimnateet eng' urwetap Hesbon: amu kamang'une maat Hesbon, ak kamang'une liplibenetap maat, Sihon, ak kagobeel luuitap Moab, ak metowekwak parak che po icheek che poldos.
Pwo! Inyee, ee Moab! Kagogeskei piigap Kemos: amu kageluul weeriiguk, ak kageluul tiibiiguk.
Ago aweechi kogeny luulenigap Moab eng' peetuusyek che po let, mwaei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor. Tee nooto anyun kirwoogetap Moab.
Ng'aleegap lagogap Ammon: Mwaei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Tos ma tinyei Israel weeriik? Ma tinyei ne namei tuguukyik? Amu nee anyun si konam Malkam Gad kobunji, ak komeny piikyik nganasookyik?

Ogeer anyuno, pwoonei peetuusyek, mwaei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ne aibu waagaatap lugeet kegas agobo Rabbah ne po lagogap Ammon; ak koek karaatya ne irurugot, ak kebeel tiibiikyik: konam anyun Israel kobunji, icheek che kiga konam ineendet, mwaei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Waach, ee Hesbon, amu kageluul Ai; oriirye, okweek tiibiigap Rabbah, ogermenegei kuniok: oteiye, ak orwaate eng' ng'otonok; amu kiluulei Malkam, kobooto tisiikyik ak pounikyik.
Amu nee anyun si itoroorge eng' atebwosyek, atebweng'ung' ne rootei, ee chepto ne ichuchuchegei let? Ne ki imang'u konoraikyik, ileen, Nyonjino ng'oo?

Ogeero, aibun kaiyweisyet, mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne po lugoosyek, eng' icheek tugul che mi tabanweguk; ak keonak, komanda chii age tugul, ama piitu chii ne iyumi ineendet ne ombenoti.
Ago ye ibata aweegu kogeny che kigeluul che po lagogap Ammon, mwaei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ng'aleegap Edom: Mwaei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne po lugoosyek ko uu ni, kole: Tos ma komi utaatyet eng' Teman? Tos ki kobet kirwooget eng' che ng'oomen? Tos ki kobek ng'omnatennywa?
Omwei, oweege, oung'egei ole ma taagu, ee okweek che omenye Dedan; amu aipchini ineendet nyalildap Esau, eng' peetuut ne aityini ineendet pireet.
Ngot kobwonjin kayumigap sabibuk, ko tos ma pagaachi turoonigap sabibuk? Ngot kobwonjin chooriik kemoi, ko tos ma parisyei kot konyoor che yamei?
Ago ki ayai Esau koek ne ma tinyei kiy, ki ang'aany komoswekyik che po ung'oot, ama komuuchi kounygei: kigeng'em iyotennyi, ak tupchosyekyik, ak piigap kokwennyi, ama komi ineendet.
Pagakte lagoguk che ma tinyei kwanisyek, si ariip kosapcho; ak ingomang'wa mosogiguk.
Amu mwaei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Ogeero, eeisei iman che ki ma ko nenywa koeise kigombet; ak tos ii ne chilili si ma kibirin? Mechilili, kibirin, ago iee iman.
Amu ki ayosyechigei, mwaei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ale, Egu Bosra ne kikwong'ee; ne kichotei, ak karaatya, ak ne kisasei; ak koek nganasookyik tugul karatwek kotugul.
Koagas ng'aleek che punu Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ak kagiyookto chiito kwo pororyosyek, koleenji, oyumgei, ak opookyi, ak ong'eetyee oyai lugeet.
Amu, keero, ki ayain iegu ne ming'in eng' pororyosyek, ak iegu ne sasei piik.

Ago ki koberberin menoteetap muguleldang'ung', amu kamuiseng'ung', ee inyee ne imenye ole kibetak eng' rwandet, ne iname walitap tulweet: nganda iteeche kesweng'ung' eng' parak ko uu kipsiichit, arorogun eng' olooto, mwaei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ak egu Edom ne kikwong'ee: kwong'ei age tugul ne siirtoi eng' yooto, ak koreeny korotwekyik tugul.
Ko uu ye ki kigabui Sodom ak Gomorah ak nganasook che kineegite olooto, mwaei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ma menyei chii olooto, ama tebee olooto lakwa ne po chii.

Ogeero, togosu ineendet ko uu ng'etundo kobunu Jordan ko kanyi peek miising' kobargei ak meng'ooteet ne kiim: ago achee, aoone komwei ineendet; ak age tugul ne kileweni, agoochini koboi ineendet: amu ng'oo ne kegerge? Ak ng'oo ne ng'atwa peetuut? Ak ng'oo mestowot ne tononi eng' tainnyu?

Ogas anyun kirwoogetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne ki koyachi Edom; ak chobutikyik che ki kochop agobo piik che menyei Teman: ichuuti icheek iman, che mengeechen che po akweetap keechiirek; yaei iman meng'ootennywa koek karaatya agobo icheek.
Potani ng'wony amu cheetap kabutennywa; mi waagaat, ne kegasei cheennyi eng' Araraita ne Piriir.

Ogeero, togosu ineendet ak kotirireni ko uu kipsiichit, ak kouito kebebaikyik kotokyi Bosra: ak koigei eng' peetuunooto mugulelwegap piik che nyigoonen che po Edom, muguleldap kwondo ne tinyei ng'wanindo ye machei kosigiis.
Ng'aleegap Damasko. Kagolilan Hamath, ak Arpad; amu kogogas ng'aleek che yaach, kogotanuiso: mi arageneet nyanjet; ma imuuchi kosiis.
Kogonyalul Damasko, kawelelgei komwei, kanam ineendet potanet: kanam ineendet pichiindo ak aragenosyek, ko uu kwondo ye machei kosigiis.
Katepto ano si ma kimeto nganaseetap kalasunet, nganaseetap poiboiyennyu!
Ibutos anyun neranikyik eng' ortinwekyik, ak kigoochin kosiisyo murenik tugul che po lugeet eng' peetuunooto, mwaei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne po lugoosyek.
Ak anaam maat eng' irimeetap Damasko, ak kobeel kooriigap laitoryat, che po Ben-Hadad.
Ng'aleegap Kedar ak che po pounatosyegap Hasor, che ki par Nebukadresar laitoryatap Babilon. Mwaei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Ong'eetyee, otogoste Kedar, ak oluul lagogap kong'asiis.
Luulei emaisyekwak ak akwotisyekwak che po keechiirek; ak koluul angookwak kobunji, ak tereenikwak tugul, ak tambeesikwak: ak kowaakyi, koleenji, mi kamuiset komosta age tugul.

Omwei, oombenote oba ole loo, oung'egei ole ma taagu, ee okweek che omenye Hasor, mwaei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor; amu kairwooch Nebukadresar laitoryatap Babilon agobo okweek, ak kagobwaat ng'olyoot agobo okweek.
Ong'eetyee, otogoste ole mi pororyet ne tinyei kaalyeet, ne meng'iisyei ama kereri met, mwaei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor: ne ma tinyei ormariichok anan temeleiywek, che menyei icheegei.
Ak keluul tambeesikwak, ak koek parunenik tuukwak che chaang': ak aiyeste koba komoswek tugul icheeget che piori metowekwak; ak aibu nyalildanywa eng' komoswekwak, mwaei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ak koek Hasor ole menyei lelwek, ak koek karaatya koigeny: ma menyei chii olooto, ama tebee olooto lakwa ne po chii.
Ki nyoonji `ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor maotyot Jeremiah agobo Elam eng' taunetap laitornatetap Zedekiah laitoryatap Judah, koleenji,
Mwaei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne po lugoosyek kole: Keero, airie kwangetap Elam, ne oo ne po kamugennywa.
Ak aipchi Elam koriswek ang'wan che punu luukwek ang'wan che po kipsengwet, ak aiyeste icheek koba koriswechooto tugul; ama piitu pororyet ole ma itei che ki kioon che po Elam.

Ak agoochi Elam koaragen eng' taitap puunikwak, ak eng' taitap icheeget che cheeng'ei saboonwekwak: ak aipchi icheek yaityet, nereegekyuk che ng'woneen, mwaei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor; ak ayookte rotwetap chok koosup icheek, kot ageesu:
ak alum ng'echerennyu ne po laitornatet eng' Elam, ak ang'em eng' olooto laitoryat ak pounik, mwaei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ago aweechi kogeny luulenigap Elam eng' peetuusyek che po let, mwaei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ni ng'olyoot ne ki mwa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' maotyot Jeremiah agobo Babilon, agobo emetap Kaldeik.

Omwaite eng' pororyosyek ak obarte, ak onamji parak songolyet; obarte, amouny: ole, Kageluul Babilon, kagigoochi Bel kolilaan, kagoaragen Merodak; kagigoochi kanamonikyik kolilaanso, kagoaragenso kanamonikyik.
Amu nyoonei pororyet eng' murot kaataam kobookyin, ne yaei emennyi koek karaatya, ama menyei chii olooto: kagomwei, kagoba tugul, chii ak tyony.
Pwoonei eng' peetuusyechooto ak eng' peetuunooto, piigap Israel, icheeget ak lagogap Judah, mwaei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor; pendi koriiryoti, ak kocheeng'oti Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindennywa.
Teeboti agobo ole teptoi Zion kotokyigei olooto, koleen, Obwa, ak onamge ak Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' kayomiset ne po koigeny ne ma kiutye.
Uu piikyuk keechiirek che petyotiin: ki ibeet mestowekwak icheek, ki imaas eng' tuloonook: ki koombeniot kong'etee tulweet ne oo agoi ne ming'in, kigoutye oldanywa ole imuung'ee.

Ki koam icheek piik tugul che kinyoor icheek: ak ki mwa puunikwak kole, ma kilel, amu ki koyachi icheek tengekto Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, meng'ootetap imanda, Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne kamang'unetap kwanisyekwak.
Omwei eng' Babilon, ak omande eng' emetap Kaldeik, ak oige kwesik eng' taitap akwotisyegap keechiirek.

Amu, ogeero, ang'eeti tuiyetap pororyosyek che eecheen che punu emetap murot kaataam kobookyi Babilon: ak kotet lugeet kotokyigei emonooto; kiluulei eng' olooto: uu kipchabonikwak che po chiito ne nyigan, ne mwogindet; ma mi ne weeksei puch.
Ak keluul Kaldea: piyang'dos tugul che luulei, mwaei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Amu ogasigei, amu oboiboi, ee okweek che opookyini porotennyu, amu ourerendosi ko uu rooryat ne tyechei peek, ak oteei ko uu paraisisyek che kiimeen;
ililani kamenng'ung' miising': toptoben ineendet ne kisichok: ogeero, egu ineendet ne letu eng' tugul che po pororyosyek, surkwen, emet ne yaamaat, ak surkwen.
Ma ki menyei amu nereegegap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ago egu karaatya miising': kwong'ei age tugul ne siirei ole neegitee Babilon, ak koreeny korotwekyik tugul.
Otetkei eng' lugeet obar Babilon, eng' komoswek tugul, okweek tugul che oriiche kwanget; omwok, amotuuch kipchabonik: amu ki koyachi tengekto Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.

Owaage eng' komoswek tugul; kagochamdagei; kagoluulyo irimoikyik, kagoluulyo inatusyekyik: amu niito yaaktaetap mugetuut ne po Kamuktaindet ne Toroor; oyaakyi mugetuut; ko uu ye ki yai, oyachi ineendet ko uu nooto.

Oiste leetaindet eng' Babilon, ak ineendet ne kesisye chepkeswet eng' peetuusyegap kesisyet: wendi chii age tugul eng' icheek ye mi piikyik, ak komwechi chii age tugul emennyi, amu kaiyweisyetap rotwetap chok ne usiisyei.
Uu Israel keechiirek che ki koiyesta; ki koon ng'etuunyik ineendet: kisip koam ineendet laitoryatap Assyria; ak eng' let koiri kawekyik Nebukadresar, niito laitoryatap Babilon.
Mwaei anyun Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne po lugoosyek, Kamuktaindetap Israel, kole: Ogeero, abire laitoryatap Babilon ak emennyi, ko uu ye ki abir laitoryatap Assyria.
Ak aweech Israel kogeny konyo ole agetye, ak koyagisye Karmel ak Bashan, ak kobiyo saboondanyi eng' tuloonoogap Ephraim ak eng' Gilead.

Ki cheeng'ei tengektap Israel eng' peetuusyechooto ak eng' kenyisyechooto, mwaei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ama kinyooru; ak ki cheeng'ei tengekwogigap Judah, ama kinyooru: amu anyochini kaat icheek che abagaaktoi kong'et.
Togoste emetap Merataim, obargei, obargei ak nganasanooto, ak piik che menyei Pekod: par ak ing'em igeesu iyotennywa, mwaei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ak iyai ko uu tugul che kaang'atiin.
Miitei emet polatetap pooryeet, ak ne po ng'emisyet ne oo.
Kibetita ano ak koildo ano kiriswetap ng'wony komugul! Ki egundo ano Babilon karaatya eng' pororyosyek!
Kaariich mesteet agobo inyee, ak kageluulin kogeny, ee Babilon, ak ki ma inai: kogenyoorun, kogenamin kogeny, amu ki oborye ak Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Kogoyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ole konoree kariikyik che po lugeet, ak kogonem kariigap nereegekyik: amu tinyei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne po lugoosyek, poisyet ne yaei eng' emetap Kaldeik.
Obwa obargei ak ineendet che obunu kiwotosyek che looen, oyat chogenikyik: oyum ineendet ko uu karurugutik ak ong'em ogesu: amat kong'et kiy nenyi.
Obar kirugikyik tugul; ochoorte koba ole kieng'se: Pwo! Icheek! Amu kagoit peetuunywa, peetuut ne ityin icheek pireet.

Kutitap icheek che mweei ak kochililyo komong' eng' emetap Babilon, si kobiit ki parta eng' Zion yaaktaetap mugetuut ne po Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindennyo, yaaktaetap mugetuut ne po hekalunnyi.

Kuur mwogik tugul kobargei ak Babilon, icheek tugul che riichei kwangok koyiem komoswekyik; amengochilil agot agenge eng' olooto: yaakyi mugetuut ko uu poisyonikyik; oyachi ko uu tugul che ki koyai: amu ki komenji Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ki komenji Ineendet ne Tiliil ne po Israel.
Ibutos anyun nerenikyik eng' ortinwekyik, ak kigoochin kosiisyo murenikyik tugul che po lugeet eng' peetuunooto, mwaei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Keero, aboryenen, inyeendet ne ii menotyo, mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne po lugoosyek: amu kait peetuung'ung', peetuut ne aityinin pireet.
Ak koriichkei kobut menotyot, ama mi chii ne ing'eeti ineendet: ak anaam maat eng' nganasookyik, ak kobeel tuguuk che miitei komoswekyik.
Mwaei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne po lugoosyek kole: Kiusei piigap Israel kobooto lagogap Judah: ak kogiich piik tugul che kiluulei icheek; eesyoi kochunda icheek koba.
Kiim katyagindennywa; kainennyi ko Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne po lugoosyek: ng'alaaldochin ineendet icheek komyee, si kobiit kogoochi kamuung'et ng'wony, ak koim piik che menyei Babilon.
Mi rotwetap chok paragutap Kaldeik, mwaei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ak eng' piik che menyei Babilon, ak eng' pounikyik, ak eng' piikyik che ng'oomen.
Mi rotwetap chok paragutap piik che ichaugei, si koberberitu: mi rotwetap chok paragutap piikyik che nyigoonen, ak koaragenso icheek.

Mi rotwetap chok paragutap paraisisyekwak, ak eng' kariisyekwak che po lugeet, ak eng' paragutap piik tugul che kiburuchkei che mi kobooto ineendet, ak koigei icheek kwonyiik: mi rotwetap chok paragutap konoraikyik, ak kerep chooto.
Tebee kemeut paragutap ainoosyekyik, ak koteenyo: amu emoniito ko emetap kanamonik che ki kiwai, ak ki koyai kanamonikwak icheek koek kibion.
Menyei anyun olooto tyong'igap surkwen kobooto suik, ak komeny tyong'igap songolik olooto: ama ki menyei olooto koigeny; ama ki menyei kobooch ibinda age agoi ibinda age.
Ko uu ye kigabui Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Sodom ak Gomorah ak nganasook che kineegite olooto, mwaei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor; uu nooto anyun ma menyei chii olooto, ama tebee olooto lakwa ne po chii.
Ogeero, punu piik murot kaataam; kobooto pororyet ne oo, ak king'eeti laitorinik che chaang' che punu komoswek che looen che po ng'wony.
Tinyei kwangok ak ng'otwek; kolgoleen, ama tinyei rireenet; morori ko uu nyanjet, ak ketei paraisisyek; choboot age tugul ko uu chiito ne wendi lugeet, kobookyinin, ee cheptap Babilon.
Ki kogas laitoryatap Babilon kalasunennywa, ak nyaluldos eunekyik: kanam ineendet pichiindo, ak ng'wanindo ko uu ne po kwondo ne machei kosigiis.

Ogeero, togosu ineendet ko uu ng'etundo kobunu Jordan ko kanyi peek miising' kobargei ak meng'ooteet ne kiim: ago achee aoone komwei ineendet: ak age tugul ne kileweni, agoochini koboi ineendet: amu ng'oo ne kegerge, ak ko ng'oo ne ng'atwa peetuut? Ak ko ng'oo mestowot ne tononi eng' tainnyu?

Ogas anyun kirwoogetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ne ki koyachi Babilon; ak chobutikyik che ki kochop agobo emetap Kaldeik: ichuuti icheek iman, agot che mengeechen che po akweetap keechiirek; yaei iman meng'ootennywa koek karaatya agobo icheek.
Potani ng'wony eng' cheetap lugeet ne kiluule Babilon, ak kigasei waagennywa eng' pororyosyek.
Mwaei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole, ogeero, ang'eetyini Babilon kobooto piik che menyei Leb-kamai, usoonet ne ng'emisyei.
Ak ayookyi Babilon toek che seesei; kowong' tugul che mi emennyi: amu paregei icheek ak ineendet eng' peetuutap nyalilda kobunu komoswek tugul.
Amat koriich kwangennyi mwogindet, amat kong'eet kolaachi ngoryeetap lugeet: amoriree neranikyik; ong'em lugeennyi tugul ogesu.
Ak kobutyo ko kagobek eng' emetap Kaldeik ko kagetoor eng' ortinwekyik.
Amu ma kimetoi Israel, anan Judah, ma metoi icheek Kamuktaindennywa, Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne po lugoosyek; nganda nyiitaat emennywa ng'oogisto ne ki yachi Ineendet ne Tiliil ne po Israel.
Omwei eng' Babilon, ingosar chii age tugul saboondanyi; amat ongobaraak tengektanyi: amu peetuutap yaaktaetap mugetuut ne po Kamuktaindet ne Toroor; yaakyin ineendet mugetuut.
Ki kigombetap thahabu Babilon eng' eutap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ne ki igoochi ng'wony komugul kobogit: ki koee pororyosyek divaikyik; amei anyun iywek pororyosyek amu nooto.
Kagobut Babilon kochaakta, ak keng'em: oteeiye amu ineendet; oipchi mwanik che kinyae ng'wanindanyi, tamangap kosap ineendet.
Kata kimache kisoop Babilon, ago ma sap: omete ineendet ak ongebe, kwo chii tugul emennyi: amu itei kipsengwet kirwoogennyi, ak kaginamji parak agoi koit kipsengwet.
Kagomoong' Kamuktaindet ne Toroor imandanyo: obwa, kibarte eng' Zion poisyonigap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Kamuktaindennyo.

Olit kipchabonik; onam long'onik komyee: kagong'eet Kamuktaindet ne Toroor mugulelwegap laitorinigap Medik; amu chobennyi ko kogirinda Babilon, kong'em: amu yaaktaetap mugetuut ne po Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, yaaktaetap mugetuut ne po hekalunnyi.
Onamji parak songolyet, otokyi irimoigap Babilon, ogimiit riipseet, onde riibiik, ochop piik che sapchin: amu kagochop Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ak koyai kiit ne ki mwa agobo piik che menyei Babilon.
Ee, inyee ne menyei peek che chaang', ne chaang' miising' konoraiguk, kait kagesuneng'ung' karagendoetap mageng'ung'.
Kagoyosyechigei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne po lugoosyek, kole, anyiitin iman piik, che tee tinapchet; ak kowaagenen icheek.
Ki yai ng'wony eng' kamuktaennyi, ki igimit ng'wonyuni eng' utotyennyi, ak kiito kipsengwet eng' naennyi:
ye twek, kobiit wasetapkei ne po peek eng' kipsengwet, ak kogoochi kibungweret kotogosta eng' ole poochin ng'wony: yachin ropta kalyelosyek, imoong'u usoonet eng' ole ki kigonoree.
Kergeitu chiito age tugul ak tyondo ne ma tinyei naet; ililane kitang'indet age tugul ne po thahabu kanamwennyi ne ki kiwai: amu lembeita kanamwennyi ne ki kitany, ama tinyei kabuset.
Puch chooto, poisyetap ng'aalseet: petos eng' peetuut ne ityin pirennywa.
Ma uu chuuto kebebertap Jakobo; amu po tai ineendet eng' tuguuk tugul; ak Israel ko pororyetap porotennyi: kainennyi ko Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne po lugoosyek.
Inyee ko ii aiywennyu ne po pooryeet, ak kariigap lugeet: ak atonatoni pororyosyek eng' inyee; ak abar pounatosyek eng' inyee;
ak atonatoni eng' inyee paraisiit kobooto chiito ne laanyei;
ak atonatoni eng' inyee chepkichutitap lugeet kobooto chiito ne laanyei; ak atonatoni eng' inyee muren ak kwony; ak atonatoni eng' inyee poiyo ak neran; ak atonatoni eng' inyee muren ak kobogoryo;
ak atonatoni eng' inyee mestowot ak akweennyi; ak atonatoni eng' inyee kabatindet kobooto eikyik che po chogit; ak atonatoni eng' inyee pounik ak kiptainik.
Ak ayaakyini Babilon ak piik tugul che menyei Kaldea, yaityennywa tugul ne ki yai eng' Zion eng' taing'wong', mwaei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Keero, aboryenen, ee inyee tulweet ne ing'emisyei, mwaei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ne ng'emei ng'wony komugul: ak achuul eunnyu atokyin, ak amilden eng' rwandosyek, ak ayain iegu tulweet ne ki kolal.
Ak ma ibei eng' inyee koita ne po luuita, anan koip koita ne po lumeiywek; ago iegu karaatya koigeny, mwaei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.

Onamji parak songolyet eng' emet, oguut iryageet eng' pororyosyek, ochop pororyosyek kobargei ak ineendet, oguur pounatosyegap Ararat, ak che po Mini ak che po Ashkenas, kobargei ak ineendet: olewen kiptaiyat ne paregei ak ineendet; ogetu paraisisyek che uu tinapchet.
Ochop pororyosyek kobargei ak ineendet, laitorinigap Medik, pounikyik, ak kiptainikyik tugul, kobooto emet tugul ne po pounatennyi.
Ak kobotan emet ak komi eng' ng'wanindo: amu tonondos chobutigap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor che kichobei agobo Babilon, si kobiit koyai emetap Babilon koek karaatya, ole ma menyei chii.
Ki kometo pooryeet murenigap Babilon che nyigoonen, tebyei eng' irimoikwak; ki kobek nyiganatennywa; kagoigei kwonyiik: kagobeel komoswekwak che menyei; kagoilyo temeleiywekyik.
Labati chiito ne kiyooktoi koip paronok kosubi age ne ibei paronok, ak kosubi kayooktoin kayooktoindet age, si koboorchi laitoryatap Babilon koleenji, kagenam nganasennyi eng' komosta age tugul:
kagenam tabarwek, ak kagebeel morong'yot, ak kagoaragenso murenigap lugeet.

Amu mwaei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne po lugoosyek, Kamuktaindetap Israel, ko uu ni kole: uu cheptap Babilon rwanyut ne kiboorsee eng' peetuut ne kityechei; tomo kitigin, si konyonji peetuutap kesisyet.
Ki koama Nebukadresar laitoryatap Babilon, ki kotuatua, ki koyaa aek tereet ne ma mi kiy, ki kolugua ko uu maswetit, kigonyiit moennyi tuguukyuk che anyiny; ki kotoorcha saang'.
Mwaei chii ne menyei Zion kole, ingotebee paragutap Babilon koroomnateet ne ki kiyaiywo ak ne ki kiyachi piikyuk; ak komwaei Jerusalem kole, ingotebee paragutap piik che menyei Kaldea, korotiikyuk.
Mwaei anyun Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole, keero, ang'alaaldoun, ayaaktoun mugetuut; ak ayaam nyanjennyi, ak agoochi koteeny kondametunnyi ne po peek.
Ak koek Babilon karurugutik, ole menyei lelwek, ne kikwong'ee ak ne kireenyei, ne ma menyei chii.
Porisendos ko uu ng'etuunyik che parnotik; morortos ko uu aaregap ng'etuunyik.
Ye tinyei tawirenet icheek, ayachini igoortanywa, ak agoochi icheek kobogityo, si koboiboitu, ak koruiyo rwondo ne po agoi, ama kosu, mwaei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Amutu icheek ko uu aaregap keechiir che pendi ole kieng'see, ko uu mengichik kobooto kwesik.
Haa, kageluul Sesak! Ak kagenam kalasunetap ng'wony komugul! Kagoek Babilon karaatya eng' pororyosyek!
Kagonyonji nyanjet Babilon: kagotuch ineendet chaang'indap mildaetapkei ne po peekyik.
Kagoek nganasookyik karaatya, emet ne yaamaat ak ko surkwen, emet ne ma menyei chii ama punei olooto lakwa ne po chii.
Arwookyini Bel eng' Babilon, ak among'u eng' kutinnyi kiit ne ki kolugui; ama korootei pororyosyek ko uu peek kobendi oldanyi kogeny: ee, luulei irimeetap Babilon.
Omang'une piikyuk, kwenunnyi, ak osaruge chii tugul oistoegei nereegek che ng'woneen che po Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.

Among' kotanuiso mugulelwekwok, anan oiywei ng'aleegap piik che kigasei eng' emet; amu pwoonei ng'aleek eng' kenyiit age, ak ye ibata kobwa ng'aleechooto eng' kenyiit age, ak koroomnateet eng' emet, koboryo pounindet age ak pounindet age.
Ogeero, pwoonei anyun peetuusyek che tuun arwookyini kanamonik che ki kiwai che po Babilon, ak kolilaan emonooto komugul; ak kobutyo eng' kwenunnyi piikyik tugul che ki kibar.
Yeityo kotyen eng' poiboiyet kipsengwet ak ng'wony, ak tugul che mi olooto, agobo Babilon; amu pwoonei piik che luulei ineendet kobunu murot kaataam, mwaei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ko uu ye ki parei `Babilon Israel kobutyo, ko uu nooto ibutos eng' Babilon piik che tuun kibarei che po emet tugul.
Oba okweek, che ki ochilile rotwetap chok, amotonon; obwaat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor omi ole loo, ak obwaat Jerusalem.
Kililandosi, amu kigegas chotisyet; ki kotuch togoochikyok kalilanet; amu kagobwa toek komoswek che tiliileen che po kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ogeero, pwoonei anyun peetuusyek, mwaei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, che karwookyini kanamonikyik che ki kiwai; ak kotigendos eng' emennyi tugul piik che ki kiguoten.
Agot nda togosta Babilon agoi kipsengwet, ak agot nda ng'oot toroorindap kimnateennyi, ko ui tugul kobunnywa piik che luulei ineendet, mwaei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Waagaatap riirek ne punu Babilon, ak ne po ng'emisyet ne oo ne punu emetap Kaldeik!
Amu luulei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Babilon, ak kong'em kutit ne punu olooto; morortos peekwak che mildogei ko uu peek che chaang', kagemwa polatetap tweguunennywa:

amu kagonyonji ineendet luulindet, kagonyonji Babilon ak kagenam murenikyik che nyigoonen, kagetonaton kwangokwak: amu Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ko Kamuktaindet ne po yaaktaetap mugetuut, yaaktoi iman mugetuut.

Ak agoochini kobogityo pounikyik ak murenikyik che ng'oomen, kobooto kirwoogikyik ak kiptainikyik, ak murenikyik che nyigoonen; ak koruiyo rwondo ne po agoi, ama kogosu, mwaei Laitoryat ne kainennyi ko Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne po lugoosyek.

Mwaei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne po lugoosyek kole: Kigabui irimoik che tebeesen che po Babilon kigeesu, ak kebeel ormariichokyik che kooen; ak kobirtogei piik puch, ak kobirtogei pororyosyek amu maat; ak kong'eetyo.

Ni ng'olyoot ne king'atyi maotyot Jeremiah Seraiah weeriitap Neriah, weeriitap Maseia, ye kibendi Babilon kobooto Zedekiah, laitoryatap Judah eng' kenyiitap ang'wan ne po laitornatennyi. Ki riibindet ne oo Seraiah eng' kootap laitoryat.
Ak ki sirchi Jeremiah bukuit yaityet tugul ne tuun nyoonjin Babilon, ng'aleechuuto tugul che ki kisir agobo Babilon.
Ak ki leenji Jeremiah Seraiah, Ye tuun iit Babilon, ko kanyool isoman ng'aleechuuto tugul,
ak ile, Ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ki imwa agobo olito, ile iistoi, si ma meny chii age tugul olito, chii anan ko tyony, ago egu karaatya koigeny.
Ak ye kaisoman bukuini igeesu, iratyi koita, ak iwiirchi aineetap Yufrets:
ak imwa ile, Imaluuchi anyun peek Babilon ko uu nooto, ama kong'eetei kogeny amu yaityet ne tuun aipchini; ak kong'etyo. Igesunegei yuto ng'aleegap Jeremiah.
Ki po kenyiisyek tiptem ak agenge Zedekiah ye ki tau kolaitorani; ak ki laitoran kenyiisyek taman ak agenge eng' Jerusalem: ak kainetap kamennyi ko ki Hamutal cheptap Jeremiah ne po Libna.
Ak ki yai yaityet eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ko uu tugul che kiga koyai Jehoiakim.
Ak ki piitune tuguuchooto nereegegap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' Jerusalem ak Judah kot kotimda icheek koba eng' tainnyi. Ak ki ingelelji Zedekiah laitoryatap Babilon.

Ak eng' kenyiitap sogool ne po laitornatennyi, eng' arawetap taman, eng' peetuutap taman ne po arawanooto, konyo Nebukadresar laitoryatap Babilon, ineendet ak lugeennyi tugul, kobookyi Jerusalem, ak koteech kotokyigei nganaseet; ak ki teech icheek irimoik koyiem.
Koyiem anyun nganaseet agoi kenyiitap taman ak agenge ne po laitoryat Zedekiah.
King'wanit rubeet eng' nganasanooto eng' arawetap ang'wan eng' peetuutap sogool ne po arawanooto, ne ki ma komi amitwogik che amei piik eng' emet.

Kobut anyun piik irimeetap nganaseet ak ki mwei murenik tugul che po lugeet kemoi kobun ooreetap ormariichet ne ki mi kwenutap inatusyek aeng', ne ki mi ole neegitee seremutap laitoryat; (kigayiem Kaldeik nganaseet:) ak ki pun icheek ooreetap Arabah.
Ago ki oon lugeetap Kaldeik laitoryat, ak ki nam Zedekiah eng' warengosyegap Jeriko; ak kiyesta lugeennyi tugul kometo ineendet.
Komut anyun laitoryat, ak komut kwo ole mi laitoryatap Babilon eng' Ribla eng' emetap Hamath; ak ki irwookyi ineendet.
Ak ki par laitoryatap Babilon weeriigap Zedekiah kogeerei ineendet: ki par kogeny pounik tugul che po Judah eng' Ribla.
Ak ki par konyegap Zedekiah; ak korat laitoryatap Babilon ineendet eng' nyororosyek, ak komut ineendet kwo Babilon, ak kitoorchi ineendet korgoreet agoi peetuutap meennyi.

Ak eng' arawetap muut, eng' peetuutap taman ne po arawanooto, ne ki kenyiitap taman ak sogool ne po Laitoryat Nebukadresar laitoryatap Babilon, konyo Nebusaradan, kiptaiyatap riibiik, ne kitononi eng' taitap laitoryatap Babilon, agoi Jerusalem:
ak ki peel kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ak kootap laitoryat; ak kooriik tugul che po Jerusalem, koot age tugul ne oo, ko ki peel.
Ak kibut lugeet tugul ne po Kaldeik ne ki mi kobooto kiptaiyatap riibiik, irimoik tugul che po Jerusalem, komoswek tugul.

Yeityo komut koluul Nebusaradan kiptaiyatap riibiik piik che kibananook miising', ak piik che kiga ng'et eng' nganaseet, ak che kiga chililso, che ki igoochigei laitoryatap Babilon, ak piigap tuiyet che ki kong'et.
Ago ki pagaakta Nebusaradan kiptaiyatap riibiik, piik che kibananook miising' eng' emet, koek riibiigap sabibuk ak koek semberik.

Ak kitui Kaldeik tolochigap sugunonik che ki mi kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ak ng'echerok che ki tebee tuguuk ak nyanjet ne po sugunwet ne ki mi kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ak koip sugunonik tugul che po tuguuchooto koba Babilon.
Ak ki ip tereenik, ak kechigosyek che eecheen, ak magasisyek che kitile ole lalei eng' taisyek, kobooto taabook ak kechigosyek, ak tereenik tugul che po sugunonik che kiboisyee.

Ak kigombok, ak tuguuk che ki ibe maat, ak taabook, ak tereenik, ak keelyegap taisyek, ak kechigosyek, ak taabook; ak ki ip kiptaiyatap riibiik tuguuk che ki kiyae thahabu, ko thahabu, ak tuguuk che ki kiyae fedha, ko fedha.

Tolochichooto, kobooto nyanjanooto agenge, ak itoonwek taman ak aeng' che po sugunonik che po kiruugik, che ki miitei kurereetap ng'echerok che kitebee, che kiga yachi Laitoryat Solomon kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor: ma naoksei nyigiisindap sugunonigap tuguuchuuto tugul.

Ago eng' tolochik, kooindap tononetap agenge ko ki mitainik taman ak sisiit che po euut; ak ki mitainik taman ak aeng' che po euut nyigiisindap toloita nooto ngeyiem; ak ki morik ang'wan nyigiisindanyi ngikwa: ki kiyai kioto koek soiyet.

Ak kimi metitap sugunwet paragunnyi; ak kooindap tononetap metoto ko ki mitainik muut che po euut, kobooto kariik che regerotiin, ak logoek che ki mi metoto komoswek tugul, che ki po tugul sugunonik: ak ki tinyei toloita ne po aeng' agine tuguuk che uu chooto, kobooto logoek.
Ak kimi logoek tamanwogik sogoolu ak lo komoswekyik; kibogol agenge logoechooto tugul che ki mi karichooto regerotiin eng' komoswek tugul.
Ak ki imut kiptaiyatap riibiik Seraiah tisiindet ne oo, ak Zephaniah tisiindet ne po aeng', ak riibiik somok che ki riibei kurgeet:

Ak ki imut eng' nganaseet kiptaiyat ne ki pou lugeet: ak piik tisap eng' icheek che kigeerei togeetap laitoryat, che ki kinyoorchi nganaseet; ak siriindet ne po kiptaiyatap lugeet, ne ki iyumi piigap emet; ak piik tamanwogik lo che po emet che ki kinyoorchi nganaseet.
Ak ki imut Nebusaradan kiptaiyatap riibiik pichooto, komutyi laitoryatap Babilon eng' Ribla.
Ak kibir laitoryatap Babilon pichooto, ak kobar eng' Ribla, eng' emetap Hamath. Ki kimut anyun Judah keluul komanda eng' emennyi.
Chu piik che ki imut Nebukadresar koluul: eng' kenyiitap tisap kogiluul Yahudik eliphuusyek somok ak tiptem ak somok:
eng' kenyiitap taman ak sisiit ne po Nebukadresar komut koluul eng' Jerusalem piik pogolwogik sisiit ak sosom ak aeng'.
Eng' kenyiitap tiptem ak somok ne po Nebukadresar komut Nubusaraden kiptaiyatap riibiik, piik pogolwogik tisap ak artam ak muut che po Yahudik: ki ek piik tugul eliphuusyek ang'wan ak pogol lo.

Ak eng' kenyiitap sosom ak tisap kobooch ngeluul Jehoiakin laitoryatap Judah, eng' arawetap taman ak aeng', eng' peetuutap tiptem ak muut ne po arawanooto, kotyach Ebil-merodak laitoryatap Babilon eng' kenyiit ne po tai ne po laitornatennyi, Jehoiakin laitoryatap Judah, komong' eng' korgoreet;
ak ki ng'alaalji ineendet eng' rireenetapkei, ak konde ng'echerennyi ne po laitornatet kotororit eng' che po laitorinik che ki mi Babilon kobooto ineendet.
Ak ki wal ngoroikyik che po korgoreet, ak ki amis eng' tainnyi kotugul eng' peetuusyek tugul che po sabeennyi.
Ak ki igoochi laitoryatap Babilon ineendet kotugul kebebertanyi ne po amitwogik, ki igoochin peetuut age tugul kebeberta ne yamei eng' peetuusyek tugul che po sabeennyi, agoi peetuutap meennyi.

Kalya si koguber nganaseet ne ki nyiitaat piik! Amu nee si kotebi ko uu kwony ne ki kosiirtoe manong'otyot, nganaseet ne ki oo eng' pororyosyek! Ineendet ne ki cheptap laitoryat eng' emotinwek, ko kagoek anyun otwogindet.
Riirei miising' kemoi, ak korang'ugei peegap kong' eng' matang'wekyik. Ma mi agot agenge ne igoigoi ineendet eng' chamanikyik tugul. Ki koberber choronokyik tugul ineendet, ki koek puunikyik.
Ki kiluul Judah kwo nyalil, ak otwoknateet ne oo. Menyei nguno kwenutap pororyosyek ak ma sichei kamung'et. Kagonam ineendet `usiikyik tugul eng' ole pichiy.
Iteitos ortinwegap Zion, amu ma mi chii ne nyoonjin tuiyet ne ki king'at. Ki koek karaatya ormariichokyik tugul, tigendos tisiikyik. Kinyaliili pergeinikyik, ak kotinyei ineendet ng'wanindo.
Ki koek `usiikyik kandoik, ak koboor puunikyik. Kogonyaliil `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ineendet amu chaang'indap pistaosyekyik. Kogimut lagokyik keluul eng' taitap puunyoot.
Kogoistoegei cheptap Zion toroornatennyi tugul; kogoigei pounikyik cheptirgichik che ma tinyei ole agetee. Kogomweiso icheek ama tinyei kimnateet eng' taitap chiito ne oonei.

Ibwaati Jerusalem peetuusyegap nyalilda ak pichiinwekyik. Ibwaati tuguukyik tugul che ki iboiboi ineendet kobooch peetuusyek che po keny. Ibwaati ye ki ibutyin piikyik eutap puunyoot, ama toret chii ineendet, Ki chot katerterikyik ineendet agobo kabutennyi.
Ki koyai Jerusalem tengekto ne ya miising'; kogoek anyun kiit ne murwoon amu nooto. Sasei ineendet tugul che ki konyiti ineendet, amu ki kogeer aach ngorinnyi. Ee, tigeni, ak koweechigei let.
Ki mi simdanyi ngoroikyik; ma ibwaat kagesunennyi ne po let. Katururgei anyun eng' kwong'eet; ma tinyei kagaigaindet: Ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, keero nyalildanyu; amu kogotoroorgei puunyoot.
Kogoitoochi puunyoot eunnyi tuguukyik tugul che koboiboitune. Amu kagogeer kole kogochut pororyosyek oldanyi ne tiliil, che ki ing'at ile amat kochut icheek tuiyeng'ung'.
Tigendos piikyik tugul ye cheeng'ei amitwogik; ki kogoito tuguukwak che korooron si konyoorunee amitwogik che isoobi saboondo: Keero, ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ak ibwaat; amu kaaegu ne kisasei.

Tos ma kiy eng' okweek, okweek tugul che osiirtoi? Ogeer ak obwaat ngo mi arageneet age tugul ne uu aragenennyu, ne ki kiyaiywo, ne ki inyalilena Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' peetuutap nereegekyik che ng'woneen.
Ki iyook ineendet maat eng' parak koyookyi kawekyuk, ak ki iterteer maata koweek. Ki riich mesteet konam keelyekyuk, ki koweekyo let; ki koyaa aek panan ak atanui peet komugul.
Ki rat eunnyi chogitap pistaosyekyuk; ki konamgei tugul, ki koit kaatinnyu; ki koges kimnateennyu. Ki kondea Kiptaiyat eunekwak, ne ma amuuchi atonon agirinda.

Ki koyai `Kiptaiyat piik tugul che nyigoonen koek puch eng' kwenunnyu; ki koguurcho tuiyet ne ki king'at kole kotuatui neranikyuk. Ki kotyechatyech `Kiptaiyat pergeiyatap Judah ko uu ye kityechei ole kitue sabibuk.
Ariire anyun agobo tuguuchuuto; saitoi peegap kong' eng' konyekyuk; amu loo eng' anee kagaigaindet ne kata isoobi saboondanyu. Ki koek lagokyuk kibananook, amu ki koterteeris puunyoot.
Iitoi Zion eunekyik; ago ma mi chii ne igoigoi ineendet. Ki kong'at Kamuktaindet ne Toroor agobo Jakobo, kole egu puunikyik piik che menyei komoswekyik. Mi Jerusalem kwenunnywa ko uu kiit ne murwoon.
Po imanda Kamuktaindet ne Toroor; amu ki angelelji ng'atuutyennyi. Asaok ale, ogas okweek pororyosyek tugul, ak ogeer aragenennyu. Kogimut pergeinikyuk ak neranikyuk koba koek luulenik.
Ki aguur chamanikyuk, ago ki iberbera. Ki pekyi nganaseet tisiikyuk ak poisyekyuk, Ye ki cheeng'jingei amitwogik kole kosoop saboonwekwak.
Keero, ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, amu ami pichiindo, anyalili moennyu kawalak muguleldanyu; amu kaangelel miising'. Rebisyei rotwetap chok eng' ole po saang', eng' ko oriit komi ne uu meet.
Ki kogas icheek ole atigendoi; ma mi chii ne igoigoa. Ki kogas puunikyuk tugul agobo nyalildanyu; poiboi icheek amu ki iyai ko uu nooto. Tuun iibu peetuut ne ki imwaite, si kegergeitu ak icheek.
Ingobwa taing'ung' yaitwogikwak tugul; ak iyachi icheek, ko uu ye ki iyaiywo agobo pistaosyekyuk tugul. Amu chaang' tigenoikyuk, ak tanui muguleldanyu.
Kalya si kotuge Kiptaiyat cheptap Zion pooldet eng' nereegekyik! Ki kotim karaaranindap Israel eng' kipsengwet konyo ng'wony, amata kobwaat ng'echereetap keelyekyik eng' peetuutap nereegekyik.
Kigong'em Kiptaiyat meng'otosyek tugul che po Jakobo ama riiree. Ki kobut eng' nereegekyik irimoigap cheptap Judah. Ki koturuur icheek kobwa ng'wony eng' kalilanet pounateet ak pounikyik.
Ki kotil kimnateetap Israel eng' nereegekyik che ng'woneen. Ki koweech eunnyi ne po tai konyo eng' taitap puunik. Ki kolal ineendet ko uu maat ne liplibeni eng' Jakobo, ne peelei komoswek tugul.

Ki koriich kwangennyi ko uu puunyoot, ki tonon kochuul eunnyi ne po tai ko uu puunyoot, ki kobar tugul che iboiboi koonyek; eng' emaitap cheptap Zion; ko ki koroong'ji nereegekyik che koroomen ko uu maat.
Ki igei Kiptaiyat puunyoot, Ki kong'em Israel; Ki kolugui kooriikyik tugul che po laitorinik, ki kobut irimoikyik. Ki kotesyi cheptap Judah riirek ak kateiyet.

Ki koisto emainnyi eng' koroomnateet ko uu mbareet, Ki kong'em oldanyi ole kituiyechin. Ki koisto Kamuktaindet ne Toroor tuiyet ne ki king'at ak sabato eng' Zion, ak eng' nyitatetap nereegekyik ko ki kogas laitoryat ak tisiindet.

Ki kotiimda Kiptaiyat kaptisisyennyi, ak ki kometo oldanyi ne tiliil. Ki konde eutap puunyoot irimoigap kooriikyik che po laitorinik. Ki kobolyo eng' kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ko uu eng' peetuutap tuiyet ne ki king'at.
Ki kochop Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kong'em irimeetap cheptap Zion; Ki kokwerto kiit ne kikwaise, tomo koaruny eunnyi eng' ng'emisyet: ki kogoochi irimeet ak tooteet kooteeiyo; ng'emaksei tuwai.

Isuwe kobendi ng'wony ormariichokyik; ki ng'em ak koiri temeleiywekyik. Mi laitoryandennyi ak pounikyik kwenutap pororyosyek ole ma mi ng'atuutyet; ma nyooru maotikyik ng'ang'utyet ne punu Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Tebyei ng'wony poisyegap cheptap Zion, siistos; Ki koseerchi temburyek metowekwak ki kogermenegei kuniok. Pergeinigap Jerusalem ko kagoabuch metowekwak.
Ibwandos konyekyuk amu peegap kong', nyalili moennyu. Ki koroong'jigei ng'wony koitonyu, amu ng'emisyetap piikyuk; amu tanuitos lagok ak che reryei eng' ortinwegap nganaseet.
Riirchin kametwagikwak koleenjin, “Mi ano amitwogik ak divaik?” Ye katanuiso ko uu che kagiguoten eng' ortinwegap nganaseet, ye karoong'jigei saboonwekwak tegetigap kametwagikwak.
Abaoryanun aleen nee? Aragenen nee, ee cheptap Jerusalem? Aaechindosin ak nee, si kobiit agaigain, ee pergeiyat cheptap Zion? Amu oo ko uu nyanjet ole ki putok eng' inyee; ng'oo ne imuuchi konyain?

Ki kogeer maotiguk ng'ang'utik agobo inyee che po tangoita ak perberyo; ak tomo kong'aany kotook tengektong'ung', si koweechin kogeny eng' ole ki kiluuljin, ago ki kogeer agobo inyee lautik che po puch ak ng'aleek che po kamaaset.

Icheek tugul che siirtoi ko iraprapchin eunek; reng'sei ak kolelechi metowekwak agobo cheptap Jerusalem, koleen: “Tos nganasaniito ne kiguure piik, ne ititaat eng' korooronindo, ne poiboiyetap ng'wony komugul?”
Puuniguk tugul ko kagoyatyin kutusweekwak; reng'sei ak kosusei kelek; mwaei kole, “Ki kelugui ineendet! Iman, niito peetuut ne ki kicheeng'e; kagenyooru ak kagegeer!”

Ki koyai Kamuktaindet ne Toroor nooto ki kochop; kagoyai ng'olyoondennyi kosulda ko uu ye kiga ng'at eng' peetuusyek che po keny; kagowiirta kwo ng'wony ama riiree; kagogoochi puunyoot koboiboitunenen, ak kagotoroor kimnateetap puuniguk.
Ki riirchi `mugulelwekwak Kiptaiyat: ee irimeetap cheptap Zion! Ingotenden peegap kong' ko uu aineet peet ak kemoi! Amemuuny, amengosiis laptetap kondang'ung'!

Ng'eet, waach kemoi eng' taunetap saisyegap kemoi! Rong'u muguleldang'ung' ko uu peek eng' taitap Kiptaiyat! Namji parak euneguk tokyi ineendet agobo saboonwegap lagoguk, che tanuitos eng' rubeet eng' tabandap ooreet age tugul.

Keero, ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ak ibwaat, Tos ng'oo ne ki iyachi ko uu nooto? Tos amei kwonyiik iyotennywa, lagok che namei eng' eunekwak? Tos kibarchin tisiindet ak maotyot kaptisisyetap Kiptaiyat?
Ruitos ng'wony murenik ak poisyek eng' ortinwek; kagebar pergeinikyuk ak neranikyuk eng' rotwetap chok; Ki ibar icheek eng' peetuutap nereegeguk, ki ibar ama iriiree.

Ki iguur puunikyuk eng' komosta age tugul, ko uu eng' peetuutap tuiyet ne ki king'at. Eng' peetuutap nereegegap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor koma piit chii ne ki chilil anan ne ki ng'et. Icheeget che ki aname ak ariibe kobooch ko mengech ko ki koges punyondennyu.
Aa chiito ne ki ageer nyalilda eng' nereegek che po kirokto ne po Kamuktaindet.
Ki kondoiywo ak kogeno awendotee mesundeito ama lapkeiyet.
Iman kiitocha eunnyi, konyil ak konyil, peetuut komugul.
Ki koyai poortanyu ak iriryondennyu koosegitu; kigoiri kawekyuk.
Kigong'ota kogirindaa ak koyiemena ng'wanindo ak nyalilda.
Kigogoono atebee mesundeito, ko uu che ki kobek keny.
Kigong'ota kot koma amuuchi achilil; kigoganapcha nyororosyek che nyigiisen.
Ee, nga ariire ak aguursei agobo toreteet, kogerchin saang' saaennyu.
Kigong'ote ortinwekyuk koik che ki kiwai, kigogunuur ortinwekyuk.
Uu ineendet magalaluut ne sapchino, uu ng'etundo eng' komoswek che ung'ootiin.
Ki komaas ortinwekyuk ak kotonatona; ki koyaa aek chii ne mi ineegei.
Ki koriich kwangennyi ak kondea aek kiit ne kimwogei.
Ki komwogo kochut suennyu kipchabonigap motyennyi.
Ki aegu ne rorechin piik tugul; ak aegu tyendanywa peet komugul.
Kigonyiita ng'wanindo, kigogoono abogit ng'wonet.
Ki koirie kelekyuk kibargoinik, ki kotugeno oreek.
Ki iste saboondanyu kolooit eng' kaalyeet; ki autye ale poiboiyo ko nee.
Ara ki amwa ale kagolus kimnateennyu, kobooto tugul che kiga amang'u eng' Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Kabwaatetap nyalildanyu ak ombenateet, ng'wonet ak kipsegetetyet.
Ibwaati saboondanyu chooto kotugul, ak kong'uruuksei eng' oriitinnyu.
Ago abwaati niito, ak ko uu nooto atinye anyun kamang'unet ale:
Ki rireenosyegap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kityo si ma kigeswech, amu mararu rireenosyekyik.
Leelachen rireenosyekyik karonet age tugul; oo imandang'ung'.
“Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ko kebebertanyu, amang'u ineendet anyun amu nooto.” Mwaei saboondanyu.
Myee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' icheeget che igeni ineendet, eng' saboondo ne cheeng'ei ineendet.
Myee eng' chii komong' ak kogen eng' muitaet yetunetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Myee eng' chii kogesen chogit eng' peetuusyegap ming'inatennyi.
Ingotep ineegei ak kosiis, amu kigesenji `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ineendet.
Ingotoore kutinnyi temburyek; tamangap kobiit kamang'unet.
Ingogoochi matandanyi ineendet ne irabaachi; ak inginyiit ineendet chotisyet.
Amu ma timdoi Kiptaiyat agoi.
Agot nga kon arageneet, kota koriiree ko uu chaang'indap rireenosyekyik.
Amu ma kwetyin koibu nyalilda, anan kogoochi arageneet weeriigap piik.
Ye kityechatyechi kimonjororinik tugul che po ng'wony;
ye kimaase chii imaninnyi eng' taitap Ineendet Ne Toroor Miising',
anan kibeet chii eng' imandanyi, tos ma keerei Kiptaiyat chooto?
Ng'oo ineendet ne mwaei ak kosulda kioto, ng'oo ne ng'atei kioto ngo ma Kiptaiyat?
Tos ma mang'une kutitap Ineendet Ne Toroor Miising' yaityet ak myeeindo?
Amu nee anyun si kong'unyng'uny chiito, chiito ne kagibir agobo tengekwogikyik?
Ongisyach ak ketyem ortinwekyok, si keeweekyigei kogeny Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ongetokyi mugulelwekyok kobooto eunekyok Kamuktaindet ne mi kipsengwet.
Ki kibistoe ak ki kingelelse; ak tomo inyoiywech kaat.
Ki itugegei nereegek ak ioonatech; ki ibarisye ama iriiree.
Ki itugegei pooldet, si ma mang'une saautikyok kobwa ole imi.
Ki iyaech keige tugun che kibuktoi kelaktoi ak pusagaryek tugun che ma kiy eng' pororyosyek.
Ki koyatyech kutusweekwak puunikyok tugul.
Kabwanjech kaiyweisyet ak pichiindo, ng'emet ak ng'emisyet.
Rootei peekyuk po kong' ko uu ainoosyek, amu ng'emisyetap piikyuk.
Isururtoe peek konyekyuk che ma siisei, ama tinyei kamuung'et,
agoi kogeer Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, kogeer eng' kipsengwet.
Iimi `konyekyuk saboondanyu eng' tuguuk che kiityi tiibiik tugul che po nganasennyu.
Kigoona icheek ko uu toriit, chooto ko puunikyuk che ki oona puch.
Ki koisto saboondanyu eng' keriinget, ak ki wiirena koik.
Rootei peek kosiirei metinnyu; ki aleen, “Kagigeswa.”
Ki aguur kaineng'ung', ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ami keriinget ne loo miising'.
Ki igas kutinnyu: “Ametiim itiiguk ye ariirchin agobo toreteet, ago koono kagaigaet!”
Ki iriigu eng' peetuut ne ki aguurin: ki imwa ile, “Meiywei!”
Ki itononji ng'aleegap muguleldanyu, ee Kiptaiyat; ki ityaach saboondanyu.
Ki igeer kanyalilenyu ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ibesyeiwo kirwoogennyu;
Ki igeer yaaktaennywa tugul ne po mugetuut ak chobutikwak tugul che ki chop agobo anee.
Ki igas inyee chotisyennywa, ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ak chobutikwak tugul che ki chop agobo anee;
Ki igas kutusweegap icheek che king'eetya ak kabwaatutikwak che ibwaati agobo anee peetuut komugul.
Ye tebyei ng'wony icheek ak ko ng'eetos, aa tyendanywa.
Iyaaktochini ng'wony icheek, ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ko uu poisyonigap eunekwak.
Igoochini mugulelwekwak kouegitu, igoochini icheek chubeng'ung'.
Ioonati icheek eng' nereegek, ak ing'em icheek koistoegei kurereetap kipsengwet ne po Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Kalya si komurwoniitu thahabu! Kalya si kowalagiis thahabu che tiliileen miising'! Kagirong' koigap ole-tiliil eng' tabandap ooreet age tugul.
Weeriigap Zion che po kamanuut ne oo ak ko uu thahabu che korooron, kalya si kiyanie icheek tereen, che poisyonigap eunegap cheptereniot!
Agot lelwek kogoochin aarekwak kinet kochuchun, ago kagogolgolit piikyuk, ko uu tyong'igap songolik eng' surkwen.
Yaamjin ng'elyeptap lakweet ne reryei kutinnyi amu melelda; soomei lagok amitwogik, ama mi chii ne putyin.
Icheeget che paegei amitwogigap talbisto kemetoi eng' ortinwek; icheeget che kinerta kalaaksetap ngoroik che piriireen ko tebee kapng'atat.
Amu ki koeet piretap piikyuk kosiir kergong'yetap Sodom, ne ki king'em kigabui eng' sait ne matya, ama twa chii.
Ki tiliileen piikyik che taagunotiin kosiir teluji, ak ki leelachen kosiir cheego. Poorwekwak ko ki piriireen kosiir koik che kiguure peninim, ki sitatiin ko uu koita ne kiguure sapphire.
Ago eng' ra, ko tuuen togoochikwak kosiir nesek; ma kinyiti eng' ortinwek. Namegei irireenikwak ak kawekwak; ki koyaam kogoigei keetit ne yamaat.
Kaigaen icheeget che parei rotwetap chok kosiir icheeget che parei rupeet; che mandoi sabeet mutyo, amu ma nyoor amitwogigap mbar.
Ki konam kwonyiik che ki tinyei rireenet lagokwak koyo; ki ek chooto amitwogikwak eng' ng'emisyetap piikyuk.
Ki koyai Kamuktaindet ne Toroor nereegekyik che ng'woneen kosulda, ki korong' nereegekyik che koroomen; ak ki konaam maat eng' Zion, ne ki kobeel lumeiywekyik.
Ki ma koyani laitorinigap ng'wony, anan piik tugul che menyei ng'wony, kole imuuchi usiindet anan puunyoot kochut ormariichogap Jerusalem.
Ki piit ko uu niito amu tengekwogigap maotikyik, ak yaitwogigap tisiikyik, che kitumda korotiigap piik che po iman eng' kwenunnyi.
Ombenioti eng' ortinwek ko uu kipkoratinik, ki komurwanitu amu korotiik, kot koma ko kanyei chii kotiny ngoroikwak.
Ki wokyi piik koleenji, “Oistegei, murwonen! Oistegei, oistegei, amatotiny!” Ara ki ek che mweisoti ak ko ombeniot, ak ki leenjigei piigap pororyosyek, “Ma kotebyei olito kogeny.”
Ki koseerseer `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ineendet icheek; ma koiti `Inee icheek kogeny; ma koiti tisiik koek kiy, ama kotinyei konyit poisyek.
Kagong'etyo konyekyok kigeni toreteet ne ma kigeere; ki kigen eng' kagenisyet kowelelegei pororyet ne ka ma imuuchi kosar chii.
Ki cheeng' kakwautikyok, kot ko ki mata kimuuchi keebe eng' ortinwekyok. Kagesunennyo ko ki riik, peetuusyekyok ko ki kiiti amu ki kagoit let nenyo.
Che ki onatech ko ki chepcheben kosiir kipsichinigap parak, ki onatech eng' tuloonook, ki ripistos kogenech eng' surkwen.
Ineendet ne iilaat ne po Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, kabusetap saboonwekyok, ko ki namji keriingonikwak, ne ki kimwae acheek keleen, “Eng' urwetap kebebaikyik ko ki menyei kwenutap pororyosyek.”
Paibaitu ak igaskei, ee cheptap Edom, ne imenye emetap Uz; amu agot aginye ko ityinin kigombet; ibogiti ak iputkei itebi aach ngor.
Piretap tengektong'ung', ee cheptap Zion ko kagosulda; ma komutin kogeny keluulin: ago tengektong'ung', ee cheptap Edom, ko iityin ineendet pireet, ng'aanyei tengekwogiguk kotook.
Ibwaat anyun, ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, kiit ne kagoityech; keero, keer chotisyennyo!
Ki kigoochi porotennyo kiprutoin, ki kigoochi kooriikyok piich che po emotinwo alak.
Ko keegu piich che ma tinyei sigiik ak che ma tinyei kwan. Kogoigei kametisyekyok mosoogik.
Si ke ee peekyok, ko agoi keal eng' robiinik; si kenyooru keetiikyok, ko agoi keal.
Ichegeet che onatech, ko ang'juto neegit konamech kaat; kigeng'etye ama ki tinyei kamuung'et.
Ki kigonugei kegoochi toretetap euut Misiri ak Assyria, asi kenyooru amitwogik che yamech.
Ki yai tengek kwanisyekyok ak ma komi; ang'ni anyun kigegesen tengekwogikwak.
Poiywech otwogik; ma mi chii ne sarwech kemang'une eunekwak.
Kindoii saboonwekyok ng'oiyondit si kobiit kenyooru amitwogik, amu rotwetap chok eng' surkwen.
Laldos irireenikyok ko uu ole kilaali amu rubeet ne lalei ne po iljet.
Ki inyaliil `murenik kwonyiik eng' Zion ak konyaliil pergeinik eng' nganasoogap Judah.
Ki igartaat pounik eng' eunekwak; ama nyoor teegisto poisyek.
Kang'etyo neranik koganopi koitap pai, ak terteiyoti lagok kolaei keetiik.
Poisyek che cham komi ormariichet koma komi, ak neranik koma kotyendos.
Ma komi poiboiyet mugulelwekyok; ki kowalak ureryennyo koek riirek.
Ki kobut kuutweet eng' metowekyok; pwo eng' acheek amu ki keyai tengek.
Amu nooto ko kagonyalulso mugulelwekyok; amu tuguuchuuto ka kagogoryo konyekyok.
Amu tulweetap Zion, ne ki koek karaatya; ko pendate lelwek olooto.
Ago inyee, ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ii laitorani koigeny; laitornateng'ung' kotononi ko po ibinda agoi ibinda age.
Amu nee anyun si iutyenech agoi? Amu nee si imeteech ne tee noo?
Waleech kewekyiingei, ee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, si keeweege; ileliit peetuusyekyok ko uu keny,
aiya ko ki ieesyech miising', ak iting'enech nereegek che ma iitoksei.

Ki ageer ng'ang'utigap Kamuktaindet eng' kenyiitap sosom, eng' arawet ne po ang'wan, eng' peetuutap muut ne po arawanooto ye kingo yaatak kipsengwet ami kobooto luulenik eng' ye neegitee aineetap Kebar.
Eng' peetuut ne po muut ne po arawet, ne ki kenyiitap muut kong'etee ngeluul laitoryat Jehoiakin,
ko ki nyoonji `ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Ezekiel tisiindet, weeriitap Buzi, eng' emetap Kaldeik, eng' ye neegitee aineetap Kebar; ak kimi eutap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor paragunnyi eng' olooto.

Ogeero! Ki ageer usoonetap ropta ne oo komang'une murot kaataam; pooldet ne oo, kobooto kalyeleet ne oo ne kiyiem kakweng'seet ne kiim. Eng' kwenunnyi ko kitogu kiit ne uu itoondap taet, komang'une kwenutap maat.
Ak ki mang'une kwenunnyi kergeindo ne po tuguuk ang'wan che saptos. Ki uu ni itoondanywa; ki tinyei itoonwek che uu che po chii.
Ki tinyei age tugul togoochik ang'wan, ak ki tinyei age tugul eng' icheek kebebaik ang'wan.
Ak ki chuulotin keelyekwak; ak ki uu keldebesaigap keelyekwak siyogap moita: ak ki ilildoi ko uu itoondap sugunwet ne sitaat.
Ki tinyei eng' kebebaikwak oriit che po komoswekwak ang'wan eunek che uu che po chiito. Ki tinyei icheeget ang'wanu togoochikwak ak kebebaikwak ko uu ni:
kiga namgei kebebaikwak; ki ma kogusegong' ye kibendi; kiwendi age tugul kogeerei tai.

Kergeindap togoochikwak ko ki uu ni: ki tinyei age tugul eng' icheek ko ang'wan togeet ne uu ne po chiito, togeet ne uu ne po ng'etundo eng' komostap tai, togeet ne uu ne po eito eng' komostap kaataam, ak togeet ne uu ne po kipsiichit.
Kibesyotin togoochikwak ak kebebaikwak eng' ole po parak; kiga namgei kebebaik aeng' eng' age tugul, ak kotuch kebebaik aeng' poorwekwak.
Ki wo tai age tugul: ki pa icheek ole kamach muguleldo; ki ma kogusegong' ye kibendi.

Kergeindap tuguuchooto saptos ko ki uu itoondanywa ng'etetyot, ko uu tagunetap kegenganik: kiwendate maata kwenutap tuguuchooto saptos: ak ki ikweng'sei miising' maata, ak ki mang'une kalyeleet maata.
Ak ki rwaei tuguuchooto saptos ak koweechegei ko uu kakweng'eetap kalyeleet.
Kingo ta ageere anyun tuguuchooto saptos, ogeero, ki tonone ng'wony tireet agenge eng' ye neegitee tuguuchooto saptos, kotinyei age tugul eng' togoochichooto ang'wan cheptirennyi.
Ki uu itoondap tiroochooto kobooto poisyennywa, itoondap berulo: ak ki tinyei icheek tugul ko ang'wan kergeindo agenge: ak ki uu itoondanywa ak poisyennywa tireet ne mi kwenutap tireet age.
Ye ki pendi kobunei komoswekwak ang'wan: ki ma kogusegong' ye ki pendi.
Ki torooreen kariik che tyektoe tiroochooto ak ki imuisei; ak ki nyiitootiin koonyek komoswek tugul eng' kariikwak che tyektoe, che ki tinyei icheek tugul ko ang'wan.
Ak ye kingo pa tuguuchooto saptos, koba tiroochooto ak icheek koboiyotyin: ak ki ngeganap tuguuchooto saptos eng' ng'wony, keganapta tiroochooto ak icheek.
Ki pa ui tugul ole kamach kabuuset; kiwendi kabuuset olooto agine: ak ki kiganapta tiroochooto tuguuchooto; amu kimi kabuusetap kioto sabei, tirook.
Kingo pa chuun, koba chu ak icheek; ak kingo tononso chuun, kotononso chu ak icheek; ak ki ngeganap chuun eng' ng'wony, keganapta tirook ak icheek: amu kimi kabuusetap kioto sabei tirook.
Ak kimi paragutap metitap kioto sabei kergeindap sengwetyet, ne uu peek che kagau che imuisei, ne ki kiitoe paragutap metowekwak.

Ak ki chuulotin kebebaikwak eng' kurereetap sengwetyet ko katokyigei `age age: ki tinyei age tugul kebebaik aeng' che tuchei komosi, ak ki tinyei age tugul kebebaik aeng' che tuchei komosin, che tuchei poorwekwak.

Ak kingo pendi, agas kirgirenetap kebebaikwak ko uu cheetap peek che chaang', ko uu tweguunetap Ineendet Ne po Kamuktaet, ko uu cheet ne imuuti, ne kergei ak cheetap lugeet: kingo tononso kochoor kebebaikwak kobwa ng'wony.
Ak ki piit cheet eng' paragutap sengwetyet ne ki mi paragutap metowekwak: kingo tononso, kochoor kebebaikwak kobwa ng'wony.

Ak kimi paragutap sengwetyet, ne ki mi paragutap metowekwak, kergeindo ne po ng'echereetap laitornatet, ne uu itoondanyi koita ne kiguure sapphire: ak kimi paragutap kergeindo ne po ng'echeranooto po laitornatet, kergeindo ne po itoondap chiito eng' paragunnyi.

Ak ki ageer kiit ne uu itoondap taet, ko uu itoondo ne po maat eng' ole po oriit eng' komoswek tugul, kong'etee itoondap suennyi ak kwo parak; ak kong'etee itoondap suennyi ak kwo ng'wony, ko ki ageer itoondo ne po maat, ak kigayiem ineendet kakweng'et.

Ko uu ole teptoi itoondap chepkuinobor eng' poolik eng' peetuutap ropta, ko ki uu nooto itoondap kakweng'et eng' komoswek tugul. Ki niito itoondap kergeindo ne po liilindap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor. Ak kinga keer, abut kot kotiiny togeet, ak ki agas kutitap ineendet ne ki ng'alaali.
Ak kimwaiwo koleenjo, Ee, weeriitap chii, tonon, si ang'alaalun.
Ak ye ki ng'alaalwo ineendet, konyoonjo anyun kabuusetap Kamuktaindet ak konama atonon; ak ki agas kong'alaalwo ineendet.
Kimwaiwo koleenjo, Ee, weeriitap chii, kayookten iwe emetap piigap Israel, ye mi pororyosyek che ngelelik, che ki kongelelja; ki kongelelja icheek kobooto kwanisyekwak agoi peetuuni.
Ak ma tinye kalilanet lagok ak ko uueen mugulelwekwak. Kayookten iwe ye mi pichooto, ak ileenji icheek, mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ko uu niito.
Agot ngo kas icheek anan koma kas, (amu icheeget ko koot ne ngelelyo,) ko tuun naei kole kimi maotyot kwenunnywa.

Meiywei icheek anyun inyee, weeriitap chii, anan iywei ng'aleekwak. Meiywei agot ngo yiemin katook che rutei piich ak che toorei piich ak imenye kwenutap tagolik. Meiywei ng'aleekwak anan itoptoben eng' togoochikwak, agot nganda koot ne ngelelyot.
Mwachi icheek ng'aleekyuk, agot ngo kas anan koma kas; amu ngelelik miising'.
Ago kas inyee, ee weeriitap chii, kiit ne amwaun; amengelel ko uu koyooto ngelelyot; yaat kuting'ung' ak iam kiit ne agoonin.
Ki ageer anyun, ak ogeero ki kiyogoiywa euut ne kinamei bukuit ne mamanat.
Ki iito eng' tainnyu; ak ki kisir oriit ak saang'; ak kiga kisirchi yooto kateiyasyek, riirek ak nyalilwogik.
