Kimwaiwo koleenjo, “Ee, weeriitap chii, am ne kenyooru; am bukuini mamanat ak iwe ing'alaalji kootap Israel.”
Ki ayaat anyun kutinnyu, ak ki koono aam bukuinooto.
Yeityo koleenjo, Weeriitap chii, pai kobiyo moeng'ung' eng' bukuini kagoonin. Ki aam anyun; ak ki anyiny eng' kutinnyu ko uu kumyat.
Ak ki leenjo, Weeriitap chii, ui kootap Israel ak imwachi icheek ng'aleekyuk.
Amu ma kiyookten iwe ye mi piik che megase ng'aleekwak anan ko che po kutit ne uui, ago iwe kootap Israel.
Ma kiyookten iwe pororyosyek che chaang' che po ng'aleek che teer anan ko che po kutit ne uui, che memuuchi igas ng'aleekwak. Iman, nda ko kayooktochin icheek, ko kota kasin.
Ago ma kasin kootap Israel; amu ma machei icheek kogasa; amu uueen metowo ago uueen mugulelwok koot tugul ne po Israel.
Keero, kaayai togeng'ung' kogirinda togoochikwak, ak kaauit turyetap togeng'ung' kogirinda turyetap togoochikwak.
Kaayai turyetap togeng'ung' kouiit ko uu koita ne uui kosiir rwandet ne uui; ameiywei pichooto anan itoptoben eng' togoochikwak, agot nganda kot ne ngelelyot.
Kimwaiwo ineendet kogeny koleenjo, Ee weeriitap chii, taach eng' muguleldang'ung' ak igas eng' itiiguk, ng'aleekyuk tugul che amwaun.
Yeityo iwe ole mi che ki kiluul, agoi kaplagogap piiguk, ak ing'alaalji icheek, ileenji, “Mwaei ko uu ni Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor”; agot ngo kas anan ko ngo ma kas.
Yeityo koganaba kabuusetap Kamuktaindet, ak agas cheetap kirgirenet ne oo eng' patennyu, kole, “Iberuurot toroornatetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kong'etee oldanyi.”
Ak ki agas cheet ne po kebebaigap tuguuchooto saptos ye kitiinyegei, ak kirgirenetap tirook che ki namgei tugul, nooto ko cheetap kirgirenet ne oo.
Koganaba anyun kabuusetap Kamuktaindet, ak komuta oldo age; ak ki awe eng' ng'wanindo, eng' nereegegap saboondanyu, ak kichiila eutap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' kimnateet.
Ki anyoo ye mi icheek che ki kiluul eng' Tel-abib ye neegitee aineetap Kebar. Ki anyoo ak ki atebee olooto, peetuusyek tisap, akwong'e.
Ak kingo kagogeskei peetuusyek tisabu, konyoonjo ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, koleenjo:
Ee weeriitap chii, kandein iegu riibindet eng' kootap Israel: kas anyun ng'olyoot ne amwae, ak iteechi icheek eng' ng'olyoondennyu.

Ye amwachi kiptengekyot aleenji, Imee iman; ama iteechi ineendet, anan ing'alaal iteechi kiptengekyot kometo ooreennyi ne ya, si kobiit isaru saboondanyi; meei kiptengekyondonooto eng' tengektanyi; ago amagenen korotiikyik.
Ago ngot iteechi kiptengekyot, ama week chiichooto kometo yaityennyi, anan kometo ooreennyi ne ya, komeei eng' tengektanyi; ago kaisaru saboondang'ung'.

Kogeny, ngo masta chiito ne po iman, kometo imandanyi, ak koyai tengekto, ak ande kanagutyet tainnyi, komeei ineendet; ko amu ma iteechi, komeei anyun eng' tengektanyi, ama kibwaati poisyonikyik che po iman, che kiga koyai; ago amagenen korotiikyik.
Ago ngot iteechi chiito ne po iman, si ma yai chiichooto po iman tengekto, ama yai tengekto, kosabei iman, amu ki kas kateunet; ak kaisaru saboondang'ung'.
Ak kimi paragunnyu eutap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' olooto; ak ki leenjo, Ng'eet, ui warenget, si ang'alaalun eng' olooto.
Ki ang'eet anyun ak awe warenget: ak ogeero, ki tonon liilindo ne ki ageer eng' ye neegitee aineetap Kebar: ak ki abut kot kotiiny togeet ng'wony.
Kichuta anyun kabuusetap Kamuktaindet, ak konama atonon; ak ki ng'alaalwo, koleenjo, Ui, kerchigei koong'ung'.
Ago, keero, inyee weeriitap chii, ratenen pichooto poroonik, ak koratin eng' tuguuchooto si memande ole mi icheek:
ak ayae ng'eleptang'ung', kouiit eng' kuting'ung', si konamagen kuut, si ma itechini icheek: amu icheeget ko koot ne ngelelyot.
Ak ye ang'alaalun ayaate kuting'ung', ak ileenji icheek, Mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole, ingogas ineendet ne kasei; ak ingoesyo ineendet ne eesyoi: amu icheeget ko koot ne ngelelyot.
Ee, inyee weeriitap chii, cheeng'jingei matabaryat, ak inde taing'ung' ak isir itoondap nganaseet, nooto Jerusalem:
ak iyiem, ak iteech irimoik iyieme, ak iwasyi ng'ung'unyek, ak iteech kooriik kotokyigei, ak inde komoswek tugul injinisyek che kibute nganaseet.

Yeityo icheeng' taabeetap karnet, ak ilumde koek tooteetap karnet eng' kwenung'ung', ak nganaseet: ak itokyi togeng'ung' nganaseet, si kobiit keyiem, ak iyiem inyeendet, ak imuut ineendet. Egu niito kaboorunet eng' kootap Israel.
Ak iru kogeny isyep komostap kaataam, ak inde tengektap kootap Israel paragunnyi: iibe tengektonywa ko uu koitetap peetuusyek che isyebe komosato.
Amu ki ang'at kenyiisyegap tengektonywa koek eng' inyee koitetap peetuusyek, chooto ko peetuusyek pogol somok ak tamanwogik sogool: iibe anyun ko uu nooto tengektap kootap Israel.
Ak kogeny, ye kaiyai chuuto kosulda, iru isyep komostap tai, ak iibe tengektap kootap Judah: peetuusyek artam, peetuut agenge ko po kenyiit agenge, kang'atiin anyun ko uu nooto.
Ak itokyi togeng'ung' yiemetap Jerusalem, koma tugoot eung'ung'; ak imaotenji.
Keero, aratenen poroonik, si meweege isyep komosta age, agoi igeesu peetuusyegap yiemeng'ung'.

Ipchigei anyun kogeny nganuuk, ak baale, ak magandek, ak sogoryek, ak mosong'ik ak kusemet, ak inde tereet agenge, ak ichopchinegei amitwogik; ko uu koitetap peetuusyek che irue isyebe kebeber, chooto peetuusyek pogol somok ak tamanwogik sogool, iame tuguuchooto.
Ak iame amitwogiguk che kigerei, shekelisyek tiptem eng' peetuut; iame chooto kotugul.
Ak ee peek che kigerei, iee kigombok aeng' eng' peetuut.
Iame ko uu magatiinik ak baale, ak ibeele ng'atateegap piik kogeerei icheek.
Ak ki mwa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole, amei ko uu nooto piigap Israel magatinikwak ko ng'woneen, eng' pororyosyek ole tuun aoonjini.

Ki amwa anyun ale, “Ee, Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor! Keero, tomo kimurwon saboondanyu; amu kobooch ko aa ming'in agoi nguno kotom aam kiy ne kameei ineegei, anan ne kabar tyong'in; ama chut kutinnyu panyeek che ng'woneen.”
Yeityo koleenjo anyun, Keero, kaagoonin ng'atateegap tuuga igeere che po piik, ak ichobe magatiniguk chooto.
Ki leenjo kogeny, Ee weeriitap chii, keero, atile amitwogik eng' Jerusalem kong'ering'itu: ak koamei icheek amitwogik che kigerei, che kendoi kot; ak eei peek che kigerei, ak eng' kwong'eet.
Si kobiit korarchi amitwogik ak peek, ak kokwong'ee `age age, ak kochuchuiso eng' tengektonywa.

Ee inyee, weeriitap chii, cheeng'jingei rotwetap chok ne ng'atip, ak iboisyee ko uu rotwetap chiito ne inemu metit, si icherunee meting'ung' ak tamneng'ung': yeityo inam kiit ne kirogendoisye, ak igere, si ipchee sumeechooto.

Ak ibeel kebeberta agenge eng' somok eng' kwenutap nganaseet, ye kagosulda peetuusyegap yiemet; ak iip kebeberta age eng' somok ak irarate iep kotuiyo eng' rotwonooto po chok; ak iseerte kebeberta agenge eng' somok koip usoonet, ak ang'usu rotwetap chok asube icheek.
Ak inam suumeek che ng'ering', ak iratyi ngoryeeng'ung'.
Ak inemu alak eng' chuuto kogeny, ak iwiirchi ma, ak ibeel eng' ma; si komang'une maat sumeechooto ak kobeel koot tugul ne po Israel.
Mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole niito ko Jerusalem: ki ande kwenutap pororyosyek, ak mi emotinwek komoswekyik.

Ak ki kongelelji kirwoogutikyuk amu ki yai sogornateet kosiir pororyosyek alak, ak kongelelji ng'atuutikyuk kosiir emotinwek che mi komoswekyik tugul: amu ki koeesyo kirwoogutikyuk, ama pendate icheek ng'atuutikyuk.

Mwaei anyun Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Amu oo piik che wasegei kosiir pororyosyek che mi komoswekwok, ama obendate ng'atuutikyuk, ama oriip kirwoogutikyuk, ama osup ng'atuutigap pororyosyek che mi komoswekwok;
mwaei anyun Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole ogeero, aboryenen agane; ak ayai kirwoogutik eng' kwenung'ung' eng' taitap pororyosyek.
Ak ayai eng' inyee kiit ne tomo ayae, ak kiit ne ma tuun ayae ne uu nooto kogeny, amu tuguuguk tugul che kiwechei.
Amei anyun kwanisyek weeriik eng' kwenung'ung', ak koam weeriik kwanisyekwak; ak ayai kirwoogutik eng' inyee, ak aseer piik tugul che ng'etu eng' okweek, aseerchi usoonaik tugul.

Mwaei anyun Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole, ko uu ye asabe aming'inin iman, amarirenen kondanyu, anan koriira moo, amu ki ing'wanit oldanyu ne tiliil eng' tuguuguk tugul che samisen, ak tuguuguk tugul che kiwechei.

Meei kebeberta agenge eng' somok eng' inyee eng' koroito, ak kigeesu icheek eng' rubeet eng' kwenung'ung'; ak kobek eng' rotwetap chok kebeberta agenge eng' somok, eng' komosweguk tugul; ak aseer kebeberta agenge eng' somok koba koriswek tugul, ak ang'usu rotwetap chok koosup icheek.

Isuldoi anyun nereegekyuk ko uu nooto, ak anereekyini icheek eng' nereegekyuk che ng'woneen, kot koyama, si kigaigaa: si konai icheek kole anee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne ki ang'alaal eng' kagiilennyu pogei, ye kaayai nereegekyuk che ng'woneen kosulda eng' icheek.
Kogeny ayain iegu karaatya ak ne kiteweeri, eng' pororyosyek che mi komosweguk tugul, eng' taitap icheek tugul che siirtoi.

Egu ko uu nooto anyun teweernateet ak sasisyet, kaneetisyet ak kwong'eet, eng' pororyosyek che mi komosweguk tugul, ye ayae kirwoogutik eng' inyee eng' nereegek, ak eng' nereegek che ng'woneen, ak eng' kereetap kong' ne ng'waan: kaamwa anee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ng'olyoondoniito:
ye amwoge icheek kipchabonik che yaacheen che po rubeet, che po ng'emisyet, che ayoogu kong'emak, ak ateswok rubeet, ak atile amitwogikwok.

Ak ayookwok rubeet, ak tyong'ik che yaacheen, che parenen piik; ak kobun kwenung'ung' koroito ak korotiik; ak aibun rotwetap chok konyo paragung'ung': kaamwa anee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ng'olyoondoniito.
Ak ki nyoonjo ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor koleenjo,
Ee weeriitap chii, tokyi togeng'ung' tuloonoogap Israel, ak imaotenji,

ileenji, ogas okweek tuloonoogap Israel, ng'olyootap Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor: mwachin Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor tuloonook che eecheen ak che mengeechen, kereruusyek ak atebwosyek: Ogeero, aibwok agane rotwetap chok, ak ang'em komoswekwok che torooreen.
Ak koek karatwek kapkorosusyekwok, ak ketui kanamonikwok che po asiista: ak awirte piikwok che kigebar, eng' taitap kanamonikwok.
Ak ande muuswegap piigap Israel taitap kanamonikwak; ak aseerchi kawekwok komoswek tugul che po kapkorosusyekwok.

King'emei nganasook eng' meng'otosyekwok tugul, ak koek karatwek komoswek che torooreen; si kobiit keng'em kapkorosusyekwok ak keyai koek karatwek, ak ketui kanamonikwok kobetyo, ak keep kanamonikwok che po asiista, ak kigees poisyonikwok.
Ak kobutyo eng' kwenung'wong' che tuun ki parei, si onai ole aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ago atuuchi che ng'etu, si kobiit onyooru che chilildos eng' rotwetap chok eng' pororyosyek, ye kiseerak obe emotinwek.

Ak kobwaata icheek che chilildos eng' okweek eng' pororyosyek ole tuun kimutyin koek luulenik, ko uu ye ki komea mugulel agobo kugoinatetap mugulelwekwak, che ki koistoenagei, ak agobo konyekwak, che ibotegei ak kanamonikwak: ak wechegei icheegei agobo yaitwogik che ki koyai eng' tuguukwak tugul che kiwechei.
Ak konai kole aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor: ma amwa puch ale ayachini icheek yaityoni.

Mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: “Irabaach eng' eung'ung' ak ityech eng' keeldong'ung',” ak ile, pwo amu tuguuk tugul che kiwechei che po kootap Israel: amu parei icheek rotwetap chok, ak rubeet, ak koroito.

Parei koroito ineendet ne mi ole loo; ak parei rotwetap chok ineendet ne neegit; ak parei rubeet ineendet ne ng'etu ne ki kigerchi nganaseet: ayae nereegekyuk che ng'woneen kosulda ko uu nooto eng' icheek.

Ak onai ole aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ye tuun mi piikwak che kigebar, kobooto kanamonikwak, che mi kapkorosusyekwak komoswekwak tugul eng' tulweet age tugul ne ming'in ne toroor, eng' walisyek tugul che po tuloonook, ak eng' kelutap keetit age tugul ne tuon, ak eng' kelutap keetit age tugul ne nyigiis, ole kibeeljine kanamonikwak tugul nyamdutik.
Ak achuulji icheek eunnyu, ak ayai emet koguber ak koek karaatya, kobooch surkwen kotokyigei Dibla, eng' meng'otosyekwak tugul: si konai icheek kole aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ki nyoonjo kogeny ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor koleenjo,
Ee inyee, weeriitap chii, mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor komwachin emetap Israel, koleenjin, Kagesunet: kagonyonji kagesunet luukwek ang'wan che po emet.
Kaityin anyun kagesunet, ak ayoogun nereegekyuk, ak arwoogun ko uu ortinweguk; ak aibun tuguuguk tugul che kiwechei.
Amarirenen kondanyu, ama riira moo: ago aibu ortinweguk, ak kotebee kwenung'ung' tuguuguk che po wegeet: si onai ole aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Yaityet, yaityet kityo, keero, nyoonei.
Kagonyo kagesunet, ng'eetyinin; keero, nyoonei.
Kagonyonjin kagikyineng'ung', ee inyee ne imeng'iisyei eng' emet: kagoit peetuusyek, kagoriik peetuut; peetuutap wasetapkei eng' tuloonook, ma waagaat ne po poiboiyet.
Karik anyun si aroong'jin nereegekyuk che ng'woneen, ak ayai kosulda nereegekyuk eng' inyee, ak arwoogun ko uu ortinweguk; ak aibun tuguuguk tugul che kiwechei.
Amarirenen kondanyu, ama riira moo: aibun ko uu ortinweguk, ak kotebee kwenung'ung' tuguuguk che po wegeet; si onai ole aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne abirisyei.
Keer peetuut o, keero, nyoonei: kagonyo kagikyineng'ung'; kagoyesyo taaptogap kirokto, kagong'at menoteet.
Kang'eet koroomnateet koek kirokto ne po tengekto; ma mi ne ng'etu eng' icheek, anan ne po chaang'indonywa, anan ne po mogornatennywa: ama piitu kateeiyet eng' kwenunnywa.
Kagoit peetuusyek, riigu peetuut: amat kobaibait alindet, anan koaragen aldaindet: amu miitei nereegek eng' chaang'indonywa tugul.
Amu ma weekyingei aldaindet kiit ne ki aldoi, agot ngo ta kosabei: amu po ng'ang'utyet tuiyet komugul, ma weechegei chii; ama igimitegei chii tengektap sabeennyi.
Kagoguut iryageet, ak kagochop tuguuk tugul; ago ma mi ne wendi pooryeet: amu mi nereegekyuk chaang'indonywa tugul.
Mi saang' rotwetap chok, komi oriit koroito, ak rubeet: ineendet ne mi mbar komeei eng' rotwetap chok; ak ineendet ne mi nganaseet, koamei rubeet ineendet ak koroito.
Ago chilildos icheeget che chilildos, ak koigei eng' tuloonook cheptugenigap atebwosyek, riirtos tugul, riirei chii age tugul eng' tengektanyi.
Nyaluldos eunek tugul, ak kochootyo kutung'oik tugul ko uu peek.
Kermenegei kogeny kuniok, ak kotuch icheek kamuiset; ak kolilaanso tugul, ak konam icheek tugul pooswek.

Wiirchin fedhaisyekwak ortinwek, ak koigei thahabusyekwak kiit ne murwoon; ma imuuchi kosar icheek fedhaisyekwak ak thahabusyekwak eng' peetuutap nereegegap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor; ma piyong'dos saboonwekwak, anan konyi mootinwekwak: amu kagoek kanagutyetap tengektonywa.
Kigainde etunateet karaaranindap lelestanyi: ago ki yai kanamonigap tuguukwak che kiwechei kobooto tuguukwak che samis eng' olooto: koayai anyun kioto koek kiit ne murwoon eng' icheek.
Ak ande kioto eunegap toek koluul, ak ande eunegap kiptengeginigap ng'wony koluul; ak kong'wanit.
Ak atuktoochi patai, ak kong'wanit oldanyu ne po ung'oot: ak kochut olooto rebiik, ak kong'wanit.
Itaany sirimdo: amu kanyi emet kirwoogutigap korotiik, ak kanyi nganaseet koroomnateet.
Amutu anyun piik che yaach miising' eng' pororyosyek, ak konam kooriikwak kobunji: ak ageesu kogeny menoteetap che kiimeen; ak king'wanit komoswekwak che tiliileen.
Nyoonei ng'emisyet; ak kocheeng' icheek kaalyeet, ama piitu.
Nyoonei pichiindo kosubu pichiindo, ak pwoonei ng'aleegap piik koosup ng'aleegap piik; ak kocheeng' ng'ang'utyetap maotyot; ago petei ng'atuutyet eng' tisiindet, ak kobet kirwooget eng' poisyek.
Riirei laitoryat, ak kilaakyi pounindet pananda, ak kinyalil eunegap piigap emet; ayachini icheek ko uu ooreenywa, ak arwookyini ko uu ye nyoljin; si konai icheek kole aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.

Ki nyoonjo eutap Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' kenyiit ne po lo, eng' arawetap lo, eng' peetuut ne po muut ne po arawanooto, ye ki atebye eng' koonnyu, ak kotebyei poisyegap Judah eng' tainnyu.
Ageer anyun, ogeero, kergeindo ne uu itoondap maat; kong'etee itoondap suennyi ak kwo ng'wony, ko ki uu maat, ak kong'etee suennyi ak kwo parak, ko uu itoondap kakweng'et, ko uu itoondap taet.

Ak ki iyogoi kiit ne uu euut, konam suumeekyuk ak kiganaba Kabuuset ne Tiliil eng' kwenutap ng'wony ak kipsengwet, ak komutwaa eng' ng'ang'utigap Kamuktaindet anyo Jerusalem, agoi kurgeetap ormariichet ne po seremut ne po oriit ne tokyingei murot kaataam; ole ki mi ng'echereetap kanamwetap ng'etkonda, ne tagisyei kogoonu ng'etkonda.
Ak ogeero, kimi olooto liilindap Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindetap Israel, ko uu itoondo ne ki ageer ami warenget.

Ki leenjo anyun ineendet, Ee weeriitap chii, tooben anyun komostap murot kaataam. Atoben anyun komostap murot kaataam, ak ogeero, kimi kanamwonooto po ng'etkonda komostap murot kaataam ne po ormariichetap kaptisisyet eng' ole kimandoe.

Ak ki leenjo ineendet, Ee weeriitap chii, igeere kiit ne yaei icheek? Chooto ko tuguuk che eecheen che kiwechei che yaei kootap Israel eng' yu, si awo alooit eng' oldanyu ne tiliil? Ago ta igeere kogeny tuguuk alak che eecheen che kiwechei.
Ak ki imutwaa anyo kurgeetap seremut; ak kinga keer, ogeero, kimi konda tooteet.
Yeityo koleenjo, Weeriitap chii, undur tooteet: ak kinga undur tootoonooto, ogeero, kimi kurgeet.
Ak ki leenjo, Ui oriit, si igeer tuguuk che yaach che kiwechei che yaei icheek eng' olito.

Ki awe anyun oriit, ak ageer, ak ogeero, kimi itoondap age tugul ne po tyong'ik che ichuutegei, ak tyong'ik che kiwechei, ak kanamonik tugul che po kootap Israel, che ki kisirchi itoonwekwak tooteet komoswekwak tugul.

Ak kitononie taitap kanamonichooto piik tamanwogik tisap che po poisyegap Israel, ak kitonone kwenunnywa Jaasania weeriitap Sapan, kotinyei chii age tugul tereennyi eng' eunnyi, ne kibeelse; ak kitogosta iyeto ne po ng'uunetap nyamdutik.

Ki leenjo anyun ineendet, Ee weeriitap chii, tos kaigeer kiit ne yaei poisyegap kootap Israel, eng' ole imen, komi chii age tugul kooriikyik che po oriit che po kanamonik? Amu leen icheek, Mageerech Kamuktaindet ne Toroor; ki kometo Kamuktaindet ne Toroor emoni.
Ki leenjo kogeny, Ta igeere kogeny tuguuk alak che eecheen che kiwechei che yaei icheek.
Yeityo komutwaa anyo kurgeetap ormariichet ne po kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne kitokyigei murot kaataam; ak ogeero, kimi kwonyiik eng' olooto che kitebyei koriirchin Tamus.
Yeityo koleenjo, Kaigeer niito o, weeriitap chii? Ta igeere tuguuk alak che eecheen che kiwechei kosiir chuuto.

Ak ki imutwaa seremut ne po oriit ne po kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ak ogeero, kimi piik che neegit tiptem ak muut eng' kurgeetap Hekaluutap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, eng' kwenutap keterut ak kaptisisyet, che kaituktoochi patai Hekaluutap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ak kotokyigei kong'asiis; ak ki sa asiista kotokyingei kong'asiis.

Yeityo koleenjo, Kaigeer niito o, weeriitap chii? Tos kiy ne ming'in eng' kootap Judah ngo yai icheek eng' olito tuguuk che kiwechei? Amu kigonyiit emet koroomnateet, ak ki kowelelgei kogeny kotacha: ak keero, indoi temetap keetit seruunekwak.
Ayae anyun agane eng' nereegek che ng'woneen: ma rireenen kondanyu, ama riira moo: agot nganda riircho eng' waagaat ne oo, koma kasyini.
Yeityo komwaiwo eng' kutit ne oo, agase, koleenjo, Mwachji icheeget che riibei nganaseet koriik, kotinyei chii age tugul karnennyi ne parisye eng' eunnyi.

Ak ogeero, ki pwa piik lo kobunu ooreetap ormariichet ne po meto, ne tokyingei murot kaataam, kotinyei chii age tugul karnennyi ne parisye; ak ki ilaachi chiito agenge eng' icheek ngoryeetap katanit, kotinyei age tugul laletap wino eng' suennyi. Ak ki pa oriit, ak kotononie ole neegitee kaptisisyetap sugunwet.

Ak kitogosta liilindap Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindetap Israel eng' ole mi kerubindet, ole kitebee, kwo ole po tugatugigap koot: ak kitwekyi chiito ne ki ilaachi ngoryeetap katanit, ne ki tinyei laletap wino eng' suennyi.

Ak ki leenji `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ineendet, Ui pun kwenutap nganaseet, kwenutap Jerusalem, ak ing'ooch turyosyegap togoochigap piik che tigendos ak koriirtos agobo tuguuk tugul che kiwechei che ki yai eng' kwenunnyi.
Ak ki mwachi alak agase, koleenji, oba obun nganaseet, osup ineendet, ak obarisyote amat koriiree konyekwok, anan koriiraak moo:
obar ogesu poiyo, muren, chepto, ak lagok che mengeechen, ak kwonyiik: ago amat ooriikyi chii age tugul ne ki king'ooch; ak otaune oldanyu ne tiliil. Kitaune anyun poisyek che ki mi taitap koot.
Ak ki leenji icheek, Ong'wanit koot, ak onyiit seremusyek piik che kagebar: oba anyun. Ki pa anyun ak ki paris eng' nganaseet.

Ak ye kita kobarisyoti, ak kigang'etu eng' yooto, abut kot kotiiny togeennyu ng'wony, ak ariir, ak amwa ale, ee, Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor! Tos ibare piik tugul che ki ng'et che po Israel eng' nereegeguk che ng'woneen che roong'jingei Jerusalem?

Koleenjo anyun, Oo kot tengektap kootap Israel ak ne po Judah, kanyi emoni korotiik, ak kanyi nganasani kamaaset ne po kirwoogutik: amu mwaei kole ki kometo Kamuktaindet ne Toroor emoni, ama keerei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ago ne uu anee, ko marire kondanyu, ama riira moo, ago aipchini ooreenywa metowekwak.
Ak ogeero, kimwaita ng'olyoondonooto chiichooto ki ilaachi ngoryeetap katanit, ne ki tinyei laletap wino eng' suennyi, kole, kaayai ko uu ye kageng'ata.
Ki ageer anyun, ak ogeero, ki took eng' sengwetyet, ne ki mi paragutap kerubik, kiit ne ki uu koitap sapphire, ne uu itoondap kergeindap ng'echereetap laitornatet.

Ak ki mwachi chiito ne ki ilaachi ngoryeetap katanit, koleenji chut kwenutap tirook che wirwirendos eng' kurereetap kerubik, ak inyiit euneguk tuwai ng'etetyot ne mi kwenutap kerubik, ak iseerchi nganaseet. Ak ki wo ineendet oriit ageere.
Ki tonondos anyun kerubik eng' komostap tai ne po koot, ye ki wendi chiichooto oriit; ak ki nyi pooldet seremut ne po oriit.
Ak ki togosta liilindap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' kerubik, ak kotonone tugatugigap koot; ak ki nyi koot pooldet, ak ki nyi seremut kakweng'eetap liilindap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ak ki kigasei kirgirenetap kebebaigap kerubik agoi seremut ne po saang', ko uu kutitap Kamuktaindet Ne po Kamuktaet ye ng'alaali.
Ak ye kingo ng'at ineendet chiito ne ki ilaachi ngoryeetap katanit, koleenji, inemu maat eng' kwenutap tirook che wirwirendos eng' kwenutap kerubik. Ki wo oriit anyun ak kotonone ye neegit tireet.
Ak ki iito kerubindet eunnyi eng' kwenutap kerubik kotokyi maat ne ki mi kwenutap kerubik ak konem, ak konde eunegap ineendet ne ki ilaachi ngoryeetap katanit, ne ki nam maata ak komanda.
Ak ki took eng' kerubik ne uu eutap chiito eng' kurereetap kebebaikwak.

Ak ki ageer, ogeero, tirook ang'wan che ki mi ole neegitee kerubik, ki neegitee tireet age kerubindet age, ko neegitee tireet age kerubindet age; ak ki uu itoondap tiroochooto, itoondap koita ne kiguure berulo.
Ki tinyei kergeindo agenge icheek tugul ko ang'wan eng' itoondanywa, ko uu ye ki mi tireet kwenutap tireet age.
Ye ki pendi, kobun komoswekwak ang'wan; ki ma kowelelegei kobendi, ago ki isubi komosta ne kagotokyigei ne tai ki ma kowelelegei ye ki pendi.
Ak ki nyiitootiin koonyek komoswek tugul che po poorwekwak tugul, ak patoikwak, ak eunekwak, ak kebebaikwak, ak tirook, tiroochooto che ki tinyei kerubichooto ang'wanu.
Ki kiguure tiroochooto agase, tirook che wirwirendos.

Ak ki tinyei age tugul togoochik ang'wan: togeet ne po tai ko ki togeetap kerubindet, ak togeet ne po aeng' ko ki togeetap chiito, ak ne po somok ko ki togeetap ng'etundo, ak ne po ang'wan ko ki togeetap kipsiichit.
Ak kitogosta kerubik: niito ko ki it ne sabei ne ki ageer eng' ye neegitee aineetap Kebar.
Ak ye kingo pa kerubik, koba tiroochooto ak icheek koboiyotyin: ak kingo tirirenso kerubik kong'eetyo eng' ng'wony, koma istoegei tirook icheek.
Kingo tononso icheek, kotononso chu ak icheek; ak kingo togosta, kotogosta chu ak icheek: amu ki mi kabuusetap kioto sabei kobooto icheek.
Ak ki wo liilindap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' tugatugigap koot, ak kitonone paragutap kerubik.

Ak kitirirenso kerubik, ak kotogosta eng' ng'wony ageere, ye kibendi, ak kimi tirook kobooto icheek; ak kitononso eng' kurgeet ne po ormariichetap kong'asiis ne po kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor; ak kimi paragunnywa liilindap Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindetap Israel.
Niito ko kioto sabei ne ki ageer eng' kurereetap Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindetap Israel eng' ole neegitee aineetap Kebar ak ki anai ale kerubichooto.
Ki tinyei age tugul togoochik ang'wan ak ki tinyei age tugul kebebaik ang'wan; ak kimi kergeindap eunegap chiito kurereetap kebebaikwak.
Ak ki kergei togoochikwak ak togoochik che ki ageer eng' ole neegitee aineetap Kebar, icheeget kobooto itoonwekwak; kibendi age tugul kogeerei tai.

Kiganaba anyun Kabuuset ne Tiliil, ak komutwaa anyo ormariichetap kong'asiis ne po kootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ne tokyingei kong'asiis: ak ogeero, kimi kurgeetap ormariichet piik tiptemu ak muut; ak ki ageer eng' kwenunnywa Jaasania weeriitap Ashur, kobooto Pelatiah weeriitap Benaiah, pounigap piik.
Ak ki leenjo ineendet, Ee, weeriitap chii, chuuto piik che chobei yaityet, ak korwoochi kirwooget ne ya eng' nganasani:
che leen, Tom koriik peetuusyek che keteege kooriik: tereet nganasani, ak kibanyeek.
Maoten anyun agobo icheek, maoten, ee weeriitap chii.
Ak ki nyoonjo Kabuusetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ak koleenjo, Mwa ile, Mwaei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole ki omwa ko uu ni, ee kootap Israel; amu angen tuguuk che obwaati.
Ki otes eng' nganasani piikwok che kibarei, ak ki onyiit ortinwekyik piik che ki kibar.
Mwaei anyun Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Panyeek piikwok che kigebar che ki onde kwenutap nganaseet, ak nganasani ko tereet: ago kimutwok omang'une kwenunnyi.
Ki oiywei rotwetap chok; ak aibwok rotwetap chok, mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ak amutwok omang'une kwenunnyi, ak andeok eunegap toek, ak ayai kirwoogutik eng' kwenung'ung'.
Obegu eng' rotwetap chok; arwookwok eng' kiwotetap Israel; si onai ole aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ma egu nganasani tereeng'wong', amoegu panyeek eng' kwenunnyi; arwookwok eng' kiwotetap Israel;
ak onai ole aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor: amu ma obendate ng'atuutikyuk, ama oyai kirwoogutikyuk, ago ki osup kirwoogutigap pororyosyek che mi komoswekwok.

Ak kime Pelatiah weeriitap Benaiah ye ki amaoteni, ki abut anyun kot kotiiny togeennyu ng'wony, ak ariir eng' kutit ne oo, ale, ee, Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor! Tos igeesu che ki ng'et che po Israel?
Ki nyoonjo anyun ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, koleenjo,

Ee weeriitap chii, tupchosyeguk, che tupchosyeguk, piigap oreng'ung', kobooto koot komugul che po Israel, icheek tugul, chooto ko che ki komwachi piik che menyei Jerusalem, koleenji, oba ole loo eng' Kamuktaindet ne Toroor; ki kigoonech emoni kobunjech:

mwaa anyun ile, Mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Nganda ki ayestochi icheek ole loo eng' pororyosyek, ak ki aseer icheek koyom emotinwek, kota aegu kora eng' icheek komosta ne tiliil eng' ne matya eng' emotinwek che ki koba.
Mwaa anyun ile, Mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Ayumok omang'une pororyosyek, ak ayumok omang'une emotinwek ole ki oyestoochi, ak agoonok emetap Israel.
Ak koba olooto, ak koisto tuguuk tugul che samisen eng' olooto, kobooto tuguuk tugul che kiwechei, koistogei eng' olooto.
Ak agoochi icheek muguleldo agenge, ak ande icheek sabeet ne leel; ak aiste muguleldap koita eng' poorwekwak, ak agoochi icheek muguleldo ne po panyeek:
si kobendatee ng'atuutikyuk, ak koriip kayomisutikyuk, ak koyai: ak koek icheek piikyuk, ak aegu Kamuktaindennywa.
Ago eng' icheeget che pendoti kosubi tuguukwak che samisen, ak tuguukwak che kiwechei, aipchini ortinwekwak metowekwak, mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Yeityo kotirirenso kerubik, ak kimi tirook kobooto icheek; ak kimi paragunnywa liilindap Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindetap Israel.
Ak kitogosta liilindap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' kwenutap nganaseet ak kwo kotonone tulweet ne mi komostap kong'asiis eng' nganaseet.

Ak kiganaba Kabuuset ne Tiliil, ak komutwaa eng' ng'ang'utyet eng' Kabuusetap Kamuktaindet, anyo Kaldea, agoi ait ole mi icheek che ki kiluul. Ki togosta anyun eng' ole ki ami ng'ang'utyonooto kiga ageer.
Ki amwachi anyun icheek che kiga keluul, tuguuk tugul che kiga koboorwo Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ki nyoonjo kogeny ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor koleenjo,
Ee weeriitap chii, imenye kwenutap koot ne ngelelyot, che tinyei koonyek che keertoe, ama keerei kiy; che tinyei itiik che kastoe, ama kasei kiy; amu icheek ko koot ne ngelelyot.

Ara anyun, inyee weeriitap chii, rat tuguuk agobo kautoet, ak iuu peet kogeerei icheek; ak iuu eng' komostang'ung' iwe komosta age kogeerei icheek: abeere imuuchi kobwaat, nganda icheek ko koot ne ngelelyot.
Ak iibu tuguuguk komong' peet kogeerei icheek, ko uu tuguugap kautoet: ak iwe imande inyeendet koskoleny kogeerei icheek, ko uu ye pendi piik luuleet.
Undur inaatut kogeerei icheek, ak iip tuguuguk kobun yooto.
Iibe itiinye kaat, kogeerei icheek, ak iip komanda ko kagoimen; ituche togeng'ung', si megeer emet: amu kaandein iegu kaboorunet eng' kootap Israel.

Ki ayai anyun ko uu nooto ko uu ye ki king'ata: ki aibu tuguukyuk kobwa saang' peet, ko uu tuguugap kautoet, ak ki aundur inaatut koskoleny, abalee eunnyu: ki aibu tuguukyuk kobwa saang' ko kagoimen, ak aip atiiny kaat kogeerei icheek.
Ak ki nyoonjo karon ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor koleenjo,
Ee weeriitap chii, tomo koteebenen kootap Israel, koot ngelelyot, koleenjin, Iyae nee?
Mwachi ileenji, mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Po lautyoni pounindet eng' Jerusalem, kobooto koot komugul ne po Israel ole mi icheek.
Mwa ile, Aa kaboorunet agobo okweek: ko uu ye ki ayai, keyachin icheek ko uu nooto: kiutoi, kiluulei.
Ibei pounindet ne mi kwenunnywa, kotiinyi kaat, ko kagoimen, ak kwo: unduri icheek inaatut si kobiit kouutoe tuguukwak yooto: tuchei togeennyi, amu ma keerei ng'wony.
Aiitochini mestennyu ineendet, ak konam mestennyu ineendet: ak amut ineendet kwo Babilon emetap Kaldeik: ago ma keerei emonooto, nganda mechin olooto.
Ak aiyeste koba usoonet age tugul, piik tugul che miitei komoswekyik kotoret ineendet, ak lugosyekyik tugul; ak ang'usu rotwetap chok asube icheek.
Ak konai kole aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ye aiyeste icheek eng' pororyosyek, ak aseer icheek koyom emotinwek.

Ago atuuchi piik che ng'ering' eng' icheek kochililee rotwetap chok, ak rubeet, ak koroito; si kobiit kobarta tuguukwak tugul che kiwechei eng' pororyosyek ole tuun pendi; si konai kole aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ki nyoonjo kogeny ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor koleenjo,
Ee weeriitap chii, am amitwogiguk eng' potanet, ak iee peeguk eng' karigisiset kobooto riibetapkei;

ak ileenji piigap emet, Mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor agobo piik che menyei Jerusalem, ak che po emetap Israel kole: Kendoi amitwogikwak, ak koeei peekwak eng' kwong'eet, si koek karaatya emennyi eng' tuguuk tugul che mi, amu koroomnatetap piik tugul che menyei olooto.
Ak king'emei nganasook che ki menyei, ak koguber emet; si onai ole aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ak ki nyoonjo ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor koleenjo,
Ee weeriitap chii, nee kalewenoni otinye eng' emetap Israel, oleen, Kigogagei peetuusyek, ak koek puch ng'ang'utyet age tugul?

Mwachi anyun icheek ileenji, mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ko uu ni kole: Ageesu kalewenoni, si ma koboisyee kogeny koek kalewenet eng' Israel; ago mwachi ileenji, kagoriik peetuusyek, ak kasuldaetap ng'ang'utyet age tugul.
Amu ma kobiitu kogeny ng'ang'utyet age tugul ne po puch anan ng'oorset ne kilasei eng' kootap Israel.

Amu aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor; ang'alaali, ak kosulda ng'olyoot ne amwae; ma kigoitoi kogeny: amu amwae ng'olyoot, ak ageesu eng' peetuusyekwok, ee koot ne ii ngelelyot, mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ki nyoonjo kogeny ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor koleenjo,
Ee weeriitap chii, keero, leen kootap Israel, Ng'ang'utyet ne keerei ineendet ko po peetuusyek che chaang' che pwoonei, ak komaoteni ineendet agobo peetuusyek che ta ko looen.
Mwachi anyun ileenji, mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Ma kigoitoi kogeny ng'olyoondennyu age tugul, ago isuldoi ng'olyoot ne amwae, mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ak ki nyoonjo ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor koleenjo,
Ee weeriitap chii, maotenji igirinde maotigap Israel che maoteni, ak ileenji icheek che maoteni eng' mugulelwekwak icheegei, Ogas ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor:
Mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Pwo! Maotik che perber, che isubi mugulelwekwak icheegei, ak ko tomo kogeer kiy!
Ee Israel, kigoigei maotiguk lelwek eng' ong'atosyek.
Ma otogoste obe ole ki kobutok, ama ong'ot kootap Israel, si kobiit kotonon eng' pooryeet eng' peetuutap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ki kogeer icheek tangoita ak ng'oorset ne po lembech, che mwaei kole, kale Kamuktaindet ne Toroor; ama iyookte Kamuktaindet ne Toroor: ak kogoochi piik komong' kole ki kimiti ng'olyoot.
Tos ma ogeer ng'ang'utyet ne po puch, ama omwa ng'oorset ne po lembech, ye omwae ole, Kale Kamuktaindet ne Toroor: ago ma amwa kiy?
Mwaei anyun Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Amu ki omwa eng' tangoita, ak ogeer lembech, ogeer anyun, aboryenok, mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.

Ak koborye eunnyu maotik che keerei tangoita, ak che ng'orei lembechek: matebee kapkirwoogetap piikyuk, ama kisirchin bukuit ole kisirchin kootap Israel, ama pendi emetap Israel; si onai ole aa Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ee, amu ki koberber piikyuk, koleenji, kaalyeet; ama mi kaalyeet; ak ye teech chiito inaatut, ogeero, male tartaarik che ma myachen:
mwachi icheek che malse taartaarichuuto ileenji, luulei: piitu ropta ne oo; ak koroobon koik che eecheen che po ropta; ak kobet usoonet ne oo inatunooto.
Ogeero, ye luul inatunooto, ko tos ma kiteebenok keele, Mi ano malset ne ki komale inatuniito?

Mwaei anyun Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet kole: Abete inatuniito eng' usoonet ne oo eng' nereegekyuk che ng'woneen; ak kobiit ropta ne oo eng' nereegekyuk, ak koik che eecheen che po ropta eng' nereegekyuk che ng'woneen, si kobiit kogees.
Abute anyun inaatut ne ki omale taartaarik che ma myachen, ak aluul kot kotook lumeiywekyik: ak kobut, ak kigeswok eng' kwenunnyi; si onai ole aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ayae anyun nereegekyuk che ng'woneen kosulda eng' inatunooto, kobooto icheek che kimale taartaarichooto; ak aleenjok, Ma komi inaatut, anan icheek che kimalei;
chooto ko maotigap Israel che maoteni agobo Jerusalem, ak kogeerei ng'ang'utigap kaalyeet agobo nganasanooto, ama miitei kaalyeet, mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ee inyee weeriitap chii, iuuiit togeng'ung' igirinde tiibiigap piiguk, che maoteni eng' mugulelwekwak icheegei; ak imaoten agobo icheek,

ak ileenji, mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Pwo! Kwonyiik che nabei lolotinwegap ndaresik che po kutung'oik tugul che po eunek, ak konap angook che po metit, che yamei chii age tugul si kobiit koriige saboonwegap piik! Tos oriiche saboonwegap piikyuk, ak osaru saboonwegap piik kobunjook?

Ak ki ong'wanita eng' piikyuk agobo baale che po rubeito ak kererutigap magatiinik, si obar saboonwegap piik che ma nyoljin kobek, ak osaru saboonwegap piik che ma nyoljin kosapcho amu lembechekwok che omwachini piikyuk che chamei kogas lembechechooto.

Mwaei anyun Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Ogeero, aweche lolotinwegap ndaresikwok, che oriige saboonwegap piik ko uu toriitik, ak agereeri tuguuchooto eng' eunekwok; ak atyach saboonwechooto po piik koba, saboonwechooto oriiche ko uu toriitik.
Agereeri angookwok ak icheek, ak asaru piikyuk komong' eng' eunekwok, si ma kotebee eunekwok kogeny si keriichei; si onai ole aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Amu ki ogoochi muguleldap chii ne po iman koaragen eng' lembechek, chiito ne ma agoochi koaragen; ak ogimiit eunegap kiptengekyot, si ma week kometo ooreennyi ne ya, ak kesar kosap:
ma ogeere anyun tangoita, anan ong'orse; ak asaru piikyuk komong' eng' eunekwok; si onai ole aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Yeityo kobwanjo alak che po poisyegap Israel, ak kotep ng'wony eng' tainnyu.
Ak konyoonjo ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, koleenjo,
Ee weeriitap chii, kigogonorchigei pichu kanamonikwak eng' mugulelwekwak, ak konde kanagutyetap tengektonywa tainnywa: tos teebena icheek ng'olyoo age tugul?

Ng'alaalji anyun icheek, ileenji, mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ko uu ni kole: Chii age tugul ne po kootap Israel ne konorchingei kanamonikyik eng' muguleldanyi, ak konde kanagutyetap tengektanyi tainnyi, ak konyo ole mi maotyot; awoljini anee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' tuguuchooto ko uu chaang'indap kanamonikyik;
si kobiit anam kootap Israel eng' mugulelwekwak icheeget, amu ki kotoiyenagei icheek tugul amu kanamonikwak.
Mwachi anyun kootap Israel ileenji, mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ko uu ni kole: Oweege, ak owalage omete kanamonikwok; ak otuktoochi patai tuguukwok tugul che kiwechei.

Amu chii age tugul ne po kootap Israel, anan ne po toek ne tebee Israel, ne istoenagei, ak kogonorchigei kanamonikyik eng' muguleldanyi, ak konde kanagutyetap tengektanyi tainnyi, yeityo konyo ole mi maotyot koteepchigei ng'olyoot eng' anee; awoljini aneendet Kamuktaindet ne Toroor chiichooto.
Ak auuiit togeennyu aborye chiichooto, ak ayai ineendet koek ne kikwong'ee, koek kaboorunet ak kalewenet, ak aistoe ineendet eng' piikyuk; si onai ole aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ak ngot kiberber maotyot ak komwa ng'olyoo, ko anee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne kaberberi maotyondonooto, ak atokyi eunnyu, ak ang'em ineendet aiste eng' piikyuk Israel.
Ak koip icheek tengektonywa: tengektap maotyot ko uu tengektap chiito ne cheeng'ei ineendet;
si ma ta koombenot kogeny kootap Israel kometaa, anan kong'wanitkei kogeny eng' pistaosyekwak tugul; ago si koek piikyuk, ak aegu Kamuktaindennywa, mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ki nyoonjo kogeny ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, koleenjo,
Ee weeriitap chii, ye yaiywo emet tengekto eng' pistoet, ak atokyi eunnyu emonooto, ak atil amitwogikyik, ak ayookyi rubeet, ak abar chii ak tyony;
agot nganda mi pichu somogu, Noah, Daniel, ak Job emonooto, ko kota saru saboonwekwak icheegei eng' imandanywa, mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ngot agetu tyong'ik che yaacheen kobun emet, ak kong'em, kot koguber, ne ma komuuchi chii kobun amu tyong'ik;
ko agot nganda mi pichuuto somogu olooto, ko ko uu ye asabe, mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, koma saru icheek weeriik anan tiibiik; kisaru icheeget icheegei, ak koguber emet.
Anan ngot aipchi rotwetap chok emonooto, ak ale, Ee rotwoni po chok, ui pun emet; si abar chii ak tyony;
ko agot nganda mi pichuuto somogu olooto, ko ko uu ye asabe, mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, koma saru icheek weeriik anan tiibiik, ago kisaru icheeget icheegei.
Anan ngot ayookyi koroito emonooto, ak aroong'ji nereegekyuk che ng'woneen atumde korotiik, aiste chii ak tyony:
ko agot nganda mi Noah, Daniel, ak Job olooto, ko ko uu ye asabe, mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, koma saru icheek weeriit anan chepto; ago saru saboonwekwak kityo eng' imandanywa.

Amu mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Kotam nee anyun ye ayookyi Jerusalem kirwoogutikyuk ang'wan che ng'woneen; rotwetap chok, ak rubeet, ak tyong'ik che yaacheen, ak koroito, si kobar chii ak tyony?

Ago, ogeero, kituuchi piik che ng'etu che tuun kimuti, weeriik kobooto tiibiik: ogeero, mong'jinok, ak ogeer ortinwekwak ak poisyonikwak: ak kigaigaak agobo yaityet ne koaipchi Jerusalem, agobo tugul che koaipchi.
Ak kogaigaak, ye ogeer ortinwekwak ak poisyonikwak: si kobiit onai ole ma ayai puch tuguuk tugul che koayai eng' olooto, mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ki nyoonjo ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor koleenjo,
Ee weeriitap chii, siirei eng' nee keetitap sabibuk keetit age tugul, anan temetap keetitap sabibuk ne mi kwenutap keetiigap timiin?
Tos kiebei keetoto si kobiit keyae poisyo? Anan tos yae piik keetoto ireut si kigartate kiy age tugul?
Ogeero, ki wiirchin ma koek kweenik: peelei maat tabanwek tuwai kobooto kwenut; tos tinyei keluno eng' poisyo age tugul?
Ogeero, ye ki tomo keep, ko ki ma kotinyei poisyo: kotam nee anyun ye kagogas maat ye kagolal, tos ta kotinyei poisyo age tugul?
Mwaei anyun Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Ko uu keetitap sabibuk ne mi kwenutap keetiigap timiin, ne ki ande ma koek kweenik, agoitoi ko uu nooto piik che menyei Jerusalem.
Ak auuiit togeennyu aborye icheek; mandoe maat, ago peelei maat icheek; si onai ole aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ye auuiit togeennyu aborye icheek.
Ak ayai emet koguber, amu ki kobistoe, mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ki nyoonjo kogeny ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, koleenjo,
Ee weeriitap chii, iboorchi Jerusalem konai tuguukyik che kiwechei,
ak ileenji, mwachin Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Jerusalem kole: Sigeng'ung', ak ole ki kisikyinin ko po emetap kanaanindet: ki kwandang'ung' Amorindet, ak ki kamenng'ung' Hitindet.
Ki ma kotil mugeng'ung' eng' ole ki kisikyinin, eng' peetuut ne ki kisichin, ama kiuunin si itiliiliitu; ma ki ilenen muunyuk, ama kinamden ngor.
Ma rireenen chii, koyaun kiy age tugul eng' tuguuchuuto, koriir moo; ago ki kiwiirchin timiin, amu ki kiwechin, eng' peetuut ne ki kisichin.
Ak kinga siir ye ki imi, ageerin ikwarkwarane korotiguk, aleenjin, Agot nganda imi korotiguk, isap inyee; ee, ki aleenjin, Agot nganda imi korotiguk, isap inyee.
Ki agoonin itesage ko uu ye ing'atos tuguugap mbar, ak ki itesage ieetu, ak ki igararanitu miising'; kigogun kinaiguk, ak kigogoeegitu suumeeguk; ago ki imi puch aach ngor.

Ak kinga pun ye imi, ageerin, keero, peetuusyeguk ko ki po peetuusyegap chamyet; ak ki atugunen ngoryennyu ak atuch aach ngoryeeng'ung': ee, ki ayosyeun, ak ki koyomiske ak inyee, mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ak ki ibunjo.
Ki aunin anyun; ee, ki aunde miising' korotiguk, ak ki aiiliin.
Ki alaagun ngoroik che ki kinde lelesta, ak ki alaagun kweonigap mengichigap peek, ak ki auenen katanit ne karaaran, ak atugenen aririt.
Ki alelesanunenen kogeny tuguuk che po lelesta, ak ki alaagun kariigap eunek ak sirimdo ne po kaating'ung'.
Ak ki ande peteiyot serung'ung', ak ki ande munaok itiiguk, ak alaagun naaryeet ne karaaran.

Ki kilelesonun anyun eng' thahabu ak fedha; ak ki po katanit ne karaaran ngoroiguk, ak aririt, ak ngoroik che ki kinde lelesta; ki iam peek che ng'ootiin che tambulul, ak kumyat, ak mwanik: ak ki igararanitu kot, ak ki kiberuurin kot inyooru atebeetap laitornatet.
Ak ki yom pororyosyek kalasunetap karaaranindang'ung'; amu ki igeesunotkei karaaraninooto, amu eetunatennyu ne kiga alaagun, mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ago kiitiegei karaaranindang'ung', ak iyai kugoinatet amu kalasuneng'ung', ak ki oipkei ak age tugul ne siirtoi; ki punji ineendet.
Ak ki ip ngoroiguk ak iyachigei komoswek che torooreen che ki ilelesane saleiywek che teerchiin, ak iyae chooto kugoinatet: ma kobiitu tuguuk che uu chooto, ama ko yaaksei ko uu nooto.
Ki ip kogeny sonoeguk che korooron che po thahabusyekyuk ak fedhaisyekyuk, che kiga agoonin ak iyachinegei itoonwegap murenik, ak oyai kugoinatet ak tuguuchooto;
ak ki ip ngoroiguk che ki kinde lelesta, ak ituge tuguuchooto, ak ki inde tainnywa mwanikyuk ak nyamdutikyuk che kibeelei.

Ki inde tainnywa kogeny amitwogikyuk che ki agoonin, peek che ng'ootiin che tambulul, ak mwanik, ak kumyat, che ki abaenen, ki inde tainnywa koek nyamdutyet, ak ki tebi ko uu nooto; mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ki inam kogeny weeriiguk ak tiibiiguk, che ki isikwa, ak ieng'ji icheek si kobiit koam. Tos ki kiit ne ming'in kugoinatosyeguk,
kot ibar lagokyuk ak igoite kobun maat igoochini icheek?
Ama ibwaat eng' tuguuguk tugul che kiwechei, ak eng' kugoinatosyeguk, peetuusyegap ming'inateng'ung', ye ki imi puch aach ngor, ak ki ikwarkwarane korotiguk.
Ak kingo pata yaitwogiguk tugul, (Pwo! Pwo! Inyee! Mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor,)
iteekyigei ole tagunoot ak iyachigei ole kitororit eng' ooreet age tugul.
Ki iteech oldang'ung' ole kitororit eng' tabandap ooreet age tugul, ak iyai karaaranindang'ung' koek kiit ne kiwechei, ak oipkei ak age tugul ne siirtoi, ak ites kugoinateng'ung'.
Ki iyai kogeny kugoinatet kobooto Misiriik, piigap kokweng'ung', piigap poorto; ak ki ites kugoinateng'ung', itacha.
Keer anyun, kaachuul eunnyu atokyin, ak atil amitwogiguk che po kotugul, ak agoiten koyaun kiy age tugul icheek che wechin, tiibiigap Philistiik, che ililandos amu ortinweguk che yaach.
Ki iyai kogeny kugoinatet kobooto Asurik, amu ki ma koyamin kiy; ee ki iyai kugoinatet kobooto icheek, ago ma yamin kora.
Ki ites kugoinateng'ung' eng' emetap Kanaan, agoi Kaldea; ago ma yamin kora.
Nyalulat ne tya muguleldang'ung', mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, amu iyae tuguuchuuto tugul, poisyetap chepkugoniot ne pou piik;
amu iteeche oldang'ung' ole tagunoot, ak iyachigei oldang'ung' ole kitororit eng' ooreet age tugul; ama iige chepkugoniot, amu isase alisyet.
Osotyot ne yaei ibeetapkei! Ne ibegei ak toek kometo manong'otyondennyi!

Igoochin pichooto chepkugonik tugul asoya: ago igoochini inyeendet tuguuguk che po kagaigaet chamaniguk tugul, ak igaigae icheek tuguuchooto, si kobiit kobwonjin eng' komosta age tugul agobo kugoinatosyeguk.
Ak oterchine ak kwonyiik alak eng' kugoinatosyeguk, amu ma mi chii ne suubin oipkei: ialisyei, ak amu ma ki alin, ii teer amu nooto.
Kas anyun, ee chepkugoniondoni, ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor:

Mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole amu ki kirong' simdang'ung', ak keng'aanyin kegeerin imi aach ngor eng' kugoinatosyeguk che ki iyai ak chamaniguk; ak amu kanamonik tugul che po tuguuguk che kiwechei, ak agobo korotiigap lagoguk che ki igoochi icheek;

nooto anyun, keero, ayumi chamaniguk tugul, che ki obaibaige, icheek tugul che koichame, ak icheek tugul che koiweche; ayumjinin icheek kobun komosta age tugul, ak ang'aang'ji icheek kogeerin imi aach ngor, si kobiit kogeer aach ngoryeeng'ung' tugul.
Ak arwoogun, ko uu ye kirwookyin kwonyiik che putei kayosyetap katunisyet, ak che tumdoi korotiik; ak aibun korotiigap nereegek che ng'woneen ak ng'etkonda.
Ak andein eunekwak, ak kobut oldang'ung' ne tagunoot, ak kobut oldinweguk che kitororitu; ak koreegunenen ngoroiguk, ak koip sonoeguk che korooron: ak kobagachin imi puch aach ngor.
Ak komutun kogeny tuiyet kobookyin, ak kolagenen koik, ak kotoorin eng' rotonikwak po chok.
Ak kobeel kooriguk, ak koyaun kirwoogutik eng' taitap kwonyiik che chaang'; ak aeetenen kugoinatet, ama ialisyei kogeny.
Ageesu anyun nereegekyuk che ng'woneen eng' inyee, ak koistoenengei ng'etkondanyu, ak asiis, ma anereechi kogeny.

Amu ma ibwaat peetuusyegap ming'inateng'ung', ago ki itacha eng' tuguuchuuto tugul; ko uu nooto, kaaweegu poisyoniguk kotebee paragung'ung', mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor. Tos ma iyai yaityoni itesyi tuguuguk tugul che kiwechei?
Keero, age tugul ne poisyee kalewenaik, koboisyee kalewenoni agobo inyee, koleen, Kiit ne uu kamet, ko uu nooto chepto.
Ii cheptap kamet, ne wechei manong'otyondennyi ak lagokyik; ak ii chepto ne otupche ak chepkametwogiguk, che kiweche manong'otaikwak ak lagokwak: ki po kamenng'ung' Hitik, ko po kwandang'ung' Amorik.
Chepkameng'ung' ne oo ko Samaria, ne menyei komostap eung'ung' ne po kaataam, ineendet ak tiibiikyik; ak chepkameng'ung' ne ming'in, ne menyei komostap eung'ung' ne po tai, ko Sodom ak tiibiikyik.
Ago ma isup ortinwekwak, anan isup iyai tuguukwak che kiwechei; ago, nda ki kiit ne ming'in nooto, ko ki iyaitu inyee kosiir icheek eng' ortinweguk tugul.
Mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole ko uu ye asabe, tomo koyai Sodom chepkameng'ung', ineendet anan ko tiibiikyik, ko uu ye ki iyai inyee kobooto tiibiiguk.
Keero, kimii tengektap chepkameng'ung' Sodom; ki tinyei ineendet ak tiibiikyik menoteet, piyeng'do, ak poroteetap talbisto; ama igimit eunegap kibananook ak che ma tinyei kiy.
Ak kimendos icheek, ak koyaei kiit ne kiwechei eng' tainnyu: ki aiste anyun icheek ko uu ye ki ageer ale nyolu.
Ama yai Samaria tengekwogik che siirei kebebertap tengekwogiguk; ago koites tuguuguk che kiwechei, kosiir icheek, ak koiityi imanda chepkametwogiguk eng' tuguuk tugul che kiwechei che koiyai.

Ip inyee kobunjiin kalilaneng'ung' amu koirwookyi chepkametwogiguk; po imanda icheeget kosiirin amu tengekwogiguk che koiyai che kiwechei kosiir chooto koyai icheeget: ee, ii teweeroksei aginye, ak iip kalilaneng'ung', amu koiityi imanda chepkametwogiguk.
Ak aweech kogeny icheek che kigeluul, che kigeluul che po Sodom kobooto tiibiikyik, ak che kigeluul che po Samaria, kobooto tiibiikyik, ak che kigeluul che po luuleniguk che mi kwenunnywa;
si kobiit iipchigei kalilaneng'ung', ak ililan amu tugul che koiyai, amu ii kagaigaindennywa.

Ak koweekyigei chepkametiniguk, Sodom ak tiibiikyik, atebwennywa ne ki po tai, ak koweekyigei Samaria ak tiibiikyik atebeennywa ne ki po tai, ak iweekyigei inyee ak tiibiiguk, atebeeng'wong' ne ki po tai.
Amu ki ma imwa kiy agobo chepkameng'ung' Sodom eng' peetuusyegap menateng'ung';
ye kitom keng'aany yaityeng'ung', ko uu eng' peetuusyegap chotisyetap tiibiigap Syria, ak ne po tugul che mi komoswekyik, tiibiigap Philistik, che sasin eng' komoswek tugul.
Koiip yaityeng'ung' ak tuguuguk che kiwechei, mwaei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Amu mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Ayaun ko uu ye koiyai, ne koisas kayasyoet ibut kayomiset.
Nganda uu nooto, abwaati kayomiset ne ki kiyomiske ak inyee eng' peetuusyegap ming'inateng'ung', ak agimiitun kayomiset ne po koigeny.
Ibwaat anyun ortinweguk, ak ililan, ye itaache chepkametwogiguk, che eecheen ak che mengeechen: ak agoonin icheek koek tiibiiguk, ago ma eng' kayomisutyeng'ung'.
Ak agimiit kayomisennyu kobooten; si inai ile aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor:
si kobiit ibwaat, ak itoptoben, ametwegu kogeny, amu kalilaneng'ung'; ye kanyoun kaat tuguuk tugul che ki iyai, mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ki nyoonjo ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, koleenjo,
Ee weeriitap chii, mwa tangochet, ak imwachi kalewenet kootap Israel;

ileenji mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole; Ki nyoonji Lebanon kipsiichit ne oo ne tinyei kebebaik che eecheen ak ko kooen, che nyiitaat koroorik che ki tinyei saleiywek che teer, ak koip walitap tarakwet:
ak ki ep temeet ne kitabanu parak ne ki namgei ak che ng'orng'oren, ak koip kwo emetap mung'aaret; ki inde nganaseetap chemung'arainik.
Ki ip kogeny kesweek che po emonooto, ak kwo kogoolji ng'ung'unyek che akwaen; kilechi ole neegitee peek che chaang'; kimin ko uu koibeiyot.
Ak ki piit ak koek keetitap sabibuk ne tebeesitu ne ma koitu, ne arung'jingei mooriikyik, ak komi tigitikyik kurerennyi: ki ek anyun keetitap sabibuk, ak kosich mooriik, ak kong'atyo.

Ki mi kogeny kipsiichit age ne oo ne ki tinyei kebebaik che eecheen ak koroorik che chaang': ak ogeero, ki aruny keetito po sabibuk tigitikyik, kotokyi kipsichinooto, ak kowakta mooriikyik kotokyigei ineendet, eng' kererchosyek ole kiga kiminji, kole si kobise peek kipsichinooto.
Kiga kiminji ng'ung'unyek che myachen eng' ole neegitee peek che chaang', si kobiit kowakta mooriik, si kobiit kooi logoek, si kobiit koek keetit ne karaaran ne po sabibuk.

Mwa inyee ile, Mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Tos myeeitu? Tos ma ituti kipsichinooto tigitikyik, ak koep logoekyik, si kobiit kores, si kobiit koresyo sogekyik tugul che ng'orng'or; agot ngo ma mi kimnateet ne wo anan piik che chaang' che itutu?
Ee, ogeero, tos myeeitu ye kagemin? Tos maresei tugul, ye usyi usoonetap kong'asiis? Resei eng' kererchosyek ole kibiitee.
Ki nyoonjo kogeny ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor koleenjo,

Mwachi anyun koot ne ngelelyot, ileenji, Tos mongen ole teptoi tuguuchu? Mwachi icheek, ileenji, ogeero, kigonyo Jerusalem laitoryatap Babilon, ak koluul laitoryandennyi, ak pounikyik, ak komut icheek kobwa Babilon.
Ak kiluul iyoteetap laitoryat ak koyomiskei kobooto ineendet: kibirchi kogeny ineendet eng' kayasyoet, ak komut piik che kiimeen che po emet
kole si kobiit konyeratit pounateet, si ma imuuch koeetkei, ago si kobiit kotonon ye riibei kayomisennyi.

Ago ki ingelelji ineendet amu ki iyookto tononjinikyik koba Misiri, si kobiit kogoochi ineendet paraisisyek ak piik che chaang'. Tos kiberuuri? Tos chilil ineendet ne yaei tuguuk che uu chooto? Tos put kayomiset, ak kochilil?

Mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole ko uu ye asabe, meei ineendet iman eng' ole menyei laitoryat ne ki indoi ineendet koek laitoryat, ne ki sas kayosyennyi, ak kibut kayomisennyi, meei kobooto ineendet eng' Babilon.
Ama tilei kiy eng' ineendet Pharaoh kobooto lugeennyi ne kiim, ak kweanet ne oo, eng' lugeet, ye irurugot ng'ung'unyek koek tuloonook ak koteech irimoik, si kobar piik che chaang'.
Amu Ki kogas kayasyoet kobut arorutyet, ak ogeero, kigonde eunnyi ago ki koyai tuguuchooto tugul; ma chilili.
Mwaei anyun Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Ko uu ye asabe, aipchini iman metinnyi kayosyennyu ne Ki kogas ak kayomisennyu ne ki kobut.
Ak aiitochini mestennyu ineendet, ak konam mestennyu ineendet ak amut ineendet kwo Babilon, ak ager kong' ineendet eng' olooto amu ngelelnateet ne ki ingelelja.
Ak kebare rotwetap chok piikyik tugul che kimweei eng' kweanaikyik tugul, ak kiseerat che ng'etu koba usoonet age tugul: si onai ole aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne koamwa ng'olyoondoniito.

Mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Aibe kogeny walitap tarakwet ne kooi ak amin; ak aep temeet ne ng'arng'ar, eng' mooriikyik che ng'orng'or che tabanu parak, ak aminji tulweet ne kooi ne tagunoot.
Aminjini tulweet ne kooi ne po Israel: ak kowakta, ak kooi logoek, ak koek tarakwet ne myee: ak komeny kelunnyi toriitik alak tugul che tirirendos; menyei toriitichooto urwetap mooriikyik.

Si konai keetiik tugul che po timiin kole aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne ki achooru keetit ne kooi, ak aeet keetit ne ming'in, ak ayaam keetit ne tuon, ak agoochi keetit ne yaamaat kotunen: kaamwa anee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ak ayae.
Ki nyoonjo kogeny ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, koleenjo,
Obooru nee si oboisyee kalewenoni agobo emetap Israel, oleen, Ki koam kwanisyek sabibuk che mindilileen, ak kiliil kelegap lagok?
Mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole ko uu ye asabe, koma oboisyee kogeny kalewenaniito eng' Israel.
Ogeero, chechuuk saboonwegap piik tugul; ko uu ye nenyu saboondap kwanda, ko nenyu agine saboondap weeriit: meei saboondap chiito ne yaei tengekto.
Ago ngot ko po iman chii, ak koyai kiit ne po iman ak ne litit,
ak tomo koamisye tuloonook, ama tokyi kanamonik che po kootap Israel, ama ing'wanit osotyotap chiitap kokwennyi, ama riikyi kwony eng' peetuusyekyik che po arawet;

ak tomo koyachi chii kiy ne ya, ago kogoweekta kiit ne ki kiname pesendo, koweekyi chiito ne ki kiname pesendo, koweekyi chiito ne kiyaachei, ama rebe chii kiy eng' koroomnateet, ak Ki kogoochi amitwogik chiito ne amei rubeet, ak kolaaksechi ne mi aach ngor;
ineendet ne tomo kogoito tuguuk si konyoorunee kelunet ne siirtoot, ama ibei che tesatiin, ne kigoistoe eunnyi tengekto, ne ki koyai kirwooget ne po iman eng' kwenutap piik,
ne ki kowendote ng'atuutikyuk, ak koriip kirwoogutikyuk, si koyai iman, po iman chiichooto, sabei ineendet iman, mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ngot kosich chiichooto weeriit ne rebindet, ne tumdoi korotiik, ak koyaei kiit age tugul eng' tuguuchuuto,
ama yaei age eng' poisyonichuuto, ago kigoamisye tuloonook, ak ki kong'wanit osotyotap chiitap kokwennyi,
ne ki koyachi ne ya kibananiat ak ne ma tinyei kiy, ne ki korebis eng' koroomnateet, ne tomo koweekta kiit ne ki kiname pesendo, ak ki kotokyi konyekyik kanamonik, ne ki koyai kiit ne kiwechei,
ne ki kogoito tuguuk si konyoorunee kelunet ne siirtoot, ak koip che tesatiin: tos sap chiichooto iman? Ma sabei: ki koyai tuguuchuuto tugul kiwechei: meei iman; tebee ineendet korotiikyik.
Ara anyun, ogeero, ngot kosich chiichooto weeriit, ne keerei tengekwogik tugul che po kwandanyi, che ki koyai, ak koywei, ama yai ko uu nooto,
ne tomo koamisye tuloonook, anan kotokyi konyekyik kanamonigap kootap Israel, ne tomo kong'wanit osotyotap chiitap kokwennyi,
ne tomo koyachi chii age tugul kiy ne ya, ne tomo koip kiy ne kiname pesendo, anan korebis eng' koroomnateet, ago Ki kogoochi amitwogikyik chiito ne amei rubeet, ak kolaaksechi ne mi aach ngor,

ne kigoisto eunnyi si ma twa kibananiat, ne tomo kotaach kelunet ne siirtoot anan che tesatiin, ne ki koyai kirwoogutikyuk, ne ki kowendote ng'atuutikyuk; koma meei chiichooto amu ng'oogistap kwandanyi, sabei iman.
Ago ne uu kwandanyi, amu kiusiis eng' kolgolyet, ak kerep tuguugap tupchennyi eng' koroomnateet, ak koyai ne ma myee eng' piikyik, ogeero, meei ineendet eng' tengektanyi.
Ago omwae okweek ole, Amu nee anyun si ma nam weeriit ng'oogistap kwandanyi? Ye kagoyai weeriit kiit ne po iman ak ne litit, ak koriip ng'atuutikyuk, ak koyai, kosabei ineendet iman.
Meei chiito ne yaei tengekto: ma namei weeriit ng'oogistap kwandanyi, ama namei kwanda ng'oogistap weeriinnyi; tebee chiito ne po iman imandanyi, ak kotebee kiptengekyot tengektanyi.
Ago ngot koweek kiptengekyot kometo tengekwogikyik tugul che ki koyai, ak koriip ng'atuutikyuk tugul, ak koyai kiit ne po iman ak ne litit, kosabei iman, ma meei.
Ma kiityin ineendet agot agenge eng' pistaosyekyik che ki koyai: sabei ineendet eng' imandanyi ne ki koyai.
Tos abaibai eng' meetap kiptengekyot? Mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor: tos ma abaibai ngo week kometo ooreennyi si kosap?

Ago ye week ne po iman kometo imandanyi, ak koyai tengekto, ak koyai ko uu tuguuk tugul che kiwechei che yaei chiito ne ya, ko tos sap? Ma kibwaati agot agenge eng' poisyonikyik che po iman che ki koyai: meei amu kachililutyennyi ne ki koyai, ak amu tengektanyi ne ki koyai.
Ago omwae ole, Ma po iman ooreetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor. Ogas anyuno, kootap Israel: tos ma po iman ooreennyu? Tos ma ortinwekwok che ma po iman?
Ye week chiito ne po iman kometo imandanyi, ak koyai tengekto, ak kome eng' tengegoto; meei anyun amu tengektanyi ne ki yai.
Kogeny, ye week kiptengekyot kometo tengektanyi ne kiga koyai, ak koyai kiit ne po iman ak ne litit, kosaru saboondanyi kosap.
Amu ruchin ak kometo pistaosyekyik tugul che ki koyai, kosabei iman, ma meei.
Ago mwaei kootap Israel kole, ma po iman ooreetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor. Ee kootap Israel, tos ma po iman ortinwekyuk? Tos ma ortinwekwok che ma po iman?
Arwookwok anyun, ee kootap Israel, chii age tugul ko uu ortinwekyik, mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor. Oweege, ak owalage, omete pistaosyekwok tugul; si ma ek tengekto ng'emisyeng'wong'.
Omete pistaosyekwok tugul che ki kogoonok obistoe; ak ochopchigei muguleldo ne leel ak sabeet ne leel: amu nee si obegu, ee kootap Israel?
Amu ma abaibai eng' meetap ineendet ne meei, mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor: owalage anyun, si osapche.
Riir anyun agobo pounigap Israel,
ak ile, Ki nee kamenng'ung'? Ki ng'etundo ne kotoy: kiribisi kobooto ng'etuunyik, kibaei aarekyik eng' kwenutap ng'etuunyik che neran.
Ak kibai age eng' aarekyik; kot koeet koek ng'etundo ne neran: ak ki ineetkei logeet, ki am piich.
Ki kas pororyosyek agobo ineendet: ak kiname keriingennywa: ak ki ichuutune kombook agoi emetap Misiri.
Ak kingo keer kamet kole kigogenis ak ki kobet kamang'unennyi, konam anyun age eng' aarekyik, ak koyai ineendet koek ng'etundo ne neran.
Ak kiwendote kwenutap ng'etuunyik ak ki ek ng'etundo ne neran: ak ki ineetkei logeet, ki am piich.
Ak ki nai kooriikwak che po laitorinik, ak king'em nganasookwak; ak kiguber emet, ak tuguugap emonooto, amu tuugeetap porisenennyi.
Ki ibookyi anyun pororyosyek eng' komoswek tugul kobunu emotinwek tugul: ak kiitoochi ineendet mestennywa, ak koname ineendet keriingennywa.
Ak ki inde ineendet korgoreet, ko rataat eng' kombook, ak komutyi ineendet laitoryatap Babilon; ki imut ineendet konyo irimoik, si mata kogas chii kutinnyi eng' tuloonoogap Israel.
Ki uu kamenng'ung' keetitap sabibuk eng' mbareetap sabibuk eng' korotiguk, ne ki kiminji ole neegitee peek che chaang'; kiyiei miising' ak ko nyiitaat mooriik amu peek che chaang'.
Ak ki tinyei keetiik che kiimeen che po kirokweegap icheek che pounisyei, ak ki kieet kogoit eng' kwenutap mooriik che nyigiisen, ak ki took eng' koindonywa kobooto chaang'indap mooriikwak.
Ago ki kitut eng' nereegek che ng'woneen, ki kiwiirta kwo ng'wony, ki yaamyo logoekyik eng' usoonetap kong'asiis: ki kiiri keetiikyik che kiimeen ak koresyo; kilalyo kogeskei eng' ma.
Kogeminji anyun surkwen, eng' emet ne yaamaat ne ma mi peek.
Ak kagomisok maat eng' keetiigap mooriikyik, kogobeel maat logoekyik, kot koma kotinyei keetit ne kiim ne egu kirokto ne po pounateet. Po niito riirek, ak egu riirek.
Ak eng' kenyiit ne po tisap, eng' arawetap muut, peetuut ne po taman ne po arawanooto, kobwa poisyek alage che po Israel kobwa koteepse Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ak kotep ng'wony eng' tainnyu.
Ak ki nyoonjo ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, koleenjo,
Weeriitap chii, ng'alaalji poisyegap Israel, ileenji, mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole, kaobwa oteepsena? Mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole, ko uu ye asabe, koma chame oteepsena.
Tos irwookyini icheek, ee weeriitap chii, tos irwookyini icheek? Iboorchi icheek konai tuguuk che kiwechei che po kwanisyekwak;

ak ileenji, mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Eng' peetuut ne ki alewen Israel, ak ayogoochi eunnyu iyoteetap kootap Jakobo, ak aboorchigei icheek eng' emetap Misiri, ye ki ayogoochi eunnyu icheek aleenji, Aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindeng'wong';
ki ayogoochi eunnyu icheek eng' peetuunooto, amutu icheek komong' eng' emetap Misiri kobwa emet ne ki amararchi icheek, ne nyiitaat cheego ak kumyat, ne toroornatetap emotinwek tugul:
ak ki amwachi icheek aleenji, Ingometo chii age tugul eng' okweek tuguuk che kiwechei che kochamei konyekyik, amat ong'wanitegei kanamonigap Misiri: aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindeng'wong'.

Ago ki ingelelja, ma cham kogasa iit; ma meto chii age tugul eng' icheek tuguuk che kiwechei che ki chamei konyekwak, ama meto kanamonigap Misiri: amwa anyun ale, Aroong'jini icheek nereegekyuk che ng'woneen, si kobiit ayai nereegekyuk kosulda eng' icheek eng' emetap Misiri.
Ago ki aboisye amu kainennyu, si ma kimurwon kogeerei pororyosyek, che ki mi icheek kwenunnywa, pororyosyek che kigeerei aboorchinigei icheek, amutu komong' eng' emetap Misiri.
Amutu anyun icheek komong' eng' emetap Misiri, amutu kobwa surkwen.
Ak ki agoochi icheek ng'atuutikyuk, ak aboorchi kirwoogutikyuk, che ngo yai chii kosabei eng' chooto.
Ki agoochi icheek kogeny sabatosyekyuk ak icheek, koek kaboorunet eng' kwenunnyu, anee ak icheek, si kobiit konai kole aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne atabaani icheek.

Ago ki ingelelja kootap Israel eng' surkwen: ma pendate ng'atuutikyuk, ak ki eesyo kirwoogutikyuk, che ngo yai chii kosabei eng' chooto; ki imurwon icheek miising' sabatosyekyuk: ki amwa anyun ale, aroong'jini icheek eng' surkwen nereegekyuk che ng'woneen si agees icheek.
Ago ki aboisye anyun kainennyu, si ma kimurwon eng' taitap pororyosyek, che kigeeronu icheek amutu komong'.
Kogeny, ki ang'werere icheek eunnyu eng' surkwen, ale mamuti icheek koba emet ne ki agoochi, ne nyiitaat cheego ak komi kumyat eng' chaang'indo, ne toroornatetap emotinwek tugul;
amu ki eesyo kirwoogutikyuk, ama pendate ng'atuutikyuk ak komurwon sabatosyekyuk: amu ki isubot mugulelwekwak kanamonikwak.
Nganda uu nooto, kogiriree kondanyu icheek si ma ng'em, ama ageesu icheek eng' surkwen.
Ak ki aleenji lagokwak eng' surkwen, Amobendate ng'atuutigap kwanisyekwok, anan osup kirwoogutikwak, anan ong'wanitegei kanamonikwak;
aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindeng'wong'; obendate ng'atuutikyuk, ak oriip kirwoogutikyuk ak oyai;
ak otabaan sabatosyekyuk; si koek kaboorunet eng' kwenunnyo, anee ak okweek, si kobiit onai ole aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindeng'wong'.

Ago ki ingelelja ak icheek lagok; ma pendate ng'atuutikyuk anan koriip kirwoogutikyuk, koyai, che ngo yai chii kosabei eng' chooto; ki imurwon icheek sabatosyekyuk: amwa anyun ale aroong'jini icheek nereegekyuk che ng'woneen si kobiit ayai nereegekyuk kosulda eng' icheek eng' surkwen.
Ago ki aiste eunnyu, ki aboisye amu kainennyu, si ma kimurwon eng' taitap pororyosyek, che kigeeronu icheek amutu komong'.
Ak ki ang'werere icheek eunnyu eng' surkwen, si kobiit aseer icheek eng' pororyosyek, ak aiyeste icheek koyom emotinwek;
amu ma yai kirwoogutikyuk, ago ki eesyo ng'atuutikyuk, ak komurwon sabatosyekyuk, ak ki isuboti konyekwak kanamonigap kwanisyekwak.
Ki agoochi anyun kogeny ng'atuutik che ki ma ko myachen, ak kirwoogutik che masabe;
ak ki amurwon icheek eng' konunoikwak icheegei, amu ki igoito lagok tugul che yaatei iyoteet kobun maat, si kobiit agoochi icheek kobononso, si konai kole aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Nooto anyun, ee weeriitap chii, ng'alaalji kootap Israel ileenji icheek, Mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Kigochuba kwanisyekwok kogeny eng' niito amu kachiliilutyet ne ki yaiywo.

Amu ye kinga muutu icheek kobwa emet, ne ki aitoochi eunnyu agoochi, kogeer tulweet age tugul ne kooi, ak keetit age tugul ne nyigiis, ak ki igoito eng' olooto korosekwak, ak ki igoito eng' olooto kagoochinoikwak che po tagisyet, kibeelei kogeny nyamdutikwak, ak koroong'ji olooto kagoochinoikwak che kieei.
Yeityo aleenji icheek, Po nee komosta ne toroor ole obendi? Ki kiguure anyun yooto Bama agoi rani.
Mwachi anyun kootap Israel ileenji, mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Tos omurwonige ko uu piteetap kwanisyekwok? Ak oyae kugoinatet osubi tuguukwak che kiwechei?

Ak ye ogoitoi kagoochinoikwok, ye ogoitoi weeriikwok kobun maat, ko tos ma omurwonegei kanamonikwok agoi rani? Ko tos oteepsena, okweek kootap Israel? Mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole, ko uu ye asabe, koma achame oteepsena:
ak ma piitu agot kitigin nooto obwaati; amu omwae ole, “Kigergeitu ak pororyosyek, ak kergeitu ak ortinwegap emotinwek, keoot keetiik ak koik.”
Mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole, iman, ko uu ye asabe, aegu laitoryat aboiywok eng' euut ne kiim, ak eng' euut ne chuulaat, ak eng' nereegek che ng'woneen che rong'ugei.
Ak amutwok omong'u eng' pororyosyek, ak ayumak eng' euut ne kiim, ak eng' euut ne chuulaat, ak eng' nereegek che ng'woneen che rong'ugei, omang'une emotinwek ole ki kiseerchok;
ak amutwak obwa surkwen ne po pororyosyek, ak agerak kong' kimni eng' olooto.
Ko uu ye ki agere kong' kwanisyekwok eng' surkwen ne po emetap Misiri, agerok kong' anyun ko uu nooto, mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ak amutak obun kurereetap kirokto, ak amutwak obwa ratuutyetap kayomisutyet.
Ak atiliilok aiste ngelelik eng' kwenung'wong', ak icheek che ki ingelelja; amutu icheek komong' eng' emet ne kigaba kotebee, ago ma pendi emetap Israel: si kobiit onai ole aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.

Ago eng' okweek, ee kootap Israel, mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ko uu ni kole: Ngot ko moepcha iit; obe anyun ak koot chii tugul kanamonikyik eng' peetuusyek che pwoonei ak icheek: ago ma omurwoni kainennyu ne tiliil kogeny eng' kagoochinoikwok, ak eng' kanamonikwok.

Amu tuun ota koot komugul ne po Israel eng' tulweennyu ne tiliil, eng' tulweet ne kooi ne po Israel, ota icheek tugul eng' emet, mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor: ataache icheek eng' olooto, ak amagenak eng' olooto kagoochinoikwok, ak tongoanigap kagoochinoikwok, kobooto tuguukwok tugul che tiliileen.
Ataachok ko uu nyamdutyet ne anyiny, ye amutwok omang'une pororyosyek, ak ayumak omang'une emotinwek ole ki kiseerchok; ak aegu ne itabaanat eng' okweek kogeerei pororyosyek.
Ak onai ole aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ye amutwok obwa emetap Israel, emet ne ki aitoochi eunnyu ale agoochini kwanisyekwok.
Ak obwaat eng' olooto ortinwekwok ak poisyonikwok tugul, che ki ong'wanitegei; ak osaske amu yaitwogikwok tugul che ki oyai.

Ak onai ole aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ye kaaboisye agobo okweek amu kainennyu, ma ko uu ortinwekwok che yaacheen, ama ko uu poisyonikwok che samis, ee okweek kootap Israel, mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ak ki nyoonjo ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, koleenjo,
Ee, weeriitap chii, tokyi togeng'ung' murot tai ak imwachi ng'aleeguk murot tai, ak imaotenji timdap emetap Negeb;

ak imwachi timdap murot tai, ileenji, kas ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor; Mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Keero, anaami maat eng' kwenung'ung', ak kobeel keetit age tugul ne tuon, ak keetit age tugul ne yaamaat: ma kimisi liplibenetap maata, ak komel togoochik tugul kobooch murot tai agoi murot kaataam.
Ak kogeer piik tugul kole aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne kanaami maata: ma kimisi.
Amwa anyun ale, ee, Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor! Mwaei icheek agobo anee kole, tos ma ng'alaalindet ne po kalewenaik ineendet?
Ki nyoonjo ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, koleenjo,
Ee, weeriitap chii, tokyi togeng'ung' Jerusalem, mwachi ng'aleek komoswek che tiliileen, ak imaotenji emetap Israel;
ak ileenji emetap Israel, Mwaei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Keero, aboryenen ak ang'usu rotwennyu po chok, ak aiste eng' inyee chiito ne po iman ak ne ya.
Amu aistoi eng' inyee chiito ne po iman ak ne ya, ng'usugei anyun rotwennyu po chok kwo kobar piik tugul kobooch murot tai agoi murot kaataam:
si konai piik tugul kole, aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne kang'usu rotwennyu po chok; ma kogetitagei kogeny.
Tigen anyun, inyee weeriitap chii; tigen eng' iletap sueng'ung' ak eng' ng'wanindo kogeerei icheek.

Ak ye teebenen, koleenjin, Amu nee si itigen? Ile anyun, Amu ng'aleek, amu nyoonei: ak kome muguleldo age tugul ak konyalulso eunek tugul, ak konyaluul sabeet age tugul, ak kochootyo kutung'oik tugul ko uu peek: ogeero, nyoonei, ak ko yaaksei, mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ak ki nyoonjo ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, koleenjo,
Ee, weeriitap chii, maoten, mwaa ile, Mwaei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole; Mwa ile, Rotwetap chok, rotwetap chok, kagelit, ak kagesit kogeny:
kagelit si kobiit kobaris; kagesit si kobiit koigei kalyeleet: tos kiboiboitu anyun? Kirokto ne po weeriinnyu ne sasei keetit age tugul.
Ak ki kigon si kobiit kesit, si kimuuch kenam: kilitei rotwetap chok, ee, kisitei, si kobiit kinde eutap parindet.
Waach ak ite, ee, weeriitap chii: amu kagong'urur piikyuk, kobooto pounik tugul che po Israel: kagigoito icheek kobar rotwetap chok kobooto piikyuk: irabaach anyun kubestang'ung'.
Amu mi tyemisyet; egu nee anyun ngot koma komi kirokto ne sasisyei? Mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.

Maoten anyun inyee weeriitap chii, ak irabaach euneguk; ak ingotesak rotwetap chok konyil aeng', ingotesak ne po somok, rotwetap chok ne po che ki kiguoten ne po meet: rotwetap chok ne po ineendet ne oo ne ki kiguoten ne po meet, ne kichut kooriikwak che po oriit.
Koatokyi rotwetap chok ormariichokwak tugul, si komeiyo mugulelwekwak, ak kotesagis kanagutikwak: haa! Kogeyai koigei kalyeleet, kogelit si kobaris.
Iyumge, ui komostap tai; chopkei, chopkei, ui komostap kaataam; oldo tugul ole ketokyi togeng'ung'.
Arabachi eunekyuk, ak ageesu anyun nereegekyuk che ng'woneen: kamwae anee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ng'olyoondoniito.
Ki nyoonjo kogeny ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, koleenjo,

Ee, weeriitap chii, lewenjige kogeny ortinwek aeng', si kobiit konyo rotwetap chok ne po laitoryatap Babilon; punu chooto tuwai emet agenge; ak iaror komosta eng' sireet, iaror eng' tabandap ooreet ne wendi nganaseet.
Lewen ooreet si kobiit koit rotwetap chok Rabbah ne po lagogap Ammon, ak koit Judah eng' Jerusalem ne ng'ootaat.
Amu ki tonon laitoryatap Babilon eng' ole pesiap oor, eng' ole pesyechin ortinwek aeng'u, si kong'orso: kisaisach kipchabonik, ki sa kanamonik, kibir moet kogeer kooet.

Ki mi eunnyi ne po tai ng'oorset agobo Jerusalem, si konde injinisyek che kibutisye, si koseng'eng'ji parisyet, ak kowaach miising', konde injinisyek taitap ormariichok, kowasyi ng'ung'unyek, koteech irimoik.
Ak egu nooto eng' icheek ng'oorset ne po puch eng' tainnywa, eng' icheeget che ki koyasyechi kayasyosyek: ago ibwaatyin icheek yaityet, si kobiit kenam.

Mwaei anyun Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Amu ki ogoonu kibwaat yaityeng'wong', amu kigeng'aany pistaosyekwok kotook, kot kotook tengekwogikwok eng' poisyonikwok tugul; amu ki kibwaatak, kenamok anyun kityo.
Ee inyee ne ya, ne ki kiguotenin ne po meet, pounindetap Israel, ne kagonyo peetuunnyi, eng' peetuusyegap yaityet ne po let;
mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Inemu chepkulet ak ireegu naaryeet: ma koigeitu niito kogeny: ieet nooto ming'in, ak iming'in nooto toroor.
Agabui, agabui, agabui; ma kobiitu nooto kogeny, kot konyo ne nyoljin kobunji; si agoochi ineendet.

Maoten inyee weeriitap chii, ile, Mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor agobo lagogap Ammon, ak agobo teweernatennywa, kole; mwaa ile, Rotwetap chok, kaging'us rotwetap chok, kagesit agobo parisyet, si kobiit kobaris, si koigei kalyeleet:
kota kogeerchinin tangoita, kota kong'orei lembechek agobo inyee, si kondein kaatwegap kiptengeginik che ki kiguoten ne po meet, che kagonyo peetuunywa, eng' peetuusyegap yaityet ne po let.
Ker rotwetap chok. Arwoogun eng' ole ki kiyaenen, eng' emet ne ki kisikyinin.
Ak aroong'jin nereegekyuk; aguutyinin maatap nereegekyuk: ak andein eunegap piik che uu tyong'ik, che ng'oomen eng' ng'emisyet.
Iegu kweenik che kilaali; kitumjin korotiguk kwenutap emet. Ma kibwaatin kogeny; amu kamwae anee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ng'olyoondoniito.
Ki nyoonjo kogeny ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor koleenjo,
Ee, inyee weeriitap chii, tos irwookyini, irwookyini nganaseet ne po korotiik? Iboorchi anyun konai tuguukyuk tugul che kiwechei.
Ak imwa ile, Mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Nganaseet ne tumdoi korotiik eng' kwenunnyi, si kobiit konyo peetuunnyi, ne yachinegei kanamonik, kong'wanitegei!

Kanamin ng'oogisto amu korotiguk che kiitumde, ki king'wanitin eng' kanamoniguk che ki iyai; ak ki igoochi peetuusyeguk koriik, ak kaiit ye pooch kenyisyeguk. Ko uu nooto kaayain koteweerin pororyosyek, ak ne kichotei eng' emotinwek tugul.
Chotin che neegit kobooto che looen, inyee ne ii murwoon ak ko nyiitaat wasetapkei.
Ogeero, pounigap Israel, mi age tugul eng' kimnateennyi, eng' kwenung'ung', si kobiit kotumda korotiik.
Ki kosas icheek eng' inyee kwanda ak kamet; kigonyalil icheek toek eng' kwenung'ung': ki koyachi ne ya eng' inyee ne ma tinyei sigiik ak mosoget.
Ki isas tuguukyuk che tiliileen, ak imurwon sabatosyekyuk.
Ki kotebee chaamik kwenung'ung' si kotumdoi korotiik: ak kigoamisye tuloonook eng' inyee: ki koyai yaityet eng' kwenung'ung'.
Ki kong'aany eng' inyee kwanisyekwak kotebee aach ngor: kigosuup eng' kwenung'ung' kwondo ne ki itabaanat eng' peetuusyekyik che po arawet.
Ak ki koyai age kiit ne kiwechei kobooto osotyotap chiitap kokwennyi, koyai age yaityet kong'wanit osotyotap weeriinnyi; ak kigosuup age chepkamet, cheptap kwandanyi, eng' inyee.

Kigotaach icheek eng' inyee asoya si kotumda korotiik; ki ip kelunet ne siirtoot ak che tesatiin, ak ki inyooru poroteet eng' keiyandit amu ki isastae piigap kokweng'ung', ak ki iutyeno, mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Keer anyuno, ki arabach eunekyuk agobo keluneng'ung' ne ma po iman ne ki inyooru, ak eng' korotiguk che mi kwenung'ung'.
Tos imuuchi komuita muguleldang'ung', anan kogimegitu euneguk, eng' peetuusyek che agerin kong'? Kamwae anee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ng'olyoondoniito, ak ayae.
Ak aseerchin pororyosyek, ak ayestochin emotinwek; ak ageesu simdang'ung'.
Ak imurwongei inyegei, eng' taitap pororyosyek; si kobiit inai ile aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ak ki nyoonjo ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor koleenjo,

Ee, weeriitap chii, ki koek eng' anee kootap Israel michikyigek che kigenendoe fedha: ki koek icheek tugul sugunwet ak kibatit ak karnook ak ngosyelait, che mi maat ne oo; icheek ko michikyigek che kigenendoe fedha.
Mwaei anyun Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Amu ki oegu okweek tugul michikyigek che kigenendoe fedha, ogeero, ayumjinok Jerusalem.

Ko uu ye kiyumjin maat ne oo fedha ak sugunwet ak karnook, ak ngosyelait ak kibatit, si kobiit keguut maat kobeel kochootyo; ayumok anyun ko uu nooto eng' nereegekyuk, ak eng' nereegekyuk che ng'woneen, ak andeok olooto, si ochootye.
Ee, ayumok tugul, ak aguutak eng' maatap nereegekyuk, ak ochootye eng' maata.
Ko uu ye chotoos fedha eng' maat ne oo, ochotosi ak okweek eng' maata; si onai ole aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne kaarong'jok nereegekyuk che ng'woneen.
Ak ki nyoonjo ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor koleenjo,
Ee, weeriitap chii, ileenji emonooto, ii emet ne tomo ki anyiny, anan kerobonji eng' peetuutap nereegek.
Miitei kwenunnyi chaamset ne po maotikyik, ne uu ng'etundo ne pooriseni kobarisyei: ki kobar saboonwek; ibei konoraik ak tuguuk che po kamanuutyet ne oo; ki kotes mosoogik eng' kwenunnyi.

Ki kobut tisiikyik ng'atuutyennyu, ak komurwon tuguukyuk che tiliileen: ma ibesyo che tiliileen ak che ma tiliileen, ama ineet piik koguiyo tuguuk che ma ianyinyotin ak che ianyinyotin, ak ki kotuch konyekwak si ma keer sabatosyekyuk, ak ki king'wanita eng' kwenunnywa.
Kaigei pounikyik eng' kwenunnyi suik che parisyei; si kotumda korotiik, ak kong'em saboonwek, si kobiit konyoor poroteet ne ma po iman.

Ak ki komalse maotikyik taartaarik che ma myachen, komalsechi icheek, kogeerei tangoita, ak kong'orchin icheek lembechek, koleenjin, Mwaei ko uu ni Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ye ma mwa kiy Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Kigoboisye piigap emet sastaet, ak korebisyei; ee, kigoiim kibananook ak che ma tinyei kiy, ak Ki kogastae toondet eng' ooreet ne ya.
Ki acheeng' anyun chii eng' kwenunnywa, si kotuur ng'ootweet, ak kotonon eng' tainnyu eng' ole kibutok, agobo emet, si ma ng'em emonooto: ago ma anyooru chii.
Kaaroong'ji anyun nereegekyuk icheek amu nooto; kaagesu eng' maatap nereegekyuk: ki ande ortinwekwak metowekwak, mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ki nyoonjo kogeny ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, koleenjo,
Ee, weeriitap chii, kimi kwonyiik aeng' che ki tiibiigap chebyoset agenge.
Ak ki yai icheek kugoinatosyek eng' Misiri; ki yai kugoinatosyek eng' ming'inatennywa: ki kichiil kinaikwak eng' olooto, ak ki kitui kutusweegap kinaikwak che po pergeinatennywa eng' olooto.
Kainaikwak ko ki Oholah, ne oo, ak Oholibah, chepkamet: ak kibunjo, ak ki sich weeriik ak tiibiik. Ak ki uu ni kainaikwak, Samaria ko Oholah, ak Jerusalem ko Oholibah.
Ak ki yai Oholah kugoinatet ye kita ko nenyu; ak ki cham miising' chamanikyik, chooto ko piigap Assyria, piigap kokwennyi,
che ki ilaachi ngoroik che buluu, che ki kirwoogik ak pounik, murenik tugul che ki chamei, murenik che ketei paraisisyek.
Ak ki yai kugoinatosyekyik kobooto icheek, murenik tugul che korooron miising' che po Assyria, ak age tugul ne ki chamei miising'. Ki ing'wanitegei kanamonikwak tugul.

Ama meto kugoinatosyekyik kobooch peetuusyegap Misiri; amu kiruiyo kobooto ineendet kobooch ming'inatennyi, ak kitui kutusweegap kinaik che po pergeinatennyi: ak ki yai kugoinatennywa miising' kobooto ineendet.
Ki ande anyun ineendet eunegap chamanikyik, kwo eunegap piigap Assyria, che ki chamei miising'.
Ki ng'aany chuuto ineendet kotep aach ngor: ki imut weeriikyik ak tiibiikyik ak kobar kwonyooto eng' rotwetap chok: ki ek teweerya eng' kwonyiik; amu ki irwookyi ineendet.
Ak kigeerei niito Oholibah chepkamet, ago king'emak ineendet miising' eng' chamennyi kosiir chepkamet, ak eng' kugoinatosyekyik che kichang'a kosiir che po chepkamet.
Ki cham miising' piigap Assyria, che ki kirwoogik ak pounik, piigap kokwennyi, che ki ilaachigei miising', murenik che ketei paraisisyek, murenik tugul che ki chamei.
Ak ki ageer ale ki king'wanit; ki isup tuwai ooreet agenge.
Ak kites kugoinatosyekyik; amu ki keer itoonwegap piik che ki kisirchi inaat, itoonwegap Kaldeik che ki kisire saleiywek che piriireen,
che kirategei mosibisyek, ak kotaae metowekwak ngoroik che ki kisal, ko pounik tugul, che tiny kegeer, che kergei ak Babilonik eng' Kaldea, emennywa ne ki kisikyin.
Ak kingo keer icheek kocham, ak koyookyi piik koba Kaldea.
Ak ki pwanji ineendet Babilonik eng' itoogutap chamyet, ak ki ing'wanit icheek ineendet eng' kugoinatennywa, ak ki imurwongei kobooto icheek, ak kitoiyo saboondanyi ak pichooto.
Ki ng'aany anyun kugoinatosyekyik, ak kong'aanygei kotep aach ngor: koistoegei anyun saboondanyu ineendet, ko uu ye ki istoegei saboondanyu tupchennyi.
Ago kites kugoinatosyekyik, kobwaati peetuusyegap ming'inatennyi, ye kingo yaei kugoinatet eng' emetap Misiri.
Ak ki cham miising' chamanikyik, che ki uu poorwekwak poorwegap sigiroik, ak ki uu tuguuk che mang'une icheek, tuguugap paraisisyek.
