Ibwaat anyun yaityetap ming'inateng'ung', ye kingo tui Misiriik kutusweegap kinaiguk che po ming'inateng'ung'.
Ara anyun, ee Oholibah, mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Keero, ang'eetyinin chamaniguk, che ki kotoiyegei saboondang'ung', ak amutu icheek kobwonjin eng' komosta age tugul;

Babilonik ak Kaldeik tugul, Pekod ak Soa ak Koa, kobooto piigap Assyria tugul: murenik che ki chamei, che ki kirwoogik ak pounik icheek tugul, pounik ak piik che taagunotiin, ki laanyei icheek tugul paraisisyek.

Ak kobookyin kotinyei kariik, kariisyek che po lugeet ak kariisyek che lau tuguuk, ak tuiyet ne po pororyosyek: ibookyinin kotinyei long'onik che eecheen ak che mengeechen ak chepkuloigap lugeet eng' komoswek tugul: ak agoochi icheek kirwooget, si korwogun, ko uu kirwoogutikwak.

Ak atokyin ng'etkondanyu, ak kogerin kong' icheek eng' nereegek che ng'woneen; tilei serung'ung' ak itiiguk; ak kebare rotwetap chok piiguk che ki ng'et: imuti icheek weeriiguk ak tiibiiguk; ak kobeel maat piiguk che ki ng'et.
Ireegunenen kogeny ngoroik, ak koibenen tuguuguk che korooron.
Ageesu yaityeng'ung' eng' inyee, ak kugoinateng'ung' ne ki ibu eng' emetap Misiri si mata inyaliil icheek, anan kota ibwaat Misiri kogeny.
Amu mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Keero, andein eutap icheek che iweche, andein eutap icheek che ki kotoiyegei saboondang'ung':
ak kogerin kong' eng' wegeet, ak korebenen poisyeng'ung' tugul, ak kobagachin itebee puch aach ngor: ak keng'aanyin itebi puch eng' kugoinatosyeguk, yaityeng'ung' kobooto kugoinatosyeguk.
Kiyaun tuguuchuuto, amu ki iyai kugoinatet isuboti pororyosyek, ak amu ki imurwonegei kanamonikwak.
Ki isup ooreetap chepkomet; nooto anyun andoi kigombennyi eung'ung'.
Mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Iee kigombetap chepkomet, ne oo ak ko paraa: kirorechinin kereenyin ak kesasin; chaang' tuguugap kigombanooto.
Kinyiitin pogitet ak arageneet, kobooto kigombetap kwong'eet, ak pananda, kobooto kigombetap chepkomet Samaria.
Iee ichololi, ak inyei rokyonokyik, ak igereer kinaiguk; amu kamwae anee ng'olyoondoniito, mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Mwaei anyun Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Amu ki iutyeno, ak ituktocha patai, kesen anyun yaityeng'ung' agine ak kugoinatosyeguk.
Kimwaiwo anyun Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kogeny, koleenjo: Ee, weeriitap chii, tos irwookyini Oholah ak Oholibah? Iboorchi anyun icheek tuguukwak che kiwechei.
Amu ki koyai ibeetapkei, ak komi korotiik eunekwak, ak ki koipkei kobooto kanamonikwak; ak Ki kogoochi icheek kogeny weeriikwak che kisikwa, ki igoito kobun maat si kobiit kebeel.
Ki koyaiywo kogeny niito: ki kong'wanit oldanyu ne tiliil eng' peetuunooto, ak komurwon sabatosyekyuk.
Amu ye kingo parchi lagokwak kanamonikwak, kobwa peetuunooto oldanyu ne tiliil komurwon; ak ogeero, ki yai nooto eng' koonnyu.
Ak kogeny ki oguur piik eng' ole loo: che kiga kiyookyi, ak ogeero, ki pwa; ki iungei amu pichooto, ak isal konyeguk, ak ki ilelesonjinegei tuguugap lelesta;
ak ki itebee itoogut ne karaaran, ne ki mi tainnyi meset ne choboot, ne ki inde nyamdutikyuk che kibeelei ak mwanikyuk.

Ak ki mi ak ineendet eng' yooto tuugeetap tuiyet ne kitalbisi: ak ki kimut eng' surkwen piik alak tugul kobooto kibogitinik; ak ki ilaakyi kariigap eunek icheek tuwai, ak ki ilaakyi chepkuloik che korooron.
Ki amwa anyun agobo ineendet ne ki yai ibeetapkei kobooch keny, ale, Yaei anyun kugoinatosyek kobooto ineendet, ak ineendet kobooto icheek.
Ak ki ipkei ak ineendet, ko uu ye ibegei ak chepkugoniot: ki ipkei anyun ko uu nooto kobooto Oholah ak Oholibah, kwonyiik che yaacheen.
Tuun irwookyin piigap iman icheek, eng' kirwoogetap chepkugonik, ak eng' kirwoogetap kwonyiik che tumdoi korotiik; amu icheeget ko chepkugonik, ak komi korotiik eunekwak.
Amu mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Amutyini icheek tuiyet, ak agoite icheek kewiirchi komosi ak komosi ak keluul.
Ak kolach tuiyet icheek eng' koik, ak kobar eng' rotonikwak che po chok; ak kobar weeriikwak ak tiibiikwak, ak kobeel kooriikwak.
Aistoi anyun ko uu nooto yaityet eng' emet, si koek kateunet eng' kwonyiik tugul si ma kosubi yaityeng'wong'.
Ak kogeerwok ko uu yaityeng'wong', ak ogesen tengekwogigap kanamonikwak: si onai ole aa Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ki nyoonjo kogeny ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, eng' kenyiitap sogool, eng' arawetap taman, eng' peetuut ne po taman ne po arawanooto, koleenjo,
Ee, weeriitap chii, sir kainetap peetuut, ne po peetuunooto: ki ibookyi laitoryatap Babilon Jerusalem eng' peetuunooto.
Ak imwachi kalewenet koot ne ngelelyot, ileenji, mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole kotkot tereet, kotkot, ak roong'ji peek:
inde tuguuk che iyoi, kiy age tugul ne myee, kubesto, ak puita; inyiit kawek che myachen.
Kwei keechiirek che myach eng' akweet, ak irurukyi ma kawek: ingowaskei miising'; ee, iyoe teronooto kawechooto.

Mwaei anyun Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Pwo! Nganaseet ne po korotiik, tereet ne tinyei kutu eng' ole po oriit, tereet ne tomo kobek kutuuk! Inemu agenge agenge; ma mi parbaryat ne kaibutyi teronooto.
Amu mi korotiikyik kwenunnyi; ki inde rwandet ne ma mi kiy; ma tumji ng'wony, si ketuge temburyek;
si kobiit kong'eet nereegek che ng'woneen konyo koyaakta mugetuut, kaande korotiikyik rwandet parak si ma ki tuch.
Mwaei anyun Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Pwo! Nganaseet ne po korotiik! Atese kogeny karurugutyet koeet.
Nde kweenik che chaang', ilaal maat ne oo, iyo panyeek komyee, ak ichop suuteek konyigiisitu, ak ingolalyo kawek.
Yeityo igotkot teronooto komi puch eng' maata si kolal, ak kolal sugunwennyi si kochoot simdanyi ne mi oriit ak kobeel kutuukyik.
Aiimigei puch eng' poisyet, kutukyik che chaang' koma istoegei; ama iwong'ugei kutukyik eng' ma.
Agot ye ki atiliilin eng' yaityetap simdang'ung', ko ki ma itiliilage, ma kitiliilin kogeny eng' simdang'ung' kot ageesu nereegekyuk che ng'woneen eng' inyee.

Kamwae anee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ng'olyoondoniito, isuldoi ak ayae nooto; ma weechigei let, amarira moo, amawale kabwaatutikyuk. Arwoogun icheek ko uu ortinweguk ak ko uu poisyoniguk, mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ki nyoonjo kogeny ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor koleenjo,
Ee, weeriitap chii, keero, aistoi eng' yooto ne iboiboi konyeguk: ago metei anan iriir, ama saitoi peeguk che po kong'.
Tigen, ago ma miising'; ametechi che ki kobek, taae meting'ung' angeet, ak ilaach kweoniguk, ametuch kuting'ung', ameam amitwogigap piik.
Ki ang'alaalji anyun piik karon; ak kime osotyondennyu koskoleny: ak ki ayai karon ko uu ye kiga king'ata.
Ak ki leenjo piik, Tos memwaiwech kiit ne uu tuguuchu eng' acheek, kot iyai ko uu nooto?
Ki amwachi anyun aleenji, Ki nyoonjo ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, koleenjo,

Ng'alaalji kootap Israel, ileenji, mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Ogeero, amurwoni oldanyu ne tiliil, menoteetap kimnateeng'wong', ne iboiboi konyekwok, ne riiree saboonwekwok; ak kebare rotwetap chok weeriikwok ak tiibiikwok che ki obagaakte.
Ak tuun oyae ko uu ye koayai: motuche kutusweekwok, anan oam amitwogigap piik.
Ak komi metowekwok angook che otaae, ak komi kweonik keelyekwok; moteitosi anan oriirye; ago ochuichuitosi eng' tengekwogikwok, ak otigenjige.
Egu anyun Ezekiel kaboorunet eng' okweek; oyae ko uu tugul che ki koyai ineendet: ye nyo niito, onai anyun ole aa Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.

Ak inyee, ee, weeriitap chii, tos manyonjinin chiito eng' peetuut ye arebee icheek kimnateennywa, ak poiboiyetap toroornatennywa, ak ne iboiboi konyekwak, ak kioto ki inde mugulelwekwak, ak weeriikwak ak tiibiikwak,
tos manyonjinin eng' peetuunooto chiichooto chilili, si kogoonin igas nooto eng' itiiguk?
Eng' peetuunooto, ing'alaaljini ineendet, ama konamageen kuut kogeny: iegu anyun kaboorunet eng' icheek; ak konai icheek kole aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ki nyoonjo ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, koleenjo,
Ee, weeriitap chii, tokyigei kaplagogap Ammon, ak imaoten agobo icheek:

ak ileenji lagogap Ammon, Ogas ng'olyootap Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Amu ki imwa ile, Haa, agobo oldanyu ne tiliil, ye kiga kimurwon; ak agobo emetap Israel ye kiga kiyai kong'emak; ak agobo kootap Judah, ye ki kiluul:
keer anyun, agoochinin lagogap kong'asiis ibunji, ak koteekso icheek eng' kwenung'ung', ak koyai meng'otosyekwak eng' kwenung'ung'; amei logoeguk ak kolu cheguuk.
Ak ayai Rabbah koek ole menyei tambeesik, ak ayai kaplagogap Ammon koek ole kiyage akwotisyegap keechiirek: si onai ole aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Amu mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Amu ki irabrap euneguk, ak itwaltwal, ak ibaibaitu eng' koroomnateet tugul ne mi saboondang'ung' agobo emetap Israel;
keer anyun, kaachuul eunnyu atokyin, ak agoochin pororyosyek koluulin; ak aisten eng' pororyosyek, ak agoonin ilus eng' emotinwek: ang'emin; si inai ile aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Amu mwaei Moab ak Seir, kole, ogeero, uu kootap Judah pororyosyek tugul:
keer anyuno, ayaate kiwotetap Moab kobooch nganasook, kobooch nganasookyik che mi kiwotosyekyik, toroornatetap emet, Beth-Jesimoth, Baal-meon ak Kiriataim,
ayaatyini piigap kong'asiis, koba kobargei ak lagogap Ammon, ak agoochi icheek konam kobunji, si ma kibwaati lagogap Ammon kogeny eng' pororyosyek:
ak arwookyi Moab; si konai kole aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Amu ki koyai ne ya Edom koyaaktochigei mugetuut eng' kootap Judah, ak ki koyai yaityet ne oo, koyaaktochigei mugetuut;
mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Achuule eunnyu atokyini Edom, ak aiste eng' olooto chii ak tyony: ak ayai koguber kobooch Teman; kibarei icheek eng' rotwetap chok agoi Dedan.

Ak ayaakyi mugetuut Edom eng' eutap piik che miitei Israel, ak koyai eng' Edom ko uu nereegekyuk, ak eng' nereegekyuk che ng'woneen, si konai icheek yaaktaennyu ne po mugetuut, mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Amu kagoyaakta mugetuut Philistiik, ak kagoyaaktochigei mugetuut eng' koroomnateet ne mi saboondo si kobiit kong'emis eng' puunyoondit ne po agoi;
mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Ogeero, achuule eunnyu atokyi Philistiik, ak aiste Keretik, ak ang'em che ki ng'et che po ngeguut.
Ak ayaakyi icheek mugetuut ne koroom, eng' kereetap kong' ne ng'waan; si konai kole aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ye ayaakyini icheek mugetuut.
Ak eng' kenyiitap taman ak agenge, eng' peetuut ne po tai ne po arawanooto, konyoonjo ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor koleenjo,
Ee, weeriitap chii, amu ki komwa Tyro agobo Jerusalem kole, haa, kogobutok ineendet ne ki kurgeetap pororyosyek; kagoweekyagei: kitesa anyun achang'ait, amu kagong'emak ineendet;
mwaei anyun Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Keero, aboryenen, ee Tyro, ak agoochini pororyosyek che chaang' kobookyin, ko uu ye igoochin nyanjet peekyik komildagei.
Ak kong'em irimoigap Tyro, ak kobut teeksosyekyik che kooen: ang'oing'oi ng'ung'unyekyik, ak ayai ineendet koek rwandet ne ma mi kiy.
Egu nganasanooto ole kiitoe regereiywek che kiname njireenik, eng' kwenutap nyanjet; amu kamwae ng'olyoondoniito, mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor: ak koek ne luulei pororyosyek.
Ak kebare rotwetap chok tiibiikyik che mi emet: si konai kole aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.

Amu mwaei anyun Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Ogeero, amuti Nebukadresar laitoryatap Babilon, ineendet laitoryatap laitorinik, kobookyi Tyro, kobunu murot kaataam, kobooto paraisisyek, ak kariisyekyik che po lugeet, ak piik che ketei paraisisyek, ak kweanet, ak piik che chaang'.
Pare rotwetap chok tiibiiguk che mi emet: ak koteech irimoik kotokyin, ak koruruuch ng'ung'unyek kotokyin, ak konamji parak long'eet ne oo kotokyin.
Ak konde injinisyek che kibutisye, taitap irimoiguk, ak kobute aonokyik teeksosyeguk che kooen.

Tuchin temburyegap paraisisyekyik amu chaang'indonywa: itumdumegei irimoiguk amu kirgirenetap paraisisyek che laanyei piik, ak ne po kariisyek che lau tuguuk, ak ne po kariisyek che po lugeet, ye tuun punei ineendet ormariichoguk, ko uu piik che pendi nganaseet oriit kobunei ole ki kobutok.
Tiechei ortinweguk tugul eng' siyoogap paraisisyekyik: parei piiguk eng' rotwetap chok, ak koluulyo tolochigap kimnateng'ung'.
Ak koluul mogornatosyeguk, ak koluul tuguuguk che po mung'aaret: ak kobut irimoiguk, ak kong'em kooriguk che korooron: ak kowiirchi peek koiguk ak keetiiguk ak ng'ung'unyeguk.
Ak ageesu cheetap tyenwogiguk; ama kegasei kogeny cheetap ketubosyeguk.

Ak ayain iegu rwandet ne ma mi kiy: iegu ole kiitoe regereiywek che kiname njireenik; ma keteechin kogeny, amu kamwae anee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ng'olyoondoniito, mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Mwachin Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Tyro kole: Tos ma potandos ngeguusyek amu cheetap kabuteng'ung', ye tigendos, che kiguoteni, ye ki parchi piik kwenung'ung'?

Kochoorgei anyun eng' ng'echerokwak che po laitornatet pounik tugul che po nyanjet, ak koreek ngoroikwak che tabanu parak, ak koreek ngoroikwak che ki kinde lelesta: ilaachi potanet; ak kotebee ng'wonyut, ak kobotanso sait age tugul ak kokwong'enen.

Ak koriiryo agobo inyee, ak koleenjin, Katepto ano si keng'emin ne tee ni, inyee ne ki menyin piigap nyanjet, nganaseet ne ko tagunoot, ne ki kiim eng' nyanjet, ineendet ak piik che komenyei, ne koimui piik tugul che komenyei olooto!
Tuun potandos anyun ngeguusyek eng' peetuutap kabuteng'ung'; ee, aragendos ngeguusyek che mi nyanjet ye iistoige.
Amu mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Ye tuun ayain iegu nganaseet ne karaatya, ko uu nganasook che ma ki menyei; ye tuun atugenen nyanjet, ak kotubin peek che chaang';

achoorten anyun kobooto icheek che choorchingei keriinget, ole mi piik che po keny, ak agoonin imeny ng'wony oriit, eng' komoswek che ki koek surkwen kobooch keny, kobooto icheek che choorchingei keriinget, si ma ki menyin; ak ande toroornatet emetap piik che saptos:
ayain iegu kamuiset, ama ipiitu kogeny: agot nda kicheeng'in, koma koi kinyoorun kogeny, mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ki nyoonjo kogeny ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor koleenjo,
Ee inyee, weeriitap chii, riir agobo Tyro,

ak ileenji Tyro, Ee inyee ne imenye ole kimandoe kebendi nyanjet, ne ii chemung'araindet ne po pororyosyek che po ngeguusyek che chaang', mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Ee Tyro, ki imwa ile, Ageesunotkei eng' korooronindo.
Mi kiwotosyeguk kwenutap nyanjosyek, ki koyai teegiguk karaaranindang'ung' koek ne ititaat.
Ki koyai icheek pagoiniguk eng' piribirinik che punu Senir: ki koip taragonik eng' Lebanon si kobiit koyaun toloitap moinget.
Ki koyai icheek mugangoguk che kiwase peek, keetiigap Bashan; kiyae seremusyeguk kelegap peeleek, che ki kiliige taragonik che teer che punu ngeguusyegap Kitim.
Ki po katanit ne karaaran ne ki kinde lelesta, angeeng'ung' ne ki punu Misiri, si koek eng' inyee songolyet; ki buluu ak ko aruus ne piriir emaing'ung' ne ki punu ngeguusyegap Elisha.
Ki kiboitiniguk che po moinget, piik che ki menyei Sidon ak Arbad: ee Tyro, ki menyin piiguk che ng'oomen che ki kwerye moinget.
Kimenyin poisyegap Gebal kobooto piikyik che ng'oomen che kitimoti ole kaundur: kimi kwenung'ung' melisyek tugul che po nyanjet kobooto kiboitiinikwak si koyai mung'areng'ung'.
Ki mi lugeng'ung' piigap Persia, ak che po Lud ak che po Put, mureniguk che po lugeet: ki kigartaat eng' inyee long'eet ak chepkulet; ki ibarta icheek karaaranindang'ung'.

Ki mi piigap Abad kobooto lugeng'ung' irimoiguk parak komoswek tugul, ak kimi Gamadik teeksosyeguk che kooen: ki igartaat long'onikwak eng' irimoiguk eng' komoswek tugul; ki koyai karaaranindang'ung' koek ne ititaat.
Ki chemung'araindeng'ung' Tarsis amu chaang'indap mogornatosyek alak tugul; kiyaei mung'aaret eng' fedha, karnook, kibatinik ak ngosyelaisyek, si konyoor tuguuguk.
Ki chemung'arainiguk Javan, Tubal, ak Meshek: kiyae mung'aaret piik ak tuguugap sugunonik koale tuguuguk.
Kiyae mung'aaret icheek che po kootap Togarmah paraisisyegap poisyet, ak paraisisyek che po lugeet, kobooto nyumbusyek si konyoor tuguuguk.
Ki chemung'arainiguk piigap Dedan: ki ek ole ialdoisye ngeguusyek che chaang': ki alunenen tuguuguk kelegap peeleek ak keetiik che tuuen.

Ki chemung'araindeng'ung' Syria, amu chaang'indap tuguugap musoknateng'ung': kiyae mung'aaret sumaragdoisyek, ak ngoroik che arusen ne piriir, ak ngoroik che ki kinde lelesta, ak katanit ne karaaran, ak tuguuk che piriireen che mi ngeguut, ak koik che piriireen si konyoor tuguuguk.
Ki chemung'arainiguk Judah, ak emetap Israel: kiyae mung'aaret nganugap Minit, ak panag, kobooto kumyat, ak mwanik, ak mwanik che kinyaise, si konyoor tuguuguk.
Ki chemung'araindeng'ung' Damasko amu chaang'indap tuguugap musoknateng'ung', amu chaang'indap mogornatosyek alak tugul; kobooto divaigap Helbon, ak koroorigap keechiirek che leelach.
Kiyae mung'aaret Bedan ak Javan tuguuk che punu Usal: kibooto tuguuguk che po mung'aaret, kariik che kita kitanyi, kasia ak kalamus.
Ki chemung'araindeng'ung' Dedan eng' ngoroik che kiitoi eng' paraisisyek.
Ki chemung'arainiguk Arabia, ak pounik tugul che po Kedar; ki aldaun aaregap keechiir ak mengichik, ak ng'oroorek.
Chemung'arainigap Sheba ak che po Raamah ko ki chemung'arainiguk: kiyae mung'aaret tuguuk che ng'uu ne anyiny kosiir tugul, ak koik tugul che po kamanuutyet ne oo, ak thahabu.
Haran, Kane ak Eden, chemung'arainigap Sheba, Ashur ak Kilmad, ko ki chemung'arainiguk.

Ki chemung'arainiguk chuuto eng' tuguuk che korooron, ngoroik che buluu ak che ki kinde lelesta, ak moingonik che korooron kot, che ki kirate poroonik, ak keyae taragonik, kibooto chooto tuguuguk che po mung'aaret.
Ki ibei tuguuguk che po mung'aaret melisyegap Tarsis: ak ki itesage, ak itororitu miising' eng' kwenutap nyanjosyek.
Ki komutun kiboitiniguk che po moinget inyoo peek che chaang': kiryebin usoonetap kong'asiis eng' kwenutap nyanjosyek.

Ibutyin kwenutap nyanjosyek mogornatosyeguk, ak tuguuguk che po mung'aaret, mung'areng'ung', kiboitiniguk che po moinget, ak piiguk che kweryei moinget, piiguk che timoti ole kaundur, ak piik che ki konam mung'areng'ung', ak piiguk tugul che po lugeet, che mi kwenung'ung', kobooto kweaneng'ung' tugul che mi kwenung'ung', eng' peetuutap ng'emisyeng'ung'.
Potandos kiwotosyek amu waagaatap piiguk che kweryei melisyek.
Chorugei eng' melisyekwak piik tugul che wasei peek eng' mugangok, kobooto kiboitiinik, ak piik tugul che po nyanjet che kweryei melisyek, tonondos eng' ngeguut.
Ak kowaach kot igas, ak koriiryo eng' ng'wanindo, ak kolakyin temburyek metowekwak, ak komildaegei oreek;
ak kocher metowekwak amu inyee, ak kogermenegei kuniok, ak koriiryo agobo inyee eng' ng'wanindo ne po saboondo, ak eng' riirek che ng'woneen.
Ak koriirchin eng' kateiyennywa, ak koriirchin kole ng'oo ne uu Tyro, ne ki king'em kewiirchi kwenutap nyanjet?
Ye kibun tuguuguk che po mung'aaret nyanjosyek, ki inyiit pororyosyek che chaang', ki igoochi laitorinigap ng'wony koek mogoreek eng' chaang'indap mogornatosyeguk.
Eng' peetuut ne ki kiiriin eng' nyanjosyek eng' rirosyek, ki ibutyo tuguuguk che po mung'aaret eng' kwenung'ung', kobooto kweaneng'ung' tugul.
Kwong'enen piik tugul che menyei ngeguusyek, ak koiyweis miising' laitorinikwak, taagu arageneet eng' togoochikwak.
Renyin chemung'arainik che mi pororyosyek; ki iegu kamuiset ama ipiitu agoi.
Ki nyoonjo kogeny ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, koleenjo,

Ee, weeriitap chii, mwachi pounindetap Tyro, ileenji, mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Amu kiitoroorge eng' muguleldang'ung', ak imwa ile, Aa kamuktain, atebee ng'echereetap Kamuktaindet, eng' kwenutap nyanjosyek; ago ii chiito, ma ii Kamuktaindet, agot nganda ki iyaige eng' muguleldang'ung' iige Kamuktaindet:
keero, ii ng'oom isiir Daniel; ma mi ung'ootyet ne imuuchi icheek koung'enen:
ki isikyigei mogornatosyek eng' utaatyeng'ung' ak naeng'ung', ak ki igonorchigei thahabu ak fedha eng' ole kigonoree konoraik:
ki ites mogornatosyeguk eng' utaatyeng'ung' ne oo ak eng' mung'areng'ung', ak kiitoroorgei eng' muguleldang'ung' amu mogornatosyeguk:
mwaei anyun Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Amu ki iyaige eng' muguleldang'ung' iige Kamuktaindet ne Toroor;
keer anyun, amutyinin toek, piik che iywei pororyosyek, ak kong'us rotonikwak po chok agobo karaaranindap utaatyeng'ung', ak komurwon kakweng'eng'ung'.
Ak kochoorten iwe keriinget; ak imeei eng' meosyegap che ki kibar, eng' kwenutap nyanjosyek.
Tos ta imwae eng' taitap ineendet ne parin, ile, aa kamuktain? Ago ii chiito, ma ii kamuktain, imi eutap ineendet ne iguotenin.
Imee eng' meosyegap che ma kimuratan eng' eutap toek: amu kaamwa ng'olyoondoniito, mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ki nyoonjo kogeny ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, koleenjo,
Ee, weeriitap chii, riir agobo laitoryatap Tyro, ak ileenji, mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Ing'ochi karagendoet, kigonyiin utaatyet, ak ii ne ititaat eng' korooronindo.

Ki imi Eden, mbareetap Kamuktaindet; ki itugegei koita age tugul ne po kamanuutyet, sardio, topasio, ak yaholom, berulo, soari, jasipi, sapphire, sumaragdo, ak bareqet, ak thahabu: ki miitei oriing'ung' poisyetap sugutisyeguk che mengeechen ak ndurerusyeguk; ki kichop chooto eng' peetuut ne ki kitau keyain.
Kii kerubindet ne ki kiil ne ki iuurisyei: ak ki andein si itebee tulweet ne tiliil ne po Kamuktaindet; ki iwendote kwenutap koik che po maat.
Ki igeesunotkei eng' ortinweguk kobooch peetuut ne ki kiyaenen, kot kenyoorchin yaityet.

Ki inyiitin icheek koroomnateet eng' chaang'indap mung'areng'ung', ak ki iyai tengekto: ki atimden anyun ko uu ne murwoon, ichooruge eng' tulweetap Kamuktaindet; ak kaang'emin, ee kerubindet ne iuurisyei, imang'une koik che po maat.
Ki itoroorge eng' muguleldang'ung' amu karaaranindang'ung', ki ing'em utaatyeng'ung' amu kakweng'eng'ung': kaawiirchin ng'wony kaandein taitap laitorinik, si kobiit kogeerin.

Ki imurwon oldinweguk che tiliileen eng' chaang'indap tengekwogiguk, eng' yaityetap mung'areng'ung'; kaanemu anyun maat eng' kwenung'ung', ki kobeelin, ak awalin iegu oreek eng' ng'wony, eng' taitap icheek tugul che keerin.
Kwong'enen icheek tugul che ingenin che mi pororyosyek: ki iegu kamuiset, ama ipiitu agoi.
Ak ki nyoonjo ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, koleenjo,
Ee, weeriitap chii, tokyi togeng'ung' Sidon, ak imaotenji,

ileenji, mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Keero, aboryenen, ee Sidon; ak kitoroora eng' kwenung'ung': si konai kole aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ye karwookyi ineendet ak aegu ne itabaanat eng' ineendet.

Amu ayookyini ineendet koroito ak korotiik eng' ortinwekyik; ak kobutyo eng' kwenunnyi icheek che kogiguoten, che kiguoteni eng' rotwetap chok eng' komosta age tugul; si konai kole aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.

Eng' kootap Israel koma kobiitu kogeny eng' komoswekwak tugul che sasei icheek ko uu kateet ne rutei ak kotoorei piich, anan kateet ne ng'waan. Ak konai icheek kole aa Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.

Mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Ye tuun kaayum kootap Israel komang'une pororyosyek ole kiga kiyestoochi, ak aegu ne itabaanat eng' icheek eng' taitap pororyosyek, komeny anyun emennywa ne ki agoochi otwogindennyu Jakobo.

Ak komeny olooto eng' chametapkei; ee teechei kooriik, ak komiin sabibuk, ak komeng'iis eng' chametapkei; ye tuun kaarwookyi icheek tugul che sasei icheek che mi komoswekwak tugul; si konai kole aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindennywa.
Ki nyoonjo ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' kenyiitap taman, eng' arawetap taman, eng' peetuutap taman ak aeng', ne po arawanooto, koleenjo,
Ee, weeriitap chii, tokyi togeng'ung' Pharaoh laitoryatap Misiri, ak imaotenji ineendet kobooto Misiri tugul:

ng'alaal, ak imwa ile, Mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole; Keero, aboryenen, inyee Pharaoh laitoryatap Misiri, maswetit ne oo ne rue kwenutap ainoosyekyik, ne ki komwa kole, ainennyu ko nenyu aneege, ki ayachinigei.

Ak andoi kombook tagilgiliguk, ak agoochi njireenigap ainoosyeguk konamgei ak periguk; ak amutun imong'u eng' kwenutap ainoosyeguk, kobooto njireenik tugul che po ainoosyeguk che ki namgei ak periguk.

Abagaaktoin ko kagewiirchin surkwen, inyee kobooto njireenik tugul che po ainoosyeguk: ibutyini kewanin; ma kimugutosok anan kiyumak: kagoiten iegu amitwogigap tyong'igap ng'wony, ak che po toriitigap parak.
Ak konai piik tugul che menyei Misiri kole aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, amu ki ek icheeget kirokto ne po tegat eng' kootap Israel.
Kingo namin icheek euut, iiri, ak ibet tigigoikwak tugul: ye kingo tienengei, iil inyeendet, ak kiitumdum suenutikwak tugul.
Mwaei anyun Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Keero, aibun rotwetap chok, ak abar eng' kwenung'ung' chii ak tyony.
Ak koguber emetap Misiri ak koek karaita, si konai kole aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor; amu ki komwa kole, nenyu aineet, anee ne ki ayae.
Keer anyun, aboryenen, kobooto ainoosyeguk, ak ayai emetap Misiri koek karaita ne ya ak koguber, kobooch teekseet ne kooi ne po Sebene agoi kiwotetap Kush.
Ma punei chii olooto, ama punei tyony, ama ki menyei eng' kenyiisyek artam.

Ak ayai emetap Misiri koguber eng' kwenutap emotinwek che kuberotin, ak koek nganasookyik karatwek kenyiisyek artam eng' kwenutap nganasook che karatwek: ak aseer Misiriik koba pororyosyek, ak aiyestochi emotinwek.
Amu mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Ayumi Misiriik komang'une pororyosyek ole kigaiyestoochi, ko kagobata kenyiisyek artamu;
ak amutu kogeny piigap Misiri che ki kiluul, ak aweekte koba emetap Patros, emet ne ki kisikyin ak komeng'iis eng' olooto koek pounateet ne nyeraat.
Egu pounateet ne nyeraat eng' tugul; ama kotorooregei kogeny kosiir pororyosyek: ak aming'ini icheek, si ma kobou pororyosyek kogeny.
Ama koegu kogeny ne kimang'u eng' kootap Israel, ne koonu kibwaat tengekto, ye kuskong' kogeer icheek: si konai kole aa Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ak eng' kenyiitap tiptem ak tisap eng' arawet ne po tai, eng' peetuut ne po tai ne po arawanooto, konyoonjo ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, koleenjo,

Ee, weeriitap chii, ki ng'at Nebukadresar laitoryatap Babilon lugeennyi koyai poisyet ne oo kobar Tyro: kichur metit age tugul, ak kosindit tigikyet age tugul: ago ma nyoor melekto, agot lugeennyi, eng' Tyro, amu poisyet ne ki yai agobo nganasanooto.

Mwaei anyun Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Ogeero, agoochini Nebukadresar laitoryatap Babilon emetap Misiri; ak komut piikyik che chaang', ak koluul tuguukyik, ak koip tuguukyik che kiluulei; si koek chooto melektap lugeennyi.
Kaagoochi ineendet emetap Misiri koek melektanyi amu poisyennyi, amu kiboisyeiwo, mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Abityini kootap Israel kuinet eng' peetuunooto, ak agoonin itwegu eng' kwenunnywa; si konai kole aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ki nyoonjo kogeny ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, koleenjo,
Ee, weeriitap chii, maoten, ile, Mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ko uu ni kole: Oteiye, pwo! Peetuunooto!
Amu kagoriik peetuunooto, kagoriik peetuutap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, peetuutap tulugenet; peetuusyegap pororyosyek.
Ak konyonji rotwetap chok Misiri, ak koityi ng'wanindo Kush, ye ibutyo piik che kibarei eng' Misiri; ak komut piikyik che chaang', ak kebut lumeiywekyik.
Kibare icheek rotwetap chok kobooto Kush, Put, Lud, ak piik tugul che kiburuchkei, kobooto Kush, kobooto piigap emet ne ki namgei ak icheeget.

Mwaei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Ibutos ak icheek che tiye Misiri, ak kobut menoteetap kimnateennyi: kibare icheek rotwetap chok kobooch teekseet ne kooi ne po Sebene, mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ak koek kibananook eng' kwenutap emotinwek che kibananook, ak kotebee nganasookyik kwenutap nganasook che ki koek karatwek.
Ak konai kole aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ye kaabeel Misiri, ak keng'em toretikyik tugul.

Pendi eng' peetuunooto eng' tainnyu piik che kiyooktoi eng' melisyek koba komu Ethiopik che leen tebyei eng' kaalyeet; ak koityi icheek ng'wanindo, ko uu eng' peetuutap Misiri; ogeero, amu nyoonei peetuunooto.
Mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Ageesu tuiyetap Misiri, eng' eutap Nebukadresar laitoryatap Babilon.
Kimutu ineendet ak piikyik kong'em emet, ineendet ne iywei pororyosyek; ak kong'us rotonikwak po chok kobar Misiri, ak konyiit muuswek emet.
Ak ateenyi ainoosyek, ak aaldochi emonooto piik che yaacheen; ak ayai emet koguber, kobooto tugul che mi olooto, eng' eunegap toek: kamwae anee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ng'olyoondoniito.

Mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Ang'eme kanamonik ak icheek, ak ageesu itoonwegap tuguuk che ma tilei kiy, eng' Nop; ama kobiitu kogeny pounindet eng' emetap Misiri: ak ande kaiyweisyet emetap Misiri.
Ak ayai Patros kobanan, ak abeel Zoan, ak arwookyi No.
Ak aroong'ji nereegekyuk che ng'woneen Sin, irimeetap Misiri; ak abar piik che chaang' che po No.
Ak abeel Misiri; nyooru ng'wanindo ne oo Sin, ak ketonaton No: ak konyoor Nop puunik peet.
Kibare rotwetap chok murenigap Aben ak che po Pi-beset: ak keluul nganasochuuto.
Imenitu peetuut agine eng' Teapnes, ye airii eng' olooto chogisyegap Misiri, ak kogeskei anyun menoteetap kimnateennyi: ago tuchei ineendet pooldet, ak keluul tiibiikyik.
Ayae anyun ko uu nooto kirwoogutik eng' Misiri: si konai kole aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ak eng' kenyiitap taman ak agenge, eng' arawet ne po tai, eng' peetuutap tisap ne po arawanooto, konyoonjo ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, koleenjo,
Ee, weeriitap chii, kaairi eutap Pharaoh laitoryatap Misiri: ak keero, ma ki rat kinde kerichek, kerate angeet, si kogimit komuuch konam rotwetap chok.
Mwaei anyun Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Ogeero, aborye Pharaoh laitoryatap Misiri ak airie eunekyik, che kiimeen, ak ne kiga keiri; ak agoochi rotwetap chok kobut eng' eunnyi.
Ak aseer Misiriik koba pororyosyek, ak aiyestochi emotinwek.
Ak agimiit eunegap laitoryatap Babilon, ak agoochi ineendet rotwennyu po chok: ago airie eunegap Pharaoh, ak kotigen eng' tainnyi eng' tigenoik che uu che po chiito ne kagiguoten ne po meet.
Ak agimiit eunegap laitoryatap Babilon, ak kobutyo eunegap Pharaoh; si konai kole aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ye agoochi rotwennyu po chok laitoryatap Babilon, si kong'werere emetap Misiri.
Ak aseer Misiriik koba pororyosyek, ak aiyestochi emotinwek; si konai kole aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ki nyoonjo ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' kenyiit ne po taman ak agenge, eng' arawetap somok, eng' peetuutap tai ne po arawanooto, koleenjo,
Ee, weeriitap chii, mwachi Pharaoh laitoryatap Misiri ak piikyik che chaang' ng'olyoondoni ileenji: Ogerge ak ng'oo eng' etunateng'ung'?
Keero, kitarakwet Assyrianindet eng' Lebanon ne tinyei mooriik che korooron, kisamum, ak ko kooi; ak ki itei walinnyi poolik.
Kibai peek ineendet, ki ibit rireet: ki root ainoosyekyik koba komoswek tugul eng' mbareennyi; ak kirootyi peekyik keetiik tugul che po mbareet.
Kitororit anyun koindonyi kosiir keetiik tugul che po mbar; ak kitesagis mooriikyik, ak kogoeegitu mooriikyik amu peek che chaang', ye kingo ywaakta.
Ki teech toriitik tugul kesonokwak eng' mooriigap keetoto, ak koiichi tyong'ik tugul che po emet kelutap keetoto, ak kiuure pororyosyek tugul che eecheen.
Ki karaaran anyun eng' etunatennyi, eng' kooindap mooriikyik: amu kineegite tigitikyik peek che chaang'.

Ma imuuch taragonik che ki mi mbareetap Kamuktaindet kouny ineendet: ki ma ko kergei piribirinik ak mooriikyik; ak ki ma ko kergei keetiik che uu kurinik ak mooriikyik; ak ki ma komi keetit age tugul eng' mbareetap Kamuktaindet ne kergei ak ineendet eng' karaaranindanyi.
Ki ayai ineendet kogararanit eng' chaang'indap mooriikyik: kot koam ng'etkong' keetiik tugul che po Eden, che ki mi mbareetap Kamuktaindet.
Kamwa anyun Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Amu kiitoroorge eng' koindong'ung', ak ki itei walinnyi poolik, ak kitororit muguleldanyi amu koindonyi;
andoi ineendet eutap chiito ne kiim ne po pororyosyek; irwookyin iman: ki aoon amu yaityennyi.

Kigoep ineendet toek che kiywei che po pororyosyek ak kometo: ki kobutyo mooriikyik eng' tuloonook ak eng' atebwosyek tugul, ak kigoilyo mooriikyik eng' kereruusyek tugul che po emet; ak ki koba pororyosyek tugul che po ng'wony kobagaakta urwennyi, ak kometo ineendet.
Menyei toriitik tugul karaitanyi, ak kotebee tyong'ik tugul che po timiin mooriikyik:

si mata kotoroorgei eng' koindonywa keet age tugul eng' keetiik tugul che mi ye neegitee peek, anan koboochit walisyekwak poolik, anan kotononso chechwaak che kiimeen eng' koindonywa, icheek tugul che eei peek: amu kagigoito tugul kobek, koba ng'wony oriit, eng' kwenutap piik, kobooto icheeget che choorchingei keriinget.

Mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Eng' peetuut ne kichoorchigei ye mi che ki kobek ko ki ang'at riirek keriirchi ineendet: ki atuch rireet amu kiteenyo peek che chaang': ak ki ang'at Lebanon koriirchi ineendet, ak kitanuiso keetiik tugul che po timiin amu ineendet.

Ki agoochi pororyosyek kobotanso amu cheetap kabutennyi, ye kinga timde ineendet kwo ye mi che ki kobek kobooto icheeget che choorchingei keriinget: ak ki igaigaigei keetiik tugul che po Eden, keetiik che korooron ak ko myachen miising' che po Lebanon, icheek tugul che eei peek, ki igaigaigei eng' ng'wony oriit.
Ki choortagei chooto ak icheek koba ye mi che ki kobek kobooto ineendet, koba ole mi icheeget che ki kibare rotwetap chok; ee, chooto che ki eunnyi, che ki menyei urwennyi eng' kwenutap pororyosyek.

Ogerge ak ng'oo anyun eng' toroornatet ak etunateet eng' kwenutap keetiigap Eden? Nganda uu nooto kechoortoin kobooto keetiigap Eden iwe ng'wony oriit: irue kwenutap che ma kimuratan, kobooto icheeget che ki kibare rotwetap chok. Niito ko Pharaoh ak piikyik che chaang', mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ki nyoonjo ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' kenyiit ne po taman ak aeng', eng' arawetap taman ak aeng', eng' peetuut ne po tai ne po arawanooto, koleenjo,

Ee, weeriitap chii, riir agobo Pharaoh laitoryatap Misiri, ak ileenji, Kiga kirogenen ng'etundo ne neran ne po pororyosyek: ago iuu maswetit eng' nyanjosyek; imong'u kobooto ainoosyeguk, ak iwase peek eng' keelyeguk, ak isamisi ainoosyekwak.
Mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Aiitoi regereiywondennyu atugenen kobooto tuiyet ne po pororyosyek che chaang'; si komutunenen regereiywondennyu itogosu.
Si ametochin emet, awirchinin kewanin, ak agoochi toriitik tugul che po parak kotebenen, ak agoochi tyong'ik che po ng'wony komugul kobiyong'enen.
Ak ande poortang'ung' tuloonook parak, ak anyiit atebwosyek koindong'ung'.
Ak abise korotiguk emet ne ibire peek, agoi tuloonook; ak inyi kereruusyek.
Ak ye tuun ageesun atuch kipsengwet, ak ayae kecheikyik koimenitu; atuge pooldet asiista, ama kooluu arawet.
Ayae lapkeiyosyek tugul che po kipsengwet che iluu miising' koimenitu eng' paragung'ung', ak ande mesundeito emeng'ung', mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Agoochini mugulelwegap pororyosyek che chaang' konereekso, ye tuun aibun ng'emisyeng'ung' eng' kwenutap pororyosyek, konyo emotinwek che kitom inai.

Ee, agoochini pororyosyek che chaang' kokwong'enen, ak koiyweis miising' laitorinikwak agobo inyee, ye tuun abarbar rotwennyu po chok eng' tainnywa; ak kobotanso eng' sait age tugul, kobotan chii tugul agobo saboondanyi, eng' peetuutap kabuteng'ung'.
Amu mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Nyonjinin rotwetap chok ne po laitoryatap Babilon.
Agoochini kobek piiguk che chaang' eng' rotoogap chok, che po piik che nyigoonen; icheek tugul ko che iywei pororyosyek: ak kong'em icheek menoteetap Misiri, ak kobek piikyik tugul che chaang'.
Abare kogeny tyong'ikyik tugul che mi ole neegitee peek che chaang'; ama kotyechei peek che chaang'; ama kotyechei chii kogeny peechooto, anan kotyech tyong'ik.
Atiliilii anyun peekwak, agoochini koroot ainoosyekwak ko uu mwanik, mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ye tuun ayai emetap Misiri koguber ak koek karaatya, emet ne ma komi tuguuk che ki nyiitaat, ye abar tugul che menyei olooto, konai anyun kole aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Chuuto ko riirek che tuun riirtos icheek; tuun riirtos tiibiigap pororyosyek eng' rirechooto: riirtos agobo Misiri, ak agobo piikyik tugul che chaang', mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ki nyoonjo ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' kenyiit ne po taman ak aeng', eng' peetuutap taman ak muut ne po arawanooto, koleenjo,
Ee, weeriitap chii, riirchi piik che chaang' che po Misiri, ak itimde icheek, ineendet ak tiibiigap pororyosyek che taagunotiin, koba ng'wony oriit, kobooto icheek che choorchingei keriinget.
Isiire ng'oo eng' korooronindo? Chortegei, ui iru kobooto che ma kimuratan.
Ibutyin kwenutap che ki kebare rotwetap chok. Ki koitoi Misiri kebaree rotwetap chok; ichuut ineendet koistogei kobooto piikyik tugul che chaang'.

Ng'alaaljin piik che kiimeen eng' che nyigoonen ineendet, eng' kwenutap ye mi che ki kobek, komi kobooto che toreti ineendet: kigochoortagei, siistos, agot che ma kimuratan, che ki kibare rotwetap chok.
Mi Ashur olooto kobooto kweanennyi tugul; mi kereeriisyekyik komoswekyik tugul: che ki kibare rotwetap chok:

che ki kinde kereeriisyekwak komoswek che po oriit che po keriinget, ak mi kweanennyi komoswek tugul che po kererinnyi: ki kibar tugul, ki kibare rotwetap chok, che ki yai kamuiset eng' emetap piik che saptos.

Mi Elam olooto ak piikyik tugul che chaang' eng' komoswek tugul che po kererinnyi: ki kibar icheek tugul eng' rotwetap chok, che ki kochoortagei koma kimuratan, koba agoi ng'wony oriit, che ki yai kamuiset eng' emetap piik che saptos, ak ki kogesen kalilanennywa kobooto icheeget che choorchingei keriinget.

Ki kochopchi ineendet itoogut eng' kwenutap che ki kibar, kobooto piikyik tugul che chaang'; mi kereeriisyekyik komoswekyik tugul: ki ma kimuratan icheek tugul, ki kibare rotwetap chok; amu kiyaak kamuisennywa eng' emetap piik che saptos, ak ki kogesen kalilanennywa kobooto icheeget che choorchingei keriinget: ki kinde ineendet kwenutap icheek che kigebar.

Mi olooto Meshek, Tubal, ak piikyik tugul che chaang'; mi kereeriisyekyik komoswekyik tugul; ki ma kimuratan icheek tugul, ki kibare rotwetap chok; amu ki yai kamuisennywa eng' emetap piik che saptos.

Ak maruitos kobooto piik che nyigoonen che ki pek che po che ma kimuratan, che kichoorchigei ye mi che ki kobek koibei kariikwak che po lugeet, ak kitiie metowekwak rotonikwak po chok, ak mi tengekwogikwak kawekwak; amu icheek ko ki kamuiset ne po piik che nyigoonen eng' emetap piik che saptos.
Ago kitonatonin eng' kwenutap che ma kimuratan, ak oruitosi kobooto icheeget che ki kibare rotwetap chok.

Mi Edom olooto, kobooto laitorinikyik ak pounikyik tugul, che ruitos eng' kimnateennywa kobooto icheek che ki kibare rotwetap chok: ruitos kobooto che ma kimuratan, ak icheeget che choorchingei keriinget.

Mi olooto pounigap murot kaataam, icheek tugul, ak Sidonik tugul, che kichoortagei kobooto che ki kibar; ililandos icheek eng' kamuiset ne ki piitune kimnateennywa; ak ruitos ama kimuratan kobooto che ki kibare rotwetap chok, ak kogesen kalilanennywa kobooto icheek che choorchingei keriinget.
Keerei Pharaoh icheek, ak kogaigaigei amu piikyik tugul che chaang' che ki kibare rotwetap chok; Pharaoh ak lugeennyi komugul, mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.

Amu kande kamuisennyi emetap piik che saptos: ak kinde ineendet kwenutap che ma kimuratan, kobooto icheek che ki kibare rotwetap chok, Pharaoh, kobooto piikyik tugul che chaang', mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ki nyoonjo ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, koleenjo,
Ee, weeriitap chii, ng'alaalji lagogap piiguk, ileenji, ye aipchi emet rotwetap chok, ngot kolewen piigap emonooto chiito eng' kwenunnywa, ak konde koek riibindennywa:
ak ngo keer ineendet rotwetap chok konyonjin emonooto, koguut iryageet ak koteechi piik;
age tugul anyun ne kasei iryageet, ama iit kateunet, ngot konyo rotwetap chok ak kobar ineendet, kotebee korotiikyik metinnyi.
Ki kas ineendet iryageet, ama iit kateunet, tebee anyun korotiikyik ineendet: amu nda kiga iit kateunet, ta kiga kosar saboondanyi.

Ago ngot kogeer riibindet konyonei rotwetap chok, ama kuut iryageet, ama kiteechi piik, ak konyo rotwetap chok, ak kobar chii age tugul eng' kwenunnywa; kebare amu tengektanyi, ago amage korotiikyik eutap riibindet.
Ee anyun, inyee, weeriitap chii, kaandein iegu riibindet eng' kootap Israel; kas anyun ng'olyoot ne amwae, ak iipchi icheek kateunennyu.
Ye aleenji kiptengekyot, Ee, kiptengekyondoni, imee iman, ameteechi kiptengekyondonooto kometo ooreennyi; komeei kiptengekyondonooto amu tengektanyi, ago amage korotiikyik eung'ung'.
Ago, ngot iteechi kiptengekyot agobo ooreennyi, si koweek kometo oranooto, ama meto ooreennyi, komeei ineendet amu tengektanyi, ago kaisaru saboondang'ung'.
Ee inyee, weeriitap chii, mwachi kootap Israel ileenji, omwae ko uu ni ole: “Kanamech pistaosyekyok ak tengekwogikyok, ak kichuchui amu chooto; kimuktoi ano anyun kesapche?”

Mwachi icheek ileenji, ko uu ye asabe, mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, koma paibaitune meetap kiptengekyot; ago abaibai ngo week kiptengekyot kometo ooreennyi, ak kosap: oweege, oweege, omete ortinwekwok che yaach; amu nee si obegu, ee kootap Israel?

Ee, inyee weeriitap chii, mwachi lagogap piiguk, ileenji, ma saru chiito ne po iman imanda eng' peetuutap pistoennyi; ago ma namei kiptengekyot tengekto eng' peetuut ne kaweek kometo tengektanyi: amaimuuchi kosap ineendet ne po iman eng' imandanyi eng' peetuut ne yaei tengekto.
Ye aleenji ne po iman, isabe iman; ngot komong' imandanyi, yeityo koyai tengekto, koma kibwaati agot agenge eng' poisyonikyik che po imanda; ago meei amu tengektanyi ne ki yai.
Kogeny, ye aleenji kiptengekyot, Imee iman; ngot koweek kometo tengektanyi; ak koyai kiit ne po iman ak ko litit;
ngot koweekta kiptengekyot kiit ne kiname pesendo, ak koweekta kogeny kiit ne kirebei, ak kowendote ng'atuutigap saboondo, amata koyai tengekto; kosabei iman ineendet, ma meei.
Ma kiityin ineendet agot agenge eng' tengekwogikyik che ki koyai: ki koyai ineendet kiit ne po iman ak ko litit; sabei iman.
Ago mwaei lagogap piiguk kole, ma po iman ooreetap Kiptaiyat: ago eng' icheek koma po iman ooreennywa.
Ye week ne po iman kometo imandanyi, ak koyai tengekto, komeei eng' tengegoto.
Ak ye week kiptengekyot kometo tengektanyi, ak koyai kiit ne po iman ak ko litit, kosabei ineendet eng' nooto.
Ago omwae ole, Ma po iman ooreetap Kiptaiyat. Ee kootap Israel, arwookyini age tugul eng' okweek ko uu ortinwekyik.

Ki nyoonjo chiito age ne kiga chilil komong' eng' Jerusalem, ki nyo eng' kenyiit ne po taman ak aeng', kobooch ngap keluulech, eng' arawetap taman, eng' peetuut ne po muut ne po arawanooto, koleenjo, Kagebar nganaseet.

Ki mi anyun eutap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor paragunnyu koskoleny, kotomo koit ineendet ne kichilili; ak kiga kogoono Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ang'alaal, ye kingo itu chiichooto karon ole ki ami, ak ki ang'alaal, ki mata konamaga kuut.
Ak ki nyoonjo ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, koleenjo,
Ee, weeriitap chii, mwaei icheek che menyei komoswek che karatwek eng' emetap Israel, kole, ki chiichak Abraham, ak ki punji emet: ago ki chaang' acheek; ki kigoonech emet kobunjech.
Mwachi anyun icheek ileenji, mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ko uu ni kole: Oame panyeek kobooto korotiik, ak otokyini konyekwok kanamonikwok, ak otumdoi korotiik: tos oname emet kobunjook?
Otiegei rotonikwok po chok, oyae kiit ne kiwechei, ak ing'waniti age tugul eng' okweek osotyotap chiitap kokwennyi: tos oname emet kobunjook?

Mwachi anyun pichooto ko uu ni ileenji, mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Ko uu ye asabe, ki pare iman rotwetap chok icheek che mi komoswek che karatwek, ak agoochini koam tyong'ik ineendet ne mi kewanin, ak kobar koroito icheek che mi irimoik ak che mi kebenonik.
Ak ayae emet koguber ak koek ne kikwong'ee, ak kogeskei menoteetap kimnateennyi; ak koek surkwen tuloonoogap Israel, kot koma kobunei chii.
Yeityo konai icheek kole aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ye kaayai emet koguber ak koek ne kikwong'ee, amu tuguukwak tugul che kiwechei che ki koyai.

Ee, inyee weeriitap chii, ng'alaali agobo inyee lagogap piiguk eng' ole neegitee irimoik, ak eng' kurgotigap kooriik, ak kong'alaaljin `age age, ng'alaaljin chii tugul tupchennyi, koleenjin, Asoomin ale, nyoo keebe kegas ng'olyoot ne punu Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.

Ak kobwonjin ko uu ye pwoonei piik, ak kotep ng'wony eng' taing'ung' ko uu piikyuk, ak kogas icheek ng'aleeguk, ago ma yaei: amu iboortoi chamyet ne oo eng' ng'aleekwak, ago isubi mugulelwekwak kelunennywa.
Keer anyuno, iuu eng' icheek tyendo ne karaaran miising', ne tinyei cheet ne anyiny, ne putindet: amu kasei icheek ng'aleeguk, ago ma yaei.
Ak ye piit kioto, (keero, nyoonei,) konai anyun kole kimi maotyot kwenunnywa.
Ki nyoonjo ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor koleenjo,

Ee, weeriitap chii, maoten agobo mestowegap Israel, maoten, ak ileenji mestowechooto, Mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Pwo! Mestowegap Israel che paegei amitwogik icheegei! Tos ma nyooljin mestoweek kobai keechiirek?
Oame che akwaen, ak olaachi koroorigap keechiirek, oenye che akwaen; ago mobae keechiirek.
Ma ogimiit che nyalulyotin, ama onyaa che myandos, ama orop ne kigoil, ama oweech kogeny ne kigeon, ama ocheeng' ne ki kobet: ago ki obou eng' kimnateet ak eng' koroomnateet.
Kiyesta amu ki ma komi mestowot: ak ki ek amitwogigap tugul che po timiin, ak kiyesta.
Ki ombenioti keechiirekyuk eng' tuloonook tugul, ak eng' tulweet age tugul ne kooi: ee, kiyesta keechiirekyuk koyom ng'wony tugul; ak ki ma komi chii ne ki cheeng'at anan kosubot icheek.
Ogas anyun ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, okweek mestoweek;

Ko uu ye asabe, mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, amu iman ko uu ye kigeluul keechiirekyuk, ak koek keechiirekyuk amitwogigap tyong'ik tugul che po timiin, amu ki ma komi mestowot, ama cheeng'at mestowekyuk keechiirekyuk, ago kibaegei mestoweek amitwogik icheegei, ama pai keechiirekyuk;
ogas anyun ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, okweek mestoweek;

Mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Ogeero, aborye mestoweek; ak amage eunekwak keechiirekyuk, ak aeete icheek kobai keechiirek; ama kobaegei mestoweek amitwogik kogeny; ak asaru keechiirekyuk eng' kutusweekwak, si ma ek amitwogikwak.
Amu mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Ogeero, anee, aneendet ne acheeng'oti keechiirekyuk, ak asuboti icheek.

Ko uu ye cheeng'ei mestowot akweennyi eng' peetuut ne mi kwenutap keechiirekyik che ki kiiyesta, acheeng'e ko uu nooto keechiirekyuk; ak asaru icheek komong' eng' komoswek tugul ole kiga kiyestoochi eng' peetuutap poolik ak tulugenet ne imen.

Ak amutu komong' eng' pororyosyek, ak ayumu eng' emotinwek, ak amutu kobwa emennywa; ak abai icheek eng' tuloonoogap Israel, eng' ole neegitee kereruusyek, ak eng' komoswek tugul che ki menyei eng' emonooto.
Ayage icheek ole mi susweek che myach, ak kotebee piunywa tuloonoogap komoswek che torooreen che po Israel: ruitos eng' olooto eng' piut ne myee, ak koagete ole pitat eng' tuloonoogap Israel.
Anee ne abae keechiirekyuk, ak agoochi koruiyo, mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Acheeng'e ne ki pet, ak amutu kogeny ne ki kioon, ak arop ne ki il, ak agimiit ne kimyani: ak abar ne neraat kobooto ne kiim: abae icheek kirwooget.
Ago ee okweek, akweennyu, mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Ogeero, arwookyini artet eng' artet, kobooto mengichik ak kwesik.
Tos kiit ne ming'in eng' okweek obaegei tuguuk che myach, yeityo otyekyi ng'wony che ki ng'at eng' ole oagete? Ak oee peek che tiliileen, yeityo oturur eng' keelyekwok che kang'et?
Ago amei keechiirekyuk che ki otyech, ak koe che ki oturur eng' keelyekwok.
Mwachin anyun Kiptaiyat `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor icheek ko uu ni koleenji: Ogeero, arwookyini aneendet artet ne neraat eng' artet ne sagitat.
Amu ki otoortaisye karaaswekwok ak tigigoikwok, ak otoore kuinoikwok tugul che ki myandos, kot oseer koba oldo tugul;
asaru anyun keechiirekyuk, ma koegu che kiluulei kogeny; ak arwookyi artet eng' artet.
Ak ande mestowot agenge koyaga icheek, ak kobai icheek, nooto ko otwogindennyu Daudi; paei ineendet icheek, ak koek mestowonnywa.
Ak aegu anee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindennywa, ak koek Daudi otwogindennyu, pounindet eng' kwenunnywa; kamwae anee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ng'olyoondoniito.
Ak kiyomiskei ak icheek eng' kayomiset ne po kaalyeet, ak ageesu tyong'ik che yaach eng' emet: ak komeny surkwen eng' chametapkei, ak koruiyo osnosyek.
Ak ayai icheek koek kaberuret kobooto komoswek ole neegitee tulweennyu; ak ang'at ropta koroobon eng' peetuusyekyik; ak kobiit roptap kaberuret.

Ak kooi logoek keetitap mbar, ak korur emet, ak kotebee chametapkei eng' emennywa; ak konai kole aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ye tuun airii keetiigap choginnywa, ko kaasaru icheek komong' eng' eutap piik che ki yai icheek koek otwogikwak.
Ama koegu kogeny che luulei pororyosyek, ama koamei tyony ne po ng'wony icheek; ago meng'iisyei eng' chametapkei, ama kobiitu chii ne imui.
Ak achopchi icheek mbareet ne tagunoot, ama kobarei rubeet icheek eng' emet, ama koiboti kalilanet ne punu pororyosyek.
Si konai kole ami anee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindennywa kobooto icheek, ak konai icheek kole kootap Israel ko piikyuk, mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ak okweek, keechiirekyuk, che oo keechiiregap akweennyu, ko oo piik, ak aa Kamuktaindeng'wong', mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ki nyoonjo kogeny ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor koleenjo,
Ee, weeriitap chii, tokyi togeng'ung' tulweetap Seir, ak imaotenji,
ileenji, mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Keero, aboryenen, ee tulweetap Seir, ak atokyinin eunnyu, ak ayain iguber ak iegu ne kikwong'ee.
Abute nganasoguk, ak iegu karaatya; si inai ile aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Amu itinye puunyoondit ne po kotugul, ak ki igoite piigap Israel kebar eng' kimnateetap rotwetap chok eng' peetuutap nyalildanywa, eng' peetuusyegap yaityet ne po let:
mwaei anyun Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole, ko uu ye asabe, achopchinin korotiik, ak kosubun korotiik: amu ma iwech korotiik, kosubin anyun korotiik.
Ayae anyun ko uu nooto tulweetap Seir koek ne kikwong'ee ak koguber; ak ageesu ineendet ne punei tulwoonooto, ak ineendet ne weegegei yooto.
Ak anyiit tuloonookyik piikyik che kigebar: ak kobutyo icheek che kigebar eng' rotwetap chok eng' tuloonooguk ak eng' atebwosyeguk ak eng' kererusyeguk.
Ayain iguber agoi, ama kemenyei nganasoguk: si onai ole aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Amu ki imwa ile, Egu chechuuk pororyosyechu aeng'u ak emotinwechu aeng' ak kenam kobunjech; ago ki mi Kamuktaindet ne Toroor olooto:
mwaei anyun Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole, ko uu ye asabe, ayae ko uu nereegeguk, ak ko uu ng'etkondang'ung' ne ki ibooru iweche icheek; ak aboorugei eng' kwenunnywa, ye tuun arwoogun.
Ak inai ile anee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne ki agas chubisyosyeguk tugul che ki imwa agobo tuloonoogap Israel, ile, Kigeyai koguber, kigegoonech keam.
Ak ki ochounenage eng' kutusweekwok, ak ki otes ng'aleekwok agobo anee: ki agas ng'olyoondonooto.
Mwaei anyun Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Ye tuun paibait ng'wony komugul, ayain iguber.
Ko uu ye ki ibaibaitune poroteetap kootap Israel, amu kiguber, ayaun ko uu nooto: iguberi, ee, inyee tulweetap Seir, ak Edom komugul, komosato tugul; si konai icheek kole aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ee inyee, weeriitap chii, maotenji tuloonoogap Israel, ileenji ogas ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, okweek tuloonoogap Israel.
Mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Amu ki komwa puunyoot agobo okweek, kole, haa! Ak kole kagobunjech komoswek che torooreen che po keny:

maoten anyun, ile, Mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Amu nganda ki koyaak icheek oegu ponoon, ak koluguak eng' komosta age tugul, si kobiit obunji pororyosyek che ng'etunotiin, ak kigochaamatak piik, ak komwaetaenak tuguuk che yaach:

ogas anyun ng'olyootap Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, okweek tuloonoogap Israel; Mwachin Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor tuloonook che eecheen ak che mengeechen, kobooto kereruusyek, ak atebwosyek ak komoswek che karatwek ak nganasook che kigemeto, che ki koek luulenik ak che rorechin pororyosyek che ng'etunotiin eng' komoswek tugul:

mwaei anyun Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Ki amwa iman eng' maatap ng'etkondanyu agobo pororyosyek che ng'etunotiin, ak agobo Edom tugul, che kiityigei emennyu kole kobunji eng' poiboiyetap mugulelwekwak tugul, eng' koroomnatetap saboondo, si kogoito keluul:

maoten anyun agobo emetap Israel, ak ileenji tuloonook che eecheen ak che mengeechen, kobooto kereruusyek, ak atebwosyek, ileenji, mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Ogeero, ki amwa eng' ng'etkondanyu ak nereegekyuk che ng'woneen, amu ki ogesen kalilanetap pororyosyek.
Mwaei anyun Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Ki achuul eunnyu, amwa ale, Ibei kalilanennywa pororyosyek che mi komoswekwok.
Ago ing'atos mooriikwok, ee okweek tuloonoogap Israel; ak oiichi logoekwok piikyuk Israel; amu neegit kobwa.
Amu, ogeero, ami komostang'wong', ak aweekyoge, si kibatak, kegolak:
ak ateswok piik, koot komugul ne po Israel, koot tugul: ak kemeny nganasook, ak keteech karatwek:
ak ateswok piik ak tyong'ik; ak kotesak ak koiiyo: ak kemenyok ko uu peetuusyekwok che po tai, ak ayaiywok ne myee kosiir eng' tai: si onai ole aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ee, agoochini piik kobendatenak, chooto piikyuk Israel; ak konamin icheek ibunji ak iegu porotennywa, ama ibare lagokwak kogeny.
Mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Amu mwaiwok koleenjinok, ii amindetap piik, inyee emoni, ak ki iegu ne ibare pororyeng'ung';
ma iame anyun piik kogeny, ama ibare pororyeng'ung' kogeny, mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor;
ama achamun igas kogeny kalilanetap pororyosyek, ama igeseni teweernatetap pororyosyek kogeny, ama inach pororyeng'ung' kogeny, mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ki nyoonjo kogeny ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, koleenjo,

Ee, weeriitap chii, ye ki menyei kootap Israel emennywa, ko ki ing'wanit emonooto eng' ortinwekwak ak eng' poisyonikwak: ki uu ortinwekwak eng' tainnyu simwegap kwondo eng' peetuusyekyik che po arawet.
Ki aroong'ji anyun nereegekyuk che ng'woneen amu korotiik che kiga kotumji emet, ak kiga kong'wanit emonooto eng' kanamonikwak:
ak ki aseerchi icheek pororyosyek, ak ki kiyestoochi emotinwek: ki arwookyi icheek ko uu ortinwekwak ak ko uu poisyonikwak.
Ak kingo it ye mi pororyosyek ole ki pa, ko ki imurwon kainennyu ne tiliil; amu ki mwa piik agobo icheek kole pichu ko piigap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ak ki koba eng' emennyi.
Ago ki ariiree kainennyu ne tiliil, ne ki komurwon kootap Israel eng' pororyosyek, ole ki pa.

Mwachi anyun kootap Israel ileenji, mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Ma yae niito agobo okweek ee kootap Israel, ago ayae agobo kainennyu ne tiliil, ne ki omurwon eng' pororyosyek che ki obe.

Ak atabaan kainennyu ne oo ne ki kimurwon eng' kwenunnywa; si konai pororyosyek kole aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ye aegu ne kitabaanat eng' okweek eng' tainnywa.
Amu amutwok omang'une pororyosyek, ak ayumak omong'u eng' emotinwek tugul, ak amutwak obwa emeng'wong'.
Ak abisenok peek che tiliileen, si otiliiliitu: ak aundawok simdang'wong' tugul, ak kanamonikwok tugul.
Agoonok kogeny muguleldo ne leel, ak andeok sabeet ne leel: ak aiste muguleldo ne uu koita eng' poorwekwok, ak agoonok muguleldo ne po panyeek.
Ak andeok Kabuusennyu, ak agoonok obendate ng'atuutikyuk, ak oriip kirwoogutikyuk ak oyai.
Ak omeny emet ne ki agoochi kwanisyekwok; ak oegu piikyuk, ak aegu Kamuktaindeng'wong'.
Ak asarwok eng' simwekwok tugul: ak aguur peek si ates, ama agoonok rubeet kogeny.
Ak ates iyoteetap logoek, ak ruroteetap mbareet, si mata kochotak pororyosyek amu rubeet.
Yeityo obwaat anyun ortinwekwok che yaach, ak poisyonikwok che ki ma ko myachen; ak osaske okweegei eng' taing'wong' amu tengekwogikwok ak amu tuguukwok che kiwechei.
Ma yae niito amu okweek, mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ingonaak ng'olyoondoni eng' okweek: olilanse, ak otoptobense amu ortinwekwok, ee kootap Israel.
Mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Agoochini kemeny nganasook kogeny, ak keteech karatwek, eng' peetuut ne aundawok tengekwogikwok tugul.
Ak kibat emet ne kiga koguber agot nganda kiga koguber kogeerei tugul che kisiirtoi.
Ak tuun mwaei kole, kaigei emoni kiga koguber, mbareetap Eden; ak kageng'ot ak kemeny nganasook che kiga koek karatwek, ak koguber, ak kong'emak.

Konai anyun pororyosyek che ng'etunotiin eng' komoswekwok, kole, koateeche anee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor komoswechuuto kiga kobutok, ak agool ole kiga koguber: kamwae anee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ak ayae.
Mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Teepsena anyun kootap Israel agobo niito, si kobiit ayachi; atesyini icheek piik kochang'a ko uu akweetap keechiirek.

Ko uu akweetap keechiirek che egu tiseiywek, ko uu akweetap keechiiregap Jerusalem eng' peetuusyekyik che po igoorwek che ki king'at; kinyiiti ko uu nooto nganasook che kiga koek karatwek eng' tuiyosyegap piik: si konai icheek kole aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ki mi paragunnyu eutap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ak ki imuta eng' Kabuusetap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ak kotua eng' kwenutap atebweet; ak ki nyiitaat kawek;
ak ki indoiywa abun komoswek tugul che po kawechooto: ak ogeero, kimi kawek che chaang' atebwonooto; ak ogeero, kiyamyotiin miising':
ak ki leenjo, Ee, weeriitap chii, tos, imuuchi kosapcho kowechu? Ak ki awolu ale, Ee Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ingen inyee.
Ak ki leenjo kogeny, Maotenji kowechu, ak ileenji, Ee, okweek kowechu yamyotiin, ogas ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Mwachin anyun Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kowechu koleenjin: Ogeero, andeok kabuuset, si osapche.
Andeok inoik ak alaakwok panyeek ak atugenok iriryot, yeityo andeok kabuuset, si osapche; si onai ole aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ki amaoten anyun ko uu ye ki king'ata: ak ye kita amaoteni, kobiit cheet, ak ogeero, ki piit kirgirenet, ak kinamatkei kawek, ak ki namgei kowet ak kowennyi.
Ak ki ageer, ak ogeero, kiga konam inoik kawechooto, ak ki piit panyeek, ak kotuch iriryot panyechooto: ago ki ma komi kabuuset.

Koleenjo anyun, Maotenji usoonet, maoten, ee, weeriitap chii, ak ileenji usoonet, Mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Nyoo eng' usoonaik ang'wan, ee kabuuset, ak ibuusyi chu kigebar, si kobiit kosapcho.
Ki amaoten anyun ko uu ye king'ata ineendet, ak ki nyoonji icheek kabuuset, ak kisopcho, ak kotononso eng' keelyekwak, lugeet ne oo miising'.
Yeityo, komwaiwo koleenjo, Ee, weeriitap chii, kowechu ko kootap Israel komugul: keero, leen icheek, Ki koyaamyo kawekyok, ak ki kobet kamang'unennyo; ki kigeswech.
Maoten anyun, ak ileenji icheek, Mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Ogeero, ayaate kereeriisyekwok, ak among'wok eng' kereeriisyekwok, ee piikyuk; ak amutwok obwa emetap Israel.
Ak onai ole aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, ye kaayat kereeriisyekwok, ak among'wok eng' kereeriisyekwok, ee piikyuk.
Ak andeok Kabuusennyu, si osapche, ak andeok emeng'wong' si kobiit onai ole anee Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne kamwae ng'olyoondoniito, ak ayai, mwaei Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ki nyoonjo kogeny ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, koleenjo,

Ee, weeriitap chii, nam kirokto agenge, ak isir ile, Po Judah, ak ko po piigap Israel che mi tugul ak ineendet: yeityo inam kirokto age, ak isir ile, Po Joseph, kirokto ne po Ephraim, ak ne po koot komugul ne po Israel kobooto che mi tugul ak ineendet:
ak ituiyechigei kirokwechooto tuwai koek kirokto agenge, si kobiit koek agenge eng' eung'ung'.
Ak ye tuun teebenen lagogap piiguk koleenjin, Tos meboorwech kiit ne ibooru inyee eng' ng'aleechuuto?

Ileenji, Mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Ogeero, aname kirokto ne po Joseph, ne mi eutap Ephraim, kobooto ortinwegap Israel che mi tugul ak ineendet; ak atuiye icheek kobooto kirokto ne po Judah, ak ayae koek kirokto agenge, si koek agenge eng' eunnyu.
Ak kotebee eung'ung' eng' tainnywa kirokweek che kesirei.

Ak ileenji icheek, Mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Ogeero, amutu piigap Israel komong' eng' pororyosyek, ole ki koba, ak ayum icheek eng' komosta agenge tugul, ak amutu icheek kobwa emennywa.

Ak ayai icheek koek pororyet agenge eng' emet, eng' tuloonoogap Israel: ak koek laitoryat agenge laitoryannywa eng' icheek tugul: ak ma koegu kogeny pororyosyek aeng', ama kepchei icheek kogeny koek pounatosyek aeng' agoi.

Ama kong'wanitegei kanamonikwak kogeny, anan eng' tuguukwak che samis, anan agot agenge eng' pistaosyekwak: ago asaru icheek eng' oldinwekwak tugul che menyei: ole kiyae tengekto, ak atiliil icheek: egu anyun piikyuk, ak aegu Kamuktaindennywa.
Ak koek otwogindennyu Daudi laitoryannywa; ak konyoor icheek tugul mestowot agenge: ak kobendatee kirwoogutikyuk ak koriip ng'atuutikyuk ak koyai.

Ak komeny emet ne ki agoochi Jakobo otwogindennyu, ole ki menyei kwanisyekwok; ak komeny olooto icheeget, kobooto lagokwak, ak lagogap lagokwak, agoi koigeny: ak koek Daudi otwogindennyu, pounindennywa koigeny.
Ak kiyomiske ak icheek kogeny eng' kayomiset ne po kaalyeet: egu eng' icheek kayomiset ne wendi agoi koigeny: ak alumde icheek, ak ates, ande oldanyu ne tiliil kwenunnywa agoi koigeny.
Tebyei agine emainnyu kobooto icheek; ak aegu Kamuktaindennywa, ak koek icheek piikyuk.
Ak konai pororyosyek kole aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor ne atabaani Israel, ye tuun tebee oldanyu ne tiliil kwenunnywa koigeny.
Ak ki nyoonjo ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, koleenjo,
Ee, weeriitap chii, tokyi togeng'ung' Gog, ne po emetap Magog, pounindetap Rosh, Meshek, ak Tubal, ak imaoten agobo ineendet,
ileenji, mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Keero, aboryenen, ee Gog, pouinindetap Rosh, Meshek, ak Tubal;

awelelin, ak ande kombook tagilgiliguk, ak amutun kobooto lugeeng'ung' tugul, paraisisyek ak piik che ketei paraisisyek, kolaachi tugul kariik tugul che po lugeet, lugeet ne oo ne tinyei long'onik che eecheen ak che mengeechen, kotinyei tugul rotoogap chok:
mi kobooto icheek Persia, Kush, ak Put; kotinyei tugul long'onik ak chepkuloik che po kariik:
kobooto Gomer ak lugosyekyik tugul; kobooto kootap Togarmah eng' tabanwek che looen che po murot kaataam, ak lugosyekyik tugul: pororyosyek che chaang' che mi kobooten.
Choboge, ee chopkei, inyee kobooto lugosyeguk tugul che kaiyumjingei, ak iegu kandoindennywa.

Kibwonjinin ko kagosiirto peetuusyek che chaang': iite eng' kenyiisyek che po let emet ne ki kiweegune rotwetap chok, ne ki kiweech eng' pororyosyek che chaang', eng' tuloonoogap Israel, ne kiga koguber peetuusyek che chaang': ago ki kiweech komong' eng' pororyosyek ak komeng'iis tugul eng' chametapkei.
Ak itogosu, inyee ko uu usoonet, iige pooldet ne tuchei emet, inyee kobooto lugosyeguk tugul, komi pororyosyek che chaang' kobooten.
Mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Pwonjinin kabwaatutik eng' peetuunooto, ak ibwaat chobutyet ne ya:

ak imwa ile, Atogostoi emetap nganasook che ma tinyei irimoik; awendi ole mi icheek che mi eng' kaalyeet, che meng'iisyei eng' chametapkei, meng'iisyei icheek tugul ama tinyei irimoik, ama tinyei temeleiywek anan ormariichok:

si kobiit aluul ak aip parunenik; si kobiit ibar komoswek che ki karatwek che ki menyei nguno, ak obargei ak piik che ki kiyum komang'une pororyosyek, che tinyei tuuga ak tuguuk, che menyei emet kween.

Teebenen Sheba, ak Dedan, ak chemung'arainigap Tarsis, kobooto ng'etunikyik tugul che neranik, koleenjinin, Tos kenyo iluul? Tos kaiyum lugosyeguk si kobiit iip parunenik? Si kobiit iip fedha ak thahabu, ak ikweri tuuga ak iip tuguuk, iluul luuleet ne oo?
Maoten anyun, ee, weeriitap chii, ak ileenji Gog, Mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Eng' peetuut ye tuun kameng'iis piikyuk Israel eng' chametapkei, ko tos menae?
Ak inyoo eng' oldang'ung' eng' tabanwek che looen che po murot kaataam, komi pororyosyek che chaang' kobooten, kolaanyei tugul paraisisyek, piik che chaang', ak ko lugeet ne kiim:

ak obwa obargei ak piikyuk Israel, ko uu pooldet ne tuchei emet; amutun eng' peetuusyek che po let obwa obargei ak emennyu, si kobiit konaa pororyosyek, ye tuun aegu ne itabaanat eng' inyee, ee Gog, eng' tainnywa.

Mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Tos inyee ne ki amwaite keny eng' otwogikyuk maotigap Israel, che ki maoteni eng' peetuusyechooto eng' kenyiisyek che chaang' kole tuun amutun inyoo obargei ak icheek?
Mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole, ye tuun paregei Gog ak emetap Israel, eng' peetuusyechooto, kobiit nereegekyuk che ng'woneen che mang'une seruunekyuk.
Amu kaamwa eng' ng'etkondanyu ak eng' maatap nereegekyuk, ale, Piitu iman potanet ne oo eng' peetuunooto eng' emetap Israel;

kot kobotanso eng' tainnyi njireenigap nyanjet, ak toriitik che po parak, ak tyong'igap timiin, ak tuguuk tugul che ichuutegei ng'wony, kobooto piik tugul che miitei ng'wony, ak kiluul tuloonook, ak kong'isyogen ole keigei, ak koluul irimeet age tugul.
Ak aguur rotwetap chok kobargei ak ineendet agoi tuloonookyuk tugul, mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor: paregei chii tugul ak tupchennyi.

Agere kong' ineendet eng' koroito ak korotiik; ak ayookyi ineendet kobooto lugosyekyik, ak piikyik che chaang' che mi kobooto ineendet, ropta ne oo ak koik che eecheen che po ropta, maat ak tuguuk che laldos.
Ak atoroorge, ak atabaangei, ak abartegei eng' taitap pororyosyek che chaang'; si konai icheek kole aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ee, inyee weeriitap chii, maoten agobo Gog, ak ileenji, mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Keero, aboryenen inyee, ee Gog, pounindetap Rosh, Meshek, ak Tubal:
ak awelelin, ak areun, ak amutun itogosu eng' tabanwek che looen che po murot kaataam; ak amutun inyoo tuloonoogap Israel:
ak akwer kwangeng'ung' ne mi eung'ung' ne po kaataam, kobut, ak agoochi kobutyo kipchaboniguk, eng' eung'ung' ne po tai.
Ibutyini tuloonoogap Israel, inyee ak lugosyeguk tugul, kobooto pororyosyek che mi kobooten: ak agoochin toriitik alak tugul che amei panyeek, kobooto tyong'igap timiin, koamin.
Imeechini kewanin: amu kaamwa ng'olyoondoniito, mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ak ayookyi maat Magog, kobooto icheeget che meng'iisyei eng' chametapkei eng' ngeguusyek: si konai icheek kole aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ak abarte kainennyu ne tiliil eng' piikyuk Israel; ama achamdoi kainennyu ne tiliil king'wanit kogeny: si konai pororyosyek kole aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor, Ineendet ne Tiliil eng' Israel.
Keero, nyoonei, ak kiyaei ko uu nooto, mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor; niito peetuut ne ki amwae.

Ak komanda icheek che menyei nganasoogap Israel, ak kolaale maat kariigap lugeet ak kobeel tuguuchooto, long'onik, ak long'onik che eecheen, kwangok, kipchabonik, ndirisyek, ak ng'otwek, ak kobeel karichooto eng' kenyiisyek tisap;

kot koma kobutei icheek kweenik anan koluul keet age tugul eng' osnosyek, amu tuun ilaale maat kariigap lugeet; ak koluul tuguugap piik che kiga koluulei icheek, ak korebe tuguuk piik che kiga korebe icheek, mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.

Ak agoochini eng' peetuunooto Gog komosta ne kitupchin eng' Israel, atebweetap icheek che punei komostap kong'asiis ne po nyanjet: ak koger icheek che punei yooto: ak kotupchi olooto Gog ak piikyik che chaang' tugul: ak koguure yooto atebweetap Hamon-gog.
Ak kotup kootap Israel icheek arawek tisap, si kobiit kotiliil emet.
Ee, tubei piik tugul che po emet icheek; ak koek kiit ne tagunoot eng' icheek, eng' peetuut ne tuun kitoroora, mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ak kotabaan piik kobunoot emet peetuusyek tugul, ak kotubot che kiga ng'et eng' emet, si kotiliil emet: cheeng'oti ye kagogeskei arawechooto tisabu.
Ak ye punooti icheeget emet, ak kogeer chii age tugul kowa ne po chii, konde anyun kaboorunet yooto, agoi kotup piik che tubisyei eng' atebweetap Hamon-gog.
Ak koek kogeny Hamona kainetap nganaseet. Ianyinyi emet ko uu nooto.

Ee, weeriitap chii, mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Mwachi toriitik alak tugul, ak tyony age tugul ne po timiin, ileenji oyumgei ak obwa; oyumgei eng' komosta age tugul si obwonji eng'sennyu ne aeng'wok, eng'seet ne oo eng' tuloonoogap Israel, si kobiit oam panyeek ak oee korotiik.
Oam panyeegap che kiimeen, ak oee korotiigap pounigap ng'wony, che po mengichik, ak che po aaregap keechiir, ak che po ng'oroorek, ak che po kiruugik, tugul che akwaen che po Bashan.
Ak koam mwanik kot obiyong'se, ak oee korotiik kot kobogitye, che po eng'sennyu ne kaaeng'wok.
Ak obiyong'dosi eng' mesennyu eng' paraisisyek ak kariisyek che po lugeet, eng' piik che nyigoonen, kobooto piik tugul che po lugeet, mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.
Ak ande toroornatennyu kwenutap pororyosyek ak kogeer pororyosyek tugul kirwoogennyu ne kaayai, ak eunnyu ne ki agonoor icheek.
Konai anyun kootap Israel kole aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindennywa, kobooch peetuunooto ak kwo tai.
Ak konai pororyosyek kole ki kiluul kootap Israel amu tengektonywa; amu ki ingelelja, ak ki aung'e icheek togeennyu: ki ande anyun icheek eutap puunikwak, ak kobek icheek tugul eng' rotwetap chok.
Ki ayachi icheek ko uu murwoonindanywa ak ko uu pistaosyekwak; ak ki aung'e icheek togeennyu.
Mwaei anyun Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor kole: Amutu kogeny che ki kiluul che po Jakobo, ak ariiree koot komugul ne po Israel; ak koama ng'etkong' agobo kainennyu ne tiliil.
Ak kogesen kalilanennywa, kobooto pistaosyekwak tugul che ki yaiywo, ye tuun meny emennywa eng' chametapkei, ama piitu chii ne imui icheek;
ye tuun kaamutu icheek kogeny komong' eng' pororyosyek, ak ayumu icheek komong' eng' emotinwegap puunikwak, ak kitabaana eng' taitap pororyosyek che chaang'.
Ak konai icheek kole aa Kamuktaindet ne Toroor Kamuktaindennywa, amu ki agoite icheek keluul koba pororyosyek, ak koayumji icheek emennywa: ama abagakyini agot agenge olooto kogeny;
ama aung'e icheek togeennyu kogeny; amu kaaroong'ji Kabuusennyu kootap Israel, mwaei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor.

Ki mi paragunnyu eutap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' kenyiitap tiptem ak muut, kobooch ngap keluulech, eng' taunetap kenyiit, eng' peetuutap taman ne po arawet, eng' kenyiitap taman ak ang'wan kobooch ngap kebar nganaseet ak komutwaa anyo olooto eng' peetuunooto.
Ki imutwaa eng' ng'ang'utigap Kamuktaindet anyo emetap Israel ak kondea tulweet ne kooi miising', ole kimi itoondap teekseetap nganaseet eng' murot tai.
Ak ki imutwaa anyo yooto, ak ogeero, kimi yooto chii, ne ki uu itoondanyi itoondap sugunwet kotinyei porowetap katanit eng' eunnyi, ak tegat ne kikwaise; ak kitonone ormariichet.

Ak ki leenjo chiichooto, Ee, weeriitap chii, keer eng' konyeguk, ak igas eng' itiiguk, ak inde muguleldang'ung' tuguuk tugul che ta aboorun; amu kagimutun inyoo olito si kobiit aboorun tuguuchuuto: tetyi kootap Yahudik tuguuk tugul che igeere.

Ak ogeero, kimi inaatut ne kiyiem koot, ak kimi eutap chiichooto tegat ne kikwaise ne po mitainik lo che po euut eng' koindo, kakwautyet age tugul eng' chooto lo, ko kitesat tebeesindo agenge ne po euut: ki ikwa anyun tebeesindap inaatut, koek tegat agenge; ak ki ek kooindap tononennyi tegat agenge.
Ki it anyun ormariichet ne tokyingei kong'asiis, ak kolaany kobun lang'eiywot, ak ki ikwa seremut ne po ormariichet, ki ek tegat agenge tebeesindo: ak ki ek seremunooto tegat agenge tebeesindo.

Ak ki ek kooindap koot age tugul ne po oriit tegat agenge, ak ki tegat agenge tebeesindo; ak ki mitainik muut che po euut kobooch koot age agoi koot age; ak kitegat agenge seremut ne po oriit ne po ormariichet ne ki mi ole kibunei kebendi keterut ne po ormariichet ne tokyingei koot.
Ki ikwa kogeny keterut ne po ormariichet ne tokyingei koot, koek tegat agenge.
Yeityo kokwa keterut ne po ormariichet koek mitainik sisiit che po euut; ak ki ek tugatugikyik mitainik aeng' che po euut; ak kitokyingei keterut ne po ormariichet koot.
Ak ki somok kooriik che ki mi komosi ak komosin che po ormariichet ne kitokyingei kong'asiis; ki aechin tugul ko somok: ak ki aechin tugatugigap komosi ak komosin.
Ak ki ikwa tebeesindap ole kibunei eng' ormariichet, ki mitainik taman che po euut; ak ki ek kooindap ormariichet mitainik taman ak somok che po euut;

ak kimi tegeleiywot taitap koorichooto po oriit, ne po kakwautyet agenge ne po euut eng' komosi, ak tegeleiywot age ne po kakwautyet agenge ne po euut eng' komosin; ak ki mitainik lo che po euut koorichooto po oriit eng' komosi ak komosin.
Ak ki ikwa ormariichet kobooch koot parak ne po koot age agoi koot parak ne po koot age, ki ek tebeesindo mitainik tiptem ak muut che po euut; kong'etee kurgeet age agoi kurgeet age.
Ki ikwa keterut, ak ki ek mitainik tiptem che po euut; kibunei keterut kemong'jin seremut ne oo.
Ki ek mitainik konom che po euut kobooch taitap ormariichet ne kibunei kebendi oriit agoi taitap keterut ne po oriit ne po ormariichet.

Ak ki tinyei koorichooto po oriit tirisyok che regerotiin, kobooto tugatugikwak che ki mi ormariichanooto komosta age tugul, ak ki uu nooto eng' keterut: ak ki mi tirisyok komoswek tugul ole po oriit: ak ki mi itoonwegap tiironigap sosik eng' tugatukyet age tugul.

Ki kimutwaa anyun anyo seremut ne ki mong'jin, ak ogeero, kimitoti kooriik che po oriit, ak ole ki kibunoti ole ki kimale koik, che ki kiyai koyiem seremut: ki mi kooriik sosomu olooto ki kimale koik.
Ki mi komoswek che ki kimal ole neegitee ormariichok, che aechin ak kooindap ormariichok, chooto komoswek che tabanu ng'wony.
Yeityo kokwa tebeesindo kobooch ormariichet ne tabanu ng'wony, agoi taitap seremut ne po oriit ole po saang', ki ek mitainik pogol che po euut eng' komostap kong'asiis ak eng' murot kaataam.
Ak ki ikwa koindo ak tebeesindo ne po ormariichetap seremut ne ki mong'jin ne tokyingei murot kaataam.

Ak kimi kooriikyik somogu che po oriit komosi ak komosin; ki aechin kakwautigap tugatugikyik kobooto che po keterunnyi, ak che po ormariichet ni kabo tai; ki kakwautik konom che po euut koindonywa ak kakwautik tiptem ak muut tebeesindo.

Ak ki aechin kakwautigap tirisyokyik, ak che po keterunnyi, kobooto che po itoonwekyik che po tiironigap sosik, ak che po ormariichet ne tokyingei kong'asiis; ak kitogostae lang'eiywot ne tinyei tuguuk tisap che kityegoti; ak kimi tainnywa keterunnyi.

Ak kimi ormariichet ne kebunei kebendi seremut ne po oriit ne kitokyingei ormariichet ne po murot kaataam ak kimi ormariichet ne kitokyingei ormariichet ne po kong'asiis; ak ki ikwa kong'etee ormariichet age agoi ormariichet age, koek mitainik pogol che po euut.
Ak ki imuta atokyigei murot tai, ak ogeero, kimi ormariichet ne tokyingei murot tai: ak ki ikwa tugatugikyik ak keterunnyi kogergeit ak mitainik chu kabo tai.
Ak ki tinyei tirisyok ormariichanooto kobooto keterunnyi eng' komoswek tugul che uu tirisyochu kabo tai: ki mitainik konom che po euut koindo, ak ki mitainik tiptem ak muut che po euut tebeesindo.
Ak kimi lang'eiywot ne tinyei tuguuk tisap che kityegoti, ketogostoi, ak kimi keterut tainnywa: ak ki tinyei tugatugikyik itoonwegap tiironigap sosik komosi ak komosin.
Ak kimi ormariichet ne kebunei kebendi seremut ne po oriit ne tokyingei murot tai: ak ki ikwa kong'etee ormariichet age agoi ormariichet age kotokyigei murot tai, koek mitainik pogol che po euut.
Ki imutwaa anyun agoi seremut ne po oriit abune ormariichet ne po murot tai: ak ki ikwa ormariichet ne po murot tai ko uu mitainik chu kabo tai;

kobooto kooriikyik che po oriit, ak tugatugikyik, ak keterunnyi, ko uu mitainik chu kabo tai: ak ki tinyei tirisyok ormariichanooto kobooto keterunnyi eng' komoswek tugul: ki mitainik konom che po euut koindo, ak ki mitainik tiptem ak muut tebeesindo.
Ak kimi keterut komoswek tugul, ne ki mitainik tiptem ak muut che po euut koindo, ak ki mitainik muut che po euut tebeesindo.
Ak kitokyingei keterunnyi seremut ne po saang'; ak kimi itoonwegap tiironigap sosik tugatugikyik: ak ki tinyei lang'eiywot tuguuk sisiit che kityegoti ketogostoi.
Ak ki imutwaa anyo seremut ne po oriit ne tokyingei kong'asiis: ak ki ikwa ormariichet ko uu mitainik chu kabo tai;

kobooto kooriikyik che po oriit, ak tugatugikyik, ak keterunnyi, ko uu mitainik chu kabo tai: ak ki tinyei tirisyok keterunnyi eng' komoswek tugul; ki mitainik konom che po euut koindo, ak ki mitainik tiptem ak muut che po euut tebeesindo.
Ak kitokyingei keterunnyi seremut ne sip kemong'jin; ak kimi itoonwegap tiironigap sosik tugatugikyik eng' komosi ak komosin: ak ki tinyei lang'eiywot tuguuk sisiit che kityegoti ketogostoi.
Ak ki imutwaa anyo ormariichet ne po murot kaataam: ak ki ikwa ko uu mitainik chu kabo tai;
kobooto kooriikyik che po oriit, ak tugatugikyik, ak keterunnyi; ak ki tinyei tirisyok eng' komoswek tugul: ki mitainik konom che po euut koindo ak ki mitainik tiptem ak muut che po euut tebeesindo.
Ak kitokyingei tugatugikyik seremut ne sip kemong'jin; ak ki tinyei tugatugichooto itoonwegap tiironigap sosik eng' komosi ak komosin, ak ki tinyei lang'eiywot tuguuk sisiit che kityegoti ketogostoi.
Ak kimi koot ne po oriit kobooto kurgennyi ye neegitee tugatugigap ormariichok; ki kiuune yooto kagoochinet ne kibeelei.
Ak kimi ye neegitee keterutap ormariichet, mesosyek aeng'u eng' komosi ak aeng' eng' komosin, che kieng'jin kagoochinet ne kibeelei, ak kagoochinetap tengekto, ak kagoochinetap chalwokto.

Ak kimi mesosyek aeng'u eng' komosta age eng' ole po saang' eng' ole kitogostoe kebendi ormariichet ne tokyingei murot kaataam; ak kimi mesosyek aeng'u komosta age che ki po keterut ne po ormariichet.
Ki mi mesosyek ang'wanu komosi, komi mesosyek ang'wanu komosin, eng' ole neegitee ormariichet; mesosyek sisiit che ki kieng'jin tiseiywek.

Ak kimi mesosyek ang'wanu, che po koik che ki kiwai, che po kagoochinet ne kibeelei, ko kakwautyet agenge ak kebeberta ne po euut, koindo, ak ki kakwautyet agenge ak kebeberta ne po euut, tebeesindo, ak ki kakwautyet agenge ne po euut, kooindap tononennyi: ki kigonoree mesosyechooto tuguuk che ki kieng'e kagoochinet ne kibeelei kobooto tiseiywot.
Ak ki kiratyi kombook komoswek tugul, che koindonywa ko kite tebeesindap euut: ak kimi panyeegap kagoochinet mesosyek parak.

Ak kimi saang'utap ormariichet ne po oriit kooriik che po oriit che po tyeniik eng' seremut ne po oriit, ne ki mi komostap ormariichet ne po murot kaataam; ak kitokyingei murot tai: kimi age komostap ormariichet ne po kong'asiis ne tokyingei murot kaataam.
Ak kimwaiwo koleenjo, Po koiito tokyingei murot tai tisiik, che tononjin riipseetap koot.
Ak po koot ne tokyingei murot kaataam tisiik che tononjin riipseetap kaptisisyet: chuuto ko weeriitap Zadok, che salu weeriitap Lawi, che riikyin Kamuktaindet ne Toroor koboisyechin ineendet.
Ak ki ikwa seremut, koek mitainik pogol che po euut tebeesindo, ki aechin komoswek tugul ko ang'wan, ak kimi kaptisisyet taitap koot.

Ki imutwaa anyun anyo keterutap koot, ak ki ikwa tugatukyet age tugul ne po keterut, ki ek mitainik muut che po euut komosi, koek mitainik muut che po euut komosin: ak ki ek tebeesindap ormariichet mitainik somok che po euut komosi koek mitainik somok komosin.

Ki ek mitainik tiptem che po euut kooindap keterut, koek mitainik taman ak agenge che po euut tebeesindo; ak kimi tuguuk tamanu che ki kityegoti ketogosyin yooto: ak kimi tolochik ole neegitee tugatugik, kimi age komosi, komi age komosin.
Yeityo komutwaa anyo Hekaluut, ak ki ikwa tugatugik, ki ek mitainik lo che po euut tebeesindo eng' komosi, koek mitainik lo che po euut eng' komosin, ne ki tebeesindap emait.

Ak ki mitainik taman che po euut tebeesindap ole kibunei kebendi oriit; ak komoswegap ole kibunei kebendi oriit ko ki mitainik muut che po euut eng' komosi, ak mitainik muut che po euut eng' komosin: ak ki ikwa koindonyi, koek mitainik artam che po euut, koek tebeesindo mitainik tiptem che po euut.

Ki wo anyun ineendet oriit, ak kokwa tugatukyet age tugul ne po ole kibunei kebendi oriit, ki ek mitainik aeng' che po euut: ak ki ek mitainik lo che po euut, ole kibunei kebendi oriit; ak ki ek mitainik tisap che po euut tebeesindap ole kibunei kebendi oriit.
Ak ki ikwa koindonyi, koek mitainik tiptem che po euut, koek tebeesindo mitainik tiptem che po euut, eng' taitap koyooto: ak ki leenjo, Olito ole-tiliil Miising'.
