Ago ineendet ne kasei, ama yaei, ko kergei ak chiito ne ki teech koot ng'ung'unyek ama lumji ng'wony lumeiywot; ak ki ryep peegap mogoch, ak ki luul koma tyanit; ak ki eet luuletap koyooto!”
Ak kingo kagogesyi ng'aleekyik tugul iitiigap piik, kwo anyun Kapernaum.
Ki mi chemogetap kiplugotinik pogol, ne ki tinyei otwogindet ne ki chamei kot, ak kimyani otwogindonooto ne ki neegit kome.
Ak ye kingo kas agobo Jeso, koyookto ineendet poisyegap Yahudik, koba komwachi konyo kosoop otwogennyi.
Ak ye kingo it icheeget ole mi Jeso, kosaisai ineendet miising', koleenji, “Nyoljin ineendet iyachi ko uu nooto:
amu chamei pororyennyo, ak kiteekwech ineendet sinagoginnyo.”

Kwo anyun Jeso kobooto icheeget. Ak ye ki ma kota ko loo eng' koyooto, koyookto kiptaiyandanooto choronokyik koba ole mi ineendet ak koleenji, “Kiptaiyat, amata iimge: amu anee, koma aa chiito ne nyolu inyoo koonnyu:
nooto anyun, agot anee, koma aiitkei ale nyolu anyoonjin: ago mwaa ng'olyoot kityo, ak kosap otwogindennyu.
Agot anee, nganda aa chii ne kiboiywa, atinye kiplugotinik che abou, ak ngaleenji ni, Ui, kowendi; ak ngaleenji age, Nyoo, konyonei; ak ngaleenji otwogindennyu, Yai ni, koyaei.”
Ak ye kingo kas Jeso ng'aleechuuto, kokwong' agobo ineendet, ak kiwelelgei ak koleenji tuiyet ne ki isubi ineendet, “Amwaiwok ale, tomo anyooru kayaneet ne oo ne tee ni, achicha, agot eng' Israel.”
Ak kingo week anyun che kiga kiyookto, koba kaa, konyoor otwogindonooto ko kagosap.
Ak ye kingo kagobata peetuunooto, kwo nganaseet ne kiguure Nain; ak ki pa kasubikyik kobooto ineendet ak tuiyet ne oo.

Ak ye kiga riikta ormariichetap nganaseet, ogeero, ki kisutei muusto, ne ki weeriit ne ki ii kamet ineegei, ak ki kwony ne ki kasiirtoe manong'otyot chebyosonooto: ak ki mi kobooto ineendet piik che chaang' che po nganaseet.
Ak ye kingo keer `Kiptaiyat ineendet, koriiree, ak koleenji, “Amat iriir.”
Ak kiriikta ye neegit ak kotwa kiit ne ki kisute ineendet: ak kitononso anyun che kisutei. Ak ki leenji `Jeso ineendet, Neranani, kamwaun ale, Ng'eet.
Ak ki ng'eet anyun ne koga kome, ak kotoi kong'alaal. Ak ki igoochi kamet.
Ak ki iyweis tugul: ak kolas Kamuktaindet kole, “Kagong'eet eng' kwenunnyo maotyot ne oo: ak, Kagorutoochi `Kamuktaindet piikyik.”
Ak ki yom ng'olyoondoniito agobo ineendet Judea komugul, ak korotinwek tugul che kiyiem olooto.
Ak ki mwachi `kasubigap Johana ineendet tuguuchuuto tugul.
Ak kiguurchigei Johana aeng' che po kasubikyik ak koyookto koba ole mi Kiptaiyat, koteebe kole, “Tos inyeendet ni nyoonei, anan kigeni age?”
Ak ye kiga it piik ole mi ineendet, koleenji, “Kagoyokwech Johana Kabatisanindet kebwa ole imi, kole, ‘Tos inyeendet ne nyoonei, anan kigeni age?’ ”
Eng' sainooto kosoop che chaang' che ki tinyei myanwogik ak korotwek ak tamirmirik che yaacheen; ak ki igoochi kipkoratinik che chaang' kogeerto.

Kowolji koleenji, “Oba omwachi Johana tuguuk che kaogeer ak che kaogas; kigoochin kipkoratinik kogeerto, ak pendoti che koing'waldos, kitiliili che tinyei mogondosaik, ak kastoi che ming'otin, king'eeti che ki kobek, ki amjin kibananook logoiywek che myach.
Ak paibai age tugul ne ma nyoorunena kanagut.”
Kingo kagoba che kiga koyookto Johana, kotoi komwachi tuiyosyek agobo Johana, kole, “Ki omande surkwen ogeer nee? Tegat ne itumdumi usoonet?
Ago ki omande ogeer nee okweek? Chiito ne ilaachi ngoroik che tangusen? Ogeero, icheeget che ilaachi ngoroik che po lelesta, ak che meng'iisyei eng' talbisto, komiitei kooriigap laitorinik.
Ago ki omande ogeer nee? Maotyot? Ee, amwaiwok ale, siirei maotyot.
Niito ne ki kisir agobo ineendet, keele, ‘Ogeero, ayooktoi kiboityondennyu kondoenen, ne chobei oreng'ung' eng' taing'ung'.’
Amwaiwok ale, eng' che ki sich kobogorisyek koma mi ne oo ne siirei Johana: kobatee ineendet ne ming'in eng' laitornatetap Kamuktaindet ko oo kosiir ineendet.”
Ak ye kingo kas piik tugul, kobooto taagigap aisuruut, koiityi imanda Kamuktaindet, amu kiga kibatisan eng' kabatisanetap Johana.
Ago ki eesyo Pharisaik ak ng'amotigap Ng'atuutik, kirwoogutigap Kamuktaindet, ma makyigei, amu ki ma ibatisan ineendet icheeget.
Ak ki le Kiptaiyat, “Aroge nee piigap ibini, ak kergei ak nee?
Kergei ak lagok che tebyei eng' ye mi ole keyae mung'aaret, ak koguuregei; koleen, ‘Kigegutwak ndurerusyek, ak ma oureren; ki kiriirchok, ak ma oriirye.’
Amu ki nyo Johana Kabatisanindet ama am magatya anan divaik; ak omwae anyun ole, ‘Tinyei oindet.’
Ki nyo Weeriitap chii koamis ak koeeiso; ak omwae ole, ‘Ogeero, kipkeiya chiichi, ak eeindetap divaik, chorweetap taagigap aisuruut ak kiptengeginik!’
Ak naat utaatyet keele po iman, eng' lagokyik tugul.”
Ak ki mach age eng' Pharisaik kole koamis ak ineendet. Ak ki wo kootap Pharisaindonooto, ak kotep ng'wony koamis.
Ak ogeero, kobogoryot age ne ki mi nganaseet, ne ki kiptengekyo; ye kingo nai kole, tebyei ng'wony Jeso koamisyei eng' kootap Pharisaindonooto, koip chuboit ne mi mwaita ne nyamdut,
ak ki tonon eng' let ole neegitee keelyekyik, koriirei, ak ki toi kosachi peegap kong' keelyekyik, ak kouuse suumeekyik, ak kong'utut keelyekyik ak koilee mwaata.

Ak ye kingo keer nooto Pharisaindonooto ne kiguurei ineendet, komwa eng' oriitinnyi, kole, “Nda ka maotyo chiichi, ta kagonai kole ng'oo kobogoryondoni katwa ineendet ak chii ne uu nee, kole kiptengekyot.”
Ak ki wolji Jeso ineendet koleenji, “Simion, atinye ng'olyoot ne amache amwaun.” Ak ki le, “Kaneetindoni, mwaa anyun.”
Kole, “Ki mi pesendoindet anum ne ki tinyei pesenikyik aeng': kibesen age dinarisyek pogol muut, ak kibesen age konom.
Ak ye ki ma kotinyei kiy ne yaakyin, konyochi kaat icheek tuwai. Ng'oo anyun eng' icheek tuwai ne chamei ineendet kosiir?”
Kowol Simion kole, “Aleen ineendet ne ki kinyochi kaat che chaang'.” Ak ki leenji, “Kairwooch komyee.”

Ak kingo weleljigei kobogoryot, koleenji Simion, Igeere kobogoryondoni? Kaanyo koong'ung' ama inaga peek aune keelyekyuk: ago kagosachi keelyekyuk peekyik po kong' kobogoryondoni, ak kouuse suumeekyik.
Ma ing'ututa; ago ineendet, kobooch ngap anyoo, kotomo kobagaakta kong'utut keelyekyuk.
Ma iilee metinnyu mwaita: ago kagoiile inee keelyekyuk mwaita ne nyamdut.
Nooto anyun ne kamwaun ale, kagenyochi kaat tengekwogikyik, che ka chaang'; amu chamei miising': ago ineendet ne kinyochin kaat kitigin, kochamei agine kitigin.
Koleenji kobogoryondonooto, “Kagenyoun kaat tengekwogiguk.”
Ak ki toi icheeget che ki miitei amisyet kobooto ineendet, komwa eng' oriitinnywa, kole, “Ng'oo ni kot konyochi kaat piik tengekwogik?”
Ak ki leenji kobogoryot, “Kagosaruun kayaneng'ung'; ui eng' kaalyeet.”

Ak kingo pata nooto, ne matyanit, kowendote nganasook che eecheen ak che mengeechen koamdaati ak komwaitaati logoiywek che myach che po laitornatetap Kamuktaindet, ak ki mi tamanu ak aeng' kobooto ineendet,
ak kobogorisyek alak che kiga kosoop eng' tamirmirik che yaacheen ak myanwogik, Maria ne kiguure Magdalene, ne kimandae oik tisabu,
ak Joana osotyotap Kusa kiboityotap Herod, ak Susannah, ak kobogorisyek alak che chaang', che kiboisyechin ineendet eng' tuguukwak.
Ak kingo yomogei tuiyet ne oo, ak kobwonji ineendet che ki punu nganaseet age tugul, kong'alaal eng' kalewenet kole:
Ki wo kolindet koleeta kesweekyik: ak ye kita koletoi, kobutyi alak ooreet taban; ak ki kityegat, ak koam toriitik che po parak.
Ak ki ibutyi alak rwandet; ak ye kingo piityo, koyaamyo, amu ma nyoor peek.
Ak ki ibutyi alak kwenutap katook; ak ki piityo katook kobooto keswechooto, ak kogiich.
Ak ki ibutyi alak ng'ung'unyek che myach, ak kobiityo, ak kooi age tugul pogol. Ak ye kita komwaei tuguuchu, komwa eng' kutit ne oo, kole, “Ineendet ne tinyei iitiik che kastoe, kogas!”
Ak kiteebe kasubikyik ole teptoi kalewenoni.
Ak ki le, “Kagigoonok okweek onai ung'ootik che po laitornatetap Kamuktaindet: ago kimwachin alak eng' kalewenaik; ‘si ye keertoi koma keerei kiy, si ye kasei koma naei.’
“Kalewenonooto ko ni: Kesweek ko ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet.
Ak chooto mi ooreet taban ko icheeget che ki kogas; yeityo konyo chesawilyet, ak konem ng'olyoot eng' mugulelwekwak, si ma nyoor kayaneet ak kesar.
Ak icheeget che mi rwandet parak, ko ye kagas ng'aleek, koyan eng' poiboiyet, ak ma tinyei tigitik. Iyani ne matya, ak kochuchuigei eng' peetuutap yoomseet.
Ak che ki ibutyi katook, ko icheeget che ki kas, ak ye kaba kogiich kererwegap met ak mogornatosyek, ak poiboiyetap tuguugap sabooni, ama iyo logoek che nyiitootiin.
Ak che mi ng'ung'unyek che myach, ko icheeget, che ye kagogas ng'olyoot, konam komyee, eng' mugulelwek che po telunateet ak ko myachen, ak koiiyo logoek eng' kagiiletapkei.
“Ma mi chii ne ye kagonaam tait kotuge kiy, anan konde kurereetap itoogut; ago indoi kiit ne tonone tait, si kobiit kogeer lapkeiyet piik che pwoonei ko.
“Amu ma mi kiy ne keunyei ne ma tuun ng'ang'oksei; ama mi kiy ne po ung'oot, ne ma tuun naaksei eng' ole lapkei.
“Oriipkei anyun eng' ole ogastoi: amu age tugul ne tinyei ko tuun kigoochin; ak ineendet ne ma tinyei ko tuun kirebe agot ne leen tinyei.”
Ak ki pwanji ineendet `kamet ak che tupcho, ago ki ma imuuch koriikyi amu chaang'indap piik.
Ak ki kimwachi keleenji, Tonondos kamenng'ung' ak che otupche eng' saang', machei kogeerin.
Ago ki wolji koleenji, “Kamennyu ak che kitupche ko chu kasei ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet, ak koyai.”
Ak ki laany moingetap peek eng' peetuut age eng' peetuusyechooto, kobooto kasubikyik; ak ki leenji, “Ongelandae araraita keebe pitoniin.” Kotoi anyun koba.
Ak kingo ta kobendi, koru Jeso konuuch: kochoorchigei anyun usoonet ne oo araraita; kot komachei konyi peek moinget ak ki nyoonji ng'oiyondit.
Ak ki pwa ole mi ineendet ak kong'eet, koleenji, “Kiptaiyat, Kiptaiyat, kagibegu!” Kong'eet anyun, ak koger kong' usoonet ak wasetapkei ne po peek: kosiis anyun araraita komung'do.
Ak ki leenji icheek, “Mi ano kayaneng'wong'?” Ki iyweis ak kokwong'yo, koleenjigei icheegei, “Ng'oo chiichi anyun, ne ng'atei agot usoonet ak peek, kot kogas iit ineendet?”
Ki it anyun emetap Gerasenik, ne tokyingei Galilaya.

Ak ye kingo nyo ngeguutap araraita, kotuiyo ak ineendet chiito age ne ki punu nganaseet, ne ki tinyei oik; ak ki ma kolaachi ngoroik kobooch peetuusyek che chaang', ak ki ma komenyei ko, ago kitebote kereeriisyek.
Ak kingo keer Jeso, kowaach ak kobutyi tainnyi ak ki mwa eng' kutit ne oo kole, “Ating'enen nee, Jeso Weeriitap Kamuktaindet Ne Toroor Miising'? Kasoomin ale, amenyaliila.”

Amu ki ng'at tamirmiryet ne murwoon komong' eng' chiichooto. Amu kiga nam eng' peetuusyek che chaang': ak ki kiriibei miising', ak kiga kirate nyororosyek ak mugurek; ak king'etyei tuguuk che kirate, ak ki oonei oindet ineendet kwo surkwen.
Ak kiteebe Jeso, koleenji, “Kiguurenen nee?” Ak ki le, “Chaang'indo”; amu kiga chut oik che chaang' ineendet.
Ak ki soom kole si ma ng'at koba keriinget ne ma tinyei ole poochin.
Ak ki mi olooto akweet ne oo ne po toorook che ki agetoos eng' tulweet: ak ki soom icheek miising' kole kochamji kochut tooroochooto. Kochamji anyun.
Ak ki mong' anyun oik eng' chiichooto, ak kochut toorook: ak ki rwai akweet kochoortaegei chemng'eisut koba araraita, ak kobek.
Ak kingo keer che ki iyagisyei tuguuk che kabiit, komwaei, ak koba komwaita eng' nganaseet ak eng' emet agobo nooto.
Ak ki pa kogeer kiit ne kagoyaak; ak ki pwa ole mi Jeso, konyoor chiichooto ne kamandae oik, kotebyei eng' keelyegap Jeso, kolaagat, ak kotinyei ng'omnatennyi: ak ki iywei.
Ak ki mwachi icheek che kageerei tuguuk che kabiit, ole kagisaapto chiito ne katinyei oik.
Ak ki soom anyun piik tugul che po ole neegitee emetap Gerasenik kole, kwo kobagaakta icheek; amu kiga nam icheek kaiyweisyet ne oo. Ki laany anyun moingetap peek, ak koweektagei.
Ago ki soom ineendet chiito ne kamandae oik kole, kotebi tuwai; ago ki mwachi kwo, koleenji,
“Iweekyigei koong'ung', ak imwaite tuguuk che eecheen che kagoyaun Kamuktaindet.” Ak ki wo anyun, komwaitaat eng' nganaseet komugul tuguuk che eecheen che kagoyachi Jeso.
Ak ye ki weeksei Jeso, kotaach tuiyet; amu ki igeni piik tugul ineendet.
Ak ogeero, ki nyo chiito age ne keguure Jairo; ki pounindetap sinagogit: ak ki ibutyi keelyegap Jeso, ak kosoom ineendet kole, konyo koonnyi:
amu ki tinyei chepto ne ki kisich ineegei, ne ki po olo po kenyiisyek taman ak aeng', ak ki neegit kome. Ago ki igiigoti tuiyosyek ineendet kowendi.
Ak ki mi kobogoryot age ne kimandae korotiik kenyiisyek taman ak aeng', ne kiga koboisyee tuguukyik tugul eng' chepkerichinik, ama imuuch kosoop ineendet age tugul eng' icheek.
Ki nyo anyun kobun let eng' ineendet ak kotwa tabandap ngoryennyi: ak koma tyanit kosiisyo korotiik.
Ak ki le Jeso, Ng'oo ne katwaa? Ak kingo tiiyo tugul, koleenji Petero ak che ki mi kobooto ineendet, Kaneetindoni, kariichin tuiyosyek ak kagogiichin.
Ago ki le Jeso, Kagotwaa chii: amu kaanai ale, kagomandaena kimnateet.
Ak ye kingo keer kobogoryot kole, ma imuuch koung'ak, konyo kobotanonu, ak kobutyi ng'wony eng' tainnyi ak komwaita eng' taitap piik tugul kiit ne kaigoochi kotwa ineendet ak ole kagisaapto.
Ak ki leenji, “Chebi, kagosaabin kayaneng'ung'; ui eng' kaalyeet.”
Ak ye kita kong'alaali, konyo chii ne ki punu kootap pounindetap sinagogit, kole, “Kagome cheptong'ung' amatata iim Kaneetindet.”
Ago kingo kas Jeso, kowolji koleenji, “Meiywei. Iyan kityo, si kisoop.”
Ak ye kingo kagoit koot, koma kochamji chii age tugul kwo ko kobooto ineendet, kobatee Petero, ak Johana, ak Jakobo, ak kwandap chebooto ak kamet.
Ak ki riirtos piik tugul, ak koteeitos agobo ineendet: ago ki le, “Morirtosi; amu ma me ineendet, ago inuuchi.”
Ak kirorechi ineendet anyun kochot, amu ki ingen kole kagome.
Ago ki nam ineendet eutap chebooto, ak koguur, kole, “Chebi, ng'eet”
Koweek anyun saboondanyi, ak kong'eet. Ak ki ng'at kole, kigoochi kiy ne amei.
Ak ki kwong'yo miising' sigiikyik; ak ki ng'at ineendet icheek koleenji, amomwachi chii age tugul kiit ne kagoyaak.
Ki kuur anyun taman ak aeng' koyumgei, ak kogoochi kimnateet ak pounateet koboi oik tugul, ak kosoop che myandos.
Ak ki iyookto koamda laitornatetap Kamuktaindet, ak kosoop che myandos.
Koleenji, “Amoip kiy ne po pandang'wong', agot kirokto, anan lolet, anan magatyat, anan fedhaisyek; amoibote sumotik aeng'.
Ak koot age tugul ne omong'jini, otebee olooto agoi obe.
Ak alak tugul che mataachak, ye omande eng' nganasanooto, olelekte temburyek eng' keelyekwok si koek paornateet agobo icheek.”
Koba anyun kobunoot nganasook, koamdaati logoiywek che myach, ak kosaaboti eng' oldo tugul.
Ak ki kas anyun kirwoogindet Herod tuguuk tugul che ki koyaak: ki iimgei miising', amu kimwaei alak kole, kagong'eet Johana eng' che ki pek;
ak kileen alak, kogotook Elijah: koleen alak, kong'eet age eng' maotik chu ki po keny.
Ak ki le Herod, “Ki atil metitap Johana; ago ng'oo anyun chiichi, ne agase tuguuk che uu chooto agobo ineendet?” Ak ki cheeng' kole kogeer ineendet.
Ak ye kingo week che kiyooktoi, komwachi ineendet tuguuk che kogoyai. Ak ki imut icheek koba taban icheegei agoi nganaseet ne kiguure Bethsaida.
Ago kingo nai tuiyosyek koosup: ak kitaach icheeget, ak kong'alaalji agobo laitornatetap Kamuktaindet, ak ki isoop icheek che kimachei kisoop.
Ak ye kimachei koimen, kobwa anyun tamanu ak aeng' koleenji ineendet, Ileenji tuiyet koba, si koit nganasook ak emet, si konyoor ole ruitos, ak amitwogik: amu kimi surkwen.
Ago ki leenji icheek, “Ogoochi okweek amitwogik.” Ak ki le, “Ma kitinye kiy kobatee magatiinik muut ak njireenik aeng'; kobatee keebe kealji amitwogik pichu tugul.”
Amu ki olo po murenik eliphuusyek muut. Ak ki leenji kasubikyik, Ochop kotep ng'wony ak ingobeate konom.
Ak ki yai anyun ko uu nooto, ak ki chop tugul kotep ng'wony.
Ak ki nam magatinichooto muut ak injirenichooto aeng', ak ki inyal kipsengwet, ak koberuur, ak kotonaton; ak kogoochi kasubik si kobiit kogoochi kabuureito.
Ak ki amis, kot kobiyong'so: ak ki kiyum katuganik che ki ng'et eng' kererutik, ak ki ek kereboonik taman ak aeng'.
Ak ye ki saaei ineegei, ko ki mi kasubik kobooto ineendet: ak kiteebe icheeget koleenji, “Mwaei tuiyosyek kole aa ng'oo?”
Ak ki wolji icheek koleenji, “Leen Johana Kabatisanindet; koleen alage, Elijah; koleen alak, kagong'eet maotyot age eng' chu ki po keny.”
Ak ki leenji icheek, “Ago oleen okweek aa ng'oo?” Ak ki wol Petero kole, “Ii Kristo ne po Kamuktaindet.”
Ago ki itigon icheek, ak kong'at koleenji, amomwachi chii ng'olyoondoniito;
kole, “Kanyolji Weeriitap chii konyalil eng' tuguuk che chaang', ak koeesyo poisyek ineendet ak tisiik che eecheen ak siriik, ak kebar, ak king'eet eng' peetuutap somok.”
Ki mwachi tugul koleenji, “Ngo machei chii age tugul kosubwo, ko ingoeesyogei, ak koip kimurtoiyondennyi peetuut age tugul, ak kosubwo.
Amu age tugul ne machei kosar saboondanyi kobeeti; ak age tugul ne ibeeti saboondanyi agobo anee, ko nooto ne saru.
Amu keljin nee chii, ngo nyoor ng'wony komugul ak kobeetkei anan kerebe saboondanyi?
Amu age tugul ne ililanjino ak ng'aleekyuk ko tuun ililanjin agine Weeriitap chii chiichooto, ye tuun nyoonei eng' toroornatennyi, ak ne po Kwanda, ak ne po malaikaisyek che tiliileen.
Ago amwaiwok iman ale, miitei alak eng' che tonondos eng' yuto che ma koi chamcham meet matiny, kot kogeer laitornatetap Kamuktaindet.”
Ak kingo keskei olo po peetuusyek sisiit, kobooch ngo mwa ng'aleechooto, komut Petero ak Johana ak Jakobo, kotogosta tulweet koba kosa.
Ak ye kita kosaaei, kowalak itoondap togeennyi, ak koleelagitu ngoroikyik kot koliil piich.
Ak ogeero, ki ng'alaalyo ak `ineendet piik aeng'u; ki Musa ak Elijah;
che ki kotook eng' liilindo, ak kiga ng'alaal agobo meennyi ne kimachei kosulda eng' Jerusalem.
Ak kiga pirto met Petero kobooto icheeget che ki mi ak ineendet: ago ye kingo kos, kogeer liilindanyi, ak pichooto aeng' che kitonondos kobooto ineendet.

Ak ye kimachei koobeesyo ak ineendet, koleenji Petero Jeso, Kaneetindoni, myee amu kimi yuto: si keteech keryosyek somok; neng'ung' age, ko po Musa age, ko po Elijah age: kimwaei ama nai kiit ne mwaei.
Ak ye kita komwaei tuguuchuuto, konyo pooldet, ak kotuch icheeget: ak ki iyweis ye kingo chut pooldet.
Ak ki mong' kutit eng' pooldet, ak kole, “Ni Weeriinnyu, ne ki alewen; ogas ineendet.”
Ak ye kingo pata kutinooto, kotook Jeso ineegei. Ak kosiisyo anyun, ama mwachi chii eng' peetuusyechooto kiit age tugul ne kiga kogeer.
Ak peetuut ne ki isubi peetuunooto, ye kingo choorugei eng' tulweet, kotuiyo ak ineendet tuiyet ne oo.
Ak ogeero, kibol chiito age eng' tuiyet, kole, “Kaneetindoni, asaain ale, riiree weeriinnyu; amu ki kisich ineegei:
ak keero, namei ineendet tamirmiryet, ak koma tyanit kowaach; ak kobirabirto kot kobun pugat kutinnyi, konyalili miising' ama chamei komanda.
Ak koariirchi kasubiguk ale koon; ago ma imuuch.”
Ak ki wolji Jeso koleenji, “Ee ibini ma tinyei kayaneet ak komaasat, atebye kobootok, ak amuitoi agobo okweek kot kotyanit? Imutu weeriing'ung' konyo yu.”
Ak kingo ta konyonei, kowiirchi ng'wony oindet ineendet ak kobirabirto miising'. Ago ki kergong' `Jeso tamirmiryet ne murwoon, ak kosoop lakweet, ak koweekyi kwanda.
Ak ki kwong'yo tugul agobo ooindap Kamuktaindet. Ago kingo ta kokwong'dos tugul agobo tuguuk che kayai Jeso, koleenji kasubikyik,
“Ongochut ng'aleechu iitiikwok: amu tuun kigoitoi Weeriitap chii kwo eunegap piik.”
Ago ma iguiyo icheek mwaonooto; kiung'ak eng' icheeget, si ma nai: ak ki iywei koteebe ineendet agobo mwaonooto.
Kotoi anyun koteebegei kole, ng'oo ne egu ne oo eng' acheek?
Ak kingo nai Jeso kabwaatutigap mugulelwekwak, konam lakweet ne ming'in, ak konde ye neegit ineendet,

ak ki leenji icheek, Chii age tugul ne taachei lakwani ming'in eng' kainennyu ko kataacha: ak chii age tugul ne taacha ko kataach ineendet ne ki iyookwo: amu ineendet ne ming'in eng' okweek tugul, ko nooto ne oo.
Ak ki wolji Johana koleenji, “Kiptaiyandani, kogigeer chii ko oonei oik eng' kaineng'ung'; ak ko ki etee, amu ma kibendoti tugul.”
Ago ki leenji `Jeso ineendet, “Amoete ineendet; amu ineendet ne ma kirindook ko neng'wong'.”
Ak ye ki neegit miising' koit peetuusyek che kitaage ineendet eng' parak, ko ki iljigei kotokyi togeennyi Jerusalem;
koyookto che ibei ng'aleek koba kondoe ineendet: koba anyun, komong'ji nganaseet age ne po Samarik, ak kochopchi oldo.
Ak ma taach ineendet, amu kiga kotokyi togeennyi Jerusalem.
Ak ye kingo keer nooto kasubikyik Jakobo ak Johana, koleenji, Kiptaiyat, tos imache keng'at maat kochoorgei eng' kipsengwet, si kowong' icheeget (ko uu ye ki yai Elijah)?
Ago kiweleljigei icheek, ak koger kong'.
Koba anyun nganaseet age.
Ak kingo ta kobendi eng' ooreet, koleenji chiito age, Asubun eng' oldo tugul ole iwendi.
Koleenji Jeso ineendet, Tineyi lelwek keriingonik, ak kotinyei toriitik che po parak kesonok; ago ma tinyei Weeriitap chii ole indoi metinnyi.
Ak ki leenji age, Isubwo. Ago ki leenji chiichooto, Kiptaiyat, chamwo awo korook atup abba.
Ago ki leenji, Pagakte che pegu kotup chechwaak che pegu; ago ui inyee ak iamdaate ng'aleegap laitornatetap Kamuktaindet.
Kole age agine, Tuun asubun, Kiptaiyat; ago chamwo korook awo agoochi piigap koonnyu saisere.
Ago ki leenji `Jeso ineendet, Ma mi chii ne namei mogombetap tuuga, ak koguskong' kogeer let, ne nyoljin laitornatetap Kamuktaindet.
Kingo pata tuguuchu kolewen Kiptaiyat piik alak tamanwogik tisap ak icheek, ak koyookto kobee aeng' kole, kondoe ineendet koba nganaseet age tugul ak komosta age tugul ole tuun punooti.
Ago ki leenji icheek, Oo kesisyet ago ng'ering' kesik: nooto anyun osoom Kiptaiyat ne po kesisyet, si kobiit koyookyi kesik kesisyennyi.
Oba: ogeero kaayooktok ko uu aaregap keechiirek eng' kwenutap suik.
Amoip lolet, anan suberet, anan kweonik: amogat chii eng' ooreet.
Ak koot age tugul ne omong'jini, omwa ole, Ingotep kaalyeet eng' kooi.
Ak ngo miitei weeriitap kaalyeet yooto, kotebee kalyeng'wong' ineendet: ak ngo ma mi, koweekyinogei okweek.
Ak otebee koyooto anyun, ak tuguuk che koonok, oam ak oee: amu nyoljin kiboityot melektanyi. Amoitote kooriik.
Ak nganaseet age tugul ne omong'jini, ak kotaachak, oam tuguuk che kindoi taing'wong';
ak osoop che myandos eng' olooto, ak oleenji icheek, Kagorikyok laitornatetap Kamuktaindet.
Ago nganaseet age tugul ne omong'jini, ama taachok, omande obe ortinwekyik ak omwa ole,
kagibukyok temburyek che po nganaseng'wong', che kanam keelyekyok; ago onai ni, ole, kagoriik laitornatetap Kamuktaindet.
Ago amwaiwok ale, Tuun kaigaitu Sodom eng' peetuunooto, kosiir nganasanooto.
“Pwo! Wee Korazin! Pwo! Wee Bethsaida! Amu nda kiga kiyai eng' Tyro ak Sidon poisyonik che po kamuktaet ko uu che kogiyai eng' okweek, ta kiga kosik keny, ak kotebee oreek kolaachi kuniok.
Ago tuun kaigaitu Tyro ak Sidon eng' kirwooget, kosiirok.
Ak inyee Kapernaum, Tos tuun kitoroorin iwe kipsengwet? Kiwiirchinin ng'wony kot iit ye mi che ki kobek.
“Ineendet ne kasook kogasa agane; ak ineendet ne eesyook koeesyoo agane; ak ineendet ne eesyoo koeesyoi ineendet ne ki iyookwo.”
Ki week anyun pichooto tamanwogik tisabu eng' poiboiyet, ak komwa kole, “Kiptaiyat, agot oik kogaseech iit eng' kaineng'ung'.”
Ak ki leenji, “Ki ageer Setani kochoorugei eng' kipsengwet ko uu kalyeleet.
Ogeero, kaagoonok kamuget si kobiit otyech erenook ak melmelwek, ak oterter kimnateet tugul ne po puunyoot; ak ma mi kiy ne imuuchi kong'emak.
Ago amoboiboitu amu ng'olyoondoni, amu kasok iit oik; ago oboiboitu amu siraatiin kainaikwok eng' kipsengwet.”

Eng' sainooto kobaibait Jeso eng' Kabuuset ne Tiliil, ak kole, “Aweegun kongoi, ee Abba, Kiptaiyat ne po kipsengwet ak ng'wony, amu ki iung'e tuguuchu che utaatiin ak che ng'oomeen, ak ki ing'aang'ji manyurunik: ee, Abba; amu ki chamak ko uu nooto eng' taing'ung'.
“Ki kogoono tuguuk tugul Abba: ak ma mi chii ne ingen Weeriit kole ng'oo, kobatee Kwanda; ama nai chii Kwanda kole ng'oo, kobatee Weeriit, ak chii age tugul ne chamei Weeriit, kong'aang'jin.”
Ak kiweleljigei kasubik, ak koleenji eng' ung'oot, “Iberuurotin koonyek che keerei tuguuk che ogeere:
amu amwaiwok ale, kimachei maotik che chaang' ak laitorinik kogeer tuguuk che ogeere, ago ki ma keer; ak kimachei kogas tuguuk che ogase, ago ki ma kas.”
Ogeero, ki tonon ng'amotyot age ne po ng'atuutik koyoom ineendet, kole, “Kaneetindoni, ayai nee si tuun anyooru saboondap koigeny?”
Ak ki leenji, “Ki kisir nee eng' Ng'atuutik? Isomandoi ano?”

Ak ki wolji ineendet koleenji, “Cham Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet ne Toroor neng'ung' eng' muguleldang'ung' komugul, ak eng' saboondang'ung' komugul, ak eng' kimnateng'ung' komugul, ak eng' ng'omnateng'ung' komugul; ak icham chiitap kokweng'ung' ko uu ye ichamdoige.”
Ak ki leenji, “Kewolu komyee: yai ko uu nooto, si isap.”
Ago ye kimachei komyeeitkei, koleenji Jeso, “Ng'oo chiitap kokwennyu?”
Kowolji Jeso koleenji, “Kichoortaegei chiito age Jerusalem kwo Jeriko; ak kotuiyo ak rebiik, che kirebe ngoroik ak kobir, ak koba, kobagaakta ko neegit kome.
Ak kichoortaegei tisiindet age oranooto; ak kingo keer ineendet korop taban.
Ak ye kingo it Lawindet yooto, ak kogeer, korop taban agine ko uu nooto.
Ago ye kita kowendi Samarindet age eng' pandanyi, koit ye mi chiichooto: ak ye kingo keer ineendet, koriiree,
kwo ole mi ineendet, koratyi ole kagibir, ak kosachinot mwaita ak divaik; ak kiganapchi chiichooto sigiryennyi, ak komut kwo kootap toek, ak koriip ineendet.
Ak mutai konem dinarisyek aeng', kogoochi chiitap ko po koot, ak koleenji, ‘Riip ineendet; ak tuguuk alak tugul che inyae che siirei chu, kotuun kaweege, anyo ayaagun.’
Eng' chuuto somok, ileen ng'oo ne ki ek chiitap kokwennyi eng' chiichooto kituiye rebiik?”
Ak ki le, “Ineendet ne kirireegei chiichooto.” Ak ki leenji Jeso, “Ui, iyai ko uu nooto.”
Ak ye kita komi pandanywa, komong'ji anyun nganaseet age: ak kitaach eng' koonnyi kobogoryot age ne keguure Marta.
Ak ki tinyei chepkamet ne kiguure Maria, ne kitebyei eng' ole po keelyegap Kiptaiyat, kogasei ng'olyoondennyi.
Ago ki iimgei Marta eng' poisyonik che chaang'; ak konyonji ineendet ak koleenji, “Kiptaiyat, meiti kiy ak kabagaakta tupchennyu abois aneege? Mwachi anyun kotoreta.”
Ago ki wolji Kiptaiyat koleenji, “Marta, Marta, igereeri met ak iimige agobo tuguuk che chaang':
ago kiit agenge ne kemachei: amu kagolewen Maria kebeberta ne myee, ne ma kirebe.”
Ak ye kita kosaaei eng' oldo age, ak kingo kes, koleenji age eng' kasubikyik, Kiptaiyat, ineetech kesaa, ko uu ye ki ineeti Johana kasubikyik.
Ak ki leenji icheek, “Ye osaae, omwa ole, ‘Kwandanyo, ingoloosunok kaineng'ung'. Ingonyo laitornateng'ung'.
Koonech ye kiech amitwogikyok che po kotugul.
Nyoiywech kaat tengekwogikyok; ko uu ye kinyoe kaat acheek pesenwogikyok. Amemutech ole mi yoomseet.’ ”
Ak ki leenji, “Ng'oo eng' okweek ne tinyei chorweet, ak kwo ole mi kemoi kween, ak koleenji, ‘Chorwani, koono magatiinik somok abesen;
amu kagoit chorwennyu ne punu rutoi, ama tinye kiy ne agoochini.’
Ak kowolji ne mi ko, koleenji, ‘Mat iima; kaager kurgeet, ak kageruiye ak lagokyuk; ma amuuchi ang'eet agoonin.’
Amwaiwok ale, agot ngo ma ng'eet kogoochi, amu chorwennyi, ko amu soomsennyi ko nooto ne igoochin kong'eet kogoochi kiy tugul ne machei.
Ak amwaiwok agane ale, Osoom, si kegoonok; ocheeng', si onyooru; ogonygony, si keyatwok.
Amu age tugul ne soomei, kigoochin; ak nyooru ne cheeng'ei; ak ineendet ne igonygonyi keyatyin.
Ak ng'oo eng' okweek kwanda ne ngo soom weeriit magatyat, ko tos igoochi koita? Anan ngo soom njiryot, ko tos igoochi ereneet kogeere njiryot?
Anan ngo soom koitap ingok, ko tos igoochi melmeldo?
Ngo ngen okweek che oo yaach ogoochi lagokwok tuguuk che myach, siirei anyun ne tya kagoitoet ne igoochin Kwandang'wong' ne mi kipsengwet Kabuuset ne Tiliil icheek che soomei ineendet!”
Ak ki oon ineendet oindet ne namaat kuut. Ak ye kingo kagomanda oindet, kong'alaal anyun ne kinamat kuut; ak ki kwong'yo tuiyosyek.
Ago ki le alak, Oone oik eng' Beelsebul, laitoryat ne po oik.
Ak kityem alak ineendet komage kaboorunet ne punu kipsengwet.
Ago ki nai ineendet kabwaatutikwak, koleenji, “Laitornatet age tugul ne pchegei ko ng'emaksei; ak koot age tugul ne pchegei koluulei.
Ak ngo pchegei agine Setani, kotonondoi ano laitornatani? Amu omwae ole, aoone oik eng' Beelsebul.
Ngot aoone oik eng' Beelsebul, koonei weeriikwok eng' ng'oo? Nooto anyun ne igoochin icheeget koek kirwoogikwok.
Ago ngot aoone oik eng' mornetap Kamuktaindet, ko kanyonjok anyun laitornatetap Kamuktaindet.
“Ak chii ne tinyei kimnateet ak kotinyei kariikyik che riibe koonnyi, kotebyei tuguukyik eng' kaalyeet:
ak ye nyoonji chiito ne kiim kosiir ineendet ak koterteer, korebe anyun ineendet kariikyik tugul che cham komang'u, ak kopcheita pareiywekyik.
Ineendet ne ma kimi tuwai kogirindaa; ak ineendet ne ma kiyumi tuwai koiyestooti.
“Ye kagomanda tamirmiryet ne murwoon eng' chiito, kosiir ole ma mi peek, kocheeng'oti ole imuung'ee; ak ye mata konyoor, komwa anyun kole, ‘Aweektoigei koonnyu ole ki abunu.’
Ak ye iit, konyoor kobugot ak ko choboot.
Kwo anyun, komut oik tisap alak che yaacheen kosiir ineendet; kochut anyun oriit ak komeny olooto: ak yaitu kagesunetap chiichooto kosiir ne po tai.”
Ak ye kita komwaei ng'aleechu, komwa kobogoryot age eng' tuiyet, kole, “Iberuurot moet ne kisichin, ak kinaik che ki irerye.”
Ago ki le ineendet, “Iberuurotin kosiir che kasei ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet, ak koriip.”
Ak ye kingo yumjigei ineendet tuiyosyek, kotoi komwa kole, “Ibini, ko ibinda ne ya: cheeng'ei kaboorunet; ago ma kigoochin kaboorunet kobatee kaboorunetap Jona.
Amu ko uu ye ki ek kaboorunet Jona eng' piigap Nineveh, ko uu nooto Weeriitap chii eng' ibini.

Tuun ng'eetei laitoryat kobogoryot ne po murot tai eng' kirwooget kobooto piigap ibini, ak korwookyi icheek: amu ki pun tabanwegap emet konyo kogas utaatyetap Solomon; ak ogeero, miitei yu ne oo kosiir Solomon.
Tuun tonondos piigap Nineveh ak ibini eng' kirwooget, ak korwookyi: amu kisik icheek eng' amdaetap Jona; ak ogeero, mi yu ne oo kosiir Jona.
“Ma mi chii ne ngo kagonaam tait, konde ole ung'aat, anan kitonget oriit, ago indoi kiit ne tonone, si kobiit kogeer lapkeiyet che pendi ko.
Taitap poortang'ung' kondang'ung': ngo myee kondang'ung', ko nyiitaat poortang'ung' komugul lapkeiyet; ago ngo ya kondang'ung' ko nyiitaat poortang'ung' agine mesundeito.
Keer anyun ngo lapkeiyet ne mi oriing'ung' ko mesundeito.
Ngo nyiitaat poortang'ung' komugul lapkeiyet, ama tinyei ye imen, kolapkeitu anyun poortang'ung' tugul, ko uu ye koonin lapkeiyet tait ne ikweng'sei komyee.”
Ak ye kita kong'alaali, koguur Pharisaindet age kwo koamis tuwai: ak ki wo ko ak kotep ng'wony koamis.
Ak ye kingo keer Pharisaindet, kokwong', amu ki amis ama iun euut korook.
Koleenji `Kiptaiyat, Okweek Pharisaik, ouni parak kigombet ak sanit; ago nyiitaat oriing'wong' rebisyet ak yaityet.
Okweek che oo perber, ineendet ne kiyaei saang' koma ne kiyaei oriit agine?
Ogoite kagoochinoik che po tuguuk che mi oriit; ak ogeero, tiliiliitu tuguuk tugul eng' okweek.

Ago pwo eng' okweek Pharisaik! Amu ogoitoi kebebertap taman ne po heduosmon ak keetiik che mengech che ng'uu, ak che po sogeek alak tugul, ak ometoi kirwooget ak chamyetap Kamuktaindet: ago kita nyolu oyai chuuto, amomete chuun alak.
Pwo eng' okweek Pharisaik! Amu ochame ng'echerok che torooreen eng' sinagogisyek, ak kagatosyek che kigatok eng' ole kiyae mung'aaret.
Pwo eng' okweek! Amu oo kerge ak kereeriisyek che mataagu, ama naei piik che punooti parak.
Ak ki wolji ng'amotyot age ne po ng'atuutik, koleenji, “Kaneetindoni, ngot imwa ko uu nooto ko keteweerech agacheek.”
Ak kole, “Pwo eng' okweek ng'amotigap Ng'atuutik! Amu oganapchini piik lautik che pichiien eng' laiset, ago okweek ko motwae lautichooto agot eng' mornet agenge.
Pwo eng' okweek! Amu oteeche kereeriisyegap maotik, ago ki parei kwanisyekwok.
Ki oegu anyun paorinik ak ochamyechini poisyonigap kwanisyekwok: amu icheeget che kibarei ak oteeche okweek kereeriisyekwak.
Ki le anyun `utaatyetap Kamuktaindet amu nooto, ‘Tuun ayookyini maotik ak che kiyooktoi; ak kobar alak eng' icheek ak kousaus alak,’
si kobiit komage ibini, korotiigap maotik tugul, che ki kitumda kobooch ko kagilumda ng'wony;
kobooch korotiigap Abel agoi korotiigap Zekariah, ne kime eng' kwenutap kaptisisyet ak Hekaluut: ee, amwaiwok ale, tuun kimage ibini.
“Pwo eng' okweek ng'amotigap ng'atuutik! Amu ki oip yaateiwot ne po ng'omnateet ama obe oriit okweeget, ak ki oger che kita mong'jin.”
Ak ye kingo mong' eng' olooto, kotoi siriik ak Pharisaik koriich ineendet miising', ak kogilgilye, si kobiit komwa ng'aleek che chaang';
koriip kole tamangap konyoor ng'olyoo ne mang'une kutinnyi.
Eng' saisyechooto, ye kingo yumgei piik ng'iisyat che po tuiyet, kot kotyechkei icheegei, kosip kotoi koleenji kasubikyik, Oriibegei mermeregap Pharisaik, nooto chombilisyet.
Ago ma mi kiy ne tugoot, ne ma tuun king'aanyei, anan ne ung'aat, ne ma tuun naaksei.
Amu kiy age tugul ne omwae eng' mesundeito kotun kegasei eng' ole lapkei; ak che ki ochaamji itit eng' koot oriit kotun kemwaitoi eng' koot parak.
Ak amwaiwok choronokyuk ale, Amoiywei che parei poorto, yeityo ko mata komuuch koyai kiy age.
Ago ateiywok si onai ineendet ne kanyool oiywei: Oiywei ineendet, ne ngo kagobar komuuchi kowiirchi Gehenna; ee, amwaiwok ale, Oiywei ineendet.
Tos ma ki aldae toriitik muut che mengeechen kebebertap muut ne po dinarit? Ama utye Kamuktaindet agot agenge.
Ago iitotin suumeek tugul che po metowekwok. Amoiywei anyun: osiire okweek toriitik che chaang' che mengeechen.
Ak amwaiwok ale age tugul ne ibortaa eng' taitap piik, kotun iboortoi agine Weeriitap chii chiichooto eng' taitap malaikaisyek che po Kamuktaindet.
Ago ineendet ne eesyoa eng' taitap piik kotun keesyoi agine eng' taitap malaikaisyek che po Kamuktaindet.
Ak age tugul ne mwaei ng'olyoo ne ya agobo Weeriitap chii, kenyochin kaat: ago ineendet ne chubei Kabuuset ne Tiliil koma kinyochin kaat ineendet.
Ak ye kimutak ye mi sinagogisyek, ak taitap kirwoogik, ak pounik, ko matogereer met agobo kiit ne owolu anan omwae:
amu ineetook Kabuuset ne Tiliil eng' sainooto kiit ne nyolu omwa.
Ki leenji anyun chiito age eng' tuiyet, Kaneetindoni, mwachi weeriit ne kitupche kopcheiywa tuguukyok.
Ago ki leenji ineendet, Chiichi, ng'oo ne kindea aek kirwoogindet anan pcheindet eng' okweek?
Ak ki leenji icheek, Ogeer, ak oriipkei eng' kasetap myat tugul: amu ma tebyei saboondap chii eng' chaang'indap tuguuk che tinyei.
Ak ki mwachi kalewenet koleenji, “Ki mi mogoryot age ne kiga rur mbareennyi miising'.
Ak ki ibwaat eng' muguleldanyi kole, ‘Ayae nee, amu ma tinye ole agonoree peekyuk?
Ak ki le, Ayae ko uu ni: abute chogenikyuk, si ateech che eecheen kosiir chu: si agonoree peekyuk ak tuguukyuk tugul che myach.
Si aleenji saboondanyu, Saboondanyu, itinye tuguuk che chaang' che myachen che konorotiin che yamei kenyiisyek che chaang'; imuuny, amisye, eeise, ak ibaibaitu.’
Ago ki leenji Kamuktaindet, ii perber inyee, kimachei saboondang'ung' kemouni po ra; ara, si kobunji ng'oo anyun, tuguuchooto koichop?”
Ki igees Jesu kole, “Uu nooto anyun chiito ne konorchingei mogornateet ineegei, ne ma mogoryo eng' Kamuktaindet.”
Ki leenji anyun kasubikyik, Nooto anyun amwaiwok ale, Amogereer met agobo sabeeng'wong', eng' tuguuk che oame; anan agobo poorwekwok, eng' tuguuk che olaachi.
Amu siirei sabeet amitwogik, ak siirei poorto ngoroik.
Obwaat chepkuginik, amu ma kolei, ama kesei; ama tinyei ole konoree anan choget; ago Kamuktaindet ne paei: osiire toriitik konyil ata!
Ak ng'oo eng' okweek ne imuuchi kogereer met si kotes koindonyi eng' kakwautyet agenge ne po euut?
Ngo momuuchi anyun oyai agot kiy kitigin, ko amu nee anyun si ogereer met agobo tuguuk alak?
Obwaat taaptook, ole pititoi: ma poisyei, anan koletis; ago amwaiwok ale, Agot Solomon, eng' talbistanyi tugul, ko ki ma kolumegei ko uu age eng' chuuto.
Ago ngo laaksechin Kamuktaindet ko uu nooto susweek che po keeweet che mi ra, ak mutai kewiirchi ma, kotos siirei ne tya anyun kolaaksewok okweek, che otinye kayaneet ne ming'in!
Amocheeng' che oame, anan che oee, amosage.
Amu cheeng'ei tuguuchuuto tugul pororyosyegap ng'wony: ago ingen Kwandang'wong' kole omakyinige tuguuchuuto.
Ago ocheeng' okweek laitornatetap Kamuktaindet, si keteswook tuguuchuuto tugul.
Amoiywei, okweek akweet ne ming'in; amu paibai Kwandang'wong' kogoonok laitornatet.
Oalde che otinye, si ogoite kagoochinoik; onapchigei suberok che maosegitu, konorwet eng' kipsengwet ne ma pegu, ole mariikyin chooriik, ama ng'emei kuutik.
Amu ole mi konorweng'ung', ko olooto ole mi muguleldang'ung' agine.
Ongogermenogis suenutikwok, ak ongolalyo taisyekwok;
ak ogergeitu ak piik che igeni kiptaiyannywa, kobunu igoortap katunisyet: si ye nyo ak kogongony, koyatyi sainooto.
Poiboen otwogichooto, che nyooru kiptaiyandanooto koriipsei ye nyo: amwaiwok iman ale, kermenigei ineendet ak chobei pichooto kotep ng'wony eng' ole amisye, ak kwo kobai icheek.
Ak ngo nyo eng' riipseet ne po aeng', anan ne po somok, ak konyoorta ko uu nooto, ko poiboen anyun otwogichooto.
Ago onai ni ole, nda ki ingen kiptaiyatap koot sait ne nyoonei choriindet, ta kiriipsei, ta ki ma kobagaaktoi koonnyi kobut choriindet.
Ochopkei ak okweek: amu nyoonei Weeriitap chii eng' sait ne mobwaati.
Ki leenji anyun Petero, Kiptaiyat, imwaiwech acheek kalewenoni, anan imwachini piik tugul?
Kole anyun Kiptaiyat, Ng'oo anyun riibindet ne kiyani ak ko ng'oom, ne indoi kiptaiyandennyi kotononji koonnyi, ak kogoochi amitwogikwak che yamei eng' peetuut ne makyin?
Paibai otwogindonooto, ne nyooru kiptaiyandennyi koyaei ko uu nooto.
Amwaiwok iman ale, indoi chiichooto kotononji tuguukyik tugul.
Ago ngo mwa otwogindonooto eng' muguleldanyi, kole, “Igaegei kiptaiyandennyu ma sip koitu,” ak kotoi kobir otwogik che murenik ak che tiibiik, ak koamis ak koeeiso, ak kobogit;
weeksei anyun kiptaiyat ne po otwogindonooto eng' peetuut ne kama koogeni, ak eng' sait ne ma naei, ak kobir miising', ak kopchechi kebebertanyi kobooto che ma tinyei kayaneet.
Ak otwogindonooto, ne ki ingen mageetap kiptaiyandennyi, ama kochopkei, anan koyai ko uu magennyi, kebire pirutik che chaang';

ago ineendet ne ki ma kongen, ak koyai tuguuk che nyoljin pireet, kebirei pirutik che ng'ering'en. Ak age tugul ne ki kigoochi che chaang', kotun kimage che chaang': ak ineendet ne ki kigoochi koriip tuguuk che chaang', kotun kimage ineendet che siirei.
“Ki anyoo awirchi maat ng'wony; nee anyun neta amache, ngo kagolal nguno!
Ago atinye kabatisanet ne tatun kibatisanena; kamarigitya ne tya agoi kosulda!
Tos oleen ki anyoo agoonu kaalyeet konyo ng'wony? Amwaiwok ale, Achicha; ago peesyet:
amu kobooch nguno kopchegei piik muutu che mi koot agenge, suryee somogu aeng', ak kosurye aeng' somok.
Pchegei, kwanda ak weeriit, ak weeriit ak kwanda; kamet ak cheptonyi, ak chepto ak kamet; kametap weeriit ak osotyonnyi, ak osotyotap weeriit, ak kametap weeriit.”
Ki mwachi anyun tuiyet koleenji, “Ye ogeer kotogosune pooldet cherongo, ole, ‘Machei koroobon’; ak koyaak ko uu nooto anyun.
Ak ye ogeer usoonet ne usune murot tai, ole, ‘Machei koit kemeut ne ng'waan’; ak koyaak ko uu nooto.
Chombilichu, ongen obesye ole teptoi ng'wony ak kipsengwet; kalya anyun si monai ole teptoi peetuusyechu?
“Kalya si morwoch okweegei agobo tuguuk che po imanda?

Amu ye ta obendi ak punyondeng'ung' taitap kirwoogindet, igiilgei obendi eng' ooreet si kounden; si mata komutin taitap kirwoogindet, ak komutyin kirwoogindet asigarindet, ak kotoorchin asigarindet korgoreet.
Amwaun ale, Ma koi imang'une olooto, agoi iyaakte sendeiyot ne po let.”
Ki mi piik alage eng' peetuusyechooto che ki mwachi ineendet agobo piigap Galilaya, che kiburuch Pilato korotiikwak ak tiseiywekwak.
Ak kowolji koleenji, “Tos oleen ki kiptengeginik pichooto po Galilaya kosiir piigap Galilaya tugul, amu kinyoor nyalilwogichu?
Amwaiwok ale, Achicha: ago, ngot ko mosigu okweek, olustosi okweek tugul ko uu nooto.
Anan chooto taman ak sisiit, che kisyep koot ne koi ne po Siloam, ak kobar, tos oleen ki kiptengeginik kosiir piik tugul che ki menyei Jerusalem?
Amwaiwok ale, Achicha: ago, ngot ko mosigu ak okweek, olustosi tugul ko uu nooto.”
Ak ki mwa kalewenoni, koleenji, “Ki mi chiito age ne ki tinyei mogoywet ne kiga minji mbareennyi ne po sabibuk; ak ki nyo kocheeng' logoegap keetoto, amanyoorchi kiy.
Koleenji riibindetap mbareetap sabibuk, ‘Keero, kenyini ko ne po somok anyoone acheeng'e logoek eng' mogoywoni amanyoorunee kiy: ep koluul; amu nee si koamei ng'ung'unyek puch?’
Ak ki wolji koleenji, ‘Kiptaiyat, ingotebi kenyini agine, si kota asemberchi ak ande ng'atateek:
ak ngo i logoek kong'etee nguno, ko myee; ak ngo ma i, iep anyun koluul.’ ”
Ak ki ineetisyei eng' sinagogit age eng' peetuutap sabato.
Ak ogeero, kobogoryot age ne ki tinyei tamirmiryet ne po nyalulet kenyiisyek taman ak sisiit; ak kigarigak, ak ki ma kota komuuchi kochuulgei agot kitigin.
Ak kingo keer `Jeso ineendet, koguur ak koleenji, “Kobogoryondoni, kagityachin eng' nyaluleng'ung'.”
Ak ki igonoor eunekyik ineendet, kochuulak sainooto ak kolas Kamuktaindet.

Ki nereech anyun pounindetap sinagogit, amu ki isoop `Jeso chiito eng' peetuutap sabato, ak komwachi tuiyet koleenji, “Miitei peetuusyek lo che nyolu koboisyee piik; obwa anyun eng' peetuusyechooto si kisaabok, ama eng' peetuutap sabato.”
Ago ki wolji Kiptaiyat, koleenji, “Okweek chombilik, tos ma yaatei age tugul eng' okweek eitonyi anan sigiryennyi eng' piiy eng' peetuutap sabato, ak kokweri koe peek?
Ak kobogoryondoni, ne cheptap Abraham, ne ki korat Setani kenyisyechu taman ak sisiit, tos manyol kityaach eng' ratuutyoni eng' peetuutap sabato?”
Ak ye kingo ta komwaei tuguuchu, kolilaanso puunikyik tugul: ago kiboiboitu tuiyet komugul agobo tuguuk che torooreen che ki yaei ineendet.
Ki mwa anyun, kole, “Kergei laitornatetap Kamuktaindet ak nee? Ak tos aroge nee?
Kergei ak keswootap karadali, ne ki nam chiito, ak komiinji mbareennyi; ak ki piit, agoi koek keetit; ak ki tebee toriitik che po parak mooriikyik.”
Ak ki mwa kogeny kole, “Aroge nee laitornatetap Kamuktaindet?
Kergei ak mermereek, che ki nam kobogoryot, ak koburukto peek che ng'ootiin che po kitongok somok, agoi kogut tugul.”
Ak kibunoot nganasook che eecheen ak che mengech, koneetisyoti, kobunei ooreet ne wendi Jerusalem.
Ak ki leenji chiito age, Kiptaiyat, tos ng'ering' che tuun kisaru? Ak ki leenji,
Ogiilgei obun kurgeet ne mariich: amu amwaiwok ale, cheeng'ei tuun che chaang' kobun yooto, ago ma tuun imuuchi.
Ak ye tuun kang'eet chiitap ko po koot, ak koger kurgeet, ak otau anyun otononse eng' saang', ak ogonygony kurgeet, ole, “Kiptaiyat, yaatwech.” Ak kowolwok ineendet kole, “Mangenok, ak ole obunu.”
Otau anyun ole, “Ki kiamisyei ak ki kiee eng' taing'ung', ak ki ineetisyei eng' ortinwekyok.”
Ak tuun mwaei kole, “Mangen ole obunu; oba eng' anee, okweek tugul yaigap tengek!”
Koek anyun riirek ak nyeetap kelek, ye tuun ogeer Abraham, ak Isak, ak Jakobo, ak maotik tugul, eng' laitornatetap Kamuktaindet, ak kewiirchok okweeget saang'.
Ak tuun pwoonei kobunu kong'asiis ak cherongo, ak murot kaataam ak murot tai, ak kotep ng'wony koamis eng' laitornatetap Kamuktaindet.
Ak ogeero, mi che po let che tuun egu che po tai, ak miitei che po tai che tuun egu che po let.
Ki pwa Pharisaik alak eng' sainooto ak koleenji, “Ng'eet mande, ui eng' oli, amu machei kobarin Herod.”
Ak ki leenji icheek, “Oba omwachi lelwandonooto, oleenji: ‘Keero, aoone oik ak asoobi piik rani ak mutai, ak eng' peetuutap somok abegechi.
Ago kanyool awo pandanyu rani ak mutai ak peetuut ne po somok: amu ma nyooljin komechi maotyondo oldo age kobatee Jerusalem.’
“Ee, Jerusalem, Jerusalem, inyee ne ibare maotik, ak ilage koik che kiyogun! Ki amach konyil ata ayum lagoguk, ko uu ngokyet ne iyumjin aarekyik kebebaikyik, ago ki ma ocham!
Ogeero, kagebagakwok koonng'wong' koek kipkuubere: ak amwaiwok ale, Maogeera, agoi tuun ole, ‘Iberuurot ne nyoonei eng' kainetap Kiptaiyat.’ ”
Ak ye kingwo kootap age eng' pounik che po Pharisaik eng' peetuutap sabato, si koamis, koriibot icheek ineendet.
Ak ogeero, ki mi chii tainnyi ne ki lolosenot poorto.
Ak ki wolji Jeso ng'amotigap ng'atuutik ak Pharisaik, koleenji, Tos chamdaat eng' ng'atuutik kisoop chii eng' peetuutap sabato, anan achicha?
Ago ki siisyo. Ak ki nam ineendet ak kosoop, ak kounda kwo.
Ak koleenji icheeget, Ng'oo eng' okweek ne tinyei sigiryet anan eito ne kagobutyi keriinget, ama sutu sainooto amu peetuutap sabato?
Ak ki mata komuuch anyun kowolji ineendet kogeny agobo tuguuchuuto.
Ak ki mwachi kalewenet che kiga kiguur, ye kingo keer ole lewendoi ng'echerok che po tai; koleenji icheek,
Ye kaguurchin chii age tugul igoortap katunisyet, ko metebee ng'echereet ne po tai; amu abeere kagiguur age ne konyitot kosiirin,
si ye nyo ineendet ne kaguurok okweek tuwai, komwaun kole, istochigei chiichi; itau anyun iwe ole po let eng' kalilanet.
Ago ye kiguurin, itebee olo po let; ak ye nyo anyun ne kaguurin, komuuchi koleenjin, Chorwani, ui oliin po tai: inyooru anyun teegisto eng' che oamisyei tugul.
Amu age tugul ne itoroorigei kiming'ini; ak ineendet ne iming'inegei kitoroori.

Ki mwachi anyun chiichooto kiga kuurso agine, koleenji, “Ye ichop amitwogik che po peet anan che po koskoleny, ko mat iguur choronoguk, anan che otupche, anan tilyonutiguk, anan mogoreek che po kokwet; abeere tos kuurin ak icheek, ak koweegun cheguuk.
Ago ye ichop igoorto, iguur kibananook, ak che po mugungon, ak che ing'waldos, ak che koryotiin:
si kiberuurin; amu ma tinyei icheeget che weegun: amu tuun kiweegun eng' ng'eetyeetap che po iman.”
Ak kingo kas tuguuchuuto chiito age ne ki mi kobooto ineendet eng' amisyet, koleenji, “Paibai ineendet ne tuun amisyei eng' pounatetap Kamuktaindet.”
Ago ki leenji, “Ki chop chiito age amitwogik che chaang' che po koskoleny; ak koguur piik che chaang':
ak ki iyookto otwogindennyi eng' saitap amitwogik, koguur che kiga kemwachi, koleenji, ‘Obwa; amu kagochobogis tuguuk tugul.’
Ak kotoi tugul eng' mageet agenge komwa kiit ne karaany. Ki leenji chiito ne po tai, ‘Kaal mbareet, kanyolja awo ageer: asoomin ale nyoiywo kaat.’
Kole age, ‘Kaal eiik taman che po chogit, kawe atyem icheek: asoomin ale nyoiywo kaat.’
Kole age, ‘Kaatunisye, nooto anyun ma muuchi anyo.’

Konyo anyun otwogindonooto, ak kotetyi kiptaiyandennyi ng'aleechuuto tugul. Konereech anyun chiitap ko po koot, ak koleenji otwogindennyi, ‘Ui chaakte ortinwek che eecheen ak che mengeechen che po nganaseet, ak imutu yu kibananook, ak che po mugungon ak che koryotiin ak che ing'waldos.’
Ak ki le otwogindonooto, ‘Kiptaiyat, kagoyaak kiit ne kageng'at, ago ta komi poroindo.’
Koleenji anyun kiptaiyat otwogindennyi, ‘Ui ortinwek che eecheen ak kiwotosyegap mbareenik, ak ichiich kobwa ko, si konyi koonnyu.
Amu amwaiwok ale, ma mi agot agenge eng' che kiga kemwachi ne chamchami amitwogikyuk.’ ”
Ak ye kingo ta kobendi inee ak tuiyosyek che chaang', kowelelgei ak koleenji,
“Ngo nyoonjo chii, ama wech kwanda, ak kamet, ak osotyonnyi, ak lagokyik, ak weeriik che tupcho, ak chepkametinik, ee ak saboondanyi agine, koma imuuchi koek kasubindennyu.
Ak chii age tugul ne ma ibei kimurtoiyondennyi, ak kosubwo, koma imuuchi koek kasubindennyu.
Amu ng'oo eng' okweek, ne machei koteech koot ne kooi, ama toi kotep ng'wony korook ak koiit tuguuk, ngo tinyei che yamei kogesune koot?
Si ma ye kagotonon lumeiywot, ak koma komuuch kogees, kotoi kochurachur ineendet tugul che keerei,
kole, ‘Ki toi chiichi koteekso ago ma imuuch kogees.’

“Anan ng'oo laitoryat ne wendi kobaregei ak laitoryat age, ama tep ng'wony korook ak korar ole teptoi, ngo tos imuuchi ineendet ak piik eliphuusyek taman kotuiyo ak ne setyin ineendet ak piik eliphuusyek tiptem?
Anan, ye ta komi age ole loo, koyookto ng'olyoot, si koteep agobo kaalyeet.
Nooto anyun, chii age tugul eng' okweek ne ma pagaaktoi tuguukyik tugul, koma imuuchi koek kasubindennyu.
“Myachen muunyuk: ago ngo kagogeskei anyinyindanyi, kota ki anyinyee nee?
Ma kotilei kiy eng' emet anan eng' kapng'atat: kilaktoi. Ineendet ne tinyei iitiik che kastoe, kogas.”
Ak kiriikyi ineendet taagigap aisuruut tugul ak kiptengeginik si kobiit kogas ineendet.
Ak ki ing'unyng'ung'so Pharisaik ak siriik, kole, “Taachei chiichi kiptengeginik, ak koamisyei tugul.”
Ak ki mwachi icheek kalewenoni, koleenji,
Ng'oo chii eng' okweek, ne tinyei keechiirek pogol, ak ngo pet agenge eng' chooto, ko tos ma pagaaktoi chooto tamanwogik sogool ak sogool eng' surkwen, ak kwo kocheeng'at nooto kabet, agoi konyoor?
Ak ye kigonyoor, konde tigikyennyi, ak kobaibait.
Ak ye kagoit kaa, koguur choronokyik kobooto piigap kokwennyi koyumgei, ak koleenji, “Ongeboiboitu tugul, amu kaanyooru keechiiryennyu ne koga pet.”
Amwaiwok ale, egu ko uu nooto tuun agine poiboiyet eng' kipsengwet agobo kiptengekyot agenge ne kasik, ne siirei piik che po iman tamanwogik sogool ak sogool, che ma mage kiy siguunet.
Ng'oo kobogoryot ne tinyei fedhaisyek taman, ak ngo pet fedhaiyat agenge, kotos ma inaami tait ak kobuch koot, ak kocheeng' miising' agoi konyoor?
Ak ye kagonyoor, koguur anyun choronokyik kobooto piigap kokwennyi koyumgei ak kole, “Ongeboiboitu tugul, amu kaanyooru fedhaiyandennyu ne koga kobet.”
Uu nooto anyun, amwaiwok ale, mi poiboiyet eng' taitap malaikaisyegap Kamuktaindet eng' kiptengekyot agenge ne kasik.
Ak ki mwa kole, “Ki mi chii anum ne ki tinyei weeriik aeng'.
Ki leenji weeriit ne ming'in kwandanyi, Abba, koono tuguuk che ka tatun punjino. Ak kipchechi icheek tuguukyik.
Ak kingo pata peetuusyek che matya koyum weerooto ming'in tuguukyik tugul, ak kwo emet ne loo; kwo koserser eng' olooto tuguukyik eng' atepto ne ya.
Ak kingo kagogesta tugul, konyo rubeet ne oo emonooto; kotoi anyun kobanan.
Ak ki wo kogakta chiito age ne po emonooto; ak ki iyookto kwo koyaga toorook eng' mbareet.
Ak kimachei miising' kole kobiyo meteteek che ki amei toorook: amu ma igoochi chii kiy.
Ak kingo pwaat, komwa kole, ‘Tya otwogik che po abba che tinyei amitwogik che yamei kot kosiir, ago anee, ko kabara rubo eng' yu!
Ang'eete ak awe kap Abba aleenji, Abba, ki achalwogenji kipsengwet ak ki achalwogen eng' taing'ung':
ma ko nyoljino kota keguureno weeriing'ung': ingaek ko uu age eng' otwogiguk.’
Ki ng'eet anyun kwo kapkwandanyi. Ago, ye kita komi ole loo, kogeer ineendet kwandanyi, ak koriiree ineendet, ak kilabat kwo kosuup kaatit, ak kong'utut.
“Ak ki leenji weeriit, Abba, ki achalwogenji kipsengwet, ak ki achalwogen eng' taing'ung': ma ko nyoljino kota keguureno weeriing'ung'.
Ago ki leenji kwanda otwogikyik, Oibu ochogune ngoryeet ne karaaran ne siirei tugul, ak olaakyi; ak ondechi peteiyot mornennyi, ak olaakyi kweonik:
ak ogetu moita ne neraat, ak oeny, si keam, ak keboiboitu:
amu weeriinnyu ni, ne kiga kome, ago kagosap kogeny; kiga kobet, ak kagobiit. Ki toi anyun koboiboitu.
“Ak ki mi weeriinnyi ne oo mbar: ak kingo riik ye neegit koot, kogas cheetap tyendo ak ureryet.
Ak kiguur age eng' otwogik, ak koteebe kole, nee tuguuchu.
Ak ki leenji, ‘Kagoit ng'eetap kamenng'ung'; ak kagoeng'ji kwandang'ung' moita ne neraat, amu kagotaach ineendet kochamegei.’
Ago kinereech, ak ki eesyo kwo ko: ak ki mong' saang' kwandanyi, kogaigai.
Ago ki wolji kwandanyi koleenji, Keero, ki aootin eng' kenyisyechu chaang', ama abut ng'atuutyeng'ung': ak ki ma igoono arwa, si keboiboitu ak choronokyuk:
ago ye ka ngo nyo weeriitang'ung'et, ne kigoam tuguuguk ak chepkugonik, ieng'ji anyun moita ne neraat.
Ak ki leenji, ‘Weeri, kimi tuwai kotugul, ak tuguukyuk tugul ko cheguuk.
Ago kanyoolu keboiboitu ak kigaske: amu kiga kome weeri otupche, ago kagosap kogeny; kiga kobet, ago kagobiit.’ ”
Ak ki leenji ineendet kasubikyik kogeny, ki mi chii anum ne ki mogoryo, ne ki tinyei riibindet ne kitononjin koonnyi; ak ki kimwaita chiichooto eng' tainnyi keele, iserseri tuguugap mogoryondonooto.
Ak kiguur ineendet koleenji, “Nee ni agase agobo inyee? Koonu koitetap riipseng'ung'; amu ma iegu riibindet kogeny.”
Ak ki le riibindonooto eng' muguleldanyi, Ayae nee anyun, amu kagoistaa kiptaiyandennyu eng' poisyet? Ama tinye kimnateet ne abatisye; ak ngale, Asoomso, alilani.
Kaanai kiit ne ayae, si ye kageona eng' poisyet, kotaacha eng' kooriikwak.
Ak kingo kuur age tugul eng' pesenigap kiptaiyandennyi, koleenji ne po tai, Ki ibesen ata tuguugap kiptaiyandennyu?
Kole, Tereenik pogol che po mwanik. Ak ki leenji, Nam kartasing'ung', ak itep ng'wony si isir konom, ichokyi.
Yeityo koleenji age, Ki ibesen ata inyee? Kole, Tereenik pogol che po nganuuk. Koleenji, Nam kartasing'ung', si isir tamanwogik sisiit.
Ak ki ichoi kiptaiyandennyi otwogindonooto ki ma ko po imanda amu kayai eng' ng'ulaatyet: amu ng'ulaatiin weeriigap ng'wonyuni eng' ibindanywa kosiir weeriigap lapkeiyet.
Ak amwaiwok ale, Oyachigei choronok eng' ooreetap mogornatosyek che ma po imanda; si ye tuun igeskei, ko tuun kotaachak eng' kooriik che po koigeny.
Ineendet ne kiyani eng' che ng'ering', kiyani agine eng' che chaang': ak ineendet ne ma kiyani eng' che ng'ering' koma kiyani agot eng' che chaang'.
Uu nooto anyun, ngo ki ma oegu che kiyani eng' mogornatosyek che ma po imanda, ko ng'oo ne tos iyanak eng' mogornatosyek che po imanda?
Ak ngo ki mata oegu che kiyani eng' tuguugap chiito age, ko tos ng'oo anyun ne koonok tuguuk che chekwok?
Ma mi otwogindet ne imuuchi koot kiptainik aeng': amu tos wech age, ak kocham age; anan konamgei ak age, kosas age. Momuuchi oot Kamuktaindet ak mogornateet.
Ak ki kas Pharisaik tuguuchuuto tugul. Ki chamei silingisyek icheeget, ak kororechi ineendet.
Ak ki leenji, “Okweget che omyeeitige eng' taitap piik; ago ingen Kamuktaindet mugulelwekwok: amu kiit ne itoroori piik ko wegot miising' eng' taitap Kamuktaindet.”
Ki tebi Ng'atuutyetap Musa ak kaneetisyosyegap maotik agoi koit Johana: kobooch peetuunooto keamdoi logoiywek che myach che po laitornatetap Kamuktaindet, ak komong'jin chii tugul eng' kimnateet.
Ago nyumnyum kosiirto kipsengwet ak ng'wony, kosiir kobut siruutyet agenge ne po Ng'atuutik.
Age tugul ne oonei osotyonnyi, ak kotun age, ko kabaigei: ak chiito ne ituni ineendet ne ki koon manong'otyot ko kabaigei.
Ak ki mi chii anum ne ki mogoryo ne ki ilaachi ngoroik che arusen ne piriir, ak che po katanit ne karaaran, ak kibaibai peetuut age tugul, ak kotalbisi:
ak ki mi kibanania ne ki kiguure Lazaro ne ki kimogoni eng' kurgennyi, ak ki nyiitaat mook poortanyi,
ak kimachei kebae tuguuk che ibutos eng' meesetap mogoryondonooto; ee, ki pwa agot sesenik ak komel mookyik.
Ak kime kibananiandanooto peetuut age, komut ineendet malaikaisyek konde tegetap Abraham: ak kime agine mogoryondonooto, ak ki kitup.
Ak ye ki mi ye mi che ki kobek konyal parak, komi nyalilda ne oo, kogeer Abraham komi ole loo, komi Lazaro tegeennyi.
Ak ki ite kole, “Abba Abraham, rireena, ak iyoogu Lazaro, koting'e peek walitap mornennyi, si kotiswa ng'elyeptanyu, amu ami ng'wanindo miising' eng' mai lalei.”

Ago ki le Abraham, “Weeri, ibwaat ile kingo ta isabe ko ki inyooru tuguuguk che myach, ki uu nooto Lazaro, kinyooru tuguuk che yaach: ago nguno kigoigoi ineendet eng' yu, ago inyee, imi ng'wanindo ne oo.
Ak ne siirei chu tugul, ko ki kinde chemng'eisut ne oo ne ioitoseech acheek ak okweek, si che machei kolong' olo omi koma imuuchi, ak che machei kolong' ole ki mi koma imuuchi.”
Ak ki le, “Asaain anyun, abba, ale, iyookte ineendet kwo ye mi abba;
amu atinye che kitupche muut; kwo koteechi icheek, si ma pwa ole mi nyalilda ne oo.”
Ak ki leenji Abraham, “Tinyei icheek Musa ak maotik; ingogas icheek.”
Ago ki le, “Achicha, abba Abraham: ago ngot kwo chii ole mi icheek ne punei ye mi che ki kobek, kosigu.”
Ak ki leenji, “Ngot koma kas Musa ak maotik, koesyoi koyan agot chiito ne ng'eetei eng' che ki kobek.”
Ki leenji kasubikyik anyun, “Pwoonei kanagutik matiny: ago pwo! Eng' chiichooto punu!
Kita kaigai eng' ineendet kirooch kaatinnyi koitap pai ne oo ak kewiirchi araraita, kosiir ye inachi age eng' chu mengech.
Oriipkei: ngo chiliilun ne otupche, iger kong'; ak ngo sik, inyochi kaat.
Ak ngo chalwogenjin konyil tisap eng' peetuut agenge, ak ngo week ole imi konyil tisap koleen, Kaasigu; inyochi kaat.”
Ak ki leenji che kiyooktoi Kiptaiyat, Teswech kayanennyo.
Ak ki le Kiptaiyat, Ndotinye kayaneet ne uu keswootap karadali, ko ye omwachi mogoywoni, oleenji, Kitutin, ak keminin eng' araraita; kogasook iit.
Ago mi ng'oo eng' okweek ne tinyei otwogindet ne ibatisyei anan ne iyagi keechiirek, ne leenjin ye kait kobunu mbar, “Nyoo tebi ng'wony iamisye?”
Tos ma kaigai koleenji ineendet, Chobwa tuguuk che aame, kermenge ak iboisyeiwo, agoi aamisye ak aeeise; si yeityo iamisye ak ieeise aginye?
Tos weekyin otwogindonooto kongoi amu kayai tuguuk che kagaging'at?
Uu nooto tuun ak okweek, ye kaoyai tuguuk tugul che kaging'atak, omwa ole, Ki otwogik che ma tilei kiy; kageyai che kanyooljinech keyai.
Ak ye ki mi ooreet kowendi Jerusalem, kobun kwenutap Samaria ak Galilaya.
Ak kingo mong'ji nganaseet age, kotuiyo ak murenik taman che ki tinyei mogondosaik, che kitonondos eng' ole loo:
ak kiwaach kole, “Jeso Kiptaiyat, rirenech.”
Ak kingo keer icheek, koleenji, “Oba oboorchigei tisiik.” Ak ye kingap kaba, kotiliiliitu.
Ak kingo keer age eng' icheek kole kagosap, koweek, kolasunonu Kamuktaindet eng' kutit ne oo;
ak ki ibutyi keelyekyik koweekyi kongoi; ak ki Samarindet chiichooto.
Ak ki wol Jeso kole, “Kama kitiliil taman? Ago mi ano chugai sogoolu?
Tos ma piit agot agenge ne kaweek kogoochi kalasunet Kamuktaindet, kobatee toondoni?
Ak koleenji ineendet, Ng'eet, si iwe: kagosaabin kayaneng'ung'.”
Ak kingo teebee Pharisaik kole “Nyoonei au laitornatetap Kamuktaindet”, kowolji icheek koleenji, “Ma nyoonei laitornatetap Kamuktaindet kegeeronu:
ama kimwaei keele, Ogeero, mi oli! Anan mi oliin! Amu, ogeero, mi laitornatetap Kamuktaindet kwenung'wong'.”
Ak ki leenji kasubikyik, Tuun pwoonei peetuusyek, che tuun omache ogeer peetuut agenge ne po Weeriitap chii, ak mogeere.
Ak tuun leenjinok, Ogeero, mi oliin! Ogeero, mi oli! Amat obe, anan osup icheek:
amu uu kalyeleet, ne ilyelune komosta age eng' kipsengwet, ak kooluu agoi komosta age ne po kipsengwet; tuun uu nooto Weeriitap chii agine eng' peetuunnyi.
Ago kanyool konyalil eng' tuguuk che chaang' ak koeesyo ineendet ibini.
Ak ko uu ole ki piitunda eng' peetuusyegap Noah, ko tuun uu nooto eng' peetuusyegap Weeriitap chii.
Ki amisyei, kieisei, kiitunisyei, ak ki igoitoi kitun, agoi peetuut ne ki wo Noah moinget oriit, ak ki nyo maraneet, ak kobar tugul.
Uu nooto agine, ole ki piitunda peetuusyegap Lot; ki amisyei, kieisei, ki alisyei, ki aldaisyei, ki koolsei, ak kiteeksei;
ago eng' peetuut ne kimanda Lot eng' Sodom koroobon maat ak koik che laldos che ki punu kipsengwet, ak kobar tugul:
uu nooto eng' peetuut ne kibooru Weeriitap chii.
Eng' peetuunooto, ko mat kochoorgei ineendet ne mi koot parak, koip tuguukyik che mi ko; amat koweek agine ineendet ne mi mbar.
Obwaat osotyotap Lot.
Age tugul ne cheeng'ei kosar saboondanyi kobeeti: ak age tugul ne ibeeti saboondanyi koriibei.
Amwaiwok ale, Tuun ruitos piik aeng'u eng' itoogut agenge eng' kemounooto; kimuti age, kebagaakta age.
Tuun ng'oisei kobogorisyek aeng'u kibagenge; kimuti age, kebagaakta age.
Tuun mi piik aeng'u mbar: kimuti age, kebagaakta age.
Ak ki wolji ineendet koleenji, “Ano, Kiptaiyat?” Ak ki leenji, Ole mi muusto, koyumjingei olooto motong'wek ak icheek.
Ki mwachi anyun kalewenet kole, Kanyool kosa peetuusyek tugul, amat chorirenso;
koleenji, “Ki miitei nganaseet age kirwoogindo ne ki ma koywei Kamuktaindet, ak ki ma koiti chii:
ak ki mi mosoget age nganasanooto; ne kinyonei ole mi kotugul, koleen, ‘Ibesyeiwo kirwooget ne po iman eng' punyondennyu.’
Ak ki eesyo eng' peetuusyek alak: ago eng' let, komwa eng' oriitinnyi kole, ‘Agot ngo ma ywei Kamuktaindet, amaiiti chii;
ago amu inyalila mosogani, abesyechini anyun, si ma konyonei kotugul koiima.’ ”
Ak ki le Kiptaiyat, “Ogas kiit ne ki mwa kirwoogindet ne ma po imanda.
Tos ma yachin Kamuktaindet imanda che lewenotin, che riirchin ineendet peet ak kemoi, ak muitoi ineendet eng' icheek?
Amwaiwok ale, yachin ineendet icheek imanda kochokyin. Ago ye tuun nyo Weeriitap chii, ko tos nyooru kayaneet eng' ng'wony?”
Ak ki mwachi kogeny kalewenoni alak che ki imang'ugei kole, ki po imanda, ak kosasei piik tugul,
koleenji, “Ki togosta piik aeng'u Hekaluut koba kosa; Pharisaindet age, ko taagindetap aisuruut age.
Ki tonon Pharisaindet kosa kong'alaal ineegei kole, ‘Kamuktaindet, amwaun kongoi, amu ma ki kergei ak piik alak, che rebiik, che ma po iman, che ibegei, anan taagindoni po aisuruut.
Arugutige konyil aeng' eng' wigiit; agoitoi kebeberta ne po taman eng' tuguuk tugul che anyooru.’
Ago ki tonon taagindetap aisuruut eng' ye loo, ak ma cham agot konyal kipsengwet, ago kiluch tegeennyi, kole, ‘Kamuktaindet, rireena, aa kiptengekyo.’
Amwaiwok ale, kichoortagei chiichooto koonnyi ko kagoek ne po imanda kosiir nin age: amu chii age tugul ne itoroorigei kiming'ini; ak age tugul ne iming'inigei ko tuun kitoroori.”
Ak ki imutyi `piik ineendet manyurunik, si kobiit kotwa icheek: ago ye kingo keer kasubik, koger kong'.
Ago kiguur Jeso icheek kobwonji, ak koleenji, “Ochamji lagok che mengech kobwanjo, amat oete: amu po che uu chu laitornatetap Kamuktaindet.
Amwaiwok iman ale, Age tugul ne mataachei laitornatetap Kamuktaindet ko uu lakweet ne ming'in, koma koi mong'ji olooto matiny.”
Ak ki teebe ineendet pounindet age, kole, “Kaneetindoni myee, ayai nee si kobiit anyoor saboondap koigeny?”
Ak ki leenji Jeso, “Amu nee si iguureno ne myee? Ma mi ne myee, kobatee agenge, nooto ko Kamuktaindet.
Ingen ng'atuutik: ‘Amoipkei, Amerumisye, Amechoorse, Amebaoryan lembech, teech kwandang'ung' ak kamenng'ung'.’ ”
Ak ki le, “Ki ariip tuguuchuuto tugul kobooch ko aa neran.”
Ak ye kingo kas Jeso, koleenji, “Ta ko rartaat kiit agenge eng' inyee: alde tugul che itinye, ak ipchechi kibananook, si inyooru konorwet eng' kipsengwet: ak inyoo, isubwo.”
Ago ye kingo kas ineendet tuguuchu, koaragen miising'; amu ki mogoryo kot.
Ak kingo keer `Jeso ineendet, komwa kole, “Pichii ne tya eng' che tinyei mogornatosyek komong'ji laitornatetap Kamuktaindet!
Amu nyumnyum eng' tambeesyet kochut kondap sindanut, kosiir komong'ji mogoryot laitornatetap Kamuktaindet.”
Ki mwa anyun che ki kasei, kole, “Ng'oo anyun ne kesaru?”
Ki le, “Tuguuk che ma imugaksei eng' piik komugaksei eng' Kamuktaindet.”
Kole Petero, “Keero, kigebagaakte tuguukyok, ak kisubun!”
Ak ki leenji icheek, Amwaiwok iman ale, Ma mi chii ne ki pagaakta koot, anan osotyot, anan che tupcho, anan sigiik, anan lagok, agobo laitornatetap Kamuktaindet,
ne ma nyooru che chaang' kosiir eng' peetuusyechu, ak saboondap koigeny eng' peetuusyek che tuun pwoonei.
Ak ki imut taman ak aeng' kobwa ole mi, ak koleenji, “Ogeero, kitogostoi Jerusalem, ak kosulda tuguuk tugul che kisir maotik agobo Weeriitap chii.
Amu kindoi ineendet eunegap Pororyosyek, si kechurachur, ak kiteweer, ak kesing'ilji:
ak kobire kipchoritiit, ak kobar: ak kong'eet kogeny eng' peetuutap somok.”
Ak ki ma iguiyo icheeget tuguuchuuto, agot agenge; ak kiung'ak mwaoniito eng' icheek, ak ki ma ibesyo tuguuk che kiga kimwa.
Ak kingo riikyi Jeriko, ko kitebyei ng'wony kipkoratya eng' ooreet taban kosoomsei:
ak kingo kas kosiirtoi tuiyet, koteep kole, “Nee chu?”
Ak ki mwachi icheek ineendet koleenji, “Jeso ne po Nazareth ne siirtoi.”
Ak kiwaach, kole, “Jeso, Weeriitap Daudi, rireena.”
Ak ki kergong' ineendet anyun che ki indoi, kole kosiis: ago kites kowaach miising' kole, “Weeriitap Daudi, rireena.”
Ak ki tonon Jeso, ak kong'at kimut ineendet kwo ole mi: ak ye kiga riik, koteebe ineendet,
kole, “Imache ayaun nee?” Ak ki le, “Kiptaiyat, amache ageerto.”
Ak ki leenji Jeso, “Keerte: kagosaabin kayaneng'ung'.”
Ki keerto anyun koma tyanit, ak koosup ineendet, kolasunoti Kamuktaindet: ak kingo keer tuiyet komugul, kogonyit Kamuktaindet.
Kimong'ji anyun Jeriko ak kobun kwenut.
Ak ogeero, chiito ne kiguure Zakayo; ak ki ne oo ineendet eng' taagigap aisuruut, ak ki mogoryo.
Ak ki cheeng'ei kole kogeer Jeso si konai kole ng'oo ineendet; ago ki ma imuuch amu tuiyet, amu ki nwach.
Ak ki labat kondo, kwo kolaany mogoywet si kogeer ineendet: amu ki nyo kosiirtoe oranooto.
Ak ye kingo it Jeso yooto, konyal keetoto, ak koleenji, “Zakayo, chooruge, chogu; amu kanyolja aru koong'ung' ra.
Ak ki chook, kochoorgei, ak kotaach ineendet eng' poiboiyet.
Ak ye kingo keer pichooto, kong'unyng'ung'so tugul, kole, ‘kawo kotebi eng' kootap chiito ne kiptengekyo.’
Ak ki tonon Zakayo, ak koleenji Kiptaiyat, Keero, Kiptaiyat, agoochini kibananook kebebertap tuguukyuk; ak ngo ki aibe chii age tugul kiy eng' ng'aalseet, aweekyini konyil ang'wan.
Ak ki leenji Jeso, Kagonyo yetunet rani kooi, amu weeriitap Abraham agine ineendet.
Amu ki nyo Weeriitap chii kocheeng' ak kosar ne kiga kobet.”
Ak ye kingo ta kogasei icheek tuguuchu, kotes komwa kalewenet, amu ki neegit Jerusalem, ak ki ibwaati icheeget koleen taagu laitornatetap Kamuktaindet sainooto.
Ki mwa anyun kole, “Ki wo chii anum ne tagunoot emet ne loo, kwo konam pounateet kobunji, ak koweek.
Yeityo koguur otwogikyik taman, ak kogoochi fedhaisyek taman, ak koleenji, Oboisyee agoi tuun aitu.
Ago kiwech ineendet piigap emennyi, koyookto ng'olyoot kosube ineendet, kole, ‘Ma kimache chiichi koboiywech.’
“Ak ye kingo week kogeny, ko kagonam pounateet, kong'at keguur otwogichooto, chu kiga kigoochi fedhaisyek, kobwa ole mi ineendet, si kobiit konai che kinyoor pichooto eng' poisyet.
Ak ki nyo tainnyi chiito ne po tai, kole, ‘Kiptaiyat, ki konyoor fedhaiyandeng'ung' fedhaisyek alak taman.’
Ak ki leenji ineendet, Ki iyai ne myee, otwogindoni myee: amu ki iegu ne kiyani eng' kiit ne ming'in miising', pou nganasook taman.
Ak ki nyo ne po aeng', kole, ‘Kiptaiyat, kigonyoor fedhaiyandeng'ung' fedhaisyek muut alak.’
Ak ki leenji nooto agine, ‘Pou nganasook muut aginye.’
“Ak ki nyo age, kole, ‘Kiptaiyat, keero, ineni fedhaiyandeng'ung' ne kigaratyi angeet ak agonor:
amu ki aiywein, amu ii chii ne kolgol: inemu ne ki ma inde ng'wony, ak igese che ki ma igol.’
Koleenji anyun ineendet, Arwoogun agobo ne kemwa eng' kuting'ung', otwogindoni ya. Ki ingen ile aa chii ne kolgol, anemu ne ki ma ande ng'wony, ak agese che ki ma agool;
kilya anyun si mende fedhaisyekyuk ole kiwalawale, ta kaanyooru ko kaitu kobooto che kitesak?
Ak ki mwachi icheek che kitonondos eng' ye neegit, koleenji, ‘Orebe ineendet fedhaiyat, ak ogoochi ineendet ne tinyei fedhaisyek taman.
Ak ki leenji icheek ineendet, Kiptaiyat, tinyei ineendet fedhaisyek taman.
Amwaiwok ale, chii age tugul ne tinyei, kigoochin; ago ineendet ne ma tinyei, kerebe agot ne tinyei.
Ago omutu anyun puunichuchuk kobwa yu, che ma chamei aboi, si obar eng' tainnyu.’ ”
Ak ye kiga komwa ko uu nooto, kwo kondo, kotogostoi Jerusalem.
Ak ye kingo kagoriikta Bethphage ak Bethania, eng' tulweet ne kiguure tulweetap Mseituni, koyookto aeng' che po kasubikyik,
koleenji, “Oba agoi oit nganaseet ne mi taing'wong'; ak ye oit ogeer moitap sigiryet ne rataat, ne tomo kolaany chii: otyach, ak ogetu.
Ak ngo teebenak chii age tugul, kole, ‘Kalya si otyach? Oleenji anyun, Makyingei Kiptaiyat.’ ”
Koba anyun che kagagiyookto, ak konyoor ko uu ye kagamwachi ineendet icheek.
Ak ye kita kotyachi moitap sigiryet, koleenji piigap ko po, Kalya si otyach moitap sigiryet?
Ak ki leenji, “Makyingei Kiptaiyat.”
Ak kiget konyo ole mi Jeso: yeityo koiito ngoroikwak eng' moata po sigiryet, ak koganapchi Jeso parak.
Ak ye kiwendi, koiitoot ngoroikwak eng' ooreet.
Ak kingo riikta tegeiyatap tulweetap Mseituni, kotoi tuiyet tugul ne po kasubik koboiboitu ak kolas Kamuktaindet eng' kutit ne oo agobo poisyonik tugul che po kamuktaet che kiga kogeer;
koleen, Iberuurot Laitoryat ne nyoonei eng' kainetap Kiptaiyat: kaalyeet eng' kipsengwet, ak liilindo eng' ole toroor miising'.
Ak ki leenji Pharisaik alage che po tuiyet ineendet, Kaneetindoni, kergong' kasubiguk.
Ak ki wolji koleenji, “Amwaiwok ale, ngot kosiisyo chu, koboldos koik.”
Ak kingo riik, kogeer nganaseet ak koriirchi,
koleen, Nda kengen eng' peetuuni, agot inyee, tuguuk che po kaalyeet! Ago nguno ko kagoung'ogis eng' konyeguk.
Amu tuun pwonjinin peetuusyek che teechei puuniguk irimeet koyiemin komoswek tugul, ak kogerchin ko eng' komosta age tugul,
ak kowiirchin ng'wony, ak lagoguk che mi oriing'ung'; ama pagaagun agot koita agenge ne mi paragutap age; amu ki ma inai peetuutap rutochineng'ung'.
Ak ki wo Hekaluut oriit, ak kotoi koon komanda che ki aldaisyei,
koleenji icheek, Ki kisir keele, Egu koonnyu kootap saaet: ago kaoyai koek kebeneetap rebiik.
Ak ki ineetisyei peetuut age tugul eng' Hekaluut. Ago ki cheeng' tisiik che eecheen ak siriik ak che taagunotiin eng' piik, kobar ineendet:
ak ma nyoor kiit ne ki imuuchi koyai; amu ki epchin iit piik tugul ineendet miising'.
Ak ye ki ineeti piik eng' peetuut age eng' Hekaluut, ak koamdoi logoiywek che myach, kobwonji ineendet tisiik che eecheen ak siriik kobooto poisyek koche ineendet;
ak ki mwachi ineendet koleenji, “Mwaiwech; iyae tuguuchu kimnateetap ng'oo? Ak ko ng'oo ne kigoonin kimnatoni?”
Ak ki wolji koleenji, “Ateebenok agane teebut; ak omwaiwo:
Kabatisaneetap Johana ko ki punu kipsengwet, anan ki punu piik?”
Ak ki ng'alaaljigei icheegei, kole, “Ngot kemwa keele, Ki punu kipsengwet; komwa kole, Ko kilya si moyan ineendet?
Ago ngot kemwa keele, Ki punu piik; kolachech piik tugul eng' koik: amu ki iyani icheek kole, ki maotyo Johana.”
Ak ki wol kole, “Ma kingen ole ki punu.”
Ak ki leenji `Jeso icheek, “Agot anee koma mwaiwok kimnateet ne ayae tuguuchu.”
Ak ki toi komwachi piik kalewenoni, kole: Kimin chii sabibuk eng' mbar, ak komanakyi meek, ak kwo emet age kotebi peetuusyek che chaang'.
Ak kingo it peetuut koyookyi otwogindet meechooto, si kobiit kogoochi icheek ineendet logoegap mbaranooto: ago kibir meek ineendet ak koon kwo puch.
Ak ki iyookto kogeny otwogindet age: ak kibir nooto agine, ak koteweer, ak koon kwo puch.
Ak ki iyookto kogeny ne po somok: ak ki iguoten agine ak kotoorchi saang'.
Ak ki le chiitap ko po mbareet, Ayai nee anyun? Ayooktoi weeriinnyu chamanennyu: tamangap kogonyit ineendet.
Ago ye kingo keer meek ineendet, kong'alaaljigei icheegei, kole, Niito ne tuun punjin tuguuk: ongebar anyun, si kindii tuguuk.
Ak ki toorta komanda eng' mbareetap sabibuk ak kobar. Itoi nee anyun chiitap ko po mbareet pichooto?
Nyoonei anyun ineendet ak kobar meechooto tugul, ak kogoochi piik alak mbareetap sabibuk. Ak ye kingo kas icheek, komwa kole, “Achicha, mat koek ko uu nooto.”
Ak ki ichiilji kong' icheek ak kole, “Nee anyun ne ki kisir keele, ‘Koita ne ki eesyo teegik, Ki kiyai nooto koek metitap luuita?’
Ak chii age tugul ne ibutyin koyata koilei konyaknyagansei; ak ineendet ne ibutyin koyata, konyirnyiraksei.”
Ak ki cheeng' siriik ak tisiik che eecheen konam ineendet eng' sainooto; ak ki iywei icheek piik: amu ki nai kole mwaei kalewenoni agobo icheek.
Ak kiriibooti icheeget ineendet ak koyookto segeik, che ki yaigei koek che po imanda, si kobiit koname ineendet ng'aleekyik, si kogoito ineendet kwo taitap pounateet ak kimnateetap pounindet.
Ak kiteebe ineendet kole, “Kaneetindoni, kingen keele imwae ak ineetisyei eng' iman, ago metiytiy chii, ak ineeti iman ooreetap Kamuktaindet:
Tos chamdoi ng'atuutik kigoochi kodi Caesarea, anan achicha?”
Ago ki nai ng'aalseennywa, ak koleenji icheek,
Oboorwo dinarit, Po ng'oo itooni ak siruutik che tinyei? Ak ki le, po Caesarea.
Ak ki leenji icheek, Ogoochi Caesarea tuguuk che po Caesarea, ak ogoochi Kamuktaindet tuguuk che po Kamuktaindet.
Ak ki ma imuuch koname mwaonooto eng' taitap piik; ak ki kwong'yo eng' waluunennyi, ak ki siisyo.
Ak ki pwanji ineendet `Sadukaik alak, icheeget che mwaei kole, ma mi ng'eetyeet; ak kiteebe ineendet,
kole, “Kaneetindoni, kisirwech Musa, kole, ‘Ngo me ng'eetap kam, ago tinyei osotyot, ne tomo kosich lakwa, kondii ng'eetap kam osotyondonooto, si kolalji ma ng'eetap kam.’
Ki mi anyun weeriik tisabu che kitupcho: ak kiitunis ne po tai, ak kime ama ki sich lakwa;
ak ki indi ne po aeng';
ak uu nooto ne po somok; ak ki igei nooto tugul ko tisap, ki pek ama sich lakwa.
Ak kingo pata kome agine kobogoryondonooto.
Tuun eng' ng'eetyeet anyun koegu osotyotap ng'oo eng' icheek? Amu kiitun icheek tugul ko tisap.”
Ki leenji `Jeso icheek, “Itunisyei weeriitap peetuusyechu, ak kogoitoi kitun:
ago che kiityin keele nyoljin konyoor peetuusyechooto pwoonei, ak ng'eetyeet eng' che ki pek, koma tuun itunisyei, ama kigoitoi kitun:
amu ma komuuchi kobek agoi: amu kergeitu ak malaikaisyek; ak icheeget ko weeriigap Kamuktaindet, amu weeriitap ng'eetyeet.

Ago ng'eetos che ki kobek, amu ki iboor Musa agine eng' siruutik che tiliileen. Ye ki kisir agobo timdo ne kilolei, ye kiguure Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindetap Abraham, ak Kamuktaindetap Isak, ak Kamuktaindetap Jakobo.
Ineendet koma Kamuktaindet ne po che ki kobek, ago po che saptos; amu saptos tugul eng' ineendet.”
Ak ki wolji siriik alak koleenji, “Kaneetindoni, kaimwa komyee.”
Amu ki mata kogany icheek koteebe ineendet teebut age tugul kogeny.
Ak ki leenji icheek, Teptoi ano si komwaei icheek kole, “Kristo ko weeriitap Daudi?
Amu ki mwa Daudi ineendet eng' bukuitap Tyenwogigap Kalasunet, kole, ‘Ki leenji Kiptaiyat Kiptaiyandennyu, Tebee eunnyu ne po tai,
Agoi ayai puuniguk koek ng'echereetap keelyeguk.’
Kuuree anyun Daudi ineendet Kiptaiyat, koegundoi ano anyun weeriinnyi?”
Ak ki mwachi kasubikyik kogasei piik tugul koleenji,

Oriipkei eng' siriik, che chamei kobendat kolaachi ngoroik che kooen, ak kochamei kagatosyek eng' ole kiyae mung'aaret, ak ng'echerok che po tai eng' sinagogisyek, ak oldinwek che po tai eng' igoorwek;
ak korebe mosoogik kooriikwak, ak kosaaei saautik che kooen kong'aalsei: tuun nyooru chuuto kirwooget ne oo kosiir.
Ak ki keer `Jeso mogoreek kondai kagoochinoikwak ole kiyumjin
ak kogeer mosoget age ne kibanania kondai sendeisyek aeng' che mengech.
Ak ki le, Amwaiwok iman ale, Kagonde mosogani panan che siirei cho tugul:
amu kagonde chu tugul eng' chaang'indonywa ole kindoi kagoochinoik; ago kagonde ineendet eng' panandanyi tugul che tinyei, agot che kosabe.
Ak kingo ta kong'alaali alak agobo Hekaluut, ole ki kimusaganda eng' koik che korooron ak kagoochinoik, kole,
Eng' tuguuchu ogeere, ko tuun pwoonei peetuusyek, che ma ng'etunee koita agot agenge paragutap age, ne ma tuun ki wiirchin ng'wony.
Ak kiteebe, kole, “Kaneetindoni, egu anyun tuguuchuuto auyo? Ak uu nee kaboorunet ye tuun machei koriik kosulda tuguuchuuto?”
Ak ki le, Oriipkei si ma kibeetook: amu tuun pwoonei piik che chaang' eng' kainennyu, koleen, Aa ineendet; ak, Kagoriik peetuusyek: amosup icheek.
Ak ye tuun ogas agobo lugoosyek ak chemargeet, ko matoaragense: amu kanyool kosip kosulda tuguuchooto korook; ago tomo koriik kagesunet.
Koleenji anyun icheek, Tuun setyin pororyet age pororyet age, ak setyin laitornatet age laitornatet age:
ak kobiit potanosyek che eecheen che po ng'wony, ak rubosyek eng' oldinwek alak, ak korotwek; ak kobiit kamuisosyek ak kaboorunoik che eecheen che punu kipsengwet.
Ago ye tomo kobiit chuuto, konamak eng' eunekwak, ak kousok, ak komutak obe sinagogisyek ak korgorosyek, komutak taitap laitorinik ak pounik agobo kainennyu.
Egu paornateet eng' okweek.
Oegu che pegechinotin eng' mugulelwekwok, si mosip ogereer met agobo ole owolundoi:
amu agoonok kutit ak utaatyet, ne ma imuuchi puunikwok tugul kota kowol kiy anan kogirindaak.
Ak kong'wektak sigiikwok, ak che otupche, ak che po oreng'wong', ak choronok; ak kebar alak eng' okweek.
Ak kowechok piik tugul agobo kainennyu.
Ak ma petei sumeiyot agenge ne po metowekwok.
Ak eng' muitaeng'wong' onyooru saboonwekwok.
Ak ye tuun ogeer lugoosyek koyiem Jerusalem, onai anyun ole, kagoriik ng'emisyennyi.
Ingomwechi anyun che mi Judea tuloonook; ak ingomanda che mi kwenutap nganasanooto; ak amat kota koba oriit icheek che mi emonooto.
Amu chuuto ko peetuusyegap mugetuut, si kobiit kosulda tuguuk tugul che ki kisir.
Pwo eng' icheek che chiioo ak che tinyei lagok che reritos eng' peetuusyechooto! Amu piitu pichiindo ne oo eng' ng'wony, ak nereeknateet eng' pichuuto.
Ak kobutyo icheek eng' ng'atibindap rotwetap chok, ak kimut luulenik koba pororyosyek tugul: ak kotyech Pororyosyek Jerusalem, agoi kosulda peetuusyegap Pororyosyek.
Ak kobiit kaboorunoik eng' asiista ak eng' arawet ak eng' kecheik; ak kobiit eng' ng'wony pichiindap pororyosyek, ak peng'jinet amu kamuutetap araraita ak peek che mildogei;
ak kobek mugulelwegap piik amu kaiyweisyet, ak amu kagenisyetap tuguuk che pwaanjin ng'wony: amu kitumdumi kimnatosyegap kipsengwet.
Ak eng' peetuunooto kogeer anyun Weeriitap chii konyonei eng' pooldet kobooto kimnateet ak liilindo ne oo.
Ak ye toi kosulda tuguuchuuto, ogeer parak, ak oyot metowekwok; amu kariik katyageng'wong'.
Ak ki mwachi icheek kalewenet; kole, “Ogeer mogoywet, ak keetiik tugul:
ye ing'atyo ogeere ak onae okweek ole, kariik kesisyet.
Uu nooto anyun ak okweek, ye ogeer koyaagiis tuguuchuuto, onai ole kariik laitornatetap Kamuktaindet.
Amwaiwok iman ale, Masiirtoi ibini, agoi kosulda tuguuk tugul.
Siirtoi kipsengwet ak ng'wony: ago ma koi siirto ng'aleekyuk.
“Ago oriipkei anyun okweek, si ma nyi mugulelwekwok keiyandit, ak pogitet, ak kaimutigap sabeetap peetuusyechu, ak konyonjok peetuunooto kocheak ko uu mesteet:
amu uu nooto tuun nyoonjin piik tugul che menyei ng'wony komugul.
Ago oriipkei eng' peetuut age tugul, ak osaae, si kobiit oterteerisye, ochilile tuguuchuuto tugul pwoonei, ak otononse eng' taitap Weeriitap chii.”
Ak ki ineetisyei eng' Hekaluut peetuut age tugul; ak kimandoi kemout age tugul, kowendi kotebyei eng' tulweet ne kiguure tulweetap Mseituni.
Ak kimusyin piik tugul ineendet eng' Hekaluut, si kobiit kogas ineendet.
Ki riik anyun igoorto ne po magatiinik che ma kinde mermereek, ne kiguure Paska.
Ak ki cheeng' tisiik che eecheen ak siriik ole partoi ineendet; amu ki iywei icheek piik.
Ak kichut Setani Judas ne kiguure Iskaryot, ne ki age eng' taman ak aeng'.
Ak ki wo kong'alaal ak tisiik che eecheen ak kiptainik, ole ng'wektochindoi ineendet icheek.
Kiboiboitu anyun pichooto, ak kochamyechi kogoochi ineendet fedhaisyek.
Kocham anyun ineendet ak kocheeng' poroindo kong'wekyi ineendet icheek eng' ole ma mi piik che chaang'.
Ak kiit anyun peetuut ne po magatiinik che ma kinde mermereek, peetuut ne ki kanyool koeny aarwetap paska.
Ak ki iyookto Petero ak Johana, kole, “Oba ochobwech paska, si kobiit keam.”
Ak ki leenji, “Imache keebe kechop eng' ano?”
Ak ki leenji icheek, “Ogeero, ye omong'ji nganaseet, kotuiyenok chiito ne ibei tereetap peek; osup ineendet agoi koot oriit ole wendi.
Ak omwachji chiitap ko po koot, oleenji, ‘Kateebenen Kaneetindet, kole, Mi ano kootap toek, ole anyoone aame paska kobooto kasubikyuk?’
Koboorwok anyun koot ne oo ne mi parak ne tetotin tuguuk: ochop eng' olooto.”
Ak ki pa anyun, ak konyoor ko uu ye kagagemwachi: ak ki chop paska.
Ak ye kingo it sait, kotep ng'wony, kobooto che kiyooktoi.
Ak ki leenji icheek, “Eng' mageet ko koamach aam paskaini kobootok kotom anyalil;
amu amwaiwok ale, kobooch nguno koma aame agoi kosulda eng' laitornatetap Kamuktaindet.”
Ak ki taach kigombet, ak kingo kagogoito kongoi, kole, “Onam ni, ak opchechigei;
amu amwaiwok ale, kobooch nguno koma aee che po logoegap sabibuk, agoi koit laitornatetap Kamuktaindet.”
Ak ki nam magatyat, ak kingo kagomwa kongoi, kobuutul, ak kogoochi icheek, ak kole, “Ni ko poortanyu ne kigoitoi agobo okweek; oyae ko uu ni si obwaatena.”
Ko uu nooto kigombet agine, kingo kagobata amitwogik che po lagat, kole, “Kigombani ko arorutyet ne leel ne po korotiikyuk, che kitumdoi agobo okweek.
“Ago ogeero, ineendet ne ng'wektoo ko mi eunnyi kobooto eng' mesani.
Amu wendi Weeriitap chii iman, ko uu ye ki king'at; ago pwo eng' chiichooto ng'wektoi ineendet!”
Ak ki toi anyun koteebegei icheegei, kole ng'oo eng' icheek ne yaei kii.
Ki ng'eet anyun tiyet eng' kwenunnywa, kole ng'oo ne kiiti keele ne oo eng' icheek.
Ak ki leenji icheek, Laitorani laitorinik eng' Pororyosyek: ak icheeget che tinyei pounateet eng' icheek keguure Toretik.
Ago, ma uu nooto eng' okweek: ago ingoigei ne oo eng' okweek ne ming'in; ak ineendet ne oo koigei ne otisyei.
Ng'oo ne oo anyun, ineendet ne tebyei eng' amisyet, anan ineendet ne otisyei? Tos ma ineendet ne tebyei eng' amisyet? Ago ami kwenung'wong' ko uu chiito ne otisyei.
Ago okweek ko oo che ki otebi kobooto eng' yoomsosyekyuk;
ak kaagoonok laitornatet, ko uu ye kigogoono Abba,
si kobiit oamisye ak koeise mesennyu eng' laitornatennyu, ak tuun otebee ng'echerok che po laitornatet, orwookyini ortinwek taman ak aeng' che po Israel.
Simion, Simion, keero, kagosoom Setani kole konamak, si kosesak ko uu nganuuk:
ago ki asaa agobo inyee, si ma pek kayaneng'ung': ak ye kaiwalage, igimit che otupche.
Ak koleenji ineendet, Kiptaiyat, kaachoboge keebe tuwai korgoreet agot meet.
