nooto Kabuuset ne Tiliil ne po imanit, ne ma imuuchi ng'wony kotaach; amu ma keerei ineendet, ama naei ineendet: ago ongen ineendet: amu tebyei kobootok, ak tuun tebyei eng' oriing'wong'.
Ma pagaaktook ko uu kibananook: anyonjinok.
Ta komi kitigin, si ma kogeero ng'wony; ago ogeera: amu asabe, osaptosi ak okweek.
Eng' peetuunooto onai ole ami eng' Abba, ak okweek eng' anee, ak anee eng' okweek.
Ineendet ne tinyei ng'atuutikyuk, ak koriibei, ko nooto ne chama: ak ineendet ne chama kochamaat eng' Abba, ak achame ineendet ak ang'aang'jigei ineendet.
Koleenji `Judas (ma Iskaryot), Kiptaiyat, kalya si ing'ang'weige, ama ing'aang'jige ng'wony?
Kowolji Jeso koleenji, “Ngo chama chii, koriip ng'olyoondennyu: ak kocham Abba ineendet ak kebwonji ineendet, ak kemeny kobooto ineendet.
Ineendet ne ma chama ko ma riibei ng'aleekyuk: ak ma nenyu ng'olyoot ne ogase, ago po Kwanda ne ki iyookwo.
Kaamwaiwok tuguuchu, kota ami kobootok.
Ago ineetook tuguuk tugul Kagaigaindet, Kabuuset ne Tiliil, ne iyoogu Kwanda eng' kainennyu, ak kobwaatwok tugul che kaamwaiwok.
Abagakwok kaalyeet; agoonok kalyennyu: ma koonok ko uu ye koonu ng'wony. Among' koiimgei mugulelwekwok, anan koiyweis.
Kaogas ko uu ye kaamwaiwok ale, Awendi, ak anyoone ole omi. Ngot ochama, ko oboiboi, amu awendi ole mi Kwanda: amu oo Kwanda eng' anee.
Ak kaamwaiwok nguno kotom koyaak, si ye kagoyaak, oyan.
Ma ng'alaalwok miising', amu nyoonei ne oo ne po ng'wony: ama tinyei kiy eng' anee;
ago si konai ng'wony kole achame Kwanda, ak ko uu ye ki koono Kwanda ng'atuutyet, ayae ko uu nooto. Ong'eetyee, keebe.”
Aa keetit ne po iman ne po sabibuk, ak semberindet Abba.
Tilei temeet age tugul ne mi eng' anee ne ma iyei logoek, ak kotiliili temeet age tugul ne yiei logoek si koi logoek alak.
Oo tiliileen nguno amu ng'aleek che kaamwaiwok.
Omenya, ak amenyok. Ko uu ye ma imuuchi temeet koi logoek ineegei, ngot koma menyei keetit; ko momuuchi ak okweek, ngot ko momenya.
Aa keetitap sabibuk, ko oo mooriik: ineendet ne menya, ak amenye ineendet, ko nooto ne yiei logoek che chaang': amu momuuchi oyai kiy okweegei ngo ma mi anee kobootok.
Ngo ma menya chii, kewiirtoi ineendet ko uu temetap keetit, si koyaam; ak koyum piik, ak kowiirchi ma, ak kolalyo.
Ngot omenya, ak komenyok ng'aleekyuk, osoom anyun kiy age tugul ne omache, si keyaiywok.
Kigonyiti Abba eng' niito, ye oiyie logoek che chaang'; si oegu kasubikyuk.
Ko uu ye ki chama Kwanda, ko uu nooto ki achamak agane; otebi eng' chamyennyu.
Ngot oriibe ng'atuutikyuk, otebye anyun eng' chamyennyu; ko uu ye ki ariip ng'atuutik che po Abba, ak atebye eng' chamyennyi.
Kaamwaiwok tuguuchu, si kotebi eng' okweek poiboiyennyu, si kobiit kosulda poiboiyeng'wong'.
Ng'atuutyennyu ni, ale ochamye, ko uu ye ki achamak.
Ma tinyei chii chamyet ne siirei ni, ale kogoito chii saboondanyi agobo choronokyik.
Oo choronokyuk, ngot oyai tuguuk che ang'atook.
Ma aguurenok otwogik; amu ma naei otwogindet kiit ne yaei kiptaiyandennyi: ago kaaguurenok choronok; amu kaang'ang'wok tuguuk tugul che ki agase Abba.
Ki ma olewena, ago ki alewenok, ak ki andeak, ale obe ak oii logoek, si kobiit kotebi logoekwok: si kobiit kogoonok Kwanda kiit age tugul ne osoome eng' kainennyu.
Ang'atwok tuguuchu, ale ochamye.
Ngo wechok ng'wony, onai ole ki kowecha kotom kowechok.
Nda oo po ng'wony, ta chamei ng'wony chechiik: ago amu mo po ng'wony, ago ki alewenok eng' ng'wony, kowechok ng'wony anyun amu nooto.
Obwaat ng'olyoot ne ki amwaiwok, Ma siirei otwogindet kiptaiyandennyi. Ngot kogiusa anee, kousok ak okweek; ngot ko ki nam ng'olyoondennyu, konamei neng'wong' agine.
Ago yaiywok tuguuchu tugul agobo kainennyu, amu ma nai ineendet ne ki iyookwo.
Nda ki ma anyoo ang'alaalji icheek, ta ma tinyei tengek: ago nguno koma tinyei kiit ne ityagegei agobo tengektonywa.
Ineendet ne wecho ko kawech Abba agine.
Nda ki ma ayai eng' kwenunnywa poisyonik che ki ma yai chiito age, ta ki ma kotinyei tengek: ago nguno ko kagogeerech ak kagowechech anee ak Abba.
Ago, si kosulda ng'olyoot ne ki kisir eng' Ng'atuutikwak, keele, Ki kowecha puch.
Ago ye kagoit Kagaigaindet, ne tuun ayookwok kobunu Kwanda, Kabuuset ne Tiliil ne po imanit, ne punu Kwanda, konyo kobaoryanjo:
ak obaoryani ak okweek, amu ki omi kobooto kobooch taunet.
Kaamwaiwok tuguuchu, si ma kinachak.
Oonok eng' sinagogisyek. Nyoonei sait, ne ibwaati chii tugul ne parok kole, ayachini Kamuktaindet poisyet.
Ak yaei tuguuchu, amu ma nai Kwanda, anan anee.
Ago kaamwaiwok tuguuchu, si ye nyo sainnywa, omuuchi obwaat ole ki amwaiwok agobo chuuto. “Ago ki ma amwaiwok tuguuchu eng' taunet, amu ki ami kobootok.
Ago kawe nguno ole mi ineendet ne ki iyookwo; ama mi age eng' okweek ne teebena kole, ‘Iwendi ano?’
Amu kaamwaiwok tuguuchu, ko kanyi mugulelwekwok arageneet.
Ago amwaiwok ne po iman: myee eng' okweek ngawe: amu ngo mawe, ko manyonjinok Kagaigaindet; ago ngot awe, ayookwok ineendet.
Ak ye kagonyo ineendet, kogikyi ng'wony agobo tengekto, ak imanda, ak kirwooget:
agobo tengekto, amu ma iyana;
agobo imanda, amu awendi ole mi Kwanda, ama ogeero kogeny;
agobo kirwooget, amu ki kirwookyi ne oo ne po ng'wonyuni.”
“Ta atinye tuguuk che chaang' che kata ta amwaiwok, ago ma omuuchi omuite nguno.
Ago ye tuun kagonyo ineendet, Kabuuset ne Tiliil ne po imanit, kondoiywok agoi oit imanda tugul: amu ma mwaei ineegei; ago mwaei tuguuk tugul che kasei: ak kong'ang'wok tuguuk che pwoonei.
Itoroora: amu namei chechuuk, ak kong'ang'wok.
Chechuuk tuguuk tugul che tinyei Kwanda: nooto kaamwa, ale, namei chechuuk, ak koboorwok.”
“Tomo kitigin, si ma ogeera kogeny; ak mi kitigin kogeny, si ogeero.”
Kong'alaaljigei anyun alak eng' kasubikyik kole, “Nee ni kamwaiwech kole, ‘Mi kitigin, si ma ogeera; ak mi kitigin kogeny, si ogeera: ak, Amu awendi ole mi Kwanda?’ ”
Kole anyun, “Nee ni kamwa kole, ‘Mi kitigin?’ Ma kingen kiit ne mwaei.”
Ki nai Jeso anyun kole, machei koteebe pichooto ineendet, ak ki leenji, “Tos oteebegei okweegei agobo ng'olyoondoni kaamwa ale mi kitigin, si ma ogeera, ak mi kitigin kogeny, si ogeera?
Amwaiwok, iman, iman, ale orirtosi ak oteitosi, ago paibai ng'wony: oaragendosi, ago kiweechi arageneng'wong' koek poiboiyet.
Arageni tamonet ye machei kosigiis, amu kait sainnyi; ago ye kagosich lakweet, koma kobwaati ng'wanindo kogeny, eng' poiboiyet amu kagesikyi chii ng'wony.
Nooto anyun otinye arageneet nguno: ago ta ageerok kogeny, ak poiboi mugulelwekwok, ama rebenok chii poiboiyeng'wong'.
Ama oteebena kiy eng' peetuunooto. Amwaiwok, iman, iman, ale, Ngot osoom Kwanda kiy age tugul, kogoonok eng' kainennyu.
Tom osoom kiy eng' kainennyu: osoom, si onyooru, si kobiit kosulda poiboiyeng'wong'.”
“Kaamwaiwok tuguuchu eng' kalewenaik: ago nyoonei sait, ye ma ang'alaalwok eng' kalewenaik, ago aboorwok komyee agobo Kwanda.
Osoome peetuunooto eng' kainennyu: amamwaiwok, ale ateebee Kwanda kiy agobo okweek;
amu chamok ineendet Kwanda, amu ki ochama, ak ki oyan ole ki abunu Kwanda.
Ki abunu Kwanda, anyoonji ng'wony: abagaaktoi ng'wony kogeny, ak agetitegei ole mi Kwanda.”
Koleenji kasubikyik, “Keero, ing'alaali nguno komyee kotook, ama imwae kalewenet.”
Kingen nguno keele ingen tuguuk tugul, ama nyoljin chii koteebenen kiy: kiyani eng' niito keele ki ibunu Kamuktaindet.
Kowolji Jeso koleenji, “Oyani nguno?
Ogeero, nyoonei sait, ee, kagonyo nguno, ye kiyestook, kwo chii tugul oldanyi, ak obagaakta aneege: ago ma mi aneege, amu mi Kwanda kobooto.
Kaamwaiwok tuguuchu, si kobiit onyoorunena kaalyeet. Otinye nyalilda eng' ng'wony! Ago onyiganitu; amu kaaterter ng'wony.”
Ki mwa Jeso ng'aleechu; ak konyal kipsengwet, ak kole, “Abba, kagonyo sait; itoroor Weeriing'ung', si kotoroorin Weeriit;
ko uu ye ki igoochi ineendet kimnateet koboi piik tugul, si kobiit kogoochi saboondap koigeny tugul che ki igoochi ineendet.
Ak ni saboondap koigeny, ale konain Kamuktaindet ne inyeendet inyegei ne po iman, ak Jeso Kristo, ne ki iyoogu.
Ki atoroorin eng' ng'wony, amu kaagesu poisyet ne ki igoono ayai.
Ak nguno, ee Abba, itoroora eng' inyeendet inyegei eng' toroornatet ne ki atinye kemi tuwai kotom kobiit ng'wony.
Ki aboorchi kaineng'ung' piik che ki igoono eng' ng'wony. Ki cheguuk, ak ki igoono; ak ki koriip ng'olyoondeng'ung'.
Kagonai nguno kole punun tuguuk tugul che ki igoono;
amu ki agoochi icheek ng'aleek che ki igoono ak ki kotaach, ak ki konai iman kole ki abunu ole imi, ak ki koyan kole ki iyookwo.
Asaae agobo icheek: ma saae agobo ng'wony, ago agobo icheek che ki igoono; amu cheguuk:
ak tuguuk tugul chechuuk ko cheguuk, ak cheguuk ko chechuuk: ak ki itoroora eng' icheek.
Ak ma amite ng'wony, ago mi ng'wony chu, ak anyoone ole imi. Abba ne Tiliil, riip eng' kaineng'ung' icheek che ki igoono, si kobiit koek agenge, ko uu acheek.
Ki ariip eng' kaineng'ung' icheek che ki igoono, ye kota kemi ak icheek: ki ariip icheek, ama pet agot agenge eng' icheek, kobatee weeriitap luseet; si kobiit kosulda siruutyet.
Ak kanyonjin nguno; ak amwae tuguuchu eng' ng'wony, si kobiit kosulda poiboiyennyu eng' icheek.
Ki agoochi ng'olyoondeng'ung'; ak kawech ng'wony icheek, amu ma po ng'wony, ko uu ye ma po ng'wony anee.
Masaae ale imut icheek eng' ng'wony, ago ale iriip icheek eng' ineendet ne ya.
Ma po ng'wony icheek, ko uu ye ma po ng'wony anee.
Itiliil icheek eng' imanit: imanit ng'olyoondeng'ung'.
Ko uu ye ki iyookwo anyo ng'wony, ko uu nooto kaayookte icheek koba ng'wony.
Ak atabaanige agobo icheek si kobiit kitabaan icheek eng' imanit.
Amasaae agobo chu kityo, ago asaae agobo icheek che tuun iyana amu ng'olyoonnywa;
si kobiit koek icheek tugul agenge; ko uu ye imi inyee Abba, eng' anee, ak anee eng' inyee, si kobiit kotep icheek eng' acheek: si kobiit koyan ng'wony kole ki iyookwo.
Ak kaagoochi icheek toroornatet ne ki igoono; si kobiit koek agenge ko uu ye ki agenge acheek;
anee eng' icheek, ak inyee eng' anee, si kobiit koek icheek che ititaatiin eng' agenge; si kobiit konai ng'wony kole ki iyookwo, ak ichame icheek, ko uu ye ichama.”
Abba, amache ale kotebi kobooto eng' ole ami, icheek che ki igoono; si kobiit kogeer toroornatennyu ne ki igoono; amu ki ichama kotom kelumda ng'wony.
“Ee Abba ne po imanda, ki ma kongenin ng'wony, ago ki angenin; ak ki konai chu kole, ki iyookwo.
Ki ang'aang'ji icheek kaineng'ung', ak ta ang'aang'jini; si kobiit kotebee icheek chamyet ne ki ichamena, ak anee eng' icheek.”
Ye kingo kagomwa Jeso ng'aleechu, koba ak kasubikyik kolanda eng' kereruut ne kiguure Kedron, ole ki mi mbareet, ole ki wo ineendet, kobooto kasubikyik.
Ak ki ingen koronooto Judas agine, ne king'wektoi ineendet: amu ki cham kowendi Jeso yooto kobooto kasubikyik.
Ak kingo kagonyoor Judas lugeetap kiplugotinik, ak kiptainik che punu tisiik che eecheen ak Pharisaik, kobwa kotinyei taisyek ak kegenganik ak kariik che po lugeet.
Kwo anyun Jeso, ko kagonai tuguuk tugul che pwaanjin ineendet ak koleenji, “Ocheeng'e ng'oo?”
Kowolji koleenji, “Jeso ne po Nazareth.” Koleenji Jeso, “Aa ineendet.” Ak ki tononi kobooto icheek Judas agine, ne king'wektoi ineendet.
Ye kingo mwachi anyun kole, “Aa ineendet,” kobee patai ak kobutyo.
Ki teebe anyun icheek kogeny, kole, “Ocheeng'e ng'oo?” Ak kole, “Jeso ne po Nazareth.”
Kowol Jeso, kole, “Kaamwaiwok ale aa ineendet; nooto anyun ngo cheeng'a ounde chu koba.”
Si kosulda ng'olyoot ne ki mwa kole, “Ma petena agot agenge eng' chooto ki igoono.”
King'us anyun Simion Petero rotwetap chok ne ki tinyei, ak koep otwogindetap tisiindet ne oo, koep iitinnyi ne po tai. Ki kiguure otwogindonooto Malko.
Koleenji Jeso anyun Petero, Weekyi rotweet choget: tos maee kigombet ne kagoono Kwanda?
Konam anyun lugeet ak kiptaiyat ne oo, ak kiptainik che po Yahudik, Jeso ak koraat ineendet,
ak komutyi Anas korook; amu ki kabyugoit ne po Caiaphas, ne ki tisiindet ne oo kenyinooto.
Caiaphas nooto ne ki iboorchi Yahudik kole, nyolu komechi chiito agenge piik.
Ki isup anyun Simion Petero Jeso, ak age eng' kasubik. Amu ki ingengei tisiindet ne oo ak nooto agenge eng' kasubik, koba koot oriit kobooto Jeso agoi kapkirwoogetap tisiindet ne oo.
Kitononi Petero eng' saang' ye neegit kurgeet. Ki manda anyun chiichooto agenge eng' kasubik ne ki ingengei ak tisiindet ne oo, ak kong'alaalji chepto ne kiriibei kurgeet, ki imut Petero konyo ko.
Koleenji anyun chepto ne kiriibei kurgeet Petero, Ma ii agenge eng' kasubigap chiichi? Kole, Ma anee.
Ak kitonondos eng' yooto otwogik ak kiptainik, che kiga kolaal maat ne po nesek, amu ki kaitit; ak kiyue maat: ak kitononi Petero agine kobooto icheek, koyue maat.
Ki teebe anyun tisiindet ne oo Jeso agobo kasubikyik ak kaneetisyennyi.
Kowolji Jeso koleenji, “Ki ang'alaalji ng'wony, amauny ng'olyoo; ki aneetisye kotugul eng' sinagogisyek, ak eng' Hekaluut, ole tuiyechin Yahudik tugul; amamwa kiy eng' ung'oot.
Amu nee si iteebena? Teebe icheek che ki kas kiit ne ki amwachi icheek; keero, ingen chu tuguuk che ki amwa.”
Ak ye kingo kagomwa ko uu niito, korabach Jeso age eng' kiptainik che kitonondos eng' yooto kole, “Iwoljini tisiindet ne oo ko uu nooto?”
Kowolji Jeso koleenji, “Ngot ko kaamwa ne ya, ibaoryan agobo nooto ya: ago ngot ko myee, ko amu nee si irabaacha?”
Ki iyookto anyun Anas ineendet ko rataat kwo kap Kaiapa, tisiindet ne oo.
Ak kitononi Simion Petero koyue maat. Koleenji anyun icheek ineendet, Ma ii age aginye ne po kasubikyik? Kotiiyo kole, “Ma aa ineendet.”
Kole otwogindet age ne po tisiindet ne oo ne kitilyonut ak chiichooto kiebei Petero itinnyi, Koma ageerin eng' mbar omi ak ineendet.
Kotiiyo anyun Petero kogeny; ak eng' sainooto koote kipsoiywet.
Ki imut Jeso anyun kong'etee kap Kaiapa kwo Praitorium: ak kita ko karon miising'; ak ma pa icheeget Praitorium oriit, si ma ng'woneegitu, ago si kobiit koam paska.
Ki manda Pilato anyun kwo ole mi icheek, ak kole, “Nee ng'olyoo ne orwookyine chiichi?”
Kowolji koleenji, “Nda koma ko chalwogin chiichi, ta koma kimutu ineendet konyo taing'ung'.”
Koleenji Pilato icheek anyun, Onam ineendet okweek, ak orwookyi ko uu ng'atuutyeng'wong'. Koleenji anyun Yahudik, Ma chamdaat eng' acheek kebar chii age tugul:
si kobiit kosulda ng'olyootap Jeso, ne ki mwa, kobooru meet ole meitoi ineendet.
Ki wo anyun kogeny Pilato Praitorium oriit, ak koguur Jeso, koleenji, “Tos ii Laitoryatap Yahudik?”
Kowolji Jeso koleenji, “Imwae ng'olyoondoni inyegei anan komwaun alak agobo anee?”
Kowol Pilato kole, “Aa Yahudyot? Kagomutun tainnyu pororyeng'ung' ak tisiik che eecheen. Ki iyai nee?”
Kowol Jeso, kole, “Ma po ng'wonyuni laitornatennyu: nda po ng'wonyuni laitornatennyu, ko kata yaei pooryeet kasubikyuk si ma kindea eunegap Yahudik: ago nguno koma po laitornatennyu oli.”

Koleenji anyun Pilato ineendet, “Ara, ii laitoryat so?” Kowol Jeso kole, “Imwae ile aa laitoryat. Ki kisicha amu niito, ak ki anyoo ng'wony amu niito, si kobiit abaoryanji imanit. Kasei kutinnyu chii age tugul ne po imanit.”
Koleenji Pilato, Nee imanit? Ak ye kingo kagomwa ko uu ni, komanda kogeny ole mi Yahudik, ak koleenji, “Ma anyoorchi anee leluut ineendet.
Ago otinye piteet, ole atyakwok age eng' paska: ara omache atyakwok Laitoryatap Yahudik?”
Kobolyo anyun kogeny, kole “Ma chiichi, ago Barabbas!” Ago anyun, ki rebindet Barabbas.
Ki nam anyun Pilato Jeso, ak kobire kipchoritiit.
Ak kita kiplugotinik ngatyet ne po katook, ak konde metit, ak kolaakyi ineendet ngoryeet ne aruus ne piriir;
ak kobwa ole mi ineendet kole, “Kigatin, Laitoryatap Yahudik!” Ak korabach ineendet.
Ak kimanda Pilato kogeny, ak koleenji icheek, “Ogeero, kamutwak ineendet konyo taing'wong', si onai ole ma anyoorchi anee leluut ineendet.”
Komong' Jeso anyun konyo saang', ko kerat metit eng' ngatyetap katook, kolaaganu ngoryonooto aruus ne piriir. Ak koleenji Pilato pichooto, “Ogeer chiichi anyun o!”
Ye kingo keer anyun ineendet tisiik che eecheen ak kiptainik, kobolyo, kole, “Igartaat! Igartaat!” Koleenji Pilato, “Omut okweek ineendet ak ogartaat; amu ma anyoorchi leluut.”
Kowolji Yahudik koleenji, “Ki tinyei ng'atuutyet, ak kanyool kome amu ng'atuutyonooto, amu ki yaigei koek Weeriitap Kamuktaindet.”
Ye kingo kas anyun Pilato mwaonooto, koywei miising';
ak ki wo Praitorium oriit kogeny, ak koleenji Jeso, Ibunu ano? Ago ma wolji `Jeso ineendet.
Koleenji Pilato anyun ineendet, “Metwekwa? Mengen ile atinye kimnateet atyachin, ak atinye kimnateet agartatin?”
Kowolji Jeso koleenji, “Kama ko tetinye kimnateet iyaiywo kiy, nda kama kigoonin eng' parak; nooto anyun, tinyei ineendet ne koindea euneguk tengekto ne oo kosiir.”
Kobooch yooto kocheeng' Pilato kotyach ineendet: ago ki polyo Yahudik, kole, “Ngot ityaach chiichi, koma ii chorweet ne po Caesarea: reenyei Caesarea chii age tugul ne yaegei koek laitoryat.”
Ye kingo kas anyun Pilato ng'aleechuuto, komut Jeso komong' saang', ak kotep ng'wony eng' ng'echereetap kirwooget eng' ole kiguure Teteetap Koik, ago kiguure eng' kutitap Yahudik, Gabata.
Ki chobetap paska peetuunooto: ak ki olo po sait lo. Ak ki leenji Yahudik, “Ogeero, Laitoryandeng'wong'!”

Kobolyo pichooto kole, “Iste ineendet! Iste ineendet! Igartaat ineendet!” Koleenji Pilato anyun icheek, agartaat laitoryandeng'wong'? Kowol tisiik che eecheen, kole, ma kitinye laitorya kobatee Caesarea.
Kogoito anyun Pilato ineendet kigartaat. Konam anyun icheek Jeso ak komut:
ak komanda, koibei ineegei kimurtoiyot, agoi koit ole kiguure Kooretap terta, ne kiguure eng' kutitap Yahudik, Golgota:
ole ki igartate icheek ineendet, kobooto aeng' alak, age komosi ak age komosi, ak ki mi Jeso kween.
Ak kisir anyun Pilato sireet, ak konde kimurtoiyot. Ki kisir keele, “JESO NE PO NASARET, LAITORYAT NE PO YAHUDIK.”
Kosoman anyun Yahudik che chaang' sironiito: amu kineegite nganaseet ole ki kigartate Jeso: ak ki kisir eng' kutitap Yahudik, ak Romanik, ak Yunanik.
Koleenji anyun tisiik che eecheen che po Yahudik Pilato, “Amesir ile, Laitoryat ne po Yahudik: ago, ki mwa kole, ‘Aa Laitoryat ne po Yahudik.’ ”
Kowol Pilato kole, “Kiit ne kaasir ko kaasir.”

Ye kingo kagogartaat anyun kiplugotinik Jeso, konam ngoroikyik, kopchei koek kebeberwek ang'wan, koip asigarindet age tugul kebeberta age; ak ko uu nooto sumet agine: ak ki ma kotinyei sumet ole ki kituiye, ki kinap koek agenge kongeete parak agoi kapkelyen.

Koleenjigei anyun icheegei, “Amongegereer, ago ongeseer parbareek, si kenai chiito ne punjin: si kosulda siruutyet ne mwaei kole, Kipchechigei ngoroikyuk, Ak kolotyigei ngoryennyu. Ki yai anyun kiplugotinik tuguuchuuto.”
Ago kitonondos eng' ye neegitee kimurtoiyotap Jeso kamet, ak chepkametap kamet, Maria ne po Klopa, ak Maria Magdalene.
Ye kingo keer Jeso anyun kamet, ak nooto agenge eng' kasubikyik ne ki chamei Jeso kotonondos eng' yooto, koleenji kamet, “Chebyosoni, keer weeriing'ung'!”
Koleenji anyun nooto agenge eng' kasubikyik, “Keer kamenng'ung'!” Ak kobooch sainooto komut ineendet chebyosonooto kwo koonnyi.
Kingo pata chooto, ko kagonai Jeso kole kagogeskei tuguuk tugul, si kobiit kosulda siruutyet, komwa kole, “Ama melel.”
Kiga kinde yooto tereet ne nyiitaat siki: konyiit anyun sponjit siki ak koyogoochine husop, konde kutinnyi.
Ye kingo kagotaach Jeso siki, komwa kole, “Kagogeskei.” Ki abuch anyun metinnyi, ak kogoito saboondanyi.
Amu ki Chobeet ak ki ma kemakyin muuswek kotebee kimurtoiyot eng' sabato (amu ki oo peetuunooto po sabato), kosoom Yahudik Pilato kole keiri keelyekwak, si kesutei.
Kobwa anyun kiplugotinik, ak koiri keelyegap ne po tai, ak ne po age ne kiga kigartaat kobooto ineendet.
Ago ye kingo pwa ye mi Jeso, ak kogeer kole kagome, ko mata koiri keelyekyik:
ago kitoore ng'otit karaastanyi age eng' kiplugotinik, ak koma tyanit komong' korotiik ak peek.
Ak kibaoryan ineendet ne ki keer, ak ko po iman paornatennyi: ak ingen ineendet kole mwaei iman, si kobiit oyan ak okweek.
Ki yaak tuguuchu, si kobiit kosulda siruutyet ne ki le, “Ma ki iriei kowennyi.”
Ak kogeny mwaei siruutyet age kole, “Tuun keerei icheek ineendet ne kitoorei.”

Ak kingo pata tuguuchu, kwo Joseph ne po Arimatea, ne ki agenge eng' kasubigap Jeso eng' ung'oot, amu ki iywei Yahudik, kosoom Pilato kole kosut muustap Jeso: ak ki chamji Pilato. Konyo anyun koip poortanyi.
Ak ki nyo agine Nikodemo, ne ki nyoonji Jeso kemoi atkinye tai, koibu tuguuk che uu igomoik che ki kiburukto nyamdutik alak, che ki olo po ratilisyek pogol.
Kisut anyun muustap Jeso, ak kotaa eng' ngoroik che po katanit kobooto nyamdutik, ko uu piteetap Yahudik ye tubisyei.
Ki mi mbareet ole ki kigartate ineendet; ak ki mi mbaranooto kererit ne leel ne kitom ketupchi chii.
Ki inde anyun Jeso olooto amu peetuutap chobetap Yahudik, amu ki neegit kererit.
Ki nyo `Maria Magdalene kererit, karon ko kairir emet, eng' peetuut ne po tai ne po wigiit. Kogeer koita ko kageisto eng' kererit.
Kolabat kot koit ole mi Simion Petero, ak nooto agenge eng' kasubik, ne ki chamei Jeso ineendet ak koleenji icheek, “Kageip Kiptaiyat eng' kererit, ama kingen ole kaginde.”
Koba anyun Petero, ak nin agenge eng' kasubik, kotokyigei kererit.
Ki rwai tuwai kibagenge: ak kilabat nin agenge eng' kasubik kondoe Petero, ak kosip koit kererit;
ak kingo ng'uruuk kogeer oriit, kogeer ngoroigap katanit ko itootin; ago ma wo oriit.
Konyo anyun Simion Petero agine, kosubu ineendet ak kwo kererit oriit; ak kogeer ngoroik che po katanit ko itootin;
ago angeet ne ki miitei metinnyi ko ki ma komi, kobooto ngoroik che po katanit, ago ki mamanat ineegei eng' oldo age.
Ki wo oriit agine nooto agenge eng' kasubik ne kiga sip koit kererit, ak ki keer ak ki iyan.
Amu kitom konai siruutyet ne ki le, ng'eetei kogeny matiny eng' che ki pek.
Koba kaa anyun kogeny chooto po kasubik.
Ago ki tononi Maria eng' kererit saang', koriirei: ak ye kita koriirei, kong'uruuk koiit kererit;
ak ki keer malaikaisyek aeng' che leelach ngoroik kotebyei ng'wony, age eng' ole po metit, ak age eng' ole po keelyek, eng' ole ki mi poortap Jeso.
Ak ki leenji, “Kobogoryondoni, kalya si iriir?” Koleenji, “Amu kageip Kiptaiyandennyu, amangen ole kaginde ineendet.”
Ak ye kingo kagomwa ko uu nooto, kowelelgei, kogeer Jeso kotononi, ama konai kole Jeso nooto.
Koleenji Jeso, Kobogoryondoni, kalya si iriir? Icheeng'e ng'oo? Ki ibwaati koleen ineendet ko riibindetap mbareet, ak koleenji, “Kiptaiyat, ngo keip ineendet, imwaiwo ole kainde, si aip ineendet.”
Kotwekyi `Jeso inee kole, “Maria!” Koguskong' ak koleenji eng' kutitap Yahudik, “Rabboni!” Ye kiweech ko, “Kaneetindoni.”
Koleenji Jeso, “Ametiinyo; amu tomo atogosyi kap Kwanda; ago ui ole mi tupchosyekyuk, ak ki leenji, ‘Atogosyini kap Abba, ago Abba neng'wong', Kamuktaindennyu ak ko Kamuktaindeng'wong'.’ ”
Konyo Maria Magdalene koleenji kasubik, “Kaageer Kiptaiyat”; ak kagomwachi tuguuchu ineendet.

Ak ki eng' koskoleng'utap peetuunooto po tai ne po wigiit, ye kiga keger kurgotik eng' ole kimi kasubik, amu ki iywei Yahudik, konyo Jeso kotonone kwenunnywa ak koleenji, “Ingotep kaalyeet eng' okweek.”
Ak ye kingo kagomwa niito, koboorchi eunekyik ak karaastanyi. Koboiboitu anyun kasubik, ye kingo keer Kiptaiyat.
Koleenji Jeso anyun kogeny, “Ingotep kaalyeet eng' okweek: ko uu ye ki iyookwo Kwanda, ayooktook ak okweek ko uu nooto.”
Ak ye kingo kagomwa niito, kobusyi, ak koleenji, “Otaach Kabuuset ne Tiliil:
piik alak tugul che onyochini kaat tengekwogikwak, kenyochin kaat; ak alak tugul che oesyoi onyochi kaat, keesyoi kenyochi kaat.”
Ago ki ma komi Thomas ne ki kiguure Didumo, ne ki age eng' taman ak aeng', kobooto icheek ye kinyonei Jeso.

Koleenji anyun chuun alage che po kasubik, Kagegeer Kiptaiyat. Ago ki leenji Thomas icheek, Ngot ko mageer eng' eunekyik perutik che po kipchumarisyek, ak ande mornennyu perutigap kipchumarisyek, ak ande eunnyu karaastanyi, ko mayani.

Ak kingo pata peetuusyek sisiitu ko ki mi ko kasubikyik kogeny, ak kimi Thomas kobooto icheek. Ki nyo anyun Jeso, ko kerotin kurgotik, ak kotonon eng' kwenunnywa, ak komwa kole, “Ingotep kaalyeet eng' okweek.”
Koleenji Thomas, Iyogou morneng'ung', ak igeer eunekyuk; ak iyogou eung'ung' ak inde karaastanyu; si meegu ne ma tinyei kayaneet, ago iyan.
Kowolji Thomas koleenji, “Kiptaiyandennyu ak ko Kamuktaindet nenyu!”
Koleenji `Jeso ineendet, “Kaiyan amu kaigeera: iberuurotin icheek che iyani ama keer.”
Ki yai Jeso kaboorunoik alak che chaang' eng' taitap kasubik che ma siraatiin eng' bukuini:
ago ki kisir chu, si kobiit oyan ole Jeso ko Kristo, Weeriitap Kamuktaindet; ak si kobiit ye oyani onyooru saboondo eng' kainennyi.
Kingo pata tuguuchu koboorchigei Jeso kogeny kasubik eng' araraita ne po Tiberia; ki iboorchigei ko uu ni.
Ki mi tugul, Simion Petero ak Thomas ne kiguure Didumo, ak Nathanael ne po Kana ne po Galilaya, ak weeriigap Zebedayo, ak aeng' alak che po kasubikyik.
Koleenji Simion Petero, Kawe aram njireenik. Koleenji chuun alage, Kibendi agacheek kobooten. Koba anyun ak kolaany moingetap peek: ak ma nam kiy kemounooto.
Ago ye kimachei koeech, kotonon Jeso eng' ngeguut: ago ma nai kasubik kole Jeso.
Koleenji Jeso anyun, Lagochu, otinye kiy ne oame? Kowolji koleenji, Achicha.
Ak ki leenji icheek, Owiirchi regereiywot ne kiname njireenik komostap tai ne po moinget, si onyooru. Kowiirchi anyun, ak mata komuuch kochuut amu chaang'indap njireenik.

Komwachi agenge eng' kasubik, nooto ne chamei Jeso, Petero, koleenji, “Kiptaiyat niito!” Ye kingo kas anyun Simion Petero kole Kiptaiyat, kolaach kotit anyun (amu kimi aach ngor) ak kochoorchigei araraita.
Ago ki pwa chuun alage che po kasubik kobunu moinget ne ming'in (amu ki ma ko looen eng' ngeguut, ago ki olo po kakwautik che po euut pogol aeng'), kochuutu regereiywondonooto mi njireenik.
Nooto anyun, ye kingo it ngeguut, kogeer eng' yooto maat ne po nesek, ak kiwatanat njiryot eng' yooto, ak magatyat.
Koleenji Jeso, Oibu njireenik alak chu korame nguno.

Kolaany Simion Petero moinget, ak kochuut regereiywot konyo ngeguut, ak ki nyiitaat njireenik che eecheen, pogol agenge ak konom ak somok: ak nganda ki chaang' njireenik miising', ko ki ma kerer regereiywondonooto.
Koleenji `Jeso icheek, “Obwa oamisye.” Ma kany age tugul eng' kasubik koteebe kole, “Ii ng'oo?” Amu ki ingen kole ineendet ko Kiptaiyat.
Konyo anyun Jeso ak konam magatyat, ak kogoochi, kobooto njireenik ak icheek.
Niito ko ne po somok koboorchingei Jeso kasubik, ko kagong'eet ineendet komong' eng' che ki pek.
Ye kingo kagoamis anyun, koleenji `Jeso Simion Petero, “Simion, weeriitap Johana, tos ichama kosiir chu?” Koleenji ineendet, “Ee, Kiptaiyat, ingen ile achamin.” Koleenji, “Pai aarekyuk.”
Koleenji kogeny ne po aeng', “Simion, weeriitap Johana, ichama?” Koleenji, “Ee, Kiptaiyat, ingen ile achamin.” Koleenji, “Iyage keechiirekyuk.”

Koleenji ne po somok, “Simion, weeriitap Johana, ichama?” Koaragen Petero amu kamwachi ne po somok, koleenji, “Ichama?” Ak koleenji, “Kiptaiyat, ingen tuguuk tugul; ingen ile achamin.” Koleenji `Jeso ineendet, “Pai keechiirekyuk.
Amwaun, iman, iman, ale, ye kita ko ii ming'in, ko ki ilaaksechinigei, ak iwendi ole imache; ago ye tuun ioositu, iitoi euneguk, ak kolaakseun age, ak komutin ole memache.”
Kimwa niito koboortoi ole teptoi meet ne itorooree Kamuktaindet. Ak ye kingo kagomwa niito, koleenji, “Isubwo.”
Kowelelgei Petero, kogeer kasubindet ne ki chamei Jeso kosubi; ne kitiegei tegetap Jeso eng' amisyetap lagat, ak koleenji, “Kiptaiyat, ng'oo ineendet ne ng'wektoin?”
Kingo keer Petero ineendet, koleenji Jeso, Kiptaiyat, lyon chiichi?
Koleenji Jeso, Ngot amach kotebi agoi tuun anyo, image nee? Isubwo inyee.
Kiyom anyun ng'olyoondoni tupchosyek, kole ma meei chiichooto agenge eng' kasubik: ago ki ma mwachi Jeso ineendet, koleenji, “Ma meei” ago ki leenji, “Ngot amach kotebi agoi tuun anyo, image nee?”
Ni anyun ko kasubindet ne paoryanjin tuguuchu, ak ne ki sirei tuguuchuuto ak kingen keele po iman paornatennyi.
Ak mi kogeny tuguuk alak che chaang' che ki yai Jeso, che, nda kisirei age tugul, aleen ta mayamei ng'wony bukuisyek che kata kisirchin.
Eng' kitabuut ne po tai, ee Theophilus, ko ki atet agobo tuguuk tugul che ki toi Jeso koyai ak koneet.
Ki atet anyun chooto tugul agoi peetuut ne ki kimuti kwo parak, ye kingo kagong'at `inee eng' Kabuuset ne Tiliil che kiyooktoi, chooto kiga kolewen.

Ye kingo pata nyalildanyi, koboorchigei icheeget kole sabei eng' kaboorunoik che chaang', kong'aang'jingei `inee icheek eng' peetuusyek artam, ak kong'alaaljin icheek agobo tuguuk che po laitornatetap Kamuktaindet.
Ak ye ki amisye tugul, kong'at icheek koleenji, “Amat obe eng' Jerusalem, ago ogen kayomiset ne po Kwanda, nooto ki ogasena.
Ki ibatisanis Johana iman eng' peek; ago kotom kogeskei peetuusyek che chaang' kibatisanook eng' Kabuuset ne Tiliil.”
Nooto anyun, ye kingo kagoyumgei, koteebe ineendet koleenji, “Kiptaiyat, iweekyini Israel laitornatet eng' peetuusyechuuto?”
Koleenji `Jeso icheek, “Mabootok onai peetuusyek anan kenyiisyek che ki konde Kwanda eng' pounatennyi ineegei.
Ago otaache kamuktaet ye tuun kanyonjok Kabuuset ne Tiliil; ak oegu paorinikyuk eng' Jerusalem, eng' Judea komugul ak Samaria, ak agoi tabandap ng'wony.”
Ye kingo kagomwa tuguuchuuto, kimut ineendet kwo parak kogeerei icheek, ak kitaach pooldet ineendet ak kobetito eng' tainnywa.
Ye kingo ta konyali kipsengwet kochiiljin kong' kowendi, ogeero, kitononso piik aeng'u eng' ye neegitee icheeget kolaachi ngoroik che leelachen,
ak ki mwa kole, “Okweek piigap Galilaya, kalya si otononse ak onyali kipsengwet? Jeso niito, ne kagimut kwo kipsengwet, ko tuun nyoonei ko uu yu kogeere kowendi kipsengwet.”
Koweek anyun koba Jerusalem kobunu tulweet ne kiguure tulweetap Mseituni, ne neegitee Jerusalem, ne yamegei ak pandap peetuutap sabato.

Ye kingo kagoba ko, kolaany koot ne po parak, ole ki tebee agot Petero, Johana, Jakobo ak Andrea, Philipu ak Thomas, Bartolomayo ak Matayo; Jakobo ne po kap Alphayo ak Simion Selote, ak Judas ne po kap Jakobo.
Ki tebi chu tugul eng' kabwaatet agenge eng' kagiiletapkei ne po saaet, kobooto kobogorisyek ak Maria kametap Jeso, ak tupchosyegap Jeso.
Eng' peetuusyechooto ko ki tonon Petero eng' kwenutap che tupcho (piik che kigatuiyo, ki olo po pogol agenge ak tiptem), ak kole,
“Che kitupche, konyolu kosulda siruutik che ki kamwa Kabuuset ne Tiliil eng' tai eng' kutitap Daudi agobo Judas, ne ki kandoindet ne ki indochin icheek che kinamei Jeso.
Amu ki kiititech, ak kinyoor kebebertanyi eng' poisyoni.”
(Ak kinyoor chiichi mbareet eng' melektap tengektanyi; ak kingo put kosyep moo, kobetak moet, komong' agutanikyik tugul.
Kinaak ng'olyoondonooto eng' tugul che menyei Jerusalem, kot keguure mbaranooto Akeldama eng' kutinnywa, nooto ko, Mbareet ne po korotiik.)
“Amu siraat eng' kitabuut ne po Tyenwogigap Kalasunet kole, ‘Ingoguber ole menyei, amat komeny chii olooto’; ak ‘Ingonam chiito age poisyennyi.’
Ingobiit age eng' piik che ki cham kebendoti tugul eng' peetuusyek tugul ye ki cham komong'u Kiptaiyat Jeso ak komandoi eng' kwenunnyo,
kotaune kabatisanetap Johana agoi peetuut ne ki kimuti kwo parak. Kanyool koek age eng' pichuuto paoryat kobootech agobo ng'eetyeennyi.”
Ara ki lewen piik aeng', Joseph ne ki kiguure Barsaba, (ak ki kiguure kora Justo) ak Matia.
Ak ki sa kole, “Ee Kiptaiyat, inyee ne ingen mugulelwegap piik tugul, iboorwech eng' pichu aeng', ne kailewen,
si kobiit konam kebeberta eng' poisyoni ak kayooktaoni, ne ki ibute Judas, si kobiit kwo oldanyi.”
Kiseer parbareek agobo icheek, ak ki ibutyi parbaryat Matia; ak ki kiitito che kiyooktoi taman ak agenge.
Kingo it peetuutap Pentekoste, ko ki mi tugul komosta agenge.
Ak ki mong' eng' sainooto cheet ne punu kipsengwet ko uu usoonet ne usei eng' kimnateet ne oo, ak ki nyi koot komugul ole ki tebee.
Ak ki mong'ji ng'elyebwek che pcheotin, che uu che po maat; ak ki tebee age tugul eng' icheek.
Ki nyi icheek tugul Kabuuset ne Tiliil ak ki toi kong'alaale kutusweek alak, ko uu ye ki igoochi Kabuuset ne Tiliil icheek kamuget kong'alaal.
Ki mi Yahudik che ki menyei Jerusalem, piik che ki konyiti Kamuktaindet, che ki punu pororyet age tugul ne mi kurereetap kipsengwet.
Kingo kas cheonooto, koyumgei tuiyet ak kokwong'yo, amu ki kas chii tugul pichooto kong'alaali eng' kutinnyi.
Ak ki tang'any tugul ak kokwong'yo komwaei koleen, “Ogeero, tos ma piigap Galilaya chu tugul ng'alaaldos?
Ak katepto ano si kegas acheek chii tugul eng' kutinnyo, ne ki kisiktech?
Echeek alak ko Partik, alak ko Medoik ak alak ko Elamik, alak kora ko che menyei Mesopotamia, Judea ak Kapadokia, Ponto ak Asia,
Phrygia ak Pamphylia, Misiri ak komoswek che po Libya che neegitee Kurene, ak toek che punu Rome, Yahudik kobooto che ki punji Yahudik eng' kayanennywa,
Kretik ak Arabuuk, kigase icheek kong'alaali eng' kutusweekyok poisyonik che eecheen che po Kamuktaindet.”
Ki tang'any tugul ak kogereer met, koleenjingei icheegei, “Egu nee ng'olyoondoni?”
Ago kichombil alak kole, “Kabogityo eng' divaik che leelach.”
Ago ki tonon Petero kobooto taman ak aeng' ak koleenji eng' kutit ne oo: “Okweek piigap Judea ak okweek tugul che omenye Jerusalem, ingonaak ni eng' okweek, ak oepchi iit ng'aleekyuk.
Ma pogityo pichu, ko uu ye obwaati; amu ta ko sait somok kityo.
Achicha, niito ne kimwaei maotyot Joel kole,

‘Tuun eng' peetuusyek che po let, mwaei Kamuktaindet, aroong'jini piik tugul Kabuusennyu ne Tiliil, ak komaoten weeriikwok ak tiibiikwok, ak kogeer murenikwok ng'ang'utik, ak korwotyi poisyekwok karwotitaosyek.
Ee, agot otwogikyuk, che murenik ak tiibiik, eng' peetuusyechooto aroong'jini Kabuusennyu ne Tiliil; si komaoten.
Ak abarte kwang'utik eng' kipsengwet parak, ak kaboorunoik eng' oli po ng'wony, korotiik, maat ak koiyenetap iyeto.
Kiwolei asiista koek mesundeito, ak kewal arawet koek korotiik, kotom koit peetuutap Kiptaiyat, peetuut ne oo ak ko ne tagunoot.
Ak age tugul ne kuurei kaineetap Kiptaiyat ko tuun kisaru.’

“Okweek piigap Israel, ogas ng'aleechu: Jeso ne po Nazareth, chiito ne ki ibarta Kamuktaindet eng' okweek eng' poisyonigap kimnateet ak kwang'utik ak kaboorunoik, che ki yai Kamuktaindet eng' ineendet eng' kwenung'wong', ko uu ye ongen okweek.
Ineendet ne ki igoito Kamuktaindet eng' pegechinetap ng'olyoondennyi ak naet ne kiga kechop eng' tai, ki ogartaat okweek ineendet ak obar eng' eunegap piik che pistoe ng'atuutik.
Ago ki ing'eet `Kamuktaindet ineendet, ko kagotyach eng' ng'wanindo ne po meet, amu ki ma komuuchi meet konam ineendet.
Amu ki mwa Daudi agobo ineendet kole, ‘Ki ageere Kiptaiyat kotugul komi tainnyu, amu mi ineendet eunnyu ne po tai si ma kitumduma.
Amu nooto anyun kogasegei muguleldanyu ak kibaibait ng'elyeptanyu; kobooto nooto komeng'iisyei poortanyu agine eng' kamang'unet.
Amu mebagakyini saboondanyu ye mi che ki kobek, Amegoitoi neng'ung' Ne Tiliil kogeer nunet.
Ki igoono anai ortinwegap saboondo; inyiitwa poiboiyet eng' taing'ung'.’
“Che kitupche, amwaiwok komyee agobo poiyot ne oo Daudi, ale, kime ak ki kitup, ak miitei kererinnyi kwenunnyo agoi ra.
Ak amu kimaotyo, ak ki ingen kole kiga koyasyechi `Kamuktaindet ineendet kole, indoi Kamuktaindet ng'echerennyi chiito ne tuun punu iyotennyi.
Kingo keer niito anyun kong'alaal agobo ng'eetyeetap Kristo kole, ‘Ma kibagakyin ineendet ye mi che kibek, ama nunei poortanyi.’
Ki ing'eet `Kamuktaindet Jeso niito, ne ki paorinikyik acheek tugul.
Amu itoroorot ineendet eng' eutap tai ne po Kamuktaindet, ak ko kagetaach eng' Kwanda kayomiset ne po Kabuuset ne Tiliil, ko kagoroong' anyun niito ogeere ak ogase.
Amu ki ma togosta Daudi kipsengwet, ago ki mwa ineendet kole, ‘Ki leenji Kiptaiyat Kiptaiyandennyu, Tebee eunnyu ne po tai,
agoi ayai puuniguk koek ng'echereetap keelyeguk.’
“Ingonai anyun komyee koot komugul ne po Israel kole, kigoyai `Kamuktaindet ineendet koek Kiptaiyat ak ko Kristo, Jeso niito ne ki ogartaat.”
Kingo kas anyun niito, kotoor mugulelwekwak, ak koleenji `icheek Petero ak che kiyooktoi chuun alak, “Che kitupche, ki yai nee?”
Koleenji `Petero icheek, “Osigu, si kibatisan age tugul eng' okweek eng' kaineetap Jeso Kristo agobo nyoetap kaat ne po tengekwogikwok; si otaach konunetap Kabuuset ne Tiliil.
Amu neng'wong' kayomisoni, ak lagokwok, ak tugul che mi ole loo, ak tugul che ta koguurei Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet nenyo kobwonji ineendet.”
Ak kibaoryan eng' ng'aleek alak che chaang' ak ko ki il koleenji, “Osaruge eng' ibini kunuur.”
Ki kibatisan anyun icheeget che kitaach ng'olyoondennyi, ak ki kitesyi icheek peetuunooto piik olo po eliphuusyek somok.
Ki igiiljingei icheek tugul kaneetisyetap che kiyooktoi ak yamdaet, eng' putuletap magatyat ak saautik.
Ki nyoor chii tugul kaiyweisyet, ak kiyaak kwang'utik che chaang' ak kaboorunoik eng' che kiyooktoi.
Ki mi tugul kibagenge che kiga koyan ak ki yamdoi tuguuk tugul.
Ki alda mbareenikwak ak tuguuk alak che ki tinyei ak kopchechi icheek tugul che tee che kinyaliili chii age tugul.
Ki mi Hekaluut peetuut age tugul kotebyei eng' kabwaatet agenge, ak eng' putuletap magatyat eng' kaa ak ki amisyei eng' kaagaasetapkei, ak eng' muguleldo agenge,
kolasu Kamuktaindet ak ki poiboi piik tugul agobo icheek. Ak eng' peetuut age tugul ko ki tesyin `Kiptaiyat icheek piik chooto ki nyooru sorunet.
Ki togosta Petero ak Johana hekaluut eng' sait ne po saaet, sait sogol.
Ak ki kiganabi chiito ne ki salamwo kobooch komi moetap kamet, ne ki cham kindoi peetuut age tugul kurgetap hekaluut ne ki kiguure Karaaran, si kosoomei tuguuk piik che ki pendi hekaluut oriit;
ko ye kingo keer `ineendet Petero ak Johana komachei koba hekaluut oriit, kosoom kole kogoochi kagoochinet.
Ak ki ichiilji kong' `Petero ineendet kobooto Johana, ak koleenji, “Keerech”.
Ak ki inyal `ineendet icheek, koleen nyoorune kiy.
Ago ki le Petero, “Ma tinye fedha ak thahabu; ago agoonin ne atinye. Ng'eet eng' kainetap Jeso Kristo ne po Nazareth, ak iwendote.”
Konam anyun ineendet eut ne po tai, ak kong'eet: ak ki nyoor kimnateet ngunooto keelyekyik ak kawegap ng'woniot.
Ki ng'eet kochokyi, ak kotonon, ak kotoi kowendot; ak ki pa hekaluut oriit kobooto icheeget kowendoti, kotorombenoti, ak kolosu Kamuktaindet.
Ak ki keer piik tugul ineendet kowendoti ak kolosu Kamuktaindet:
ak ki nai icheeget kole, ineendet ne ki cham kotebyei kosoomei konunoik eng' kurget ne kiguure Karaaran ne po hekaluut: ak ki kwong'yo miising' ak kotang'any agobo nooto kagoyaak eng' ineendet.
Ak kingota konamoti chiichooto Petero ak Johana, korwai piik tugul ole mi icheek eng' keterut ne kiguure ne po Solomon, kokwong'dos miising'.

Ak ye kingo keer Petero, kowolji piik koleenji, “Okweek piigap Israel, kalya si okwong'ye agobo ni? Anan kalya si ochiiljech kong' ko uu ne oleen acheek che kagigoochi ineendet kowendot eng' kamugennyo anan eng' imandanyo?

Kamuktaindet ne po Abraham, ak ne po Isak, ak ne po Jakobo, Kamuktaindet ne po kwanisyekyok, ko kagotoroor kiboitiondennyi Jeso, ne ki ogoite ak ki otiiye ineendet eng' taitap Pilato, ye kiga kobegechi kotyach ineendet.
Ago ki otiiye okweek Ineendet ne Tiliil ak ko po Imanda, ak osom ole kegonok rumiindet,
ak ki obar Ne Oo ne po saboondo; ne ki ing'eet Kamuktaindet eng' che ki pek; kibaorinigap nooto acheek.

Ak kagogoochi kainennyi chiichi kimnateet, amu kayanet eng' kainennyi, chiichi ogeere ak ongen okweek: ee, kayanet ne mi eng' Jeso ko kagogoochi chiichi sabeet ne igesunotkei eng' taing'wong' okweek tugul.
Ak nguno anyun, che kitupche, angen ale, ki oyai nooto amu kima ongen, ko uu ye ki yai pounikwok ak icheek.
Ago tuguuk che kiga koboor Kamuktaindet eng' tai eng' kutuswegap maotik tugul, kole tuun nyalili Kristo nenyi, ko kagoyai nooto kosulda.
Osigu anyun ak owalage, si kobiit kibukto tengekwogikwok, si kobwa anyun peetuusyek che po kamuung'et che punu taitap Kiptaiyat;
si koyook Kristo ne ki kilewenwok, ineendet Jeso:
ne kanyool kotaach kipsengwet agoi peetuusyek che kiwale tuguuk tugul komiagitu, che king'alaalee Kamuktaindet eng' kutuswegap maotikyik che tiliileen che ki mi kobooch taunetap ng'wony.
Ki mwa Musa iman, kole, ‘Ing'eetwok Kiptaiyat Kamuktaindet maotyot ne punu che otupche, ne uu anee’; ogas iit ineendet eng' tuguuk tugul che te che mwaiwok.
Ak tuun king'emei kiwong'u eng' kwenutap piik, chiito age tugul ne magase it maotiondonooto.
Ee, ak maotik tugul kobooch Samuel, ak icheek che ki pwanei let eng' ineendet, tugul che te che ki ng'alaal, ko ki mwa ak icheek agobo peetuusyechu.
O weeriigap maotik, ak che po kayomiset ne ki iyomiskei Kamuktaindet ak kwanisyekwok. Ki leenji Abraham, Kiberuuri pororyosyek tugul che po ng'wony eng' keswondeng'ung'.
Ak ye kingo kagong'eet Kamuktaindet kiboityondennyi, koyokwok okweek korook si koberuurok, ak koistoe chii age tugul eng' okweek tengekwogikyik.”
Kingo ta kong'alaaljin `Petero ak Johana piik, kobwonji icheeget `tisiik ak kiptaiyatap Hekaluut ak Sadukaik,
kotinyei nereegek amu ki ineet piik ak koamda eng' Jeso ng'eetyeetap che ki pek.
Ak ki nam icheeget ak kotoorchi korgoreet agoi mutai amu kiga koimen.
Ago ki iyan che chaang' eng' icheek che ki kas ng'olyoot; ak ki ek koitetap murenik olo po eliphuusyek muut.
Ak eng' peetuut ne ki isubi nooto koyumgei pounik ak poisyek ak siriik eng' Jerusalem;
ak Anas tisiindet ne oo, ak Caiaphas, ak Johana, ak Aleksanda, ak tugul che po ooreetap tisiindet ne oo.
Ak kingo kagonde icheek kwenunnywa, koteebe kole, “Nee kamuget ne koyae ni, anan eng' kainetap ng'oo?”
Kingo nyi anyun Petero Kabuuset ne Tiliil, koleenji icheek, “Okweek pounigap piik ak poisyek,
ngemachei keginenech rani agobo poisyet ne myee ne ko ki yachi chiito ne nyalulat, ole ko kisaapto chiichito;

ingonaak anyun eng' okweek tugul, ak eng' piik tugul che po Israel ole chiichi tononi eng' taing'wong', ko kagosap eng' kainetap Jeso Kristo ne po Nazareth, ne ki ogartaat okweek, ne ki ing'eet Kamuktaindet eng' che ki pek.
Jeso niito ko ‘koita ne ki osas okweek teegik, ne kiga kiyai koek metitap luuita.’
Ama mi yetunet eng' chiito age, amu ma mi kainet age eng' kurereetap kipsengwet, ne ki kigoochi piik, ne kanyool kesaruunenech.”
Kingo keer `icheek nyiganatetap Petero ak Johana, ak konai kole piich che ma ineetatin ama che taagunotiin, kokwong'yo ak konai kole ki cham komi kobooto Jeso.
Kingo keer chiito ne kogisoop kotononi kobooto icheek, ko mata komuuch komwa kiy agobo nooto.
Ago ye kingo kagong'at icheek komanda eng' kapkirwook, kong'alaal icheegei,
kole, “Ki itoi nee pichu? Amu naat eng' piik tugul che menyei Jerusalem keele koyaak iman eng' icheek kwang'utyet ne oo, ama kimuuchi ketiiye.
Ago si mata koiyestaat eng' kwenutap piik, konyolu keger kong' icheek, si mata kong'alaalji chii age tugul eng' kainaniito kogeny.”
Ara ki kuur icheek ak kong'at koleenji amatata kong'alaal anan koneetis agot kitigin eng' kainetap Jeso.
Ago ki wolji `Petero ak `Johana icheek koleenji, “Orwooch okweek ngot ngo myee eng' taitap Kamuktaindet kegasak iit kosiir Kamuktaindet.
Amu ma kimuuchi kesisye kobatee kemwa tuguuk che ki kegeer ak che kigegas.”
Kingo kagoger kong' icheek kogeny, kounda icheek koba, ko mata konyoor ng'olyoot ne irwookyine, amu piik; amu kiitoroor piik tugul Kamuktaindet agobo nooto koyaak.
Amu kisiirei artam kenyiisyegap chiichooto kiyaak eng' ineendet kwang'utyoniito po kasaabet.
Ak kingo kageunda, koba ole mi piikwak, ak komwaita tugul che kamwachi tisiik che eecheen ak poisyek.
Kingo kas icheek komwachi Kamuktaindet eng' kutit ne oo eng' kabwaatet agenge, koleenji, “Ee Kiptaiyat, inyee ne ki iyai kipsengwet ak ng'wony ak araraita, ak tugul che mi olooto,
ne ki imwa eng' Kabuuset ne Tiliil eng' kutitap kwandanyo Daudi kiboityondeng'ung', ile, ‘Kilya si kobolyo Pororyosyek, ak kobwaatoti piik tuguuk che ma namegei ak kiy?
Kitetegei laitorinigap ng'wony, ak koyumgei pounik, agobo Kiptaiyat, ak Kristo nenyi.’
Amu iman kituitos eng' nganasani Herod ak Pontio Pilato agine kobooto Pororyosyek ak piigap Israel, kole kogirinda Kiboityondeng'ung' ne Tiliil Jeso, ne ki iil,
si koyai kiit age tugul ne kisip kong'at eung'ung' ak ng'omnateng'ung' kole kosulda.
Ak nguno anyun, Kiptaiyat, keer kertaennywa po kong': ak igoochi otwogiguk komwa ng'olyoondeng'ung' eng' nyiganateet tugul,
ye iitoi inyee eung'ung' isoobi piik; si koyaak kaboorunoik ak kwang'utik eng' kainetap Kiboityondeng'ung' ne Tiliil, nooto ko Jeso.”
Kingo kagosa, kotumdumgei ole kiga koyumjigei; ak ki nyi icheek tugul Kabuuset ne Tiliil, ak ki mwa ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet eng' nyiganateet.
Ak ki po muguleldo agenge ak saboondo agenge tuiyet ne kiga koyan. Ma mwa chii agot agenge kole nenyi kiy age tugul ne ki tinyei, ago ki yamdoi tuguukwak tugul.
Ak kibaoryan che kiyooktoi eng' kimnateet ne oo agobo ng'eetyetap Kiptaiyat Jeso, ak ki tebee myeeindo ne oo icheek tugul.
Amu ki ma komi agot agenge eng' kwenunnywa ne kibanani kiy, amu tugul che ki tinyei korotinwek anan kooriik, ko ki alda ak koip tuguuk che kiga aldae kobwa
konde keelyegap che kiyooktoi; ak ki kipchechi chii age tugul ne ki nyalili.
Ki mi Lawindet, chiito ne kisalu Cyprus, nooto Joseph, ne kitoochi che kiyooktoi kainet ne po aeng' koguure Barnaba (ne ye kiweech ko “Weeriitap kagaigaet”), ne ki alda mbareet ne ki tinyei,
ak ki ip silingisyek konde keelyegap che kiyooktoi.
Ago ki mi chiito age ne ki kiguure Anania, ak osotyonnyi Sapira, ne ki alda korennyi,
ak kiituuch kebebertap che ki kialdae, kongen agine osotyonnyi, ki ip kebeberta age yeityo konde keelyegap che kiyooktoi.
Ago ki le Petero, “Anania, kalya si konyi Setani muguleldang'ung' kot iberber Kabuuset ne Tiliil, ak ituuch kebebertap che ki kialdae kooret?
Kingo ta komi, ko ki ma ko neng'ung'? Ak kingo kagealda, ko ki ma ibou? Kalya si ichop kii eng' muguleldang'ung'? Ma iberber chii, ago Kamuktaindet.”
Kingo kas Anania ng'aleechu, kobut ak kome. Ak ki nyoonji kaiyweisyet ne oo tugul che ki kas.
Ak king'eetyo `murenik ak kotaae muusto angeet, ak kosut kwo saang' ak kotup.
Ye ki neegit kogeskei saisyek somogu, koit osotyonnyi agine, ak ki ma kongen kiit ne kagoyaak.
Koleenji `Petero ineendet, “Mwaiwo ngo ki oaldae kooret tuguuk che tee chooto.” Kole ineendet, “Ee, tee chooto.”
Ago ki leenji `Petero ineendet, “Katepto ano kot ochamyechi tuwai oyoom Kabuusetap Kiptaiyat? Keero, mi kurgat keelyegap icheeget che katubei manong'otyondeng'ung', ak sutin aginye imande.”
Ak ki ibutyi keelyekyik sainooto ak kome. Ye kingo pwa ko anyun murenik konyoor ko kagome, ak kisut kwo saang' ak kotupchi ye neegitee manong'otyondennyi.
Konyonji anyun kaiyweisyet ne oo kaniset komugul kobooto tugul che ki kas tuguuchooto.
Kiyaogis eng' eunegap che kiyooktoi kaboorunoik ak kwang'utik che chaang' eng' kwenutap piik. Ak ki mi tugul eng' kabwaatet agenge eng' keterut ne po Solomon.
Ago eng' piik alak ko ki mata kobiit chii ne kita kogany konamgei ak icheeget, ago kiitoroor piik icheek.
Ak kitesak kayanik eng' Kiptaiyat kosiir, kichang'a murenik kobooto kobogorisyek;
kot komut icheek che myandos kobwa ortinwek, ak komogonji itogusyek ak kiplusisyek, kole tamangap kokwer urwetap Petero alak eng' icheek, kosiirtoi.
Ki iyomogei tuiyet ne punu nganasook che neegitee Jerusalem, komutu che myandos kobooto che ki inyalili tamirmirik che murwonen, ak ki kisoop age tugul eng' icheek.
Ago ki tonon tisiindet ne oo, inee ak tugul che ki mi kobooto ineendet (kasubiigap Sadukaichooto), ak ki nyiitaat icheek ng'et konda,
konam che kiyooktoi ak kotoorchi korgoreet ne po piik tugul.
Ago ki yaat malaikaiyatap Kiptaiyat kurgotigap korgoreet kemoi ak komut icheek komong' saang', ak koleenji,
“Oba, ak otonon eng' Hekaluut ak omwachi piik ng'aleek tugul che po Sabooni.”

Kingo kas ko uu nooto, koba Hekaluut ko kaech ak koneetis. Ye kingo nyo tisiindet ne oo ak che ki mi kobooto ineendet, koguur kirwooget ak poisyek tugul che po piigap Israel, ak koyookto kimut icheek kobwa eng' ole ki kiratyi.
Ago kingo it kiplugotinik koma nyoor icheek; ak kiweektagei icheek ak komwaita,
kole, “Kaginyooru ko kerat komyee korgoreet ak kotonondos riibiik eng' kurgotik, ago ye kangeyat, koma kenyoorchi chii oriit.”
Ak kingo kas ng'aleechu kiptaiyatap Hekaluut ak tisiik che eecheen, koiimgei miising' agobo icheek kole egu nee anyun ng'aleechu.
Ak ki nyo chii ak koleenji, “Ogeero, pichoo kogotoorchi korgoreet, kotonondos eng' Hekaluut ak koneeti piik!”
Kwo anyun kiptaiyat kobooto kiplugotinik ak komut kobwa, ago ma eng' kimnateet, amu ki iywei kole imuuch kolach piik `icheek eng' koik.
Kingo kagomut icheek kobwa, konde taitap kapkirwook. koteebee tisiindet ne oo icheek,
kole, “Kigeetenak inne keele, amatata oneet piik eng' kainani, ak ogeero, ki onyiit Jerusalem kaneetisyeng'wong', ak omache oibwech korotiigap chiichito kobwanjech.”
Ago ki wol Petero ak che kiyooktoi kole, “Kanyool kegas iit Kamuktaindet kosiir piik.
Ki ing'eet `Kamuktaindet ne po kwanisyekyok Jeso, ineendet ne ki obar ogartaat eng' keetit.
Ineendet ne kiitoroor Kamuktaindet eng' eunnyi ne po tai koek Ne Oo ago Yetindet, si kogoochi Israel siguunet ak nyoetap kaat ne po tengekwogik.
Ak ki paorinik acheek che po tuguuchu, ak Kabuuset ne Tiliil agine ne Ki kogoochi Kamuktaindet icheek che kase iit ineendet.”
Kingo kas icheek niito, kong'wanit miising' eng' mugulelwekwak, kot komach kobar icheek.
Ago ki tonon Pharisain eng' kapkirwook ne ki kiguure Gamaliel, kaneetindetap Ng'atuutik, ne kigonyiti piik tugul, ak kong'at kole kimut pichooto koba saang' ne matya.
Ak ki leenji icheek, “Okweek piigap Israel, oriipkei eng' pichu, eng' kiit ne omache oyai.

Amu kingo tomo koit peetuusyechu, koit Theudas kochoigei kole aa chiito ne oo ak konamgei ineendet ak piik che itei olo po pogol ang'wan. Ago ki kibar ineendet ak kiyesta tugul che kigase iit ineendet ak kibetyo.
Kingo pata chiichooto kong'eet Judas ne po Galilaya eng' peetuusyek che po sirisyetap kainaigap piik, ak kochuut piik alak koosup ineendet; kime agine, ak kiyesta tugul che kigase iit ineendet.
Ara anyun, amwaiwok nguno ale, oistoegei pichu ak omete icheek; amu ngo po piik ng'aleechu anan poisyoni, kowong'ugei;
ago ngot ko po Kamuktaindet, ko momuuchi owong'u; si ma kinyoorwok obortosi ak Kamuktaindet.” Kocham anyun ng'aleekyik,
ak kingo kagoguur che kiyooktoi kobwa ole mi icheek, kobir ak kong'at koleenji amatata kong'alaal eng' kainetap Jeso, yeityo kounda icheek koba.
Koba anyun eng' taitap kapkirwook koboiboi amu kagiit keele nyoljin konyoor kateweerisyet agobo Kainanooto.
Ak ki ma siisyo eng' peetuut age tugul koneetis ak koamdoi eng' Hekaluut ak eng' kooriik, kole Jeso ko Kristo.

Eng' peetuusyechooto anyun, ye kitesaksei koitetap kasubik, kong'eet kang'unyng'unyet eng' Yahudik che ki kutinnywa ko Yunanik, kong'unyng'ung'ji Yahudik, amu ki kinyasta mosoogikwak eng' tuguuk che ki cham kigoochin kotugul.
Koguur anyun tamanu ak aeng' tuiyet ne po kasubik ak koleenji, “Ma myee kebagaakte ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet ak keboisye eng' mesosyek.
Ko uu nooto anyun, che kitupche, ocheeng' piik tisap eng' okweek che taagunotiin keele myachen, che nyiitootiin Kabuuset ne Tiliil ak utaatyet, che kimuuchi kinde poisyoni.
Ago si ki kiiljige acheek saaet, ak kaneetisyetap ng'olyoot.”

Ki cham anyun tuiyet komugul ng'olyoondonooto; ak ki lewen Stepano, chiito ne nyiitaat kayaneet ak Kabuuset ne Tiliil, ak Philipu, ak Prokoro, ak Nikanor, ak Timon, ak Parmena, ak Nikola ne po Antiok ne kiwalak koek Yahudyot.
Ki inde chooto anyun taitap che kiyooktoi, che ki imuuch kosachi ak kogonoor icheek eunekwak.
Kitesak anyun ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet; ak kotesak miising' koitetap kasubik eng' Jerusalem; ak kogas iit kayaneet tuiyet ne oo ne po tisiik.
Ak kinyiitat Stepano myeeindo ak kamuget, koyai anyun kwang'utik che eecheen ak kaboorunoik eng' kwenutap piik.
Ago king'eetyo alak che po sinagogit ne po Che Ityagotin (ko uu ye ki kiguuree), che ki punu Cyrene, che po Alexandria, ak alak chooto che po piigap Cilicia ak Asia, ak kobelgei ak Stepano.
Ago ki ma imuuch icheek kogirinda utaatyet ak Kabuuset ne Tiliil ne ki ng'alaale ineendet.
Kogaigai anyun eng' ung'at piik komwa kole, “Kigegas komwaei ineendet ng'aleek che po chubisyet agobo Musa ak Kamuktaindet.”
Kong'eetng'eet anyun piik konereekso ak poisyek, ak siriik, kobwonji ineendet ak konam ak komut kwo kapkirwook,
ak konde paorinik che po lembech, che ki mwa kole, “Mabagaaktoi chiichi komwa ng'aleek che yaach agobo yu tiliil ak Ng'atuutyet;
amu kigegas ineendet komwaei koleen, tatun kong'emei yuto Jeso niito po Nazareth, ak kowal pitonwek che ki koonech Musa.”
Ki ichiilji kong' anyun ineendet `piik tugul che kitebyei eng' kapkirwook, kogeer togeennyi ko uu togeetap malaikaiyat.
koteebee anyun tisiindet ne oo kole, “Tos uu chooto tuguuchu?”
Kowol Stepano kole, “Che kitupche ak kwanisyekyok, ogaso! Ki mong'ji Kamuktaindet ne po toroornatet kwandanyo Abraham, ye ki mi Mesopotamia, kotomo komeny Haran.
Ki leenji, ‘Mong'u eng' emeng'ung' ak eng' ole mi piiguk, ak inyoo emet neta aboorun.’
Komong' anyun eng' emetap Kaldeik ak komeny Haran. Kingo kagome kwandanyi, ko uu `Kamuktaindet ineendet, konyo emoniito omenye rani.
Ki ma igoochi ineendet poroteet eng' olooto, acha, agot ole indoi keldanyi; ak ki iarorchi kole tuun igoochin ineendet ak iyotennyi eng' let, nganda kitom kosich lakwa.
Ak ki mwa Kamuktaindet ko uu ni, kole, Egu lagokyik punootik eng' emetap piik alak, che tuun yaei icheek koek otwogik ak koyachi ne ya eng' kenyiisyek pogol ang'wan.
Ago arwookyini pororyonooto ne ratei icheek. Ak ye ibata nooto komong' ak koboisyeiwo eng' olito.
Ki igoochi ineendet arorutyet ne po kamuratanet. Ki sich anyun `Abraham Isak ak komuratan ineendet eng' peetuut ne po sisiit. Kosich `Isak Jakobo, ak ki sich `Jakobo kwanisyekyok taman ak aeng'.
“Ye kingo am ng'et kong' poisyechooto agobo Joseph, koalda ineendet kwo Misiri. Ago ki mi Kamuktaindet kobooto ineendet,
ak ki sar ineendet eng' nyalilwogikyik tugul, ak kogoochi chameet ak utaatyet eng' taitap Pharaoh laitoryatap Misiri; ne ki inde ineendet koek pounindet eng' Misiri ak koonnyi tugul.
Ki nyo anyun rubeet Misiri komugul ak Kanaan, ak ki piit nyalilda ne oo, ak ma nyoor kwanisyekyok amitwogik.
Ago ye kingo kas Jakobo kole miitei peek Misiri, koyookto kwanisyekyok eng' panda ne po tai.
Ak eng' panda ne po aeng' koboorchigei `Joseph tupchosyekyik; ak kinaak eng' Pharaoh piigap Joseph.
Ak ki iyookto Joseph kole keguur kwandanyi Jakobo ak piikyik tugul, piik tamanwogik tisap ak muut.
Kochoortagei anyun Jakobo kwo Misiri. Ki me ineendet eng' olooto ko uu kwanisyekyok.
Ki kila icheek koba Shekem ak ki kitupchi kererit ne kiga al Abraham eng' kamanuutyetap fedha eng' weeriigap Hamor eng' Shekem.
“Ye kingo riik peetuut ne po arorutyet, ne ki iyasyechi `Kamuktaindet Abraham, koyabak piik ak kotesagis eng' Misiri,
agoi kobiit laitoryat age eng' Misiri, ne ki ma kongen Joseph.
Ki ng'oomenji ineendet pororyennyo, ak koyachi ne ya kwanisyekyok, si kolakta manyurunikwak si ma sapcho.
Eng' peetuusyechooto ko ki kisich Musa ak ki karaaran ineendet miising'; ak ki kigu eng' kootap kwandanyi arawek somok;
ak kingo kagemeto, konyo che po Pharaoh, konyo komut ak kogu koek weeriinnyi.
Ak ki kineet Musa utaatyet tugul ne po Misiriik ak ki kiim eng' ng'aleekyik ak poisyonikyik.
“Ye kingo it olo po kenyiisyek artam, kobwaat eng' muguleldanyi korutoochi tupchosyekyik, piigap Israel.
Ye kingo keer kinyaliili age eng' icheek, kotoret ineendet ak koyaaktoochi mugetuut ineendet ne kaginyalili, kokwer Misirindet kobar.
Ki leen ineendet naei tupchosyekyik kole igoochin Kamuktaindet icheek saruunet eng' eunnyi, ago ma nai.
Ak eng' peetuut ne isubi nooto kochunji icheek koboortos, ak kimachei ko oiyo icheek, koleenji, Murenju, otupche okweek; kalya si oyachigei ne ya?
Ago ki toorta ineendet ne ki yachi nin age ne ya, ak kole, Ng'oo ne koindein iegu pounindet ak kirwoogindet kot irwokwech?
Imache ibara ko uu ye koibar Misirindet amut?
Ki mwee Musa anyun ng'olyoondonooto, kwo komwei ak koek punootyo eng' emetap Midian, ole ki sikyi weeriik aeng'.
“Kingo pata kenyiisyek artamu, komong'ji ineendet `malaikaiyat eng' surkwen ne po tulweetap Sinai, eng' maat ne lalei eng' keetit ne samum.
Ak kingo keer Musa, kokwong' eng' kioto kageer; ak kingo riikta kole kogeer, kotwek kutitap Kiptaiyat kole:
‘Aa Kamuktaindet ne po kwanisyeguk, Kamuktaindet ne po Abraham, ak ne po Isak, ak ne po Jakobo.’ Kobotan Musa ak ko mata kogany kogeer.
Koleenji Kiptaiyat anyun ineendet, ‘Icheru kweoniguk eng' keelyeguk, amu tiliil ng'wonyut yooto itonone.
Ki ageer iman nyalildap piikyuk che miitei Misiri, ak ki agas tigenennywa, ak kaachooruge si kobiit asar icheek: nyoo anyun nguno, ayookten iwe Misiri.’

“Musa niito ne ki eesyo icheek, koleen, ‘Ng'oo ne koindein iegu pounindet ak kirwoogindet?’ Ineendet ne ki iyookto Kamuktaindet eng' eutap malaikaiyat ne ki mong'ji ineendet eng' keetit si kobiit koek pounindet, ak katyagindet.
Ki imut chiichi anyun icheek komanda, ye kingo kagoyai kwang'utik ak kaboorunoik eng' Misiri, ak eng' araraita ne piriir, ak eng' kenyiisyek artam eng' surkwen.
Musa niito ko nooto ne ki leenji piigap Israel, ‘Ing'eetwok Kamuktaindet ne Toroor maotyot ne tuun punu che otupche, ne uu anee.’
Ye kimi tuiyet eng' surkwen, ko Musa niito ne ki ng'alaalji `malaikaiyat eng' tulweet ne po Sinai ak kobooto kwanisyekyok. Ineendet ne ki taach ng'aleek che saptos si kogoonech.
Ki ma kas iit kwanisyekyok ineendet, ago ki eesyo ineendet, ak kiweektagei mugulelwekwak Misiri,
koleenji Aron: ‘Yaiywech kanamonik kondoenech; amu ma kingen ole katepto Musa niito, ne ki imutwech kemang'une emetap Misiri.’
Ki yai anyun moita eng' peetuusyechooto, ak koipchi tiseiywot kanamwonooto, ak koboiboitu eng' poisyonigap eunekwak.

Ago ki ituktoochi patai Kamuktaindet icheek, ak kogoito icheek koot lugeetap kipsengwet; ko uu ye siraat eng' bukuitap maotik, keele: ‘Tos ki ogoono che kiyagi che kageeny ak tiseiywek eng' kenyiisyek artam eng' surkwen, Ee kootap Israel?
Ki oip okweek emait ne po Molok, ak kecheiyat ne po kanamwet Repan, kanamonik che ki oyai si osaa. Ara amu nooto autok obe Babilon pitoniin.’
“Ki tinyei kwanisyekyok Emait ne po Paornateet eng' surkwen, ko uu ye kiga koaror ineendet ne ki mwachi Musa, koleenji, koyai ko uu kergeindo ne kiga kogeer.
Ne ki ip kwanisyekyok ak icheek eng' peetuusyekwak, kobooto Joshua, ye kinamei Pororyosyek, che ki oon Kamuktaindet eng' taitap kwanisyekyok. Ki mi yooto agoi peetuusyegap Daudi,
ne kinyoor chameet eng' taitap Kamuktaindet, ak kosoom konyoor meng'ootetap Kamuktaindet ne po Jakobo.
Ago ki Solomon ne kiteekyi ineendet koot.
“Ago ma menyei Ineendet Ne Toroor Miising' kooriik che kiyae eunek; ko uu ye mwaei maotyot, kole,
‘Ng'echerennyu ne po laitornatet kipsengwet, ak ng'wony ko ng'echereetap keelyekyuk. Tos oteekwo koot ne uu nee? Mwaei Kiptaiyat, anan ano ole amuung'e?
Tos ma eunnyu ne kiyaei tuguuchu tugul?’
“Okweek che uui kaat che ma kimuratan mugulelwek ak iitiik, ogirindoi Kabuuset ne Tiliil kotugul, oyae ak okweek ko uu ye kiyaei kwanisyekwok.
Ng'oo eng' maotik ne ma us kwanisyekwok? Ak ki par che kisip koboor nyonunetap Chiito ne po Imanda; ne kaoegu okweek nguno ng'wektoik ak rumiik.
Okweek che ki otaach Ng'atuutyet ko uu ye ki king'at eng' malaikaisyek, ak ma oriip.”
Ye kingo kas ng'aleechuuto kong'woneegitu miising' eng' mugulelwekwak, ak konyei kelek agobo ineendet.
Ago ki inyal kipsengwet kochiilji kong' ko nyiitaat ineendet Kabuuset ne Tiliil, ak ki keer liilindap Kamuktaindet ak Jeso kotononi eng' eutap tai ne po Kamuktaindet.
Ak ki le, “Ogeero, ageere kipsengwet ko kagoyatagis, ak kotononi Weeriitap chii eng' eutap tai ne po Kamuktaindet.”
Ago ki polyo eng' kutit ne oo, ak koger iitiikwak, ak kotorombenji kibagenge;
ak ki toorta ineendet komanda eng' nganaseet, ak kolage koik. Ki inde paorinik ngoroikwak keelyegap muren age ne ki kiguure Saulo.
Kolach anyun Stepano, koguurei Kiptaiyat, koleen, “Kiptaiyat Jeso, taach saboondanyu.”
Ak kigutuny ak komwa eng' kutit ne oo kole, “Kiptaiyat, ameiityi icheek tengegi.” Ak kingo kagomwa niito, konuuch.

Ak ki iyan Saulo agine agobo pareetap Stepano. Ki ng'eet peetuunooto usiisyet ne oo agobo kaniset ne ki mi Jerusalem, ak kiyesta icheek tugul koyom emotinwegap Judea ak Samaria, kobatee che kiyooktoi.
Kotup anyun Stepano `piik che ki konyiti Kamuktaindet, ak koteiyo miising' agobo ineendet.
Ago ki inyaliil miising' `Saulo kaniset, kowendi koot age tugul ak kochuutu murenik ak kobogorisyek ak kotoorchin korgoreet.
Ki pa anyun icheek che kiga koyesta, koamdaat ng'olyoot.
Ak kichoortagei Philipu nganaseet ne po Samaria, ak koamji icheek Kristo.
Ak ki epchi iit tuiyosyek eng' yamdaet agenge ng'aleek che kimwaei Philipu, ye kingo kas ak kogeer kaboorunoik che ki yai.
Amu kimanda tamirmirik che murwonen eng' che chaang' che ki tinyei, kowaaktos eng' kutit ne oo; ak ki kisoop che chaang' che meiyotiin poorwek, ak che ki ing'waldos.
Ara ki piit poiboiyet ne oo eng' nganasanooto.
Ki mi chiito age ne ki kiguure Simion, ne ki cham kong'orsei eng' peetuusyek alak eng' nganasanooto, ak ki igoochi pororyetap Samaria kokwong'yo, komwaei ineendet kole chiito ne oo.
Ki epchin iit `icheek tugul ineendet, kobooch ne ming'in agoi ne oo, koleen, “Kimnateetap Kamuktaindet chiichi ne kiguure Ne Oo.”
Ak ki epchin iit ineendet, amu ki cham kogoochin kokwong'yo eng' peetuusyek che chaang' eng' ng'oorsosyekyik.
Ago ye kingo yan ng'aleegap Philipu ye ki amdoi logoiywek che myach agobo laitornatetap Kamuktaindet ak kainetap Jeso Kristo, kibatisan anyun murenik kobooto kobogorisyek.
Ki iyan Simion agine ak kingo kagibatisan kotebi kobooto Philipu. Ak kingo keer koyaogis kaboorunoik ak poisyonigap kimnateet kokwong'.
Kingo kas anyun che kiyooktoi che ki mi Jerusalem kole kogotaach Samaria ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet, koyookyi Petero ak Johana.
Ye kingo kagochoorgei icheek, kosa agobo icheek kole si kotaach Kabuuset ne Tiliil;
amu kitom kochoorchigei agot agenge eng' pichooto. Kiga kibatisan icheek eng' kainetap Kiptaiyat Jeso kityo.
Yeityo kogonoor icheek eunekwak, ak kitaach Kabuuset ne Tiliil.
Ye kingo keer anyun Simion kole kaga kigoochin chii Kabuuset ne Tiliil ngo konoor `che kiyooktoi eunekwak, kogoochi `silingisyek che kiyooktoi
ak kole, “Ogoono agane kimnatoni si ngagonoor chii age tugul eunekyuk, kotaach Kabuuset ne Tiliil.”
Ago ki leenji Petero ineendet, “Ingobetyo siling'isyeguk kobooten, amu keleen inyooru konunetap Kamuktaindet eng' silingisyek.
Metinye kebeberta anan motwet eng' ng'olyoondoni, amu ma myee muguleldang'ung' eng' taitap Kamuktaindet.
Sigu anyun eng' tengeging'ung'et ak isaa Kiptaiyat, tamangap kenyoun kaat amu kabwaatetap muguleldang'ung'.
Amu ageere ale imi eng' ng'wanindo ak eng' ratuutyetap tengekto.”
Ak ki wol Simion kole, “Osaiywa Kiptaiyat, si ma pwanjo agot agenge tuguuk che kaomwaiwo.”
Ye kingo kagobaoryan anyun Petero ak Johana ak komwa ng'olyootap Kiptaiyat, koweektagei Jerusalem, ak koamji logoiywek che myach nganasook che chaang' che po Samarik.
Ki mwachi malaikaiyatap Kiptaiyat anyun Philipu koleenji, “Ng'eet ak iwe murot tai agoi ooreet ne choortogei kong'etee Jerusalem ne wendi agoi Gaza” (punei oranooto ole melewet).

Ara king'eet anyun ineendet ak kwo. Ak keero ki mi chiitap Ethiopia ne ki kimooch, ne ki tinyei pounateet ne oo eng' eutap Kandake, laitoryat kwondo ne po Ethiopik, ne kiriibei tuguukyik tugul che po kamanuutyet ne oo. Kiga nyo Jerusalem kosa;
ak ki weeksei kaa anyun, kotebee chepkichutinnyi, ak kosomani bukuitap maotyot Isaiah.
Ak ki leenji `Kabuuset ne Tiliil Philipu anyun, “Ui riikte, onamgei ak chepkichutina.”
Ak ki labat Philipu ak kogas ineendet kosomani bukuitap maotyot Isaiah, ak ki leenji, “Iguitosi kiit ne isomani?”
Ak ki le, “Amuktoi ano, ngo ma iboorwo chii?” Ak ki igaigai Philipu `ineendet kole kolaany chepkichutit ak kotebi tuwai.

Ak chu siruutik che kisomanoti, “Ki kimut ko uu keechiiryet ne ki kweryei kwo eng'seet; ak ko uu aarwetap keechiiryet ne siisei eng' taitap chiito ne tilei koroorikyik, uu nooto agine mang'aany kutinnyi.
Ki kiisto kirwoogennyi eng' kaming'inennyi pogei. Ng'oo ne tuun mwaitoi ibindanyi? Amu kinemu saboondanyi eng' ng'wony.”
ki teebee `chiichooto ki kimooch Philipu koleenji, “Asoomin ale, mwaei maotyot ng'olyoondoni agobo ng'oo? Agobo ineendet anan agobo chiito age?”
Kong'aany anyun Philipu kutinnyi, ak kotoi eng' siruutyoni koamji ineendet agobo Jeso.
Ye kingo ta kobendi eng' ooreet, koit ye mi peek, kole chiichooto, “Keer peek o; nee ne kera si ma kibatisana?”
Ak ki le Philipu, “Ngiyan eng' muguleldang'ung' tugul, kimuuchi kibatisanin.” Ak ki wol kole, “Ayani ale Jeso Kristo ko Weeriitap Kamuktaindet.”
Kong'at anyun kotonon chepkichutit, ak kichoortagei tuwai koba peek, Philipu ak chiichooto; ak ki ibatisan `Philipu ineendet.
Ye kingo long' eng' peek, komut `Kabuusetap Kiptaiyat Philipu. Ak mata kogeer anyun kogeny `chiichooto ki kimooch Philipu, ago ki wo kotestai chiichooto eng' poiboiyet.
Ak ki took Philipu eng' Azoto. Ye kisiirtoi kobune emonooto, ko ki amjinoti logoiywek che myach nganasook tugul agoi koit Caesarea.
Ye kita konereechi Saulo koboisyee kamuiset ak parisyet agobo kasubigap Kiptaiyat. Ki wo kaptisiindet ne oo,
ak kosoom ineendet paronok che ibei koba Damasko agobo sinagogisyek, kole ngo nyoor alak tugul che po Oranooto, ngo murenik anan kobogorisyek, komuuchi komut kobwa Jerusalem ko ratotiin.
Ye kita kowendi ak ko kariikta Damasko, kooluu sainooto lapkeiyet ne ki punu kipsengwet koluuchi ineendet komoswek tugul.
Ki ibutyi, ak kogas kutit koleenji ineendet, “Saulo, Saulo, amu nee si iusa?”
Ak ki le, “Ii ng'oo, Kiptaiyat?” Ak ki le, “Aa Jeso ne iuse.
Ago ng'eet, ui nganaseet, si kemwaun kiit ne kanyool iyai.”
Ak kitononso konam kuut piik che kibendi kobooto ineendet, kogasei tweguunet, ama keerei chii.
Ki ng'eet anyun Saulo, ak kingo kagoyatagis konyekyik, koma kogeerei kiy; komut anyun `icheek ineendet konamoti euut agoi Damasko.
Ki tar ineendet peetuusyek somok ama keerei kiy, ama amisyei anan koeeiso.
Ki mi kasubindet age Damasko ne ki kiguure Anania. Ki leenji `Kiptaiyat ineendet eng' ng'ang'utyet, “Anania.” Kowol Anania kole, “Ami yu, Kiptaiyat.”
Koleenji Kiptaiyat, “Ng'eet, ui ooreet ne kiguure Ne Litit, ak iteep eng' kootap Judas chiito ne kiguure Saulo, chiitap Tarsis. Keero, saaei;
ak kagogeer ineendet eng' ng'ang'utyet chiito ne kiguure Anania, konyonei agoi ko, ak kogonoor ineendet eunekyik si kogeerto.”
Ago ki wol Anania kole, “Kiptaiyat, ki agas eng' piik che chaang' agobo chiichito, ole tee yaityet ne ki koyachi piiguk che tiliileen eng' Jerusalem;
ak tinyei eng' yuto kimnateet ne punu tisiik che eecheen si korat tugul che kuurei kaineng'ung'.”
Ago ki leenji Kiptaiyat, “Ui inyee, amu kinnyu ineendet ne aboisyee ne ki alewen, si koip kainennyu taitap Pororyosyek ak laitorinik, ak piigap Israel:
amu aboorchini ineendet ole tee chaang'indap tuguuk che kanyool konyoorunee nyalilda agobo kainennyu.”

Ki wo anyun Anania, ak ki wo agoi ko, yeityo kogonoor eunekyik Saulo ak koleenji, “Tupchennyu Saulo, kagiyokwo Kiptaiyat, ineendet Jeso, ne kichunjin eng' ooreet ne ki ibunu, kole igeerte, ak kinyiitun Kabuuset ne Tiliil.”
Ak eng' sainooto kobutyo eng' konyekyik tuguuk che uu peerik, ak kigeerto. Ki ng'eet anyun ak ki kibatisan;
ak ki amis ak ki nyoor kimnateet. Ki tebi ineendet peetuusyo alak kobooto kasubik che ki mi Damasko.
Ak ne matyanit koamda agobo Jeso eng' sinagogisyek kole, “Ineendet ko Weeriitap Kamuktaindet.”

Ki kwong'yo tugul che ki kas ineendet ak kole, “Tos ma chiichi ne kotar piik eng' Jerusalem, icheeget che cham koguurei kainani? Ak kogonyo oli agobo ng'olyoondoniito si kobiit komut icheek ko ratotiin koba taitap tisiik che eecheen.”
Ago kitesak Saulo kogimit, ak ki igoochi kokwong'yo Yahudik che ki menyei Damasko, koboorchin icheek komyee kole Jeso niito ko Kristo.
Ak ye kingo keskei peetuusyek che chaang', kotuiyo Yahudik korwooch kole kobar ineendet,
ago kinaak eng' Saulo chobennywa ne po ung'oot. Ki riip icheek ormariichok peet ak kemoi kole si kobar ineendet;
ago ki imut `kasubikyik ineendet kemoi, ak kochoorta kosiir irimeet, komiitei mesendet oriit.
Ye kingo nyo `Saulo Jerusalem kotyem kole koyomogei ak kasubik; ago ki iywei `icheek tugul ineendet, ama iyan kole kasubindet ineendet.

Ago ki imut Barnaba ineendet kwo ole mi che kiyooktoi, ak kotetyi anyun ole kigeerto `ineendet Kiptaiyat eng' ooreet, ak kole kiga kong'alaalji ineendet, ak ko uu ye kigoamda eng' nyiganateet eng' Damasko eng' kainetap Jeso.
Ara ki mi kobooto icheek ak komong'u eng' Jerusalem, komandoi eng' nyiganateet eng' Kainetap Kiptaiyat.
Ki ng'alaali ak kobeligei kobooto Yahudik che ki kutinnywa ko Yunanik; ago ki cheeng'ei kotugul kole kobar ineendet.
Ye kingo nai tupchosyek, komut ineendet kochoortagei kwo Caesarea ak koyookto kwo Tarsis.
Konyoor anyun kamuung'et kaniset eng' emet komugul ne po Judea, Galilaya ak Samaria ak koteegak. Ak ye kibendoti eng' kayweetap Kiptaiyat ak eng' kagaigaet ne po Kabuuset ne Tiliil, kotesak.
Ye kiwendote Petero komoswek tugul, kochoortagei ole ki mi che tiliileen che ki menyei Lydda.
Ak kinyoorchi olooto chiito age ne ki kiguure Ainea, ne kiga korue itogunnyi kenyiisyek sisiit, amu ki meat poorto.
Koleenji anyun `Petero ineendet, “Ainea, isaabin Jeso Kristo; ng'eet ak iite itogung'ung'.” Kong'eet anyun sainooto.
Ak kigeer ineendet tugul che ki menyei Lydda ak Sharon, ak koyan Kiptaiyat.
Ki mi agenge eng' kasubik Joppa ne ki kiguure Tabita, ne ye kiweech eng' kutitap Yunanik ko Dorkas. Ki tinyei kobogoryondoni poisyonik che chaang' che myach ak kagoochinoik che ki igoitoi.
Ak kimyan eng' peetuusyechooto, ak kime. Kingo kagoun, konde koot age ne mi parak.
Ak amu kineegityin Lydda ak Joppa, ko ye kingo kas kasubik kole mi Petero olooto, koyookyi piik aeng' ineendet, kosoom kole, “Nyonjech, amegagei.”

Kong'eet anyun Petero ak koba ak icheek. Ak kingo kagoit, komut ineendet kwo koot ne po parak. Ak kitonondos mosoogik tugul koriirtos eng' ye neegit ineendet ak koboorchi sumotik ak ngoroik che kinabei Dorkas ye kita komi kobooto icheek.
Komaanda Petero tugul koba saang', yeityo kogutuny ak kosa. Ki weleljigei muusto ak koleenji, “Ng'eet, Tabita.” Ak ki yaat konyekyik, ak kingo keer `ineendet Petero, kong'eet kotep ng'wony.
Ki igoochi ineendet eunnyi ak konam kotoret ineendet kong'eet. Ye kingo kagoguur che tiliileen ak mosoogik, konde ineendet tainnywa ko kagosap.
Kinaak niito eng' Joppa komugul, ak ki iyan che chaang' Kiptaiyat.
Ak ki tebi eng' Joppa peetuusyek che chaang' kobooto chiito age ne ki kiguure Simion ne teiteindetap muiywek.
Ki mi chiito age Caesarea ne ki kiguure Korneli, ki kiptaiyatap kiplugotinik pogol chooto ki kiguure asigarigap Italy.
Ki chiito ne kigonyiti ak koywei Kamuktaindet kobooto koonnyi tugul; ki igoochin piik kagoochinoik che chaang' ak kosaaei Kamuktaindet kotugul.
Eng' koskoleng'ut age olo po sait sogool ne po peet ko ki keer eng' ng'ang'utyet kimni, ne eng' ng'ang'utyonooto ko ki keer malaikaiyatap Kamuktaindet konyonjin ineendet ak koleenji, “Korneli.”
Keer `Korneli ineendet miising' eng' kaiyweisyet ak kole, “Tos nee, Kiptaiyat?” Koleenji, “Kigoit parak saautiguk ak kagoochinoiguk koek kabwaatet eng' taitap Kamuktaindet.
Iyookte nguno anyun piik koba Joppa, koguur chii ne kiguure Simion ne kainennyi ne po aeng' ko Petero;
ineendet ko toondetap Simion ne teiteindetap muiywek, ne mi koonnyi ngeguutap araraita.”
Ye kingo kakwa malaikaiyat ne ki ng'alaalji ineendet, koguur otwogik aeng' che po koonnyi, ak asigarindet ne kigonyiti Kamuktaindet ne ki age eng' che kiboisyechin ineendet kotugul;
ak kingo kagomwachi icheek ng'aleek tugul, koyookto koba Joppa.
Eng' peetuut ne ki isubi ye kita kobendi, ko kariikta nganaseet, kotogosta Petero koot parak, eng' olo po sait lo, kwo kosa.
Ak ki am rubeet ak kimach koamis; ak ye ki kichobei amitwogik, kobutyi kiy ne uu rwon.
Ki keer kipsengwet koyaatak, ak kochoorugei kiit ne uu angeet ne oo kot, kechooru eng' kuinoik ang'wan agoi ng'wony.
Ki mi oriit tyong'ik alak tugul che po keelyek ang'wan ak tuguuk che ichuutegei che po ng'wony ak toriitik che po parak.
Ki nyoonji anyun tweguunet koleenji, “Ng'eet, Petero; eeny ak iam.”
Ago ki le Petero, “Ma uu nooto, Kiptaiyat; amu tomo aam kiy ne ma tiliil anan ne ng'waan kobooch atkinye kora.”
Ki nyoonji anyun tweguunet kogeny ne po aeng' koleenji, “Kiit ne kagotiliil Kamuktaindet, ko mata ile ng'waan.”
Ki yaak kiito konyil somok, ak eng' yooto ketaach kioto eng' kipsengwet.
Ak ye kita koiimegei Petero miising' eng' muguleldanyi kole ibooru nee ng'ang'utyoni kagogeer, ogeero, kotononso eng' kurgat piik che kiga koyook Korneli, ko kagoteep ole mi kootap Simion,
ak koguurso ak koteep ngo mi Simion olooto, ne kainennyi ne po aeng' ko Petero.
Ye kita kobwaati Petero agobo ng'ang'utyonooto, koleenji `Kabuuset ne Tiliil ineendet, “Keero, cheeng'in piik somogu.
Ng'eet anyun nguno, ak ichoortegei, ak obe tugul, amesage kiy; amu kaayogu icheek.”
Ara kichoortagei anyun Petero kwo ole mi pichooto ak kole, “Aa ineendet ne ocheeng'e. Nee ne kagoonok obwa?”

Ak ki le, “Ki iboorchi komyee Kamuktaindet Korneli, eng' malaikaiyat ne tiliil, koyook piik kobwa koguurin iwe koonnyi ne ineendet ko kiptaiyatap pogol, chiito ne po imanda ak koywei Kamuktaindet, ak paoryanjin pororyet tugul ne po Yahudik kole myee ineendet, kole si kogasenen ng'aleek.”
Koguur anyun kobwa ko ak kochopchi icheek ole ruitos. Ak king'eet karon koba kobooto pichooto ak tupchosyek alak che ki punu Joppa.
Ak peetuut ne ki isubi peetuunooto koit Caesarea. Ki igeni icheek `Korneli, ko kagoguur tupchosyekyik ak choronokyik che ki ingengei komyee.
Ye kingwo ko Petero, kotorooch `Korneli ineendet ak kobutyi keelyekyik, kogutung'ji.
Ago ki ing'eet `Petero ineendet koleenji, “Tonon; aneendet ko aa chiito agane.”
Ak kingo ta kong'alaaljindos tuwai, kwo ko ak konyoor piik che chaang' che kagoyumgei:

koleenji anyun icheek, “Ongen okweek ole kiy ne eesyoot eng' ng'atuutik eng' chii ne Yahudyo konamgei ak chii ne po poror age anan konyo ole mi; ago kagoboorwo anee Kamuktaindet kole si mata aguure chii age ne ma tiliil anan ne ng'waan.
Amu nooto anyun, ye kingo kageguura ko kaanyo amata asich kiy ne amwae. Nooto anyun ateebee ale nee ne koguurcho.”
Kole anyun Korneli, “Peetuusyek ang'wan rani kobooch yooto agoi saini, ye ki asaae eng' sait sogool eng' koonnyu; ak keero, ki tonon eng' tainnyu mureno ne ilaachi ngoroik che liilei piich,
ak kole, ‘Korneli, kigegas saaeng'ung', ak ki koek kabwaatet eng' taitap Kamuktaindet kagoochinoiguk.
Iyookte anyun piik koba Joppa si koguurun Simion ne kainet ne po aeng' ko Petero; miitei ineendet ko toondet eng' kootap Simion teiteindetap muiywek, ye neegitee ngeguutap araraita.’
Ki ayoogu anyun piik eng' sainooto kobwa ole imi; ak kaiyai ne myee amu kainyo. Ki mi anyun yu nguno acheek tugul eng' taitap Kamuktaindet, si kegas tuguuk tugul che king'atin Kiptaiyat.”
Ki ng'aany anyun Petero kutinnyi, kole, “Iman ageere ale ma chamei `Kamuktaindet piik alak kosiir alak:
ago taachaksei eng' ineendet chiito ne iywei ineendet ak koyaei iman eng' pororyet age tugul.
Ng'olyoot ne ki iyookyi ineendet piigap Israel, ko koamda ng'aleek che myach che po kaalyeet eng' Jeso Kristo, ineendet ko Kiptaiyat ne po tugul.
Ongen okweek ng'olyoondonooto, ne ki kiamda eng' Judea komugul ketaune Galilaya, kingo pata kabatisanet ne ki amdoi Johana;

ongen ole ki iil `Kamuktaindet Jeso ne po Nazareth eng' Kabuuset ne Tiliil ak eng' kamuktaet; kiwendot ineendet ak koyaei ne myee, ak kosoobi tugul che ki inyaliili chesawilyet, amu ki mi Kamuktaindet kobooto ineendet.
Ki paorinik acheek che po tuguuk tugul che ki yai eng' emetap Yahudik ak eng' Jerusalem. Ki par `icheek ineendet kogartaat eng' keetit;
ago ki ing'eet `Kamuktaindet ineendet eng' peetuutap somok ak kogoito kotook,
ma eng' piik tugul ago eng' paorinik che kiga sip kolewen Kamuktaindet, acheeget chooto che ki kiamisyei ak keeisei kobooto ineendet ko kagong'eet komong' eng' che ki pek.
King'atech keamji piik ak kebaoryan keele niito ko ineendet ne ki inde Kamuktaindet koek Kirwoogindet ne po che saptos ak che ki kobek.
Paoryani maotik tugul agobo ineendet kole nyooru nyoetap kaat amu tengekwogikyik eng' kainennyi age tugul ne iyani ineendet.”
Ye kita komwaei Petero ng'aleechu, kochoorchigei Kabuuset ne Tiliil tugul che kigasei ng'olyoot.
Icheek che po kamuratanet che ki iyani che kibwanei kobooto Petero ko ki kwong'yo amu kageroong'ji Pororyosyek ak icheek konunetap Kabuuset ne Tiliil;
amu kigasei icheek kong'alaali eng' kutusweek che teerchiin ak kotoroori Kamuktaindet. Koteep anyun Petero kole,
“Imuuchi chii koete peek, si ma kibatisan pichu, che kagotaach Kabuuset ne Tiliil ko uu acheek?”
Ki ng'at anyun kole kibatisan icheek eng' kainetap Jeso Kristo. Kosoom anyun `icheek ineendet kole kota kobeni peetuusyek alak.
Ki kas anyun che kiyooktoi ak tupchosyek che ki mi Judea kole kogotaach ak icheek Pororyosyek ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet.
Kingo kagonyo `Petero Jerusalem, kobelgei ak ineendet icheek che po kamuratanet,
koleen, “Ki iwe ye mi piik che ma kimuratan ak iamisye kobooto icheek.”
Ago ki toi Petero kotetyi icheek komyee ng'aleechooto, koleenji,

“Ki ami nganaseetap Joppa asaae, ak kingo putya kiy ne uu rwon ageer ng'ang'utyet. Ki mi kiy ne kichoorugei ne uu angeet ne oo kot kobunu kipsengwet, ki kichoor eng' kuinoik ang'wan; ak ki nyo agoi ole ami.
Ye kinga keer miising' ko ki ageer tyong'igap ng'wony che po keelyek ang'wan ak tyong'ik che po timiin ak tuguuk che ichuutegei ak toriitik che po parak.
Ago ki agas kutit koleenjo, ‘Ng'eet, Petero; eeny ak iam.’
Ak ki amwa ale, ‘Ma uu nooto, Kiptaiyat; amu tomo kochut kutinnyu kiy ne ma tiliil anan ne ng'waan.’
Ago ki wol kutinooto ne po aeng' kobunu kipsengwet kole, ‘Amata ing'wanit kiit ne kagotiliil Kamuktaindet.’
Ki yaak kioto konyil somok, ak ki kichuut kogeny tugul koba kipsengwet.
Ak eng' sainooto ko kitonondos piik somogu eng' taitap koot ole ki kimi, che ki kiyok eng' Caesarea kobwa ole ami.
Kong'ata anyun Kabuuset ne Tiliil kole keebe tugul, amat isage. Ak ki kibe tugul ak tupchosyechu lo ak icheek; keebe agoi kootap chiichooto.
Kimwaiwech ko uu ye kiga keer malaikaiyat kotononi eng' koonnyi, kole, ‘Iyookte piik koba Joppa koguur Simion, ne kiguure kainennyi ne po aeng' Petero;
konyo komwaun ng'aleek che kisaruunenen, inyee ak koong'ung' tugul.’
Ak ye kinga tau ang'alaal, kochoorchigei `Kabuuset ne Tiliil icheek ko uu ye kichorchechkei agacheek eng' taunet.
Abwaat anyun ng'olyootap Kiptaiyat, ko uu ye ki mwa kole, ‘Ki ibatisanis Johana eng' peek; ago kibatisanook okweek eng' Kabuuset ne Tiliil.’
Ngo ki igoochi anyun Kamuktaindet icheek konunet ne kergei ak ne ki koonech ye kingi yan Kiptaiyat Jeso Kristo, ko tos ki aa ng'oo anyun kot amuuch agirinda Kamuktaindet?”
Kingo kas ng'aleechuuto, kosiisyo. Ak ki iloos Kamuktaindet, koleen, “Kaagaa kagogoochi `Kamuktaindet Pororyosyek ak icheek siguunet ne ibu saboondo.”
Ki pa anyun icheek che kiga yesta amu usiisyet ne king'eet agobo Stepano agoi koit Phoenisia, Cyprus, ak Antiok, koma ng'alaaljin chii age ng'olyoot kobatee Yahudik.
Ago ki mi alak eng' icheek, piigap Cyprus ak Kurene, che kingo pwa Antiok kong'alaalji Yunanik ak icheek, koamdoi Kiptaiyat Jeso.
Ki mi eutap Kiptaiyat kobooto icheek, ak ki iyan piik che chaang' konam ng'aleegap Kiptaiyat.
Ki kas ng'aleek agobo icheek kaniset ne ki mi Jerusalem, ak ki iyookto Barnaba kwo kot koit Antiok.
Kingo it ineendet ak kogeer myeeindap Kamuktaindet, kobaibait, ak kogiil icheek tugul konamgei ak Kiptaiyat eng' mugulelwek che pekyinotin.
Barnaba ko ki chii ne myee ak ki nyiitaat Kabuuset ne Tiliil ak kayaneet. Ki tesak anyun piik ko chang'a che ki pwanji Kiptaiyat.
Ki wo agoi Tarsis kocheeng' Saulo,
ak kingo kagonyoor, komut konyo Antiok. Ara ki iyumgei eng' kenyiit agenge kobooto kaniset, ak koneet piik che chaang'. Ki kitoi keguure kasubik Kristyanik eng' Antiok.
Ki choorgei anyun maotik eng' peetuusyechooto eng' Jerusalem kobwa Antiok.
Ak ki tonon age eng' icheek ne ki kiguure Agabo ak koboor eng' Kabuuset ne Tiliil kole tuun ityin rubeet ne oo ng'wony komugul; ak ki isulda niito eng' peetuusyegap Klaudio.
Kichopkei komyee kasubik koyookyi toreteet tupchosyek che ki menyei Judea, chii tugul ko uu ye ki imuuchi.
Ki yai anyun ko uu nooto, ki iyookyi poisyek eng' eunegap Barnaba ak Saulo.
Ye ki neegit peetuusyechooto kotoi laitoryat Herod kous alak che po kaniset.
Ki par Jakobo ng'eetap kametap Johana eng' rotwetap chok.
Ak ye kingo keer kole ki ibaibai nooto Yahudik, kotoi konam Petero agine. Ak kibetusyegap magatyat ne ma kinde mermereek, peetuusyechooto.
Kingo kagonam ineendet, konde korgoreet, ak kogoochi kiplugotinik ang'wan konyil ang'wan koriip ineendet, koleen ye ibata Paska komutyi piik.
Ye ki kiriipe Petero anyun eng' korgoreet, ko ki saaei kaniset Kamuktaindet miising' agobo ineendet.
Eng' kemounooto ki machei `Herod komoong' ineendet, ko ki rue `Petero kwenutap asigarik aeng', koratatee nyororosyek aeng'. Ak ki riip korgoreet riibiik eng' taitap kurgeet.
