Ak ogeero, ki tonon malaikaiyatap Kiptaiyat eng' ye neegitee ineendet ak ki ikweny lapkeiyet koot. Ki irabaach karaastap Petero ak kong'eet koleenji, “Ng'eet chokyi.” Ak ki ibutyo nyororosyek che ki mi eunekyik.
Ak koleenji malaikaiyat ineendet, “Ratkei, indegei kweoniguk ak irat.” Ak ki yai ko uu nooto. Ak ki leenji, “Ilaach ngoryeeng'ung' ak isubwo.”
Ak ki wo Petero saang' ak koosup ineendet; ak ki ma nai kole iman kiit ne kayai malaikaiyat, ago kileen kageer ng'ang'utyet.

Kingo kagosiir riipseet ne po tai ak ne po aeng', kobwa agoi ormariichet ne po karnet ne kibunei kebendi nganaseet, koyaatak ineegei. Ak kimanda saang' ak koba kobun ooreet agenge; ak eng' sainooto kobagaakta ineendet `malaikaiyat kwo.
Ye kingo pwaat Petero, komwa kole, “Kaanai nguno iman, ale, kagoyok `Kiptaiyat malaikaiyandennyi ak kasarwo eng' eutap Herod, ak eng' kagenisyet tugul ne po piigap Yahudik.”
Ara ye kingo kagobwaat komyee, konyo kootap Maria kametap Johana ne kiguure kainennyi ne po aeng' Mariko, ole kiga koyumjigei che chaang' ak kosaaei.
Ak ye kingo kongony kurgeetap ormariichet, konyo chepto ne ki kiguure Roda kogas.
Ak kingo nai chebooto kutitap Petero, koma koyaat ormariichet amu poiboiyet ago kilabat ko, ak komwaita kole tononi Petero eng' ormariichet.
Ki leenji `icheek ineendet, “Amin iywek!” Ago ki mwa eng' kimnateet kole, uu nooto. Ak ki mwa icheek kole, “Malaikaiyandennyi.”
Ago kites Petero kogongony; ak kingo kagoyat, kogeer ineendet ak kokwong'yo.

Ago ki iboorchine `ineendet icheek euut kosiisyo, ak kotetyi ole kagomutunda `Kiptaiyat ineendet komong' eng' korgoreet. Ak ki mwa kole, “Omwachi ng'aleechu Jakobo ak tupchosyek.” Ak ki wo agoi komosta age.
Ak kingo kagoeech, kotoptobenso kiplugotinik miising', kole katepto ano Petero.
Ye kingo kagocheeng' `Herod ineendet, ama konyoor, kogin riibiik ak kong'at kole kanyool kebar. Ak kichoortagei eng' Judea kwo Caesarea ak kotebee olooto.

Ki nereekyi miising' `Herod piigap Tyro ak Sidon. Ara ki pwanji `icheek ineendet eng' kabwaatet agenge, ak kingo nam chorwandi ak Blasto ne ki riibei ole kirue laitoryat, kosoom kaalyeet amu kibaei `emetap laitoryat emennywa.
Ak eng' peetuut ne ki king'at, kolaach Herod ngoroigap laitornatet, ak kotebee ng'echereetap kirwooget, ak kong'alaalji pichooto.
Ak ki polyo piik kole, “Kutitap kamuktain niito, ma po chii.”
Eng' sainooto anyun kobir ineendet `malaikaiyatap Kiptaiyat, amu ma konyit Kamuktaindet. Ara ki am ineendet kuutik ak kime.
Ago ki testai ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet, ak koityi che chaang'.
Ye kingo kagogees poisyennywa Barnaba ak Saulo, koweektagei Jerusalem, komuti Johana ne ki kainennyi ne po aeng' ko Mariko.
Eng' kaniset ne ki mi Antiok ko ki mi maotik ak kaneetik: Barnaba, Simion ne ki kiguure Niger, Lukio ne po Kurene, Manaen ne ki kigui kobooto kirwoogindet Herod, ak Saulo.
Ye kiboisyechin Kiptaiyat ak korugutegei, kole Kabuuset ne Tiliil, “Otabaannywa Barnaba ak Saulo agobo poisyet ne ki aguurchi.”
Ak ye kingo kagorugutkei ak kosaaei, kogonoor icheek eunekwak ak koyookto koba.
Kingo kagoyookto icheek `Kabuuset ne Tiliil, kochoorchigei Seleusia; ak ki pa eng' olooto kobun moinget agoi Cyprus.
Ye ki miitei Salamis, koamda ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet eng' sinagogisyegap Yahudik. Ak ki mi kobooto Johana ne kiboisyechinoti.
Ak kingo kagobun emet komugul ne ki ikween peek agoi koit Paphos, konyoorchi olooto poonin, maotyo ne po lembech, ne Yahudyot, ne ki kiguure Bar-Jesu.
Ki mi `ineendet kobooto pounindet, Sergio Paulas, chiito ne ng'oom. Ki kuur chiichito Barnaba ak Saulo koba ole mi ineendet ak kimachei kogas ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet.
Ago ki kirinda icheek `Eluma ng'oorindet (amu uu nooto kainennyi ye kiweech), ki kirinda pounindonooto, kocheeng'ei komaas kole si ma nyoor kayaneet.
Ago ki nyi `Kabuuset ne Tiliil Saulo, ne kiguure Paulo, ak ki ichiilji kong' ineendet

ak kole, “Ee inyee ne nyiitaat ng'aalseet tugul ak ng'omnateet tugul ne po kabeetet, inyee weeriitap chesawilyet, inyee puunyootap imanda tugul, mebagaaktoi imaas ortinwek che lititen che po Kiptaiyat?

Ak keer nguno anyuno, mi eutap Kiptaiyat paragung'ung', ak eng' peetuusyo iegu kipkoratya si mata igeer asiista.” Ak ki ibutyi sainooto mirmirindo ak mesundeito, ak kiwendot kocheeng'at piik che namoti ineendet euut.
Kingo keer anyun pounindet kiit ne kayaak, koyan, kokwong' agobo kaneetisyetap Kiptaiyat.
Ki pa anyun Paulo ak che ki mi kobooto ineendet kobun moinget eng' Paphos, ak koit Perga eng' Pamphylia. Ak ki wo Johana koweektagei Jerusalem kobagaakta icheek.
Ak kingo pun icheek Perga, koit Antiok ne po Pisidia. Ki pa sinagogit eng' peetuutap sabato ak kotep ng'wony.
Kingo pata somaneetap ng'atuutyet ak siruutigap maotik koyookto pounigap sinagogit piik koba ole mi icheek, koleenji, “Che kitupche, ngo tinye ng'olyoo age tugul ne imuuchi kotoret pichu, omwa.”
Kotonon anyun Paulo ak koboorchine euut, kole, “Ogaso okweek piigap Israel, ak okweek che oiywei Kamuktaindet.
Ki lewen Kamuktaindet ne po pichu Israel kwanisyekyok ak kotoroor pichooto ye ki punootik eng' emetap Misiri, ak ki imut icheek komong' eng' euut ne kiim.
Ak kimuitoochi icheek eng' atebosyekwak eng' olo po kenyiisyek artam eng' surkwen.
Kingo kagong'em pororyosyek tisap eng' emetap Kanaan, kogoochi icheek emennywa koek poroteet, eng' olo po kenyiisyek pogol ang'wan ak konom
ak kingo pata tuguuchu kogoochi icheek kirwoogik agoi Samuel maotyot.
Ak kingo pata kosoom laitoryat; ak ki igoochi `Kamuktaindet icheek Saulo weeriitap Kish eng' kenyiisyek artam, chiito ne po ooreetap Benjamin.
Kingo kagoisto ineendet, kong'eetyi Daudi koek laitoryannywa; ne kibaoryanji agine kole, ‘Kaanyooru Daudi weeriitap Jesse, chiito ne iboiboi muguleldanyu, ne tuun yaei maguutikyuk tugul.’
Ki imutyi `Kamuktaindet Israel Yetindet, Jeso, eng' kesweegap chiichito, ko uu ye kiga koaror;
ye kiga sip koamji `Johana piik tugul che po Israel, kabatisanet ne po siguunet, ye ki tomo konyo ineendet.
Ak ye ki neegit kogees Johana pandanyi, komwa kole, ‘Oleen aa ng'oo? Ma aa ineendet. Ago ogeero, isubwo age, ne ma nyoljino atyakyi kweonigap keelyekyik.’
“Che kitupche, lagogap kesweek che po Abraham, ak alak che mi kwenung'wong' che iywei Kamuktaindet, kagiyokwech acheek ng'olyoondoni po yetunet.
Amu ki ma nai ineendet `meng'iigap Jerusalem kobooto pounikwak, anan koguiyo kutusweegap maotik che kisomani eng' sabato age tugul, ki isuldae icheek ng'aleechooto ye ki irwookyi ineendet.
Nganda ki ma nyoor eng' ineendet ng'olyoot ne igoochin kome, ko ki soom `icheek Pilato kole kebar ineendet.
Ye kingo kagogees tuguuk tugul che kiga kisir agobo ineendet, kochoor ineendet eng' keetit ak konde kererit.
Ago ki ing'eet `Kamuktaindet ineendet komong' eng' che ki pek.
Ak ki keer ineendet eng' peetuusyek che chaang' icheek che kitogosu kobooto ineendet kobunu Galilaya kobwanei Jerusalem, che nguno ko paorinik eng' piik.
Ak ki ibwook logoiywek che myach che po arorutyet, ne ki kigoochi kwanisyekyok,
ko uu ye kigosuldochi `Kamuktaindet lagokyok nooto, amu ki ing'eet Jeso; ko uu ye siraat eng' Tyendap Kalasunet ne po aeng', kole, ‘Ii weeriinnyu, kaasichin rani.’
Ak ko uu ye ki ing'eet ineendet komong' eng' che ki pek, ma koweekyingei ineendet kogeny nunet, ki mwa ko uu ni kole, ‘Tuun agoonin kaberuroik che tiliileen, ak ko po iman, che po Daudi.’
Amu ki mwa agine eng' Tyendo age kole, ‘Matun igoochini neng'ung' Ne Tiliil kogeer nunet.’
Amu ye kingo kagoboisyechi Daudi kirwoogutigap Kamuktaindet ne Toroor eng' ibindanyi, konuuch, ak ki kitup kobooto kwanisyekyik, ak kogeer nunet.
Ago ma keer nunet ineendet ne ki ing'eet Kamuktaindet.
Ingonaak anyun eng' okweek, che kitupche, keele, kimwaiwok eng' chiichi nyoetap kaat ne po tengekwogik;
ak kiityin imanda eng' ineendet age tugul ne iyani, eng' tuguuk tugul, che koma komuuchi koiityok imanda ng'atuutyetap Musa.
Oriipkei anyun, si ma nyonjok ne ki kimwa eng' maotik keele,
‘Ogeero, okweek saasiik, okwong'ye ak olusye; Amu ayae poisyet eng' peetuusyekwok, poisyet ne ma koi oyan matiny, agot ngo mwaiwok chii.’ ”
Ak kingo ta komandoi icheek, kosoom kole tuun kota koamji icheek ng'aleechooto eng' sabato ne nyoonei.

Kingo kagomanda tuiyet eng' sinagogit, koosup Paulo ak Barnaba `che chaang' che po Yahudik ak `che konyiti Kamuktaindet che kiwalak kobunji Yahudik. Ye kingo ng'alaaljin icheek, kogiil kole koba tai eng' myeeindap Kamuktaindet.
Ak eng' sabato ne isubi nooto, koyumgei nganaseet che neegit tugul kole kogas ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet.
Ago ye kingo keer `Yahudik tuiyosyek, koam ng'et kong' ak koeesyo eng' kimnateet ng'aleek che kimwaei Paulo, ak komwa ng'aleek che yaacheen kochubis.

Kong'alaal anyun Paulo ak Barnaba eng' nyiganateet koleen, “Konyolu kemwaiwok korook ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet. Amu ki ogirinde ak orwookyinige okweegei ole ma nyolu onyooru saboondap koigeny, ogeero, kagibe ye mi Pororyosyek.
Amu king'atech Kiptaiyat ko uu nooto kole, ‘Kaandein iegu lapkeiyet ne po Pororyosyek, si kobiit iegu yetunet agoi tabandap ng'wony.’ ”
Kingo kas Pororyosyek ng'olyoondoniito, koboiboitu ak kogonyit ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet; ak koyan tugul che kiga kelewenji saboondap koigeny.
Ak ki yom ng'olyootap Kiptaiyat koronooto tugul.

Ago ki inde `Yahudik ng'aleegap chaamset kobogorisyek che konyiti Kamuktaindet ak ko taagunotiin, ak piik che eecheen che po nganaseet, ak ki ing'eet usiisyet kous Paulo ak Barnaba, ak koon komanda eng' kiwotosyekwak.
Ago kilelekyi icheek temburyek che mi keelyekwak, ak kiit Ikonio.
Ak ki nyi kasubik poiboiyet ak Kabuuset ne Tiliil.
Ye kingo mi Paulo ak Barnaba Ikonio, ko ki pa sinagogitap Yahudik ak kong'alaal kot koyan tuiyet ne oo ne po Yahudik ak Yunanik.
Ago kiim Yahudik che kibistoik saboonwegap Pororyosyek kot kogoochi kowech tupchosyek.
Ki tebee olooto anyun peetuusyek che chaang' ak kong'alaali eng' nyiganateet agobo Kiptaiyat, ne kibaoryanji ng'olyootap myeeindonyi ak kogoochin koyaak kaboorunoik ak kwang'utik eng' eunekwak.
Ago kipcheigei tuiyet ne po nganaseet; ak ki namgei alage ak Yahudik, konamgei alage ak che kiyooktoi.
Ak ye kimachei Pororyosyek ak Yahudik kobooto pounikwak kobookyi icheek, kole koyachi ne ya, ak kolach eng' koik,
kosip konai, ak kimwechi Lystra ak Derbe, nganasook che po Lukaonia, ak korotinwek che neegitee olooto,
ak ki amda logoiywek che myach eng' olooto.
Ki mi chii age eng' Lystra ne ki ma ko kiimeen keelyekyik ak ki tomo kowendot, amu ki salamwo kobooch komi moetap kamet.
Ki kas chiichooto Paulo kong'alaali. Ak kingo ochiilji kong' `Paulo chiichooto, ak kogeer kole tinyei kayaneet ne kimuuchi kisoop,
komwa eng' kutit ne oo kole, “Tonon komyee eng' keelyeguk.” Ak kitoromben ak kowendot.
Ak kingo keer tuiyosyek kiit ne kayai Paulo, kobolyo eng' ng'aleegap Lukaonia, kole, “Kachorchechkei kamuktaik eng' kergeindap piik.”
Ak kiguure Barnaba, Seu; koguure Paulo, Herme, amu ki ng'alaalindet ne oo ineendet.
Ak tisiindetap Seu ne ki mi hekalunnyi taitap nganaseet ko kiget tuuga ak sinendoik kobwa kurgotik, ak kimachei ineendet kobooto tuiyosyek kogoito tiseiywot.
Ago ye kingo kas agobo nooto che kiyooktoi Barnaba ak Paulo kogereer ngoroikwak ak korwai koba kwenutap tuiyet, koboldos koleen,

“Choronochu, kalya si oyai tuguuchu? Ki piik agacheek che kergei ak okweek, ak kagiibwok logoiywek che myach, si kobiit oweeige omete tuguuchu ma tilei kiy ak obwonji Kamuktaindet ne sabei, ne kiyaei kipsengwet ak ng'wony ak araraita ak tugul che mi olooto.
Ki pagaakyi `ineendet pororyosyek tugul eng' ibinwek che ki kosiirto kobendat eng' ortinwekwak.

Ago ki ma tebi puch ineendet ama tinyei paorya, amu ki yai ne myee, ak kogoonok ropta ne punu kipsengwet ak peetuusyegap rurateet, kogoochin kobiyong'so mugulelwekwok eng' amitwogik ak kaagaasetapkei.”
Agot eng' ng'aleechu ki mwa, ko ki neegit kotemenee kogirinda icheeget si mata kogoochi icheek tiseiywot.
Ago ki pwa Yahudik che ki punu Antiok ak Ikonia ak kolom tuiyosyek. Kilach `icheek Paulo eng' koik, ak kochuut komanda eng' nganaseet, koleen kagome.
Ago ye kitonondos kasubik ko kayiem ineendet, kong'eet ak kwo nganaseet. Eng' peetuut ne ki isubi nooto koba Derbe ak Barnaba.
Ye kingo kagoamji logoiywek che myach nganasanooto, ak ko kagoyai che chaang' koek kasubik, koweektagei koba Lystra, ak Ikonia, agoi Antiok.
Ki igimitoti saboonwegap kasubik, ko ki ili koba tai eng' kayaneet ak koleenji, “Kanyool keit laitornatetap Kamuktaindet eng' nyalilwogik che chaang'.”
Ak kingo kagolewenji icheek `poisyek eng' kaniset age tugul, kosa eng' karugutetapkei, konde icheek eutap Kiptaiyat ne kiga koyan.
Ki pa kobun Pisidia ak koit Pamphylia.
Kingo kagoamda ng'olyoot eng' Perga, kochoortagei Attalia.
Kotaune olooto ko ki pun moinget agoi Antiok, ole ki kindae icheek myeeindap Kamuktaindet agobo poisyet ne kiga koyai kosulda.
Kingo kagobwa, koyum kaniset komugul ak komwachi tuguuk tugul che kiga koyai Kamuktaindet eng' icheek, ak ole kiga koyatyindo Pororyosyek kurgeet ne po kayaneet.
Ak ki tebi peetuusyek che chaang' olooto kobooto kasubik.
Ki choorgei anyun piik alak che ki punu Judea ak koneet tupchosyek kole, “Ngot koma kimuratanak ko uu piteetap Musa, ko momuuchi onyooru saruunet.”

Ak ye kingo kagotiiyo Paulo ak Barnaba miising' ak koteebegei miising' kobooto icheek, kolewen `tupchosyek Paulo ak Barnaba ak alak eng' icheek kotogosta koba Jerusalem ole mi che kiyooktoi ak poisyek agobo ng'olyoondoniito.

Kingo kagoyomis anyun icheek kaniset eng' pandanywa, kobun Phoenisia ak Samaria, komwaitaati agobo che ki kowalogis koyan Kamuktaindet eng' Pororyosyek, ak ki igoochi ng'olyoondonooto tupchosyek tugul poiboiyet ne oo.
Kingo kagoit Jerusalem, kotaach icheek `kaniset ak che kiyooktoi ak poisyek, ak komwachi icheek tuguuk tugul che kiga koyai Kamuktaindet kobooto icheeget.
Ago kitononso alak eng' kasubiigap Pharisaik che iyanotin kole, “Kanyool kimuratan icheek, ak keng'at icheek koriip Ng'atuutyetap Musa.”
Ki iyumgei che kiyooktoi ak poisyek si kobiit kogeer ole teptoi ng'olyoondoniito.

Ak kingo kagoteebegei miising', kotonon Petero ak komwachi icheek kole, “Che kitupche, ongen okweek ole ki kolewen Kamuktaindet eng' kwenung'wong' kobooch ye po ui kole kogas Pororyosyek ng'olyoot ne po logoiywek che myach eng' kutinnyu ak koyan.
Ak kibaoryanji icheek `Kamuktaindet ne ingen mugulelwegap piik, kogoochi icheek `Kabuuset ne Tiliil, ko uu ye ki koonech;
ak ki ma ibesyech ak icheeget, ye ki itiliili mugulelwekwak eng' kayaneet.
Kalya nguno anyun si otyem Kamuktaindet kot onde chogit kaatitap kasubik, ne ki ma imuuch koip kwanisyekyok anan acheek?
Ago kiyani keele kisarwech eng' myeeindap Kiptaiyat Jeso, ko uu ye kisaru ak icheek.”
Kosiisyo anyun tuiyet komugul; ak koepchi iit Barnaba ak Paulo kotetyin icheek kaboorunoik ak kwang'utik che kiga koyai Kamuktaindet eng' icheek eng' kwenutap Pororyosyek.
Ak kingo kagosiisyo, kowol Jakobo kole, “Che kitupche, ogaso.
Kagomwa Simion ko uu ye ki rutoochi `Kamuktaindet Pororyosyek eng' tai, si kobiit kolewenji kainennyi piik eng' icheek.
Kanamgei niito ak ng'aleegap maotik, ko uu ye siraat kole,
‘Ye ibata tuguuchu aweege, ak ateech kogeny kootap Daudi ne ki koluul; ak ateech kogeny komoswek che ki koluulyo, ak alum kotonon,
si kocheeng' piik che ng'etunotiin Kiptaiyat, ak Pororyosyek tugul che kiguurtoe kainennyu.
Mwaei Kiptaiyat, ne yaei tuguuchu si konaak kobooch taunetap ng'wony.’
“Nooto anyun, atile kirwooget ko uu ni ale, amata kinyalil `acheek icheek che po Pororyosyek che pwaanjin Kamuktaindet;
ago ongesirchi icheek keleenji kotabaanegei murwoonindap kanamonik, ak sokseet, ak ne po tuguuk che kagiget, ak korotiik.
Amu ki tinyei Musa kobooch ibinwek che po keny eng' nganasook tugul, icheeget che amdoi agobo ineendet, che kisomani eng' sinagogisyek eng' sabato age tugul.”

Kogeer anyun che kiyooktoi ak poisyek, kobooto kaniset komugul kole myee kolewen piik alak eng' icheek, ak koyookto koba Antiok kobooto Paulo ak Barnaba. Ki iyookto Judas ne ki kiguure Barsaba, ak Sila, piik che eecheen eng' tupchosyek,
kobooto parweet: “Kisirchini `acheek che kiyooktoi ak tupchosyek che poisyek, tupchosyek che po Pororyosyek che mi Antiok ak Syria ak Cilicia, kigatok.
Ko uu ye ko kegas keele, inyalilok eng' ng'aleek piik alak che kibunei kwenunnyo, kong'emei saboonwekwok; piik che ki ma king'at ko uu nooto;
kagigeer keele myee eng' acheek, che kagechamyechi, kelewen piik ak kiyakwok kobooto chamanikyok Barnaba ak Paulo,
piik che ki kogoito saboonwekwak amu kainetap Kiptaiyandennyo Jeso Kristo.
Kagiyogu anyun Judah ak Sila, si komwaiwok icheeget ak icheek tuguuchuuto eng' kutusweekwak.
Amu kigeere keele kagomyeeit eng' Kabuuset ne Tiliil ak eng' acheek, keele, ma kigesenjok mileet ne nyigiis ne siire tuguuchu nyolu:
keele otabaanegei tuguuk che kieng'jin kanamonik, ak korotiik, ak panyeegap che kagiget, ak sokseet; ngo tabaanegei chooto, komyeeitu eng' okweek. Saisere.”
Ye kingo kagiyookto koba anyun, kochoortagei koba Antiok; ak kingo kagoyum tuiyet, kogoochi parweet.
Kingo kagosoman koboiboitu agobo kagaigaet.
Ki igiil `Judah ak `Sila tupchosyek eng' ng'aleek che chaang', ak kogimit amu ki maotik ak icheek.
Ak kingo kagotebee olooto peetuusyek alak, kounda tupchosyek icheek eng' kaalyeet koba ole mi icheek che ki iyoogu.
Ago ki cham Sila kota kotebee olooto.
Ago ki tebee Paulo ak Barnaba Antiok, koneeti ak koamdoi ng'olyootap Kiptaiyat, kobooto piik alak che chaang' ak icheek.
Kingo pata peetuusyek alak koleenji `Paulo Barnaba, “Ingeweege nguno kerutoochi tupchosyek eng' nganaseet age tugul ole kigeamdaate ng'olyootap Kiptaiyat, ak kegeer ole teptoi.”
Ki machei Barnaba miising' komut Johana ne ki kiguure Mariko, koba tugul.
Ago ki ibwaat Paulo kole ma myee kimut ineendet ne kiga kobagaakta icheek eng' Pamphylia, ama cham koba poisyet kobooto icheek.
Ak king'eetyo ng'aleek che koroomen kot kopcheigei icheegei. Ki imut `Barnaba Mariko ak kobun moinget agoi Cyprus.
Ago ki lewen `Paulo Sila ak koba, ko kagonde tupchosyek icheek myeeindap Kiptaiyat.
Ak kobun Syria ak Cilicia, kogimitoti kanisosyek.
Ki wo kora Paulo agoi Derbe ak Lystra. Ki mi olooto agenge eng' kasubik ne ki kiguure Timoteo, weeriitap chepyahudyot ne ki kayanindet; ago kwandanyi ko ki Yunanindet.
Kibaoryanjin ineendet `tupchosyek che ki mi Lystra ak Ikonio kole myee.
Ki machei Paulo chiichito koba tuwai; ak ki imut ineendet ak komuratan amu Yahudik che ki mi komoswechooto, amu ki ingen tugul kole Yunanindet kwandanyi.
Ak ye kibendi pandanywa kobunoti nganasook kogoochi icheek ng'atuutik, che kiga ng'at che kiyooktoi ak poisyek che ki mi Jerusalem, si koriip.
Ki kigimit anyun kanisosyek eng' kayaneet, ak kotesak koiitennywa peetuut age tugul.
Ki pa anyun kobun kooret ne po Phrygia ak Galatia, ko kagoete icheek `Kabuuset ne Tiliil komwaita ng'olyoot eng' Asia.
Ye kingo toorchigei Mysia, kotyem koba Bithynia, ago ma chamji icheek `Kabuusetap Jeso;
ak kingo siir Mysia, kochoortagei Traos.
Ki nyoonji anyun ng'ang'utyet Paulo kemoi; ki mi chiitap Makedonia ne kitononi, kogoigoi ineendet koleen, “Long'u Makedonia, nyoo toretech.”
Ye kingo kagogeer ng'ang'utyet, eng' sainooto kemach keebe Makedonia, ko kagenai keele kogoguurech Kamuktaindet si kobiit keamji icheek logoiywek che myach.
Ki kibun anyun moinget kebunu Traos, kitoorchigei Samothrase, ak peetuut ne ki isubi nooto keit Neapoli.
Ak keng'eetyo eng' olooto keebe Philippi, ne nganaseetap Makedonia, ne ki tagunoot eng' emonooto, ne ki uuchi Romanik. Ki kitebee nganasanooto eng' peetuusyo.
Ak eng' peetuutap sabato kemandae ormariichet keebe ole neegitee aineet, ole ki kileen ole kisaae; ak ki kitep ng'wony ak keng'alaalji kobogorisyek che kiga tuiyo.

Ki mi kobogoryot age ne ki kiguure Lydia, ne ki ilasu Kamuktaindet. Ki po nganaseet ne kiguure Thyatira, ak ki aldaindetap ngoroik che arusen ne piriir. Ye kigaseech, koyaat Kiptaiyat muguleldanyi koepchi iit ak kotaach tuguuk che ki mwaei Paulo.
Ye kiga kibatisan ineendet ak piigap koonnyi, kogaigaech kole, “Ngo kaogeer ole ayani Kiptaiyat, obwa koonnyu ak otebi.” Ak kibirchech keebe.
Peetuut age ye ki kibendi ole kisaae, kotuiyenech chepto ne ki tinyei tamirmiryet ne ng'oorsei ne ki ipchi kiptainikyik tuguuk che chaang' amu ng'oorset.
Ki isubot Paulo kebendi tugul, ak komwaei eng' kutit ne oo koleen, “Pichu ko otwogigap Kamuktaindet Ne Toroor Miising', che mwaiwok ooreetap yetunet.”

Ak ki yai ineendet ko uu nooto eng' peetuusyek che chaang'. Ago ki aragen Paulo miising', ak kowelelgei ak koleenji oindonooto murwon, “Kang'atiin eng' kainetap Jeso Kristo ale, mong'u eng' ineendet.” Ak ki mong' eng' sainooto.
Ago kingo keer kiptainikyik kole kagobet kamang'unetap keljinennywa, konam Paulo ak Sila, ak kochuut koba taitap pounik eng' ye kiyae mung'aaret.
Kingo kagomut icheek kobwa taitap kirwoogik, komwa kole, “Inyaliili pichu nganasennyo miising', ago icheeget ko Yahudik,
ak ineeti pitonwek che ma chamdaat eng' ng'atuutik ketaach anan kisup, amu acheek ko ki Romanik.”
Ak ki ng'eet tuiyet kibagenge kobookyi icheek, ak kogereer kirwoogik ngoroigap pichooto ak kong'at kebir eng' kirokweek.
Ak kingo kagobir icheek miising', kotoorchi korgoreet ak kong'at riibindetap korgoreet koriip komyee.
Kingo kagonyoor ng'atuutyet ne uu nooto, kotoorchi icheek koot ne po oriit ak koratyi keelyekwak temeleiywek.
Eng' olo po kemoi kween ko ki saaei Paulo ak Sila ak kotyenjin Kamuktaindet tyenwogik ak ki epchin iit tyenwagikwak kimonjororinik alak.
Ak ki potan emet miising' eng' sainooto kot kotumdumgei lumeiywegap korgoreet; ak eng' sainooto koyatagis kurgotik tugul ak kotyagogis tuguuk che ki kirate chii tugul.
Kingo siir eng' rwondo riibindetap korgoreet ak kogeer kurgotigap korgoreet ko yaatatin, kong'us rotwennyi po chok ak ki neegit kobargei, koleen kagochiliilyo kimonjororinik.
Ago ki mwa Paulo eng' kutit ne oo kole, “Ameyachigei kiy ne ya, amu kimi yu acheek tugul.”
Ak kiguur keip taisyek, ak kotorombenji ko oriit, ak ki ibutyi keelyegap Paulo ak Sila kobotananu eng' kaiyweisyet.
Ak ki imut komong' saang' ak kole, “Kiptainichu, ayai nee si kesarwo?”
Koleenji, “Iyan Kiptaiyat Jeso, si kesaruun, inyee ak koong'ung'.”
Ak ki amdechi ineendet ng'olyootap Kiptaiyat, kobooto tugul che ki mi koonnyi.
Ki imut icheek sainooto po kemoi ak kounji pirutikwak; ak ki kibatisan ineendet ak piikyik eng' sainooto.
Ara ki imut koba koonnyi ak kogoochi amitwogik, ak kiboiboitu miising' ineendet kobooto koonnyi tugul amu kagoyan Kamuktaindet.
Ak ye kingo kagoeech, koyookto kirwoogik kiptainigap kiplugotinik, kole, “Ounde pichoo koba.”
Ak ki mwachi riibindetap korgoreet Paulo ng'aleechooto kole, “Kagoyok kirwoogik kole keundak obe; omong'u anyun ak obe eng' kaalyeet.”

Ago ki leenji Paulo icheek, “Kagobirech eng' taitap piik, ama kirwookwech, acheek piik che ki Romanik, ak kogotoorchech korgoreet; ak nguno komachei koonech eng' ung'oot? Achicha, ma uu nooto; ago ingobwa icheeget komutech kemande.”
Ki mwachi kiptainigap kiplugotinik ng'aleechuuto kirwoogik ak ki iywei kingo kas kole icheeget ko Romanik.
Ki pwa anyun kogaigai icheek. Kingo kagomut icheek kobwa saang' kosoom kole koba eng' nganaseet.
Ki manda anyun eng' korgoreet ak ki pa agoi kootap Lydia; ak kingo kagogeer tupchosyek kogaigai icheek ak koba.
Kingo kagobun icheek Amphipoli ak Apolonia, koit Thessalonike, ole ki mi sinagogitap Yahudik.
Ak ki wo Paulo ole mi icheek, ko uu ye ki cham koyaei, ak kong'alaal kobooto pichooto eng' sabatoisyek somok agobo siruutik,
kong'aang'jin ak koboorchin komyee kole kiga nyoljin Kristo konyalil ak kong'eet kogeny eng' che ki pek; ak kole “Jeso niito aamwok, ko Kristo.”
Ki iyan anyun alage eng' icheek ak konamgei ak Paulo ak Sila. Ki yai ko uu nooto tuiyet ne oo ne po Yunanik che ki konyiti Kamuktaindet ak che chaang' eng' kobogorisyek che taagunotiin.

Ago ki am ng'etkonda Yahudik, ak ki namgei ak piik che yaacheen che ma tilei kiy ak koiyum tuiyet kole kong'eetyi chemargeet nganaseet. Ye ki cheeng'ei `icheek Paulo ak Silas komachei kole si komut icheek saang' koba ole mi piik, kobookyi kootap Jason.
Ye ki mata konyoor, kochuut Jason ak tupchosyek alak koba taitap kirwoogigap nganaseet, koboldos koleen, “Pichu ko kowas emet ko kagobwa oli kogeny,
ak kagotaach `Jason icheek. Yaei pichuuto tugul tuguuk che etei ng'atuutigap Caesarea, komwaei koleen miitei laitoryat age ne ineendet ko Jeso.”
Ye kingo kas tuguuchuuto, ko ki iim tuiyet ak kirwoogigap nganaseet.
Ak kingo kagonam `icheek tuguugap katyaget kobun Jason ak piik alak, kounda koba.
Ak ne matyanit koyookto tupchosyek Paulo ak Sila kemoi koba Berea; ak kingo it olooto, koba sinagogitap Yahudik.
Ak ki myachen pichu kosiir chooto po Thessalonike, amu kitaach ng'olyoot ak kocham miising' ak kosyachi siruutik peetuut age tugul, si kobiit konai ngo iman tuguuchu.
Ki iyan anyun che chaang' eng' icheeget ak kobogorisyek che po Yunanik, ak murenik che taagunotiin.
Ago kingo nai Yahudik che po Thessalonike kole amdoi Paulo ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet eng' Berea agine, koba olooto agine, ak kowas ak konyalil tuiyosyek.
Ki iyookto anyun koma tyanit `tupchosyek Paulo kot koit araraita, ak kita kotebi eng' olooto Sila ak Timoteo.
Ago icheeget che ki imuti Paulo ko ki imut agoi Athens; ak kingo taach ng'atuutyet koipchi Sila ak Timoteo kole koba ole mi ineendet kochook, koba anyun.
Kingo ta koogeni `Paulo icheek eng' Athens, ko ki iimak eng' oriitinnyi, ye kingo keer nganaseet ko nyiitaat kanamonik.
Kong'alaal anyun eng' sinagogit kobooto Yahudik ak piik che konyiti Kamuktaindet, ak eng' ye mi ole keyae mung'aaret eng' peetuut age tugul kobooto che kituitos ak ineendet.

Ak ki tuiyo kobooto ineendet alak che po ng'amotigap Epikurio ak Stoiko. Ak kole alak, “Mwaei nee kipchang'alaini?” Kole alak, “Uu kabartaindet ne po kamuktaik che teer.” Ki mwa ng'aleechu amu ki amdoi agobo Jeso ak ng'eetyeet.
Ara ki nam `icheek ineendet ak komut kwo agoi Areopago ak kole, “Tos kimuuchi kenai keele nee kaneetisyoni leel, imwae?
Amu keipchi iitiikyok tuguuk alak che leelach: nooto anyun kimache kenai kiit ne ibooru tuguuchuuto.”
Ki ma kotinyei piik tugul che po Athens ak toek che ki mi olooto, poroindo ne po kiy age kobatee komwa anan kogas ng'al che too.
Ki tonon anyun Paulo eng' kwenutap Areopago ak kole, “Okweek piigap Athens, kaageer ale eng' tuguuk tugul ogiiligei miising' eng' saautik.
Amu ye ki asiirtoi ak ageer tuguuk che osaae, anyooru agine kapkorosuut ne tinyei siruutichu, ‘Po kamuktain ne ma naei chii.’ Nooto anyun ne osaae amongen, aboorwok anyun niito.
Kamuktaindet ne ki yai ng'wony ak tuguuk tugul che miitei olooto, ineendet ko Kiptaiyatap kipsengwet ak ng'wony, koma menyei hekalusyek che ki kiyae eunek.
Ama kiboisyechin eng' eunegap piik, ko uu ne panani kiy, amu ineendet ne igoochin tugul saboondo ak kabuuset, ak tuguuk tugul.
Ki yai eng' `chiito agenge pororyet age tugul ne po piik si komeny ng'wony komugul, ko kagoboorchi kenyiisyek che ki king'at, ak kiwotosyegap meng'ootennywa;
si kobiit kocheeng' Kamuktaindet, komang'u kole tamangap kotamdamat, ak konyoor ineendet, nganda ma loo eng' age tugul eng' acheek.
Amu ‘Eng' ineendet kesaptosi ak kebendoti ak kemi’; ko uu ye ki komwa alage eng' siriikwok che po tyenwogigap kalasunet kole, ‘Amu ki lagokyik ak acheek.’
Ngo ki lagogap Kamuktaindet anyun, ko manyoljech kibwaat keele kergei Kamuktaindet ak thahabu, anan fedha, anan koita, che ki kiyai eng' musoknateet ak eng' ng'omnatetap piik.
Ki ma mage kiy anyun Kamuktaindet peetuusyek che ki ma komi naet; ago kang'at anyun nguno kole kosik piik tugul eng' komosta age tugul.
Amu Ki kochop peetuut ne tuun irwookyine ng'wony eng' imanda eng' chiichooto ki kolewen; ak agobo niito ko ki koboorchi komyee piik tugul ye ki ing'eet ineendet komong' eng' che ki pek.”
Ye kingo kas anyun agobo ng'eetyeetap che ki pek, kochombil alage; ago ki le alak, “Ta kegasun niito peetuut age.”
Eng' yooto ko kimanda anyun Paulo eng' kwenunnywa.
Ago ki namgei piik alak ak ineendet ak koyan; ki age eng' icheeget ko Dionusio Areopagindet, ak kobogoryot ne kiguure Damaris, ak alak che ki mi kobooto icheeget.
Kingo pata tuguuchu kwo Paulo eng' Athens, ak koit Korinto.

Ki nyoorchi yooto Yahudyot age ne kiguure Aquila, chiito ne po Ponto, ne kita kobunu Italy kobooto osotyonnyi Prisila, amu kiga ng'at Klaudio kole koba Yahudik tugul eng' Rome. Ki nyo Paulo ole mi icheek;
amu ki kergei poisyennyi ak nenywa, kotebi anyun kobooto icheek, ak kobois tugul; amu ki nabiik che po emaisyek icheeget.
Ak eng' sabato age tugul ko ki ng'alaali eng' sinagogit, kole tamangap kotoret Yahudik ak Yunanik.
Ago ye kingo choorgei Sila ak Timoteo kobunu Makedonia, konyonji Paulo kachirchiret ne po ng'olyoot, kobaoryanjin Yahudik kole Jeso ko Kristo.
Ye kingo kirinda ak komwa icheek ng'aleek kochup ineendet, koleglekta ineendet ngoryennyi ak koleenji, “Ingotebi korotiikwok eng' metowekwok; aa tiliil anee. Kobooch nguno ko kawe ye mi Pororyosyek.”
Ki wo anyun eng' olooto ak kwo kootap chiito age ne kiguure Tito Justo, chiito ne ki ilasu Kamuktaindet, ne kinamegei koonnyi ak sinagogit.
Ak Krispo, ne ki pounindetap sinagogit, ko ki iyan Kiptaiyat kobooto koonnyi tugul; ak kingo kas che chaang' che po Korintoek, koyan, ak ki kibatisan.
Ak kemout age ko ki leenji `Kiptaiyat Paulo eng' ng'ang'utyet, “Meiywei, ago ng'alaal inyee amat isiis;
amu ami kobooten, ama mi chii ne twain koyaun ne ya, amu atinye piik che chaang' eng' nganasani.”
Ki tebee olooto kenyiit agenge ak arawek lo, koneeti ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet eng' kwenunnywa.
Ago ye kingo kirwoogindetap Akayo Galio, kong'eetyi `Yahudik Paulo eng' mageet agenge, ak komut ineendet kwo taitap ng'echereetap kirwooget.
Kole icheek, “Ichuuti chiichi piik kole kolas Kamuktaindet eng' ooreet ne etei Ng'atuutyet.”
Ago ye kimachei Paulo kotwek, koleenji `Galio Yahudik, “Okweek Yahudichu, nda po yaityo ng'aleechu iman, anan ko po chalwok ne ya, ta nyolu agaswok;
ago ngo teebutik agobo ng'aleek ak kainaik ak ng'atuutyeng'wong' okweeget, oyai okweegei; ma mache aek kirwoogindetap ng'aleechuuto.”
Ak ki oon icheek koba eng' ye mi ng'echereetap kirwooget.
Ak ki nam tugul Sosten, pounindetap sinagogit, ak kobir ineendet eng' taitap ng'echeranooto po kirwooget. Ak ki ma mage kiy Galio ng'aleechooto tugul.

Ak kingo kagotebi Paulo peetuusyek che chaang', kobagaakta `ineendet tupchosyek ak kobun moinget kwo Syria, kobooto Prisila ak Aquila. Eng' Kenkrea ko ki kicherchi metit, amu kiga koarorta kiy eng' kayasyoet.
Kingo it Epheso, kobagaakta icheek eng' olooto, ago ki wo ineendet sinagogit ak kong'alaal ak Yahudik.
Ak kingo mwachi kole, kota kotebi ak icheek, koma kocham;
ago kingo pagaktoi icheek, komwa kole, “Aweekyinoge kogeny, ngo cham Kamuktaindet.” Ak ki wo eng' Epheso kobune moinget.
Ye kingo kagolanda Caesarea, kotogosta kwo kogat kaniset, ak kochoortagei kwo Antiok.
Ak kingo kagotebi olooto eng' peetuusyo, kwo kobunoot kooret ne po Galatia ak ne po Phrygia, ko uu ye rubegei, kogimitoti kasubik tugul.
Ki nyo Epheso Yahudyot age ne keguure Apolo, ne po Alexandria. Ki chiito ne ng'oom, ak ki kiim eng' siruutik.
Kiga kineet chiichito ooreetap Kiptaiyat; ak amu ki tinyei kagiiletapkei eng' muguleldanyi, kong'alaal ak koneet komyee ng'aleek agobo Jeso, kongen kabatisanetap Johana kityo.
Ki toi kong'alaal eng' nyiganateet eng' sinagogit. Ago ye kingo kas Prisila ak Aquila, komut ineendet kwo taban, ak koboorchi ineendet ooreetap Kamuktaindet komyee kosiir.
Ak ye ki machei Apolo kolanda kwo Akaia, ko ki igimit `tupchosyek ineendet ak kosirchi kasubik kole kotaach ineendet. Ye kingo kagoit, kotoret `ineendet icheek miising' che kiga koyan eng' myeeindo,
amu ki iguiyechi Yahudik komyee eng' kimnateet eng' taitap piik, koboorchin eng' siruutik kole Jeso ko Kristo.
Ak ye kita komi Apolo Korinto, ko kagobun Paulo emet kween, koit Epheso ak konyoor kasubik.
Ki leenji icheek, “Tos ki otaach Kabuuset ne Tiliil ye kingo yan?” Koleenji, “Achicha, tomo agot kegas ngo miitei Kabuuset ne Tiliil.”
Ak ki leenji, “Ki kibatisanjok nee anyun?” Ak ki le, “Ki kibatisanjech kabatisanetap Johana.”
Kole Paulo, “Ki ibatisanis Johana eng' kabatisanetap siguunet, koleenjin piik kanyool koyan ineendet ne isubu ineendet, nooto ko Jeso.”
Ye kingo kas niito, kibatisan icheek eng' kainetap Kiptaiyat Jeso.
Ak ye kingo kagogonoor `Paulo eunekyik icheeget, konyonji anyun `Kabuuset ne Tiliil icheek, ak ki ng'alaal eng' kutusweek che teerchiin, ak koamda.
Ak ki olo po taman ak aeng' pichooto tugul.
Ki wo sinagogit oriit ak kong'alaal eng' nyiganateet eng' arawek somok, kong'alaali ak kolomei agobo tuguuk che po laitornatetap Kamuktaindet.

Ago ye kingo uegitu mugulelwegap alak ak kobistoe, ak komwaei ne ya agobo Oranooto eng' taitap tuiyet, kwo eng' ole mi icheek, ak kotabaan kasubik, kong'alaaljin peetuut age tugul eng' sukulitap Turano.
Ki yaak ko uu nooto eng' kenyiisyek aeng'; kot kogas ng'olyootap Kiptaiyat tugul che ki menyei Asia, Yahudik kobooto Yunanik.
Ak ki yai Kamuktaindet poisyonigap kimnateet che teer eng' eunegap Paulo:
kot keipchi che myandos kitambaok ak angook che kiga kotiiny poortanyi, ak ki istogei myanwogik eng' pichooto, ak ki manda tamirmirik che yaacheen eng' icheek.
Ak ki toi Yahudik alage che ki ombenoti, che kileen koon oik, komwa kainetap Kiptaiyat Jeso eng' icheeget che ki tinyei tamirmirik che yaacheen, koleen, “Ayosyewok eng' Jeso ne amdoi Paulo.”
Ak ki mi weeriik tisabu che po Skeba, ineendet Yahudyot, tisiindet ne oo, che ki yai ng'olyoondoniito.
Ak ki wolji tamirmiryet ne ya icheek, koleenji, “Angen Jeso, ak angen Paulo; ago okweek ko oo ng'oo?”
Ak kitorombenji chiichooto ki tinyei tamirmiryet ne ya icheek, ak konenet icheek, ak koterteer, kot komwei komanda eng' koyooto aach ngor ko kagiguoten.
Ak kinaak niito eng' tugul, Yahudik kobooto Yunanik, che ki menyei Epheso; ak kinyoor kaiyweisyet icheek tugul, ak kinyoor teegisto kainetap Kiptaiyat Jeso.
Ki pwa ak icheek che chaang' che ki iyan, kong'aanyei ak koboortoi poisyonikwak.
Ki ip anyun bukuisyekwak `piik che chaang' eng' icheek che kiyaei ng'oorset, ak kobeel eng' taitap pichooto tugul; ak kiit kamanuutyennywa, konyoor kole ki itei fedhaisyek eliphuusyek konom.
Kotesak ko uu nooto anyun ng'olyootap Kiptaiyat eng' kimnateet ak koterteer.
Kingo pata anyun tuguuchuuto, komach Paulo eng' muguleldonyi kwo Jerusalem, ko kagobun Makedonia ak Akaia, koleen, “Ye kaawe olooto, ko kanyool ageer Rome agine.”
Ye kingo kagoyookto aeng' eng' icheek che kiboisyechin ineendet koba Makedonia, Timoteo ak Erasto, kota kotebi ineendet eng' Asia ne matya.
Ak king'eet polateet ne oo eng' peetuusyechooto agobo Oranooto;
Chiito age ne kiguure Demetrios ko ki kitang'indet ne po fedha, ne ki itanyi kanamonik che po fedha che po Artemi, ne ki ipchin tuguuk che chaang' kitang'ik.
Ki iyum chuuto kibagenge, kobooto piik che ki tinyei poisyet ne uu nooto, ak koleenji, “Murenju, ongen okweek ole, punu mogornatennyo poisyoni.
Ogeere ak ogase ole, ma eng' Epheso kityo ago neegit Asia tugul, kagochuut piik che chaang' Paulo-iniito, ak koweechi, koleenjin chooto ki kiyae eunek koma kamuktaik.

Ma keele kityo piitu pichiindap sasisyet ne kisasei poisyennyo; ago kiiti keele ma kiy hekaluutap kamuktain ne oo ne kobogoryot Artemi, ak keistoe ineendet teegistanyi ne koilasu Asia tugul kobooto ng'wony.”
Ye kingo kas niito, konereekso inne ak kobolyo kole, “Oo Artemi ne po Ephesoek!”
Ak konyi anyun nganaseet polateet; ak korwai kibagenge ye mi ureryet, ko kagonam Gaio ak Aristarko, piigap Makedonia che kibendoti ak Paulo.
Ak ye kimachei kwo Paulo oriit ole mi piik, koma kochamji kasubik.
Ak ki iyookto ng'olyoot piik alage che eecheen che po Asia, amu ki choronokyik, si mat kogoitogei kwo ye mi ureryet oriit.
Kiboldos anyun alage, komwaei ni, komwaei alage kiit age; amu ki piit polateet eng' tuiyet, ak ki ma kongen che chaang' kiit ne ki igoochi kotuiyo.
Ak ki imut Aleksanda komong' eng' tuiyet, kogoito `Yahudik ineendet. Ak ki iboorchi `Aleksanda pichooto eng' euut, ak kimachei kosargei eng' pichooto.
Ago ye kingo nai kole ineendet ko Yahudyot, kobolyo tugul eng' kutit agenge, eng' olo po saisyek aeng', koleen, “Oo Artemi ne po Ephesoek!”

Kingo kagomwachi siriindetap nganaseet tuiyet kosiisyo, kole, “Okweek piigap Epheso, tos mi ng'oo ne ma ingen kole nganaseetap Ephesoek ko riibindetap hekaluutap Artemi ne oo, ak kanamwet ne ki ibut kobunu parak?
Ak ngo ma kimuuchi ketiiyo agobo tuguuchu, ko kanyool osisye, matosartae ng'olyoo.
Amu kaomutu pichu, che ma reenyei hekalutap kamuktaindet ama chubei kamuktaindennyo ne kobogoryo.
Ngo tinyei anyun Demetrios ak musogik che mi kobooto ineendet, ng'olyoo agobo chii, ko yaatatin kapkirwoogutik, ak miitei pounik: ingorwookyin anyun icheegei.
Ago ngo cheeng' okweek ng'olyoo agobo tuguuk alak, ko tuun kilititi eng' tuiyet ne cham komi.
Amu mi pichiindo ne tos kirwookwech agobo polateet ne po rani, amu ma mi kito ne po: ak ma kimuuchi ketetu kiy agobo tuiyoni.”
Ak kingo kagomwa ko uu nooto, kotyakta tuiyet.
Ak kingo pata polateet, ko kagoyookto Paulo kasubik kobwa ak kogimit icheek, koyomiskei, si kwo Makedonia.
Ak kingo kagobun komoswechooto, ko kagogimiit icheek eng' ng'aleek che chaang', koit Greece.
Ak kingo kagotebee olooto arawek somok, kochop Yahudik ng'aleek eng' ung'oot agobo ineendet, ye kimachei kobun moinget kwo Syria, komachei kole koweegegei ooreetap Makedonia.
Ak ki pa kobooto ineendet agoi Asia Sopatro ne po Berea, ne po kap Puro; ak che po Thessalonikek Aristarko ak Sekundo; ak Gaio ne po Derbe, ak Timoteo; ak Tukiko ak Tropimo che po Asia.
Ago kiga kondo chuuto, ak ki igenech eng' Traos.
Ak ki kibun moinget eng' Philippi ko kagobata peetuusyegap magatyat ne ma kinde mermereek, ak keit ole mi icheek eng' Traos eng' peetuusyek muut; ole ki kitebee eng' peetuusyek tisap.
Ak eng' peetuutap tai ne po wigiit ye kiga kiyumge si kebuutul magatyat, koamji Paulo icheek, ye kimachei kwo eng' peetuut ne po aeng'; kong'alaal koek keny agoi kemoi kween.
Ak ki mi taisyek che chaang' eng' koot ne po parak, ole kiga kiyumjige.
Ak kitebee tirisyet neraneet age ne ki kiguure Eutuko ak kibirto met; ak kita koamji Paulo koek keny, ak kingo pirto met, kotururtogei kong'etee koot ne po somok, ak ki kisut ko kagome.
Ak kichoortagei Paulo, ak koitaegei ineendet ak kosuube eunekyik, komwa kole, “Moiimge; amu ta kosabei.”
Ak kingo togosta, ak kobuutul magatyat, ak koam, ak kong'alaal keny kobooto icheek, agoi koeech, kwo anyun.
Ak ki imut nerananooto ko kagosap, ak kinyoor kagaigaet ne oo.
Ago ki kindoi acheek keebe meeliit, keebe Assos, amu ki kimache kimut Paulo eng' olooto: amu kiga kong'at ineendet ko uu nooto, komach ineendet kole kobun keeldo.
Ak ye ki ngetuiye ak ineendet eng' Assos, kimut ineendet konyo moinget, ak keit Mitulene.
Ak ki kibe eng' olooto kebun moinget, keit Ki o eng' peetuut ne po tai; ak peetuut ne po aeng' keit Samo; ak peetuut ne po somok keit Mileto.
Amu kiga kobegechi Paulo kwo kosiirtoe Epheso eng' moinget, si ma igagei eng' Asia; amu ki igirgiri, kole tamangap koit Jerusalem eng' peetuutap Pentekoste.
Ak ki iyookto eng' Mileto keguur poisyegap kaniset eng' Epheso.
Ak ye kingo pwa ole mi ineendet, koleenji, “Ongen okweeget kobooch peetuut ne po tai ye kinga tau atyech Asia, ole ki ateptoi kobootok tugul,
aboisyechini Kiptaiyat eng' kaming'inetapkei tugul, ak eng' peegap kong', ak eng' tyemuutik che kibwanjo eng' chobutik che po ung'oot che po Yahudik;
ko uu ye ki ma ariiny amwaiwok kiy age tugul ne imuuchi kotoretook, ak aneetaak eng' taitap piik, ak ang'eete koot age agoi koot age,
abaoryanjini Yahudik kobooto Yunanik siguunet eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ak kayaneet eng' Kiptaiyandennyo Jeso Kristo.
Ak ogeer anyun nguno, awendi Jerusalem ko aa mutworiin ne po Kabuuset ne Tiliil, amangen tuguuk che pwonjino eng' olooto:
kobatee kityo paoryanjino Kabuuset ne Tiliil eng' nganaseet age tugul, koleen, igeno ratisyosyek ak nyalilwogik.
Ago ma iiti saboondanyu ale kiy ne achame kot, si kobiit agees pandanyu, ak poisyet ne ki ataach eng' Kiptaiyat Jeso, abaoryanji logoiywek che myach che po myeeindap Kamuktaindet.
“Ak nguno anyun, ogeero, angen ale okweek tugul che ki aamdaate logoiywegap laitornatetap Kamuktaindet, koma ogeere togeennyu kogeny.
Abaoryani anyun eng' taing'wong' peetuuni, ale, aa tiliil eng' korotiigap piik tugul.
Amu ma ariiny amwaiwok maguutik tugul che po Kamuktaindet.
Oriipkei anyun okweeget, kobooto akweet tugul, ne ki koonok Kabuuset ne Tiliil oegu riibiik, obai kanisetap Kamuktaindet, ne ki ale korotiikyik.
Angen ale ye kaawe komong'jok suik che koroomen, ama riiree akweet.
Ak tuun ng'eetos alage eng' kwenung'wong' komwaei ng'aleek che imaasi piich, si kochuut kasubik koosup icheek.
Oriipse anyun, ak obwaat ole ma abagaakte atigoon chii age tugul eng' peegap kong' eng' kenyiisyek somok kemoi ak peet.
“Ara anyun, kabagakyok nguno eutap Kamuktaindet, ak ng'olyootap myeeindonyi, ne imuuchi koteechak, ak kogoonok poroteet kobooto icheek tugul che kitiliili.
Ma agase myat fedha che po chii age tugul, anan thahabu, anan ngoroik.
Ongen okweek ole kibois eunechu agobo tuguuk che ki anyalili, ak agobo icheek che ki mi kobooto.

Ki agoonok kaboorunet eng' tuguuk tugul, ale ye oboisyei ko nyolu otoret che ma tinyei kimnateet, ak obwaati ng'aleegap Kiptaiyat Jeso, ko uu ye ki mwa ineendet kole ‘Tinyei poiboiyet kagoitoet kosiir taaget.’ ”
Ak kingo kagomwa ko uu nooto, kogutuny, kosa kobooto icheek tugul.
Ak ki riiryo icheek tugul miising', ak kosuup kaatitap Paulo, ak kong'utut ineendet,
koaragendos kosiir agobo ng'olyoot ne kiga komwa, kole ma tuun kogeerei togeennyi kogeny. Ak ki iyomis ineendet kowendi kolaanyei meeliit.
Ye kingo kagebesye ak icheeget, ak ketau keebe eng' moinget, kilitit panda, kitoorchigei Kos, ak peetuut ne ki isubi nooto keit Rhodes, ak keebe eng' olooto agoi keit Patara.
Ye ki ngenyooru meeliit ne landoi kowendi Phoenisia, kelaany, ak keebe.
Ak ye kiga kegeer Cyprus, kesiirtoe komi euut ne po kaataam, keebe agoi Syria, ak kechooruge eng' meeliit eng' Tyro, amu yooto ye kinemune tuguugap meeliit.
Ak ye kiga kenyooru kasubik, ketebi eng' olooto peetuusyek tisap. Ki mwachi `icheek Paulo eng' Kabuuset ne Tiliil koleenji amat kotyech Jerusalem.
Ak kingo kagigesu peetuusyechooto, keebe pandanyo; ak ki iyomiseech icheek tugul kobooto osotik ak lagok, agoi kemande eng' nganaseet, ak kegutung'se eng' ngeguut, kesaa
ak kigoochigei saisere. Kelaany anyun meeliit koweek icheek koba kaa.
Ak ye kiga kigeesu panda ne po moinget kebunu Tyro, keit Ptolemais; ak kigat tupchosyek, ak ketebi kobooto icheek peetuut agenge.
Ak eng' peetuut ne po aeng' keebe, agoi keit Caesarea: ak keebe kootap Philipu amdoindet ne po logoiywek che myach, ineendet ko agenge eng' piik tisap, ak ki kitebi ak ineendet.
Ki tinyei chiichito tiibiik ang'wan, pergeinik, che ki maoteni.
Ak ye kita ketebye eng' peetuusyek che chaang' eng' olooto, konyo kochoorgei maotyot age ne punu Judea ne ki kiguure Agabo.

Ak kingo kagoit ole kimi, konam pireneetap Paulo, ak korate keelyekyik ak eunekyik, ak kole, “Mwaei Kabuuset ne Tiliil ko uu ni kole, ‘Ratei ko uu niito Yahudik che mi Jerusalem chiitap ko po pirenoni, ak tuun indoi ineendet eunegap Pororyosyek.’ ”
Ak ki ngegas ng'aleechuuto, kigaigai ineendet, acheek ak piigap olooto, si ma togosta Jerusalem.
Kowol Paulo kole, “Oyae nee, orirtosi ak obare muguleldanyu? Amu aa choboot, ma kerata kityo, ago ame eng' Jerusalem agobo kainetap Kiptaiyat Jeso.”
Ak ye ki mata kocham ko uu nooto, kesisye, kemwa keele, “Ingoyaak mageetap Kiptaiyat.”
Ak kingo pata peetuusyechooto kenam tuguukyok ketogoste Jerusalem.
Ak ki kibe kobooto kasubik che ki punu Caesarea, komutu Mnason ne po Cyprus, ne kiga koek kasubin koek keny, ne ki kibendi ketebee koonnyi.
Kingeit Jerusalem, kotaachech tupchosyek eng' poiboiyet.
Ak peetuut ne ki isubi peetuunooto keebe acheek ak Paulo kap Jakobo; ak ki mi poisyek tugul.
Ak kingo kagogat icheek, kotetyi tuguuk tugul agenge agenge che kiga koyai Kamuktaindet eng' poisyennyi eng' Pororyosyek.

Kingo kas icheek ng'olyoondonooto, kogonyit Kamuktaindet. Koleenji `icheek ineendet, “Igeere anyun, ne kitupche, ole tee eliphuusyek ng'iisyat eng' kwenutap Yahudik che ki koyan; ak tinyei tugul kagiiletapkei agobo Ng'atuutyet.
Ak ki kiboorchi icheek agobo inyee, keele, ineeti Yahudik tugul che mi ye mi Pororyosyek kobagaakta Musa, ak ileenjini icheek amat komuratan lagokwak, anan koosup pitonwek.
Nee anyun nguno? Ma kogas icheek iman kole kaiitu.
Yai anyun ni kimwaun: Ki tinyei piik ang'wan che ki koarorta kiy eng' kayasyoet;

imut anyun pichu, ak ianyinyge kobooto icheek, ak igamanji fedha, si kobiit kicherchi metowekwak: si konai tugul kole ma mi imanit eng' tuguuchooto ki kiboorchi agobo inyee; ago inyee iwendoti komyee, iriibe Ng'atuutyet.
Ago eng' Pororyosyek che ki koyan, kogigesir ketil kirwooget keele, kotabaanegei tuguuk che kieng'jin kanamonik, ak korotiik, ak panyeek che po che kagiget, ak sokseet.”

Komut anyun Paulo murenjoto, ak eng' peetuut ne po aeng' koanyinygei kobooto icheeget ak kwo Hekaluut oriit, koboortoi kasuldaetap peetuusyek che po kaanyinyet, agoi kigoito kagoochinet ne po age tugul eng' icheek.
Ye kimachei kogeskei peetuusyek tisabu, kowas tuiyet Yahudik che ki punu Asia, ye kingo keer ineendet komi Hekaluut. Ak konam ineendet,

koboldos koleen, “Okweek piigap Israel, otoretech! Chiichito ne ineeti piik tugul eng' komosta age tugul kowech piik, ak Ng'atuutyet, ak yuto: ak kobooto nooto koimut Yunanik ak icheek kobwa Hekaluut, ak kagong'wanit yuto tiliil.”
Amu kiga kogeer Tropimo Ephesoindet komi kobooto ineendet eng' nganaseet, ne kileen ki imutu Paulo konyo Hekaluut.
Kowaskei anyun nganaseet komugul, ak ki rwai piik kibagenge: ak konam Paulo, ak kochuut komong' eng' Hekaluut: ak ki kiger kurgotik eng' sainooto.
Ak ye ki cheeng'ei kobar ineendet, koityi ng'aleek kiptaiyat ne oo ne po murenigap lugeet kole, miitei chemargeet Jerusalem komugul.
Komut sainooto kiplugotinik ak kiptainigap pogolwogik, korwai kochoortagei ole mi icheek: ak kingo keer icheek kiptaiyat ne oo ak kiplugotinik, kobagaakta pireet ne kibirei Paulo.
Konyo anyun kiptaiyat ne oo koriik, ak konam ineendet ak kong'at kole, kerat ineendet eng' nyororosyek aeng'; ak koteebe kole, ng'oo niito? Ak kayai nee?
Ak kobolyo alak eng' tuiyet komwaei kiit age komwaei alage kiit age: ak ye ki ma imuuch konai komyee kiit ne po polateet, kong'at kole kimut ineendet kwo irimeet.
Ak kingo it lang'eiywot, koganap kiplugotinik ineendet amu koroomnatetap tuiyet;
amu ki isubi tuiyet ne po piik, koboldos, koleen, Oiste ineendet.
Ak ye ki kimachei kimut Paulo kwo irimeet, koleenji kiptaiyat ne oo, “Ichamwo amwaun ng'olyoo?” Koleenji, “Tos ingen kutitap Yunanik?
Tos ma ii Misirindet ne ki ing'eet lomset yaginye ak komut piik eliphuusyek ang'wan koba surkwen, piik che kiguure Rumiik?”
Ago ki le Paulo, “Aa Yahudyot ne po Tarsis eng' Cilicia, aa po nganaseet ne ma nyeraat; ak asoomin ale, chamwo ang'alaalji piik.”
Ye kingo kagochamji, kotonone Paulo lang'eiywot, ak koboorchi piik eng' euut kosiisyo; ak ye kingo kagosiisyo inne, kong'alaalji icheek eng' kutitap Yahudik, kole,
“Che kitupche ak kwanisyekyok, ogas ng'aleek che amwae nguno eng' taing'wong' che asaruunegei.”
Ak kingo kas kole ng'alaaljin icheek eng' kutitap Yahudik, kosiisyo miising': ak ki le

aa Yahudyot, ki kisikyo Tarsis ne po Cilicia, ago ki anerchi nganasani, ak ki ineeta Gamaliel, ak ki kineta komyee ko uu ole teptoi Ng'atuutyetap kwanisyekyok, ak ki atinye kagiiletapkei eng' Kamuktaindet, ko uu ole oteptoi okweek tugul rani:
ak ki ausausi Orani agoi meet, arate ak atoorchini korgoreet murenik ak kobogorisyek.

Ko uu ye paoryanjino tisiindet ne oo, ak kapkirwooget tugul ne po poisyek: che ki anyoorunee paronok, che ki aibe koba kaptupchosyek, ak ki awe Damasko, ale amut icheek che ki mi olooto kobwa Jerusalem ko ratotiin, si kobiit kebir.
“Ak ye ki awendi, ko kariikyi Damasko, ko katonon asiis, kooluu eng' sainooto lapkeiyet ne oo ne ki punu kipsengwet koluucha komoswek tugul.
Ak ki abutyi ng'wony, ak agas kutit koleenjo, ‘Saulo, Saulo, amu nee si iusa?’
Ak ki awolu ale, ‘Ii ng'oo inyee, Kiptaiyat?’ Ak ki leenjo, ‘Aa Jeso ne po Nazareth, ne iuse.’
Ak ki keer lapkeiyet iman che ki mi kobooto, ago ki ma kas kutitap ineendet ne ki ng'alaalwo.
Ale, Ayai nee anyun, Kiptaiyat? Koleenjo Kiptaiyat, Ng'eet, ui Damasko; si kemwaun eng' olooto tuguuk tugul che kigeng'at iyai.
Ak ye ki ma kota amuuchi ageer kiy amu liletap lapkeiyonooto, ait Damasko, konamota euut icheek che ki mi kobooto.
“Ak ki nyo ole ami, chiito age ne keguure Anania, chiito ne po iman eng' riibetap Ng'atuutyet, ne kibaoryanjin Yahudik tugul che ki menyei olooto kole myee.
Ak ye kitononi eng' ye neegiteena, koleenjo, Ne kitupche Saulo, keerte. Ak eng' sainooto ageer ineendet.
Ak ki le, ‘Ki kolewenin Kamuktaindet ne po kwanisyekyok si kobiit inai magennyi, ak igeer Ineendet ne po Imanda, ak igas ng'olyoot ne punu kutinnyi.
Amu iegu paoryandennyi eng' piik tugul agobo tugul che koigeer ak che koigas.
Ta igeni nee anyun nguno? Ng'eet kibatisanin, ak kiuundo tengekwogiguk iguure kainennyi.’
“Ak kingo kaaweektegei Jerusalem, ak kingo ta asaae eng' Hekaluut, kobutya kiit ne uu rwon,
ageer ineendet koleenjino, ‘Igirgir, chaakte, mande eng' Jerusalem, amu mataachei paornateet eng' inyee agobo anee.’
Ak ki ale, ‘Kiptaiyat, ingen icheeget kole ki arate ak abire eng' sinagogit age tugul eng' icheek che ki iyanin.
Ak ye ki ngetumdoi korotiigap Stepano paoryandeng'ung', ko ki atononi agane eng' yooto, ayanjini ak ariibe ngoroigap icheeget che ki parei ineendet.’
Ak ki leenjo ineendet, ‘Ui, amu ayooktoin iwe ole loo agoi ye mi Pororyosyek.’ ”
Koepchi iit anyun icheek ineendet agoi ng'olyoondoniito; yeityo komwa eng' kutit ne oo, kole, “Oiste chiito ne uu niito kwo eng' ng'wony; amu ma nyolu kosap.”
Ak ye kita koboldos, ak kowiirtoi ngoroikwak, ak kowastoi temburyek koba parak,
kong'at kiptaiyat ne oo kole kimut ineendet kwo irimeet, kong'at kole, ogine eng' pireet ne po kipcharitisyek, si konai ineendet kiit ne kabolji icheek ko uu nooto agobo ineendet.
Ak ye kingo kagorate ineendet anook, koleenji Paulo kiptaiyatap pogol ne kitononi eng' yooto, Tos chamdoi ng'atuutik eng' okweek obir chii ne Romanindet, ama kirwookyi?
Ak kingo kas chemogonooto po kiplugotinik pogol, kwo ole mi kiptaiyat ne oo, ak komwachi ineendet koleenji, “Imache iyai nee nguno? Amu Romanindet chiichi.”
Konyo anyun kiptaiyat ne oo, ak koleenji ineendet, Mwaiwo, tos ii Romanin? Ak ki le, Ee.
Kowol kiptaiyat ne oo kole, “Ki aegu chiitap pororyoni eng' alyet ne oo.” Ak ki le Paulo, Ki kisikyo pororyoniito.
Koba anyun eng' sainooto icheek che kimachei kogine ineendet: ak ki iywei agine kiptaiyat ne oo, ye kingo nai kole kaagaa Romanindet ineendet, ak amu kiga korat ineendet.

Ago ye kimachei konai komyee eng' peetuut ne po aeng', kiit ne koitaame Yahudik, kotyach ineendet ak kong'at tisiik che eecheen ak kapkirwooget tugul kotuiyo, ak komut Paulo kochoorgei, ak konde ineendet tainnywa.
Ak kingo keer Paulo kapkirwoogonooto komyee, komwa kole, “Che kitupche, ki atebee kotugul kabwaatet ne myee eng' taitap Kamuktaindet agoi rani.”
Kong'at Anania, tisiindet ne oo, icheek che kitonondos eng' yooto kole, korabach kutinnyi.
Koleenji anyun Paulo ineendet, “Tuun pirin Kamuktaindet, inyee inaatut ne ki kisal koleelit. Itebye ak irwokwo ko uu ye mwaei Ng'atuutyet, ak ing'ate kebira ama chamdoi Ng'atuutyet?”
Komwa icheek che kitonondos eng' yooto kole, “Ichube tisiindet ne oo ne po Kamuktaindet?”
Kole anyun Paulo, Kama anai, che kitupche, ale ineendet ko tisiindet ne oo: amu ki kisir keele, Amemwa ne ya agobo pounindetap piiguk.

Ago ye kingo nai Paulo kole, Sadukaik alage, ko Pharisaik alage, komwa eng' kutit ne oo eng' kapkirwook kole, “Che kitupche, aa Pharisaindet, weeriitap Pharisaik. Kagirwokwo agobo kamang'unet ak ng'eetyeet ne po che ki kobek.”
Ak kingo kagomwa ko uu nooto, kong'eet anyun toiyet eng' Pharisaik ak Sadukaik: ak kipcheak tuiyet.
Amu mwaei Sadukaik kole, ma mi ng'eetyeet eng' che ki pek, anan malaika, anan saboon: ago iyani tugul Pharisaik.

Kong'eet anyun polateet ne oo: ak kitononso siriik alak che po Pharisaik, ak koboryo koleen, Ma kinyooru yaityo eng' chiichi: ak tos nee eng' okweek ngot ko kang'alaal ak ineendet kabuuso, anan malaika?
Ak ye kingo ng'eet toiyet ne oo, koywei kiptaiyat ne oo kole tos tonaton pichu Paulo, kong'at anyun kiplugotinik kochoortagei ak komut ineendet eng' kimnateet eng' kwenunnywa, ak komut konyo irimeet.
Ak eng' kemout ne ki isubi nooto kotonon Kiptaiyat eng' ye neegitee ineendet ak koleenji, “Nyiganitu: amu ko uu ye ki ibaoryanjo eng' Jerusalem, ko uu nooto kanyool ibaoryan eng' Rome agine.”
Ak kingo eech koyumgei Yahudik, ak korategei kayasyoet, kole ma kiame kiy ama kiee agoi kebar Paulo.
Ak ki siirei artam icheeget che ki yosyo.
Ak ki pwa ole mi tisiik che eecheen ak poisyek, ak koleenji, “Kageratkei eng' kayasyoet ne oo keele, ma ki chamchami kiy agoi kebar Paulo.
Oboorchi anyun okweek ak poisyek kiptaiyat ne oo komut ineendet kochoorgei konyo ole omi, ko uu ne omache ogin komyee ng'aleekyik. Ak kichobootiin acheek kebar ineendet agot kotom koriikyech.”
Ago ki kas weeriitap chepkametap Paulo agobo setyinennywa, ak ki nyo kwo irimeet ak komwachi Paulo.
Koguur anyun Paulo age eng' kiptainigap pogolwogik, ak koleenji, “Imut murenoni kwo ole mi kiptaiyat ne oo: amu tinyei ng'olyoo ne machei komwachi ineendet.”
Komut anyun ineendet kwo ole mi kiptaiyat ne oo, ak koleenji, “Kaguura Paulo, kimonjororyot, awo ole mi ineendet ak komwaiwo amutun murenoni konyo ole imi, tinyei ng'olyoo ne machei komwaun.”
Konam anyun kiptaiyat ne oo eutap weerooto, ak komut taban, ak koteebe eng' ung'oot kole, “Nee nooto imache imwaiwo?”
Kole, “Kagochamyechi Yahudik kole kosoomin imutu Paulo kochoorgei mutai konyo kapkirwook, ko uu ne imache iteepse ineendet komyee.

Ameyanji anyun amu miitei eng' icheek che siirei artam che setyin ineendet, che kagoratkei eng' kayasyoet, kole ma amei kiy anan koe agoi kobar ineendet. Chobootiin icheek nguno kogeni ng'atuutyet ne punun.”
Kounda anyun kiptaiyat ne oo murenonooto kwo, ak kong'at ineendet koleenji, “Amemwachi chii agot agenge ileenji kaimwa tuguuchu.”

Ak kiguur kiptainik aeng' che po pogolwogik koba ole mi ineendet ak koleenji, “Ochop kiplugotinik pogol aeng' koba agoi Caesarea, ak kiplugotinik tamanwogik tisap che ketei paraisisyek, ak murenigap ng'otwek pogol aeng', eng' sait somok ne po kemoi.
Ki mwachi kochop paraisisyek, si kobiit komute icheek Paulo, ak komut kot koit ole mi Felix pounindet kochamegei.”
Ak kisir parweet ko uu ni:
Anee Klaudio Lusia, agatin inyee pounindet Felix, ne ii tagunoot.
Konam Yahudik chiichi, ak ki neegit kobar icheek ineendet, awe anyun ak kiplugotinik ole mi icheek, ak asaru ineendet, ko kaanai ale kaagaa Romanin ineendet.
Ak ye ki amache anai kiit ne ki itaame icheek ineendet, amutu anyun kochoorgei kapkirwoogennywa:
ageer ale, ki kitaam ineendet agobo ng'aleegap ng'atuutikwak, ago ma mi ng'olyoo ne ki kiityi ineendet ne nyoljin meet anan ratuutik.
Ak ye kongiboorwo keele kogechop ng'aleek eng' ung'oot agobo ineendet, ayoogu ineendet konyo olong'ung' achogune, ak ang'at che kataamikyik si komwa ng'aleek eng' taing'ung', che itaame ineendet.
Komut anyun kiplugotinik Paulo, ko uu ye kagaging'at, ak komut kemoi kwo Antipatris.
Ago mutai kobagaakta murenik che ki laanyei paraisisyek koba kobooto ineendet ak koweektagei koba irimeet:
ak kingo kagoit Caesarea, ak kogoochi pounindet parweet, konde Paulo agine tainnyi.
Ak ye kiga kosoman parweet, koteebe icheek koleenji, ano emetap chiichi? Ak kingo kas keele, po ineendet Cilicia,
kole, “Tuun agasun ng'aleeguk ko kait piik che ki itaamin.” Ki ng'at keriip ineendet eng' kootap kirwooget ne po Herod.
Ak kingo pata peetuusyek muutu, kochoorgei Anania tisiindet ne oo ak poisyek alak, ak ng'alaalindet age, ne kiguure Tertulo; ak koboorchi pounindet ng'aleek che ko kitaame Paulo.
Ak kingo kageguur, kotoi Tertulo kotaam ineendet kole, “Amu kiboiboitune kaalyeet ne oo eng' inyee, ak ki istoi yaitwogik eng' pororyoni amu ng'omnateng'ung',
kitaach anyun eng' ortinwek tugul ak eng' komoswek tugul, kobooto kongoi tugul, ee inyee ne ii tagunoot, Felix.
Ago si mata again miising', asoomin ale igaseech eng' ng'aleek che ng'ering' eng' myeeindong'ung',
amu ki kegeer chiichi keele ineendet ko chii ne itoitos piich, ne ing'eeti chemerereet eng' Yahudik tugul eng' ng'wony komugul, ak kandoindet ne po kasubiigap Nazaretik.
Ki tyem kogeny kole kong'wanit Hekaluut, ak ki kinam ineendet. [Ak ki kimache kirwookyi ineendet ko uu ng'atuutikyok.
Ago ki nyo ole ki mi Lusia kiptaiyat ne oo ne po kiplugotinik, ak korebenech ineendet eng' eunekyok eng' kimnateet ne oo.]
Imuuchi inai tuguuchu tugul eng' ineendet ye igine inyeendet, agobo tuguuchooto ko kitaame.”
Ak ki iyomechigei Yahudik kataamsonooto, kogiimit kole uu nooto ng'aleechuuto.
Ak kingo kagoboorchine pounindet Paulo euut, kole kong'alaal, kowol Paulo kole, “Asaruge eng' poiboiyet, angen ale, ii kirwoogindet ne po pororyoni eng' kenyiisyek che chaang'.
Imuuchi inai ile tomo kosiir peetuusyek taman ak aeng' kobooch ngap atogoste Jerusalem awe asaa.
Ama nyoorwo icheek eng' Hekaluut kibeligei ak chii age tugul, anan awase tuiyet, anan eng' sinagogisyek, anan eng' nganaseet.
Amaimuuchi icheek koboorun komyee tuguuk che itaamena.
Ago kang'ang'un niito, eng' Oranooto kuure icheek piteet age, aoote Kamuktaindet ne po kwanisyekyok, ak ayani tuguuk tugul ko uu ye mwaei Ng'atuutyet, ak che ki kisir eng' maotik:
atinye kamang'unet eng' Kamuktaindet, ne cheeng'ei pichu ak icheek, ale, tatun komi ng'eetyeetap che po imanda ak che ma po imanda.
Ak achobegei anyun agane eng' ng'olyoondoni atebee kotugul kabwaatet ne ma tinyei kanagut eng' taitap Kamuktaindet ak piik.
“Ak kingo pata kenyiisyek che chaang' anyoo aipchi piigap pororyennyu kagoochinoik ak tuguuk che kigoitoi.
Ye ki ayae niito, ko ki nyoortaa kitiliilo eng' Hekaluut, ak ki ma komi tuiyet anan polateet.
Ago ki mi Yahudik alak che ki punu Asia; myee nda kami yu icheek eng' taing'ung' si komwaitaa ngo ting'ena icheek ng'olyoo.
Anan ingomwa pichu icheeget poisyet ne ya ne kinyoor, ye kinga tonon eng' taitap kapkirwooget,
kobatee tweguunet agenge ne ki ariirchi atononi eng' kwenunnywa, ale, ‘Kagirwokwo rani eng' taing'wong' agobo ng'eetyeetap che ki kobek.’ ”
Amu ki ingen Felix komyee agobo Oranooto, koleenji, “Ogen, ye tuun kachoorgei kiptaiyat ne oo Lusia, atil anyun ng'aleekwok.”
Ak kong'at chemogetap kiplugotinik pogol kole keriip ineendet, ak kigoochin poroindo; amat koete age tugul eng' choronokyik koboisyechi ineendet.
Ago kingo pata peetuusyek alage, koit Felix, kobooto Drusila osotyonnyi, ne ki Chebyahudio, ak koyookto Paulo konyo, ak ki kas eng' ineendet agobo kayaneet eng' Kristo Jeso.
Ak ye kita kong'alaali agobo imanda, ak riibetapkei, ak kirwooget ne nyoonei, koiyweis Felix, ak kowol kole, “Ui korook; ak ye tuun anyooru poroindo ne myee, aguurin.”
Ki imang'u kole togot kogoochi Paulo silingisyek: kiguur anyun ineendet konyil che chaang', ak kong'alaal kobooto ineendet.
Ago kingo keskei kenyiisyek aeng'u, konam Porkio Pesto poisyetap Felix; ak amu kimachei Felix kobaibai Yahudik, kobagaakta Paulo ko rataat.
Kingo kagoit Pesto koronooto, kotogosta Jerusalem kobunei Caesarea, ko kagobata peetuusyek somogu.
Ak ki mwachi tisiik che eecheen ak piik che taagunotiin che po Yahudik ng'aleek che kiting'e Paulo; ak kogaigai icheek ineendet,
kosoom chamdaet agobo ineendet, kole koyookto ineendet kimut konyo Jerusalem; si kobiit korat ooreet kobar ineendet.
Ago ki wol Pesto kole keriip Paulo eng' Caesarea, ak kole, Neegit si awo aneendet olooto.
Ak kole ineendet, “Ongechoortegei ak che eecheen eng' okweek, si ngo mi ng'olyoo age tugul ne ya eng' chiichito, komwa icheek.”
Ak kingo kagotebi eng' kwenunnywa kobooto icheek eng' peetuusyek che ma siirei sisiit anan ko taman, kochoortagei Caesarea; ak mutai kotebee ng'echereetap kirwooget, ak kong'at kole kimut Paulo.
Ak kingo kagoit, koyiem ineendet Yahudik che ki punu Jerusalem, koibu ng'aleek che chaang' che koroomen che ki itaame ineendet, che ki ma imuuch koboor komyee kiit ne ineet;
ago ki mwa Paulo eng' ng'aleek che kisaruunegei, kole, “Tom ayai tengek agot kitigin agobo Ng'atuutyetap Yahudik, anan agobo Hekaluut, anan agobo Caesarea.”
Ago ye kimachei Pesto kobaibai Yahudik, kowolji Paulo, koleenji, “Tos imache itogoste Jerusalem, si kirwoogun eng' olooto agobo tuguuchu eng' tainnyu?
Ago ki le Paulo, Atononi eng' taitap ng'echereetap kirwooget ne po Caesarea, ole kanyool kirwoogunena: tomo ayachi kiy ne ya Yahudik, ko uu ye ingen inyee komyee.
Ngo aa kiptengekyo, ak ngot ko koayai kiy ne nyoljin meet, koma eesyoi ame: ago ngot koma po iman tuguuchooto, che itaamjino pichu, koma mi chii ne imuuchi kondea eunekwak. Ariirchini Caesarea.”
Ak kingo kagong'alaal anyun Pesto ak piigap kapkirwook, kowol kole, “Kairiirchi Caesarea; ara anyun, iwendi kap Caesarea.”
Ak kingo kagosiirto peetuusyek alage, koit laitoryat Agripa ak Bernike Caesarea, si kogat Pesto.
Ak ye kita kobeniei peetuusyek che chaang', koboorchi Pesto laitoryat ng'aleegap Paulo, koleenji, “Miitei chii age ne ki pagaakta Felix ko rataat.
Ne kimwaiwo ng'aleekyik tisiik che eecheen ak poisyegap Yahudik ye ki ami Jerusalem, ki soomei ng'aleek che kigikyine ineendet.
Ak ki awolji icheek aleenji, ma piteetap Romanik kigoito chii kotomo kogeergei kimni chiito ne kitaami ak che itaamsei, ak konyoor poroindo ne saruunegei eng' ng'aleek che ki kitaamjin.
Ye kingo yumgei anyun eng' yu, ko mata agagei, ago eng' peetuut ne po aeng' atebee ng'echereetap kirwooget, ak ang'at kimut chiichooto.
Ak kingo tononso icheeget che ki itaami ineendet, koma koip ng'olyoo ne ya ne po kagikyino agobo ineendet ko uu ye ki abwaati;
ago kiting'e ineendet teebutik agobo kayanennywa, ak agobo chii ne kileen Jeso, ne ki kome, ne igiiljingei Paulo kole, sabei.
Ago ki aleen agin ole teptoi ng'aleechu kotemena, ateebee ngo machei kwo Jerusalem, si kirwookyi eng' oliindo agobo ng'aleechuuto.
Ago kingo riirchi Paulo kotebi kole si kotil kirwooget pounindet ne oo, ang'at ale keriip agoi tuun ayookte kwo kap Caesarea.”
Ak ki leenji Agripa Pesto, “Amache agas agane ng'aleegap chiichito.” Koleenji, “Igase mutai.”

Ak mutai ko kagoit Agripa, kobooto Bernike, eng' etunateet ne oo, ak ko kagoba koot ne kigase ng'aleek, kobooto kiptainik che eecheen, ak piik che taagunotiin che po nganaseet, kimut Paulo eng' ng'atuutyetap Pesto.

Komwa Pesto anyun, kole, “Laitoryat Agripa, ak piik tugul che kimi yu tugul, ogeere chiichi, ki koriircho tuiyet tugul ne po Yahudik agobo ineendet, eng' Jerusalem ak eng' olito, koboldos, koleen, manyol kota kosap.
Ago ki ageer ale ma yai kiy ne nyoljin meet: ak ko uu ye ki riirchi ineendet pounindet ne oo, acham anyun ayookto ineendet.

Ma tinyei ng'olyoo ne po iman ne asirchini kiptaiyandennyu agobo ineendet. Nooto anyun kamutu ineendet konyo taing'wong', ak ne siirei ko konyo taing'ung', inyee, laitoryat Agripa, si ye kageteebse, asich ng'olyoot ne asire.
Amu ageere ale, ma nyolu kiyookto kimonjororyo, ama kibor tuguuk che ki kitaamjin.”
Koleenji anyun Agripa Paulo, Kagichamun iwolu ng'aleeguk. Kochuul anyun Paulo eunnyi, ak komwa ng'aleek che saruunegei, kole:
Abwaati ale abaibai, ee laitoryat Agripa, amu amuuchi asarge rani eng' taing'ung' agobo tuguuk tugul che koitaamja Yahudik:
ne siirei ko amu ingen komyee pitonwek tugul ak teebutik tugul che tinyei Yahudik; nooto anyun, kasoomin ale igasa eng' muitaet.
Ingen Yahudik tugul ateptap sabeennyu, kobooch ko aa ming'in, ne ki atinye kobooch ko ka piitu eng' pororyennyu, ak eng' Jerusalem;
ak kongeno icheek kobooch eng' tai, nda chamei icheek kobaoryan, ko uu ye ki aa Pharisaindet ne isubi piteet ne koroom ne po kayanennyo.
Ak katonon nguno eng' yu si kirwookwo agobo kamang'unet ne po arorutyet ne kichopchi Kamuktaindet kwanisyekyok;
nooto ne imang'u ortinwekyok tamanu ak aeng' kole nyooru, koboisyechin Kamuktaindet eng' kagiiletapkei peet ak kemoi. Kagogikyo Yahudik agobo kamang'unoniito, ee, laitoryandani!
Amu nee si kibwaat keele ma iyanaksei eng' okweek keele, ing'eeti Kamuktaindet che ki kobek?
Ki abwaati aneendet iman ale kanyool ayai tuguuk che chaang' che kirindoi kainetap Jeso ne po Nazareth.
Ak ki ayai niito agine eng' Jerusalem: ak atoorchi korgorosyek piik che chaang' eng' che tiliileen, ko kagogoono kimnateet tisiik che eecheen, ak ki achame ye ki kibarei icheek.
Ak ki abirote konyil che chaang' eng' sinagogisyek tugul, abirchini kochubis; ak ye kiga konyita icheek miising', ausote agoi nganasook che po toek.
Ak ye kinga wendi Damasko atinye kimnateet ak kayooktoet ne po tisiik che eecheen,
ageer lapkeiyet ne ki punu kipsengwet, ne siirei kaluunetap asiista, koluucha komoswek tugul kobooto che ki kibendi tugul, eng' ooreet peet kween, ee, laitoryandani.
Ak kingo kagibutyi ng'wony tugul, agas kutit ne leenjino eng' kutitap Yahudik, Saulo, Saulo, amu ne si iusoo? Pichiy eng' inyee ityar kiplitwet.
Ak ki ale, ii ng'oo inyee, Kiptaiyat? Kole Kiptaiyat, Aa Jeso ne iuse.
Ago ng'eet, tonon eng' keelyeguk: kang'ang'unge amu ni, ale andein iegu kiboityot ak paoryatap tuguuchu kaigeer agobo anee, ak tuguuk che tuun ang'ang'unenegei;
asaruun eng' piik, ak eng' Pororyosyek, ole tuun ayooktoin iwe,

si kobiit ing'aany konyekwak, ak koweek eng' mesundeito kobwonji lapkeiyet, ak eng' kimnateetap Setani kobwonji Kamuktaindet, si konyoor icheek nyoetap kaat ne po tengekwogik ak poroteet eng' icheek che ki kitiliil amu kayaneet ne mi eng' anee.
Nooto anyun, ee, laitoryandani Agripa, ma abistoe kaboorunet ne po kipsengwet:
ago ki aboorchi che mi Damasko korook, ak eng' Jerusalem, ak eng' emet komugul ne po Judea, ak eng' Pororyosyek ak icheek, si kosik ak koyan Kamuktaindet, koyaei poisyonik che nyoljin siguunet.
Ki nama anyun Yahudik eng' Hekaluut amu niito, ak kotyem kobara.
Ye kinga nyooru toreteet ne punu Kamuktaindet, atonon agoi rani abaoryanjini che mengech ak che eecheen, amamwae kiy age kobatee che ki mwa maotik ak Musa, kole tuun pwoonei;
kole kanyool konyalil Kristo, ak kole komwaita korook eng' ng'eetyeetap che ki pek, lapkeiyet, komwachi piik ak Pororyosyek.
Ak ye kita kosarugei ko uu nooto, komwa Pesto eng' kutit ne oo, kole, “Paulo, ii kibiywa; kagogoonin iywek `kaneetetapkei ne oo.”
Ago ki le Paulo, “Ma aa kibiywa, ee Pesto ne ii tagunoot: ago amwae ng'aleek che po iman ak che po ng'omnateet.
Amu ingen laitoryat ng'aleechuuto, ineendet ne ang'alaaljini eng' nyiganateet: amu angen komyee, ale ma ung'ootiin ng'aleechu eng' ineendet, agot agenge; amu mayaak ng'olyoondoniito eng' taban.
Laitoryat Agripa, tos iyani inyee maotik? Angen ale iyani.”
Ak ki leenji Agripa Paulo, Ka neegit igaigaa eng' ng'aleek che ng'ering' aek Kristyanindet.

Kole Paulo, “Achame ko uu nooto eng' Kamuktaindet, ale ngo eng' che ng'ering' anan eng' che chaang', ma inyee kityo, ago tugul ak icheek che kasa rani, ale kotebi ko uu anee, ago ama eng' ratuutichu.”
Kong'eet anyun laitoryat, ak pounindet ak Bernike, kobooto icheek che ki mi tugul:
ak kingo kagoba, kong'alaaljigei icheegei, kole, “Ma yai chiichi kiy ne nyoljin meet anan ratisyosyek.”
Koleenji anyun `Agripa Pesto, “Kota kityaachi chiichi, nda ki ma riirchi Caesarea.”
Ak kingo kagetil ng'aleek keele kebun moinget keebe Italy, ki kigoochi Julio chemogetap kiplugotinik pogol, ne po lugeetap Augusto, Paulo ak kimonjororinik alak.
Kelaany anyun meeliit ne po Adramutio, ne kimachei kwo komoswek alak che mi ngeguutap Asia, keebe ak Aristarko Makedonianindet ne po Thessalonike.
Ak eng' peetuut ne po aeng' keit Sidon: ak ki riiree `Julio Paulo, ak kochamji kwo ole mi choronokyik si konyoor toreteet.
Ak ki kibun moinget eng' olooto ak ki kiteektaegei Cyprus, amu ki kirindaech usoonet.
Ak ye kiga kebun moinget kelande eng' nyanjet ne po Cilicia ak Pamphylia, keit Myra, nganaseet ne po Lycia.
Ak ki nyoorchi olooto chemogetap kiplugotinik pogol meeliit ne po Alexandria, ne wendi Italy; kondeech meeliit anyun.
Ak ye kiga keebe mutyo eng' meeliit eng' peetuusyek che chaang', agoi keit Cnido eng' pichiindo, koraanyech usoonet, keebe keteektaegei Krete, ne itoorchingei Salmone.
Ki kibun ngeguut eng' pichiindo agoi keit komosta age ne kiguure Luukwek che Myach; ole neegitee nganaseetap Lasea.
Ak kingo kagosiirto peetuusyek che chaang', ak kobichiit pandap nyanjet, amu kiga kosiirto peetuusyegap Karugutetapkei, koteechi Paulo icheek,
koleenji, “Murenju, kaageer ale miitei ng'oiyondit ak luseet eng' paniito po nyanjet, ma ne po meeliit kityo ak tuguuk che mi oriit, ago ne po saboonwekyok ak icheek.”
Ago ki kas chemogetap kiplugotinik pogol ng'aleegap pounindet ak chiitap ko po meeliit, kosiir ng'aleek che kamwaei Paulo.

Ak amu ki ma ko luuita ne yamei ketebee eng' peetuusyegap kaitityet, komwa che chaang' kole, myee kota kinaakte eng' olito, tamangap keit Phoenisia, si ketebee olooto eng' peetuusyegap kaitityet; nooto ko ki luuitap Krete, ne kitokyingei murot kaataam kitigin ak murot tai kitigin.
Ak ye kingo us mutyo usoonet ne punu komostap tai, koleen icheek kagonyoor kiit ne kamachei, konem nanget ak kobun tabandap Krete, ye neegit ngeguut.
Ak ne matenit kous kipchurchuryet ne oo, ne kiguure Eurakulo:
ak ye ki ngenam meeliit, ak mata komuuch kootap usoonet, keistochigei, ak koonech.
Ak ki ngerwai keteektaategei emet ne ki ikween peek ne kiguure Kauda, kimuuch eng' pichiindo keganap moinget ne ming'in.
Kingo kagotogosune moingonooto, koboisyee tuguuk che kitorete, koratune moinget oriit; ak kingo iywei icheek kole si ma kiwiirchi Surti, kochoor angook, ak ki oon usoonet koba.
Ak ye kita keboisyei miising' eng' kagiiletapkei, ketabe usoonooto oo, ketau eng' peetuut ne po aeng' kewiirte tuguuk che mi meeliit,
ak eng' peetuutap somok kowiirta icheeget eng' eunekwak tuguuk che kiboisyee eng' meeliit.
Ak ye ki mata koluuchech asiista anan kecheik eng' peetuusyek che chaang', ak kogiichech usoonet ne oo, kogeskei anyun kamang'unet ne ki kileen, tos kisarwech.
Ak ye kiga kotar peetuusyek che chaang' ama amis, kotonon Paulo eng' kwenunnywa, ak kole, “Murenju, kita myee nda ki kogasa, ak kita myee nda ki ma obwa eng' Krete, ak onyooru nyalili ak lusoni.
Amwaiwok nguno ale onyiganitu: amu ma mi chii ne meei eng' okweek, kobatee meeliit.
Amu kotonon malaikaiyatap Kamuktaindet eng' ye neegiteena kemouni, ne aa nenyi, ak ne aoote,
kole, ‘Ameiyweisye, Paulo; kanyool itonon eng' taitap Caesarea: ak keero, kagogoonin Kamuktaindet tugul che obendi tugul eng' moinget.’
Ara anyun, murenju, onyiganitu, amu ayani Kamuktaindet, ale yaaksei ko uu ye kogomwaiwo.
Ago kanyool kewiirchech emet ne ki ikween peek.”
Ago ye kingo it kemoutap taman ak ang'wan, ye kita kowiirchinech usoonet komosi ak komosi eng' nyanjet ne kiguure Adria, ko ki ibwaati piigap moinget olo po kemoi kween koleen kagoriikta emet age.
Ara ki irooch peek kiit ne kikwaise, ak konyoor kakwautik artam; ak kita koba kitigin korooch peek kogeny kioto, konyoor kakwautik sosom.
Ak kingo iywei icheek kole abeere togot kewiirchech pitet ne mi rwandosyek, kounda nangaisyek ang'wan eng' moinget olo po let, kosoom kole nda kaech.
Ak ye kimachei piigap moinget komwaei kobagaakta moinget, ko kagochoorta moinget kwo araraita, koleen si kobwaat piik kole wiirtoi icheek nangaisyek eng' olo po moinget tai,
koleenji Paulo chemogetap kiplugotinik pogol ak kiplugotinik, “Ngot koma tebi pichu eng' moinget, ko momuuchi osapche.”
Kotil anyun kiplugotinik rogoosyek che po moinget, ak kobagaakta kobut.
Ak ye kimachei koeech, kogaigai Paulo icheek tugul koamis, koleenjin, Rani ko peetuutap taman ak ang'wan ogeni ak kota orugutige, ak tomo oam kiy.
Nooto anyun asoomok ale oamisye: amu niito sabeeng'wong'; amu ma petei sumeiyot agot agenge eng' metitap chii age tugul eng' okweek.
Ak ye kingo kagomwa ko uu nooto, ak konam magatyat, kogoochi Kamuktaindet kongoi eng' taitap tugul: ak kiton, ak kotoi koamis.
Konyiganitu anyun icheek tugul, ak koamis.
Ak acheek tugul ko ki piik pogol aeng' ak tamanwogik tisap ak lo eng' meeliit.
Ak kingo kagobiyong'so, kowiirchi araraita nganuuk si kowisisiit meeliit.
Ak kingo kagoeech, koma konai emonooto: ki keer luuita age ne tinyei ng'aniek, ne ki ibwaati kole, ngo mugak kokweri meeliit kwo olooto.

Kotyach anyun nangaisyek, ak kobagaakta eng' araraita, ak kotyach rogoosyek che ki kirate pagoinik che kindochine moinget; ak ye kingo kagonamji parak angeet ne mi oliin po tai kotokyi usoonet, koba ngeguut.

Ago kingo it ye tuiyechin nyanjosyek aeng'u, kochunda icheek meeliit koryep ng'aniek; ak kinamak moinget ole po tai kot koma kotwau, ago ki toi moinget kong'asur eng' ole po let eng' kimnateetap mildaetapkei ne po peek.
Ak ng'olyoot ne ki tinyei kiplugotinik ko kobar kimonjororinik, kole si ma pir peek alage eng' icheek, kochililyo.
Ago amu kimachei chemogetap kiplugotinik pogol kosar Paulo, koeete icheek si ma yai kiit ne kamachei; ak kong'at icheek che ki imuuchi kobirot peek kole, kowiirchigei nyanjet, si kosip koit ngeguut:
ak ki pun alage pagoinik, kobun alage tuguuk alak che po meeliit. Kolong'ji anyun tugul emet kochamegei.
Ak ye kingo kagesapche, kenai anyun keele ki kiguure emonooto ki ikween peek Melita.
Ak kiyaiywech ne myee miising' piigap emonooto: amu ki ilaal maat, ak kotaachech acheek tugul, amu ki mi ropta ak kaitityet.
Ago ye kingo kagoyum Paulo ratuutyet ne po kweenik, ak konde ma, komong' anyun ereneet amu maat, ak kotaachigei eunnyi.
Ak kingo keer piigap emonooto ereneet kosonginini eng' euut, koleenjigei, “Rumin chiichi iman, agot nga kagosargei eng' nyanjet, koma chamjin ineendet Imanda kosap.”
Ago kilelekta tyonyooto kwo ma, ama am kiy Paulo.
Ago kileen icheek abeere tos ibwo, anan kobut ak kome sainooto: ak ye kiga koogenis keny, ama kogeer kiy ne ya konyonji ineendet, kowal kabwaatutikwak ak komwa kole ineendet ko kamuktain.
Ki mi anyun eng' ole neegitee yooto, korotinwegap chiito ne oo ne po emonooto ki ikween peek, ne ki kiguure Publio; ne kitaachech eng' chamyet, ak koyaech keegu toekyik eng' peetuusyek somok.
Ak ki myani kwandap Publio koamei eseet ak myandap moet ne pendi korotiik: ak ki wo Paulo kootap chiichooto, ak kosa, ak kogonoor eunekyik ineendet ak kosoop.
Ak kingo kagoyaak niito kobwa ak icheek che ki myandos eng' kakwembeiyondonooto, ak ki kisoop:
ak kigonyitech eng' teegisto ne oo; ak ye ki ngebe eng' moinget, kondewech moinget tuguuk che tee che ki kimakyinige.
Ak kingo pata arawek somogu ketau panda eng' meeliit ne po Alexandria, ne kiga tebee kakwembeiyondonooto eng' peetuusyegap kaitityet, ne kaboorunennyi ko ki Saramek che Muren.
Ak ki ngeit Syriakus, ketebee yooto peetuusyek somok.
Ak keng'eetye eng' olooto keebe keyiemategei, kot keit Reghio: ak kingo pata peetuut agenge kous usoonetap murot tai, ak eng' peetuut ne po aeng' keit Puteoli:
ole ki kinyoorchi tupchosyek, ak ki igaigaech ketebi ak icheeget peetuusyek tisap: keit anyun Rome.
Ak kingo kas tupchosyek agobo acheek eng' olooto, kobwa kotorookwech kot koit Siireet ne po Apio ak Kooriik Somok che po Toek. Kingo keer Paulo icheek, komwachi Kamuktaindet kongoi ak konyiganit.
Ak ki ngeit Rome, kechamji Paulo kotebi ineegei kobooto asigarindet ne kiriibei ineendet.

Ak kingo kagosiirto peetuusyek somogu koguur piik che eecheen che po Yahudik kotuiyo: ak kingo kagoyumgei, koleenji icheek, Che kitupche, agot ngo ma yai anee kiy ne ya eng' piik, anan eng' pitonwegap kwanisyekyok, ko ki kindea eunegap Romanik eng' Jerusalem, ko aa kimonjororyo:
ak kimachei kotyacha icheek, ko kagogin ng'aleekyuk, amu ki ma komi kiy eng' anee ne nyoljin meet.
Ago ye kingo kirinda Yahudik ng'olyoondonooto, ageer ale kanyool ariirchi Caesarea; ma keele ki atinye kiy ne ang'andoe pororyennyu.
Amu niito anyun kasoomok obwa kegeerge ak keng'alaal tugul: amu aa rataat eng' sirimi agobo kamang'unetap Israel.
Ak ki leenji ineendet, Tomo kenyooru paronok che punu Judea agobo inyee, anan konyo oli age eng' tupchosyek ak koboorwech anan komwa kiy ne ya agobo inyee.
Ago kimache kegasenen kiy ne ibwaati: amu ki konaak eng' acheek keele kimwaoti ne ya agobo pitoniito eng' komosta age tugul.

Ak ye kingo kagochop peetuut, kobwonji ineendet che chaang' eng' koot ne ki menyei; ak ki iborsechi komyee, kobaoryani agobo laitornatetap Kamuktaindet, ak kogiiljingei koneeti icheek agobo Jeso eng' ng'atuutyet ne po Musa ak eng' maotik, kobooch karon agoi koimen.
Ak ki iyan alak tuguuk che ki kimwaei, koma iyan alak.
Ak ye ki mata kogasyin icheegei, koba, ko kagomwa Paulo ng'olyoot agenge, kole, “Ki mwachi komyee Kabuuset ne Tiliil kwanisyekwok eng' maotyot Isaiah, kole,
‘Ui ye mi pichu ak imwa ile, Eng' kaseet ogase, ago moguitosi agot kitigin; ak eng' keeret ogeere, ago mobestosi agot kitigin.

Amu kwolilenotin mugulelwegap pichu, ak ma kastoi komyee iitiikwak, ak kiger icheeget konyekwak; si ma keer eng' konyekwak, anan kogas eng' iitiikwak, anan koguiyo eng' mugulelwekwak, si koweek kogeny, ak asoop icheek.’
Ingonaak anyun eng' okweek, ole, kiyookyin yetunoni po Kamuktaindet pororyosyek; kasei ak icheek.”
Ak ye kingo kagomwa ng'aleechu, koba Yahudik, koteebategei icheegei miising'.
Ak ki meny eng' kenyiisyek aeng' koonnyi ne ki alei meng'et, ak kitaach tugul che ki pwonjin ineendet,
koamdoi agobo laitornatetap Kamuktaindet, ak koneeti tuguuk agobo Kiptaiyat Jeso Kristo eng' nyiganateet tugul, ama etee chii.
Paulo, otwogindetap Jeso Kristo, ne ki kiguur koek kayooktoindet, ne ki kitabaanji logoiywek che myach che po Kamuktaindet,
che kisip koaror eng' maotikyik eng' siruutik che tiliileen,
logoiywek che myach agobo Weeriinnyi, ne ki kisich eng' kesweegap Daudi eng' poorto,
ne ki kimwaita keele Weeriitap Kamuktaindet eng' kimnateet, ko uu Kabuuset ne po tiliilindo, eng' ng'eetyeetap che ki pek; Jeso Kristo Kiptaiyandennyo,
ki kitaach eng' ineendet myeeindo ak kayooktoet, agoi kasetap iit ne po kayaneet eng' pororyosyek tugul amu kainennyi:
ki kiguurok ak okweek eng' icheeget obunji Jeso Kristo:
eng' okweek tugul che omite Rome, chamanigap Kamuktaindet, che ki kiguur koek che tiliileen: Ingotep kobootok myeeindo ak kaalyeet ne punu Kamuktaindet Kwandanyo ak Kiptaiyat Jeso Kristo.
Ne po tai, amwachini Kamuktaindet nenyu kongoi eng' Jeso Kristo agobo okweek tugul, amu kimwaitoi kayaneng'wong' eng' ng'wony komugul.
Amu Kamuktaindet paoryandennyu, ne aoote eng' saboondanyu eng' logoiywek che myach che po Weeriinnyi, ale masise amwa agobo okweek kotugul eng' saautikyuk,
asoome ale, tamangap kobiitwa poroindo nguno ko neegit, Anyoonjok eng' mageetap Kamuktaindet.
Amu atinye emosto ageerok, si agoonok konunet age ne po saboon, si kobiit kigimitok;
nooto ko si kobiit kigaigaige anee ak okweek eng' kwenung'wong', chii tugul eng' kayaneet ne po age, neng'wong' ak nenyu.

Ak ma mache oegu che mongen, che kitupche, ale, ki amach konyil che chaang' Anyoonjok (ak kigeraanya agoi kora), si kobiit anyoor logoek alak agot eng' okweek, agot ko uu eng' Pororyosyechuun alak ak icheek.
Aa ne kiyaachei eng' Yunanik ak che ma Yunanik, eng' che utaatiin ak che perber.
Nooto anyun, ko uu ye amuuchi, ko aa choboot aamwok logoiywek che myach ak okweek che omite Rome.
Ma lilanjini anyun logoiywek che myach; amu niito ko kimnateetap Kamuktaindet ne koonu yetunet eng' age tugul ne iyani; eng' Yahudyot korook ak eng' Yunanindet agine.
King'aanyei eng' niito imandap Kamuktaindet kobun kayaneet agoi kayaneet; ko uu ye siraat kole, “Ineendet ne po imanda ko sabei eng' kayaneet.”
Ki keng'aany nereegegap Kamuktaindet kobun kipsengwet agobo pistoet tugul ak yaityet tugul ne po piik, che kirindoi imanit eng' yaityet;
amu tuguugap Kamuktaindet che naotin ko taagunotiin eng' icheek; ki kong'aang'ji Kamuktaindet icheek.

Amu ki keerei komyee tuguukyik che ma taagu kobooch yaetap ng'wony che naoksei eng' tuguuk che yaotin, agot kimnateennyi ne po koigeny ak ineendet iman ko Kamuktaindet; si ma ek icheek che tinyei lotania; Kiguitos ak kotaagu komyee kimnateet ne po koigeny ak piteetap Kamuktaindet che nga ma taagu kobooch yaetap ng'wony, kiguitos ak kotaagu eng' tuguuk che ki yai Ineendet; si ma ek icheek che tinyei lotania;
amu kingo kagonai Kamuktaindet, koma kolas ko uu Kamuktaindet, anan koweekyi kongoi; ago ki perberitu eng' kabwaatutikwak, ak ki imenitu mugulelwekwak che ma tinyei naet.
Kingo leen kondegei kole utaatiin, koberberitu,
ak kowal toroornatetap Kamuktaindet ne ma ng'emaksei kogergeit ak itoondap chiito ne ng'emaksei, ak ne po toriitik, ak tyong'ik che po keelyek ang'wan, ak tuguuk che ichuutegei.
