Nooto anyun ki pagaakyi Kamuktaindet icheek magutigap mugulelwekwak koosup murwoonindo, si koteweer poorwekwak icheegei eng' icheegei:
amu ki wal imanitap Kamuktaindet kowale lembeita, ak kolas ak koot kiit ne ki kiyai kosiir Yaindet, ne iberuurot koigeny. Amen.
Amu niito ki pagaakyi Kamuktaindet icheek maguutik che po teweernateet. Ki wal kobogorisyekwak piteet ne nyolu koek ne ma nyolu.

Ak ko uu nooto ak icheek murenik, ki pagaakta piteet ne nyolu ne po kobogorisyek, ak kogasegei icheegei mageet ne lalei, koyachingei murenik eng' murenik nooto ne ma nyolu, ak taachei icheegei melekto ne yamegei ak yaityennywa.
Ak ko uu ye ki eesyo kotebee Kamuktaindet naennywa, kobagakyi Kamuktaindet icheek kabwaatutik che ki kong'emogis, si koyai tuguuchooto che ma nyolu;
ko nyiitaat tuguuk tugul che ma po iman, sogornateet, kasetap myat, yaityet; nyiitaat ng'etkonda, rumisyet, pooryeet, keniisyet, suryet; chaamik,
che po chemererosyek, che wechei Kamuktaindet, che kolgoleen, che menotik, che ichougei, taunigap tuguuk che yaacheen, che ma kase iit sigiik,
che ma tinyei kaguiyet, putigap kayomisutik, che ma tinyei chamyet, che ma tinyei rireenetapkei:
che nganda ingen ng'atuutyetap Kamuktaindet ne leen, nyoljin meet icheeget che yaei tuguuk che uu chuuto, koma yaei kityo che uu chuuto, ago chamyechin kobooto icheeget che yaei tuguuchuuto.
Nooto anyun, metinye lotania, ee, inyee chii age tugul ne irwoochi: amu nooto irwookyine age, irwookyinegei inyeendet; amu inyee ne irwoochi, iyae aginye tuguuchooto.
Ak kingen keele namegei kirwoogetap Kamuktaindet ak imanit agobo icheek che yaei tuguuk che uu chooto.
Ee, inyee chii, tos iiti inyee, ile ichilile kirwoogetap Kamuktaindet, inyee ne irwookyini icheek che yaei tuguuk che uu chooto, ak iyae aginye chooto?
Anan isase mogornatosyek che po myeeindonyi ak muitaennyi ak talasyennyi ama inai ile imutyinin siguunet myeeindap Kamuktaindet?
Ago eng' uindang'ung' ak muguleldang'ung' ne ma tinyei siguunet, igonorchinigei nereeknateet kobunji peetuutap nereeknateet ak ng'ang'utyetap kirwooget ne po imanda ne po Kamuktaindet;
ne tuun igoochin chii tugul ko uu poisyonikyik:
igoochin saboondap koigeny icheek che cheeng'ei eng' muitaet ak eng' poisyonik che myach, toroornatet ak teegisto ak che ma ng'emaksei;
ago eng' icheek che ngelelik, ama kase iit imanit, ago che kase iit ne ma po imanda, koegu nyitatet ak nereeknateet,
nyalilda ak pichiindo, eng' saboondap chii age tugul ne yaei yaityo, ne po Yahudyot korook, ak ne po Yunanindet agine;
ago toroornatet ak teegisto ak kaalyeet eng' chii age tugul ne yaei ne myee, po Yahudyot korook ak Yunanindet agine:
amu ma tiytiy `Kamuktaindet piik.
Amu tugul che ki yai tengek koma mi Ng'atuutyet, ko tuun lustos ama eng' Ng'atuutyet: ak tugul che ki yai tengek komi eng' Ng'atuutyet, ko tuun kirwookyin eng' Ng'atuutyet;
amu ma icheek che kasei Ng'atuutyet ko che po imanda eng' taitap Kamuktaindet, ago icheek che yaei Ng'atuutyet, kiityin imanda.
Amu ye yaei Pororyosyek, che ma tinyei Ng'atuutyet, eng' piteennywa, tuguuk che po Ng'atuutyet, chuuto, pichooto ma tinyei Ng'atuutyet, kobougei icheegei;
iboortoi eng' nooto poisyetap Ng'atuutyet ne siraat eng' mugulelwekwak, kobaoryanjin ak icheek nautikwak, ak komwaitogei icheegei eng' icheegei eng' kabwaatutikwak, anan kosarugei;
eng' peetuut ne tuun irwookyin Kamuktaindet ung'ootigap piik, ko uu logoiywekyuk che myach, eng' Jeso Kristo.
Ago ngeguurenen Yahudyot, ak itiegei Ng'atuutyet, ak ichouge eng' Kamuktaindet,
ak ingen magennyi, ak ichame komyee tuguuk che korooron kosiir, amu ki kineetin Ng'atuutyet,
ak iiti ile ii kandoindet ne po che koryotiin, lapkeiyetap icheeget che mi mesundeito,
kotigonindet ne po che perber, kaneetindet ne po manyurunik, ne itinye eng' Ng'atuutyet kergeindap naet ak imanit;
inyeendet anyun ne ineeti age, ko meneetige? Inyee ne iamdoi ile amat kochoorse chii, ko tos ichoorsei inyee?
Inyee ne imwae ile amat oipkei, ko tos iyae inyee? Inyee ne iweche kanamonik, ko tos irebe che mi kooriigap kanamonik?
Inyee ne ichouge eng' Ng'atuutyet, ko tos iteweeri Kamuktaindet eng' pistoeng'ung' ne ibistoe Ng'atuutyet?
Amu kichubei kainetap Kamuktaindet eng' kwenutap Pororyosyek, amu okweek, ko uu ye ki kisir.
Amu toreti iman kamuratanet, ngo ii yaindetap Ng'atuutyet: ago ngot ko ii putindetap Ng'atuutyet, ko kagoek kamurataneng'ung' ne ma kamuratano.
Ngot koriibei anyun tetuutigap Ng'atuutik ineendet ne ma kimuratan, ko tos ma kiiti ne ma kimuratan keele imuratanat?
Ak tos ma tuun irwogun ineendet ne ma kimuratan eng' atebeennyi, ngot koyai Ng'atuutyet kosulda, inyeendet ne ii putindetap Ng'atuutyet ak itinye ng'atuutik che siraatiin ak kamuratanet?
Amu ma Yahudyot ineendet ne Yahudyot eng' poorto parak, ama kamuratanet nooto po poorto parak;
ago Yahudyot ineendet ne Yahudyot eng' oriit; ak kamuratanet ko nooto po muguleldo, eng' saboondo, ma eng' sireet; ne kalasunennyi koma po piik, ago po Kamuktaindet.
Tinyei porot nee anyun Yahudyot? Anan nee toreteet ne po kamuratanet?
Oo eng' ooreet age tugul: ne po tai, ko amu ki kigoochi Yahudik kotononji ng'aleegap Kamuktaindet.
Amu egu nee ngot koma tinyei alage kayaneet? Kayanennywa ne ma mi, ko tos walei imandap Kamuktaindet koek puch?
Achicha: ma uu nooto: ingoek ne po iman Kamuktaindet, ago kiplembechwa chii age tugul; ko uu ye siraat kole, Si kobiit kindein imanda eng' ng'aleeguk, Ak imuuch ibelisye ye kirwoogun.
Ago ngot kogonyiti atebeennyo ne ma po imanda, imandap Kamuktaindet, kota kemwae nee anyun? Tos ma po imanda Kamuktaindet ne nyoonei eng' nereegek? (Ang'alaali ko uu piik.)
Achicha! Ma uu nooto; amu nda uu nooto korwookyindoi ano `Kamuktaindet ng'wony?
Ago ngo tesak imanitap Kamuktaindet eng' lembeitanyu agoi toroornatennyi, ko amu nee si kota kirwookwo ko uu kiptengekyo?
Ak amu nee si ma ki mwa (ko uu ye kimwaitaenech ne ya, ak ko uu ye iyani alage kole kimwae acheek) keele, Ongeyai che yaach si kobiit kobwa che myach? Po iman kirwoogennywa.
Nee anyun? Tos ki myachen kesiir icheek? Achicha, agot kitigin: amu kiga kisip kiityi Yahudik ak Yunanik keele mi icheek tugul eng' pounatetap tengekto;
ko uu ye siraat kole, Ma mi ne po imanda, achicha, ma mi agot agenge:
Ma mi ne iguitos, Ma mi ne cheeng'ei Kamuktaindet;
Ki komasta tugul, ki koek tugul che ma tilei kiy; Ma mi ne yaei ne myee, achicha, ma mi agot agenge:
Mookwekwak ko kererit ne yaataat; Kiboisyee keniisyet eng' ng'elyebwekwak: Mi ng'wonetap erenook kutusweekwak oriit:
Che nyiitaat kutusweekwak chubisyet ak ng'wanindo:
Chepchep keelyekwak kotumda korotiik;
Mi ortinwekwak ng'emisyet ak nyalilda;
Ama nai ooreetap kaalyeet:
Ma mi kaiyweisyet ne iywei Kamuktaindet taitap konyekwak.

Ak kingen keele tuguuk alak tugul che mwaei Ng'atuutyet, komwachin icheek che miitei eng' pounatetap Ng'atuutyet; si kobiit keger kutit age tugul, ak si ki mutyi ng'wony komugul kirwoogetap Kamuktaindet:
amu ma mi chii ne kiityin imanda eng' tainnyi eng' poisyonigap Ng'atuutyet: amu punu naetap tengekto Ng'atuutyet.
Ago nguno ko kagong'ang'ak imandap Kamuktaindet ama eng' ng'atuutik, ne paoryani Ng'atuutyet ak maotik;
agot imandap Kamuktaindet ne mi eng' kayaneet eng' Jeso Kristo eng' icheeget tugul che iyani; amu ma mi kabesyet;
amu ki koyai tugul tengek, ama ityin toroornatetap Kamuktaindet;
che kiityin imanda puch eng' myeeindonyi eng' katyaget ne mi eng' Kristo Jeso:
ne ki inde Kamuktaindet koek kaptisiisyo eng' kayaneet, eng' korotiikyik, si kobarta imandanyi, amu kachundaetap tengekwogik che ki kisip keyai, eng' muitaetap Kamuktaindet;
amu kabartaetap imandanyi eng' peetuusyechuuto, si kobiit koek ineendet ne po imanda, ak koek ne iityin imanda ineendet ne tinyei kayaneet eng' Jeso.
Mi ano anyun kachaunetapkei? Kigegerchi saang'. Eng' ng'atuutyet ne uu nee? Ne po poisyonik? Achicha: ago eng' ng'atuutyetap kayaneet.
Ki iti anyun keele kiityin chii imanda eng' kayaneet ama poisyonigap ng'atuutik.
Anan Kamuktaindet ko Kamuktaindet ne po Yahudik kityo? Ama Kamuktaindet ne po Pororyosyek ak icheek? Ee, po Pororyosyek ak icheek:
ko uu ye agenge Kamuktaindet, ak koiityin imanda eng' kayaneet che ki kimuratan, ak koiityin imanda eng' kayaneet che ma kimuratan.
Tos ki yai anyun Ng'atuutyet koek ne ma tilei kiy amu kayaneet? Achicha, ma uu nooto: ki kimiti Ng'atuutyet.
Kimwae nee anyun agobo Abraham, kwandanyo, kinyoor nee eng' atebeetap poorto?
Amu nda kiga kiityi Abraham imanda eng' poisyonik, kotinyei ineendet ne ilasunegei; ago ma eng' taitap Kamuktaindet.
Mwaei nee anyun siruutik? Ki iyan `Abraham Kamuktaindet, ak ki kiityi ineendet imanda.
Ago ineendet ne poisyei, koma kiityin melekto keele po myeeindo, ago po pesendo.
Ago eng' ineendet ne ma poisyei, ago iyani ineendet ne iityin imanda chii ne ya, kiiti kayanennyi keele po imanda.
Agot ko uu ye ki mwa Daudi agine agobo kaberuretap chiito ne iityin Kamuktaindet imanda ama eng' poisyonik,
kole, Poiboen icheek che kigenyochi kaat tengekwogikwak, Ak che kigetuch tengekwogikwak.
Paibai chiito ne ma tuun iityin kiptaiyat tengekto.
Tos kimwae kaberuroni agobo che ki kimuratan, anan che ma kimuratan ak icheek? Amu kimwae keele, Ki kiityi Abraham kayanennyi kobunji imanda.
Ki kiityindo ano anyun? Ye kiga kimuratan anan ye kitom kimuratan? Ma eng' kamuratanet, ago ye kitom kimuratan:

kitaach kaboorunetap kamuratanet, ng'ookset ne po imandap kayaneet ne ki tinyei ye kitom kimuratan: si kobiit koek kwandap icheek tugul che kiyani, agot ye kitom kimuratan, si kobiit kiityi icheek imanda;
ak koek kwandap che imuratanotiin eng' icheek che ma po kamuratanet kityo, ago che pendi ak icheek eng' tyegutigap kayanonooto po kwandanyo Abraham ne ki tinyei ye kitom kimuratan.
Amu ki ma kigoochi Abraham ak kesweekyik arorutyet eng' ooreet ne po Ng'atuutyet keele kobunji ng'wony, ago eng' imanda ne po kayaneet.
Amu ngot koek che namei tuguuk, icheek che po Ng'atuutyet, ko kagoek puch kayaneet, ak kageyai arorutyet koek ne ma tilei kiy:
amu ibu Ng'atuutyet nereegek; ago ole ma mi ng'atuutyet, koma mi pistoet.

Punu kayaneet amu niito, si kobiit koek ne po myeeindo; si ma walak arorutyet eng' iyoteet tugul; ma chooto po Ng'atuutyet kityo, ago chooto ak icheek che po kayaneetap Abraham, ne kwandanyo acheek tugul
(ko uu ye siraat kole, “Kaayain iegu kwandap pororyosyek che chaang' ”) eng' taitap ne ki koyan ineendet, nooto ko Kamuktaindet, ne isoobi che ki kobek, ak koguurei tuguuk che ma mi, ko uu che mi.
Ki iyan eng' kamang'unet ye ki ma komi kiy ne kimang'u, si kobiit koek kwandap pororyosyek che chaang', kiga kemwa ko uu nooto keele, “Tenitu chooto iyoteng'ung'.”
Ak ki ma nyalul eng' kayaneet ye ki ibwaati poortanyi ne uu ne ki kome, (ye kiga kotar olo po kenyiisyek pogol) ak Sara ne kiga kosiirto peetuusyegap iyoteet:
ee, ki ma sage kobistoe ye ki ibwaati arorutyetap Kamuktaindet, ago kitesak kogimit eng' kayaneet, kotoroori Kamuktaindet,
ak ki ingen komyee kole kiit ne kiga koaror ineendet, komuuchi koyai kosulda.
Eng' nooto anyun, ko ki kiityi ineendet imanda.
Ago ki ma kisir agobo ineendet ineegei, keele ki kiityi ineendet;
ago amu acheek agacheek, che tuun kiityin, che iyani ineendet ne ki ing'eet Jeso Kiptaiyandennyo komong' eng' che ki pek,
ne ki kigoito amu pistautikyok, ak ki king'eet si kobiit kiityech imanda.
Ki tinyei kaalyeet ak Kamuktaindet eng' Kiptaiyandennyo Jeso Kristo amu ki kiityech imanda eng' kayaneet;
ak ki kenyooru eng' ineendet agine kemong'ji eng' kayaneet myeinooto kitonone; ak ongeboiboitu eng' kamang'unetap toroornatetap Kamuktaindet.
Ak ma uu nooto kityo, ago ongeboiboitu eng' nyalilwogikyok: kingen keele ibu nyalilda muitaet;
ak ibu muitaet tyemisyet; ak ibu tyemisyet kamang'unet:
ma koonu kamang'unet kililan; amu kigerong'ji chamyetap Kamuktaindet mugulelwekyok eng' Kabuuset ne Tiliil ne kigegoonech.
Amu ye kita ko kinyalulyotin, kome Kristo agobo che yaacheen eng' peetuut ne kiga kelewen.
Amu pichiy kome chii agobo chii ne po imanda: ago abeere kanyei chiito age kome agobo chii ne myee.
Ago iboorwech acheek Kamuktaindet chamyennyi, amu ye kita ko ki kiptengeginik, kome Kristo agobo acheek.
Ak ne siirei miising' anyun, ko kagiityech imanda eng' korotiikyik, kesarwech eng' nereegegap Kamuktaindet eng' ineendet.
Amu ye kita ko ki puunik, ko ki kituiyech ak Kamuktaindet eng' meetap Weeriinnyi, ne siirei miising' anyun, koga kituiyech, kesarwech eng' saboondanyi.
Ak ma uu nooto kityo, ago kiboiboi agacheek eng' Kamuktaindet eng' Kiptaiyandennyo Jeso Kristo, amu ki kenyooru eng' ineendet katuiyet.
Nooto anyun, ko uu ye ki mong'ji ng'wony tengek eng' chiito agenge, ak meet amu tengek; koityi anyun meet piik tugul, amu ki yai tugul tengek
amu ki mi ng'wony tengek agoi koit Ng'atuutik, ago ma kiiti tengek ye ma mi ng'atuutik.
Ago kiboi meet kobooch Adam agoi Musa, agot eng' icheek che ki ma yai tengekto ne kergei ak pistoetap Adam, ne ki itoondap ineendet ne kitun konyo.

Ago ma uu pistoet, konunetap chamyet. Amu ngo ki pek che chaang' eng' pistoetap agenge, ko kitesak miising' kosiir eng' che chaang', myeeindap Kamuktaindet, ak konunet eng' myeeindap chiito agenge, Jeso Kristo.

Ak ma kergei kiit ne pitunee konunet ak kiit ne pitunee tengektap chiito agenge: amu ki nyo kirwooget eng' agenge agoi kagikyinet, ago ki nyo konunetap chamyet eng' pistautik che chaang' agoi kaiityinetap imanda.
Amu ngo kiboi meet eng' pistoetap agenge; ne siirei miising' anyun, kobou eng' saboondo icheek che taachei chaang'indap myeeindo ak konunet ne po imanda eng' agenge, nooto Jeso Kristo.

Nooto anyun, ko uu ye ki nyoonji piik tugul kirwooget agoi kagikyinet eng' pistoetap agenge; ko uu nooto ki nyoonji piik tugul konunet ne kigoitoi puch, agoi kaiityinetap imanda ne po saboondo eng' pistoet agenge ne po imanda.
Amu ko uu ye ki ek che chaang' kiptengeginik eng' pistoetap chiito agenge, ko uu nooto kiyaei che chaang' kobunji imanda eng' kasetap iit ne po agenge.
Ak ki nyo Ng'atuutyet, si kobiit kotesak pistoet; ago ye kitesak tengekto, ko kitesak myeeindo miising' kosiir:
si, ko uu ye kiboi tengekto eng' meet, ko uu nooto pou myeeindo eng' imanda agoi saboondap koigeny eng' Jeso Kristo Kiptaiyandennyo.
Kimwae nee anyun? Ki testai ketebi eng' tengek, si kobiit kotesak myeeindo?
Achicha, ma uu nooto. Acheek che kigebekyi tengek, kota kesoptoi ano eng' tengek?
Anan ma onai ole acheek tugul che ki kibatisanjech Jeso Kristo ko ki kibatisanjech meennyi?
Nooto anyun kigetubech kobooto ineendet eng' kabatisanet agoi meet: si ko uu ye ki king'eet Kristo eng' che ki pek eng' toroornatetap Kwanda, ko uu nooto, kibendoti agacheek eng' saboondo ne leel.
Amu ngo ki kituiyech ak ineendet eng' kergeindap meennyi, ke uu nooto agacheek eng' kergeindap ng'eetyeennyi;
kingen ni, keele ki kigartaat chiinyo ne po keny kobooto ineendet, si kong'emak poortap tengek, si mata koratech tengekto kogeny.
Amu ineendet ne ki kome kotyagat eng' tengek.
Ago ngo kigebegu kobooto Kristo, kiyani kora keele kisoptosi kobooto ineendet;
kingen keele ki king'eet Kristo komong' eng' che ki kobek: ma komeei kogeny; ma kotinyei meet pounateet eng' ineendet kogeny.
Amu meet ne kime, kogimechi tengek konyil agenge ak koyam; ago sabeet ne sabei ineendet kosabei eng' Kamuktaindet.
Ko uu nooto oiityige ak okweek ole ki obekyi tengek, ago osaptosi eng' Kamuktaindet eng' Kristo Jeso.
Nooto anyun amochamji tengek koboi poorwekwok che pegu, si ogas iit maguutikwak:

anan ogoochi tengek kebeberwegap poorwekwok koek kariik che ma po iman; ago ogoochigei Kamuktaindet, ko uu che saptos che kamang'une che ki pek, ak ogoochi Kamuktaindet kebeberwegap poorwekwok koek kariigap imanda.
Amu ma tinyei tengek pounateet eng' okweek: amu ma omi eng' Ng'atuutik, ago eng' myeeindo.
Nee anyun, ki yai tengek, amu ma kemi eng' Ng'atuutik, ago eng' myeeindo? Achicha, ma uu nooto.
Mongen ole, ineendet ne ogoochinigei oegu otwogik agoi kasetap iit, ko oo otwogigap ineendet ne ogase iit; ngo po tengekto agoi meet, anan ngo po kasetap iit agoi imanda?
Ago kimwachini Kamuktaindet kongoi, amu, okweek che ki oo otwogigap tengekto, ko ki ogas iit eng' muguleldo kaneetisyet ne uu ne kigegoonok okweek;
ak ye kingi tyachak eng' tengek, oegu otwogigap imanda.

Ang'alaali ko uu piteetap piik amu nyalulet ne po poorwekwok: amu ko uu ye ki ogoite kebeberwegap poorwekwok koek otwogigap murwoonindo ak tengek agoi tengek, ko uu nooto anyun ogoite kebeberwegap poorwekwok koek otwogigap imanda agoi tiliilindo.
Amu ye kita ko oo otwogigap tengekto, ko ki otyagotin eng' imanda.
Ki otinye logoek nee eng' peetuusyechooto eng' tuguuk che olilane nguno? Amu kagesunetap tuguuchooto ko meet.
Ago nguno ko kagityaachak eng' tengekto, ak kaoegu otwogigap Kamuktaindet, otinye logoekwok agoi tiliilindo, ak kagesunet ko saboondap koigeny.
Amu melektap tengek ko meet; ago konunetap chamyet ne po Kamuktaindet ko saboondap koigeny eng' Kristo Jeso Kiptaiyandennyo.
Anan mongen okweek, che kitupche (amu ang'alaaljini piik che ingen Ng'atuutyet), ole tinyei ng'atuutyet pounateet eng' chiito eng' peetuusyek tugul che po sabeennyi?
Amu kobogoryot ne tinyei manong'otyot koratei ng'atuutik eng' manong'otyot eng' peetuusyek tugul che po sabeennyi; ago ngo me manong'otyot, kotyagak anyun eng' ng'atuutyetap manong'otyot.

Nooto anyun, ye ta kosabei manong'otyot, ak konamgei ak chiito age, keguure ineendet chebaigeiyat: ago ngo kagome manong'otyot, kotyagak eng' ng'atuutyet, eng' nooto anyun, koma keguure chebaigeiyat, agot ngo tuun chiito age ineendet.
Nooto anyun, che kitupche, kigeyaak obegu eng' Ng'atuutyet eng' poortap Kristo; si kobiit obunji chiito age, ineendet ne ki king'eet komang'une che ki pek, si keiichi Kamuktaindet logoek.
Amu ye kingota kemi eng' poorto ko ki poisyei maguutik che po tengek eng' kebeberwegap poorwekyok, che kimi amu Ng'atuutyet, si koiiyo logoek che ityin meet.
Ago nguno, ko ki kityaachech eng' Ng'atuutyet, ko kagebekyi nooto ne kiga ratech; si kobiit keotisye eng' leelindap Kabuuset ne Tiliil, ma eng' osindap ng'atuutik che siraatiin.

Kimwae nee anyun? Tos tengek Ng'atuutyet? Achicha, ma uu nooto. Ago ki ma kota anae tengek nda ki ma ko eng' Ng'atuutyet: amu ki ma kota anai kasetap myat nda ki ma mwa Ng'atuutyet kole, “Amegase myat.”
Ago kinyoor tengek poroindo eng' ng'atuutyet koyai eng' anee kasetap myat age tugul: amu ye ma mi Ng'atuutyet ko meat tengekto.
Ak ki asabe eng' tai ye ki ma komi Ng'atuutyet: ago ye kingo nyo ng'atuutyet, kosap kogeny tengekto, amee anyun;
ak ki ageer ale ki punji meet ng'atuutyet ne ki po saboondo:
amu kinyoor tengek poroindo eng' ng'atuutyet kong'ala, ak kobara eng' nooto.
Nooto anyun tiliil Ng'atuutyet, ak ko tiliil kayomiset, ak ko po imanda, ak ko myee.

Tos ki ek anyun nooto myee meet eng' anee? Achicha, ma uu nooto. Ago si koboorgei tengekto keele tengekto, kogiyai meet eng' anee eng' nooto myee; si kobiit koek `tengekto tengekto inne eng' ng'atuutyet.
Amu kingen keele po Ng'atuutyet saboondo; ago aa chiitap poorto, ne kigealdochi tengek.
Amu mangen ne ayae: amu ma ne amache, ne ayae; ago ne aweche, ko nooto ne ayae.
Ago ngayai nooto ma mache, ayan anyun ale myee Ng'atuutyet.
Nguno anyun koma ko anee ne ayae, ago tengekto ne menya.
Amu angen ale eng' anee, nooto ko eng' poortanyu, koma menyei kiy ne myee: amu mi chameet kobooto, ago ale ayai nooto myee, koma yae.
Amu nooto myee ne kata ayae, koma yae: ago yaityet ne ma mache, ko nooto ne cham ayae.
Ago ngot ayae ne ma mache, koma ko anee ne yaei, ago tengekto ne menya.
Ageere anyun ng'atuutyet, ale, eng' anee, ne kata ayae ne myee, komiitei yaityet kobooto.
Amu abaibai eng' Ng'atuutyetap Kamuktaindet eng' chiito ne po oriit:
ago ageere ng'atuutyet ne teer eng' kebeberwegap poortanyu, kobortos ak ng'atuutyetap ng'omnatennyu, koyaa aek luulenetap ng'atuutyet ne po tengekto ne miitei kebeberwegap poortanyu.
Ee, anee ne nyalili! Ng'oo ne ityaacha eng' poortap meoni?
Amwachini Kamuktaindet kongoi eng' Jeso Kristo Kiptaiyandennyo. Nooto anyun, aoote eng' ng'omnatennyu ng'atuutyetap Kamuktaindet, ago eng' poorto aoote ng'atuutigap tengekto.
Nooto anyun ma komi kirwooget eng' icheek che miitei eng' Kristo Jeso.
Amu kagotyacha ng'atuutyetap Kabuusetap saboon eng' Kristo Jeso amang'une ng'atuutyetap tengek ak meet.
Amu kiit ne ki ma imuuch Ng'atuutyet koyai, amu nyaluletap poorto, koyook Kamuktaindet Weeriinnyi eng' kergeindap poortap tengek si koek kagoochinet ne po tengekto, kogikyi tengekto eng' poorto:
si kobiit kosulda kayomisetap Ng'atuutyet eng' acheek, che ma kisubi poorto, ago Kabuuset ne Tiliil.
Amu icheek che isubi poorto kogereeri met agobo tuguugap poorto; ago icheek che isubi Kabuuset ne Tiliil kogereeri met agobo tuguugap Kabuuset ne Tiliil.
Amu kererwegap met che po poorto ko meet; ago kererwegap met che po Kabuuset ne Tiliil ko saboondo ak kaalyeet:
amu kererwegap met che po poorto ko puunyoondit eng' Kamuktaindet; amu ma kase iit Ng'atuutyetap Kamuktaindet, amaimuuchi:
ak icheeget che mi poorto kotemenee kobaibai Kamuktaindet.
Ago ma omi eng' poorto ago eng' Kabuuset ne Tiliil, ngo menyok Kabuusetap Kamuktaindet. Ago ngo ma tinyei chii Kabuusetap Kristo koma nenyi.
Ak ko ngo mi Kristo eng' okweek, ko nga ki kome poorto amu tengekto; ko sabei saboondo amu imanda.

Ago ngo menyok Kabuusetap ineendet ne ki ing'eet Jeso komang'une che ki pek, kosoobi poorwekwok che pegu ineendet ne ki ing'eet Kristo Jeso komang'une che ki pek, eng' Kabuusennyi ne menyei eng' okweek.
Nooto anyun, che kitupche, ki che kiyaachei, ma eng' poorto, si kisubi poorto:
amu ngo subi poorto, obegu matiny; ago ngo par eng' Kabuuset ne Tiliil poisyonigap poorto, osaptosi.
Amu tugul che indochin Kabuusetap Kamuktaindet, ko weeriigap Kamuktaindet chooto.
Amu ki ma otaach kogeny muguleldap otwoknot ne koonok oiyweisye; ago ki otaach Kabuuset ne Tiliil ne ki kiyaenak oegu lagogap Kamuktaindet. Eng' nooto anyun ye kiriire keele, Abba, Kwanda
ko paoryani Kabuuset ne Tiliil ineendet ak mugulelwekyok kole ki lagogap Kamuktaindet;
ak ngo ki lagok, ko ki che punjinech tuguuk; che punjinech tuguugap Kamuktaindet, ak che punjinech tuguuk kobooto Kristo; ngot kenyalildosi kobooto ineendet, si kitoroorech kobooto ineendet.
Amu aiiti ale nyalilwogik che po peetuusyechu koma nyolu kiroge toroornatet ne tuun king'ang'wech.
Amu igeni miising' ak koganyei yaeet komugul ng'ang'et ne po weeriigap Kamuktaindet.
Amu ki kigoochi yaeet tugul kogas iit kiit ne ma tilei kiy, ma ko uu ye machei, ago amu ineendet ne ki igoochi kogas iit ko uu nooto eng' kamang'unet,
si kobiit kityaach yaeet komugul agine eng' otwoknateetap ng'emisyet agoi katyaget ne po toroornatetap lagogap Kamuktaindet.
Amu kingen keele tigeni ak kogasei ng'wanindo yaeet komugul kobootech agoi nguno.
Ak ma uu nooto kityo, ago agot acheek, che ki tinyei tongoanigap Kabuuset ne Tiliil, ketigendosi agacheek eng' oriit, kigeni keyaech keegu lagok, nooto ko katyagetap poorwekyok.
Amu kigesarwech eng' kamang'unet: ago kamang'unet ne kigeerei koma kamang'unet; amu ng'oo ne imang'u nooto keerei?
Ago ngimang'u nooto ma kigeere, kigeni nooto anyun eng' muitaet.
Ak toreti ko uu nooto agine Kabuuset ne Tiliil nyalulennyo: amu ma kingen kesaa ko ye nyolu; ago saiywech Kabuuset ne Tiliil ineendet eng' tigenoik che ma kimuuchi kemwa;
ak ineendet ne isyachi mugulelwek kongen kiit ne ibwaati Kabuuset ne Tiliil, amu saaei agobo piik che tiliileen ko uu mageetap Kamuktaindet.
Ak kingen keele, eng' icheek che chamei Kamuktaindet, kotuitos tuguuk tugul si kobois koreu che myach eng' icheek che kigeguur ko uu magennyi.
Amu Kamuktaindet ne kisip konai icheek, ko ineendet ne kisip kolewen icheek si kogergeit ak itoondap Weeriinnyi, si koek ne po tai eng' che tupcho che chaang':
ak icheeget che kisip kolewen, koguur chooto; ak chooto che kiguur, ko ki ityi imanda: ak chooto che kiityi imanda, ko ki itoroor.
Kimwae nee anyun eng' tuguuchuuto? Ngo mi Kamuktaindet komostanyo, ko ng'oo ne kirindaech?
Ineendet ne ki ma riiree Weeriinnyi, ago kigon ineendet agobo acheek tugul, tos ma koonech tuguuk tugul eng' aiyebindo kobooto ineendet?
Ng'oo ne itaami che ki lewen Kamuktaindet? Kamuktaindet ne iityin imanda;
ng'oo ineendet ne igikyin? Kristo Jeso ne kime, ee, ineendet ne ki king'eet komang'une che ki pek, ne mi eutap tai ne po Kamuktaindet, ne saiywech agine.
Ibestoseech ng'oo eng' chamyetap Kristo? Nyalilda, anan pichiindo, anan usiisyet anan rubeet anan aach ngor, anan ng'oiyondit, anan rotwetap chok?
Ko uu ye ki kisir, keele, “Kibarech peetuut komugul agobo inyee; ki kiitech ko uu keechiirek che po eng'seet.”
Ago, ki katerterik kot kosiir eng' tuguuchu tugul eng' ineendet ne ki chamech.
Amu angen komyee ale ma imuuchi kobesyech meet, anan saboondo, anan malaikaisyek, anan pounatosyek, anan tuguuk che miitei, anan tuguuk che pwoonei, anan kimnatosyek,
anan toroorindo, anan asurto, anan kiy age tugul ne ki kiyai, eng' chamyetap Kamuktaindet, ne mi eng' Kristo Jeso Kiptaiyandennyo.
Amwae iman eng' Kristo, ma mwaei lembech, paoryani kabwaatutikyuk kobooto eng' Kabuuset ne Tiliil,
ale atinye arageneet ne oo ak ng'wanindo ne ma igeesugei eng' muguleldanyu.
Amu kata amache ale king'wanita aneendet eng' Kristo agobo tupchosyekyuk, che piikyuk eng' poorto;
che Yahudik; che ki kiyai koek lagok, che neny wo toroornatet, ak kayomisutik, ak kagoitoetap Ng'atuutyet, ak otetap Kamuktaindet, ak arorutik;
ne chechwaak kwanisyek, ak nenywa Kristo eng' atebeetap poorto. Iberuurot koigeny Kamuktaindet, ne pou tugul. Amen.
Ago ma keele kogoek puch ng'olyootap Kamuktaindet. Amu ma Yahudik icheek tugul, che po Israel:
ama keele lagok icheek tugul, amu kesweegap Abraham: ago, Kiguurtoe Isak keswondeng'ung'.
Nooto anyun, icheek koma lagogap poorto che lagogap Kamuktaindet; ago lagogap arorutyet che kiiti koek keswoot.
Niito anyun ko ng'olyootap arorutyet, Anyoone tuun kapkora eng' kenyiit ne nyoonei, ak kosich Sara weeriit.
Ak ma uu nooto kityo; ago ye kingo kagomanach Rebeka agine eng' agenge, nooto kwandanyo Isak -
amu ye ki tomo kesich lagok, koyai kiy age tugul ne myee anan ne ya, si kobiit kotonon mageetap Kamuktaindet ko uu lewenet, ama po poisyonik, ago po ineendet ne kuursei,
ki kileenji ineendet, Otei ne oo ne ming'in.
Agot ko uu ye siraat, keele, Ki acham Jakobo, ago ki awech Esau.
Kimwae nee anyun? Mi ne ma po imanda eng' Kamuktaindet? Achicha, ma uu nooto.
Amu mwachin ineendet Musa koleenjin, Ariiree ineendet ne amache ariiree, ak atinye rireenetapkei eng' ineendet ne amache ariireegei.
Nooto anyun ma po ineendet ne machei, anan ineendet ne labati, ago po Kamuktaindet ne tinyei rireenetapkei.
Amu mwachin sireet Pharaoh koleenjin, “Kang'eetin amu ng'olyoondoniito ale, abartaenen kamuktaennyu, si keamdaat kainennyu eng' ng'wony komugul.”
Nooto anyun ineendet ne machei koriiree, koriiregei, ak ne machei kouiit, kouiiti.
Ileenjino anyun, Amu nee si kota kocheeng'ei lelutyet? Amu ng'oo ne kirindoi magennyi?
Chiichi! Ii ng'oo ne tos iwolji Kamuktaindet kiy? Tos mwachin `kiit ne ki kimimii mimiindet koleenjin, “Amu nee si iyaa ko uu ni?”
Anan ma tinyei cheptereniot kimnateet eng' meneet, koyai eng' kebebertap menonooto tereet ne po teegisto, ak age ne ma po teegisto?
Tos nee anyun, ngo machei Kamuktaindet kobarta nereeknatennyi, ak kong'aany kimnateennyi, komuita eng' talasyet ne oo agobo tereenik che po nereegek che nyoljin ng'emisyet:
ak si kobiit kobarta mogornatosyegap toroornatennyi eng' tereenik che po rireenetapkei che kiga sip kochopchi telunateet,
agot acheek che ki kuurech, ma eng' Yahudik kityo, ago eng' Pororyosyek ak icheek?
Ko uu ye mwaei agine eng' Hosea kole, “Aguure icheek piikyuk, che ki ma ko ‘piikyuk’; ak aguure ineendet chamaneet, ne ki ma ko ‘chamaneet.’ ”
“Ak eng' olooto ole ki kimwachine, keleenji, ‘Ma oo piikyuk,’ keguure eng' olooto weeriigap Kamuktaindet ne sabei.”
Ak ki mwa Isaiah eng' kutit ne oo agobo Israel, kole, “Agot ngo koitetap piigap Israel ko tee ng'aniegap nyanjet, kesaru che ki ng'et;
amu yaei Kiptaiyat ng'olyoondennyi eng' ng'wony, kogees ak kotil konwagit.”
Ak, ko uu ye kiga sip komwa Isaiah kole, “Nda ki ma pagaakwech Kiptaiyatap Lugoosyek keswoot, ta kiga kegergeitu ak Sodom, ak ta kiga keyaech keige Gomorah.”
Kimwae nee anyun? Kimwae keele kigonor Pororyosyek imanda che ki ma kosubi imanda, nooto ko imanda ne po kayaneet:
ago Israel, ye kingo sup ng'atuutyetap imanda, koma ityi Ng'atuutyonooto.
Amu nee? Amu ki ma cheeng' eng' kayaneet, ago ko uu eng' poisyonik. Ki riich icheek koita ne riichei piich;
ko uu ye siraat kole, Ogeero, andoi Zion koita ne riichei piich ak rwandet ne inachi piich: Ak ne iyani ineendet koma kigoochin kolilaan.
Che kitupche, mageetap muguleldanyu ak soomennyu eng' Kamuktaindet agobo icheek ko ale kesar icheek.
Amu abaoryani agobo icheek ale tinyei kagiiletapkei agobo Kamuktaindet, ago ma eng' naet.
Amu ye ki ma nai icheek imandap Kamuktaindet, ak ye ki cheeng' kogimit nenywa, koma kogas iit imandap Kamuktaindet.
Amu Kristo kagesunetap Ng'atuutyet agoi imanda eng' age tugul ne iyani.
Amu sirei Musa kole chii ne yaei imanda, ne punu Ng'atuutyet, kosabei eng' nooto.
Ago mwaei imanda nooto po kayaneet ko uu ni, “Amemwa eng' muguleldang'ung' ile, ‘Ng'oo ne togostoi kipsengwet?’ (Nooto ko komut Kristo kochoorgei)
anan, ‘Ng'oo ne wendi kochoortogei kebeberwegap ng'wony che looen?’ ” (Nooto ko komut Kristo kotogos eng' che ki pek.)
Ago mwaei nee? “Neegitenen ng'olyoot, mi kuting'ung' ak mi muguleldang'ung'.” nooto ko ng'olyootap kayaneet, ne ki amdoi;
amu nging'aany eng' kuting'ung' ile Jeso ko Kiptaiyat, ak iyani eng' muguleldang'ung' ile ki ing'eet `Kamuktaindet ineendet komang'une che ki pek, kesaruun.
Amu iyani chii eng' muguleldo agoi imanda; ak ng'aanyei eng' kutit agoi saruunet.
Amu mwaei sireet kole, “Age tugul ne iyani ineendet koma kigoochin kolilaan.”
Amu ma mi kabesyet eng' Yahudyot ak Yunanindet; amu Kiptaiyandanooto ko Kiptaiyatap tugul ak aiyeep eng' icheek tugul che kuurei ineendet.
Amu age tugul ne kuurei kainetap Kiptaiyat, kesaru.
Kuurtoi ano anyun ineendet `icheek che tomo koyan? Ak iyandoi ano ineendet `icheek che tomo kogas agobo ineendet? Ak kastoi ano ama amdoindet?
Ak amdoitoi ano, ngo ma kiyookto? Agot ko uu ye siraat kole, “Korooron ne tya keelyegap icheeget che ibu logoiywek che po poiboiyet, che po tuguuk che myach!”
Ago ki ma kas iit tugul logoiywek che myach. Amu mwaei Isaiah kole, “Kiptaiyat, ki koyan ng'oo ng'aleekyok?”
Nyoonei anyun kayaneet eng' kaseet, ak nyoonei kaseet eng' ng'olyootap Kristo.
Ago ateebee ale, tos ki ma kas? Ee, iman, “Ki wo tweguunennywa koyom emet komugul, ak ki pa ng'aleekwak agoi ole poochin ng'wony.”
Ago amwae ale, tos ki ma nai Israel? Ki sip komwa Musa kole, “Andeok ng'etkonda eng' nooto ne ma pororyet; atachok eng' pororyet ne ma tinyei naet.”
Ak nyigan miising' Isaiah, ak mwaei kole, “Ki nyoorwo icheek che ki ma cheeng'a; ki ataagu eng' icheek che ma teeba.”
Ago mwaei agobo Israel kole, “Ki aitoochi eunekyuk eng' peetuut komugul piik che ma kase iit ak che ngelelik.”
Amwae anyun ale, Tos ki toorta `Kamuktaindet piikyik? Achicha, ma uu nooto. Amu aa Yahudyot agane, ne po kesweegap Abraham, ne po ooreetap Benjamin.
Ki ma toorta `Kamuktaindet piikyik che kisip konai. Anan ma onai ne mwaei sireet agobo Elijah? Ko uu ye king'andoi `ineendet Yahudik eng' taitap Kamuktaindet kole,
“Kiptaiyat, ki kobar maotiguk, ak ki koluul ole ki tisiisye; ak kaang'etu aneege, ak cheeng'ei icheek saboondanyu.”
Ago leenjin nee waluunetap Kamuktaindet? Kaatukyigei murenik eliphuusyek tisap, che ma kutung'ji Baal.
Agot ko uu nooto anyun agine eng' peetuusyechu, miitei che ng'etunotiin ko uu lewenet ne po myeeindo.
Ago ngot ko po myeeindo, koma ko po poisyonik: ngo ma uu nooto, ko mata koek `myeeindo myeeindo.
Nee anyun? Ki ma nyoor Israel nooto ki cheeng'ei; ago kinyoor lewenik, ak ki kiuuiit chuun alak:
ko uu ye siraat kole, “Ki kogoochi `Kamuktaindet ne Toroor icheek rwondo ne nyigiis, ak koonyek che ma keerei kiy, ak iitiik che ma kasei kiy, agoi peetuuniito.”
Mwaei Daudi kole, Ingoek meesennywa meset ak rigeito, Ak kanagutyet, ak yaaktaet eng' icheek:
Ingoimenitu konyekwak, si ma keer kiy, Ak iyai patoikwak kogumbu kotugul.
Amwae anyun ale, Tos, kiterteryot kot kobutyo? Achicha, ma uu nooto: ago ki nyoonji yetunet Pororyosy ek eng' kabutennywa, si kobiit kogoochi icheek ng'etkonda.
Ngot koegu kabutennywa mogornatosyegap ng'wony, ak koek luseennywa mogornatosyegap Pororyosyek; kosiirei ne tya anyun nyiennywa?
Ago ang'alaalwok okweek che oo po Pororyosyek. Ko uu ye aa kayooktoindet ne po Pororyosyek, atoroori poisyennyu:
si agoochi ng'etkonda eng' oor age tugul icheeget che kiborto agenge, ak asaru alak eng' icheek.
Amu ngo toortaennywa ko katuiyetap, ko tos nee anyun taagetap icheek, kobatee saboondo ne mang'une che ki pek?
Ak ngo tiliil tongoaniat, ko tiliil kiit komugul agine: ak ngo tiliil tigityot, ko tiliileen ak icheek mooriik.
Ago ngot ko ki kiiri mooriik alak, ak inyee ne ii mseitunitap timiin, ko ki kinamnyenen icheek eng' kwenunnywa, ak ki oyamde kobooto icheeget ne po tigityot ak akwaiyetap mseituni;
mechauge ile isiire mooriik: ago, ngot ichauge, koma inyee ne igeseni tigityot, ago tigityot ne kesenin.
Imwae anyun ile, Ki kiiri mooriik, si kinamnyena.
Myee; ki kiiri icheek amu pistoennywa, ak itononi eng' kayaneng'ung'. Amelaske, ago iyweisye:
amu ngo ki ma riiree Kamuktaindet mooriik che ki po keetoto ye kinye, koma rireenen ak inyee.
Keer anyuno myeeindo ak koroomnatetap Kamuktaindet: eng' icheek che kibutyo, ko koroomnateet; ago eng' inyee, ko myeeindap Kamuktaindet, ngitebi eng' myeeindonyi: ngo ma uu nooto ketilin aginye.
Ak ngo ma tebi icheek eng' pistoennywa, kinamdos: amu imuuchi Kamuktaindet konamnyo icheek kogeny.

Amu ngo kigetilin eng' mseituni ne po timiin eng' piteennyi, ak ki kinamnyenen mseituni ne myee ne ki ma ko po timiin eng' piteennyi: ko siirei anyun ne tya kinamnye mooriik che ki po ye kinye emdinnywa!
Amu ma mache oegu che mongen ung'ootyoni, che kitupche, si moiityige ole oo ng'oomen eng' loseng'wong' pogei, ale kanyonji Israel uuindo eng' kebeber, agoi konyo nyiyet ne po Pororyosyek;
ak uu nooto tuun kisaru Israel tugul: ko uu ye siraat kole, Tuun mang'une Zion Katyagindet; Ak koistoe Jakobo pistoet:
Ak ni arorutyennyu eng' icheek, Ye tuun aiste tengekwogikwak.
Ago puunik icheek eng' okweek, amu logoiywek che myach: ago eng' ng'olyootap lewenet, ko chamanik icheek amu kwanisyek.
Amu ma tinyei ndara konunoigap Kamuktaindet ak kuursennyi.
Amu ko uu ye ki ongelelji Kamuktaindet eng' peetuusyek che ki kosiirto, ago nguno ko kaonyooru rireenetapkei eng' pistoennywa,
ko uu nooto ak icheek chu, ki kobistoe, si konyoor ak icheek rireenetapkei eng' rireenetapkei ne ki kiboorwok.
Amu ki koratyi Kamuktaindet tugul eng' pistoet, si kobiit koriiree tugul.
Ee tyanitu anyun ooindo ne po mogornatosyegap utaatyet ak naetap Kamuktaindet! Ak kirwoogutikyik che ma isiagaksei, ak ortinwekyik che ma cheeng'oksei!
“Amu ng'oo ne ki konai kabwaatutigap Kiptaiyat? Anan ng'oo ne ki koek kaneetindennyi?
Anan ng'oo ne kisip kogoochi kiy, si kobiit koyaakyi ineendet kogeny?”
Amu pou ineendet, ak kobunu ineendet ak koweekyingei ineendet, tuguuk tugul. Punjin ineendet toroornatet koigeny. Amen.

Nooto anyun che kitupche, asoomok miising', eng' rireenosyegap Kamuktaindet ale, ogoite poorwekwok koek tiseiywot ne sabei, ne tiliil, ne taachaksei eng' Kamuktaindet, nooto ko poisyeng'wong' ne nyolu.
Amoyaniegei ateptap peetuusyechu: ago ingewalak eng' kaleelitetap kabwaatutikwok, si kobiit onai komyee mageet ne myee ne po Kamuktaindet, ne tachaksei ak kogesunotkei.

Amu amwachini chii age tugul ne mi kwenung'wong', eng' myeeindo ne kigegoono, amat kobwaatkei chii kole toroor kosiir ne tee ne nyolu kobwaat; ago kobwaat ne yamei, ko uu ye ki igoochi Kamuktaindet chii age tugul karagutyetap kayaneet.
Amu agot ko uu ye ki tinyei kebeberwek che chaang' eng' poorto agenge, ama tinyei kebeberwek tugul poisyet agenge:
ko uu nooto eng' acheek che ki chaang', kiborto agenge eng' Kristo, ak ki kebeberta age tugul ne po age.
Ak ketinye konunoik che teerchiin ko uu myeeindo ne kigegoonech, ngo maonateet, ko ongeamde ko uu ole tee kayanennyo;
anan poisyet, ongigoochigei poisyennyo; anan ineendet ne ineetisyei, kochuljigei kaneetisyennyi;
anan ineendet ne iteitoi, kochuljige kateitaennyi: ineendet ne igoitoi, kogoito eng' aiyebindo; ineendet ne pou, koboi kochuljigei; ineendet ne rireegei, koriiregei eng' poiboiyet.
Ingoek chamyet ne ma tinyei ng'aalseet. Wech miising' nooto ya; onamge ak ne myee.
Ochamyee eng' chamyet ne uu ne po tupchosyek; ingoiit chiito age chiito age kosiir ineendet eng' teegisto;
eng' kagiiletapkei amochoriren; ogiilgei miising' eng' mugulelwekwok, oote Kiptaiyat;
oboiboitu eng' kamang'unet; omuitoi eng' nyalilda; ogiiljigei saaet kotugul;
otoret che tiliileen eng' tuguuk che pononi; oaiyebitu eng' toek.
Oberuur che usook; oberuur, amochup.
Oboiboitu kobooto che poiboi; oriirye kobooto che riirtos.
Oegu che tinyei kabwaatet agenge okweegei eng' okweegei. Among'asyige tuguuk che torooreen, ago onamge ak che iming'inegei. Moiityige ole oo ng'oomen eng' loseng'wong' pogei.
Amoyaakyi chii yaityo eng' yaityo. Ibwaat tuguuk che po teegisto eng' taitap piik tugul.
Ngo mugaksei eng' okweek, otebi ak piik tugul eng' kaalyeet.
Chamanichu, amoyaakte mugetuut, ago ogoochi poroindo nereegek: amu siraat kole, “Nenyu yaaktaetap mugetuut; ayaaktoi, mwaei Kiptaiyat.”
“Ngo am rubeet punyondeng'ung', ibai; ngo am melel, inage koe; amu ye iyae ko uu nooto ko kerurukyi ng'etetyot metinnyi.”
Ameng' koterteerin yaityet, ago iterteer yaityet eng' ne myee.
Ingogas iit chii tugul pounatosyek che eecheen: amu ma mi pounooto, kobatee ne punu Kamuktaindet; ak ki indoi Kamuktaindet chooto miitei.
Nooto anyun ineendet ne kirindoi pounateet, kobistoe ng'atuutyetap Kamuktaindet: ak icheek che pistoe kocheeng'jingei kirwooget.
Amu ma po pounik kamuiset eng' poisyonik che myach, ago eng' che yaach. Ak tos meiywei pounateet? Yai ne myee, si inyooru kalasunet eng' nooto;

amu ineendet ko kiboityotap Kamuktaindet eng' inyee, ne yaei ne myee. Ago ngiyai ne ya, iywei; amu ma ibooti rotwetap chok puch: amu ineendet ko kiboityotap Kamuktaindet, yaaktaindetap mugetuut agobo nereegek eng' ineendet ne yaei yaityo.
Nooto anyun kanyool ogas iit, ma amu nereegek kityo, ago amu kabwaatet agine.
Amu ng'olyoondoniito anyun ogoitoi aisuruut agine; amu icheeget ko kiboitinigap poisyetap Kamuktaindet, che igiiljingei kotugul kioto.

Ogoochi tugul tuguuk che nyoljin: kodi eng' ineendet ne nyoljin kodi; aisuruut eng' ineendet ne nyoljin aisuruut; kaiyweisyet eng' ineendet ne nyoljin kaiyweisyet; teegisto eng' ineendet ne nyoljin teegisto.
Amobesen chii kiy age tugul, ago ochamye: amu ineendet ne chamei chiitap kokwennyi ko kagoyai kosulda Ng'atuutyet.

Amu eng' mwaonooto kimwaei keele: Amoipkei; Amerumisye; Amechoorse; Amegase myat kiy ne po chii, ago ngo mi ng'atuutyet age, kiyumi tugul eng' ng'olyoondoni, keele, Cham chiitap kokweng'ung' ko uu ole ichamdoige.
Ma yachin chamyet kiy ne ya chiitap kokwennyi: nooto anyun chamyet ko kasuldaetap Ng'atuutyet.
Ak anyun, ongen peetuusyek, ole kagoit sait ne kanyool ogosu eng' rwondo: amu kagorikyech nguno yetunet kosiir ye kingi yan eng' tai.
Neegit kosiirto kemout, kariik peetuut; nooto anyun ongireegu poisyonigap mesundeito, ak ongilaach kariigap lapkeiyet.
Ongebendoti ko uu ye nyolu, ko uu peet; ma eng' waseetapkei anan pogitet, ma eng' sokseet anan mageet ne ya, ma eng' polateet ak ng'etkong'.
Ago olach Kiptaiyat Jeso Kristo, amochopchi poorto poroindo, si oyai maguutikyik.
Ago otaach ineendet ne nyalulat eng' kayaneet, ago ma si orwookyi kabwaatutikyik.
Tinyei chiito age kayaneet koam tuguuk tugul: ago ineendet ne nyalulat koamei ingweek.
Amat kosas ne amei ne ma amei; ak amat korwookyi ineendet ne ma amei, ineendet ne amei: amu kagotaach `Kamuktaindet ineendet.
Ii ng'oo inyee ne irwookyini otwogindetap chiito age? Tononi anan kobuti eng' kiptaiyandennyi. Ee, kinamei kotonon; amu imuuchi Kiptaiyat konam ineendet kotonon.
Iiti chiito age peetuut age kosiir peetuut age: iiti chiito age peetuut age tugul kogergeit. Ingonai komyee chii age tugul eng' ng'omnatennyi.

Ineendet ne riibei peetuut, koriipchin Kiptaiyat: ak ineendet ne amisyei, koamisyei eng' Kiptaiyat, amu mwachin Kamuktaindet kongoi; ak ineendet ne ma amisyei, koma amisyei eng' Kiptaiyat, ak mwachin Kamuktaindet kongoi.
Amu ma mi age eng' acheek ne sabei agobo kei, ama mi ne meei agobo kei.
Amu ngesaptosi, kesaptosi eng' Kiptaiyat, ak ngebegu, kebegu eng' Kiptaiyat: nooto anyun, ngesaptosi anan ngebegu, kebo Kiptaiyat.
Amu kime Kristo agobo niito, ak kisop, si koek Kiptaiyat ne po che ki kobek ak che saptos.
Ago inyee, ko amu nee si kirwookyi ne otupche? Anan kogeny, ko amu nee si iit ne otupche koek puch? Amu tuun kitonondosi acheek tugul eng' taitap ng'echereetap kirwooget ne po Kamuktaindet.
Amu ki kisir keele, “Ko uu ye asabe, Mwaei Kiptaiyat, ko tuun kutung'jino kutundo age tugul, ak kolas ng'elyepta age tugul Kamuktaindet.”
Nooto anyun, tuun tetyin chii age tugul Kamuktaindet atebeennyi.
Nooto anyun, amat kota kirwookyigei kogeny: ago kaigai orwooch ko uu ni keele amat konde chii kanagut ooreetap ne tupcho, anan kiy ne igoochin kobut.
Angen, ak koanai komyee eng' Kiptaiyat Jeso, ale ma miitei kiy ne ng'wanitu ineegei: kobatee eng' ineendet ne iiti kiy kole ng'waan, kong'wanitu eng' ineendet.
Amu ngo aragen ne otupche amu amitwogik, koma iwendoti eng' chamyet. Amebar ineendet eng' amitwogiguk ne ki mechi Kristo.
Amat kemwaitae myeeindong'wong' yaityo:
amu laitornatetap Kamuktaindet koma amisyet ak eeiset, ago imanda ak kaalyeet ak poiboiyet eng' Kabuuset ne Tiliil.
Amu ineendet ne otei Kristo eng' tuguuchuuto koboiboi Kamuktaindet, ak koyanjin piik.
Nooto anyun, ongisup tuguuk che yaei kaalyeet, ak tuguuk che kiteegegei acheegei eng' acheegei.
Amowechawech poisyetap Kamuktaindet eng' amitwogik. Tiliileen tuguuk tugul iman; ago ya eng' chiichooto amei eng' kanagut.
Myee ngot koma ki am panyeek, anan kee maiyek, anan keyai kiy age tugul ne inachi ne otupche.
Kayaneet ne itinye, itepte inyegei eng' taitap Kamuktaindet. Paibai ineendet ne ma tinyei ne irwookyinegei eng' kioto kagoyanjigei ineegei.
Ago ineendet ne tinyei saget, ki kikyin ngot koam, amu ma amei eng' kayaneet; ak kiit age tugul ne ma po kayaneet ko tengek.
Nooto anyun kanyoljech acheek che ki kiimeen kegesen nyalulnatetap che ma kiimeen, ama kibaibaigei acheegei.
Ingobaibai age tugul eng' acheek chiitap kokwennyi eng' nooto myee, si koteegak.
Amu ki ma ibaibaigei Kristo ineegei; ago ko uu ye ki kisir keele, kogoityo agane churisyetap icheeget che kichurin.
Amu tuguuk alak tugul che ki kisir keny ko ki kisir si kinetkei, si kenyooru kamang'unet eng' muitaet ak eng' kagaigaet ne po siruutik.
Ingogoonok anyun Kamuktaindet ne po muitaet ak kagaigaet oegu che otinye kabwaatet agenge okweegei eng' okweegei ko uu ye machei Kristo Jeso:
si kobiit otoroor Kamuktaindet ineendet Kwandap Kiptaiyandennyo Jeso Kristo eng' mageet agenge ak kutit agenge.
Nooto anyun otaachkei, ko uu ye ki taachok Kristo agine, eng' toroornatetap Kamuktaindet.
Amu amwae anyun ale ki keyai Kristo koek kiboityotap kamuratanet agobo imanitap Kamuktaindet, si kobiit kogimit arorutik che ki kigoochi kwanisyek,
ak si kotoroor Pororyosyek Kamuktaindet amu rireenennyi; ko uu ye ki kisir keele, Nooto anyun alasun eng' kwenutap Pororyosyek, Ak atyenji kaineng'ung'.
Ak ki mwa kogeny kole, Oboiboitu okweek Pororyosyek, kobooto piikyik.
Ak kogeny, Olasu Kiptaiyat, okweek Pororyosyek tugul; Ak ingolas piik tugul ineendet.
Ak kogeny mwaei Isaiah kole, Tuun piitu tigityotap Jesse, Ak ineendet ne tuun ng'eetei koboi Pororyosyek; Kotun imang'u ineendet Pororyosyek.
Nooto anyun, ingonyiitak Kamuktaindet ne po kamang'unet poiboiyet tugul ak kaalyeet eng' kayaneet, si kobiit otesage eng' kamang'unet, eng' kamuktaetap Kabuuset ne Tiliil.
Ak kaanai aneendet agine agobo okweek, che kitupche, ale oo nyiitootiin eng' myeeindo, oo nyiitootiin eng' naet tugul, ak kogeny, omuuchi otigongei.
Ago, asirwok agobo ng'aleek alak eng' nyiganateet ne siirei, ko uu ye abwaatwok kogeny, amu myeeindo ne ki koono Kamuktaindet,
ale aek kiboityotap Kristo Jeso eng' Pororyosyek, aboisyei eng' logoiywek che myach che po Kamuktaindet, si kobiit koek kagoitoetap Pororyosyek ne taagaksei, ko kagitabaan eng' Kabuuset ne Tiliil.
Nooto anyun atinye kalasunennyu pogei eng' Kristo Jeso eng' tuguuk che tokyingei Kamuktaindet.
Amu ma kanye ang'alaal agobo tugun alak tugul kobatee chooto che ki koyai Kristo eng' anee, agobo kasetap iit ne po Pororyosyek, eng' ng'olyoot ak yaeet,

eng' kamuget ne po kaboorunoik ak kwang'utik, eng' kamuktaetap Kabuuset ne Tiliil; nooto anyun, kong'etee Jerusalem, ak komoswekyik agoi Iluriko, ko ki aamdaate komyee logoiywek che myach che po Kristo;
ee, ayae nooto koek kiit ne atoorchinigei ale aamda logoiywek che myach, ma eng' ole kigemwae kainetap Kristo, si ma teech eng' lumeiywotap chiito age;
ago, ko uu ye ki kisir keele, Keerei icheek, che ki ma pwanji logoiywekyik, Ak tuun naei icheek che tomo kogas.
Kigeraanya anyun konyil che chaang' si ma nyonjok:
ago ko uu ye ma atinye oldo age eng' komoswechu, ak ko uu ye atinye eng' kenyisyechu chaang' emosto ale Anyoonjok,
eng' ui tugul ye tuun awendi Spania (amu amang'u ageerok eng' pandanyu, si oyomisa eng' pandanyu, si ye tuun ngo kagoyama atebeet ne kagitebi tugul ak okweek) -
ago nguno, awendi Jerusalem, awo aboisyechi piik che tiliileen.
Amu ki cham miising' Makedonia ak Akaia kobasyi tugun piik che ponondos eng' kwenutap che tiliileen che mi Jerusalem.

Ee, kigocham icheek miising' ng'olyoondoniito; ak icheek ko pesenikwak. Amu ngo ki keyai Pororyosyek koek yamdoik che po tuguuk che po saboon, ko kanyool ak icheek koyaakta eng' poisyet ne poisyechin eng' tuguuk che po poorto.
Ye kaagesu anyun niito, ak ang'okyi icheek logoechu, anyo abun oldang'wong' awendi Spania.
Ak angen ale, ye Anyoonjok, anyoone eng' nyiietap kaberuretap Kristo.
Asoomok miising' anyun che kitupche, eng' Kiptaiyandennyo Jeso Kristo, ak eng' chamyetap Kabuuset ne Tiliil, ale ogiilgei kobooto eng' saautikwok che osaae Kamuktaindet agobo anee;
si kobiit kityaacha eng' icheek che ma kase iit eng' Judea, si koek poisyennyu ne atinye agobo Jerusalem ne taagaksei eng' che tiliileen;
si amuuch Anyoonjok eng' poiboiyet eng' mageetap Kamuktaindet, ak anyooru kamuung'et kobootok.
Ingotep Kamuktaindet ne po kaalyeet kobootok okweek tugul. Amen.
Kande eunekwok Poibe ne kitupche ne cheboityotap kaniset ne mi Kenkrea:
ale otaach ineendet eng' Kiptaiyat, ko uu ye nyoljin che tiliileen, ak otoret ineendet eng' kiit age tugul ne magenok; amu ineendet agine ko kitoretindet ne po che chaang', ak kitoreta agane.
Ogat Priska ak Aquila che ki kiboitiinik tugul eng' Kristo Jeso,
che ki chobootiin kogoito saboonwekwak agobo saboondanyu; che ma mwachini kongoi aneege, ago kobooto kanisosyek tugul che po Pororyosyek ak icheek:
ak ogat kaniset ne mi koonnywa. Ogat Epeneto ne achame miising', ne tongoaniat ne po Kristo eng' emetap Asia.
Ogat Maria, ne kiboisyewok eng' poisyet ne oo.
Ogat Androniko ak Junia, che po ornyo, ak che kimonjororinik kobooto, che taagunotiin eng' che kiyooktoi, che ki mi eng' Kristo kotom ayan.
Ogat Ampliato ne achame miising' eng' Kiptaiyat.
Ogat Urbano kiboityondennyu ne kiboisyei tugul eng' Kristo, ak Stako ne achame.
Ogat Apele ne chamat eng' Kristo. Ogat icheek che po kootap Aristobulo.
Ogat Herodion ne po ornyo. Ogat icheek che po kootap Narkiso, che mi eng' Kiptaiyat.
Ogat Truphena ak Truphosa, che poisyei eng' Kiptaiyat. Ogat Persis chamaneet, ne kibois miising' eng' Kiptaiyat.
Ogat Rupo ne lewenot eng' Kiptaiyat, ak kamet ne kamennyu agane.
Ogat Asunkrito, ak Plegon, ak Herme ak Patroba, ak Herma, ak tupchosyek che mi kobooto icheek.
Ogat Pilologo ak Julia, ak Nereo ak chepkamet, ak Olumpa, ak che tiliileen tugul che mi kobooto icheek.
Ogatkei eng' ng'ututet ne tiliil. Igatok kanisosyek tugul che po Kristo.
Kasoomok anyun che kitupche, ale ogeer icheek che ing'eeti kabesyosyek ak kanagutik, che ma namegei ak kaneetisyet ne ki oneetkei: ak koistoegei icheek.
Amu icheeget che uu chooto, ko maotei Kiptaiyandennyo Kristo, ago otei mootinwekwak; ak kong'alei mugulelwegap che libwoben eng' ng'aleekwak che tangusen ak che po chemwaigutnateet.
Amu ki kogasak eng' piik tugul kaseng'wong' po iit. Nooto anyun abaibai eng' okweek: ago amache oeguche utaatiin eng' nooto myee, ak oegu che perber eng' nooto po yaityet.
Ak tuun tuei Kamuktaindet ne po kaalyeet Setani eng' keelyekwok ko neegit. Ingotep kobootok myeeindap Kiptaiyandennyo Jeso Kristo.
Igatok Timoteo ne kiboityot kobooto; ak Lukio ak Jason ak Sosipatros, che po ornyo.
Anee Tertio ne kasirei parwaani, agatok eng' Kiptaiyat.
Igatok Gaio ne ami koonnyi, ak kaniset komugul. Igatook Erasto riibindetap tuguugap nganaseet, ak Kuarto ne tupcho.
Ingotep kobootok tugul myeeindap Kiptaiyandennyo Jeso Kristo. Amen.
Nguno eng' ineendet ne imuuchi kogimitok ko uu logoiywekyuk che myach ak amdaetap Jeso Kristo, ko uu ng'ang'utyet ne po ung'oot ne ki kagiuny kosiis kobooch peetuusyek che po koigeny,
ago kagong'ang'ak nguno, ak eng' siruutik che po maotik, ko uu ng'atuutyetap Kamuktaindet ne po koigeny, ko kagiboorchi pororyosyek tugul agoi kasetap iit ne po kayaneet;
po Kamuktaindet ne utaat ineegei toroornatet koigeny, eng' Jeso Kristo. Amen.
Paulo, ne ki kiguur koek kayooktoindet ne po Kristo Jeso eng' mageetap Kamuktaindet, ak Sosten tupchennyo,

kisirchini kanisetap Kamuktaindet ne miitei Korinto, icheek che ki kitabaan eng' Kristo Jeso, che ki kiguur koek che tiliileen, kobooto tugul che kuurei kainetap Kiptaiyandennyo Jeso Kristo eng' komosta age tugul, Kiptaiyannyo ak ko nenywa.
Ingotep kobootok myeeindo ak kaalyeet ne punu Kamuktaindet Kwandanyo ak Kiptaiyat Jeso Kristo.
Amwachini Kamuktaindet nenyu kongoi kotugul agobo okweek, amu myeeindap Kamuktaindet ne ki kigoonok eng' Kristo Jeso;
amu kigeyaak oegu mogoreek miising' eng' ineendet eng' kiy age tugul, eng' ng'aleek tugul, ak naet tugul;
ko uu ye ki kigimit paornateetap Kristo eng' okweek:
si moletu eng' konunotyot age tugul; ogeni ng'ang'utyetap Kiptaiyandennyo Jeso Kristo.
Ne igimitok agine agoi let, ko motinye kiy ne kirwoogunenok eng' peetuutap Kiptaiyandennyo Jeso Kristo;
Kamuktaindet ko ne kiyani, kigeguurok eng' ineendet obwonji yamdaetap Weeriinnyi Jeso Kristo Kiptaiyandennyo.

Asoomok miising' anyun, che kitupche, eng' kainetap Kiptaiyandennyo Jeso Kristo, ale, omwa tugul kiit agenge, si ma piit pesyosyek eng' kwenung'wong'; ago si oegu che ititaatiin kibagenge eng' kabwaatet agenge ak eng' kirwooget agenge.
Amu ki komwoiwo icheek che mi kootap Kloe agobo okweek, tupchosyekyuk, kole mi toiyasyek kwenung'wong'.
Ki it anyun ne amwae ko ni, ale, mwaei age tugul eng' okweek, kole, “Aa po Paulo,” kole age “Aa po Apolo,” kole age “Aa po Kepha,” ak kole age “Aa po Kristo.”
Tos pcheat Kristo? Tos ki kigartatwok Paulo? Anan ki kibatisanjok kainetap Paulo?
Amwachini Kamuktaindet kongoi amu ma abatisan chii eng' okweek, kobatee Krispo ak Gaio,
si ma mwa chii age tugul kole ki kibatisanjok kainennyu.
Nga ki abatisan che po kootap Stephana ak icheek: mangen kogeny, ngo kita abatisan chii age.
Amu ma iyookwo Kristo abatisanis, ago aamda logoiywek che myach: ma eng' utaatyet ne po ng'aleek, si ma ki yai kimurtoiyotap Kristo koek puch.
Amu perberyo ng'olyootap kimurtoiyot eng' icheeget che lustos; ago eng' acheek che kisaru ko kimnateetap Kamuktaindet.
Amu ki kisir keele, Ang'eme utaatyet che utaatiin, Ak aeesyoi kaguiyetap icheeget che iguitos.
Mi ano ne utaat? Mi ano siriindet? Mi ano kiptiyotyot ne po kenyisyechu? Tos ma yai Kamuktaindet ng'omnatetap ng'wonyuni koberberit?
Amu eng' utaatyet ne po Kamuktaindet koma nai ng'wony Kamuktaindet eng' utotyennyi, ki cham Kamuktaindet kosar icheeget che iyani, eng' perberyo ne po ng'olyoot ne ki amdoi.
Amu soomei Yahudik kaboorunoik, ak cheeng'ei Yunanik utaatyet:
ago ki amdoi acheek Kristo ne ki kigartaat, ne kanagutyet eng' Yahudik, ak ko perberyo eng' Pororyosyek;
ago eng' icheek che ki kiguur, Yahudik kobooto Yunanik, Kristo ko kamuktaetap Kamuktaindet, ak utaatyetap Kamuktaindet.
Amu perberyo ne po Kamuktaindet ko utaat kosiir utaatyetap piik; ak nyalulnatetap Kamuktaindet ko kiim kosiir ne po piik.
Amu, ogeer kuurseng'wong', tupchosyechu, ole ma kiguur che chaang' che utaatiin eng' atebeetap poorto, anan che chaang' che kiimeen, ama che chaang' che taagunotiin:

ago ki lewen Kamuktaindet tuguuk che perber che po ng'wony, si kogoochi kalilanet che utaatiin; ak ki lewen Kamuktaindet tuguuk che nyalulyotin che po ng'wony, si kogoochi kalilanet tuguuk che kiimeen;
ak ki lewen Kamuktaindet tuguuk che ma taagunotiin che po ng'wony, ak tuguuk che kisasei, ak tuguuk che ma miitei, si kowal koek puch tuguuk che miitei:
si mat koloskei chii age tugul eng' taitap Kamuktaindet.
Ago oo po ineendet okweek eng' Kristo Jeso, ne ki kiyai eng' Kristo Jeso, ne ki kiyai eng' acheek koek utaatyet ne punu Kamuktaindet, ak imanda, ak tiliilindo, ak katyaget:
si koek, ko uu ye ki kisir keele, “Ineendet ne ilasugei, ko ingoloskei eng' Kiptaiyat.”
Ak ye ki Anyoonjok tupchosyechu, ko ki ma anyoo eng' anyinyindap ng'alaalet anan ne po utaatyet, anyoo aboorwok ung'ootyetap Kamuktaindet.
Amu ki abegechi ale ma mache anai kiy age tugul eng' kwenung'wong' kobatee Jeso Kristo, ineendet ne ki kigartaat.
Ki ami kobootok eng' nyalulet, ak eng' kaiyweisyet, ak eng' potanet ne oo.
Ak ng'alaalennyu ak ng'olyoondennyu ne ki aamdoi ko ki ma ko ng'aleegap kagaigaet che po utaatyet, ago eng' kaboorunetap Kabuuset ne Tiliil ak ne po kamuktaet:
si ma tonone kayaneng'wong' utaatyetap piik, ago eng' kamuktaetap Kamuktaindet.
Ago kimwae utaatyet eng' kwenutap che ititaatiin: ago utaatyet ne ma po peetuusyechu, anan ne po pounigap peetuusyechu, che machei koek puch:
ago kimwae utaatyetap Kamuktaindet eng' ung'ootyet, nooto ne kigeuny, ne kiga sip kong'at Kamuktaindet agobo toroornatennyo ye kitom kobiit ng'wony:
ne manaei agot agenge eng' pounik che po peetuusyechu: amu nda kiga nai, ta ki ma kogartati Kiptaiyatap toroornatet:
ago ko uu ye ki kisir keele, “Ma mi kong' ne ki kogeer, anan it ne ki kogas, anan muguleldap chii ne kigoguiyo, tuguuk tugul che kichopchi `Kamuktaindet icheeget che chamei ineendet.”
Ago king'ang'wech Kamuktaindet eng' Kabuuset ne Tiliil: amu isyachi Kabuuset ne Tiliil tuguuk tugul, agot tuguuk che po oriit che po Kamuktaindet.
Amu tos ng'oo chii ne ingen tuguugap chii kobatee muguleldap chiichooto ne miitei ineendet? Ko uu nooto ma mi chii ne ingen tuguugap Kamuktaindet, kobatee Kabuuset ne po Kamuktaindet.
Ago ki ma kitaach kabuuset ne po ng'wony, ago Kabuuset ne po Kamuktaindet, si kenai tuguuk che ki kogoonech Kamuktaindet puch.
Tuguuchooto ak icheek che kimwae, ko ma kimwae eng' ng'aleek che ineeti utaatyetap chii, ago che ineeti Kabuuset ne Tiliil; ki poisyee Kabuuset ne Tiliil asi kiguiyo tuguugap saboon.
Ma taachei chiito ne mi eng' atebeetap poorto tuguuk che po Kabuusetap Kamuktaindet: amu perberyo eng' ineendet; ak temenee koobeesyo tuguuchooto, amu naoksei eng' toretetap Kabuuset.
Ago ineendet ne mi eng' atebeetap Kabuuset ne Tiliil kobestos tuguuk tugul, ago ma mi chii ne ibestos ole teptoi chiichooto.
Amu ng'oo ne ki konai kabwaatutigap Kiptaiyat, si kobiit koneet ineendet? Ago ki tinyei acheek kabwaatutigap Kristo.
Ki temena anyun, che kitupche, ang'alaalwok ko uu piik che mi eng' atebeetap Kabuuset ne Tiliil, ago ko uu piik che mi eng' atebeetap poorto, ko uu che manyurunik eng' Kristo.
Ki aguenak cheego, ma abaenak amitwogik che uueen; amu kitom omuuch; achicha, agot nguno kotom omuuch;
amu ta omi eng' atebeetap poorto: amu ko uu ye mi kwenung'wong' ng'etkonda ak pooryeet, tos ma mi eng' atebeetap poorto, ak obendoti ko uu piteetap piik?
Amu ye mwaei age kole, “Aa po Paulo” ak koleen age, “Aa po Apolo,” tos ma oo piik?
Nee anyun Apolo? Ko nee Paulo? Kiboitiinik che ki koonok oyan; ak ko uu ye ki igoochi Kiptaiyat age tugul.
Ki agoole, kobisi Apolo; ago ki ibit Kamuktaindet.
Nooto anyun ma tilei kiy ne koolei, anan ne ibisi; ago Kamuktaindet ne ibiiti.
Nooto anyun, ineendet ne koolei ak ineendet ne ibisi ko agenge: ago tuun nyooru age tugul melektanyi ineegei ko uu poisyennyi.
Amu ki kiboitinigap Kamuktaindet che kiboisyei kobooto ineendet: okweek ko oo mbareetap Kamuktaindet, kootap Kamuktaindet.
Ki alumde lumeiywot ko uu teegindet ne oo ne ng'oom, ko uu myeeindap Kamuktaindet ne ki kigoono; ak teechei chiito age paragunnyi. Ago ingoriip chii age tugul ole teektoi eng' paragunnyi.
Amu ma mi lumeiywot age ne imuuchi chii kolumda kobatee nooto kigelum, nooto Jeso Kristo.
Ago ngo teech chii paragutap lumeiywondonooto eng' thahabu, fedha, koik che po kamanuutyet ne oo, keetiik, susweek, mobeek;
tuun king'aanyei poisyetap chii age tugul: amu tuun ng'aanyei peetuut, amu king'aanyei eng' maat; ak kotyem matole teptoi poisyetap chii age tugul.
Ngo tebi poisyetap chii age tugul ne ki teech paragunnyi, kotaachei ineendet melekto.
Ngo lal poisyetap chii age tugul, kobetos tuguukyik: ago kisaru ineendet; ago ko uu ye kisaru eng' maat.
Mongen okweek ole oo Hekaluut ne po Kamuktaindet, ak menyok Kabuusetap Kamuktaindet?
Ak ngo ng'em chii age tugul Hekaluut ne po Kamuktaindet, kotun ng'emei `Kamuktaindet ineendet; amu tiliil Hekaluut ne po Kamuktaindet, okweek hekaluunooto.
Amat koberbergei chii. Ngo pwaati chii age tugul eng' kwenung'wong' kole utaat eng' peetuusyechu, ko ingoek ne perber, si kobiit koek ne utaat.
Amu ng'omnateet ne po ng'wonyuni ko perberyo eng' Kamuktaindet. Amu ki kisir keele, “Ineendet ne namei che utaatiin eng' ng'aalseennywa;”
ak kogeny, “Ingen Kiptaiyat kabwaatutigap che utaatiin, kole puch.”
Nooto anyun amat koloskei chii eng' piik. Amu tuguuk tugul ko chekwok;
ngo Paulo, anan Apolo, anan Kepha, anan meet, anan tuguuk che miitei, anan tuguuk che pwoonei; tugul ko chekwok;
ak oo po Kristo; ak Kristo ko po Kamuktaindet.
Ingoitech anyun chii kole ki kiboitinigap Kristo, ak riibiik che po ung'ootigap Kamuktaindet.
Eng' yuto anyun kogeny, kemage riibiik keele koek chii age tugul ne kiyani.
Ago kiit ne ming'in miising' eng' anee ale ogina okweek, anan eng' kirwoogetap chii: ee, ma kinegei aneege.
Amu mangenjigei kiy: ago ma kiityina imanda eng' nooto: ago ineendet ne kina ko Kiptaiyat.

Nooto anyun amat orwookyi kiy kotom koit peetuut, agoi konyo Kiptaiyat. Inee ne tuun ng'aanyei tuguuk che ung'ootiin che po mesundeito ak kobarta kabwaatutik che po mugulelwek; si konyoor chii age tugul anyun kalasunennyi eng' Kamuktaindet.

Nguno anyun che kitupche, kaayai tuguuchu koek kayaniet eng' anee ak Apolo agobo okweek; si kobiit oneetenechkei acheek si mosiir tuguuk che sirootin; si ma menegei chii agobo chii age, kotil let chiito age.
Amu tos ng'oo ne kayain iegu ne teer? Ak nee ne itinye inyee ne ki ma itaach? Ago ngo kiitaache, ko amu nee si ilasugei, ko uu ye ki ma itaache?
Oo nyiitootiin, kooegu mogore, koobou ama kimi: ee, achame ale obou, si kobiit kebou agacheek kobootok.

Amu, aleen, ki kondaech Kamuktaindet acheek che kiyooktoi keegu che po let eng' tugul, ko uu piik che ki kirwookyi kobek, amu kigeyaech keegu che kigeerei eng' ng'wony, ak eng' malaikaisyek, ak eng' piik.
Ki che perberen acheek amu Kristo, ago oo utaatiin eng' Kristo; kinyalulyotin acheek, ago oo kiimeen; otinye teegisto okweek, ago ma teechech chii.
Agot sainiito ketinye rubeet ak melelda ak kimi aach ngor ak kiluiluchech, ama ki tinyei ole ki menye;
ak kibirtoigei, keboisyee eunekyok: ye king'emwech kuut, kiberuur; ye kiuseech, kemuitoi;
ye kimwaitaenech yaityo, kigoigoi: kiyaech kegergeitu ak pusagaryegap ng'wony, tuguuk che kibuktoi che kilaktoi, agoi nguno.
Ma sire tuguuchu ale si olilanse, ago si atigoonok ko uu lagokyuk che achame.
Nga ndotinye riibiik eliphuusyek taman eng' Kristo, ko motinye kwanisyek che chaang': amu ki asichok eng' Kristo Jeso eng' logoiywek che myach.
Nooto anyun asoomok ale oegu kasupiikyuk.

Kaayokwok anyun Timoteo amu ng'olyoondoniito, ne ineendet ko lakweennyu ne achame ak iyani, eng' Kiptaiyat, ne nyoonei kabwaatwok ortinwekyuk che mi eng' Kristo, ko uu ye aneetoti komosta age tugul eng' kaniset age tugul.
Mendos alak anyun, koleen abeere manyonjinok.
Ago neegit Anyoonjok, ngo cham Kiptaiyat; ak aguiye, ma ng'olyootap icheek che meniotin, ago kamugennywa.
Amu laitornatetap Kamuktaindet koma eng' ng'olyoot, ago eng' kamuget.
Nee ne omache anyun? Anyoonjok ak kirokto, anan eng' chamyet ak muguleldap talasyet?
Mwaat komyee keele miitei ibeetapkei kwenung'wong', ibeetapkei ne ma mi agot eng' Pororyosyek, keele ibegei chii ak osotyotap kwandanyi.
Ak omendosi, ama agot oaragense, si kobiit keisto eng' kwenung'wong' ineendet ne ki yai kioto.
Amu anee iman, ko mamite eng' poorto, ago amite eng' saboon, kaarwookyi anyun ineendet ne ki yai kiito ko uu nooto, ko uu ye amite,
ye koyumge eng' kainetap Kiptaiyandennyo Jeso, kobooto saboondanyu, ak kamuktaetap Kiptaiyandennyo Jeso,
ogoochi Setani chiito ne uu nooto si keng'em poorto, si tuun kesar saboondanyi eng' peetuutap Kiptaiyat Jeso.
Ma karaaran kalasuneng'wong' pogei. Tos mongen ole igutu mermereek tutigin kererutyet komugul?
Ounde mermereek che po keny, si kobiit oegu kererutyet ne leel, ko uu ye ma mi mermereek eng' okweek. Amu kigeeny agine arwennyo ne po Paska, nooto ko Kristo:
nooto anyun ongeriip igoorto, ma eng' mermereek che po keny, anan eng' mermeregap yaityet ak tengekto, ago eng' magatyat ne ma kinde mermereek che ma tinyei keniisyet ak po iman.
Ki asirwak eng' parweennyu ale amonamge ak piik che soksei;
ma mwaei ale otabaanegei miising' che soksei che po ng'wonyuni, anan kipkeinik anan rebiik, anan che saaei kanamonik; amu nda uu nooto ta kanyooljok omande eng' ng'wony:

ago nguno asirwok, ale amonamge ak chii age tugul ne kiguure tupchet, ne soksei, anan kipkeiyat, anan ne saaei kanamonik, anan ne chubisyei, anan kibogityot, anan rebindet; amat oamjine ak chiito ne uu nooto, achicha.
Amu amage nee arwookyi icheek che miitei saang'? Tos morwookyini okweek icheek che miitei ko?
Ago icheek che miitei saang' korwookyin Kamuktaindet chooto. Oiste anyun chiichooto sogoran eng' kwenung'wong'.
Tos kanyei age tugul eng' okweek ne ting'ee ng'olyoo chiitap kokwennyi kwo kapkirwook eng' taitap che ma po iman, ama eng' taitap che tiliileen?
Anan mongen ole tuun irwookyin piik che tiliileen ng'wony? Ak ngot kotun orwookyini ng'wony, ko tos ma nyoljinok orwooch agobo tuguuk che mengeechen?
Tos mongen ole tuun kirwookyin malaikaisyek? Siirei anyun ne tya, tuguuk che po sabooni!
Ngot otinye ole kirwookyine tuguuk che po sabooni, ko tos ondoi koek kirwoogik icheek che ma kiiti keele kiy eng' kaniset?
Amwae ni si agoonok olilanse. Tos iman, ma mi chii ne utaat eng' kwenung'wong' ne imuuchi kotil ng'aleek eng' kwenutap tupchosyekyik,
ago imuti tupchet age tupchennyi kwo kapkirwook, ak ne siirei ko, eng' taitap che ma iyanotin?
Achicha, kagoek nguno leluut eng' okweek, amu orwookyinige okweegei. Amu nee si mochamdegei kinyalilaak? Kalya si mochamdegei kerebenak tuguuk?
Achicha, ago, okweeget che oyae ne ya, ak orebisyei, agot eng' tupchosyek.

Anan mongen ole ma tuun nyooru icheeget che ma po iman laitornatetap Kamuktaindet? Amat kiberberak: ma mi eng' che soksei, anan che saaei kanamonik, anan che ibegei, anan chemuulkwonyiik, anan chemogorgoinik,
anan chooriik, anan kipkeinik, anan kibogitinik, anan che chubisyei, anan rebiik, che nyooru laitornatetap Kamuktaindet.
Ak ki uu chooto alak eng' okweek; ago ki kiuunok, ago ki kitabaanak, ago ki kiityok imanda eng' kainetap Kiptaiyat Jeso Kristo, ak eng' Kabuusetap Kamuktaindet nenyo.
Chamdaat tuguuk tugul eng' anee; ago ma tuguuk tugul che nyolu. Chamdaat tuguuk tugul eng' anee; ago ma mache koboiywa age tugul eng' chooto.
Po amitwogik moet, ak po moet amitwogik; ago tuun yaei Kamuktaindet tuwai koek puch, moet ak amitwogik. Ago poorto, koma po sokseet, ago po Kiptaiyat; ak Kiptaiyat, ko po poorto;
ak ki ing'eet `Kamuktaindet Kiptaiyat, ak tuun ing'eetech ak acheek eng' kamuktaennyi.
Tos mongen ole poorwekwok ko kebeberwegap Kristo? Ara anyun aiste kebeberwegap Kristo, ak ayai koek kebeberwegap chepkugoniot? Achicha, ma uu nooto.
Anan, tos mongen ole ineendet ne ituitoskei ak chepkugoniot ko poorto agenge? Amu, mwaei ineendet kole, “Egu tuwai poorto agenge.”
Ago ineendet ne ituitoskei ak Kiptaiyat ko kabuuset agenge.
Omwee ibeetapkei. Tengek age tugul ne yaei chii komiitei saang'utap poorto; ago ineendet ne yaei ibeetapkei koyachin poortanyi tengekto.
Anan, tos mongen ole poorwekwok ko Hekaluut ne po Kabuuset ne Tiliil ne miitei eng' okweek, ne otinye eng' Kamuktaindet? Ama oo pogei okweegei;
amu ki kialenak kamanuutyet: otoroor Kamuktaindet anyun eng' poorwekwok.
Nguno anyun agobo tuguuk che ki osirwa: ko myee eng' muren ama twa kobogoryo.
Ago, amu ng'olyootap soksosyek, ko ingotebi chii age tugul ak osotyonnyi, ak ingotebi osotyot age tugul ak manong'otyondennyi.
Ingogoochi manong'otyot osotyonnyi ko uu ye nyoljin: ak ko uu nooto agine osotyot eng' manong'otyot.
Ma tinyei osotyot ineegei kamugo eng' poortanyi, ago manong'otyot: ak ko uu nooto agine manong'otyot, ma tinyei kamugo eng' poortanyi, ago osotyot.
Amoetegei okweegei, kobatee ye kochamyechi eng' peetuusyek alak, si onyooru poroindo ne po saaet, si otuiyegei kogeny, si ma yoomaak Setani amu motinye riibetapkei.
Ago amwae ni amu chamjinet, ma ng'atuutyet.
Ago kata achame koigei piik tugul anee. Ago tinyei chii age tugul konunennyi ne punu Kamuktaindet, age ko uu ni, ak age ko uu no.
Ago amwachini che tomo kotunis ak mosoogik, aleenjini, myee eng' icheek ngo tebi ko uu anee.
Ago ngo ma tinyei riibetapkei, ko ingotunis icheek: amu kaigai kotunis kosiir mageet ne lalei.
Ago ang'ate che ki kotungei ago ma anee, ago Kiptaiyat ale, Amat kobagaakta osotyot manong'otyondennyi
(ago ngot kometo, komat kitun, anan kogasyin ak manong'otyondennyi); ak amat kometo manong'otyot osotyonnyi.
Ago amwachini piik alak, ago ma Kiptaiyat, ale, ngo tinyei ne ketupche age tugul osotyot ne ma iyanaat, ak kochamei kotebi ak ineendet, komat kometo.
Ak kobogoryot ne tinyei manong'otyot ne ma iyanaat, ak kochamei kotebi ak ineendet, ko mat kometo manong'otyondennyi.
Amu kitiliili manong'otyot ne ma iyanaat eng' osotyot, ak kitiliili osotyot ne ma iyanaat eng' manong'otyot: nda ma uu nooto ta ma tiliileen lagokwok; ago tiliileen icheek nguno.
Ago ngwo ne ma iyanaat, ko ingwo: ma rataat ne ketupche mureno anan kwony eng' ng'aleek che uu chu: ago ki kuurech Kamuktaindet eng' kaalyeet.
Amu inaitoi ano inyee, ee, osotyondoni, ngo tos mesuru manong'otyondeng'ung'? Anan inaitoi ano inyee, ee manong'otyondoni, ngo tos mesaru osotyondeng'ung'?
Ago, ko uu ye kigopchechi Kiptaiyat chii age tugul, ko uu ye kigoguur Kamuktaindet age tugul, ingotebi ko uu nooto. Ak ang'ate anyun ko uu nooto eng' kanisosyek tugul.
Tos ki kiguur chii age tugul ko kagimuratan? Ko mat koigei ne tomo kimuratan. Tos ki kiguur chii age tugul kotom kimuratan? Ko mat kota kimuratan.
Ma kiy kamuratanet, ak ngo ma kimuratan koma kiy; ago keriip ng'atuutigap Kamuktaindet.
Ingotep chii age tugul ko uu ole kiteptoi ye ki ngeguurei.
Tos ki kiguurin ko ii otwogin? Ko mat iimgei, ago ngimuuchi ityagage, ko myee iboisye.
Amu ineendet ne ki kiguur eng' Kiptaiyat, ko otwogin, ko chiito ne ityagat ne po Kiptaiyat: ko uu nooto, ineendet ne ki kiguur kotyagat, ko otwogetap Kristo.
Ki kialaak eng' kamanuutyet; amat oegu otwogigap piik.
Tupchosyechu, ingotep chii age tugul ak Kamuktaindet ko uu ole kiteptoi ye ki ngeguurei.
Ma tinyei anyun ng'atuut eng' Kiptaiyat agobo pergeinik: ago amwae ko uu ole ageertoi, ko uu chii ne kigonyoor rireenetap Kiptaiyat aek ne kiyani.
Abwaati anyun ale myee niito, amu pichiindo ne miitei nguno, ale myee kotep chii ko uu ole teptoi nguno.
Tos kigeratyin osotyot? Mecheeng' kityaachin. Tos ityagat eng' osotyot? Mecheeng' anyun osotyot.
Ago ngot itunisye, koma iyai leeluut; ak ngitun pergeiya, koma yai ineendet leeluut. Ago nyooru che uu chooto nyalilda eng' poorwek: ak amache ale si moiimge.
Ago amwae ni, anyun, che kitupche, ale, kagonwagitu peetuusyek; si kotebi, kobooch nguno, che tinyei osotik ko uu che ma tinyei;
ak icheeget che riirtos, koigei che marirtos; ak icheeget che poiboen, koigei che ma poiboen; ak icheeget che alisyei, koigei che ma tinyei kiy;
ak icheeget che poisyee ng'wony, koigei che ma poisye miising': amu siirtoi itoondap ng'wonyuni.
Amu amache ale otyagage eng' kaimutik. Ineendet ne ma itunis kochirchirenjin tuguuk che po Kiptaiyat, ole imuuchi kobaibaita Kiptaiyat:
ago ineendet ne ki kotunis kochirchirenjin tuguuk che po ng'wony, ole imuuchi kobaibaita osotyonnyi.

Ak mi teerchinet agine eng' osotyot ak pergeiyat. Ineendet ne ma kitun kochirchirenjin tuguugap Kiptaiyat, si koek ne tiliil eng' poorto ak eng' saboondo; ago ineendet ne ki kitun kochirchirenjin tuguugap ng'wony, ole imuuchi kobaibaita manong'otyondennyi.
Amwae niito anyun agobo keluneng'wong'; ma si atoorchok mesteet, ago agobo nooto ne nyolu, si kobiit ochuuljige Kiptaiyat ko motinye kiy ne iimok.
Ago ngo pwaati chii age tugul kole ma yachin pergeiyandennyi ne nyolu, ak ngo kagosiirto karaaranindap ming'inatennyi, ak ngo mi kiy ne nyoljin, koyai ko uu ye machei; ma yai tengek; ingotungei.
Ago ineendet ne lumdaatkei eng' muguleldanyi, koma tinyei pirchino, ago imuuchi koboi maguutikyik, ak kagotil ko uu niito eng' muguleldanyi, koriip pergeiyandennyi, ko kayai ne myee.
Nooto anyun, ineendet ne igoitoi pergeiyandennyi kitun koyaei ne myee; ak ineendet ne ma igoito kitun koyaei ne myee kosiir.
Ratat osotyot kota kosabei manong'otyondennyi: ago ngo me manong'otyot, kotyagat ineendet kotun chiito ne kacham mosoganooto: eng' Kiptaiyat kityo.
Ago paibai kosiir ngo tep ko uu ye konye, ko uu ye abwaati: ak aleen atinye agane Kabuusetap Kamuktaindet.
Nguno anyun agobo tuguuk che kieng'jin kanamonik: kingen keele ki tinyei acheek tugul naet. Menei naet, ago teeksei chamyet.
Ngo leen chii age tugul ingen kiy age tugul, ko tomo konai ko uu ye kanyool konai;
ago ngo chamei chii age tugul Kamuktaindet, konaat chiichooto eng' ineendet.
Nooto anyun eng' ameet ne po tuguuk che kieng'jin kanamonik, kingen keele ma mi kanamwet ne kiy eng' ng'wony, ama mi Kamuktaindet age kobatee agenge.
Amu agot nganda miitei che keguure kamuktaik, ngo eng' kipsengwet, anan eng' ng'wony; ko uu ye miitei kamuktaik che chaang', ak kiptainik che chaang';

ago eng' acheek komiitei Kamuktaindet agenge, ineendet Kwanda, ne punu tuguuk tugul ak acheek eng' ineendet; ak Kiptaiyat agenge, Jeso Kristo, ne mi tuguuk tugul amu ineendet, ak acheek eng' ineendet.
Ago ma mi naonooto eng' piik tugul: ago ko uu ye ki konerta alak kanamonik agoi nguno, koamei ko uu kiit ne kagieng'ji kanamwet; ak murwoniitu kabwaatennywa ne nyalulat.
Ago amitwogik koma kiit ne imutech keriikyi Kamuktaindet: anan ngo ma ki amisye, ko mararwech kiy; anan, ngeamisye, ko matesak kiy.
Ago oriipkei si ma ek kanagutyet kimnatoning'wong' eng' che nyalulyotin.
Amu ngo keerin chii inyee ne itinye naet, iamisyei eng' Hekaluut ne po kanamwet, ko tos manyiganitu kabwaatennyi, ngot ko nyalulat, kot koam tuguuk che kieng'jin kanamonik?
Ak lusei ineendet ne nyalulat amu naeng'ung', ineendet tupchet ne ki mechi Kristo.
Ak uu nooto anyun, ye koyachini tengek tupchosyek, ak oguoteni kabwaatennywa ne nyalulat, ko koyachi tengek Kristo.
Nooto anyun, ngot konachi amitwogik ne kitupche, koma aame panyeek agoi, si ma nach ne kitupche.
Tos ma atyagat? Ma aa kayooktoindet? Tos ki ma ageer Jeso Kiptaiyandennyo? Tos ma oo poisyennyu okweek eng' Kiptaiyat?
Ak ngot koma aa kayooktoindet eng' alak, ko aa kayooktoindet eng' okweek: amu ng'ooksetap kayooktoinatennyu ko okweek eng' Kiptaiyat.
Niito anyun ne asaruunegei eng' icheeget che kina.
Tos ma ki tinyei kimnateet keam ak kee?
Tos ma ki tinyei kimnateet kimutate osotyot ne iyanaat, ko uu alak che kiyooktoi, ak tupchosyek che po Kiptaiyat, ak Kepha?
Anan aneege kityo ak Barnaba, che ma ki tinyei kimnateet kebagaakte poisyet?
Tos ng'oo asigarindet ne poisyee tuguukyik? Ng'oo ne minei logoek, ne ma amei logoekyik? Anan ng'oo ne iyagi akweet, ama luei cheego che po akweet?
Tos amwae tuguuchu ko uu piteetap piik? Anan ma mwaei agine Ng'atuutyet chooto?
Amu ki kisir eng' Ng'atuutyetap Musa keele, Amerat kutitap eito ye tyechei peek koborye. Tos ibwaati Kamuktaindet miising' agobo eiik,
anan mwaei kityo amu acheek? Ee, ki kisir amu acheek: amu ineendet ne ibatisyei, ko nyolu kobatis eng' kamang'unet, ak ineendet ne porei koboorei komang'u kole sige kiy.
Ngo ki kigooljok tuguugap saboondo, ko tos kiy ne oo ngeges tuguukwok che po poorto?

Ngot kotinyei piik alak yamdaet eng' kamugoniito koboiywok, ko tos ma kisiirtoot? Ago ma kiboisyee acheek kamugoniito; ago kimuitoi eng' tuguuk tugul, si ma ki kirinde logoiywek che myach che po Kristo.
Tos mongen ole icheeget che poisyei agobo tuguuk che tiliileen koamei tuguuk che po Hekaluut, ak icheeget che riibei kaptisisyet kotinyei kebebertanywa kobooto kaptisisyet?
Ki ng'at ko uu nooto Kiptaiyat kole icheeget che amdaati logoiywek che myach kosaptos eng' logoiywek che myach.
Ago tomo aboisyee tuguuchooto agot agenge: ama sire tuguuchu ale keyaiywo ko uu nooto: amu kata kaigai ame kosiir kowal chii toroornatennyu koek puch.
Amu ngaamde logoiywek che myach, koma tinye kiy ne alasunegei; amu kanyool ayai ko uu nooto; Pwo eng' anee ngot koma amde logoiywek che myach.
Amu ye ayai ni eng' magennyu aneege, atinye melekto: ago ngo ma po magennyu aneege, atinye riipseet ne ki kiyanwa.
Nee anyun melektanyu? Nooto ko ni, ye aamdoi logoiywek che myach, ayae logoiywechooto myach koek ne ma pooto melekto, si ma poisyee kamugennyu miising' eng' logoiywek che myach.
Agot ngo ki atyagat eng' piik tugul, ko ki ayaige aek ne rataat agobo tugul, si kobiit anyoor che siirtoot.

Ak eng' Yahudik, ko ki aige Yahudyot, si kobiit anyoor Yahudik; eng' icheeget che mi eng' Ng'atuutyet, ko ki aige agane ne mi eng' Ng'atuutyet, ama keele ami aneendet eng' Ng'atuutyet, ago si kobiit anyoor icheeget che mi eng' Ng'atuutyet;

eng' icheeget che ma mi eng' Ng'atuutik, ko ki aige agane chii ne ma mi Ng'atuutik, ma keele ma mi eng' Ng'atuutik eng' Kamuktaindet, ago ami eng' Ng'atuutik eng' Kristo, si anyoor icheek che ma mi eng' Ng'atuutik.
Eng' che nyalulyotin ki aegu anee ne nyalulat, si tamangap anyooru che nyalulyotin: ki aegu tuguuk tugul eng' piik tugul, tamangap amuuch asar alak eng' ooreet age tugul.
Ak ayae tuguuk tugul amu logoiywek che myach, si kobiit anyoor yamdaet eng' chooto.
Mongen ole icheeget che ibelegei eng' labatet korwaei tugul, ago agenge ne nyooru konunet? Orwai anyun, si onyooru.
Ak chii age tugul ne igiilegei eng' ureryosyek, koriibegei eng' tuguuk tugul. Yaei anyun icheek nooto si konyoor kuutweet ne ng'emaksei; ago acheek ko ne ma ng'emaksei.
Alabati anyun ko uu nooto, ma ko uu ne tinyei saget, ayae anyun kabeletapkei ko uu nooto, ma ko uu chii ne pirei ola puch:
ago abire poortanyu, ak abou ineendet: si ma ye kaamji piik alak, kotun keesia.
Ma mache anyun, che kitupche, ale oegu che mongen, ole ki miitei kwanisyekyok tugul ng'wonyutap pooldet, ak ki pun tugul nyanjet:
ak ki kibatisanji tugul Musa eng' pooldet ak eng' nyanjet;
ak ki am tugul amdit agenge ne po saboon;
ak kiee tugul eet agenge ne po saboon: amu kiee tugul eng' rwandet ne po saboon ne ki isubi icheek: ak rwandanooto ko ki Kristo.
Ago ki ma paibaitune miising' Kamuktaindet che chaang' eng' icheek: amu ki kiserta eng' surkwen.
Ki ek tuguuchu anyun kaboorunoikyok, si ma kimakyigei tuguuk che yaacheen, ko uu ye kimakyigei icheek miising'.
Amoegu che saaei kanamonik, ko uu alak eng' icheek; ko uu ye ki kisir keele, Ki tep ng'wony piik koamis ak koe, ak kong'eetyo kourerenso.
Amongesokse, ko uu ye ki yai alak eng' icheek, ak ki ibutyo eng' peetuut agenge eliphuusyek tiptemu ak somok.
Anan ketyem Kiptaiyat, ko uu ye kityem alak eng' icheek, ak ki par erenook.
Amat ong'unyng'ung'se, ko uu ye ki ing'unyng'ung'so alak eng' icheek, ak ki pek eng' ng'emindet.
Ki yaak anyun tuguuchuuto eng' icheek si koek kaboorunet; ak ki kisir agobo kateunennyo, acheek che kagonyonjech kagesunetap kenyiisyek.
Nooto anyun ingoriipkei si ma ibut, ineendet ne ibwaati kole tononi.

Ki ma namak yoomseet kobatee nooto ne imuuchi komuitae chii tugul; ago po iman Kamuktaindet ne ma chamdook keyomak kosiir ne tee ne omuuchi; ago kobooto yoomsonooto koyaei agine ooreet ne ochilile, si kobiit omuuch omuite.
Nooto anyun, chamanikyuk, omwee piteetap kanamonik.
Ang'alaali ko uu ye ang'alaaljini piik che ng'oomen; obesye kiit ne amwae.
Kigombetap kaberuret ne kiberuuri, ko tos ma yamdaet ne po korotiigap Kristo? Magatyat ne kibuutuli, ko tos ma yamdaet ne po poortap Kristo?
Amu acheek che ki piik che chaang', ko ki magatyat agenge, poorto agenge: amu ki ame acheek tugul magatyat agenge.
Ogeer Israel o eng' atebeetap poorto: tos ma tinyei yamdaet ak kaptisisyet icheek che amei tiseiywek?
Amwae nee anyun? Amwa ale kiy kiit ne kieng'jin kanamonik, anan tos kiy kanamwet?
Ago tuguuk che igoitoi Pororyosyek koeng'jin oik, ago ma Kamuktaindet: ama mache koyai yamdaet ak oik.
Momuuchi oee kigombetap Kiptaiyat, ak kigombetap oik: momuuchi oam eng' meesetap Kiptaiyat, ak meesetap oik.
Anan kitache Kiptaiyat konyoor ng'etkong'? Tos ki kiimeen kosiir ineendet?
Chamdaat tuguuk tugul; ago ma tuguuk tugul che nyolu. Chamdaat tuguuk tugul; ago ma tuguuk tugul che teeksei.
Amat kocheeng'jigei chii chechiik ineegei, ago che po chiitap kokwennyi.
Kiy age tugul ne ki aldoi eng' kabany, oam, amoteep kiy amu kabwaatet;
amu po Kiptaiyat ng'wony, ak che nyiitaat ng'wony.
Ngo kuurok age eng' icheek che ma iyani kole kobaak, ak omache obe; ko kiy age tugul anyun ne kaginde taing'wong', oam, amat oteep amu kabwaatet:
ago ngo leenjok chii age tugul, Kagigoitoi kii koek tiseiywot, ko moam, amu ineendet ne kagoboorun, ak amu kabwaatet:
kabwaatet ne amwae koma neng'ung', ago po age; amu kalya si korwookyi katyagennyu kabwaatet age?
Ngot ataache eng' kongoi, ko amu nee si kemwaitaena yaityo eng' kiit ne koagoite kongoi?
Nooto anyun ngo ame, anan ngo ee, anan agot eng' kiy age tugul ne oyae, oyai tugul otoroori Kamuktaindet.
Amonach Yahudik anan Yunanik, anan kanisetap Kamuktaindet:
agot ko uu ye aboiboi piik tugul eng' tuguuk tugul, ma cheeng'e kelunennyu aneege, ago kelunet ne po che chaang', si kobiit kesar.
Oegu kasupiikyuk, ko uu ye aa kasubindetap Kristo.
Aloswok anyun nguno amu obwaata eng' tuguuk tugul, ak oriibe kaneetisyosyek ko uu ye ki arorwok.
Ago amache onai, ole metitap muren age tugul ko Kristo; ak metitap kobogoryot ko muren; ak metitap Kristo ko Kamuktaindet.
Muren age tugul ne saaei anan koamdoi logoiywek ko kerat metit, ko kagoteweer metinnyi.
Ago kobogoryot age tugul ne saaei anan koamdoi logoiywek ko yaataat metit, ko kagoteweer metinnyi: amu kagergeit ak chii ne inemunoot met.
Amu ngo ma tugoot metitap kobogoryot, ko ingetilji agine suumeek: ago ngo kalilano eng' kobogoryot ketilji suumeek anan kinem, ko ingotuch metinnyi.
Ma nyooljin iman muren koger metit, amu ineendet ko kergeindo ak toroornatetap Kamuktaindet: ago kobogoryot ko toroornatetap muren.
Amu ki ma pun mureno kobogoryo; ago ki punu kobogoryot muren:
ak kogeny, ki ma kitoi keyai muren agobo kobogoryo; ago ki kiyai kobogoryo agobo muren:
amu niito anyun konyaaljin kobogoryo kotinyei kaboorunet ne po pounateet eng' metinnyi, amu malaikaisyek.
Ago ma mi kobogoryondo ngo ma mi mureno, ak ma mi mureno ngo ma mi kobogoryot, eng' Kiptaiyat.
Amu ko uu ye ki punu kobogoryot muren, ko uu nooto agine mureno kisichei kobogoryot; ago punu tuguuk tugul Kamuktaindet.
Orwooch okweegei: tos nyolu eng' kobogoryot kosa Kamuktaindet koma tugoot metit?
Tos ma ineetook agine piteetap poorto, kole, ngo tinyei mureno suumeek che kooen, ko kalilanet eng' ineendet?
Ago ngo tinyei kobogoryot suumeek che kooen, ko toroornatet eng' ineendet; amu ki kigoochi suumeekyik kotugegei.
Ago ngo machei chii tiyet, koma ki tinyei piteet ne uu nooto, anan eng' kanisosyegap Kamuktaindet.
Ago, ye ang'atook eng' ng'olyoondoni, ko maloswok amu oyumige koma agobo che myach ago agobo che yaach.
Amu ne po tai eng' tugul, ye oyumige eng' kaniset, agase keele miitei pesyosyek eng' kwenung'wong'; ak ayani kitigin ale uu nooto.
Amu mi ne matiny pesyosyek eng' kwenung'wong', si kobiit kotook icheek che po iman eng' kwenung'wong'.
Ye oyumige anyun koma imugaksei keam igoortap Kiptaiyat:
